summary: Thousand Land is a battle simulator where the players create a sandbox land with various environmental pieces to choose from and protect the land from the opponents. The lands can be beautiful, powerful, artistic or cute depending on the player's preferences. Online battles against other players are available as well.

name: The Idolmaster: Shiny TV

name: The Tuttles: Madcap Misadventures
summary: The Tuttles Madcap Misadventures is a hilarious arcade adventure game about a thoroughly modern family trying to bond on a road trip to the Alamo. Beautifully detailed art and wonderfully silly situations bring this familiar story to the Interactive age.

name: The Impossible Quiz
summary: See how many questions you can answer before it's Game Over. Sounds simple? Think again... the questions are BASTARD hard and require obscure insane logic, super fast reactions or just pure luck to answer correctly. It's not actually impossible though, just really really hard. GOOD LUCK! Mwahahah! :p

name: The Stadium Project
summary: The Stadium Project is a simplistic stadium building game.

name: Thor: The Dark World - The Official Game
summary: A mobile game based on the Marvel film Thor: The Dark World.

name: The Perils of Willy
summary: Commodore Vic-20 exclusive "Miner Willy" game from Software Projects

name: The Untouchable
summary: Combat-style fighting game developed by Creative Edge and published by Tiburon Interactive Publishing.

name: The Rapture is Here and You will be Forcibly Removed from Your Home
summary: The Rapture Is Here And You Will Be Forcibly Removed From Your Home is a game created by Connor Sherlock. Each game gives around 20 minutes to look around and experience the rapture of earth. Inspired by H. P. Lovecraft.

name: The Dark Hour
summary: A retail mod of Quake that has the player saving POWs through a variety of levels.

name: The Walk
summary: Created with the NHS and the UK's Department of Health, The Walk helps you walk more, every single day. When you’re playing The Walk, every step counts.

name: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer 2
summary: Based on Louis Cha's novel, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, this PC game is a continuation of the novel's storyline.

summary: The Tower DS is a Nintendo DS entry in the SimTower/The Tower franchise.

name: The Squared Circle
summary: Four games including Wrestling Encore, Booking Encore, Grass Roots, and World War Alpha.

name: The Battles of King Arthur
summary: The Battles of King Arthur is a strategy game by Excalibur Publishing.

name: The Collectables
summary: The Collectables is a free to play shooter game by Crytek.

name: The Scheme
summary: The Scheme is an action RPG released by Bothtec (later known as Quest) for the PC-88 in 1988. It features Metroidvania-style open-world exploration, side-scrolling run & gun shooter combat, and chiptune music by Yuzo Koshiro.

name: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire - Panem Run
summary: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire - Panem Run is an endless runner based on The Hunger Games: Catching Fire.

summary: The Earth Fighter Rayieza is a role-playing game.

summary: The Screamer is a 1985 cyberpunk-horror action RPG taking place in a post-apocalyptic, sci-fi setting. It was released by Magical Zoo, for the PC-8801 in 1985 and for the PC-9801 and X1 in 1986. An English fan translation was released in January 2015.

name: The Chronicles of Shakespeare: A Midsummer Night's Dream
The Chronicles of Shakespeare: Romeo & Juliet
summary: A hidden object game set to Shakespeare's tale of Romeo & Juliet.

name: The Order: 1886 - Blackwater Edition
summary: The BlackWater Edition of The Order 1886 is only available on PS4 and contains a necklace, tags, stickers, postcards and some DLCs.

name: The Pyramids of Egypt
summary: A game developed by John Romero where players control Mike the Explorer as he navigates Egyptian pyramids.

name: The Jelly Bean Factory
summary:
A DOS game where players must clear the board by aligning jelly beans. 
 
Coloured blocks, or jelly beans fall from the top of the screen. Each bean has three coloured balls in it and the player must position them so that when they hit the bottom of the screen they make rows of three or more of the same colour. The colour sequence of each bean can be altered as it falls, there are reject beans that are hard to remove and there are clearing beans that remove all beans that match the first colour they make contact with. 
 
The game is controlled either by the keyboard or by a keyboard/joystick combination. It has optional sound, a high score table, four levels of difficulty, nine levels, and other customizable options.

name: The Fall of Nemesis: Clash of the Kaijujin
summary: The Fall of Nemesis: Clash of the Kaijujin is the second release in the Colossal Kaiju Combat! series.

name: The Secrets of Hosea Freeman
summary: The Secrets of Hosea Freeman is a mystery game for the Memorex MD 2500 VIS.

name: The Cellar Door
summary: A scary point-and-click Flash game.

name: The Hockey Experiment
summary: This Arcade Style Ice-Hockey game features old school inspired 8-bit music and classic gameplay, but is updated with fast-paced action and 3D graphics that are enhanced through the use of on-ice Power-Up Icons. These enable crazy-fast slap-shots, lightning-quick skating, and extra powerful checking.

name: The Cosmic Tunnels
summary: A action game written by Tim Ferris and published by Datamost for the Commodore 64 and the Atari 8-bit family.

name: The Legend of the Dragonflame High School: Youth Battle Story
summary: The Legend of the Dragonflame High School: Youth Battle Story is an 8-bit inspired brawler.

name: The Old Village Story
summary: An adventure game developed by Enix that follows the stories of Shion and Lisa Lisa in a small village town.

name: The Useful Dead
summary: The Useful Dead is a puzzle game where you have to die to progress. You control a horde of critically-stupid critters who can use each other’s dead bodies as stepping stones, to hold down buttons, prop open doors, etc. It features about 50 levels and is meant to be a simple, fun time.

name: The Legend of Styk
summary: The Legend of Styk is a Top-Down/Side Scroller Adventure/Action game.

name: The World's Biggest Pac-Man
summary: Players from around the world create their own mazes, which connect with other players' mazes to form one continuous monster of a game.

name: The Unbreakable Chain

name: The Moonlighters
summary: The Moonlighters is an adventure game centered around bank heists in the 1950's.

name: The Gods: Uprising
summary: A hack and slash game developed by Chillingo.

name: The 7th Guest: Infection
summary:
Mobile game based on the microscopic puzzle from The 7th Guest.

Infection can be played against Henry Stauf, the main antagonist from The 7th Guest, with 7 difficulty levels. As in the original game, Stauf often taunts the players between moves. There is also a Mono Y Mono option where two human players can play together on the same device, and a Demo mode where the AI controls both players.

name: The Grave
summary: New game from Adam Saltsman.

name: The Adventures of Gumby & Friends: Super Sneaky Disguise Kit
summary: Dress up Gumby in different costumes, like those dress-up games all over the internet these days, but with less boobs.

name: The Secret of Margrave Manor
summary: The Secret of Margrave Manor is a hidden objects game for the PC.

name: The Curse of Blackwater
summary: Survival horror Indie game.

name: The Lost Inca Prophecy
summary: The Lost Inca Prophecy is a PC puzzle game from Seppia Interactive.

name: The Denpa Men 3: The Rise of Digitoll
summary: The Denpa Men are mysterious creatures that live among radio waves. Invisible to the naked eye, they can only be seen and caught by looking through your Nintendo 3DS. In this game, catch Denpa Men, form your team, and head out on an exciting adventure across the world. All to save a special someone! This time, some Denpa Men can capture monsters, turning them into allies who can be summoned to your side. Capture powerful monsters to turn the tide of battle. Also, your Denpa Men friends now have their own little homes, which can be customized and decorated to suit your style. Network play is now better than ever. Trade items with players worldwide, and lend or borrow Denpa Men. You can import your hero and bring all your friends from the previous two THE “DENPA” MEN titles, too.

name: The Unlikely Legend of Rusty Pup
summary: The Unlikely Legend of Rusty Pup is a 2D platformer with a strong focus on character and a sad story seasoned with dark humor. It is developed by the creator of Conker's Bad Fur Day and ex-RARE staffer Chris Seavor.

name: The First Funky Fighter
summary: The beautiful Chris has been kidnapped by flying crocodiles! Now Chris's boyfriend Randy must fight his way through hoards of reptilian monsters to save her!

name: The Amazing Frog?
summary: A game in which the player is tasked with launching the titular frog character into the air by jumping into explosions or giant fans.

name: The Sushi Spinnery

name: The Cheetahmen: The Creation

name: The Tournament of Zulula
summary: The first Zulula fighting game.

name: Thomas the Tank Engine 2
summary: Thomas returns in his first sequel

name: Thomas the Tank Engine's Fun with Words
summary: Educational game with Thomas the Tank Engine.

name: The Dragon & Princess
summary: The Dragon & Princess is the first known RPG developed in Japan. It tasks the player with finding a king's stolen treasure. It is a hybrid between the RPG, adventure and strategy genres, and laid the foundations for tactical RPGs.

name: The Denpa Men 2: Beyond the Waves
summary: The Denpa Men are mysterious little creatures that float around radio waves. They all have their own territory. You can't see them with the naked eye, but you can use your 3DS to find them and catch them. In this RPG, you can form a team of the Denpa Men you caught and take them on an exciting adventure across the world, in order to save the hero's family. Many wonders and strong enemies await you on your journey!

name: The Amory Wars: Fall of the Keywork

name: Thomas the Tank Engine
summary: Inagural game based on the popular English children's telly program.

name: The King of Fighters: NESTS Collection
summary: A compilation of three games in The King of Fighters series that make up the NESTS Saga: The King of Fighters '99, The King of Fighters 2000 and The King of Fighters 2001.

name: The Delusions of Von Sottendorff and His Squared Mind
summary: A puzzle/adventure game for the 3DS eShop in which players rotate rooms around to let Von Sottendorff progress.

name: The Journey of Ieser
summary: The Journey of Ieser is a point and click game.

name: The Thought Saved for Last
summary: A point and click indie game developed by Igor Hardy.

name: The Oregon Trail: American Settler
summary: Mobile game in which you create and manage your own Oregon settlement.

name: The Thirty Nine Steps
summary: An interactive story based on John Buchan's classic novel The Thirty-Nine Steps, made for PC, Mac, Linux, and tablets.

name: The Seed
summary: The Seed is a physics-based puzzle game from Little Bit Games.

name: The Castle of the Internet Invasion
summary: The Castle Of The Internet invasion is a top down adventure game. It is developed by Jayit Inc.

name: The Broadside Express
summary: One-third of the Humble Bundle Mojam, The Broadside Express is a Unity-powered Steampunk Action-Strategy game.

name: The Armament Project
summary: The Armament Project is a Science Fiction First Person Shooter.

name: Thermo Nuclear War Games
summary: Thermo Nuclear War Games is a graphical text adventure for the Commodore 64 and SC-3000.

name: The Reaper
summary: Short hack 'n' slash featuring a female grim reaper versus zombies.

name: The Death Trap
summary:
An adventure game released in 1984. It was Squaresoft's first game.

The game's plot is set during the 1980s. In the game, the Cold War has become tense, and many countries have begun to prepare for a global-scale war, working on new weapons. One of such countries is the mysterious "B country" in Eastern Africa, which in an attempt to create biological weapons kidnaps the famous scientist Dr. Gitanes. An agent named Benson is sent to B country in order to rescue the doctor and avert the new threat to world peace.

name: The White Birch
summary: The White Birch is a PC prototype developed by Double Fine during their 2012 Amnesia Fortnight.

name: The Button Affair
summary: An auto-runner revolving around a thief as he attempts a heist to nab the priceless Button Jewel

name: The Love Letter
summary: A high school based browser game created by Axcho and Knivel. You have five minutes to read a secret letter without letting anyone else around you see it.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Horns of the Reach
summary:
A DLC pack for Elder Scrolls Online that is free for those with an active ESO Plus subscription or available for purchase costing 1500 Crowns, about $16(US) worth of the games premium currency.

It contains 2 new dungeons as well as new gear, unique item sets, boss collectibles, titles, and achievements.

"The Horns of the Reach DLC game pack arrives with Bloodroot Forge and Falkreath Hold, two brand new, challenging dungeons for four-player groups that pit you and your party against the menacing hordes of the Dreadhorn Clan."

name: The Queen of Duellist Gaiden α
summary: Upgraded release of The Queen of Duellist Gaiden.

name: The Queen of Duellist Gaiden
summary: NEC PC-9801 exclusive sequel to The Queen of Duellist.

name: The Queen of Duellist
summary: First game in The Queen of Duellist series.

name: The Queen of Duellist Gaiden α+
summary: The final game in the Queen of Duellist series.

summary: The Runner is an indie Xbox game

name: The Rescue of Pops Ghostly
summary: The Rescue of Pops Ghostly for the Action Max

name: The Path of Kara
summary: The Path of Kara is a matcha-3 puzzle game exclusive to the Windows Phone. Join Kara, a young shaman, on a quest to save her island from imminent danger.

name: The 4th Wall
summary: The 4th Wall is an surreal horror puzzle game by GZ Storm. It was designed specifically to prey on the phobias of Youtube LPer AzuriteReaction.

name: The Wavy Tube Man Chronicles
summary: The Wavy Tube Man Chronicles is a modern FMV homage to Mad Dog McCree featuring Lloyd Kaufman and Wiley Wiggins.

summary: This meta-puzzle game continues the story of The Fool's Errand. It was released on October 25, 2012 for Mac and PC.

name: The Legend of Myra
summary: In The Legend of Myra, humanity tries to exterminate all rabbits. And obviously the best way to do this is by storing all cabbages underground so that they can't reach them. The player takes control over the rabbit Myra who has to try just that.

name: The X-Files: Unrestricted Access
summary: As an extension of one of the most long-running television series of all time, The X-Files, play through the eyes of Special Agent Craig Willmore, a new FBI field investigator brought in to locate missing agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully whose last location was the Everett, Washington, area. In this "movie quality" video production, characters are played by the actors and actresses from the show, including Gillian Anderson (Scully) and David Duchovny (Mulder).

name: The Lost Medallion
summary: Mobile suite of games based on the kids movie/book The Lost Medallion.

name: The Tempura Samurai
summary: Tempura cooking awesomeness!

name: The Best Play Baseball Special
summary: A Japanese baseball sim developed by ASCII for the NES. It focuses more on team management than playing the sport itself.

name: The Game Maker
summary: A strategy/simulation game for the Playstation that tasks you with managing your own video game company. It was developed by Kuusou Kagaku in 1998 and was only released in Japan.

name: The Falklands War 1982
summary: Historical Wargame simulating the 3 month War between England and Argentina over the Falkland Islands.

name: The Last Phoenix
summary: The Last Phoenix is an aerial-combat game that sets players as the titular 'Last Phoenix.'

name: The War of Eustrath
summary: A turn-based strategy RPG developed by iQubi and available for iPhone and iPad. You control Lucas, Tiana, and a squad of other GEAR (which are essentially mechs) pilots in their fight against the Kradionese forces for control of the world of Eustrath.

name: The Last Rocket
summary: You play as Flip, "The Last Rocket" who must flip and fly his way out of this dangerous and puzzling spaceship. Along the way you can collect Memory Gears and help the ship's onboard computer discover more about your situation.

name: The Tower: A Bomb's Climb
summary: The Tower: A Bomb's Climb is a multiplayer 2D platform game played using only one button. Players hold down the jump button to charge up a jump and then release to leap into the air. Ascend the tower quicker than your friends to drop them into the fire below and win the game.

name: The Border Lands
summary: The Border Lands is a 2D top-down browser version of the popular console game Borderlands 2. The game has cool 2D 16-bit graphics and authentic map locations to explore. Before starting, you can choose from 4 of the original characters from Borderlands 2 – Salvador, Maya, Zero or Axton - each character has unique abilities and differing skills.

name: The Sultan's Labyrinth
summary: A hidden object game. Long ago in ancient Persia, Sultan Bahar`s rule inspired the minds of his followers. Although, it was his fair and beautiful daughter, Princess Sadira, who captured their hearts. Can you help Sultan Bahar find a suitable prince for his royal daughter? Each prince must demonstrate his wisdom by solving puzzles within the Sultan`s Labyrinth. In a grueling Hidden Object-themed competition, who will defeat the Sultan`s Labyrinth?

name: Thunder Offshore
summary: Thunder Offshore is a DOS based action game from Spain.

name: The Dark Knight Rises
summary: Game based on the movie of the same name for iOS and Android.

name: The Space Sheriff Spirits
summary: The Space Sheriff Spirits, is an action game for the PlayStation 2. This game is based on the popular Japanese live-action TV series Space Sheriff trilogy produced by Toei Company.

name: The Warbler's Nest
summary: A piece of Interactive Fiction written by Jason McIntosh, about the European myth of changeling.

name: The eXceed Collection
summary: A collection of the entire eXceed shooter series: Gun Bullet Children, Vampire REX, and Jade Penetrate Black Package.

name: The Land
summary: The Land is a shareware roguelike released in 1985 and set in the world of Stephen R. Donaldson's "The Chronicles of Thomas Covenant" books.

name: The Wild
summary: Platformer based on the animated Disney movie.

name: The Act
summary: An interactive comedy which follows the hijinks of Edgar the window washer as he tries to woo the woman of his dreams and save his brother from a fate worse than death.

name: The Great Gonzo in WordRider
summary: A Commodore 64 Visual Novel/Adventure Game. Players choose words and the stories become playable.

name: The Worlds of Billy
summary:
Catch enemies in holes and drop them to the floor below.

In the levels are several goodies to find, e.g. tennis balls which can be thrown at the enemies or bombs which decreases time needed to dig a hole. There are five worlds with different themes like a building site, caves or Egyptian ruins. The player has to beat a whole world before he can save the game.

name: The Naked Gun: I.C.U.P.
summary: Deadpan, juvenile humor and silly one-liners rule in this episodic heir to the Naked Gun throne. Crack cases, find collectibles and annoy coworkers as Frank Drebin Jr. in this point and click adventure.

name: The Book of Biblets: Part 1 - In the Beginning
summary: A trivia game covering the earliest parts of the Bible. It is available on Xbox Live Indie Games.

name: The Bunny Game
summary: A board game aimed towards children. Players must try to go around the board to get to the carrot patch.

name: The Three Stooges: Treasure Hunt Hijinks
summary: The Three Stooges: Treasure Hunt Hijinks is a hidden objects game based on The Three Stooges.

name: The Idolmaster: Gravure for You! Vol. 6
summary:
Gravure For You! is a sub-series of The Idolmaster series. Instead of producing the idols, the focus of the game is photoshoots. The player takes pictures of the idols posing in various outfits on different backgrounds. Each volume was released bundled with Blu-Ray releases of episodes of The Idolmaster anime series. Each game features songs from previous games, plus a new remix. Each available idol has their own song, with the featured idol getting the new remix.

In Vol. 6, the idol focus is on Makoto Kikuchi, and the new remix is "MAKOTO BlackMIX." The locations are Studio Set and Classroom, the outfits are Devil Swimsuit and My Dear Vampire, and the accessories are Heart of Vampire and the optional Vampire Mouthpiece.

name: The Moogies
summary: The Moogies is a game sold on apple's appstore. It is made with kids from 2-6 years old in mind.

name: The Big 6
summary: A compilation of Dizzy games for the Amiga CD32 consisting of: Prince of the Yolk Folk; Crystal Kingdom Dizzy; Magicland Dizzy; Spellbound Dizzy; Treasure Island Dizzy; Fantastic Dizzy

name: The Ultimate Battle of the Sexes: Quiz & Play!
summary: Players compete in a variety of mini games based around stereotypical gender roles.

name: The Fancy Pants Adventure: World 3
summary: The Fancy Pants Adventure: World 3 is a flash port of the main story from "The Fancy Pants Adventures" 2011 console release .

name: The Great Word Adventure
summary: The Great Word Adventure is a educational game created by 7th Level. The game helps young children develop their word skills through minigames involving synonyms, antonyms, and more.

name: The Impossible Dungeon
summary: The Impossible Dungeon is an Xbox Live Indie game.

name: The Fourth Wall
summary: Similar to older platformers, players in The Fourth Wall are able to wrap from one side of the screen to the other. The core mechanic that the game is built around allows players to turn this screen wrap ability on and off, allowing the camera to follow the player until they come across a puzzle that requires a lock of the screen.

name: The Solar System
summary: The Solar System is an educational astronomy program developed on the Unreal engine. The game centers around the local planetary system, complete with extensive information on the planets, as well as 88 constellations.

name: The Vision of Escaflowne
summary: A game based on the popular anime series from Sunrise. It features an alternate storyline and additional characters not featured in the TV series.

name: The Answer
summary: A visual novel from Four Leaf Studios.

name: The Mystery of the Wicked Village
summary: An traditional adventure game played in 3rd person and sporting gorgeous hand-painted visuals

name: The Dating Game
summary: This game resides on Facebook and is an exciting modern twist on the 60's hit TV game show where panelists compete for the heart of the contestant.

name: Thor: Son of Asgard
summary: Thor: Son of Asgard features Marvel's superhero in a mobile game released shortly after the movie "Thor" in 2011. In this game you can play as mighty Thor and defend Odin's Kingdom of Asgard from her enemies.

name: The Driver
summary: A cinematic action-racing arcade game released by Kasco in the 1970's. It consisted of pre-filmed situations recorded on 16 mm film that required the player to match their steering wheel, gas pedal and brakes with the movements shown on screen.

name: The Settlers Online: Castle Empire
summary: Online browser based sequel to the Settler's series.

name: The Wing of Madoola
summary: This side-scrolling action RPG game for the Nintendo Famicom was only released in Japan. Developed by Sunsoft in 1986, it stars the female protagonist Lucia.

name: The Manipulator
summary: As a mysterious operative with the ability to "Manipulate" people and objects and take control of them, you must infiltrate a terrorist stronghold.

name: The Life of a Pacifist is Often Fraught With Conflict
summary: A short visual novel created by Bento Smile, centered around a game development studio. Like many of Bento Smile's games, this utilizes the Ren'Py engine.

name: The Man in the Cape: Special Edition
summary: In retaliation for using his roof as a city lookout point, The Man in the Cape is captured and left for dead in Mr. Granderson's superhero elimination dungeon. To escape, the determined Capeman must blast his way past Granderson's horde of malcontents.

name: The Lost Angelic Chronicles of Frane: Dragon's Odyssey
summary: The 3rd Frane action RPG game from Exe-Create, also known as "Lost Memory of Angel Frane"

name: The Clumsys 2: Butterfly Effect
summary: The Clumsys 2: Butterfly Effect is a hidden object/puzzle game for the PC.

name: The Angry Hand of God
summary: The Angry Hand Of God is an Xbox Live Indie game, in which you, as God cause mass destruction to civilizations with lightning bolts.

name: The Lost Town: The Dust
summary: Get dusted with this DSiWare release from CIRCLE Entertainment.

name: The Sword of Camelot
summary: In The Sword of Camelot you will find a variety of mini-games targeted for young children. Though, the game also has the peculiarity of having more of a cinematic feel, rather than playable portions.

name: Thrill Drive 3
summary: An arcade racing game, where you race through traffic. You get a score based on how much damage your accidents cause.

name: Thrill Drive 2

name: Their Finest Missions: Volume One
summary:
The Their Finest Hour: Battle of Britain Mission Disk is an expansion pack that enhances the original World War II flight simulation game. This add-on content injects new life into the base game by providing 23 additional missions, offering players fresh challenges and scenarios to test their aerial combat skills in the context of the historic Battle of Britain.

A key feature of this expansion is the inclusion of one experienced pilot for each aircraft type available in the game. These veteran pilots likely come with enhanced abilities or characteristics, allowing players to experience missions from the perspective of seasoned airmen. This addition not only increases the gameplay variety but also adds a layer of historical authenticity to the simulation, as it reflects the importance of experienced pilots during the actual conflict. By expanding the mission roster and introducing these skilled pilots, the Mission Disk aims to deepen the strategic depth and replayability of Their Finest Hour: The Battle of Britain, providing enthusiasts with more content to explore in this acclaimed World War II flight sim.

summary: Ford Simulator is an advergame developed by The SoftAd Group and Beck-Tech, published by Ford Motor Company in 1987. It was designed to promote the 1988-line of Ford cars.

name: The Aeronautics Quiz MK 2
summary: A text based quiz game with questions about Aeronautics.

name: The History Channel: Crusades - Quest for Power
summary: A real-time strategy which allows the players play either as the Christians or the Muslims.

name: The Worst-Case Scenario Survival Trivia Challenge
summary: A survival-themed trivia game for PC.

name: The Koshan Conspiracy
summary:
A graphic adventure game based on the planet Shedishan.

Known as B.A.T 2 in Europe.

name: The Games People Play: Gin, Cribbage, Checkers, and Backgammon
This Means War!
summary: This Means War! is a post-apocalyptic real-time strategy game where players command UN forces in a world devastated by a virus that destroyed most computer technology. As the UN's primary strategist, you manage resources and armies while battling over remaining technological assets across the wasteland. The campaign features diverse adversaries including a religious extremist, an Australian survivalist, and an aristocratic opponent, each presenting unique strategic challenges as you fight to control the scarce technology and territory in this dystopian setting.

name: The Amazing Flying Brothers
summary: You play as the infamous flying brothers as they try to perform the flying trapeze act.

name: The Bugs Bunny Hare-Brained Adventure
summary: As Bugs Bunny, players explore a labyrinthine tower while avoiding enemies.

name: The Cave of Time
summary:
This is a multiple-choice adventure game based on the first book in the popular "Choose Your Own Adventure" series.
In the game, you are a kid who enters the Cave of Time to recover four items stolen by the Time Grouches and must return them to their proper places and times. The items are: a golden crown, Abraham Lincoln's hat, the Loch Ness Monster's egg, and a piece of flint.

name: The Global Dilemma: Guns or Butter
summary:
Following Balance of Power, designer Chris Crawford stuck to the big-picture approach but shifted the focus from power politics to macroeconomics. In a grassroots simulation of industrial production and allocation, players balance a country’s military and social spending to survive in an environment of fictitious nations competing for land and resources.

Key element in the turn-based The Global Dilemma is a basic tree of industries such as coal mines, lumber mills or gunpowder factories. The entire production chain culminates in only two results: an increase in either military strength or population. Guns or butter.

name: The Shadows of Mordor
summary: The Shadows of Mordor is a text adventure game.

name: The Crack of Doom
summary:
The Crack of Doom is the last game in Melbourne House's series of adventure games based on Tolkien's Lord of the Rings.

The gameplay combines a text-based adventure with illustrations from the main character's perspective. Players interact with the game using text-based descriptions and a parser system to execute actions.

name: The Vault of Darkness
summary: The Vault of Darkness is a collection of five games in one box, that includes American McGee's Alice, Clive Barker's Undying, Dungeon Keeper 2, Dracula: The Resurrection and Dracula: The Last Sanctuary.

name: The Lost Crown of Queen Anne
The Operational Art of War II: Flashpoint Kosovo
The Sacred Mirror of Kofun
summary: A point and click adventure from Enteractive.

name: The Full Wormage
summary: The Full Wormage is a compilation of early games in the Worms series.

name: Thinkin' Things Collection 2
summary: The second game in the award winning Thinkin' Things edutainment series. Made for kids from ages 6-12, it aims to improve spacial awareness, creativity, analysis, observation, and memory.

name: They Call Me... The Skul
summary: In the North Putnam Maximum Security Correction Facility, strange things have been going on. Rumors of secret experiments taking place with some of the inmates, a strange Power Elite gang, and other criminals walking around with super powers. It it to this strange location that Steve Kane was taken when he was wrongly convicted of highway homicide. His life was saved on day by a man named Big John, which unleashed strange powers within him and turned him into the Skul.

name: The Aethra Chronicles, Volume One: Celystra's Bane
summary: A fantasy roleplaying game developed by Michael Lawrence and released as shareware.

name: The Perfect General: Greatest Battles of the 20th Century
The Scrolls of Abadon
summary: You have to collect pieces of an amulet. Whenever you pick up a piece it's replaced with an arrow which can only be trespassed in that direction, thus creating a maze.

name: This is Football
summary: This Is Football played a good game of footy on the Playstation. It took on EA's mammoth with some style and flair.

name: The Shield: The Game
summary: Based on the television show of the same name, this third-person shooter ties the third and fourth season of the show together, putting the player in the shoes of dirty cop Vic Mackey.

name: The History Channel: Civil War - Great Battles
summary: Players take command of the Union or Confederate army and wage war state to state across a strategic map of the United States, directing troops and generals to seize capitol cities or railway hubs and fighting turn based tactical battles with armies purchased at the strategic level.

name: The Even More Incredible Machine
summary:
Do you remember watching with amazement when those cartoon heroes constructed machines to catch someone or start something?

Those very complicated Rube Goldberg-like ones with knives, toasters, anvils etc?

Or did you ever wonder how it would feel to construct a mouse-powered device to cook some eggs and launch a rocket?

Well, the answer is here!

Build monkey or mouse-powered machines, use lasers and fire fireworks, start fires using a bowling ball and flint, throw things with anti gravity platforms or a jack-in-the-box or crack open an aquarium with a cat, mouse, alligator, cannon, cheese and more!

name: The Adventures of MicroMan
summary:
A platformer developed for Windows 3.1.

The game is broken into two episodes and was planned to have a third which was never released.

- Adventure 1: Crazy Computers
- Adventure 2: Savage Stones
- Adventure 3: Wild Waters (Abandoned)

name: The Magic School Bus Explores Bugs
The Ward
summary:
The Ward is a point and click adventure video game. The story follows the fictionalized version of events of the Apollo 19 mission from 1979. Two of the crew member are found dead, with the protagonist, David Walker, finding himself in an extraterrestrial laboratory. Throughout the story, the protagonist realizes he is meant to be the mythical Ward, in order to resolve the conflict between two alien races; the Greys and the Reptillians.
He sets out to help humanity from total annihilation, but also aids Greys in their war against their former masters, the reptillians. During the course of the adventure, he uncovers many secrets and histories of the universe.

name: The Case of the Muffin Diver
summary: Detective Max Griff gets a call from the local Sheriff, there's a headless body in the forest! A contribution to the Reality on the Norm community series of games.

name: The Day Nothing Happened
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Creed Malay and Denzil Quixode as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Starfire Soccer Challenge
summary: A game by Purple Moon. The game sees the player control an all-girls soccer team.

name: The TunnelMan
summary: Arcade platform DOS game

name: The Magic School Bus Explores in the Age of Dinosaurs
summary: Ms. Frizzle turns the bus into a time machine to more effectively teach her class about everyone's favourite terror lizards.

name: The Awesome Adventures of Victor Vector & Yondo: The Hypnotic Harp
summary: One of a series of fully interactive comic book adventures for kids where you play as the heroic Victor Vector and his digital Saint-Bernard dog Yondo. They are field agents of The Museum of Fantastic Phenomena, and travel through time collecting unique items. In the games, the arch-villain Ram Axis, a virus spawned in the great crash of 2093, will often pop up in disguise in order to prevent their efforts. Players explore a virtual environment by clicking on the onscreen knobs and directional controls to move through the game. They click on images to talk to people, collect treasure and other items that may boost or diminish their energy level or are needed to solve puzzles. Information can also be retrieved from Yondo's data bank collar.

name: The Jetsons: The Computer Game
summary: The Jetsons: The Computer Game is a side-scroller with some driving and puzzle elements, based on the popular cartoon series The Jetsons.

name: The Magnificent Seven
summary: This title was a compilation of games (7 games plus one added for free)

name: The Settlers: Smack a Thief!
summary: Smack A Thief! is an mini-game from the Settlers-series, intended as an advertisement game for The Settlers IV. Your mission is to protect your gold and silver from the thieves.

name: The King of Fighters: Battle de Paradise
summary: The King of Fighters: Battle de Paradise is a minigame collection, similar to Mario Party or Sonic Shuffle, based loosely on The King of Fighters '99.

name: The Eigyoudou
summary:
The Eigyōdō (or "The Business Road") is an adventure game that teaches you the business trade. You play Daisuke Suzuki, a fresh, without much experience, young lad who joins a big company hoping to become a top salesman. While receiving the teaching from your superior official, Mr. Ichimura (whose character is based on a real successful businessman, Hirofumi Ichimura), you will struggle on your way to success.

The game is split into four chapters, and features static background screens with characters and dialogues set in front plan during the dialogues. While talking with other characters, you are constantly on alert for possible business opportunities, the game tries to create a viewpoint of a top salesman.

name: The Hidden: Source
summary: The Hidden is a multiplayer total conversion for the popular Half-Life 2 computer game. The gameplay revolves around the retrieval of an escaped research subject where the subject is highly agile, incredibly strong, and nearly invisible. The first beta version was released on June 13, 2005 and its latest release was September 8, 2007.

name: Thomas & Friends: The Great Festival Adventure
summary: Thomas and his friends are getting ready for a festival. They have to do various activities to have the festival on tracks like preparing the rides, sorting the goods coming in for the event and much more.

name: The Adventures of Little Red Riding Hood
summary: Help Little Red Riding Hood find her way safely to Grandma's.

name: The Batman: Gotham City Rescue
summary: Use logic, spelling, geometry, math and spatial skills to rescue the mayor from the Joker, the Penguin, and Mr. Freeze.

name: The Mice Men
summary: Players try to move all of their mice to the opposite side of the screen, while preventing the other team from doing the same.

name: They Came From Space
summary: They Came From Space is an online team destruction game where players must destroy the city, collect energy, and use it to take out the opposing team. Players take on the role of the alien Overseer in VR or a drone pilot outside of VR in a world where cloud-compute allows physics on a massive scale.

name: The Computer Edition of Risk: The World Conquest Game
summary: The computer version of the classic Parker Brothers board game.

name: The 5th Fleet
summary: The Avalon Hill board game covering a hypothetical war between the US and Russia is converted to the PC.

name: The Fidelity Ultimate Chess Challenge
summary: This handheld chess game uses Chessmaster 2100's basic game engine. This includes such items as en passant attacks for pawn, castling, check and checkmate, and draws for various reasons. Move time limits are optional, and the CPU's thinking time can be specified. If you need a hint, you can press the B button and the computer may or may not give you a hint. You can also play against another human opponent, alternating.

name: The C.H.A.O.S. Continuum
summary: A "cinematic science-fiction adventure" for Mac and Windows, developed by Dash Digital.

name: The Awesome Adventures of Victor Vector & Yondo: The Vampire's Coffin
The Punk Allen Trilogy
summary: A Text Adventure Game created by Signe Rocklin as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Soviet Union Strikes Back
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Ben Pettengill as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm Project.

name: The Mean Checkers Machine 2
summary: A version of the classic board game in which the opponent of the player is "The Mean Checkers Machine". Written by Lance Micklus and published by Adventure International for TRS-80.

name: The Murder of Adrian Elkwood
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Dylan Downing as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Great Unknown: Houdini's Castle
summary: Your honeymoon is cut short when your plane crashes on an uncharted island in The Great Unknown: Houdini's Castle. You awake to discover a madman has kidnapped your husband. To get him back, you'll have to use all your wits to pass his sinister tests and solve the mysteries of Houdini's castle. Along the way, you'll uncover Houdini's secret past and learn about the brilliant apprentice who changed his life. Can you expose Houdini's greatest trick to save your husband and escape the island?

name: The Emperor's Mahjong
summary: This is a mahjong game from 2003.

name: The Goalkeeper
summary: Create your own goalkeeper, choosing between Handling, Reflexes, Jumping and Charisma skill. Then select your starting team from 6 different leagues: England, Italy, Spain, France, Germany and The Netherlands.

name: The Case of the Cautious Condor
The F.A. Premier League Football Manager 2000
summary: The F.A. Premier League Football Manager 2000 is a football sports management game. It is the first sequel to The F.A. Premier League Football Manager 99.

name: The World of Cars Online
summary: The World of Cars Online was a online game based on the Cars film series.

name: The Crazed Chicken
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Chris Dobrzyniecki as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: That Crazy World
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Tobias Schmitt as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Lost Dollar
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Padraig O'Regan as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Petshop Incident
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Tobias Schmitt as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Spoons
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Richy as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Legend of Lotus Spring
summary: A graphical adventure computer game set in the Qing Dynasty. Originally released in China in 1998

name: The Strangers
summary: It's great to have your own country house, but it's also a big responsibility. But if your house is located in the forest, then this is also a danger. What if you were left alone in this house? There are no neighbors or policemen around. It sounds scary, doesn't it?

name: The Incredible Machine: Even More Contraptions
summary: Create Rube Goldberg devices to solve puzzles.

name: The Warhammer Universe Strategy Game Collection
The Amazing Adventures of Lucy Lavender
The 3D Adventures of Sailor Moon
summary: The 3D Adventures of Sailor Moon is an activity game in which Queen Beryl has stolen the Sailor Scout's Transformation Pens. The player must retrieve the pen in each different play area; Galactic Moon Library, the Magical Puzzle Room, Moon Castle TV Show, Sing A Long, Crystal Fighting Arena, and Fashion Salon.

name: The Reposessor
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Dave Gilbert as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Unraveling
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Dylan Downing as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Phantom Inheritance
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Gabriel Fortuna as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Purity of the Surf
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Dave Gilbert as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Underworld
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Kunafits as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The First Stitch
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Dylan Downing as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Phantom Slayer
summary: You can select two types of randomly generated mazes. Then you proceed on a quest to destroy three phantoms.

name: The Chef
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Francisco Gonzalez as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Sorceror's Appraisal
summary: A Graphic Adventure Game created by Ben Croshaw as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Universal Equalizer
summary: A one-room animation in Point And Click Adventure style created by Telemachus Stavropoulos as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm Project.

name: The Lost Treasure of RON
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Francisco Gonzalez as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Postman Only Dies Once
summary: A Point And Click Adventure Game created by Dave Gilbert as part of the Reality-On-The-Norm project.

name: The Improv Presents: Don't Quit Your Day Job
summary:
Adventure game authored in Macromedia Director puts you in the role of an agent trying to scout and book one of 2 comics. Fail and you're booted to mini-games which you can beat to return to the main game.

Gameplay consists mostly of exploring and clicking on people and items in the correct order.

name: The Civil War
summary: This old-school turn-based strategy game covers the American Civil War from the years 1861 to 1865. Play as the North or South, and take over a certain amount of cities of the opposing side before the war ends.

name: This Planet Sucks!
summary: This Planet Sucks is Greg Troutman's first game for the Atari 2600 and is based on the Taito arcade game Lunar Rescue. Your goal in This Planet Sucks is to rescue colonists trapped on the planet's surface, while avoiding the asteroid belt between your mother ship and the colonists. In addition to fighting gravity and avoiding the asteroids, care must also be taken not to squash the poor colonists you're trying to save! And to make matters worse, the asteroids turn into enemy ships after rescuing a colonist!

name: The Oracle
summary: The Oracle is a first-person perspective, photo-realistic adventure game, photographed entirely on-location in Canada and all over Portugal.

name: The Cat in the Hat
summary: The Cat in the Hat is a game based on the classic childens book of the same name.

name: The Cure
summary: The Cure is an action game for the MSX.

name: The Space Adventure
summary: While waiting in a bar for his partner, Cobra encounters a beautiful bounty hunter named Jane. Very soon he realizes that the bounty Jane has been hunting for is his own head, for which the Galaxy Patrol has put quite a reward. But everything changes when Crystal Boy, the head of the Pirate Guild and Cobra's archenemy, appears on the scene. Jane's father had apparently hidden a great treasure, encoding its location in tattoos on the backs of his triplet daughters. Crystal Boy wants this treasure, and is going after Jane and her sisters. Cobra and Jane decide to join forces in order to find Jane's sisters and to undermine Crystal Boy's plans.

name: The Dark Half
summary: The Dark Half is a point and click story based adventure game based on the Stephen King novel of the same name. It was released in 1992 by Capstone and even though many consider it to be a terrible game, it is highly sought after and considered a cult hit.

name: The Omega Stone: Riddle of the Sphinx II
summary: The Omega Stone is a Microsoft Windows puzzle adventure game developed by American studio Omni World Studios. It was the sequel to the game Riddle of the Sphinx: An Egyptian Adventure and was released by DreamCatcher Interactive on March 18, 2003.

name: The Second Kids' World Almanac Adventure
The Flintstones: Dino - Lost in Bedrock
summary: The Flintstones: Dino - Lost in Bedrock is a platform game based on the famous animated show. Fred Flintstone's pet dinosaur, Dino is, well, lost in the city of Bedrock. Fred Flintstone and Barney Rubble try to find him.

name: The Berenstain Bears: Learning At Home, Volume One
The Adventures of Hyperman
summary: The Adventures of Hyperman was an educational point-and-click adventure game for the PC, which was released in 1995.

name: Thunderbolt II
summary:
In Thunderbolt 2 you play the role of something flying through the long corridors. The main task is to shoot down objects thereby collecting fuel, which very quickly ends. To avoid collisions with other figures and go to the coveted finish.
This time you can get some relax in this stylish symmetry puzzle game.

name: The Messenger
summary:
As a demon army besieges his village, a young ninja ventures through a cursed world, to deliver a scroll paramount to his clan's survival.
Leveraging players expectations as a core game design ingredient, The Messenger is first presented as an 8-bit action platformer with a simple story, that unravels into an epic time traveling tale, eventually revealing itself as a 16-bit Metroidvania game packed with replay value and deadpan humor.

name: The Alcor Trivia Pro Classic Star Trek (Star-Log I)
Through the Looking Glass
summary: Through the Looking Glass is a game for the Apple Lisa and Macintosh, developed and published by Apple.

name: The Gladiators: Galactic Circus Games
summary: The Gladiators: Galactic Circus Games is a Real-Time-Strategy game developed by Eugen Systems and published by Arxel Tribe. It was released in the United States on March 1, 2003.

name: The Final Conflict
summary: The Final Conflict is an old military strategy game.

name: The Last Starfighter
summary:
The Last Starfighter is based on the 1984 movie of the same name. The hero must single-handedly pilot an extraordinarily powerful starfighter to destroy an enemy armada. The action takes place in outer space from a side-scrolling perspective where the ship always remains lined up in the middle of the screen but is able to turn forwards and backwards while accelerating and decelerating. The ship can also collapse into a slimmer configuration. Enemies come at you from all directions and in all formations. Shoot them as quickly as possible while also disabling the enemy fleet's starcruisers as best you can.

The game also features a 2-player mode where each player takes turns fighting the armada.

name: The Geekwad: Games of the Galaxy
summary: Players control the Geekwad Game in this DOS minigame collection.

name: The Premiership
summary: The Premiership is a soccer management game.

name: The Bard's Tale Trilogy
summary: All three titles of the Bard's Tale series in one compilation.

name: The Smelly Mystery
summary: The Smelly Mystery is a children's interactive story book centered on the mystery of the switched smells.

name: Theme Park Mystery
summary: Theme Park Mystery is a strange adventure game set in the mysterious world of gypsies, magic and supernatural powers where nothing is quite what it seems. Your routine life is disrupted forever when you use a discarded tokens in the fortunetelling machine. Use the tokens to get a ticket from the Zoltan Wizard fortune telling machine at the Train Station to journey through the four worlds of Dragonland, Dreamland, Futureland and Yesterdayland. Find out what drove the fun seekers away and your uncle insane. Hunt for hidden keys, fiery torches and supernatural potions to help you avenge your uncle's death.

name: Thomas & Friends: Thomas Saves the Day!
The Farmer's Daughter
summary: The Farmer's Daughter is a Commodore 64 erotic text adventure. The game centers around you pursuing a farmer's attractive daughter.

name: The Settlers II: 10th Anniversary - Vikings
summary: We have now entered the year of the wolf. Many years have passed since the discovery of the world portal and the vikings are a accepted race with a high level of wealth due to the trading with other nations which the portal made possible. One day they invited all their friends for a big feast. The celebration goes well until the world portal suddenly explodes and half of the nearby village people are missing. Those people were caught in the blastwave and thrown through the world portal onto an unknown land. Under the rule of Eirigg they now find out, that the guests they harbored were the Pirates of the Wolf and now seek vengeance and a way home.

name: The Aly & AJ Adventure
summary: A game starring Aly and AJ Michalka, members of the pop duo 78violet.

name: The Little Raven & Friends: The Tricycle Story
summary:
When Little Raven happens upon Eddy Bear's bike, he wonders aloud what it is like to ride, and he just can't resist the temptation to hop on and take it for a spin. Well, the inevitable happens - he crashes into a tree, scattering tricycle parts everywhere! Even though he'd like to blame it on the tree, deep down he knows it's all his fault. Being a little worried about consequences, however, he needs help deciding whether or not he should lie to Eddy Bear. After all, Eddy's going to be really mad...

Thus begins the first of several such decisions the player must help Little Raven make in this game; weighing questions about whether to help out a friend even though he's "too busy", whether to stop and refill a bug jar he knocked over, whether to share his cookies, even though that means there will be less for him, and others. The player is asked to make a yes or no choice in each instance, and if he makes a "bad" one, Little Raven is sent immediately to the Time-Out Cave - a hollowed out tree where he must sit and reconsider the choices. A good decision at this point will bring him right back into the game.

name: The Citadel of Chaos
summary: The Citadel of Chaos is a role-playing game based on the Fighting Fantasy book of the same name.

name: The Marriage
summary: The Marriage is a PC game developed by Rod Humble as a purely video-interactive piece of art. It's general concept is to represent the flow of a masculine/feminine marriage, but beyond that is intended to be left open to personal interpretation by each user, as all artwork is.

name: The Doonesbury Election Game Campaign '96
summary: Manage a presidential campaign in the 1996 election in "the most comprehensive and challenging election strategy game ever designed." Pair such unlikely opponents as George Wallace and Shirley Chisholm, or the actual matchup of Bob Dole, Ross Perot and Bill Clinton. Even choose candidates from the past like JFK -- 60 different candidates at your disposal. Staff your campaign with such Doonesbury characters as Zonker, Duke, Lacey or even Mike.

name: The War in Heaven
summary: A Christian themed first-person shooter set during the war in heaven where you can play as either an angel or demon.

name: The Exchange Student: Episode 2 - Point Club
The Railroad Works
summary: Construct your own model railroad.

name: The Psychotron
summary: The CIA have covertly purchased a Psychotronic generator from the Russians. Upon attempting to bring it back to CIA headquarters the plane crashed into a farm in Virginia. You are to investigate the crash and determine the location of the Psychotronic generator before it can fall into the wrong hands.

name: The Awesome Adventures of Victor Vector & Yondo: The Cyberplasm Formula
The Last Refuge
summary: The Last Refuge is an action game on the Amiga.

name: The Suite Life of Zack & Cody: Tipton Trouble
summary: Join Zack and Cody in their adventures at the Tipton Hotel.

name: The Book of Pooh: A Story Without a Tail
summary:
Playhouse Disney's The Book of Pooh: A Story Without a Tail is based on a Disney television series that is in turn based on characters created by the author A. A. Milne. The characters in the game are animated to resemble the Bunraku puppetry style of the series.

As the game begins, Pooh and his friends are gathered in the Hundred Acre Wood discussing the fine-ness of the day when Eeyore announces he has lost his tail. The friends quickly offer to help him find it, and the player can select any of five characters to set off on a search.

name: The Biggest Creators of Empires
summary:
This compilation includes the following titles from Impressions Games' City Building series:

- Caesar III
- Pharaoh
- Cleopatra: Queen of the Nile (Pharaoh Expansion Pack)
- Zeus: Master of Olympus
- Poseidon: Master of Atlantis (Zeus Expansion Pack)
- Emperor: Rise of the Middle Kingdom

name: The ClueFinders 3rd Grade Adventures: The Mystery of Mathra
summary: Join the ClueFinders deep in the rain forest and learn a year full of 3rd grade skills. A scientist has vanished and animals are disappearing. Has an ancient monster returned? Apply math, reading, science, geography, and problem-solving skills to solve the mystery!

name: The Corporate Machine
summary:
The Corporate Machine is Stardock's classic 2001 real-time economic strategy game, available now on Steam. Dive back into the timeless battle for one of the most ruthless environments ever created: international trade.

Corporations exist in a constant state of war: Plotting to destroy their rivals, CEOs chase world domination through economic strategies less deadly but more complex than any military maneuver. Control the market, or face the prospect of buyout and bankruptcy. Build your business empire, dominate the industry, and amass a fortune you will need that private island to fully enjoy.

name: The Dead City
summary: It's been a few months since the zombie apocalypse began.The world has fallen.The earth is inhabited by zombies, looters and small groups of survivors.

name: The Great Battles of Alexander
summary: The computer game version of the boardgame, from GMT Games, of the same name. It is a turn-based tactical wargame that includes ten of Alexander's battles.

name: Thunder in Paradise Interactive
summary: Fight crime with Spence and Bru in this CD-i exclusive starring Terry "Hulk" Hogan.

name: The Tomorrow War: Factor K
summary: The computer game "Tomorrow is War: Factor K", created based on the original script by Alexander Zorich, continues the story told in the large-scale space simulator "Tomorrow is War" and the book trilogy of this famous science fiction writer ("Tomorrow is War", "Without Mercy", "Time is Moscow!").

name: The Spirit Engine
summary: The Spirit Engine is a 2D, sidescrolling adventure/RPG game with a simple story and a straightforward, innovative real-time combat system. Written as an experimental reaction to old 16bit console RPGs, it took a little under two years to complete and was released in November 2003 as freeware under Natomic.

name: The Time Warp of Dr. Brain
The Family Skeleton
summary: Family Skeleton is a narrative driven horror game, where you visit your childhood home and discover the truth behind the events that tore your family apart. A story-rich experience where you

name: The Zero Dome
summary: Float, build and shoot in VR in the zero gravity arena known as "The Zero Dome" . Mixing elements of arcade and survival games, The Zero Dome is a sandbox arcade game like no other, built from the ground up for VR.

name: The Afterwoods
summary: In this VR first person RPG, a young mage casts an unlikely spell that conjures a mysterious weapon. With no time to waste, the mage embarks on a perilous journey to unlock its secrets, find long lost spells, and defeat the invaders.

name: The Quiet Sleep
summary: The Quiet Sleep is a simulation/tower defense game set in your mind. Build out different parts of your personality to keep a handle on your emotions and to achieve your goals!

name: The Exorcist: Legion VR
summary: The Exorcist: Legion VR is an interactive VR experience set in the academy-award winning world created by horror maestro William Peter Blatty. Each chapter features a unique demonic entity that will test your courage and resolve. Available for HTC Vive and Oculus Rift. Not for the faint-hearted.

name: The Little Prince VR
summary: "It is only with the heart that one can see truly".The Little Prince VR is an interactive adventure that follows the events of Antoine de Saint-Exupery's masterpiece.

name: The Charge of the Light Brigade
ThunderWheels
summary: ThunderWheels is a retro racing game with a classic top-down perspective plus third and first person view, realistic physics and really fun circuits full of 80's nostalgia.

name: The Pirate: Plague of the Dead
summary: Command the most fearsome pirates in an exciting Caribbean adventure! Plague of the Dead is a new installment of The Pirate series, featuring an open world without loading screens, dynamic day and night cycle and weather system, it offers each gamer an unforgettable experience.

external_ids.url: https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/The Pirate: Plague of the Dead

name: The Princess is in Another Castle
summary:
Follow the touching story of a medieval knight that is having bad luck in finding its princess. 
A classic platform game where you will have to avoid dangers like bats, spikes etc.

name: The Last Monster Master
summary: Will your monsters save the world, or destroy it? As a Monster Master, you'll telepathically train wild monsters to be treasure guardians, royal pets, or giant stone masons. As war breaks out with the kingdom to the north, will you train monsters to be vicious soldiers and mindless power generators?

name: The Well
summary: The Well is a classically designed RPG built distinctively for VR with a beautifully stylized, storybook art style and dark, dreamlike atmosphere. Explore the world, collect secrets, recruit allies, and fight strange, challenging enemies for rewards.

name: The Backyardigans: Mission to Mars
summary: Calling all astronauts! When Tyrone and Tasha receive a strange signal at Mission Control, Commander Uniqua needs you to suit up with her, Science Officer Pablo, and Equipment Specialist Austin for their mission to Mars! Help pilot the shuttle, race through a meteor shower, explore underground Martian caves, collect space gems, and more in an out-of-this-world adventure with The Backyardigans!

name: The Legend of Knight Templar
summary:
Hack n Slash platformer? a bit of an Adventure, mixed with a "complex" fighting style? Then this might be the game you're looking for. 
 
The Legend of Knight Templar is a 2D Action Platformer, where you control a mysterious armored warrior, unleashing devastating moves and also able to manipulate elemental magic later on. 
 
The game offers different playstyles, from basic Hack n Slash, stealth, ability "spam", ranged/magic, or even better to never make things boring, mix the use of all of them. 
They're all balanced and it's all about being creative on your combos! 
 
Secret items and chests to find, gold and combat points grind will be needed to make your life easier. 
Failing too much? Step inside the Training Room from the main menu and improve your combat performance without any costs! 
 
Exploration and a good combat performance is the key to succeed. 
Rushing through is not a good idea. 
 
Learn more at: 
https://forum.yoyogames.com/index.php?threads/unnamed-action-platformer-video-inside.35482/

name: The Serf's Tale
summary: Text Adventure for ZX Spectrum set in a fantasy world.

name: The Kore Gang: Outvasion from Inner Earth
summary: A 3D platformer for the Wii, developed over a period of about 10 years, during which many different companies contributed to some extent. The central mechanic is the ability to switch between three characters with different abilities.

name: The Fourth Generation
summary: The 4th generation is a side ways scrolling shooter from d'india Software and Webfoot. The game contains a wide variety of weapons to blast your enemies with and many power-ups that you can upgrade your ship with. Armour, missiles, auto repair, shield generators, lasers etc

name: Things on Wheels
summary: Jump in one of the many miniature race cars of Things on Wheels, on the 2 firsts crazy tracks of the Championship! Make good use of the numerous powerups and traps laying on the tracks to eliminate the opposition and lead the race!

name: The Bibleman
summary: Based on the direct-to-video series starring Willie Aames.

name: The Tainted
summary: The Tainted is a sci-fi action RPG set in a cyberpunk world where mega-corporations have opened up portals leading to an alien invasion. Only released in South Africa in limited quantity.

name: The Jetsons: George Jetson and the Legend of Robotopia
The Fast and The Furious: Drift
summary: It's the sequel to The Fast and The Furious. It is sold by Raw Thrills as an upgrade kit that can be used in almost all driving game cabinets; as an upgrade kit for The Fast and The Furious and as a standalone cabinet.

name: The Sims: Bowling
summary: The Sims: Bowling combines a life simulator with a bowling game, where the player must collect points by playing bowling in different game modes in order to set up their home and buy bowling equipment.

name: The Fast and The Furious: Super Bikes
summary: F&F Super Bikes is a spin-off of The Fast and The Furious arcade game. Since this game is about motorcycle races, it uses a different cabinet, with a replica of a byke's body, like most motorcycle based arcade games.

name: The Tripods
summary: Released in 1985 as a tie in to the BBC's TV series, adapted from John Christophers series of books.

name: The Woodleys Summer Sports
summary: The Woodleys Summer Sports is a DS game for young kids.

name: The Backyardigans: Viking Voyage
summary: The backyardigans appear in this wonderful viking journey teaching children colours, shapes, numbers and counting, rhyming, size comparisons and memory skills.

name: They Hunger: Lost Souls
summary: First person horror action game made by Black Widow Games; the creators of They Hunger trilogy. Designed using the Source engine.

name: Thomas and Friends: Engines Working Together
summary: Thomas and his friends teaching young children spelling, logic, vocabulary and number patterns.

name: The City of Metronome
summary: Ever elusive adventure featuring a distinguished art direction and crazy sound-based gameplay.

name: The Palace of Deceit: The Dragon's Plight
The Agency
summary: Cancelled in March 2011, The Agency was a spy-themed action MMORPG being developed by SOE.

name: The Axys Adventures: Truth Seeker - Battle Against the Lies
The Pack Rat
summary:
The Pack Rat is a DOS platformer released in 1992. The goal of The Pack Rat is to complete levels while collecting coins and wedges of cheese and avoiding environmental obstacles such as water and light bulbs.
The pack rat contains single-player and two-player hot seat modes along with a block based level editor however, progress in The Pack Rat cannot be saved.

name: The Trials of Odysseus Kent
summary: Odysseus has arrived in a small village community in search of a bonanza called the Lost Treasure of Randolph McBoing. He has tracked the burial site down to a plot in the local churchyard, but the parish priest won't let him dig there. As luck would have it, the man due to be buried there is on his last legs. Unfortunately he has vowed never to die until his last wishes are fulfilled. He's been tucked up in bed for ten weeks now; the old guy means business. Your task is to help him shuffle off this mortal coil and, consequently, gain access to the burial site.

name: The War College: Universal Military Simulator 3
The Quest of Kwirk's Castle
summary: The Quest of Kwirk's Castle is a DOS clone of Kwirk.

name: The Fifth Disciple
summary: Help Engeor, a student at the University of Magic, save Rovenland from the evil wizard Wahargem. In the beginning of the game Engeor accidentally says something against the evil wizard and finds himself in a prison camp. His first task is to free himself from the prison so he can continue on his journey to save his country and its inhabitants.

name: The Vortex: Quantum Gate II
summary: The Vortex, sequel to Quantum Gate is a cinematic journey of a young soldier (Drew Griffin) in a peculiar hostile world where he fights for his life. You decide Drew's fate by making inquires and displaying emotions that will guide his actions from a first person perspective just like many other interactive movies.

name: The Oregon Trail: 3rd Edition
summary: The 9th release of the long-running educational game series, and the first to feature FMV.

name: The Arrangement
summary:
The Arrangement is the second game developed and published by independent developer Michael B. Clark.

The story puts you in the role of attorney Richard Sullivan whose life gets turned upside down one fateful day. He has had a great life thus far. With a successful career, lovely home and a loving wife, everything is exactly like he dreamed it could be. Little does he know that his bubble is about to burst! His wife is kidnapped... he must find and rescue her!

You play Richard in this first-person, point-and-click adventure. Help him find leads and clues in numerous locales to track down the kidnapper. Solve numerous puzzles using your powers of deduction, logic and wit.

name: The Hustle: Detroit Streets
summary: The Hustle: Detroit Streets is a billiards game for the Xbox, PSP, and Playstation 2.

name: The Sydney Mystery
summary:
This mystery adventure game takes place in Sydney, Australia, where you play the role of the niece of a kidnapped retired Private Investigator. While you seek out clues to solve his disappearance, you take an interactive tour of Sydney including the Opera House and the Harbour. As the mystery unfolds, you will visit other places in the city of Sydney and even venture into parts of Australia's bushlands.

Through the use of full-motion video, the game features over 240 scenes, 11 characters, 17 authentic Australian locations, puzzles, inventory objects, music and interactive exploration and conversation.

name: The California Raisins
summary: Three blues singing raisins are on a harrowing journey to escape the Raisin Factory. Battle through traditional 2D side scrolling platform puzzles to reach freedom, or face being baked in an oatmeal cookie.

name: They Sold a Million II
summary: A compilation of best-sellers for the ZX Spectrum and Amstrad CPC. This one includes Bruce Lee, Knight Lore (replaced by Entombed on the C64 version), Match Game, and Match Point.

name: The Mystery of the Nautilus
summary:
This adventure game was inspired by the Jules Verne novel "20,000 Leagues Under the Sea".

The story begins aboard the USS Shark, a research submarine, exploring the depths of the Atlantic Ocean. The crew discovers a huge metallic object and argues whether to further examine it. During the debate, a young scientist, taking it upon himself to go without orders, steals a mini-sub and docks at the mysterious wreck. You play the scientist aboard what he learns to be Captain Nemo's vessel the "Nautilus". There are many rooms to explore and numerous puzzles to be solved in this 1st person point-and-click adventure game.

name: The Awesome Adventures of Victor Vector & Yondo: The Last Dinosaur Egg
The Chase on Tom Sawyer's Island
summary: This Pac-Man inspired maze game is based upon the Tom Sawyer's Island attraction at Disneyland. Players maneuver Tom Sawyer along the island's paths in his quest to gather berries and avoid being caught by Aunt Polly, Injun Joe, and a bear.

name: The Sims: Carnival - SnapCity
summary: "Put your skills to the test in a fun combination of city building and quick-thinking puzzle solving!"

name: The Perfect General Scenario Disk: World War II Battle Set
The Magic School Bus Explores the World of Animals
summary: Animals from the Wild Animal Park are returned to their wilderness, but they're in the wrong places. Help Ms. Frizzle and her class return them to their natural habitats on a rescue adventure that spans the globe!

name: The Royal Game of Ur
summary: The Royal Game of Ur is an ancient racing game where players try to get all of their tokens across the board first. 3000 years ago this was one of the most popular board games in the world. Play it yourself to find out why!

name: The Great Battles of Hannibal
summary: The computer game version GMT Games' boardgame SPQR (Senātus Populusque Rōmānus) and several SPQR scenario packs. It is a turn-based tactical wargame that includes eleven battles of the Second Punic War pitting Rome versus Carthage.

name: The Forgotten: It Begins
summary: The Forgotten is set in New Orleans, were you must find your friend, Richard Haliburton, who has mysteriously disappeared. He's been exploring a sect of black arts practitioners called Collectors.... are they somehow involved??

name: The Island of Lost Hope
summary: A pirate themed text adventure game.

name: The First Mile
summary: A horror themed interactive fiction game.

name: The Blair Witch Experience
summary: A box set containing the three PC Blair Witch games.

name: The Adventures of Little Miss Scatterbrain
The Arrival
summary: You've been abducted. You're in a cold, steel room. A window provides you a view of outer space. Your assignment is to escape without alien detection, so play a game of "cat and mouse" and work your way through the maze of the alien space station, moon base (mining colony) and three outstations.

name: The Birds and the Bees II: Antics
summary: Boris the Bee has been kidnapped and it's now up to you, his cousin Barnabee, to rescue him.

name: The Dolphin's Pearl
summary: Players control a dolphin in this Commodore 64 game. The game was also released under the title "The Dolphin's Rune".

name: The Guardian of Darkness
summary: Guardian of Darkness is an action game with puzzle-solving elements. The player takes the role of a monk at an occult organisation who must face and defeat supernatural entities.

name: The All New Family Feud
summary: In this game you will experience the exciting classic gameplay of one of America's hottest gameshows at home now!

name: The Game With No Name
summary: Released for DOS in 1990, the peculiarly named "The Game With No Name" has you attempting to power up your crashed spaceship by collecting red diamonds on an unknown alien world.

name: The Operational Art of War II: Elite Edition
The ClueFinders 4th Grade Adventures: Puzzle of the Pyramid
summary: Join the ClueFinders in an archaeological dig and learn a full year of 4th grade skills. Unearth a sinister plot to release an ancient, destructive force into the world. Build language arts, math, reading, science, geography, and problem-solving skills while stopping a disaster.

name: The Tone Rebellion
summary: The Tone Rebellion is a real-time strategy game (RTS) with light RPG and puzzle-solving elements. The player must first choose the Floater tribe he/she desires to control - Tarks, Zygons, Cepheans, or Dyla. Each tribe starts on a different island, and has different affinities to the realm types encountered in the game: Physical, Supernatural, Ethereal, and Natural. The player begins with a very small unit of Floaters around a tribal center. By harvesting Tone, the player can build new structures, unique to each race, increasing the number of units. The goal is to build a bridge to another island, eventually uniting all of them in the struggle against the Leviathan.

name: The Scruffs
summary: A hidden object game, released for personal computers everywhere in 2007.

name: The Yukon Trail
summary: Partner up and set sail, Dawson City awaits in the hunt for gold on The Yukon Trail.

name: The Apprentice: Los Angeles
summary:
The Apprentice: Los Angeles recreates the original US version of the TV series, starring businessman Donald Trump's attempt to find a new business star. Former contestants and key figures from the show also feature. You face a series of challenges, beginning with a sushi bar and moving onto a boutique.

On each sub-level you must put people's orders together by clicking on icons in the correct order (rice, fish and extras such as tea and umbrellas in the sushi bar, for example). You will usually be managing multiple deals at once, so prioritize those where the customer has been waiting for longest, or which are part of a big order. Some tasks take time to complete (boutique assistants must find dresses, beach balls must be blown up by your surf shop's assistant, for example), so factor this into your thinking. Normal and Expert goals are provided - reach the normal goal regularly to survive.

name: The Scoop
summary: You play as reporter for a big city newspaper. Recently, a rival reporter was found stabbed to death in a phone booth. Your job is to travel around the city following suspects, listening in on conversations, and even searching in their homes when they're away. Based on an Agatha Christie novella.

name: The Legend of Xanadu
summary: An overhead fantasy ARPG that uses a similar bump-attack style to the Ys games. Some unique features include a day/night cycle, some side-on action sequences and the ability to level up your weapons and armour.

name: The Eire Raising Adventures of Seamus O'Mally
summary: A point and click adventure for the Amiga.

name: The Warlock of Firetop Mountain
summary: The Warlock of Firetop Mountain is a tabletop adventure come to life! This fantasy solo RPG combines unique, simultaneous turn-based combat with a journey that changes based on each figurine you take into Firetop Mountain! Which hero will you take into Zagor's lair THIS time?

name: The Realm Online
summary: One of the earliest graphical MMORPGS to be released, The Realm consists of a 2D world filled with monsters, loot, quests, and many other things that are seen in MMORPGS today.

name: The Magic School Bus Explores Inside the Earth
The Quest of Agravain
summary: A long time ago, Lord Agravain roamed the land of Riva in his quest for the Elixir of Youth, the only hope for the all the ageing knights. The Quest of Agravain is a platform game where the player controls a medieval knight armed with a sword. The main objective is to reach the exit door at the top of each level.

name: The Beverly Hillbillies
summary:
A quasi-adventure based on the movie The Beverly Hillbillies, which in turn was based on the movie of the same name, and not the television show.

The player takes control of Jed Clampett after his unexpected discovery of oil, and help him build a new life in Beverly Hills, only to find out that two criminals targeted him as a blackmail victim.

name: The Crypts of Plumbous
summary: In The Crypts of Plumbous, the player has to fight alien ships who are trying to raid underground Nuclear waste storage for some unknown reason and unleash it on the planet.

name: The Residents: Freak Show
summary: Freak Show is an animated CD-ROM created by the rock band The Residents, with animation design by Jim Ludtke.

name: The Rescue of Lorri in Lorrinitron
summary: A 2D, top-down role-playing game.

name: The Interstate '76 Arsenal
summary:
It's 1976... a different '76. Stretched out before you are thousands of miles of desert - the American Southwest. The massive engine roars as you slam down the throttle. It's time to get funked up...

You are Groove Champion, auto-vigilante. Your agenda: payback for your dead sister. Your weapon: A 425-horsepower '72 Picard Piranha with two 50-caliber machine guns on the roof and a flamethrower on the side. You're one mean dude in an even meaner ride.

They've messed with the wrong Champion.
Includes the original Interstate'76 and its expansion Interstate'76: Nitro Pack
Cinematic atmosphere, fast-paced action and an immersive story
Awesome soundtrack with funky disco tunes

name: The Abyss: Incident at Europa
summary: The Abyss: Incident at Europa is a first person shooter for the PC that is a based on and is a chronological sequel to James Cameron's "The Abyss".

name: The Toy Shop
summary: A tool for customizing and printing out designs for real-life scale models.

name: The Floor Is Made of Lava
summary: Discover many different worlds as Jimmy searches for his brother, in this game that's somewhere between Mario and Megaman.

name: The Doorbreaker
