Over the course of 80 unique turn-based campaign battles taking place across the lands of Thra, recruit new allies and customize their forces by assigning them jobs and outfitting them with new equipment.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
summary:
An epic adventure across the land and skies of Hyrule awaits in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom for Nintendo Switch. The adventure is yours to create in a world fueled by your imagination.

In this sequel to The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, you'll decide your own path through the sprawling landscapes of Hyrule and the mysterious islands floating in the vast skies above. Can you harness the power of Link's new abilities to fight back against the malevolent forces that threaten the kingdom?

name: The Wardrobe: Even Better Edition
summary: A protagonist overflowing with sarcasm, cynicism and who continually breaks through the fourth wall. More than 40 hand-illustrated and digitally colored locations, populated with more than 70 characters and enriched by dozens of puzzles.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition
summary:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Complete Edition is a comprehensive release that includes the base game, both major expansions (Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine), and all free DLCs. It has been issued in multiple versions over time:

- 2016 (PC, PS4, Xbox One): Released alongside the Game of the Year Edition, functionally identical but branded differently depending on region.

- 2022 (PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC): Updated version including the next-gen enhancements, such as ray tracing, visual upgrades, and quality-of-life improvements, plus additional content inspired by the Netflix series.

name: The Longest Game Ever 2
summary:
Don't download this game, it's terrible. And way too difficult for you.
Why do you think it's called The Longest Game Ever? Because it is long, super hard and with tons of content. No human has ever finished it, and it's not a random guy like you who will change that!
I am 7805j, the most sophisticated Artificial Intelligence in the world. If you still decide to play my game, I will do everything in my power to make you give up!

name: The King of Fighters for Girls
summary: A mobile King of Fighters dating otome game. On March 04, 2021 it was announced on their twitter that the game would shutdown on March 31, 2021.

name: The Flawless: Art's Tale
summary: The Flawless: Art's Tale is a metroidvania, hack 'n' shoot, action RPG set in a brutal world of cats. Join our young hero, Art, and his droid sidekick for some epic hack 'n' shoot battles, an endearing cast of characters, an unforgettable coming of age story, and a gorgeous hand-drawn art style.

name: The Final Boss
summary: For a long time you have played video games where you were the hero and had to kill the final boss, but now you are the final boss!

name: This Is the Zodiac Speaking
summary: Story-driven FPS mystery thriller-horror with stealth and detective modes based on facts from the world-famous story of Zodiac, a never-captured American serial killer.

name: The Scream
summary: The Scream by Edvard Munch is omnipresent. Its terror-twisted face has made such a deep and lasting impression on the collective imagination that it is even used for an emoji representing anxiety. But do you really know this iconic painting?

name: The Homestead
summary: The most visually stunning representation of a real-world environment. This is a real location, a real art-gallery based in Auckland New Zealand. The art-work has been scanned to a level of detail not demonstrated in any other traditional VR experience.

name: Thinkrolls Space
summary:
Thinkrolls Space is a child-friendly puzzle game that's out of this world. Colorful heroes boldly roll where no Thinkroll has rolled before, in over 200 mazes set across seven unique planets.
A cast of oddball aliens will make you grin from ear to ear. But you'll need brains and nimble fingers to reach your goal - and catch the waiting UFO that will beam your Thinkroll to the next fun-filled planet.

name: The House in Fata Morgana: Dreams of the Revenants Edition
summary: A gothic suspense tale set in a cursed mansion. 'The House in Fata Morgana' is a full-length visual novel spanning nearly a millennium that deals in tragedy, human nature, and insanity.

name: The Expression Amrilato
summary:
In "The Expression Amrilato", the main character is lost in an alternate world where Juliamo (which in the real world is Esperanto, an existing constructed language.) is the official spoken language.
Therefore, while enjoying a story between cute girls, you can also learn the Esperanto language!
The text in this game has been officially supervised by the National Esperanto Association in Japan.

name: The Myth Seekers 2: The Sunken City
summary: A strange artifact has been excavated on the coast of Brittany - and now the agents of the Myth Seekers are in grave danger. Amelia has to act fast to protect modern-day Paris. What other mysteries lurk deep within the Sunken City?

name: The Real Man Summer Championship 2019
summary: The Real Man Summer Championship 2019 is an over-the-top sports game, in which equally unathletic competitors from around the world arrive in Finland to participate in various ridiculous events to find out who is the Manliest Man of them all.

name: The Hunters Journals; Pale Harbour
summary: A coastal town is overrun by horrors, and only YOU can save it!

name: The Panel DC
summary: The Panel DC is a puzzle game where you will turn valves, pull levers and push buttons. Start interacting with the panel elements and found the combinations to make it work. Then you can make it out of the room you get locked in.

name: The Lost Game
summary: Welcome to the lost game! A game which should be terminated. You will visit the Red Rock Arean in the Dragon Kingdom. Although it is only a small part of the world, you still will have exciting fightings.

name: They Are Beasts
summary: They Are Beasts is a third-person shooter in which you will fight an army of undead, led by the most vile creatures of darkness, and wrest your soul from the demon's tenacious claws. Do not forget to recharge!

name: The Dark Veil: West Haven
summary: In this Third-Person Survival Horror, Azdriel writhes underneath the mysterious Dark Veil. Cyrus continues on his mission to track down a powerful wizard in hopes of procuring a magical item to save his wife. While traveling Cyrus gets detoured from his path and is forced to enter West Haven.

name: The Last Cowboy
summary: Feel like a real hero of the Wild West. Put on your hat, become a cowboy and protect your flock.

name: The PIT: Broken Bones
summary: The Pit is a turn-based tactical game set in dark fantasy. You will manage the guild of gladiators, fight battles for life and death.

name: That's Pretty Clever
summary: Chose clever, score better! The clever dice game where you try to beat the community in weekly challenges for the highscore.

name: The Ring of Truth
summary: The Ring of Truth is an exploration story game set in an abandoned factory.

name: There Will Be Ink
summary: There Will Be Ink is a tactical action game for 1-4 players. Play solo or with friends in battles between stick figure armies on a paper notepad, just like you used to draw in class instead of paying attention!

name: That Flipping Mountain
summary: A physics driven flipping and skiing game inspired by "Getting Over It". Flip yourself up a massive mountain of stuff! Fall down, rage, get up, keep flipping!

name: Thinnest Judgment
summary: Become a worker in a vast facility filled with meaningless mysteries and crap you don't need. You'll get your own personalized room to give you the illusion of comfort, and ultimately have it all ripped away from you when you fail to satisfy the corporate overlords.

name: The Itch
summary: The Itch is a 2D platformer centered around using heart rate as a resource to make objects move, grow, and shoot in order to find a doctor who can cure a deadly virus. The path to the doctor is full of obstacles as you traverse cavernous environments filled with plant life and people.

name: The Way of Cinnamon
summary: Join Cinnamon on this 3D platforming adventure, and rescue his captive Red Panda family from the evil Wu-Long and his band of Snow Leopards! Create your own platforms and attack enemies using an innovative shield-throwing mechanic, and collect items across multiple unique environments!

name: The Beast of Gevaudan
summary: Эта история о неведомом Звере, терроризировавшем север французской провинции Жеводан в 1764-1767 годах. За 3 года существо совершило порядка 250 нападений на людей, и более 100 из них закончились летальным исходом жертвы.

name: THC
summary: THC is a visual novel for adults.

name: The Breach: A VR Escape Game
summary: The Breach is a Virtual Reality Escape Game set in a futuristic and mysterious atmosphere. Solve a short yet intense and challenging enigma, taking place in an immersive world with a puzzling ambiance. Will you be able to overcome an environment collapsing before your eyes?

name: The Last Escape of Yeti
summary: Yeti living in the forests of Karelia was kidnapped by the evil oligarch Ivan Ivanov.... Now he has to win in an unequal battle local mafia and corrupt police officers. To do this, he needs to go through the streets of the city filled with dangers.

name: The Cube
summary: The cube is the best digital representation of the 70's iconic Magic cube. You may pick different sizes from 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 and 5x5, all of this while playing at the beat of great music.

name: The World is Your Weapon
summary: Wells, pitfalls, houses, villagers, monsters (!?), anything around you can be a weapon! An action RPG that you've never seen before, you can fight with all the objects you see in the game. There are more than 300 kinds of weapons.Aim to complete the weapon gallery!

name: The Purge Man
summary: You feel tired of your own existence, you feel like everything is going wrong, there is no way out of this. The only way is to PURGE.

name: The Heist
summary: "The Heist" is an interactive comic book adventure by "Munzesky Games Studio" made as a spinoff story to their upcoming project "Sol Invictus". Set in a futuristic capital of Ganymede, the story follows a team of four dedicated individuals throughout their organised effort to steal a certain technological...

name: The Rabbit Hole Principle
summary: Dr. Sato is a psychologist who is about to reveal his secret research at the ACP conference in Japan. Code named : The Rabbit Hole Principle. He claims his research will open new horizons in the understanding of human behavior and psychology.

name: The Abduction of Bacon at Dawn
The 13th Doll: A Fan Game of The 7th Guest
summary: Return to The 7th Guest's Stauf Mansion in this mind bending fmv puzzle game made by fans of the original series.

name: The Fragment
summary: His wife Jane and you are scientists hired by the US government to investigate a strange element found in an asteroid that fell to planet earth, but in the middle of the investigation his wife Jane disappears, something terrible is happening in that place.

name: The Saga of Nino's Transmigration
summary: A Roguelike JRPG game that tells the story of Nino being transported to another world and becoming a cult leader. Due to a poor twist of fate, he ended up cursed and must break the curse within the three days he has left to live.

name: The New Universes: Eine Neue Reise Beginnt - Chapter 1
summary: A Visual Novel where a young woman learns about her life in a war-torn, hostile galaxy.

name: The Lattice Grimoire
summary: The curse wove their fates together. Now their thoughts and feelings influence Verity and her actions determine their fates. Will she be able to break the curse? Or will their dark pasts drag her into an inescapable despair? And can a fresh start really erase the past?

name: The Lost
summary: The Lost is ultimate FPS VR game. You must defend yourself from enemies with various guns. The Lost is only available in single mode, and you can gradually clear the stages according to the difficulty. Take over best teleport spots and choose proper guns strategically to defeat enemies!

name: The Hunters Journals; Vile Philosophy
summary: Five hunters have tracked the beast and failed. Now it's YOUR turn!

name: The Plight
summary: Three childhood friends disappeared more than a decade ago. You don't remember exactly what happened, but the only other person who might is an old woman in a wheelchair who hasn't spoken in years. However, while it's said that time heals all wounds, it also provides the opportunity to open old ones.

name: The Prophecy Lies!
summary: Take the role of Darius, a Tiborean, who has to work with the most despicable creatures of all... the humans! Go to Panom'Arah, a part of the Human World and complete the difficult mission of finding and retrieving the Anomaly, a rare and dangerous form of magic.

name: The Demon - Nicolas Eymerich Inquisitor Audiogame
summary: The inquisitor is back. Nicolas Eymerich has returned for the final battle! The plague... the cursed village... the Devil's dark plan is revealed in the final chapter of the Inquisitor saga. An accessible audio game with engaging game mechanics and 8 different scenarios.

name: theFisher Online
summary: theFisher Online - online wild fishing simulator. Forget about licenses and catch rates. Choose bait or lures and catch fish in Europe and Russia.

name: The Stranger: Interactive Game
summary: The Story: Your wife died in a boat accident. After the funeral for months you have been away from everyone and everything. You have retired to a farm in the middle of nowhere. But maybe.. you're not alone.

name: The Game of Life Vacations
summary: Pack your bags and whisk away your family and friends on a magical adventure, in The Game of Life: Vacations! Get ready to get lost in the first digital-only spin-off of the beloved Hasbro board game classic.

name: The Dandelion Girl: Don't You Remember Me?
summary: A short visual novel about a middle-aged man on his summer vacation, where he meets a strange girl who claims to be from the future. Adapted from a short story.

name: The Witch's Love Diary
summary: Spring is here and love awaits, an oasis just over the horizon, a beautiful story waiting to be told. Join Takumi and Alice in a tale of fleeting cherry blossoms and forgotten first love.

name: The White Door
summary: Robert Hill wakes up in a Mental Health facility and suffers from severe memory loss. Follow the strict daily routine of the facility and help him to recollect his memories by exploring his dreams. The White Door is a point-and-click adventure by Rusty Lake that uses a split-screen for interaction with the environment and protagonist. The release is planned for iOS, Android, Steam and itch.io at the end of summer 2019.

name: The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest
summary:
The Transylvania Adventure of Simon Quest is a parody/homage to NES ClassicVania and other NES titles from the era.

The titular hero, Simon Quest, has just arrived in Transylvania only to discover his vampire hunting rival, Stan Helsing, has already slain the evil Count Dracula. In order to reclaim the glory that should be his, he journeys across Wallachia to gather what he needs to resurrect the dark count piece by piece and kick his ass himself!

name: The Doulos Study
summary: The Doulos Study is a Bible quiz game. It is designed to help improve your understanding of the Bible. Have fun learning with over 90 Bible related questions, and play 4 different game modes.

name: The Governor
summary: Rebuild and battle and improve. While your city growing, fight against the criminals in new style turn-base combats. Improve yourself, upgrade your buildings and get new items. Decide and live with the consequences. Rule with fear or Justice it's all up to you. Now it's your turn to be the Governor!

name: The Searchers of Legends : Origin
summary: Psychological, story indie horror, made in the style of Penumbra and Amnesia. An interesting story with a lot of details, the ability to interact with almost all the objects around, the random of some events and the unpredictable behavior of the characters, dangers, riddles and a terrible atmosphere are waiting for you!

name: The Not Very Golden Age of Piracy
summary: This is a small, historical game.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion - Horse Armor Pack
summary: Horse Armor Pack is the first official add-on for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. It adds two different types of armor for your horse (Elven and Steel) and a quest to retrieve your first armor for free.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion - Spell Tomes
summary: Spell Tomes is the seventh official add-on for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. The add-on adds new spell books which can be randomly found while looting chests. The books contain both new and existing spells. It also adds a single new NPC who will attack you and drops a spell tome after killed.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion - The Vile Lair
summary: The Vile Lair is the sixth official add-on for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. It adds a new quest where the player has to buy all upgrades to the Deepscorn Hollow hideout (also added by the DLC), after which it becomes the player's property. The add-on also adds some new items and a new merchant to the Wawnet Inn.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion - Mehrunes' Razor
summary: Mehrunes' Razor is the fifth official add-on for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. It adds a fort called Sundercliff Watch to the game. Sundercliff Watch consists of nine larger areas (mostly dungeons) and various smaller ones. The add-on also adds a quest called Unearthing Mehrunes' Razor, where you have to retrieve a dagger underneath Sundercliff Watch, new items and characters.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion - The Thieves Den
summary: The Thieves' Den is the fourth official add-on for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. It adds a new location called Dunbarrow Cove and a quest to rid the cave of skeletons so that it would become the player's property. The add-on also features various new items and spells.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion - The Wizard's Tower
summary: The Wizard's Tower is the third official add-on for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. It adds a new tower called Frostcrag Spire, which the player can use as his house, a quest in which you have to buy "upgrades" to the tower and a new merchant called Aurelinwae.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion - The Orrery
summary: The Orrery is the second official add-on for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. It adds a new quest (Repairing the Orrery) and a location. In the quest, you have to retrieve four missing artifacts so that a mage could repair the Orrery which you can later visit to fortify an attribute in the expense of another.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion - Fighter's Stronghold
summary: Fighter's Stronghold is the final official add-on for The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. It adds a new quest where you have to rid Battlehorn Castle of marauders. After doing this, the castle becomes the player's property and has to be upgraded to finish the quest. The add-on also adds various new items and NPCs. The PC version was available for free during a limited time after release.

name: The Bard's Tale IV: Director's Cut
summary: The Bard's Tale IV: Director's Cut is the triumphant return of one of the most iconic RPG series of all-time. Delve into a tactically rich combat system that rewards creativity, solve puzzles to gain treasure and advantages, and discover a beautifully crafted world.

name: The Tales of Epicton Kingdom
summary: After hearing the rumours about the pigs, the King sent out a small squad of Knights to investigate. Switch between casual gameplay and visual novel for an even more interactive experience. Read from multiple perspectives and uncover the epic story and deeper message within...

name: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos
summary: Step into the wacky heroic fantasy universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Lead a team of unlikely and clumsy heroes in an epic and challenging tactical RPG. Live an adventure filled with humor, surprises and silly encounters.

name: The Orville: Interactive Fan Experience
summary: Step aboard the USS Orville (ECV-197), the Planetary Union's finest mid-level exploratory class cruiser. With every room on every deck recreated with painstaking accuracy, you are free to explore the ship at your leisure and engage in all manner of shenanigans!

name: The Story of Henry Bishop
summary: The story of Henry Bishop is a first-person psychological thriller, where the player will have to fight, guess riddles, immerse into a mystical plot and an incredible story.

name: The Henry Stickmin Collection
summary: The Henry Stickmin Collection is a Newgrounds choose-your-own-path classic, reborn and revitalized. This 6-game epic culminates in multiple entirely canon, extremely different endings. Each step of the journey has you choose from options such as a Teleporter or calling in your buddy Charles to help you out. Correct choices will move the story forward, but incorrect choices lead to a fail. If you get to the end on your first try, you're doing it wrong. Failing is half the fun.

name: The Last AntLion
summary: The Queen Ant doesn't like filthy half-ant, half-lion hybrids like you living in her nefarious kingdom. She has made it her life's mission to eradicate your kind from the earth. It's time to get revenge and redeem your fallen comrades. YOU are The Last AntLion. Can you survive?

name: The Backrooms
summary: You find yourself in a strange world with no idea how you got there. As you explore more, the world gets increasingly convoluted and unstable. You are now in... The Backrooms.

name: The Heroic Legend of Eagarlnia
summary: Eglia's It is a "grand strategy" game with an aerial background, with a combination of Japanese lihua and pixel art style. The game takes the aerial world as the background and designs several countries with their own characteristics.

name: The Creature
summary: You and your friends are in a dark and abandoned environment. But you are not alone. Something crashed here earlier and it looked like a spaceship. Is it hostile? Does it want to kill you? Who knows ...

name: The Cross Horror Game
summary: The Cross is the most Scary Survival horror game with creepy witch monster and ghosts.

name: The Grim and I
summary: The Grim and I is a unique 155,000 word interactive novel, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based - without graphics or sound effects - and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

name: The Legend of Paco the Jungle Duck
summary: Paco is a winged duck who, as the descendant of an ancient Inca dynasty, has the special privilege of hatching a fossilized dinosaur egg. He seems to be doing well, but then monkeys from Nazi Germany steal the egg to use genetic engineering to build a German Dino wonder weapon.

name: The Last Aura
summary: Journey through the dark ruins of The Last Aura. In this action puzzle game, you must traverse labyrinths laden with obstacles and traps. Set on floating ruins tainted by the dark, your only source of light in the face of obscurity is your own.

name: Thirteen & Half Cats
summary: You have a mysterious curse. Learn magic spells that will help you to collect 13 and a half cats and find your way again.

name: The Away Team: Lost Exodus
summary: In this interactive sci-fi adventure novel, you are the AI pilot of Earth's last interstellar ship, tasked with finding a home for your crew—the last remnants of humanity. Your choices will determine their fate, and your own.

name: The Misadventure of Melon
summary: Join Melon in this Misadventure that takes him through 6 amazing chapters, Snow, Caves, Forest, Swamp, Mountains and Corrupted lands to battle through corrupted creatures and to make your way back to the village and save the world from this evil.

name: The Tower 2
summary: The action packed sequel to The Tower. Survive a breakneck race through a world of 80s sci-fi classics! Run, swing and glide through a neon lighted homage to your favorite 80s sci-fi action movies.

name: ThreeStep
summary: Take on the wilds of Western Alaska as Sadie Kalastade, as she survives the cold wilderness and searches for closure in ThreeStep, a deliberately-paced top-down story focused exploration game.

name: The Designer's Curse
summary: The first chapter of an unforgettable survival horror experience. Solve puzzles and work your way through this terrifying place. You may be more familiar with it than you initially think.

name: The Luminist
summary: An inconvenient electrical failure turns into an unspeakable nightmare as Dietrich becomes trapped in an abandoned subterranean mining town full of horrid creatures.

name: The Council: Episode 5 - Checkmate
summary:
The Council is an episodic game that delivers a fresh new take on the narrative adventure genre. Make hard-hitting decisions, develop an array of skills, and directly impact how the story unfolds. With permanent, long-lasting consequences, there is no going back.

Checkmate is the fifth and final episode of The Council's inaugural season.

name: The Sims 4: Jungle Adventure
summary: Explore a unique wilderness landscape in The Sims 4: Jungle Adventure, a game pack for The Sims 4, revealing a temple, jungle obstacles, cursed relics and treasures. Experience the culture and customs of Selvadorada, from devouring local eats to learning spicy new dance moves!

name: The Quest for Achievements Remix
summary: The Quest for Achievements Remix is a casual pixel Role playing game where you are an ordinary gamer now tasked with the quest to save your Account as you search for answers, fight monsters and capture achievements lost in the real world.

name: The Dragons' Twilight II
summary: The Age of Dragons draws to a close, and the ever meddling Elder Dragon, Kaia, won't stop until she rights the atrocities wrought by her own kind. The forbidden resurrection is nearly at hand. What could possibly go wrong?

name: The Sims 4: Movie Hangout Stuff
summary: Why go out when you can stay in, relax, and watch movies? Invite some friends over, hang out, and have a movie marathon with The Sims 4: Movie Hangout Stuff, a stuff pack for The Sims 4. Pop a bowl of popcorn and entertain your Sims with a flick on the all-new projector screen. Chill out and relax with boho-chic outfits and effortless hairstyles.

name: The Sims 4: Romantic Garden Stuff
summary: Build a lush Victorian garden for your Sims and get ready for romance with The Sims 4: Romantic Garden Stuff, a stuff pack for The Sims 4. Set the mood with romantic, floral fashions for your Sims and share a playful moment by the magnificent water fountain. Then head over to the Wishing Well, toss in a coin, and see if your Sim's deepest desires come true.

name: The Sims 4: Kids Room Stuff
summary: Spark the imagination of Sims with new items to personalize kids' bedrooms in The Sims 4: Kids Room Stuff. Collect and trade monster cards, then bring them to life in the electronic battle station. Put on a puppet show to tell stories and entertain family and friends. Show off your kid Sims with new clothing items and hairstyles that express their style.

name: The Sims 4: Backyard Stuff
summary: Give your Sims a backyard they can really enjoy with The Sims 4 Backyard Stuff, a stuff pack for The Sims 4! Add fun lawn water slides and colorful new objects to spice up the space. Slip into something a little more comfortable, and remember to keep plenty of lemonade on hand.

name: The Sims 4: Vintage Glamour Stuff
summary: It's time for your Sims to live luxuriously with The Sims 4: Vintage Glamour Stuff, a stuff pack for The Sims 4. Dress Sims in stunning vintage fashions and accessories, then try on makeup at the vanity table. Adorn your Sim's home with high-end furnishings and even hire a butler to fulfill their every need.

name: The Sims 4: Bowling Night Stuff
summary: Build a bowling hangout and take your Sims to the lanes for an evening of fun with The Sims 4: Bowling Night Stuff. Compete against friends and improve your bowling skills to unlock trick shots. Customize your alley with bowling-themed décor and give your Sims a striking new look.

name: The Sims 4: Fitness Stuff
summary: Elevate your Sim's fitness and embody an active lifestyle with The Sims 4: Fitness Stuff. Challenge your Sims to scale the rock climbing treadmill as a fun way to burn energy and improve their physique. Choose from a collection of fashionable activewear, and decorate your Sim's home with nature-inspired objects and décor.

name: The Sims 4: My First Pet Stuff
summary: Teach your Sims how to care for smaller household pets, decorate a home with pet-inspired furniture, and dress pets in your favorite Sims outfits with The Sims 4: My First Pet Stuff, a stuff pack for The Sims 4!

name: The Backrooms Simulator
summary:
Find out what happens when you no-clip out of reality. Explore the Backrooms, a place filled with the stench of old, moist carpet, the hum-buzz of fluorescent lights, and only the comfort of knowing you might not actually be alone in approximately six hundred million square miles of randomly segmented empty rooms. 
SYSTEM REQUIREMENT

name: The Gun Knight
summary: The Gun Knight is a free top down arcade game with procedurally generated levels, dozens of guns and spells, and tons of baddies to mangle.

name: Think_
summary: A normal rhythm-combat RPG in which nobody can die.Maybe.

name: Theater Commander: The Coming Wars
summary: A real-time modern warfare simulation game on campaign and battle level, Theater Commander features more than a dozen scenarios covering hypothetical conflicts around the globe involving current air, naval and land force from 17 countries.

name: The Fate of the Bully
summary: Let me introduce myself, I'm a mugger, a thief. Do not rush to turn away from me his "Holy" face. Every one of you could be in my place.

name: The Werewolf Hills
summary: The Werewolf Hills is a First Person Shooter that tells the adventure of a person that get lost in a mysterious mountain where a fierce monster lays in the nights.

name: The Unclearness
summary: You are going to try your luck in the role of a private detective Stan Ingram and try to solve a tricky case of suicide.

name: The Dreadful Whispers
summary: A handcrafted adventure about overcoming fear and doubt. Will you defeat your inner demons or be crippled with regret ?

name: The Driver's Mission
summary: ''s Mission is a very challenging multi-mode racing game. Aside from regular racing modes which requires players to get to the finish-line first, this game includes modes such as "championship cup", "Police chase mode" , "Police officer mode","1vs1 mode", "Drag race" and "Elimination".

name: The Stars Between Us
summary: Step into VR and take part in a love story that is out of this world! The vastness of space separates our two heroes, and only you can bring them together. Experience intuitive and immersive gameplay as you travel between planets and stars, solving 3D puzzles at your own pace.

name: The Grand Heist
summary: Grand Heist is the engaging game that allows you to be part of thief team in 1930 is. Action packed strategy with an interactive environment.

name: This was for you
summary:
These memories are all that's left...
this was for you. is an interactive visual novel, originally created for NaNoRenO2019.

name: The Ultra Code
summary: Build machines... break codes... win the war! It's 1942 and the world is engulfed in war. Meanwhile, in a country mansion in South East England, a group of expert mathematicians are fighting a war of their own, breaking an unbreakable Nazi code... Enigma!

name: The Portal Dimension
summary:
Run, Jump, Attack, Dash!
The portal Dimension is a fast-paced 2D scrolling action game. The variety of mysterious dimensional armies has released several bizarre creatures to attack the innocence from various worlds.

name: The Man with the Ivory Cane
summary: If all the world is a stage, what role do YOU play? Solve the Ivory Cane mystery to find out!

name: The Machine That Breathes
summary: A tunneling machine finds itself injected into a body resembling a human. Conditioned without a purpose and no mortal coil to subsist from, what then spews forth?

name: The Lost
summary: A game about danger, fear, survival... The Lost - is a sandbox, PvE open-world survival game.

name: The Captain is Dead
summary: It's the last 10 minutes of your favorite sci-fi TV show... except that this time things have gone seriously wrong and The Captain Is Dead! This turn-based, survival strategy game puts you in the Captain's chair as you try to save your crew from being blown to bits by aliens...

name: The Raintime
summary: Delve into a troubled student's mind as his grasp on reality slowly unravels . . .

name: The Treasures of Montezuma 4 Easter Bundle
The Sword and the Slime
summary: The Sword and the Slime is a unique take on the 2D puzzle-platformer where you play as a flying sword and find an unlikely ally in a slime. Using only the mouse, protect and guide your companion through a dangerous dungeon full of nasty monsters and cruel traps.

name: The Castle
summary: Evil has taken over a small town. But a group of courageous adventurers has decided to organize an expedition to end the feared vampire. Recruit a group of characters to enter the castle and fulfill your mission. But get ready because the castle hides many surprises.

name: The Last Spell
summary: Defend the last bastion of humanity with your squad of heroes! Exterminate fiendish monsters with magic and brute force by night and re-build your battered city defenses by day in this tactical RPG with rogue-lite mechanics.

name: The Escapists 2: Game of the Year Edition
summary:
The Escapists 2 is the forthcoming sequel to the sandbox prison-escape game which will include, in a first for the series, drop in/drop out play for up to four players in both local and online play.

The Game of the Year Edition will include all 11 prisons from the base game and all Escapists 2 DLC and impenetrable penitentiaries such as Wicked Ward and the Glorious Regime!

name: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu
summary: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu is a maze-based action role-playing arcade game Player need break throught Tower resuce princesses and escape TigerQiuQiu as you get your way to the top of the TigerQiuQius Tower

name: The World Ends with You: Solo Remix
summary:
The World Ends With You: Solo Remix, the mobile version of the critically acclaimed action RPG, brings players back to the streets of Shibuya as Neku with new tracks and new social gameplay elements specifically designed for mobile players.

Activate combat abilities, or “psychs,” with simple touch commands like tapping, slashing, and dragging. Control Neku and his partner on the same screen and take the combat up a notch, and boost item drops in battle with the revamped Fusion system. Enjoy the game in full HD. Art and animation across the game has been redrawn for this release, making combat a beautiful experience.

Composer Takeharu Ishimoto’s complete soundtrack is included in the game with high-quality audio and full vocals, including remixes and new songs. Exchange profiles with other players, and their avatars will appear in the streets of Shibuya! If friends have Twitter accounts, their avatar will think their latest tweet, and players can receive free items for every trade!

Finish the main story to unlock a bonus chapter, more quests and items to find, new combat challenges, and secret reports that further flesh out the story.

name: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
summary:
The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is a Korean survival horror-adventure. As Mina Park, you must venture from your deserted school to survive. Explore the surrounding Sehwa district to uncover the shadow realm's secrets and avoid the psychotic killer hellbent on ending your life!

The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is an atmospheric, story-driven game. Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

Heroines, forced to confront their worst fears, rarely emerge unscathed. Over the course of the story, Mina will encounter dangerous scenarios from which she could sustain permanent damage. Craft items to anticipate future dangers to avoid injury.

Dark Song is now more fearsome and powerful than ever before. Falling into her grasp could spell instant death. Running and wielding your flashlight makes you an easy target. You must precariously balance the urgency of exploration with your absolute need to survive!

name: The Library of Babble
summary:
Deep within the computer, a library grows. 
 
Wander through a gentle garden of words, an endless oasis of serenity. Discover the mumblings and memories of other storytellers, and be inspired to leave your own. 
 
 
Best encountered over a warm mug of coffee (with your fondest cassette mix-tape) and snuggled up on a cold winters morning, the Library Of Babble is an experimental prototype designed around smaller acts of storytelling and prose, and the wish for more-intimate spaces of shared asynchronous communication.

name: The Pilgrim
summary: Explore a strange and mysterious world, searching through the environment for symbols that will open the way forward.

name: They'll Find You
summary: A retro horror game that places you as a small child against a variety of monsters in an isolated mansion.

name: The Pointless Car Chase
summary: Drive fast, and escape the never ending horde of police in Pointless City.

name: The Falconeer: Revolution Remaster
summary: The Falconeer is an open-world air combat game, featuring frenetic aerial dogfights and deep exploration of the mysterious open-world of The Great Ursee. Generations of poisonous decisions and treason swirl in the deep, as factions clash in a fight to preserve the past or flee its terrible consequences.

name: The Eternal Cylinder
summary: In The Eternal Cylinder, players control a herd of adorable creatures called Trebhums and must explore a strange alien world filled with exotic lifeforms, surreal environments, and the constant threat of the Cylinder, a gargantuan rolling structure of ancient origin which crushes everything in its path. This unique ecosystem is a massive, procedurally generated land with unique animal AI, real-time world destruction, and organic exploration and puzzle design to create emergent gameplay that ensures no two playthroughs are ever the same.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Thieves Guild
summary: Join the Thieves Guild in Hew's Bane, a never-before-seen area of Hammerfell! Explore Abah's Landing, a decadent port town ruled by corrupt merchant lords, who struggle with the Thieves Guild for power. New stories, delves, group bosses, and much more!

name: This is the Only Level
summary: The elephant forgot the rest of the levels, but luckily he still has one left! Help him beat it in all his metagaming glory. Use your keen knowledge of gaming and dexterity to manhandle your way through a variety of challenges. Get your mind out of the box for once! Take it outside for a walk, or maybe grab a bite to eat with it.

name: The Cult: Marduk's Longest Night
summary: In a world where nothing is as it seems, join Caleb Marduk in a race against time to find his daughter. Explore Harvester City's slums, meet demons and legendary creatures, escape the summoners of The Cult and delve into Marduk's shadowy past in the first episode of his adventures.

name: The Touryst
summary:
Discover exotic islands, explore ancient monuments, uncover secret passageways, and make the trip you always wanted in The Touryst

You are just arriving at the Monument Islands. Want to go swimming? Or rather take a dive into the deep sea? Or do you want to visit the amusement arcade, do some shopping, dance at the beach party? Fancy some surfing? Or will you talk with the strange old tourist and listen what he has to say about these ancient mysterious monuments..

name: The Big Con
summary: Flex your inner teenager in The Big Con, an adventure game where you hustle across the country as a teen trying to save your family video store. In classic 90s con movie style, you'll get to persuade and pilfer your way to greatness using a whack of potential grifts.

name: The Wind and Wilting Blossom
summary: Navigate the war-torn lands of a randomly generated Heian period Japan in this FTL-style roguelike.

name: TheMovingMaze
summary: A traditional maze awaits you, and you'll enjoy the old days

name: The Lewd Knight
summary: Help the girl - a superhero in the fight against evil

name: The Shattered Blade
summary: This Game is a pure action platformer,in this game you will control a very fast character,slash in endless danger, meet insane enemies and crazy traps.

name: The Need for Speed Collection
summary: A collection of five classic Need for Speed games, released in 2003 in North America.

name: The Yakuza Remastered Collection
summary: This collection includes remastered versions of Yakuza 3, Yakuza 4, and Yakuza 5. All three games have been upgraded from 720p at 30fps to 1080p at 60fps, and include content never-before-seen in the original Western releases, including Mahjong, Shogi, and the ever-popular Cabaret minigames.

name: The Legend of Tobimaru
summary: A challenging old-school platforming adventure that sees you learning Nimpo skills and using them to fight your way through the most powerful ninja warriors.

name: The Dealer
summary: The Dealer is a dialogue driven game that takes place in the fictional version of the United States, set against catastrophic economic and political situation. You play as a street dealer in the most troubled city of the country. To survive, you have to sell everything you can get and face hard moral decisions.

name: The Dark Eye : Book of Heroes
summary: Book of Heroes is a classic role-playing game with a clear top view. The character mode is extensive: players can choose from 12 different professions and four species and adapt the appearance of their character as they wish.

name: The Love
summary: Amy wakes up in a strange room. She seems to have lost all her memory. She only knows that there is a blue monster under the same roof. She needs to avoid the weird monster and escape from unknown houses. As time passed and groped, the weird monster tried to give her an Injection of a drug.

name: The Suicide of Rachel Foster
summary: Coming back to the family Hotel after years, a strong-willed woman finds herself trapped with the ghosts from her past and a cellular telephone as the only way to unveil a terrible truth.

name: The Settlers II: History Edition
summary: The Settlers II: History Edition is modernized version of the highly detailed and humorous economic simulation. As leader of the Romans, you take over the responsibility for the fate of your people. Withstand the elements and be aware of your opponents: Vikings, Nubians and Japanese. Includes The Settlers II, The Settlers II Mission and the map editor. Some of the improvement highlights include: Windows 10 compatible, auto save, different resolutions including full screen, mouse, keyboard, and controller support for split-screen mode

name: The Settlers IV: History Edition
summary:
Experience in this modernized History Edition, the beauty and wonder of the world of The Settlers with four playable races: the Romans, the Vikings, the Mayans, and the Trojans. Face the threat of the Dark Tribe and his leader Morbus.
It also includes The Settlers IV, The Settlers IV Mission CD, the add-on The Settlers IV – The Trojans and the Elixir of Power and The New World addon.

name: The Devil's Womb
summary: First chapter of the saga, The Devil's Womb is a free "Made in Italy" classic puzzle adventure-horror title produced by Insane Kat Studio and made with RPG Maker MV.

name: The Hero
summary: "The Hero" is an open world action adventure game . The story takes place in two cities in two different ages with two different playable characters. The first is : Newyork (USA) in an imaginary gloomy way and the second story: London (United kingdom) in 1802 at the Fraser campaign on Egypt.

name: The lost dungeon of knight
summary: The Lost Dungeon Of Knight is a first-person adventure game with puzzle elements.

name: The Wanderer: Frankenstein's Creature
summary: In this exploration/adventure game, you play Frankenstein's Creature, a being with no memory and past. At the start of the game you know neither Good nor Evil, you are a blank soul in an adult body. By exploring the world, you will experience your emotions, develop and write the first pages of your story. When confronted with mankind, there will be no way to escape the question of your origins: Who abandoned you in this world? Hunted by this question The Wanderer: Frankenstein's Creature will take you on an adventure throughout Europe. Your experiences - some brutal and tragic, others joyful - as well as your choices, will bring you closer to the truth with every step. But will you be ready to face this truth?

name: The Flower on Christmas Eve
summary: This is a galgame independently produced by a small team in China. The CG, character figures, BGM and background graphics are made right according to the scenario to maximize player's immersion into the story.

name: The Legend of Sword and Fairy 7
summary: The Legend of Sword and Fairy 7 is an action role-playing game developed by Softstar Technology (Beijing). The story revolves around a conflict encompassing the three races of humans, gods, and demons. The combat system has undergone major changes compared to previous games in the series. Instead of a traditional turn-based system, it uses third-person real-time combat.

name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Little Hope
summary: Trapped and isolated in the abandoned town of Little Hope, 4 college students and their teacher must escape the nightmarish apparitions that relentlessly pursue them through an impenetrable fog.

name: The Watchers
summary: The Watchers is a co-op horror puzzle game in which two players take control of a brother and sister searching for clues about their mother's disappearance. Work together to discover the truth as you explore the abandoned headquarters of a local cult. But be careful. You're being watched.

name: The Terrible Old Man
summary: Experience a bite-sized slice of Lovecraftian horror in this updated version of our cult freeware point and click adaptation of HP Lovecraft's classic short story.

name: The Young Gabriel King Chronicles
summary: The Young Gabriel King Chronicles is a free 2D click-and-point adventure game. It features an inventory. The game can be controlled via mouse and keyboard. As young Gabriel King you get thrown out the camping wagon by your mother in order to search for a replacement of a book she is reading and also get a lighter. It is a very short game and takes place on one screen. Unlicensed spin-off / fan game of the Gabriel Knight series.

name: The Addams Family: Mystery Mansion
summary: Get creepy and kooky with the Addams family! Get legendary sweethearts Morticia and Gomez plus Wednesday, Pugsley, Uncle Fester and more. Build them a house that's the stuff of nightmares! And don't forget to decorate it! Enjoy a mysterious and spooky story that unfolds as you play!

name: Throne Quest Deluxe
summary: Throne Quest Deluxe is a seem-less open-world Action Role Playing Game (ARPG). Delve into an adventurous world full of dungeons and crypts, fighting many types of vicious monsters and search for huge amounts of loot. Change between 12 classes throwing your axes, fire, harps and even a djenty-guitar in fast-paced combat whilst gulping potions and collecting drops to level-up and become a champion. Explore your way through the dangers of the lands on an epic quest to reach the central castle- to claim the Throne held by a demon boss.

name: The Sims 4: Realm of Magic
summary: Explore a supernatural world and master the art of wizardry in The Sims 4: Realm of Magic, a game pack for The Sims 4. This countryside town may look and feel like other neighborhoods, but once the secret portal is unlocked, the true magic begins. Potions, wands, and even a floating world will charm your Sim, but beware of spells gone wrong! Learn the craft of wizardry, summon a familiar for protection, and immerse yourself in this spellbinding realm.

name: The Climate Trail
summary: The Climate Trail is a Free multi-platform game about climate refugees fleeing ever worsening conditions after inaction on climate has rendered much of the USA (and the world) uninhabitable. The game combines the adventure and play of the journey north with visual novel elements where characters reveal how and why this climate apocalypse unfolded.

name: The Cases of the Thousands Shogi Records
summary: This is a mystery adventure in which you set out to find out where one of the strongest shogi masters disappeared off to.

name: The Caligula Effect: Deluxe Digital Bundle
summary:
The Caligula Effect: Deluxe Digital Bundle includes: 
 
Game 
Swimsuit DLC 
Original Vita theme 
19 Avatars

name: The Crew 2: Steelbook Gold Edition
summary:
Take on the American motorsports scene as you explore the USA in one of the most exhilarating open worlds ever created. With a wide variety of vehicles to choose from, experience the thrill and excitement of competing across the USA as you test your skills in a wide range of disciplines.

Get The Crew 2 three days early with the Gold Edition. It also features:
• SteelBook
• Season Pass
• The Crew 2 Motorsports Deluxe Pack, which includes:
• Ford F-150 Raptor Race Truck 2017
• Abarth 500 2008 Monster Truck Editions
• Pilatus PC-21
• Three outfits to customize your avatar

name: The Pillar
summary: Welcome to "The Pillar"! Escape Room Game leading to mystery Island.

name: The seven deadly seas
summary: Enter the seven deadly seas! Create your crew and become the most feared pirate on the ocean. But be aware! You are not alone! You are not the only one seeking such glory. Kill or be killed. It's your Choice.

name: The Fisherman: Fishing Planet
summary: The gold standard for fishing games, now available in a complete version! Experience all the fun of the sport and hone your skills in single-player or multiplayer mode. Exclusive content: the new map of Creuse in France, the trolling technique and four new fish.

name: The Clique: Diss and Make-Up
summary: Use gossip, fashion, and wit to make friends, join cliques, attend classes in The Clique: Diss and Make Up.

name: The Cowlitz Gamers' 2nd Adventure
summary:
A full-fledged co-op platformer for your NES.

Looking for Lost Adventure? It's here. Play alone or with a friend as you help Kaylee–and her brother, Justice–run, jump, duck, and climb their way out of perilous mines and up a massive tower! Collect gold, uncover diamonds, reveal secrets, and unlock new characters as you traverse the treacherous terrain and avoid the creepy crawlies that lie ahead

name: The Secrets of Jesus
summary: The Secrets of Jesus is a classic point & click adventure game, which tells an old tale in a completely new manner.

name: The Powerpuff Girls: Relish Rampage - Pickled Edition
Those Chosen By God
summary: Those Chosen By God Is a story driven, text heavy rpg that's more story than gameplay. It follows the life of Aden. (Pronounced in game as /ah, den/ ) Born into an appalling void known as the world. Aden must fight both mentally and physically If he wishes to survive the cruelty thrown at him.

name: Thy Kingdom Crumble
summary: Ascend the crumbling ruins of a fallen kingdom using the mouse to aim your jumps in this vertical platformer. Collect silver and acquire new abilities as you rocket, swing, teleport, fly, and claw your way to the top.

name: The Long Drive
summary: Random generated open world semi-post apocalyptic survival car driving game.

name: The Ancient Labyrinth
summary: The Ancient Labyrinth is a survival horror game inspired by games like Alien: Isolation. Set in Ancient Egypt, your aim will be to escape from a labyrinth by exploring the environment, solving puzzles and above all surviving a dangerous creature that will hunt you for the entire duration of the game.

name: The Rising of the Shield Hero: Relive the Animation
summary: The popular anime `` The rise of the shield brave '' by Aneko Usagi appears in RPG! Not only can you experience the famous scenes in anime, but you can also enjoy the world view of "The rise of the shield hero" as a game, such as a battle system and a commerce system that make use of the characteristics of the main character...

name: The Deed II
summary: Can you commit the perfect murder? Outside a brothel in 1930s Paris, a man recognises one of the orderlies who had cruelly abused him while he was in a mental asylum. Some deeds cannot be forgiven ...

name: The Dukes of Hazzard
summary:
Driving around in the car known as the "General Lee", you must avoid all sorts of obstacles in an attempt to catch up to Jeremiah Stinge. Beware though as Boss Hog and his police force are trying to chase you. The Duke boys are as usual on the side of right in this scenario and it's Jeremiah who has orchestrated things to put them on the wrong side of the law.

The gameplay is a top-down view of your vehicle heading down a path vertically across the screen. Also on the screen is your speedometer, a bonus timer (faster times mean more points!) and a gear shift. The General Lee itself has gears 1 through 4 and higher gears mean MORE SPEED. As for obstacles, the path ahead of you is full of hills and oil slicks making it difficult to catch up to (and pass) your prey.

name: The Space Between
summary: The Space Between by Christoph Frey is a surreal short narrative experience in three acts about the walls we build for us.

name: The Best of Microsoft Entertainment Pack
summary: The Best of Microsoft Entertainment Pack (BOMEP) was a collection of thirteen 16-bit simple games sold separately from Windows. It was published in the Microsoft Home series of software. They were selected as the best games from the previously released Microsoft Entertainment Pack series.

name: The Eye of Borrack
summary: The Eye of Borrack will take you back to yesteryear, with our take on the classic text adventure. You'll put the world of action games to one side, as you delve deeply into a rich, funny, imagination lead, text adventure.

name: The Klaxo Radio Hour
summary: A perfectly safe radio that is not haunted. Offering a rare chance to be a part of Radio History!

name: The Inanimate Mr. Coatrack
summary: A Bawdy Buddy-Comedy Adventure

name: The Heart Pumps Clay
summary: In The Heart Pumps Clay, players take control over Mara, a swamp witch, her golem, Bud, and the aptly named Crow as they climb the Tree of Life in order to obtain the Source of All Things.

name: The Elysian Fields and Other Greek Myths
summary:
The Elysian Fields and Other Greek Myths is a classical Greek themed graphical adventure game for the Apple II.

Game is played via typing VERB NOUN commands. All graphics are displayed using colored graphics, and there is also an option for a text-only mode.

name: The Video Game Machine
summary: The ultimate video game sandbox! Create, explore, and survive across a retro gaming universe. Gather heroes, forge weapons, and build worlds - the adventures are endless!

name: The Deep Deep
summary: The Deep Deep is a tactical dungeon crawler in a side-scrolling environment. Explore dark mines, ruined cities, and lava-filled caverns; solve puzzles and battle enemies to unlock dwarven classes and find treasure.

name: The Museum of Anything Goes
summary: The Museum of Anything Goes is an adventure game where the player explores a virtual museum while discovering artifacts, sculptures, and writings.

name: The Day We Fought Space
summary: A wreck-em-up with unique touch-screen controls, physics-powered chain reaction combat, and over-the-top customizable weapons.

name: The Puppet of Tersa: A Curious Place
The Second World
summary:
The Second World is a turn-based strategy game set in a science-fiction scenario. The play world is divided into 25 countries and four opponents (optionally all of them can be controlled by humans) want to become the leading force. This is either achieved by gaining control over 15 countries (either by buying them or with force), driving all competition out of the business or getting a certain amount of victory points with economic or belligerent achievements.

Gameplay focuses on economical management and can be seen as expanded Kaiser. During each round (which represents three months), the player can adjust the setting screws of the countries, e.g by hiring agents (can be sent on special missions like assassinating an opponent), stock dealing, trading produced goods, setting the tax or starting a war. Especially important is constructing buildings like hospitals or plants. All those factors determine the statistics of the country, e.g. productivity, prosperity or the death rate. A killed ruler will be replaced by offspring if available. Gameplay is menu based with the exception of smaller action sequences.

name: ​The Ninja Saviors: Return of the Warriors
summary: Based on the 1994-released The Ninja Warriors: Again, which is a Super Famicom arrangement of the 1987-released arcade game The Ninja Warriors, ​The Ninja Saviors: Return of the Warriors is a 25-year-later remake from the Tengo Project main staff that brought you the original games. While retaining its 16-bit style, The Ninja Warriors: Once Again significantly enhances the character resolution, pattern amount, and more to match the latest hardware. In addition to two new playable characters, ​The Ninja Saviors: Return of the Warriors implements a two-player co-op mode that was not available in The Ninja Warriors: Again.

name: The Dark Wish
summary: You came to the silent village in the middle of the woods. It should be your first real commission. But you discovered that man who brought here is gone. All people are gone. And you have to figure out what happened. Suddenly you realize, your'e not alone. And sometimes it's better to be alone.

name: The Wizard Sniffer
summary: You were recently acquired by the brave Ser Leonhart and his squire to sniff out the evil shapeshifting wizard. Unfortunately, you are not a wizard sniffer (if such a thing even exists). As far as you can tell, you are an ordinary pig.

name: Throw the Ball in the Hole
summary: Just how accurate are you? In this VR-game you literally have to throw the ball in the hole, that's it! You'll soon find out it's much easier said than done. With 15 unique puzzles, each one offering a different challenge. You will have to combine precision, speed, and a little creativity to even complete this game.

name: The Survivor
summary: You received an invitation and were told to come to a villa in the suburbs to receive a huge amount of inheritance. Because of the desire for money, you readily agree to the invitation. When you arrive at the villa, you discover the truth is that if you want to get a huge amount of inheritance you must win a killing game.

name: THE ART: Metamorphosis
summary:
The Art is a puzzle game where you have to arrange the fragments of the picture in the correct sequence. You are going to see a lot of artwork in a variety of styles and genres of painting. By experimenting with the message that artists put into their work, you will be able to comprehend a little more in the art than can be seen at first glance by most of the people; you will be able to let a bit of art through yourself and finish the started artworks.
And in doing so, you will help the artist finish the paintings, and she will be gradually letting you in on her work in return by telling you more about her work and her passion. You will see most of her works, as well as be able to directly influence her success. Will she succeed or not – it depends only on you.

name: The Bunker 69
summary: After 20 years of living in a terrible post-apocalyptic world, you find yourself in a miraculously undiscovered bunker, which... is filled with food and beautiful girls. It seems that your life will now go according to a completely different script, but...

name: The Amazing Shrinking Man
summary: An action game by Infogrames in which the player has to help the shrunken Professor Nitro to regain his normal size.

name: Three of a Fish
summary: The classic and many favorite genre of three in a row is now on the theme of fish. Move similarly colored fish in a row vertically or horizontally to...

name: The Bonfire 2: Uncharted Shores
summary: Build, survive, explore. Design your city, manage resource chains and workers, Send ships on expedition, trade with cities, discover mysterious dungeons and uncover secrets of ancients.

name: The Magician's Research
summary: The MAGICIAN'S RESEARCH is an RPG style IDLE - INCREMENTAL - MANAGEMENT Game! The Experiments of the Mage's Guild have broken out and you are tasked with tracking down, researching, and disposing of them before they can disturb the nearby towns or multiply!

name: That's How Sumireko's Roach Stomping Mafia Works
summary: A platformer game jam project featuring Sumireko Usami from Touhou Project, where she must stomp on cockroaches consecutively using air dashes.

name: The Shape You Make When You Want Your Bones to Be Closest to the Surface
The Doll Shop
summary:
Doll Shop is an adventure game based on the Japanese countryside. It is half romance, half horror. The Doll Shop will let you choose your fate.
But maybe you're already doomed...

name: The Testimony of Trixie Glimmer Smith
summary:
After finding the cursed play 'The King in Yellow', Trixie Glimmer Smith, a slacking student at Bluebell University recounts the terrible events that set her a week behind in her coursework.

This story follows on from the events of Parsnip with a host of new characters and an expanded world, although you can still enjoy it without playing Parsnip.

Trixie is around 3-5 hours long, if you want to play all the content.

name: The Grisaia Trilogy
summary:
The whole "The Fruit of Grisaia" series in one bundle!
All of the episodes below from "The Fruit of Grisaia," "The Labyrinth of Grisaia," "The Eden of Grisaia," and "The Fruit of Grisaia -Side Episode-" in one bundle for your enjoyment!

name: The Curse of RA
summary: The Curse of RA is an Amiga logical game arcade game released in 1990 by Rainbow Arts.

name: The Get Out Kids
summary: The Get Out Kids is a narrative puzzle experience. An original story, each chapter unfolds within a 3D diorama, leading to a conclusion you will never see coming.

name: The Deepest Sleep
summary: Here you are, at the final depth. Danger lurks behind every corner, even the Shadow People are afraid of this place. Will you be able to get back to the surface and wake up? Or will you remain here forever?

name: The Pinball Wizard
summary:
Oh, young Apprentice! Atop the Mountain of Shadow, at the foot of the castle tower, the wisdom bestowed upon you shall come to pass. A pinball dungeon crawler awaits to test your skill!

Ascend the castle tower. Level up your skills. Fulfill your destiny. Become the wizard you were born to be!

The Pinball Wizard is an arcade adventure game where the main character is propelled into action by a set of flippers, like the ball in a pinball machine. Each level of the game is a contained area inside a tower. The goal of the game is to survive and get to the top of the tower.

name: The Rainbow World
summary: Explore a vibrant world in this action adventure RPG where you get embroiled in a war between the 7 major races of the rainbow world.

name: The Empire's Crisis
summary: The Empire founded three centuries ago by Tyrell, Humanity's greatest champion, teeters on the edge of collapse. It falls to you, formerly a mercenary, to prevent their fears from coming to fruition, while experiencing the rich history and characters of this troubled land.

name: The Alien Cube
summary: A disturbing reality is about to be unveiled, something that mankind should never know. After a mysterious finding, unexplainable facts occur and strange happenings will lead you to doubt the world around you. Uncover an otherworldly secret and explore forbidden places to find out the truth.

name: The Chasm
summary: Lovecraft. Procedural generation. Roguelike experience. Digging. Cosmic horror. The Chasm has opened.

name: The Far Rings: A Space Opera Visual Novella
summary: Choose your path in this short, densely-packed space opera visual 'novella', where one full play-through can be finished within an evening! With what consequences will your path lie? Choose wisely, as your decisions may lead you to one of seven potential endings.

name: The Legend of Viccess
summary: Official exchange group QQ: 497587042

name: The Slormancer
summary: Fight hordes of enemies lead by The Slormancer, an evil warlock from the past, in an absurd yet epic Action RPG! Featuring loads of shiny loot, tons of collectibles, countless hours of content, a frenetic gameplay and carefully crafted pixel art.

name: The Light Remake
summary: There is only you, the abandoned remains of a former life and the flourishing nature that feels great in the absence of man. This world is both gloomy and empty, but so incredibly beautiful.

name: The Yellow Ladder
summary: Fight through enemies with multiple tools and shut down a massive computer in this frantic, action-packed side-scroller!

name: The Yellow King
summary: A dark horror mmo inspired by the writings of H. P. Lovecraft. Infinite dungeon exploration, boss raids, guilds, pvp, leaderboards, and the destruction of your soul by an uncaring immortal elder god slowly devouring the universe.

name: The Legend of Crystal Valley
summary: The Legend of Crystal Valley is an indie point n' click adventure game, based on story and exploration, set between the real and the fantasy world.

name: Three Little Bears
summary: A great adventure of three little bears. Be the bear you want to be or... be them all. Riddles, puzzles and quite a lot of magic. Three bears, three adventures, one big goal. Can you reach it?

name: The Hunter's Journals - Blissful Ignorance
summary: A desperate cry for help...can YOU solve the mystery?

name: The Maze of Horror
summary: You wake up inside a horrible maze of terror. The unknown dangers lurk behind every corner and the exit is locked. Make your way through the Maze and find the three skulls to escape the horror of the Surreal maze.

name: Through the Dust
summary: Through the dust is a survival game with sandbox elements. Overcome a hot, dusty canyon to survive.

name: The Exorcist: Legion VR - Deluxe Edition
summary: The Exorcist: Legion VR Deluxe Edition is a complete collection of all FIVE chapters of the acclaimed VR experience based on The Exorcist franchise. Investigate and exorcise sinister demonic entities as you make your way to a final confrontation with your darkest, most hidden fears. HTC Vive, Oculus Rift/S and Valve Index.

name: The Bloodline
summary: An open, freeform Adventure RPG that lets you play your way. Reforge bonds between kingdoms, explore the wilds, craft and plan adventures and wield mighty weapons or magic as you prepare for what is to come…

name: The Void of Desires
summary: The is space filled with rumours of the temple, in which any desire can be fulfilled. Many tried to find it, but only two space refugees managed to discover it, whose planet was destroyed by the halfgod Constructor. Now they have a long path ahead - straight to the wishgranter.

name: The Guise
summary: Dark-fantasy metroidvania, where you turned into a monster with weird abilities like walking on the ceiling, acid spits and bile bombs.

name: The Room VR: A Dark Matter
summary:
The British Institute of Archaeology, London, 1908: The disappearance of an esteemed Egyptologist prompts a Police investigation into the unknown. Explore cryptic locations, examine fantastic gadgets and uncover an otherworldly discovery which blurs the line between reality and illusion.

Designed from the ground up for the unique capabilities of virtual reality, players can inhabit the spine-tingling world of The Room and interact with its strange contraptions in this compelling new chapter.

name: The Legend of Edgar
summary: When Edgar's father fails to return home after venturing out one dark and stormy night, Edgar fears the worst: he has been captured by the evil sorceror who lives in a fortress beyond the forbidden swamp. Donning his armour, Edgar sets off to rescue him, but his quest will not be easy. The Legend of Edgar features large levels with different environments, a variety of weapons, a persistent game world that can be travelled through, boss battles, lots of sound effects and music tracks, joypad support with configurable controls, and configurable keyboard support.

name: The Almost Heaven Crisis
summary:
The Almost Heaven Crisis is an isometric survival game. The world plays on whether you take action or not. Day becomes night, blue skies turn to thunder and lightning. And zombies will take over the world unless you stand up and fight against them!
The other villagers aren't useless- they will try their best, and those armed with guns will attempt to take down the zombies. However, the zombies are fast-moving and strong and with out your help it could be a lost cause.

name: The Game Paradise: Crusin Mix Special
The Haioku Byoutou
summary: The Haioku Byoutou is an Adventure game, developed by Intense and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2008.

name: The Shouboutai
summary: The Shouboutai is a Simulation game, developed by Tamsoft and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2008.

name: The Pyraplex
summary: Transcend the boundaries of space and time to construct a colossal new wonder of the world in this pyramid-building adventure!

name: The Quest Trio
summary: The Quest Trio is a puzzle game compilation featuring three distinct matching experiences across African and Asian settings. Players follow Rupert Pack's search for a legendary jewel board while engaging in jewel-matching, mahjong tile arrangements, and solitaire card challenges. The collection includes Jewel Quest Expeditions, Jewel Quest Solitaire, and Mah Jong Quest: Expeditions, offering varied puzzle mechanics that combine exploration themes with traditional matching gameplay. Each game mode presents different objectives, from restoring world balance through tile matching to pursuing fortune through card-based adventures.

name: The Trump
summary: The Trump is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Vanguard and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2006.

name: The Wonder Pets!: Save the Animals!
The World of Golden Eggs: Nori Nori Uta Dekichatte Kei
The Adventures of 00 Dilly
summary: After Crash-Test-Dummy 00 Dilly withstood several tests in the 1950s and was thrown into the dump, some confused aliens mistakenly breathed life into 00 Dilly. WOW! OK, 00 Dilly is definitely not too bright, but he wants to prove to the world that he's the right test dummy for any kind of test.

name: The Last Crystal
summary: The Last Crystal is a co-op adventure game for 1 or 2 players. Team up to explore a dangerous magic temple with its lively forest and dark caves, defeat epic foes, join helpful allies, acquire unique powers and solve enigmatic puzzles to unravel the secrets behind the last and most powerful crystal.

name: The Bomb Project
summary: Bombs come falling from the sky, destroying the terrain around you. Face the chaos with the help of one of five agents and their special abilities. You must survive the bullet hell alone, or together with a friend's help... or nuisance.

name: The Unicorn Princess
summary: Explore the world on horseback and help the inhabitants of your village. Befriend Unica the unicorn and try to save the Dream World by completing all your missions!

name: The Loopholes Chronicles
summary: The Loopholes Chronicles is an escape game in virtual reality. In a futuristic fantasy universe, you will travel through time and time to solve unique riddles.

name: The Room Syndrome
summary: Explore the mysterious room by traversing time, while you watch a man succumb to the room syndrome.

name: The Black Rose
summary: The Black Rose is a first person, psychological horror experience. The player is invited out on a date to the Black Rose bar, however once inside they soon discover that something is terribly wrong. Explore the nature of the Black Rose and venture deep into its belly. Interact with objects and find hidden notes left behind in order to discover the dark truth; the further in you go, the more secrets you will uncover. You are not as innocent as you may think...

name: The Hikyou Tankentai: Choutoko Special
summary: The Hikyou Tankentai: Choutoko Special is an Action Adventure game, developed by Japan Art Media (JAM) and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2009.

name: There is a Thief in my House
summary: How is the life of a thief? While others are at work, you break into their house, doing some renovations and taking their TV and Game consoles because they don't need them anymore!

name: The Button Witch
summary: Adventure game full of magic, puzzles and cute characters, featuring a young witch-in-training and a talking ghost-squirrel!

name: The Endless Summer: Search For Surf
summary: Open World Two Player 3D Surfing Physics Game. Learn to surf, explore the tropical islands by jet ski or land, find new surf spots, challenge your friends to a contest.

name: They Can't Stop all of Us
summary: D.A.B. Your foes in co-op & PvP battles. (D)efend bases with weapons and skill. (A)ttack with clever AI armies. (B)uild amazingly creative defenses.

name: The Arcana
summary:
Enter the interactive world of Vesuvia, the most captivating visual novel full of mystery, love, and romance.

Choose your preferred pronouns, make your own choices and romance to your heart’s desire! The Arcana is LGBTQ+ friendly.

name: The God of Crawling Eyes
summary: The God of Crawling Eyes is a game about Max, a color blind high school student who's taking an experimental drug to cure his condition. As he goes about a normal school day, he begins to see strange and frightening things. The player controls Max as he tries to figure out the school's mystery while getting help from his friends Chase and Lily.

name: The Settlers: Heritage of Kings - Legends Expansion Disc
summary:
The Settlers: Heritage of Kings - Legends Expansion Disc is the second add-on for Heritage of Kings: The Settlers.

Besides five new single player- and ten new multiplayer maps, the add-on also features four new campaigns

name: The Settlers: Heritage of Kings - Expansion Disc
summary:
The Settlers: Heritage of Kings - Expansion Disc is the first add-on for Heritage of Kings: The Settlers.

After the defeat of Kerberos, the old empire flourishes under the rule of King Dario and finally the dream of peace and prosperity seems to come true. But far in the east of the old empire, on the shore of the river Nhern, a bridge is being build. A bridge to the legendary old lands of Hen Brughs. But as the impressive structure grows and grows, the fear of the workers also increases. They see strange, shadowy creatures roaming on the other side of the river. Watching every move the builders make and waiting for them to come. Always surrounded by a fog that seems unreal and very cold.

name: Three Ghostly Roses
summary: Tackle the twisted and miserable with fists of determination.

name: The Marionette
summary: Martin is a bachelor and sculptor struggling to make a living in the city. One evening he finds in his mail a strange white envelope, unmarked except for the number "1011" written in the top right corner. Inside is a photograph of a room with ropes hanging from the ceiling. He has barely registered that fact when he is struck unconscious, and later wakes to find himself in completely unfamiliar surroundings, with only a house nearby to offer any hope of help...

name: The Yakutsu Noroi Game
summary:
The Yakutsu Noroi Game is a Japan-only PlayStation horror visual novel game that is sequel to Yuujou Dangi.

The protagonists visit an abandoned school at midnight to dig out a time capsule they buried when they were in elementary school. The trip turns out unexpected.

name: Three Guys That Paint
summary:
This is a romance visual novel. Nigel is a house painter. While trying to earn money with his two colleagues and taking care of 6-year-old Alicia, Nigel decides to take in a new tenant: Morwenna.
Despite being new to this whole 'parenting' thing, Nigel is becoming a good parent for Alicia. She and Nigel are having a pretty okay life. However, there have been recent reports of mysterious disappearances around the neighbourhood. And Morwenna seems to be acting stranger and stranger...

name: The Secret Society - Hidden Objects Mystery
The Tomorrow Corporation Collection
summary:
This digital compilation contains: 
 
- Human Resource Machine 
- Little Inferno 
- 7 Billion Humans 
- World of Goo

name: The World Next Door: Deluxe Edition
The Final Station: The Only Traitor
summary: While the train is heading to the Final Station, you are going on a road trip through the dying world, with the ultimate goal of finding the last remaining shelter. You’ll discover new locations, revisit familiar places, encounter new dangerous enemies, and find more clues about the mystery of Visitations.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel II - All Ride-Alongs
summary: This DLC includes All Ride-Alongs from The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel II

name: The Bard's Tale IV: Director's Cut - Deluxe Edition
The Tenth Line: Special Edition
summary: In The Tenth Line, you'll guide the princess of the tiny nation of Easania, along with her unusual but reliable companions, and explore a vibrant world of humans, beasts, and dragons, while escaping the clutches of a mysterious cult in hot pursuit.

name: The Banner Saga 3: Eternal Arena
summary: Take up your axe and enter the Eternal Arena and quick-play new, unique challenges! Customize your own maps, rules, and enemies to create unique tests of skill. Become the stuff of legends by conquering the weekly tournament and competing against the world for the high score.

name: The Last Federation: The Lost Technologies
summary: Dozens of new technologies, a new technology-focused game mode, and technology "side effects" on even existing techs. Champion enemies also make their first appearance in combat. Plus new turrets, abilities, events, alliances, a new planet, type, and more!

name: The Escapists 2: Wicked Ward
summary: Things have taken a strange turn in the locked off rooms of an abandoned hospital. Once again, you'll have to craft, fight and scheme your way to freedom from this eerie supernatural slammer.

name: The Escapists 2: Glorious Regime Prison
summary:
Experience the thrill of escaping the hidden compound deep in the jungle. You'll need determination and drive to avoid the unquestioningly devoted guards, constant surveillance, and the illustrious Leader himself, in your bid for freedom.
And remember to praise your Glorious Leader!

name: The 25th Ward: The Silver Case - Digital Limited Edition
