name: The Black Grimoire: Cursebreaker
summary: Immerse yourself in a medieval fantasy world in this classic top-down single player adventure RPG. Journey through a sprawling open world and progress through dialogue options to uncover the story of Rothar Aercrest - the cursed lord to the remote lands of Imberthale.

name: The Most Boring Game Ever
summary: Clicker Simulator experiment to give you the feeling of being bored. Spacebar away and zone out.

name: The Golden Cross
summary: The Golden Cross is a plot based game targeted at causal gamers who enjoy a mix of dialogue, action, adventure and puzzles. Or those players that need a break from their intense hard core games. So take a trip back to the basics and easy play. Try the free demo then decide if it's a game for you.

name: The Monster of Memory: Destiny
summary: Winning the 8th Golden Manga Award in Taiwan, The Monster of Memory: Destiny has been adapted from the manga of the same name! Memory... Does it represent all a person has? Represented in the form of a visual novel, the ultimate in brotherly love...

name: The Annoying Game
summary: Run, jump, die, repeat. Help Teddy on his journey through the complex, 2D dungeon, where every step will try (and usually succeed) to kill him. Are you patient enough to finish one of the most difficult games of the year?

name: The Sunken Hero
summary: The Sunken Hero is a game, in which one bullet and your equipment will not survive, sending you to the forefathers. Be careful and do not let yourself be intimidated by some sea monsters. Show dexterity and ingenuity. A variety of weapons, nice graphics and music for true connoisseurs of the genre.

name: The Elf's Lewd Training
summary: In this game, players subject the elf queen Elfin to lewd sexual training.

name: Thyra Adventure
summary: Thyra Adventure is a game based on medieval history. Become a warrior and save the middle earth from Zarod's hands, going through traps, facing warriors and magicians along the way.

name: The Line
summary: Reinventing of 3D puzzles. Experimental gameplay you've never seen before.

name: The Great Art Heist
summary: You play as Jack a kid who loves art ever since he could remember. His parents took him to many museums when he was younger, ever since he has wanted to collect art pieces. Take on contracts or collect for yourself.

name: The Curse of Mantras
summary: Play as Lily or Ace and with the help of 10 different avatars (each one a potential love interest) remember their past and discover if you can escape the Afterlife. With optional card battle gameplay.

name: The Lost and The Wicked
summary: The Lost and The Wicked is a Brutal Twin-Stick Psycho-Thriller. You wake up surrounded by strange creatures, confused with no memory. Explore the world, defeating monsters and bosses along the way to uncover more about this place, who you are, and how you got here. Are you lost or are you wicked?

name: The Enemy Below
summary: Escape from the depths of a top-secret research facility as you slash through creatures like giant mutant aliens, robot demons, and countless other experiments gone wrong. Inspired by classic games like Half-Life, Quake, and Doom, The Enemy Below raises the bar of what a modern retro-FPS can be.

name: The Station: Escape Room
summary: Escape the confinement of the space station and restart the systems to gain freedom. Cooperative Escape Room style game to challenge yourself and your friends. Seven rooms to solve the amazing and challenging mysteries before the timer runs out!

name: The Arena Guy
summary: It's a really hardcore challenge. How long can you survive on this arena?

name: The Last Saviour
summary: A first-person shooter in the style of survival and science fiction. Before you stretches a huge unexplored forest. Which is beautiful during the day and very scary at night. But be careful! At every step you can expect a werewolf who can take over your mind.

name: The Chronicles of Moses and the Exodus
summary: Enjoy the classic story of Moses and his quest to lead his people to freedom in the epical match-3 game "The Chronicles of Moses and the Exodus". When Moses flees Egypt after turning against the Pharaoh, he has no idea that God has great plans in store for him...

name: Throw Knives
summary: Throw Knives is a new casual and addictive retro-style game that will help pass the time at lunch, at work, during insomnia. Its essence is to compete in throwing knives at a tree. Sounds simple, but it's actually not that easy. Try to hit the target without hitting other knives.

name: The Sims 4: Bust the Dust Kit
summary: Dust off the vacuum and tidy up with The Sims 4: Bust the Dust Kit. Dust is piling up and spawning friendly bunnies and dastardly filth fiends in Sims' homes. Get rid of the muck by cleaning, or settle in for a messy life. Conquer chores with new buffs and rewards for each dust level, vacuums to help fight the good fight, and aspirations related to cleanliness.

name: The Hopebringer
summary: The Hopebringer is a storyline driven action RPG featuring procedurally generated dungeons and a skills based leveling system. The last great human settlement has fallen. Mankind's final hope has been rotting away in a cell for the past twenty years, with no memory of their past.

name: The Gap
summary: The Gap is a sci-fi first person narrative exploration thriller. You play as Joshua Hayes, a neuroscientist who's lost it all. Your mysterious ability to explore parallel realities through deja vu seems to be the only way to recover your memories and salvage your life.

name: The Death Into Trouble
summary: Help The Death to undo his mess, collect souls between heaven, purgatory and hell. Run, Jump, Hide and Explore!

name: The Sundew
summary: You are Anna Isobe, a cyborg cop abandoned by progress and thrust into the midst of a global conspiracy. Experience classic point and click gameplay as you travel across the dark future, and make choices that will seal the fate of the world.

name: The Origin: Blind Maid
summary: Play the role of a corrupt politician who fled from justice who has searched a place to hide himself in an area full of old and dark legends. A first person terror adventure that will take you to find the dawn of evil. Will you survive to the Blind Maid and being able of find out her terrible Origin?

name: The Slaughter: Magdalene
summary: A short interlude from the world of The Slaughter.

name: The Penguin IQ Test
summary: Are you intelligent enough to save the penguin? Help him get back to the ice floe. This test will measure your IQ and give you a result between 0 and 180.

name: Thief Girls Quartet
summary: Thief Girls Quartet tells the story of a group of thieving girls who steal valuable treasures that an evil merchant has hidden in a giant tower. The thieving girls can move around freely using wires. Let's find the treasure that lies at the top of the tower together!

name: The Call of Paper Plane
summary: Welcome to the relaxing adventure game paper airplane. Move the paper plane up and down to avoid obstacles, leap over fields, towns, forests, and many other scenes. Listening to the music, let us go on a fantasy journey with the paper plane.

name: The Altered Lands
summary: Start your journey in a dark medieval world. Prepare to face challenging enemies with swords, bows, and powerful spells. You can choose whether to sneak as a stealth or perhaps by fighting fiercely with the long Sword.

name: The Gold River Project
summary: Single or multiplayer open world camping adventure game where you and your friends are offered a remote camping trip. One week turns into several as you suspect your guide is never coming back. Deserted, you discover you are trapped in an experiment to see if you can survive.

name: The Chatters Show
summary: The Chatters Show is designed for Twitch streamers and their chats. Create questions sets and play with your chat to see who is the smartest person.

name: The Little Black Bestiary: A Midsummer Night's Barcrawl
summary: A modern fantasy visual novel dating sim where you attempt to woo an astoundingly wealthy fae businesswoman.

name: The Third Day
summary: The Third Day is a biblical science fiction adventure game in which we must guide Jesus in search of the truth through a story full of humor and satire.

name: This Is Not Chess
summary: A turn-based tactics game about goofy characters with wide and varied techniques duking it out across a bright and colourful battlefield.

name: The Last Plague: Blight
summary:
The Last Plague: Blight is an extremely challenging and realistic single-player top-down perspective survival game.

The game takes place in a time long ago, just as a new disease called the Blight appears out of nowhere and begins enveloping the world. You escaped as it took over your village and now find yourself alone in the wilderness, tired and hungry.

The game is for players that are looking for an immersive survival game experience with a decent amount of realism and depth. All the while trying to manage the countless threats the wilderness and the Blight throws at you.

name: The Chewllers
summary: The Chewllers is an online, multiplayer, VR game. The project presents stylized and comic nature, where 4 players protect the tower from monsters in Co-op mode.

name: The Legend of Tianding
summary: The Legend of Tianding is a sidescrolling action game about Liao Tianding, the legendary Taiwanese Folk Hero. Explore the dazzling streets of Colonial Japanese Taiwan in the early 20th century, as you rob the rich, feed the poor, and expose the darkness lurking in the heart of Taipei.

name: The Longing Ribbon
summary: You and two friends find yourselves lost in the woods one day and decide to seek refuge in a nearby mansion. Certainly nothing could go wrong; people do that sort of thing all the time, don't they? But what you are about to discover is that this is no ordinary mansion, and its inhabitants are no ordinary people...

name: The Count of Monte Carlo
summary:
The game is Blackjack, but not as you know it. The wager is your life, but you do not plan to lose it.

Beat the house and double down on the double-dealers who sealed you away. Experience a twist on both a classic card game and a classic novel.

name: The Knight of Nephiart
summary: The Knight of Nephiart sees players leading a party in an adventure to take on a great evil. The game features a first-person perspective and turn-based combat.

name: The Crystal Rainforest
summary: The game takes place on the planet Oglo. In the kingdom of Azon, the last remaining rainforest is being cut down by the antagonistic "Cut and Run Gang". The king of Azon ordered the Cut and Run Gang to stop threatening the rainforest, and is shortly shot by a poison dart. The two protagonists must take part in a variety of settings and activities to retrieve the magical rainforest crystals to save the king and stop the deforestation of the planet.

name: The Hundred Year Kingdom
summary: Create a world free of conflict in this innovative turn-based simulation. Work together with a mythical young goddess to develop a peaceful civilization over the course of a century.

name: The Visitor
summary:
Gather round, kids, it's time for some
story-telling. You got the lights off and curtains down?
Then let's start.

Let's go back in time, to the year 1913.
We're going to follow the story of a normal,
but yet not so normal family.
It all started when the family inherited
a big mansion from the mothers
now deceased uncle.

They weren't rich by any means, but they also inherited
quite a bit of money.
So they thought: "Wow, living in a mansion,
let's try it out!"
Ah, the young and foolish.
Would there be any stories to tell without them?

Alright kids, let grandma Agatha guide
you through this night of horror.
You like scary stories, don't you?
Because if you don't...
Shoo! Go away!

name: The Luffeltera Renovator
summary: The Luffeltera Renovator is a repair craft simulation game that completes a large-scale repair of the magic tower of the forest (commonly known as the light blue tower). Regain the brilliance of the decaying magic tower! Collect and craft materials! Sell it, fix it, and cultivate it! Let's complete a large-scale renovation once every 100 years with our friends!

name: The Use of Life
summary: The Use of Life is a “game book”-style multi-ending JRPG. The main character’s various “attachments” fluctuate in accordance with the choices the player makes, and the ending changes depending on “the use of life” you choose through your journey.

name: Thin Walls
summary: Iki had lost her voice due to previous events and thus only speaks internally. She wakes to find herself alone in her home with only the comforting voice named -Lo who resides in the walls of her home. A thunderstorm rages outside her window and seems to create strange objects in her home. She may unravel the events that caused her trauma or let them consume her, all the while being pursued by a dark faced, yet familiar stranger.

name: The Lost Night
summary: You wake up in the middle of a spooky town trying to find your way back home. Help the citizens of this weird town and they will open paths for you.

name: The Door
summary: The Door is an escape room game with teleportation based puzzles. Planned for a full launch at some point in the year 2021. The initial publication was July 9th of 2020, and is playable on Windows, and Android.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki - Spriggan Edition
summary:
The Spriggan Edition is a Japan-only release that includes:

- Game: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki
- The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki Soundtrack Mini with Tall Case
- The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki Early Materials Book: "To The Land of Origin and Dawn"
- The Arcride Solution Office Character Data File

name: The Poisoned Roots
summary: The Poisoned Roots is a narrative driven game about abuse, obsession, and the dark secrets of a troubled American home. It's a short game, and is intended to be played in a single sitting.

name: The Machine's Garden
summary: Uncover the mystery of the Machine's Garden as you make your way through this short and atmospheric narrative-puzzle game.

name: The Dark World: Edge of Eternity
summary: Enter the cursed realm of Pannonia in The Dark World: Edge of Eternity, a modern-day survival RPG blending gothic horror with brutal action. In a land divided between vampires, werewolves, witches, and humans, survival is never guaranteed. Explore an open world torn by ancient grudges, uncover the secrets of the Book of Blood, and face terrifying world bosses in a dynamic cycle of raids, dungeons, and survival mechanics, player-driven choices to shape the fate of a dying world.

name: The Anacrusis
summary: The Anacrusis is a four-player, cooperative first-person shooter set aboard a massive starship stranded at the edge of explored space. Team up with your friends in an infinitely-replayable fight against alien hordes to unlock perks, weapons, and new ways to play that you can share with your team!

name: The Last Oricru
summary: The Last Oricru is an action RPG with a strong emphasis on storytelling and player choices. The player is awakening in a sci-fi medieval world at a time of war and starts influencing the destiny of a whole nation. Game is designed as both - single-player and a coop experience.

name: The Chant
summary: The Chant is an action horror game set on the tormented grounds of a new age cult, that fulfills players' thrill of supernatural horrors dealing with the dark sides of spirituality and cultism, and untangles terrifying revelations about the universe.

name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: House of Ashes - Pazuzu Edition
summary:
The Pazuzu Collector's edition, exclusive to the Bandai Namco Entertainment Store includes:

- The House of Ashes game
- The Pazuzu edition box
- An exclusive Underworld creature figurine (9x9x10cm)
- A metal Eclipse pin
- Exclusive art print
- Exclusive stickers
- Access to the Curator's Cut DLC

name: The Last Cove
summary: A gripping, explorative tale of a father and daughter both desperately clinging to life in their final enclave. The father trying to find his daughter one last time, while she moves further from his grasp. Join them on a journey within The Last Cove.

name: The Depraved Vampire Slut
summary:
A casual hack n' slash RPG!

Doris is a vampire that awoke in a graveyard one night. After asking the nearby nun, she discovers that the mysterious Lord of Monsters stole her castle and all her possessions 100 years ago. Doris flies into a rage and sets off into demon territory to take back what's rightfully hers.

name: The Outer Worlds 2
summary: The Outer Worlds 2 is the sequel to the award-winning first-person sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment.

name: The Crystal Golem
summary:
The Crystal Golem is a short but hard action game, inspired by Dark Souls and playing old games without a manual.

Will you be able to destroy the corruption from the Void and restore Humankind?

name: The Fast and The Furious
summary: The Fast and the Furious (Wild Speed in Japan) is a racing video game licensed by the film of the same name. The game was released in several versions, first was the so-called "2D version" developed and published by I-Play for mobile phones and released on March 4, 2004 and then the so-called "arcade version" developed and published by Raw Thrills for Arcade in July 2004 (the game is a spiritual successor to the saga Cruis'n; containing similar elements and the design of Eugene Jarvis), and later I-Play releases the so-called "3D version" developed by Juice Games for mobile phones in September 2005.

name: The Sims 4: Cottage Living
summary: Delight in the quaint charm of The Sims 4: Cottage Living, an expansion pack for The Sims 4, with animal friends, garden-to-table meals, and a close-knit community. Explore the forest to befriend woodland creatures, or head to town to meet the locals. Whether Sims are hugging a cow, making friends (or enemies) with their chickens, or growing the biggest vegetables around, the countryside presents abundant new ways to reconnect with the world.

name: The Sims 4: Dream Home Decorator
summary: Turn your client's fantasy into reality with The Sims 4: Dream Home Decorator. Every home is full of unrealized potential, and only you can take it from drab to fab. If you want to build your professional reputation, get to know every Sims' Likes and Dislikes before you start designing, then deliver the perfect renovation for each client. Once you've worked your magic, get ready to see the astonished look on your client's face with the big reveal!

name: The Swordsmen X: Survival
summary: It's a martial art open world adventure game that combines survival and crafting. Built with Unreal 4 engine makes it perfect to collect, create, explore and manufacture in a world covering an area of 256 square kilometers. Fight back enemies and eventually become a well-known martial art hero.

name: The Immortal Mayor
summary: The Immortal Mayor is a construction & management sim game where you play as a local deity that watches over the land. Befriend other gods and use magic to help your residents build the town, thereby earning the offerings of your people and growing your town.

name: The Shape on the Ground
summary: This software is not a game. A cross between a walking sim and a tarot card reading, TSOTG asks you to find 12 evocative dioramas and answer a single question: What do you see? Answer instinctively and receive one of five different endings and a final reading meant to stimulate self-reflection.

name: The Tale of Bistun
summary: The Tale of Bistun follows an amnesiac stone-carver on his journey up the slopes of the Mount Bistun. He’ll have to battle legions of monstrous foes using fast-paced, melee combat and powerful magical abilities as he explores the real world and the mysterious place, known as the Revelations Realm.

name: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos - Ruins of Limis
summary:
Experience the first ever DLC for hit RPG parody The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk!
In Ruins of Limis, the party faces a whole new batch of terrifying enemies, including vampires, zombies, necromancers and chickens. Expect new missions, challenging battles, side quests, new factions, and fresh laughs, as the unlikely heroes set out to discover the sinister secret of a haunted tavern.

name: The Seagull
summary: A young woman grows up on the shores of a lake and loves it as the gulls do, and is as happy and free as they are. But a man happens to come that way and destroys her, just because he can.

name: They Are Here: Alien Abduction Horror
summary: They Are Here is a first-person horror story about a journalist who witnessed an alien abduction at the Grayswood farm. Explore the area armed with a flashlight. Take photos of evidence of aliens presence and get to the bottom of the horrifying truth.

name: The Colorful Creature
summary: A difficult platformer with the main mechanic of changing color in order to stand on colored blocks to progress. Play over 200 levels with unique items with diverse gameplay that have many items and hazards, in-game level editor, local multiplayer, endless run, customizable skins & hats, and more!

name: The Daunting House
summary: You are a Paranormal Researcher who accidently crashed in a village near foothills of Himalayas along with his colleague, you find yourself trapped in a chaos. Something seems very strange about this place, you have to make a safe escape, try finding some help in the mysterious house. Good Luck.

name: The Power Latch Kid
summary: Play as the Power Latch Kid in this classic arcade style twin-stick shump! Enjoy the complex gameplay experience of physics melding with shooting anarchy! How long can you stand to dwell within the crushing madness of the Amalgotron before you succumb to its mighty insanity?

name: The Dark Pictures Anthology Triple Pack
summary:
This triple pack includes:
- The Dark Pictures - Little Hope
- The Dark Pictures - Man of Medan
- The Dark Pictures - House of Ashes
- 3 x Exclusive Collectible Pins
- The Dark Pictures Anthology World Cloth Map
- 4 Disc Steelbook

name: The Last Chimera
summary: This is RPG use only mouse. The player "chimera" changes to next generation by execute specific events. You will know the meaning of "your birth" when you get to "that place". There are three levels of difficulty. If it's "Easy", you can enjoy the story purely without any trouble.

name: Thirty Minute Nightmare
summary: A short and sweet Survival Horror story with terrifying environments, a dark-ambient soundtrack and creatures hiding behind every corner. This is both a 90's classic PSX-style experience as well as a horrifying modern day adventure: The era and style of graphics is your choice. Good luck...

name: The Last Yandere: Cursed Dark
summary: The Last Yandere: Cursed Dark is a horror visual novel that takes place within the mythology of the AppSir Games Universe. You play the role of an amnesiac trying to find his place in the world after losing his memories three years prior. Soon after, he meets a mysterious woman named Kara.

name: The Village
summary: The Village - is a game that links some traditional occidental cultural's elements (poetry, classical music and myth) and standard 2D rpg features (mainly influenced by SNES and PS1's 2D rpg).

name: The Magic of Three
summary: The Magic of Three - is a hybrid puzzle platformer and match 3 genre. If you love puzzles, this is the game for you. Using the skills of the golem, you have to collect all the "Stone Orbs of Knowledge". To do this, you will have to use your brains, because not everything is so simple.

name: The Legends in Kylamar
summary: The Legends in Kylamar is an action, thrilling turn-based RPG that will immerse the player in a world filled with enemies, surprises, and more importantly, memories!

name: The Terrible Persistence of Memory
summary: When you wake from a deep sleep, the first thing the goblin doctor asks is "What's your name?" The problem is: you don't know. Retrace your steps. Find what you've lost. Piece together who you are from the strange and incredible things you can do

name: Thousand Lives
summary: This is a game as beautiful and unpredictable as life. Navigate what fate throws at you and explore what a life well-lived can mean in this minimalist roguelite role playing life simulation. Life is wild and then you die - a thousand times over.

name: The Pirate King
summary: imagine you wake up in a sea world, and you have to become a pirate, so if you want to survive, you should gather all materials needed to build your own ship to travel the world and To return to the real world,By finding the lost treasure.

name: The Dinosaurs Are Here
summary: The Dinosaurs Are Here is a physics-based sandbox game set in a huge park where you control a dinosaur. Hunt for humans and try to survive against the park security guards!

name: The Mountain Hunting
summary: Whether you hunt freely in the open world with the "Free Hunt" mode, or try to complete the missions given to you with the "MISSION" mode. Besides that this mode also includes interestingly extraordinary missions from time to time.

name: The Last Poem: The Trials of Poe
summary: The Last Poem - The Trials of Poe is a third person action RPG set in the mid-1800s that sends the player into the shoes of Edgar Allan Poe. It combines combat elements like those found in Dark Souls and related games with the RPG and travel elements found in games such as Kingdom Hearts.

name: The Faraway Land
summary: The Faraway Land is an open world survival simulator. Plunge into the relaxing atmosphere of a magical world filled with cute and dangerous creatures.

name: The Court of Wanderers
summary: The Court of Wanderers is a puzzle game focussed on logical and spatial reasoning. Enter an open world where you never know what you will find behind the next door. Wander, think, solve, and be amazed as the impossible becomes possible.

name: The ordinary case of Margaret Luoni
summary: The ordinary case of Margaret Luoni is a sci-fi detective game with a deep story. Help Detective Dirk understand what happened, explore a new futuristic world. There are no obvious solutions here, find your own approach to witnesses and look for hidden places and clues to discovery.

name: The tram of wishes
summary: The meditative journey game about a tram driver. He is a sincere but humble dreamer who loves his job. And he also knows how to show love and sensitivity, like reading other people's desires. But what to do about it?

name: The Wind: A Story of Surrender
summary: A short side-scrolling platformer about a little bird who lost the ability to fly. With about 40 minutes to an hour filled with parkour and puzzles, this cute little story aims to teach an important lesson to people who struggle to overcome emotional trauma.

name: The Isle of Elanor
summary: You wash ashore on The Isle of Elanor, the last bastion of humanity remaining in the world. The situation on the island is grim. You're given a small plot of land. Can you help humanity survive?

name: The Secret of Dyes
summary: A puzzle game about dye three primary colors, lowpoly style, fresh painting style, let's explore the secret of dye!

name: The Handbook
summary: Embark in a chaotic quest in a fantasy world to save a small town from certain destruction. Play as the great wizard Tim in an RPG while learning powerful spells and leveling your character. Explore the world, find its secrets and unravel the story behind The Handbook.

name: The Little Tank Hunter
summary: Your mission is to destroy the tank master, can you do it? Shoot yourself through various levels and collect coins. Be careful, if you die you lose some of them. Find the hidden emeralds and use them to upgrade your tank.

name: The last tank fight
summary: A 2D tank battle from a top corner, you can choose different combinations of module parts to complete the game, some levels have some weird and strange design, there are boss battles, there is a certain story line.

name: The Story of Qingzhi Town
summary: The betrayal of your partner makes you choose a different life. Although you have a vengeful heart, in this complex world, you still have new hopes and choices. Do you want to live with a mission, or let go of your obsession, or run your own hospital,or do you want to kill your enemy?

name: Thirty Two HardMod
summary: Go on a little adventure with a yellow cube. This is a minimalistic platformer in which you have to collect coins on levels to get to the next level.

name: The Unnamed Game
summary: The Unnamed Game is a top-down hardcore online game where you beat monsters to survive on a cursed reality.

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as an Orc
summary: That Time I Got Reincarnated as an Orc follows Okubo Tatsuya. He is a 35-year-old convenience store clerk. He is an introvert, has no friends. One day, he received a text message signed "The Goddess": "Do you want to be a hero in another world?" Accidentally, he reincarnated in another world and became an orc...

name: The Evil King
summary: Text-Based Game, Adventure Game

name: The King's Cards
summary: A deckbuilding roguelike where you use and collect cards, explore 3 mysterious areas, and battle monsters. Collect powerful area-specific cards to deal massive damage to your opponents, and see if you can find your way through each level

name: The Bounty Huntress
summary: In this a Metroidvania style game made in crispy pixel art, Join Rhea , a bounty huntress with a task to save some people who have been kidnapped and taken to an old abandoned castle where there are many dangers, she needs your help to rescue these people and to bring peace to the city of Vaunard

name: The Game is ON
summary: Boris wants to learn English, but he's having problems with idioms. Solve wacky puzzles to discover hidden phrases and help him out. The Game is ON.

name: The Grotto Diary
summary: The Grotto Diary is a Oriental style horror game. In the midnight, Hua Xiaoxi was on the way home as usual, but she felt the strange look behind her. She never expected that she would be in this peaceful neighborhood, with a sense of evil is following her. Can she get out of danger? nobody knows.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Yukon Valley
summary: Referred to by some as "The Last Frontier" and "The Land of the Midnight Sun", it's hard to deny that Alaska is a place of untamed natural beauty. Under the watchful gaze and devoted care of warden Jim Murray, Yukon Valley has become a haven for knowledgeable hunters and ecologists, looking to maintain the delicate balance of the...

name: The Weald
summary: Following the last of the Salem Witch Trials, a Puritan father claims to have had a vision showing a place where his missing son might be, and suspects a witch is behind his abduction.

name: The Great Empire: Relic of Egypt
summary: Stop a fuming pharaoh from ravaging an island paradise and send his mummified army scrambling for safety as you rebuild and defend your land!

name: The Unmarked
summary: This family friendly first person shooter is full of adventure, places to explore, and a story to be unfolded. You explore a incredible hand designed world full of secrets and hidden Items, Your goal is to unfold the story of the lost soldier.

name: The Legend of Fjarri
summary: The Legend of Fjarri is an adventure action game focused on discovering a deep plot full of myths, legends and an ancient fight against an evil foe, all set in a beautiful world for you to explore.

name: The Last King's Archer
summary: Survive the night killing enemies using your bow, Fire Dragon or Thunder Dragon special attacks in this wave based 2D platformer packed with a lot of action and upgrades. Can you last until daylight?

name: The Corruption Within
summary: The Corruption Within is a psychological thriller first-person point & click adventure game set in the Victorian era, with an emphasis on strong narrative, intriguing characters and puzzle-solving.

name: The Headsman
summary: The Headsman is a game about the everyday life and work of an executioner in a medieval city. Enforce punishment, use stocks, flog, hang and behead! Ask questions later...

name: The Palace on the Hill
summary: An open-world adventure, exploration game where you tend to your farm, talk to villagers and collect stories from them to make beautiful Indian miniature inspired paintings in your own unique way.

name: The Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle
summary:
The Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle for the Game Boy is a port of the game called Mickey Mouse, which is, in turn, a port of the Famicom Disk System game Roger Rabbit (known in the West as The Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle, NES version).
It is a portable port of the first Crazy Castle game.

name: The Z Land: FPS Survival
summary: The Z virus infected the planet, and you are one of the last survivors! Alone or in groups you will have to survive in a hostile world populated by living dead!

name: The DangerZone
summary: No more glitches, no more ID conflicts, no more lag! This game has been built simply & beautifully from the ground up! The best part is... it will run on almost any computer! You won't need a gaming computer for this one... it's a game for everyone!

name: Thrice in a row: A new adventure
summary: Continuation of the great puzzle. Available 28 completely new levels. Thrice in a row is a logic game for creating chains of identical elements. The goal of the game is to put in a row from 3 identical elements, get points and go to the next level There are also bonuses.

name: The Scorchfarer
summary: A scarred kingdom, a mourning god and an unfulfilled promise made with the past. Uzu and Zuhaar, two continents ravaged by a cosmic event are the setting of The Scorchfarer. The story follows Mikaela and Yukiharu, a Terramagus team tasked with healing their world and unraveling its secrets.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki SC Evolution
summary: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki SC Evolution is a remake of The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki SC. The remake brought many changes to visuals, presentation and gameplay including updated art, music and new voice acting.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki the 3rd Evolution
summary: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki the 3rd Evolution is a remake of The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki the 3rd. The remake brought many changes to visuals, presentation and gameplay including updated art, music and new voice acting.

name: They Speak From the Abyss
summary:
Venture into the Abyss and face strange and horrifying monsters in this bone chilling RPG.

With the spirit Sophia at your side, you must venture into the nightmare-ish world of the Abyss in order to escape. Monsters will block your path, will you be strong enough to conquer them, or will you perish and join the other lost souls who roam the depths.

name: The Zodiac Trial
summary: The Zodiac Trial has begun, and everybody's life is on the line! Will these 12 jurors be able to solve the mysteries and cooperate, or will they resort to betrayal, deception, and violence? Get out alive or die, die again!

name: The Dilma
summary: The Dilma is a game that mixes horror with a little political humor. With the antagonist being the ex-president of the Federative Republic of Brazil, Dilma Rousseff.

name: The Theater
summary: A horror game where you are in an empty cinema, with only a ticket seller, explore the entire cinema and try to escape from it.

name: The Medium: Two Worlds Special Edition
summary:
The Medium: Two Worlds Special Edition contains:

The game
Exclusive SteelBook
Soundtrack of the game
32-page hardcover artbook

name: The Morning Star
summary:
Waking up in a field off a 2-lane highway isn't the best start to anyone's night. Especially when you don't have a single clue how you got there to begin with.

Unfortunately, it's what Alec has to deal with tonight. It's cold, the wind's bitter, and he simply can't remember what happened earlier in the night. It must have been something big.

At least he finds a bus stop for shelter, but given it's a bus stop, he's not the only one there waiting.

Alec has two choices before him. Ignore the stranger's attempts to converse (he could be a serial killer, after all) and wait for the bus, or engage him (what else is there to do stranded at a bus stop) and see what happens.

The choice is yours.

name: Thermo Sudoku
summary: How does Thermo Sudoku work? Well each sudoku grid contains thermometer shapes (often drawn to create themes) and digits on thermometers must increase as one moves further from the bulb end. The interactions between the thermometers leads to new logical ideas and patterns that completely refreshes the standard sudoku solving experience.

name: The Wanderer Vibes: Neon
summary: Play as the wanderer known as Key, as they check out what happened to the music of the Neon Vibe Realm. With their trusty key tar, and the aid of a van driving jellyfish, they set out to defeat the ghostly Maestro!

name: That Which Faith Demands
summary: Work as a contractor for Ichor Extractions, Inc. and visit the site of a fallen mech to extract valuable materials and glean as much profit as you can before the work day ends. Gossip with coworkers, rend flesh from the bones of the divine, and try not to piss off your boss.

name: The Cost of Recovery
summary: What would you do if someone close to you suddenly went through major trauma? What sacrifices would you be willing to make to keep your family together? Experience the different perspectives and emotional journeys of four protagonists when their worlds are suddenly turned upside-down.

name: Themes of Dark and Light
summary: Themes of Dark and Light is a 2D puzzle platformer where changing the colour theme will alter the environment.

name: The Fear Island
summary: The Fear Island is an online co-op survival horror game where players accidentally land on an island full of supernatural entities and need to find an escape vehicle and its necessary resources.

name: The Epic
summary:
A plot-based Open World, Skill-Driven ARPG in the reinterpreted world of Russian fairy tales, telling the story of species segregation that turned into class and religious war.

The key mechanics of the game are centered around exploring the vast and dynamically changing world. The gameplay is based on an atypical isometric RPG combat system that makes each battle difficult, forcing you to look for an approach to a specific type of enemy.Opponents' blows are strong, and their behavior in battle requires learning and forming tactics or choosing another area for research.
The open world changes depending on the behavior of the player and the freedom of action allows you to play a role, without being tied to be good or bad.

name: The Amethyst Stones
summary: Zoe explores the intense origin story of her father to identity and find the clues and Amethyst stones to save her sister from a blood illness and survive the lost island from a young woman to a hardened survivor.

name: The Frosts: First Ones
summary:
An adventure about searching for a missing hunter and meeting with alien beings!
Explore wild nature, follow the friend's trail, climb on a rock, lure out a boar, meet a wolf, survive in a rockfall. Heal a deer and trick a creature!
Meet the Unknown!

name: The Exclusion Zone Online
summary: MMO First-person shooter with RPG elements. The usual laws do not apply here, there are no police and law enforcement agencies - so the zone attracts people who want to avoid justice. And various anomalies and their creations attract scientists, mercenaries, hungry for profit, and ordinary stalkers.

name: The Exomachinist
summary: Explore a strange alien world in this real-time strategy/action game and fight the forces of the Exomachinist.

name: The Absolutely Hilarious Cat Game
summary: The Absolutely Hilarious Cat Game is exactly what you would expect it to be, the only thing is, things take a dark turn when you wake up in a place you shouldn't be... Wrong place wrong time I suppose... Watch out, Felines are on the prowl in Ginger's Peak. Get the job DONE, then GET OUT!

name: The Chronos Principle
summary: The Chronos Principle is a breathtaking journey through a series of intricate puzzles that explore the concept of time manipulation.

name: The Elysian Field
summary: A gorgeous 3rd person casual adventure game centred around a dying soldier wondering through the elysian field witnessing the final moments of those already gone before leaving his own final mark. Uncover memories and a final conversation before laying to rest.

name: The Durka: You will (not) die
summary: The main character - Mickey, returns to his hometown by the end of the holidays. As soon as he arrived at the station, he was met there not only by friends, but also by his father, who decided to hire him to work for him. When he got home, Mickey noticed something sitting in his closet - a guy in a black suit, mask and holding out a pineapple in his hand. He said he would help, but in what way? Suddenly, the city is being attacked by giant robots of an unknown corporation! Not time, make a decision!

name: The Play's the Thing
summary: Win fame as a playwright before dark forces bring the curtain down for good! In a city stalked by a deadly curse, how will the power of your pen change the world?

name: The Great Menace
summary: The Great Menace is an 'The war of the Worlds 1938' fictional aftermath as an 2D RTS game, after the fake radio drama in 1938, an alien force commences an invasion on Earth the following day, the 5 great powers: USA, Britain, Germany, Japan and USSR must endure the invasion force

name: The Crackpet Show
summary: The Crackpet Show is an action-packed rogue-lite shoot-'em-up about mutated animals that fight in a bizarre TV show, crushing their opponents with a variety of weapons. Choose your beastie, gear 'em up, and go kill your enemies in the name of fame and sweet sponsorship deals!

name: The Shepherd
summary: After finding an old picture of your grandfather on a camel, you decide to leave the city and set off into the serenity of the desert. In order to become a great rider, just like he was. Train your herd, befriend desert-folk, fight predators, and navigate the mysteries of the desert.

name: The Wolf's Den
summary: The Wolf's Den is a suspenseful first person experience through a dark atmospheric mountain. Explore a mysterious train tunnel on your way to escape from a tragic accident that destroyed you and your partner's lab and uncover the truth behind the mysteries that surround you. Enter The Wolf's Den!

name: The List
summary: A young man is interviewed by the police only to turn up dead a week later. 3 years have passed, a special agent from Santa Fe navigates the police database in order to solve the mystery.

name: The Fermi Paradox
summary: The Fermi Paradox is a choice-driven sci-fi narrative strategy game in which your decisions in one corner of the galaxy can upend entire civilizations in another. Guide species through millennia and help them explore the vastness of space, make contact and, perhaps, create harmony.

name: Thumb Fighter
summary: These Thumbs are hungry for battle. You in?

name: The Little Black Bestiary: The Salted Cookies of Carthaginia
summary: A modern fantasy slice-of-life visual novel about what it's like to have a retired world-conquering lich queen for a girlfriend where you get to make inconsequential decisions about how you spend your afternoon together.

name: The Teleport
summary: The Teleport is a horror game where we try to protect ourselves from creatures through cameras.

name: The Patcher
summary: Feel the full-scale tactical multi-player action game on VR! Play strategic multi-play battles in PvP and PvE at the same time!

name: The Tower
summary:
The Tower is an action-packed first-person shooter created by a single developer. It mixes tense combat, challenging puzzles, and a constantly unfolding story.
It's your first day as a security guard for one of the most secure buildings in the city. But your first day becomes your worst day when an explosion rocks the building, blocking stairwells and disabling elevators.

name: The Harem Life of the Violent Swordsman!
summary: Nick wants to become more handsome and stronger. On the way to become stronger, he meets Leslie, who is helpful and helpful. The powerful and beautiful Josephine and the outstanding temperament Pandora start a happy harem life.

name: The First Samurai + The Second Samurai Bundle
The Last Defense!
summary: You are the last hope of humanity! Defend humanity by using your towers, buildings, walls and missiles. Plan your tactics, manage your sources, place your turrets to most effective positions and defeat the enemy!

name: The Farmthis Gallery
summary: View the 3D animations of farmthis on desktop & VR. Fantastic fetishisitc fantasy forms for your fulfilment.

name: the Mercenary
summary: You are a former CIA cleaner who decides to become an unscrupulous mercenary ready to take out anyone for money. Man, woman and children will not be a problem for you. You will travel all over the globe to carry out your contracts and pocket your due.

name: The Search For Fran
summary: " The Search for Fran " Welcome to the City Park. You are here to search for Fran. While searching, You can also talk with people and go on Quests , Collect Glorbs , Throw a Ball , Drive a Car , Fly a Ship , Fix Traffic Jams, Try a "Challenge" and much more !

name: The Wolf
summary: Dive into the world of wild wolves and live your life as one of them! The best wolf RPG is finally here. Explore the amazing environment, develop your character and upgrade your skills to become the Alpha of your pack! Play with people from all over the World!

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Rancho del Arroyo
summary: Hunt unique desert animals, explore a landscape full of secrets, and solve a century-old mystery that tore a powerful family apart in the latest reserve for the immersive hunting game theHunter: Call of the Wild.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Parque Fernando
summary: You've wandered through valleys and hills, savannas and frozen forests but now, it's time to explore our latest reserve in South America. Parque Fernando has asked for your aid in turning an otherwise wild slice of Patagonia into world class hunting grounds.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Vurhonga Savanna
summary: Having explored the idyllic Layton Lake District, roamed the hills of Hirschfelden and hunted in the ice-cold forests of Medved-Taiga National Park, it's time to head south to the Cradle of Life. Vurhonga Savanna is in need of your assistance, and it is up to you to answer the call.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Te Awaroa National Park
summary: Nestled at the foot of the Southern Alps, this paradise is home to both temperate beech forests and steep alpine peaks. While some are drawn here in search of Sika Deer, others come to trace its trails of history. You can rest easy knowing your next adventure awaits in Te Awaroa National Park.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Silver Ridge Peaks
summary: Whether you are tracking turkeys through the valley or lining up to shoot a mountain goat on a cliff above the cloudline, it's hard to resist taking in the grandeur of Silver Ridge Peaks.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Cuatro Colinas Game Reserve
summary: Strolling across dazzling fields and through soft rolling hills, this part of Iberia is a romantic setting for any reserve. From the graceful marble quarry to the meadows covered in sunflowers and lavender alike, Cuatro Colinas will take your breath away.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Medved-Taiga
summary: You've hunted among the rolling hills of Hirschfelden and explored the iconic Layton Lake District. Now get ready to face nature's most challenging conditions during a rare hunting expedition to Medved-Taiga National Park.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Remi Warren
summary: Remi Warren, a renowned real-life hunter and game warden in Silver Ridge Peaks can now become your hunter of choice when playing theHunter: Call of the Wild in this free DLC.

name: The Cryptologist Room
summary: The Cryptologist Room is a puzzle driven game that will test your cryptology skills to the limit! With the most difficult puzzles you can imagine! Are you able to escape the building in time?

name: The Spoon of Doom
summary: A simple maze game with incremental difficulty where you have to find the spoon of doom.

name: The Blackwell Bundle
summary: New York, the city that never sleeps, is waiting for you to solve 4 gripping mysteries before it's too late! The Blackwell Bundle includes the first four episodes: Legacy, Unbound, Convergence, and Deception. Four unique adventure games with more than 10 hours of adventure greatness. Get to know the New York of the 70's and visit some of its unique locales such as the old Minetta Tavern in the West Village. Switch between Joey Mallone and Rosangela Blackwell to gather clues and solve the case.

name: The Quest: Islands of Ice and Fire
summary: The Quest - Islands of Ice and Fire is an expansion to The Quest; a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement, turn based combat and intricate quests. Explore a huge world, full of challenging mysteries and dangerous monsters!

name: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters - Deluxe Edition
The Surge 2: Premium Edition
summary:
Welcome to Jericho City.

Explore the devastated metropolis and fight its numerous, ferocious threats in unforgiving combat. Slash and tear equipment from foes utilizing The Surge 2's dynamic Limb Targeting System.

The Surge 2 - Premium Edition contains the full game, and all the Season Pass content. This includes the story-focused expansion The Kraken, and all the new weapons and armor sets DLCs.

name: The Medium: Deluxe Edition
summary:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
- The Medium (game)
- Original Soundtrack - co-composed by legendary Japanese composer Akira Yamaoka and Arkadiusz Reikowski
- The Art of The Medium - an official digital album that will lead you through the game's unsettling world.

name: The First Templar: Special Edition
summary: The First Templar follows the story of two main characters – a French Templar, and his companion, a noble lady who has been proclaimed a heretic. Taking control over these two unlikely allies, the player must uncover the mysteries behind the Templar Order, play a role in a grand conspiracy, and discover the secret of the Holy Grail. The heroes face powerful opponents at every turn, including Sacracen, King Philip the IV of France and the Inquisition.

name: The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos - Deluxe Edition
summary: The Deluxe Edition includes the game The Dungeon Of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet Of Chaos, the Official Soundtrack and the Goodies Pack with the digital Artbook, additional tracks and artworks.

name: The Signifier: Deluxe Edition
summary: The Signifier Deluxe Edition melds the mind-bending experience of The Signifier game together with its ambient filled soundtrack.

name: Thief: Definitive Edition
summary: Garrett, the Master Thief, steps out of the shadows into the City. In this treacherous place, where the Baron’s Watch spreads a rising tide of fear and oppression, his skills are the only things he can trust. Even the most cautious citizens and their best-guarded possessions are not safe from his reach.

name: The Metronomicon: Slay the Dance Floor - J-Punch Pack
The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time
summary: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time is a physics-based heist game where you and your friends gear up to take on some of the most challenging heists conducted by penguins in penguin history.

name: The Saboten Man
summary: In a post-apocalyptic world, a man-cactus travels through three worlds: East Town, Living Desert, Metal Planet. You can interact with and use objects.

name: The Tau Ceti Terminus
summary: You weren't supposed to the first person to set foot on this rock. Communications out, ship damaged, you are on your own. Solve enough problems and you get to go home in this realistic sci-fi exploration and survival VR game. With a free-form style, your story unfolds depending on what you do next.

name: The Witcher Franchise Bundle
summary: This bundle includes: - The Witcher Enhanced Edition - The Witcher 2: Assassins of Kings Enhanced Edition - The Witcher Adventure Game - Thronebreaker: The Witcher Tales - The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt (Complete Edition)

name: The Evil Within Bundle
summary:
The bundle contains the following:
- The Evil Within
- The Evil Within: The Assignment DLC
- The Evil Within: The Consequence DLC
- The Evil Within: The Executioner DLC

Developed by Shinji Mikami and team at Tango Gameworks, The Evil Within is a survival horror game with highly-crafted environments, horrifying anxiety, and an intricate story are combined to create an immersive world that will bring you to the height of tension in this game. With limited resources at your disposal, you'll fight for survival and experience profound fear in this perfect blend of horror and action.

name: The Coma: Back to School Bundle
summary:
Sharpen your pencils, pack your notebooks, and pick up your controller (what?!) - it's time for a new lesson in fear. We’re going Back to School!

This bundle includes
- The Coma: Recut
- The Coma 2: Deluxe Edition
- Artbook
- Soundtrack
- 2 DLC costumes

Dive headfirst into the Korean shadow realm and explore the twisted halls of Sehwa High with BOTH full games.

name: The Adventures of Wolf and Hood: A Jigsaw Tale
summary: A fairy tale story told through 20 beautiful hand illustrated jigsaw puzzles.

name: The Bad, The Worse & Djanky
summary: A local and controller only western versus game featuring ricochets and 'realistic' weapon reloading.

name: The Invisible Hand: Deep Pockets Edition
summary: The Deep Pockets Edition includes the satirical stock broker simulator The Invisible Hand and its Original Soundtrack.

name: Through the Ages: New Leaders & Wonders
summary: The New Leaders & Wonders expansion brings exciting new content to the base game, adding leaders, wonders, and military cards so you can change the flow of history and build even greater civilizations!

name: The Shattering: Secret Room
summary: The Shattering is presenting a mysterious Secret Room, a place filled with wonders and surprises. Discover a new environment, deleted content from the main game, developer commentary and many more.

name: This War of Mine: Stories - Fading Embers
summary: 'Fading Embers' is the third installment in This War of Mine: Stories. The expansion features a narrative-driven scenario that portrays the story of Anja. Living in a warzone and carrying a heavy burden, Anja wrestles with herself to answer the question of what is more important - survival of human legacy or the survival of a man.

name: The Escapists 2: Dungeons and Duct Tape
summary: This content requires the base game The Escapists 2 on steam in order to play.

name: The Escapists 2: Big Top Breakout
summary: A clown's life awaits in Big Top Breakout!

name: The Desolate Hospital
summary: The Desolate Hospital is a horror adventure game where a gas masked man explores a desolate hospital to recover a red jewel. Upon entering, he receives a letter that reads, "If you wish to live, you must completely purge this place.

name: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Complete Pack
The Tower of TigerQiuQiu: Nyaa Invaders 1
summary: About Alien cats are hungry and ready to invade the earth. If you fly the most advanced cat lunch box spaceship, you must feed them before they starve. Save the earth!

name: The Tower of TigerQiuQiu: Tiger Tank 63
summary: Adding weather systems to the battlefield, heavy rains can break walls and cause mud on the ground; persistent rainstorms can make roads water; cooling from snowy days can freeze water; and when temperatures rise, ice and snow melt. The changing weather changed the terrain of the battlefield.

name: The Abnormal Place
summary: The Abnormal Place is a game about Abigail, a young woman who has lost her voice and has found herself in a strange resort and hotel inhabited by monsters. Abigail must recover her voice and navigate through the hostile world or she'll be forever trapped.

name: The Incredible Machine Mega Pack
summary:
Do you remember watching with amazement when those cartoon heroes constructed machines to catch someone or start something? Those very complicated Rube Goldberg-like ones with knives, toasters, anvils etc? Or did you ever wonder how it would feel to construct a mouse-powered device to cook some eggs and launch a rocket?

Well, the answer is here! Build monkey or mouse-powered machines, use lasers and fire fireworks, start fires using a bowling ball and flint, throw things with anti gravity platforms or a jack-in-the-box or crack open an aquarium with a cat, mouse, alligator, cannon, cheese and more!

Includes Even More Incredible Machine, The Incredible Machine 3 (contains all levels from The Incredible Machine 2), Contraptions and Even More Contraptions

Solve wacky puzzles with even more wacky solutions, using absolutely crazy contraptions

Countless challenges to keep you busy for many days to come

name: The Unexpected Quest Prologue
summary: Adventure game with strategy and management elements in a medieval fantasy setting - drawing inspiration from classic games of the genre. In this prologue, play through chapters 1, 2, and 3, where you learn to manage your resources as you build and battle to bring order to the world.

name: The Trap
summary: You got trapped in the labyrinth and need to find an exit. All you got is an old flashlight, while world around is trying to get rid of you! Use flashlight to resist darkness and evil, solve puzzles and explore dungeons and nether realms in The Trap, dark arcade adventure psychological horror!

name: The Arcadia of Wulin
summary: The Arcadia Of Wulin is a relaxed and casual individual independent game with the theme of construction and management. In the game, you will create a beautiful and prosperous paradise from nothing. Carefully plan each building, so that the building will have a sense of heaven and earth, so that the residents living here can comprehend the peerless martial arts. Here are the masters from outside the world, and here are the knights who return to hermit.

name: The Surge 2: Future Shock Weapon Pack
summary: Expand your The Surge 2 experience with the Future Shock Weapon Pack and get access to 4 new devastating weapons from the shadiest corners of Jericho City. The quarantine has sparked a surge in black market activities that unearthed previously secret projects.

name: The Bible: Exodus
summary: The Bible: Exodus is a third person melee combat game based on the most read book: The Bible. Come to know, participate and help the God's people to arrive on the promise land. Fighting against different kind of enemies.

name: The Eye of Borrack: Tangled Tales
summary:
Ever wondered what else goes on in the strange setting that surrounds the tale of Borrack? Well, now you can.

Play Tangled Tales as either Cinderella or Prince Charming as you attempt to find your way back to the family castle in time for your friend's wedding, encountering all manner of rude, annoying and often unhelpful fairy tale folk, intent it seems, on hindering you.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel - Shining Pom Bait Pack 2
summary: This pack contains 3 consumable baits that, when used, will lure out an elusive Shining Pom. Defeating these rare creatures in battle will reward a massive amount of EXP, helping your party reach new heights. Once used, they will disappear from your inventory.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Helm’s Deep - Premium Edition
summary:
Helm's Deep Premium Edition - Digital Download includes:
Enforcer of Helm & Avenger of Helm: Exclusive in-game Rohirrim titles
2,000 LOTRO Points for use in the LOTRO Store
Armour of the Hammerhand: An exclusive full set of Rohirrim cosmetic armour
Quest log slots: +10:
Expands your maximum number of active quests by 10 (Quest Slots will not apply to your Monster Play character).
Crystal of Remembrance: Adds one additional legacy to your legendary weapon

name: The Phenomenon of Edgar Allan Poe 1/2
summary: A horror novel visual in which you can choose a way, anime style.

name: The Lost Robot: Jigsaw Puzzle Stories
summary: Find help for a lost robot by restoring its memory.

name: Thrilling Triple Treat
summary: What do you get if you mix a platformer with a metroidvania and something in between but then seperate that mix into three games that are then collected into a single game? Nonsense. You get nonsense. This game is nonsense. But dear, is it funny!

name: The Haunted Exmone Theatre
summary: The Haunted Exmone Theatre is a 2D Survival Horror Game based on the story of a paranormal investigator called Omar, who got an urgent call from the owner of the Exmone Theatre to investigate the building for the paranormal evidence.

name: The Last Surface
summary: This is a short minimal,relaxed game

name: The Crow King
summary: The Crow King is a 2D side-scrolling action-strategy with a unique Handmade style, where you have to explore and gather resources to improve your strength until you lead your army to victory.

name: The Deepest
summary: Explore the depths, gather materials, these caves must have an end. Beware of creatures and save materials, look for guiding lights.

name: The Last Order: Dungeons
summary: The world is headed for destruction. Olvelia and Olvelius (members of the last order) need your help. Only the three of you can prevent the coming catastrophe and change the fate of the world.

name: The Episodic
summary: The Episodic is about an astronaut who came back to the earth and finds out that the earth is destroyed by a something big. The player needs to find out what caused this problem.

name: The Schizophrenic Dynasty of Müller
summary: In this visual novel you're a voice in schizophrenic heads of dynasty Müller. You pass from generation to generation and you control your schizophrenic, talking sometimes with him. The important thing is, you shouldn't let your schizophrenic die without offspring, otherwise you'll die with him.

name: The Cassir Simulator
summary: This is a cashier simulator, you need to serve customers, check and scan products, take money and give change. With the money you earn, you can improve your housing, buy food and medicine. Try to survive in difficult living conditions.

name: The End of Dyeus
summary: Go in a quest for Dyeus in a primitive and cryptic open world ! Face mysterious assailants in intense and fast paced sword fights, and survive against a carnivorous fauna. Will you uncover the truth about Dyeus?

name: The Next Jianghu I
summary: "The next Jianghu I" is a game that combines the jianghu, martial arts, collection, cultivation and war chess. You can experience the adventures and anecdotes in the Jianghu. Where do we not meet in life? Who are heroes? Next stop, Jianghu!

name: The Passage of Time
summary: Challenge the passage of time and try to survive in dark dungeons while fighting with their inhabitants. Create unique weapons, develop skills and explore caves. But be careful - time is running out ...

name: The Owl Quest
summary: The Owl Quest is an unpretentious little pixel art point'n click adventure game that aims to immerse the player in the atmosphere of the first adventure games of the 80s and 90s.

name: The Island
summary: The Island a computer game with an open world and a first-person view in the genre of survival.

name: Their Radiance
summary: Their Radiance is an unconventional walking simulator about love.

name: The Secret Blue Forest
summary: A relaxing wordless low poly adventure. You play as an Ice Sorcerer whose magic has a connection to the Ice forest, you're the only one who doesn't seem to be warped by the Ice forests magic, this allows you to create slippery ice, shoot ice shards, double jump and move boxes at range.

name: The Deepening: Eco-Offensive
summary: Follow along with Kyle, and experience the events prior to those of The Deepening book series from a neo-retro 2D perspective when you run, jump, and shoot through waves of beasts to make our trek to the stars more safe.

name: The Flawless Cup
summary: An urban fantasy platformer-adventure with a branching narrative, The Flawless Cup reacts to the choices you make on your quest for caffeine. Featuring a cast of caffeine starved characters and hand-crafted narrative that changes with you!

name: ThrustWorks
summary: ThrustWorks is jetpack flying combat game with enemy turrets, coin collecting, and vivid views in 4 unique levels. PC and VR support included.

name: The Witch in the Forest
summary: A young woman who lives alone in the forest one day meets another woman- a real witch!

name: The Shooting Maguro
summary: You are a MAGURO and have to swim through six stages with perfect control and the fastest speed in the world. Let's blow away anyone who gets in the way with a MAGURO bullet. There is no remaining-lives system in this game.However, you will be called a "sluggard" if you do too much continuation.

name: The Menacing
summary: The Menacing is a 1-4 player online co-op survival where you and your friends explore different environments and work together to survive. Search for key objectives in order to escape and complete challenges to earn new unlocks, all whilst avoiding the bloodthirsty threats and other dangers.

name: The Hell Hives
summary: Classic FPS style game with modern graphics. Fight through a series of highly challenging levels in a variety of environments. Take on many types of enemies with your shotgun, assault rifle, grenade launcher & nuke launcher. Solve puzzles, race rising lava, decipher codes and activate portals.

name: The Outpost
summary: Six robots have crash-landed on a beach on a distant planet and they have one job to do: chill out and socialize while they wait for help to arrive. Visit the far reaches of space in this new Social VR experience where each participant controls a unique procedurally generated robot avatar.

name: The Haunted Tunnel
summary: The Haunted Tunnel is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror Game based on the story of the Haunted Subway tunnel located in Ohio.

name: The Tree

name: The Majesti
summary: Before there were cities, towns, or even people, magical animals known as Majesti ruled the world. The Majesti is a family-friendly (though intense at times) story-rich JRPG. Play as different animals from the three Majesti factions; herbivore, carnivore, and scavenger.

name: The Cat Banny
summary: The Cat Banny is a puzzle, a story of a lost cat trapped in a dreams world.

name: The Mystery of Caketropolis
summary: A bakery falls to arson and a city falls to chaos. With the harmony between human and dragon crumbling, can Rimentus solve the Mystery of Caketropolis before his kind face exile?

name: This Legion Kills
summary: Competitive wargaming gets a facelift with fast-paced tactical battles and turn-based strategy, set in in the hilariously brutal, but not so very grim-dark, universe of the future.

name: The Sickle Upon Sekigahara
summary: The Sickle Upon Sekigahara is a short Visual Novel that puts the player in the role of Kobayakawa Hideaki in the most tumultuous period of his life.

name: The Great Pickle Adventure
summary: In The Great Pickle Adventure, a pickle-based platformer, you can compete for the best level times, relax in an RPG world or try your skill in a game of breakout. Become a master of gravity and find your favorite among multiple unique weapons. Explore 20+ unique themed levels and special levels.

name: The Banana Saved the World
summary: The Banana Saved The World is a classic platform game with levels to go as well as end-of-level bosses Avoid traps and enemies, to defend yourself you only have one stone to throw at them

name: The Forsaken Ruins
summary: The Forsaken Ruins is a first-person atmospheric horror game. As prisoner of Ever-Bleed Keep, your chance to escape has come. Delve deep into the ruins and try to survive long enough to unravel its dark history and your true identity.

name: The Drained Goddess
summary: The Drained Goddess is a first-person 3D action horror game. You will have to investigate what happened long ago. But those evil entities have been watching you and waiting for your return for decades. Will you try to defeat and expel them? Or just get what you need and sneak away?

name: The Lost Game: Royal Game of Ur
summary: The Royal Game of Ur is a board game thought to be played as early as 2600BC. The Lost Game seeks to restore this ancient tradition with a twist. The board is entirely customizable, allowing players to reshape the strategy of the game and even share it with others through the Steam Workshop.

name: The Firelord
summary: The Firelord is a platformer arena that tells of the adventures of a fire mage. Discover new abilities, create your own build and challenge the strongest fire magicians!

name: The Only Wise
summary: A non-linear detective, where you, based on the knowledge gained, make decisions and investigate the case. This is a short story with no markers or directions, only information. You, the player, decide what is right and what to do. What turns out to be true?

name: The protectors of Deya
summary: Embark on an adventure that will take you to discover the story of Silver and his friends, each with their own skills and characteristics. A turn-based strategic combat in pure RPG style.

name: Thrust Legend
summary: There are a lot of bad thrust clones out there... This is not one of them.

name: The Legend of Bear: Truck Trucker
summary: The physics bear driving stacking hauling trading game

name: The Lodge
summary: A first-person, psychological horror game, The Lodge takes players on a journey into the horrors of a twisted mind.

name: The Last Hope
summary: The Last Hope is a Metroidvania-style platform game with RPG elements, in which the player controls an unnamed character who is transported against his will to the underworld, and now has to discover how to escape and how to survive the dangers around him.

name: The Search for Deep Loving
summary: With 30 days to try and discover your soulmate, you have to work each day to get past the crazies. Unfortunately, online dating is not always the safest way to meet people and each date could be fatal. Will you meet your soulmate? Or will you crash and burn, literally, in your search?

name: The Fantastic Adventure of Monsieur Grape
summary: The Fantastic Adventure of Monsieur Grape is a 2.5D platformer where you play as Monsieur Grape: A high brow, high class, grape who is trying to save his friend Peanut from an evil piece of bread!

name: The Shadow of Yidhra
summary: Delta wakes up from the explosion and finds that the surrounding area has been overrun by zombies. When she tries to escape from the Institute, she finds a strange girl named Rei and goes to save her. In this game you will find out the truth about the world and lead the survivors to live through this disaster.

name: The Adventures of Bluke Bifton: Chapter 1
summary: The Adventures of Bluke Bifton is a bizarre point-n-click adventure game set in a world of complete absurdity. Ally (or make enemies) with a cast of strange characters, and make choices that determine your fate.

name: The OmniGallery
summary: The OmniGallery is a VR multiverse of art exhibits

name: The Fancy Pants Adventures: Classic Pack
summary: The classic Flash game series, compiled as a complete desktop collection for the first time. Experience the series that set the bar for platforming games throughout the industry! Includes Worlds 1-3 (including the World 1 Remaster + Remix), and Fancy Snowboarding.

name: The Gorcs' Forge
summary: Amid the news of the returning Tronraneren dwarves and the imminence of a new war, take the role of Zrurk, leader of the Gorcs - experts in the art of forging - and manage the workforce, inputs, capital, other resources and help provide all the equipment and weaponry needed to defeat the dwarf army!

name: The Viking Way
summary: Experience the Viking way of life. Sail, explore, trade, build a fleet, and lead your fearless army to raid and conquest. Write your own story of the golden Viking age. You have many choices, and a leader can always find his own.

name: The Sych Story
summary: Live a couple of days in the life of an ordinary omezhka owl. This is a visual novel about each of us, and no one in particular. Make your choice and decide the fate of Slavka Sychov.

name: The Cubedex of Boxes and Lines
summary: The Cubedex of Boxes and Lines is a collection of seven puzzles pretending to be classic games in a cubic arcade. Like puzzle hunts or escape rooms, figuring out the goal of each puzzle is, itself, part of the puzzle.

name: The End of Labyronia: Nerubis
summary: Travel through time and the four seasons to avert the apocalypse in the last part of the popular Labyronia saga.

name: The Perfect Shape
summary: An action precision platformer to test your dexterity, wit and patience

name: The Dream Libra Had
summary: The two girls who had a traffic accident, Libra and her girlfriend Amili, wander the supernatural world as a near-death experience.

name: The Last Stand Legacy Collection
summary: Survive the zombie apocalypse and make humanity's last stand in this three-game legacy bundle, revamped for modern hardware. Explore, build, and survive for as long as you can in The Last Stand, The Last Stand 2, and The Last Stand: Union City.

name: The 99
summary: The 99 - An Action-Quiz Don't just answer the same stupid questions! At The 99 there are randomized quiz, memorie and puzzle elements in one little game.

name: The Adventurer: Episode 2 - New Dreams
summary: Imagine every time you fall asleep new adventure awaits you...

name: This Game is Trash
summary: This Game is Trash. Yes, it's literal trash. You are a KEYBOARD and you ROLL on a UFO all the way to the END! WHAT MORE COULD YOU WANT?? But seriously, can you make it to the end? Because it took us like 1000 tries. We counted. So play the game and see if you can. Your life depends on it now.

name: The Faded
summary: An ongoing kidnapping mystery of little kids from past 10 years, can a 14 year old girl stop it?

name: The Adventures on Uranus
summary: The Adventures on Uranus is a short interactive experience. The game provides a chance to explore the imaginary planet of Uranus for a few minutes.

name: The Hardest Game in the Universe
summary: Why are you getting to know one of the most difficult games in the universe, Embark on this challenge with the new casual game, platform that aims to become one of the games most hated for its difficulty,

name: The Seven Keys: Escape Room
summary: Escape Room The Seven Keys is a graphic mystery adventure where your logical reasoning will help you escape, in addition to solving different challenges.

name: The Case of Maneki
summary:
The Case of Maneki is a Detective game about a Maneki Neko, or lucky cat, following his adopted guardian to find the truth that is hidden between a series of gruesome murders.

You play as Kichiro and Nobutoshi, the detective and the apprentice of the city. With murders being committed at every corner, it is up to you to solve this case that traces back to years ago.

name: The Curse of Fafnir
summary: You play as a rogue mage who tapped into dark arts to try and gain more power but as soon as you opened a dusty old book, Fafnir was summoned and not pleased, which caused him to place a curse on you and sent you to a eternal dungeon. Survive by beating the dungeon and breaking the curse.

name: The Host
summary: After a Post-Armageddon event the world has gone back to its roots living in simpler times, back to swords, kings, and war. Something is brewing in the kingdom could it be related to the first apocalyptic event?

name: The Alchemist Alekki
summary: This is a game about running a potion shop and saving time! Alekki has been accused of creating a potion that caused areas of time to merge together. Help her uncover the truth by defeating powerful Echoes of time in different Time-Warped areas.

name: The Depths
summary: You are a 45 year old man who wakes up in this new world trying to figure out its secrets as you explore this first person horror you will find your self sneaking pass threats hiding from the shadow beset and solving puzzles.

name: The Happy Little Virus
summary: As a virus, attack the servers of charities on orders from your sinister creator that seem strange... maybe even unethical? Journey down into their computers and engage in frantic debris-strewn battles with the antiviruses in this comedy puzzle shooter.

name: Thief's Shelter
summary: Uncover what happened at Highburn Mansion — before it unravels your mind. Investigate, solve intricate puzzles, document elusive evidence, and question every shadow. Thief’s Shelter is a first-person psychological mystery where the deeper you dig, the more reality slips away.

name: The World
summary: 小明因黑人抬棺穿越到神秘新大陆开始了传（造）奇（孽）的一生。这是一款颠覆性的RPG扮演类游戏，是一个完全的开放性世界，你不再被主线剧情所拘束可以自由的在这个世界的各个角落探索，寻找宝物，或是完成一件件难忘的冒险。在游戏中做一个坏人亦或者是一个好人都由你自己决定，你还可以加入各种门派，学习绝学，制作装备炼制法宝等等，直到你从一个屌丝成长为一个大屌丝！

name: Thearchy
summary: A pixel art style simulation of a fantasy post-apocalyptic Earth.

name: The Telos Monument
summary: The Telos Monument is a highly atmospheric 2D psychological horror adventure game set in a strange and mind-bending monument, standing at the center of the dystopian world.

name: The Dark Hills of Cherai 2: The Regal Scepter
summary:
Explore The Dark Hills of Cherai
A powerful artefact lies locked away, entombed behind a door that can only be opened by combining 12 amulets. Find the map and you will find the answers that you seek. Journey across the dark hills, discover curious hidden objects and overcome the guardian creature to save the Regal Scepter of Cherai!

name: The Sims 4: Throwback Fit Kit
summary: Outfit your Sims in retro-inspired athleisure looks with The Sims 4: Throwback Fit Kit. Take it back to nostalgic colors, bold patterns and trend-forward silhouettes with these all-new Create-a-Sim items. Updated everyday classics and workout wear elevate this unique collection - and your Sim's fashion.

name: The Truth About 9th Company
summary: The Truth About 9th Company is the first Russian documentary computer game. The game simulates the historical battle for Hill 3234 which took place on 7–8 January 1988 in southern Afghanistan between Soviet paratroop units of the 345th Independent Guards Airborne Regiment and mujahideen.

name: The Rebellion
summary: The Rebellion is a bold new take on real-time strategy that enables you to command from above and also seamlessly transition to 3rd person to join your warriors on the battlefield. Secure absolute victory by outfitting your army, harvesting resources, and waging all-out war in this dark divided empire.

name: The Hero We Need
summary: The Hero We Need is a tower defense with real-time strategy elements with a focus on narrative where players have the power to create their own custom towers by crafting and combining runes.

name: The Sims 4: Limited Edition
summary:
Unleash your imagination and create a unique world of Sims that's an expression of you! Explore and customize every detail from Sims to homes, and much more with The Sims 4.
