- Official booklet

name: The Forgotten City: Digital Collector's Edition
summary:
Edition offers the ultimate experience for those who want to immerge into the ancient Roman era with:

- The game's full soundtrack
- The digital map, hand-drawn by Francesca Baerald
- Sentius statue 3D-printing file

name: The Settlers 7: Paths to a Kingdom - Uncharted Land Map Pack
summary: Introducing the first DLC package for The Settlers 7: Paths to a Kingdom! The first DLC pack consists of a map pack with 3 maps: Battle of Tanholm: On this two-player map, it is up to you to reunite the divided Metropolis of Tanholm and bring it back to its former glory.

name: The Legend of Eratus: Dragonlord
summary: In this heroic match-3 game you have to help Aurora and her dragon Eratus in their fight to overthrow the evil Queen and restore peace to the land.

name: The Fisherman: Fishing Planet - Blue Crab Island Expansion
summary: Welcome to Blue Crab Island! Situated off the Gulf Coast of Mississippi, this picturesque island is an angler's paradise. The canals, local mangrove trees and sawgrass thickets hide plenty of fish, including 8 new species. Make the most out of your trip with an exclusive new bass boat and tackles.

name: The Termination
summary: It's a story of deception and redemption. You receive a mysterious invitation to a seven days doomsday journey. An expectant interstellar journey has become a doomsday route to the end. There is only one word difference between "victim" and "perpetrator".

name: Thermonuclear
summary: Gain control of the ultra-advanced cyborg machine 'Thermonuclear,' and use its abilities to defeat enemy AI and end the disastrous war. In this sci-fi, turn-based strategy game, you can complete unique procedurally generated levels, upgrade and strengthen Thermonuclear and improve your base.

name: The Dark
summary: You come round as your escape pod plummets into the inky waters of a distant flooded planet. Comms are down and power failing. You have no choice but to head out into.. the dark.

name: The Bart Bonte Collection
summary: Flash is dead, long live the Bart Bonte collection! A collection of 28 Flash games carefully packaged and remastered for you, all accessible from a selection menu with loads of achievements. All the classics you know from the browser, including the Sugar, Sugar and the Factory Balls series.

name: The Life of Bally
summary: Bally's life is like our lives. Go through Bally's life solving puzzles, facing new challenges and growing up with him.

name: The Holy Orange
summary: A Christian Ball Rolling Game

name: The Outbreak: Wilderness
summary: The Outbreak is a third person, coop, intense and challenging survival shooter in a massive open-world. Survive at all cost and experience a constant threat. Whether it is the lack of resources or creatures chasing you.

name: The Nightmare
summary: The Nightmare is a first-person horror game. Dive into the nightmare and try to get rid of that nightmare...

name: Throwing Stone
summary: Throw your stone, and you are forced to move to the point where it stops. The rule is as the same as golf.

name: The Vampire Regent
summary: Rule over a secret society of vampires in a game full of political intrigue, occult powers, and conflicting loyalties. Will you play or be played?

name: The Spirit of Snowflake
summary: Platform game where you incarnate a ghost and go through lasers and fireballs on a background of epic music. You can create your own levels and share them with your friends...

name: The Ghost
summary: Genre: Suspense. A simple novel with only screen transitions. A game for people who like novels.

name: The Drift Challenge
summary: Slide your ride in different game modes. Earn XP points and complete challenges to level up and unlock cars or drift with friends in the Online Multiplayer mode.

name: The Necromancer's Tale
summary: A story-rich gothic RPG. Master the rituals of an ancient spellbook. Raise an undead army to march against your enemies. Commune with the realm of the dead & struggle with your descent into madness. Progress through secrecy, diplomacy, blackmail, coercion & seduction until ready to reveal yourself.

name: The Enthralling Realms: The Blacksmith's Revenge
summary: A challenging fantasy match-3 game! Help the Blacksmiths daughter Ara to avenge her village and defeat a vicious dragon.

name: The Disaster
summary: Defend, survive, unlock, interact, upgrade and eliminate all zombies. A first person shooter game against zombies.

name: The Outbreak Guardian
summary: The Outbreak Guardian is a third person open-world game where you are in charge of ensuring the welfare of the citizens of Patriam by managing the cities resources and agents, which involves delivering equipment and some driving.

name: The Pit: Infinity - Juggernaut
summary: Summoned to Arbuda by the promise of a huge reward, Tor Makari is here to rescue a kidnapped human from a high-security alien facility and pull down the biggest bounty of his career. He is a force to be reckoned with, nigh unstoppable. He is a Juggernaut!

name: The Pit: Infinity - Healer
summary: With a planet ravaged by disease and the only cure at the bottom of a long-abandoned alien science facility, SolForce medic Astryd Jemison must lay down her oath to do no harm, pick up her Transfuser pistol, and enter... The Pit.

name: The Dawning Clocks of Time
summary: A classic story of love, war and betrayal on an intergalatic scale. A epic turn based RPG with both sandbox and linear story progression. Take up arms with energy and exciting weapons and skills for the battle of the ages, who will decide the fate for all of humanity?

name: The Lion's Song: Episode 2 - Anthology
summary: In "Episode 2 - Anthology" you play as the aspiring painter Franz who has a unique but unsettling ability to see the hidden layers of his subjects' personalities. Can he overcome his fears and self-doubt to finally see himself?

name: The Lion's Song: Episode 4 - Closure
summary: "Episode 4 – Closure", will take players on a mysterious train journey that brings together four strangers and connects the storylines of all three previously released episodes. What stories will they share along the way and where will their journey end?

name: The Lion's Song: Episode 3 - Derivation
summary: In "Episode 3 – Derivation", you take on the role of Emma, a brilliant mathematician, who struggles to make her voice heard in the male-dominated world of academics at the beginning of the 20th century. Can she lift the curtain of reality to get a glimpse of the principles governing her world?

name: The Alpha 001
summary: Dive into the simulation, explore, play mini games, break loot boxes, grow plantations on your farm, fight orcs, play with your friends, rescue robots, increase your village's population, mine resources, conquer villages! The simulation will prepare a lot of different things for you, get ready.

name: The Final Frontier
summary: The Last Frontier is a retro multi-directional shooter inspired by the likes of Asteroids and Galaga. You destroy waves of endless enemies while trying to survive as long as possible by upgrading your ship's abilities along the way.

name: Three Kingdoms Simulator
summary: A Three Kingdoms Simulator ARPG Game

name: The Top of the Dream
summary: An TouHou style barrage shooting game, with a unique firepower and boundary mechanism, use of the mechanism and resources, in the difficult Stage and BossBattle to master the rhythm and explore the SpellCard ,to defeat the FinalBoss, uncover the veil of transformation, and see the "dream of the sky"

name: The Maiden, the Butler, and the Witch
summary: A classic-style turn-based RPG. Irina must leave her home and embark on a journey to complete her training to become a witch. However, the Demon Lord has built a castle on the island, and unleashed monsters who threaten its citizens.

name: The Garden of Orilon
summary: Meet your engagements with the ones who keep watch on you. Your memories are sealed and soul binds to soft dolls. When the doll opens its eyes, the castle where it appears is under attack...

name: The Niflhel Day
summary: A visual novel in the setting of Slavic folklore in which you will walk through the forest at night, when the line between the world of the living and the dead is thinner than ever. Look carefully at your feet and, perhaps, you will see the dawn.

name: The Heat of War
summary: Another first person perspective title, referring to the events of the Second World War.

name: The Running Man
summary: If you want to relax, this game is not for you, this game is made to make you rage. go through challenging and hard levels and run to the finish line. will you take the challenge?

name: The Village
summary: After you graduated from college, you were assigned to a small village as a doctor.It looks like an ordinary village, but there are many strange things in it.A man knocking at the door in the middle of the night may not be asking for a doctor.The person you saw may not be alive.Haunted?

name: The Light at the End of the Ocean
summary: A point-and-click visual novel about unlikely friendship and loss of identity

name: The LEGO Movie Videogame: Wild West Pack
summary: It’s a rip-roarin' good time in the wild, wild west! Get a chock-full of laughs and abilities with these special pants. Spin around and attract more studs with the Tornado Pants. Put on your Prospector Pants and spawn more high-value studs. Get all fired up with the Hot Pants and jump higher with the Jack Rabbit Pants. There's even more action with new characters: Old Ollie, Wild Will, Sudds Backwash and Rootbeer Belle.

name: The Exorcist: Legion VR - Chapter 2: Idle Hands
summary: The Exorcist: Legion VR - Chapter 2: Idle HandsIn this chapter you come to the aid of Lucie Moss, a schoolteacher who seems to have lost her mind and is set upon by an unseen force. What torments her? How can the ancient tools you've found aid you in your journey?

name: The Exorcist: Legion VR - Chapter 4: Samaritan
summary: The Exorcist: Legion VR - Chapter 4: SamaritanHaiti has become a failed quarantine zone. Racked by a unknown plague, a slew of health worker deaths have led to the collapse of efforts to control the mounting victim toll. You travel to a small aid centre to discover what (or who) lies at the heart of the epidemic.

name: The Exorcist: Legion VR - Chapter 5: The Tomb
summary: The Exorcist: Legion VR - Chapter 5: The TombYou have been summoned to the final chapter... and there is no turning back.In this tense climax, your journey takes you deep into the mountains of Upper Mesopotamia where a final confrontation will put everything that you have learned to the test.

name: The Dream Machine: Chapter 5
summary: In Chapter 5, Victor must gain access to the last two neighbors' dreams and try to stop the dream machine once and for all.

name: The Dream Machine: Chapter 3
summary: In an effort to shut down the mysterious dream machine, Victor enters the dream of his sleeping wife.

name: The Dream Machine: Chapter 4
summary: In Chapter 4, Victor must gain access to his elderly neighbor's dream and find his way through her frail and decaying mind.

name: The Dream Machine: Chapter 6
summary: In the concluding chapter, Victor must journey to the heart of dreams in order to rescue his loved ones from the dream machine.

name: The Crown of Leaves: Chapter 2
summary: The second chapter of the Crown of Leaves.

name: The Strange Story of Brian Fisher: Chapter 2
summary: After escaping from the old cabin, and falling down without consciousness, Brian Fisher traveled in time and space. He woke up 30 years ago, when he was a little boy, in a place that he doesn't remember where it is, and how he got there.

name: The Chase
summary: The Chase is a 2.5D racing game where you have to run from the cops, collect some cash, and do some missions. Unlock new cars and goofy characters

name: The Evil in the Forest
summary: The Evil in the Forest is a 3rd-person fantasy horror adventure game. The game tells you the dark story of a man named Derek Bain - a single father who, being a researcher in the field of natural resources, arrives with his daughter Kate in a mystical forest...

name: The Importance of Choosing: Second Chance
summary: This story tells us about a girl who went through a lot in her life, and each of her decisions led to certain consequences. In this game, you will see the consequences of one of the elections, and understand what decision will be correct.

name: The Blue Box: Oligocene Snapshot
summary: Go back in time to the Oligocene Era and use your Hyper Digital Camera to take pictures of ancient creatures! With the help of your best friend Professor Choke, his time gateway technology, and the All Terrain Friend you’re able to withstand time travel and document the process.

name: The Blue Box: BurgerGame
summary: Man the grill at your dream fast food job, following customer orders (or not) to create the burgers of their dreams (maybe). Work through seven burger-flipping days, dealing with your co-workers shenanigans, and learning to improvise when things get tough! If you work hard, you may even find help from an unexpected place.

name: The Blue Box: YWDH (You Will Die Here)
summary: Grandpa is on an adventure to put an end to his pounding migraine, but he only has ten minutes until his painkillers kick in!

name: The Blue Box: DDAFPST Ostriches
summary: Can you smell that? It’s cocaine. The most desirable drug to any well respected business Ostrich. That’s why your gang of like-minded drug-enthused Ostrich companions decided to trade drugs, money, and personal exchanges in the middle of a street. That is, until you got word that the police would soon arrive to bust everything up

name: The Blue Box: Llama Goes to Market
summary: It’s 4 o’ clock, it’s time to get some chili! Our floppy protagonist is on his way to the market to get the ingredients he needs to make a nice bowl of chili going -- on a budget. He’ll have to engage in the ancient art of Haggle Ball!

name: The Blue Box: BBA Slam
summary: It’s the bottom of the 9th, you’ve got 20 yards left and only 1 more stroke to reach par. Will you get a strike, or will you leave as strong as a turkey? Only you and your team can decide.

name: The fairy tale you don't know
summary:
Little Red Riding Hood, Snow White, Alice in Wonderland, Thumbelina...
Let's travel to these well-known fairy tales' world, and play hide and seek with the heroines! In this game, you can rewrite the ending of these well-known fairy tales.

name: The Seeker
summary: Join four orphans as fate calls upon them for a role greater than they could have ever imagined! Prove yourself worthy of becoming a Seeker and defeat the Unholy Beast hellbent on ruling over those you care for!

name: The Cursed Revenant
summary: The Revenant has returned to break the curse, This is a story of a legend who got cursed for ages traveling through different dimensions to find who cursed him.

name: The Second Reproduction
summary:
The Second Reproduction is an otome game, set in the same universe as Queen of Darkness, the circle's first game, as well as serving as a sort of sequel.

Christina was the third princess of Almenan, and born in the era of war against the Demons. Having the status of a “Champion”, Christina had countless battle victories upon her shoulders and was feared by the Demon race.

Being the most successful of her three sisters, her mother the queen sent her on a secret mission to assassinate the Demon Lord Gardis in return for his ruthless annihilation of the Kingdom of Crofts.

Obeying her mother’s orders for the sake of her kingdom, Christina set out alongside with her most loyal knight Lezette to take the Demon Lord’s head, and to bring peace to the land. But they soon discover the Demon Lord and his people are not as ruthless as they have been told all their life.

name: The Adventures of Sisharpic
summary: A game about a funny character Sisharpica, his girlfriend was stolen and therefore he went in search of her. It will be a very interesting journey in which you will get a lot of emotions.

name: The Adventures of Lwanda Magere
summary: This is an action-adventure game based on the history of a famous Kenyan hero, Lwanda Magere and his encounters with other African heroes at large. Lwanda Magere was invincible to physical attacks, and had the ability to takedown entire armies.

name: The Shimmering Horizon and Cursed Blacksmith
summary: "Try all you can, through hell and fire's end..."Forge yourself the best weapon you can, and jump into the ever-changing dungeon searching for your memory and the truth of this world!Roguelike X Forging X Souls-like, Dungeon Crawling RPG

name: The Divine Speaker
summary: A story-rich tale of breaking the bonds of fate... and meeting some cute guys along the way!

name: The Hand of Merlin: Deluxe Edition
summary: The Hand of Merlin Deluxe Edition includes the full game and the Official Soundtrack, which features music inspired by Arthurian legend with a playtime of over 2 hours and 20 minutes. Music by: Old Sorcery

name: The Banner Saga Trilogy: Stoic Edition
summary: Weave your own thread through this epic Viking RPG adventure with the Banner Saga Trilogy. The Banner Saga Trilogy Stoic Edition includes The Banner Sagas 1, 2, and 3 along with their soundtracks, additional in-game items, titles, and much more!

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel III - Digital Limited Edition
summary: "The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel III - Digital Limited Edition" content includes: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel III (full game). Consumable Starter Set. Standard Cosmetic Set

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel IV - Digital Deluxe Edition
summary: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel IV Digital Deluxe Edition includes the base game, the Swimsuit Bundle, Magical Girl Bundle, and Standard Costume Bundle.

name: The Escapists: Supermax Edition
summary:
The Escapists Supermax Edition bundle files through the bars and digs to freedom to smuggle the award-winning prison escape game and all the additional premium content past the guards in this definitive Escapists experience!

Includes:

The Escapists
The Escapists DLC: Duct Tapes are Forever
The Escapists DLC: Escape Team
The Escapists DLC: Alcatraz
The Escapists DLC: Santa's Sweatshop

name: The Dark Pictures Anthology: Little Hope & Man of Medan Bundle
summary:
The Dark Pictures Anthology is a series of intense, branching cinematic horror games featuring single and multiplayer modes.

Each story can be played independently.

This Bundle gives you access to Man of Medan and its supernatural horror in the south pacific, and Little Hope, where 4 college students and their professor must escape nightmarish apparitions whilst trapped in an abandoned town.

name: The Journey: Episode 1 - Whatever This Is
summary: The first step that you never knew you needed to take to get to wherever you're wanting to go...

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quad Pack
summary: Get all four award-winning The Lord of the Rings Online Expansion Packs in a single purchase! Mines of MoriaDelve into the dangerous depths of Moria, and try to reclaim its dark halls from the evil burrowed within. Over 350 quests designed to support player levels 50 - 60.

name: The Pirate's Fate: Prisoner of Destiny
summary: What would have happened if Mila had volunteered to stay behind at the Cursed Coast instead of Darious? Find out in this all-new path in The Pirate's Fate - Prisoner of Destiny. What price will you pay for escaping the dungeon? Will your long-lost friends remember who you really are?

name: The Chronicles of Hercules: The 12 Labours
summary: In this epic match3 game. you join Hercules, one of the most famous heroes of mythology, the demi-god son of Zeus. With Iolaus' help you have to solve 12 tasks and slay unstoppable beasts.

name: The Benjamins
summary: The Benjamins is a business tycoon / harem building simulation. Recruit girls, train them and put them to work. You'll need to improve your street cred and keep your bankroll growing to succeed in the adult industry.

name: Through the Frame
summary: Race through the frames with your grappling hook and reach the finish line as quickly as possible to get the highest score and beat the other players!

name: The Last Pirate Adventure: Drake's Treasure
summary: Rum. Pillage. Gunshots. Far away that is, only vague memories of the legend of Captain Drake's treasure. The golden age of piracy is long gone, but who tells there is not one last chapter to write?

name: The BridgeMaster
summary: The kingdom is collapsing! Use your combined powers of logic & magic to help the townsfolk find a path to escape. Sacrifice the village - Build bridges - Save the villagers!

name: This Rain Will Never End
summary: You are in a noir adventure game where you will play a cat detective who needs to investigate the suicide of the Mayor of Sunny city. Suddenly the rain started to drop endlessly and no one knows why.

name: The Deep
summary: Marine biologist Joel Price was sent to alien planet R-Aqua to help searchers find out why the marine life there was lasting for so long.

name: The USB Stick Found in the Grass
summary: This is a forensic challenge game – find out who the owner of the USB stick was and reconstruct their story.

name: The King of Warriors: Battle in the Three Kingdoms
summary: Who will be the King of Warriors? Defeat a great deal of enemies using various skills and Special moves! The King of Warriors(KOW) - Battle in the Three Kingdoms - is a Beat'em up game in the battlefields of ancient China!

name: The Last Islands of Man
summary: The Last Islands of Man is a retro rpg that forces you to manage your time. The waters are rising. Can you save yourself? Can you save your family?

name: Thats Life of Ralph
summary: This is the life of Ralph, a teenage raccoon, in this story you will experience the most incredible moments of his life. In this relaxing experience, accompany Ralph, his friends, his girlfriend and his family, told in 5 handmade illustrated scenes. Have a calm and relaxing experience.

name: The Beast Awoke to Eat Your Darlings
summary: BATEYD is a horror game mixing puzzle and action mechanics. Outwit the Beast who haunts your nights, and save as many of your darlings as you can. Each nightmare is a puzzle you can solve in a myriad of different ways. The better you do, the more you discover about a past you've long forgotten.

name: The Darkest Island
summary: You are the only survivor of a plane crash. You are on a mysterious island and must face surprises and fight to stay alive. Lose yourself on an incredible journey of survival. Can you find a solution and leave the island?

name: The Pacifist's Great and Final Nightmare
summary: The Pacifist's Great and Final Nightmare is a first-person three-dimensional game with platformer and horror styles of gameplay. The gameplay of this game involves navigating through levels to avoid dangers, solve puzzles, and reach the level exit.

name: The Kalalau Trail
summary: A first-person 3D version of the famous Kalalau Trail on the Hawaiian island of Kauai. Vast open world includes the full length of the trail. Many surprises and easter eggs, many famous sights along the trail.

name: The Wednesday
summary: It is a serious game that traverses time to fulfill the wish of a lifetime.Immerse yourself in a world of 3D graphics and embark on a journey to change the past and save the future by finding hidden clues on the island of death.

name: The Extinguishers
summary: The Extinguishers is a Tower Defense combined with epic Third Person Shooting combat. You and your towers will be taking on different types of demons that are coming towards the city. Are your defenses strong enough to protect the HQ holding the organization together?

name: The Holy Silence
summary: A Roguelike action adventure shoot game that creates your legendary experience. In the dark and wide world, explore the five races and the causes of the world's cataclysm. Flexible to deal with the complex and changing world environment with different weapons, technology and elements.

name: The Last Place
summary: The end of the world is coming!

name: The Lord of the Parties
summary: The lord of the parties is a brand new game that combines an RPG with a party shoot 'em up. Explore this unique fantasy world with your own allies!

name: The World's Hardest Game 3D
summary: Easy to play, very hard to finish. The World's Hardest Game, which you used to play on flash game sites, is now with you in 3D. Good luck in this challenging game of 30 unique levels!

name: The Witch Eye
summary: The Witch Eye is an indie psychological horror game . As a local hunter vicky explore valley of majuli village and try to survive long enough to discover the terrible secrets of the witch "nale ba"

name: The Sin Collector: Repentless
summary: The Sin Collector: Repentless is a game on the border of a visual novel and a classic text RPG, set in the world of The Sin Collector. Action takes place a couple of years before the events presented in the books.

name: The Village Story
summary: This is the story of a kid name Jorah and his adventures throughout the beautiful pixel art towns. It has been foretold that anybody who does good deeds will be granted access to the Village of Gods. Fulfill Jorah's quest by visiting beautiful pixel art towns like Christmas,Snowtown,Waterworld etc.

name: The Well
summary: The Well is a compact (avg. play time 20 mins) one-button horror game based off of a poem by HP Lovecraft.

name: The Indestructible Moxy Boxy
summary: Heal and reload by inhaling defeated enemies in this precision, twin-stick shooter. Solve action-oriented puzzles and explore an adorably violent world, in a thoughtful story - told through shoebox dioramas.

name: The Crafter's Defense
summary: An active strategy game where you customize your dungeon and defend against waves of invaders. Create your dungeon, place monsters and traps, and protect your core! Take direct control of any of your dungeon's monsters to directly engage in the combat or sit back watch the battle unfold.

name: The Day They Came
summary: The game is set in current time, survive, craft, build, 5ppl coop.

name: The Kingdom of Galanor
summary: A wandering hero, you find yourself in the Kingdom Of Galanor where you will need to use all of your skills to survive the numerous quests you will undertake and the danger you will face.

name: The Maze
summary: The Maze was created to challenge you in many different ways, it has such a simple objective, find the end.The Maze is a very large 3d maze built on terrain, with vegetation, trees, water, and different biomes, it stretches many miles with dozens of different challenges,

name: The Scary Square
summary: The Dark Side Of Mr.Square To Be Discovered.

name: The Curse of Esrevni
summary: Turn-based strategy game Use your cards well Survive Board game Don't give up !

name: The Curse of Illmoore Bay
summary: A 90's Halloween/Horror comical platforming adventure! Can you stop Illmoore Bay from a world of perpetual Halloween?

name: The ultimate secret of the universe: Soul
summary: The dialogue content of the game is based on the cosmic cycle, 33 dimensional space-time and religious theology.

name: The Book of Yorle: Save the Village
summary: This DLC, the first of four, entitled Save The Village, allows access to the warehouse and to the tavern's wine cellar. Is there more to discover than these areas? Yes! Search and explore to uncover the secrets hidden therein. Seal the gates to the village and prevent further infiltration from the Evil Ones.

name: Three Pigeons in a Trench Coat
summary: A game about Three Pigeons in a Trench Coat stuck in a time loop until they save the world. Pretty Simple.

name: The Adventures of Fatman: Intergalactic Indigestion
summary: Emerge from the Fat-cave once more and help Fatman defeat the Intergalactic Indigestion! A cheap and cheerful continuation to The Adventures of Fatman series, by Mike Doak.

name: The Political Machine 2016: Campaign DLC
summary: Battle for your spot in the White House against some of the most famous (and infamous!) presidents in American history. In the new ladder mode, you will choose your political party and launch your campaign against increasingly challenging opponents. Do you have what it takes to go down in history?

name: The Witch's Apprentice: A Magical Mishap - Collector's Edition
summary: The Collector's Edition includes: - 10 additional Levels (Help Grimelda on another adventure and defeat the evil ice spirit to save the poor villagers!) - Wallpapers - ingame Strategy Guide

name: The Christmas Spirit: Journey Before Christmas - Collector's Edition
summary:
This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

The Collector's Edition includes:
- Break the spell and save Carlos from Mrs. Tovenare's control!
- See if you can solve every puzzle on Easy and Hard!
- Collect gifts and holiday treats from around the world!
- Enjoy exclusive music, wallpapers, concept art, and more!
- Complete strategy guide included! Always on hand when you need it!

name: The Catch: Carp & Coarse Fishing - Lake Beasts Equipment Pack
summary: A 53-item pack containing a wide variety of items from boats to baits that will help you find, hook and land the elusive monster boss fish found in The Catch: Carp & Coarse.

name: The Catch: Carp & Coarse Fishing - Jezioro Bestii
summary: A remastered, favourite is back but with new species and bigger fish! With 17 different species of fish and 25 Boss Fish, this venue fits every style of fishing with predators weighing over 100lb and carp to 50lb.

name: The Entity: Returning Home
summary: In this DLC you will find out the truth behind the creature after the events of The Entity and what it actually wants with Jack and his family.

name: The Trial
summary: "Someone must have been telling lies about Josef K., he knew he had done nothing wrong but, one morning, he was arrested." Story about life, choices and a Man vs the System. This unique literature, even after 100 years is still up to date. Brought to You in early text-adventure games style.

name: The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I
summary: Let's the show begin! The Last Show of Mr. Chardish: Act I is a prologue of "The Last Show of Mr. Chardish" full game. Together with the Actress Ella, embark on a journey through the past and discover the secrets left by the brilliant Director in his magical performances.

name: The Disappearing of Gensokyo: Kogasa, Iku Character Pack
summary: This pack will add Nagae Iku and Tatara Kogasa to the game.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Where the Cat and Wolf Play...'
summary:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest "Where the Cat and Wolf Play..." is a free DLC quest released in July 2015. In this quest, Geralt investigates a village whose inhabitants have been mysteriously killed. The story centers on a confrontation with a Witcher from the School of the Cat and introduces choices that affect the outcome of the mission.

It adds a new standalone side quest with unique dialogue, a new location, and narrative ties to the broader Witcher lore.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Fool's Gold'
summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest 'Fool's Gold' is a free DLC quest released by CD Projekt Red on June 3, 2015. In this humorous side quest, Geralt teams up with a character named Hystian to investigate a seemingly cursed village inhabited by pigs.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - New Quest 'Contract: Missing Miners'
summary: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – New Quest 'Contract: Missing Miners' is a free DLC quest released by CD Projekt Red in May 2015. In this contract, Geralt investigates the disappearance of miners near the village of Blandare in Skellige.

name: The Message
summary: First person shooter in setting of 80th years. You need to kill everyone in the house. Use guns on levels, be fast and kill without doubt.

name: The Black Watchmen: Alone in the Dark Web
summary: In the Alone in the Dark Web DLC, you'll need to complete an all new in-client mission that brings you to the brink of the dark web - and insanity. Investigate the hidden secrets behind an occult website to discover the ultimate truths.

name: The Black Watchmen: Mother Russia
summary: In the Mother Russia DLC, you'll need to complete an all new in-client mission set that brings you through the cold case files of Agent Msika and the circumstances surrounding her disappearance. Investigate the dark truths behind secret Soviet weapons programs and their modern day counterparts.

name: The Black Watchmen: Season 2 - Enduring Conflict
summary: In Season 2 of The Black Watchmen you have been assigned to investigate the aftermath of the Abyss Incident. Get ready for a new set of missions, mini-games and puzzles where you'll battle against rival groups that wish to keep this advanced paranormal research to themselves.

name: The Black Watchmen: Whitechapel
summary: Rumors have emerged suggesting the return of one of the Agency's most dangerous enemies. Where he goes, mayhem surely follows...

name: The Surfeit: Episode 1
summary: Control the fate of Planet Naizyr, in this four-part Adult science fiction drama! Your choices change the events of this visual novel. Broker peace, instigate war, incite romance or ruin friendships. You are change and change is coming.

name: The Loop
summary: A lonely writer wakes up in the middle of the night. He doesn't feel like he's about to fall back asleep, so he gets up to have a drink. Something doesn't feel quite right, though. What he doesn't know is that he's in a loop, stuck forever in an endless loop of the same mundane events at the hands of a mysterious ghastly clown figure. But not everything is as it seems. There are clues, riddles scattered around the false world of this insane dream, and it's up to you to guide the protagonist into solving the puzzles laid out before him and escape from the loop!

name: The Question
summary: Sylvie has been your friend ever since you were children. But now, at the university, you need to ask her a question. This is a very small game made to teach others to work with the Ren'Py engine, and is available as a standalone download.

name: The Market of Light
summary: A short game and tech demo created with Unreal Engine 5. The player is a small firefly that collects orbs of light scattered around the market. Experience a meticulously rendered world from a micro view point!

name: The Forgotten Phobia
summary: The Forgotten Phobia is a horror puzzle game made in 2D pixel graphics.

name: The Sandbox: The Humans
summary: This extra Human Pack DLC offers to enhance your game experience in The Sandbox through the 60 extra levels of 4 new Campaigns!

name: The Survivor
summary: Welcome to the world of "The Survivor", hit by unknown virus which has wiped out most of the world's population. You are one of the few that have survived (stalkers) and now you must to fight for your life against what is left of the indigenous population now infected with the disease.

name: The World's Most Impossible Game
summary: The Worlds Most Impossible Game is a third person action game, where you as the player will have to maneuver throughout the course full of obstacles and manage to make it to the end without hitting anything.

name: The Research Age Deluxe
summary: In a time of turmoil and decay, a dark organization named INPLANT Industries and based in Harsh Town, casts its shadow over the world with it's sinister agenda.

name: The Goddess of Time and the Ice Princess: Episode 1
summary: The Goddess of Time and the Ice Princess episode 1 is the first part of a yuri visual novel following the love story of Catherine and Sabrina, along with the secrets that hold the Ice princess.

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Upgrade Pack 1
summary: Upgrade THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV STEAM EDITION for more amazing KOF XIV content! Includes additional DLC characters, DLC costumes, along with a bonus Digital Artbook & Digital Soundtrack for the ultimate KOF XIV experience!

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Upgrade Pack 2
summary:
This pack contains the following DLC content for “THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV STEAM EDITION

・4 DLC characters:
Oswald, Heidern, Najd, Blue Mary

name: The Hero Project: Redemption Season - MeChip Warning System
summary: Your MeChip will inform you of strategic possibilities and warn you if you're about to make a decision with a high level of risk.

name: The Reason Why Raeliana Ended up at the Duke's Mansion: Heika's Colorful Day Out
summary: The story that follows the happy ending with Noah. Step outside the mansion and enjoy a special holiday with the High Priest, Heika.

name: The Executioner: Watchmaker's Son
summary: The Watchmaker's Son is about the origin story of the Executioner's most controversial companion.

name: The Remainder: Act 1
summary: The Remainder is a dark fantasy mystery where you will try to save The High Magus Vyn from certain death. Will you find your way alone or will you reignite a lost love? Is it worth the sacrifice? Do you deserve to be saved?

name: The Trap: Remastered
summary: The game includes inside the Buzludzha Monument.

name: The Hardest Game in the Universe: Kangel
summary: The most difficult challenge on the planet, a new level of difficulty, more terrible, more complicated, with many more obstacles

name: The Maze
summary: The Maze- a giant maze set to challenge any puzzle fanatic.

name: Through Hell to Heaven
summary: Help Amy survive the Vile Demons in Hell in order to find the Portal and Ascend to Heaven.

name: The Survivalists: Monkey Business
summary: Survive in style. Add some flair to your wardrobe as you explore The Survivalists. The Monkey Business pack contains 3 player hats and 6 monkey hats, all as part of the Box-ex side quest.

name: The Advisor: Episode 1 - Royal Pain
summary: The Advisor Series is a player-driven narrative where your choices & decisions, both in the game, and out of the game, determine how future episodes unfold. Play the role of villain protagonist Magnus the Magician, as he wreaks havoc across the land, one well-placed fireball at a time!

name: The Dungeon Revealed
summary: Commercial re-release of the popular shareware roguelike, The Dungeon of Doom. Along with a new look to the interface, this version adds secret "vault" areas and a "Gate Keeper" boss on every fifth level. To escape the dungeon, you must descend to the 40th level and return with the Orb of Carnos.

name: Theldrow
summary: Theldrow is a turn-based computer role-playing game, written in 1989 by Glenn Andreas. The game featured a turn-based first person perspective interface similar to early Might and Magic games, pixel art (originally black-and-white), and a very original fantasy setting. It is a very difficult game.

name: The King of Fighters XV: Day One Edition
summary:
The King of Fighters XV, is the fifteenth installment of The King of Fighters series. Transcend beyond your limits with KOF XV! Classic popular characters, heroes and villains revived from the dead, new challengers, and more!

The Day One Edition includes:
- Base game
- DLC Costume: Terry "Garou: Mark of the Wolves

name: The Repairing Mantis
summary: The Repairing Mantis is a narrative horror game that lets you experience the disturbing, violent nightmare of a mantis on a mission to repair a bridge made of flying squirrel flesh.

name: The Island of Dr. Yepstein
summary: The Island of Dr. Yepstein - an uncompromising first-person action shooter that takes place on a paradise tropical island. The player in the role of a super-cool commando will have to meet face to face with dangerous enemies and solve all the secrets of the mysterious island.

name: The Escapists: Santa's Sweatshop
summary: After suffering Santa's cruel regime for 20 years, it's time you got back home to enjoy Christmas with your real family. Sick and tired of bad working conditions and rubbish pay, you decide to hit Santa where it hurts most and escape Santa's Sweatshop!

name: Thea: The Awakening - Return of the Giants
summary: The Return of the Giants is a free DLC for Thea: The Awakening. Just as you thought the Darkness was dealt with, a new threat rises and shakes the ground you've built on! Discover 70 new quests, new creatures and buildings and create your very own adventures in Thea!

name: The Line: The Other Path
summary: The other path is an alternative way to stand in the Line. In this DLC you can ignore cops, knocking at your door and escape in old living district.

name: The Plague: Kingdom Wars - Dead Rising
summary: The Dead Rising DLC adds an optional Undead mode to The Plague: Kingdom Wars campaign. The millions infected with the Black Death will soon turn into an even deadlier plague, as hordes of undead aimlessly roaming Europe, destroying everything in their path.

name: The Cure
summary: An open world strategy game set in a dark medieval fantasy environment. You can buy and place buildings and you must manage your resources to upgrade them. Every night, you are attacked by creatures.

name: The Remainder: Act 2
summary: The Remainder is a dark fantasy mystery where you will try to save The High Magus Vyn from certain death. Will you find your way alone or will you reignite a lost love? Is it worth the sacrifice? Do you deserve to be saved?

name: The Game of Life 2: Haunted Hills world
summary: Explore new worlds in THE GAME OF LIFE 2. Enter a realm where creepy creatures rule! Join your friends and family for a spooky adventure, wherever you are!

name: The Detail: Episode 2 - From the Ashes
summary: From the Ashes is the second episode of The Detail, a neo-noir crime adventure from Rival Games. It continues the story of detective Reggie Moore, informant Joe Miller and officer Katelyn Hayes as they seek to find out what is truly happening to their city.

name: The Pioneers: Surviving Desolation
summary: The Pioneers: surviving desolation is a survival/simulation game for PC. You play as a crew of specialists isolated in a space station and trying to survive the climatic and geological threats of Io, the first moon of Jupiter. Customize your space station, manage your vital resources, explore the surrounding area to strategize and complete your mission.

name: The Hunt
summary: The name says it all - in The Hunt, you get, well, hunted by hunters who will do everything they can to hunt you down. In order to survive, you must explore, scavenge, craft, and fight in order to survive. And if you survive and scavenge for long enough, there might just be a way to escape.

name: The Lost Valley
summary: Lightning killed your plane near an unknown continent.

name: The Game of Life 2: Frozen Lands World
summary: Explore in The Game of Life 2. Put on your warmest coat and snow boots, it's time to join your friends and family for magic that will never melt away, in the Frozen Lands world!

name: Three Kingdoms: The Last Warlord - The Age of Turbulence
summary: In the last years of the Han Dynasty, the empire was plunged into long-term chaos and turmoil. The warlords fought with each other; bandits run rampant; foreign races disturbed the frontiers; ancient beasts seem to be coming to the world soon...

name: The Lost Artifacts
summary: Explore dungeons, find crafting materials, unlock new locations and battle monsters in this turn based rpg game!

name: The Game of Life 2: Age of Giants World
summary: Step into The Game of Life 2: Age of Giants world! Experience a land where pegs and dinosaurs are the best of friends! From Coastal Caves, through the Jurassic Jungle, all the way to Stone Town, it's the journey of your prehistoric life!

name: The Game of Life 2: Sandy Shores World
summary: Dive into The Game of Life 2: Sandy Shores world! Watch the difficult decisions melt away on this forever holiday in the land of sunshine! Ride the waves as a Surf Instructor, or swim beneath them as a Marine Biologist. It's a life-long escape and the choices are all yours!

name: The Game of Life 2: Fairytale Kingdom World
summary: There are more worlds to explore in THE GAME OF LIFE 2. Join your friends and family in a mystical adventure through the Fairytale Kingdom world, where dreams come true!

name: The Seven Years War (1756-1763): Pomeranian War
summary: The Seven Years War (1756-1763) - Pomeranian WarONCE A GREAT NORTHERN EMPIRE, NOW DEGRADED. A FLEETING MOMENT IN HISTORY. A CHANCE TO RESTORE WHAT WAS LOST?- new playable nation: Sweden- 5 new campaign scenarios for Sweden, where you may attempt to lead the nation from 1750 all the way through the war, or go for historical goals in the...

name: The Lost Legends of Redwall: The Scout - Act 3
summary: A whimsical puzzle-adventure game set in the world of the bestselling Redwall books. In this third and final episode, seeking escape from Cheesfthief you find yourself beholden to a family of mysterious Stoats who may or may not be carnivores...

name: The Detail: Episode 3 - Devil in the Detail
summary: Devil in the Detail is the third and final episode of the first season of The Detail, a neo-noir crime adventure from Rival Games. It brings the modern noir story of detective Reggie Moore, informant Joe Miller and officer Katelyn Hayes to a dramatic finale.

name: The Great War 1918
summary: TGW 1918 is a WW1 modification for Company of Heroes, focusing on the last year of the First World War. Currently it features the British Expeditionary Force and the German Empire as opposing factions; however new nations will be brought over time, such as France and Austria-Hungary.

name: The Lost Legends of Redwall: The Scout - Act 2
summary: A whimsical puzzle-adventure game set in the world of the bestselling Redwall books. In this second episode, fresh off your defeat of the murderous Scumsnout, you wake to hear the sounds of battle - and must make your way into the fray to find your lost beloved!

name: The Book of Bondmaids
summary: A Kingdom in ruins, a Princess in chains, a Hero caught between redemption and damnation, and an ancient, worn, dusty old Book...

name: The Hurricane of the Varstray: Threat of Third Force
summary: The Hurricane of the Varstray -Threat of 3rd Force- Studio siestA high speed SF shooting game!The story will be the day before "The Hurricane of the Varstray". An additional story of full voice. All 8 stages of play stage. New weapons "Diverion" and "Highgrabaster" added!

name: This Throne Is Mine: The Card Game
summary: You play as King of Qin, the one ended the 500-year civil war on this land. Act like a King to manage your follower and the royal court and unite the country. Ready to defence your throne?

name: The Bum
summary: The game tells a story of a homeless man who communicates with the world using an old sock on his right hand. He's a huge football fan and plays it a lot near his backalley. One day he gets mugged by a wandering bully and looses his precious ball in the process. Now he must pull himself together, team up with a local superhero, find a new ball and confront his oppressor again. Available in English, German & Polish

name: The Dungeons of Grimlor
summary:
The Dungeons Of Grimlor is a shareware puzzle action game.

The souls of all the children of Grimlor have been captured by the dragon that lives beneath the town. Naturally, the honour of entering the evil dragon's dungeon falls to Sir Merdimek, who is the most famous dragon slayer in the town of Grimlor. The story places the player in the role of Sir Merdimek to whom the task of navigating the dungeon's many rooms, collecting treasure and killing monsters has fallen.

name: The Dungeons of Grimlor II
summary: The Dungeons of Grimlor II is a single player, shareware, DOS dungeon game. The dungeons are labyrinthine and are full of traps to avoid, monsters to battle and puzzles to solve. Boulders can be moved to trap nasties and to block arrow shooting walls. There are some monsters which cannot be killed by Sir Merdimek's arrows, though they are vulnerable to other things, and there are wizards who can raise the dead. Sir Merdimek can ride rivers to secret rooms and use teleporters which may lead more hidden treasures.

name: The Bunker
summary: Ronin golfer Mike Roman just wants to play golf, but when the evil sorcerer Manlocke miniaturizes him and traps him in the bunker, he must utilize his wits and his golf club in order to escape... ...or he may never be able to play golf again. This game was the winner of the June 2005 MAGS competition.

name: The Ramen Prince
summary: A Visual Novel game that chronicles the loves and tribulations of a young man who, thanks to a generous benefactor, is starting fresh in a new city and opening a new ramen restaurant.

name: The Burgomaster
summary: A dark plague is consuming the town. One doctor is left to learn the truth, and try to find a cure.

name: The Cabin
summary:
Why can't you remember a time before the snow started falling?

The Cabin is a short, first person, slow-burn psychological thriller set in a cabin. Why is this cabin here? Better yet, why are you here?

The Cabin is proof-of-concept game created in 15 days for the November 2020 AGS monthly adventure game challenge.

name: The Cadaver Synod
summary: The year is 897. Pope Stephen the sixth or seventh, is holding a trial against his predecessor Formosus, and you have been chosen as Formosus defender. The thing is, you hardly know a thing about law. That's probably why Stephen chose you. This game was made for MAGS in June 2016 with the theme "Neglected Historical Eras".

name: The Dark Convergence
summary:
The Dark Convergence is a very rare horror adventure game from the early '90s.

The plot is simple: one night the player and some friends have a car crash on a near-deserted road. The player is sent out to search for some help and stumbles on an abandoned house. Inside it bloody bodies are found, and unknown menaces from other worlds and other dimensions try to kill the player. Will you survive the night and save the day?

The game is programmed in QBasic (there is even the .bas file inside the game's folder) and the engine is similar to the one used in the Hugo's House of Horror series. The player controls the character with arrow keys and types the desired action using the parser.

The game focuses on a morbid atmosphere and on violence with many nasty and gory situations in it. The plot and atmosphere for some ideas are reminiscent of Dark Seed.

name: The Dark Convergence II
summary:
This is the sequel to The Dark Convergence and takes place some time after the end of the original game.

The player has survived the horrible night, but his mind is deeply scarred by the horrors he had to face. In fact, the player lives as a bum, wandering aimlessly on the streets, not capable of retrieving his own lost sanity. A new horrid menace may be lurking underneath the apparent calm and may be linked to the psychiatrist who is searching for the player...

This game uses the same engine as the original game with similar gameplay and atmospheres.

name: The Darkest Night
summary:
The Darkest Night is a graphical adventure game with a horror theme, set in the land of 'Tilorm'. The protagonist is a young anthropomorphic fox called 'Rolan', who is lost in a forest after an evening of heavy drinking with his friends, celebrating Hallows Eve.
While sleeping it off in the woods, he is awakened by a tattered and bloody yelling man, who comes running up to you, collapsing but managing to tell you of an evil cult trying to release the Demon Yaxagiraw tonight, a netherworld being who was imprisoned in an old Abbey hundreds of years ago, but who could be released again during Hallows night, when the souls of the damned are close to our dimension.
Having delivered his warning, the man dies and leaves you to prevent the cultists from achieving their goal.

name: The Disgraced Prince
summary: This is the story of a prince who, due to a tiny attempt to murder his own sister and usurp the throne, has been forced into exile in a remote mountain monastery. Surprising to none, something sinister dwells among this isolated group of men dressed in dark hooded cloaks. Seriously, has anyone seen a story about a rural community that DIDN'T hide something fishy?

name: The Execution of Anne Boleyn
summary: Created for MAGS September 2017, for the theme "Past and Future Collide". When villains from the future alter the past, a time traveler must try to set history back on track with the help of an imprisoned queen.

name: The Frame on the Wall
summary: This project was made in collaboration with Blondbraid for Mags october 2017. An old woman ends up in a small cabin in the woods a stormy night, but is everything alright with the strange old painting hung on the wall?

name: The Kingdom of Syree
summary:
The Kingdom of Syree is a RPG based on the novels by Lord Steven and heavily inspired by the earlier Ultima games.

After many years of peace evil is threatening the kingdom of Syree: an evil wizard wishes to conquer the kingdom. None of the kingdom's great heroes have returned from their search for the wizard, and now it is your time to search for him and kill him.

The screen is divided into three parts. To the upper left is the game area where all the action takes place. To the upper right is the status area where you can see your equipment, health and wealth, and at the bottom of the screen is the message window where conversations and such will show up. The game features lots of exploring and monster killing.

name: The Lost Tribe
summary:
In The Lost Tribe you get to go back in time and lead a prehistoric tribe to a new homeland. When the volcano that your tribe has always called "home" explodes and molten lava engulfs your village at its base, you have little choice but to assume command of your frightened tribe and seek out a different place to live. This means providing for your tribe's food, shelter, safety, and general happiness all along the way.

Six different scenarios provide a variety of challenges for players of various skill levels. The game's educational side is present in teaching the player about prehistoric cultures, artifacts, and mythology.

name: The Man From Fugue State
summary: A stranger arrives in the sleepy town of Tumbleweed with no memory of his identity only to find the residents suffering at the hands of feared outlaw El Marcado, 'the marked one'. Soon he finds himself caught up in a plot to defeat the outlaw once and for all. But who is this stranger and why is the mysterious El Marcado so interested in Tumbleweed?

name: The Revenant Protocol
summary: The Revenant Protocol is a third person shooter with hack'n slash features where you will combine your deadly blade and vicious firepower to become the apex hunter in a world mutated by an experimental technology.

name: The Elm Game
summary: A board game for two players that is easy to learn yet hard to master, played on a stylized tree stump. The computer can substitute for a second player at any time.

name: The Long Journey to Farewell
summary: An SNES style action\puzzle RPG. Help two friends caught as a queen tries to save her brother but curses him instead. Dramatic story, loveable characters, strategic action battles, amusing puzzles and a fantasy\sci-fi world to explore.

name: Throne of Fate: Tiger Roar
summary:
Throne of Fate: Tiger Roar includes:
- Sword FINN damage 20-20
- Special hairstyle
- Special body
- FINN costume (Mask, body)

name: Throne of Fate: Hell Demon
summary:
Throne of Fate: Hell Demon includes:
- Sword Sausage in the dough damage 0-99
- Special hairstyle
- Special body
- Sandwich suit (Mask, body)

name: The Ever-Beginning Tale
summary: You find yourself in a strange new world and now you must find your way back home!

name: The McCarthy Chronicles: Episode 1
summary:
A film-noir inspired, supernatural detective story.

Rick McCarthy is a private detective marred by a secretive and destructive past.

He is pulled into a world of blood sacrifice and invocation.

Can he hide his past, solve the crime and get the girl?

name: The Madness of Roland
summary: Interactive novel and audiobook with FMV cutscenes that adapts the epic poem Orlando Furioso about medieval French king Charlemagne's heroic paladin Roland who falls tragically in love with sorceress Angelica and loses his mind.

name: The Book of Yorle: Save the Kingdom
summary: In the final chapter of The Book of Yorle, you must Save the Kingdom and banish the Evil Ones forever! Battle your way through Castle, a hidden Pirate Ship, and Caverns to find the secret lair of the Evil Ones. Complete your book with one of two unique endings - one is only possible if you own all 4 DLCs.

name: The Legend of Dark Witch Renovation: Day Stage
summary: You can play the Day stage. It is a very difficult stage, so it is recommended to play after all stages have been completed.

name: The Trolley Problem Game
summary: The Trolley Problem Game creates has over 500 different interpretations of The Trolley Problem for the player to solve!

name: The Spirit
summary: The Spirit is a simple Action RPG with elements of old school dungeon crawlers. Creatures and Demons are entering through the Rift. The people of the realm need you, but so does your family.

name: Theomachiae
summary: Play as giant monsters and fight! Sow destruction and chaos in destructible environments! And compete against other players in local or online multiplayer.

name: The Little Drone 2
summary: You are a little drone sent to investigate a debris field on the edge of Dark Space in a lost world behind the Bermuda Triangle, that seems to be caught in some kind of state of flux. You must collect all Data Nodes lost there so that their data can be retrieved by your makers back in Cloud Space.

name: The Devil's Luck
summary: A psychological horror experience situated in an apartment, with puzzles and scares to mess with your mind, alongside therapeutic rain sounds!

name: The Chaos Gene
summary: The Chaos Gene is a Indie casual fighting game. Inspired by some of the classic fighting games I grew up playing in the arcades.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki I KAI - Thors Military Academy 1204
summary:
The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki role-playing game series is highly acclaimed by gamers all over the world for its elaborate character portrayals and epic storyline. The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki and The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki II have sold over 1 million copies in total.
The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki I: Kai: Thors Military Academy 1204 is a remastered version of the series' iconic first installment, including all-new features!
The game also features the popular high-speed Skip Mode from the PlayStation4 version. With the touch of a button, you can jump between events and fields at twice the normal speed, and battles at four times the normal speed!

Tension is raising in the militaristic Erebonian Empire due to the conflict between the Nobel and Reformist Factions.
A dramatic busy student life awaits for members in special Class VII—established by the renowned Thors Military Academy—and Rean who is chosen as the new member!

name: Theogony: Crystal Water Blue
summary: A monster taming game crossed with tactical grid based combat and open exploration.

name: The Witch Doctor
summary: Lua is a Witch Doctor, a mutated magician that helps those in need, though they only repay her with disdain and prejudice. As one of the last of her kind, Lua finds out a fellow magician has evil plans to ressurrect the Gigantos, she takes it upon herself to stop the rogue magician.

name: The Mistral Report
summary: An espionage-themed turn-based RPG in which an agent must track down a rival agent hunting down their employees by infiltrating the hideouts of their rival's connections.

name: The Princess and The Frog
summary: Experience Tiana's exciting world set in the jazz-infused era of 1920's New Orleans with the official video game inspired by the Walt Disney Pictures release of The Princess and the Frog. Celebrate favorite moments from the movie and take on new challenges with Tiana, as she pursues her dreams in a fun adventure. Meet favorite characters from the film and new friends, triumph over enemies, play frog games in the bayou, create music, cook New Orleans style and so much more. Along the way, discover what it takes to make Tiana's dreams come true!

name: The Bookwalker: Thief of Tales
summary: The Bookwalker is a narrative adventure where you play as Etienne Quist, a writer-turned-thief with the ability to dive into books. Use your powers to traverse reality and book worlds, and track and retrieve famous items like Thor's Hammer and the Excalibur in exchange for your creative freedom.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask - Masked Quest
summary: This is the second phase of Garo-Mastah's modifications of the game, with many changes in the gameplay, altering many known locations.

name: The Legend of Zelda Game Watch
summary: The Legend of Zelda Game Watch, referred to as The Legend of Zelda 8321 in the instruction manual, is a combined game and wristwatch released by Nelsonic Industries.

name: The Legend of the Spirit Bird
summary: An evil spirit has thrown the ancient forest into disarray. Search for the long-lost magical masks of the forest's protectors and help restore the balance in this eerie adventure. For young and adult dreamers alike.

name: The Adventures of Bryan Scott
summary: 2D point & click adventure, that combines classic elements from games like "Broken Sword" and "Deponia".

name: Thetan Arena
summary: Thetan Arena is an e-sport game based on Blockchain technology. You can gather your friends, form a team, battle with others and earn money with just your skills. Thetan Arena's gameplay is designed to revolve around the combination of your personal skills and teamwork. Challenge yourself with various game modes: MOBA & Battle Royale, coming with monthly updates and attractive rewards.

name: The King of Fighters XV: Deluxe Edition
summary:
The King of Fighters XV, is the fifteenth installment of The King of Fighters series. Transcend beyond your limits with KOF XV! Classic popular characters, heroes and villains revived from the dead, new challengers, and more!

The Deluxe Edition includes:
- Base game
- KOF XV DLC Characters "Team 1"
- KOF XV DLC Characters "Team 2"
- KOF XV DLC Costume "Garou: MotW Terry"
- Digital Edition Exclusive Bonus
- KOF XV DLC Costume "Classic Leona"

name: The Raven: Legacy of a Master Thief - Episode 2
summary: The Raven: Legacy of a Master Thief is a thrilling crime adventure in three episodes. This thrilling crime adventure – full of twists and turns – immerses you in both sides of the story, combining elements of classic whodunit and heist stories. Cinematic presentation with hundreds of camera angles and dozens of cutscenes. Optional puzzles and scoring system for adventure game veterans Notebook and help function for adventure game newcomers.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Picross
summary:
A picross fangame based on A Link to the Past, available for Windows and in the Universal Updater for the 3DS homebrew.

You start at Link's house, go to Hyrule Field where a fork leads you to the main dungeon (since the other ways are blocked by a boulder and a grass respectively), fight an enemy in the dungeon that gives you a sword to cut the grass, and so on. It has exploration, bosses, itens, hearts and a bucketload of picross puzzles.

name: The Awakener: Risen
summary: Set in a medieval fantasy world, Arise of Awakener is a third-person action-adventure game with a class system that gives players direct control in how they choose to fight. With three class choices - mages, archers, and warriors, the way players decide to fight the fantastical creatures which fill this world is entirely up to them. Battles are great spectacles in which players must use their abilities and weapons to overcome the trials and challenges they will face. Fight dragons, control flying airships, collect resources and explore the expansive world that Arise of Awakener offers

name: The Robolovers
summary: Do you believe in love and future full of troubled robots? Well, then this game is for you! You play as a LO43R, a robot prepared to do anything to have love back in his life. Naturally, she is trapped in a sleazy massage parlour. It's your job to fight the bad robots, use the help of not so bad ones and get her out of there.

name: The Bend
summary: Enter the depths of the ocean and discover a mystery in this tense, thrilling adventure.

name: The Trials
summary: Use three challenging skills including moving between worlds, teleporting and time manipulation to discover seven main areas in The Trials island and solve over 30 side puzzles to collect gemstone to unlock new areas on the island.

name: The Twins' Experiment
summary: The Twins' Experiment is a platform adventure game. You play as Object 62473 who is called to discover his hidden brother in a dream world of his mind.

name: The Upturned
summary: A frantic adventure. Welcome to the Upturned Inn: a grand hotel for the dead! You just want to find your room.

name: Three in a Rogue
summary: Three in a Rogue is a tactical turn-based three in a row roguelike. Cascade combos to fight monsters and explore a randomly generated dungeon.

name: The Chicken's Fall
summary: Once Upon a time, A chicken that dreamed of flying, she tried 30 times... and fell. Fall, dodge obstacles and don't die.

name: The Eightfold Path
summary: The path of a Buddhist monk is a path of enlighenment. Find your way through the mystical forest and encounter beautiful creatures, magical places, evil spirits and puzzling challenges which you will have to complete in order to be released from suffering.

name: The Last Will
summary: "The Last Will" is a 3D point-and-click adventure game played from the perspective of a grieving father whose son just passed away.

name: The Facility Project
summary: An epic horror adventure crafted with a strong focus on atmosphere and story. Explore the environments of an abandoned facility, solving its mystery. Action taking place in the year 2006, play as a private investigator tasked to obtain information about the strange activities that were rumored.

name: The VanMan
summary: this game is made by one person and will be uppdated irregulary

name: The Last Cadet
summary: The Last Cadet is a deep sea action-driven metroidvania with elements of dread and isolation. Play one of two single player campaigns using twin-stick controls to escape a submarine sunk by an ancient monster. Also featuring two local co-op multiplayer modes at launch.

name: The Steps of Divynia
summary: Fight tainted beasts and uncover magic as Eustera transforms from the mundane to the unknown. Carve out your destiny as Aldyia in a tale about courage and holding to your beliefs. Is the past worth not knowing, or does it deserve to be remembered? Find out in this storybook 2D platforming adventure.

name: The Story of Bill Bear
summary: Help the little bear to find the way home. What dangers can be hidden in the night streets of a quiet suburb? Who is waiting for him at home, and who is waiting in the dark around the corner?

name: The Dawning
summary: The Dawning is a first-person puzzle mystery game. Play as Detective Madison as he searches 7 beautifully crafted areas for clues to catch a killer. Use stealth to sneak past deadly enemies. Solve complex puzzles to access new areas, progress the rich storyline, and obtain key items.

name: The Hero of Bangaona
summary: The Hero of Bangaona is a 2D Side-scrolling Action game where you play as the Hero of Bangaona kingdom whose mission is to capture the enemy bases in order to rescue the Princess who got kidnapped by the soldiers of the Weins Territory.

name: The Island: Into the Mist
summary: The Island: Into The Mist is a mystery adventure visual novel where every decision counts.

name: The Last Worker
summary: The Last Worker is a first person narrative adventure centered around our struggle in an increasingly automated world. Combining a hand crafted art style with uniquely immersive gameplay mechanics in an epic setting, The Last Worker delivers an emotional, thought provoking and comedic story packaged with rich characters performed by an all-star cast.

name: The Card Battle: Eternal Destiny
summary: The Card Battle: Eternal Destiny is an epic card game inspired by myths and legends, featuring 600+ cards with delightful animation! Build your own deck with various cards, and beat enemies with high-level strategy combining evolutions, abilities, and attributes.

name: The Forgotten City: Cloud Version
summary:
The Forgotten City - Cloud Version is a mystery adventure game of exploration and deduction, and a re-imagining of the critically acclaimed mod that won a national Writers' Guild award and racked up over 3 million downloads.
Combat is an option, but violence will only get you so far. Only by questioning an intertwined community of colourful characters, cleverly exploiting the time loop, and making difficult moral choices can you hope to solve this epic mystery. Here, your decisions matter. The fate of the city is in your hands.

name: The Survivalists: Deluxe Edition
summary: A living world full of surprises, secrets and danger awaits in The Survivalists, an adventure-filled survival sandbox set in The Escapists universe. Explore, build, craft and even train monkeys with up to three friends in a desperate bid to survive. Be prepared for your trek into the unknown and pack The Survivalists Deluxe Edition for the journey ahead.

name: The Last War
summary: The Last War is an online multiplayer shooter where are you try to kill the opposite team with your friends, after you kill so many call And a kill streak and see what happens, customize your weapons and play a lot game modes.

name: The Age of Gods Return
summary: Behind the people and law of elementary physics,there are transcendental law instigator protect this world and pointer space which store the souls of everyone.

name: The Judgement of Q
summary: In an alternate reality, using a keyboard and a mouse, despite the danger of dissolving to nothing again, the player chose to transform potential into actuality, in a space of possibility he will try every key and every combination of keys until he forms an ultimate map of this new reality.

name: The Ghost Cage
summary: In this short and light-hearted adventure game, you inadvertently rent a house with a ghost. Should you befriend the ghost, or drive it out of the house? Multiple endings available depending on your choices and the items you find!

name: They Are Coming!
summary: They Are Coming! is a zombie action game. Control, upgrade and grow your zombie horde. Defeat all humans through past, present, and future and make the zombie apocalypse happen!

name: The Madhouse: Kansen Yashiki
summary: The Madhouse | Kansen Yashiki is a survival horror game. Contains Fear, Stealth, Exploration/Puzzle solving, Item management. Moreover "Multiple first-person views" provides a new level of fear, immersion, strategy. Steal the vision of "something" lurking in the abandoned house and try to survive.

summary: A thru-hiking roguelite adventure

name: The Prisoner of the Night
summary: The Prisoner of the Night is a single-player platforming game with a wide range of scenarios, where the lovely girl Nartide must survive terrible monsters and deadly traps in the darkest, scariest night of her life.
