name: The Walking Stick
summary: A stylish old man who loves adrenaline enters a world where canes release power. Collect powerful canes and travel through the four biomes full of challenges and action in an endless fight to conquer this fantastic world.

name: Thirty-One 3D Premium
summary: Thirty-One 3D Premium brings a lot of game variants, challenging opponents and environments with great 3D graphics on your PC.You can play in Singleplayer offline or LAN and Online Mode! The full animated Tutorial explains rules of the popular card game step by step.

name: The Hungry One
summary: A mysterious story about the consequences of loneliness and unfulfilled dreams. Help artificial intelligence in the form of a little girl and avoid facing a ruthless monster.

name: The Grip of Madness
summary: The Grip of Madness is a multiplayer cooperative FPS where your teammates can betray you at any time. Shoot your way through hordes of monsters, gather clues, and complete the ritual to stop their invasion.

name: The Cloud Dream of the Nine
summary:
Yang Soyu, lives in a village in Hwaju Castle, in the state of Cheonin. Her father, a fairy god from Mt. Gonryun ascended to the fairy world after his connection with the human world came to an end when his beloved wife passed away, Soyu’s mother.

With no parents to raise her, Soyu was taken in by her friend Chaeyoon and his family. While the villagers in her town, are resentful to Soyu, thinking her story about her father being a fairy god is absurd, it was only her friend Chaeyoon and his family, that she fully trusts.

One unfortunate day, their house burned down and amidst the calamity, Chaeyoon goes missing. Soyu sets off on a journey to find her friend, and along the way meets new characters (which either became her friend or her potential love interest).

During her journey, Soyu will get to unravel the secrets behind the political tyranny of their land. Her fate and ending will change depending on the choices you, as a player, choose for her.

name: The Unearthened
summary: Build & defend a small remote mining base on Taichin XI from the alien hordes. Deploy defenses, upgrade your turrets and get ready for the nightfall. The Unearthened is a classic Tower Defense game where you build towers and prepare for the invasion.

name: They Look Like People
summary: A Psychological story game set within a Kubrickian world. A tale of Space & Adventure into the Abyss of your mind, two astronauts come into close encounters with an unknown object during a routine mission.

name: The Last Clockwinder
summary: Create intricate clockwork contraptions out of your own clones and restore life to an ancient tree. Your mission is to repair the Clocktower, an ancient haven for the galaxy’s plants and seeds.

name: The Witchmade Shop
summary: The Witchmade Shop is a witch shop simulator in a provincial town. Listen to the stories of visitors, take orders, brew potions (trying not to poison the one who will use it), earn money, buy ingredients, and everything in a circle.

name: The Van of Justice
summary: The van of justice is an action casual simulation game that contains many physical interaction elements. Knock all the students who bullied kim out. And it's also a good idea to show them around the police van of the police "J". At final, buy a nuke in kim's home and explode the entire school!

name: The Labyrinth of Greed
summary: Having collected all the treasures, you will gain power that the gods themselves did not dream of. Classic gameplay in which you have to collect items and avoid dangers.

name: The First Odyssey
summary: Face an Odyssey built on violence, horror, puzzles, challenges and human cynicism. Experience a truly atmospheric and realistic survival horror experience in a dystopian future.

name: The Night You'd Wish to Forget
summary: One night, an alarm goes off in the old mansion of one of the richest families in the world. You, an employee of a security agency, go to find out the reason for this, but you quickly realize that everything is not as simple as it seemed at first.

name: That Castle
summary: A huge castle arose in the north devastating everything around it, the kingdoms are afraid, making agreements and political movements. A reward was made to the brave, can you find the culprit and put an end to it?

name: THICC: The Himalayan Ice Climbing Challenge
summary: THICC: The Himalayan Ice Climbing Challenge is a 2-4 player online party game. Climb, Swing, Grab your way to claim victory over your friends in the THICC cup.

name: The Final Hour
summary: The Final Hour is a captivating first person horror game with its very own story. Can you solve the mystery of the mysterious house? Has your final hour come? Find out now in "The Final Hour."

name: The Dark Prophecy
summary: The Dark Prophecy is a 2D pixel-art point & click adventure inspired by the best retro games of the 90's. Welcome to a peaceful medieval village, where life is safe and calm. But one fateful night, everything changes.

name: The Last Rite of Death
summary: You will have to get used to the role of the main character James, with whom you will learn the terrible story of his Walker family, solve riddles, get to the truth and find out what really happened in this cursed house.

name: The Legend of the War Axe
summary: The Legend of the War Ax is a real-time, third-person PvP combat. Choose a hero and fight other players in various arenas. Dynamic sword fighting, archery, magic and bombs. Now there are 8 heroes for which you can play.

name: The Soul Box
summary: The Soul Box is a kinetic visual novel about the mystery of a puzzle box. A story of an inheritance hidden behind what’s written. A different look at the future, a worried glance at the past.

name: The Future Project
summary: Take control of an AI soldier, explore planets, and partake in fast paced combat in The Future Project, a first person metroidvania. Explore distinct worlds, obtain new weapons and abilities, and defeat powerful enemies in humanity's quest to journey the stars.

name: The Infecting 3
summary: Fight zombies, customise your character or your ride and try to survive! In The Infecting 3 the characters have crash landed on a mysterious island, and must find the truth behind this horrific apocalypse.

name: The Tribulation Entanglement
summary: Born into a nightmarish fever dream, the Entangled One must fight its way through diverse, visually striking environments, from a blasted wasteland beneath an eternal eclipse, to mutant-filled swamps, and the putrid guts of the underworld...

name: The Misty Tale
summary: The Misty Tale is a third-person fantasy-fighting game where you have to swim on a raft, navigate the terrain on the map, find and remove magical runes, and fight their defenders, to fulfill the request of your savior

name: The Fabulous Fear Machine
summary: Everything you’ve ever dreamed of can be yours with The Fabulous Fear Machine, a narrative-driven strategy game with a pulp horror style. Become a Master of the Machine, spread the darkest Legends of urban myth, and let fear rule the world.

name: The Divide
summary: "The Divide" Is a tactical turn-based strategy game, with deckbuilding elements, set in a divided land, fight for your king, and unite the kingdom!

name: The Hepatica Spring
summary: Run a beautiful bathhotel, uncover drama, and date a fabulous cast in this fairytale-inspired visual novel!

name: The Legends of Tynedale
summary: The Legends of Tynedale is a classic top-down action adventure game. Journey with Geordie as he takes on his Grandfather’s legacy: to find out if there is truth in the old Legends.

name: The 8 Sins: New Hell Order
summary: Turn-based horror strategy game with RPG elements where the action takes place in hell, player take lead one of 8 demonic races that each of them represents one of 7 Deadly Sins (the 8th sin is Acedia).

name: The Pied Piper of Gamelin
summary: Casual third person game. In fact, this is a remake of "Snake", but thanks to the 3D graphics it has a peculiar gameplay. The camera position can be easily adjusted at will. Character control is very simple, you can also use a gamepad.

name: The Unlikely Prometheus
summary: A classic 2D Point and Click adventure game

name: The Vellescian Gambit
summary: Play the role of a merchant's apprentice in this 1600s-inspired realistic setting full with trading companies and business ploys. A short (2-3h) but replayable visual novel/RPG with logistics and trading aspects, brought to life with beautiful baroque paintings and classical music.

name: The Medieval Psychologist
summary: You are a stranger in Lostworth, full of people lost in the darkness of the Middle Ages. Your purpose; helping people spiritually. For this, you only have books, potions, spells and your words. In this adventure, you will face the truth about yourself as you uncover the secrets of the city.

name: Three Defilements
summary: Three Defilements is a hack and slash adventure game about a young woman who keeps waking up in the same place every day. She travels to find a way out of this cycle, passing through various strange places. and must battle her most vexing foe, her own defilements.

name: There is No Stairs
summary: Thousands of rocket jump accidents are reported worldwide every year. Unfortunately, a bald inventor here also lost legs trying to get up to the second floor. But he wasn't frustrated. Now he is designing an unprecedented new invention, dreaming of a world without rocket jumps... It's the stairs.

name: The Dormant Knight
summary: Fight your way through hordes of skeletons and spirits, in The Dormant Knight! A 2D Halloween Hack and Slash, Adventure. Explore the mysterious land of Dreadborough, a once lavish land now tainted by evil spirits due to the Dormant Knight's re-wakening! Why has the Dormant Knight awoken once more?

name: The Circle of Suffering
summary: This game is a psychological horror in which the main character wakes up in an unfamiliar house and must pass all the levels by solving puzzles.

name: The Spanish Privateer
summary: Escape the confines of high-society and find freedom, romance, and danger on the high seas as a privateer in this pirate otome. A historical fiction visual novel set in the early 17th century, travel from Spain across the Caribbean while surviving life at sea.

name: The Holy Chalice
summary: The Holy Chalice is a fast-paced top down roguelike based in a fantasy world. You are a goblin shaman whose village has just been attacked and the villages holy chalice has been stolen by the evil entity. Fight different bosses and explore a fantasy world in this shooter roguelike.

name: They Came From Below
summary: They Came From Below is a cute Tower Defense in Lowpoly 3D graphics. Here you have to build an economy and various defense towers to resist hordes of skeletons.

name: The Missing Link
summary: The Missing Link is a pixel art-style RPG game with turn-based strategy. Available in portuguese and english. The game features: 90 collectable cards for the mini-game, +400 spells, legendary weapons and demonic relics forging system, resource collection system, 9 playable characters.

name: That Role Playing
summary: In a sinister days, when the darkness condensed in tricking all of us, only the Light of our Souls and clear-eyed Consciousness could serve well to save the people of The Fantasy Kingdom. Once again — a brave and skilful knight sets forth in a quest to find the legendary seven Crystals of Light...

name: The Shadows Lengthen
summary: A first-person, open-world, horror indie game made only in Blender!

name: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown
summary: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown is a complex city builder, where the fate of your kingdom hinges on your every decision. Explore this medieval land alone or with friends, make tough moral choices and conquer your foes in RTS combat. Will you struggle to survive, or find the strength to Thrive?

name: The Oldest Edda
summary: Control the brave Runar, the toothy, one on a journey to the ends of Niflheim to fulfill a mission given by Odin: Stop a beast known as Grabak in exchange for survival. Venture into this Oldschool 2D platform game through a variety of unique and hostile environments.

name: The Hellbrand
summary: Set in a time where gods and monsters still share the world with humans. Embark on a quest as The Hellbrand, a king who has made a deal with the devil to bring his son back to life, as long as you retrieve an ancient weapon for her in return... How far are you willing to go to save your son's life?

name: The Trooper
summary: The Trooper is a third-person shooter in a modern war setting and Low Poly style.

name: The Forgotten Castle
summary: Play as an old man who wakes up in a mysterious castle full of magic and danger. Explore every corner of the castle and discover what is hidden between the walls of this misterious and ancient place while you keep fighting with monsters and improving your abilities.

name: The Simpsons: Itchy & Scratchy Land
summary: The Simpsons: Itchy & Scratchy Land is a 2.5D adventure mobile game based on The Simpsons. Run For Your Lives! It's The Simpsons Itchy & Scratchy Land! Just like in the classic Simpsons episode, our favorite family's theme park outing is ruined by Itchy & Scratchy 'bots. Play as Homer, Bart, Lisa and Marge as they survive Explosion Land, Unnecessary Surgery Land, Torture Land and Searing Gas Pain Land. Kill the Kill 'bots with Bart's stink bomb slingshot. Build Bomb 'bots with Lisa's Robo-Generator. Blow 'bots to bits with Marge's vacuum gun. Life is a thrill ride with The Simpsons.

name: The Thorn of Warldia
summary: The Thorn of Warldia is a fantasy turn-based tactical RPG with an interesting story and unique character art that takes place in the world of Warldia! Take command of Thorn and his friends in their journey towards freedom.

name: The Last Exterminator
summary: You're an exterminator. You kill things for a living. When a hostile invasion of alien cockroaches rocks your city, you've got a job to do. A high-octane retro-FPS inspired by some of the best games of the 90s.

name: The Final Rescue
summary: The world is plagued by a deadly virus. You are the last human to survive in what is left of the city, and perhaps even the world. Your only mission is to find a way to reverse the effects of the virus.

name: The Haunted Grounds
summary: Introducing, "The Haunted Grounds" - a new and upcoming indie horror game, developed by BA747 and made in the Unity game engine. The Haunted Grounds is targeted for PC platforms, with ultra realistic graphics. It provides a new take on the psychological horror genre, with stunning graphics.

name: The Adventurer's Domain Online
summary: The Adventurer’s Domain Online is a multiplayer online RPG offering a shared world for players to adventure. TADO attempts to merge some ‘classic’ MMO vibes with more modern third person action combat systems.

name: The Family Cat
summary: An emotional, 3rd-person adventure story game about a cat separated from his family who are dealing with cancer. Players take control of the cat on a touching and beautiful journey as he tries to reunite with his family!

name: Threaded
summary: A beautiful relaxing new twist on pixel art puzzles. Color beautiful threaded pixel art while learning some trivia along the way!

name: The Flow Experience
summary: The Flow Experience is a classic 2D action game about evading and blocking enemy attacks through rythmic interactions on your path to personal growth. Move, dash, and guard to protect yourself and find your true potential on this zen-like twist on traditional arcade bullet hells.

name: The Celestra
summary: Celestra is a text-based online RPG in which you’ll play one of the crew on a sci-fi ship exploring the galaxy and trying to save their home. Choose from one of seven departments and raise your skills as you embark on missions throughout the cosmos.

name: The Northern Gate: Special Agent
summary: Save the world from the monsters invading! With your flying board, keep moving, get weapons, and kill the monsters! Don't forget to make strategies before every combat because it won't be an easy fight!

name: The Mysterious Misadventures of Mollie & Mordecai
summary: Mollie and Mordecai are transformed into dolls by an evil wizard, and have to team up to find his magical book to change themselves back.

name: The Ancients
summary: The Ancients is a turn-based survival strategy game where you will manage a hunter-gatherer tribe through the ice age. Every decision you make will affect the tribe culturally and politically.

name: The House of Closed Doors
summary: The House of Closed Doors is a game in which you are locked in a mysterious house. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a dark old mansion. Explore mysterious rooms, collect various items, try to find a way out and stay alive.

name: The Forgotten Empire
summary: Now, as the Chosen One of the Empire of Atlantis, Lily must go through the most difficult challenges facing the most ferocious monsters of the Deep Sea during her journey to save Atlantis.

name: The Throne of Bernicia
summary: A classic fantasy role-playing game, telling the tale of the kingdom of Bernicia falling into chaos as the forces of darkness encroach on every front. Answer Queen Amelia's call for help as a brave adventurer seeking fame and fortune in a troubled land.

name: The Smugglers
summary: You will smuggle goods or protect the law. Assemble a team and take on the role of a clever smuggler or an honest law enforcement officer once per turn. Compete against the opposing team on one of many boards. Will you tactically pursue victory or pull a gun? Decide and win!

name: The Chick C
summary: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Collect eggs with the main hero of the game The Chick C. Collect all eggs in the world and become the egg warrior.

name: The Paper Game
summary: A game about tearing paper, cutting stickers, avoiding Goobles, and unlocking the greatest paper puns you've never

name: The Tribe Game
summary: The Tribe Game is a story-driven video game where the player gets to create their own custom character and step into the world of The Tribe. In this RPG (role-playing game) they will interact with many iconic characters and explore familiar places from The Tribe TV series. There are quests to be accomplished, profession skills to level up, items and resources to be found, battles to be won, and adventures to unfold… as the player tries to survive in a post-apocalyptic world and to keep their (and their tribe’s) dreams alive.

name: The Office: Somehow We Manage
summary: The Office: Somehow We Manage lets fans play through hilarious moments from the critically-acclaimed Emmy award winning comedy, where they'll tap their way to record proﬁts at Dunder Mifflin, and get down to business with Michael Scott, Jim Halpert, Pam Beesly, Kelly Kapoor, Dwight Schrute, Stanley Hudson and others.

name: That Which Gave Chase
summary: A scientist, seeking to return to the expedition he had to abandon, hires a sled dog musher to bring him on the last leg of his journey. That Which Gave Chase is a narrative-driven, first-person dog sledding thriller.

name: The Salt Order
summary: The Salt Order is an adventure horror game created by Khamelot and released on June 3, 2020 for itch.io and Game Jolt.

name: The Tousou Highway: Nagoya-Tokyo
summary: It is a racing game developed by Tamsoft and published by D3 Publisher for the PlayStation 2. In the game, the player actually escapes from Nagoya to Tokyo on the Tomei Expressway over a period of four hours, while collecting evidence to expose the corruption of a rogue politician.

name: The Sims 4: My Wedding Stories
summary: It’s time to walk down the aisle with The Sims 4: My Wedding Stories game pack for The Sims 4! Embark on this journey for the day more and plan the perfect ceremony. From the wedding request to the reception, customize every detail to celebrate each Sim’s love story in a truly unique way. In the world of Tartosa, anything becomes romantic.

name: The Griffin and the Minor Canon
summary: The Griffin and the Minor Canon is a visual novel adapted from Frank Stockton's classic short story.

name: The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story
summary: The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story centers around the ill-fated Shijima family, who have experienced a chain of inexplicable deaths in their family over the past century. Players will take on the role of mystery novelist, Haruka Kagami and use their powers of deductions to uncover the truth behind four murder cases that have taken place in the Shijima household over the last one hundred years.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess is an enhanced port of the Wii game under the same name, released only in China for the Nvidia Shield console. It was part of a batch of Nintendo games released for the console in a collaboration of Nintendo and Nvidia, in 1080p and with gameplay adapted to work without the need of motion controls. All the Nintendo games released in this deal ran on special versions of the emulator Dolphin, which made possible all the changes applied.

name: The King of Fighters '95
summary:
The King of Fighters '95 is the second game in The King of Fighters series.
The Game Boy version features Nakoruru from the Samurai Shodown series as an exclusive character.

name: The King of Fighters: Heat of Battle
summary:
The King of Fighters '96 is the third game in The King of Fighters series by SNK. This game is the second chapter of the story arc "Orochi Saga", which began in The King of Fighters '95.
Like with '95, '96 would receive a Game Boy product based on it, called Nettō The King of Fighters '96; it was also released in Europe, as The King of Fighters: Heat of Battle.

name: The Ratchelor Season 2
summary: The Ratchelor is back with a whole new season! Play as The Ratchelor, and marry the rat of your dreams. Choose from 21 eligible contestants and slowly narrow it down until you find true love.

name: The Oregon Trail
summary: The famous and iconic 1980s graphical version of the game where settlers travel west, featuring dysentery, river crossings, and an entire family of characters.

name: The Mirror Between Us
summary: Guide this couple through the puzzles - Love may not have forsaken them yet...

name: The Sunday Museum
summary: This little "retro" experimental game lets you explore a small museum, called "The Sunday Museum". You can walk around and interact with either the signs or tv sets in each room.

name: The Game
summary: With over 40 levels, over 60 characters, over 3 minutes worth of cutscenes, over 2 months of development, over 9000 jokes, over $153 spent on coffee, and over 6 statistics made up, you'd think I'd have a better title.

name: The Dark Dwellers
summary: The Dark Dwellers is a difficult Souls-like side-scrolling action game driven by a strong narrative and Metroidvania-esque exploration. Fight and crawl your way through this subterranean land, collect unique weapons, learn devastating Blood Magic spells and attempt to end The Maddening Curse.

name: The Witch-in-Training and the Magic Seal
summary:
The Witch-in-Training and the Magic Seal is an adventure puzzle game where you control Ena and her party to escape the insides of a magical seal, all while uncovering its secrets.

The game features heavy focus on cutscenes and dialogue to slowly unravel the story and backgrounds of the various featured characters.

name: The Secret of Monkey Island: Recoded
summary:
30 Years of Monkey Island 2: LeChuck's Revenge....
Monkey Island 2: LeChuck's Revenge turned thirty. The extraordinary second chapter of the series of "point and click" graphic adventures - born thanks to the intuition and the inimitable comic streak of Ron Gilbert, Dave Grossman and Tim Schafer (LucasArts), continues to thrill many nostalgic players even today.

To celebrate this important anniversary with great fanfare, Daniele Spadoni invite you play at a timeline never seen before, an adventure that will have no end.

name: The Voluptuous Demon Queen and our Shoebox Apartment Life
summary: Start your new life in a shoebox apartment with the sudden appearance of a big-breasted Demon Queen!

name: The Burgle Cats
summary: The Battle Cats take on a new challenge as... Cat burglars?! Sneak into player generated rival mansions in hopes of stealing fame and fortune as you climb your way to the top of the Burgle Leagues by using a whacky assortment of cats and traps. Set up your own devious mansion using traps you've acquired to prevent rivals from successfully heisting your own treasures.

name: The UnMaking
summary: Carve a path through space and time to the depths of hell in these 33 maps split across three chapters from legendary mapper Scwiba.

name: The Life of Saint Fiona Bianco Xena
summary:
In the rubble of the Syxtercian cathedral you find 3 shell vials containing experimental hormones harvested from slugs. They used to belong to Saint Fiona Bianco Xena - Mother of the Motherless, patron saint of the voiceless.

You hear distant whispers, entangled with the melted beats of early Molluscwave. They tell the story of many wounds and many adventures : flesh consumed by a rare blue speckled gutter slug, bioplastic mixed with piss under the light of a half moon, crystal eyes winking provocatively at the face of God, children saved and revolutions lost.

name: There's No Such Thing As Bad Publicity
summary: A fully-voiced story mod for Fallout 3, There's No Such Thing As Bad Publicity adds a new quest line involving pre-War secrets in the nation's capital, and several new locations to explore.

name: The Meteorite
summary: Get a Multiplayer Action Shooter Game experience with your friends and family. Create your own Clans and fight for the best Clan. Create custom rooms as you want and enjoy with your friends. Earn In game Coins while playing The Meteorite and redeem them in the upcoming In Game Shop for new skins, weapons and new characters.

name: The Adventures of Mr. Hat
summary: "The Adventures of Mr. Hat" is an interesting side-scrolling puzzle game with a minimalist design and a wealth of entertaining levels. This game is easy to start and each level has a different way to pass. These levels will blow your mind and develop your imagination!

name: The Odyssey of the Mammoth
summary: Through lavish but perilous landscapes, assist a mammoth mother and her child escape from their extinction. Discover breathtaking views from 12,000 years ago. Beware of the increasingly hostile environment. Protect your offspring from the hunters tracking you and send them flying!

name: The Sims 4: Carnaval Streetwear Kit
summary: Bring the energy with The Sims 4 Carnaval Streetwear Kit*! Designed in partnership with Pabllo Vittar, this collection celebrates Brazil’s Carnaval spirit with creative ways to spice up your Sim’s appearance.

name: The Rooms
summary: The Rooms is an escape room game with puzzles. Find out the hidden items in three rooms!

name: The One Who Pulls Out the Sword Will Be Crowned King
summary:
The one who pulls out the sword will be crowned king is a short experimental game about pulling a sword from a stone to be crowned king, like in the Arthurian legend.

The game consists entirely of grabbing the sword with your mouse and trying to pull it all the way out. If the cursor stops looking at the sword, your grip will be lost and the sword will fall back to its original position.

The Steam version includes an online mode in which the sword gets longer and heavier each time someone pulls it out.

name: The 11th Annual Vanilla Level Design Contest: Collaboration Hack
summary: This ROM hack/mod of Super Mario World is a collaboration made by the SMW Central community, based on the levels submitted to the 11th Vanilla Level Design Contest (VLDC).

name: The Taidon History
summary: Dive into this exciting Action RPG game with elements of a Shooter. In which you must be fast and agile to beat your opponents. A small challenge for adrenaline fans, set in an unusual magical world. The philosophy of this game is that there are no enemies too small, all opponents represent a real threat no matter how strong you are.

name: The Last of Samual
summary: Welcome to a new galaxy! You are Samual, a simple farmer that lives in a small abandoned town called First Valley. You live there with your daughter Sam who is the light of your world. One day you are attacked and your daughter is taken away from you!

name: The Kungfu Scrolls
summary: A roguelike deckbuilding game based on Chinese mythology. You can collect over 100 kinds of cards to develop your deck. Fight with various monsters and aim to defeat the last boss.

name: The Sims 2: Pets
summary: Create the perfect pet for your Sims to train, play with, and love in The Sims 2: Pets. Choose from dozens of the most popular dog and cat breeds like Dalmatians and Persians or create a unique cat or dog by customizing their features and body type. Then pick a personality - you decide if your Sims' Siamese is cowardly, gifted, or lazy. Your Sims can teach their pets tricks, take them for a romp in the park to meet other furry friends, and much more as they share a lifetime together.

name: The Sims 2: Pets
summary: Create the perfect pet for your Sims to train, play with, and love in The Sims 2: Pets. Choose from dozens of the most popular dog and cat breeds like Dalmatians and Persians or create a unique cat or dog by customizing their features and body type. Then pick a personality - you decide if your Sims' Siamese is cowardly, gifted, or lazy. Your Sims can teach their pets tricks, take them for a romp in the park to meet other furry friends, and much more as they share a lifetime together.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Zero no Kiseki
summary: The Legend of Heroes: Zero no Kiseki is the fourth installment in the main Kiseki series, serving as a direct sequel to the events of the Liberl arc and the beginning to the Crossbell arc. The game follows Lloyd Bannings and his colleagues Elie MacDowell, Randy Orlando, and Tio Plato. The four form the Special Support Section, a newly formed department of the Crossbell police in a city-state located between two great powers fighting for control over it.

name: The Gift
summary: Horror point and click game. You play as an administrator who will have to try to survive in in a closed hotel full of traps and terrible creatures. To move along the plot, the player will have to solve puzzles for attentiveness and find letters left by a stranger.

name: The Unknown Halls
summary: TUH is a Horror Puzzle game where the player must beat a series of mazes in order to beat the game. In order to survive you must run from danger or avoid it entirely. As the player progresses each maze gets more difficult introducing a new goal of beating the game other then getting to the end.

name: The Tree
summary: The Tree is a minimalist building and puzzle game in which you recover a forest after natural disaster on floating islands high in the sky.

name: The Anacrusis: Deluxe Edition
summary: This bundle contains the base version of The Anacrusis and The Anacrusis Infinity Pass.

name: The Office Type
summary: Add love to your resume! Date a wide variety of characters at once and explore dozens of narratives in this office-themed comedy dating sim.

name: The Devils: A Visual Novel of WWII
summary: A graphic novel about a true life horror story rooted at the end of World War II.

name: The Fall of Balance
summary: The Fall of Balance is a VR, fantasy game focused on colossal boss fights, each with various mechanics, like climbing, character skills, and others.

name: The House Where They Dwell
summary: The House Where They Dwell is a first-person action thriller game where you play as the hosts of a popular ghost hunting show that is normally staged for views and discover for yourself the true horrors that dwell within this mysterious mansion.

name: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child: Log-3
summary: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure

name: The Doll Beneath
summary: Awakened from a deep slumber, six students find themselves trapped inside an abandoned research facility, otherwise known as the "Losinglight". Delve deep into the trenches of the black eclipse, and search for a way out. Just remember, you're not alone.

name: The Last Citadel
summary: The Last Citadel is a Roguelike, Role-Based, Third-Person shooter. Embark in an expedition to uncover artifacts inside a Citadel suspended above a black hole where many challenges and deadly encounters await. Explore the ever-changing citadel alone, or with a group of up to 4 players.

name: The Long Road North
summary: A story-driven game supported by the song Cold Burn from Cult Of Luna

name: The Vortex
summary: The Vortex, a metaverse connected social environment where all are welcome. The facilitation system ensures all people have an equal opportunity to speak.

name: There's no way that tsundere girl I met in the infirmary will be my girlfriend
summary: "B-baka! Who said you could get in!? I'm not prepared yet!" "Oh well... since you're already here, why not stay for a while?" "D-don't misunderstand, okay? It's not like I asked you to stay because I like you or anything..."

name: The Great Deer
summary: The Great Deer is a modern point-n-click adventure game. You play as an intrepid explorer searching for an artefact of great value. Journey into an ancient temple, discover the secrets within, and uncover the truth behind a sinister ritual taking place within its walls.

name: The Roy Game
summary: A game where puking zombies try to puke over your trashcans, you have to defend your trashcans by placing automatic puking robots. Meanwhile you have to attack the zombie-printing machines.

name: The Savior From Above
summary: A sidescrolling 3D adventure shortgame combining multiple genres and featuring various action and puzzle sequences. Its artistic approach is supported by powerful visuals, intense atmosphere and a unique game narrative on the boundaries of science-fiction and fantasy.

name: The Last Days of Sodom
summary: Play as a Fallen Angel fighting a host of Enemies through the burning streets of Sodom, the Underworld and Third City of Hell. An exciting third-person shooter where the player will have to use intelligence as well as the trigger finger. Multiple different types of enemies. Original soundtrack.

name: The Knight of Turn
summary: Knight of Turn is a board game where the brave knight, imprisoned by the monsters in the deep dungeon, must find freedom and free the kingdom from this threat.

name: The Apollo Project
summary: In The Apollo Project, you must survive against men and nature itself before it's too late. Harness the power of an alien artifact to infiltrate a top secret research facility to save the world from impending climate disaster. Can you make it out alive before it's too late?

name: They Сame From Above
summary: They Came From Above is a cute Tower Defense in Lowpoly 3D graphics. Here you have to build an economy and various defense towers to resist hordes of aliens.

name: The Happy Dismal Town
summary: A funny and dramatic game telling the story of a detective. NOIR themed with a cyberpunk background with elements of Lovecraftian horror story.

name: The Humbling of a Holy Maiden
summary: The Tree of Life is dead and withered, and the kingdom's Holy Maiden longs to be disgraced. You have come from another world to teach her what it means to love. Witness the Holy Maiden's transformation as she descends into sweet corruption!

name: The Dark Journey
summary: The Dark Journey is a multiple ending hardcore survival horror game telling a story of a group of people who lost their way in the sea , ending on a mysterious dark island where they have to survive and find their way out

name: The Asfrixa
summary: Trapped in an installation made for "Asfrixa's", you'll have to go through your worst nightmares and puzzles to find your way out before being consumed by the shadows along with the place.

name: The World According to Girl
summary: A deck-building roguelike caring game In a collapsed world, a plan to raise a young girl into a savior begins in order to find the only salvation. You become an "administrator" to raise a girl to become a savior, and raise her by selecting "human resources (cards)" with various effects.

name: Three Mazeketeers
summary: Help these girls to finish the task by journeying through the labyrinth. Use different forms to see different perspectives and to tackle various challenges. Solve puzzles and find the cause by utilizing all the abilities you have.

name: The Mystery Fountain in Space
summary: A mysterious fountain of energy was found in space while a group of astronauts on a spaceship were going on a mission.

name: The Bad Son
summary: The Bad Son is the anti-authority indie horror RPG that your parents don't want you to play.

name: The Lighthouse of São Bento do Oeste
summary: The Lighthouse of São Bento do Oeste is a mystery visual novel for the Sega Saturn about Renne Bras, a detective who travels to the small town of São Bento do Oeste to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a couple in the city lighthouse.

name: The Sims 2
summary: The Sims 2 for Nintendo Game Boy Advance takes place in Strangetown. In it, players create Sims to star in a TV series called 'Strangetown'. The player's Sim then stars in 12 episodes of the series. In between episodes, the Sim plays mini games and socializes with other Sims.

name: The Sims 2
summary:
The Sims 2 for Nintendo DS is the first DS game of The Sims 2. Like the many of the console games it takes place in Strangetown with some of the same faces.
The aim of the game is to improve the hotel by adding extensions, furnishing rooms, completing goals, rescue guests or help them find missing objects and keeping the hotel clean.

name: The Sims 2: Castaway
summary: Castaway is the third console spin-off of the video game The Sims 2. The Sims Castaway Stories is a similar game created for personal computers. It is the final game in the series released for the PlayStation 2 and the final game in the Sims 2 series for console.

name: The Sims 2: Castaway
summary: Castaway is the third console spin-off of the video game The Sims 2. The Sims Castaway Stories is a similar game created for personal computers. It is the final game in the series released for the PlayStation 2 and the final game in the Sims 2 series for console.

name: The Day We Met was a Regular Day in the Infinitely Looping Highschool, is That Normal?
summary: The story tells a mind-boggling suspense-filled adventure story on campus. The game is played via two main elements: text interaction and scene decryption. If you are interested in text-based adventure games, science fiction, and a certain big big big big pink cat, please do not miss it.

name: Three Finger Battle Arena
summary: Three Finger Battle Arena is a game where you can punch your friends into orbit, then swing away like nothing ever happened!

name: Three Sons
summary: A world blanketed by endless snow...Experience this interactive adventure from the POV of more than 3 different characters whose choices will determine the fate of a dying world.

name: The Backrooms: Survival
summary: The Backrooms: Survival mixes survival horror with roguelike elements. Explore randomly generated levels with different items and entities while trying to maintain your thirst, hunger, and sanity.

name: The Giant of Torridge Island
summary: Help or hinder Torridge Island as you take control of a Giant in this sandbox of villagers, wildlife and natural disasters. Will the villagers praise you and beg for your return in the morning, or pray that you never reappear.

name: The Pest
summary: Solve challenging puzzles and avoid dangerous traps of the computer defence system in this puzzle-platformer game about a tiny optimistic computer pest heading to the System's Core. Will he plunge our world into chaos, or will he have mercy? It's up to you.

name: The Choice VR
summary: DEXTER STUDIOS' 3RD VR WEBTOON! A CONJOINED TWINS, HA-EUN AND YE-EUN, BORN WITH A SHARED HEART! WHO WILL … WIN THE HEART?

name: The Christmas Spirit: Golden Ticket - Collector's Edition
summary: You need a Christmas miracle!

name: The Baleful Tower
summary: The Baleful Tower is an action filled roguelike dungeon crawler, combining hack and slash with twin-stick shooting for high-intensity isometric gameplay. Venture forth to uncover the mysteries of the Tower, but beware the treacherous monsters that lie within.

name: The Game of Life 2: Lunar Age
summary: Launch into THE GAME OF LIFE 2 Lunar Age! Experience a world of adventure and discovery. Build your life in orbit, from the Moon Base to the Biodome City, all the way to the Advanced Alien Civilisation! The choices are all yours on the furthest frontier!

name: The Wanderer
summary: The Wanderer is an immersive, narrative-driven game with a focus on atmosphere. You play as a little robot, wandering through the end of the world. Will you too fade into memory? Only you can uncover secrets long kept hidden and take control of fate. Enjoy The Wanderer!

name: The Lost Oregon City Gold
summary: Find secret treasure at the end of the Oregon Trail!

name: The Cloud Dream of the Nine: A new beginning of a dream
summary: This is the spin-off story of the main episode of The Cloud Dream of the Nine where you can target three characters in it. A new story unfolds which is similar yet different from the main story. This is a DLC that can be purchased while possessing the main game.

name: Thief Simulator: Luxury Houses
summary: To access this content you need to have the game Thief Simulator on Steam.

name: The Haunted: Hells Reach - The Island
summary: The Island - Welcome to the new level!

name: Throne and Crown
summary: Critically acclaimed music sound track Rares Bosses Statistics Leveling secret trainer Cut Scene adventure Puzzle Nature calming Choice

name: The Impossible Game 2
summary: Your 12-year wait is over: the original rhythm platform game is back! Test your skills with all-new levels, online battle royale and more.

name: The Bridge Curse: Road to Salvation
summary: Fear, anxiety, and laughter are the symbol of youth. Experience the true paranormal haunting with your friends from the first-person perspective and stay alive. An adaptation of a horror film, includes Taiwanese urban legend and an intriguing backstory.

name: The Unseen Fears: Last Dance
summary: When the people of Lyon are plagued by haunting visions of their past mistakes, you're called in to investigate! There's more to this case than meets the eye as specters using mirrors track your every move. Can you save the locals without becoming the mirrors' next victim yourself? Find out in this spine-tingling Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

name: The iCarly RPG
summary:
The iCarly RPG is an interactive fiction game based on the Nickelodeon show iCarly! Kind of.

Help Carly Shay survive the ups and downs of high school, from math tests to encounters with ancient deities, in time for Spencer’s spaghetti tacos.

name: The New Chronicles of Noah's Ark
summary: Help Noah in this Match3 game to build a great ark capable of housing two of each kind of animal, in order to save them and bring them safely through the flood. It will be a tremendous task, one that sounds impossible to complete.

name: The Renovator: Origins
summary: We play as the son of a restorer, a museum worker who died tragically. While searching for the memorabilia, the door suddenly closes and strange things begin to happen. The hero is waiting for immersion in the world of art and the paranormal.

name: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child: Log-1
summary: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure.

name: The Red Hood
summary: Game is about little lost girl, who tries to find right path to visit her grandmother

name: The BuildSphere: Rise of the Anomalbots
summary: The BuildSphere: Rise of the Anomalbots is a cyber-cool and retro style, sci-fi scavenger hunt and puzzle solving game with platforming and obstacle course like levels. Each progressive level will challenge you to collect assets and craft your next piece of loot in order to progress in the game.

name: The Soul Stone War 2: Web of Shadows
summary: Take a closer look at the motivations and politics of the major players in Cridevar! Learn more about your companions' pasts and Manerkol's Court.

name: The Dark
summary: Single player and online multiplayer survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world, with an open world dungeon system.

name: The Ascent: Cyber Edition
summary:
The Ascent is a solo and co-op action RPG set in a cyberpunk world. The mega corporation that owns you and everyone, The Ascent Group, has just collapsed. Confusion and chaos ensue, security and order are in disarray, and without protection, everyone is left to fend for themselves. Stop gangs and hostile corporations from taking over and discover what really happened.

The Ascent: Cyber Edition includes:
- Base Game
- Steelbook
- 88 Pages Artbook
- Tuck-in Box

name: The Chronicles of Hercules II: Wrath of Kronos
summary: The Titan Kronos has broken free from Tartarus and raised an army of giants to attack Olympus and defeat the gods! Help Hercules in the second part of the epic Match3 game defeat Kronos and save the Olympus!

name: The Pointless Car Chase: Refueled
summary: You're being chased... clearly; For what reason? none; Now it's up to you to outrun your pursuers. Drive and customize over 20 vehicles, and try to escape; It's a dangerous task, maybe you can succeed.

name: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child: Log-2
summary: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure.

name: The Legend of Pomodoro
summary: The Legend of Pomodoro is a pomodoro tool and idle game driven by tomatoes.

name: The Oregon Trail
summary: Experience The Oregon Trail like never before. A modern twist on the trials and tribulations of the road to Oregon, this official successor to the global phenomenon will immerse players in exhilarating journeys ranging from the historically accurate to the totally extreme.

name: The Zium Gallery
summary:
Zequel to The Zium Garden.
The Zium Gallery is a Museum Exploration Game filled with artwork and installations from artists around the world, working in various mediums and styles.

name: The Way Home: Dungeon Cat
summary:
Trapped on a strange island, Kevin and Cheese struggle to return home.
There are also terrifying monsters and other lost people on the island.

name: The FMV Bundle
summary: Wales Interactive are proud to offer three critically acclaimed FMV games in one discounted bundle! Featuring the high stakes FMV crime thriller Late Shift, the award-winning FMV horror The Bunker and the FMV murder mystery The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker.

name: The Age of Navigation
summary: It is a single-player game with the theme of navigation. Our goal is to do our best to restore the magnificent era of navigation.

name: The Way Home
summary: The Way Home is a rogue-like dungeon crawler game. Defeat enemies, collect resources, and construct buildings. You can enjoy dynamic battles with the cuteness of pixel art.

name: The Ancestral Legacy!
summary: 'The Ancestral Legacy' is a visual horror novel game that lets you step into the shoes of the main character and experience mystery, horror, and thrills as you choose your own story. Experience a wide range of episodes and discover tons of thrilling stories in all the chapters.

name: The Secret of Cat Island
summary:
A meow adventure begins! An exciting escapade on Cat Island! The second cat tale from the developers of the relaxing idle game, My Dear Cat! This time, on an island!

The adventure begins with drifting ashore on an island.
Two adorable cats Nana and Muna were swept away by a huge tsunami in the middle of the ocean, and they opened their eyes on an unknown island empty-handed.

What a CAT-astrophe!
The island is larger than expected, and no other islands are on the horizon.
Anyone living on the island? Any food here?

Help Nana and Muna to survive a shipwreck on the new Cat Island!

Start your idle farming adventure with two adorable cats and unfold new meowsteries in Cat Island!

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: The Quintuplets Can't Divide the Puzzle Into Five Equal Parts
The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin
summary: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin is an open-world action RPG set in the universe of The Seven Deadly Sins. Step into the role of Prince Tristan of Liones and explore an open-world Britannia, as you embark on a journey to restore order to a world thrown into chaos by the collision of time and space.

name: The DioField Chronicle
summary: The DioField Chronicle is a tale of war and honor. Featuring a unique and beautiful world that blends fantasy, medieval and modern-day influences with a deep yet innovative real-time battle system.
developers: Square Enix Creative Business Unit II

name: The Trap 2: Mindlock
summary: The Trap 2: Mindlock tells the story of an alien that participates in an experiment to research the nature of human survival. The player's consciousness will be implanted into the minds of people and subjects to that they control through a series of ingenious experiments based on solving puzzles.

name: The Hydra

During their search they give a merchant a helping hand and suddenly events go out of control.
Who is this mysterious one-eyed man who doesn't even hesitate to murder a Devotee of Praios and what sinister plans does he pursue? What's the matter with Archmage Rakoriums mysterious researches? Is there a connection between the researches and the parts of the figurine which falls into the heroes' hands?

The Mod "Eye of the Goddess" starts directly after the main game and and sends the player on a new journey across the Kosh to experience new adventures and to discover new secrets.

name: The Ultimate Doom: Knee-Deep in Zdoom
summary:
Knee-Deep in ZDoom (also known by the abbreviation KDiZD) is a ten-level PK3 for The Ultimate Doom, designed for use with the ZDoom source port. The project was led by Daniel Gimmer (Tormentor667). It was first released on June 2, 2007, and at the 2007 ceremony it picked up a regular Cacoward as well as the Mordeth award. The final version of the mod was uploaded on June 16, 2012.

The PWAD is a reinterpretation of the original id Software's Knee-Deep in the Dead. A core concept of the mod was to expand the original levels by making full use of the power of Marisa Heit (Randi)'s ZDoom port, which adds features that are not possible under the original Doom engine. The levels have an atmosphere and design similar to Quake 2, with large tech bases and similar ambient sounds.

name: The Sword of Ares for Quake
summary:
The Sword of Ares is a 1998 unlicensed total conversion for Quake.

The game adds several features not available in vanilla Quakes, such as the ability to switch to a third-person view (which may be a bit buggy) and several selectable player skins.

The Sword of Ares was made of free content but was distributed as shareware. It appears that the registered version (as a separate PAK file) was eventually made available by the author as a free download too, as it can be found on PlanetQuake mirrors alongside the shareware release. It is an unofficial commercial total conversion, whether it was licensed by id Software is unclear.

The game retailed at $9.99 on their official website.

name: The Mansions of Shadows
summary: First person game. Or you play Erwan, a young journalist. You are investigating a missing person.

name: The Night Walkers
summary: This third-person game is inspired by the horror classics of the 90's. Intense and terrifying pace, survive the endless night and stay sane. Reveal through dramas and tragedies the hidden truth about the night walkers and figure out what lurks after death.

name: The Silent Swan
summary: The Silent Swan is a first-person open world narrative experience across a monolithic, derelict world. Mixing both the walking simulator and open world genres together, the game brings the meaning of openness to urban areas for the first time to this scale.

name: The Safe Place
summary: This is a dramatic deep social point&click adventure about tough childhood and self-sacrifice.

name: The Instruments of Faith: Padua's Destiny
summary: The Instruments Of Faith Padua's Destiny is an epic apocalyptic 2D pixel Metroidvania fantasy action-adventure video game. Journey through the Universe as Young Padua, one of the 7 Guardian protectors of the Universe, to restore the balance of Good over Evil before it is too late!

name: The Darkest Star
summary: Fight for survival by gathering a fleet of powerful space warships in a turn based rogue-like, Decisions are key as the battle evolves over multiple turns. Use a multitude of weapon systems and ship types to press home the attack with a unique turn based system.

name: The Sword of Rhivenia
summary: Are you worthy of the throne? Or do your siblings deserve it more than you do? What kind of heir will you be?

name: The Four Elements: Zombies
summary: A Single player/ Co-op zombies shooter game, with a twist! There are many types of enemies and you utilize a list of abilities based on the four elements to defeat them. Along with many challenges and puzzles to solve, you progress to explore and discover the Four Elements: Zombies universe.

name: The Endless Summer Surfing Challenge
summary: A realistic physics based surfing simulation. Complete the 12 challenge rounds with a choice of 5 different surfers or a body boarder. Compete in two player timed and scored contests with two players surfing at the same time.

name: The House of Da Vinci 3
summary: Walk in the shoes of an apprentice and friend of Leonardo da Vinci. Find hidden mysteries, solve handcrafted mechanical puzzles and travel through time and space to lead the story to its grand finale.

name: The Bunny Graveyard
summary: An episodic puzzle adventure about a bunny who seeks to find the horrifying truth behind her existence.

name: The Dreadful Space
summary: A very action space war game, the mission is to fight the ships from other planets, the game requires a lot of skill to get rid of enemy shots and counterattack with all the cool features you can get in the game. The combat is intense and very agile, confronting your skills as a Battleship player.

name: The Beresford family
summary: On the night of July 20, 1824, eight-year-old Matilda Beresford was found dead. What happened that night? Was little Matilda's death an accident? Discover the origin of the curse.

name: The Jelly Adventure
summary: The Jelly Adventure is a puzzle-casual game peefect for kids or even for those who had a more stressful day.

name: The Mensional
summary: Adventures of different characters with their unique atmosphere and puzzles.

name: The Deep Diving of FloodDragon
summary: "Landing on the moon and diving into the deep sea" is a human dream. In this game, you will experience this great journey. Understand the structure of Jiaolong, drive the submarine with the deepest diving depth in the world to dive into the deep sea and explore unknown places.

name: The Enjenir
summary: In this light hearted physics based building game, you are a clumsy medieval engineer. The game combines gridless sandbox building with hilarious physics driven third person controls. With infinite structural design possibilities - the only limit is your imagination… oh, and gravity!

name: The Complex: Found Footage
summary:
Experience the liminal world of the backrooms through a VHS camera, immersing into a mysterious story and wandering the dream-like structures... Might there be something following you?

The Complex: Found Footage is a walking simulator with the world being viewed through a VHS camera. Uncover a mystery that lies in the world of "The Complex", though it may leave more questions rather than answers...

name: The Forgotten Demons
summary: The Forgotten Demons is a 2D, top-down, dungeon crawler, packed with fierce enemies, powerful spells, multiple unique weapons and more.

name: The hardest game in the universe 2
summary: The sequel to the most impossible game. The new 2D adventure, embark on this platform game that will test your skill of how much patience you are capable of,New mechanic, 10,000 kills, if you lose your game will be erased, What is the way to make a sequel to an extremely difficult game???

name: The Castle of Time
summary: This is a fighting platformer with a dynamic combat system where you have to fight enemies with your sword.

name: Thwackity Puttz
summary:
Time to putt for success, as you aim to complete each of the 9 holes in each round of Thwackity Puttz golf.
Somewhat similar to most Golf games, Points are scored based on how many hits you have remaining at the end of each hole, with extra points awarded for hitting a birdie or eagle.

name: The Football Playbook: Tactical Puzzles
summary: The Football Playbook is a collection of tactical puzzles. In each puzzle you are presented with a snapshot of a football match. To successfully complete the puzzle you must score a goal. Use a combination of timing, movement and key passes to get your players into a scoring position.

name: The Busker
summary: A metroidvania 2D platformer where you explore a dystopian urban landscape. Smash your enemies with your trusted guitar! Unlock new abilities and weapons. Meet friends and make choices that will affect the future of this city.

name: This Next Time
summary: This Next Time is a sci-fi strategy game.

name: The Sinking Structure, Clione, and Lost Child: Log6
summary: Two silent wanderers,6 full chapters,A game of exploration and adventure

name: The Price of Flesh
summary: An immersive choose-your-own-adventure survival horror with optional adult content featuring hand drawn backgrounds, sprites, and over 150 pieces of full screen art- and 50 endings.

name: The Backrooms: Lost Tape
summary: You work in the cinema as an usher and accidentally fell into the Backrooms, now being trapped, needing to unravel the mysteries of the yellow rooms in order to get out of this place, but be careful, there are entities that will be in your way.

name: The Lost Weld
summary: The Lost Weld is an exciting, fantasy-themed action-adventure game being made by an all-female development team. The game features a compelling, movie-like script recorded by some of the industry’s top voice-acting talents, beautiful open world environments, and engaging game action.

name: The Forked Road
summary: The Forked Road is a story about traveling through a dead world in search of a place to call home. Which path will you choose, and can you not lose yourself?

name: The Hand of Glory: The Blowtorch Files
summary: A young girl, Erica Thimber, vanishes into thin air overnight. Is it a classic teen runaway? That's not what Lazarus Bundy, renowned serial killer hunter in charge of the case, believes.

name: The Golden Rose: Book One
summary: Explore an alternative medieval Europe in this low-fantasy epic adventure! How far are you willing to go to take back your stolen treasure?

name: The Ancient Cat Temple
summary: This is a little Metroidvania where you control a cute archeologist cat trying to find the secrets of an ancient civilization. Explore, solve puzzles and be careful, the brightest path is not always the safest.

name: The Breadmaker
summary: Welcome to the kitchen of the future! Learning to cook has never been simpler! Enjoy five days of easy to understand recipes guided by our brand new automated instructor. As she helps you with each day's lessons you'll discover that cooking isn't really as scary as you thought.

name: The Fantasy World of Mahjong Princess
summary: This is a 2D Japanese Mahjong game with adult simulation features. You are a big Mahjong fan who got reincarnated in another world. As the world‘s top Mahjong tutor, you need to build your own team and train your students while developing special relationships with them.

name: The Legend of Gandar
summary: The Legend of Gandar is an action-adventure video game. The player slips into the legend of Gandar, in the role of the farm boy. He woke up one day and received a strange letter, and so begins the story of a boy.

name: The Highlands
summary: A top down-multiplayer-arena-brawler where you collect resources and craft your weapons of choice all while trying to stay alive and become the ultimate brawler in this fast paced game.

name: The President
summary: The President is a management / political simulation game where you play as the president of one of the available countries. Shape your country and meet the expectations of your people to be re-elected in the next elections.

name: The Expedition
summary: "The Expedition" is a first person open world survival game based on a remote island in the Bermuda Triangle. Try to survive as long as you can. Gather resources to build more and more gear and discover all hidden weapons, treasures and locations.

name: The Valley
summary: A fantasy based, RPG with magic, story, potion crafting, puzzles, platforming, story, and more!

name: The Quarry: Deluxe Edition
summary:
As the sun sets on the last day of summer camp, the teenage counselors of Hackett’s Quarry throw a party to celebrate. No kids. No adults. No rules. Things quickly take a turn for the worse.

Enjoy some extra teen horror flair with The Quarry - Deluxe Edition!

This Edition includes:

- The Quarry Full Game
- Deluxe Bonus Content Pack: ‘80s-themed character outfits, instant access to the Death Rewind system, Gorefest Movie Mode option, and Horror History Visual Filter Pack

name: The Haunted: Hells Reach - The Fog
summary: THE FOG - Welcome to DLC 2!The second brand new full level of THHR. The testers were excited about the brand new level and you will be too - so get the achievement "SALVAGED FOG" on all difficulty levels.

name: The Enchanted Cave
summary: Enter the Enchanted Cave, collecting artifacts, stat gems and gold as you fight to reach floor 100! Use the Escape Wings to teleport out and recover, then head back in with powerful artifacts to delve deeper into the cave each time.

name: The Escapee
summary: The Escapee has been remastered and a great number of improvements has been added, such as built in hint system, improved gameplay and controls.

name: ThirdMiracle
summary:
This game is a classic package style.
Stories of rebels against Empire tyranny.
Charming little girl characters and beautiful stories.

name: The Unrest Age
summary: Introducing The Unrest Age: an Action-RPG in the large open world of Russia of the early 17th century that offers an amazing combination of dynamic battle system and nonlinear storyline, an advanced character growth system and detailed dialogues, a seamless world and a wide variety of things. The whole amazing world right in your pocket. The Unrest Age combines the best ideas from desktop platforms and brings them to the mobile format.

name: The Oracle Land
summary: "The Oracle Land" is a 3D fantasy MMOARPG, set in the magnificent story, enjoy a journey of mission in the western fantasy world.

name: The Vaults
summary: The Vaults is a turn-based RPG card game where you will engage with creatures and beings of other worlds, Explore powerful scrolls and weapons, find treasures, learn abilities, and upgrade your keepers to save the mysterious world of Alexandria!

name: The Mysterious Case of Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Hyde
The Tower of Egbert
summary: The Tower of Egbert is a physics-based tower building game with a magic twist. You are able to build freely until the tower is tall enough to reach the target line of the current level. Hitting a start button activates gravity for a few seconds and your construction either stands or falls. If any single block of the tower is still above the target line after the physics simulation stopped, the whole building is magically “frozen” by Egbert, so that the already completed sections of the tower will never again be subject to gravity. In the next level you will have to build on this newly created, always different, often crooked, foundation – a task that can turn out to be quite challenging.

name: The Birdwatcher
summary: The Birdwatcher is the thirteenth game in the Carol Reed series. Set in Sweden in the summer, Carol has been down with the flu. She is contacted by Immodia, a character from a previous game Profound Red, because her future husband Henrik, a recent widower, has disappeared. She wants Carol to help her track him down. The game uses its trademark first-person view with photographs of real locations and objects in a fixed-screen slideshow style. There are puzzles to solve with items stored in an inventory near the top of the screen. A journal is used to keep track of objectives.

name: The Fall of April
summary: The Fall of April is the fourteenth game in the Carol Reed series. Set in Sweden Carol helps her friend Andrea who suffers from temporary memory loss induced by a drug. Soon it turns out this event is not only tied to the unresolved murder of Andrea's daughter two years before, but also to a Swedish Arctic balloon expedition in 1915. The game uses its trademark first-person view with photographs of real locations and objects in a fixed-screen slideshow style. There are puzzles to solve with items stored in an inventory near the top of the screen. A journal is used to keep track of objectives.

name: This is the Only Level Too
summary: Do you like jumping? Do like spikes? There are both in this game, and a handful of different ways to try to beat the only level in the game. Confront each new stage challenge with a sort of heart and dignity that we can only befall on our most noble of creatures. Also you can unlock a velociraptor, how cool how is that?

name: The Witcher: Versus
summary:
The Witcher: Versus (initially called The Witcher: DuelMail) was a free Flash-based multiplayer fighting browser game, developed for CD Projekt RED by one2tribe, that has you create a character from one of three classes and challenge other players to deadly battles.

The game was later ported from webBrowser to iOS in 2011. Since 2014 however both versions aren't playable anymore and the game is considered delisted.

name: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Ch 2: Retribution
summary: Your tour through undead New Orleans continues in this new chapter to the Tourist’s story in The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners. Hunted by the seemingly unstoppable Axeman and facing off against the Tower’s latest push for total dominance, discover what connects these new threats together before it’s too late. New faces, places, weapons and gear all await you on your journey to a final showdown for the city's fate. Do you have what it takes to survive it all?

name: The Pigeon P
summary: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Donate gifts to the incoming drivers with our here of the game The Pigeon P.

name: The Red Crystal: The Seven Secrets of Life
summary:
You are in the land Darkmoore which is reigned by the evil Lexnor. And because you are playing an RPG you have to defeat him. For this purpose you travel through Darkmoore to conquer dungeons and maximize your fame. You can choose between five classes.

The screen is divided into two parts. On the left side is always our hero, the right side is reserved for various indexes like a map. This is, if you play alone. Quite unusually for RPGS of its time you can play the game with a friend - the second player is seen on the right side of the screen.

Before every fight you can try to bribe your enemy.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Online
summary: A mod which allows online multiplayer while playing The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. This mod needs an application called ModLoader64 to work. It also supports cosmetic and audio mods, as well as specific events and collectibles that can be purchased by using a specific currency called Rubies in Morshu's shop (adapted from the CD-i Zelda games).

name: The Shopping List
summary:
The Shopping list is a full length mystery-psychological story rich horror game experience that blends unsettling scenarios with intense characters and a nostalgic retro theme.

Rediscover your past as you try to make yourself at home in a new town. Enjoy different encounters and puzzles while talking to the locals,

and finish the shopping list as the mysteries of the town watches from the shadows.

name: The Legend of Peach
summary:
The Legend of Peach is a mod of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time that intends to translate the Super Mario 64 stages in the Ocarina of Time engine and Zelda mechanics.
The creator gave up on its development after releasing the first demo.

name: This is a game
summary: This game is not a revolution, but this game is made with a lot of love and not a lot of skills.Play this game with a can of beans and enjoy!!!Discord :

name: The Crown of Wu
summary:
"The Crown of Wu" (or simply Crown of Wu) is a 3D third-person adventure-action, puzzles and platforms game.

Get ready to explore a new world inspired by Journey to the West, a traditional Chinese tale about the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. You’ll explore the future-past fantasy world as Sun Wukong, fighting alone against enemies and overcoming complex obstacles to retrieve the great Crown stolen by the antagonist Zhu. With Zhu waiting to fight and kill you, will you be able to get back the Crown and save your world from destruction?

name: The Beatles: Adventures in Pepperland
summary:
The Beatles Adventures: in Pepperland is loosely based on the 1968 film Yellow Submarine.

Play as The Beatles and fight blue meanies in this colorful adventure in the unearthly paradise called Pepperland.

name: The Cleaner
summary: The Cleaner is a hardcore die 'n' retry inspired by John Wick, Hotline Miami and SuperHot. You control a highly-trained " cleaner " with a unique power. No cliché storyline, no cutscenes, start the game and play.

name: The Code Zone Retro Pack
summary: The Code Zone Retro Pack is a collection of fifty fun little Windows games originally made for CD-ROM compilations in the 90s, now repackaged and updated to run on newer systems by their original developer.

name: The Geography
summary: The Geography is an endless, nonlinear orchestration. The Geography is presented as a musical companion for meditation, relaxation, jubilation, contemplation, self-care, sleeping and dreaming, where every instance's composition is unique, and plays endlessly.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Parallel Worlds Remodel
summary:
The Legend of Zelda: Parallel Worlds Remodel recreates Parallel Worlds according to the 6 years of revisions from players all over the globe. Featuring new grafics, various asm patches, completely new overworld and dungeons, etc.

It is suitable for beginners and veterans, for those who have failed at Parallel Worlds and for those who have finished it, since this game is a lot more than just a plain reduction of sprites.

It's a game that’s fair to the player and doesn’t want to force any super tricks, stunts or logic to finish the game, while still having a decent difficulty. It makes Parallel Worlds enjoyable. You don’t have to use save states or cheats to finish the game. You don’t have to be a veteran or a super player either. You will not be frustrated while playing.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 9
summary: Save your next party! 5 new games in 1 party pack: the trivia bluff-off Fibbage 4, the team test Quixort, the joke auction Junktopia, the silly guessfest Nonsensory and the reality TV game Roomerang.

name: Thunder Blade
summary: The LCD version of Thunder Blade is a watered-down version of the arcade game Thunder Blade created by Tiger Electronics.

name: The Addams Family
summary: Handheld game based on The Addams Family movie adaptation.

name: The A-Team
summary: LCD game based on the franchise The A-Team, released in 1983. It is part of the Double Wide Screen line.

name: The Pink Panther
summary: An LCD game based on The Pink Panther franchise. It was released in 1983.

name: The Shadow
summary: A handheld game based on the movie The Shadow.

name: The Simpsons
summary: A second Tiger Electronics game with the title of The Simpsons, released in 1999.

name: The Simpsons
summary: A The Simpsons licensed wristwatch game by Tiger Electronics.

name: The Terminator
summary: Tiger Electronics LCD game based on the movie of the same name.

name: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
summary: A game based on The Lost World: Jurassic Park for the Tiger R-Zone.

name: The Mask of Zorro
summary: A game for the R-Zone based on the homonymous movie.

name: The Crazy Journalist
summary: Collect coins as the crazy journalist is trying to chase you for an interview.

name: The Migrant
summary:
Axion is an alien being who was exiled from his planet a long time ago.

Regretful for his actions, he now travels the universe in search of a new planet to live in peace.

Will Axion find a new home?
or succumb to the dangers of the unknown planets?

name: The Asmodian Princesses and the Witch in the Forest
summary: One day, Shoichi heard the call from a mysterious goddess. "Please come and take down the devil!" Although it sounds like a template, he still came to the "demon world". After meeting the two princesses and the king, he was made to make an "ultimate choice", and the legend of this young man began.

name: The Dark Defender
summary: The Dark Defender is a story driven adventure game where you play as a character who has been deserted, with no recollection of your past. With determination you make your way through a world with many friends to assist you on your journey, as well as enemies burdening your adventure.

name: The Lost Mines
summary: The Lost Mines is a remake of the first game I made for MSX computers. In this puzzle game, you must collect all the resources to advance to the next level, avoiding the guardian and fighting against the clock. Old style difficulty with remastered graphics and sound.

name: The Ultra Mission
summary: The Ultra Mission is a shooting game where, on each of the eight levels, the protagonist must reach civilians to rescue them. Once all civilians on a level are rescued, the level is complete.

name: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos - Chicken Edition: Splat Jaypak's Arenas
summary: Join the party as they are trapped and captured by the sadistic owner of the Wheel of Misfortune, Splat Jaypak. If they want to get out, they will have to shape up and fight through every ordeal their captor can throw at them. Are you ready for battle?

name: The Detroit After
summary: You are a robot, you have to kill everyone...

name: This is Infinity
summary: This is Infinity is an abstract exploration/puzzle game, created in 36 hours for the Ludum Dare 16 competition.

name: This War of Mine: Final Cut
summary: This War of Mine: Final Cut contains all the updates and free expansions released so far and introduces not only a new scenario but also expands all scenarios with the locations known from Stories DLCs - even if you don't own those. In short words - that means you can now experience lots of never-seen-before playthroughs and struggle with new challenges.

name: The Future You've Been Dreaming Of
summary:
Take on the role of a Zashiki-Warashi, a house-bound spirit that can bring good fortune, and peer into Sachi's life. You'll see some of her more vulnerable moments and have no choice but to intervene from time to time, but it's all to guide her toward a bright future!

Give her direction while she's at home and help her grow her parameters in all kinds of ways. Your guidance will determine the future she ultimately heads toward. There are 20 total paths awaiting Sachi, and it's up to you to help her find them!

name: The Birthday
summary: The Birthday is a point-and-click adventure game made for the birthday of the game designer community The Poppenkast. Its protagonist finds himself in a beach region, where his brother has unluckily ended up standing on top of a bomb which may explode at any time. The protagonist is trying to save his brother.

name: The Rewind Factory
summary: A software update fails and you end up in a test track. The only way out: complete the test track. You can rewind trough time, wall run, dash and slow time to complete the test chambers as fast a possible. Can you beat the fastest time in this FPS movement based game?

name: The Moonlight Circus
summary: In this first-person VR-Horror game, you wake up in the middle of an empty circus arena, with a syringe in your arm and the feeling of being watched. Solve puzzles and discover clues to unveil the tragic backstory and find your way out.

name: The Coven of Calahree
summary: Three wacky, wild, and witchy sisters are up to no good in this fantasy RPG world. They’re off battling dungeon beasts, performing odd jobs and quests for the local townspeople all in hopes to gain as many new followers as they can for their new Coven…The Coven of Calahree.

name: The Circus
summary: On one continent, a special group of individuals exists. Although their appearance is no different from mankind beings, but their bodies contain great power. They are entrusted with a divine destiny and can only be freed after passing a trial.

name: The Night of the Scissors
summary: Scrap hunting season has gone wrong, VHS slasher survival horror.

name: The Break-In
summary: The Break-In is a 4 player online co-op burglary game about sneaking into houses, museums, and bank vaults to steal everything that isn't bolted down. Use your profits to buy special thief equipment to help you tackle more dangerous locations.

name: The Quest for Excalibur: Puy du Fou
summary:
Get ready to travel back in time with the family with the first Puy du Fou video game!
Everyone knows the legend of King Arthur and his rival, the knight Lancelot du Lac. The latter, eaten away by jealousy, challenges him to a duel. Only Excalibur, the king's sword, breaks at the end of the fight and only the hilt remains. After a pact with Morgana, Arthur decides to throw what's left of Excalibur into troubled waters. But trapped by the fairy, he finds himself a prisoner of the kingdom of Avalon. Merlin the magician, commissioned by his beloved king, is responsible for finding the king's heir who can find the 15 pieces of the legendary sword, and bring King Arthur back from the underworld!

name: The Supermarket Hunter
summary: Flex, buy everything, buy more and buy!

name: The Hunsa Magic
summary: Take control of a mage with the unique ability of possesing golems, overcome obstacles and puzles reliying on both character sinergies and dismantle the plans of the cult of mages that are trying to awake "The ancient one".

name: The Revenge of Mr.Samuel
summary: Samuel! The name of the dark evil master god of a distance universe created by himself. 4 fellas felt to this dimension by a huge mistake made by Huseyin –our hero. Help these 4 fellas to return home safely and defeat Samuel if you can!

name: The Rusty Sword: Vanguard Island
summary: The Rusty Sword: Vanguard Island is a short, top-down adventure game inspired by several 16-bit games.

name: The Legend of Zelda Redux
summary:
