Celebrating the 35th Anniversary since the release of the original Legend of Zelda on the Famicom Disk System on February 21st, 1986; and continuing over from the Zelda II Redux hack, The Legend of Zelda Redux (or Zelda 1 Redux) aims to tackle some of the odd designs and programming decisions from the original NES classic to revitalize and give new life to the beloved and cherished classic.

This hack tries to address a lot of points to make the game fit with the rest of the series (and Zelda 2 Redux) by doing some rebalancing and QoL changes, and also some visual flare into the game, without compromising the original game’s design. Be sure to check the full Changelog inside the ReadMe file for the full list of changes made to this hack, and also don’t forget to check the optional patches too!

name: The Dark Heart of Balor
summary: Archdemon Balor has opened the Gate of Hell into the human realm and hordes of demons and monsters have flooded into your world destroying everything in their path. You must protect those who are still alive and ultimately destroy Balor to close the Gate.

name: The Neroe
summary: Action-adventure roguelike game in which you can catch and control creatures. Explore the open world, find the secrets, get items and complete the dungeons. Play solo or local multiplayer: each player makes his own adventure!

name: The Great Ocean
summary: Dive into adventure-missions in the earth’s oceans. Explore in your high-tech submarine fascinating spots like the Galapagos or the Deep Sea. Use your upgradeable tools to solve quests when you free jailed whales, or explore sunken WW2 battleships. Swim with majestic whales, sharks and sea turtles. And take real action to save the oceans.

name: The Airline Project: Next Gen
summary: Set up a widespread network and gain as much market share as possible in the era of your choice using your favorite aircraft in this offline airline tycoon. Do you have what it takes to coordinate an airline?

name: The Immortal
summary: This is running game in 2D Platformer, enemies will appear on the way, kill them all if you want to reach the end of the land, Lung Cu. You have to focus on the game 100%, just one hit of enemy everything will back to the beginning.

name: The Farmer's Story of Slow Life
summary: The sisters inherited the ranch and the mountains from their father's estate. But the island is no longer vibrant. You set out to rebuild the ranch and the town. When you have gathered enough assets, you can visit remote islands far away. You will surely find unknown items waiting for you.

name: The Backrooms: Found Footage
summary: The Backrooms: Found Footage is a psychological horror game where you "no-clip" through reality and into the Backrooms. Explore 600 million miles of randomly generated office space, contend with entities, collect unique and useful lore, and attempt to maintain your sanity as you try to escape.

name: The Divine Speaker: The Sun and the Moon
summary: The story-rich 18+ prequel to The Divine Speaker. Follow alongside a younger Aemyl as he uncovers the world for himself!

name: The Old Forest
summary: The Old Forest is an open world RPG with dungeon crawling, exploration, crafting, survival mechanics and loot! Slash, sneak or cast your way through the ominous forest, catacombs, ruins, caves and dungeons to uncover why the forest spirits are angry and how to bring an end to the endless winter.

name: The Ball Flow: Nature and Light
summary: Explore beautiful world! The ball use to carefully calculated physics. Change the ball's material for explore beautiful world smoothly. Enjoy and I deeply wish that you feel better after playing my game.

name: There's a Rikishi in my House
summary: A casual escape game with 15 multiple endings.

name: The Heroic Legend of Eagarlnia: Expansion Pack
summary: The DLC of include four new forces, Yan and Kaze，Ikaris and Herricido.

name: The Last Secret
summary: Light-hearted visual novel adventure with an epic tale - with challenging and fun puzzles, humorous storyline and quirky characters. Solve the "last secret", save your friends and maybe find true love on the way, too...

name: The Unsettled
summary: The Unsettled is a first-person Psychological Horror game. You as an Investigative Journalist, Got Intel about a Missing girl in a Boarding School, but it reveals something more Evil and Scary.

name: The Medical Examination Diary: The Exciting Days of Me and My Senpai
summary: Would you like to start the love romance by your senpai that you desired? "The medical examination diary: the exciting days of me and my senpai" is the novel game.

name: The Lotus Holidays
summary: A stylish single player story-based game, where you win a free weekend at the "Lotus", a luxurious spa resort. But soon, things take a strange and sinister turn.

name: The Perfect Pencil
summary: Help John on his journey of personal growth. Unravel the nuances of human reactions to fear. Surprising exploration, fast paced combat, complex choices and allegorical characters, all intertwined with a psychological narrative in this hand-drawn 2D action-platformer.

name: The Detail's in the Devils
summary: A short narrative deduction game set in the overly litigious bowels of Hell. A simple text-based investigative game about asking the right questions of the right people. When surrounded by pathological liars always remember, the detail's in the devils. A simple text-based investigative game.

name: The Remains: Chapter 1
summary: In this linear story driven horror game you have the daunting task to find out what has happend to the asylum of Piekielna Wioska, a "special research facility". Your mission is simple: get you and your target out of there. Happy hunting.

name: The Neighborhood
summary: The Neighborhood is a humorous simulator of life in a small town. The player has the opportunity to direct the fate of a new member of this local community. He will get to know local neighbors and unique stories, he will take part in various exciting and often funny events.

name: The Last Shape
summary: The Last Shape - is a hand-drawn 2d platformer game, which gives the player an amazing opportunity to sink into the breathtaking atmosphere of a destroyed alien world. The player has to pass all the floors of the game accompanied with a little cube and finally see what happened.

name: The Last Planets
summary:
This is an infinite and endless run, adventure, arcade, physics based, space and planets exploring game.

Take part to this infinite progression through the dangers of this universe, controlling some planets that are shattered from a great explosion produced somewhere...

name: The Hong Kong Massacre / Beautiful Desolation Bundle
summary: If there are two things most people love in life, it’s science fiction and blasting things! We’ve put together two of our titles in a special package that will have you exploring African-inspired future landscapes and shooting your way through legions of adversaries in the underworld of Hong Kong. This is an epic bundle you don’t want to miss!

name: The Legend of Heroes: Akatsuki no Kiseki Mobile
The Little Star Spirit
summary: Take on the challenge and start your journey to unexplored realms. Meet foreign creatures, be aware of traps and find all the stars, that got lost after the star constellation of the fox was destroyed. Rebuild the little Star Spirit’s home to former glory and let it shine brighter than before.

name: The Slovak Run
summary: The Slovak Run is an infinite runner game, where you play as a typical old Slovak shepherd whose lovely sheep is lost. Run through the forest, dodge obstacles, and collect wool to help you find your lost sheep.

name: The FED
summary: An agency called the FED has identified an online group of potential threats. All they need is evidence to have them locked away. You are a new agent going undercover in that online group with the task of getting that evidence, by whatever means necessary.

name: The Tales of Bayun
summary: Can a flat world resting on the backs of three demon bears live in peace? Of course not! Immerse yourself in the universe of the dark Slavic legends, explore the characters' stories and make difficult choices that affect the course of events. Bayun the Cat will help you. If you're lucky, that is.

name: The Dropper 2
summary: The famous mine mini game: The Dropper 2 comes to iOS! This game supports world wide multiplayer! Room can has up to 40 players! You can play it with other players all over the world.

name: The A-Team
summary: LCD game based on The A-Team franchise. Is it part of the "Large Screen" line.

name: The A-Team
summary: An LCD game based on The A-Team franchise.

name: The Quest: Hero of Lukomorye V
summary: The Quest: Hero of Lukomorye V is an expansion to The Quest, a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement and turn based combat. After enabling the expansion, you can explore new areas and adventures. However, if you don't have The Quest, you can also play the expansion as a standalone game.

name: The Quest: Curse of Linmore
summary:
The Quest: Curse of Linmore is an expansion to The Quest, a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement and turn based combat.

After enabling the expansion, you can explore new areas and adventures. However, if you don't have The Quest, you can also play the expansion as a standalone game.

name: The Quest: Hero of Lukomorye II
summary:
The Quest: Hero of Lukomorye II is an expansion to The Quest, a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement and turn based combat.

After enabling the expansion, you can explore new areas and adventures. However, if you don't have The Quest, you can also play the expansion as a standalone game.

name: The Quest: Asteroids
summary:
The Quest: Asteroids is an expansion to The Quest, a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement and turn based combat.

After enabling the expansion, you can explore new areas and adventures. However, if you don't have The Quest, you can also play the expansion as a standalone game.

name: The Quest: Mithril Horde
summary:
The Quest: Mithril Horde is an expansion to The Quest, a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement and turn based combat.

After enabling the expansion, you can explore new areas and adventures. However, if you don't have The Quest, you can also play the expansion as a standalone game.

name: The Robot Factory
summary: Create robots. Test robots. Collect robots. Build with exoskeletons, zephyr mechanisms, hydrostatic tentacles, machinos locomotors, G-Force mixers, and more! Make any robot you can imagine! Robot cats. Robot samurais. Robot spies.

name: This Is a True Story
summary: Explore a beautiful, hand-painted landscape in this lush narrative puzzle game that's based on actual events and interviews. Survive a windstorm, catch poachers, and even befriend a goat! Adventure and insight await you at every turn as you search for water and marvel at Earth’s natural beauty.

name: The Game: Play ... as long as you can!
summary: "The Game" is the digital single player version of the popular card game, "Spiel des Jahres". Play ... as long as you can! The Game is you opponent. You can beat it, but even if the rules are very simple - it will not be easy. Think carefully and plan ahead, this is the only way to succeed!

name: The Barbarian
summary: The Barbarian is a full, action packed RPG game designed to have a desktop-like feel on mobile! Over 30 Hours of gameplay featuring 13 environments, hordes of over 100 enemy types and thousands of potential weapons and armor as well as a skill and class system that changes how the game can be played.

name: The World II
summary: This is a game for you to face off gigantic monsters while progressing through the story to become the epic hero of the world.

name: The Escapists: Prison Escape
summary:
The Escapists is a unique prison escape sandbox game where you get to experience a life behind bars and barbed wire fences. You'e had a life of crime but now you're caught. With thrilling and immersive gameplay, you need to create an escape route in a world of other prisoners and ruled by routine.
Escaping requires cunning, strategy, the right equipment and staying at least two steps ahead of the guards. Bribe and fight your way through the prison ranks. If your fellow prisoners like you enough, recruit them and create your own gang. You might even take over a prison! The guards are out to stop any escape attempts, so you’ll have to avoid suspicious behaviour by attending roll calls, working a prison job and hiding your stolen contraband.

name: The Last Tater
summary: You are a little fried tater trying to survive as earth turns apocalyptic in this action packed side-scroller shooter

name: The 10th Planet
summary: The 10th Planet is a cancelled game from Bethesda Softworks. It would have been a sci-fy space combat game, slatted for release in 1997. Playstation and Sega Saturn version were also planned.

name: The Bathhouse
summary: The Bathhouse is a Japanese horror game.

name: The President
summary: The secret service discovers that a group of gunmen wants to kill the president, so they send Paul to investigate the area. Upon arriving in the area, Paul must send the information to the secret service and eliminate the men who are there.

name: The Felix the Cat Trivia Quiz
The Backrooms VR
summary: Live the true Backrooms VR Experience in a psychological horror game, where you'll be alone in a liminal world full of entities that will hunt you at every moment, Scary, dark this immersive VR experience allows you to use your hands to grab and use items to solve puzzles inside this liminal world.

name: The Golden Eyed Ghosts
summary: The Golden Eyed Ghosts is a dark fantasy soulslike heavily influenced by the legacy of Zelda adventures, set in the crumbling kingdom of Andromeda. As exiled warrior Orion, search for a way to restore his memories and unravel a terrifying conspiracy.

name: There Swings a Skull: Grim Tidings
summary: Enter the doomed town of Pareildas. Watch as the flames turn bone and stone to ash. Like joined wicks, we'll all burn together.

name: The Lost Kingdom Prophecy
summary: Help Princess Serena stop the dark wizard Balaak and save Rosefal in a fantasy match‑3 with hidden‑object stages, four match modes, and power‑ups across configurable square and hex boards.

name: The Princess of the Tower wants a Hero
summary: Princess Lumi has been held captive in the demon lord’s castle situated in a land of everlasting winter. She hates it. It’s cold, it’s lonely, the food is bad, and there’s literally nothing to do! The only good thing about this place is the tea and snacks.

name: The Call of Krul'ar
summary:
Survive the horrors of the unknown as you expand out to keep from being dragged into the darkness; and devoured by that which lurks inside.

Collect, Combine, Defend, and Expand using the various cards you find in this land.

name: The History Channel: The Civil War Experience
Thirty Cycles
summary:
A game made for Nemesis Jam.
Control one of the nine knights and fight to become the greatest.

Video game mechanics should not be patented.

Inspired by a recently patented Nemesis system from Shadow of Mordor and Shadow of War games.

name: The Adventures of Detective Bron
summary: The Adventures of Detective Bron is a detective-adventure game in which you have to investigate all kinds of crimes: from murders and missing people to robberies. Solve all the mysteries and test your deductive skills!

name: The Jumping Burger
summary:
Join BIG B on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!
Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Witch's Garden
summary: The Witch’s Garden is a relaxing, slice-of-life gardening and crafting game.

name: The Lost Dachshund
summary: Your granddaughter is coming over on the ferry from the mainland. You have promised her a puppy for her birthday– a dachshund named "Peanut". But Peanut has escaped her pen and is free on the island. You must traverse the island and rescue the mischievous puppy, before your granddaughter arrives.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Conquest
summary: Play as Evil characters in a brand new, 'Evil' campaign. Battle through scenarios after Frodo failed to destroy the One Ring; it's good to be bad! Battle online, in a co-op campaign or offline in split-screen.

name: The Incredibles: Rise of the Underminer
summary: When the evil Underminer rises to the surface with a sinister plan to rule the world, it's up to Mr. Incredible and his super cool pal Frozone to save the day. While Mrs. Incredible, Violet, Dash, and Jack-Jack take care of things topside, Mr. Incredible and Frozone race underground to put a stop to the Underminer's dastardly plans and bury the diabolitical baddie once and for all! All-new action/adventure game. Play as Mr. Incredible or Frozone at anytime. Cooperative game-play with the ability to switch characters at any point in the game. Update your character's moves and abilities as you progress through the game.

name: The Unfamiliar Story of Grandfather's Heritage
summary: Returning to her grandfather's house years later, a woman finds herself in an adventure with ghosts from her past as the only way to uncover a terrifying truth.

name: The Legend of the Dragonflame: Highschool Collection
summary: Kick, punch, and jump your way to becoming the toughest kid in school

name: The Backrooms 1998
summary: The Backrooms 1998 is a first-person found footage psychological horror survival game where it tells the story of a young teen after accidentally falling into the depths of The Backrooms in 1998. Roam freely, mark, explore and try unravel the story - however you are not alone. Don't scream.

name: The Harlem Shake Dance Video Game
summary:
You've seen people doing it, your friends have done it and even you may have done it. But now you're going to play it!

The Helmet Guy and his friends are doing the best Harlem Shake video ever, but all this shaking is knocking down everything they have! Don't let the weird toys ruin your shake!

name: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
summary: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian is an action-adventure fantasy video game.

name: The Legend of Chibi Ninja
summary: CHIBI NINJA is a ruthless 2D Puzzle platformer. Play as The Legendary Hero and destroy hordes of mechanical beasts to save your world from a mind controlling extraterrestial parasite using detonable BOMB SHURIKENS. Be very wary though, you can only endure one single hit. Are you up to the task?

name: The Flames
summary: The Flames is a top down shooter where you fight a powerful boss called Hodaya and help save the Wisp the leader of the planet.

name: Thieves' Paradise
summary: Welcome to Shopper's Paradise! Thieves' Paradise is a stealth action game where you will break into the capitalistic wonderland known as Shopper's Paradise in order to steal what you need. Explore 3 different storylines and 9 individually designed heists!

name: The Lucid Dreamer Bundle
summary:
Sherlock Holmes Chapter One + The Sinking City Bundle

Use your mind to investigate and your willpower to resist madness.

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets the Movie: Five Memories of My Time With You - Limited Edition
summary:
This edition includes the following:
- The Quintessential Quintuplets the Movie: Five Memories of My Time with You
- Five-disc drama CD set

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Five Memories Spent With You
summary: I want to confess my feelings for you...

name: The Somerton Man
summary:
On 1 December 1948, a body was found on Somerton Beach in Adelaide, Australia. From there unfolded one of the most perplexing (and still unsolved) mysteries of the 20th century.
This game seeks to recreate the experience of the 1948-1949 investigation.

name: The Rhythm of the Knight
summary: ROTK is a VR rhythm game based on your reflex and lightsaber skill. Deflect shots, slash projectiles, slash enemies, dodge obstacles, use your powers to break others. All this to the beat of a dark techno song in hand-crafted levels designed to match the music.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel I - IV & Trails into Reverie Complete Box
summary: At Thors Military Academy, Erebonia’s best and brightest learn everything from the art of war to the liberal arts. First-year Rean Schwarzer learns that he's been selected as a member of Class VII, which controversially includes both nobles and commoners. But they’ll need to deal with more than just class warfare - they’ll need to safeguard their country from those who would plunge it into chaos.

name: The Final Boss
summary: Ever wonder what the boss does without you?

name: The Trailblazer
summary: You take the role of Malcolm Striker - a former member of Earth's special forces that main job was to obviously save the Earth on daily basis. A loner and a mercenary now, who's only purpose is to find and finish off his dreaded nemesis - Vladimir Vladimir, a one-man factory of lust for world domination. His shadowy presence is ever pervasive, and despite all of these ugly things getting in your way and giving you a reason to expend shotgun shells in some as ugly faces, such as invasion from outer dimension, caused by accident thanks to UAC, for which sure as 'Hell' V.V. is responsible for - perhaps one day you will finally face him upon the field of battle to avenge his lost love and the tragic refrigerator accident. Where that damned villain could be now, anyway?

name: The Other Line
summary:
The Other Line is a game that started as a Yume Nikki fangame. It involves a boy named Nathan in his apartment haunted by nightmares who, by use of his phone, dials into the alternate world (the "other line").
Rather than totally free roaming exploration, there are more linear paths that focus on puzzles or events.

name: The Library of Babel
summary: Join Ludovik in a 2D Stealth Platformer and Graphic Adventure, as he explores the jungles of a futuristic Babylon to discover the secret behind the Library of Babel’s sudden lockdown and the mysteries behind their mythical creators.

name: The Darkest Road
summary: In this old-school RPG, you play as Callum and Lucia, the Trial Ones, as they find their way to be together in an epic battle that will change their and everyone else's lives.

name: The Last Man
summary: A topdown survival space horror where a single enemy hit can end your life

name: The Big Con: Grift of the Year Edition
summary: Grift through the totally rad '90s in all its plaid and payphone glory!

name: The Visit
summary: The Visit is a short platform game. The player controls a mustached gentleman who wishes to visit his girlfriend.

name: This is Just to Say
summary: A poetic reenactment.

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
summary: J.R.R. Tolkien's Middle-earth is a land of beauty, magic, and darkness. In The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring, you follow Tolkien's narrative from the Shire to the halls of Moria, and finally to the banks of the River Anduin. Gameplay alternates between melee, archery, sorcery, and stealth as you control Frodo, Gandalf, and Aragorn. Join this band of heroes in their quest to destroy the One Ring, which contains all the power of the dark lord Sauron.

name: The World of a Mermaid
summary: Welcome in the underwater world of a mermaid, with aquatics creatures & the queen, welcome in The World of a Mermaid!

name: The Splitting: Chapter 3
summary:
The Splitting is a mystery adventure game.

In the 3rd chapter Daniel and geM visit Coldwin prison to look for llehctiM, who disappeared at the end of chapter 2 . There they learn more about Mitchell’s escape, and the mysterious ‘Dave’.

name: The Golden Time in High School
summary: As a high school student of Shiguang high school, you will spend three years here. What kind of students that you will be? You can choose to study hard and get a good grade.You can choose to be an assistant to teacher to help with their daily affairs. Or just have a romantic date with somebody?

name: This is a Ghost
summary: This Is a Ghost is a horror game in which you embody a ghost hunter. This action game will immerse you in the heart of a paranormal investigation, in solo or multiplayer.

name: The Pegasus Expedition
summary: The Pegasus Expedition is a story-driven sci-fi grand strategy game set in a key moment for humankind’s survival. Facing an overwhelming threat at home, humanity sends expeditions to the Pegasus Galaxy in a desperate attempt to find a refuge for the population of Earth.

name: The Detective
summary: Detective vintage game. Ask questions, search for clues, and items. Objects can tell stories too. In your notebook, you will mark who is lying and who is telling the truth.

name: The Twilight of Infinity
summary: Anyone with a time machine can change history, but saving it requires creative problem solving. Pocket sized episodes based on the greatest unsolved mysteries; solve, manipulate, interrogate and impersonate. The only thing you don't have to worry about with time travel is being late.

name: The Devil's Chosen
summary: Demons fled from hell and civilization fell. Now it's up to you to gather survivors, scavenge for resources and build a community in a post-apocalyptic world on cards - a world where you define what it means to survive.

name: Thread
summary: A puppet themed platformer metroidvania with a focus on platforming rather than combat. Throw your crystal scissors into walls to create your own platforms, explore a twisting and mysterious land, and solve puzzles on a worldwide scale.

name: The Touhou Empires
summary:
The Touhou Empires is a real-time strategy simulation game (RTS) in which you lead Touhou Project characters and fairies with various abilities to fight!

Players command Touhou Project's catactors and fairies to complete the prepared missions while responding to ever-changing situations!

The game flow is as follows: players collect resources from the map, construct buildings to expand their own camps, and organize their armies to advance and march.
Then, organize your army, march forward, and battle the enemy to complete the mission!

name: The Creature Zone VR
summary: welcome to the experiment, The Creature Zone VR is thrilling, scary, and fun. get ready for spooky time. choose between the three levels present, vent run, terry's pizzeria, and missing friend. they are all spooky games.

name: The Backroom Project
summary: Scientists made a new discovery about the Backrooms. Noclipping out of bounds in normal reality was a myth for long, but now it can be reality! Now they are looking for subjects to test it on civil people. There are already scientists inside, so you have nothing to worry about, they say. Or do you?

name: That Which Was Lost
summary: Delve into a fantastic old-school RPG featuring great characters and an emotional storyline developed by the makers of Ultima Adventum.

name: The Old War
summary: This is an indie-developed co-op strategy game set in a dark medieval fantasy world.

name: The Knight Witch
summary: The Knight Witch is a metroidvania adventure game with fast-paced, shoot 'em up combat set in a beautifully hand-drawn world. Cast devastating card-based spells, forge close bonds, and make moral choices all in your quest to save your home and discover who's behind the War Golem invasion.

name: The Forgotten Boundary
summary: "The Forgotten Boundary" is a stand-alone independent game based on magic tower strategy puzzle solving, map exploration, and dungeon challenge.

name: The Elf Maiden
summary: You are the Fair Maiden. Walk upon the lands to gather the souls of fallen warriors from past events and escort them to the Holy Land. Fight to gain power and free the fallen who deserve rest and peace.

name: The Spirit in the Woods
summary: Your journey begins now, Kuara Bay has become one of the few habitable places on earth, but there is still hope for a fresh start. The future is in your hands, with some tools to start and wonderful people by your side, starting this new adventure in a forgotten corner of Brazil.

name: The Warrior's Path
summary: The Warrior’s Path is a singleplayer RPG, focused on your decisions in many different events. Those decisions can have longterm effects on other events. Prepare your character for hard fights with different crafting skills. How long can you walk on the warriors path? What's your story?

name: The Backrooms: Deeper
summary: A first person immersive experience into The Backrooms. Experience them as a scientist working for [REDACTED] . Solve puzzles to advance the many halls of surreal terror. Take photographs for your team to see if The Backrooms are a reality, or just your sanity dripping away.

name: The Backworld
summary: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

name: The World of Gangs
summary: The King’s Mountain Gang disciple, Lu Huanding, set out with her childhood friend Yuan Liai and the others, To find the legendary lost Excalibur. The ventured in the world of gangs, encountered many incidents of that world on the way, experienced all kinds of dangers, and solved various problems.

name: Thirayan
summary: Thirayan is an action platformer game set in India. A hand-drawn action platformer game offering players new experience with its story and art.

name: Thunder Ray
summary: Thunder Ray is Arcade-Boxing, Retro-like gameplay with blood and violence. Defeat all the best fighters in the galaxy to become the GOAT of the universe.

name: The United Space of America
summary: The United SPACE of America is a high action, arcade style, run-n-gun bullet hell, twin stick shooter that allows you to absorb enemy bullets with your Proton Sabre while you blast through countless enemies and unlock new abilities. There's air dashing, giant Proton Shots and more!

name: Thorn Demon Hunter
summary: This is an AVG game similar to Metroidvania. The player will perform a demon hunter exploring and decrypting the castle in the Gothic period and hunting the corrupt soul

name: The Illusion: Nightmare
summary: The Illusion: Nightmare Is A Horror Game Made By Professional Crew In The Art Of Horror. You Will Have The Opportunity To Experience One Of The Most Powerful Types Of Psychological Horror Based On An Environment Designed In Every Detail To Be A Real Hell That Makes You Terrified.

name: The Alpinist
summary: Make your way up the mountain with your ice axe and your grappling hook. Hold tight, watch your steps and make sure not to fall, you never know how far you're gonna land.

name: The Red Village
summary: The Red Village (TRV) is the leading Dark-Fantasy franchise in the Metaverse. TRV digital assets called 'Champions' are used across two distinct game modes: Tournaments (currently live, in Beta), and Darklands (currently under development in a multi-year partnership with the award-winning game development studio 'Blowfish Studios' (a subsidiary of global blockchain giant Animoca Brands)).

name: The 7th Sign Project
summary: The 7th Sign Project is a classic 2D-platformer action game inspired by Doom, Quake, Abuse, and Painkiller games. Our goal is to entertain the player with massive enemy fights, boss fights, and stirring music.

name: The Kobolds Left Behind
summary: A tear-filled story game about the bittersweet last day of three abandoned kobolds.

name: The Syber Virus
summary: This is a casual rpg game, there are twelve levels from different challenges. You control the main role, with a little bit delicate play skill,to eliminate enemies.You can collect resources inside game to buy items and enhance your role...like a RPG,anyway.

name: The Bat D
summary: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Collect flies with the main hero of the game The Bat D. Collect all flies in the world!

name: The King of Fighters XV: Characters Team South Town
summary: Geese Howard, Billy Kane, and Ryuji Yamazaki of "Team South Town" can be used in "The King of fighters XV".

name: The Simpsons: Road Rage
summary:
This is the Game Boy Advance version of The Simpsons: Road Rage that was first released in 2001 for PlayStation 2, Xbox and GameCube. The game is based on the animated television series The Simpsons, and is part of a series of games based on the show.

The game stars Homer, Marge, Bart, and Lisa, as well as Mr. Burns and several other characters from the show. The Simpsons: Road Rage is similar to Sega's 1999 video game Crazy Taxi, in that the main objective is to drive picked up passengers to their destinations as quickly as possible. These similarities led to Sega suing Radical Entertainment and Electronic Arts for patent infringement though it was settled before going to court.

name: The Ferryman
summary:
Keep your lantern to your chest, lad. These waters aren't as calm as they may seem...

As the Ferryman, it's your duty to deliver goods and supplies to the denizens of the sea. It isn't an easy job, but it needs doing. The Keepers depend on you, so you'd better get to it. Just remember - the further you stray from the shore, the rougher yet the seas become.

name: The Legend of Banjo-Kazooie: Gruntilda's Mask
summary: A Banjo-Kazooie ROM hack which puts Banjo and Kazooie in Clock Town from The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask.

name: The Finally
summary: JRPG 2D retro pixel adventure puzzle drama love sacrifice tells the story of a young man who must travel to get back to his lover. The gameplay is a walk to find information from the characters around you. to find a way to continue Walk against enemies with battle commands.

name: The Bird's Realm 3
summary: This is another simple calm open world bird flying simulator! There are no goals or quests, just simply flying around this large island in a sandbox open world to kill time. Find glowing eggs to unlock a bird.

name: The Valiant
summary: Embark on a journey of brotherhood and redemption in The Valiant, a squad-based RTS set in 13th Century Europe and the Middle East. Command and level-up your medieval knights as you fight through an epic SP campaign, then take your skills online in both cooperative and competitive MP modes.

name: The Bagel Archive
summary: 5 small games for Playdate

name: The Sims Medieval: Deluxe Edition
summary: Includes both The Sims Medieval and The Sims Medieval Pirates & Noble Adventure Pack. The Sims Medieval takes players back to the Middle Ages, where players can create a hero, go out on quests, and build a kingdom of their very own. Players' adventures decide the future of their realm, shaping it into a thriving utopia or a war-torn area of disaster. The Pirate Pack switches gears, tossing players into a feud between the Pirates of Aarbyville and the Nobles of Tredony.

name: The Sims Medieval
summary: Mobile port of The Sims Medieval.

name: The Sims 4: Moonlight Chic Kit
summary: With The Sims 4 Moonlight Chic Kit, Simmers can discover new styles and dress up for a night to remember in the City of Love! Inspired by Parisian designer Paola Locatelli and today’s youth fashions, these new looks are perfect for all the experiences a Sim will encounter during a night out on the town.

name: The Sims 4: Little Campers Kit
summary: The Sims 4 Little Campers Kit encourages Sims to explore and enjoy the great outdoors with cozy and cunning camping gear. Sims can play outdoor games from the safety of their DIY blanket fort, with a collection that offers everything a family needs for a night of creative fun!

name: The Sims 3: Starter Pack
summary: A compilation of The Sims 3, The Sims 3: Late Night, The Sims 3: High-End Loft Stuff, and Date Night set from The Sims 3 Store.

name: The Red Sea
summary: The Red Sea is a Japanese Yume Nikki fangame. You play as Nagi, a boy who stays in his room. The goal of the game is to explore and find effects.

name: Threshold
summary: Threshold is an English Yume Nikki fangame. The protagonist is a boy named Hideko, who refuses to leave his room. The goal is to collect effects.

name: The Final Hours of Mass Effect 3
The Hauntings: Surveillance
summary: Welcome to the Directive Seven Bravo surveillance team. There's an office that's been experiencing paranormal events. Your task is to scan through various cameras set up throughout the building and document as many activities as possible. Be warned: this assignment is of high importance and If you miss too many activities, or report improper activities, you will be fired.

name: The Instruction Manual
summary: Instruction manual for having sex in space. A homage to a tale of the same name by Julio Cortázar.

name: The Twilight of Infinity Episode 2 - Attack on the Hydro Processor
summary: An explosion in 2041 will lead to an investigation at the Mesa Hydro Processor. Why would anyone blow up a civilian facility, and who could be behind it?

name: The Journey: Episode 2 - Words of Wisdom
summary: The second step that you never knew you needed to take to get to wherever you're wanting to go... You won't regret this experience. You have nothing to lose, and everything to gain...

name: The Riftbreaker: Metal Terror
summary: Explore an entirely new area of Galatea 37 in this Story Campaign expansion for The Riftbreaker. Catalog new species. Craft new and unique weapons. Fight hordes of aliens unlike anything you've seen before.

name: The Misanthropic Girl
summary: You control two protagonists at the same time in this action RPG, letting you combine their unique skills. Explore and discover in the seamless open world setting of a detailed Japanese town as you watch these two high schoolers learn what “existence” really means in this post-apocalyptic tale.

name: The Last Human is a Biker
summary: The Last Human is a Biker is a few hours of pure entertainment. In this 2D shooter you play as John, the last human, and unleash his fury in his quest of vengeance! With unlimited item synergies, make the choices that will allow you to survive against countless swarms of aliens!

name: The Robot Girl Meets the Human!
summary: This is an adventure game that takes you on a journey through a world after humans have disappeared. Lead the robot girl "Scarlet" to find the surviving humans.

name: The Overlord Isn't Another Isekai Protagonist, Is He?: Chapter 1
summary: Have you ever wondered what awaits you after death? At 25, Kay had no plans to die... let alone to wake up in literal HELL one day. Did he deserve such a fate, or is it all just a ridiculous mistake? Kay can’t remember his past, but he firmly believes that he doesn't belong here.

name: The Fright Before Christmas
summary: Help Billy, Mandy and Grim destroy the evil toys that have taken over Santa's toyshop.

name: The Lizartian
summary: The Lizartian is a top-down action-adventure game. We will embody a lizard tamer, a Lizartian, who will have to travel the vast lands of Dekoto to fulfill his revenge. Along the way, he'll face dangers like savage bandits, rugged terrain, and the legendary sandstorm.

name: The Sword and Peachblossom
summary: This is a country strange theme of short visual novel. The game has part of the text of classical Chinese. This game is purely fictional and has nothing to do with real history.

name: The Otherwilde
summary: A gorgeous world of photorealistic natural assets, cute villages, and unexpected NPCs. Explore the open world map, gather herbs, create potions, hunt wild animals, build bases, and farm. Currently Early Access.

name: The Oregon Trail: 40th Anniversary Edition
summary: Relive a part of American history and a slice of gaming history at the same time as a classic frontier adventure blazes a new trail on Wii. In the middle of the 19th Century, America is headed West, chasing the promise of a new life. Load up the wagon and set out from Independence, Missouri, making your way to Oregon City on a trail full of adventure. Face the challenges of the wide-open frontier as you battle the elements, hunt and fish to feed your family, and more.

name: The Inquisitor
summary:
The Inquisitor is a story-driven, dark renaissance, action-adventure mystery game set in an alternate history 1500’s. In this world, Jesus did not die on the cross. Instead, he broke free from his crucifixion and unleashed bloody vengeance on those who did not believe in him. Centuries pass and now an army of zealot Inquisitors brutally enforce the faith of this blood-hungry Church that has taken hold in Europe.

You play as one such Inquisitor in service this The Holy Office - Mordimer Madderdin. Dispatched to the despondent town of Konigstein, you will be tasked with dealing with the various crimes and transgressions of the common folk, all while dealing with an ancient evil that is trying to take root around you.

name: The Last City
summary: Find food, build your colony, recruit new workers, feed your population, craft tools and equipment, cook food and research technologies!

name: The Unseen Fears: Stories Untold - Collector's Edition
summary: Can you help people escape their magical prisons in time?

name: The Jumping Pizza
summary:
Join BIG P on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!
Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Ao no Kiseki Evolution
summary: The Legend of Heroes: Ao no Kiseki Evolution is the remake version of the original Ao no Kiseki PSP game. This version of the game features full voice acting, new side quests and mini-games, updated graphics and a new rearranged soundtrack.

name: The Inquisitor 3D
summary:
"The Inquisitor III" is a full-fledged RPG based on GZDoom engine. There are no defined classes. You can develop your character in different directions, creating your own class as a result. You can get in the way of the warrior, battle mage, priest (i.e. mage, specializing mainly in defensive spells) or a combination of these ways in different proportions.
We have our own dialogue system for which you have to setup two additional buttons in the menu: one - to switch between anwers, the other - to use the selected one. These buttons are also used to select and cast defensive spells.
Compared with "The Inquisitor II", the set of weapons and monsters is significantly expanded. New spells and items in the inventory are also available.
There are 12 large maps combined into one hub.

name: That Smiling Game
summary:
What can we eliminate from our life to make it better?

A short point-and-click game.

name: The Gannet
summary: An island creation myth featuring divinity and a sea bird.

name: The Quest for One
summary: Become the greatest common divisor, reap the greatest dividends.

name: The Griffon Legend
summary: The Griffon Legend is a freeware zelda-like RPG created in FreeBASIC as part of a contest by Syn9 (Daniel Kennedy). 500 years after the Griffon-Dragon war, the Dragons have returned to reclaim their empire. Cities are falling, everyone is dying, and the lone Griffon Knight Fayne is caught up in the middle of it all.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Oni Link Begins
The Legend of Zelda: Time to Triumph
The Sky Left Us
summary: The Sky Left Us is a sci-fi visual novel about climate crisis, classism, and how relationships shape our politics. Play as Spire Risan, an off-worlder scientist who becomes entangled in the drama of a mountain they came here to save. Fall in with the denizens of the three castes, and find that things are more complicated than they seem: be it love, family, or the systems that shape us.

name: Them's Fightin' Herds: Deluxe Edition
summary: The Deluxe Edition includes Them's Fightin' Herds (base game) and the Season 1 Pass.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Randomizer
summary: A randomizer mod for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man
summary: The Nintendo DS port of The Amazing Spider-Man.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man
summary: The port of The Amazing Spider-Man for smartphone devices.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man
summary: The Nintendo 3DS port of The Amazing Spider-Man.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man
summary: The port of The Amazing Spider-Man for J2ME based platforms.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man
summary: The Wii port of The Amazing Spider-Man.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
summary: The Android and iOS port of The Amazing Spider-Man 2.

name: The House That Dripped Blood
summary: Blood. Blood. Suffering.

name: The Horus Heresy: Legions - Titandeath
summary: Titandeath is a new expansion coming to the mobile game The Horus Heresy: Legions, bringing two new playable armies in the form of Loyalist Titans and Traitor Titans, new cards, and more.

name: The Meaning
summary: "The meaning" is a psychological horror game, where you should expect the unexpected, It's a story about a man, who have lost everything & everyone. You'll view the life of Ethen Daniels from his perspective and submerged in the deep and sad reality of his life.

name: The Farnese Hercules
summary: The Farnese Hercules is an puzzle game with a new and unique central mechanic. Take on the role of the famed sculptors of history as you gaze into your material and see your work before you carve it and reveal it to the world.

name: The Tennis & The Snowboard
summary:
A compilation of:

- Simple 2000 Series Vol. 6: The Snowboard
- Simple 2000 Series Vol. 8: The Tennis

name: The Shooting & The Helicopter
summary:
A compilation of:

- Simple 2000 Series Vol.35: The Helicopter
- Simple 2000 Series Vol.37: The Shooting - Double Shienryu

name: The Battle for Mata-Nui
summary: The Battle for Mata Nui is an online game based on the LEGO Bionicle franchise. It takes place during the invasion of the Bohrok swarms. The Bohrok are on a mission to completely destroy the island of Mata Nui in order to return it to how it was in the "before-time." It's up to the Toa to stop them and protect their people.

name: The Butcher
summary: Fighting your way through hellish enemies to seek vengeance in this dark-fantasy action game.

name: The Forest Prison
summary: In 2160, political dissidents were not sentenced directly to death but were sent for 'cognitive and orientation tests' to a prison from which no one had ever escaped alive. This is the story of James Webb, who was sentenced to life in prison.

name: The Box Game
summary: The Box Game is a 2D top down platformer game written in Java, and your objective is to get to the end of the labyrinth. The game has 11 levels that get progressively larger each level. More gameplay elements will get introduced to you as you go, and in total the game will take roughly 10-20 minutes to fully play through, depending on your skills (or maybe luck?).

name: The Backrooms: Mass Extinction
summary: If you noclip out of reality in the wrong areas, you'll end up in the Backrooms. The old moist carpet, the mono-yellow rooms and the hum-buzz of the fluorescent lights will be your only comfort in the endless purgatory you have found yourself in. Don't bother crying out for help. Nobody is left.

name: The Office
summary: The Office is a visual novel for adults only. In this game, you control a guy who just got a new job, but was late on his first day of work. His new boss is unhappy with this delay... The game is filled with sex scenes, humor, romance.

name: The Lion's Beak, or Six Ways to Not Make a Videogame
summary: A look at games unmade.

name: The Walker
summary: The Walker is a single-player survival horror game. Find out the truth behind what is happening while surviving the zombies. Feel the tension and fight your fear because they await you!

name: The Roots
summary: In this game you gonna explore Townique.

name: The Gramsby Summoning
summary: Peek out the door and see what's stirring. Made for Two-Minute-Horror Jam.

name: The Lion King Legeng
summary: The Lion King Legeng is an unlicensed port of The Lion King game for SNES and Sega Genesis, released by Waixing in February 1997.

name: The Lion King V: Timon & Pumbaa
summary: The Lion King V: Timon & Pumbaa is a game released on the Famicom by Dragon Co. as a sequel to their first ever release, The Lion King III: Timon & Pumbaa.

name: The Katydids Incident
summary: There is a big discussion going on about a mysterious group named The Katydids proposing riddles and challenges on online forums, Are you clever enough to unravel the mystery of this obscure organization?

name: The Wine Story
summary: Become one of the biggest wine company in the world with this breathtaking story of young entrepreneur with small dream which comes through.

name: The Minesweeper: Crew Bomber Expedition
summary: The classic minesweeper for Nintendo Switch. Train your brain, increase your skill and, at the same time, have fun with this challenging logic puzzle.

name: The Diabolical Trilogy
summary:
"The Diabolical Trilogy" is a collection of 3 challenging old-school games including;

- Xenon Valkyrie+: A roguelite platformer with RPG elements for hardcore gamers.
- Riddled Corpses EX: Frenetic arcade style twin-stick shooter. Fight your way through hordes of enemies alone or with a friend!
- Demon's Tier+: Dungeon-RPG roguelike with arcade and adventure elements. Enter the dungeons of King Thosgar and destroy his demonic minions!

name: THE Bass Fishing
summary: We've recreated rod and reel controls, the joy of fishing, with the Joy-Con! The realistic graphics make you feel like you're really there, letting you enjoy real bass fishing anytime, wherever you are! Don't worry if you're new to bass fishing, either!…

name: The Search for Fran 2
summary: Welcome to Sans Fran City. You are here to search for Fran, again. While searching, You can also talk with people and go on quests, collect glorbs, drive cars, fly a drone, crash cars, try a "challenge" and much more!

name: The Dead Sea Scrolls Adventure
summary: Play as Dr. Jerusalem Jones, an explorer set on finding out the history behind the 7 major Dead Sea Scrolls. Along the way, the player gets to meet a whole cast of characters and traverse across the deserts and caves near the Dead Sea and Bethlehem to learn about the history behind these relics.

name: The Lovely Estate
summary: Second-Person Analog Comedy Horror Mystery in which three crazy NPCs describe the bizarre actions of your crazier intruder. You're here to get someone. They're here to breathe until they can't anymore. Mind the fumes.

name: The Redress of Mira
summary: With a variety of gameplay mechanics, venture through Mira's fantasy world filled with atmosphere and adventure, and pursue her inner peace.

name: The Space-Eating Croc
summary:
The Space-Eating Croc is a mystery adventure game influenced by classic horror RPG Maker games. Inspect your surroundings to find clues, and solve puzzles to progress.

Explore the mysterious hotel by controlling a mysterious man and a suspicious hotelier. Face the dark truth hidden deep inside the metaphorical spaces within the hotel, and find the monster hidden in between the rifts of space.

name: The Tyrning Combat Challenge
summary: The player, Tal, has been issued a combat challenge. Participate in a one-on-one duel to the death in order to secure your team’s position in the Tyrning. Using artifacts secured during previous hunts, engage in melee combat with the opposing team’s champion. Made by four Drury University students.

name: The Jumping Fries
summary: Join BIG F on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!

name: The Bastonnes
summary: The Bastonnes is an action, strategy game taking place in a fictional atmosphere of the 20s. Play members of a family and fight against each other ! One goal, be the last at the table !

name: The Trials of Beadie
summary: The Trials Of Beadie is a 2D side scrolling platformer that relies on precision playing mechanics such as run, jump, wall jump, dash, fast fall, hover, and wall grab. Play for fun or speed run as fast as you can. You can die as many times as you like, but there are no save points and no continues.

name: The Abandoned Planet
summary: When a wormhole tears open in space, an astronaut is hurled down and crashes on a distant planet. But where is she? Where are all the inhabitants of the planet? And how is she going to get back home? Solve the puzzle and piece together the mystery in this 2D, pixel art, first person, point and click adventure.

name: The Rabbit's Scroll
summary: Play as a rabbit ascending up a paper scroll, scrambling to escape a rampaging wall of deadly ink. Can you ensure your beautiful world won't be erased from the history books?

name: The Sand Knight
summary: Kill your foes and power up your mech in this combat-heavy game of destruction and mayhem. Maneuver around the battlefield, avoiding enemy fire while dishing it out in kind.

name: The Witch Blade
summary: An exciting classic adventure in the world of dark fantasy with honed game mechanics, memorable enemies, and retro aesthetics.

name: The Questing
summary: The Questing is an action-RPG game set in the fantasy world. You can grow by hunting enemies using various weapons and skills that you like. Also, feel free to explore the wide world, discover new towns and cities, and take quests from NPCs around the world to solve them.

name: The Legend of the Soulforce: Heroes of the Abyss
summary: Heroes of the Abyss is an RPG featuring deep character customization and advanced combat mechanics. You will evolve in a universe plunged into the night by the god Asteros. Discover Asteros' dark motives and plans as you adventure through the abyss that has opened up in the world

name: The Last Starship
summary: Introversion Software, the indie legends behind Prison Architect, Darwinia, DEFCON and Uplink, present to you the broken, unfinished and bug filled Alpha of The Last Starship. Pick a ship hull, kit her out with engines, life-support, sensors and rail guns and start your galactic adventure!

name: The Gallery
summary: An art curator is held hostage by a portraitist who threatens to detonate a bomb unless their demands are met. 'The Gallery' contains two interactive narratives - set in 1981 (with a female protagonist) and 2021 (with a male protagonist).

name: The Chronicle
summary: After receiving a package in the mail, Detective Walter Miles is suddenly transported to a World War II Era newspaper building. Can you solve the mystery and escape?

name: The S.Sterling Co.
summary: This is a game about three cats living in one office.

name: The Dead Rooms
summary: The Dead Rooms is an immersive horror experience with Roguelike elements. Can you survive? Explore a never ending world of rooms, as you push further into the Dead Rooms, trying to find what supplies you can and avoiding the monsters that call this place home.

name: That Summer
summary: This world's most beautiful girl, visual noble. His fate is determined by his choice.

name: The Way of the Badass
summary: Join Scarlet, Princess of Badass, in her crusades against the takeover of aliens, monsters, hybrids, and "Cancel Culture" as she brings toughness back to humanity. Lead desperate allies, from a Nazi to a hobo and other Special Ed students, in liberating humankind from the satire of the Far Left.

name: The Swordbearer
summary: Take on the role of a young adventurer who recently inherited a sword. Your journey starts after you apply to the Knights Guild at the capital. Meet loveable characters as you explore this world that awaits you. Face the darkness that surfaces and uncover the evil plot as your story progresses.

name: The Wakers
summary: Great energies are stirring, now it's time to wake. Revive giant spirits in this playfully mystical puzzle odyssey.

name: Thnt
summary: You've woken up in an artificial body on a strange and hostile world. Can you uncover its secrets and fight your way out? Take part in a metal fueled FPS single-player campaign that combines frantic action with tactical decision-making.

name: Thrill Penguin
summary: crazy parkour game with No cycles, No texts, No complicated weird mechanics, Just have fun and get the thrill now !!

name: The Twilight Zone VR
summary: Where nothing is as it seems and everything feels possible.

name: The Jumping Fries: Turbo
summary: Join BIG F on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!

name: The Last of Us Part I
summary:
Experience the emotional storytelling and unforgettable characters of Joel and Ellie in The Last of Us, winner of over 200 Game of the Year awards and now rebuilt for PlayStation 5.

Enjoy a total overhaul of the original experience, faithfully reproduced but incorporating modernized gameplay, improved controls and expanded accessibility options. Plus, feel immersed with improved effects and enhanced exploration and combat.

It also includes the Left Behind story DLC.

name: The Curse of Grimsey Island
summary: Four separate cases spanning hundreds of years. Are they linked by a curse or something else entirely? The Curse of Grimsey Island is a futuristic detective game where you collect evidence, find motives, and solve one of the greatest mysteries in modern times.

name: The Plucky Squire
summary: Storybook characters discover a three-dimensional world outside the pages of their book and must jump between 2D & 3D realms to save their friends in this charming action-adventure.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - Expansion Disk
summary: A ROM hack/mod for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time which recreates the original design of its cancelled Expansion for the Nintendo 64DD, which was later cancelled and retooled as the Master Quest. It changes the dungeons, changing their layout and puzzles. It was based on the information found within the 2020 Gigaleak.

name: The Galactic Junkers
summary: Become the space captain you always wanted to be. There are just a few problems, your ship needs work, there’s a price on your head, and your crew are idiots. Seek your fortune and the truth in The Galactic Junkers, a comedic space combat adventure game.

name: The Preservation Project
summary: A Super Mario 64 ROM hack which aims to recreate the SpaceWorld 1995 demo of the game.

name: The Queen's Gambit Chess
summary: This game features lessons, puzzles, and matches that can be played against real opponents or AI characters based on individuals from the show. Take some lessons from Mr Shaibel, play matches against Borgov or compete against friends in this love letter to the show.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria
summary: The only survival crafting game set in the Fourth Age of Middle-earth, the iconic fantasy world created by J.R.R. Tolkien.

name: The Entropy Centre
summary: Think in reverse. Outsmart the impossible. A mind-bending first-person adventure where you solve ingenious and complex puzzles by rewinding objects through time.

name: The Lion King
summary: The Master System and Game Gear port of The Lion King.

name: The Last Case of Benedict Fox
summary: Take on the last case of Benedict Fox and dive into a twisted world of secret organizations, forbidden rituals, and cold-blooded murders. Explore the memories of deceased victims as you search for clues and fight demons in this fantastical Lovecraftian Metroidvania.

name: The Constructors
summary: Become the owner of a construction company and help rebuild Wondersville's crumbling urban landscape. Design new neighborhoods, hire contractors to execute your vision, and try to stay calm handling your clients. Will you play by the rules or cut corners to maximize your profits?

name: The Alters
summary: Explore an emotional sci-fi game with a unique blend of survival, adventure, and base-building elements. Help Jan Dolski, the sole survivor of an ill-fated space expedition, create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoils with this unconventional crew.

name: The House
summary:
In 1970, there was a house that belonged to a family of four. But inexplicably, the family were all found dead in what was declared a mass suicide. Since then, nobody had dared to enter the house in the fears that it may be haunted, not willing to risk the same mysterious death that the family did.

The player's goal is to enter the house and venture through the five rooms.

name: The Backrooms World
summary: The Backrooms World is a plane of existence where unlucky souls find themselves to be stuck in by noclipping from reality. This unique game is free to play for Single player or Multiplayer mode. Players can do exploration, survival, and unlock the mysterious levels in the backrooms. Goodluck!

name: The Mystery Cleaner
summary: Play the role of a janitor who specializes in "unusual" orders. Clean up the most iconic locations in the world and uncover their (dirty) secrets. Highly guarded facilities, unusual situations, all that mess to deal with... sounds like a challenge!

name: The Block
summary: The Block is the world's smallest city builder. Place randomly generated buildings on a square and watch your tiny city block come to life!

name: The Appraiser
summary: The Appraiser is a short, first person narrative game. As an art appraiser you will sell the art collection of a dying man. Each painting is by 4 famed artist. They have a story to tell you, but only if you choose to listen.

name: The Ecdysis
summary: The Ecdysis is a single player – third person episodic game that allows the player to live the life of Robin.jr, a professional photographer and takes you through the adventures and mysteries that he encounters on his journey.

name: The Lab: Escape Room
summary: Walk through a futuristic complex while solving puzzles and discover how you got there. What are this misterious creatures? Why everything looks abandoned? Could you escape from The Lab?

name: The Lawyer: Episode 1 - The White Bag
summary: The Lawyer - Episode 1: The White Bag is the first part of an episodic adventure game which combines gripping crime story with classic courtroom drama. Immerse yourself into a world set in early 90’s in which you gather (or fabricate!) evidence, deduct and run fierce courtroom battles.

name: The Looker
summary:
You wake up, alone, on a strangely familiar island full of puzzles that will frustrate and annoy you.

A parody of Jonathan Blow's The Witness.

name: The Hotel
summary: The Hotel is a psychological horror thriller in which the player will have to face the evil living within the walls of a lonely hotel. But more importantly, the player will have to decide what this evil is to him. Maybe the nature of this evil is deeper than it seems at first glance.

name: The Callisto Protocol: Day One Edition
summary:
Pre-purchase now to get the following digital content:
- Retro Prisoner Character & Weapons Skin

Survive to escape the horrors of Callisto and uncover the dark secrets of Jupiter's dead moon.

name: The Last Door: Legacy Edition
summary: ​Feel what it's really like to be alone in the dark in this multi-award-winning, lo-res 'point-and-click' horror-thriller adventure. Explore old mansions, run-down neighborhoods, and underground caves with only a flashlight and magnifying glass to guide you.

name: The Ancestral Trail
summary: An adventure game based on Frank Graves's fantasy partwork magazine series The Ancestral Trail. The game was released exclusively with the Italian version of the magazine, titled La Storia Ancestrale.

name: The Blight
summary: The Blight aims to evolve the open world survival with unprecedented levels of horror, strategy, and prediction, where knowledge and skills become the ultimate weapons for long-term survival.

name: The Lobster Game
summary: "The Lobster Game" is a roguelike pixel-art styled action shooter. Break through as many levels as you can, killing bandits to avenge brother death.

name: The Land of Alembrume
summary: The Land of Alembrume is a classic RPG. You will explore 50+ maps and interact with many people. Play through main quests and smaller side quests, to get bonus items and information. You can also find a couple of hidden valuables if you seek them out.

name: The Jumping Hot Dog
summary: Join BIG H on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!

name: The Callisto Protocol: Digital Deluxe Edition
summary:
Pre-purchase now to get the following digital content:
- Retro Prisoner Character & Weapons Skin
- Season Pass

Survive to escape the horrors of Callisto and uncover the dark secrets of Jupiter's dead moon.

name: The Spidy D
summary: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Catch moths with the main hero of the game The Spidy D and chatch all the moths in the world!

name: The Haunted Library
summary: Psychological horror game in VHS style. In which your goal is to record evidence of paranormal activity in your house. Find items, solve puzzles and record as mutch as you can.

name: The Unachievable Game
summary: The Unachievable Game will be the hardest game you will ever play in your life nobody can finish this game.

name: The Fishercat
summary: Catch fish if you can! Play as a cat who takes to the seas for one purpose: to dive into the waters and harpoon as many fish as possible while oxygen lasts. Earn coins and mechanical parts to upgrade your air tank, harpoons and boat to access new regions and bag more and more expensive fish. Now includes an aquarium mode and dreamscape levels where you can ride your air tank among the fish while catching them.

name: The Jumping Taco
summary: Join BIG T on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!

name: The Lilliput Workshop
summary: A sandbox logic puzzle game with a nostalgic temperament. You can experience the endless fun of designing automata here.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki II: Crimson Sin - Scenario Book Limited Edition
summary:
This edition includes the following:
- Game: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki II: Crimson Sin
- Original Soundtrack mini
- Trails Series Special Desktop Calendar 2022 to 2023
- Large Microfiber Cloth Map of Calvard Republic
- Downloadable Content BGM Set
- An Entire Scenario Book of "The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki"

name: The Tomorrow Children: Phoenix Edition
summary:
Return to the world of The Tomorrow Children in a brand new experience developed by Q-Games. Featuring new islands, new equipment and multiple new ways to play. Available for PlayStation 4 and with enhancements for PlayStation 5.

The Tomorrow Children: Phoenix Edition is a multiplayer co-operative action game that takes place within an alternate future. Following a failed experiment to unite the minds of all humanity, the return of civilisation now lies in the hands of Projection Clones; new life forms capable of venturing deep into the Void in search of preserved human survivors.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki II: Crimson Sin - Limited Edition
summary:
This edition includes the following:
- Game: The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki II: Crimson Sin
- Original Soundtrack mini
- Trails Series Special Desktop Calendar 2022 to 2023
- Large Microfiber Cloth Map of Calvard Republic
- Downloadable Content BGM Set

name: The Madman
summary: The Madman is an action roguelike, use the space capsule and go on an adventure! Destroy crowds of enemies! You can choose from a variety of weapons that will help in this difficult battle!

name: The Sims 4: Werewolves
summary: Howl the night away in The Sims 4 Werewolves Game Pack. Your Sims will transform, join packs, and run wild under the light of the full moon. Explore the world of Moonwood Mill and discover the secrets of the werewolves as you navigate your new lycanthrope life. Sims will unlock new skills, manage new temperaments, and maybe even meet their fated mates.

name: The Lord of the Tower
summary: Once upon a time, there lived an amiable folk in the small kingdom of Ukron, ruled by a responsive and fair king. But the hard times came to the kingdom. A dark army under the command of Pukin invaded the peaceful lands and enslaved all their populace, having deceived the people with a sweet honeycake. But not everyone submitted the invader. A brave volunteer corps gathered together and rebuffed the impure force. Help the soldiers build protective structures, defend your king and the whole kingdom of Ukron.

name: The Quest: Hero of Lukomorye IV
summary:
The Quest: Hero of Lukomorye IV is an expansion to The Quest, a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement and turn based combat.
After enabling the expansion, you can explore new areas and adventures. However, if you don't have The Quest, you can also play the expansion as a standalone game.
Grab your weapons and spells! The war is over but Kozney the Deathless refuses to give up his chance for the throne. While winter chokes Lukomorye in its icy grip, Kozney has summoned strong forces to defeat the Tzar's loyal army and navy. It's time to face the Deathless once again. This time it must be Death to the Deathless!
To access the new areas (not applicable if you are playing the expansion standalone), go to Mithria harbor and talk to captain Hanty, then select "Luko IV" as your travel destination. It's recommended you reach at least level 70 before taking on the challenges posed by this expansion.

name: The Quest Classic: Asteroids
summary:
The Quest Classic: Escape from Asteroids is an expansion to The Quest Classic, a beautifully hand-drawn, immersive and enchanting world full of exciting challenges.
After enabling the expansion, you can continue to play The Quest Classic with your existing character(s) to explore new areas and quests. However, if you don't have The Quest Classic, you can also play the expansion as a standalone game.
Your ship has run off course, Hero. You find yourself sucked into a black hole that warps you far away. The world you know so well is gone. It's as though there were a huge explosion. All around you the asteroids appear on fire. You feel great pain and pass out . You wake up in a strange room with an unearthly creature looking down on you.

name: The Duck Song Game
summary: Your favorite duck now goes flappy. See how long you can last. Fly him past the lemonade stands for the entire song and earn your reward.

name: The Idolmaster Heardle
summary:
A clone of Heardle, and K-Pop Heardle but for THE IDOLM@STER songs.

Each IM@S Heardle is randomly chosen from THE IDOLM@STER's discography.

name: The Fairyland Story
summary: An NES/Famicom prototype of arcade game The Fairyland Story. It was never released.

name: The Most Desperate Angel
summary:
An angel meets a woman on earth. There is trouble in heaven.

A visual novel with platformer elements.

name: The Original Wizard
summary: The game is a Dungeon Crawler, where the player must survive the succeeding dungeons and defeat Impeficus on his throne.

name: The Horace Trilogy
summary: In the early 1980s, the Horace games were some of the most beloved on the ZX Spectrum. Now, take on the maze navigating of Hungry Horace, the slope slaloming of Horace Goes Skiing, and the challenging platforming of Horace and the Spiders in this compilation.

name: The Western Rooms
summary: Will you beat the Rooms? None of them will be easy. Challenge your mind with 3 Escape Room Scenarios! Look for clues, and keep your eyes wide open! Explore an old Western Town Find the Bartender's Recipe Break in the Bank's Vault & Escape the Sheriff's Department

name: The Wizard's Apprentice
summary: A trading game for Playdate

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Revontuli Coast
summary: Explore a sprawling archipelago that teems with life. Hunt waterfowl, ducks, and upland birds, in addition to larger game such as Brown Bear and Whitetail Deer. Gaze at the magical Northern Lights, and discover exciting new hunting opportunities in this region of the "land of a thousand lakes".

name: The Flintstones
summary: A second The Flintstones Tiger game, based on the movie adaptation.

name: The Rocketeer
summary: Based on the homonymous movie.

name: The Cryptographer
summary: The Cryptographer is an indie game about decoding famous phrases, book quotes and more.

name: The Gigglebone Gang: The AlphaBonk Farm
The Holoween collection
summary:
The Holoween collection is a set of 3 games featuring HoloMyth's halloween costumes from the Holoween stream!
Play as Amelia Watson, Gawr Gura and Ninomae Ina'nis in their cute outfits!

Pumpkin Party, Ame's game, is a first-person shooter where you fight hordes of pumpkin creatures!
Pick your powerups wisely, as the pumpkin mutations will make your life hard!

Dr. Ninomae's evil laboratory of dangerous experimentations is a puzzle game where you use MATHS to help Ina transform Takodachis into perfect creatures!

Gawrzilla attacks lets you wreak havoc in a city as the most adorable kaiju ever, Gura!
Destroy skyscrapers and dodge nukes to score millions of points!

name: The Faces of Evil Remastered
summary: A fan remaster of The Link: The Faces of Evil, an official Zelda game for the Phillips CD-i, changing some features of the original game in order to improve playability.

name: The Wand of Gamelon Remastered
summary: A fan remaster of Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon, an official Zelda game for the Phillips CD-i, changing some features of the original game in order to improve playability.

name: The Ant Bully
summary:
Based on the animated movie, The Ant Bully puts you in the role of Lucas, a 10-year old boy who passes his time by tormenting an ant hill. Before he knows it, the ants use a magic potion to shrink him down to their size. Then they put him to work for the colony, giving him a fresh perspective on life.

The game is played from a 3D third-person perspective. Most actions are context-sensitive, performed with the press of one button, e.g. Lucas automatically jumps when running off a ledge. You play various missions, and receive medals upon their completion. These medals are worth varying amounts, depending on how well you played: gold is 50 points, silver is 30 points, and bronze is 10. You use these medals to unlock special abilities every time you reach 300 points. The missions mostly involve fighting enemies and collecting items scattered in the game world.

name: The Kings of the Dark Age
Theater of Death
summary: Wander through dark corridors, look into abandoned editing rooms, penetrate dusty archives and uncover the secrets of the movie studio and its employees. Collect puzzle pieces: Study notes, letters, photos, listen to audio recordings to understand what happened on the set of the cursed movie.

name: The Adventures of Busy Billy
summary: The Adventures of Busy Billy is a puzzle game aimed at children between 3 and 8. Players choose between two mechanically identical scenarios after starting the game: Busy Billy Wonderland and Busy Billy Fantasy.

name: The Adventures of Peter Rabbit & Benjamin Bunny
The Adventures of Pinocchio
summary: This is an interactive movie game based on the 1996 live action movie by the same name. After Pinocchio realizes his dream of becoming a real boy, the evil Lorenzini kidnaps him and turns him back into a puppet. You must help Pinocchio's creator, Geppetto, find and rescue him. You'll go through Pinocchio's home town, row a boat through monster-infested waters and visit Terra Magica, the fair where Lorenzini turns boys into donkeys. To succeed, you'll have to dodge deadly traps, solve puzzles and outwit Lorenzini's conniving henchmen. Sometimes, you'll have to turn yourself into a puppet, a fish, a bird or even a donkey to rescue Pinocchio. Along the way you must collect six passwords, each reflecting a lesson in morality that Pinocchio learns.

name: The Adventures of Pinocchio: Activity Center
Through Time
summary: Through Time is a single-player platform game in which you have to pass levels. The more levels you go, the more difficulty increases. Every month there is a new season with a new theme that is illustrated through the levels. You can unlock new characters and play with them, there are also temporary events in which you can unlock a lot of rewards.

name: The Mystery of the Mary Celeste
summary:
The Mystery of the Mary Celeste is a hidden object game with adventure elements. The objective is to collect all the items shown at the bottom, as a series of black-and-white images on porthole windows, and use them to solve puzzles. Some portions of the scenery bring up a close-up window showing another angle of the scene, usually containing some of the required objects. Clicking on certain objects and characters opens up a number of connected containers around them, and the player has to drag and drop the collected tools from the inventory portholes to these blue circles, to complete the scene and move to the next one.

Mini-games usually appear at the end of each chapter, presenting various challenges and puzzles. A pipeline has to be reassembled with scattered pieces, lengths of rope must be untangled by dragging a series of pulleys, wires have to be connected to complete a circuit, red pins have to be fixed to a nautical map following a list of coordinates and a radio has to be tuned to the correct sound waves. The games can be skipped at any time.

name: The Table of N
summary:
A blessed meal is an ingredient to a happy life.

Those who feed on humans, the Neversistas, have lived a life
close to an eternity.
They shoulder a melancholic feeling as they circle around the
dull dining table for yet another time.
However, they cannot stop feeding themselves.

The people fear the unknown Neversistas.
They victimise, hurt, and cast doubt on each other.
However, they cannot stop from being suspicious of others.

Even in this town, a widespread rumour about monsters that
terrorise people has initiated a "Neversista hunt" to
exterminate those that slipped into town.
The endless and repetitive mealtimes, suspicion, and love...

Will they be able to obtain a closure?

name: The Multipath Adventures of Superman: Menace of Metallo
The Isle of four Winds: Rune War
summary: The Isle of the Four Winds: Rune War combines traditional Asian Mahjong with strategic territorial conquest in a fantasy world. Players alternate between five-minute Mahjong rounds and tactical Rune War phases. During Mahjong sessions, players compete against up to three opponents to form tile combinations that unlock magical spells, summon creatures, and provide strategic advantages. These earned benefits transfer to the Rune War phase, where players deploy them to capture territories on a fantasy map. Performance in the tile-matching segments directly determines available resources and abilities during territorial battles, creating an interconnected gameplay loop between puzzle-solving and strategic warfare.

name: The Great Tree
summary: The Great Tree is a building game where you choose how to grow each branch of your tree, maintain enough resources to continue growing and reach higher and higher.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Treason of Isengard
summary: The Lord of the Rings: The Treason of Isengard was a third-person action-adventure video game for PlayStation 2, Windows, and Xbox. It was the sequel of The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring and like its predecessor was based on the books. It was to be released by Vivendi Universal in late 2003 but was cancelled in September 2003 due to failing the standards Vivendi had set for their games.

name: The Jumping Hot Dog: Turbo
