summary: MECC released a DOS version of The Oregon Trail that was essentially identical to the Apple II version. However, the graphics had to be redrawn for the DOS version, using a different color palette and a slightly different resolution – and therefore screen shots of the DOS version are slightly different than the corresponding Apple II screen shots.

name: The Fish
summary: Dive down and see what lies beneath the surface. Discover a vast underwater world as different fishes. The game does not offer any real "Game Play" but is more of a simulation.

name: The Rage of Valhalla
summary: All the rage of Valhalla descended from heaven to prevent the coming of hell to earth With The help Of Ivdrasil you will visit Helheim, Vanaheim, Jotunheim, Niflheim,and also midgard which is captured by the troops of hell and is on fire

name: The Gallagher Case
summary: One night in 1982 a teenager comes home from school. He receives a call from Mrs Gallagher, his neighbour, an invalid woman with Alzheimer's disease. She can't turn on the TV, she's not very good with technology, so she convinces the young man to help her with the television, not knowing that he was about to live the worst experience of his life.

name: The Untouchables
summary: Take on the mob! The ultimate six exciting action sequences put you in control of Elliot Ness's elite squad of crime-busters. Alleyway shootouts, the Border Raid, the Railway Station confrontation and Warehouse bust, culminating in the thrilling denouement of a rooftop duel as you re-live the knife-edge existence of Ness in his stuggle against the retribution of Capone! The Untouchables - live an American legend!

name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Islands
summary: A Link to the Islands is a Wind Waker-inspired hack of A Link to the Past. It was originally called Lyra Islands and developed by SePH in 2004-2005, but it wasn’t finished. In 2015, the Lyra Islands project was once again restarted with the goal of finishing the game one day. New overworlds and dungeons were made, and the original LTTP graphics were restored. The project was eventually renamed A Link to the Islands.

name: The Last Matches
summary:
Who would buy matches on Christmas Eve? On a cold, snowy Christmas Eve, the girl strikes her first match in the darkness, illuminating memories she’d since buried deep. Will the last matches give her the strength to keep going?

Inspired by the tragic fairy tale by Hans Christian Andersen, together we bring you an alternate story of a maybe happier ending and a happier life for the little match girl.

name: The Backrooms Footage
summary: You have found a camera with a footage in it. For some reason you can't rewind the video, and as soon as you try winding it forward you find yourself in the Backrooms. Figure out whats in the footage and try to ESCAPE AS FAST AS POSSIBLE!

name: They Came From Dimension X
summary: A sci-fi horror first person shooter where gravity is only as consistent as the ground your boots are stepping upon. Navigate labyrinthine research stations, strange alien planets and escheresque eldritch tombs while surviving your maddened colleagues, monstrous entities, and worse.

name: The Same World 2
summary:
This is the call from another world.
The guidelines of the fate.
You will walk in one and one time node,
face with the choice of life and death.
Continuation of exquisite picture.
Brand-new gameplay,
Whisper slowly and walk, find the new world,
Silently feeling,

name: The Top
summary: The Top is a simple precision platformer about climbing a mountain.

name: The Nameless
summary: A classic survival horror game with themes that are loosely based on the works of H.P. Lovecraft.

name: This Thing of Ours
summary: Welcome to New Temperance, known as the last frontier for the Italian-American mafia. The two controlling La Cosa Nostra families are locked in a peaceful rivalry for the city's rackets. You play as a young hood named Vinny that's in a neighborhood-based crew known as The Beacon Hill Crew.

name: The Madness of Death
summary: The Madness of Death is a first person psychological horror game. Explore the house in order to escape from it and break the curse of the Death Stone. You will have to solve the puzzles in order to advance and try not to stay in the dark.

name: The Ghosts Race
summary: This is a Phasmophobia-like horror game in which you, as a rookie trapper, infiltrate a black market "ghost race" to find out what spirits are.

name: The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos - Back to the Futon
summary: Once again, your favourite party of unlikely heroes are in a bit of a pickle: arrested by the Dungeon's Fund, they have to accomplish a dangerous mission to earn back their freedom.

name: The Forest of Drizzling Rain
summary: Alas, it was the "promised place," where Shiori was never meant to go. Finally, a remake of The Forest of Drizzling Rain, that masterpiece of an exploration horror game with multiple endings from the creator of the big hit Angels of Death!

name: The Darkest Files
summary: The Darkest Files is a historical investigation and courtroom game based on true crimes of the Nazi era. Investigate cold cases, search for clues, interrogate witnesses, immerse the crimes and defend your case in court to bring the perpetrators to justice.

name: The Proponent
summary: What if the city is a living being with its own essence? The Proponent is a first-person horror where you take on the role of a man trapped in a high-rise building and try to find a way out.

name: The Hideaway
summary: The Hideaway is an exploration and discovery low-poly game with Hardcore survival mechanics. Lost and wandering in the wilderness without food, water and weapons, your objective will be to survive and contact an aid center as soon as possible without harming your environnement in any way

name: The Ramsey
summary: The Ramsey is a 2D exploration platform game that solves puzzles using various weapons by controlling cute squirrel characters. Explore the maze of islands and defeat the villains who threaten the peace of the planet.

name: The Last Medic
summary: The Last Medic is a 2D precision platformer set in space. Earth was hit by an asteroid and you are the last surviving medic. Your space suit is equipped with a jetpack, a dash booster, and a healing device. Use these tools as you travel from planet to planet on your way to save Earth.

name: The Book of Aaru
summary: Seek ultimate Egyptian god power and reveal it’s mystery. Fight demons in precision & rhythm based combat, while crawling trough living and everchanging dungeon of Aaru. Experience true rogue-like game with no compromise.

name: The Resurrection of Amelia: Across Two Worlds
summary: One night, Amelia was involved in a dispute, died in a car accident, and then strangely resurrected. Amelia woke up and found herself in a strange place. She needed to escape here as soon as possible.

name: The Necro-Nom-icon
summary: Follow the recipe-like instructions of the Necro-Nom-icon and perform rituals to make contact with the Ancient Ones. Will it provide the answers you have been looking for? A reason for those odd dreams? Or will you succumb to madness first?

name: The Finals
summary: The Finals is the world’s first Dynamism Shooter, a free-to-play, fast-paced, physics-driven, first-person shooter set on the stage of the biggest Gameshow of the future! Fight for Fans and fortune in fully-destructible, virtual Arenas that guarantee no two rounds will ever play the same!

name: The Great War: Western Front
summary: The Great War: Western Front is the definitive WW1 strategy game. Play a deciding role in history with this real-time tactical experience as you take charge in the iconic Western Front from 1914 to 1919. Pick your faction and lead your forces to victory.

name: The Making of a Prophet
summary: A sequel to the controversial title "The You Testament", made by the same developer. Travel back in time to ancient Arabia during the "Days Of Ignorance" and shadow the Prophet Muhammad as he struggles to enlighten his pagan contemporaries. Having been granted a glimpse of the true nature of reality, he beholds mankind to have gone astray and seeks to reunite them with their creator. Follow in his footsteps across 20 unique locations and become his most trusted companion as his destiny gradually unfolds. It doesn't promise to be easy, however, as a disbelieving public and an oppressive Quraysh regime seek to stifle his fledgling movement.

name: The Arm Wrestling Classic
summary: You are Barry Biceps. Train your arm to get stronger. Arm Wrestle through the champions of the world and collect your prize money. Take on challengers in the backyard, the parking garage, the bar, the school gym, and the arena. Use the password system to pickup where you left off or to enter secret codes. Go solo with 1 player story mode or invite a friend for 2 player versus.

name: The C64 Collection 1
summary:
THEC64 Collection 1 cartridge for Evercade brings the golden age of '80s home computer games back for another round. Take on the world in thrilling sport action with Summer Games and Winter Games, indulge in some perilous platforming in Jumpman and take on the role of a martial arts master in Lee. Then "stay a while, stay forever" with Impossible Mission and a great selection of other big hits and deep cuts from THEC64's extensive back catalogue!

Cartridge contains the following 14 games:
- Summer Games
- Winter Games
- Impossible Mission
- Jumpman
- Lee
- Gateway to Apshai
- The Movie Monster Game
- Marauder
- Stormlord
- Subterranea
- Iridis Alpha
- Battle Valley
- Alleykat
- Street Sports Baseball

name: The Viking's Games: Madness Fight
summary: Enjoy this game with friends! Invite them to a game and prove who will be the king of The Viking's Games: Madness Fight.

name: The Jumping Coffee
summary:
Join BIG C on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!
Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Sacred Geography of Kazakhstan
summary: Kazakhstan's Sacred Symbols & Geography games make it fun to learn about Kazakhstan's long history, rich and vibrant culture, and beautiful geography.

name: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia
summary: The Last Hero of Nostalgaia is a satirical action-adventure, brought to life by a twisted and wicked tale. Featuring hard but fair combat, *full character customization, unique battle armor and engaging narrative mechanics rich in lore, Nostalgaia plunges you into almost certain death at every turn.

name: The Lost Vikings
summary:
The PC port lacks second player to play the other vikings, backgrounds are pure black, the HUD is put at the bottom of the screen.

In 2014 the game was added to Battle.net as a free download emulated through DOSBox.

name: The Kwanstone Project
summary: Join the colorful & lively agents of LUANG SENGKEO as they free the mighty guardian spirits known as the KWAN from centuries of imprisonment, solve the mysteries of the destructive VOLENAUTS & save what remains of this magical land; inspired by the lush & majestic culture and people of LAOS.

name: The Tavern Online.
summary:
The Tavern Online, is an "old-school" MMORPG that brings together the best mechanics and elements of other games.
The game takes place on the continent called Pandora and with the awakening of the monsters that once lay dormant, you'll need to find out what's going on!
Do you have the courage to break through and unravel these mysteries?

name: The Lost Vikings
summary: The Amiga and Amiga CD 32 port has a tiny bit different music, lacks second player to control other vikings, black backgrounds, and has wider screen compared to the Super Nintendo original.

name: The Last Star
summary: Mythical beings, an eternal night, and a fairytale that seems to tie it all together.

name: Thatcher's Techbase: Arcade Edition
summary: An arcade version of Thatcher's Techbase created for the Living Rent organisation, debuting at Liverpool's The World Transformed Festival in 2022. This new version of Thatcher's Techbase runs on arcade hardware and has redesigned gameplay, along with a new storyline, fast-paced maps and a scoring system.

name: The Jumping Coffee: Turbo
summary:
Join BIG C on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!
Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Last Alchemist
summary: The Last Alchemist is a third-person alchemy simulation game about the blazing pursuit of science and friendship.

name: The Citizen Part II
summary:
Set in and around City 17, "The Citizen Part Two" contains the next three chapters of our citizen's story.

After the events of the previous two chapters, you find yourself rescued from the grave by rebels, among whom you are now a valuable asset. Taken to a makeshift field hospital, you recover in the hands of rebel medics. But the Combine are determined to crush the rebels out of existence, and the peace can't last long. You will face choices, and how you decide to proceed will ultimately dictate how the story plays out for you. Some choices are less obvious than others, and require you to take initiative where you otherwise might be distracted. One way or another, it's time to take back the city.

Part Two was originally going to be much longer, but was split in half during development. The first half was released as the current Part Two. Later in 2014, Part 2 and 3 were merged into a single part after the final release, and the ending was retconned.

name: The Sprucecape Mod
summary: The Sprucecape Mod is a modification for Half-Life 2 Episode 2, featuring elements of classical Half-Life 2 action, exploration, horror and puzzles. In this single-player experience you step in the shoes of John Sprucecape, who is set on a dangerous quest to find his escaping family. The road to them is all but easy and John has to fight and solve his way trough the hazardous environments of Alaska. This mod has updated the original map pack with some new textures, models, locations and combat for a new refreshing experience.

name: Thunder in Paradise
summary: Thunder in Paradise was an unreleased game based on the TV series featuring Hulk Hogan. It was in development by Software Toolworks.

name: The Game Formerly Known as Hidden Nazi Mode
summary: The Game Formerly Known as Hidden Nazi Mode was, in fact, formerly known as Hidden Nazi Mode. As such it was a failed experiment, detailed in the accompanying essay. In this release the Nazi mode has been removed, and what remains is, as the subtitle says, "a cute game for unattended young children". It involves bunnies and lots of hints.

name: The Midnight Dance
summary:
Prince Everett has been sickly ever since he was young. Out of fear for his life, his parents, the King and Queen, forced him to stay in his room. On the night of the biggest seasonal event, he is laying in bed wishing to dance the night away like others in his class.

As if an answer to his prayers, a stranger appears on his balcony injured and asking to be let inside. But without knowing his intentions, what can Everett expect of him?

This Victorian-era Visual Novel revolves around our main protagonist: Prince Everett. On a night like any other, he expects to retire to bed and sleep through a once-in-a-lifetime event. But during the night, he wakes up to the sound of something rapping against his balcony glass. When he investigates the noise, he finds a tall man with an injured shoulder asking to be let in for refuge.

name: The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection
summary: The Zachtronics Solitaire Collection is here! Inside you will find all seven Zachtronics solitaire games, updated with new 4K graphics, plus one brand new Tarot-themed solitaire variant only available here.

name: The Anointed: David Saves Keilah
summary: The Anointed: David Saves Keilah is a single player, 3rd person action/adventure game. As David, the player can run, climb, scale walls, swing from ropes and ride a horse on the journey through ancient Judah - using Stealth, Combat and Strategy to fulfill God's plan and save the people of Keilah from the Philistines.

name: The Other Side
summary: "The Other Side" is a puzzle horror game, where you secretly drill through a reinforced metal wall using a janky drill. You have to repair and maintain the drill throughout the process, using tools and other pieces of equipment to pinpoint and fix the issues that occur. Before you finally break through the wall.

name: The Last of Us Part I: Firefly Edition
summary:
The Last of Us Part I: Firefly Edition was made only available to buy as an exclusive directly from the PlayStation Direct online store.

Experience the emotional storytelling and unforgettable characters of Joel and Ellie in The Last of Us, winner of over 200 Game of the Year awards and now rebuilt for PlayStation5.

Enjoy a total overhaul of the original experience, faithfully reproduced but incorporating modernized gameplay, improved controls and expanded accessibility options. Plus, feel immersed with improved effects and enhanced exploration and combat.

The Last of Us Part I Firefly Edition includes the complete The Last of Us single-player story (PS5) and celebrated prequel chapter, Left Behind; limited edition SteelBook display case; The Last of Us: American Dreams #1 - #4 comics reprint with new cover art; and early in-game unlocks.

name: The Ouroboros King
summary: The Ouroboros King combines the strategic tactical depth of chess with the build variety and replayability of roguelikes. Build a formidable army, discover powerful relics, and buy surprising gadgets to defeat the three evil witches.

name: The Penguin P
summary: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat fish with the main hero of the game The Penguin P and eat all the fish in the world!

name: The Jig Is Up!
summary: From the fans that brought you Is Lupin Still Flirting, comes another tale of master thief Lupin the Third, as he sets his sights on cool gunman Jigen Daisuke. Keep social stats balanced as you help Lupin win over Jigen’s trust, without getting Jigen fed up with Lupin's constant BS.

name: The Demon Lord is Mine!
summary: A indie visual novel on Itch.

name: The Now We've Named
summary: For all your coffee shop needs: a little story about making terrible coffee and having awkward conversations with strangers.

name: The Mushroom Season
summary:
Originally made for Indiepocalypse x kuš! collaboration!

become a hermit who lives in the woods
collect weird mushrooms
talk to critters of the forest
enjoy nature

name: That Hole-in-the-Wall Place
summary: A (semi)autobiographical game with only one aim: to make you hungry.

name: The Tennis Master
summary: The protagonist of this adult visual novel is a disgraced former tennis champion. The former champion is hired by a mysterious businessman to coach his daughter Sofia.

name: The Rest of Our Lives
summary: An erotic kinetic novel(a visual novel with no choices) inspired by Pride and Prejudice.

name: The Jumping Lasagne
summary: Join BIG L on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Jumping Lasagne: Turbo
summary: Join BIG L on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Vampires
summary: Your attention is invited to an exciting logical game about vampires, which will force you to make a lot of effort to pass difficult levels. Solve difficult puzzles to get to your destination, this may not be so easy as it seems at first glance, as you must go through many levels and infect the vampirism of all!

name: The Imaginary Circle
summary: The Imaginary Circle is a narrative experience, lasting about an hour and a half, in which you must find your way around an abandoned prison. Rummage through the documents, force open doors, call former employees, craft tools, but overall ask yourself: Should I use my only bullet now?

name: The Ourboros King
summary: The Ouroboros King combines the strategic tactical depth of chess with the build variety and replayability of roguelikes. Build a formidable army, discover powerful relics, and buy surprising gadgets to defeat the three evil witches.

name: The Hunt for the Chocolate Egg
summary:
A short Easter-themed hack.

Mario wants to eat his chocolate egg, but Larry stole it! Now Mario has to collect 15 eggs in order to be able to defeat Larry!

name: They Seem to Be Very Good Friends
summary: Puzzle game created for the online exhibition "This game is romantic, dangerous and intense".

name: THEC64 Mini
summary: THEC64Mini (or THEC64 MINI) is an updated version of the Commodore 64 home computer, manufactured by Retro Games Ltd. and distributed by Koch Media. It is based on an ARM CPU A20 SoC and Linux operating system running the VICE emulator. It connects via HDMI to any ordinary home TV. It comes supplied with 64 classic C64 games, such as Uridium, Paradroid, Hawkeye, Nebulus, and Monty Mole.

name: The Sims 4: First Fits Kit
summary: Dress the next generation of trendsetters in fashion fit for a playdate with The Sims 4 First Fits Kit. Whether a child Sim wants to turn heads on the first day of school or run around having fun with friends, these versatile styles will keep them looking fashionable (and SO cute).

name: The Songbird Guild
summary: The Songbird Guild is a Yuri RPG/Visual Novel hybrid about magical girls falling in love. Investigate the secrets of a corrupt fantasy world and fight creepy (yet somehow adorable?) monsters in turn-based battles, all to pay the bills in this world where being a magical girl is a regular 9-5 job.

name: The Suits Have Gone Mad!
summary: The Suits Have Gone Mad! is a brand-new episodic series where you unravel the mysteries behind the monopoly of Blake & Whitley Innovations and bring color into the world.

name: TheTravelGame
summary: A few minutes per play. Your questions will change the world.... A quiz horror game with multiple endings.

name: The Twilight of Infinity: Episode 4 - Therefore I Am
summary: "If only I'd paid attention in French class" was something Alex could only say in English, which is not helpful when in 16th century France trying to help victims of the Black Death..

name: This Girl Does Not Exist
summary: This Girl Does Not Exist is the first game of its kind. It is a game full of beautiful girls .. all of whom have been generated by a creative AI! Dive into this vibrant colorful puzzle game and discover unique personality of each girl as you unlock their beautiful pictures.

name: The Wave of Monké
summary: The Wave of Monké is an action-comedy RPG set in the internetwork of the multiverse. Explore the journey of a gorilla wanting to be more... evolved.

name: The Wassie Games
summary: Do you have what it takes to survive the wassie games? This is the ultimate test of a wassie's skill and determination! There can be only one winner, so only the bravest wassies should choose to compete in this multi-level Battle Royale.

name: The Unexplained
summary: The Unexplained is a paranormal/psychological horror game where you and up to 6 people can go to various locations to discover and find the deep dark hidden secrets! But beware of the spirits left behind as we don't know if they are friendly.

name: The Underground Man 2
summary: We at MEHSOFT are proud to present a sequel to our very first game The Underground Man. This game is a pleasure for the fans of classic video games. Experience a mix of different genres such as beat 'em up, point-and-click, platformer, and many more in a thrilling post-apocalyptic adventure.

name: The Pizza Courier
summary: Our mission is to make people happy, eating the best pizza in town, as it is taken out of the oven. Do you think you are ready for such challenges?

name: The Peak Climb VR
summary: Peak Climb VR will bring you an action-packed full-time professional climbing experience and give you exciting moments. While every part of this experience will entertain you, it will also provide you with a tiring calorie burn and game music will provide you with spiritual therapy.

name: The Original Island
summary: The Original IslandIs an open world island survival RPG independently developed by Lanmeng technology. From the main perspective of the victim, Lin Yunfeng, it depicts a beautiful and dangerous, magnificent and mysterious island, and tries to solve its secrets.

name: The Longest Walk
summary: The Longest Walk is a deeply personal biographical documentary walking simulator game about my father's experience of living with depression and suicidal thoughts.

name: The Lightkeeper
summary: The magnetism of a cursed island in the middle of the ocean. Loneliness and fear in its pure state. The Lightkeeper is a first-person game where you will delve into the most unfathomable mysteries of the human being without neglecting your main mission: to keep the lighthouse lit.

name: The Legend of Capa Negra
summary: The Legend of Capa Negra is a souls-like Action-RPG set in a medieval, dark fantasy world. As a new member of the Rebel Faction, your first mission will be to travel to a small village to meet a contact, find your way through dangerous landscapes, and join the war against the King!

name: The King's Castle
summary: The castle is in danger.! Enemies from neighboring kingdoms are approaching. Take everything under control, because there is no one left. Everyone relies only on you.

name: The Impossible Knight Runner
summary: The Impossible Knight Runner is an intense hack-and-slash platformer full of creatures trying to put an end to your adventure. Enter the dungeon with courage and decisiveness as the slightest misstake will be your downfall.

name: The Hunted
summary: Horror based and survial strategy game

name: The Hard Game
summary: Can you beat these five HARD levels? Who knows, you may just get some "lovely rewards" for your efforts!

name: The Grizzled: Armistice Digital
summary: In The Grizzled: Armistice Digital, players take on the role of soldiers facing the Trials and Hard Knocks of the first World War. They work cooperatively across a campaign where they confront the major events of the war. From the introduction scenario of Boot Camp, through the nine different Missions, everything that happens carries forward and affects the next steps of the game. Players will need to make good decisions and support each other if they hope to make it to the end of the war alive.

name: The First Step
summary: Explore 2 levels, and collect all the required items. The levels are timed, so you can try to beat the levels as fast as possible. Or you can casually take your time and explore around. This project is only meant as a learning project for me. So please do not expect a complete game.

name: The Stick and the Basket
summary: A short and contemplative promenade inspired by Ursula K. Le Guin's Carrier Bag Theory of Fiction

name: The Wall Mustn't Fall
summary: You will select a hero with unique abilities. As you defend your castle, you will earn money and loot. This will allow you to upgrade your castle and recruit ai controlled allies to synergize with and equip them with weapons and relics. You may also choose to allow the ai to control your hero.

name: The Birthday
summary: This is a non-typical RPG game. Most of the elements of an RPG are not including in this game except controlling the protagonist, some triggered events, and items. The game purpose is searching and collecting enough candles in finite time. Sometimes you have to think in this game.

name: The Burrito Quest
summary: Someone stole your burrito. You have to find it. What are you waiting for?

name: The Chronicles: Wasteland Assault
summary: The wastes of Dubai have been overwhelmed by Screamers. Play and evolve the iconic characters from the hit novel; The Chronicles: Wasteland and take back the dead lands. Survive against the horror and use whatever it takes to last long enough to build sanctions, unlock characters and items.

name: The City Cards Challenge
summary: Relax with this challenge by building your city and placing the cards buildings with different effects in an optimal way for the residents.

name: The Entity Code
summary: The Entity Code is a sci-fi themed 2D puzzle game with simple but challenging mechanics.

name: The Fairy's Secret
summary: In the sequel to the fantasy yuri visual novel, The Fairy's Song, Marnie and Lisbeth return to Fenchapel to visit Marnie’s grandmother. Things soon become complicated, however, when they run into two figures from the past who ought to be dead.

name: The Lost Delinquents of Rollings High
summary: "The Lost Delinquents of Rollings High" A visual novel, choose your own adventure game, with an 80s anime inspired look and feel.

name: The Big Comfy Couch
summary: The Big Comfy Couch is a cancelled game for the Xbox.

name: The Cabin: Summer Vacation | Episode 1
summary: When your summer plans take a sharp detour, and you find yourself out in the middle of the wood, you'll soon learn this will be summer you'll never forget. Filled with adventure, love, fear and danger; your choices could be the difference between life and death out here, at The Cabin.

name: Theme Hospital
summary: The PlayStation port of Theme Hospital has a a different menu system to accomodate the controller, and a slightly different graphical presentation of the HUD.

name: The Story of a World
summary: The Story of a World is an experience. There are things to discover and to unlock, and the primary point of this app is to create a meditative experience. You will have to be willing to let your mind relax, to think, to create your own understanding of what is happening if you are going to enjoy it.

name: The Salatroisk Incident
summary: 'The Salatroitsk Incident' is a short PSX-style horror game set in a fictional Russian city after a nuclear incident.

name: The Final Battle: Adventure
summary: The Final Battle is a funny point and click adventure game. The plot is happening at the age of the knights kingdom. Your character is a guy which wakes up lost in a prison cell with amnesia. He doesn’t even know who he is! Your task is to escape from the prison go to the city and find out the entire mystery behind your capture. And of course try to stay alive...

name: The Settlers: New Allies - Deluxe Edition
summary: Upgrade your game experience with the Deluxe Edition including the game, the Deluxe Pack and additional digital content.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Starter Edition
summary:
The Starter Edition includes the base game and an Explorer's Guide.

Forget everything you know about The Legend of Zelda games. Step into a world of discovery, exploration, and adventure in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, a boundary-breaking new game in the acclaimed series. Travel across vast fields, through forests, and to mountain peaks as you discover what has become of the kingdom of Hyrule in this stunning Open-Air Adventure. Now on Nintendo Switch, your journey is freer and more open than ever. Take your system anywhere, and adventure as Link any way you like.

name: The Five Steps to Ensuring Momo Graduates Successfully!!!
summary:
As a magical girl, it is your duty to fight against the forces of evil and save the planet!!!
Now, you're being faced by your most daunting task yet... Ensuring a high schooler graduates.

name: The Impossible Bottle
summary: Housework is only as dull as your imagination. Join Emma, six years old, on a playful adventure of peculiar proportions.

name: The Moonlit Tower
summary:
No, not a prison, though stone stands around you, as expressionless as a mirror awaiting face and form; and in the silence you hear no plaint of flute or roar of gong, but instead the crash of porcelain shattering.

A work of interactive fiction by Yoon Ha Lee.

name: The Magpie Takes the Train
summary: A millionaire guards a fabulous ruby in her private train car. Countless thieves have failed to steal it. But they weren't the Magpie!

name: The Football A
summary: Throw the ball to become the best American football player in the world.

name: The Jumping Ice Cream
summary: Join Big I on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The End is Nahual: If I May Say So
summary: A surreal puzzle game, where everything that we put into the game is possible. Push yourself through puzzles, fights, dialogue boxes, and an inventory. Use your will, wits, and English reading ability, You can do it!

name: The Great Forever Tomorrow
summary: The Great Forever Tomorrow is a surrealist adventure through an AI's mind.

name: Thelos
summary: Your main ability is to place two crystals on a viable surface and pull towards them. You can use dashing, jumping, running, and perform a special jump which is available after collecting rewards. Your opposition will be two types of sentries, dragons, mines, and traps who all want to keep you down.

name: The Lonely People
summary: The game is a third-person open-world shooter in which you can hack, shoot, steal, and complete missions. We took making this game very seriously and we hope you will enjoy it, have a good day.PS: there is a control manual in the pause menu if you click on the "Controls" button.

name: The Joy of Creation: Ignited Collection
summary: The Joy of Creation: Ignited Collection is an upcoming bundle developed by Nikson. The collection includes complete remakes of two "The Joy of Creation" games, including Reborn and Story Mode. both these games will be remade from the ground up, with new assets, new gameplay, etc.

name: Thistledown: Marrowroot
summary: In a world riddled with dangerous magic, a half-dead opossum has to find the source of a toxic fungus that is threatening his family. Digging into dark, forbidden houses and dodging a murderous fairy named Barker, he discovers the problem is deeper than he ever would have dreamed.

name: The Unluckiest Man
summary: After his wife draws her last breath, Dragomir is devastated. As a poor man with a drinking habit, he must not only manage to hold a decent funeral, but also stand for himself in a small town that doesn't see him with good eyes.

name: The Pepper Prince: Episode 5 - A Royal Descent
summary:
He's found. But his heart is broken into a thousand pieces. It is up to you to bring him back from the brink and return together to restore the kingdom!

This DLC unlocks Episode 5 of The Pepper Prince: Seasoning 1, a quirky point-and-click adventure about love, grief, and the power of friendship. Solve puzzles, meet quirky fairy-tale-inspired characters, and help your friend regain confidence and self-love after heartbreak!

name: The Overthrow
summary: The Overthrow is an RPG slasher game with one life, with hardcore arena battles, a special leveling tree and a system of procedurally generated enemies. In the game you have to be one of the recruits of the squad to overthrow the government. The world is inhabited by robots with humanoid AI.

name: The Dancer: Definitive Edition - Revolution
summary: Take back Brazil(?) As the elusive Bronze mothership threatens to destroy the country in this brand new Dancer adventure!

name: The brave loves the body of the devil
summary: Tucker's goal is to become a heroic brave, and for this he embarked on a journey to defeat the devil, but after seeing the devil, he has a brand new goal-to make the devil his own woman!

name: The Blue Cat
summary: The Blue Cate is a game about a little girl who finds a cat and learns about love and compassion.

name: The Excrawlers
summary: Action-RPG roguelike game in which you and others hero will have to plunge into the dark atmosphere of dungeons full of monsters and madness.

name: The Hunt of the Blood Moon
summary: The Hunt of the Blood Moon offers a first person murder mystery experience. Interacting with friends and other people from all over the world to find out who is the mythological creature that’s trying to kill everyone else. Win by killing the creature, before it kills you.

name: The Hustle
summary: The Hustle is an open-world board game about GETTING RICH: avoid government overreach, ruin real-world friendships, and go anywhere - anywhere - to build your empire from the bottom up.

name: The King's Tournament
summary: The King's Tournament is a party game playable with up to 4 players in Online and Local Multiplayer. TKT is a fun party game, with a replacement of the board game phase by transforming it into an intense combat phase with various items and endless customization.

name: The Lightnwatchers
summary: The Lightnwatchers is a 2.5D shooter and fighting game. In the future, humans open the portal connecting the other world. The Lightn, an organization that guards human cities, welcomes a new agent "J". He will guard the city while facing the threat from the other world with his friends.

name: The Play
summary: Pull yourself together, Ainsley. Just one more rehearsal until the big day, assuming nothing catastrophic happens. But really, all you have to do is get your motley crew of actors to run their parts once through from beginning to end. How hard can it be?

name: The Life and Deaths of Doctor M
summary: Your vision clears as you gently land in an endless landscape. There is the wind, a bleak and chill thing. And there is your sense of uncertainty: You don't know which way to go. Or, maybe, which way you went.

name: The Mono-Yellow Madness
summary: The Mono-Yellow Madness is a survival horror game taking place in the backrooms. Will you survive in this multi-level trap? Will you put an end to this? Only you can uncover the mysteries.

name: The Legend of Gandar II
summary: The Legend of Gandar II takes place four years after the events of The Legend of Gandar. The Legend of Gandar II is again based on an 2D action-adventure video game.

name: The Alien Creature
summary: Try to escape The Alien Creature, an atmospheric horror puzzle game that tests your skills... and your nerves. Gather weapons and tools that will help you defend yourself as you search for a way off this forsaken planet.

name: The Doll's Window
summary: A horror exploration game that takes place in an underground labyrinth. Avoid malicious creations that are hungry for your soul. Depart from the nightmares that constantly haunt you.

name: The Wizardz Dungeon
summary: A difficult, fast-paced action-rogue-lite where you hack n'slash your way through a dungeon full of loot and monsters. Your goal is to get strong enough to be able to defeat the Guardian. Death means starting over again.

name: Theseus Protocol
summary: Theseus Protocol is a SCI-FI DBG strategy game. In this highly intelligent time, you are forced to adapt to the laws of survival and become stronger in battles. Seeking for the truth, you must travel across variety of novel scenes to reveal the full story by collecting fragments of information.

name: The King's Dilemma: Chronicles
summary: Lead the King’s Council for generations as the consequences of your decisions decide the kingdom’s resources and political standing. Form alliances, solve dilemmas, and prepare for the final uprising that was foretold by an ancient prophecy

name: The Brothers
summary: The Brothers is a classically styled 2D JRPG featuring Octopath Traveller inspired combat, with modern features you can't live without: Auto saving, quest logs, a built in encyclopaedia and a digital manual just scratch the surface.

name: The Broken Balance
summary: Shoot your way through the worlds only zombie prison. Infected lives will not let you leave. Jump, run, swim, and tear your way passed hordes of undead. It only gets worse from here.

name: The Jianghu
summary: 敬请期待！

name: The last four
summary: The waking girl lost her memory? There's a zombie in an empty base? What is the cat guarding? Sleeping girl , is she eager to wake up? What's the wandering boy doing? Can we find out what happened on this base, get our happiness back? A little AVG game. I hope you like it.

name: The Chase
summary: “The chase” is a first-person survival horror game developed by RAM Studios. The story revolves around a couple that has been separated for some time. The only hope for him is to strive through the darkness and pray to God that everything will be alright.

name: The Blunderbuss
summary: The blunderbuss is a powerful bomb created by the most secretive cartel in the DR. They involve Eduardo, an ordinary man who must prevent the detonation of that unique bomb to protect his loved ones before... Blunderbuss!

name: The Blood Games
summary: 100 players awake in a room alongside a prize of $1 Billion. Your goal, pass 7 deadly challenges and be the last one standing.

name: The Beast in the Cave
summary: This is an adventure plot game in the pixel style of kesulu. Follow the tourists described by Lovecraft to have an incredible Cave Adventure. In the depths of darkness, there are eyes staring at you

name: The Day After
summary: Floods, raging hurricanes, and weather anomalies cause great havoc around the globe. People are forced to leave their homesteads. Each day becomes a challenge and a fight for survival.

name: The Death Tree
summary: The Death Tree is a first-person horror hunt game set in a nightmarish dark forest that involves action and "jump scares" through a tension and intrigue atmosphere. Hunt creepy monsters,ruthlessly creatures and witches.

name: The Director's Cut
summary: The Director's Cut is a story-driven psychological horror game set in a 1984, USA. Redefine your meaning of horror. Using DREAMu.

name: The Events at Unity Farm
summary: Horror, fantasy and a dash of steampunk, EVENTS AT UNITY FARM is a fresh take on Open World VR. Use your ancestral power to cast spells, overcome undead evils and merciless bosses. Gather and craft potions, search for clues to solve puzzles all to stop the impending Multipocalypse.

name: The Evil Furry
summary: Your choices are all that matter in this adventure comedy. Solve mysteries, survive the furry and fight for love but beware of the consequences of your decisions.

name: The Evil of Mutant
summary: Game features ・JRPG ・Easy operation ・No complicated explanations ・Addictiveness that gets you hooked in 5 minutes from the start ・There are so many mini game

name: The Godfeather: A Mafia Pigeon Saga
summary: A mafia pigeon roguelike saga full of danger, adventure and poop! Join the pigeon underworld. Take back the old neighbourhood. Become The Godfeather.

name: The Heroes Around Me
summary: The Heroes Around Me tells a story of a family of 3: the hard-working and quiet father – Nan, his daughter Lili, and their pet dog Sesame. Players will experience the harshness and warmth in the simpler time of the 1990s, where lots of stories are untold.

name: The Host: Cataclysm
summary: After a Post-Armageddon event the world has gone back to its roots living in simpler times, back to swords, kings, and war. After the hero has chosen evil the world is left in ruins as everyone struggles to survive in this new found world.

name: The Hungry Fly
summary: Once upon a time, there was a fly. A hungry fly. A fly with razor-sharp teeth, with a taste for dead things. This is the tale of its adventure to find something dead to devour, in a swamp where nothing dies, everything is grotesque, and every choice matters, no matter how surreal.

name: The Operator
summary: As an Operator, you will assist FDI's field agents by analyzing evidence on your computer and making deductions. Help them solve impossible cases in this immersive interface game, full of plot twists and mysteries. Everything will be explained, you just have to ████ ██ ██████.

name: Them or Us
summary: Them or Us is an Open-World, First Person Tactical Survival Shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world where Soviet and Western civilizations collide on a chain of fictional islands in the Bering Sea.

name: The Multi-Medium
summary: The Multi-Medium is a visually unique 2D puzzle platform adventure in which you play an interdimensional explorer lost in the multiverse. Travel to diverse worlds, each drawn or painted by hand in a different medium and style, in search of your place in the cosmos.

name: The Nutcracker
summary: A mascot survival horror game where you turn detective and learn the truth about disappearances within a local shopping mall. Evade and outwit the Nutcracker whilst finding out what happened to the missing.

name: The Outlaw and the Newcomer
summary: A suspense ADV of mobsters in Eastern Europe. Walk around the nostalgic city and talk with fascinating characters as you uncover the identity of a terrifying poison. The game system combines elements of exploration, collecting, and visual novels.

name: The Masked Prisoner
summary: "The Masked Prisoner" explores the untold stories of several Half Life characters - taking place in a prison on the outskirts of City 17.

name: The Phantom Keeper
summary: The Phantom Keeper is a monster-collecting RPG adventure where you are a fallen Soul trapped in the land between the living and the dead. Take up the mantle of Keeper to train and care for ghostly creatures known as Phantoms!

name: The Last World
summary: The Last World is a sci-fi simulation game with elements of space, adventure, survival, modding and automation. The game in which the player has to create his own empire from the ruins of the old one. Mine, build, research, produce and travel!

name: The Secret Life of Dorian Pink
summary: A choices-matter narrative RPG set in an alternate universe of the Picture of Dorian Gray by Oscar Wilde. Save your boyfriend Basil from the Devil by making questionable choices, gaining allies, and making doughnuts explode.

name: The Many Deaths of Lily Kosen
summary: A demon is trying to kill you and your friends, and it's all that you can do to survive. How can you stop it permanently? How many of your friends have to die before it's all over? Try and make the best choices you can in this pulse-pounding horror visual novel!

name: The Sob Island
summary: The Sob Island is a 2D plot puzzle game. The story of Aidan's mysterious death of his mother on his 13th birthday is like the first domino that fell, changing everything he knew.

name: The 9th Charnel
summary: A first-person survival horror game, The 9th Charnel is filled with a rich and frightening atmosphere. While exploring the many mysteries of this world, you must survive- whether you do it through stealth or by using weapons.

name: The Witch of Fern Island
summary: The Witch of Fern Island is a game about a young girl who wants to become a real witch. Immerse yourself in the history of the island and get to know its inhabitants. It's time to find your place in the world.

name: The Sixth Faction
summary: The Sixth Faction is a turn-based tactical RPG, optimized for cooperative experience through an innovative scheduling system that allows both players to plan their strategy simultaneously.

name: Thyria
summary: Thyria is a RPG, with turn-based combat and isometric 2D exploration, playing on time management mechanics. Summon and train a team of Guardians, who will accompany Thyria into the minds of the cursed villagers. Help them vanquish their nightmares.

name: These Doomed Isles
summary: Inspired by classic god games, survival city-builders and roguelike deck-builders, in These Doomed Isles you'll craft your deck of cards to raise islands from the sea, build settlements for your followers and keep them alive as famine threatens, forests burn and raiders loom on the horizon.

name: The Spirit Lift
summary: The Spirit Lift is a deck-building rogue-like horror adventure in a haunted hotel. Ascend 13 floors in a ghostly elevator. Use equipment cards to battle monsters. Make it to the villain at the top… or die trying!

name: Through the Abyss
summary: Join the protagonist in his adventure through a mysterious place called the Abyss. Explore unique and tough environments with hundreds of hand crafted levels!

name: The In Between
summary: A competitive party game that pits demons against spell-casting hunters! A demon must possess a hunter to attack other hunters, and a hunter must successfully attack a possessed hunter to defeat the demon. But both sides must be careful to not attack members of their own team.

name: The Bakerville Case
summary: Get ready for a first-person horror, adventure and survival experience, enter the darkness and enjoy incredible graphics generated in real time with the Unity engine. Play as Thomas Baker and explore Bakerville to discover the terrible evil that resides there.

name: The Axis Unseen
summary: The Axis Unseen is a heavy metal horror game created by one of the developers of Skyrim, Starfield and Fallout. Hunt nightmarish monsters from ancient folklore in a mysterious open world, collecting their enhanced sense powers and discovering elemental arrows.

name: The Antarctic Sphere
summary: The Antarctic Sphere is a sci-fi narrative game in which you decipher an unknown language in order to communicate with a mysterious sphere that has been found under the ice of Antarctica.

name: The Levels of Backrooms
summary: Explore, discover, and document the dark, liminal reality known as the Backrooms, experiencing dread and isolation as you navigate it. We wish you luck in your travels.

name: The Personal Reasons
summary: After a crime has occurred within the walls of a university, the main character finds himself in the very epicenter of events. So be patient and put on your knight's armor. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of student life and other people's secrets.

name: The Tower of Luminus
summary: After a horrible accident, Benjamin’s only company is his battered teddy bear. Together, you must find your way to safety, while solving puzzles and evading those that hide in the dark. Find ways to repair your bear to unlock its full potential, and discover new ways it can help you on your journey.

name: The Eternal Fool
summary: A poetic adventure game about nostalgia, the death of faith, and the relentless feeling of Toska.

name: The Button Be: Fields
summary: Through loss and acquest alike, make these Fields a little more beautiful.

name: The Button Be: Unexpected
summary: Bring out even more wonderful things now! Just figure out how they come and at what cost...

name: Theatrhythm Final Bar Line
summary: Theatrhythm Final Bar Line is a game in the Final Fantasy musical spin-off series, packed with 385 music tracks from across the whole Final Fantasy series.

name: The Chicken Quiz
summary: Do you want to learn some amazing facts about the Chickens? We have the right game for you The Chicken Quiz.

name: The Purge: Revenge
summary: This is a Half-Life MOD based on the famous movie the Purge (created by James DeMonaco).

name: The Moon Watch
summary: You're an ordinary Soviet citizen, but to your surprise you are selected to play a highly important part in the defense of the Motherland - and then the crisis comes...

name: The Flash
summary: An LCD electronic handheld based on the DC Comics superhero The Flash.

name: The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz
The Last Barbarian
summary: "The Last Barbarian" is a third-person action role-playing adult game. You are encouraged by the game to proceed with caution, learn from past mistakes, or find alternate areas to explore. Find different locations, new friends and dangerous enemies.

name: The Fire Tower
summary: An exploration of a hike to the Mt. Cammerer Fire Tower in the Great Smoky Mountains National Park.

name: The Frenetic Five vs. Sturm und Drang
summary: In this game about under-powered superheroes, you play as Improv, leader of the Frenetic Five. You use common objects in surprisingly useful ways. Bob, your contact at Supertemps, hires your team for a new job: defeat the melodramatic supervillains Sturm und Drang who have holed up in the abandoned flange mill at the waterfront.

name: The Tempest
summary: An interactive fiction adaptation of William Shakespeare's comedy The Tempest in which the player guides the spirit Ariel. The text and descriptions are lifted from the original work, i.e. in Early Modern English.

name: The Little Big Crisis
summary: The Little Big Crisis is a financial simulation game based on the 2008 Great Recession where you become the chairman of the Federal Reserve and are tasked to tackle the situation.

name: The Mighty Quest for Epic Loot
summary: Raid the world of Opulencia by swiping your way to victory! Crush your enemies and grab some loot in this fast-paced action RPG. Start your quest with the humongous single-player campaign to earn limitless wealth, powerful gear and other sweet loot. Rise to the challenge of each area as the enemy hordes grow, and the bosses become ever-more hulking. On top of the main campaign, you can jump into the PVP Arena to prove your mettle against thousands of other players in The Mighty Quest For Epic Loot's Tournament. There is more, you can always try your hand at a feast of ever-changing, single-player, time-limited events that come stuffed with exclusive rewards, ensuring the loot keeps flowing!

name: The Sims 4: Desert Luxe Kit
summary: Soak up the sun with luxurious indoor/outdoor pieces from The Sims 4 Desert Luxe Kit. Arrange matching neutral-toned furniture, curtains, and more to create a bright, sophisticated space for Sims to relax and entertain.

name: The Jumping Ice Cream: Turbo
summary: Join BIG I on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Big Catch
summary: The Big Catch is a 3D platformer all about tight expressive player movement, exploration, and FISH. In addition to inheriting the best parts of retro and modern platformers, The Big Catch is designed to be something fresh (like the fish).

name: The Legend of Zelda: Hard Awakening DX
summary: This is essentially Master Quest for Link’s Awakening (DX). The dungeon maps are the same as in the original with different layouts, some minor modifications made to the overworld, some edited text for better or worse, and new uses for a few items not utilized in the original.

name: The Shark T
summary: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat fish with the main hero of the game The Shark T and eat all the fish in the world!

name: The Baseball T
summary: Throw the ball to become the best baseball player in the world.

name: The Copper Age
summary:
This year you have been assigned to be the CEO of the Copper mine.
To start mining the copper and become the biggest copper mine in the world.

name: The Cow Quiz
summary: Do you want to learn some amazing facts about the Cows? We have the right game for you The Cow Quiz.

name: The Chaput's Baby
summary: The Chaput church was a well know place by the neighbors. Year gave way to year and the small church now is only the place where the Chaput family lives. Samantha is hired by the family to look after their baby, but things starts to go off inside the house.

name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past - Master Quest
summary: The purpose of this hack was to take the same approach Nintendo took with Ocarina of Time: Master Quest. Numerous Zelda games have a second quest in one form or another, and the author felt that A Link to the Past deserved a similar treatment. The dungeons have detours, rearranged items, tougher enemies, and an intermediate difficulty level. However, an optional “Double Heart Damage” patch is included for those looking for a greater challenge.

name: The Fate of the Bombiwa
summary: You have been tasked with aiding the Bombiwa Tribe with the missing person’s investigation. What will this task lead you to? The fate of the Bombiwa is in your hands

name: The Legend of Zelda: Goddess of Wisdom
summary: A comprehensive ROM Hack of The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, with all-changed dungeons and a new overworld.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Shadow of Night
summary: A completely new Zelda II adventure! With new maps, dungeons, graphics, music and so much more! Guide link across the kingdom of Hyrule and defeat the ominous shadow!

name: Thunder Roar
summary: An action combat game on rails, starring a cute anime girl.

name: The Mating Season
summary: Donatello decides to admit to April that him and the rest of the Turtles have been jerking off to the news reports featuring April.

name: The Raccoon Who Lost Their Shape
summary: The story of a raccoon whose job is to summon the ghosts of dead shape people. Talk with various shapes and summon their ghostly friends!

name: The Aurora World
summary: A three-faction RVR mmorpg with an advanced pet system.

name: The Jumping Churros
summary: Join Big C on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Jumping Churros: Turbo
summary: Join Big C on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Simpsons: Bart vs. The Space Mutants
The Mask: From Zero to Hero
The Real Ghostbusters
summary: Based on The Real Ghostbusters animated series.

name: The Dark Eye Bundle
summary: Three games in the fantasy universe of "The Dark Eye"

name: The Lifetime
summary: After falling through a void for an entire lifetime, you land in a mysterious underground world, with a mask you can't remove. All you're told is that you need to collect time so you can return to your former life back up on the surface. But time moves in mysterious ways down here...

name: The Jumping Pumpkin
summary: Join BIG P on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Silent Huntress
summary: "The Silent Huntress" is a visual novel in the genre of a dark fairy tale with choices and different endings. Not only the development of events will depend on your choices, but also the conclusions that the main character makes about her life and the world around her.

name: The Bombs Have Been Dropped, I am Listening to Steely Dan and Wearing Cheap Sunglasses.
summary: A visual novel about talking to cute girls during the nuclear holocaust.

name: The Dark Conjunction
summary: The Dark Conjunction is a Single-Player Total Conversion for Quake 3: Arena that is inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft.

name: The Chronicles of Myrtana: Archolos
summary:
The Chronicles Of Myrtana: Archolos is a free, total conversion mod for Gothic II: Gold Edition. It features a completely new open world, improved skills systems, gameplay mechanics and complex story.

Main goal of this project is to honour one the best classic cRPG and take the die-hard fans of the original Gothic trilogy as well as new players on one more adventure in the Kingdom of Myrtana.

name: The Real World
summary: The creators of ‘MAX PAYNE: Kung Fu Edition 3’ and ‘Katana’ join forces to deliver THE most explosive and complete mod to ever grace the Max Payne engine! Combine a massive arsenal of lightning-fast punches, kicks, and cool signature takedown moves to devastate your opponents with style! Run along walls, dodge bullets effortlessly, and flip off walls, objects and even people! The rules are yours to bend and break, as you relive some of the Trilogy's most memorable scenes, including The Lobby, Dojo, and The Burly Brawl!

name: The Family
summary: "The Family" follows the young gangster Tony in an entire black and white film noir-ish world of the 1930's mafia era.

name: The Others
summary: The toy factory is closed. Mysterious things are happening. Mary Bingham knows why in The Others, a creepy hidden object mystery that calls on your imagination in unique ways as you put the pieces of this ominous story together.

name: The Door Project
summary: Set up in a beautiful little town, you will have to investigate the mysterious disappearance of your friend and his community. Based on a high interactivity with the world, be prepared to use your brain and the tools around you for this unique first person adventure!

name: This Bed We Made
summary: This Bed We Made is a third-person mystery game in which you play as a maid in a 1950s hotel and snoop around strangers' rooms to uncover their deadly secrets. Discover what links the clients together in this tale of love, heartbreak and murder!

name: The Lost Bloodline
summary: The Lost Bloodline is a game where you will venture into an immersive story developed in medieval times, endowed with a lot of action, exploration and a touch of fantasy, we recommend you to venture into this great epic journey.

name: The Odarian Accounts
summary: Follow Cedric on his adventure as he tries to get his home and family back after events take place uprooting all that he knows, and throwing him into a world of chaos.

name: The Cat Maze
summary: it is a 2d solving puzzle game, the maze is subvert your imagination, you need to find the start point and end point by yourself that to solve the cats maze. there have many type of cats have special power to help you to solve it, there have 499 level waiting for you to solve!!

name: That Night
summary: That Night is a short PSX horror game. You're a girl in the 90's that one night decided to take a walk in a road in the middle of the forest. The more you progress, the more you hear voices of something that is following you.

name: The Slasher Camp Massacre

The Cymanti are a breakout group of Polytopians who moved to the swampy forests long ago and learned to live in symbiosis with the incredible Ciru Bug, which attaches to their faces and merges with their brains! These bug-loving Polytopians cultivate fungus that they use to feed their population and defend themselves from invaders! Led by a mystical Shaman, the Cymanti train gigantic bugs, use their enemies to fertilize their fungi farms, and bathe their foes in crippling poisons to vanquish all who would threaten their marshy home!

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Polaris
summary: Polaris is Polytopia’s third Special Tribe! From the frozen wastes emerge the Polaris, servants of the mysterious Gaami, who are hellbent on freezing the Square into a new frigid paradise. Imbued with icy powers granted by their overlords, the Polaris construct adorable Mooni, freeze the waters, shatter their foes, and diligently work their way toward an unforeseen fate...

Guide coloured blocks to their goal through a series of mazes and see if you can find the treasure at the end. Crafted in crisp, colourful pixel art with relaxing music, The Nodus will fire your brain cells on a nostalgia trip. How many levels can you solve? Can you find the treasure? Jump into The Nodus and find out!​

name: The Amazing Spider-Man in the Villain Round-Up
summary: Spider-Man & The Villain Round-Up is a Plug It in & Play TV Game based on Spider-Man.

name: Thomas & Friends: Right on Time
summary:
Right on Time is a TV Plug and Play video game released by Jakks Pacific and developed by HotGen in 2006.

Welcome to the Island of Sodor, it's nearly time for the party and Thomas has his work cut out for him gathering supplies and helping his friends. Capture runaway diesels, pick up cargo from Cranky the Crane, bring coal to stranded engines and clean up after those pesky coal trucks. Follow Sir Topham Hatt's directions while exploring the island to help Thomas become a useful engine.

The player can play as Thomas, Percy, James, Emily or Molly and help them do various jobs on Sir Topham Hatt's orders. The joystick is used to move the engine to where they need to be.

Along the way, useful tickets can be picked up and used to collect tokens for unlocking other engines. Other power-ups include speedups and freezing time.

name: The Witcher: Project Sirius
summary: Game developed by The Molasses Flood with support from the CD PROJEKT RED team, set in The Witcher universe. It has been described to tell "an unforgettable story for existing Witcher fans and new audiences." Compared to existing CD PROJEKT RED games, this one is said to "target a much broader audience." name: The Cheetah Girls: Passport to Fame

summary:
The only thing Bell Park likes more than a mystery is solving it on her own. But when a time-travelling 12-year-old version of herself lands face-down on her rented co-working desk, she'll have no choice but to take the displaced kid detective along on her latest case.
Follow the trail of a missing heterosexual on the strange streets of Toronto! Investigate a quirky cast of drag kings, chicken wing enthusiasts, and women in elaborate cat make-up! Thrill in the pervasive ennui of your early twenties! Struggle to remember where your preteen self was at with the whole being gay thing!
Will Adult Bell make peace with the figurative and literal ghosts of her past? Can Kid Bell navigate the uncanny world of the 2020s and find her way back home? How's the chicken in that creepy basement food court? These questions and more will be answered in THE GROWN-UP DETECTIVE AGENCY.

Would you sacrifice someone to prolong your life?

The story of 'The Room' follows our occult loving protagonist who gets an apartment for a very cheap price.
For the first few days everything seemed fine, but then weird things start happening when some special conditions are met.

What are these conditions?

What exactly is happening in the apartment?

Played online, your quarry is another human player but can you find them amongst the AI inhabitants of the Ship? Once you know who they are, find yourself a weapon but keep an eye out for security guards and cameras. If you're spotted trying to murder someone you'll be transported to the Brig and suffer a hefty fine. If you succeed in killing your quarry Mr. X will reward you with a cash prize, depending on how entertaining he found your murder. At the same time you must look after yourself, wash, sleep, eat and have fun and remember - always look over your shoulder because somewhere there's a player looking for you!

name: The Electric Yoyo
summary: The goal of the game is to collect all dots on the playfield with your yo-yo. In each level the dots are placed in different patterns and the numbers of enemies vary. There are two types of enemies. One type (that you may not touch at all) puts electrical charges on the dots, which you have to catch. The other type is also deadly, unless you hit it when you are charged, which gives you bonus points. You can move your yo-yo in four different directions and it grabs onto the dot which is nearest in each direction. The longer the distance to the next dot, the more points you get.

name: Thief City

A scientific facility called the Xeno Project has been set up on the planet for continuing research into portal technology. Tension on the planet is running high due to the secrecy surrounding the project and the military’s distrust of the scientific community.

You are Gordon Freeman. Your mission is to report to the underground test lab at the Xeno Project.

name: The Girl in the Window
summary: The Girl in the Window is the first point and click game the Dark Dome with which the series of a dark town called Hidden Town would begin surrounded by ancient mysteries. In this game you play Dan, a curious guy who has entered an abandoned house and has been locked up. You will have to solve riddles and puzzles, open drawers and decipher codes, everything in your power to escape the room.

name: The Backrooms
summary: The Backrooms is a first person survival horror game set in one of the most terrifying environments of the human psyche. Explore an ever evolving nightmare while running from terrifying creatures to stay alive.

name: The Thing at the Window
summary:
You live with your father in the rural American midwest. He left you home alone while he's out of town for the weekend, and you heard on the radio that there's a large storm heading your way.

You live in a rather underdeveloped part of the country so you're off the power grid, but fortunately your dad's pretty handy and he's wired up your old farmhouse to a gas generator, which you moved to the basement to keep it out of the storm. The basement smells kind of funny and it's really hazy down there, but it should be okay for now. There's a big fuel tank outside where you can refill your jerry can, and dad refilled it before he left. There's also a big pile of wooden boards out front from when your dad renovated the barn over the summer, so you can use those to board up the windows just in case.

The storm should be here soon and you're as prepared as you can be, but still you feel uneasy; something's not quite right... you feel as if something's lurking out there, watching.

Your goal is to survive three nights of the Thing trying to force its way into your home, by barricading doors and windows. The thing really doesn't like light, so you can drive it away with your rechargeable flashlight. You can also "reinforce" parts of the house by turning lights on, which will slow the thing's attacks at the cost of draining more power and needing to refill the generator more frequently.

name: The Most Awesome Game Ever Made
summary: Do you really want to live your life knowing that you never played 'The Most Awesome Game Ever Made?'... I didn't think so! Wishlist it right now so you don't miss out on the fun!

name: The Brains & The Brawn

name: This Way Madness Lies
summary:
Let us begin our tale, in the quiet city of Verona, Italy. A town for lovers... and giant, mutant flower attacks.

As the leader of the Stratford-Upon-Avon High Drama Society, Imogen is no ordinary girl! Sure, she goes to school every day and helps produce plays for the community, but beyond that, she's a magical girl! With her powers, she can teleport to alternate dimensions based on Shakespeare plays, fight back the forces of Nightmare, and still get back in time for dinner!

Join Imogen, Paulina, Viola, Rosalind, Miranda, Beatrice, and Kate on an epic adventure throughout the Shakespearean metaverse in this comedy JRPG!

name: The Glitched Attraction
