name: The Sword of Ianna
summary:
In a time and a world dominated by the shadows, the goddess IANNA chose a warrior, who defeated the evil that threatened these lands.

Now that fear is reborn, it is your time.

name: The Gate 2
summary: The story continues from where the last game left off, this time The TimeGate will take the player to amazing new world in distant universes. Unlike the first Game The Gate II will feature many more enemies to fight! Some Alien some Human and a few more besides.. We have a full inventory of Professional voice actors on our team so The Gate II will of course feature a full movie style script. The Gate II like its predecessor will also be released with a full classical musical score.

name: The Item Sagashi: Joshikousei Tantei Shinjitsu no Jikenbo
summary:
This is the first item-seeking adventure game in the @SIMPLE DL series, in which the player solves cases that occur in the school while searching for items.
The objective of the game is to solve the case by finding the items that are given to you in various places in the school. You can enjoy both the school slapstick story and the item-seeking puzzle elements.

name: The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Nou wo Kitaeru Sports Gym-Hen
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Enchou Hisshi no Karaoke-hen
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Fushigi Hakken! Hakubutsukan-hen
The Noroi no Haikousha: Noroi no Kamen to Futago no Shoujo
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Tabi wa Michi-zure! Tetsudou-hen
The Dasshutsu Game: Uragiri no Misshitsu
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Yukai na Saru to Family Restaurant-hen
The Shogi
summary: The game has a free battle mode that you can play right away, and a level up mode that allows you to play against computers with 4 levels of strength under various conditions, allowing you to improve your skills while having fun. It also has a game record storage function and a two-player match function, allowing you to enjoy playing games with friends using a single Nintendo 3DS.

name: The Kanshikikan: File. 1 - Kinkyuu Sousa! Juuryou Shouko wo Touch Seyo!
The Kanshikikan: File. 2 - Kinkyuu Shutsudou! Ochita Hoshi wo Oe!
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Iyasarenai Onsen-hen
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Asobi no Tengoku Kumadonaru Bowl-hen
The Uwaki Kareshi: Totsugeki! Uwaki Genba
The Uwaki Kareshi: Uwaki no Daishou
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Terebi Kyoku Micchaku 24-Ji-hen
The Uwaki Kareshi: Christmas Chuushi no Oshirase
The Uwaki Kareshi: Kaseifu ga Kenta Uwaki Genba
The Dasshutsu Game: Kiken na 5-tsu no Misshitsu
The Taxi: Boku ha Charisma Untenshu
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Fushigi na Kumadonaru Burger-hen
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Gakkou no Kyuukousha-hen
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Celeb na Goutei-hen
The Misshitsu Kara no Dasshutsu: Nangoku no Resort-hen
The Noroi no Haibyouin: Tojikomerareta Kao no Nai Shoujo
The Xeno Project II
summary:
After fighting your way across Xen and escaping in a rocket, you are captured and imprisoned aboard an Earth vessel full of grunts, lead by the our old friend the G-Man.

What happens next? I’m afraid that’s up to you. Good luck. You’ll need it.

name: The Sims 5
summary: Project Rene is the working title for a "next generation Sims game," widely speculated in the Sims community to be The Sims 5. Project Rene was officially unveiled during Electronic Arts's "Behind The Sims" summit on October 18, 2022 by Lyndsay Pearson, Vice President of Franchise Creative for The Sims team.

name: The Mysterious Mine Bouncin' Back Edition
summary: This is the author’s Earthbound hack that they have worked on since 2006. This hack is a graphics, story, gameplay change hack.

name: Thomas to Asonde Oboeru Kotoba to Kazu to ABC
The Citizen Returns
summary:
The Citizen Returns is a mod for Half-Life 2: Episode Two, created by Accidental Games.

Set in both the heart and outside of City 17, “The Citizen Returns” contains the final chapters of our citizen’s story, as well as an updated version of Part II.

The setting takes place after Larry have been rescued by the Resistance of you after risking your life. Part 2 and 3 have been merged into a single part after the final release. Part 2's ending (the collapse of the ceiling) has been retconned, now Larry and the protagonist are just running out.

name: The Jumping Burger: Halloween Edition - Turbo
summary: Join Big B on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Legend of Tiger and Phoenix
summary: The Legend of Tiger And Phoenix is a unique timing-parrying/infiltrating game that allows you to experience Fireballs, Energy Blast, ​levitating, and the life of an invisible human.

name: The Inverse
summary: Defend yourself against the creatures and destroy the FlipSide!

name: The Mucus Empire
summary:
A fairly challenging slaughter map by me.

It could be a little difficult for beginners or somebody who prefer more relaxing gameplay, you can just lower the difficulty.

Have a good time!

name: The Man From the Window
summary:
Mama Rabbit returns home from work one late night.

Awake long past his bedtime, a frightened Junior Rabbit rushes in.

The book in his hands has very visibly spooked him, and Mama Rabbit tries convincing him that it's only a story.

But then a tap-tap-tapping begins on the window...

name: The Adventures of Bouapha: Spooky Castle
summary: Years and years before there was Supreme With Cheese, Bouapha battled a horrible green monster in an exceedingly spooky castle. Relive that classic adventure today with this freebie game! It's like living a history book, except that it's fictional and incredibly unrealistic and silly!

name: The Fast and The Furious: Tokyo
summary: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo mobile game based on the 2006 movie The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift. It was released alongside a 3D version. Both versions have the same game modes and locations, but whereas the 3D version can be played from either a first-person or third-person perspective this uses a top-down perspective.

name: The Rice Story
summary:
This year you have been assigned to be the CEO of the Rice farm.
Start growing the rice and become the biggest rice farm in the world.
Good Luck and Have Fun.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - Gold Quest
summary:
Gold Quest is like an expanded Master Quest. Different dungeon & overworld layouts plus many other little gameplay changes.

Designed with the more experienced OOT player in mind & for those who like to complete 100% of the game. Like Master Quest, it’s the same story, although there are some text changes & cutscenes have generally been made shorter. Text speed has been increased. Dungeon Maps have all been updated for new chest locations with fast chest openings.

name: The Jumping Pumpkin: Halloween Edition
summary: Join Big P on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Jumping Pumpkin: Halloween Edition - Turbo
summary: Join Big P on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Surgeon
summary: Medical simulation game where players are presented with a patient's complaints and must diagnose the issue, prescribe treatment, and operate if necessary. The player must follow well-defined steps in order to prevent patient death during surgery. Served as the basis for 1988's Life & Death.

name: The Turgenev Study
summary: Harvest DNA and assimilate new samples for your paramountly important research. Your laboratory is located in a warzone, resulting in limited access to energy sources. Your agent can only launch a harvest every 10 seconds. Do your best despite these harsh conditions.

name: The Shadow People
summary: The Shadow People is a retro point and click horror adventure game with a minimalistic aesthetic. As a student cramming for finals, you drive all the way to school, sit through class, and try to slog your way back home. But fatigue sets in, and dark creatures dance in the edge of your eyesight.

name: The Rumble Fish 2
summary: A legendary arcade game developed by Dimps in 2005. This fighting game gained popularity for its smooth visuals powered by S.M.A as well as the high level of strategy driven by its 2-gauges system. And with the addition of new current-gen features it's even easier to play.

name: The Rumble Fish 2: Collector's Edition
summary:
The Rumble Fish 2: Collector's Edition includes:
- Physical copy of The Rumble Fish 2 game with download codes for 3 characters and The Rumble Fish 1 game
- Collector's Edition Box
- Soundtrack
- Art Book
- Strategy Guide and Command List

name: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - Ghosts of Christmas Passed
summary: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark bonus case is playable now! Ghosts of Christmas Passed features Ghosts! And Christmas! And Francis McQueen's definitely-for-real-actually-for-all-time-he's-dead-death. Yes, siree, he's dead as a doornail, he is.

name: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - One Flew Into the Cuckoo's Nest
summary: Buzz is missing! Head to the Twin Lakes Botanical Gardens to get to the bottom of this here mystery! Based off the Darkside choose-your-own adventure from Twitter last year, you can check out the trailer just down below

name: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - Tales of the Darkside
summary: In The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark - Tales of the Darkside you'll join the fan favorite side characters to solve the mysteries of Twin Lake! Will the Bloodwolves, the Brightside Division, and Rexa each solve their cases and save Twin Lake

name: The Quest for the Candies
summary: This is a Halloween-themed hack that was started in 2019 and finished in 2022. There are 34 exits, spread across 5 worlds.

name: The Plumber Thing
summary: Do plumbery things in this horror puzzle platformer!

name: The Castle
summary:
This game can be called an ancestor of the Worms game series. The goal is very simple: you need to destroy the enemy's fortress with the help of cannonballs. However, behind the simplicity, a far more intricate process is hidden.

The Castle allows the player to customize the game settings to diversify each duel: you can change the curvature of the landscape and the height at which the fortresses are relative to each other; you can change the degree of influence of the wind on the shots; you can even choose the magnitude of the gravitational force and the number of hits after which the fortress is considered defeated.

name: The Binding of Isaac: Epiphany
summary: The Binding of Isaac: Epiphany is a mod that aims to add a new variant for all characters in Repentance, called "Tarnished" characters, alongside new items to unlock and new challenges.

name: The Great Ghoul Duel 2
summary:
Exploring one of several spooky maps, players must collect as many wandering spirit flames as they can in two minutes and return them to their homebase. After time’s up, the team that has collected the most spirit flames wins. But beware! - Opponents can intercept spirits from one another as they bring them back to homebase.

Players can choose to host a game with up to seven friends and family via a custom invitation link OR just play with randomized players around the globe. The team built several systems to enable this multiplayer gaming, all running on the Google Cloud Platform, including integrating Open Match, a highly-scalable, open source matchmaking framework cofounded by Google Cloud and Unity.

It looks like the ghost is clear—Let's Ghoul!

name: The Event Horizon
summary: The Event Horizon is a four level PWAD for Doom II designed for Boom-compatible source ports created by Killer5. The maps use primarily stock textures and feature a nukage theme with the style of gameplay ranging from short and compact in the vein of Zzul Bases to slaughter. The mapset was uploaded to the idgames archive on May 30, 2021 and received an honorable mention at the 2021 Cacowards.

name: The Egg of Human Endeavors
summary: The Egg of Human Endeavors is a single map made in February 2018 for Vargskelethor's Doom Mapping Contest 2: Hellectric Boogaloo. It's complevel 9 and tested thoroughly by me in PrBoom+ and GZDoom (but mostly in PrBoom+). Hurt Me Plenty is designed to be fun for everyone, and Ultra-Violence is designed to be fun for challenge enthusiasts.

name: The Jumping Bagel
summary: Join BIG B on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Iron Age
summary:
This year you have been assigned to be the CEO of the Iron mine.
To start mining the iron and become the biggest iron mine in the world.
Good Luck and Have Fun.

name: The Jumping Bagel: Turbo
summary: Join BIG B on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Unfettered
summary: Now is the time to take on demonic souls by identifying with the warrior selfness of Lura, heir to the legendary bird. Feel the power within you with The Unfettered.

name: The Legend of Gwen
summary: Join this amazing magical adventure and help Gwen restore the moons! The legend of Gwen is a hardcore platform game, with a retro style, where the objective is to get all the stars in each level, but the real question is... can you do it?

name: The Mixer
summary: The Mixer is a unique take on a rhythm-driven rogue-lite where you create your own custom soundtrack by mixing-and-matching different music loops. Wield your own beat to conquer a dungeon full of rhythmic dangers.

name: The Expedition Squad
summary: Be part of the second expedition team sent to shed light on the mysteries of the archipelago. Make your way through hordes of zombies, hostile factions and hostile creatures in a game environment where recklessness and poor planning could put you in serious trouble.

name: The Complex: Expedition
summary: You play as one of MagWave's researchers, going on an expedition into the Complex. When that expedition goes horribly wrong, you're left alone and lost, wandering the infinite maze of hallways. Otherwise known as the Backrooms. Might there be something in there with you?

name: The Happies: Amber Falcon
summary: After the destruction of homeworld, you fled into space and were shipwrecked in an unknown location. Build a hot air balloon from the wreckage of the lander. Explore strange places, discover ancient artifacts, collect resources to repair the ship. Save the crew and maybe find a new home...

name: The Last Humble Bee
summary: The Last Humble Bee is a heart-buzzing bumble bee rogue-like! Hack and slash demon bugs in high-speed, skill-based gameplay and explore an SNES-inspired pixel art world to find the portal to Hell.

name: The Book of Fredley
summary: Gather the Pages, Reform the Book, and Harvest the innocent to defy The Reaper.

name: The Umbridge Estate
summary: The Umbridge Estate is a 1-4 Player Co-Op Survival Horror Game like no other. Solve the riddles of the maze, read the notes of the people who came before you but most importantly… survive the horrors within.

name: Think and Co-op
summary: Think and work is a cooperative arcade game. The game was designed in such a way that several players could enjoy it at the same time. Land in an icy land or a busy city, it's up to you where you go!

name: The Apothecary
summary: The realm depends on your help: mix ingredients and create potions to cure wild, fantastical illnesses that befall your fellow citizens. But be warned, you are all on your own. Enjoy figuring out which ingredients work and which don't -- curing or killing those who ask for your help!

name: The Fernweh Saga: Book One
summary: Expose the dark secrets and mysteries of your seemingly idyllic hometown in this romantic thriller! Will you fall in love or fall victim to its horrors?

name: The Pencil is cast!
summary: Fight the greats with a pencil! All you need in this fight is a strong dose of luck! Can you survive against the greats?

name: The Janus Problem
summary: A first-person 3D puzzle game where the player can reverse time.

name: The Parvificent Seven
summary: How did the seven dwarfs meet before Snow White appeared in their house? Real time tactics game with heroes like you have never seen before. Specialization, environmental advantages and cooperation. These elements make the game a real challenge!

name: The Search For Paradisus
summary: You are in a place called Purgatorium, a labyrinth prison. Why are you there? A mysterious being called Mr. Nobody introduces himself and says his goal is to get to Paradisus. However, he doesn't care if you make it, but, he's the only help you have. Will you be able to get there? Who is Mr. Nobody?

name: The Dragon's Prophecy
summary: The Dragon's Prophecy is an old-school 2D RPG in the style of the early Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest. The road is long and perilous, and a Dragon waits at every corner.

name: The Fantastic Kitty Rue
summary: On the retro-futuristic planet of Felmuria lives a little girl named Felicity Rue. Despite living in destitution, she dreams of becoming the most famous tap dancer in the galaxy! The Fantastic Kitty Rue is a blend of visual novel, point-and-click, and rhythm game!

name: The Woods
summary: Explore, build, craft and survive on a mysterious forest island.

name: The Lik
summary: "The Lik" is a horror story about a father who came to the temple with the last hope of saving his daughter. But now she is not the only one who needs help... You will have to get to know the temple better to make the right decision when the time comes... If, of course, you want to survive.

name: The Muller-Powell Principle
summary: You awake and find yourself in a parallel dimension. The year is 2032. All you can remember is that you’ve been participating in some kind of experiment that went horribly wrong. Travel through parallel worlds to get back home and uncover your past in this puzzle game where sci-fi meets surrealism.

name: The Last of Them
summary: Complete missions across different regions to stop the infection. ️ Promote your rank to unlock new weapons. Make radio calls for for air aid, supply packages, etc.

name: The Longest Road on Earth: World Tour Bundle
summary:
This World Tour Bundle includes:
• The Longest Road on Earth
• The Longest Road on Earth bundle exclusive soundtrack
• 3 master tracks – perfect for remixes!
• A selection of chords and lyrics sheets
• A behind-the-scenes documentary about the development of The Longest Road on Earth and its soundtrack
• An art book chalked full of stunning pixel-art

name: ThanksKilling Day
summary:
The boy, who was about to celebrate Thanksgiving Day with his family, finds himself stuck in a house with a dangerous stranger who seems to be responsible for his parent's disappearance.

A bleak, cold, and dark night was certainly the perfect setting for the sinister events, that you will be forced to witness for yourself!

Run, Hide, Solve Survive!

Featuring an incredible voice cast including Doug Cockle (Geralt from the Witcher series), Sandy Johnson (1978's Halloween), Christopher Murray (twin peaks, parks and rec), CinnamonToastKen (Professional Youtuber) & many more!

name: The Siren's Song
summary: A brief kinetic novel for the O2A2 2022 game jam, a marine biologist falls down a trench and meets a siren, upon which they develop a rich infatuation.

name: The Surge 2: Public Enemy Weapon Pack
summary: Expand your The Surge 2 experience with the Public Enemy Weapon Pack and get access to 13 brand new weapons. From pillaged CREO equipment to nanite-infected staves and recycled rotor blades, find the enemies that equip them, cut them off and equip them for yourself in your fight for Jericho City!

name: The Surge 2: Jericho's Legacy Gear Pack
summary: Expand your The Surge 2 experience with the Jericho's Legacy Gear Pack and get access to 3 new armor sets. Fight your way out of the city with the brutally stylish beast Tank Buster, the sleek Kyoko Hacker Suit and Jericho's official Firetails Mascot! Find the enemies wearing them, cut them off and equip them for yourself!

name: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing II: Complete Pack
The Akupara Classics Bundle
summary: Enjoy three of the first titles Akupara Games ever published, spooky mystery, Whispering Willows; effortlessly cool racer, Desert Child; and high-octane, twin-stick shooter, Relic Hunters Zero.

name: The Artful Adventures Bundle
summary: Play two beautiful, masterpiece adventures where immersive art features just as much as cryptic mystery in Mutazione and Behind the Frame.

name: The Guardian Stone
summary: The Guardian Stone is a online third person Action Tower Defense Game with Rpg elements and mulitplayer. Set in the fantasy world of Elrone, You play as a hero protecting the realm from the forces of evil.

name: The Sacred Pools
summary:
The Sacred Pools is an unreleased FMV game by Sega, planned for release in 1997.
Thanks to Joe Cain, former game tester at Sega of America and associate producer David Gray it was uncovered and uploaded in October 2022.

name: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind - Siege at Firemoth
summary: Siege at Firemoth is an official plugin that adds a small island chain southwest of Seyda Neen, and a small quest involving taking out a large army of skeletons. Unlike most areas in the game, this place is very combat-oriented—you may find yourself facing dozens of enemies at one time. At the end, you will face Grurn, the leader of the island's undead, and a powerful lich to boot. You will be rewarded with the Ward of Akavir, a shield with a constant effect Fortify Luck enchantment.

name: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind - Helm of Tohan
summary: Helm of Tohan is an official plugin that includes a new quest to find the titular legendary artifact. The quest can be started by asking for rumors around Dagon Fel, which will direct you to the Daedric ruin of Onnissiralis. Outside the ruin are two warring brothers, one of whom will accompany you as you enter the ruins to find the artifact. It is not an Artifact in the usual sense in TES games, as it does not come pre-enchanted.

name: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind - Master Index
summary: Master Index is an official plugin that adds a new quest to find all ten Propylon Indices. The quest can be started by talking to Folms Mirel at the Guild of Mages in Caldera. Completing the quest will earn you the Master Propylon Index, which allows for easier transport via the propylon chamber system.

name: The Elder Scrolls III: Morrowind - Entertainers
summary: Entertainers is a plugin that adds the option to entertain the patrons of the Eight Plates in Balmora for Dulnea Ralaal. You can perform a variety of tricks to receive a small cash reward.

name: The Vanishing Hitchhiker
summary: The legend tells the story of a young girl who appears mysteriously on dangerous curves of the road. Make different choices to discover all the alternate endings and find out how the story unfolds.

name: The Barker & Mustard Files
summary:
The Barker & Mustard Files is a 2D/3D Mystery-Adventure game where you play as a dashingly daring dynamic duo of Dog Detectives by the names of Harvey Barker and Frank Mustard.

Point and click your way through the luxurious Clydesdale Hotel, meet the multitude of suspicious sweeties and dubious degenerates contained within, and solve a wide variety of puzzles on your journey to unravel the mysterious disappearance of the bashful Beaver, Stuart "Flappy" Brown.

It's a tough gig, being a detective. And it's tougher still when nobody gives you the respect you deserve. Harvey and Frank have been pounding the proverbial pavement for years, doing big-time work for small-time pay, only to get credit snatched away by the (sometimes literal) Vultures at the Scarlet City Police Department.

But all of that changed when the case of a lifetime fell right into their laps... along with a couple of trigger-happy, gun-toting thugs. But a little bullet-themed office redecoration courtesy of those two-bit toughs wasn't about to scare Harvey Barker and Frank Mustard off the biggest case (and biggest paycheque) they've ever had...

So grab a good snack, your beverage of choice, and head on down to the Clydesdale Hotel... because it's time to crack this case wide open!

name: The Fisherman: Fishing Planet - Trophy Catch Pack
summary: It’s time to score BIG with some real Trophies! All you need is skills, patience, persistence and the Trophy Catch Pack to maximize your chances of landing trophy-sized fish!

name: The Dark Pictures: Switchback VR
summary: Immerse yourself in this fast-paced rollercoaster action-horror shooter. Experience the thrill of VR roller coaster action-shooter, enhanced by the innovative features of PlayStation VR2 and set inside the world of The Dark Pictures Anthology.

name: The Temple Of
summary:
The Temple Of is a Roguelike Dungeon Crawler game. It is 3D, procedurally generated, and packed with ancient horror around every corner! Use your torch to find secret passageways, treasures, and mysteries all while avoiding (or seeking?) the supernatural. Explore ever changing environments, from dusty and forgotten tombs to subterranean jungles.

Experience exploration like never before in a brand new horror adventure beneath the sands of Egypt! Grab your torch and load your pistol, for there's treasure to find, mysteries to solve, and nightmares to uncover.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel IV - Attachment Set
summary: A set of attachments that will let you accessorize behind your wildest dreams.

name: The Ball 2
summary: The Ball 2 is a 2.5D physics based Platformer where you play as a Ball. You can finish little puzzles or play them against others in the Online mode. You can also play in the Challenge mode where you can play different challenges and compete with all other players for the fastes finish Time! The Ball 2 also has a Level editor and Steam Workshop Support for levels made by the community. The Ball 2 also saves Replays of your best best runs and if you got the world record your run gets uploaded so that all other players can see it.

name: The Contract Bound
summary: The Contract Bound is a linear, fully voiced kinetic-NVL that's a bit audio-book + a bit puppet show + a bit D&D-inspired tomfoolery!

name: The Metronomicon: Slay the Dance Floor - Indie Game Challenge Pack 1
summary: Three amazing songs from some classic indie games, three new challenges, and three new awesome pieces of gear! Test your Metronomicon skill to the max with Indie Game Challenge Pack 1!

name: The Witcher: The Price of Neutrality
summary:
The Price of Neutrality is a premium module for The Witcher, created by CD PROJEKT RED and released on April 10, 2008, together with the D'jinni Adventure Editor. The original adventure required Patch 1.3 to work, but had no voice acting. The next patch, version 1.4 or The Witcher: Enhanced Edition, added Side Effects premium module, and voice acting for both modules.

While the plot itself is new, the locations were originally meant to be included in the main game, but were cut from the final version.

name: The Witcher: Side Effects
summary: Side Effects is a fully voiced premium module for The Witcher, created by CD PROJEKT RED. It was released on September 16, 2008 as part of the The Witcher: Enhanced Edition.

name: The Light Brigade
summary: A roguelike VR shooter with realistic gunplay and immersive light magic. Ascend the ranks of The Light Brigade to unlock new weapons, upgrades, classes, and abilities as you fight to restore light to the darkness.

name: The World's Hardest Game 2
summary: This is The World's Hardest Game #2! It is harder than any game you have ever played, or ever will play. Work your way through 50 incredibly hard levels and claim your spot on the world highscore board.

name: Thick as Thieves
summary:
Enter the shadows in this introduction to Thick as Thieves. In the shadow-draped streets of Kilcairn, fortune favours the bold. As a member of the Thieves' Guild, you'll undertake daring heists to claim precious heirlooms and uncover arcane secrets hidden within this alternate-history 1910s Scottish city, where magic and early technology have begun to collide.

Whether working alone or playing online co-op, only the most cunning will seize their fortune in Thick as Thieves!

name: The Quarry: '50s Throwback Character Outfits
summary: Travel back in time with your favorite counselors!

name: The Enemy Approached the Walls
summary: "The Enemy Approached The Walls"is a war strategy game. You will play a commander, choose different card combinations to improve the combat effectiveness of the army, recruit and deploy soldiers in real time according to the battlefield situation, and finally repel the enemy.

name: The World of the Candy Girl
summary: The World of The Candy Girl is an action game in which you are a young female shooter with super powers, and must destroy hordes of enemies to save all the candy in the world.

name: The Gravehouse
summary: Take on the role of a defenseless man in this survival-horror game and experience frightening evil firsthand: A trap leads you straight into a gloomy mansion where gruesome things are going on. A creepy life and death adventure begins that will take you to dark cellars, jails and even worse places..

name: The Bunnyman
summary: TheBunnyMan is a psychological horror inspired on newspaper and police archives. Police in Virginia has issued a public appeal to find a pregnant woman after reports of her missing. Her husband, a journalist is out to find her after the police search went cold. Something Evil is lurking...

name: The Ghost and The Phoenix
summary: We've all asked ourselves, "What happens when we die? Is there life after death? Is there a soul? What happens to it when we die? " Move beyond the veil of life and death in The Ghost and The Phoenix, a supernatural neo-classical top-down shooter!

name: The Good Ghouls
summary: The Good Ghouls is a brawler-meets-adventure game combining beat 'em up gameplay with campy horror fun. Play and upgrade your favorite ghoul, meet quirky characters alongside a killer soundtrack, and fight a demonic robot uprising to take back the town of Ghoulcrest.

name: The Exorcist's Story
summary: You are in the role of a young priest Antonio, who previously had experience in the rites of exorcism, but one day everything went wrong and a girl died during the rite.The devil Asmodeus was stronger.Antonio avoided prison, but promised himself never to perform exorcisms again.

name: Throw Wizard
summary: A Roguelite, Top-Down, Action, Adventure where a Silly Little Wizard Braves the Depths of a New Dungeon! Battle Tenacious Monsters and Enemies who will not relent until the Squid Lord has his Claim on the Land!

name: The Wayhaven Chronicles: Book Three
summary: Your decisions will shape who is friend or foe, who will share in your secrets, and just how your romance with a certain vampire will grow!

name: They are in the Trees
summary: Prussia 1892, It's been five years since your old man mysteriously disappeared in the woods. After all this time, you decided to search for him. But after a short while, you realise that you are not alone in the woods. Something is lurking in the trees and they will hunt you by night.

name: The Day That Changed My Life
summary: The Day That Changed My Life is a mystery-horror visual novel. It's designed for both fans of visual novels and those who find story-driven games tedious. Decipher the murky tale accompanied by a hundred-plus-piece score and a mountain of artwork.

name: The Helper
summary: The Helper is a fast-moving, energetic, fun and madness-packed 2D video game that allows you to play as “The Helper” (hence the name, duh!), a lad that helps The Professor by gathering Gravity Crystals for his secret experiment.

name: The Moon Hell
summary: The Moon Hell is a very difficult third-person action RPG set in a fantasy mood in all game elements: sound, levels, light, atmosphere and other.

name: The Gods Are Fickle
summary: Your army of souls has been summoned by vain gods - fight for their glory or spit in their face! Embark in roguelite campaigns or fight other players. Discover new Souls & Artifacts, create quirky builds. Anticipate moves & checkmate your opponent in this tactical turn-based meets card collectable!

name: The Nihil War
summary: The Nihil War is a game that blends cinematic platformer, base management, and strategy into one package. Set in a post-apocalyptic world, you will take the role of a young prince accused of being involved in your father's death. Build your forces, traverse the beautiful world, and unveil the truth!

name: The Slothgate Experiment
summary: The Creature Zone Returns In An Unexpected Way… The Slothgate Experiment is a physics-heavy vr game that takes place in Los Angeles, California, where Oliver Franklin has recently moved into an apartment. He is captured and taken to slothgate two weeks after he gets a job at a warehouse.

name: The Old Ultraviolet
summary: JRPG-styled historical magical-realism indie, set in 1970s U.S.A. - The Old Ultraviolet, hallmark of '70s alt-culture, suddenly pivots from diverse concert venue to corporate discotheque! Outraged, The Vinyl Club sets off to save The T.O.U. from the clutches of disco and its new corporate overlords.

name: The Iron Union
summary: Greetings tank commander,and welcome to the《The Iron Union》.In this game,you will prove yourself by using your tanks to break though the blockade,and eliminate all your enemy.

name: The Outer Space Bugs
summary: Exterminate the bugs that are hidden on the dark side of the moon. A game based on space exploration, with a variety of items and monsters and a evil to be defeated. Adventure in this space experience and destroy them.

name: The Reaper Survivors
summary: The Reaper Survivors – 2D roguelike combined with some RPG elements that takes place in the gothic world. As a reaper of death, you have to fight hordes of dark forces.

name: The Rules
summary: In this first-person horror survival game, you must Follow the Rules, keep a clear head, and be attentive. Only then may you live to see the end of the night. Relying on ambient horror and speech recognition to keep the player on their toes, this is a horror game like you've never played before.

name: The Heart Defenders
summary: Building defender 2D strategy game! Place building and gather resources. Use the resources you collect to then build towers that will defend your heart in the middle of the map. Survive as many levels as you can manage! Good luck!

name: The Mighty Eighth VR
summary: The Mighty 8th VR puts you in the shoes of a B-17 Flying Fortress crew member at the height of the Strategic Bombing Campaign over Europe. Partner up with friends and do your part to ensure that the plane reaches the target and returns home safely.

name: The Fall
summary: A short visual novel about a man living its worst nightmare. There is no way out, no safe place, no death, just eternal limbo. Only you can help him... if that's what you want.

name: The Karaoke
summary: The Karaoke is a Japanese horror game about a girl at a Karaoke.

name: The Night of The Penanggalan
summary: Retro styled low budget Asian Indie Walking Simulator Horror Game. Based on Malaysian and Indonesian supernatural beliefs, where the protagonist is a young pregnant mum to be who is being targeted and stalked by the feared night creature, The Penanggalan, or "The Flying Head".

name: The Spider
summary:
It’s the year 2199 and your ship has been caught in a batch of strong magnetic storms and has somehow wound up near a black hole that is spewing robotic spiders and other insect-like creatures that are now attacking your ship.

Programmed by Toshiyuki Sasagawa, who would go onto write music for many popular Hudson Soft games.

name: The Sims
summary: Home consoles version of The Sims.

name: The Slaughter Spectrum
summary: The Slaughter Spectrum is a five-map PK3 for Doom II and the GZDoom source port created by Bridgeburner56 in May 2019. It is a collection of slaughter maps that were influential for introducing a fresh visual style to the genre. At the 2019 Cacowards, this mapset was a runner-up, and Bridgeburner56 was named a promising newcomer.

name: The Long Trek Back Home
summary: Meant to be an immediate follow-up to the story of Doom II, it features maps that are heavily inspired by their original counterparts, but with a reversed progression. The player begins at the destroyed Icon of Sin site and retraces their steps through the Hell levels, city levels and finally the starport levels, while facing increasingly heavy demonic opposition and changed, mostly destroyed and twisted architecture heavily reminiscent of the original layouts.

name: The Cleaner
summary:
Play as a mysterious trauma cleaner as he faces the end of society as we know it, brought to its knees by a new and unknown phenomenon that has no cure.

Having given up on most things, every day feels to him like the same sluggish chore of waking up, cleaning, going to sleep and repeating.

That is, until he receives a request like none other from a man he barely knows.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man: Webslinger
summary: The Amazing Spider-Man: Webslinger is a rhythm video game developed and published for mobile games. The idea behind Webslinger is to help Spider-Man swing on his webs to protect the streets.

name: The Ninja
summary: Adventure through the dark region of the Hado empire to find what is in the darkness that lies there and to go up against enemies that'll try to stop you.

name: The Letter: Classic Edition
summary: The Letter: Classic Edition is the ORIGINAL experience from the classic title "The Letter", with a few changes and additions. Relive the Wii U game that gathered so much hate it became a cult classic. Embark on a creepy narrative driven tale about a boy in search of his missing father.

name: The Tower
summary: The Tower is a casual-action style game with various levels and a final boss level. In this game, one must find or craft new weapons to defeat your foes, the chicken army. Along with enemy chickens, the Chicken Elder has also set up various traps and obstacles that block your way to him. Good luck!

name: The Qin Empire
summary: Set in the most dramatic era in Chinese history! Let's conquer the world like the first emperor by making full use of strategy and wisdom! This is the war that leads to the First Emperor!

name: The Wolf Within
summary: The Wolf Within is a small single-player exploration game about a wolf's journey in a mysterious, beautiful world.

name: The Adventures of Snacky
summary: The Adventures of Snacky is a cute and fun platform jumper. You as snacky the vending machine must run jump and shoot your way through this new and hostile world, avoiding obstacles Emery's finding checkpoints and coins.

name: The Secret Pyramid

name: The Girl With the Gray Hair Awakens
summary: "A girl wakes up in a strange room, unsure of who she is... Play multiple times to uncover the full story!"

name: The Sims 2
summary: The console versions of The Sims 2 featured local splitscreen multiplayer, a story mode and an option to control game characters directly, as opposed to queuing options as is traditional Sims gameplay. In this videogame, you cannot have children nor age, but you are only adults (excluding elders), even though you can get married. You must earn aspiration points to unlock rewards by filling up your "goals" which will also be needed to complete story mode. Story mode is a sequence of multiple levels along with developed storylines which each character asks you to fulfill wants that pertain to their story. There is also a sandbox mode where you can live in a preset family or build your own.

name: The Far Rings
summary: Play as Athena, a doctor of mixed heritage torn between two worlds, as she tries to find her true home alongside two possible suitors!

name: The Life Threads
summary: A teacher and his bodyguard on a journey across the desert sands, what sort of fate awaits them?

name: The Citizen Kane of Video Games
summary: Memories at once real and imagined! Experience Citizen Kane as never before! From the palatial Xanadu to the deathbed of Charles Foster Kane! Be amazed by a spectacle of sight and sound. Play through Every Single Shot of The Classic Movie! (for 5 minutes) At long last! The Citizen Kane of Video Games!!

name: The No Button Game
summary: The No Button Game is a fast paced button-free platform game that does not require the use of buttons or sticks to be played. Place your wireless controller on a box then tap with your fingers and it is done! Don't you have a wireless controller or a box handy? No worries, there's the one button mode.

name: The Table Game: Deluxe Pack
summary: You can play Othello, Mahjong, Shogi, Igo, Hanafuda, Texas Hold'em, Chess, Backgammon, all in this single package!

name: These Trees Are Spectral Fingers
summary: Your car has broken down in the middle of nowhere. Surrounded by age-old trees, you walk down the road in search of help,… with no idea of what lurks in these old forests.

name: The Sims 4: Everyday Sims Bundle
summary: The Everyday Sims Bundle will transform how your Sims live day to day, from teaching life lessons to child Sims to doing their laundry!

name: The Sims 4: Pet Lovers Bundle
summary: The Pet Lovers Bundle will nourish your caring side. Help Sims develop their parenting skills or care for neighborhood pets as a veterinarian. You can even create a variety of cats and dogs to add to your Sims' homes, forever changing their lives!

name: The Sims 4: Decorator's Dream Bundle
summary: The Decorator's Dream Bundle will have you creating in style. Delight in the quaint charm of a country cottage or create a tiny, comfy, home - you can even become an interior designer and turn your client's fantasy into reality!

name: The Seaside Inn
summary:
You arrive in the small town of Cauwick Bay to help your Aunt Jody run her bed & breakfast, The Seaside Inn. It’s a place steeped in memories from your childhood, and your summer awaits.

The two people at the centre of your time in Cauwick Bay are Melani, a mermaid curious about life on land, and Taylor, a young man on the brink of deciding his future.

Both have individual romance routes, and can also be romanced together in a polyamorous route. Romance is not required, and you can befriend the characters instead.

name: The Rumble Fish 2: Greed
summary: Adds the character Greed.

name: Thomas and the Magic Railroad Print Studio
summary: Thomas and the Magic Railroad Print Studio is a PC CD-ROM game based on the movie Thomas and the Magic Railroad. It was released by Hasbro Interactive in the UK only and features narration by Michael Angelis.

name: The Woodsman
summary: The Woodsman retells Little Red Riding Hood as a narrative point and click game set in a richly haunted forest world.

name: The Bible Game
summary: A trivia game to test gamers' biblical knowledge, The Bible Game for Game Boy Advance combines action/adventure play style with trivia challenges. In their quest to protect the Armor of God, players may choose to play as either Billy or Jenny across seven levels, including forest, snowy tundra, desert, and tropical island environments. Along the way, they must answer questions from both the Old and New Testaments. Either the New International Version or the King James translation may be selected, and three levels of difficulty keep the game accessible for all ages.

name: The Curse of Tencond
summary: The Curse of Tencond is a short adventure game, where your player character is afflicted by a terrible curse, making them die every 10 seconds and start their journey all over again.

name: The Metronomicon: Slay the Dance Floor - The End Records Challenge Pack
The Flintstones: Dino to the Rescue
summary:
The second GBA platformer developed by Tantalus, The Flintstones is a stone splitting, hard rocking, action packed challenge for all ages. The Flintstone family has been abducted and i's up to Dino to rescue them. With the help of the Great Gazoo, Dino sets off on a journey that takes him from Bedrock to the perils of a distant galaxy. It's a prehistoric adventure with everything, as Dino leaves no stone unturned to bring Fred and the gang home to safety.

Take a whirlwind downhill ride with Dino at the wheel, ride on the backs of alligators, and overcome all manner of dastardly enemies to reach your goal and save the Flintstones. The Flintstones is hours and hours of varied gameplay. It's everything you'd expect from your favorite Stone Age pet.

name: The Incredible Hulk
summary:
The Incredible Hulk was supposed to be a video game created by toy and game manufacturer Parker Brothers in 1983 for the Atari 2600.

The release of The Incredible Hulk was scheduled for Autumn 1983. However, this period coincided with the video game crash of 1983 (following E.T.'s release in December 1982). During this crisis, numerous companies, including Parker Brothers, opted not to launch games that had already been developed for the Atari 2600. Consequently, The Incredible Hulk was never made available to the public.

name: The Sullen Boku Girls Alliance
summary: An incredibly facetious and silly short RPG in which the protagonists of six separate original projects go on an errand in attempt to make their creator get to work on their stories. Hopefully their strong personalities won't be too much of an obstacle to their quest...!

You suddenly wake up in a little fishing boat, right in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. To make things worse, you have lost all your memories! How unfortunate...

However, it's not all that bad. You will now work along with your new friend Comi at her family business, the Mauri Oceanografic Team!

Explore the seven seas, look for your lost memories, meet new friends, be a little bit rude, and much more!

The walls have been gouged open. Strange noises come from below. Apparitions bar your progress. Death has visited here.

This is the building where your girlfriend went missing. If you want to find her and save your relationship, you have only one option.

Francesca, a brilliant young transgender journalist, goes back to the house where she grew up to celebrate the birthday of her father. Unfortunately for Francesca, there's an abandoned toy factory across the street where many people have died or have been reported missing, and strange phenomena can be witnessed at night. She has always dreaded that place, and now what was supposed to be a nice celebration will turn out to be a night full of horrors beyond human comprehension...
The horrors of...The Toy Factory Across the Street...

Enter KOF Arena and become the strongest fighter in the world in the newest installment of the greatest fighting game series, The King of Fighters!

name: The Heart of the Teddy Bear

summary: The Work of Your Hands is a small-scale, deep, and relaxing open-world survival crafting game. You have no crafting screen or list of items. Harvest raw materials, create tools from them, build practical structures, and grow delicious food. You are in control of every step to live off the land.

name: Throwing Master
summary: Throwing Master is a casual competitive game played by two to four players, who make decisions based on the rules of the game and choose their preferred weapon to defeat their opponent.

name: The Search for a Colour Palette
summary: Play as Mr. Colourfool, a father looking for his son that is lost in the castle that recently appeared out of thin air. The colours are all gone, and there is a voice beckoning you towards the castle. Perhaps it is fate, or just your imagination...There is nowhere else to go anyways.

name: The Seekers: Survival
summary: After a plane crash, you are the only survivor. You will quickly find out that you are in a remote place, surrounded by unknown creatures.

name: The Sentient Box

name: The Magical Mixture Mill
summary: Brew magical mixtures for the local adventurers - and get them hooked! Team up with a mushroom-loving witch to restore her run-down shop. Build automated production lines, experiment with exotic ingredients, explore a cozy world - and try not to blow everything up.

summary: A 2.5D side scrolling, walking sim set in outback Australia. Play as a man named James whose childhood house has burnt down. He is walking to the house see if anything can be salvaged. Whist walking and talking on the phone to his wife the childhood memories come flooding in...

summary: The Alien Cube: Deluxe Edition includes the full game and Behind the scenes DLC. Discover terrifying secrets as you follow your uncle's disappearance, and confront a terrible truth that will change your life forever in this first-person cosmic horror.

name: The Isle Tide Hotel
summary: A live-action mystery FMV game, where you make decisions for a father that must rescue his teenage daughter from an eclectic cult before their final night at the Isle Tide Hotel. Save Eleanor Malone by making decisions, collecting clues, solving puzzles and unlocking hidden scenes and endings.

name: The Long Dark: Tales from the Far Territory
summary: The first paid Expansion for the award-winning survival experience, THE LONG DARK. Explore the vast and mysterious Far Territory, deep in the heart of Great Bear. Extract its dark secrets. Navigate its treacherous Regions. And most of all: strive to survive.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel IV - Standard Costume Bundle
summary: A set of costumes and accessories perfect for those seeking new looks and classic styles alike (Altina's Black Rabbit Costume x 1, Rean's Military Uniform x 1, Kurt's Military Uniform x 1, Ash's Military Uniform x 1...)

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - New England Mountains
summary:
Welcome to New England Mountains!

Grab your gear and get ready to explore the majestic Appalachian Mountains! Pit your wits against a new Great One, discover three remastered animals, and check in with an old friend in this beautiful location.

name: The Barnacle Goose Experiment
summary: An abiogenesis body horror idle clicker about a researcher locked in a biodome tasked with generating a working world out of their own body.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Seasoned Hunter Bundle
summary: Ready to Roam? Let's go! With a wide array of weapons at your disposal, high-tech gear and your trusty hound at your side, the Seasoned Hunter Bundle has everything you need to survive and thrive in the wider world of theHunter: Call of the Wild.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Master Hunter Bundle
summary: You've outgrown your home territory - now the world's your oyster! With the Master Hunter Bundle you're ready for anything! From the frozen wilds of Medved-Taiga National Park to the plains of Vurhonga Savannah, your gear will carry you through.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Greenhorn Bundle
summary: The Greenhorn Bundle is perfect for Hunters who are looking for a head-start on the hunting trail. Explore the reserves of theHunter: Call of the Wild in an ATV, get to know your faithful Bloodhound, and explore the variety of gear available.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Essentials DLC Bundle
summary: The Essentials DLC Bundle has everything a Hunter needs to get started. Take a spin in the ATV, head out on a hike with your faithful Bloodhound and brand-new rifle, and lay out your trophies for all to see at the Saseka Safari Trophy Lodge.

name: The Deadly Cursed Enjmin Steamroller in: The Bloody Killing on Wheel in the Atrium
summary: You're playing a cursed steamroller that must kill cultists to summon the demon that cursed you.

name: The Eminence in Shadow: Master of Garden
summary: Modeled after the anime. The Eminence in Shadow RPG is a continues action style RPG With combo skills and ultimate's to change the tide of battle. The units are reskinned as A/S/SS/SS+ and can be different elements depending on there rarity. It is highly recommended to start building a single element team as soon as you can to truly dominate the battlefield!

name: The Spectator
summary: The world is on the verge of collapse. The once fertile lands have become barren. The sun, once a beacon of life, has become a sign of terror. The temperature is unbearable. Living things live in constant fear and seek shelter from the scorching light.

name: The Great War: Day 13
summary: The Great War: Day 13 provides a unique combination of Hack 'n' Slash, beat'em up and on-chariot archery game-play. It has Archers, soldiers, dual sword soldiers, mace soldiers, spear soldiers, etc.

name: The Continents: Breakthrough Gaming Activity Center
summary:
A game in the "Breakthrough Gaming Activity Center" series!
This game's release is part of Breakthrough Gaming's "Bible Video Game Sundays"!

name: The Asher Asylum
summary: Explore the abandoned Asher Asylum in an effort to find a missing cop. Learn about the horrors plaguing the old asylum, and try to find a way to stop its cursed residents from leaving. This indie horror FPS is designed as a throw-back to the late 2000s indie horror scene.

name: The Widow's Boutique
summary: Step into 1820s small town society in this historically accurate visual novel, filled with drama, dresses and danger.

name: The Tales of Imjin War
summary: Join the epic journey of the Yuldogook warriors to uncover the truth behind the Imjin War and end the war once and for all.

name: The Backrooms Together
summary: 1-4 player online co-op horror game! You find yourself in the backrooms. Luckily your friends are there too. Are they really there with you? Are they just an illusion? Try to survive and escape as fast as you can, before the entities find you. Search for books and reveal the truth of the backrooms!

name: The Game of Life 2: Under the Sea
summary: Swim through a new life adventure in Under the Sea world! Flash your fins in the Mermaid outfit and become one with marine life in the Seahorse Onesie. Face your first crossroads in the Seaweed Forest and make a splash in the Bustling Reef. In this watery world, every choice turns the tide!

name: There Was a Mixup at the Factory!
summary:
One of Funny Jester's duties as president of the Fiscal Jesters is quality control of the group's officially licensed fruit snacks, Juicy Jesters. However, there was a mixup at the factory and the Peachy Platinum gummies were replaced with actual platinum coins!

To preserve the financial solvency of the Fiscal Jesters, you simply must match as many rows or columns of snacks as possible, and fish out as many coins as you can before your forklift breaks down! But be careful, there have been other mixups at this factory before, and there will be more mixups at the factory.

name: The Jumping Choco Santa
summary: Join Big C on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: Thunderbolt Poker
summary: Collect ring fragments to forge your legend ring! Treasure chests with great rewards! Rise through the leagues to become the poker legend!

name: The Squash P
summary: Hit the ball to become the best squash player in the world.

name: The Great Book of Mario
summary: The Great Book of Mario is a text hack of Super Paper Mario created by Solargress. The original game's script is placed through oscillating translations on Google Translate, creating a new plot and comedic moments.

name: The Mechsmith Run=Dim
summary: In the year 2052, global warming has melted the polar ice caps and entire land masses plunge under the swells of newborn water. Charged with the task of saving what's left of the economy, you and a team of techs develop mecha to help achieve salvation.

name: The Button Be: Mizzle
summary: Meet a grand mysterious construction. Bring out some awesome things in this bite-sized experimental quest.

name: The Ugly Ducling
summary: The Ugly Ducling is a minimalist block-based exploration and horror game, using the children's story "The Ugly Duckling" as a theme, where the player will need to find the lost pages of the protagonist's story in different biomes, while surviving.

name: The Curse of AstaroK
summary:
The evil Astarok has cast a nasty curse on the folk of Griford and turned them into pumpkins! The town’s people have asked you to battle the AstaroK and his evil friends in their hideout - an old castle on the edge of town.

You need to fight your way in the dark castle of the evil AstaroK, by casting runes that will release different powers depending on the combinations cast. You start with a limited arsenal of skills but will be able to acquire more advanced skills with the SP (Skill Points) that you gain by winning battles in the dark castle. You may also win gold too if you are lucky! When you win a battle, you can continue further into the dungeon or head back to town to buy more supplies with your winnings.

Be careful, if you are defeated in a battle you will be warp back to town but with half of the SP that you gained during the game. You will also forfeit a helmet or potion as punishment.

name: The Bounce
summary: The Bounce is a bouncy ball physics platformer game. Simple to understand yet incredibly hard to master, what seems easy at first glance is actually pretty rage inducing when you get to the later levels. The game has a focus on simple design, which allows for easily customisable levels and awesome gameplay.

name: The Crawl
summary: The Crawl is a dungeon crawling platformer in which you have to find a path that allows you to discover enough keys to make it to the exit.

name: The Tale of Galariel
summary: You play as an orc wishing to conquer the land and make it your own, you may make allies such as Goblins, Kobolds, Dragonkin, and More. Be warned Humans and Heroes are on their way. Are you ready to conquer the land?

name: The 12th Annual Vanilla Level Design Contest: Collaboration Hack
summary: This is the collaboration hack of SMWCentral’s 12th Vanilla Level Design Contest from 2020. We started working on this hack right after the VLDC11 compilation got finished. 8 months of work that paid off in the end. This hack has 127 entries and 4 switch palaces, with 131 exits in total.

name: The 8th Annual Vanilla Level Design Contest: Collaboration Hack
summary: This is SMW Central's third completed collaboration hack based off of the 2015 Vanilla Level Design Contest (VLDC.) It contains 95 levels which you can play in any order you wish - all of them are open from the start except for the secret world, which is unlocked by completing every exit in the game.

name: The Jumping Gingerbread
summary: Join Big G on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Jumping Gingerbread: Turbo
summary: Join Big G on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Hypno Shop
summary: You have just started your own online business, where you will be commissioned to create the perfect hypnotic spiral to help your clients get off. You'll be rated on how well you fulfill their kinks and other preferences.

name: There is a Genie in my Szechuan Sauce: Remastered
summary:
"There is a Genie in my Szechuan Sauce Remastered" is a remaster of a game made in 2017.

This will be the most epic of throwback, relive all the best classic memes from 2014 through 2017 with this meme time capsule!

This is an interactive story featuring Jeff in his quest for the tasty and nasty Szechuan Sauce, when he finds out that his best friend Paul has it at his house, he literally walks to his house to get a taste! But Paul forgot to buy some tasty chicken nuggets... What will they do? Lick the sauce directly from the cup? No, ask a magic genie to give them some nuggies of course!

Relive this 2017 classic from Kimulator's Films in their first remaster of one of their first game ever!

name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance
summary: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance is the ultimate edition of the award-winning roguelike twin-stick shooter. It includes all the content from previous editions of The Binding of Isaac (Rebirth, Afterbirth and Afterbirth+) plus Repentance, the game's final and biggest-ever expansion, adding hundreds of additional new features, modes, and improvements. Experience the modern classic like it's never been seen before!

name: The Social Distance Game
summary: Get more points by keeping your distance from pedestrians and make your community proud.

name: The 7th Annual Vanilla Level Design Contest: Collaboration Hack
summary: For the past seven years, SMW Central has held a vanilla level design contest every spring. “Vanilla level design” refers to using only Lunar Magic to create your level - that is, no custom blocks, no custom sprites, and no custom code of any sort. They eventually began allowing people to use custom music, but this is not factored into their score. Once they finished designing their level, they would submit an IPS file, it would get judged + ranked, and that would be the end of it. This year, however, S.N.N. decided to assign resources (secondary exits, Map16 slots, etc) to users with the intention of putting all of their levels into a ROM and essentially creating a full hack out of it. The hack features 82 submitted entries and 4 switch palaces, which makes a grand total of 86 levels for you to beat. All of the levels are open from the start - you can play them in any order you’d like. To help you keep track of your progress, the game autosaves on the world map and beating a level will give you an “M” in the top right corner of the overworld. As a disclaimer, the levels are organized on the overworld by theme, and not by ranking. This means that the quality of the levels might fluctuate dramatically from one to the next (e.g. having a 70th place entry directly before a 12th place entry). The bottom 8 and top 8 each have their own world, however, so it’s easy to distinguish them from the rest.

name: The Unofficial Squaresoft MUD
summary:
The Unofficial Squaresoft MUD is a free online text-based fan-game, which is based on the worlds and combat systems of various Squaresoft games. UOSSMUD includes a class system based primarily on Final Fantasy Tactics, and worlds based on Chrono Trigger, Secret of Mana, and Final Fantasy 5, 6, and 7. It has a focus on accurately recreating these worlds from the original games and mirroring their storylines in missions.

In addition to the above, UOSSMUD also has smaller amounts of content from a wide variety of Squaresoft and Square Enix games. There are classes based on the combat system from SaGa Frontier, bosses from Xenogears, and a roguelike mode based on Chocobo's Mysterious Dungeon. This is a MUD with fast-paced combat, and a multiclassing system that allows for a wide variety of strategies.

UOSSMUD has a blind user mode available to improve the experience for those who use a screen reader to play.

name: The Sims 3: Pets
summary: Bring excitement and surprise into your Sims' lives with pets in The Sims 3: Pets, an expansion pack for The Sims 3! Create the perfect (or imperfect) pets for your Sims, from fierce guard dogs to destructive kittens to trusty horses and more as you determine not only how your Sims' pets look but their personality traits as well. With a variety of new activities and social interactions, take direct control of your Sims' pets and explore new ways to mess with their lives. Give your Sims a new member of their household and discover all-new ways to play with life!

name: The Mayor of Sanctuary
summary:
As Yuu, the former mayor of Anzen, you had hoped for a quiet retirement away from the hustle of civic life. However, the peace you sought is shattered when a wave of cursed spirits begin to emerge from the once tranquil forests of Sanctuary. It is now up to you to return to Anzen and connect with its inhabitants to unravel the mysteries behind the unrest.

Will you be able to uncover the sinister forces that lie beneath and restore harmony to Anzen?

Embark on a journey of casual exploration through a large unique map, brimming with charming characters and captivating scenery. This leisurely experience offers mild combat, light puzzles, and hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.

name: The Great Battle Pocket
summary: The Great Battle Pocket is a classic game for the Game Boy Color platform. It offers exciting action, strategy, and role-playing elements to keep players engaged. With its captivating storyline and challenging gameplay, players can expect an immersive experience as they navigate through various levels. The game allows you to control a variety of characters and engage in epic battles against formidable enemies. Overall, The Great Battle Pocket delivers a thrilling gaming experience that combines multiple genres seamlessly.

name: The Jumping Cookie
summary: Join Big C on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Jumping Cookie: Turbo
summary: Join Big C on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Lake of the Blind Mannequin
summary: You're an old fisherman, who lives by catching fish all his life. One day his lake was closed, because people kept missing there and rumours say that the Blind Mannequin is behind all of this. But the fisherman is old and has nothing to lose, so he sneaks in...

name: The Cooking Class
summary:
Come Cook With Us

Welcome in the Dupont Family. A nice, quiet household in the Nova Scotia province of Atlantic Canada. Let's learn together how to cook delicious meals for you and your family. Because remember, can't live with an empty belly!

Find the right VHS scattered around the house through a randomic system of placement in order to find the code to escape the house.
Good Luck!

The Cooking Class is an horror escape room, there are no hints, no clues, you are completely alone.
Or, are you?

The first of a scheduled trilogy of games involving the Dupont Family, The Cooking Class is an homage to VHS found footage horror, 80's and 90's slasher movies, and the story of a family and its legacy.

A first person atmospheric game, where the player will have to find its way out.

name: The Quiz Room
summary: The Quiz Room is an educational game by the New South Wales government about drug and alcohol use. The game plays as a trivia cube where you are given various multiple choice questions about negative side affects of drugs and alcohol and you have to answer them correctly to fill out each side of the cube. The game ends after each side of the cube is complete, or after you get 3 incorrect answers.
developers: NSW Health and the Alcohol And Drug Information Service
publishers: NSW Health and the Alcohol And Drug Information Service

name: The Little Mermaid Pinball
summary: The Little Mermaid Pinball is video game developed for Windows by Disney Interactive and published by Disney Online. It was released on July 11, 2005.

name: The Feast
summary:
The Feast is a short and intensely dramatic experience designed to be completed in one sitting (20-30 minutes).

This dark and peculiar spectacle grants you the lead role. In a theatrical setting, survive the utterly confusing and twisted dinner. You will be observed and judged, so face reality, weigh every action, consider possible outcomes, make choices - and define the conclusion of this life-changing celebration.

After all, what happens here is not your problem…
… or is it?

name: The Mold Exorcist
summary: You are a mold remediator, just doing their job.

name: The Rex T
summary: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat steaks with the main hero of the game The Rex T and eat all the steak in the world!

name: The Cleft of Dimensions
summary:
The Cleft of Dimensions is a text adventure MMO (aka, a MUD) with content inspired by classic video games.
Do you want to jump on goombas? Maybe you'd rather immolate them with lava or bombard them with meteors. You could always confuse them into hitting themselves. Then again, why fight goombas when you could enslave them into your army? If that doesn't work out, you've got this motorcycle you could crash into them. The Cleft has 16 character classes, each with a different play style.
Gameplay in the Cleft is as much about exploring as it is about killing things. Secret treasure is hidden everywhere, waiting to be claimed by those willing to endeavour. Quests are prominent, with activities ranging from committing industrial espionage for a paranoid innkeeper to seeking the blessings of the mana spirits. To top it all off, we have an active roleplaying community to make your own story part of the Cleft.

name: The Adventures of Catto Boi
summary: The Adventures of Catto Boi is the first of many adventures featuring an angry cat who has to find lost cat biscuits scattered all over some random, poorly designed levels.

name: The Game of Life 2: Deluxe Life Bundle
The 1st Annual Vanilla Level Design Contest: Collaboration Hack
summary:
This a compilation of the levels from the 2008 Vanilla Level Design Contest (VLDC)

It contains 50 levels which you can play in any order you wish - all of them are open from the start.

name: The Hacker
summary: When a computer programming agency catches his friends, a computer hacker must go online into the virtual world in order to rescue them.

name: The Game of Life 2: Ultimate Life Collection
The Knight of the Crimson Tower
summary: Laura is a daughter of the lord of the Crimson Tower. To impress her friends she steals a certain thing from an old witch, so the witch curses her: now, when the full moon rises, Laura turns into a beast and is put in a cage of her tower. But would it be enough to hold her?

name: The Inquisition: Legacy
summary:
A free, multiplayer Multi-Used Dungeon (MUD) revolving around medieval religious oppression and the fight against magic in a fantasy world. The Holy Order is the dominant faith of the Kingdom of Lithmore and guides its followers with an iron grip.

Experience a vast city filled with secrets. Craft and personalize hundreds of items. Engage in storylines, relationships and conflict with other players and staff-run plots. Cast fantastic spells in five different magical elements, or oppose magic through organised religion. Explore a setting 25 years in the making!

name: The Strange and Somewhat Sinister Tale of the House at Desert Bridge
summary: When the inventor/magician known as Old Man Bill suddenly disappears from his house in the middle of the desert, his friends, companions and pets start worrying: what could have happened? To solve this sinister mystery, they call upon their old acquaintance, pretentious game designer Jonas Kyratzes, who builds a magical portal into the Lands of Dream. Using this portal, YOU can now interact with the wondrous and colourful world of the house at Desert Bridge, and help Harold the Talking Picture Frame and his friends locate their master, Old Man Bill.

name: The Ascent of the Gothic Tower
summary: A story of mild and non-debilitating obsession.

name: The Symbiant
summary: The Symbiant is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about two men, both from vastly different worlds, embracing their sexuality and their newfound romance. It is also a tale of interstellar friendship and being gay in space!

name: The Stars Here Below
summary: John is a young man with a secret he wishes to tell his friends. Confessing to the stars one night John find himself and his friend transported to a mysterious world where wishes can be granted.

name: That time I was about to do something important but a god zipped me to another world full of people with masks and I needed to make them fall in love with me to go back
The Split
summary: The Split is an online two player puzzle experience, designed during quarantine as a way to connect people over the internet.

name: The Elephant E
summary: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat grass with the main hero of the game The Elephant E and eat all the grass in the world!

name: Thickety Creek
summary:
What secret lies hidden behind the locked gates of Thickety Creek?

Locals talk of bank robbers and a lost fortune hidden in this forbidden forest.

name: The Haunted Song
summary:
What is it about a home that makes it feel so warm and cozy - Is it the fireplace cracking in the dim light, the placement of your favorite mug in a cabinet, or the people living within its corridors?
Moving into a new home can be exciting, but for little Song Li it was scary…
Explore a wholesome horror point and click adventure where you discover the secrets of Song Li’s new family home.

name: The Travelling Salesfrog Problem
summary: A gift for the Bitsy Secret Santa 2019

name: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Ch 2: Retribution - Payback Edition
summary: It's time to get some Payback! Get this upgrade and receive two weapon recipes, 10 collectable postcards, and a unique "Demon" storage shelf!

name: The Punchuin
summary: You are on a quest to solve the mystery of the treasure of Punch Mountain. Punch your way down, collect money and diamonds, improve your punching skills and make some new friends along the way.

name: The Jumping Muffin
summary: Join BIG M on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Jumping Muffin: Turbo
summary: Join Big M on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Dream Diary
summary: The Dream Diary is an English fangame created for the 2017 Dream Diary Jam. It is also a fangame of Cinderella Girls, a title from the Idolmaster series. You play as Uzuki Shimamura, one of the characters from Cinderella Girls, as she explores her dreams.

name: The Floor is Breathing
summary: The Floor is Breathing is a short liminal space horror game. Play through multiple perspectives as you try to understand the deaths of four innocent people.

name: The Dungeon of Doom
summary: Shareware roguelike for the classic Mac. The later commercial version was known as "The Dungeon Revealed".

name: The Land Before Time: Activity Center
summary: The Land Before Time: Activity Center is the first educational title based on the The Land Before Time movie series. This game features a selection activities featuring trivia quizzes about dinosaurs, mazes, memory games, and building their own dinosaurs and printing them out to share with friends and family. Tree stars can be earned to unlock movies to be played in the Movie Theater.

name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
summary: The Game Boy Advance port of A Link to the Past has some small design differences with the original version, like Link's voice and an additional quest and dungeon unlocked after the completion of the main content. The new dungeon is only available after finishing Four Swords.

name: The Golf G
summary: Dribble the ball to become the best golf player in the world.

name: The Snowman Story
summary: The snow has finally come, and you have the chance to build the snowmen, which you ever wanted. Go on and enjoy the snow!

name: The Jumping Onigiri
summary: Join Big O on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Jumping Onigiri: Turbo
summary: Join Big O on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump! Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

name: The Crash: Storm Clouds of the Mind
summary: The Crash: Storm Clouds of the Mind is an English Yume Nikki fangame made for Dream Diary Jam 2. The game uses Alice in Wonderland as its theme mixed with 1960's aesthetic. You play as Elizabeth, a young 1960's college student who is having weird dreams. The goal is to explore and collect effects. The player can collect items hidden in the dream world as well.

name: This Emptiness
summary: A Yume Nikki fan game set during the 1960s. Play as a Soviet spy deep inside the United States government who has bad dreams.

name: The Chicken Game
summary:
This is not your parents' chicken farming simulator. Granted, they probably didn't have a chicken farming simulator, but still!

Starting your journey as a humble farmer, you will improve and expand, unlocking and rediscovering the long lost secrets to the chicken genome. What secrets might you ask? Polka dots. And rainbow stripes. And super speed. Design your own farm, collect your crops, and create new and unique chickens in this indie pixel-art game.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ancient Dungeon
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Ancient Dungeon is a completely new way to play the original The Legend of Zelda on NES. This romhack makes The Legend of Zelda play like a roguelike. Venture through a randomized, ever-changing dungeon with progressive difficulty the further you go. Collect classic items and upgrades, and battle familiar foes throughout your journey. Every playthrough is different. Ganon is lurking deep within the dungeon, but beware, for if you perish, you’ll have to start all over from the beginning. Are you up to the challenge?

name: The Spidy Quiz
summary: Learn some amazing facts about the Spiders in this quiz game.

name: The Jhonson Parable
summary: The Jhonson Parable is a Yume Nikki fangame that centers around a man named Jhonson, who is also known as Worker #069.

name: The Better Place
summary: The Better Place is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame, where you have to collect an effect, but also orbs that are located in the dream worlds.

name: The Caverns
summary:
An employee at the roadside tourist attraction “The Caverns” falls asleep after closing down the gift shop. Explore their dreams and find the six gifts in order to wake up again.

The game was developed for Dream Diary Jam 5 and is the first entry in a series called The Night Shift Anthology.

name: The Foxglove Catcher
summary:
A young man falls down a cavern, into a different world.

The Foxglove Catcher is a Yume Nikki Fangame made for Dream Diary Jam.

name: They are Confined
summary: An entry for the Dream Diary Jam 6. You explore the protagonist's troubled past through their dreams. This game has no "Effects" to collect. Your goal is to find / view particular "Events" that will lead you to the end.

name: That's a lot of pixels!
summary: That's a lot of pixels! is a fast-paced retro mini-games compilation, it features a wide variety of genres: rogue-like, platformer, puzzle, shooters, beat'em up, ….

name: The Gods Fabled: Soil Frontier
summary: Sow life back into the land in an open-world fantasy farming experience like no other in The Gods Fabled: Soil Frontier!

name: The Telwynium: Book Two
summary:
The Telwynium Book Two continues directly from Book One. Don't worry, there's an in game re-cap if you haven't played it!

You've been betrayed! The magic wielding Aldor that rescued you from the hands of the shadowfell is dead. Your home town burns, and your only remaining childhood friend is held captive by those monsters, on the way to Targoth, south of the Burning Swamp.
