summary: Thrusta X is a unique and surprising combination of retro-style 2D shooter, adventure game, and puzzler. Varied environments & evolving storyline. Shoot to kill, shoot to solve puzzles.

name: The Fallen Night
summary: Dominate the battlefield with your cold, ruthless warrior skills and engage in deadly battles.

name: Thumb Tanks
summary: Annoy your friends and get awards for it: shoot, deploy mines, heal and use your tank's special ability to take the crown in this PVP-only split-screen game for up to four players. Collect medals and upgrade your tank after each round. Easy to learn, yet with tactical possibilities to explore.

name: The Devil's Face
summary: This horror game offers a unique and unforgettable experience, taking you on a journey into the heart of madness and terror.

name: The Eyes of Mars
summary: A thousand years beyond the fall of Earth, the return of Mars heralds doom for a small town, as foes approach under the cover of the god-storm. Sin and siege await, with only a young captain, untested and uncertain, to stand in their way...

name: The Last Hair
summary: Move, jump, toss hair! It is a simple platformer game. Reach your destination avoiding obstacles with multiple humorous elements! If you hit an obstacle and the game is over, start over! Reach your destination and meet the princess! It's a simple and fun game!

name: The Past
summary: The Past is a story-driven psychological horror and thriller game. Can you solve the events and the mystery underlying the game, which is about the reflection of the events that happened in the past to the present day of a 21-year-old university student named Enes?

name: The Empress of Aeser
summary: Make decisions, learn magic and lift the villain's curse instead of destroying her in this puzzle-adventure visual novel.

name: The Zebra-Man!
summary: The Zebra-Man! is a hyper-charged pixel art top down action game with brutal fist fights and blood spilling in your wake. You'll have to get out of impossible situations while unraveling time paradoxes and blasting the enemies you encounter along the way.

name: The Parcel
summary: The Parcel is a new style of narrative adventure game. You will enter the city of Rakuza Street, which is modeled by modern Japan, and become Shyou Mizushima, a lawyer with a sense of justice, to experience a story of confrontation with a giant pharmaceutical corporation.

name: The Bogtavern
summary: Escape the shady brackwater swamp together with the Professor and the Captn in a small Cutter, in a short, text-heavy, linear Horror-Adventure (without Jumpscares).

name: The Last Hike
summary: The Last Hike - is an excellent 2D adventure game, with elements of survival, in which you need to resist the ancient evil, playing as a knight named Richard.

name: The Wizard
summary: The Wizard is a 2D Open World game inspired on the very good Metroidvania genre titles. Talk, Run, Explore. Find secret passages and characters and discover a Fantasy World full of magic and crazy Choo Choos ruled my a Wizard. Can you find the Choo Choo Clown before your Time runs out?

name: The Lost Uncle
summary: The lost uncle is a single-player first-person adventure game with several smaller worlds filled with various stories and side activities.

name: The Last Saviour: Search of Truth
summary: You woke up as a test subject in an empty, deserted place. Here begins the study of the mysterious sequoia forest, where there are many mysteries, fantasy, wild animals. With the onset of night, there will be a meeting with the "Great", who will lead you to truth and death.

name: The Specter Chronicles: Episode 1 - The False Prophet
summary: The Specter Chronicles is a cyberpunk visual novel that combines text-based adventure with turn-based tactical combat.

name: The Orphanage
summary: Zack has a simple choice.. Run. Escape. Survive. With lots of puzzles to solve, Keys to find, Puzzle items to obtain to help progress through the game to lead to your escape. Will you live to tell the tale of JJ Randalls Orphanage?

name: The Cursed Knight
summary: The Cursed Knight is an action / platform / shoot‘em up game, based on a « die and retry » style and made with love and passion to pay tribute to the games made in the 90s.

name: The Hero's Journey Through Time
summary: On your journey you will meet a wide variety of heroes who are as different as fire and ice. You will meet brave warriors who risk their lives for their beliefs, but also benevolent magicians who use their powers for the good of others.

name: The Futanati
summary: Being the curious hacker, you stumble upon something that wasn't meant for your eyes. Something sinister, strange and...sexy.

name: The Secrets of Hope
summary: Lose yourself in an immersive story, as you follow a man coming to terms with terminal cancer. Explore a surreal world from a first-person perspective. Revisit both new and old memories and follow along as he discovers The Secrets of Hope.

name: Thronefall
summary: A minimalist game about building and defending a little kingdom. Thronefall is a classic strategy game without unnecessary complexity, just some healthy hack-and-slay. Build up your base during the day, and defend it ‘til your last breath at night.

name: The Wings of Dawn
summary: The Wings of Dawn is an open world survival game either survive as a dragon or thrive as a human. The wildlife having evolved entirely differently to anywhere on earth will pose a challenge to everyone. Do what it takes to survive the day and make sure to be in shelter at night.

name: The Hidden Object Guru
summary: The Hidden Object Guru - Find the Hidden Plushies in some of Your favorite Steam games from Archor Games and HO Guru Games !

name: The Red Abyss: Deep Below
summary: The Red Abyss deep below is a game about a detective in the underwater city of Atlan. A few days ago the mayor's wife disappeared. Will you find her, or will the abyss madness get you first?

name: The Master of Puzzles
summary: You are the bad guy. And you targeted the wrong house.

name: The Prison
summary: Your police force team has been cracking down on criminal gangs for years and taking no prisoners. The last major operation left several corrupt police heads rolling. Therefore, glory is just one step from oblivion. You’ve been framed and put in jail on trumped-up charges. Your friends still have their freedom though. The escape plan is all set, and now you’ll need all the courage, all the cunning and all the luck you have to get to freedom and clear your name. And to carry on your fight for justice.

name: The Children's Friend
summary:
Become a slightly terrifying Santa and deliver presents to children.
Observe the items in each home to decide whether the child has been good or bad, and give them the appropriate gift.
Will it be a toy… or a swing of the chainsaw?

name: The Risen Survival
summary: "The Risen Survival" is a fast-paced game that challenges players to gather resources, craft items, and build shelter in order to survive against all odds. Can you outlast the competition and emerge as the ultimate survivor?

name: The Last Job
summary: What seemed like an easy job, descends into something horrifying. Explore mysterious house, that holds dark secrets, in this first person horror experience.

name: The Backrooms Anthology
summary: A classic survival game set in the backrooms where 5 survivors try to escape. Unravel the mystery of the backrooms, escape or fight against the creatures that lurk in this terrible and infinite place.

name: The Lonker
summary: Experience bizarre moments, kill strange creatures, explore mysteries, and move forward in pixelated 2D. You are Lonker, a talented son of a missing king and your goal is to find your father! But he doesn't know what awaits him.

name: The Last Duskreaper
summary: Try this hardcore side view metroidvania that tells the story of a bird in a dying kingdom infected by glitched monsters.

name: The Secret of Darkwoods
summary: Open-world procedural illustrated text-based RPG

name: That Last Girl
summary: First person, Indie, horror survival game. Use light and sound-based strategies to evade the ghost and achieve objectives to unlock the extended ending.

name: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek
summary: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek is a dark fantasy visual novel about fulfilling your aspirations by sacrificing parts of yourself. Literally.

name: The Infernal Masquerade
summary: The Infernal Masquerade is a gothic horror PS2 -inspired take on the classic minesweeper game along with resource management, where taking risks and doing speedy reveals gives you access to helper items that make it easier to find the hidden, masked vampires.

name: The Neverland of the Mountain and Sea
summary: Falling in love with a robot girl!

name: The Salt Keep
summary: The Salt Keep is a text adventure (think interactive fiction with Choose Your Own Adventure and RPG mechanics) and should feel familiar to fans of classic gamebooks and fantasy fiction in general.

name: Thomas & Friends: Race On!
summary: Meet Thomas and his engines friends on the rail! With the new Augmented Reality (AR) and Voice Control function, meet your favorite engines in the real world and speak with them! You can also set up races, choose your favorite engines, and tap the screen to make the engines run faster to win races in this fun, kid-friendly racing adventure.

name: The Last Vagabonds
summary: The Last Vagabonds is set in a zombie apocalypse. Fight against zombies and travel with a friend or alone through the forsaken world.

name: The Prey's Turn
summary: The Prey's Turn is an action platform where you are a cute animal and need to save your friends from predators. Now, It's the PREY'S TURN!

name: The Lost Legends of Redwall: The Scout - Encore Edition
summary: A narrative puzzle-adventure game based on Brian Jacques' Redwall️ book series. Vicious searats are invading the once peaceful Mossflower wood and it's up to the Lilygrove Scout Corps' newest recruit to save the day. Play as Sophia or Liam on their adventure to Redwall Abbey!

name: The kidnapped: Escape Room
summary: You have been kidnapped and you find yourself trapped in an unknown house. In this escape room with a dark setting, you will have to solve different puzzles to get out of there. Will you be able to escape and survive?

name: The Lone Alien
summary: This is a story about an alien who had a shipwreck on a planet where people lived and now he needs to figure out how he can leave this planet.After all, people's technologies are far behind those that he has on the planet.

name: The Land of Babel
summary: Build and nurture the universe of your dreams with Land of Babel; an expansive simulation city builder. Construct and manage powerful empires, establish intricate and detailed economies, explore unknown lands, embark on captivating quests, and much more.

name: The flower of desire
summary: In the fragmented world after the "Sin of Seven Day", watch from four perspectives how the people in this world fight against the almost irreversible disaster, confront the fate written for them by the world, reveal their hearts, show their heartfelt desires, watch them tell their stories

name: The Strange Box
summary: 2D horizontal scroll adventure game, interweaving unique art style, horror, suspense and fantasy. A horror secret is hidden in the apartment where lost children are going to be engulfed by nightmares.

name: The Unknown
summary: You and Your Team Of 4 Players Hunt down Paranormal Entities While Trying to Survive The Night Solving Paranormal Cases of the Unknown in this Online horror Multiplayer Game

name: The Big One
summary: Challenge your enemies by overcoming a simulation in perpetual construction. The Big One is an action/platform game of the "dungeon crawler" type, where your reflexes and concentration will be put to the test.

name: The Visitor
summary: In 'The Visitor' you will play as an author named Rachel. Your goal is to complete your book chapter by chapter before the deadline that is coming up. The longer you sit and type, the more you will slip into a schizophrenia state of mind. Complete the chapters and return to a normal average life!

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Collector's Edition
summary:
The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom is the sequel to The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. The setting for Link’s adventure has been expanded to include the skies above the vast lands of Hyrule.

The collector's edition includes the following:
- The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (physical version)
- Artbook
- SteelBook case
- Steel Poster
- A set of four pin badges.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Clockwork City
summary: Enter the mechanical world of the Clockwork City and explore Sotha Sil's greatest creation.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Markarth
summary: The Dark Heart of Skyrim epic concludes in Markarth. As the Gray Host marches on the Reach, find unlikely allies among the clans that call this wild region home and unveil the true motivations of the mysterious Vampire Lord, Rada al-Saran.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Ascending Tide
summary: The Legacy of the Bretons year-long story starts here! Strange things are happening in the Coral Aerie and Shipwright's Regret as old rivalries, ancient history, and the birthright of the Bretons come into focus and lead to the upcoming High Isle Chapter.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Lost Depths
summary: Out at sea or in the heart of a druid grove, the Legacy of the Bretons year-long story sails on! An ancient enemy rises to threaten the peace of Earthen Root Enclave, and dark storms erupt from Graven Deep. The earth trembles before the next DLC!

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Firesong
summary: Set sail for Galen as the Legacy of the Bretons year-long story comes to a close! A druid civil war erupts and followers of the True Way vie for the legacy of the Druid King. Unite with new allies to make the Systres safe once and for all.

name: The Abyss
summary: "Everlasting night. Shadowed crescent, red moon runs. Watch the sleeping sun." -The White Crown Traverse throughout Mondreich, Learn its secrets, and free yourself from the chains of power and madness.

name: The Faceless
summary: You have been thrown into an unknown territory, your task is to find and clear all enemies. As you progress through the game, you explore the abandoned buildings and industrial areas. Third Person Shooter. Explore the area and its buildings, collect ammo, protection and medical kits.

name: The Bird That Drinks Tears
summary: The Bird That Drinks Tears us is an action adventure game based on the novel series. The Bird That Drinks Tears, the best-selling series by Korean author Lee Yeongdo has enchanted millions of fans with its unique fantasy world. With fascinating characters, a carefully constructed plot, and poignant themes, it’s unsurprising they instantly fell in love with the books.

name: The Night of Death
summary: Let's escape from the shrine to find the five beads sealed in the red box to avoid various goblins.

name: The Slothgate Experiment: Death's Door
summary: welcome back to The Slothgate Experiment... Part 2 continues the story of the first slothgate. You are returned to slothgate, where a guard sabotages the rules, he is gonna help you escape, will you make it back and escape your traumas, or will you die in slothgate?

name: The Spirit Stone
summary: Oh no, you're dead! Luckily you can fix that if you get your hands on every piece of the Spirit Stone. This is a short adventure game.

name: The Light in the Darkness
summary: The Light in the Darkness tells the story of a working-class family of Polish Jews in France during the Holocaust. It is the first videogame to portray the Holocaust accurately, releasing free for educational purposes.

name: The Red Sun Sets Over the Fields of Grain
summary:
Life on the farm is not as simple as it once was...

You return home one day and are provoked into committing murder. Life appears to carry on as normal after the killing, but is everything truly all right? Can you forget your deep-seated guilt by planting crops and buying power-ups? Can you ignore the glaring reminders of your past?

This seemingly simple and fun iPhone game raises questions about complacency and mindlessness in smartphone video game culture. Rather than simply tap away and watch the gold coins increase, The Red Sun Sets pushes its users to carry the burden of the main character, establishing a strong link between the player and the character that the player controls.

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Gotopazu Story
summary: Gotopazu, the October 27, 2020-released smartphone game based on The Quintessential Quintuplets, comes to consoles in the form of memorial stories. The console version is developed by MAGES., developers of The Quintessential Quintuplets ∬: Summer Memories Also Come in Five and The Quintessential Quintuplets the Movie: Five Memories of My Time with You. It features the first year’s worth of memorial stories from Gotopazu for all five quintuplets, fully voiced across 24 volumes. There are also over 500 illustrations. And the Illustration Book Set editions are a must-have item for diehard fans.

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Gotopazu Story - Nino Nakano Set
summary:
The Nino Nakano Set includes:
- The Game
- Illustration Art Book "Nino Nakano"
- Gotopazu Story Soundtrack Included
- Nino Nakano Set Box

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Gotopazu Story - Ichika Nakano Set
summary:
The Ichika Nakano Set includes:

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Gotopazu Story - Miku Nakano Set
summary:

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Gotopazu Story - Itsuki Nakano Set

- Gotopazu Story Soundtrack Included

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Gotopazu Story - Yotsuba Nakano Set
summary:
The Yotsuba Nakano Set includes:
- The Game
- Illustration Art Book "Yotsuba Nakano "
- Gotopazu Story Soundtrack Included
- Yotsuba Nakano Set Box

name: The Dwarf Kingdom: Magic World of War vs Orks and Dragon
summary: An ancient evil has awakened. Are you strong enough to resist it?

name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild Expansion Pass Bundle
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild game packs countless hours of play into a vast world of discovery. That makes it an ideal foundation for more adventures! This special bundle comes with the full game for the Nintendo Switch system and the Expansion Pass, which grants access to three new treasure chests, The Master Trials DLC Pack 1, and The Champions Ballad DLC Pack 2.

name: The Orc Invasion
summary: Game is a narrative driven 2,5D platformer shooter. It's based on collecting gold and resources from battlefield, learning new recipes, crafting everything necessary for yourself, your army and your mobile castle from basic to advanced.

name: The LEGO Movie 2 Videogame: Galactic Adventures Character & Level Pack
summary: More levels focusing on what Rex Dangervest and Sweet Mayhem were doing before the movie / game began.

name: The Game of Life 2: Complete Collection
The Backrooms: Liminal Reality
summary: Explore the backrooms and liminal spaces while trying to find your way out while you fight with the feeling like you are in a dream, or if you have just entered one of your own.

name: The Atla Archives
summary: The Great City has fallen, and you find yourself clinging to a piece of driftwood in the aftermath. A new nation, Atla, has risen from the ashes.

name: That's a Cow: Extended Edition
summary: Soar through the air and don't get milked in this cute game.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel III - Digital Deluxe Edition
The Collector
summary: Multi story collection, experience many different nightmares, integrate physics, plot, battle and other rich content, and provide horror games with continuous content updates.

name: The Forgotten Concluder
summary: “The Forgotten Concluder” is a third person perspective 3D Role-playing game base on the ancient Chinese fantasy wu-xia world. Being a young teenager Shen Zi-Jun that grew in a isolated valley, taking on a adventure to discover a great secret and his true dentity.

name: The Smile Alchemist
summary: Follow the growth of a young alchemist aiming to become the best in the world!

name: The Dreadmill
summary:
It will slam you, it will crush you, and it will ALWAYS end you. You will never beat it. It will never stop.
Tap to jump, avoiding everything The Dreadmill can throw at you. Reach the top to reset the floor and push further, collecting as much loot as you can. With randomly generated floors, brutal traps and explosive gameplay, The Dreadmill will always have new ways to destroy you.

name: The Pale Beyond: Collectors Edition
summary: The Pale Beyond Collector's Edition includes the base game and the Original Soundtrack, featuring a curated selection of 19 tracks from the game.

name: The Pale Beyond: Deluxe Edition
summary: The Pale Beyond Deluxe Edition includes the base game, the Digital Artbook and the Deluxe Soundtrack, which collects all 51 tracks from the game.

name: THZ
summary: THZ is an arcade style top-down shooter with an emphasis on the greatest substance known to man. It's pretty dope.

name: The King of Cats
summary: Navigate the claustrophobic corridors of a cargo ship and try to survive a night with man-eating tigers on the loose. Your choices will determine who lives and who dies.

name: The Voice from the Well: The Velessar Saga
summary: Stranded in a foreign world, Jay must fight to reclaim his stolen memories as mysterious forces conspire!

name: The Curse of Kubel + Expansion DLC
summary: Return to Asserya, and visit your favorite characters again with all-new character art and voiced dialogue!

name: The Final Bastion
summary: The Final Bastion is a Multiplayer PvP & PvE Tower-defense with a classic Medieval-Fantasy theme. Compete against players in head to head online in a PvP, sending waves against the enemy and growing your economy. Play side by side with your friends in PvE and see who survives the longest.

name: The Watcher
summary: Our heroes hear about a strange land, where everything become pixel, so they come to find out what happen here.

name: The Dragon Queen
summary: Enola has lived her own life on a small village secluded from the rest of the world. But soon this will change!

name: The Lost Sheep
summary: A beautiful, 3rd-person exploration game centered around two parallel stories: a lost sheep trying to find the way home, and a man restoring his life from his dark mistakes. Uncover artifacts from the man's life as he becomes intertwined in The Lost Sheep's journey to his home.

name: The Great Divide
summary: The One Being, the Goddess who ruled it all, one day grew tormented by the actions of its own creations. That frustration led to what is known as The Great Divide. Now the world faces unbalance as those spirits fight each other for full control.

name: The Adventures of Mr. Willickers the Rotting Mule
summary: Mr. Willickers can never, ever die. He'll chase you until the very ends of the earth.

name: The Quinfall
summary: Embark on an adventurous journey to explore the Quinfall universe. Be a part of unique battles and an immersive story with dozens of different professions in the depths of medieval times in an all-new MMORPG experience.

name: The Kaiyo Mission
summary: The Kaiyo Mission is a casual, 2.5D, single player, sci-fi based, underwater exploration game set on alien ocean worlds.

name: The Longest Dungeon
summary: The Longest Dungeon is a infinite, dungeon crawler, beat em' up , roguelike, action, game.

name: The Tower
summary: "I awaken once again. Shackled. Beaten. Broken. And yet there is hope. An opportunity..." Enter the darkness of The Tower. A unique, constantly expanding dungeon crawling experience. Gather your senses and find your way through the hellish corridors of your prison.

name: The Thing
summary: An homage the 1982 movie The Thing, this mod recreates Outpost 31 from the movie as accurately as possible. It doesn't follow the movie as it's simply a recreation of the location, so there is no combat.

name: The Button by Elendow
summary:
Every time you press the button you get 1 point.

Every time you press the button your odds to lose all your points increases by 1%.

Good luck.

name: The Devourer: Hunted Souls
summary: Play as a paranormal investigator in our hybrid between first person survival and psychological horror game. Investigate a haunted forest with up to 5 players CO-OP vs AI and try to lift the curse. The forest is active... time may run out. Will you survive or will you lose your soul?

name: The Voidness
summary: The Voidness is a Sci-fi psychological horror game where it takes place inside the void where it's filled with just gloom - the only way to see is by scanning the environment with your range finder device, however you are not alone. Don't breathe ... as they are listening.. and watching.

name: The Feathered Serpent
summary: The Feathered Serpent is a 2d action-platformer with randomly generated levels, enemies, and items! It has heavy Roguelite elements, a progression system granting permanent upgrades, and many items and weapons that change how you attack.

name: The Super Stoo-Pendous World of Dr. Seuss
The Guard
summary: You are on the night shift at the mall. While you were taking your post, your partner went missing. All the time you hear some kind of noise. You need to find out their origin and find your partner. As you pass, you will need to find the keys and open locked rooms.

name: The Pub Simulator
summary: When you are a middle age single man on a shitty job with all your dreams faded away, there is only one choice. Open a bar! It is pub simulator game where you can build a pub, make new friends and drunk them to death.

name: Thalassic
summary: Thalassic is a VR underwater horror survival game where you explore an planet a few thousand years after its evacuation. Explore the depths of this new world ocean with your capsule communicator George. Encounter different creatures as you go deeper and find what lurks down in the depths.

name: The Meme Hunter
summary: The Meme Hunter is a dynamic first–person shooter in which you will exterminate crowds of evil memes. They're everywhere. They're out for your blood. They will follow you wherever you go…

name: The Fabric of the Mind
summary: "The Fabric of the Mind" is a difficulty, but rewarding game. The Game is structured into multiple acts that take the player through different creative ideas, sometimes painful gameplay and a lot of deaths. And all of that in complete Black and White.

name: The Offering
summary: The Offering is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror. You enter the halls of a roaming evil spirit, and the only way to survive is to gather the haunted artefacts quickly, using the equipment at your disposal. Work together as you explore the halls, where every turn could be your last.

name: The Way of Joy
summary: The Way of Joy reflects actual life, where you must fail so much to achieve success, complete the mission, and reach the "Joy" at the end of the goal.

name: The Horror of Secret Experiments
summary: You are one of the surviving scientists. Your task is to find a laptop with data on experiments and get out of the laboratory.

name: The Crimping
summary: A first-person horror game based on one of America's most haunted hotels. Use your wits and reflexes to escape supernatural encounters within Oregon's underground "Shanghai Tunnels."

name: Those Darn Brothers!!!
summary: 'Those Darn Brothers!' is a slice of life BL about bonding with family.

name: The Astonishing Captain Skull
summary: A mysterious death on a planet full of ghosts draws the investigative powers of the amazing Captain Skull.

name: The Enchanted Worlds 2
summary: Enchanted Worlds 2 is a puzzle adventure game from Syntaxity studio. Find an ancient artifact, following the clues from the books. At the same time, you have to explore many locations, look for items and interact with the environment. Touch the doorway to move from one location to another. When you find items, tap them to add them to your inventory. You can always see these things in a satchel. To use an item, select it, then tap the screen where you want to use it. Some puzzles require you to find clues to solve the puzzle: explore the area to find them. You can always use a hint if something does not work out for you.

name: The Bride Horror Game
summary: Investigation and horror game, where the player becomes a detective and seeks clues to unravel a mysterious case that took place years ago. Whenever the player restarts the game, the clues change position. The crime scene, weapons and culprits are also changed with each new match started.

name: The Slaying of Sandy Hook Elementary
summary: Based on the shootings at Sandy Hook Elementary, perpetrated by Adam Lanza.

name: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker - Limited Edition
summary:
The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker is the first Zelda game for the Nintendo GameCube and also the first in the series to employ cel-shading, a lighting and texturing technique that results in the game having a cartoon-like appearance. Like its predecessors, The Wind Waker is an action game with puzzle-solving and light role-playing elements. Basic gameplay mechanics are similar to those found in Ocarina of Time, but it differentiates itself with its massive Great Sea which must be explored using a boat named King of Red Lions.

The limited edition of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker includes the game itself and a second disk containing:
- Ocarina of Time
- Ocarina of Time Master Quest

name: The Settlers: New Allies - Deluxe Pack
summary: The Settlers: New Allies Deluxe Pack includes in-game content and digital items.

name: The Big One
summary: Challenge your enemies by overcoming a simulation in perpetual construction. The Big One is an action/platform game of the "dungeon crawler" type, where your reflexes and concentration will be put to the test.

name: The Beasties: Hello World
summary:
Swoooooosh! With a glance you see a tiny creature run across the room. Did you see that? Why that’s a Beastie! Grab it!
What are The Beasties? Well, they are tiny creatures that go unnoticed in our world, but now you have a chance to learn all about these special, smart creatures.
Each and every type of Beastie has a unique personality that will determine which of its needs are most important. If players don’t keep up with their Beasties needs, the Beastie won’t survive for long. Care for, train, train, play and customize your Beasties with your own signature style in The Beasties: Hello World!

name: The Mute House
summary: Inspired by old and classic survival horror games, The Mute House combines exploration, management, puzzles and a touch of action. As Emily investigates about her sister's vanishing, she finds herself trapped in a mysterious mansion.

name: The C64 Collection 2
summary:
TheC64 Collection 2 brings 14 8-bit home computer classics from the beloved C64 platform to Evercade.

Includes :
- California Games
- Cybernoid
- Firelord
- Impossible Mission II
- Insects in Space
- Mission Impossibubble
- Nebulus
- Pitstop II
- Slayer
- Street Sports Basketball
- Sword of Fargoal
- Uridum
- World Games
- Zamzara

name: The Castle Burns!
summary: Kill literally all of the Goblins, Orcs and other monsters with ridiculous oversized weapons and items born from pure insanity in this 2D Roguelike Arena Survival game! Do it fast, because The Castle Burns!

name: The Lizard King
summary:
Tomb Raider fan game made using the Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation engine. It's a new experience using the resources that one of the oldest games in the franchise has to offer.

This TRLE was placed in the trle.net hall of fame in 2005.

name: The Tower of Druaga
summary: Game Boy port of The Tower of Druaga.

name: The Legend of Dragoon
summary:
Experience The Legend of Dragoon originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Unveil a fantasy of magnificence, deception, magical combat, and retribution as you join swordsman Dart and his companions to harness the spiritual forces of Dragons and triumph over evil.

Using a unique and innovative tactical combat system, transform into Dragoons and unleash extraordinary powers. Control a wide variety of characters that wield unique weapons and Dragoon attacks powered by the elements in this unforgettable role-playing game.

name: This was Once a Place of Honour
The Dream Where Even Though You’ve Been Done With School for Years You Have to Go Back to School Because of a Class You Forgot About
summary: awful nightmare sim

name: The Sign
summary:
Imagine there's a video full of nightmarish and shocking images circulating. As soon as you've watched it, your phone rings and a voice whispers "You have 7 days left..."
Does that RING a bell? We bring the triumph of the creepy video cassette from the 90s to the present! When evil enters your smartphone, your life will turn into a horror trip!
Your classmate and good friend Gabriela has been acting strangely for a week and has been keeping to herself more and more. Just when you were about to contact her parents, she gets in touch and shares her mysterious story: Exactly 7 days ago, she saw a creepy video and then received a call saying that she was going to die today...

name: The Healing
summary:
Out of the blue, you’re added to a group chat by Dr. Crow, an ominous person in the guise of a plague doctor. For some inexplicable reason, it's impossible for you to leave this chat.
You’re added to a mysterious group chat with 7 others you don't know. While you're figuring out what the group is all about, Dr. Crow – an ominous stranger with a plague doctor mask – suddenly appears!
Initially you take the situation casually, but suddenly a real psycho terror begins! Creepy dolls and symbols randomly appear at your house. You receive shocking video calls and mysterious clues.

name: The Purgatory and the Stolen Souls
summary: Welcome to The Purgatory and The stolen souls, in this game you will experience the exciting adventure of Baby against Springtrap... in space!

name: The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story
summary:
Developed by Digital Sun, creators of Moonlighter, The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story is an action RPG that takes place in the League of Legends universe. In the kingdom of Demacia, the Mageseekers hold the power to oppress magic-using citizens in the name of public order–by inducting and indoctrinating them, locking them away, or driving them into hiding.

Play as Sylas, a spell-stealing mage who has just broken free of his unjust captivity at the Mageseekers’ hands. Wielding the chains that once bound you, you must liberate your homeland from tyranny, one Mageseeker at a time.

name: The Arson Betrayal
summary:
The Arson Betrayal is a choice-driven and story-focused action-thriller visual novel. Players are given the opportunity to choose which girls they wish to pursue a relationship with, as they spiral down towards the center of a deadly conspiracy.
As the story goes, you'll discover the girls' different kinks and be given the chance to determine how your relationship with them progresses, romantically or otherwise.
A majority of your choices and conversations with characters throughout the story are remembered and may affect the story as you go forward.

name: The Foglands
summary: Run into the unknown, fight monsters, scavenge loot, and try to make it back before you are swallowed by the fog. The Foglands is an atmospheric roguelike adventure where you’ll discover new paths and uncover old secrets.

name: The Foretold: Westmark Legacy
summary:
The Foretold: Westmark Legacy is Horror Deck Building game inspired by H. P. Lovecraft.

Fight to investigate another day in this gothic horror adventure card game. Equip items and relics. Buy cards and use them wisely to survive what lurks in the darkest corners of town. Take a short and mind-bending dive into the unknown with a cozy horror atmosphere.

name: The Game of Dots.
summary:
"The Game of Dots" is based on an old, logical game that we used to play with pen and paper. The app for iOS brings you new, 3D experience in the world of friendly dragon Albert. Passing through the levels you help Albert to bring the colors back to his world...
Simple, but not easy, relaxing but sometimes irritating, addictive puzzle game.

name: The Long Siege
summary: The Long Siege is a real-time match-three puzzle game with RPG elements set inside an extraordinary atmosphere of music and visuals. The core mechanic centers on matching items in your own tower through a mixture of belt-type scrolling and single taps to command your army. It’s a fun-to-play strategic thinking challenge requiring you to plan ahead to summon the right units, level up, upgrade your defences and complete the quests to unlock special items.

name: The Good Life: Behind the Secret of Rainy Woods
summary:
Elizabeth is alive, and no one remembers what happened in the Goddamn Hellhole, that is Rainy Woods. It's time to find out what’s really going on… And maybe enjoy some time in the countryside along the way.

Take on a slew of new side quests from the residents of Rainy Woods and come across some new faces along the way. Help them learn photography! Cook together! Set up secret dates! Save someone’s life...?

Well it’s time for Naomi to put that drink aside and put on her journalism hat once again!

This DLC includes 12 new side quests, with many secrets left to uncover…
Let's peek a bit further behind the curtain of Rainy Woods shall we?

name: The Entity Within
summary: The Entity Within is a echolocation Hardcore Stealth Horror game, each map has its story and each monster (called entities in the game) has different powers. Join this atmosphere and try your best.

name: The Man in the Park
summary: You see a man in the park on your walk home. Will you help him?

name: The Warfstache Clicker
summary: Warfstache Clicker is Lixian's second fan-made clicker-adventure video game played by Markiplier. It was gifted to Mark by Lixian for his 32ed birthday.

name: The Obscura Experiment
summary: Anabasis & Co. welcomes you to the family - we’re so glad to have you here! Your mandate as part of this research project will be to monitor and document a new energy form: the [Redacted]. To begin, let’s review your perso- oh? We’re detecting some anomalies near you… care to investigate?

name: The Devilry Reservation
summary: A faceless PSS agent visits a "reservation" due to complaints from its residents. Deal with the problems of evil spirits and reveal their mysteries and secrets. Explore a world once hidden from people. Get to know the mythological stars and their life stories.

name: The Battle of Sacred Heart
summary: The Battle of Sacred Heart is a refreshing action RPG. Sacred Heart nuns challenge the elite of the four armies of Middle Earth. What the player must face is a protracted battle to the death.

name: The Abyss
summary: The Abyss is a 2D puzzle about descent, in order to pass the levels you need to score a certain number of points and choose the right ways to pass the level.

name: Thief of Smiles
summary: Thief of Smiles is a 2D physics puzzle game with stealth elements. Move lamps, fling barrels, tie up enemies and swing through levels. But be sure to stay hidden in the shadows. All you need for this is your chewing gum companion Ponti. Uncover the dark secrets of the Smiles Savings Bank!

name: The Segment Twins
summary: The Twin Hunters fell into The Segment World... Combat various monsters and bosses, and complete their segmented journey! The Segment Twins is a hack-and-slash game with simple controls and a unique character tag action feature.

name: The Editor
summary:
Newspaper Editing Adventure.
"In 1996, a congressman was murdered...The prime suspect is a congressman's aide.
As the suspicious article was published the story begins"
Play the role of editor-in-chief of a newspaper.
You become the editor of a newspaper and write a front-page article every day.

name: The Awaited ReCollection
summary: A story about fatherly love and family affection. A gift for those children who have lost a father in their lives.

name: The Legend of Skye
summary: We will put ourselves in the shoes of a young druid who will be claimed by her tribe to carry out an important mission. After some events in her town, she will have to leave the safety of the forest behind and go explore a world full of dangers. The fate of her grove will be in her hands.

name: The Front
summary: The Front is a survival-open-world-crafting shooter game. Players will assume the role of a resistance fighter sent back in time to stop the rise of a tyrannical empire that has conquered the world using technology based on unknown relics.

name: The Prince is Dead
summary:
You've never really felt at home in The Abyss.

Your father, er, the Demon King... he's always been cold, but he's only gotten worse with time. You feel like you spend every day running from something. Whether its your past, your responsibility, or even yourself... but you can never quite escape.

That's why, when you catch an adventurer wandering the upper layers of your home, you decide to accompany her descent. She needs safe passage, and you'll never learn the truth of the world around you by moping alone.

The journey doesn't scare you. You don't fear the depths. You're only scared of what they might bring up from within you.

name: The Lilows 2
summary: Board game made by people who love games. Because we can.

name: The Secret of the Blue Water
summary: One of the games based on the Nadia: The Secret of Blue Water series.

name: The Thaumaturge
summary: The Thaumaturge is a story-driven RPG with morally ambiguous choices, taking place in the culturally diverse world of early 20th century Warsaw. In this world, Salutors exist: esoteric beings that only Thaumaturges can truly perceive and use for their needs.

name: The Last Runner
summary:
A fast runner that you can play with one hand, tap or double tap to overcome obstacles in your way!
Ray, our hero, is an experienced runner with parkour knowledges. He was born in Cat Town 18 years ago, but today that town is not the same. Now it's an abandoned place, dangerous, with radiactive waters and infected cats...
But Ray is a great runner and adventurer (a bit opportunist), he knows about Cat Town's treasures, there's a lot of coins and hidden treasures and he's ready to collect it all!

name: The Labyrinth
summary:
The Labyrinth game where you control the ball while avoiding holes and traps to reach the destination.
50 Gorgeous looking levels with challenging puzzles to solve.
Calibrate and play the way you hold your device.

name: The Fifteen Puzzle
summary: Drag. Drag. Drag. Get ready for an addictive and challenging game!

name: The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition
summary: The Outer Worlds: Spacer's Choice Edition is the ultimate way to play the award-winning RPG from Obsidian Entertainment and Private Division. Including the base game and all DLC, this remastered masterpiece is the absolute best version of The Outer Worlds.

name: Three Lilies and Their Ghost Stories
summary: Three different areas, three different decades, three different tales. A visual novel defined as a "kinetic story anthology".

name: The Night Driver
summary: The Night Driver is a point and click, RPG, adult game. Set in a dark and dirty world, full of drug dealers, prostitutes, criminals, and liars.

name: The Adventures of LinShanHai: Chapter 2 - Bus Bombing
summary: The bus to the suburbs suddenly exploded, the scene was a mess, the sales staff, including all 10 people on board died. Lin Shanhai led the scene investigation team to conduct a detailed investigation and visited all the families and friends of the deceased, but the case is still no clue.

name: The Azmodeus Project
summary: A survival game in an open world of zombies.

name: The Goblin is Out
summary: Continuing my tradition (??) of making a deranged kink Bitsy at Christmas time for the Bitsy Jam but then not actually submitting it to the jam. This time it has basically nothing to do with the jam theme.

name: The Whisperer
summary: Join Suzie on her journey to rescue her cute little friends.

name: The Sweet Little Monster
summary: Meet with "The Sweet Little Monster". "The Sweet Little Monster" is an 2D endless arcade/puzzle game for just to have fun. You are controlling a sweet little monster to catch the falling colored little monsters.

name: The Ape Painting
summary:
Tomorrow is the day that you publish your debut novel. But tonight is the night in which your date’s hideous painting has fallen off the wall and killed him, leaving you trapped in an apartment of nightmares - both his and your own.

The Ape Painting blends point-and-click elements into a visual novel structure, and sets you loose in an apartment where everything hates you. So get off your date's corpse, put on some clothes, and get to work. But remember: achieving your dreams might cost more than you think.

name: The House
summary: You are invited by your friend Ashley to spend the weekend at a house away from the city.

name: The EdCo Incident
summary: A point-and-click style horror game made in Microsoft PowerPoint over the course of nearly 3 years.

name: The Die Is Cast
summary: The Die Is Cast is an interactive fiction set in a medieval-fantasy universe. You will have to balance your skills and make the right decisions to survive the scenario and reach your goal.

name: The Lacerator
summary: A mix of classic survival horror and trash movies, play as an 80's porn actor and beware of every corner because you can get Lacerator and lose a limb in real time... But you can still adapt and survive.

name: The Legend of Heroes V: Umi no Oriuta
summary: The Legend of Heroes V: Umi no Oriuta (Cagesong of the Ocean) is the fifth installment in Falcom's long-running RPG franchise and the final entry in the "Gargarv Trilogy." The title was publish by Falcom initially for the PC on December 9, 1999 and was later remade for the PlayStation Portable by MiCROViSion in 2006.

name: The Legend of Heroes IV: Akai Shizuku
summary: The Legend of Heroes IV: Akai Shizuku is the fourth entry in Falcom's Legend of Heroes RPG series and the second installment in the "Gagharv Trilogy." The game was originally developed and published by Falcom for the NEC PC-98 on March 24, 1996 with a port being released for the PlayStation in 1998.

name: Theseus in the Dark
summary: Escape a pitch-black maze with nothing but your hearing to guide you. You are not alone. Sound-only.

name: The Lightkeeper
summary: You've decided to take up a job offer as a lightkeeper. You'll be there for a month, and you'll have a partner so you don't go insane. All you have to do is man the light and the foghorn, nothing could go wrong, right?

name: That Lonesome Valley
summary: A short retro-style gay romance game / visual novel about walking, sheepherding, and kissing.

name: The Gunslinger
summary: Annihilate an ever-growing horde of monsters to survive. Unlock & choose from a variety of upgrades to create unique and game-breaking builds. Play a variety of game modes for the ultimate monster-slaying experience!

name: The Holy Gosh Darn
summary: The Holy Gosh Darn is a narrative adventure with a time-travelling twist. Time travel to jump between the past and present across Heaven, Hell, Earth and Helheim. Uncover information in one timeline to alter things in another in a bid to stop your universe from going bang. Again.

name: The Sewer Job
summary: You were on the brink of becoming homeless, but that's when you found a sewer job application, you got accepted. What seemed like a chill work at first turned quickly in to an unsettling experience.

name: The War
summary: "The War" is a unique real-time war game. It has the fierce war of RTS, aircraft tank, missile laser; It is a real strategic game, operating base, expanding territory, and planning vertically and horizontally; Drive the Core Gear to command the battlefield to change the dark and turbulent world!

name: The Doorway Effect
summary: The Doorway Effect is a 1-4-player co-op psychological horror roguelike. Explore the inner world of a dying man's mind, racing through door after door in a labyrinth of nightmares. Encounter traumas incarnate, and discover the secrets locked within. If you can survive long enough...

name: The Fall of Aether Station
summary: A ruthless tower defense game with a focus on replayability and synergy. Fight increasingly difficult hordes of aliens as you upgrade your ships and adapt to new battlefields. Can you buy humanity enough time to escape?

name: The Magical Land of Canada
summary: Our heroes must travel to Canada and are surprised to find out it's a real place and not fictional.

name: The Cursewood
summary: A fantastical action-adventure game. Explore the forest, craft dozens of unique potions, and survive the dangers of the night!

name: The Witch's Cauldron
summary: The Witch's Cauldron is a narrative roguelike game about being a medieval witch. Grab your cauldron and get brewing. Love, curses, laughter, wisdom for sale! Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law. At least before the inquisitors come around.

name: The End: Pronton
summary: The chaotic Earth has barely regained stability, but meets a force called Poroton beyond the universe...

name: The Druid
summary: We embody the spirit of The Dagda, king of the Celtic gods, with the objective of liberating his territory from the corruption of the goddess Morrigan in a 2D roguelike platformer full of intensity.

name: The Little Witch Shop: New in Town
summary: In this shop management game, acquire new familiars to help cultivate your greenhouse, hunt fantastical creatures, and craft potions or runes to fulfill customer orders. Earn gold to upgrade your magic shop and impress the Witches’ Council.

name: The Hellchemist
summary: The Hellchemist is an intense pve arena shooter where you will fight waves of monsters while random events will alter the way you have to play the game and makes every run unique. The game is heavily inspired by Doom and Quake. Bunny hops, shooting and a whole lot of explosions!

name: The Aching
summary: In a dark world somewhere between dream and nightmare you find yourself alone, cold, and without memory of who you are or where you came from. Guided by little more than a silver locket and questions, you must find your way off an isolated island in pursuit of answers.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild Randomizer
summary:
This Randomizer will randomize items you will find in chests and be given by NPCs. Randomized enemy drops are included too. Additionally, warping via both the Sheikah Slate as well as going inside and outside of shrines has the chance of getting randomized too.

It was taken down from GameBanana by request from Nintendo of America.

name: The Lamplighters League
summary: Sneak, steal, and shoot your way through a world of pulp adventure in The Lamplighters League! Globetrot across a variety of exciting locales around the world and outwit your enemies in strategic turn-based combat - and, if you play your cards right, you might just save the world.

name: The Awakening
summary: The Awakening is a choice-driven adult visual novel with sandbox elements. You as the player are in recovery for amnesia and must navigate your new world with the help of your otherworldly sidekick.

name: The Botanist
summary: Follow the Botanist as they travel through space, searching planets for the rare plants needed to solve the food shortage back home.

name: The Last Grape
summary: The Last Grape is a game about fruits, vegetables and vengeance. Slice through your enemies with speed and precision in this action, fast paced platform where you control a tiny grape in seek for revenge.

name: The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story - Deluxe Edition
summary: The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story Deluxe Edition includes the Silverwing Supply Station Pack, the Home Sweet Cave Pack, the Hijacked Spells Pack, and the Unchained Skins Pack.

name: That's My Family: Family Fun Night
summary: Family Fun Night is the first game from That's My Family to offer both original board games and classic games that were part of your childhood! Play 14 different games, from Snakes and Ladders to Parcheesi, Chess and 4 in a Row, and many more!

name: The Treflik Family
summary: Leap into a world of imagination alongside Treflik and his sister Treflinka. Give in to this magical land and see it through their eyes.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Journey Deluxe
summary:
The Legend of Zelda: Link's Journey Deluxe is a fan game of The Legend of Zelda by Tropical Bird. It's story line is heavily inspired by Ocarina of Time, with many places being revisited.
The game became somewhat infamous for it's poor quality, due to the fact that it was the first game by the developer.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Triforce Duo
summary:
The Legend of Zelda: Triforce Duo is the sequel to Tropical Bird's "The Legend of Zelda: Link's Journey". Despite showing quite some improvements, it is still known for it rather poor quality, like is predecessor.

This game however introduced the mechanic of two playable characters that can be switched between, which is necessary to solve various puzzles.

name: The Golden Girls Take Manhattan DX
summary: A cancelled Persona parody featuring The Golden Girls.

name: The Legend of Lorosity
summary: A traditional turn-based rpg following a story-driven plot with vibrant characters, and unique animations combined with fast and explosive gameplay!

name: The Cure
summary: The Cure is a hardcore 3D shooter with surviving elements where you must survive in zombie apocalypse.

name: The Hero Journey in Yggdrasil
summary: Meet the Fjernis wolf, The Norns, the chattering squirrel Ratatosk, the eagle Hräsvelg. In hero's journey, you leave the known world for an adventure, then return with new knowledge, insight and power! Climb Yggdrasil, fight the dragon, save the environment, ride the rainbow! Go from zero to hero

name: The Viriditas Chapel of Perpetual Adoration
summary: Contemplate the beauty of creation and the love of God kneeling at a virtual altar inspired by Hildegard von Bingen.

name: The MisAdventures of Xenos
summary: "Princess Fayne leads in "The MisAdventures of Xenos," a hilarious, turn-based RPG parody. Full of crude humor, meta jokes, and retro graphics, enjoy a fresh take on classic RPGs with new game+ mode. Discover a what-if quest line and defy genre conventions. Clear in 6 hours. Join the adventure now!"

name: The Idolmaster Tours
summary:
THE iDOLM@STER TOURS is an upcoming arcade game that was first announced on February 10th, 2023, at Japan Amusement Expo 2023. It will be the first mainline arcade game since the original game. The graphics and models from Starlit Season have been carried over with some adjustments and additional models for the newly added characters.

The first location test began in the summer of 2023, and a second location test began in summer of 2024. The game is set to be released in Spring 2025.

name: The Ultimate Sports Quiz
summary: The Ultimate Sports Quiz is a Miscellaneous game, developed by Mere Mortals and published by Oxygen Interactive Software, which was released in Europe in 2005.

name: The Amazing Dare Dozen
summary:
Enjoy the serene atmosphere of the forest and the chirping birds with The Amazing Dare-Dozen game! If you are looking for a way to get away from the stress of daily life, you might enjoy this quirky adventure. Can you believe that the main character is a carton of eggs? Even if it sounds silly, you'll find that excelling in this challenge requires plenty of patience and precision!

Your daring mission is to reach the top of the tree by launching eggs from one nest to the other. However, there's a catch! The nests are moving! Besides, a single mistake will cost you one of your precious eggs. As a result, you should move carefully, just like you're walking on eggshells!

name: The Origin of Hope
summary: Turn-based team tactical games, you can freely match a variety of basic and advanced classes, explore rich gameplay routines, and pursue extreme gameplay such as one-turn clearance.

name: That Rhyme Game
summary: So you're good in taking 4 pics and guessing the 1 word common between them. Now try a different challenge. With That Rhyme Game, you have 2 words to guess and 2 pics to get those words, with an added twist - both words have to rhyme!

name: That Racecar Game
summary: Casual Racing Experience. Play against friends locally, or against the AI.

name: The Cowlitz Gamers Adventure
summary:
A game made for the NES in 2016. Developer Łukasz Kur and musician Robi put together the game in aid of the 2016 Cowlitz Gamers for Kids Expo, an event organised by popular retro gaming YouTuber John Hancock plus friends Chelsea Beck and Jonathan Rose.

The Cowlitz Gamers’ Adventure casts you in the role of youngster Justice as he delves into some mysterious caves in search of gold. Following the format of classic 8-bit single-screen platformers, your goal is seemingly simple: collect all the gold before the time runs out.

Naturally, accomplishing this goal is anything but simple, as there are scores of obstacles and dangerous creatures just waiting to make Justice’s life miserable. With no way to fight back, Justice will have to avoid these various perils on his quest if he wants to survive long enough to spend all his shinies!

In classic 8-bit platformer style, all of the obstacles in your path run on strict, set patterns. When you start a new level, take a moment to watch how everything moves in relation to one another, and you’ll soon be able to spot an opportunity to get through safely. Even the most seemingly impenetrable obstacles have a safe path through — but thinking of a plan is just half the battle. Then you have to execute it, of course!

name: The Closing Walls
summary: Jump from one wall to the other and collect balls to move the walls back so you do not get crushed.

name: The Island: Brave Heart
summary:
The Island,Man in the Wild,Amazing Adventure....
This is a game about exploring and surviving on a deserted island, finding a way to survive on the island while working towards your final goal of escaping the island.
You take the role of a fanatic explorer, travelling to places all around the world exploring earth's unknown and unexplained mysteries. A carefully thought out plan, still can't prevent the dangers of the unknown. Your ship sinks and you wake up on the beach of an island, you don't know where you are; hunger, fear and disappointment are close to defeating you…

name: They Came from Another Planet
summary: A twin stick, fixed shooter, bonus hell, pixel art, shoot 'em up. Aliens have invaded and you, a blue housecat with a stretchy head, are, of course, our last hope. Fight the aliens on earth, under the ocean and in space in this risk/reward based fixed shooter inspired by old arcade shoot 'em ups.

name: Threesome Puzzle
summary: 1 vs 2, a game for three people, it's up to you to decide this beautiful encounter!

name: The Puzzle Factory
summary: The Puzzle Factory is a 3 in 1 puzzle game including Wordsearches, Crosswords, Maths Platformer, and more suprises!

name: The Lushes Land
summary: Explore The Lushes Land and uncover its mysteries in this Action-Adventure spin-off of Tochi! On your adventure, you'll be tasked with finding the lost gems of The Lushes Land! While you're exploring, you'll encounter some of the inhabitants. Most are friendly, others not so much, so be wary while exploring and make sure you don't get lost in the wilderness!

name: The Last Wish
summary: See the world from the prospective of different animals and learn what they have in their life to teach you.

name: The Most Lecherous
summary: The first erotic game for young people, why pay when you can play for free?

name: The Last of The Core
summary: The Last Of The Core is a third person survival horror shooter for one player where you are a soldier member of the "Two Six" team. You must recover samples in an area where there was an incident at the research facility and dinosaurs are on the loose everywhere.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask Randomizer
summary: Majora's Mask Randomizer is an application that randomizes item locations, music, and more for Majora's Mask, presenting millions of combinations and new ways to replay the game.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess Randomizer
summary: A randomizer mod for The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword Randomizer
summary: A randomizer for the game The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword.

name: The Callisto Protocol: Contagion Bundle
summary: Death is only the beginning in Contagion Mode, The Callisto Protocol's ultimate survival horror experience. Fight tactically and use your ammunition wisely - Contagion Mode's difficulty is custom balanced with stronger enemies and limited resources.

name: The Wagadu Chronicles
summary: The Wagadu Chronicles is a Role-Play-First Afrofantasy MMORPG featuring multiplayer synchronous turn-based combat, communal settlement building and capture, and a cinematic dialogue mode.

name: The Track Star
summary: Are you the new drag strip champion? Take your talents to the track and race in the high stakes drag race.

name: The Banished Vault
summary: A strategy game of exploration, endurance, and space travel on an interstellar gothic monastery. Explore solar systems, harvest resources, construct outposts, and face hazards in the challenging universe of The Banished Vault.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Ages Randomizer
summary: A randomizer mod for The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Ages.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons Randomizer
summary: A randomizer mod for The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Seasons.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX Randomizer
summary: A randomizer mod for The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX.

name: Thomas & Friends: Up, Up and Away! Diesel's Special Delivery
summary: Up, Up and Away! Diesel's Special Delivery is a video game that was released for Vtech's V. Reader System. It was released in 2012.

name: The Little Engine That Could
summary: A Merry Engine is pulling cars filled with toys and food for the good boys and girls when it cannot go any further. The little clown asks some other Engines for help but all of them refuse to pull the train. Finally, a little Blue Engine pulls the train over the mountain with her spirit and determination, telling herself "I think I can, I think I can, I think I can." Join the Little Engine on her journey and learn the importance of bravery and courage.

name: The Faces of Evil Remastered Randomizer
summary: A randomizer mod for The Faces of Evil Remastered.

name: The Wand of Gamelon Remastered Randomizer
summary: A randomizer mod for The Wand of Gamelon Remastered.

name: The Legend of Zelda Randomizer
summary: Have you ever wanted to replay the Legend of Zelda, but played it so often that you can't get it out of your head? Similar to many other randomizers out there, this can shuffle the game as you like to allow you to re-experience Zelda each time that you play it.

name: The Classroom
summary: In The Classroom, the player controls a high school student called Alex who is in his last ten days of school and has to take an exam on each of those days. However, Alex does not study and would rather risk cheating to perform well in his exams. In each of the ten levels in the game, the player must fill their cheat meter completely by moving next to smart students (who are represented by yellow circles) and holding the left mouse button.

name: The Curse of Kubel: Deluxe Edition
The Journey
summary: Surf over 300 waves from around the world, ride boards from the top shapers and style out with well-known brands in The Journey!

name: The Moroccan Castle 3: Behind The Secrets
summary: Dive into the adventures inside The Moroccan Old Castle, solve the mystery, prepare yourself for a great horror experience!

name: The Wingless Bee
summary: The Wingless Bee is a brand new Frogger-inspired game where a bee named Bella is abruptly thrown far away from the hive she lives and works at. With her wings destroyed, she can only hop to get back home.

name: The Amazing Circus
summary:
The circus is in town! Welcome to The Amazing Circus, where you’re the star attraction!
Can you make the jump to the other side?
Can you get all the stars?
Can you ignite the crowd with a Jump Frenzy?
Fill up the entertainment meter and earn extra points by unleashing the Jump Frenzy!

name: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners - Tourist Edition
The Illusion: Curse
summary: The Illusion: Curse Is a horror game made by professional crew In the art of horror. You will have the opportunity to experience one of the most powerful types of psychological horror Based on an environment designed in every detail to be a real hell that makes you terrified.

name: The Hero with a Thousand Arms
summary: The Hero with a Thousand Arms has created a challenging game where multiple mini-games are running simultaneously on the screen, and the player needs to switch between them to operate. Meanwhile, the other games enter bullet time mode.

name: The Territory of Egg
summary: This is a variant tower defense indie game. Use the Egg Warriors to form a defense line, observe the type and distribution of the enemy, use the terrain structure, build a reasonable formation, explore different skill combinations, and protect the Holy Egg.

name: The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron Boy Genius: Jet Fusion
summary: Game Boy Advance port of The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron Boy Genius: Jet Fusion.

name: The Riddler
summary: Think you're clever? Prove it with an enigmatic AI, the ultimate master of riddles beyond imagination.

name: The Underside
summary:
The Underside is an exploration based action platformer in the vein of games like Castlevania, Metroid, and Cave Story.

The game is seemingly not complete with the last major update occurring in 2009.

name: The Penguin Game: Antarctic Savior
summary: Collect air conditioners, save Antarctica! Only you can save penguins. Antarctic savior! This is an open world adventure game with various contents such as sports mini-games, FPS, boss battles, item farming, quests, platformers, and puzzles.

name: The House of E.
summary: The House of E. is a story-driven puzzle game with horror elements and a creepy atmosphere.

name: The Lions Knight
summary: The Lions Knight is a game designed to the players who love SRPG game. A large number of 3D heroes and monsters! The battle is tactfully and simple operation; And the other leisure playing - farm and mining. we provide a strategy and relaxed game experience for player experience.

name: The Light Box
summary: This challenging and unique puzzle game is easy to pick up but has hours of gameplay.

name: The Ripper: Serial Killers
summary: Remember that voice in your head telling you to do the wrong thing? That voice is you. Guide the protagonist and whisper in his ear whether to spare the lives of the citizens or murder them

name: The Day
summary:
It's Tia's birthday, and she's looking forward to beating all of her friends with the new card her dad gave her! Beat the other kids by choosing the right cards, and earn more cards until you're the best of them all!

And don't go into the woods, or the guards will kill you.

This is a Flash game from Gregory Avery-Weir, released in 2010 and now available as a downloadable projector for the first time.

name: The World Hockey Championships
summary:
Play a competitive real-time​ hockey game! Position your player to take your best shot and make epic saves in real time to become the next World Hockey Champion!
Play in multiplayer or single game mode, competing with people around the world in real time to win The World Hockey Championships.

name: They Need To Be Fed
summary: Run and jump through 11 crazy worlds to feed the monsters in this 360° gravity platformer. It doesn't matter which way you go; up or down, left or right, you can't fall off because of the 360° gravity!

name: The Legend of Zelda: The Sealed Palace
summary:
An Ocarina of Time romhack.

Lots of gameplay in various areas and dungeons with custom cutscenes, songs and much more. Good luck finding all 100 skulltula tokens and 20 hearts!

name: The House of Evil Grandmother
summary:
You find yourself waking up in a room. You have been locked up in an old, decrepit house by Crazy Grandmother, a crazy old woman who hunts her prey with a bloodied baseball bat.
Explore and find items and tools to open the various locks Crazy Grandmother keeps on her front door, all while outrunning her pursuit.

In Your mission to unlock the front door, you must find hammer, that is also a weapon that can knock Crazy Grandmother out for a 15 seconds, battery and main door key.

Will You be able to escape this prison or will You succumb to her unending chase and face Your doom in the walls of the house?

name: The Reacher
summary: The Reacher is a platform game with different aspects in it. Run, slide and swing for reaching the goal. It is designed for speed runs.

name: This is a Work of Fiction
summary:
A game for people who like strange mysteries and puzzle solving.

This is a Work of Fiction is a game dedicated to conspiracy-theory websites, like the old one about the time cube (find it on the internet archive some time – it’s incredible). It’s a collection of puzzles with no written instructions other than their titles, and completing them unlocks pieces of a story about a person who has been finding clues about an impossibly huge and amorphous conspiracy (but be warned – it doesn’t involve any elder gods, or aliens, or robots, or politicians, or deadpan guys in suits, or giant companies).

name: The Soul of Dracula
summary: The Soul of Dracula is a dark Japanese platformer heavily inspired by the classic Castlevania series. A vampire hunter journeys to the Dark Prince’s castle armed with a rather familiar whip, which he can use to cut down the skeletons, bats, and ghouls that cross his path.

name: The Hive
summary: In The Hive you play as Alex Rig, a reporter who was investigating a missing persons case when he discovers a heavily-fortified research facility while snooping around for clues. Similar to Iji, Prince of Persia and Flashback, Alex will be doing a lot of climbing up platforms and crawling through air vents to find ammunition or health-replenishing items that he can keep in his inventory for later use.

name: The Penguins of Madagascar: The Helmet
summary: When Kowalski invents a helmet that turns thoughts into actions, it’s only a matter of time before King Julien tries to get his hands on it. Once in control of the helmet, King Julien turns up the power to such a level that he can’t control it, and it’s up to the Penguins to find a way to stop it before chaos takes over the zoo.

name: The Linear RPG
summary: The Linear RPG is a short "RPG" game that involves leveling up a character while reading a ridiculous RPG story.

name: The Dream of Cocoon
summary: This is a pixel art style open world survival adventure game. Player wake up in a strange dream world, start an unknown journey. Player need to acquire resources through foraging, hunting, mining, fighting,etc.,to build bases, to craft equipment, to cook foods, and to develop himeself/herself.

name: The Thrill of Combat
summary: The Thrill of Combat is quite possibly one of the most disorientating experiences you’ll ever have, even though the concept sounds simple (if a little bizarre): fly your helicopter into enemy territory, kill the soldiers, cut out their vital organs—and repeat.

name: The Shadow Warrior Trilogy
summary:
The Shadow Warrior Trilogy includes all three games in the fast paced first-person shooter series:

- Shadow Warrior
- Shadow Warrior 2
- Shadow Warrior 3: Definitive Edition

name: Thumb Buggy
summary: Thumb Buggy is always ready for action! Collect items to score as many points as you can in "Score Attack" mode, grab coins as quickly as possible in "Coin Dash", and become the ultimate striker in "Goal Rush". Challenge your friends and family, and compete against others from across the world! Vroooom!

name: The 8th Son? A.R.
summary:
Scenario is based on a new Anime-derived original story directed by Y.A!
As the mysterious protagonist of Another Reincarnation, players set out on an adventure to save a world on the brink of destruction with Wendelin and his friends.

name: Throne Rush
summary: Throne Rush is an epic strategy game which allows players to rule their own kingdoms and achieve prosperity while destroying enemies and capturing their wealth.

name: The Orphan
summary: In The Orphan, you'll step into the shoes of Eric, a young orphan who has returned to the abandoned orphanage. As you explore its dark and twisted corridors, you'll encounter all manner of supernatural creatures and otherworldly horrors that will test your courage and your sanity.

name: The Adventures of LinShanHai: Chapter3 - The Headless Woman
summary: The third Lin Shanhai case involves a severed female corpse found hanging in an abandoned factory, missing from City A's hospital morgue. With the body assaulted and police stumped, you'll search multiple crime scenes to unravel this mysterious case.

name: The Fairly OddParents: Breakin' da Rules
The Legend of Zelda: Mercuris' Chest
summary: In this independent fangame from the Solarus Team, Link is brought to a mysterious kingdom where his help is needed to fight a giant bird who tries to steal a dangerous chest. Who is that mysterious bird warrior? Why does this place seem so familiar, but also so different? Enjoy a whole new journey in a huge kingdom full of mysteries, travelling and side quests.

name: The Last of Us Part I: Digital Deluxe Edition
summary: Experience the emotional storytelling and unforgettable characters in The Last of Us, winner of over 200 Game of the Year awards.

name: The Cycle: Frontier - Authority Peacekeeper Pack
summary: A fresh prospector with its various color versions to fit any taste. Suit up with your squad mates to show who's got style. Get your special Operative gear, equip your melee and hop on your drop pods. Plus, a bonus of 1000 Aurum

name: The Cycle: Frontier - Vivid Party Style Pack
summary: An exciting bundle of Vivid weapons and 'goldies' charms to bring your color and style down upon those dare to cross your path on Fortuna III. Plus, a bonus of 1000 Aurum!

name: The Cycle: Frontier - Howler Tamer Bundle
summary: Let the competition know who's really the planet's apex predator with this Howler themed vanity pack. Each is precious, each is deadly.. Plus, a bonus of 1000 Aurum

name: The Big Pond
summary: Sail a small boat around in the pond

name: The Keyper
summary: A new caretaker in an old, mysterious building. Collect keys and unlock the secrets beneath.

name: The Alchemist of Ars Magna
summary: The main character enters a school and gains experience in research, study, and love. This is the adventure story of an alchemist who grows through encounters and experiences and paves the way.

name: The Last Dragon Slayer
summary:
Go it alone... Or team up with friends!
Four Heroes arrive on the shores of Baelor, a Kingdom ravaged by the tyrannic rule of a Dragon. In order to defeat this Pagan Idol, you'll first need to scour the deep depths of mysterious dungeons, labyrinthic caves, and lush terrains.

Team up in Local Co-Op gameplay! Find secrets, collect upgrades, and power up on your journey to become the Last Dragon Slayer!

name: The JOTA Collection
summary: The Jump Over the Age Collection brings together the critically acclaimed In Other Waters, where you play as an Artificial Intelligence guiding a stranded xenobiologist, and Citizen Sleeper, a gripping adventure inspired by the flexibility and freed

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - NieR Pack
summary: A pack of additional music tracks to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

name: The Coffin of Andy and Leyley
summary: In The Coffin of Andy and Leyley, you follow the story of Andrew and Ashley, siblings who have been quarantined in their house for months and are slowly starving to death. Everyone in the building appears to have contracted a contagious disease and are now locked in their apartments by armed guards. The guards do keep promising to bring food, but none ever comes, so eventually they have to resort to drastic measures.

name: The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog
summary: A brand new Sonic experience from the minds of the Sonic Social team: The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog is a visual novel, point-and-click adventure! It's Amy Rose's birthday and she's hosting a murder mystery party on the Mirage Express. When Sonic becomes the game's victim, everyone is off to get to the bottom of things. However, something feels a bit off - is this really an innocent game or something more sinister afoot?

name: The ​Aquarium Does Not Dance
summary:
The ​Aquarium Does Not Dance is a Japanese free horror game. The first part was developed in 2021, and the complete version including the second part was released in 2024.

This is a horror adventure game in which a girl who cares for her best friend searches for her friend in an aquarium that has turned into a world of horror. While escaping from the deformed beings called " CREEPY," the player must solve the mysteries hidden in the aquarium.

The horror elements are mild, so players can enjoy solving the challenging riddles. In addition to the main character, the game features unique and attractive girls. The story is multi-ended, and the ending changes depending on your choices.

name: Thinkin' Science: Zap!
summary:
It is a dark and stormy night as you step backstage to be guest director at the Wonder Dome, the world-famous auditorium of light, sound, and electricity. But great zotz! The theater has been zapped by lightning, and the Laser Control System is on the fritz! Can you learn all about light, sound and electricity to rescue the show?

Using your own mental powers and some help from zany ZAP! stars Blaze, Surge and Riff, apply the principles of science to set up and test experiments with lasers, sound waves and circuits. Then, orchestrate your own wacky electro-laser-sound concerts!

name: The Thieves!
summary: The time has come to see how hard you worked at the gym!

name: Things to Get
summary: In this game, the user must pick up objects that will help him and solve the puzzles and finish the tasks. With each finished task the user will go to the next level. The user must look for objects that will help him solve the puzzles.

name: The Test: Secrets of the Soul 2
summary: You will answer questions that will reveal things deep within. Some will be uncomfortable, but with great knowledge comes great sacrifice. Can you make it all the way through The Test, and are you SURE you want the answers you seek? For it is time to once again unlock "Secrets of the Soul..."

name: The RailIdle
summary: Run the rails at the base, collect materials, and use them to head out on your adventure. The rails run automatically, so you can leave them alone! The further you advance, the more side content you unlock!

name: The Last Saintess
