summary: The offensive of the undead begins. Gather holy power to summon soldiers and strengthen the starlight of Hellendil to defeat the undead.

name: The Emperor Penguin Keita
summary: Keita, an intrepid emperor penguin, gets lost during his migration and begins an extraordinary adventure on the ice alone.

name: The Dungeon Vendor
summary: Travel to dungeons. Meet new heroes. Craft new weapons. Collect the loot. You are The Dungeon Vendor. The world has become a dark place and heroes are answering the call. It is time for you to help them by creating powerful weapons… for a tidy profit of course.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Book of Mudora
summary: Link’s newest quest is set a few generations after Twilight Princess and spans two different continents of Hyrule. Explore eight unique temples and defeat enemies and bosses in order to gain powerful items to assist you in your goal. Discover many areas of Hyrule and assist different races in their conflicts in order to stop the Dark Tribe from destroying Hyrule by obtaining the power of the Book of Mudora.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Mystery of Solarus DX
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Mystery of Solarus DX is a fan-made sequel to The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past on SNES, using the same graphics and game mechanisms.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Return of the Hylian SE
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Return of the Hylian SE is a Solarus-made remake of Vincent Jouillat’s first game, hence the SE suffix (stands for Solarus Edition). It was first released on 12th August, 2006, and made with another custom engine in C++. It has been remade entirely in Solarus to take advantage of the better capabilities of the engine.

name: The Perfect Specimen
summary:
You are Teagan, a Fae subject in an evil underground experiment run by the notorious mad scientist Doctor Dwight. Can you stay sane until help arrives? Or will you succumb to the Doctor’s dark experiments?

Content warning: Murder, stabbing, abusive relationship, medical horror, gore, psychological and physical torture, disturbing imagery, jumpscares, unsettling background music, drug use and sedatives.

name: The ABC
summary: This is the ABC story of Hee-chan's encounter with Brahmanism. Because Hee-chan is a girl who has a strong sense of justice, she is easy to lose her temper. Brahmana knows such a person's feature very well and he smells cinders from Hee-chan. Where does the smell of future comes from?

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Five Promises Made With Her
summary: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Five Promises Made with Her is the third The Quintessential Quintuplets romance visual novel developed by MAGES. The theme this time is “heart-pounding summer vacation dates.” As for what kind of story will unfold this time, more information will be shared in future announcements.

name: The Cycle: Frontier - Breakthrough
summary: The third season of The Cycle: Frontier.

name: This Is Not a Ball Game.
summary: This Is Not A Ball Game includes more than 90 challenging levels with Retina-quality graphics and a mysterious French genie as your guide. Swipe and tap the screen to launch balls into the arena to free Star Blocks, and bring the magic back to the Absurd Circus!

name: The Delusions of Maximillian Wurst
summary: The first chapter of a loop-de-loop platformer in which you control Maximillian Wurst, silver-tongued poet and abject moron, as he pursues a fantasy that wants nothing to do with him. Escape Father Time! Shoot as many Chadwicks as you can! Stumble along with poison coursing through your lily liver!

name: The Judgement Chamber
summary:
You will be shown a self-proclaimed victim, and the person whom they claim is the wrongdoer.

You will listen to their conversation, and from a neutral standpoint, you will determine whether the victim should take their revenge against the wrongdoer.

But do exercise caution.

After all, revenge here means that "the wrongdoer will be sentenced to death at the victim's hands".

name: The Legend of Zelda XD2: Mercuris' Chess
summary:
The Legend of Zelda XD2: Mercuris Chess is the sequel of the first XD parodic game, and was also released on April 1st, in 2017 this time. As a direct sequel, the overworld is expanded, the story is extended and the funny tone is kept, if not bettered!

The game was made in 10 weeks (!), beginning with an a discussion about how people always mispronounce Mercuris Chest (note the T at the end). Diarandor suggested that a game could be named Mercuris Chess to make fun of the title, and the same day it was decided that it would be the next big April’s fools joke.

The team worked really hard, and you can feel the improvements from the previous games. The game has 2 dungeons, and lots of side-quests and secrets everywhere, and also feature silly NPCs around the overworld. Be sure to speak to every one to not miss a joke!

name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Dream
summary:
The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Dream is a fanmade remake of the Game Boy cult classic The Legend of Zelda: Link’s Awakening, first published in 1993 and enhanced with colors in 1998 with its DX version.

The Solarus-made remake uses A Link to the Past graphics, extended with lots of custom sprites and tiles, in order to represent all the game’s characters, enemies and landscapes. Even the music has been remade in SNES-like fashion, to get the perfect feeling as if the game was released on Super Nintendo.

name: The Green Room Experiment: Episode 1 VR
summary: You're locked in a dream and you need to wake up. This game is designed on an escape game structure, you must solve a puzzle to move on to the next table. You will be transported to a dreamlike, strange universe, mixing exploration, mystery and poetry.

name: The King of Fighters XV: Characters - Kim Kaphwan
summary: "Kim Kaphwan" can be used in THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV.

name: The King's Campaign
summary: The King's Campaign is a hybrid of Grand Strategy and Real-Time Strategy gameplay set in Medieval Europe and North Africa, where you manage your cities, engage in diplomacy and direct your armies on the world map before plunging into battle and commanding your troops directly on the battlefield

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Omoide VR - Yotsuba
summary:
The Quintessential Quintuplets: Omoide VR - Yotsuba is the second official VR adventure game based on the popular manga series!

Play as Futaro Uesugi and enjoy spending time with the fourth Nakano Quint, Yotsuba, in this VR adventure game.

name: The Mega FMV Bundle
summary: Wales Interactive is proud to offer the Mega bundle for their very best FMV games! Featuring The Complex, Late Shift, The Bunker, The Shapeshifting Detective, The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker, Five Dates, Who Pressed Mute on Uncle Marcus, Bloodshore, Night Book and I Saw Black Clouds in one bundle!

name: The Solitaire Conspiracy: The Atlantis Project
summary:
The Atlantis Project is a noble force of aquatic avengers, hydrated heroes and lubricated legends. They fight for the seas, and all who treat the water with respect.

Players unlock this new crew via their own FMV campaign, hosted by Alanah Pearce. Via an intriguing story, players use their powerful Submerge skill, and take it into daily challenges, countdown and skirmish modes.

name: The Solitaire Conspiracy: Return of the Merry
The Riches of Agrabah with Disney
The World of Pirates
summary: Welcome in this simulation-action game of "The World of Pirates" where you take the role of a pirate battling to take over the sea.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 10
summary: Become a party legend! The celebrated franchise returns with epic drawing battles in Tee K.O. 2, chaotic type-offs in FixyText, time-travel trivia in Timejinx, hidden identity intrigue in Hypnotorious, and group music-making in Dodo Re Mi.

name: The Stig IV
summary: A Slovak text adventure recently re-released in English based around the subject of computer hacking and system penetration. It is an unofficial sequel to The Stig 3, by Fuxoft and there is important info that can help a user in this game. The story takes place in the (then) near future of 1991 in New York. You play as Tim Coleman, a programmer\hacker and your job is to hack Jack Ragger and clean out his accounts.

name: The Farmer Was Replaced
summary: Program and optimize a drone to automate a farm and watch it do the work for you. Collect resources to unlock better technology and become the most efficient farmer in the world. Improve your problem solving and coding skills.

name: The Legend of White Whale
summary:
Legend of White Whale is a role-playing game that focuses on a group of three mushroom friends on a quest to find "The White Whale," the legendary ship that brought their ancestors into the world.

The village of Mushsnail is starting to dry up, and that would mean certain death for everyone who lives there. Frup-Foo (our hero) believes that if the mythical White Whale exists, he can keep the secret of a new beginning. But there is an evil afoot. Now that Mushsnail is starting to dry up, he has been left vulnerable to monsters that previously couldn't enter the magic barrier. With each passing day, the village becomes more at risk.

White Whale features turn-based rpg battles and an aerial world map. Each character has their own abilities, of course. Priss is the healer as well as the state spell caster. Frup is slower than the others, but has a powerful special attack and is the only character who can use items during battle. Chup is the fighter, and he can only ... well... fight!

The game progresses in chapters. Each chapter takes place in the same world, just with a different goal.

name: The Runic Conjecture
summary: The Runic Conjecture is a magical puzzle game about experimenting and learning the meaning of mysterious runes. What may seem like Magic now is merely a Science that you have yet to understand.

name: The Return to Bloody Nights
summary: Get ready for a spine-tingling lore focused experience with our new fnaf fan game, "Return to Bloody Nights." Inspired by FNaF Plus, the original 4 FNaF games, and the books by Scott Cawthon, this game takes its own unique twist on the timeline and crucial events of the Five Nights at Freddy's series. With a combination of old-style atmosphere and gameplay, along with new mechanics, our game brings the best elements of the official games to the table. It's a reborn version of our previous game, "Bloody Nights at Freddy's."

name: The Shooting Range 3D: Shooting Gallery Simulator
summary: Shooting range is a great way to practice your shooting skills and improve your accuracy!

name: The Prowler Hell
summary: Escape from the devasted land and try to survive.

name: The Andromeda Mysteries
summary: Solve a mystery of a ring of spies, or a stolen alien artifacts. Play on an asteroid or at the edge of a black hole. This sci-fi whodunnit lets you chat naturally with AI-generated characters to discover the culprit of the mystery. Driven by ChatGPT, this mystery game gives you a new scenario and characters every time you play! Rank up as a detective to gain new characteristics of locations and suspects. Chat naturally with the characters as you hunt for clues. Even the artwork for each character is custom created by AI.

name: The Lonely Hacker
summary: Ever wanted to feel like a hacker? Welcome to the Lonely Hacker! A realistic hacking simulation game!

name: The Slime Plague
summary: A meteorite brought to Earth a poisonous slime that infects everything in its path in order to populate the planet with inhabitants from deep space. You will face monsters together with your friends to protect your farm and defend the invaders. Do not be afraid, because your friends rely on you.

name: The Last Exam
summary: Step into Dylan's shoes and experience a life-changing day in this point&click adventure game. Embark on a journey with Dylan through his last exam day and shape his destiny.

name: The Sorcerer's Sword
summary: Embark on a magical and wondrous adventure as you trek through dungeons, meet interesting characters, solve puzzles, and combat numerous enemies.

name: The Gerbil Experiment
summary: A Relaxing 2D Puzzle Game with 100s of both easy and challenging levels to solve by doing things in the correct order.

name: The One: Chapter 2
summary: Every hundreds of years or more, a male will be born, some say he will be a god amongst men who will save them as he will give them gifts that will make them Stronger, faster, better..... Follows "the One Chapter 1", The adventure continues.

name: The Alpha Wolf
summary: The Alpha Wolf is an RPG animal simulator game. Play as a wolf in this open world environment. Hunt and kill animals, gather your own wolf pack, upgrade their skills and become stronger. Unlock magic skills to hunt stronger animals, to fight bosses or other players in PVP Arena Battles.

name: The Chronicles of Rovania: Darkest Bridge
summary: Venture into a dark and terrifying world with Johann, fleeing from a war-torn region in the kingdom of Rovania. This captivating RPG features spine-chilling monsters, challenging quests, and intense battles. Immerse yourself in its breathtaking graphics and prepare for an unforgettable adventure.

name: These Doomed Isles: The First God
summary:
These Doomed Isles: The First God is a prologue chapter of the main game, These Doomed Isles. Play as Cernunnos, the Celtic god of nature, and lead the Celtic civilisation to victory against waves of invaders, curses and more!

Raise land from the sea, build a settlement for your followers and provide them with the means to gather the resources they need to prosper. Expand from humble beginnings to a sprawling island chain with farms, factories, fortifications and more, as you discover ever more advanced buildings and strategies.

name: The Way of Death
summary: Go on a path crucial for your honor. Pass through dangerous areas to complete your destiny. Duel against enemy warriors and kill dangerous Yokai creatures. Practice in sword combat to become a better swordsman.

name: The American War
summary: The American War is a first person shooter that takes place during the Vietnam conflict. The narrative is told through comic book panels from the perspective of a US Veteran recounting his experience. The accuracy of this account is dubious, twisted by trauma and the use of military stimulants.

name: Thesmophoria
summary: Do you and your friends have what it takes to impress the Greek Gods?

name: The Forgotten World
summary: "A game about growth and forgetting, and a card adventure named rescue. If you are Alice from a parallel world, how will you lead the poker army to save the "Forgotten World"?"

name: That Rocket Game
summary: That Rocket Game is the ultimate space themed relaxing arcade game. Upgrade your rocket to reach further into the unknown...

name: The Clown's Forest 2: Waking Shadows
summary: 25-year-old Carla Stevens and 25-year-old James Barlow head to Hartown Park one day after the events of The Clown's Forest. Can they survive the horrors that Blitzo the clown has in store for them? And can Michael survive his own nightmares?

name: The Guestlist
summary: The Guestlist is a horror game where you play as a traveler who gets trapped in a hotel during a thunderstorm. The eccentric and strange guest is your only company, but as you talk to them, you'll uncover the hotel's dark history.

name: The Hidden Room: Pyramid
summary: Continue your adventure in The Hidden Room with The Hidden Room: Pyramid! After what happened in Tom Barkley's house, you think that it's not over yet. That something else might have been hidden. This is your chance to find it out...again

name: The Lancaster Leak: O'Brien State Park
summary: An FBI intern leaked special investigation tapes before suddenly disappearing. The first tape of the series contains found footage from O'Brien State Park revealing the true events that were covered up in the 1980s.

name: The Last Castle
summary: "The Last Castle" is a lightweight tower defense Roguelite game, the game has a unique rotating castle mechanism, rich weapons and equipment systems, resist monsters, and reach the Holy Land of Eden!

name: The Danger Zone
summary: The Danger Zone is a post-apocalyptic 2.5D shooter with a side view and elements of survival in the unique style of "eternal sunset".

name: The Devil Lives Down Here
summary: Solve puzzles and trick demons while looking for a way out of this absurd situation involving the release of the Devil.

name: The Squire
summary: Some adventurers have hired you as a squire. Help these intrepid adventurers take down the new lord of darkness, while you pass your trial period. All jobs have their dangerous side, but precariousness in the kingdom and hunger is more dangerous.

name: The Kindeman Remedy
summary: The most blasphemous, diabolical and morally unacceptable management game ever. Aided by a lascivious nun in a hellish prison, rig executions, conduct horrid experiments and do unspeakable things to create The Kindeman Remedy. Don't fear: this time, you're the monster!

name: The Heights
summary: The heights is a story based first-person single-player action platformer. Shoot and climb to the top of the skyscraper whilst avoiding assured death. Solve puzzles to proceed to the next floor. Get Access to the CEO's hard-drive in the office on the top floor to sell it to the highest bidder.

name: The Pair Annihilation
summary: The Pair Annihilation is a grid-based and turn-based strategy game that depicts a war to protect the human race. It features multiple battlefields, different ship combinations, and various relics.

name: The Last Root
summary: The Last Root is a gripping top-down RPG about a young cactus named Rogi who must rescue her family from an oppressive empire that is attempting to take over the world.

name: The Twin Paradox
summary: The Twin paradox is an RPG in which you need to get ready for the first time travel. Learn real physics concepts in an easy way while you explore and talk with different characters. Prepare the best for the mission or it may be a failure.

name: The Willow Man
summary: Beware The Willow Man as he lurks throughout the halls, in your dreams, and into your soul. Can you survive the night in this indie 2d horror adventure.

name: The Elderseed
summary: Embark on an epic action adventure by unraveling the mystery of the Elder Seed and save the world from falling into chaos. Journey with Milo through colorful handcrafted lands, forests, caves and dungeons. Forge new weapons and encounter strange creatures who will help you throughout your journey.

name: The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication
summary: The Bridge Curse 2: The Extrication is part two of The Bridge Curse series. It's a first-person survival horror game where the player controls four characters during Wen Hua University's "Carnival of Horror." What lurks around the corner is foreboding dread, a few laughs, and of course... pure fear.

name: The Void Calls
summary: The Void Calls, and you will answer. Explore the mysteries and secrets of Reprieve, a town stitched together from the dark past of its bizarre inhabitants in this horror-filled point-and-click adventure.

name: The Backrooms: Investigate and Escape
summary: Backrooms: Investigate and Escape is action-survival horror experience. You are at the mercy of the entities lurking and must do whatever it takes to survive while completing each level's objectives. Multiple new levels will be added each month as we develop the true Backrooms experience.

name: Three Minutes to Eight
summary: Three Minutes To Eight is a mind bending pixel art adventure. A gaming experience threading the edge of consciousness, where everything is possible and yet remains elusive.

name: The Archives
summary: You'll explore a post-apocalyptic world that's been ravaged by war and natural disasters. Set in the aftermath of a global economic collapse and escalating tensions between NATO and BRICS, the game takes place several years after a devastating event that has left the world in ruins.

name: The Regions
summary: This is a puzzle game about "Region". Manipulate the region to reach the goal state.

name: The Declassifier
summary: Uncover The Government's darkest secrets in this action packed top down shooter inspired by 80's action flicks of questionable quality.

name: The Mountaineers
summary: The Mountaineers is a climbing platformer set in a wholesome universe. It’s an arcade game with the objective to climb as high as possible despite various obstacles. As you progress you can get rid of your rental shoes, earn your way to go shirtless and buy proper equipment.

name: The Paracelsian Project
summary: You awaken in an unfamiliar location with unfamiliar people and are surrounded by mystery. Will you be able to solve the puzzle and uncover why you are here in this sci-fi/mystery/puzzle visual novel? The future hangs in the balance.

name: The Great Smog
summary: The Great Smog is a Co-Op Steampunk Horror that blends the group scares of Horror Hunters with the player-driven gameplay of Immersive Sims. Descend from your fully customizable airship to scavenge resources from an alt-history London and take on monsters inspired by British myths.

name: The Chalk
summary: Descend into abandoned gold mine filled with danger. Compete with others for gold, but beware of the lurking monster and water flooding the floors. Use chalk marks to navigate, and customize your character to suit your style. Survive and escape with your riches intact.

name: The Gentle Art of Slaughter
summary: Kill all the cultists before midnight strikes

name: The Secret of Varonis
summary: An indie Gameboy-style RPG. Build a party from four unique races and unravel the mystery of Varonis through challenging old-school turn-based combat.

name: The Mangust
summary: The Mangust is a high octane action platformer. You play as the Mangust, a lone drifter with a loose grip on reality. Blitz through enemies with an arsenal of customizable guns and special abilities. Explore different environments, defeat iconic bosses, and stop the plans of the Evil Dr. Cassowary.

name: The Rebirth of Kingdom Lo
summary: This game is a conversational RPG, depicting the story of the kemono prince and six princesses, in order to revive the kingdom and reproduce their offspring.

name: The Song of the Nightrider
summary: Unravel the secrets of evil love with sword and song. Become a sound witch and break the Nightrider's curse!

name: The Jeffy Game
summary: The Jeffy Game is an outrageously fun 2D platformer where you play as Jeffy and embark on the adventure of a lifetime! Defeat the evil green beans, collect the cereal boxes, and discover hidden surprises!

name: The Drone Zone
summary: Action survival shooter with an open map, upgrades, lots of weapons and many enemy types.

name: The Alchemist of Nafiljar
summary: You wanted to be an Alchemist and after several years studying you finally have your own business. Will you be able to stand out and become the real Alchemist? Mix ingredients, sell potions and find out the essences to grow your reputation in this game of deductions where each game is unique.

name: The Black Within
summary: The Black Within is a single-player first-person psychological horror. When selling her soul for fame and fortune, Laila Rose faces the consequences of her actions. A tale of Greed, fear, and change.

name: The Gap
summary: The Gap is a short first-person horror experience taking place in a ghostly abandoned house on a lonely street corner.

name: The Phoenix Initiative
summary: Play as one of the last surviving humans on a post-apocalyptic Earth, where resources are scarce and danger lurks around every corner. As you scavenge for supplies, fend off vicious enemies, and build a small colony, you must use your wits and combat skills to survive in this harsh new world.

name: The Geometric Golfer
summary: The Geometric Golfer is an educational game about geometry that is loosely based on the sport of golf.

name: The Gray Wolf and The Little Lamb
summary: Once upon a time there lived the grey wolf and the little lamb. One was infamously cruel while the other had a heart of gold. They both egotistically believed they could teach one another a life lesson. But maybe they could become friends in the end?

name: The Lonely League
summary: The Lonely League is a comic book style superhero tactical fangame RPG with Superman, Batman, Venom and John Lennon. It alternates between comic book cutscenes and tactical battles inspired by games like Shining Force and Final Fantasy Tactics. Battles are challenging and deeply tactical, and there are always multiple paths to victory, which often include not only attacking but also interacting with map objects and recruiting temporary characters. The story develops from common errands of an ordinary guy, slowly escalating to an epic journey with psychological and political undertones.

name: The Sorrowvirus
summary: On the verge of death of a life unlived, Wyatt Heyll was given The Sorrowvirus by his parents, a substance that suspends the human soul in Purgatory after death; allowing Purgatory's mysterious properties to heal them. As he ebbs, Wyatt's only desire is to be free, forever.

name: Thrusters
summary:
Thrusters is the twelfth game of the NES version of Action 52.

The gameplay is one of the many space shooter games on Action 52. It is which you play as a spaceship shooting enemies.

name: They Came...
summary: A game featured in Action 52.

name: The Quest: Mithril Horde II
summary: The Quest - Mithril Horde II is an expansion to The Quest, a beautifully hand-drawn open world role playing game with old school grid-based movement and turn based combat.

name: The Idle Forces: Army Tycoon
summary:
The Idle Forces: Army Tycoon is incremental game. But it isn’t one of the traditional idle city builder games! You won't find here supermarket, restaurant, roller coaster and amusement park because it is an army simulator, rookie!
Do you want to become an idle army commander and command the tycoon military units of a powerful state and execute peacekeeping campaigns? Do you want to raise a recruit to a military specialist? Bring Freedom, Law and Order even to the most remote corners of the planet!

name: Thanks, Come Again
summary: A game by Incisor Studios for the Cartomancy Anthology. A game about the day-to-day of a simple shopkeeper and their complex wares. Try not to give too much of yourself away.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man Rescue
summary: "The Amazing Spider-Man Rescue" is a simple portable game that is mostly based on random luck. The player presses a button, after which various lights illuminate, accumulating different points. These points need to be manually counted and added to the score wheel as Spider-Man climbs higher and higher. The game can be played with two players. The game is functionally identical to The Incredible Hulk Escapes.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man: Dodge Doc Ock
summary: An LCD handheld game based on Spider-Man.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man: Skyscraper Scaler
summary: An LCD handheld game based on Spider-Man.

name: The Batman: Bring on the Batman
The Game Machine
summary: Multi-game tabletop system that has 4 games built in with overlays: Shooting Gallery, Black Jack 21, Code Hunter Game and Auto Race Game. Can also be used as a calculator.

name: The Incredible Hulk Escapes
summary: The Incredible Hulk Escapes is a simple handheld game mostly based on random luck. The player presses a button to which different lights will light up leading to different scores. The scores need to be counted up manually and added to the score wheel while the Hulk climbs higher and higher. The game can be played with two players.

name: The Vampire(?) Detective and the Case of the Lying Maid
summary: Enid had a crush on her eccentric lady Olivia for as long as she can remember, but she'll rather die than admit it. One day, she's summoned to Olivia's study for an unclear reason...

name: The Hit Car
summary:
The Hit Car is a car driving - invasion preventing simulator.
Earth has been affected with the every possible threats. Aliens, zombies and even robots are already here and your job it to get rid of them.
Collect the coins to buy car upgrades and the powerful weapons.
Hit, shoot, and smash anything that stands in your way and show to everyone how good you are on online leaderboards.

name: The Aether II
summary:
The Aether II is the sequel to the highly popular dimension mod "The Aether", set in a hostile paradise miles up in the clouds, the Aether is an entirely different world from what regular players are used to, filled with fantastic creatures and mysterious structures, the Aether is a world brimming with life and history. You'll have to relearn key ideas as the Aether challenges you with twisted materials, terrifying monsters and deep lore if you want to survive and prosper in this strange new land.

As the mod comes closer to a final release, Dungeons, Biomes, NPC settlements will pepper the landscape, offering new and exciting challenges and experiences unique to this mysterious world.

name: The Artist: Act One
summary: Do you feel good where you are? Some people do, some don't even if they have everything in the world. Does love fix that sort of feeling, even if such feelings feel so hard to grasp and such love could be toxic to yourself? What is a loving muse to the artist who paints them?

name: The Witch, Wife, & the Wish
summary: Once upon a time, there was a witch who lived in the middle of a forest. Rumors said that even the witch was cursed herself, but the witch had long forgotten what spell had been cast, until one day a brave young man came to ask a favor of the witch, for his ailing wife.

name: Threat Actor
summary: Threat Actor is a story rich, cybercrime-themed game, where you, an infamous hacker and paranoid owner of an underground marketplace, are ready to do whatever it takes to secure the legacy of your business as one of the most luxurious trading sites on the Dark Web.

name: The Kingpin
summary: Kingpin is a popular, tactical board game, today available also for iOS users. It takes place in a dark city. The players are involved in the fight between four crime groups: the Russian Mob, the Italian Mafia, the Colombian Cartel and the Yakuza. Shootings, murders and robberies happen very often. The city can be ruled only by one group. Users have to choose their mafia and do their best to support it. In each group there are various characters with different skills which are useful during direct confrontation with the enemy. The player's task is to defeat the opponent mafia and take control of the city. Nice graphics, based on the aesthetic of a comic strip make the game even more interesting. There are three different tactics which can lead you to success, but there is only one Kingpin!

name: Three Kingdoms Origin
summary: Three Kingdoms Origin is a multi-player online real-time strategy game based on the Three Kingdoms history which recreates realistic landscapes in the world map. Look out for flank attacks and road blocks from your enemies when you explore the open world and build your city.

name: The Final Exhibition
summary: Explore an ever-changing maze as you hunt for photos of important objects and avoid whatever could be stalking you throughout the halls.

name: The Bread Must Rise
summary: The Great Godstone Bake-off has arrived! As a hapless baker deeply in debt, you finally have the opportunity to rise to fame and fortune! Under the tutelage of famous chefs , you will learn the arts of baking, breading, and dare you whisper it...necromancy?

name: The Forgotten Tapes: Twisted Forms
summary: The second collection in the widely received "Forgotten Tapes" series, where we explore the theme of "Body Horror" with 8 unique games from different developers. Explore a morgue after hours & experiment on 8 poor souls who have lost their way. Can you make it through the night?

name: The Game of Annie
summary: This is a third person action shooter game. Support for custom character size, support for costume change, use guns and bows for long-distance combat, can also use cold weapons for melee combat, with some training elements. Enemies include monsters and humans.

name: Them's Fightin' Herds: Stronghoof
summary: The 9th character to join the TFH roster is Stronghoof the Reindeer. Conjure an arsenal of icy, magical weaponry and fight alongside his muscly winter sprite Vetr!

name: The Capcom Collection
summary:
The Evercade EXP features 18 built-in games from world famous publisher Capcom!
Out of the box, no download required, you’ll have access to 14 arcade greats and 4 home console classics including
Street Fighter II’: Hyper Fighting, Mega Man, Final Fight, Ghouls ‘n Ghosts, Strider, Breath of Fire (full games list below) and more including full TATE mode support!

name: Therapist: Mind Manager
summary: Therapist: Mind Manager is a visual novel with simulation elements set on modern times, following the life of an ordinary man working as a psychotherapist.

name: The Deep Ones
summary:
In a mysterious little town, inhabited by a strange tackle shop owner, the deep waters are stirring...

Explore the foggy landscape and try to fill out your fish species logbook. Purchase items and upgrades to help you catch stronger and rarer fish. But beware, these fish won't be caught without a fight - they may just drag you down with them!

name: The Door
summary: The Door is a short supernatural horror game made in a month for "The Forgotten Tapes: Analog Nightmares", and the debut game for it's developer.

name: The Lost World
summary: A somewhat Frogger-like game with a military theme.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Necrom
summary:
Traverse the Telvanni Peninsula in Morrowind and preserve secrets ascribed to the unfathomable realms of Apocrypha. Unlock the runic power of a brand-new class - the Arcanist - and fight to uphold reality itself.

The Collection: Necrom contains the base game, Necrom and all previous Chapters. Pre-purchase to get the Spore mount instantly and more items at launch.

name: The King of Thieves
summary: King of Thieves is frighteningly addictive game in which you must demonstrate a cunning, perceptive and intelligence. Grab the treasure and don't get caught the soldiers who defend it. 20 different levels, and each of them will provide you many moments of great fun. Play and become the King Of Thieves.

name: The Chicken Family
summary: Embark on an adventure with a daring and determined hen, as she sets out to rescue her chicks from treacherous cages. Use your wit and puzzle-solving skills to navigate through challenging levels filled with obstacles, traps, bridges, and more. Collect cookies, gems, and coins along the way, unlocking new levels, worlds, and customization options. Help the hen lead her chicks safely to the coop, but be careful not to fall off the platforms or get stopped by rolling barrels and sharp traps. With vibrant, cartoon-style graphics and exciting, fast-paced gameplay, this low poly 3D platformer puzzle game is a delightful experience that will keep you entertained for hours. So gather your courage, grab your key, and join the hen on her quest to save her chicks and become the ultimate chick hero.

name: Thriving City: Song
summary: In 960 A.D., the Zhao Song Dynasty was established. As the mayor, you'll need to help the townspeople settle down, cultivate the land and expand. However, when the emperor issues a national mandate, conflicts between factions threaten city development—what strategy will you adopt?

name: The Sims 4: Greenhouse Haven Kit
summary: The Sims 4 Greenhouse Haven Kit

name: The Sims 4: Basement Treasures Kit
summary: Hand-me-down furniture and forgotten favorites await in The Sims 4 Basement Treasures Kit.

name: The Akaneia Build
summary: The Akaneia Build is a ground-breaking Melee mod that adds new viable and authentic content to the game such as costumes, stages, and more. The mod is powered by m-ex, our own system that allows for streamlined expansion of content in Melee.

name: The Other Shore
summary:
The Other Shore an RPG title that tells the wonderful story of heaven and earth. At the beginning of the creation of the world, God created a paradise to share divinity with man. However, man was deceived into sin, causing God to abandon man and paradise forever.

Since then, the world has been divided into two parts including the present world, which is full of war, conspiracy and abyss, which is full of spirit and sin. To return to the ideal paradise, people have been searching endlessly "Tears of God" because they possess mysterious powers. However, as the soul gradually awakens, the immediate question is whether humans should be wiped out of all sense of self and become lifeless beings?

name: The Tail of CatPat
summary: Follow CatPat and the gang on an amazing adventure!

name: The Milked Busty Stepsister
summary: The Milked Busty Stepsister (all characters are 18+ and no character get hurt in this video game), sex Simulator where you will be able to penetrate hard penis to vagina and make an incredible pleasure to make the vagina squirt and wet

name: The Swordsmen X: Green-bamboo pack
summary: This DLC item is a construction blueprint (not a finished product). Green Bamboo Weapons need to be forged at level 8 to unlock and make them. Green Bamboo Houses need to be built at level 16 to unlock and make them. It takes a long time in the game, so please buy carefully!

name: The Revolt Fire Rising
summary: The revolt fire rising, traitors are everywhere. Is the council working for you or the enemy? Is the army on your side or are they against you? Answers will bring more questions

name: The Treflik Family: Deluxe Edition
summary: The Deluxe Edition of The Treflik Family includes the game plus the "Cure for Treflinka" DLC.

name: The Goblins are Coming
summary: Arm Yourself! The Goblins Are Coming! Become the last line of defense to protect your lords treasure from unrelenting attacks from goblin hordes. In this action based tower defense style game protect your lords treasure chests from goblin raiders.

name: The Tale of Food
summary: Embark on a 2-million-word fantasy adventure as the descendant of the Food God. Collect and nurture Food Souls as you explore time and space! Interact with them closely and record every precious moment.

name: The Catapult
summary: Game about hero in castle siege, vs stickmans with catapult and archers with bows and arrows.

name: The Ultimate FMV Bundle
summary: Wales Interactive is proud to offer the ultimate bundle for their very best FMV games! Featuring The Complex, Late Shift, The Bunker, The Shapeshifting Detective and The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker in one bundle!

name: The Interactive Movie Bundle
summary: Wales Interactive is proud to offer two of their very best interactive movies, The Complex and Late Shift, in one bundle!

name: The Oregon Trail: Cowboys and Critters
summary: Embark on new journeys, cook for real cowboys, and discover the legends of fearsome critters.

name: The Oregon Trail: Boom Town
summary:
Get ready to experience life as a pioneer in this reimagining of the classic game, The Oregon Trail! A game that combines adventure, simulation, and settlement survival. Build, grow, craft and harvest as you turn the small frontier village, of Independence Missouri, into a thriving boom town!
Dysentery, Cholera, Typhoid and snakes - oh my! Help Settlers survive the dangerous journey west in this re-imagining of the classic game, The Oregon Trail!

Help pioneers survive the trail, and prepare for their dangerous journey across the Oregon Trail and outfit settlers with all the supplies they need to survive! Follow the progress of the Pioneers as their wagons forge the way west across America’s frontier on their way to a new life. The wagons may call for supplies along the way, so be ready to collect resources and send them food, tomatoes, corn, eggs, medicine, clothes or whatever else they need to survive. Challenge your survival skills as you fix your wagons and face the harsh desert conditions.

Create the town of your dreams in this town-building simulator game! Start with building marketplaces, shops, and saloons on your own land. Upgrade with a port, rail station, museum, or even a university for your villagers. Arrange and rearrange your layout. Add decorations, design, upgrade and monuments to make your town beautiful. As you level up, new buildings are unlocked, opening exciting new possibilities. With hard work and creativity, you can truly build the Independence of your dreams!

Design, Manage and grow your very own frontier boom town in this farming and city building simulator inspired by the classic game The Oregon Trail! Plant, collect, and harvest crops, raise and care for a variety of farm animals on the land, build stores, factories and more as you help prepare pioneers for their journey west along The Oregon Trail. The town of their dreams is in your hands!

Go beyond your own town to participate in a wide variety of weekly and seasonal events. You can connect with your friends or family, join a clan, and compete or collaborate in special challenges.
Are you ready? Do you have the skill, foresight, and creativity to turn Independence into a Boom Town? Hopeful settlers are gathering in Independence, counting on you to make their dreams come true. The journey begins when you join this thrilling town-building simulator game—The Oregon Trail: Boom Town!

name: 'The
summary:
Mario goes on another quest to save the kingdom. What obstacles will he be facing this time?

'the (also known as Coronation Day) is a Horror themed Super Mario World ROM Hack released in January 2016. The hack features Mario in a forest like environment, with various messages coming from a strange, disembodied voice, but there's something more to it than that...

name: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo: Fantabulous Edition
summary: Includes exclusive cover and keyring.

name: The Many Pieces of Mr. Coo: Coollector Edition
The Adventures of LinShanHai: Chapter 4 - Vanishing Masterpiece
summary: A famous painting called 'The Rhapsody of the Goddess' worth over 100M has been stolen from the Treasure Chamber on the top floor of the Central Art Museum in City F. The municipal bureau has ordered that the case must be solved within three days due to the involvement of this national treasure.

name: The Unfallens: Awakening
summary: Returning from exile underground, a shattered world awaits you. The once-thriving civilization of Unfallens now lies in ruins. The ruthless guardian wait to attack. Journey through remains, use your skills to overcome intense boss battles. Awaken your true power. Reclaim what was lost.

name: The Great War 3032
summary: We are in the year 3032. For some time now, there has been a war between the Northern and Southern nations. Choose a side and enter the battle as an advanced combat robot. Play against friends in multiplayer deathmatch or team up with up to three others in co-op mode.

name: The Enemy Weapons Are Better
summary: Goofy Ahh stories that take place in the world of data. The game simply has to press the move button to run around and kill enemies with their weapons.

name: The Stoevi Curse
summary: Unravel the mystery of The Stoevi Curse, a first-person survival horror game set in rural post-Communist Bulgaria. Protect your farm, save your family.

name: The Cosmic Wheel Sisterhood
summary: Immerse yourself in an enchanting narrative experience as Fortuna, a fortune-teller Witch condemned to exile on her asteroid home. Craft your own Tarot deck, regain your freedom, and shape the fate of the cosmic Witch society.

name: That's a Cow: Special Edition
summary: Soar through the air and don't get milked in this cute game.

name: The Pellar
summary: The Pellar is an action-adventure game in which you play the role of a lonely quack doctor. Your task is to prepare medicines, potions and bandages that will be used to help those in need. Struggle with healing various ailments in this magical world inspired by Slavic mythology.

name: The Last Z VR
summary: A cooperative virtual reality game playable from 1 to 12 players with a variable game duration between 10 to 30 minutes.

name: Thereafter
summary: You play as a stray black cat, abandoned in a dark alleyway. Your goal is to find and untangle the mysteries of several lost spirits in order to fulfill their journey into the afterlife.

name: The Old Man and His Cat
summary: Play as Domino, a stray cat in love with food, in this heartwarming adventure where you help an old man overcome his grief after his wife passed away. Use your feline skills to explore and solve puzzles as you strive to bring joy into the old man's life and build an unbreakable bond with him.

name: The Scrap
summary: The Scrap is an independent third-person shooter that takes place in a futuristic world inhabited by robots.

name: The Last Survivors
summary: Kill the zombies and take on challenges by helping the last survivors in the city. The Last Survivors is a fun roguelite action game with an infinite power-up experience that is repeatable every time you play. Never stop, collect as much XP and Boosters to get stronger by choosing your upgrades.

name: The Girl From the Snuff Video
summary: A visual novel about a girl who watches a snuff video to relieve stress, justifying herself with the fact that what is happening on the screen isn’t real...

name: The Magistrate
summary: The Magistrate is a construction & management sim game which at the same time provides players with unique legal case investigation experiences.

name: The Flying Feathers
summary: Nia accidentally goes into her best friend—Alice's past, the only way to escape and go back to the real world is to help Alice to solve all her problems. When you can go back to the past, do you want to do everything you can to save what you've lost?

name: The Murder Hotel
summary: Interrogate suspects, search for clues, & uncover a dastardly plot, as you solve a string of mystifying murders to help reluctant detective Ilmarinen escape the foreboding Fafnir Hotel. From the maker of The Donnerwald Experiment comes a detective adventure with a twist.

name: The Quiet Things
summary: An auto-biographical, narrative game, based on real diary entries kept as a teenager. The Quiet Things seeks to explore mental health issues with a raw but brave look at childhood abuse and trauma. With a deep focus on storytelling through audio, set foot in Alice’s world and hear her story.

name: The Rusty Longsword
summary: Join Rana, a cute gnome, on a whimsical adventure up a magical island in this enchanting 3D pixel art game. Meet new friends, collect treasures, and unlock secrets along the way!

name: The Apothecary
summary: Discover the source of a mysterious plague and build your apothecary in the city of Bloodmill. An epic adventure in a world full of disease and ruin. Explore the city, build your apothecary, create toxic potions, fight corrupt diseased creatures, discover powerful weapons and useful allies.

name: The Crimson Kingdom
summary: Travel and fight your way through this fantasy world to save your kingdom from evil forces in a 2d roguelike adventure!

name: The Red Selene
summary: The new genre of sci-fi horror survival and all-out action is now with your beloved pixel-art classic games. Grab the top weapons, and resources and use them in the modern combat system with a traditional and retro vibe, Immerse yourself in the huge hand-drawn environments with massive details.

name: The Happies: Doomsday Stories
summary: Build ships, assemble crews, evacuate the planet from disaster. Conquer space, explore a universe full of dangers: aggressive ufos, ravenous space piranhas or deadly radiation. Find your way, fight battles and if you can survive, find a new home. Indie casual strategy card game.

name: The Abandoned Presence
summary: The Abandoned Presence is a gritty and challenging Metroidvania set in a world heavily inspired by India's urban heritage and industrial core. Search for answers as Zoe; wield industrial weapons, traverse city skylines, and take on elite enemies to uncover the secrets of The Abandoned Presence.

name: The Lost Moon
summary: The Lost Moon is an Adventurous Online Multiplayer Coop game where your group of future Astronauts are on a mission to solve the mystery of the failed Moon missions. But be aware or your surroundings, we can never be sure what is really going on up there...

name: The Chef's Shift
summary: The Chef’s Shift is a fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING.

name: The Paper Arcade
summary: The Paper Arcade is a collection of classic arcade-style games with a unique drawing and sketchbook aesthetic. Enjoy fast-paced, high-score chasing action, challenging puzzles, and casual games. Each game is brought to life with stunning hand-drawn graphics. Addictive, retro-style gaming fun!

name: The Last Golden Fox
summary: Protect the last golden fox at all costs! Fight against hordes of monsters and prevent them from taking the precious fox through the portal. Be quick and strategic with your slingshot in this epic battle for the survival of the Golden Fox. Will you be able to defend it or will it become extinct?

name: That Potato Game
summary: Explore life as a potato and roll your way through the cozy, mystical home of Hilbert. Complete puzzles, gain abilities, and find hidden secrets within!

name: The Outsiders
summary: Outsiders is an 80's inspired horror experience with asymmetric multiplayer game modes, along with a full single player story mode.

name: The Tenants: Pets
summary: Experience the joy of bringing people and pets together in this delightful expansion for The Tenants. Build your property empire with a pet-friendly approach, and watch your business thrive as you satisfy animal lovers in Wondersville!

name: The Moonflower
summary: The Moonflower is a cooperative horror-survival video game the game is set in an abandoned forest island, where there is the known demon "Moonflower" and the players will have to block it as much as possible / hunt it via an underground laboratory.

name: Therapy Simulator 2023
summary: Top-down fast paced game. Find the right person, make the therapist happy

name: The Hero's Way
summary: Get ready for battle, hero! Your bravery and strength will be a bulwark in this world of the risen dead, and you will defeat them all!

name: The Witch of Sherdorne Forest
summary: The Lord's son has vanished and you decide to venture out in search of the boy.

name: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - Song for Prism
summary: The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors - Song for Prism is a free-to-play rhythm game based on The Idolmaster: Shiny Colors.

name: The Jungle Book
summary:
IBM produced FMV game starring uncredited chimpanzee and Gary Schwartz.

Deep within India's Black Jungle, a scandalous crime has taken place. Someone has stolen the jeweled crown of King Louie, the orangutan who rules Monkey City. Now he's hoppin' mad and there will be no peace until his crown is returned. Mowgli and his friends are counting on you to help recover this sacred treasure and restore calm to the jungle world.

name: The Intermine Legacy: I am the Darkness
summary:
Deep underground, nestled in the remains of a post-apocalyptic American South, rests a cryogenic facility called Intermine Laboratories. In this miniscule piece of frost-stricken hell rests a collective of eclectic individuals who are inexplicably awoken from their restless dreams long before their assigned time.

But, the facility has changed in the time since they've gone to sleep. It's become a fascistic nightmare in the wake of a gruesome civil war, and everywhere they go ... it feels like they're being watched. To add insult to injury, some of them have started acting ... funny ...

name: The Voyager
summary: After working all your life you have finally managed to build a device that allows you to travel between parallel worlds. will you be able to return home?

name: The Legend of Zelda: The Shadow's Fall
summary: The Legend of Zelda: The Shadow’s Fall is a short 2-4 hour long hack that was made over the course of 18 hours as part of a casual challenge between Letterbomb, Zarby89, Scawful, and Jared_Brian_. Each had to design the entirety of the overworld, dungeons, story, ASM, and everything else in between with the 18-hour time limit, only allowing extra time for testing and bug fixing.

name: The Picture of Cafe au Lait
summary: The picture of café au lait is a visual novel game that makes the players feel immersed in story and character. They will experience the story in the game through the first-person perspective of the main character in the story named "Takagi".

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
The Sum of All Fears
summary: The Sum of all Fears is a shooter reminiscent of Rogue Spear. The look and feel is alike, although it's simplified in its gameplay mechanics. It is also not a huge departure in comparison to the original version, but obviously converted to a top-down perspective.

name: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
summary: Mobile port of The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie

name: The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron Boy Genius: Attack of the Twonkies
summary: Game Boy Advance port of The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron Boy Genius: Attack of the Twonkies.

name: The Fairly OddParents: Shadow Showdown
summary: The Fairly OddParents!: Shadow Showdown is a 3D platformer game based on The Fairly OddParents cartoon. When the TV goes out just as the season finale of Crash Nebula starts, Timmy Turner asks his Fairy Godparents for a little help. When they find their magic is gone, they travel to the Fairy world, where they quickly learn that the Royal jewel is missing and Jorgen von Strangle thinks a recently fired jester is responsible. Now the player is off to uncover the truth.

name: The Legend of Spyro: A New Beginning
The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy
The Incredibles: Rise of the Underminer
The Sims 3
summary:
The Sims 3 is a handheld game, developed by Electronic Arts for the Nintendo DS handheld system.

For the first time ever, players can experience a full life simulation on a handheld with Nintendo DS. However, Sims are unable to age, WooHoo, or have children. The neighborhood in the game is Beacon Bay, and many familiar Sims and/or relatives, such as Malcolm Landgraab and Alexander Goth, appear.

name: The Sims 3
summary: Mobile port of The Sims 3.

name: The Sims 3
summary:
The Sims 3 is a console game developed by Electronic Arts for the Nintendo Wii.

For the first time ever, players can take on up to three friends in the Life Moments Game. The neighborhood in the game is Vista Beach.

name: The Dukes of Hazzard: Return of the General Lee
The Smurfs Bakery
summary: Budge Studios presents The Smurfs Bakery! Join Smurfette in the kitchen and whip up delectable desserts. Fancy a Smurfberry Ice Pop? Choose a flavor, try out different chocolate dips and get creative with toppings. Once you’ve created the smurfiest dessert, test out the recipe at home!

name: The Lord of the Rings: Gollum - Precious Edition
summary:
Whether you are a long-time fan of the world created by J. R. R. Tolkien or whether you are exploring The Lord of the Rings for the first time, the Precious Edition offers an even more immersive game experience.

This edition includes:
- The Lord of the Rings: Gollum
- Lore Compendium
- Sindarin Voiceover
- Art Exhibition
- Original Soundtrack

name: The Urbz: Sims in the City
The Dark Book
summary: An obscure old-school rpg - Single player offline with a skeleton warrior

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero - Deluxe Edition
summary: The Deluxe Edition includes Base Game, Digital Soundtrack and Mini Art Book.

name: Therapy for Orchestra Movement III
summary: Instruments do have a soul, and we should nourish that.

name: Theo Space Miner
summary:
Join Theo on his space adventure and help him get the minerals that Earth needs.
Your task is to collect minerals and fuel on planets full of space machines with different abilities that prevent you from collecting them.

name: The House of Rats
summary: The House of Rats is a short horror game based on the work of the same name by H.P. Lovecraft.

name: The Big Big Castle!
summary:
Build amazing 100, 500 or even 1000 foot tall castles for the King, because, well, that's what Kings like. Castles! And really big ones!
Take on the role (if you dare) of the King's personal castle builder and be prepared to jump at his every whim as you build amazing castles for the kingdom.
Building castles hasn't been this much fun since 1326.
And when your done building castles, it's time to destroy them! Use Cannonballs, Super Cannonballs and even UFOs to destroy not only your castles, but the castles of your Game Center friends.
Compete with your friends and the world to build the tallest and most amazing castles.
The King isn't stingy. Building castles earns coins you can spend on exciting upgrades and new building styles like Cathedrals!

name: The Way Home
summary: The Way Home is a Metroidvania 2D platformer where you play as a raccoon, separated from his family, who must flee from a raging forest fire. Explore the vast and beautiful woodland, find hidden secrets and collect useful items, and avoid dangerous enemies and obstacles.

name: The Night Market
summary: Welcome to the Night Market. Survive your journey while navigating a foreign land, rife with political intrigue, arbitrary rules and secrets designed to keep you distracted. Fall in love, explore a world with rich characters, and try to save the realm.

name: The Precinct
summary: Averno City, 1983. Gangs rule the streets and your father lies restless in his grave. Clean up the city, uncover the truth, and embark on thrilling vehicle chases through destructible environments in this neon-noir action sandbox police game.

name: The Nameless: Slay Dragon
summary: The Nameless: Slay Dragon is a gamebook-adventure flavored turn-based RPG In short - how to slay the immensely powerful and cunning evil dragon? You will play as a young man having a bloody feud with a dragon, and face powerful, sinister and tricky enemies with friends....

name: The Red
summary: Debt-ridden and desperate? Get out of the red and into The Red! Join the Red Horizons on Mars as an Extraction Security Associate and pay off your debts by defending your way to wealth in this ironic first-person/tower-defense/comedy-horror adventure!

name: The Dream Labyrinth
summary: The Dream Labyrinth is a single-player game that combines tower defense with roguelike elements. Gather companions in the form of souls and use artifacts and structures to aim for the deepest part of the dream, where the key to the contract lies!

name: The Groom of Gallagher Mansion
summary: Hunt down a beheaded ghost to save your college club from losing funding! It'll be a piece of cake— wait, what do you mean he wants to marry you!? The Groom of Gallagher Mansion is spooky comedic romantic visual novel full of laughs and scares all around!

name: The Paradell
summary: The Paradell is a third person, country-side adventure rpg where you harness elemental magic to farm, fight and explore the isolated and deceivingly cozy world of the Paradell. Explore the deepest catacombs and soar above the tree tops, gaining magical knowledge and helping shape the world.

name: The Dark Tower
summary: This is a traditional bomber combat mode and arena shooting into a furnace of Rougue maze exploration games, players will play a bomb and accurate and deadly ghost pistol warriors all the way to kill the enemy, gradually uncover the hidden secrets inside the magic tower

name: The Lawn Zapper
summary: A game about mowing the lawn.

name: The Adventures of Tintin: Prisoners of the Sun
The Black Knight
summary: In a fight against time, Diego needs to find the 5 stones of Praxx to open the portal and save Princess Amanda from the mighty Lox, leader of all monsters in the Kingdom of Belvedor.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Deluxe Edition
summary: The Deluxe Edition includes Base Game, Digital Soundtrack and Mini Art Book.

name: The Squeal of the Pig
summary: The CEO of the biggest meat producing corporation is kidnapped by a cannibalistic serial killer that exclusively eats human flesh. The former fears being eaten, but the latter assures him he has other plans for him, including a special surprise.

name: Thunderday
summary: Thunderday is a twin stick shooter following a group of friends and family fighting their way and traveling through multiple worlds after their home got destroyed. Choose your hero and start your journey to find and destroy the one responsible for it.

name: The Blood Mage by Daniel da Silva
summary: The Blood Mage is a fast-paced Puzzle/RPG hybrid. Reach the powerful blood crystal!

name: The Revived Throne
summary:
With the power of the dead, claim your rightful place in your throne, capture the despicable enemies, sign contracts with other lords, fight epic battles, and destroy anyone who stands in your way.
You lost everything because of an unexpected betrayal, but the power of the dead revived you and gave you a second chance. Rule your city and build an undead army, return to the battlefield, slay the traitors, send your army to sack their cities, destroy their army and capture their champions for your use! Real-time battles full of strategies will give you more than enough space to show your worth as a commander!

name: The Sarah Jane Adventures: Alien Alliance
summary: A Flash web game from The Sarah Jane Adventures website, a spin-off series of Doctor Who. Match up the aliens to score the most points.

name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Proto
summary:
This prototype is an is an interpretation of various development phases of the game based on the Alttp prototype assets. This is not an authentic prototype nor does it represent a single or specific point of development.

This is a result of 4 months (maybe 5) of “behind the scenes” hard work, a few assembly hacks and fixes etc. This game was known as A Link To The Past and only has been renamed into A Link To The Proto for the release to stand on it’s own.

There is a lot of changes, prototype assets that made it into the game, but unfortunately due to the multiple iterations of the same tilesets and a rather limited space for graphics, only a few select ones made it into the reconstruction.

But still, there is a lot of places to explore and many unseen things to discover from the proto content that was cut from the final vanilla game by Nintendo.

name: The Wailer
summary: A highly stylized horror adventure game set in the depths of an ancient dungeon. With torch in hand, explore and find a way to escape before falling prey to the unspeakable horror that lurks within.

name: The Seven Awakenings: I Randall
summary: Run your own shop in the Middle Ages. Manage your economy and serve your customers well. Collect the elements to discover who you were in your previous life and fight off bandits if necessary. Unveil the veil of prophecies and discover your own secret.

name: The Bookkeeper
summary: The Bookkeeper is a cozy simulation game about learning the craft and mindset of book restoration. Using touch controls developed for iPad, experience the satisfying, tactile nature of book restoration as you methodically deconstruct and repair books (through tasks such as cleaning the cover, washing the pages and hanging them to dry, and unbinding/rebinding the pages) for a wide variety of customers.

name: The Cleaner
summary: The Cleaner is a 2D simulation game that immerses players in the challenges of game creation under extreme censorship policies. Players take on the role of lead designer, Lia, who must design her game while navigating team feedback and censorship regulations.

name: The Mountain Calls
summary: The Mountain Calls is a 2D puzzle platformer where the player takes on the role of a Feng Shui priest who uses elements from nature to repair broken incantations, preventing a disaster from befalling the village.

name: The Dawn is Inevitable
summary: The Dawn is Inevitable is an interactive crime drama/neo-western novel inspired by classic RPG games. A mysterious stranger is forced to hide in a village called Rassvet. This place is isolated from the outside world for the whole winter and keeps many dark secrets.

name: The Empress of Mahjong
summary: The Empress invites you to play! Immerse yourself in the amazingly beautiful locations of Asia and complete mahjong levels approved by the Empress herself!

name: The Sims 4: The Daring Lifestyle Bundle
summary: Seek adventure - and adventurous fashion! - with this free bundle containing The Sims 4 Jungle Adventure Game Pack, The Sims 4 Luxury Party Stuff Pack, and The Sims 4 Fashion Street Kit.

name: The World of Obert Skye
summary: The World of Obert Skye is an adventure, puzzle solving game for current and future Obert Skye fans.

name: The House 2
summary: The sequel to The House. Explore a haunted house that nobody has entered for decades. The family who lived there before committed suicide, but nobody knows why.

name: The Elephant Collection
summary: The Elephant Collection remasters ten of jmtb02’s classic blue elephant games into one mammoth-sized package! From puzzle platformers to rapid-fire arcade games, this collection of ten Armor Games classics is tied together by a new overarching metanarrative.

name: The World's Hardest Game HTML5
summary: A remastered version of The World's Hardest Game made after the closure of Adobe Flash Player.

name: The Secret Life of Probes Prologue
summary: Converse with the unlikely inhabitants of our galaxy. Use tools, applications, and learned information to discover your place in the cosmos.

name: Thunder
summary:
Thunder is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are running in the middle of a thunderstorm. Collect the stars that form when lightning strikes the ground to score points. But avoid getting hit by lightning. Reverse your direction by pressing a button or by hitting the sides of the screen.

The game is over when you get struck.

name: Thea 2: Rat Tales & More
summary: The long-awaited DLC for Thea 2: The Shattering containing new stories, characters, classes, and pets.

name: The King of Fighters XV: Character "Sylvie Paula Paula"
summary: This character is also bundled together in the available The King of Fighters XV Fighter Pass DLC character set.

name: The Closure
summary:
The Closure (also known as Half-Life 2 Episode 3: The Closure) is a Mod for Half-Life 2, developed and published by SPY Interactive. This Mod acts as an unofficial sequel to Half-Life 2: Episode Two, starting after the death of Eli Vance.

The Mod received negative feedback due to the gameplay and design having very little to do with Half-Life and its extensive use of cutscenes.

name: The Mighty Claw
summary: The Mighty Claw is a 2D platformer that takes grappling hook mechanics to a new level. Attach your claw to any surface and use tons of cool grapple moves to jump, swing, and zip your way through masterfully designed challenges across a colorful cartoon world full of a wacky cast of characters.

name: The Doll
summary: Lucy bought an exquisite large doll at a low price. While she combs its hair and chats with it, Little does she know that her nightmare is about to begin...

name: The Hostel: Night Terrors
summary: In this game, you will find yourself in a hostel in the middle of a mysterious forest. You will discover terrifying and mysterious things, from murders to challenging puzzles. Use your skills to uncover the hidden secrets in the hostel. Get ready for an exciting and hair-raising experience!

name: The Black Door
summary: The Black Door is a short and sweet horror point and click game. Players take on the role of a nameless protagonist who finds themselves trapped in a mysterious and sinister location. With a new take on the genre, utilizing new technology to allow a deeper more rich environmental exploration.

name: The Books Tale: A Hop Adventure
summary: The Books Tale: A Hop Adventure is a game where you help Verbum save a library from creatures that threaten the interdimensional knowledge books. Overcome levels in a world made of blocks and explore unimaginable worlds to gather the energy necessary to purify them.

name: The Cursed Amulet
summary: Enter a mysterious cave and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test. Explore the depths of the cave, search for clues, and solve challenging puzzles that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

name: The Dark Pursuer
summary: You find yourself locked up alone in an abandoned place, but something is nearby, something dark and dangerous. Try to look for ways to get out of there before you can no longer...

name: The Source
summary: A sci-fi visual novel where our main heroes journey through time and discover the mysteries of their world.

name: The Night of the Inquisitor
summary: Uncover the mystery behind a cursed rosary in this chilling survival horror game. Evade the Inquisitor, solve puzzles, and interact with NPCs to collect all the pieces of the rosary and break the curse. Can you save Emilia and her mother before it's too late?

name: The Two Moons
summary: A Comedy/Walking Simulator RPG that follows a 4th-wall breaking main character who knows he is in a crappy RPG maker game and wants no part of it, but he is forced into being the main character by a series of infinite loop Yes/No choices where No isn't a real option. Chaos ensues in this wacky game.

name: The Omins
summary: Lead your faction of omins in fantastic worlds, build their villages, train their skills, satisfy their needs, and send them to war! Will you save them from the destruction deity Nefasto and his hordes of Gormuns? Play the role of a deity in this real-time strategy inspired by the classic god games.

name: The Last Seal
summary: When a presumed to be extinct race starts wreaking havoc, Joan and Cadel begin what will be the journey of their lives.

name: The Sisters 2: Road to Fame
summary:
Get on trend and take the road to fame!
Double the trouble, double the fun, our Sisters are back to cause twice the chaos!

name: Through the Mist
summary: A terrible disease known as the Blight is spreading across all four corners of the world. Without a cure, he who is afflicted by it, is doomed. As the Lighwielder, Edan must now find it's origin and cause and put it to an end. He is people's last hope.

name: The Dead Await
summary: Build your deck and try to survive in The Dead Await, a deck-building RPG set during a zombie apocalypse. As one of many survivors, set out across the desolate world, discover the truth about the outbreak, and rebuild human civilization - or die trying.

name: The Legend of the Radient Mask 2
summary: Fight bosses, discover areas, find treasure and challenge your friends in 2-player mode!

name: The Magical Lands
summary: The Magical Lands is a cross between a reimagining and a sequel to the original Mario 64. Visit new and familiar places, meet new friends, face new foes, and save Peach's castle from Bowser's clutches!

name: The Pizza
summary:
You decide to hold a party and order a pizza.
What could possibly go wrong...

name: Thrive
summary: A digital adaptation of the 2020 board game.

name: The Smurfs 2: The Prisoner of the Green Stone
summary: With your crack team and the help of the SmurfoMix, liberate the village of the Smurfs from the grip of the Green Stone!

name: The Wired Narrative Bundle
summary:
Narrative games are the perfect blend of masterfully crafted stories, emotion, music, atmosphere, dialogues, player choices and, of course, gameplay. This is a curated bundle of Wired games we thing will live on in your memories long after you’ve reached the credits.
Includes :
The Town Of Light
Martha Is Dead
Those Who Remain
Close To The Sun
The Last Worker
Deliver Us The Moon
Tin Hearts

name: The Wonderful One: After School Hero
summary:
A standalone version of the free DLC for The Wonderful 101: Remastered made as a crowdfunding stretch goal.

As the latest member of the centinels, new recruit Luka delivers remarkable achievements. What challenges did he need to overcome to become the prestigious Wonder Goggles? This is a story of love, battle, and growth. Experience Luka's journey to becoming a full-fledged hero!

name: The Book of Warriors
summary: The Book of the Warriors is a retro SLG+ roguelike game. As a fan of SLG, have you been looking for a kind of war chess that can build a variety of fancy Bulid? Start the game! You will find the charm of SLG~

name: Thalassa: Edge of the Abyss
summary: Uncover the mystery of Thalassa, a first-person psychological drama set under the sea. Ill-fate has fallen on your former crew and friends and it’s up to you to find answers onboard the wreckage. Experience the melancholic underwater journey of human stories facing life and loss.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Relics of the Past
summary: A mod for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild which changes the game to be more challenging by enhancing the map and enemy locations, being akin to an unofficial expansion for the game.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Islands Expansion
summary: A mod for The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild which adds new maps in the form of floating islands across Hyrule.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Hyrule Rebalance
The Adventures of Nerdstan
summary: Join Nerdstan In His Ultimate Adventures to save the NerdDom. Defeat Enemies, Collect Coins, Navigate Platforms and Face Powerful Bosses.

name: The Wonderful 101: Remastered - The Wonderful One: After School Hero - Part 1
summary:
Get ready for a unique side-scrolling experience in the world of The Wonderful 101: Remastered! This free DLC lets you enjoy a brand new episode in which you experience Luka's story!

As the latest member of the CENTINELS, new recruit Luka delivers remarkable achievements. What challenges did he need to overcome to become the prestigious Wonder Goggles? This is a story of love, battle, and growth. Experience Luka's journey to becoming a full-fledged hero!

name: The Diary
summary: Several diaries gradually reveal the thrilling story of a missing case; after multiple deductions, are the answers in the past or present? With frequent plot twists, you never know which is the truth and which is the unexpected; in a dense fog, time buries the past, but the marks remain.

name: That's a Cow: Premium Edition
summary: Soar through the air and don't get milked in this cute game.

name: Think Shift
summary: If you like solving Rubix cube, jigsaw puzzles or sliding puzzles, then Think Shift is for you. Base on the simple mechanic of sliding puzzle, Think Shift will provide endless hours of puzzle solving.

name: Theft Ride Legacy
summary: Gear up for the ultimate treasure hunt on wheels!

name: The Centennial Case
summary:
The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story is a new unique mystery-adventure game.
Directed by Koichiro Ito (Metal Gear Solid V), and with Yasuhito Tachibana, producer of Netflix's 'The Naked Director' serving as the Cinematographer and Scenario Director, beautiful yet thrilling live-action footage intertwines with mysteries to solve, creating highly immersive gameplay.
The player follows a chain of murders which take place over the span of a century. Four murders have been committed in three different time periods - 1922, 1972, and 2022.
Each episode is comprised of three parts, the Incident phase, the Reasoning phase, and the Solution phase, inviting the player to seamlessly enter into this world of mystery.
Explore these time periods, collect multiple clues, and solve a 100-year mystery.

name: The Paradixion: Son's Room
summary: The Paraxition: Son's Room is the first series of The Paraxition, a point-and-click adventure game with a mysterious atmosphere developed by a solo developer in Korea.

name: The Unfair Platformer
summary: Who said platform games had to be nice and fair? Time for a little change. Arrow keys to move, try get through all the levels. You don't have lives, but it records how many you lose. You will lose a lot, the game is pretty hard, so try not to get too mad on the first level. And yes, the game is possible.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Fall of Hyrule
summary: ActionGamer is here to present to you the official sequel in the Triforce Power Saga, The Legend of Zelda: Fall of Hyrule. It has every feature and improvement you loved about Triforce Power and more.

name: The Diner
summary: This project started as a small prototype, for testing Godot 4's new graphics capabilities, but as time went on, it slowly became a full-on, short, interactive horror experience.

name: The Pit
summary: Fight extremely challenging bosses by dodging their every attack and landing powerful combos. In a game that tests your reaction speed while making you feel untouchable.

name: The World of Kung Fu: Dragon and Eagle
summary: A nostalgic pixel RPG that tells a Wuxia fantasy set in ancient China. You will start as a no-name wayfarer in a world of Kungfu, acquaint yourself with journeymen from feuding clans and sects, learn different schools of martial arts, and eventually make your own name at the crossroads of times.

name: The Dusk Alliance
summary: The Dusk Alliance is a 1-4-player coop Action/Investigation horror game.

name: The Epic Quest of Birdo The Pink Dinosaur
summary:
Play as Birdo the pink dinosaur and help her free yoshi from the evil wart, who is trying to cook yoshi´s eggs!
Travel through the world and defeat SMB1,SMB2 and SMB3 characters. Drive on a rollercoaster, jump around in space and visit wart´s personal swamp. Buy something from the shop to make you more powerfull! Find secrets in every level. And defeat the bosses from SMB2, who have sworn themself against birdo.

name: The Malice Kingdom
summary: Explore an ancient world in The Malice Kingdom. Travel the rich and diverse landscape filled with ancient ruins, foreboding forests, and haunting mansions. Discover powerful weapons, befriend Whimsical characters, and uncover the dormant secret within the kingdom.

name: The Land Past Redemption
summary: The Land Past Redemption is a medieval, turn-based combat, rogue-lite. Take on bounties, recruit more heroes, get better loot, and earn enough gold to pay your way out of the Land Past Redemption.

name: The Sum
summary:
Fallout: The Sum is a total conversion mod for Fallout Tactics: Brotherhood of Steel that reimagines the post-apocalyptic genre through an anarchist, utopian lens. Set after a global meltdown triggered by the "Sum" of every major anticipated catastrophe, the game offers a uniquely positive take on survival.

It is a bilingual, single-player, non-linear RPG. You are not a hero, but an ordinary person trying to survive and carve out a meaningful existence in a hostile, toxic world. The story unfolds based on your choices, and you can end the game whenever you feel your character's journey has reached a satisfying conclusion.

name: The Strongest Tofu
summary: Be The TOFU. The one and only Tofu action game created by a real Tofu Meister. You choose one of three varieties, and in its endless journey it gradually softens, crumbles, stews, and acquires bittern to become TOFU.

name: That's My Space
