This project tries to honor Ty with levels that pay tribute to his work be it in the form of his levels or contribution to the Boom sourceport.

There are 20 levels in this megawad along with plenty of new music and awesome new, original skies! The project also uses a big part of Team TNT's The Return and Final Doom: Evilution resources.

name: The Lion King: Operation Pridelands
summary: Operation Pridelands is a video game inspired by The Lion King. It was released on March 11, 2004, by Disney Interactive Studios.

name: The Sims 4: Extreme Violence
summary: The Sims 4: Extreme Violence is a mod where you can perform violent interactions and murders. Turn violent and beat sims up in different violent ways, kill sims in 40+ different ways, develop a horrible reputation by becoming the most hated and feared sim in town, and join gangs or start a feud with them.

name: The Haunted Hospice
summary: The Haunted Hospice, You got yourself stuck in the hospital while you where searching for your friend. Are you capable and smart enough to escape from the hospital and save your friend? Remember that you are not alone in the hospital there is always danger lurking.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel - Northern War
summary:
A smartphone RPG based on the anime The Legend of Heroes: Sen no Kiseki - Northern War.

In addition to the story of the anime, the mobile game will feature an original story and new characters. The tactical orbment system “ARCUS II” introduced in The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel III will also be implemented. Players will be able to explore the world while progressing through the story, and experience the “pure emotion and exhilaration” of the Trails of Cold Steel series’ battles on mobile devices.

name: The Simpsons Game
summary: Nintendo DS port of The Simpsons Game.

name: The Simpsons Game
summary: Wii/PS2 port of The Simpsons Game.

name: The Simpsons Game
summary: PSP port of The Simpsons Game.

name: The Life of a Magical Circle
summary: The Life of a Magical Circle is a deceptively simple evade-and-collect game about following your dreams. Take control of a circular creature and see if you can figure out your purpose with only a little help from a mysterious narrator.

name: The One Way Challenge
summary: A platformer game where you can only move forward, left and right. You play as a ball rolling through levels and getting through obstacles. Seemingly nothing is wrong at least.

name: The Settlements
summary: A set of 3 maps with an emphasis on exploring surreal environments. Some bits may had challenging combat and traps. Mostly non linear progression. This mapset its a spiritual succesor to Liminal Doom aesthetics in some ways.

name: The Tale of Dragons and Oceans
summary: The Tale of Dragons and Ocean is a fast-paced boss rush game where a mother must defeat four huge dragons to retrieve her son's soul from the sea by throwing a spear and pulling the enemy's energy through a rope while dodging their attacks.

name: The Dreamer Must Die
summary: 'The Dreamer Must Die' is an RPG shooter where you're the only hope for a fading dream world. Advance the story, find new equipment, and improve your character within the mind menu to ensure your survival.

name: The Graveyard Shift
summary:
Created by Melancholy Marionette using Naninovel x Unity.
Based on a script by Reece Shearsmith & Steve Pemberton (Adapted, altered, and added to by Melancholy Marionette).

name: The Hostage
summary: Visual novel by Melancholy Marionette.

name: The Panic Room: House of Secrets
summary: A hidden object game featuring an exciting detective plot, realistic graphic and atmospheric music.

name: The Scientists' Secret: Hidden Object Game
summary: Can you find all the differences in the scenes? Discover them to unveil the mysteries of the scientists, only then you will know what has happened in their research.

name: The Return of the Heroes
summary:
The monsters attacked the Castle wyk and have kidnapped the Princess!
Heroes, join the battle, occupy the farms, summon the soldiers of God, find the way to victory and rescue the princess!

name: They Linger
summary: Navigate the narrow hallways in the darkness to find and rescue Jessica and survive the infinite Labyrinth.

name: The Shapeshifter
summary: Are you ready for an unforgettable adventure? 'The Shapeshifter' is an 8-bit classic point and click adventure game for the original Game Boy and other compatible systems. In this game, you will become Elliot, an ordinary person spending the weekend in the mountains with friends. But what was supposed to be a peaceful camping trip turns into an incredible fantasy world full of humour and mystery.

name: The Shapeshifter 2
summary: Welcome to the world of "The Shapeshifter 2 - Become the Animal You Touch" by Green Boy Games, the second part of the trilogy that has taken the Game Boy community by storm! In this unique and original Old-School Adventure game, you'll join Elliot on a mission to save the Elven world from the wizard's spell. Armed with a great power to become any animal he touches, Elliot must race against time as the powers run out at dawn.

name: There Are Dinosaurs
summary: In There Are Dinosaurs, you'll face the formidable challenges of resource management and dinosaur encounters. Construct and expand your underground refuge, strategically allocating rooms to meet the essential needs of your community, including food, water, power, and entertainment.

name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. The villainess Scarlet, deceived and falsely accused of killing of the King, becomes the first streamer. Through this, she uses manipulates and diversion to rebel against the vast military force of the Imperial Kingdom.

name: Three Days to Chicago
summary: One of them is visiting a friend in Chicago. The other wants to shake things up in New York City. It starts in San Francisco, but where this relationship goes is all up to you.

name: The Marvelous Misadventures of Flapjack: Bottle Cap'n
The Walking Dead: Betrayal
summary: Betray your friends in this 5-8 person game of cooperation and social deception set in the universe of The Walking Dead. Work together to survive, but trust no one! Traitors have so many ways to sabotage the team, the walkers are the most predictable threat.

name: The Ultimate Doom: In Name Only
summary: The project was designed to be a creative exercise in building levels around the original map titles for all 36 maps of the Ultimate Doom with an increasing emphasis on creating challenging but enjoyable maps that will even given experienced veterans a stern test (Especially for an Ultimate Doom megawad and especially so for episodes 3 and 4). All maps are built to a limit removing (complevel 3) format and are beatable from a pistol start, difficulty setting are included, but some may need a little refinement to pitch the difficulty with more precision. Co-op starts are included but anything beyond this will be patchy and dependent on the author who made the map.

name: The 4 Masters of Melody
summary: The 4 Masters of Melody is a puzzle game for the MSX based on Simon.

name: The 4 Masters of Melody Ex
summary: The 4 Masters of Melody Ex is a remastered version of The 4 Masters of Melody, with improved graphics, a color palette optimized and switchable during gameplay for MSX2 or higher, title music, four background music options, joystick support, in-game hero animation, animated end story, cutscene, and the "Where Did I Go Wrong?" feature, which shows in case of game over which was the correct color to choose.

name: The Shrouded Parchments
summary: Arise, lowly foreigner, and embark on an epic quest! Unravel the mysteries of this fantasy world, slay the monster that threatens to crumble it, and save it from its own destruction. Or, if you're feeling more ambitious, profit from its collapse.

name: The Creature Zone VR: Nightfall
summary: Eddy Miles Is Sent On A Mission By The Creature Zone Department Of Science, Where He Will Travel Back To The Locations And Times Of 3 Infamous Incidents, The First Terry's Pizzeria Murder, The Extraterrestrial Massacre On Camp Clearwater, And The Death Of A Kid In The Vents Of Terry's Pizzeria.

name: The King in the Shades
summary: A classic survival-horror experience set in a fictional universe where the invisible hand of unspeakable horrors is turning humanity into a fleeting memory. Enter the world of The King in the Shades and rid this decaying world of the curse of Gods.

name: The God Slayer
summary: The God Slayer is an open-world action RPG featuring a highly immersive gameplay system and story experience, allowing players to enhance their abilities through battles and world exploration with the ultimate goal of defeating enemies and saving the world.

name: The Winds Rising
summary: The Winds Rising is a story-driven action RPG developed by TiGames. It follows the journey of a girl from a peaceful village who embarks on a grand adventure after she encounters a lost monster cub, which affects the rise and fall of the entire kingdom. Her fate is in the player’s hands. Players can look forward to a refreshing and smooth combat experience, immersive and captivating story, and a world of ever-changing adventure.

name: The Night Watch: Ranger Survival
summary: The Night Watch : Ranger Survival is a tiny top-down shooting game where you must survive through the night with ranger's oldest friends - bow, arrow, and a bonfire. Shoot down monsters marching out from darkness, keep your bonfire and yourself safe, and survive to see the next sun rises.

name: The Voices Stories
summary: A collection of 5 short stories written by Matthew Green about 20 years ago

name: The Ultimate Doom
summary:
The Ultimate Doom was included in Doom 3 Collector's Edition for the Xbox, which was released in 2005. This port includes an exclusive level, "Sewers". It featured multiplayer like the PC version, however not through Xbox Live. This port was programmed by Vicarious Visions. The Xbox version of Doom 3: Resurrection of Evil also contains this port.

This particular "port" actually appears to be an emulation of the aged DOS version of the game; furthermore, it seems to have been somewhat rushed, as it is somewhat limited in functionality, and has a few bugs and design quirks.

name: The Last Sight
summary: You started a neighborhood security program, which gradually expanded in size. Over time, it evolved to monitor not only homes but also warehouses, gas stations and various other locations. However, as your program grew, it began attracting the attention of dubious individuals.

name: Themm: Harukanaru Meikyuu
summary: Long time ago, human beings believed in gods. But time has passed, and the humans stopped worshipping them. The gods got angry. The world plunged into chaos. Demons who looked like pretty girls have appeared, driving people insane. Five kings have sent brave heroes to find a magical stone that alone could restore peace to the world. One of these heroes is Lucido. Aided by a simple village girl, he bravely descends into a dungeon full of seductive monsters - but he should beware of the competition...

name: The Anglerfish Project
summary: Use your friendly probe, Paul, to fish for communication packages in the cosmos. Aim at an alteration in the sky and, being careful of your strength, cast your fishing rod. You will need to decrypt these hidden messages to help keep everyone safe. Good luck, angler.

name: The Night Owl Murder
summary: You need to solve the case before a chip in victim's head runs of out time. However, the time passes ONLY through your actions. So feel free to read and listen to dialogues in your own pace. Time passes only when you click on a dialogue option. Time is limited so choose wisely!

name: The 64 kb challenge: Vanilla
summary: 34 maps made under or equal the file size limitation of 64 kylobites, all these levels are vanilla doom / DOS executable friendly.

name: The 64 kb challenge: Limitless
summary: 35 maps made under or equal the file size limitation of 64 kylobites, all these levels are limit-removing ports (complevel 2) compatible, don't play these with vanilla sets or original DOS executable

name: The Great Urban Battle
summary: One Player ..... One City ..... Many Monsters. Your mission is simple. Seek, destroy and escape!

name: Thursday Nite Thunkin'
summary: I'm not sure why there are two descriptions but pretend I put something really funny here

name: Thawed Waters
summary: Boating adventure of the old priest who stands against the ruthless corporation practising animal testing. Dive into flooded Siberia of 2047, where remnants of humanity fight another thawed virus. The game offers unique physics-based gameplay, wrapped in a heartfelt rabbits rescue saga.

name: The Secrets of Skellig
summary: A mysterious puzzle game with crossword inspired gameplay. Use your brain, keyboard, and mouse to unravel the secrets beneath a remote island.

name: The M/S Cornelia II Incident
summary: Somewhere in the Nordic Archipelago a man wakes up with no memory of who he is, how he got there or what happened to him. A short point-and-click adventuregame about a man overboard survivor.

name: The Backrooms: Last Expedition
summary: "The Backrooms: Last Expedition" is a cooperative horror game designed for 1 to 4 players. Its main objective is to create an enjoyable gaming experience for friends. Players will navigate through terrifying levels, filled with various entities and dangers, as they strive to escape.

name: The Grey Dream
summary: The Grey Dream is an adult Visual Novel about a man who got offered a job in an international trading company right after graduation. As soon as you accept it, the consequences of the past start to manifest. Who knows? Maybe you can get rid of your past or spice up your future with it.

name: The Revenge of Tungsten
summary: Bullet shooter with no visible bullets

name: The Last Windmill
summary: Embark on an epic journey in The Last Windmill an action-adventure game where you defend the last standing windmill against relentless hordes of monsters. Engage in intense battles, face increasingly challenging waves of enemies. Become the hero that saves humanity in this thrilling fight.

name: The Book Of Hiro
summary: “The Book of Hero” is a 3D visual puzzle game where players solve challenges and puzzles using illusions and perspective to find the hidden key in the map. The game tells the story of a brave villager named Hero who was ordered to meet the king and encountered various challenges and puzzles.

name: The Owl, the Thief and the Strawberries
summary: An adventure platformer focused on stealth and exploration.

name: The Armardisp
summary: A physics-puzzler in which you drive around a little tank and knock down buildings from afar.

name: The Severn Rising 2222
summary: A graphic adventure set 200 years in the future in the flooded city of Worcester. Who were the humans? Why did they have to leave? Where are they now? Guide a swan and a duck as they attempt to find out.

name: The Way
summary: "The Way" is sci-fi third or first person physics based real-time action adventure game with character customization.

name: The House
summary: You are an 18-year-old Spanish boy called Antonio who one day went shopping, and when he returned home he noticed things that were somewhat strange...

name: The Elite of Mboa
summary: The Elite of Mboa is a satirical life sim game from Cameroonian developer Kiro'o Games. Set in the fictional "very very democratic republic of Mboa", this sendup of African politics puts players in the shoes of a very ordinary man stepping into his first week on the job in the General Ministry of His Excellency Mougabiang. Players make countless choices over the course of their careers, from whether to follow a corrupt or honest path in politics to where to spend their time and money at night, with many different branching story paths.

name: Thirty Monsters Challenge
summary: The mission was simple: make a map with thirty monsters in it. In the end, sixty-four of them were made, for your personal enjoyment.

name: The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary
summary: Adam wakes up trapped in his apartment building, where darkness and strange visions abound. To unravel the mystery and escape, he must find missing diary pages, embarking on a heart-pumping First Person Visual Novel Adventure in 'The Midnight Town Stories: Adam's Diary.

name: The Prospector Odyssey
summary: A lonely trek to a desolate planet unearths a strange anomaly, seemingly causing denizens of a nearby station to become horrifying, violent mutants. Run, think, scavenge and improvise. Only the smartest will survive.

name: This is a Small Town
summary: A trainee police officer arrives in a strange small town, but unexpectedly falls into a conspiracy. What happens during the process of investigating the truth?

name: Thief Simulator: Shopping Center
summary: To access this content you need to have the game Thief Simulator on Steam.

name: The Blue Stars
summary: The Blue Stars is a strategy RPG where you can bond with weird alien party members. It features simple yet deep strategy combat and a lot of characters and enemies.

name: The Lancaster Leak: Crisis at Call Center
summary: Another tape has been leaked, this time a cover-up of a tragic mass casualty event.

name: The Jusou
summary: "The Jusou series", renowned as the most terrifying horror escape game in the history of smartphones, is now available on Steam! Many players have abandoned their games due to the sheer terror it instills! *Please play at your own risk if you experience any unusual phenomena after playing this game.

name: The Rush
summary: The Rush is a horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up with graphics inspired by classic space shooters of the MSX. Buckle up and see if you have what it takes to master the highly adaptive Chameleon Quartz space fighter, single-handedly obliterate the alien invaders, and overcome The Rush!

name: The House on Ninth Avenue
summary: Explore the house and surrounding garden to uncover clues and to find a way out.

name: The Backrooms Project
summary: "The Backrooms Project" is an exciting solo/multiplayer horror game with infinite levels and lots of puzzles. Explore the almost endless levels alone or with friends, solve exciting puzzles, hide from monsters that won't shy away from killing you, try to escape.

name: The City of Fury
summary: The City of fury is a SWAT-like team management RTS set in a dystopian Cyberpunk-Noir setting, where you play as the team leader who gets involve in shady matters. Explore the themes of violence as you face the harsh city with your team to ultimately break free from the circle!

name: The Great Fear
summary: Deep Fear will make you plunge into an atmosphere of horror and hopelessness. For salvation, you can only rely on yourself.

name: The Mirror Dimension
summary: The Mirror Dimension is a co-op story-based thriller game that can be played with 2-4 people. The objective of the game is to observe paranormal activity in the house you are visiting as a guest, destroy the incoming spiritual beings. Are you ready to explore the parallel universe?

name: Theatrics
summary: Game made over the weekend.

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Battle for Middle-earth Anthology
summary: The Lord of the Rings, The Battle for Middle-earth Anthology offers fans the chance to bring together all the epic The Lord of the Rings battles within a single compilation.

name: The Umbrella Ninja
summary: Defeat the Evil with your Umbrella!

name: The Legend of Zelda Remastered
summary: While this one is not a full remake of Zelda games like what happen to Link’s Awakening, but rather a remastered of The Legend of Zelda original game released for NES back in 1986 to HD using the latest and closest graphics, music and sound to newer Legend of Zelda games, this game is certainly not something to be missed for all Zelda fans and especially to those who never really have a chance playing the original game.

name: The Weapon King
summary:
Warrior! Please be awake!
The world is in danger! Now Hurry!!
Evil spirits from the dark dimension are giving everyone a trouble!
Take this sword at once and forge the greatest sword!

name: The Amazing Shrinking Giraffe
summary:
Explore space in your spaceship, drive around on planets, and get energy from alien creatures and plants.

Ride on the back of giant sand worms, or shrink down and ride on the back of beetles.

Grow to the size of a planet and jump between asteroids.

This is a short experimental type game with an added sandbox component.

name: This Hack Needs a Name
summary: A hack of Super Mario World with 118 exits where Mario and Luigi find a strange new world where someone is in need of help.

name: The Magic Cooking Pot
summary: A 32-exit long romhack for SMW with new characters, enemies, and visuals. The levels are longer compared to those in SMW.

name: The King of Fighters XV: Character - Najd
summary: "NAJD" can be used in The King of Fighters XV.

name: The Visitors from Mir
summary:
A fun and easy game for all ages. The Mir aliens have come to Earth along with the Groog. Do they come in peace?
Mastering this game seems easy but to score a perfect game is puzzling unless you are the clever one.
This game carries a message of peace and the only violence in this game is bopping the aliens on the head. No one dies and no gore.
Sounds best with earbuds and is a great game for zoning out and also has a lesson for kids. Game has multiple end game messages based on your performance. Info window has settings for difficulty level and time period (1 to 10 minutes).

name: Therapy Game
summary: Experimental game by increpare.

name: The Big, Friendly Thud!
summary: BF_THUD!, which stands for The Big, Friendly THUD!, is a 1995 megawad for Doom II. It was designed by Christen Klie, and includes half a dozen levels from his earlier ChrisK, which was itself based on his earlier Chris_E1, and which were also re-used in The Lost Episodes of Doom.

name: The Boggy Region
summary:
Sooner or later, all cool guys die. No matter why. So the marine does.

26 map megawad.

name: The Clown
summary: Play as an unnamed female narrator as you suddenly wake up in a dark room, and move around to find yourself in a circus theater where you will witness probably one of the most disturbing things in your life.

name: The Mapwich
summary: The Mapwich is a collaborative megawad for Doom II, first released on June 2019. The project was led by Bridgeburner56 and based around the idea of pairing up mappers for each of the levels in the set, but also having the pairs be randomly chosen: the result was a total of 30 mappers, for 15 regular maps + 1 hub map. Each mapper was given free reign on what to build and what settings to utilize, the only rules being that the project had to be tested in GZDoom and that only a handful of liquid fall textures and new skies would be used as far as new graphics go, with everything else being stock Doom 1 and Doom 2 assets.

name: The Mapwich 2: The Mapwichening
summary: The Mapwich 2 is a collaborative megawad for Doom II, first released on October 2020. A sequel to the previous year's The Mapwich, the project was led by Bridgeburner56 and was once again based around the idea of pairing up mappers for each of the levels in the set, but also having the pairs be randomly chosen: the result was contributions of 45 mappers, for a total of 22 maps. Unlike its predecessor, Mapwich 2 is built with the OTEX texture pack by ukiro and integrates the gameplay changes of the Supercharge mod by Tango.

name: These Remains
summary: last night out.

name: The King of Fighters '96
summary: A bootleg version of The King of Fighters '96, except it plays more like Street Fighter II.

name: The Cognition Engine
summary:
"The Cognition Engine" is a single Doom 2 map for limit-removing ports. The map is somewhat exploration-focused, takes roughly 25-35 minutes to beat (depending on difficulty and how thorough you are with said exploration).

Difficulties are implemented, UV starts off pretty easy but has a few tough fights near the end, though the difficulty may vary greatly depending on the amount exploration and secret hunting the player does. Because of that, and since the map is fairly lenghty, I recommend saving a few times. Expect HNTR and HMP to be on a significantly easier side.

name: Thomas the Tank Engine & Friends
summary: A cancelled NES port for Thomas the Tank Engine & Friends.

name: The Princess and the Rose Knight
summary:
Short yuri-themed RPG Maker game created by rpgex/En. The player controls Galatea, commander of the newly established princess guard,on her adventures trying to protect the adventure-loving princess of Laomedia. The player must explore various dungeons and partake in turn-based combat to defeat enemies.

While the in-dungeon gameplay is fairly similar to most traditional console RPGs (although, the game does feature a SaGa-inspired glimmer system for unlocking new abilities mid-combat), while in the castle, the player can also interact with a variety of characters and flirt with all the cute girls around! The game keeps track of how "yuri" the player's responses to the different characters are via a yuri gauge, a fun play on the typical alignment gauge found in other RPGs.

name: The Space Brigade: Space Raiders - Refueled
summary:
Classic-Arcade Styled Space Shooter, Fast Paced, Simple Gameplay.

The game is intended for short sessions, as it's more of an infinite shooter rather than a complex experience.

The game is available for Microsoft Windows and Android in it's complete state with updates from time to time.

name: The Singularity Complex
summary: Singularity Complex is an episode of 9 levels for Ultimate Doom, done in the "classic" Doom style. It is the successor of the much acclaimed Classic Episode, so I guess you could also call it Classic Episode 2.

name: The King of Fighters XIII: Global Match
summary: The King of Fighters XIII: Global Match, a version of the game with rollback netcode, was announced at Evo Japan 2023 for PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch. Three open beta tests took place throughout 2023 and the game was released on consoles on November 16, 2023. On PC, unlike previous rollback netcode upgrades by developer Iron Galaxy, Global Match was ported by Safari Games and announced as a separate purchase with Steam Edition being delisted shortly after its February 20, 2025 release.

name: The Hidden Fragmentation
summary: Explore a half-abandoned complex in the middle of the desert, meet strange characters and discover the mysterious Fragmentation.

name: The Warlock's Hearth
summary: The Warlock's Hearth is a very large map for limit-removing ports with an emphasis on atmosphere, exploration and enjoyable fights that still challenge the player without putting the pressure on all the time. The map features an .ogg soundtrack courtesy of Der Wolfmensch (Marco from Decoded Feedback's sideproject).

name: The Realm of Parthoris
summary: The Realm of Parthoris is an episode one replacement for Heretic, created in 2015 by the Doomworld community, led by Jeff King (Egregor). It requires a limit-removing port that also features Heretic support to play. Development began on January 27, 2015, with the aim of creating a full Heretic megawad, but due to a lack of interest from mappers, the project was scaled down to a single episode

name: Theorists
summary:
Welcome to my game, buddy!

Matt is glad to see you! He waited a long time for someone to visit him! Feel like at home and get ready for endless theories!

This game is a parody of the Mr. TomatoS game based on the intro of an Game Theory video. It's not meant to make fun of the original, it's just a silly fan game.

name: Thomas The Tank Engine & Friends
summary: Thomas The Tank Engine & Friends was an educational video game based on the television series of the same name. It was planned for a 1999 release date but was cancelled for unknown reasons.

name: The Rabbit Crazy Adventure
summary: The Rabbit Crazy Adventure is an exciting precision platformer with 50 levels full of challenges and enemies. Take control of a brave rabbit as he embarks on an epic adventure through vibrant and dangerous worlds. Traversing chasms, avoiding deadly traps, and defeating cunning enemies are just a few of the skills you'll need to master to progress.

name: The Last Three
summary: In the depths of a magical, peaceful forest lives the last stone tiger family, guardians of balance and protectors of the mystical creatures' realm. Their tranquil life is thrown into turmoil when a dark power invades, kidnapping the mother to use the family's powers for their own ends. The father and cub set out on a journey to find and rescue her, restoring harmony to the forest while facing a brave and determined adventure against the forces of darkness and mystery.

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - SaGa Pack Vol. 3
summary: A pack of additional music tracks to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

name: The Barbie Diaries: High School Mystery
summary: The Barbie Diaries: High School Mystery is a game based on the 2006 movie The Barbie Diaries. The game is set in Barbie's high school where valuable items for the high school charity auction have gone missing. By locating these Barbie cannot only help the school, but it will also help her land the TV anchor position currently held by Raquelle, a girl she does not like.

name: The DBK Holiday Special
summary: The DBK Holiday Special is a 15-map Christmas adventure from the December Bastards Krew, which takes the holiday season into the darkest reaches of outer space. Fans of Alien Bastards! and Spaceballs: The Seque﻿l should be particularly interested in this one! ;)

name: The Box of a Thousand Demons
summary: The Box of a Thousand Demons is a brand new 32-map Boom megawad, targeting DSDA-Doom as a port and using OTEX as its main texture pack. It focuses on variety over visual consistency, and explicitly caters to all manners of niche and aberrant gameplay - within you will find lite and fat slaughter, key hunts, puzzles, platforming, pacifist maps, Tyson maps, NoMo maps, ammo starvation maps, the whole nine yards. A little something for everyone. Atmosphere was my main concern, with streamlined gameplay a distant second.

name: The Man in the Park 2
summary: It's been so long. You've tried to forget, however tonight you must walk through the park again. Now there are two men in the park. Will you help one, or both? Who will you trust?

name: The Old Bean Factory
summary: The map is pretty linear and has a bunch of tangents and secrets and is stuffed with low-tier enemies and pickups for all you murder-headed-secret-hunting-bonus-fiends out there.

name: The Magenta Spire
summary: The Magenta Spire is a partial conversion mapset taking place in parallel to the events of Doom 1; albeit on a much more remote planet. Much too far for any hope of "backup" arriving from Earth. A lone UAC communications technician must find a way to survive the onslaught of demonic forces invading the remote research complex. A shuttle off of this rock, a big gun, or maybe a bomb shelter to hide and weather the storm. The walls of every installation are coming down and the monsters seem to have brought their own reality with them.

name: The Isle Survival
summary: The Isle Survival is a vast open world survival / crafting game. Loot resources, craft items, build camps and explore the environment. Protect yourself from hazards and wildlife. Find ways to survive in hostile living conditions.

name: The Other Me
summary: The Other Me is a first-person psychological horror game delving into the realms of horror that prowl the recesses of one's psyche. Pursue the dread ruminations amidst the maelstrom of the Asylum. This game offers both mind-bending horror elements and realistic environments.

name: The North Woods
summary: The North Woods is a single player horror game in which you take on the role of a police officer, responding to a call, all the while looking through the view of his bodycam.

name: The Divine Speaker: A Bounty Hunter's First Christmas
summary: A Chistmas themed afterstory to The Divine Speaker featuring Leos and Raen! Search for the elusive Mister Bells, spend the Winter Solstice together, and win at rock-paper-scissors against your favorite ex-assassin turned bounty hunter!

name: The Endgame
summary: True sandbox hack'n'slash entirely focused on endgame. Slay hordes of monsters in the most spectacular way and with extreme speed. Collect countless items, materials or cosmetics and take part in living economy.

name: The Farming Frontier
summary: The Farming Frontier is a tranquil wilderness RPG, that delivers a farming simulation. Within this realm, you can cultivate crops, cut wood, catch fish, mine, and build amid wild landscapes. Reclaim your village, and confront adversaries in this tranquil wilderness RPG.

name: The Legend of Ogorets 1: Wrat
summary: An immersive, barebones-style interactive visual novel with choices, lore, and endgames. Not for heroes.

name: The Legend of Ogorets 2: Tsundere
summary: An interactive visual novel with choices, lore, and endgames. Do not read in the dark.

name: The Echo Whispers
summary: The Echo Whispers is a psychological horror experience that takes you to the shattering of expectations and a surprising outcome. In this game, you are Amy and you are alone with yourself, which is much scarier than being alone without you.

name: The Sacrificial Girl of the Fantasy 3: Kingdoms 2
The Hookmarine
summary: What would happen if during an expedition the submarine's engines stopped working and you only had your grappling hook to move and do your work?

name: The Cable Guy
summary: Your job is to connect all the users from different projects to their servers in the procedurally generated network. In an ever changing office environment you'll have a lot of nifty tools to help you save your job and keep everyone from losing their cool. Are you up for the challenge?

name: The Last Exodus
summary: Turn-based tactical strategy with massive capital ships, frigates, gunships and fighter squads. Gather resources, research technologies, design and expand your fleet. Destroy your enemies. Single player and multi player mode, hot seat mod also available.

name: The Void
summary: Join the quest to overtake the void and become a hero! In this game, you will slay your enemies in a point and click fashion and overtake the void for good, or so you think... Join the quest in taking over the void to find out!

name: The Legend of Tiny Man
summary: A story about a dark fairy tale where you need to save a small kingdom from two evils.

name: The Lost Prince
summary:
The Lost Prince is a story-based package game developed inspired by the fairy tale 'The Little Prince'. It is a visual novel-based complex genre in which the story begins with the assumption that the prince died from a snakebite.

It's an indie game developed by one person, so it's not enough, but please take care of it.

name: The Eastern Drive
summary: A fun and casual car driving game featuring Asian cars.

name: The Brittle Epoch
summary: An immersive short story walking simulator. About an hour to complete for people who enjoy relaxed exploration while investing in a long term narrative project.

name: The Blobjob
summary: The Blobjob is an educational adventure video game developed by Detonium Interactive and published by Sampo. It tells the story of Joe Ridley, a security officer of the NanoBlob Corporation who needs to prevent an intruder from stealing a piece of technology that will adversely harm the world.

name: The Lost Son
summary: The Lost Son is an upcoming indie puzzle platformer game. When trapped inside a mysterious world, Sean and Belle embark on a journey to discover the secrets behind the digital dimension and to find their lost son.

name: The Conductor
summary: A short horror game about a train journey and a descent into madness.

name: ThrowBomb
summary: Throw Bomb is a basic entertainment of 80's PC. Select angle and force, fire the bomb.

name: Third Eye
summary: A strange and disorienting speed slaughter map

name: The Cosmic Wheel Sisterhood - Deluxe Edition
The Line Game
summary:
After an early 3-level demo released on February 20th, 2007 via Digg became viral, this full release was published on AlbinoBlacksheep.

In this game you have to guide the line through the pulsating red maze to the end with the mouse or keyboard. It’s simple but stupidly addictive. 8 levels, online highscores, and a mouse mode.

name: The Commander of Steel
summary: The Commander of Steel is strategy game to come to iOS. Can you lead your army on a military operation and make enemies get down on their knees? It's time to find out.

name: The Lord of War
summary:
Trade arms to build your own empire
You begin your arms dealer career having only small boat and a pair of warehouses. And then everything is started. Some suspicious guys send you an offer: "Bring us several containers with weapons and you will get very good money". Now, it depends only on you. Be arms dealer, own huge flotilla of ships and planes and go into big politics by supporting local gangs and clans with your weapons.

name: The Catch!
summary:
Slide, run, jump and claw your way through the marvelous world of The Catch!
Each day is a new pursuit as the environment develops around you.
In this colorful world, Grandma, the dog and a couple of nasty crows are all out to get you! Take to the streets as a fat cat with stolen sausages. Test your reflexes as you zip across rooftops, tippy-toe over power lines and dash along ledges.
Swipe to turn, slide and jump to avoid danger while earning coins, special bonuses and power-ups. Challenge and beat your Facebook friends’ high score and become the top cat!

name: The Immortal Mayor: Kingdom of Women
summary: As the deity of the Kingdom of Women (yes, there will only be females in this world), you will lead the villagers to develop and grow stronger. The villagers of the Kingdom of Women have higher abilities and more needs.

name: The Great Wall
summary: The Great Wall is a clone of Hunchback. You have to jump over obstacles or walk under them.

name: The Chimba's Adventure
summary: Chimbinha was living peacefully in his luxurious castle when he received the news that his new lead singer had been kidnapped by a hairy villain. Now, Chimbinha will go through a lot of trouble to get his singer back!

name: The Iron Forge
summary:
The Iron Forge﻿ is a single map for Heretic, created by Xaser (architecture/layout) and me (thing placement). It plays in the E2M1 slot and requires ZDoom/GZDoom.

This map includes a variety of tweaks to Heretic's monsters and weapons to improve the pacing and balance of the game (especially to address that feeling you get when all the monsters are super weak but take forever to kill).

name: The Lost Glitches
summary: The Lost Glitches is a Techno-Optimist set Trading Card Game with RPG progression. Head-to-head PvP battles require strategy, unique deck construction and clever wits to climb the ladder.

name: The Crackpet Show: Happy Tree Friends Edition
summary: The Crackpet Show is an action-packed rogue-lite shoot'em-up about mutated animals that fight in a bizarre TV show, crushing their opponents with a variety of weapons. Choose your beastie, gear ‘em up, and go kill your enemies in the name of fame and sweet sponsorship deals!

name: The Queen's Quest
summary: “The Queen's Quest” is a fantasy point-and-click adventure game and Yuri dating sim. Play as Elysia Fernwhisper as she goes on an epic quest for Queen Drusilla that takes her across her vast and majestic kingdom. Along the way she will meet many beautiful women and may even fall in love!

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Slaughter Family Execution Pack 1
summary: Unleash terror on your Victims with these new gut-wrenching executions for the Slaughter Family! This pack features one kill each for Leatherface, The Cook, The Hitchhiker, Sissy, and Johnny. Happy hunting!

name: The Legend of Zelda: Trident of Power
summary: The Trident of Power is a Zelda fangame developed by Pizus, under RPG Maker 2003. It offers a very complete experience with both battles and puzzles and a complete storyline taking place in both Hyrule and the neighboring country of Tylistem. The game is available in both Spanish and English

name: The Walking Dead: Destinies
summary: Begin your journey as Rick Grimes, waking alone in a hospital surrounded by the dead. Assemble allies and fight your way through the walker apocalypse across iconic locations from The Walking Dead, including Atlanta, the Greene family farm, the prison, and Woodbury. In crucial choice-driven moments, you’ll forever shape the destiny of your team of characters from the series. Heroes and villains, living and dead – it’s up to you to decide whether to stay the course of history or forge your own path through the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead.

name: The Final Pin
summary:
"The Final Pin" is a full length story based game with voice acting and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat.
You'll need to use your investigative skills and survival instincts to navigate the treacherous world of the crow killer and uncover the truth behind the town's dark past.
Each step you take is a closer step into the darkness.

name: The Nightmare: Serial Killers
summary: An astute killer infiltrates the dreams of his victims, sowing mental chaos until their death. Five days, five victims and multiple alternative endings.

name: The Paper Parable
summary:
Welcome to The Paper Parable. You will play as Mario, and you will not play as Mario. Your choices will matter, and your choices will be meaningless. You will solve the mystery of Princess Peach's disappearance, and you will be forever left in the dark.

The Paper Parable is a fully custom remix of The Stanley Parable, with more than a double-handful of fully unique endings. Knowledge of The Stanley Parable is not necessary for playing this game.

name: The Fall of Rome
summary: The Fall of Rome is a strategy game set in 395 BC where the Roman Empire was starting to lose it's grip from Barbarians and armies around Europe, the Middle East and North Africa. You have the chance to save the Empire by fighting off attacks or attacking your enemies around your various provinces over 12 turns. Each turn represents five years and is split into three phases, Income and Expenditure, Movement and finally Combat.

name: The Incredible Coneman
summary: The Incredible Coneman is a maze chase game developed by Lars Barstad and Per Ivar Pedersen unique for its 3d graphics, its death sound, and the three-second bass melody that loops infinitely. It was originally featured in issue 32 of the PSX 'Exclusive Demos' series and made using the Net Yaroze development kit.

name: The Ledge
summary: Created for Doom 2, any limit removing port will do. No additional resources required, as this map (Map 20) intends to make the most of Doom 2's stock resources to create its aesthetic.

name: The Beginning of the End (part 1)
summary: The Beginning of the End (part 1) is a two-episode PWAD for Doom. It was created by Emil Brundage (NaturalTvventy) in 1997.

name: The Darkening: Episode 1
summary: The Darkening Episode 1: The Nameless Project is a Doom II megawad containing twenty-two maps, split equally between single player/coop and deathmatch.

name: The Darkening: Episode 2
summary: The Darkening Episode 2 is the 2000 sequel to 1998's The Darkening. This new episode features twenty-four levels split equally between single player and deathmatch modes. It was initially released on March 8, 2000 with a soundtrack primarily composed by Peter Tomaselli (Kniggit).

name: The Mountaineer
summary: The Mountaineer is a set of 5 MBF21 (-complevel 21) maps depicting a journey to the top of an uncharted mountain. A gift to MIDI connoisseur and good friend @Jimmy, commemorating his 31st birthday.

name: The Legend of Peks
summary: The Legend of Peks is a game made using RPG maker MZ in under 100 hours. For the streamer IHasPeks.

name: The Adventures of Sheep and Sheep
summary: Yangyang Road Finding Adventure is an adventure puzzle solving casual game.

name: Thy Dungeonman 1 & 2 for Playdate
summary: A port of Thy Dungeonman from flash to the Playdate

name: The Paradixion: Laboratory
summary: The Paradixion: Laboratory is the second installment in the "The Paradixion" series, created by a solo South Korean developer. It's a point-and-click adventure game with a mysterious atmosphere.

name: The Valley
summary: The Valley is a graphical roguelike RPG with a simple interface and semi-real-time combat system. The background story is all but non-existent, suffice to say that you're the hero and you want to explore the name-providing Valley to slay monsters and find treasure.

name: The White Barrows
summary: This is a text based game that has elements from a multiple genres dungeon crawl, puzzle, logic challenge, and even resource management. The back story is about a bad wizard who's stolen a magic chalice and you play the plucky adventurer who has to get it back. The bad guy is hiding in the ancient burial grounds, or barrows. The game is based on a map of the barrows in which there are 40 or so rooms. You are dropped randomly into a room. In other rooms are gnomes, trolls, dragons etc and in one room is the wizard. The game is played by moving from room to room exploring. You may view connecting rooms. You may raise a magic wall in an adjacent room. However you have only 400 magic points and viewing or raising a wall costs points so it's important to find the wizard before points run out. The game is a text game. There is only one graphic which is the map that shows how the rooms are connected.

name: Thank Goodness You're Here!
summary: Thank Goodness You're Here! is an absurd comedy slapformer set in the bizarre Northern English town of Barnsworth. As a traveling salesman, take the time to see the sights and meet the locals, who are very eager to give you a series of increasingly odd jobs…

name: The Rising
summary: Wadazine Master Collection 01: The Rising or shortly WMC01: The Rising is a six-level collaborative mapset for Doom II and the GZDoom source port, created by various members of The Doom Master Wadazine community led by Alexa Jones-Gonzales (Remilia Scarlet), with support from Christian Blair (Endless). It is the first entry in the Wadazine Master Collection series. The project started on March 11, 2021. The first version was released on April 25, 2021. The maps were created with heavy use of Doom 3 textures.

name: Thy Flesh Vored
summary: Everyone trembles at the sound of his name. Everyone remembers those distant memories of sleepless nights trying to achieve victory. Countless deaths are forgotten in ancient corners. Rivers of blood overflow to give way to oceans of curse. Your flesh is consumed by sin itself. Trapped in marble fortresses, surrounded by hellish castles, deep in gothic hells and exiled in a world of gore. This is Thy Flesh Vored, a project inspired by the dreaded E4 of Ultimate Doom, and one that is coming for your flesh. Hand it over.

name: The Heart of Stone
summary: The Heart of Stone is a single-level PK3 for Doom II and the GZDoom source port. It was designed by evil space tomato in 2015 and uses the music track "Coalescence" from Risk of Rain. It reached fourth place in the Doomjà-Vu contest.

name: The 12 Days of Doomas!
summary: Snow is falling, reindeer are flying, arch-viles are doing that bubbly gurgle noise thing they do, and the fourth installment of the Pineapple Under the Sea Monthly Speedmapping Series has left a very nice gift under a tree near you! 15 uniquely wrapped 10 sectored gifts are here and waiting for you to rip and tear open this Doommas! Unfortunately for you, there are also 75 arch-viles under the tree. Guess you shouldn't have been such a naughty kid this year, huh.

name: The Unending
summary: The Undending is about a guy who just had an unfortunate accident and is now in a sort of repeating personal hell.

name: The World's Hardest Game: On Steam
summary: I present you The World's Hardest Game... On Steam! An aesthetic take on a classic browser game from 2008. Wait, are you sure you're ready to face The World's Hardest Game again? With aesthetic visuals and enhanced gameplay? Oh, and a revamped soundtrack? Alright. You can try.

name: The Participants
summary: The third game in the HauntedPS1 C.H.A.I.N. anthology, it documents a nightmare-like trawl through a surrealist underwater world.

name: Thor's Ascension: Nine Realms
summary: Rule the god of thunder and challenge all the gods of the nine realms! In this Rogue-like, hack and slash game, develop your strategy and skills, subject all the gods who challenge you to your wrath, and become the only god of the universe.

name: The Camp
summary: You have been sent to The Camp. You cannot leave unless you collect all tents. There are a lot of monsters, so be careful. If they touch you, you die.

name: The Great Hunt
summary: Deep in the forest, far away from civilization, an evil awakens that no one can stop. As a forest ranger, you embark on a rescue mission that escalates into a terrifying nightmare. Defy your fears in this first-person survival horror game.

name: The Inner Demons
summary: The Inner Demons is the first game in a new genre of “Cinematically Cut Games”. Explore a horror environment through a cinematic lens in this innovative interactive experience.

name: The Temple Warrior: Battleground of Demons
summary: Defeat the demons and save the prestigious Indian Temple in this FREE action-packed mini melee combat game.

name: The Demons of Truth
summary: The Demons of Truth is an action-adventure, open-world role-playing game set in an Ancient Time.

name: The Faceless Ones
summary: Four of the most capable warriors in the Kingdom of Abrujah are about to commence a journey that will change their lives forever, if they fail, the world is doomed!

name: The Crimson Pearl
summary: The Blight has plagued The Kingdom for as long as one can remember. Ashanti and Scarlett believe they have found out a way to fight The Blight and defeat it once and for all. Their path to such solution will drastically change their lives!

name: The Solar Queen
summary: The Solar Queen - an arcade disaster simulator. Your "professional" spaceship crew will break every part on board, get you into a thousand troubles, and make you learn high-flying stunts with just one engine.

name: The Simplest Game in the World
summary: You can beat this game with any key on your keyboard. ANY key, I mean it.

name: The Flat
summary: The Flat is an FPS Immersive Horror where you're just a small cog in the vast, dark machinery of Corpo Corporation. Navigate corporate chaos, fight for your life, master unique stealth mechanics, and immerse yourself in a brutalist horror setting. How much can you take before you snap?

name: The White Prison
summary: The White Prison is a tragic and thrilling story about the confrontation of indigenous peoples, the impending civilization, told through the prism of a survival simulator. Take the role of polar aviation pilots who made an emergency landing in the Siberian taiga and try to survive.

name: Through Time the Girl Puzzle
summary: "Gentleman puzzle, relying on puzzle skills and skills to keep moving into the hearts of various beautiful girls! "

name: Thanks, Light.
summary: [Thanks, Light.] is a first-person 3D geometry puzzle game where you shine and absorb light to transform 2D and 3D states.Watch as one boy saves a world that has lost its light.

name: The Projection Room of Malka Spitzer
summary: The Projection Room of Malka Spitzer is an atmospheric, psychological RPG adventure that delves into the depths of the mind. Unravel the enigmatic maze of dreams, confront inner demons, and challenge your perception of reality.

name: The Grugs: Origins
summary: The Grugs: Origins is a creative mix between runner and platformer games, mixing the challenging elements of both into it's gameplay, while allowing for player expression with four playable characters with multiple available skills to use.

name: The Riftbreaker: Heart of the Swamp
summary: Explore an entirely new area of Galatea 37 in this Story Campaign expansion for The Riftbreaker. Catalog new species. Craft new and unique weapons. Fight hordes of aliens, unlike anything you've seen before.

name: The Devilry Reservation: Сhapter II
summary: The second chapter of The Devilry Reservation: Behind the Shadow - Shadow. Immerse yourself in the internal affairs of the Paranormal Security Service. Be ready to see the other side of the interaction of evil spirits with our world. How people side by side with them hold the two worlds in harmony.

name: The Cursed Village TD
summary: The Cursed Village is a rogue-lite Tower Defense game. With six types of towers, dozens of enemies, dozens of abilities and a unique rune system, you will strategize and defend your village against an ancient curse.

name: The First Explorers
summary: The First Explorers is a Settlers-like game, that offers the perfect mix of organic city-building and RTS in a bustling world. Set in the time of antiquity in Europe, you will play as the Romans, Carthaginians or Gauls. Are you ready to raise an army backed by a thriving economy?

name: The Leverage Game
summary: You can learn realistic, world-class management techniques! The Leverage Game is an updated online version of “Leverage: The Game of Business,” an authentic business board game developed by ActionCoach 20 years ago.

name: The Police Interceptors Simulator: War Against Racers
summary: You will become part of an elite police squad. Your mission is to engage in battles with unpredictable street racers who pose a danger to ordinary citizens on the roads. You will have to control various police vehicles and use your skills and tactics to apprehend and stop these dangerous offenders.

name: The Broken Moon
summary: The Broken Moon Execution is a text-based fast-passing supernatural puzzle game. Game play is diverse, players need to explore through the map, collect various clues to solve the mystery, and gradually understand the truth of the collapse of "Samle" ......

name: The Sailor’s Guide to Game Design
summary: The Sailor’s Guide to Game Design is an interactive visual novel try to use a 'Dialect' narrative style in games, Writing from the Margins.

name: The Leverage Game: Business Edition
summary: You can learn realistic, world-class management techniques! The Leverage Game is an updated online version of “Leverage: The Game of Business,” an authentic business board game developed by ActionCoach 20 years ago.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Assorted Sidearms Pack
summary: Add three versatile handguns to your hunting arsenal with the Assorted Sidearms Pack.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - New England Scout Cosmetic Pack
summary: Decorate your weapon collection with these unique cosmetics inspired by the New England Mountains hunting reserve.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - New England Veteran Cosmetic Pack
summary: Decorate your weapons, tents, and ground blinds with these unique cosmetics inspired by the New England Mountains Reserve.

name: The Demon's Lust
summary: A nun trapped in a mansion full of lust.

name: The Demon King takes Revenge! Card Battle!!
summary: Card battle game! The story is about the main character, the weakest Demon King, who battles rival magical girls, angels, and the Demon King of Hell, and grows up trying to subdue them. If you win, you can acquire your opponent's cards and incorporate them into your own deck.

name: The Clubies
summary: The Clubies is a party platformer where players navigate cute cube characters through the disco to reach the dancefloor! Encounter various hazards, puzzles, and shortcuts in a fun, colorful environment as you master user-built levels together.

name: The Journey
summary: A new 32-map megawad for DOOM II, focusing on short to medium length levels, played in a series or from pistol start, in single player or cooperative. THE JOURNEY takes you across a variety of locales, challenging you along the way with insidious traps and vicious monsters. The levels are easy to understand, but don't underestimate them because of the lack of massive hordes! Close quarters and strategical monster and item placement will test your skills. The average time to complete a given level is about 8 minutes.

name: The Uprising
summary:
Looks like you're coming out of retirement, son.

Another citadel was taken over by the forces of Hell, just when you thought you exterminated them all!

This time, it's not so easy. The minions are more dedicated than ever, to take over the world! They've teamed up in larger numbers, and in tougher groups. This will be the toughest battle you may ever have been in, provided you can last through this marathon of gunfire.

name: The Beginning of the End: Part 2
summary: The follow up to The Beginning of the end. Lots of new stuff here. All these levels have an original feel to them. You will enjoy playing these wads! But be warned... they are tough!

name: The Mean Green
summary: The levels are small-medium in size and plays more like Ult. Doom since only lower tier monsters and weaponry were used. They should offer a good 45 minutes of some classic, old school fun! The action is fast paced and the levels feature their usual style of interconnectivity and semi-realistic to abstract visuals.

name: The Mean Green 2
summary:
The first 3 maps saw you fighting against Imps, Sergeants and Demons with only the Shotgun, Chaingun and the Rocket Launcher. This time they are cranked up to 11 and you're gonna get bigger guns. But also a whole lot of beefier meat to aim them at! You are the Mean Green and you are about to bully the crap out of this strange world!
The levels are medium sized and sets the player in an abstract semi realistic hellish tech setting.

name: The Wailing Horde
summary: This one large map is Chris Hansen's interpretation of an action filled and slightly different episode 2 level. It tried to stay true to the style of eps. 2, but cranked it up a bit.

name: The Darkened Outpost
summary: Yet another demon-infested, abandoned base. Fight your way through these nukage-processing industrial environments and expect surprises.

name: The Bunnyman
summary: Your roommate, Tyler, decided to go camping with some friends a couple of weeks ago near Fairfax Station. He hasn't been seen in almost a month. Although you have tried to reach out and contact him, he has not responded. Fearing the worst, you decide to go and investigate to see if you can find him. Along the way, you realize that something sinister is happening behind the scenes.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - Stamina Bar
summary: A challenging mod that implements a stamina bar for all items.

name: The Discrete Era
summary: An Action-Roguelike, multiplayer coop game.

name: The Senate
summary: While Mario was asleep due to poisonous wine, a group of mysterious and powerful enemies which call themselves “The Senate” took over the Mushroom Kingdom. Will Mario be able to defeat all of its members through a lot of new worlds and enemies? Only time will tell.

name: The Tartine's Show
summary: In a world made of toast, you are the best, the only one. You are part of

name: The Backrooms Deluxe
summary: In "The Backrooms Deluxe", there are many entities blocking your way of finally exiting the backrooms. Each of the entities has its own appearance and mechanics

name: The Awakener: Forgotten Oath
summary: The Awakener: Forgotten Oath is a rogue-like action game with a highly flexible combat system. ACT and Rogue-like lovers will embark on a thrilling adventure in a magical world called Sylvalond.

name: The Arena Pit
summary: Ready for a blend of RPG and Tower Defense in a 2D rogue-lite game? Enter The Arena Pit! Choose your hero, wield powerful weapons and skills. Strategize your moves in the arena, setting traps, obstacles, and towers against hordes of monsters in the epic battle of good versus evil!

name: The Purge
summary: The Purge offers you a different experience. Embark on a dark adventure to find your lost Wife Cristina in this story-based game and unravel the mystery behind the deep story. Run from place to place with many universes, enemies and mechanical styles in it and feel the purge.

name: The Mending
summary: Another threshold has been opened, and is in need of mending. It’s time to perform your duties. Weaken the demon, seal the door and send it back to Hell.

name: The Green Room Experiment: Episode 2
summary: You're locked in a dream and you need to wake up. This game is designed on an escape game structure, you must solve a puzzle to move on to the next table. Immerse yourself into a dreamlike, strange universe, mixing exploration, mystery and poetry.

name: The Barkless Doctrine
summary: The Barkless Doctrine is an interactive comedy novel; a book in which you navigate the complex geopolitical tomfoolery that gets thrown at you. Will you accept Kitty’s invitation to a daring mission? Will you be rude to people, or only kind of rude? Green or red salsa? Choose wisely, for the fate of the free world is in your goofball hands!

name: The Thief Simulator 2023: From Crook to Boss
summary: Advance from novice to crafty pro, executing daring heists and outsmarting police in a captivating world of intrigue and danger!

name: The House of the Dead: Remake - Z Version
The Winter's Embrace: Celestial Gateway
summary: Embark on a heartwarming journey through a stunning winter wonderland in this enchanting 3D platformer. Traverse snowy landscapes, and collect magical hearts to unlock the Celestial Gateway. Unravel the mysteries of this captivating world filled with challenges!

name: The Jetsons: Space Race
summary: A simple, slick side-scrolling platformer starring The Jetsons, everyone's favorite space age family. George is running late and there's bumper-to-bumper traffic on the intergalactic interstate. But he still has to drop off Elroy at the Little Dipper School, Judy at Orbit City High, Astro at the Galaxy K-9 School, and Jane at the Shopping Center. All before heading to work. Will he make it to Spacely Sprockets on time?

name: The Genesis Order
summary: Murder and mystery lead a young detective to investigate a cult and to cross paths with a criminal organization. With the help of an angel and a harem of beauties, take on the challenge of saving the world from a mysterious threat.

name: The Left Behind
summary: The Left Behind is a solo and co-op post-apocalyptic survival game. Explore an overgrown open world at day time and beware of enemies coming in at night. Salvage, hunt and build your way through this world to survive. How long will you survive?

name: The Tale of Lumi
summary: Master tight platforming sections, collect and upgrade Godly powerups, battle powerful enemies, solve intriguing puzzles and explore the riveting world of LUMI in this fast paced 2D action game

name: The Pocket Arcade
summary:
Enter into the golden age of arcade gaming with The Pocket Arcade. Play the biggest collection of amazingly detailed and crafted retro arcade games anywhere you want.
The Pocket Arcade is a love letter to arcade games from a bygone era, where neon-soaked, coin-operated machines were the pinnacle of interactive entertainment. From early 8-bit shooters and monochrome vector games through 16-bit puzzlers and action games, right up to early 3D games from the mid-'90s, as well as non-videogame coin-ops such as darts, pool, and table football. The Pocket Arcade is a gamer’s paradise!

name: The Keyboard
summary: This is a text based game. You need to use the given keyboard to achieve the level goal.

name: The Dark Tower
summary: Complete the Trials of Kornath and learn the location of the dark evil behind the events that unfurled in The Curse of Feldar Vale and Mystery at Morgoth. An adventure for 4-6 characters of Level 6-12, loosely based on D&D Open Game License (1e/2e).

name: The Good, the Bad, and the Horsey
summary: Brittney hates her podunk, horse-crazy town almost as much as she hates horses themselves... but, with the town's traditional Silver Lasso Run only a month away, can she take this chance to finally grab the reins of her own destiny? Bounced between a good ol' Southern cowgal on the hunt for a dangerous criminal, a mysterious magical drifter with a dark secret, and a rogue centaur who lives by her own rules, Brittney is thrust into a fantastical alternate Wild West world... and has to choose between The Good, The Bad, and The Horsey!!

name: The Third Age
summary: Magical SLG Masterpiece Real Strategy & Exclusive Heroes Together into Battle.

name: The World is Drowning
summary: The world is drowning, and everyone you know is gone. If you wish to survive, you'll have to climb to the moon. On your way up you’ll encounter many traps and monsters, but remember, you must never stop. The sea of blood is coming, and it will rob you of your final breath.

name: The Girl with the Guitar
summary: A short bullet-ridden action-adventure experience where you kill robots by smashing them with a flying guitar. Learn to stop living life bullet after bullet as you leverage deadly momentum against projectiles and enemies, saving the galaxy and shredding some awesome tunes along the way!

name: The Encounter
summary: This game tells the story of a Chinese family who inexplicably disappeared in 1999. Afterwards, a journalist was sent by the TV station to investigate and visit this incident and the subsequent events. The final outcome will be unimaginable to you! Looking forward to your experience!

name: The Great Below
summary: Immerse yourself in a haunting map-based horror experience. Break free from the loop and the mansion where you find yourself while unveiling the secrets underneath it all. The Society expects something from you but are you ready to face the consequences?

name: The Sheriff's Town
summary: The Sheriff's Town is a game where you control a sheriff to exterminate hordes of zombies.

name: The Dark Tower
summary: The Dark Tower is a side-scrolling Apple II adventure. Guide the character via keyboard, solving puzzles, gathering items, and defeating the dragon to claim King Arthur's crown jewels, all while encountering Merlin and ghosts.

name: The Mythical City
summary: Protect the magic crystal, to which waves of enemies are coming!

name: The Daily Sudoku
summary: A new Sudoku puzzle each day! Indulge in your daily habit with all the bells and whistles from some classic Sudoku including notes, auto-cleanup, and slash notes.

name: The Incredibles: Jack-Jack's Escape
summary: Heroic Baby Hijinx! The game takes place within the Underminer’s colossal digger. You control Jack-Jack, the infant member of the Incredibles. A Disney game.

name: The Villainess Just Wants to Eat!!
summary: Life’s greatest pleasures are food and fantasy manhwa. When reading, you can drool over hot characters and delicious looking food. After a late night of reading your favorite manhwa, you fall into the land of sleep and dream of being the fiance of the prince…only it isn't a dream! You’ve been reincarnated as the villainess! Will you be able to survive and live your dream of eating delicious food, or will you suffer the deadly fate of all villainesses?

name: The Winter Games
summary: On a cold winter night, the worst members of the naughty list find themselves abducted to the North Pole and forced to play in a series of death games run by a mysterious evil woman claiming to be Santa. Why are they here, and will they survive?

name: The Harlem Shake vs. Gangnam Dance Game
summary: What's your favorite move: The Harlem Shake or Gangnam Dance? Play as either one in this epic dance game! The biggest YouTube legends ever battling it out.

name: The Sims 3
summary: Based on the number 1 PC game franchise of all time, The Sims 3 brings exciting new gameplay and endless possibilities all on your mobile phone! Enjoy unexpected moments of surprise and mischief, as you choose whether (or not!) to fulfill your Sims' destinies and make their wishes come true. Create and customize your Sims appearance and personality, then take your Sims out of the house and into the neighborhood with all new open world gameplay. Make their world your own!

name: Thunder Rally
summary: Announced as a vehicular combat game in the vein of Twisted Metal, the game was one of a few game at the time cancelled during a massive corporate structuring that found much of the company instead focusing on the original Metroid Prime game.

name: This Picture
summary: This picture is a puzzle game of folding parts of the image of the whole picture.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Chainsaw Skin Variants
summary: Show off your twisted personality with these three new skins for Leatherface's chainsaw! Includes the Pristine, Stickers, and Rusty variants. Slaughter with style!

name: The Legend of Super Mario: Save Mushroom Kingdom
summary:
Welcome to Mushroom Kingdom, where Bowser has captured Princess Toadstool and thrown the Kingdom into tyranny. It is up to a heroic plumber named Mario to find all Starmen, become super and save the day!

Along the way you’ll be challenged by Goombas, Koopas and an endless array of ruthless creatures who will stop at nothing to prevent you from finding the 8 Starmen of power. Please hurry up and rescue Peach!

name: Three Minutes With Your Dog
summary: Play with your trusty dog today! The sky is clear, the sun is shining and oh cool, theres a dog walking his huma-

name: Thinkin' Things: All Around Frippletown
summary: Thinkin' Things Frippletown offers age-appropriate activities that allow students to explore and practice various thinking strategies, including analyzing attributes, using logic, working backwards, identifying multiple solutions, and practicing creativity.

name: The Noose
summary:
"My older sister killed me.
My younger sister hung me.
I killed my older sister."

This was... everything her dead brother wrote in his diary.
He'd said he'd be right back, but he never returned.
Shortly after, they found his bloody hat.

name: The Fairway Club
summary: Grab your clubs and get to The Fairway Club now! We offer a relaxing golfing experience for any type of golfer. Hit one of our courses or driving ranges, located all around the world, in the morning, evening or night!

name: This is My Place
summary: This is my place - This is a fantasy war game with simple gameplay but difficult survival. Players need to upgrade facilities to obtain more resources to defend their territory. In addition to wars, players can also gain more resources or morale by playing mini-games. So how many days can you last?

name: The Spectral Web: Hitodama
summary: Explore a Labyrinth full of magic, monsters, and mystery in this dungeon crawler inspired by retro classics. Wield unique spells to battle enemies, break blocks, and uncover hundreds of secrets hidden within the Labyrinth's walls.

name: The Princess's Dragon
summary: Traverse the winding dungeon of the dragon as you attempt to reverse the curse that has been set upon you by the cursed sword.

name: The Paper Trials
summary: A first-person horror maze game. Hiding & Standing still is Death. Run or you are dead. Trapped in a realm of nightmarish mazes with your only hope of survival is to find all of the pages to the mysterious book and escape!

name: The Nascent Necromancer
summary: When you're falsely accused of sorcery, corrupt inquisitors make you the object of a witch hunt. Now, sorcery might be the only way for you to survive.

name: The Impossible Tower
summary: In Impossible Tower, a young boy with no particular skill has been transported back to the Medieval Times by a clumsy wizard. There he will find lots of adventures and fun while trying to reach the tower top in order to escape this zombie-infested and full-of-magic world!

name: The Adventures of Liam
summary: Liam is going on an adventure! What could go wrong? Other than... You know, needing to save the world.

name: The Elder Tales
summary: Prepare for a challenging adventure in this oldschool 2D action-RPG. Experience the nostalgic charm of retro graphics combined with modern gameplay solutions. With low computer requirements, immerse yourself in an intriguing story and explore a world filled with endless activities.

name: The Fall of Elements
summary: The Fall of Elements is an action-adventure game set in an ancient dungeon. You are chosen by the Elements to find an evil enemy. Solve puzzles, explore a vast dungeon, overcome obstacles in your way and fight forbidden magic.

name: The Hallway: Escape Room
summary: “The Hallway - Escape Room” is a story-based single player puzzle adventure game that will take you on a mind-bending journey to uncover the mysteries of a long-forgotten civilization and their gods discovered during an expedition. Will you face them?

name: The Hangman
summary: After weeks of relentless searching, the Detective finally uncovers a critical clue that leads to an isolated location, unveiling the fate of the Hangman's victims. Can you make a getaway with your findings before it's too late?

name: The Case of the Golden Idol: Complete Edition
summary:
Additional content included:
- The Lemurian Vampire
- The Spider of Lanka
- Soundtrack

name: The Fall of Elena Temple
summary:
Fall from a ledge, collect the coins below, then undo back to where you fell from, with the coins in your pocket! An old-school puzzle platformer in which you explore rooms, avoid perils and collect all coins to progress. Missed some coins? Fall, collect, undo! Falling into some spikes? Undo!!

Test your forward thinking and logical skills. Plan your falls carefully, as your undos are limited. If you're not paying attention, you'll find yourself unable to restore back to the top, with coins still needing collecting!

Enjoy the retro aesthetics with monochrome pixel art, playing the game on the state of the art handheld GrimBoy (TM) (wink). Reminisce about the good times with lovely pixel art backgrounds to put you right back into your childhood bedroom, the backyard, the park, grandma's living and many more.

name: The Three Stooges
summary: Cancelled Game Boy Color port of The Three Stooges.

name: The Outer Zone: Survival Tactics
summary: Lead a caravan of survivors through a world on the brink of collapse. Scavenge for resources, form bonds with your fellow survivors, and make difficult choices in this turn-based strategy roguelite. Will you survive long enough to reach the Outer Zone?

name: The Next Big Thing
summary: A proposed hybrid video game mixed racing, platforming, and trick performing. The game was cancelled when developers Pandemic Studios could not find a publisher, and the company shutdown shortly afterwards.

name: The Wonderful 101
summary: Early plans for the game included releasing it on the Wii with existing Nintendo characters, though plans stalled and the game was put on hold. The game concepts were later revived as an original game with new characters for the Wii U and released in 2013.

name: The Hunter's Journals: Return to Wight Chapel
summary: The Crawling Horror is dead, but its legacy of madness lives on!

name: Theft Ride Legacy: Deluxe Edition
summary:
Gear up for the ultimate treasure hunt on wheels!
Get ready for an adrenaline-packed adventure in "Theft Ride Legacy"!
Bundle includes "Extra Color Pack" !

name: The Addams Family: Pugsley's Scavenger Hunt
The Addams Family: Pugsley's Scavenger Hunt
The Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends
The Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends
The Blues Brothers
summary:
The Blues Brothers is a platform game based on the band The Blues Brothers, where the object is to evade police and other vigilantes to get to a blues concert.

The characters have the ability to pick up boxes to throw them at enemies. Each level is a variation on the jumping theme, with the characters finding a necessary attribute (e.g. a guitar) somewhere in the level. The sixth and final level ends on-stage.

The game's soundtrack consists of music from the movie. Dimitris Yerasimos composed the music for all versions of the game except for the Game Boy, where Thorsten Mitschele composed the music.

name: The Hardest Game Ever
summary: The Hardest Game Ever is a precision 2D platformer. As the name suggests, it's a very difficult game, so difficult that the developer has created a challenge to pay the first person to beat the game.

name: The Grinch
summary: As the Grinch, your mission is to undo Whoville's Holiday preparations in a most mischievous way. With help from lovable Max the Dog, you'll creep stealthily about Whoville, stealing presents and decorations. But be careful, those pesky Whos are determined to stop your despicable acts!

name: The Adventures of Robin Hood
summary: From The English Software Company.

name: Three Random Archives
summary: In this action-adventure game play a collection of three short stories all confined within a single package. Shoot your way to survival, platform your way to victory, and explore a distant but familiar city! Just whatever you do, stay off circus grounds!!! (It's private property.)

name: The Johnny Papa
summary: The Johnny Papa is a strategic multiplayer horror game with 3 main characters, 5 side characters and 1 murderer. Welcome to the village of Agris.

name: The Adventures of Bunny and Pig
summary: Narrative game where Bunny heals an injured Pig and then together they fight against monsters. Psychological healing theme with a cute art style.

name: The Sentinel
summary: Defend your castle against waves of invaders in 'The Sentinel,' a tower defense game. Strategically upgrade weapons and defenses, make tough choices, and immerse yourself in intense battles. Will you triumph and protect your realm?

name: The Bowyage
summary:
The Bowyage is a low fantasy platformer inspired by the NES Castlevania games, where you control Yew Bowman, a member of the low nobility and a longbowman, in his journey of conquests against his other two elder brothers.
Yew, lacking resources, figured that he needs to gain power to fend off against his two more powerful brothers, so with his trusty bow and arrow and his loyal army, he marches towards the path of conquest.

name: The War of 2022
summary: Enlist, fight, and decide how loyal you are to your country in this modern military war novel!

name: They Come In Waves
summary: Forge your path through unending zombie swarms! Craft inferno-spewing flamethrowers & explosive rocket launchers for ultimate undead domination. How long will you survive?

name: ThinkExplosive
summary: ThinkExplosive is a first-person puzzle-platformer about bombs! Throw bombs to overcome obstacles - or launch yourself to new heights! Explore the corridors of an abandoned facility and discover new game mechanics.

name: The Weird Dream
summary: The Wierd Dream is a hand-drawn anime style 2D horizontal action-adventure Metroidvania game. You play as a mysterious Rabbit in the middle of a destroyed city. Defeat residents who have been alienated and continue to improve yourself to finally unlock the ultimate secret behind.

name: The Last Braincell
