summary: Do you ever want to revisit the good old days of bouncing screen savers? Well not only can you do that you can also add whatever images you'd like to it, customize its background to whatever you'd want it to be, and even play around with them as you brain blast your last few brain cells!

name: The Rabbit Haul
summary: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

name: Thetawave
summary: Thetawave is a physics-based space shooter with procedurally generated levels, diverse foes, and distinct characters.

name: The Last General
summary: Lead your army through raging conflicts in this massive RTS modern war game. Execute tactics and conquer the resources you need to achieve your goals. Take the enemy territory, perform assassinations, lead insurrections, rescue your stranded troops and much more, in millions of different missions.

name: The House
summary: Escape from the house where it all began, collect items, weapons and level up. Travel between worlds and through time to reach your goal. Go discover the dark secrets of the House where it all began!

name: The Amazing Crackpots Club!
summary: The Amazing Crackpots Club! is a fast-paced, action-packed magic duel in a 2D arena, where wizards throw powerful spells trying to destroy the opponent’s pots, while using mobility and defensive abilities to protect their own pots from incoming attacks.

name: The Backrooms: Unbounded
summary: The Backrooms: Unbounded is a Free single player first person body camera horror game based on the backrooms. You take the role of a police officer who noclips out of reality while on duty. Will you make it out alive?

name: The Barnacle Squad
summary: The Barnacle Squad is a tactical turn-based RPG set in the slimy, tentacle-infested waters of a flooded necropolis. Choose from 12 distinct character classes as you manage your squad of mercenaries rowing through a labyrinth of nautical fiends.

name: The Galaxy Rider
summary: Welcome to The Galaxy Rider! Cruise the cosmos as a space taxi driver! Your mission? Get rich while carrying passengers between planets. Ready for an out-of-this-world ride?

name: The Attic
summary: A Survival Horror Mystery Explorer

name: The Garden of Silvergrass
summary: The main character, Naho, meets a mysterious fox spirit named Semi in a silver grass field. Fall into her lovely charm. The closer you get to her, the more you will face her and your dark past. Can your choice create a new future?

name: The Keeper's Book
summary: Join a young hero in his journey through a magical world filled with wonders and perils, and help him reveal the mystery that lies between the pages of the Keeper’s Book. Explore, craft and fight in this brand new indie adventure.

name: The Bearer & The Last Flame
summary: The Bearer & The Last Flame is a dark fantasy action adventure. In a realm where death is rampant, a living soul has received his commission, to carry the last flame and light the lands of the night, the dark lands.

name: The Signal: Stranded on Sirenis
summary: The Signal: Stranded on Sirenis is a single-player survival craft game set on a captivating alien planet that has ensnared you. Scavenge, build, extract, and survive your way through a complex world as you reveal the true intentions of this sentient planet - and why it has brought you here.

name: The World's Hardest Game 3D Nostalgia 2
summary: Easy to play, hard to finish. The World's Hardest Game 2, which you used to play on flash game sites, is now with you in 3D! The same 50 levels as in the original game are now here. Be patient, dodge enemies and reach to the end in this 3D Hard Platformer!

name: The Hero gives up!... Wait, What!?
summary: Adult-Only Fantasy Visual Novel featuring 5 girls, plenty of choices, comedy, and sex in a laid-back story!

name: The Intruder
summary: Uncover the chilling secrets of 'The Intruder.' Navigate a haunted mansion, solve puzzles, and evade the lurking darkness. A suspenseful horror-adventure that tests your survival instincts.

name: The Troll
summary:
Hello people of all ages, places, and wages, and welcome to THE TROLL! Come on down and win a shiny Star! No scams here, my friends! Promise!

Made for SimpleFlips's Troll Competition 2023, this hack is a linear experience that has a little story that goes along with it.

name: Thunder War Rabbit Alien Fight
summary: A Cosmic Battle Begins: Thunder War Rabbit to the Rescue!

name: The Fox Awaits Me Hana
summary: In "The Fox Awaits Me Hana," players take on the role of a young man named Takahiro who, after getting lost in the mountains, stumbles upon a mysterious shrine dedicated to the fox deity. He is then suddenly transported to a mystical world where he meets a beautiful fox girl named Hana. As the story progresses, Takahiro learns more about Hana and her past, and the player's choices will determine the outcome of the game.

name: The Sims 4: Poolside Splash Kit
summary: Turn heads at the pool with bright and playful swimwear from The Sims 4 Poolside Splash Kit.

name: The Sims 4: Modern Luxe Kit
summary: Treat yourself to luxurious modern furniture that says “I made it” with The Sims 4 Modern Luxe Kit.

name: The Moshpit Tournament
summary:
"The Moshpit" is a Horde Mode TPS Single Player game, where you gun down waves of enemy Cyphers that assault you from every side!

Waves ​have a fixed set of points to be won. The faster you complete the wave & squash your opponents, the MORE points you'll WIN!

name: The Top Hat Club
summary:
Gain entry to the exclusive club where top hats are a strict dress code requirement. The Top Hat Club is a platform game where you must collect the top hat on each level before you can get into the club. There are a variety of obstacles to overcome, and collecting all of the coins on each level provides a further challenge for the completist gamer. The game includes over 30 levels, awards and secrets to unlock. Presented in glorious monochrome with a pseudo-Victorian style.
A total remake of the original browser game with high-resolution graphics, a new control system and widescreen support.

name: The Boy and the Cathedral
summary: Drawn to a mysterious cathedral, a boy sets out to unlock its secret.

name: The Merlies
summary: Meet the Merlies, a tiny birds community trying to find harmony in a world where the remains of an ancient civilisation are still visible. Build your village ingeniously, gather your birdies and explore this way-too-big world in this cute post-apocalyptic adventure ! Ready to spread your wings?

name: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 1: Archer's Paradox
summary: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

name: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 2: Hunting Grounds
summary: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

name: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 3: First Ones
summary: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

name: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 4: Impossible Objects
summary: Experience the exciting universe of The Expanse like never before in Telltale’s latest adventure, The Expanse: A Telltale Series. Follow Cara Gee, who reprises her role as Camina Drummer, and explore the dangerous and uncharted edges of the Belt aboard the the Artemis. From scavenging wrecked ships in a zero-g environment, to surviving a mutiny, to combating fearsome pirates, you make the difficult choices and reveal Camina Drummer’s resolve in this latest Telltale adventure.

name: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Episode 5: Europa's Folly
summary: Immerse yourself in the role of Camina Drummer, the Executive Officer aboard the Artemis, a scavenging ship hunting for a big score in the outer regions of the Belt. You must corral a crew rife with tense relationships and powerful personalities, and make tough decisions that will decide everyone’s fate.

name: The Expanse: A Telltale Series - Archangel Bonus Episode
summary: A bonus DLC episode for The Expanse announced as part of its Deluxe Edition and set to be released after the 5 episode story is finished in September.

name: The Hunt
summary: A supernatural killer stalks five camp counsellors through lethal nightmares in a psychological game that blurs the line between reality and the subconscious.

name: The Chronos Event
summary: The Chronos Event is a fast-paced third-person shooter that emphasizes the tactics of time travel and fast, aggressive play. Players rewind time, battling alongside their younger selves against overwhelming opposition.

name: The Wind's Disciple
summary: It's a parody of the famous MOBA game League of Legends. The Wind's Disciple is a visual novel with a tiny bit of open world details.

name: The Detective Reaper Invites
summary:
Invitation from the Detective Grim Reaper is a roguelite deduction game.
As the detective grim reaper, your job is to solve randomly generated murder cases, find the culprit, and execute them.

name: The Green Machine
summary: he Green Machine is a 12-level PK3 for Doom II that requires the GZDoom source port to play. It was the second mapset created by speedrunner Andrea Rovenski (Cyberdemon531), and features such additions as decorate monsters, 3D floors and scripted events. Released in November 2014 as part of her continuing SecretDoom series, The Green Machine features medium to hard maps, with improved atmosphere and level design over her initial offering, Disrepair.

name: The Blogger
summary: The Blogger is a third-person horror game focused on story, exploration, and solving simple puzzles to progress through a terrifying atmosphere. Take control of our protagonist, a young photographer for a horror blog.

name: The Castle Mystery
summary: A first-person horror game where you step into the shoes of a historian who, on a solo mission, receives a tempting invitation to explore a long-abandoned castle. Drawn by the promise of a generous reward, you accept the offer without hesitation.

name: The Backrooms Recorded
summary: Navigate a nightmarish labyrinth, avoid eerie entities, and uncover dark secrets in this liminality based horror game. Explore realistic levels, unravel secrets, and figure out life or death puzzles. Will you escape the madness? Brought to you by a solo 13 year old dev.

name: The Jumping Food Memory
summary:
Embark on an unforgettable card memory adventure!

Dive into the fascinating world of our brand new card memory video game developed by the creators of "The Jumping Food" Games. We proudly present an exciting gameplay with a homage to our Jumping Games and a pinch of challenge that will keep you hooked for a long time.

Each of our three kitchens holds unique levels full of tricky card pairs. Find the right combinations to unlock the next level and put your memory skills to the test.

name: The Vorlec
summary: Enter an adventure where you will have to make your way to the great metropolis, where hundreds of obstacles will stand in your way, you will have to be very careful because any obstacle can kill you...

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Succubus
summary: Sumire was just like any other woman... until she was reincarnated as a succubus in a magical world! Now she must find her way back to her home world and survive the many challenges that await her in this fantasy realm!

name: The Route
summary: You go along a road as your speed keeps going faster and faster until you lose

name: The Super Shinobi
summary: An unlicensed and unofficial port of Shinobi III: Return of the Ninja Master,

name: The Chant: The Gloom Below
summary: Survive a mind-bending new chapter in The Chant: The Gloom Below DLC. Harness dark forms of Prismic Science with new ability upgrades and weapons against unpredictable enemy encounters. As each death leads you closer to escape, finding the right build is essential.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Hunter Power Pack
summary: Take your big-game hunting to the next level with the Hunter Power Pack, which contains three bolt-action rifles known for their long-range precision and powerful performance.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Hirschfelden Veteran Cosmetic Pack
summary: Decorate your weapons, tents, and ground blinds with these unique cosmetics inspired by the Hirschfelden Reserve.

name: The Passenger
summary: Alone on a crippled spaceship with a distrustful AI. What are you willing to do to survive?

name: Though the Heavens Fall
summary: Though the Heavens Fall is a Christian game reminiscent of classic JRPG gameplay while presenting a perspective of the spiritual world using the Christian Mythos. One where God reigns supreme and though there is conflict in heavenly places, His will is imminent and unstoppable. The game while light-hearted and comedic in tone is backed by the reality that things in the spirit realm are real, our prayers have effect, and that no lesser principality will have its way forever.

name: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles
summary: The Hyper‑Dungeon awaits! Explore an evershifting labyrinth where classic dungeon‑crawling meets exhilarating action. Challenge yourself in turn-based combat with a real‑time, arcade‑inspired twist and befriend an eccentric cast of dungeon dwellers on the quest for the legendary Sacred Groowl!

name: The Scramble Vice
summary: It is the year 2048. Tokyo Police Department’s notorious 9th Mobile Unit, “The Scramble Vice” is ready to fight high-tech robot crime! Clad in an armed exoskeleton suit, police officer Sakuragi Kei of the 9th unit stands to fight robot crimes within Neo Tokyo! Are you ready to scramble up Tokyo?

name: The Pixel Grotto
summary: The Pixel Grotto is a video game published in 2011 on Windows by Apocalyptic Coders. It's an action game, set in a fantasy and dungeon crawler themes.

name: Thalassophobia
summary: Thalassophobia is a 4 player online co-op diving horror game. You and your team are tasked to dive and retrieve valuable objects from sunken vessels. Use your diving and scavenging equipment to clear out anything that tries to stop you from completing your mission.

name: Three Blades Ranch
summary: Three Blades Ranch is a ranching management simulator set in the wild west with a high fantasy twist. After a dragon destroys your ranch it's up to you to rebuild, resettle, and reclaim your homestead from the beast's fiery claws.

name: The Last Tempest
summary: An action game taking place on floating isometric islands, and on each stage, the player must find and kill all the enemies therein. The game is notable for its unusual and visceral depiction of Christian religious figures.

name: The Phone Rings
summary: It has been a bad week!

name: The Bones of You
summary: flatgame

name: The Ghosts of Terinor
summary: The Ghosts of Terinor have recently gained the ability to drain magical powers. As expected your ability to throw fireballs was confiscated by them almost immediately. Use your dual enchanted blades to regain your mojo!

name: The Snow Reach
summary: "The Snow Reach!" is a highly customizable CCG tactical strategy game. You can combine various unique abilities to create your own personalized followers. The game focuses on Roguelike elements and player versus player battles.

name: The Last Librarian
summary: Fight tons of robots, upgrade your abilities and explore an abandoned artificial planet with your jetpack in this non-linear shoot'em up adventure! Play as Gabriela Xanchez, a galactic government agent sent to investigate a dying world and find the last paper book in the galaxy.

name: The Incident
summary: This is a techbase themed map for Doom 2, where you are sent to Mars Base Rama to investigate an incident in subsector B3. The base personnel has vanished and in its place you encounter hordes of hellish demons. What happened?

name: The Daily Diaonal Sudoku
summary: It's just like standard sudoku, but with diagonals! Each row, column, nonet, and diagonal must include exactly one copy of each number 1 through 9.

name: The Comedian Adventure
summary: A minimalist one-button platform game for Net Yaroze.

name: The Order of the Snake Scale
summary: Inspired by Lovecraft, a psychological survival horror game set in a dystopian, alternative universe. Discover the mystery of the woman's death and learn the dark secrets of the Happy Rock. Are you ready? Demo available in February 2024.

name: The Sun Shines Over Us
summary: An award-winning visual novel that dives into the lives and minds of high school students. While focusing on the stories of victims of bullying, The Sun Shines Over Us also explores the social, mental and emotional issues facing modern teenagers.

name: The Lost Ashford Ring
summary: "The Lost Ashford Ring," a captivating hidden object adventure set in the enchanting world of Victorian England. In this immersive game, you step into the shoes of a brilliant detective, hired to unravel a mesmerizing mystery that will test your keen eye and sharp wit.

name: The Local
summary: A fast-paced parkour game set in the Australian outback. Rail grind around the long abandoned country to complete orders or compete in timed courses. Master the movement mechanics and conquer the leaderboards.

name: The King In Yellow: Escape Room
summary: You have been sent to investigate a spaceship whose members have inexplicably disappeared and there is a strange symbol everywhere. In this escape room you will have to solve puzzles as you get closer to the truth behind the mystery.

name: The Cult
summary: In the shadowed year of 1985, a killer has been at large leaving behind trails of clues and grisly scenes. Two years have passed, yet the enigma of Ophelia's disappearance still remains. Ophelia vanished without a trace, leaving behind an unsettling scene.

name: The Arrogant Kaiju Princess and The Detective Servant
summary: Living as a slave to the Monster Princess in a colorful cohabitation lifestyle! An enriching and exciting time management love development game.

name: The Scourge
summary: The Scourge game tells stories revolving around urban legends from the 1990s in Saigon, Vietnam. The male protagonist is trapped by past sins caused by his and his family's mistakes. Now, he must confront and overcome the consequences to find a path to redemption, and you are him.

name: The Nights on Arcade
summary: In The Nights on Arcade, Axel searches for his sister in the spooky Arcade World. Face your fears and reveal dark secrets in this nightmare.

name: Three Goblin Wobblin'
summary: Goblins are prohibited from entering a local tavern, but luckily, they hatched a cunning plan. Move and balance the three goblins to help them quench their thirst and end goblin discrimination in this cute casual wobbling simulator.

name: The Windows Are Gone
summary: Haunted by grief and guilt after a tragic accident, you start seeing a house in your dreams. No matter what you do, you can't get its image out of your mind. You feel it calling for you, so you answer it.

name: The Last Kingdom
summary: Embark on an epic journey in our immersive Viking survival game, where untamed lands await your exploration. Roam through a sprawling open world, navigating lush forests. As you brave the elements and carve out your path, your survival instincts will be put to the test.

name: The Mine
summary: Embark on a captivating 3D point-and-click adventure in the copper mines of 17th-century Sweden. With a mix of humor and puzzles ranging from accessible to challenging, "The Mine" will transport you to a unique historical setting.

name: The Diner at the End of the Galaxy
summary: Build your diner. Grow exotic ingredients and create a menu for your intergalactic guests. Send expeditions to outer worlds in search of loot. Form alliances and rivalries with powerful factions and shape the fate of the galaxy. Welcome to the Diner at the End of the Galaxy.

name: The Big Deal
summary: The Big Deal is a follow-up to the 2008 title Road to Vegas. It is a card game featuring 10 different play modes including Texas Hold 'Em, Black Jack, Spit, Baccarat, Whist, Higher or Lower, Casino War, Solitaire, Pairs, Five Card Draw. Adjustable difficulty levels and multiplayer with up to eight persons.

name: The Last Game
summary: Traverse the dungeon in this awesome action roguelite bullet hell inspired by The Binding Of Isaac and Tiny Rogues, where every choice could make or break your run. Stack over 100 different items and create powerful synergies to become truly overpowered with over 10 unique characters!

name: The Journey Home
summary: The Journey Home is a cinematic and meditative platformer adventure set in a surreal world where you travel beyond the boundaries of time and space. Make your way through stunning and mysterious settings, solve surreal puzzles, and find answers to the life-long questions that haunt Walter.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
summary: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered.

name: The Rewinder: Root of Evil
summary: “Root of Evil” is a DLC adventure that takes place during Yun's childhood… But this story is all about his father – the legendary Rewinder, Master Mont!

name: The Legend of Beowulf
summary:
The Legend of Beowulf is an action adventure game that has been developed primarily for younger audiences.

The plot loosely follows the famous poem telling the adventures of the titular Scandinavian warrior. The player is provided a more accessible adaptation of this work, focusing on selected events portrayed in a fairy tale style. The action of the game takes place in the 6th century AD, and the protagonist's main objective is locating and defeating the beast called Grendel. In the next phase of the game, after the official coronation of Beowulf as King of Denmark, the goal is to face the mother of the defeated monster.

While playing as Beowulf, the player explores a variety of lands and eliminates comical opponents, solves simple puzzles, and plays mini-games.

name: The Protean Forest
summary: The game "The Protean Forest" combines Rogue-Like card game and turn based mechanisms. Defeat demons by deploying and moving unit cards in the area and using skill cards at appropriate times. Uncovering the secret of The Protean Forest

name: The Paper Trials: Chapter 2
summary: A first-person horror maze game. Hiding & Standing still is Death. Run or you are dead. Trapped in a realm of nightmarish mazes with your only hope of survival is to find all of the pages to the mysterious book and escape!

name: The Infirmity
summary: The Infirmity is the third-person zombie shooter game that includes the stories of different characters living during the zombie epidemic.

name: The Appointed Station
summary: Net Yaroze shooting game.

name: The Baseball 2002: Battle Ball Park Sengen
summary: The Baseball 2002 - Battle Ball Park Sengen is Japanese-exclusive sports game. It was announced March 11, 2002 and released on July 11, 2002. It was developed and published by Konami. Beside on the Original Xbox it was also released on Playstation 2. It features all the teams of Japan's professional league and a close tie-in with Nippon Television Network's TV broadcast presentation.

name: The Bone Maze
summary: A labyrinth filled with corpses, and a minotaur at its center.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel III / The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel IV
summary: A bundle including Trails of Cold Steel III and Trails of Cold Steel IV for the PS5, with enhanced performance and bonus cosmetic DLC.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Limited Edition
summary: The Limited Edition includes The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Deluxe Edition, Digital Soundtrack, Mini Art Book, "TRAILS UNCOVERED" 240+ Page Art Book, Disc Digipak Soundtrack, Steelbook, ARKRIDE Solutions Office Business Card Case, Calvardian Cinema" Movie Poster Art Card Set and Collector's Box with "Oct-Genesis" Outer Sleeve.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Deluxe Edition
summary: The Deluxe Edition includes the Base Game, Digital Soundtrack and Mini Art Book.

summary:

name: The Best Play Baseball '90
summary: Best Play Pro Yakyuu '90 is a Sports game, developed and published by ASCII Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 1990.

name: The Best Play Baseball II
summary: Best Play Pro Yakyuu II is a Sports game, developed and published by ASCII Entertainment, which was released in Japan in 1990.

name: The Assassins: PD Games Volume 01
summary: Amiga compilation disc with 5 games by the famous Assassins.

name: The Seven Realms: Realm 3 - High Lathión
summary: The Seven Realms is a fantasy, story-driven, adult visual novel where your choices will shape the fate of the Realms and the people around you. Will you be a Fair or a Strong Ruler? Will fate be enough for you, or will you want more? The choices are yours to make.

name: The Red Forest
summary: Play as Yaro, an introverted young adult who's forced to explore the mysterious and bizarre Red Forest after his brother gets dragged into its depths by a sinister creature.

name: The Foretold: Exordium
summary: Embark on an ancient Egyptian odyssey in this prequel to the gothic horror card game, The Foretold: Westmark Legacy. Build your deck, collect relics, and wield items to conquer creatures and bosses lurking in Egypt's shadows.

name: The Night of Erosion: Prequel
summary: 'I', an ordinary high school student, turns into a monster every night after a certain incident. The protagonist struggles to find out why he became a monster and at the same time avoid being restrained. Please join this girl on her journey toward truth.

name: The Stormy Islands
summary: Survive mother nature, prepare for the different seasons protecting yourself from cold, heat, hunger and thirst. Beware of Tornadoes, Storms, Tsunamis and predatory animals, on a variety of islands where each one will have to adapt to its limited resources.

name: The Spirits of Whispermoon
summary: Embark on an unforgettable co-op adventure in The Spirits of Whispermoon. Team up with friends to jump into a world of magic and mystery, full of intricate puzzles, treacherous dungeons, and fearsome foes.

name: The Last Martian
summary: The only survivor. The Last Martian. Unite 10 civilizations against an invincible enemy. Fight for the right to life of the last people in the universe, during 20 hours of storyline. Author's Uroboros Universum. A game unlike any other.

name: The Lab Thing
summary: The lab thing is a first-person survival horror game. Explore a mysterious secret lab and play as the only human left alive. Gather all the scientist's notes about the monster, upgrade backpack items, record information and try to escape before you join the body collection of the lab thing!

name: That Damn Goat
summary: A chaotic multiplayer party game where the world, and your character, is constantly changing. Battle to keep control of the crown all while That Damn Goat does everything in its (omnipotent) power to get in the way.

name: The Big Lez Video Game
summary: Choose between battle royale, deathmatch, infected and free roam mode and play with your friends as some of the main Big Lez Show characters! Use each characters specific special ability to assist you during combat and create your preferred weapon loadout to play optimally. Beware of the Choomahs!

name: The Dark House
summary:
Spooky lights, strange noises have been heard by walkers passing by an old unused house. What is causing this usual activity?
Tom is determined to find out, along with a slightly reluctant Jen!
Join Tom and Jen as they go on an exciting adventure right on their doorstep.
What will happen on the adventure? You decide!

name: The Legend of Robin Hood
summary: This game was in the final stages before release. At this vital time Kevin Costner's movie, Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves was released. But Arcadia didn't have the funds to obtain licensing from both Nintendo and the movie, so they were forced to pull out. The game itself is an action RPG and it shows the life of all the Merry-Men.

name: The Antaresian Spacepond
summary: This is a map made for antares031's birthday, which was on the 19th.

name: They Hunger: Episode 1
summary:
The first part of a horror oriented total conversion mod for Half-Life made as a promotional game for PC Gamer.
After a nasty car crash, you search for help only to find that monsters have taken over the area. you have to run and fight through graveyards, sewers, a swamp and even a volcano all in an effort to make it to the radio station in order to call for help.

name: They Hunger 2: Rest in Pieces
summary: The second part of a horror oriented total conversion mod for Half-Life made as a promotional game for PC Gamer.

name: They Hunger 3: Rude Awakening
summary: The third and final part of a horror oriented total conversion mod for Half-Life made as a promotional game for PC Gamer.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki FC Evolution - Chara-Ani Limited Box
summary:
The CharaAni Limited Box includes:
• The game
• Everyone Assemble! Falcom Academy FC DVD
• Trails in the Sky FC genuine leather accessory case

• Sora no Kiseki First Chapter Evolution Archives (Joshua version)

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki FC Evolution - Limited Edition
summary:
The Limited Edition includes:

• Sora no Kiseki First Chapter Evolution Archives (Joshua version)

name: The Invasion 2
summary:
The Invasion 2 is a Super Mario Brothers X Episode that was created by Redigit.

Unlike the original Invasion, it has only 7 bonus levels as opposed to 12 and adds the "Star Palace", an area with many bonus items for the player to collect if they have enough Stars. It also introduces names for worlds and map warps.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki SC Kai - HD Edition
summary: A remaster of the PSP version of the second installment in the series, serving as a direct sequel to the events of the previous installment, with enhanced graphics, cross-save with the PSP version and extras like PS3 themes, music, calendars and more. The game follows Estelle sets out to a new adventure, after completing some training by the Bracer Guild to prepare for that adventure.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki SC Evolution - Limited Edition
summary:
The Limited Edition includes:
• The game
• Falcom Academy SC DVD
• Sora no Kiseki Second Chapter Evolution Archives

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki SC Evolution - Chara-Ani Limited Box
summary:
The CharaAni Limited Box includes:
• The game
• Falcom Academy SC DVD
• Trails in the Sky FC genuine leather accessory case
• Sora no Kiseki Second Chapter Evolution Archives
• 5 rubber character straps for Estelle, Joshua, Olivier, Kloe, and Renne

name: The Leviathan's Fantasy
summary: This is a Simulation game. You will manage your cloud city, recruit adventurers all over the world, take them for exploration, obtain resources and blueprints. Construct buildings, make equipment, produce items, so to develop your city into greatness together with your adventurers.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Sora no Kiseki the 3rd Kai - HD Edition
summary: A remaster of the PSP version of the third installment in the series, serving as a direct sequel to the events of the previous installment and the ending to the Liberl arc, with enhanced graphics, cross-save with the PSP version and extras like PS3 themes, music, calendars and more. The game follows Kevin Graham and Ries Argent in their quest to retrieve an ancient artifact for the Septian Church.

name: The Dead Zone
summary: The soldiers who survived the disaster. In a world that has turned into apocalypse, explore those challenging death zones, and in order to defend the continuation of human civilization, kill all those ugly monsters! Lead the survivors to survive in this disaster.

name: Th3-M15 Guild
summary: Deadly missions for a deadly group! TH3-M15 Guild is a bullet hell survival game with rogue-lite elements. Undertake assignments, fighting off against armies of robots and creatures alike. Use an arsenal of unique skills, weapons, and items! Do you have what it takes to finish the job, mercenary?

name: The Firm
summary: A Tactical Turn Based VR Gunfest. Translating classical turn-based mechanics into VR. 48 physics-based weapons to choose from. 16 levels and lots of foes with their own abilities and armament. Many destructible objects.

name: The Joy of Kaizo with Bob Ross
The Magic Roundabout
summary: The Magic Roundabout is the direct videogame adaptation from the popular TV show for kids, recently remade in CGI. It's Friendship Day, a celebration invented by the waggish Zebedee. At this occasion, he promises Dougal a wonderful gift if he succeeds in helping all the other people in the village. So does begin Doogal's adventure.

name: The World of Golden Eggs: Nori Nori Rhythm-kei - Nissan Note Original Version
summary: A version of The World of Golden Eggs: Nori Nori Rhythm-kei made to advertise the Nissan Note vehicle.

name: The Studio 100: Play Island
summary: The Studio 100: Play Island (or Het Studio 100 Speeleiland) is a collection of games based around popular characters such as Studio 100's K3, Kells, Maja the bee and Amika. The game can be played by everyone together in the same style as the immensely popular WiiSports. Whether played by children, children with one parent, or with your grandmother, everyone has fun. In short, a true party game!

name: The Saddle Club
summary: After the books and the TV series, here's the videogame! This adventure game will allow the players to meet all the characters who made the success of the series, but also gives them the opportunity to realize their greatest dream of becoming a member of The Saddle Club!

name: The Sweetest Ring
summary: The Sweetest Ring is a short linear NTR visual novel about meeting and dating a ghost woman until she discovers there is better dick to be found by crawling back into the very TV she came from and joining the professional porn stars inside!

name: The Puzzle of Blocks
summary: Infinite challenges, millions of innings with different levels of difficulty.

name: The Forgotten Village of Gondomayit
summary: Kinan, a Yogyakarta native, became a civil servant and was posted to Gondomayit Village in remote Central Java. Here, electricity is scarce, and locals depend on traditional lighting. Evenings are quiet due to the lack of illumination.

name: The Paper Aircraft of Childhood
summary: How far can a childhood paper airplane fly.?

name: Thunder Jumper
summary: Rocket, hook, and pound your way all across the land to destroy Motorhead's evil expansion of factories! Speedrunners beware: There is no max velocity. Can you handle the power of lightning speed?

name: The Bullet Hopper
summary: A rabbit find itself dead, help it gains its life back in this time limited platformer where knowledge and skills are required. To aid you in this quest, an arsenal of guns is at your disposal, employing their bullets to propel you forward and upward.

name: The Collar
summary: What would it be like to be taken from your normal life and be pitted against random strangers. Would you fight and kill to survive?

name: The Cosmic Tramp
summary: Embark on a cosmic journey as Moby, a curious wanderer. Traverse surreal realms, meet eccentric characters, and uncover the universe's enigmatic wonders. Each encounter offers unique stories and perspectives, expanding your understanding of existence.

name: The Anime Super Remix: Kyojin no Hoshi
summary: Based on Star of the Giants (Kyojin no Hoshi), coming out alongside Ashita no Joe 2: The Anime Super Remix.

name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past - Hylian Legacy
The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of the Past
The Legend of Zelda: PuzzleDude's Quest
The Legend of Legacy: HD Remastered
summary:
RPG fans rejoice as the classic adventure, The Legend of Legacy is remastered in HD!

The unique stories of 7 heroes spring to life as you explore the mystical land of Avalon and face unknown dangers along the way. Classic RPG gameplay has never felt more engaging with features such as battle formations, combat roles, and forging contracts to channel the power of elementals. An adventure unlike any other awaits you!

name: ThinkSmart: Family!
summary: A Puzzle Game for the whole family -Now the whole family can power up their minds and bodies And everyone can go head to head at your own level! -Over 8,000 exercises for well toned minds and bodies -Players establish their own “THINK” quotient and track their progress receiving expert evaluations throughout -Players can customize their own Avatars and enter the "Think Institute” to create their personalized daily plan -7 different categories: language comprehension, math, memory, logical and three-dimensional reasoning, readiness of mind and physical fitness -Includes puzzle games like Sudoku, Towers of Hanoi, Signal Boxes, Sort the Luggage and Mirror Image, absolutely free!" -Fun for up to 16 players in single and multi-player modes, Tournament, Competition and Endurance

name: The Voice: La Plus Belle Voix
summary: A video game adaptation of the French version of The Voice.

name: The Swan Princess: Hidden Tales
summary:
Your favorite princess is back with a new hidden objects game!
Help Odette, Derek, Alise, Uberta and Bromley in this new and exciting adventure! Win stars and find incredible secrets on this game!
Play your own story! Even if you don't beat a task, a brand new storyline can be opened only for you!

name: Thief: The Trail of the Arch-Heretic
summary: A moody, ambient WAD intended to put some of the feeling of "Thief: the Dark Project" into Heretic. It's a reworking of my own njthief WAD for Doom2.

name: The Sewers of D'Sparil
summary:
"Even underwater cities like D'Sparil's Dome need sewers"

A collection of speed maps made in 100 minutes.

name: The Crypts
summary: This large map is a remake of E1M7 (The Crypts).

name: The History of Fruit
summary:
This is a 9 level Heretic wad designed for single/cooperative play.
In an epic turn of events, the Overlords of Fruit have rallied their unequaled forces of ferocity and badness and meanness and have struck back. It's up to the heretics to fight them back to the last bastion in The History of Fruit!

name: The Fiery Crater
summary: After you entered the core of the volcano in Fiery Descent, you found yourself in the middle of a smoldering crater on the other side. This map picks up where that one left off, as you journey deeper into it, discovering an ancient fortress built into the side of the lava mountain.

name: The Fiery Descent
summary: A short map, set inside a great volcano.

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Mana Pack Vol. 2
summary: A pack of additional music tracks to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Bravely Default Pack
summary: A pack of additional music tracks to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

name: The 20 Heretics Challenge
summary: 20 monster challenge from Doom but Heretic. Only 20 monsters per map. Period. Max 1 boss monster of any type

name: The Komainu Quest
summary: Promotional game for the town of Seto.

name: The Forgotten Portals
summary: You're making your way through an icy region and are nearly crushed when some ice caverns collapse. Eventually you make your way out only to find yourself trapped in a long deserted temple complex. The gates are enchanted and cannot be opened. You decipher an inscription that tells you that you must pass through three portals to remove the barriers that will allow you to leave.

name: The Subterranean River
summary: A river running through an underground city. Fight your way through the docks, the throne room, the flooded temple, a cathedral, the crypts and much more in this massive level.

name: The Master's Domain
summary: A full replacement, (9) levels for Episode 1.

name: The Indespensible T_DUNNxx.WAD Series : For Heretic
summary: The Indespensible T_DUNNxx.WAD Series - For Heretic is a single-level PWAD for Heretic designed by Travers Dunne and Alister Dunne and released in 1997.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Dungeon Rush
The Legend of Zelda: Petrie's Challenge
The Legend of Zelda: Ruinous Shards
The Legend of Zelda: Sacred Armor - Project Izou
The Legend of Zelda: Zelda's Eternal Youth
The Spy Who Loved Me 64
summary:
The Spy Who Loved Me 64 is a full campaign mod for GoldenEye that aims to recreate the original film from 1977.

Currently available as a demo that features the first 3 levels of the game, and a glimpse of the multiplayer in level 4. Level 1 will take the player to the opening scene of the movie in the Alps. Level 2 will take place in a search for answers in Egypt, and Level 3 will pit the player up against a major assassin.

The project was made with a console first mentality, and has been thoroughly tested to run on N64 hardware. An Expansion Pak is required, however.

name: The Village of Archensheen
summary: A bite sized Heretic level with the restrictions of no more than 100 enemies, 100 sectors, and 1000 linedefs.

name: The Remote Outpost
summary: Sarge Baldy's first released Heretic map, to be used as E2M1 of the FreeHeretic project. The overall theme is therefore vaguely similar to the original.

name: The River Of Fire
summary: Find the way back to the surface.

name: The Lost Clown
summary:
The Lost Clown is a DOS shareware platformer that was released in 1993. Although additional levels were planned the game remains shareware.

The controls are simple and the movement and jumping is tile-based.

name: The Mysteries of Underville
summary: The level is direct continuation of the Heretic: Shadow of the Serpent Riders, with Corvus stepping through a portal after defeating all Maulotaurs in the fifth episode.

name: The Seven Chambers
summary: This is an _incredibly_ immense level, with seven main areas. It has a good range of difficulties, and much time was spent on the design.

name: The Little Match Girl 3: The Escalus Manifold
summary: "The Snow Queen controls her servants with Shards from the Mirror of Belial," Ebenezer Scrooge explained.

name: The Heist
summary: The Heist is a free racing game. You're a professional getaway driver who does freelance work for the mob, bank robbers, and anyone else looking to pull off a quick job. Don't think too much about the morals, ethics, or legalities of this kind of work. All that matters is that if you pull it off you'll get paid in fat stacks of cash. Cash you can use to upgrade your engine, your wheels, your steering, and even your look.

name: The Gayest & Greyest Castle In All Of Parthoris
summary: A medium-sized Heretic map (127 monsters on smite-meister difficulty) with extra textures/props and a few monsters imported from Hexen (the Centaur, Stalker, & Wendigo).

name: The Fighting Wolf AT
summary: Belt scrolling beat em up for MSX.

name: The Lychgate
summary: This is an awesome "1-level-hub" which is tough, beautiful, and complete. The architecture is nice, the enemies are numerous, and it'll give you a good challenge, especially on the top skill level.

name: The Smile Friends
summary: You are an employee of a school that closed three years ago. Now, you have been anonymously invited to explore the premises, but apparently, you are not alone from the school...

name: The Monk
summary: The Monk is an epic adventure in the cyberpunk world. Blood, implants, brutality and fights. That all you can try by yourself

name: The Lost Magic
summary: This mapset was produced during NaNoWADMo and contains 32 Boom (CL9) maps with heavy DeHackEd shenanigans. The difficulty is a lot more on the softer side with a decent ramp up, so if you've just beat Doom 2 on UV, you can give this a crack!

name: The Lost Cemetery
summary: Map for vanilla style play.

name: The Museum of Mid 2000s Forum Signatures
summary: Inside this humble museum dedicated to media left behind, you will find 15 pieces on display. The museum should take between 5 and 10 minutes to browse!

name: The Lost Tomb
summary: Explore different locations, collect useful items and solve intriguing puzzles in this escape adventure.

name: The Red Line
summary: 9 maps for Doom 2 with a mixed theming. In each map you get one additional weapon.

name: The Elder Scrolls: Castles
summary:
From Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning developer behind The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout Shelter, comes The Elder Scrolls: Castles—a new mobile game that puts you in control of your very own castle and dynasty. Oversee your subjects as the years come and go, families grow, and new rulers take the throne.

Build Your Dynasty – Tell your story for generations—each day in real life covers the span of an entire year in The Elder Scrolls: Castles. Train your subjects, name heirs, and maintain order to help your kingdom flourish. Will you keep your subjects happy and ensure a long life for their ruler? Or will they grow discontent and plot assassination?

Manage Your Castle – Customize your castle from the ground up, adding and expanding rooms, placing lavish decorations and inspirational monuments, and even assign subjects to workstations to ensure your castle has the resources to thrive for years to come!

Rule Your Kingdom – Make key decisions that impact your legacy. Will you risk a limited supply of food to aid a neighboring kingdom? How should a heated spat between your subjects be settled? Your choices determine if your rule will inspire prosperity or lead your castle to peril.

Complete Epic Quests – Create heroes, equip them with epic gear, and send them to battle against classic Elder Scrolls foes to collect valuable items and keep your kingdom growing.

name: The Highway Racing
summary: Top down racing game for GBC

name: The Sims 4: Home Chef Hustle Stuff Pack
summary: Grow your culinary skills with new small appliances and turn cooking into cash with The Sims 4 Home Chef Hustle Stuff Pack.

name: The Goblinseekers
summary: The Goblinseekers is a Cozy Graphic Adventure, with RPG elements and a careful narrative. Live immersive self-contained adventures, solve puzzles, make potions, collect items, unveild mysteries and meet unique characters, which will take you through different endings.

name: The Finnish War x Sotidrokhima: Finlandsaga
summary: The heroes of Finland's past must come together to save the land from oblivion in the hands of the sorcerer, Louhi. The game is a non-canonical sequel to The Finnish War and Sotidrokhima, combining hack-n-slash and real-time strategy gameplay from the two titles.

name: The Dark Cowboy
summary: Embark on a harrowing first-person horror adventure through untamed pine forests and deep caves. Track the Blackwood gang to avenge your family, but beware: outlaws aren't the only threat. Cling to the light, survive otherworldly nightmares, and keep your lantern burning.

name: The Chad
summary: The evil Simp Co is turning everyone at Muscle Beach into Simps! Can you fight your way through all the simps and thots to find the source of the simp pandemic? We need your help Chad!

name: The Hidden Art of Innkeeping
summary: Transform an old farmhouse in a seaside village into a luxurious inn! Meet interesting guests, discover new areas and hidden treasures, configure rooms and amenities, complete mini-quests, uncover secrets, and rejuvenate the struggling village in this simulation-adventure game!

name: The Mothering
summary: Step into the ethereal realm of The Mothering, a hauntingly unique game where you must care for forgotten souls in the afterlife. Can you assist the aging Mother and ensure the spirits' needs are met before it's too late?

name: ThisIsTheGame
summary: Return to an old game project that you once abandoned, only the game hasn’t stopped changing since you left it. The game has begun to evolve, NPCs have slowly started to abandon their intended rolls, new bugs have emerged, and the morality of this world is becoming questionable.

name: Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals
summary: Three Kingdoms: Battle of Generals is a multi-player online real-time strategy game based on the Three Kingdoms history which recreates realistic landscapes in the world map. Look out for flank attacks and road blocks from your enemies when you explore the open world and build your city.

name: The Fall of the Dungeon Guardians: Enhanced Edition
The Baseball 2003: Shuuki-gou
summary: An updated version of The Baseball 2003 released only for the PS2 in Japan. Includes an updated roster and gameplay fixes.

name: The Phenomenon
summary:
The Phenomenon is an episodic survival horror game with great re-playability. The main character is Barry Nellan, a paranormal researcher whose work is known worldwide. Many cases connected with unexplained activity were investigated. Most gave no real results, but the last one…

In the Episode 1, you will explore map of 3 square kilometers with over 500 spawns of objects, use devices for paranormal research, fight against creatures with smart and tricky AI, and find out a lot of other things that make each new game unique.

Compete with other players to take the first place in the global leaderboards.

name: The Dog: Happy Life
summary: The game features realistic dogs that can be dressed up in accessories and photographed and played with in various ways. It was developed by Yuke's. The Dog: Happy Life is similar and is known to be compared to Nintendogs for the Nintendo DS. The game includes a feature that allows the player to take pictures of the virtual dog and share it on other devices like cell phones by transferring it to a PC. The game came out in April 2006 in Japan only. The format of this game is intended for a single player. The game type is considered to be a simulation, and is exclusive to the PSP console.

name: The Dog: Happy Life McDonald's Ver.
summary: A version of The Dog: Happy Life that features exclusive McDonald's branded items and clothing. It was given out to customers at McDonald's.

name: The Joy of Mapping 3: Mandatory Joy
summary: The Joy of Mapping 3: Mandatory Joy is a communal mapping session which took place on January 28th, 2017. It is the third of such sessions held under the guidance of James Paddock (Jimmy) and a few assistants, where mappers were talked through the basics of mapping, such as creating connected areas, interesting layouts, and using thing placement sensibly.

name: The Joy of Mapping 4: Summer School
summary: The Joy of Mapping 4: Summer School is a communal mapping session which took place between the 1st and the 10th of July, 2017. It is the fourth of such mapping sessions held by James Paddock (Jimmy), and while it respects most of the same rules, it marks a number of differences for the series going forward, such as maps being split under multiple episodes, and the presence of a central hub map from which other levels can be selected.

name: The Joy of Mapping 5: Winter Weekend
summary: The Joy of Mapping 5: Winter Weekend is a communal mapping session which took place between the 1st and the 4th of December, 2017. It is the fifth Joy of Mapping session held by James Paddock (Jimmy), and continues its predecessor's usage of a central hub map and maps being split into multiple episodes.

name: The Joy of Mapping 6: Joy Eternal
summary: The Joy of Mapping 6: Joy Eternal is a communal mapping session which took place between the 17th and 20th of December 2018. It is the sixth Joy of Mapping session held by James Paddock (Jimmy), and to date, also the last. It is also the largest project coming from the series, with a total of 72 maps.

name: The Smoking Dog
summary: set of 5 levels for doom2

name: The Bikini Bottom Massacre
summary: When Squidward is let go of his job at the Krusty Krab, his dissatisfaction with life is at its zenith. After years of torment from his buffoon neighbours, Spongebob and Patrick, Squidward decides to take his life into his own hands. A Spongebob-themed Doom II total conversion parody mod for use with GzDoom.

name: The Delirium Dimension
summary: The Delirium Dimension is a 13-map experience draped in minimalist classical horror atmosphere complete with an excellent soundtrack assorted from vintage horror bangers.

name: The Legends of Oz: One Hundred Years of Oz
summary: Join the lovable characters in the magic Land of Oz for their new adventures on CD-ROM! Young and old alike will remember Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion as their adventures unfold in The Legends of OZ️. Enjoy the complete story of L. Frank Baum's classic, The Wonderful Wizard of Oz, with faithful recreations of W.W. Denslow's original illustrations linked to interactive stories of all the characters you've come to know and love. This full-featured PC/Mac version also includes three entirely new adventures with the SillyOZbul️ of Oz by Roger S. Baum, great-grandson of L. Frank Baum. With interactive animation, narration, a challenging game, and video from the classic movie "The Wizard of Oz"️, The Legends of Oz will delight the child in everyone.

name: This Is a Good Hack to Play If You Just Started Playing Kaizo... World
The Legend of Zelda: Journey of a Day
The End is Never the End
summary: "The end is never the end" is a visual novel made by Purechito.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Shadow
The Floor is Wet
summary: Extremely short horror game where you are a worker of the very popular cleaning company, were sent to clean a place where some kind of incident happend. Just do your job and don't worry! Nobody will try to kill you.

name: The Hauntings: Dark Passenger
summary: Dive into Alex Mercer's twisted reality. Navigate eerie landscapes, solve cryptic puzzles, and uncover the 'Dark Passenger' mystery. Will shadows consume you or will truth emerge?

name: The Path to Memento Mori
summary: In 'The Path to Memento Mori,' players explore eerie mazes in a 4-player horror puzzle game, uncovering buried family secrets and facing relentless monsters. Teamwork and puzzle-solving are essential to unveil the haunting truth.

name: The Mouse Game
summary: Run from robot vacuums, dodge electric wires and mouse traps, and avoid flames and lasers to secure the cheese! Can you beat all 35 levels of this hardcore maze game?

name: The Amnesiac: Final Chapter
summary: "The Amnesiac:Final Chapter" is a story-based text game set in a low-magic world. In a crumbling baron's castle, a banquet takes an unexpected turn with the baron's death and everyone's amnesia. Players choose from 10 amnesiacs to uncover their individual stories.

name: The Soul of Too Birds Game
summary: Destroy all art. Free the soul.

name: The Wicked Souls
summary: The Wicked Souls is a Metroidvania with a strong focus on an exciting and imaginative story. Explore the mysterious tower in the afterlife with the postman Bones and his mischievous companion Dietrich and uncover its secrets.

name: The Legend of Ogorets 3: Kikimora
summary: An interactive visual novel with choices, lore, and endgames. Reader beware.

name: The Consumist Journey
summary: The Consumist Journey is a surreal exploration game where you play as a strange character on a quest to explore the capitalist and consumerist paradigms of modern society. Navigate through bizarre and nonsensical environments, solve puzzles, and interact with eccentric characters.

name: The Leak
summary: Wake up, watch tv, make a cup of cofffee and try to bear your own meaningless existence.

name: The Whistle
summary: Dave Wilson, a 20 year old adult who loves to go camping. Little did he know what would happen once he explored the forest of Harmony Hus Lake.

name: The Adventures of Sir Kicksalot
summary: A first-person action game that provides various ways for defeating your foes, whether through weaponry, magic, stealth, or clever tactics like kicking into deadly spikes.

name: The American Delta Vengeance Action Blood Force Kill Commando
summary: Join and play this C64-funsplatter-pixel-massacre! Made for the fans of Wolfenstein, Doom, Duke Nukem, Shadow Warrior and Redneck Rampage!

name: The Bunny Graveyard: Chapter 1 - The Bunny Garden
summary: The Bunny Garden is the first of 5 chapters planned for the horror adventure game, The Bunny Graveyard.

name: The Legend of Legacy HD Remastered: Deluxe Edition
summary: Embark on an epic journey with "The Legend of Legacy HD Remastered Deluxe Edition," the ultimate package that combines the base game, an essential Recovery Items Set, and an exquisite Art Book. Ideal for both enthusiasts and newcomers, this edition promises a richer, more immersive experience, curating every element to enhance your journey through Avalon. Embrace the full legacy in one deluxe bundle.

name: The Bunny Graveyard: Chapter 2 - Terror in Carrot Town
summary:
Terror in Carrot Town is the working title for Chapter 2 of the horror adventure game, The Bunny Graveyard.

Chapter 2 has started development and will follow Skye the Bunny with a different moveset and more gameplay options then the previous chapter. Plans are for the story to get darker but still have wacky moments and fun minigames throughout a more connected world map with a less linear path through the story.

name: Thea Realm Fighters
summary: A cancelled fighting game for the Atari Jaguar. It was developed by High Voltage Software, but never released officially.

name: The Lamplighters League: Nocturne
summary: Fight darkness with darkness by adding the mysterious Nocturne to your league, a macabre spectrophysicist marooned in an alternate dimension, who returned forever altered. Nocturne manipulates her body’s electric field to inflict Shock Damage on her enemies while also supercharging her cutting-edge suit to enhance her abilities. Count yourself lucky that this mysterious skirmisher is on your side - now you see her, now you’re dead!

name: Thrall
summary: To be enthralled by love is murder on the soul in this paranormal, point-and-click, otome visual novel.

name: This Magical Girl is a B*tch
summary:
Join Tabitha Bones in act 1 of a lighthearted romp through the world's most dysfunctional school!

It's Halloween Spirit Week, and even grumpy Tabbie is ready for some fun. But when her nemesis, Eden (the worst kind of 8th grade boy), steals her thunder, everything goes horribly wrong.

Luckily for her, a magical pixie gives her the power to grab fate and whack the sh*t out of anyone in her way!

name: The Super Mario Bros. Movie 64 DS
The Search Master: Metal Gear Solid Edition
The Final Prize is Soup
summary:
Survival-horror yuri visual novel.

After a disastrous break up, Qian Hailu wakes up to find that she's dead. Luckily (or unluckily), she's been given a chance to turn back the clock and avert her death—as long as she can pass three rounds in the game of life.

name: The Chase: Cop Pursuit
summary:
The Chase is finally here. A thrilling and action-packed game that will have your heart racing! Prepare to unleash your inner speed monster as you take on the role of a driver who is being chased by the cops.

It's a challenging game in which you'll be immersed in a world of powered car races and exciting driving. Take control of a variety of customized cars and abilities, each with its own unique characteristics, and overcome your pursuers with your expert driving abilities. Explore smoothly created maps inspired by Eastern culture to give your escape ways a unique touch.

As you race through the maps you will come across power-ups that can give you a significant advantage in your daring escape. Keep an eye out for NOS to boost your car's speed and leave your pursuers in the dust. Additionally, strategically deploying mines can slow down police cars in order to earn victory.

Prepare to be on the edge of your seat with a captivating storyline that immerses you in danger, Can you escape the police? Prove your strength as an escape artist. Unlock additional characters to enrich your gameplay.

name: The Hamster's Journey
summary: The Hamster's Journey is a roguelite platformer in which you guide Hammy Jo through the exciting cage escape of his dreams. Don hats and pants to imbue Hammy Jo with unique types of movement, and combine these powers in clever ways to overcome the obstacles strewn in your way.

name: The Masquerade
summary: The Masquerade is a murder party game from 2 to 8 players. Impersonate NPCs to hide from your stalker, while gathering enough clues to unmask your target.

name: The Last Bot
summary: Play as a lone robot exploring a post-human world where nature has overtaken cities of towering skyscrapers. Unearth the forgotten legacy of your creators by reviving your sole companions - long dormant, malfunctioning robots - each holding a key to both the past and humanity's fate.

name: The Duel
summary: A two-part head-to-head fighting game.

name: The Legend of Steel Empire
summary: In a dystopian world where the Motorhead Empire has conquered and enslaved virtually the entire planet, mammoth battleships, armored locomotives, and invincible fortresses dominate the skies. However, there is hope for the republic of Silverhead, and you are the only one who can save it. Take control of the Striker airplane or Zeppelin with an aerial mine launcher and engage in intense euro-shmup action, battling enemies both in the air and on the ground, and using devastating screen-clearing attacks in tight spots. With improved graphics and controls, Steel Empire, originally released in the early 90s for a 16-bit console, has been ported to various handheld consoles. Join the fight and defeat the Motorhead Empire.

name: The Unknown Planet
summary: A mysterious and strange map on a weird alien planet.

name: The 3D Gamemaker
summary:
Unleash your imagination...

Now anyone can build their ideal game in seconds. With just one click of a mouse, you can create a uniquely playable game without needing any programming knowledge or artistic skills at all. Offering over 12 billion gaming options. The 3D Gamemaker opens up a whole concept in gaming, providing fun for all the family.

name: The Lost Moonbase
summary: In an EDF's secret base Duke didn't stop the aliens and they have stolen a very powerful bomb in that hi-tech airplane. Destination was unknown...

name: The Big City
summary: A very big city map

name: The Toxicity
summary: Aliens have taken over a city and have set up residence, and of course as Duke it's your job to flush the bastards out

name: The No-Name Project
summary: Welcome to 'The No-Name Project,' where limitless freedom awaits! Adopt various characters, from animals to NPCs, even resurrecting them with necromancy. Explore, mine, and interact with the world's secrets. Frequent updates ensure endless adventures!

name: The Ruins
summary: If you’re reading this I apologize. I will not reach an October release date, unfortunately my SSD containing all the game files for both the ruins and jumpah has failed. This is a very tough time for me I will try my best to get back on track. Thank you.

name: Throw Anything: Radiation Zombies
summary: Complete missions to save a world devastated by zombies, utilizing Arm Units and special abilities! Throw Anything: Radiation Zombies is a third-person shooter 3D-action roguelite game set in a world overrun by zombies, where you survive by throwing objects around. Equip a powerful Arm Unit, enhance yourself with a personalized skill tree, and explore a maze-like world!

name: The Witches Story
summary: The Witches Story is a visual novel for adults only. Eric, an ordinary man who has always laughed at tales about witches, finds himself in the center of the witches' magical world. He gets to meet the witches, get to know them from a different side and in different poses.

name: The Skyland Chronicles
summary: You are a bloody pirate. Will you make the most of it in the new world and fulfill your destiny? This is your battle, where you'll come face to face with dark creatures from Slavic mythology. Take on the role of a legendary warrior and decide if the world is worth saving.

name: The Looming Madness
summary: Large egyptian map with a unique mix of textures. Features a few custom monsters such as the SOA goblin and the Snakeman.

name: The King's Wish
summary:
It has been a hundred days since your father, the king, passed away. You have spent a hundred days in your high tower with the knight who ended his life, and who has sworn to end yours as well.

It's time to make a choice.

name: The Shadow of the Evil Tower
summary: This is a platform action game with various traps and tons of levels for players to challenge!

name: The Fourth Sense Evolution: Stone Age
summary: Top View, 2D, Evolution, Survival, and Cult game. "Be a God, Evolve Followers, and Spread Your Faith: A Stone Age Sandbox Game"

name: The Dark Whispers
summary: The Dark Whispers is a chilling descent into madness, a haunting tale of one detective's relentless pursuit of the truth. Will you brave the darkness and uncover the horrifying secrets that lie hidden within, or will you become just another lost soul in its malevolent embrace?

name: The InVincible Iron Ivy: Enter the Pretty, Pretty Princess
summary: This game is a Soulslike Role-playing game that uses a progress system (“leveling system”) for measuring players’ rates of success. This version of the game is a single-player mode-only game.

name: The Cauldron Kids: The Summoning of Mr. Vermicelli
summary: The Cauldron Kids is a pixel art short narrative RPG about two kid witches on their way to magical mischief and plushie bewitching, combining quirky and sweet dialogues and minigames. Featuring the small and cozy chalet the characters live in, players discover soon that the Cauldron Kids’ home is full of magical and playful surprises.

name: The Carrier and Crows
summary: Crows have downed your plane and you are trapped at the far end of a remote peninsula in northern British Columbia. You must craft the necessary tools to contend with the local eccentrics and find your way back to civilization.

name: The Spiritworld
summary: Large episode with 7 main levels + 3 secret levels + custom start map + new end boss, all inspired by Quake 1 episode 4 (Elder World) in a classic-ish id1 style. Supports co-op.

name: The Final Threat
summary: Medium to large, interconnected, professionally built IKBase map. Features the Mega Enforcer from Zerstörer.

name: The Castle of Koohoo
summary: Small mappack in a swamp/tribal setting. Features a start, main level and boss map.

name: The Masque of Red Death
summary: Large Medieval mountain fortress with extreme scale and horde combat.

name: The Lorax: Truffula Shuffula
summary: The Lorax: Truffula Shuffula is a mobile game based on the 2012 movie adaptation of The Lorax.

name: The Colony 2044
summary: Balance survival with strategic combat in this unique simulation. Lead a bunny colony through a post-apocalyptic world infested with zombie bunnies. Manage resources, construct a thriving settlement, and navigate intricate social dynamics to uncover the cure held by one of your survivors.

name: The King of Fighters Bundle
summary: The King of Fighters Bundle comes with 6 games plus Upgrade pack 1 and 2 for The King of Fighters XIV: Galaxy Edition!

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Parque Fernando Cosmetic Pack
summary: Decorate your weapons, tents, and ground blinds with these unique cosmetics inspired by Parque Fernando.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Medved-Taiga Cosmetic Pack
summary: The contents of this pack are cosmetic only and applicable to all weapons, tents, and ground blinds in the game. They can be previewed in-game for free before purchasing.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Vurhonga Savanna Cosmetic Pack
summary: The contents of this pack are cosmetic only and applicable to all weapons, tents, and ground blinds in the game. They can be previewed in-game for free before purchasing.

name: The Slipgate Duplex
summary: Professionally constructed remake of E1M1 with some additional areas.

name: The Putrid Pumps
summary: Large metal/runic industrial slime temple.

name: The Widow's Shadow
summary:
Following her late husband’s funeral, a widow laments her loss. The townsfolk's whispers surround her every time she leaves the house, rumours she cannot avoid no matter how she tries.

Yet one night, everything she wishes to ignore will be laid bare as she steps into a twisted reality — one borne from her own heart.

name: The Dark Triad
summary: Short episode with custom start map + 3 small / medium sized levels of various themes, with custom weapons and monsters. Some textures from Doom, some custom music sampled from Nine Inch Nails.

name: This Onion
summary: Large medieval castle in an underground cave with DKTe3 textures, a couple of new monsters and (optional) background music.

name: The Stars We Lost To Grief
summary: A small wizard / runic themed map built within a 1024x1024x1024 volume.

name: The Great Cave Offensive
summary: The Great Cave Offensive is the fourth main game available in Kirby Super Star and its remake, Kirby Super Star Ultra. It features a large labyrinthine cavern system divided into four stages, with the goal being to escape the cave, while collecting Treasure along the way.

name: The Arena
summary: The Arena is a Sub-Game debuting in Kirby Super Star, where the requirement is to the defeat the Main Game bosses and mid-bosses encountered in the title it appears in, with a single life, with limited health benefits. It is similar to Boss Endurance modes, but is generally given more importance, and is always required for 100% completion of the game.

name: The Anomaly
summary: Medium-sized base map with a unique twist: 'anomalies' have warped several areas which now play tricks on the player's mind and perception.

name: The Anomaly 2: Water
summary: Large brick/metal complex where reality is twisted and many optical illusions occur. Nonlinear, explorational gameplay with puzzles and a great number of secret areas. The sequel to digs05.

name: The Parallel Worlds
summary: A huge and highly detailed base map with a unique twist - it is actually three levels in one, to be played in succession. Each exit leads to a different version of the same map with modified layouts/routes and monster placement.

name: The Occupied Base
summary: Professional remake of Quake's original deathmatch map DM3. Highly detailed and many expanded areas for single player, yet still maintaining the original layout in deathmatch mode. Map source is included.

name: The Secret Installation
summary: Fifth map of the IKSPQ series: a medium-sized IKbase map.

name: The Guardhouse
summary: Medium sized detailed Metal level with base and medieval monsters. Comes with a start map.

name: The Dark Portal
summary: A remake/remix of DM6 'The Dark Zone': Quake's stock deathmatch level turned into a large, industrial base-style singleplayer map. The map source is included.

name: The Grim Outpost
summary: Large Wizard-/Episode 2-themed fortress.

name: The Epoch Turning
summary: Large Wizard map with caverns and a Base bit.

name: Thetan Rivals
summary: Thetan Rivals: Fun Run Party is the ultimate party and fun-filled adventure, perfect for players of all ages. Join the charming Thenions in a vibrant 3D world, where thrilling races and hilarious knockout challenges await you and your friends. Express your unique style with a plethora of cute skins and cosmetics.

name: The Mountains of Insanity
summary: Large level with a secret military research base in the mountains built on top of a runic/metal dungeon. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a few modified models and a custom skybox. The map and QC sources are included.

name: The Battery
summary: Medium-sized military base with an artillery battery. Comes with a custom skybox. The map source is included.

name: The Rust Forge
summary: Medium / large runic base map with "void vibes", built on progs_dump 3.0 (already included). Some sounds from Arcane Dimensions, custom music "Yss Éskiuth" by Immorpher. Map source is included.

name: The Edge of Sanity
summary: Medium to large abstract metal/industrial-ish level floating in the void. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a couple of new models and sounds. The map and qc sources are included.

name: The Darkstone Halls
summary: Large metal/runic fortress. Comes with a custom skybox. The map source is included.

name: The Underkeep
summary: Large white brick/medieval fortress. Comes with a custom skybox. The map source is included.

name: The Isolation
summary: Large fortress with four differently-colored/textured areas around a Minecraft-styled courtyard.

name: The Pro Yakyuu: Pennant race
summary: The Pro Yakyuu: Pennant Race (ザ・プロ野球 ペナントレース) is a Sega Master System baseball game developed by Whiteboard and published by Sega. Exclusively released in Japan in 1987, the game is an evolution of the developer's earlier title Great Baseball, and is now played from a bird's-eye perspective.

name: The Unlife of Gorlak
summary: The Unlife of Gorlak is an RPG Where you play as a dragon who died but got better (or is at least trying to). You have been resurrected as a skeletal dragon by a necromancer. As you returned to the living world you felt the presence of the hero who had slain you has given chase. You have one month to prepare for his arrival so you can tell him how you really feel about him!

name: The Silent Swan: Rising in the Mist Edition
The C.G.L Project
summary: Short arena-style map themed and timed to a techno music track.

name: The Dreamer's Demesne
summary: Medium-sized blue desert castle, made for Arcane Dimensions v1.81+

name: The Tenacious Tentacle
summary: Small level created in the spirit of the 100b competitions (using not more than 100 world brushes). The map source is included.

name: The Terracotta Terror
summary: Small terracotta-colored Coagula-style space map.

name: The Ivory Tower
summary: Medium-sized medieval towers in a mine canyon with many secret areas that allow for somewhat nonlinear gameplay, a built-in skill selection area, and custom medieval-themed items. The map source is included in the pak.

name: The Cobalt Palace
summary: Small blue Metal map with easy gameplay but a very unique style.

name: The Circulation of Shadows
summary: Large underground industrial base with rocket silos and conveyor belts; and a small start map. It was originally started in 2005 for a Nehahra addon episode. It uses Daikatana textures and runs on the Rubicon 2 mod (included), featuring new and modified enemies and effects. Also comes with a music track and a custom skybox.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Reserve Cosmetics Bundle 1
summary: Decorate your weapons, tents, and ground blinds with these unique cosmetics inspired by Medved-Taiga National Park, Vurhonga Savanna Reserve, and Parque Fernando. All in one bundle!

name: The Living End & Elder World Waystation
summary: Two-map SP unit: a large medieval dungeon in an underground lava cave (using rtGnosis textures), and a medium sized IKbase-themed stargate facility. It comes with a couple of new sounds and a custom skybox.

name: The Elder Reality
summary: Medium-sized Elder World-style map that features at least one room from each level in the fourth episode of Quake (except for E4M1). An expanded version of the author's Retro Jam 4 entry.

name: The Lair of DOOMestic Animals
summary: Small Metal/runic level. A polished and extended version of PuLSaR's SM57 map.

name: The Rats in the Walls
summary: Small oldschool brick level with a few DOOM textures.

name: The Lima Project
summary: Medium-sized industrial facility using cr8 and Doom 3 textures. It comes with a custom skybox and a music track.

name: The Vigil
summary: Small Medieval map with focus on arena combat.

name: The Coagula Contest
summary: This contest was run mid-September to mid-November of 2001, with the goal of creating maps in the tradition of Tim Elek's 'Coagula' series of maps - a series of structures floating in the void. There were 5 entries: Tronyn(2), Fat Controller, Dilvish, and Necros. In addition, a start map created by Tronyn is included, as well as the original Coagula series by Tim Elek.

name: The Hand That Feeds You
summary: Large, interconnected base in the mountains with a lava cave beneath. It comes with a custom skybox.

name: Three Towers And A Sick Base
summary: Large open base map set inside a lava canyon.

name: The Coagula Contest 2
summary:
Results of the second Coagula contest
1st: tyrcoag: Outside In - Tyrann
2nd: pushcoag: The Vertical Mile - Pushplay
3rd: nesp10: Embers of Cruelty - necros
4th: jesus: Jesus Wants You - [anon]
4th: discoag2: Usher Recompiled - distrans
6th: chain3: Indigo - Chainer

name: The Lizard's Trance
summary: A remix of id's e2m5 in Q3 gothic textures and bigger scale. Beautiful architecture and solid gameplay.

name: Thirteen Tombs of the Brilliant Dynasty
summary: Large medieval dark fantasy castle in frozen lands with haunted crypt. A late entry for Twisted Christmas Jam 2022. Built for Arcane Dimensions v1.81+

name: The Warden
summary: Large underground castle / medieval sewer map in the style of Honey. Requires Arcane Dimensions v1.81+ Custom music is "Only Child" by Julia Kent

name: The Faults Within
summary: Remake/remix of stock Quake map E3M2 - The Vaults of Zin. The map source is included.

name: The Semen Donation Truck!
summary: Two succubus invite you to donate your semen using the condoms they provide. If you beat their record in the Whack-O-Mole minigame, they also gladly provide physical help in your endeavor at donating.

name: The Rubro Rose's Castle
summary: For centuries, an ancient family has ruled the lands of the morbid and decadent province of Rubro Rose, but with the sudden illness of the lord of Vorkrom Castle, everything falls upon the young princess of pale skin...

name: This Game Is Easy
summary: This Game Is Easy is a game that challenges you. It will test and confuse you. Are you up to the challenge of this super-easy game?

name: The will of space
summary: You can freely assemble a spaceship and shoot with a double joystick at the top view angle in the survival Roguelike game! Explore science fiction space and build your strongest battleship!

name: The Unknown Fear
