summary: The Unknown Fear is about a prisoner, sentenced to death, that had his memory deleted. His only chance of changing his life is by retrieving a file on the main computer of a secret settlement. Will you be able to get a new life or will the imprisoned creature in the settlement devour your body?

name: The Refinery
summary: Base level.

name: The Grand Guignol
summary: Originally designed for speedrunning this map is fun for everyone. Dressed in Sock's egyptian textures.

name: The Shark's Bathhouse
summary:
A megaman-like platformer for the strawberry jam 5.
A Fox is on a mission to defeat the big bad shark daddy at his steamy bathhouse.
He'll need to jump, cum and hump his way to victory! And you're here to help him!
Or he can fail at the last minute and face the consequences

name: The Machinery
summary: Large dark industrial map using IKbase textures. Comes with a custom music track by the author. The map source is included.

name: The End of Solace
summary: Large moldy blood dungeon "in the style of E1M3". The map source is included.

name: The Gateway to Hell
summary: Small to medium-sized medieval / hell map, the sequel to Castle of the Dark Ages. Uses DKT and Doom3 textures, and comes with a few additional ambient sounds as well as a hell skybox.

name: The Contract
summary: Medium-sized Knave-style flying cathedral with a courtyard and a crypt area. It comes with a start map and a custom skybox.

name: The Forgotten Level
summary: Medium sized Wizard map

name: The Fierce Livid
summary: Large Metal windtunnel map

name: The NetherWorld
summary: Medium sized Metal map.

name: The Rest is Silence
summary: Around medium Knave-style fortress. Requires the Lost Chapters pack.

name: The Lost Levels
summary: Classic singleplayer campaign made by Gotshun that was never finished or released: Two episodes with 16 levels of various themes including a start map and a secret map. The second episode lacks a conclusion/boss fight due to the unfinished nature of the pack, but it is perfectly playable.

name: The Corral
summary: A beautiful base map that shines with graphical perfection. Gameplay is ok (only grunts and enforcers plus a few rotfish) and very straight-forward (no keys).

name: The Underworld
summary: Small Base map with an outdoor area.

name: The Subconscious Fear
summary: Large 'techno-dungeon' with many corridors and ambushes.

name: The Citadel of Sinners
summary: Very large fortress/citadel with many corridors and ambushes. Comes with a small skill selection map.

name: The Katagean Redoubt
summary: A big, interconnected, green-wizardish map with well thought-out secrets.

name: The Hell That's Coming
summary: Medium-sized medieval map with fairly linear gameplay and some monster modifications.

name: The Grinding of Teeth
summary: Small Metal level.

name: The Black Fog
summary: Small cave tomb / temple map with Makkon textures, built for Arcane Dimensions v1.81+ (NOT included). Some textures and sounds from Thief: The Dark Project. Custom music by MrDetonia. Map source is included.

name: The Love: Date Simulator with Girls
summary: Discover the power of words to shape your destiny in a game that celebrates the beauty of human connection!

name: The Legend of Shadow: Mask of the Force
summary: Shadow action to collect the masks of power and take vengeance on the gods. Use the power of many masks of special skills to get stronger! Enjoy stylish shadow action!

name: The Westcoast Drive: Lowrider Simulator
summary: Experience 1960s American lowrider culture. Customize your ride, hit the streets, and dominate with iconic hydraulics

name: The Phantom
summary: The Ghost Who Walks is back! Comics' very first costumed hero is coming to Steam and console in an all new side scrolling beat-em-up adventure. Take on the Singh brotherhood across the globe with only your physical strength, skill with weapons and fearsome reputation!

name: The Tainted Land
summary: 'The Tainted Lands' is a classic 2D turn-based RPG about an epic adventure in world of dark and eldritch horrors. As the last of an ancient order of Guardians, you must gather allies, explore the wilderness where the secrets of the past dark ages lie dormant, and slay the unspeakable horrors.

name: The Clown's Forest 3: Haunting Apparitions
summary: On a cold snowy night on December 17th 2011... David discovered his son missing and vowed to look for him around Hartown Park. But his desperate search ends in misery.

name: The First Attempt
summary: Medium to large Metal level.

name: The Tomb of Chak Toh Ich`ak
summary: A big mayan city.

name: The Death Lair
summary: Medium-sized brick/metal dungeon.

name: The AMC Pleaser
summary: Duke's chilling in his apartment doing whatever Duke does while he's home alone, when an explosion outside interrupts his "me" time.

name: The Restless Resort
summary: A level with a lot of inspiration from Half-Life, The Restless Resort mixes military base themes with tropical climates.

name: The Brave New World
summary: The Brave New World takes place some ten years after the events of 11/09/01 in a reality which is not altogether too different from our own. Brave New World features five levels.

name: The Fall and Rise of Sadcock-upon-Avon
summary:
In the fiefdom of Sadcock-upon-Avon, strange things are happening. There are rumours of penises not looking or acting as they should...

Follow the witch Agnes Nutt as she magic-spells cursed phalluses back to health, saves or destroys marriages, shapeshifts, and more!

name: The PenguinGame 2: Lies of Penguin
summary: The heroic penguin pulled the legendary club from the rock. pass the ordeal! Revenge on humans! Save Antarctica in crisis! The Penguin Game2 : Lies of Penguin is an action game made with a deep impression of the soul-like genre. Challenge a total of 7 types of boss battles!

name: The Space Mission
summary: This two-map space episode is High Treason's first solo effort

name: The Wall
summary: An interactive rock opera, a conceptual map based on the movie Pink Floyd The Wall.

name: The Dream
summary: Game story take place in Duke's dream (while he fall asleep after some sensitive dose of booze, or maybe after saving the world one more time). In his dream his shuttle was rammed by enemies helicopter. Duke managed to jump safely on the ground and found himself on the streets of the unknown city....

name: The Temple of Blooooood
summary: Large blood temple. The map source is included.

name: The Journey Home
summary: Small egypt style outpost surrounded by snowy mountains.

name: The Super Penguboy
summary: Help little Super Penguboy overcome all the challenges in the Dark world!

name: The End of Nowhere
summary: A cold game set in a remote Alaskan town. Waking up in a freezing Alaskan town, you are forced to survive against creatures that you have never seen before. Balance your scarce resources against the threats that inhabit the town, and find a way to escape this frozen hell.

name: The Summit Library
summary: A Library that's falling apart, an Empire on the brink of war, and a dangerous magical mystery you've been tasked to solve. Set out to uncover the Summit Library's secrets and get drawn into the complexities of the Empire's politics; navigate love, truth, betrayal, and heartbreak.

name: The Last Commander
summary: You are the last remaining commander. Grow your sector well and protect Earth from invading alien spaceships for 50 days. Build the best building combination on the hexagonal terrain.

name: The Backrooms: Escape
summary: The Backrooms: Escape is a first-person walking simulator in which you need to survive and find a way to escape. Move freely, explore the secrets of the corporation, but remember - you are not alone.

name: The Desire of the Amazons
summary: Desires of the Amazons is a transformative erotic RPG game for adults. The main character is a knight, sent to fight the Amazons, but falls into an ambush and is slowly transformed into a woman by the sorceress Cassandra. During your transformation you will experience many sexual adventures.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Ambusher Pack
summary: The Ambusher Pack contains an electronic caller, a lever-action rifle, and a takedown recurve bow, ideal for skillfully ambushing prey in the wild.

name: The Man from the Window 2
summary:
"Time will pass, the seasons may change, we know that nothing can ever stay the same...
But still The Man continues to play his twisted game."

name: The Voluntary Chipping
summary: You have resieved an invitation from the "Greenhouse" corporation for free chipping. But you have a choice not to be enslaved! You have to fight back against cyber machines.

name: The Red Juggernaut
summary: "The Red juggernaut" is a retro-style JPRG crossed with a modular ship building & combat game. Level up your ship, build it bigger, battle enemy ships, explore the solar system, and save the human race!

name: The Night Watch
summary: The Night Watch is a retro-styled survival horror set in an abandoned shopping mall that shut down in the 1990s. Investigate overnight vandalism reports as a night watch security guard. Assemble a team in online co-op mode, or venture in and take on the job alone.

name: The Ump Show
summary: The Ump Show is a baseball umpire simulator where you balance making accurate calls and enforcing your will on the game. Make accurate calls but cheat to make sure your favorite team wins!

name: The Interval
summary:
Agent Wells, it's time to prepare for your most dangerous and critical mission yet.
At 0600, your colleague and mentor Agent Cross, powered up the Time Interval Device and made an unsanctioned jump into the distant past. Her motives are unclear, but given her combat skills and precognition, she could irreparably alter the course of human history, in direct violation of the Institute's pursuits.Your mission: to find and eliminate Agent Cross, wherever and whenever she may hide.To avoid exposing past humans to our advanced technology, you must deploy unarmed and scavenge equipment on-site.
We have every confidence in your success, upon which our continued existence depends. Good luck, Agent. Commencing time-jump in 3... 2... 1..."

The Interval was made in 2022 during the month of May for the first Reload Magazine Game Jam.

name: The Ghost X: Sniper Simulator
summary: In the Shadows We Thrive - GhostX Sniper Elite!

name: The Sims 4 Halloween Bundle
summary: Transform your Sims and their homes for Halloween with The Sims 4 Werewolves Game Pack, The Sims 4 Vampires Game Pack, and The Sims 4 Spooky Stuff Pack.

name: The Callisto Protocol: Riot Bundle
summary: Experience the Riot Bundle, featuring the all-new Riot Mode, new animations showcasing lethal kills, and an exciting new cosmetic collection.

name: They Are Coming
summary: They Are Coming is a hybrid game that combines roguelike, tower defense, and base building in a side-scrolling shooter format. It offers a straightforward gaming experience for pure enjoyment.

name: Threshold of Awakening
summary: In 1960s USA, Jane Ferguson, a New York restaurant owner, receives an information on her CIA agent husband Mark, who had vanished mysteriously during a Tibet mission. To uncover his hidden secrets, she follows his trail, delving into the enigma of his disappearance.

name: The Hotel: Floor 13
summary: You've just stepped out of an erratic elevator into the eerily silent reception of a hotel floor that shouldn't exist. The neon lights flicker, casting long, ominous shadows, and the décor screams 1980s – an atmosphere frozen in time, filled with an unsettling nostalgia.

name: The Show is Over It
summary: The Show is Over It is a challenging platform game with caricatured characters. Players must climb levels filled with quirky obstacles and surprises These unexpected events add excitement to the game.

name: The Good Overlord
summary: You're the guardian of the realm's most feared dungeon, now aiding heroes. 'The Good Overlord' is a Roguelike Bag-Builder with monsters, traps, and secrets. Defeat enemies, collect relics, and uncover the reason behind the Overlord's benevolence.

name: The Bourntyverse!
summary:
Welcome to the Bourntyverse!

Explore the Bourntyverse, play games, and experience the joy of Bournty!

name: The Binding of Isaac: Fall from Grace
summary:
Do you have what it takes to keep it cool in the Boiler?

Face off against brand new challenges in this alternate floor to the Downpour! Weave through seas of steam, and slay blistered freaks in this mod, which has been created by some of those who have worked on mods such as Fiend Folio and Revelations!

name: Thief in Cafe
summary: Open your dream restaurant. Create a unique exterior and interior, hire the best workers and chefs, create a place where people will love to eat, spend time and spend their money. Simulation of the restaurant business.

name: The Raindrop: A Vocal Odyssey
summary: Become Poseidon's voice and harness the elemental power of ice, water, and vapor in this enchanting 2D platformer, drawing inspiration from the rich tapestry of Greek mythology. Your voice becomes the key to unlocking intricate puzzles in a visually striking world.

name: The Return to Freddy's Classic
summary: The Return To Freddy's Classic (formerly known as Five Nights at Freddy's 3 Fan-Made and just Five Nights at Freddy's 3 before that) is the first game in the TRTF SAGA and the first game in Volume 1. The next game in the series is The Return To Freddy's 2, though The Return To Freddy's 3 would chronologically be the next game.

name: The Lords of Midnight
summary: Mike Singleton's '84 classic Adventure Strategy game, brought to and updated for modern platforms.

name: The Dungeon
summary: In the dungeon, a legendary endless treasure awaits. Countless brave adventurers have come, but none have unveiled its secrets. Monsters and traps fill the dungeon. Are you courageous enough to conquer them and claim the final treasure?

name: The Unknown
summary: A psychological horror, first person platformer. Solve puzzles and dodge deadly obstacles while being haunted by mikes inner demons.

name: The Knowledge of Hermit
summary: Non-Linear Top-down action-adventure-puzzle game with Power Ups & Health Upgrades.

name: The Witch and the Bottle of Concept
summary: The meat pigeon game of Demon City, with meta elements, allows you to experience the joy of breaking the fourth wall, a refreshing sense of strike, and difficult battles. Do you want to challenge the thrill of harmless clearance?

name: This Side Up
summary: Simultaneously control four players who fall in different directions in this mind-bending puzzle platformer. Together they stand, divided they fall!

name: The Dollmaker
summary: The Dollmaker is a first person horror game, where after being captured, you find yourself searching a mansion for a way to escape. But the Dollmaker and his creations will be searching for you, will you become a part of his collection?

name: The Bleeding Tower Of Pisa
summary: Another piece of human history has been desecrated by those ruthless Hell-spawned monsters. The Bleeding Tower Of Pisa is an affront to everyone on Earth and they've called you in to set things right. First, you must find a way into the tower. Then clean up the mess, floor by floor.When you've collected the keys, and "taken out the trash," head to the basement for the final showdown. Remember: in the Bleeding Tower Of Pisa, blood will flow. Try not to let it be yours!

name: The Villa of Pain
summary:
The "Villa of Pain" awaits. The monsters have infested this quaint country villa. The owners called Terminix and Orkin, but the Imps just ate the guys they sent out. Now they've called you in. You begin in the courtyard and must figure out a way into the building. Once inside, your mission is simple: destroy everything in your path.
It's time for you to clean house! And bring a mop, there'll be plenty of blood.

name: The Bard's Tale
summary: The NES version, while ported by the same team, was released on a card with half the ROM size, with a lot of the content from the original versions, including the Famicom port, being cut.

name: The Bard's Tale II: The Destiny Knight
The Flaming Shipwreck
summary: Aliens have decided to grab a beer at a modernised British pub in Lynnchester called The Flaming Shipwreck, slaughtering the local folk and causing all sorts of trouble. Being too much for the local police force, Duke has been assigned to remove their presense from the area.

name: The Army of Death
summary: Castle Camelot has been taken over by a bunch of skeletons and your mission is to bone 'em to death.

name: The Final Confrontation
summary: One of the first episodes (7 SP levels, 1 DM) for Duke3D. Especially famous for its train map "Moving Death".

name: The Gate
summary: Duke has defeated the alien invasion force! What Duke doesn't know is that the force he defeated was the first wave and that the real armada is forming around the alien home world at this very moment! Providing 4 episodes with 24 levels, it is named by many as THE classic total conversion for Duke3D

name: The Prequel To Time
summary: 4 maps which are more focused on design and combat. Like in its predecessor "Time", you still have certain things to do, but it's much less like a real mission.

name: The Railway Station
summary: The Railway Station is a short to medium sized level centered around none other than a railway station - and of course it's populated by alien scum

name: The System: Opposing Facility
summary:
A small island with a base has been overtaken by the aliens,
same old story and it's up to Duke to fix the problem. However what is there reason to take over an abandoned area anyway?

name: The Spiegul Contest
summary: 3 city maps from a contest with the goal to use a small street area with mirroring windows and continue building a map based on that area. Only three entries made it into the final poll, with MRCK's and Taivo's maps both winning and Devastator's one getting the second place.

name: The Starlite Project
summary: Starlite takes you to a top secret research facility which is surprisingly devoid of anything to stop you from simply walking in

name: The Chronic
summary: A 5 level episode made by Sanek with help of Zykov Eddy in the first map.

name: The Cradle of Thorns: My Brother Belongs to Me
summary: The Cradle of Thorns was a Japanese free-to-play BL visual novel developed by Koyonplete. It was released on May 7th, 2014 for Android and iOS and was available in Japanese and English.

name: The Bugs Manor
summary: The Bugs Manor is a free 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay, focused on direct interactions with the environment. Can you survive your first night in this haunted house and uncover its mysteries?

name: The Book of the Dead
summary: This is a story where you are a Grim Reaper. On the night of the 31st of October (Halloween) every year, Grim Reaper gets a chance to save only one person. Get to know all of the characters by hearing their stories and make your choice.

name: The Trotties Adventure
summary: Discover the new magical Trotties adventures with their amazing videogame, perfect for your little ones!

name: The Kitty in the Trapping Garden
summary: On my way to a temple, I found a garden. What's wrong with this place……！？

name: The Cerpan Project
summary: Welcome to Project Cerpan! As a new test subject, you will have to go through countless puzzles and tests that will put your intelligence to the limit. Embark on this new Graphic Adventure with Red Salazar and discover what mysteries are happening in Calle Larga.

name: The Most Beautiful Room in the World
summary: Virtual world that reenacts through interactive animations the content painted by Andrea Mantegna in the Saint Giorgio Castle in Mantua, Italy. Virtual Reality interactive animated environment. For artists and scholars.

name: The King of Creation
summary: This is a shooting game with exquisite game backgrounds and character images.

name: The Elision Effect
summary: The Elision Effect is a short surreal puzzle game. The last person finds themselves in an empty office. Not knowing what made everyone abandon these liminal spaces, they look for an exit.

name: The Edibles
summary: Play as a creature that woke up on an alien planet and destroy everything around you, picking up genetic information to evolve into the strongest creature you can find. Defeat the bosses hiding in the castle and get your hands on the magical orbs.

name: The Vorezkor Hack
summary: Uncover an existential conspiracy, rescue your friend and save the world from mindless drudgery in this irreverent Sci-fi point and click adventure!

name: The Shadows of Fallen City
summary: The Shadows of Fallen City is a reality mystery drama that tracks a violent incident caused by someone's fall, as people who have fallen with different stories gathering in a city where common sense and human relationships have fallen.

name: There's No Easter Eggs
summary: There's no Easter eggs is a casual hidden object game with over 500 Easter eggs to find.

name: The Book of Death for Dummies
summary: Death has taken a well-deserved vacation in Cancun and left George in charge! He'll have to learn to deal with Destiny and decide who should continue their journey in the land of the living. But beware, wrong choices lead to undesirable consequences!

name: The Dark Survivors
summary: In the darkness, the survivor hunts monsters for fun! Eliminate monsters and become a more powerful dark survivor!

name: The Eastern Sacrifice
summary: “The Eastern Sacrifice” is an idle game combining simulation with Eastern Cthulhu-inspired themes. In a world spiraling into chaos over authority, vanquish enemy, gather treasures, and build a devoted religion. Your sanctuary will help you reclaim theurgy, ascend to the divine realm.

name: The Mystery of the Village's Sacred Tree
summary: The mystery of the village's sacred tree. The day of the festival is approaching. The happiness and pleasure of people. The salvation of mankind by the cursed village begins now. ・Game Introduction A visual novel style horror adventure game!

name: The Attraction to All Things Uncertain
summary: A city now mutated into hell.

name: The Holyburn Witches
summary: An atmospheric survival-horror game made from chilling panoramic photographs and terrifying sound design. According to old Scottish folklore, witches haunt the forests of the accursed village of Holyburn.

name: The Transference
summary: Escape from your own house, in which you have been locked up. But be careful, you will not be alone in your captivity. Immerse yourself in this first-person horror adventure, full of family secrets and betrayals. And find out who and why they locked you up.

name: The Stalked
summary: Escaped from Liam's obsession, Kate seeks refuge in her grandpa's mansion. Strange occurrences raise questions about Liam's presence or another figure. Unraveling mysterious letters, Kate embarks on a journey, seeking peace.

name: The Undersea
summary: In 'The Undersea', dive into horror with co-op players hired by AquaMarine Tech to recover HDDs from a secret and abandoned undersea facility. Left untouched for 30 years, the depths hold unknown mysteries and dangers. Explore the secrets, but beware of what lurks in the darkness.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Sonny Outfit Pack
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Sonny.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Leland Outfit Pack
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Leland.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Julie Outfit Pack
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Julie.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Connie Outfit Pack
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Connie.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Ana Outfit Pack
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Ana.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Slaughter Family Bloody Skins Pack
summary: Show off your lust for brutality with these blood-soaked variants of the Family's default outfit. Includes 1 bloody skin for Leatherface, The Cook, The Hitchhiker, Sissy, and Johnny.

name: The Curious Study of Dr. Blackwood
summary: Explore a room full of magic and mystery in our free VR tech demo! Experiment with spectral power, reveal hidden secrets, or just chill . . . in The Curious Study of Dr. Blackwood!

name: The Restricted Archive
summary:
A point & click adventure created for Adventure Jam 2023.

A voice in your sleep orders you to steal the fabled Necronomicon from the library of the world-renownd Miskatonic University. Will giving in and doing it finally put an end to your nightmares?

name: The Journey of Allen Strange: Match-Master
summary: Generic memory game based on the sci-fi sitcom

name: The Angry Beavers: Match-Master
summary: A generic memory game based on the cartoon

name: The Lost Fear
summary: "The Lost Fear" is a short 10-15 min psychological horror game about a nightmare. Solve puzzles and confront your fears to escape and wake up.

name: The Twilight Zone II: Final Dreams
summary: The Twilight Zone II - Final Dreams (originally released in 1999, and revised in 2014) is the sequel to The Twilight Zone and is a complete 32 level megawad created by Paul Corfiatis. In The Twilight Zone II, you must travel throughout the galaxy via Ethereal Travel to find and defeat Johnny Boy; an evil cartoon character of a boy who's sprite was drawn by Andrew Snow, a penpal Corfiatis knew throughout the late 1990's.

name: The Deep
summary: The Deep is a single map for GZDoom 4.5.0 and above. Made for Realms Deep Map Jam 2021, this map features the rainbow shader from Void & Rainbow nestled amongst a black and white landscape.

name: The Miracle Piano Teaching System
summary: The Miracle Piano Teaching System is educational software that uses a MIDI keyboard to teach how to play the piano.

name: The Legend of Mystic Zone
summary: You decided to read one ancient book, open it and... In one second you wiil be transfeered inside the Book's World. There after nuclear war in the six states become chaos and bloody wars ruled by Saint King.

name: The Shape of Happiness
summary:
How many days has it been...
Since seeing another human?

Since having grandma's home-made baked potatoes?

A human named Cassie is travelling on the road one fateful day, when an accident sends her into a world vastly different from hers.

name: The Day of Chains
summary: E2-themed map, made as a present for Chaingunner's birthday.

name: The Call of Ktulu
summary: A marble castle and the surrounding caves and mountains. The name comes from the music, "The Call of Ktulu" by Metallica.

name: The Hazard Variation
summary: This is a map that was created in 2003 as "E4M1: First Gate" for the project "The Ninth Gate". However, as that project remained incomplete, this map was never released. Now that the maps from the project are being released individually, you can now play what would have opened that episode, retitled as "The Hazard Variation"!

name: The Farside of Titan
summary: Given your success with the UAC mining base and the Anomaly investigation, it was inevitable that you get picked for this foray into the Titan Farside Research Base. Oh well. Rumours have it that some prototypes of alien technology are being tested here. Please investigate and report.

name: The Island
summary: The Island is a single-level PWAD for Doom II. It is a very large level set on a volcanic island, featuring lakes, forests and a large UAC base in the centre, as well as several visual and sound effects to enhance the ambience. Several new DECORATE monsters are also included, many from the then-new Monster Resource WAD. The author cited Far Cry as the main inspiration when designing this level

name: The Island 2
summary: The Island 2 is a single-level PWAD for Doom II. A sequel to farlowj's previous map, The Island, it once again features a similar setting as before, with large outdoor coastal areas and forested landscapes, but this time with a greater emphasis on indoor locations, including a cave system and a large UAC underground complex.

name: The Interdiction Zone
summary: You've been dropped in the maintenance area of enemy headquarters. You've got to find your way out, cross the interdiction zone, and destroy enemy HQ by locating and pressing the well guarded security destruct switch.

name: The Outer Darkness
summary: This map is heavily inspired by Episode 4 of The Ultimate Doom, especially E4M1 and E4M6. It was originally made for a project called The Ninth Gate that never saw the light of day.

name: Threshold of Pain
summary: Threshold of Pain is a ZDoom episode which attempts to recreate the look and feel of Midway's famous PSX conversion of Doom whilst maintaining the core elements of the PC versions and a level of difficulty PC players would expect.

name: The Waterfront
summary: The Waterfront (Wtrfront.Wad) is a level created by Scott F. Crank in May 1995. It is often considered the earliest level to deliberately exploit the ghost monster bug, which its text file calls the "arch-vile bug"

name: The Board AI
summary:
Step into a realm of endless possibilities and creepy conversations with this cutting-edge ChatGPT spirit board experience.

The Board AI is designed to provide you with an immersive and interactive experience where you can feel real interactions with entities from the afterlife.

name: The Temple of Nightmares
summary: Medium-sized elder world map with medieval and wizard elements, classic vanilla id1 style.

name: The Warmest Body in the Room
summary: Small dark semi-linear single-player map with minimalist brushwork and texturing. Map source is included.

name: The Da Vinci Cryptex
summary: Are you ready to solve 50 incredible riddles to gain your freedom? Test your IQ skills by playing The Da Vinci Cryptex and find out the genius you are!

name: The World Well: Blood of Caro
summary: 814 R.E; the war is approaching. In Redimus, the chaotic world where magic, technology, slaves and vampires coexist, a young girl happens upon a magic gun that sets her on a journey of revenge. There is a burning manor behind her, and the road ahead disappears in the jungles of the night...

name: The Grand Adventures of Leo
summary: Join Leo in a platform adventure has he fights the CAT MAFIA to rescue his precious Mommy!

name: The Braves: Beginning
summary: Demolish hordes of enemies and survive against all odds! Unlock different characters, find powerful skill combinations and embark on an exciting journey through the variety of very different worlds in this cute but unforgiving roguelike game!

name: The Library
summary: The Library is a mysterious trove of old, an arcane structure that has stood since time immemorial. Aged, yet ageless. What will you find within its walls and amongst its countless tomes? This map is an experimental design philosophy I'll be trying out called "Environment Studies": making a focused effort to produce one high-fidelity scene, with a special emphasis on atmosphere or exploration, leaving other more traditional elements like progression or combat behind.

name: The Little Mermaid: Visual Harmony
summary: Immerse yourself in a magical tale with dazzling illustrations as you live a new adventure in the underwater world of The Little Mermaid.

name: The Dark Book 2
summary: Explore dark secrets and battle evil in The Dark Book 2, the epic sequel to the dark fantasy RPG. An unconventional hero, a resurrected skeleton, unravels mysteries in sinister dungeons and dark lands. Confront malevolent creatures and formidable bosses. An enthralling adventure in the shadows

name: The Cakeman
summary: Indulge in "The CakeMan" — a whimsical journey where you, as Cakeman, stack scrumptious cake pieces to reach towering heights. Navigate sweet landscapes, conquer challenges, and race against time. Unleash multiplayer mayhem. Ready for the ultimate cake-stacking delight?

name: The Hospital of Fear
summary: The Hospital of Fear - indie horror from the first person, in the genre of walking simulator. The main focus is on the atmosphere of horror, which is emphasized by realistic 3D graphics and immersive sounds, as well as a well-developed storyline with two endings.

name: The Gnorp Apologue
summary: (the) Gnorp Apologue is the journey of the gnorps as you guide them towards their goal of delightfully excessive wealth accumulation.

name: The Light of the Darkness: Origins
summary:
A captivating dark fantasy action RPG featuring rich-visual biomes, an intriguing narrative, and a challenging Souls-like combat.
Players experience unique and epic aerial combats and exploration with a winged protagonist and absorb essence from others to grab their essence and natures. While doing so, they collect items that help to uncover a dense lore in this 8-hour adventure in the 'Lands of Oblivion, a perfect warm-up for players craving for short metroidvania/souls-like games before diving into heavier titles.

name: The Adventures of The Black Hawk
summary: Hide behind your mask so they won’t discover your true identity, and grab your sword to face the tyranny of the nobility in the days before the French Revolution in this funny point-and-click adventure, following the path of the classics of the 90s… thirty years later!

name: The End Grows
summary:
"The End Grows - a tales of Ashes" is a 2D action RPG combining exploration and time loops. Players battle hordes of monsters in a world collapsing every five minutes, grow stronger through persistent gear between runs, and uncover a powerful story told across 8 chapters filled with revelations.

The game is part of the Ashes saga, set in the same universe as "Ashes – Exponential RPG" released on mobile.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Nicotero Leatherface
summary: From the mind of legendary special make-up effects creator, producer, and director Greg Nicotero, comes this twisted new Leatherface created exclusively for The Texas Chain Saw Massacre.

name: The Rake
summary: The Rake is an open world survival horror game. The gameplay loop is gearing up in your RV, Exploring the map for locations that house long scripted & unscripted horror sequences, or you can choose to look for evidence, hunt, or capture The Rake instead too.

name: The Black Knight: Halloween
summary: Are you ready to live a Halloween adventure?

name: The Police Mystery
summary: The police have arrested dangerous criminals from the neighborhood and sent them to jail. During their time in jail, one of them was a witch who casted a spell to shrink many police officers to the size of an ant. The tinies now need to get a giantess police woman's attention before it's too late.

name: The Unwanted War
summary: Fight battles through human history, defeat your enemies and save humanities future! The Unwanted War lets you follow history itself and take influence on humanities ultimate fate. Are you going to use your knowledge and power for good or will you bring doom over the human race?

name: The OG Cake Factory
summary: You've woken up in this magnificent cake factory, but soon realize that a crazy chef is after you… Have fun baking cakes in this stressful Point-and-click Horror game!

name: The Haunted Farm
summary: Once upon a time there was a farm. It's owner left it for unknown reasons. So far, no one could get close to it due to it's scary stories. whoever go there never came out or heard of. However, one man went there and came out of it with an incredible way

name: The Basement
summary: This is the basement of a large power plant recently taken over. Several Space Marines have already failed to retake. It is crucial that this plant not remain in enemy hands. It is reported that there are spiders in the basement...

name: The Smurfs 2: The Prisoner of the Green Stone: Corrupted Outfit / Farmer Outfit / Adorable Outfit
The Sims 4: For Rent
summary: Bring the neighbours together (literally) and experience multi-family lots as a tenant or property owner in The Sims 4 For Rent Expansion Pack. Purchase now to get bonus items** to bring the Night Market home for your Sims.

name: The Puzzle Maker: Cebba's Odyssey
summary: Solve and create fantastical puzzles in The Puzzle Maker: Cebba's Odyssey! Follow the tale of Cebba the Puzzle Maker as you take on her many trials to inherit her title. Use the unique abilities of friendly units to manipulate and destroy enemy monsters. Become the next great Puzzle Maker!

name: The Quest of the Tiny Hero
summary: Embark on a valiant quest in "The Quest of The Tiny Hero," a 2D top-down RPG where you craft, battle, and explore your way to becoming the hero of your village.

name: The Smiling Man: Remake
summary:
It's back! In this remake you can play through the real story told by Blue Tidal, as well as the alternative story, which is a recreation of the first game. In this remake too, the music and sounds have been recreated, with each ending having its own music.

The suspense part of the game was inspired by some famous horror movies from the 80s/90s.

As the main story is based on the real story of Blue Tidal, it ends up being very short, unlike the alternative story which is a recreation and reimagining of the first game.

name: The A500 Mini
summary: The A500 Mini is a compact, officially licensed emulation-based console that replicates the experience of the Commodore Amiga 500. Released in 2022 by Retro Games Ltd, it comes preloaded with a selection of classic Amiga titles and supports additional game loading via USB. The system includes a modern replica of the original Amiga mouse and a gamepad, offering HDMI output and save state functionality for convenience.

name: The Last Note From Dad
summary: A short horror experience on a supposedly uninhabited island.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Goddess of Wisdom
summary:
The Legend of Zelda: Goddess of Wisdom follows the original design of ‘Zelda3 Goddess of Wisdom’ but is edited to create a more comprehensive experience for novice and/or expert players that feels akin to something Nintendo would release.

This hack built upon the framework created in ‘Zelda3 Goddess of Wisdom’ with all due respect to the original author(s), and is made to correct some of the issues observed in the final ‘Zelda3 Goddess of Wisdom’ release.

name: The Brutalist Volumes
summary: Enter a Quake world of pure concrete, minimalist structures, and eldritch horror. What started as just a map for QBJ2 got out of hand and became a standalone episode.

name: The Ninji Saga Part 1: Birth of a Legend
summary: A little story from the perspective of one of the more easily forgotten enemies from the Mario series.

name: The Line TD
summary: In The Line TD, you decide your path and you survive! Plan your strategy, carve your own path, choose your difficulty and survive the longest!

name: The Lost Detective
summary: This is a single-player third-person action-adventure puzzle game that allows players to solve certain puzzles and explore more game content. This game currently only supports computers and can be operated through a keyboard and mouse.

name: The Lumenites
summary: Build a cozy village on your flying turtle. Land on floating islands, recycle, upgrade your village, repeat! There's no combat, or wrong answers - just explore and go from chaos to control as you shape your perfect paradise.

name: The Hydra Experiment
summary: Solve puzzles as a mad scientist in this action-adventure RPG.

name: The Structureworld: Myths of Skull Island
summary: Survive in this epic semi-open world Survival Game on a new interpretation of Skull Island filled with your biggest nightmares! Build small bases, resource holders, traps and barricades to fight off the horrors and the simulated ecosystem of the island.

name: The Janitor
summary: Take a deep dive into an isometric dystopian world of corporate intrigue in this mechanical whack and smash. Join the janitor as he solves puzzles and thwarts traps to find his way out of the clutches of his captors. Utilize hidden potential to become a savior of the queen and a hero to the ants.

name: The Lab and Dungeons
summary: The Lab and Dungeons is a fusion of roguelike action and shooter RPG. As a robot, mine ores, craft unique weapons, and conquer procedural dungeons. Collect materials to unlock more advanced weapons. From a novice to a high-spec warrior robot, enjoy physics-based combat solo or in co-op mode online!

name: The Exit 8
summary: You are trapped in an endless underground passageway. Take a good look around and find a way to escape.

name: The Quiet Execution
summary: A dark, suspenseful, first-person horror game where you play as the executioner of a demonic cult. When you thought your work was over, the evil entity gave you an irrefusable offer. Possess an ancient evil, become the Quiet Reaper once more. Your freedom lies behind one last life to be sacrificed.

name: The Smell of Death: A Tsugunohi Tale - Steam Edition
summary: "Tsugunohi" creator ImCyan's former 3D dungeon horror film is now available on Steam. The game also features a battle mode against monsters, and if you complete the hard mode, which is new to the Steam version, a later story will appear. Can you escape safely from the "world of death"?

name: Theme-Gawad
summary: Each mapper has taken a specific theme, and then tried to make something nice looking, but also fun, within specific confines (3072*3072 Grid or Smaller, bar some exceptions, and stock textures-only). This Doom II megawad is divided between chapters of varying difficulty, with each chapter using specific monsters and enemies, with the purpose of the whole thing feeling like a gradually more challenging adventure.

name: The Adventures of Timmy: Run Kitty Run
summary:
The Adventures of Timmy: Run Kitty Run is a side-scrolling platformer game, focused on a boy who must battle a bully to save his true love: Kitty.

Join Timmy in a quest to rescue the girl of his dreams in "The Adventures of Timmy." This game offers a story-driven world filled with fast-paced fun and has received recognition from the press. Timmy is not your average kid; he's the coolest you'll ever encounter, especially in his iconic cat suit. His mission is to rescue Kitty, the school's prettiest girl, who has been captured by the school bully, Mitch. Timmy embarks on an imaginative journey to infiltrate Mitch's tree house lair and save Kitty.

name: Thief: The Complete Collection
summary: Slip into the world of Garrett, the greatest thief the world has never seen. Thief - The Complete Collection contains all three of the genre-defining stealth adventures, including the ultra-rare Gold edition of the first Thief game.

name: The Invincible: Deluxe Edition
summary: Packed with additional content, The Invincible: Deluxe Edition lets you take an even deeper dive into a hard sci-fi adventure. Enjoy the base game along with The Art of The Invincible digital artbook, a digital comic book, and the game's Original Soundtrack.

name: The Legend of Zelda: The Mini Quest
summary:
This hack is based on The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, with references from other games of the franchise.
Now go save Zelda once again!

name: The Wrath of Sona
summary: A freeware classic style RPG made in QuickBasic. The game's plot involves the main character becoming a Mage Knight, though their master is killed as they were about to learn the most powerful spell. Character portraits are photos downloaded from the internet.

name: The Snowman
summary: The Snowman is an import exclusive and import friendly with English and Japanese options for sampling the finer aspects of Raymond Brigg's Snowman creation. Includes some enjoyable mini games to embellish flying through the sky with a gaggle of rotund snowmen.

name: The Great Battle of Shark Monkey Squirrel Dinossaur Bird Bee
summary: This is a story that has never been told before.

name: The Neverwhere Tales : Book 1
summary: The Neverwhere Tales - Book 1 is a story-driven Adult Visual Novel. The story takes place in an urban fantasy setting and combines a modern world with fantasy elements. Book 1 is the story of Alexander Callister and how he learns about this hidden world called "Neverwhere."

name: The Political Machine 2024
summary: Win the hearts and minds of America’s voters and run for President in this political strategy game. Choose a candidate or create your own and run against the opposing party’s candidate or up to 4 primary candidates controlled by the computer or other players online.

name: The Political Machine 2024: Cabinet of Curiosities
summary: Dive into the ultimate customization experience with the 'Cabinet of Curiosities' DLC! Outfit your candidate with a wild array of gear, from Drengin heads to astronaut suits. Campaign in style or outlandish flair!

name: The Paupers
summary: On a special day, spirits emerge, seeking your assistance for a seamless journey to the beyond. Listen to their requests and gather the essential items to aid their passage into the afterlife. It's your task to cater to the spirits' needs in this mysterious yet delightfully comical journey!

name: The Detective
summary: Step into the shoes of an experienced detective and uncover dark secrets while solving criminal cases. In this thrilling detective world, you'll face stressful decision-making moments, reconstruct crime scenes, and utilize cutting-edge technology for evidence analysis.

name: The Darkened Halls
summary: Prepare to face nightmarish bosses in 'The Darkened Halls.' Armed with intellect, not weapons, you are a vulnerable young protagonist hunted by demons. Solve puzzles, secure key items, and challenge powerful foes in a relentless pursuit.

name: The Ampoule
summary: A drug leak during an unknown experiment turned scientists into monsters. You are tasked with finding a cure to escape the monster and returning them to their original form. Only you can save the world in "The ampoule."

name: The Land of Seidr
summary: Lead the warriors of a doomed kingdom in this dark, tactical SRPG. All stats can be damaged by normal attacks, so even powerful units weaken over time. With scarce supplies and steadily deteriorating allies, you must make tough decisions to keep your squad alive—sometimes at great cost.

name: The Dire
summary: Dean Holt, popular Urbex vlogger, sets off on another exploration of an abandoned home but this time things aren't going as planned. Something dark is lurking inside and Dean quickly finds himself in over his head

name: The Valley of Calm Trees
summary: The Valley of Calm Trees is a fairly short limit-removing single map for Doom 2, set in a relaxing forested

name: The Silent Neighbor
summary: In the neighborhood you step into, everyone has their secrets... But only your silent neighbor's is deadly. "The Silent Neighbor" is an immersive horror game that combines mystery and suspense. In the depths of a house filled with hidden passages, puzzles, and unexpected perils, you will uncover the dark secrets of your neighbor and strive to stay alive. Solve mind-bending puzzles, navigate through terrifying moments, and dare to confront the cursed past of your silent neighbor. Silence can be deceiving. It is time to face a silent threat in the darkness.

name: The Crew: Motorfest - Deluxe Edition
summary:
With the Deluxe Edition, get access to the base game and the Fitted Ultimate Pack, including:
- Porsche 718 Spyder 2021 Fitted Edition.
- Honda Civic Type R 2021 Fitted Edition.
- Customization items.

Welcome to Motorfest, the ultimate driving experience! Explore the vibrant open world of O‘ahu in Hawaii as you compete in intense races, themed events, and much more!

name: The Last World
summary: After the world ends, the remaining survivors must defend the last spark of human civilization. Use the camp as a position to repel the waves of monsters in each city! Thay are too powerful? It doesn't matter! Get stronger equipment, learn stronger skills, and finally sweep thousands of armies!

name: The Castle
summary: Title: Hidden Castle This is a first-person perspective exploration horror game where you aim to escape from a mysterious castle you stumbled upon while seeking shelter from the rain.

name: The Mouse The Merrier
summary: The Mouse the Merrier is a cozy puzzle game about reuniting a mouse with his lost family. Traverse through a beautiful flooded landscape, sliding along floating petals and hopping onto buttons. Help Mousimus find his family and try your best not to leave anymouse behind!

name: The Legend of Yan Loong 1+2
summary: A nostalgic collections of the chapter 1 and 2 of “Yan Loong Legend” series. Pick up your sword again, transform into Yan Loong, Zhi Loong or Shui Yan with your friends to have a battle of light and darkness with the final boss Bai Loong and regain the occupied Green Hill Lake.

name: The Launching Section
summary: An arcade game where you launch projectiles at fruits, because why not

name: The Crevice
summary: Explore, adapt, and survive. Climb deep inside The Crevice and unearth the mysteries, horrors and treasures buried within in this subterranean roguelite survival adventure.

name: The Brave Little Cloud
summary: In the game "The Brave Little Cloud", you will become the main character - a little cloud that fights against evil to protect its world.

name: The Smurfs: Learn and Play
summary: Discover the world and learn by playing with Smurfs!

name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories
summary: Hop into the wonderful world of Smurfs and check what stories are waiting for you!

name: The Dark Eye Bundle
summary: This bundle contains three games set in the famous tabletop fantasy universe of "The Dark Eye". Dive into the universe's lore, uncover dark machinations, solve puzzles and test your skills in turn-based combat across three classic games from Daedalic Entertainment.

name: The Town Secrets
summary: You're neighbor is suspicious! Go to his house and discover what he's doing.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Minas Morgul
summary: The Lord of the Rings Online: Minas Morgul is the seventh expansion. It raised the game's level cap from 120 to 130 and added the Morgul Vale and dead city of Minas Morgul as well as seven new group instances and a new raid set in Shelob's lair. The expansion also introduced the seventh playable race of Stout-Axe Dwarves, whom players who pre-ordered it could access prior to the release date.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: War of Three Peaks
summary: The Lord of the Rings Online: War of Three Peaks is the eighth expansion for the MMORPG The Lord of the Rings Online. Announced as a "mini-expansion pack", it is smaller than other expansions in both scope and price, comparable to 2009's Siege of Mirkwood. Unlike all previous expansions, it did not raise the game's level cap. Instead, a new type of quests called "Missions" was introduced, which scale to the player character's level, allowing players across all levels to participate.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Fate of Gundabad
summary: The Lord of the Rings Online: Fate of Gundabad is the ninth expansion for the MMORPG The Lord of the Rings Online. It is a direct sequel to the previous year's War of Three Peaks expansion and concludes the storyline that has been developing over several updates. The expansion raised the level cap to 140, added the region of Gundabad, a new Brawler class and brought a major change to the Legendary Item system introduced in the Mines of Moria.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Before the Shadow
summary: The Lord of the Rings Online: Before the Shadow is the tenth expansion for the MMORPG The Lord of the Rings Online. It did not raise the game's level cap or advance the current storyline, but instead added a new starting zone for the new player experience, with a storyline set prior to that of the Shadows of Angmar.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Corsairs of Umbar
summary: The Lord of the Rings Online: Corsairs of Umbar is the eleventh expansion for the MMORPG The Lord of the Rings Online. Corsairs of Umbar introduces the new innovative New Mariner Class, a fearless swordfighter with a unique balance system. Players can unleash powerful skill sequences in their swordplay to create powerful skill chains that leave their enemies in a daze and allies in awe. Slash through foes with slick swordplay, belt out rousing sea-shanties, and pull off crafty moves that will have enemies spinning in confusion.

name: The Unvisited Grandma
summary: How long have you been visiting your grandmother?

name: The Devil's Imago
summary: A tale of primeval forces, unknown, uncaring, and unearthed.

name: The Rake: Rust Dead Survival
summary:
After you successfully defeated Jeff The Killer
and Slender Man,
you are ready for your next mission!
Hunt down and kill The Rake.
Find 8 Rake Voodoo dolls.
Lock and load! Revenge is MY NAME!

Find 8 Voodoo Dolls and Kill The Rake.
Good Luck!

name: The Amazing Digital Funkin'
summary: The Amazing Digital Funkin' is a parody Friday Night Funkin' mod based around The Amazing Digital Circus. In the mod, Boyfriend goes against Pomni and Jax.

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Final Fantasy XVI Pack
summary: A pack of additional music tracks to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

name: The Backrooms Exploration
summary: You were an employer of M.E.G and you were assigned to go on an adventure into the Backrooms, but something went wrong and you were completely lost. Deep into a various liminal spaces with a realistics graphics created with Unreal Engine 5

name: The Forgotten Tribe
summary: The Forgotten Tribe is a small arcade game with 9 levels to go through and get your fellow tribesmen back. Use a map to navigate the dungeon and successfully collect all of your tribe to unlock a happy ending!

name: The Source
summary: The Source is a unique modern take on the Text Adventure genre. An outsider to a foreign world, you must choose a kingdom to help gain an ancient power locked deep beneath a mysterious Well. Explore each kingdom, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery surrounding this shattered world.

name: The Tau Experiment
summary: The Tau Experiment is an episodic RPG Adventure game where you play as Sam, an employee with the Tau Corporation. Choose your own adventure as you work to help Sam put an end to the company's plans.

name: The Void Project
summary: The Void Project is a fast paced arena shooter that throws you into an arena simulation. Face different kind of demons, overcome their patterns and finish them off in as less time as possible to reach the top of the leaderboard and make yourself worthy of calling ~The Void Breaker~.

name: The Perplexing Orb: Bounce N' Roll
summary: The Perplexing Orb returns in a brand new entry packed with new features! New art style, new levels, and new game play mechanics! Bounce N' Roll through this all new adventure!

name: The Game Of Death
summary: Step into the bony shoes of Death in this unique platform game. As the iconic skeleton character, you're one day away from retirement when a sinister thief steals your life savings. Reclaim what's yours and set off on your dream vacation.

name: The Maze Contract
summary: The Maze Contract is a single player retro action game with vector-style graphics. It takes a lot of inspiration from the 1980's shoot-em-up arcade games, but with added tactical elements and lots of upgrades for your ship and weapons.

name: The Backrooms: You've Been Here Before
summary: You find yourself in Backrooms, and it's up to you to find a way out of this place. You are completely lost, in a world of endless corridors and liminal spaces. And no one knows what's waiting for you around the next corner.

name: The Ascent: CyberSec Pack
summary: The CyberSec Pack is the new explosive collection from CyberSec Mega. With 2 new weapons, 1 new tactical, 4 new pieces of armor and 4 new animated weapon skins, you will have all you need to make a bang!

name: The Fast Journey
summary:
In "The Fast Journey", embark on an exciting 2D adventure as a brave frog named Rafa.
Your beloved frog, Polly, is captured by malevolent creatures.

name: The Dragon Prince: Xadia
summary: Explore Xadia, team up with friends, and battle evil forces in this hack & slash looter ARPG.

name: The Ghost: Survival Horror
summary:
You were getting your daily treatment with friends at the New Wishlie Hospital for 2 weeks already, and today was time to get discharged from the hospital. But something happened. You woke up at 2 AM and found out that all the patients were gone, except you and your friends. The place looks much muddier and it’s... locked! You read in magazines about the hospital and turns out that it's haunted. Now It seems like the only way to escape is through the garage door. Will you be able to get away by the time the ghost devours your soul?

Emily and Leila were studends and best friends. They lived in a small house in a town with almost no people. It was Sunday, and it was routinuous for them to visit the cemetery together. Only this time, for some reasons, Emily felt she would better stay home. So she decided to stay home. Looking out of window, Emily sees strange creature creeping behind her sister... The next day after Leila's absence, she runs to school for help. On her way to get inside the school, the main school gate closes behind her. Now locked inside the school area, the next thing she notices are students who struggle to survive..

name: The Way of All Flesh-Again
summary: This add-on does not change the history of the episode, it only allows you to play it in an alternate way. There are 8 new levels and new textures from games such as: F.E.A.R., Kingpin, Redneck Rampage, Witchaven (1,2), Duke Nukem 3D, Shadow Warrior, NAM, WW2GI, TEKWAR, Manhunt, etc

name: The Cult
summary: BLOOD: the Cult is a new episode that contains 5 single player maps for original Blood.

name: The Dreamwell Enigma: Barlington Estate
summary: Explore Master Barlington's estate, also home to his exclusive gentlemen's club including some prominent figures of the area, owners of influential businesses; Cobbleson & Son's Crimson Brewery, Leroux's M'daillon Bathhouse, Ashford's Bank and Trust, etc. Strange activities have been taking place at the estate and these men are likely involved. Rumours also spread about a new religious cult forming and gossip regarding Barlington's mental health as of late. Sudden disappearances have been reported surrounding the area, but no concrete evidence pointing to the club itself. What secrets are they hiding? Break inside, rummage around, seek documents and discover the truth, no matter how far you must dig to find it.

name: The Pandemonium
summary: A single map that includes rotating doors, explosive walls ,respawning monsters, and more

name: The Hall of Epiphany
summary:
Fight your way through the dark realm and seal the rift once and for all!
You've reached the Hall Of Epiphany, now it's time for revenge! In order to summon Tchernabog's presence, you'll need to fight your way through the "Army Of Darkness". Once you finish the 3 main bosses, T-daddy opens a portal for you to return for the final battle. Once on the other side, you see Ophelia's soul trapped and tormented. You are now face to face with Tchernabog. The only way to set Ophelia free a end the Cabal, is to destroy T-daddy himself!

name: The Carnage Continues
summary: The Carnage Continues is a modification for Blood that was developed over several years, with it being finally released on January 4, 2006, although the author commented that it could never be finished entirely as intended. The add-on was created by Harry, with one level jointly developed with Joel "Reactor" Blackwell (co-creator of Gods, the Epic Trilogy from 1998).

name: The Lost Episode
summary: The Lost Episode is a unofficial add-on for Blood that adapts eight level files found in the Blood Alpha release and makes them into a coherent whole; speculated to be drafts by James Wilson III. Put together by Maz/kingmaz and released on November 27, 2014.

name: The Lost Episodes
summary: Five dark tales of terror lost to the void of time, now available for your edification. From some of the best creators of Blood maps, this five adventure set promises to challenge the most avid Blood fan! A Collection Of Hard To Find Episodes Gathered Together In One Carnage-Filled Collection Including GODS by Joel & Kurt Blackwell, Journey to Hell by Martin Brintnall, Legend of Ravenloft by Michael Shire, Killing Time by Marc Levesque, Haunted Realmsby Joel Dube with additional maps by Treks, Johnnie Blaster, Craig L. Duckett & Dwayne Anderson. Adding Up To 23 Levels of Hardcore Gorefest

name: The Abandoned Factory
summary: Collect all six 6 keys and kills as many bad guys possible

name: The Fallen Priest
summary: A short map requiring Plasma Pak

name: The Lost Temple
summary:
There are some rumors about a ruin of a temple deep in the woods where strange things are happening. You are about to find out if this ruin really exists and what evil might has manifested itself in there. But first you have to fight your way into the ruin, as you find out that it is heavily guarded by some cultists and hordes of zombies. You wonder what will be inside this ruin, that seems to be reactivated in some strange way.
Will you be able to fight your way into the ruin...

name: The Old Manor
summary: This map was going to be in an episode, but the episode is on hold right now and may not fit in very well.

name: The Way of Ira
summary: The Way of Ira is a fan add-on for Blood by MariusArmand currently featuring two chapters, the first released on September 22, 2019 and the second on July 9, 2021. The title is derived from "ira", the Latin word for "rage" (or "ire"). The add-on features narration and new Caleb dialogue performed by David "Tekedon" Wikström, as well as tracks from the Blood Music Project.

name: The Roottrees Are Dead
summary: The Roottrees are Dead is a puzzle game based around correctly assembling a family tree.

name: The Dream Of A Cockspur
summary: Stranded on a desolate island with Earth's final researchers, you investigate a mysterious celestial body. The day before departure, the return boat is damaged, forcing an extended stay. Is someone playing tricks, or does the island want to kill all of you?

name: The City Of Hope
summary: A light city-building game that combines elements of card games and tower defense, where players must survive daily enemy attacks and gradually grow their strength to ultimately defeat powerful invaders.

name: Three Thousand Worlds
summary: "Three Thousand Worlds" is a massively multiplayer online game (MMORPG). The game provides players with a lot of different quality equipment, and the pursuit of high-level (or best) equipment is one of the most important goals for players in the game.

name: The Imperial Capital Burns: Muv-Luv Alternative Total Eclipse
summary: A prequel to Muv-Luv Alternative Total Eclipse which follows Takamura Yui and her friends during their time as surface pilot cadets.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Labrador Retriever
summary: Introducing the Labrador Retriever, your faithful new hunting partner! This popular and versatile breed can fetch a variety of small game on land or in water.

name: Thank You for Sharing Your World
summary: This work aimed to reproduce the world experienced by blind people, focusing on the expressive uniqueness of VR.

name: The King Of Fighters XV: Character - Hinako Shijo
summary: [Product Contents]"Hinako Shijo" can be used in The King Of Fighters XV.

name: The King of Alzoria
summary: A game where you talk to a tyrant king

name: The Red Bell’s Lament
summary:
The Redbell Tree scrapes the sky, standing proudly in the heart of Hemeria, a land of sunlight. In a land ruled by a monarchy for generations, humans lived in peace and tranquility. That is, until the dawn of the day the world was dyed red.

On that day, vampires laid waste to Hemeria. They preyed on, devoured, and devastated its inhabitants. A great many people would go on to mourn their loved ones, their families and friends, for the rest of their lives. One particular town of Hemeria bore such a tragedy. A single girl was left alone in despair and disgrace. She vowed revenge, and grew into one of Hemeria's finest vampire hunters.

And one day, she became a member of the Elpis 7; those who inspired a light of hope in its people.

One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and a royal knight awaiting her. The hunters assembled receive an order from the monarch.

They are to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires. A shiver of anticipation crackles through her at the opportunity she's been waiting for her whole life. However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake. Pawns are sent forth, discarded, hidden out of sight...

And just how many will remain when this all comes to an end?

name: The White Owl
summary: The White Owl is a short atmospheric horror experience.

name: The Last Orpheus
summary: The Last Orpheus is a first-person horror game with music mechanics inspired by Ocarina of Time.

name: The Overlook Rehaunted
summary: All work and no play makes Jacka a dull boy...

name: The Mountain is as It Always Was
summary: A small narrative game about mountains, emptiness, loss, and remembering what it means to be alive.

name: The Division 2: Warlords of New York - Year 5 Season 1: Broken Wings
summary: In the wake of the attack at the White House, The Division has discovered that 11 people are unaccounted for and considered missing. You will be tasked to go on a high-stakes rescue mission to find the missing civilians, as they have valuable intel on the White House and The Castle Settlement.

name: The X-Com Files
summary: This megamod will allow you to grow X-Com from its humbled beginnings, as a two-men team travelling the world in an expensive-looking car to global the military force we all know and love. It contains many, many additions, like new mission types, enemies, equipment and story arcs (including the entirety of my previous project, the Final Mod Pack). It also places the game a bit more firmly in the 90's conspiracy genre and its clichés.

name: The Christopher Redemption: I
summary: The Christopher redemption part I is a story-driven action thriller game that explores the intense and original story of Christopher and his sister.

name: The Piece
summary: “The Piece” is a simple & fun block puzzle game, train your spatial ability!

name: The Devious Four Chronicles 4: Hunter's Revenge ReVised
summary:
After stopping the alien duo known as Hunter and Scorpion from ending the world via the Furnace, an alien doomsday device which was constructed in the center of their crash landing site, the Mushroom Kingdom rebuilt.

With peace once again prevalent, Mario must now travel to the neighboring distant kingdom of Hyrule to announce the Mushroom Kingdom's presence as a peaceful one. However, on his journey, Mario meets a rather strange individual, who tells the even stranger story of a recent foe who might not be so dead after all.

A romhack with 107 exits

name: The Devious Four Chronicles 3: The Crater
summary:
A romhack with 100 exits

Mario has bested the King Koopa, Bowser, time and time again. He has stopped boos from taking over and even giant frogs. However, not long ago, he foiled the attempt of two otherworldly beings named Racter and Magna, from distorting his world's magnetic field. Mario bested Racter, but not before he could call for help.

Mario must now face off against an enemy like no other he has seen... two enemies! He must be quick, for they have built a devious super weapon that could very well turn the Mushroom Kingdom and more into nothing more than a parking lot! He's not alone though, traveling with him is yet another otherworldly being who seems to know the two villains.

name: The Tape
summary:
You have till 3am to escape the hotel or they they will come.

Watch tapes, progress and find a way out before it is to late...

Can you break the cycle?

name: The Devious Four Chronicles 6: The Fourth Sector
summary:
Mario and Sonic have earned a well deserved vacation from the Devious Four's attacks. Sonic decides to have a normal adventure with Mario. Instead, they find a whole new world filled with wonders, bombs, and a strange creature called Sectorial. Unfortunately, trouble is brewing in the dimension between dimensions, and it's not to be taken lightly.

This romhack has 102 exits.

name: The Dark is a Soft, Warm Pressure
summary: isitjustmeinhere?

name: The King of Fighters XIII: Global Match: Deluxe Edition
summary:
KOF XIII, the final chapter in the Ash Saga—and one of the series’ most acclaimed entries—is back! This enhanced version comes with rollback netcode for exhilarating online play, as well as brand-new online lobbies that allow you to join/spectate matches with multiple players at once. Also features a packed roster of 36 playable characters, including NESTS Style Kyo, Classic Iori, and Mr. Karate! KOF’s greatest-ever 2D graphics come to life as you face off against players online and around the world!

Complete with rollback netcode and overhauled online functionality!

Comes with magnificent must-haves for fans of the series: a Digital Artbook (with 100+ pages of exclusive illustrations, storyboards, and more) and a Digital Soundtrack (featuring the now-elusive melodies of THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII)!

Includes:
- "THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH" Base game
- "THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH Artbook & Soundtrack"

name: The Key
summary: It is a multiplayer, competitive combat game with support for 8 players per game. Your objective is to obtain 3 keys and survive to create your own path to the helicopter on the map which is your victory point.

name: The Unworld
summary:
Story: Bowser has tricked Mario into getting inside of a very strange glass box, called The Unworld. It is a very strange world in
there... Mario, inside, asks you to help get him out of there using the controller connected to the box. It is up to
you to lead Mario out of the Unworld and back to the real world in time to stop Bowser! Expect some humorous comments
and a some-what storyline within this.

To get to Bowser in the regular, just getting one normal exit after another path, will take you 33 exits. However, if you are a player
who likes looking for secret exits, finding new Overworld areas and paths, then you will have a whole 93 exits to find.
I only used Lunar Magic and the instant Death blocks in this hack, so I would call it a vanilla hack (I guess?) This hack
has, in my opinion and that of others', a very nice difficulty curve, where it is pretty easy in the beginning and slowly gets much much harder.
Many levels have hidden bonuses and secret surprises... So, what are you waiting for? Download this and have fun!

name: The Desolation
summary: The Desolation brings a complete cross-platform co-op looter-shooter experience to PC and mobile devices. Make your impact across endless procedurally generated worlds via cooperative action combat, deep build customization and richly satisfying tactical gameplay.

name: The Five Rivers Land
summary: Mini campaign in DOOM 3 hell-style with three small to medium sized, dark and scary maps, D3 textures (needless to say) and some ambient sounds.

name: The Last of Us Part II Remastered
summary: Experience the winner of over 300 Game of the Year awards now with an array of technical enhancements that make The Last of Us Part Il Remastered the definitive way to play Ellie and Abby's critically acclaimed story.

name: The Flintstones
summary: In 1995, Sega Genesis port of Ocean's The Flintstones was released exclusively via the Sega Channel. Due to its limited release, the port was previously considered lost, with the only playable build existing being an early prototype build that was dumped in 2019. The final broadcast version was ultimately archived by the Video Game History Foundation and Gaming Alexandria in 2025.

name: The Walking Dead: Empires
summary:
Cooperative survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world after a letas virus causes people to turn into zombies when they die and infects the people they bite. Game from the series franchise: The Walking Dead.
The game is web3 and can be found in the Gala Games store. Developed by Ember Entertainment

name: The Archivist and the Revolution
summary:
A woman alone in a dying city, on a dying world. What will be left when it all falls apart?

The Archivist and the Revolution is a slice-of-life/romance/history simulator set in a far-future sealed city that has undergone cycles of destruction and revival. You play as Em, a middle-aged woman who is no longer an archivist, as she struggles with rent payments, chronic illness, and the remnants of past relationships.

name: The Myth Seekers Collection
summary:
This bundle includes:

The Myth Seekers: The Legacy of Vulkan - Face off against the legacy of ancient gods!
The Myth Seekers 2: The Sunken City - Can love revive what hate has ruined?

name: The Chronicles of Ezra Blackwell: Episode 1 - Pappi's Peril
summary: First Person Mystery Adventure with twisting story and multiple endings.

name: The Sireen
summary: You are trying to prevent the spread of a top secret invention to the islands from an accidental Laboratory explosion on an island You are maybe the last people left on the island , Crafts, you build houses, you hunt. a new open world survival horror simulator

name: ThroneForge: The Fortress War
summary: Throneforge: The Fortress War:Build an arsenal of diverse towers, each with unique abilities and strengths.Strategically place towers along the enemy's path to maximize their impact and create impenetrable defense lines.

name: The Bowling Tournament
summary: Enjoy a completely new way to bowl. Try to make all the pins fall and compete against other players.

name: The Death Focal
summary: The death focal(TDF) is a first-person shooting game where you have to prove yourself worthy in mini-battles in order to be qualified for the incoming great battle .

name: The Spellswapper
summary: The Spellswapper is an arcade roguelite where you use spells to defeat waves of enemies. Command an ever-moving arsenal of spells. Swap out old spells for new ones after each wave, crafting a unique magical repertoire in every run.

name: The Dragonhood
summary: The Dragonhood is a clicker RPG with rougelite elements and automatic battles. Collect eggs, hatch dragons, and loot stuff on a variety of 1 vs 1 adventures or 3 vs 3 dungeons. Complete quests and build your dragons the way you want with various evolutions, abilities, amulets, and more!

name: This Game is For You 2022
summary: Hi there, welcome! This is a horror game I've made just for you.

name: Thought Experiment Simulator
summary: Trolley Problem, Ship of Theseus, Brain in a Vat, Infinite Monkey, Sisyphus, Prisoner Paradox, Schrodinger's Cat, etc.

name: The Ohio Weedeater Mishap
summary: This parody of The Texas Chainsaw Massacre sees Leatherface replaced with a bumbling idiot from Ohio who can't start his weedeater leading to an accident.

name: Thunderblade Saga
summary: "Thunderblade Saga" is a 2D side-scrolling action game featuring a rich array of combos and unique skill builds. Come challenge the distinctively unique bosses, unlock powerful skills, and enjoy an intense and thrilling combat journey!

name: This Is How U Look Saying This Shit
summary: This Is How U Look Saying This Shit is a mod for Friday Night Funkin' by phantasmuh that is based on the Boykisser meme.

name: The Wizard Party
summary: The Wizard Party is a whimsical adventure game where all dialogue options are physics objects that interact with each other!

name: The Last Catalyst
summary: Delve into this real-time roguelike deckbuilder mixed with an auto-battler. Find powerful synergies, improve your spells, collect artifacts and skills, and climb your way through swarms of enemies until you face the final boss!

name: The Witches Pond
summary: The Witches Pond is a horror-adventure game based on the real-life place with the same name. Enter a world of mystery and strange places where you will experience events that may or may not seem real.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Revival
summary: A Majora's Mask romhack with a small world to explore.

name: Thunderbolts and Lightning!
summary: Thematically open to interpretation, the jam had just one rule: maps must include a Thunderbolt (aka Lightning Gun)! This speedmapping event also includes some new mini powerups! A mini-pentagram, mini-quad-damage, and mini-bio-suit, each of which last only 8 seconds!

name: The Iceman
summary: The Iceman is an exciting and thrilling game that puts you in the shoes of a character who loves the cold and will stop at nothing to reach the fridge.

name: The Last 66 Days
summary: I'm Anna, met Qiqing in a video game, he bright light in my once dark world. But in 66 days, he'll be gone, every day precious. You, my friend, the only one can help me. Please review my story, nurture our relationship, find out why he's leaving!

name: The Shape of Things: Gacha Box 1
summary: Experience a relaxing atmosphere from the comfort of your cozy room by solving small 3D puzzles inside collectible gachapons, and find the original shape of things inspired by Rubik’s style.

name: Thieves
summary: A multiplayer co-op game (Players vs NPC) horror escape game where the thieves decided to steal a house, but the house owned by a killer.

name: The DarkCity
summary: Prepare for a visceral and heart-pounding fusion between fast-paced hack-and-slash action, platforming, and a first-person shooter. As a fearless inquisitor sent by the church, you must unleash hell on the vampire legions that plague this isolated and obliviated city.

name: The Midnight
summary: The Midnight is a mod being developed by Cryptic Mushroom that adds a new, mysterious and scary dimension to explore. It is a dimension of darkness; the only light comes from crystals and the various life of the dimension. You may travel willingly to this dimension, though you may find yourself being unwillingly dragged into this strange and hostile world...

name: The Quaddle Family Mysteries 1: The Case of the Scarce Scarab - Lobby / Kitchen
summary: Miscellaneous adventure game, developed and published by Lightspan, which was released in 1998.

name: The Melting Apartment
summary:
A moody and surreal horror adventure game inspired by Italian giallo movies and Junji Ito, created for the Game Boy.
A young woman disappears soon after moving into an old building at the edge of town. Can you find out what happened to her and escape with your life?

name: The Time Machine
summary: This time machine takes you where others won't.

name: The World's Egg: For Those Who Dream
