summary: While enjoying an ordinary day in town, Mari suddenly finds herself surrounded by people collapsing, and some transforming into monsters. Guided by a mysterious voice, she is given the ability to fight back against the evil creatures.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Nancy
summary: Bring home Nancy, possibly the most heinous and disturbed Family member of them all! She's an expert at using her friendly looks to lure unsuspecting Victims into deadly situations they can't escape. Her barbed wire traps and unnatural Spy ability make for a unique and deadly combination.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Danny
summary: A kind and intelligent Victim with a rough exterior, Danny is desperately searching for his missing girlfriend, Maria. His Study and Tamper ability allows him to examine and manipulate crucial items around the environment, giving himself and fellow Victims a better chance at survival!

name: The Secret of Timberland
summary: The secret of Timberland is an adventure horror novel that will immerse you in a dark world full of mysteries and dangers. You have to unravel all of the secrets that Timberland hides and save the main characters from mortal danger. But... can you do it?

name: The 52 Fragments
summary: The 52 Fragments are an experimental, esoteric series of games and experiences. Beginning Nov. 1, 2023, one fragment will be added to the library each week for one year. These games examine themes related to identity, agency, perception, and the creative process.

name: The Castles of Burgundy: Map Pack 1
summary: Map Pack 1 DLC can be purchased to gain 9 new Maps to play. It contains Map 10a-10h and 11. Owning the base game of Castles of Burgundy is needed to play.

name: The Castles of Burgundy: Map Pack 2
summary: The "Map Pack 2" DLC an be purchased to gain 9 new Maps to play. It contains Map 13a-13h and 14. Owning the base game of Castles of Burgundy is needed to play.

name: The Invincible Iron Man: Flight Test
summary: Put Iron Man's shooting skills to the test with flying enemies all around him at once. Finally, you get the high score you want. This Marvel oldie is so addicting!!

name: The Rumble Fish +
summary: The fight for survival has returned.

name: The Mofflys: Invasion Mayhem
summary: Embark with your alien team on an epic quest to invade planet Earth and put the universe back into mayhem! Explore 7 iconic Earth regions filled with secrets, a wide variety of targets and defeat Earths biggest bosses on the battlefield.

name: Thirstchasm
summary: Thirstchasm is a Hack N' Slash lewd furry roguelike, featuring solely animated M/M sex scenes.

name: The Artifacts of Marvelous Birds
summary:
Finally, after 10 years of working on this project, exit1337 is able to present the 3rd (and last) demo of The artifacts of marvelous birds - or short: Taomb

Expect a mysterious adventure through tropical islands, dubious fields, haunted forests and icy areas.
Please keep in mind that the first two worlds are really old, though some parts of levels have been revamped. The great quality of this hack definitely lies within later worlds, so don't quit too soon!
This hack starts out really easy, but gets harder and harder as you progress. World 4 and 5 do get challenging.

name: The First SMW Hack that will Ever be so Lucky as to Gain the Luxury of Leaving My PC
summary: DynastyLobster's first public hack

name: The First Present
summary: For this christmas you want to please your mother with the greatest gift. Gather your courage and explore this uncanny forest to find your objective. But be carefull of your environment, do not loose too much time and find your way back before IT catch you !

name: The Cadet Files: Scene Unseen
summary: Navigate crime scenes in 'The Cadet Files: Scene Unseen', using your tablet to solve puzzles and find hidden objects. Test your detective skills in a world of intrigue! Unravel mysteries, master new challenges, and progress through levels to become a top agent in this thrilling adventure.

name: The Curse of the Egyptian Pyramid: Remaster Edition
summary: A first-person horror game about Egypt. Explore the scary secret of the mysterious pyramid. In order to protect the heroes from danger, the player can use the characters' cameras to see a ghostly entity and anomalies invisible to the human eye.

name: The Caped Crusader
summary: This is an exciting medieval adventure in which the hero, The Caped Crusader, takes on the King's Guard in an effort to give back to the poor the gold coins the King has unfairly collected from poor tenants. The goal of the game is to take as many bags of gold as possible from the King's Guard.

name: The Da Vinci Cryptex 2
summary: Take the challenge again and crack 50 new incredible riddles in the sequel of The Da Vinci Cryptex!

name: Thief: The Black Parade
summary: The Black Parade is an unofficial expansion for Thief Gold and a love letter to Thief: The Dark Project. Shadows and silence are your allies. Light is your enemy. Stealth and cunning are your tools. And the riches of others are yours for the taking.

name: The Void Equation
summary:
30 minutes left until the girl's death...
The Void Equation is a short science fiction visual novel.

name: The Last Soldier of the Ming Dynasty
summary: The Japanese pirates have terrorized the Ming Dynasty for generations. You've devoted your life as a soldier to fighting them.And now you are in their turf, alone with your sword; the last soldier in pirate's land in this 3D-action game inspired by traditional Chinese ink painting landscapes.

name: The Witch's Bakery
summary:
The Witch’s Bakery is a 2D Adventure Puzzle game where you play as a joyful witch who opens a bakery in modern Paris.

She has a special power: she can heal emotions with her bread.

name: The Nefargad
summary: The Nefargad is a thriller, horror, puzzle, and storytelling game that offers a true first-person perspective. The game narrates the story of an archaeologist named Mert, who is kidnapped and imprisoned in a dungeon and his efforts to escape.

name: The Legend of Zelda GBC
summary: A Game Boy Color-styled remake of the original Legend of Zelda for the Nintendo Entertainment System for PC and Linux.

name: The Shaft
summary: Mine ore for the federation, kill monsters in dark caves, protect yourself from radiation, but most importantly, DON'T DIE. Dark caves conceal horrifying abominations. Sell the extracted ore at the safe house and buy new equipment and upgrade your unique weapons.

name: The Phantom Forest
summary: Embark on a perilous journey through the haunting Phantom Forest, where survival meets souls-like combat in an open-world adventure. Face nightmarish creatures, build thriving settlements, and unravel the mysteries of a malevolent force.

name: The Legend of Ogorets 4: Warren
summary: An immersive, barebones-style interactive visual novel with choices, lore, and endgames. Not for the faint of heart.

name: The Black Guards of Odom: Desert Town Prison
summary: You just joined the guards in Odom, a border town full of merchants, travelers, and shady individuals. Soon enough, you'll start climbing the ranks and getting the many perks of a successful career. How far will your ambitions take you?

name: The Last Human: Go!
summary: Jump, jump, don't fall! explore and just go up

name: The Red Beret
summary: This is a story that happened during World War II. As the only survivor of the mission, you need to survive on the island and eliminate the Super Mutants and Nazi Germans

name: Thanatophobia
summary: Thanatophobia is a survival game in a horrific atmosphere, playable solo or in cooperation with a minimum of 2 players and a maximum of 4 players. Escape unscathed, don't get caught, there won't be a second chance.

name: The Emperor and State
summary: This is a turn-based strategy game that simulates the rule of an ancient feudal monarch. It involves the administration, policy adjustment, diplomatic checks and balances, national wars, as well as the emperor's self-cultivation, the cultivation of successors and so on.

name: The Mask Game
summary: Which is worse: a toxic friend or a literal demon?

name: The Descent
summary: The Descent, a horror walking sim in Rockwell Mine, immerses players in miners' harsh life and unsettling mine encounters. Play as an investigator uncovering hometown mysteries

name: The Crimson Maid
summary: As a secret celestial curse takes hold of his father, a young cleric finds himself enraptured by the charms of a strikingly beautiful maid. A period drama that combines romance and murder mystery, with a dash of supernatural.

name: The Diseases, and Casualties this year being 1632
summary: We've got 11 Boom-compatible maps here made by SA goons all based on the image "The Diseases, and Casualties this year being 1632". Each mapper took causes of death and disease from the list below and made levels based on their interpretation of the cause.

name: The Magician's Academy
summary: A PS2 Role-Playing game based on the anime & manga series of the same name.

name: The Andesia Project
summary: Investigate a disturbed solar system in this short, first person horror exploration experience.

name: The Hiker
summary: Photograph the animals and learn about them and their environment.Find the right moment to take a photo of the animals you find. No rush, take this walk at your own pace.Talk to your contacts through your mobile and thus advance the story. Make your own decisions.

name: The Inquisitor: Deluxe Edition
summary: Jesus did not die on the cross, but came down and unleashed vengeance on all the nonbelievers. 1500 years later, an army of Inquisitors brutally enforce the faith. In this dark fantasy adventure you solve intricate cases & unveil abysmal secrets as Inquisitor Mordimer Madderdin.

name: The Fan Game: Back to the Future - Part III: Timeline of Monkey Island
The Inn-Sanity
summary: Early 90s. You stayed in a quiet hotel for just one night and the next morning you’ve found out that the old world was destroyed. Alien dreams, secrets of your past and other guests that are turning into monsters. This hotel will not let you to check out.

name: The Lamplighters League: Isaac
summary: Heat things up in the fight against the Banished Court with Isaac, a new agent who will join your team with a light machine gun - and a hefty grudge!

name: The Lost Nomad
summary: The Lost Nomad is role-playing game (RPG) and (survival system) that made by one solo developer. with an engaging building system and resource management mechanics, chose your own path in the shattered lands.

name: There is Not Really A Name for This Game
The Art of Reflection
summary: The Art of Reflection is a first-person puzzle game where you traverse mirrors as if they were natural extensions of space. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and perform gravity-shifting acrobatics through a sprawling environment as you learn to navigate this world with mastery.

name: The Mermaid Mask
summary: Magnus Mortuga has been killed. The captain of the world's strangest submarine, he was found in a locked room with an ancient stone cauldron - unsealed and opened for the first time. How did he die? Was it a curse? Perhaps one of his eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...

name: The Events at Unity Farm: Magic & Melee
summary: The new update comes with melee combat, spell enhancements, shrines and stability improvements.

name: The Amazing World of Gumball: Fellowship of the Things
summary:
In the Fellowship of the Things game, The Wattersons have to battle some ghosts and monsters in a chase after their stolen belongings. While Tobias was teaching Gumball some fighting moves, the phone rang. A scary voice lets the Wattersons know that their missing stuff is in the cemetery. They have to take their electronics back before their mother arrives home! Can you give them a hand?

Your role is to help Gumball and Darwin defeat the enemies that took their stolen objects and restore them to their place. You will be given clues on what you should do. All you need to do is make sure to follow the instructions carefully. Are you ready for a spooky adventure with the Wattersons?

name: The Fan Game: Back to the Future - Part IV: The Multitasking Crystal
The Fan Game: Back to the Future - Part V: Multidimensional Space-Timelines
The Dabloon Project
summary: An Exploration/Adventure game set in a procedural map. Fight, Explore, and Build to become comfortable with your Dabloon fortune.

name: The Backrooms Regret
summary: Are you prepared to survive in this hostile world? Uncover who you are and how you ended up in this dimension. But don't worry, the warm company that accompanies you will make your experience much "more pleasant". Oh, and good luck, you will need it.

name: The Phoenix Protocol
summary: The Phoenix Protocol is an action-roguelike game set in a cyberpunk world that is easy to learn but hard to master with a focus on complex mechanics with a lot of depth.

name: The Outforce
summary: In the 25th century, humanity fights for survival, having abandoned Earth due to a devastating asteroid impact. They now strive to settle in Epsilon Eridani, a nearby star system. Upon reaching their destination, the colonists find themselves entangled in an unforeseen intergalactic conflict.

name: The Shape of Us
summary: A VR journey that brings you closer to Nature. You’ll use your whole body on the way – prepare to stretch, crawl, rest, dance, feel!

name: The Rise of the Golden Idol
summary: The Award-winning detective saga returns. Uncover the truth behind 20 strange cases of crime, death and depravity in the 1970s. The world has changed dramatically - the sins of humanity have not.

name: Thrasher
summary: Thrasher is a mind-melting cosmic racer and an essential audiovisual experience. Swoop, dash and thrash across the void, taking on wild bosses in a race for survival that begins at the dawn of time.

name: The Casting of Frank Stone
summary: The shadow of Frank Stone looms over Cedar Hills, a town forever altered by his violent past. As a group of young friends are about to discover, Stone’s blood-soaked legacy cuts deep, leaving scars across families, generations, and the very fabric of reality itself.

name: The First Berserker: Khazan
summary: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pelos empire, whom overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

name: The Two Towers
summary:
The Two Towers MUD is a free Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game set entirely within Tolkien's world of Middle-earth, at the time of 'Lord of the Rings'. We have extensively re-created the lands of Middle-earth in a rich text environment, from Mithlond to Mordor and the lands of Harad beyond. With over 100,000 rooms and always growing, The Two Towers is a richly developed and highly interactive world. There are hundreds of quests, with rewards great and small, for you to discover.

The Two Towers has an active community of players from around the world who come together to play online. Players join together to create guilds, raid enemy lands, and more.

Online continuously since 1994, The Two Towers is one of the longest running multiplayer games on the internet and is maintained by a staff of hardworking volunteers who love Tolkien and multiplayer gaming.

name: The Finals: Season 1
summary:
Season 1 was the first season of THE FINALS. It launched along with the game on December 7, 2023, and ended three months later on March 14, 2024.

This season was sponsored by HOLTOW and VOLPE, featuring an all-new arena: Las Vegas.

New content introduced in Season 1 includes:
- Arena: Las Vegas
- New cosmetics
- New Battle Pass
- Weapon: Throwing Knives
- Gadget: Vanishing Bomb
- Game show event: Alien Invasion
- Progression: New career levels

name: The Brimstone Project: Odyssey Live
summary: At The Brimstone Project, you will be tested in various ways. Control drones, find data on target individuals, and gain access to the necessary information. Throughout, you'll be in constant contact with Anna, your contact at the Initiative. Diverse puzzles await you, demanding different skills. But beware: your actions have consequences. Depending on how well you perform, the course of the story will change.

name: The Last of Us Part II Remastered: W.L.F. Edition
summary: The Last of Us Part II Remastered W.L.F. Edition includes steelbook case with full game featuring additional digital content for PS5.

name: The Ratchelor Season 3: Rats in the City
summary: IT’S HERE! 21 new charming rats are ready to woo you. Which one will you choose? The Ratchelor 3: Rats In The City is now online and free!

name: The Eye of Typhoon: Tsunami Edition/Saiki
summary: The Eye of Typhoon: Tsunami Edition/Saiki is a fan-made project aiming to bring The Eye of Typhoon to the platform it was originally developed on, the Neo Geo, and overhaul it.

name: The Inn at Nightfall
summary: Manage an inn for travelers seeking refuge before nightfall. Interact with diverse guests, each harboring their own secrets. Your choices can forge or fracture relationships, uncovering hidden truths along the way. But beware - the real threat may be hiding among your guests.

name: The Bard for Her
summary: A visual novel, dating sim with map exploration. Play a womanizing bard with a lute and romance and build a relationship with five attractive women.

name: Thrilling Stories Collection
summary: Explore the depths of suspense, adventure, and intrigue. Immerse yourself in fascinating worlds, solve captivating mysteries and discover extraordinary stories.

name: The Snare
summary: The Snare is a single-player crime and horror game. Atlas follows clues sent by the killer to rescue his wife Samira. While trying to find out the reason for Samira's kidnapping, he encounters surprising facts.

name: The Milgram Experiment
summary: A first person narrative game, based on one of the most controversial psychological experiments of all time. Step into the shoes of an unwilling subject faced with the toughest moral choice: who lives and who dies. You alone will decide who to kill and who to spare. Please wishlist!

name: The Brilliant Coup
summary: A fun and exciting 2D pixel art point and click adventure game with classic commands. Steal a world-famous brilliant from the best guarded bank in the country.

name: Three Kingdoms: The Last Warlord - Heroes Assemble
summary: 'Heroes Assemble' expansion pack introduces 24 new generals and exclusive sets, allowing players to choose and experience the charm of unique generals at the beginning of the game.

name: The Book of the Dead: Lost Souls
summary:
The Book of the Dead: Lost Souls is immersed in a gloomy atmosphere of horror, which is overflowing with the storyline of the novel. The game is made in the genre of visual storytelling, in which you will observe the events of a young man named Charles and his wife Emily. The heroes inherit a mansion from their uncle, to which a young couple goes. Upon arriving at the place, strange events begin to occur after a while, which will scare the guys and face otherworldly forces.

Users will observe the events taking place with the help of illustrations made in an anime style. The game creates a feeling of gradually escalating suspense, intimidating and arching

name: The Verge Miner

summary: Come savor the peaceful town of Lilygrove in this cute and cozy cooking game based on the beloved book series Redwall by Brian Jacques. The theme of the Jam was lost and this game is all about lost information which you have to piece together. The competition features a 'duck' category. You can find the 'duck' in the fourth audio call. A duck is a British cricket term for no rounds (or points) scored when batting.

summary: The Russian Doll is the sibling game of The Remains of Richard Fletcher.

name: The Dragon, Thyme
summary:
The Dragon, Thyme is a 3D Action Platformer with RPG elements. As a fox-eared adventurer named Paprika, you'll run, jump, and swing through beautiful and treacherous lands along with your dragon companion, Thyme. Defeat the forces of Chaos and collect mystical Hourglasses to bring Order back to the world.

Platforming - Use platforming abilities inspired by classic 3D platformers including, wall running, double jumping, and swinging from your Grapple Sword!

Thyme the Dragon - Fight alongside your constant companion, Thyme the Dragon! Collect shards of the elements themselves from your fallen foes to empower Thyme, allowing them to fight using the powers of fire, water, air, and many more!

Explore - Damaged by the tides of Chaos, the lands surrounding Aromata have become perilous. You and Thyme will need every resource at your disposal to survive! Hidden within the fractured lands and toxic swamps are the relics of Aromata's citizens. By recovering these Trinkets and summoning them back, you'll be able to use their services to upgrade your gear!

The Dragon Thyme is a student project developed by the team at Panda Castle. The game features 9 unique levels to explore and 6 elements, each with type advantages against one another and abilities for Paprika to harness.

name: The Drugstore: Matsumoto Kiyoshi de o Kaimono!
summary:
The Drug Store: Matsumoto Kiyoshi de Okaimono! is a simulation game made by Human in which the player can build his own Drug Store shop. The first is to choose the proper place to do it, since the possible customers will depend of the place chosen to the shop. After building the shop the next step is to choose the proper furnitures and the goods that are going to be sold.

After all that choices the shop will be opened and the game features different announcements to make the shop more known so depending of how much money the player have the publicity will be more effective and bring more customers.

The game features some events like conversations with some people in first person perspective with anime 2d cartoon designs.

name: The D Show
summary: Essentially a Disney version of the You Don't Know Jack series, up to three players play a trivia game show to prove their knowledge of The Walt Disney Company.

name: The Last Revenant
summary:
Made for the 22nd Metroidvania Month Game Jam, The Last Revenant is an atmospheric sci-fi action metroidvania with horror elements, multiple upgrades to collect and a short but engaging story to uncover.

Over 1200 years into the future, the last of a series of faulty cryosleep pods finally collapses open on a faraway lunar outpost. Sombre, a poor soul with little left of their original form, is serving their sentence on a barren moon with no way to call for help. The only possibility of survival lies in an abandoned comms satellite located in low orbit, which they can only reach by collecting items to survive the harsh journey across and beyond the facility. Entrusted with a spare Hookshot, Sombre will have to try and upgrade this tool to cling to salvation.

But what happened to the rest of the research colony, and their bodies..?

name: The Asteroid Field
summary: Asteroids clone for the Apple II.

name: The Anomaly 3: Tower
summary: Latest in digs' Anomaly series featuring trademark mind tricks, map hacks and surprises. Dressed in a medieval/wizard theme with many textures and visual flourishes taken from Arcane Dimensions, for which the map was created.

name: The Slime Sanctuary
summary: A medium sized metal-themed map for Copper

name: The Elektra Complex
summary: Medium sized Metal/Ebon style map.

name: The Journey of Elisa
summary: A patologic game about a term that isn't and should not be used anymore: Asperger

name: The Edge of Forever
summary:
Far across the Dead Sea, beyond the shores of white sand are The Dragon's Teeth--heartless mountains consumed by cold howling winds and separated by valleys of icy fog. Nestled deep within is a small rocky pinnacle upon which rests the palace of The Guardian, the architect of the Vault of Knowledge.

For centuries people have visited the Guardian hoping for blessings and the chance to take the Trial of Knowledge but few have been granted the wish. After many wars and natural disasters the location of The Guardian eventually slipped from people's memories and was lost forever from maps. Only legends remain telling of the trial and the strange machines that seem to crackle with the power of the skies.

For years you have dreamt of finding the Vault and gaining the treasure of the ancients but the mountain paths have just led you round in circles. One day, while searching the northwest mountain peaks, you discovered a hidden trail marked with small piles of stones covered in unusual symbols. Something looks familiar and you suspect you have seen these symbols before in ancient books, but your memory is fading and you are not sure anymore.

After days of walking past countless marker stones, the trail eventually descended from the higher peaks towards a misty valley. Far off in the distance you could see a small hill with what seemed to be a man made structure on the top but you will need to get closer to find out.

The trail leads down into a dense forest shrouded in a thick miasma that chills you to the bone. The boughs creak and groan but there is no wind, just the fog blocking out the light above. Several days pass and eventually the winding trail leads upwards again, out of the mist. You stand before a small ornate building with glass on all sides.

You enter the main door...

name: The Koopa Who Stole Christmas
summary: The Koopa Who Stole Christmas is a Christmas themed community ROM hack of Super Mario 64 DS, made by Hailbot and several contributors. The hack features 10 Main Courses and 1 Side Course.

name: The Apartment
summary:
The Apartment is a short RPG-Maker horror experience, about Joe Malcom, a resident of an apartment. After he receives books from his neighbour, after her husband commited suicide, strange things start to happen. Perhaps the same books offer an explaination on what is happening.

A speciality of the game is, that everything happens in this one room apartment.

name: The Interactive Adventures Of Seymore Butts
summary: The Interactive Adventures of Seymore Butts is an adult full motion video game with basic adventure game elements, although it's more of an interactive story than an adventure. The player takes the role of Mr. Butts as he meets his new attractive neighbor and attempts to romance her.

name: The Quinary Conundrum
summary: This was produced during NaNoWADMo 2023. It is a sequel to The Lost Magic (you may want to play that first!), and is a fair bit harder in difficulty and far more experimental.

name: Thirty Years with Doom
summary: A classic Doom megawad made by level designers at iddqd.ru to celebrate the anniversary of their beloved game. The maps provide a variety of experiences: there are ones authored by newcomers and by experienced mappers, desert cities and snow-covered bases, compact and very large levels. The first episode is based on the original Doom, while the later maps are variations on Doom II-related themes.

name: The Little Eggy That Could
summary: In The Little Eggy That Could, you star as the Easter Egg. As the egg, you must make your way through each level while picking up all of the pieces of candy that there is to collect. After all of the candy has been collected, a Golden Egg will appear somewhere within the level. You must locate and jump into this Golden Egg in order to be teleported to the next level or world.

name: The End
summary: This is The End! You must destroy the space pirates attempting to steal bricks from you defense bases. They will use the bricks to spell out END. The game is lost if all defense bases are destroyed or E-N-D is completed.

name: The DJ-ROM: Da CD-Extra of Hip-Hop Music
summary: The streets of Night City are full of cool sound materials! Make songs in the studio and play them in the club. This is an electric fighting space with a Hip-Hop taste! The game world realistically portrays the life of authentic DJs with 3D graphics. Hone your heart as a DJ while experiencing various events in the city of freedom, opportunity, demonization & violence!

name: The Book of Lulu
summary: The Book of Lulu is an interactive multimedia book by Romain Victor-Pujebet where player can flip the pages to read through and click on various images in the book. Certain images in the book allow for slide changes or result in a small video animation, while others open in full screen mode with ability to interact with them by clicking on a certain area. Interactive images allow changes such as changing the sky, weather, season, colors and mode, while interactive videos let you interact with objects and characters which result in a short FMV sequence.

name: The Complete Carriers at War
summary:
This bundle contains the original 1992 strategy game Carriers at War, its expansion Construction Kit, and its 1993 sequel Carriers at War II.

Additionally, The Complete Carriers includes 30 new scenarios covering the North Atlantic and Mediterranean theaters of the Second World War.

name: The Princess Cliche
summary: The Princess Cliche is an episode for Super Mario Bros. X game and its branches. This is the second episode that was released alongside Super Mario Bros. X 1.1.0 Beta 1.

name: The Lost Key
summary: The task before you is very big, but you are not one of those who give up, it is your time, get up and move and retrieve the key.

name: The Suite Life of Zack & Cody: Pizza Party Pickup!
summary: This time, the twins have to work together to beat Maddie and London on a quest to throw the best pizza party of the summer. The hotel can seem like a maze sometimes, which is why the kids need your help! Navigate the hallways, and collect all the pizza, snacks, and cool stuff needed for an epic party.

name: The Suite Life of Zack & Cody: Maddie's Snack Encounter
The Inheritance
summary:
Having learned of the Courier's exploits, a dying man contacts the player in hopes of employing him/her to deliver a mysterious package. Upon accepting the job, the Courier will soon find himself/herself making unwilling allies and dangerous enemies, all jockeying to claim the same prize.

The Inheritance is a compact, lore-friendly quest mod for Fallout New Vegas, designed to offer new avenues to experience combat and role-playing for high-level characters.

name: The Better Angels
summary: The Better Angels is a small quest mod that is intended to wrap up various plot threads from the Someguy Series. It includes elements and characters from planned but now-cancelled projects like Sinners and Slaves and The Siege of Firebase Zulu. It is a lean project that I produced in a few weeks, so it is free of side quests and the usual array of dialogue options. It is tight and relatively brief, but it should provide a greater sense of closure for several characters and the series as a whole.

name: The Apple of Our Time
summary: An indie RPG where you need to aim your attacks.

name: The Cat Scheduled Oil Sampling Game
summary:
In this game you control a bulldozer that rides around and pushes dirt.
Each dirt pile represents a "job". To keep from exploding you have to send in oil Samples to the cat dealership, then you will be told if the oil is good or bad. If you fail to do this occasionally your oil will go bad and you bulldozer will explode. To clean the oil you have to go to the cat dealership. You might also need some repair !
The goal of the game is to make the most money from finishing "jobs".

name: The Captcha Game
summary:
Welcome to "The Captcha Game" – Where completing a verification is the game itself.
Don't worry, it'll only take a few seconds.
So... Are you a Human?

name: The Game Maker
summary:
The Game Maker is the 18th game in the Carol Reed series.

The game is 100% mouse driven and features a classic adventure game interface.
There is absolutely no need to have played any of the previous games in the Carol Reed series to fully enjoy The Game Maker.

The game takes place is Sweden, but it is in English. All dialogues have subtitles.
The game contains no graphic violence or any swearing. It has no action elements, and is suitable for ages 15 and up.

name: The Day of Sagittarius III
summary: The Day of Sagittarius III is a strategy shooter game in space based on the fictional one featured in Haruhi Suzumiya. In this version, the player has to complete missions by destroying enemies using five fleets.

name: The Idolmaster
summary:
The Idolmaster is a popular Japanese rhythm and simulation game that focuses on the management and training of virtual pop idols. Developed by Namco (later Bandai Namco Entertainment), the game places players in the role of a producer working with a talent agency to nurture and guide aspiring idols towards stardom, and the first title in the 1st Vision era.
It was released as the second installment of the "Rewritable Stage" touchscreen cabinet.

name: The Mummy
summary:
The Mummy is an action game with puzzle elements based on the movie of the same name. The plot basically centers on an Egyptian priest who was mummified in his time and later resurrected in 1926. Now he threatens to destroy the world.

It concentrates on exploring tombs and getting the artifacts inside. In most of the 46 levels, the player has access to three protagonists with different abilities: Evelyn can transport items and jump high, Rick can shoot with his pistols to kill enemies or use a sniper rifle to hit far away switches and Jonathan can use explosives. Each of the characters has their own life bars and the player can switch instantly between them. It is necessary to put all three characters to good use to solve the puzzles and platforming challenges the game offer. It is possible to bring a level to an unwinnable state, but there is a function to reset the level without penalty.

name: The VHS Paradise
summary: You are Robert, the cashier from The VHS Paradise. Your job is to serve customers on the night shift, but be careful! There is a lot of crime in the city and all kinds of crazy people on the loose.

name: The Darkness
summary: An upcoming remaster/port of the Darkness (2007) video game, confirmed by Stephen Kick, the CEO of Nightdive Studios.

name: The Mystic Realm
summary: A level pack for Sonic Robo Blast 2 with over 30 stages and many secrets to unlock. Famed for being one of the oldest SRB2 mods.

name: The Bugs
summary: The Bugs is a new look at the genre as tower defense. It's a colorful action game with a top view of the small meadow in the grass, mire or sand, which is gradually overgrown with harmful and dangerous flowers, mushrooms or thorns.

name: The 3rd Night
summary: The 3rd Night was a short 3D experiment made in Construct 2 (using the Q3D plugin). It was made in around 15 days, just in time for the Haunted PS1's Horrifying Halloween game jam.

name: The Bet
summary:
The game is divided into 5 levels. The protagonist will have to climb the 5 highest mountains in Italy for a bet. But his fierce opponent will make sure that he doesn't win by throwing him anything and everything. Moreover, he has installed sharp obstacles and just touching them is certain death.
Fatigue will be felt, and to recover the lost energy, during the journey there will be water bottles that will restore it (only one notch at a time).

name: The F.A. Premier League Football Manager 2002
summary: The F.A. Premier League Football Manager 2002 is a Sports game, published by Electronic Arts, which was released in Europe in 2001.

name: The Lost Signal: SCP
summary:
"Lost Signal" agency investigates paranormal events from all around the world. You are one of the agents who participates in the research of various artifacts. Investigate paranormal activities in this 3D game which has great action and elaborate 3D graphics!

Interesting quests and creepy monsters await you! New artifacts or paranormal events in every update!

name: The Daily Diff
summary: A spot the difference game which updates the puzzle daily. Each image contains 10 differences, with some obvious and others more hidden.

name: The Sims Medieval: Limited Edition
summary: This version of the Sims Medieval adds three themed throne rooms with Barbarian, Dark Magic and Princess themes as well as the Monarch and Executioner outfit sets.

name: The Man Man
summary: Be a serial killer, with no bones tho.

name: The Respawn Banter
summary: The Respawn Banter is an adventure and visual novel hybrid where you are bound to die during your exploration. In the afterlife, the goddess of life’s role extends beyond mere revival: she seizes every opportunity to humor the hero’s demise, making each encounter a one-of-a-kind witty exchange.

name: The Aids Avenger
summary: The Aids Avenger is an unreleased educational game by Raya Systems for the SNES and PC. The game was made to teach kids about AIDS and HIV awareness.

name: The Pay is Nice
summary: Discover what happens in an ultra secure facility, as you get ready for work and wander the dark halls of your office. Using old school fixed-camera perspective, they're watching your every moves.

name: Thrillville
summary:
Experience Thrillville originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Thrillville allows gamers of all ages to easily build and customize the coaster of your dreams. Gone are the days of the complex PC techniques used in other coaster games. Rather, Thrillville's easy to use building mode has been designed specifically for the console platforms and makes building all 75-plus rides from wooden, corkscrew and inverted coasters to merry go rounds, trains and carnival rides, easy, and most importantly, fun. Imagination is the only height limit with Thrillville, where the fun ranges from racing on go-kart tracks you put together and playing mini-golf on courses you designed to dozens of party games, from bumper cars to arcade shoot-'em-ups. You can also tour the park on foot - a first for theme-park titles - chatting and joking with all the guests to help them out and make sure they're enjoying themselves.

• Build, manage, ride, customize and socialize your way through the five theme parks you've created
• The simplest, most intuitive development tools available for all 75-plus ride types, from wooden, corkscrew and inverted coasters to merry-go-rounds, trains and all your favorite carnival rides
• Play classic midway games like bumper cars, saucer soccer, remote-control cars, shooting gallery, mini-golf, rhythm challenges, arcade-style shoot- em-ups and puzzlers
• Interact and develop a relationship with any guests you see - Listen to and address their unique concerns about your park, joke with them, and even help a guest impress his crush by winning that special prize
• Explore 15 different themed areas spread across five theme parks, such as Pirates Gone Wild, Gold Rush, Ancient Treasures of Egypt and Moon Base

name: Thrillville: Off the Rails
summary:
A port of Thrillville: Off the Rails, originally released on the PlayStation Portable system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Thrillville: Off the Rails is a theme park simulation game developed by Frontier Developments and originally released in 2007. Players design and manage amusement parks while also riding attractions and playing mini-games. The game allows roller coasters to be built with fewer restrictions, encouraging more experimental designs. A story-driven campaign features characters and challenges set across different themed parks

name: The Void Between
summary: When one man's dream holiday turns into a nightmare, it's up to you save him from himself... VOID is an FMV style puzzle game that leads you through a labyrinth of mysterious challenges and puzzling obstacles. Can you uncover the keys that will unlock your freedom, or seal your fate...

name: The Tour
summary: The Deepening solar system tour is incoming and Jon and his band need to get back in sync. Join them on a tour around the country as they learn their new songs, rock the crowd, and build up the hype for their spacefaring tour.

name: The Tale of (Your Name)
summary: Embark on a procedurally generated dungeon, make choices to craft your own narrative. Select your hero and confront monsters, solve puzzles, and make decisions that shape your unique story as you play.

name: The Street 10
summary: Caught in an infinite alley, look for Street 10 to find your way out.

name: The Skirmish
summary: Fight in online battles for one of two teams or play with bots.

name: The Seven Betrayers
summary: This is a pixelated casual action game, the adventure of finding the seven betrayers, in which you collect the fruits of plants to strengthen yourself, defeat monsters to find the betrayers, and finally leave this continent for a new world!

name: The Road of Heroes
summary: A game for rapidly shaping heroes, featuring randomized equipment attributes and combat maps. After leveling up, you can customize attribute enhancements and learn skills of your choice, with the goal of defeating bosses upon entering combat.

name: Thousands of Heroes
summary: This game is a roguelike where item management is crucial. Since almost all items have a limited number of uses, the choice of whether to use or save each item becomes important. You can also cooperate with other users by sharing dungeon IDs!

name: Thin Way
summary: Thin Way is an exciting platformer that combines parkour and intense fights. You are an experienced traceur in a world where towering skyscrapers, crowded high-rises, and abandoned buildings create a unique playground for your art. No opponent will halt you and no obstacle will slowdown your path

name: They Who Dwell Below
summary: They Who Dwell Below is an exploration horror game set within the crumbling ruins of a lost dwarven city. The player is tasked with escaping the long abandoned vestige and along the way uncovering the truth of its fall. But be wary, spirits are not all that haunt these ancient halls.

name: They Came From Venus
summary: You are alone at your uncles remote mountain estate, when a mysterious package gets delivered to his doorstep. Soon after, things get out of hand and the house becomes your last bastion of survival.

name: The Valley of the Architects
summary: A puzzle game, narratively grounded around architecture, adventure and elevators. Follow architectural writer Liz on a journey through Africa to uncover the secrets of a lost and forgotten Architect. Using your problem solving skills, overcome each puzzle and slowly unwrap the story of a lifetime.

name: The World Has Gone
summary: The World Has Gone—a fast-paced zombie shooter couch-co-op game!

name: The Moon 2044
summary: Explore a secret NCIS facility and discover its dark secret. Take on the role of the XV-11 unit and face hundreds of enemies in a dark sci-fi shooter inspired by old school hits!

name: The Cost Of Bliss
summary: Force to spend a month in a psych ward to cure your addiction, you fight yourself going through painful levels of withdrawal. To cope, you make friends with a man who helps ease your pain, in exchange for unsettling favours.

name: That's a Warp
summary: A tiny sokoban browser game with a warp mechanic.

name: The Last Starfighter
summary: A game based on the homonymous movie. It was cancelled on all three platforms, but was rebranded and released for the Atari 8-bit as Star Raiders II.

name: The Tower
summary: Climb an impossible tower.

name: The Mouth Of The Woods
summary: Search for a friend missing in the woods.

name: The Best of Microsoft Entertainment Pack
summary:
A trimmed-down port of "The Best of Microsoft Entertainment Pack" for PC, including the following titles:

- FreeCell
- LifeGenesis
- Minesweeper
- SkiFree
- TicTactics
- TriPeaks
- Tut's Tomb

name: Three Kingdoms Chronicle
summary: A real-time strategy game based on the history of the Three Kingdoms. The player can experience the fun of conquering cities, directing the country, and ultimately ending the Three Kingdoms disputes and uniting the world through their own efforts in the simulated historical background of the game!

name: The Legend of Liu Bei of the Three Kingdoms
summary: It's a traditional turn-based Japanese RPG! The game starts with the "Liu Bei" Yellow Turban Uprising, goes through the battle of Chibi, collects Xichuan, and ends with the end of the world as the story line... The overall gameplay is about 20 hours!

name: The Hundredth Floor
summary:
You and your sister get stuck inside of a VRMMO where if you die in-game, you die in real life.

Your goal is to get to the 100th floor and get out of the game alive.

So far the game has character customization, a party system with npcs, combat, a unique inventory system that requires the use of a wardrobe, a housing system, a cooking system, being able to take jobs and a stat points system.

name: The Basement
summary: You are locked in the dark basement of a mad professor: Alone with a horrible monster. Can you escape this nightmare in just 5 days?

name: The Bonerooms
summary: The Bonerooms is a goofy horror-themed multiplayer game about surviving in a living maze while being pursued by skeletons. Last one standing wins!

name: The Big Blue
summary: A rouge top-down bullet screen shooting game

name: The Deepwater Witch
summary:
"What wish would you ask the witch to grant?"

In a world ruined by pollution, the oceans have swallowed the lands. Ramil is a scavenger, a lowlife who digs through the trash littering his once idyllic hometown. One day he finds a mysterious girl on the beach. She can't speak, and she says that she doesn't remember where she came from. When Ramil meets her, he is dragged into a surreal dreamscape...but are they dreams or delusions?

As the mysteries surrounding the girl's identity unravel, Ramil is forced to answer a question: What price is he willing to pay to be happy?

name: The Trickster's Domain
summary: M.C. Escher's Relativity was providing the theme and it's featured prominently in the main area of the map. There is also a progression in which certain areas are only accessible with a certain weapon, similar to what the Metroid games are known for.

name: The Dismal Silhouette
summary: Single player map for Quake, using the Arcane Dimensions mod. Based on E2M6: The Dismal Oubliette, by John Romero.

name: The God Heroes
summary: The God Heroes is a 2.5D metroidvania filled with challenges and intense combat. You play as Fezuki, a warrior searching for his lost memories, destined to become a Guardian and protect the universe from the Entity of Darkness.

name: The Ripper
summary: The Ripper is a canceled video game created by Visceral Games intended for release on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. The game was set in the 19th century and was to have the player assume the role of Jack the Ripper, an unidentified murderer who was active in that time.

name: The Music Machine
summary: In this game, you play as Stevie and Nancy. The Music Machine moves back and forth at the top of the screen, dropping symbols that represent good qualities (Fruits of the Spirit). You have to catch these in you basket. Once you have caught one of each of the other symbols, then the heart (representing love) comes down. You MUST catch the heart to end the round and go to the next round. If you miss the heart, you lose a life. Just under the Music Machine is Mr. Pims. He tries to mess you up by dropping down his assistants, the Pudgeons. If you catch a Pudgeon, you lose a life.

name: The King is Watching
summary: The King is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder. Rule by the power of your royal gaze! Decide between producing resources, training armies, or balancing both, while adapting to unique events every run.

name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

name: The Vambrace of Destiny
summary: A light dungeon crawl. Tap spell gems to defeat monsters!

name: The Backrooms
summary: The survivors have noclipped out of reality and are now trapped in the Backrooms. Now all you have to do is survive because you are not alone...

name: The Privacy
summary: The fifth game released by Gotmail. The player must escape an office.

name: The Mandela Experience
summary: Experience The Horrors From Mark's Perspective In This Short Visual Novel RPG Maker Game

name: The Great Sea Battle
summary: The Great Naval Battle is a traditional naval combat strategy that probably everyone knows, but in a 3D computer format.

name: This House Is Not A Home
summary: The week was rough, work was exhausting, and your husband did his best to set something nice up for you to come home to. Relax, embrace and enjoy the rest of your life weekend.

name: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire
summary: Rule the night, become the city's boss! Manage your own nightclub, explore the dazzling nightlife, and stand against rival gangsters. Walk the fine line between the business world and the criminal underworld, dealing with corrupt police and authorities

name: The Clockwork Prince
summary: The game follows Ian, a clockwork robot whose job is to repair the great clock tower in which humanity resides after a great tragedy forced them to seek shelter within its walls. After finishing up his repairs for the day, Ian heads home and meets with a mysterious robed figure.

name: The Legend of Zelda: The Wheel of Fate
summary: The game follows the epic story of Din, last daughter of the dying Goddess Tribe. Her tribe alone knows the truth of Hyrule's past, that Ganon, Zelda and Link are locked into an endless cycle of reincarnation, dooming Hyrule to continual recurring war. Din can break the cycle by finding and rejoining the three pieces of the broken triforce. Unfortunately, they are contained within the living bodies of Ganon, Zelda and Link, and the only way to get them out is to kill all three of them. Din must also find her two sisters, Nayru and Farore, who have gone out into Hyrule and never returned, for they hold the key to defeating the mysterious force that has kept the Goddesses from saving their world.

name: The Legend of Zeldo: Lonk's Awakening DX
summary: Prince Zeldo's been kidnapped... again. Looks like a job for Lonk, the Heroine of Thyme! Grab your sword and... oh, you forgot it at home? Uh, that's fine. Probably.

name: The Cookie Project
summary:
The holidays are a busy time for the tiny bakery you run in the Last City, and you're used to all kinds of unique customers frequenting your shop during these days. What you didn't expect was a handsome awoken—a guardian no less—carrying a strange contraption and sheepishly requesting your help with his... holiday baking?! In the midst of winter's dreary cold, the blossoms of friendship (or romance ) may soon yet bloom!

The Cookie Project is a Destiny 2 fangame in which you can romance or befriend Vanade's Guardian OC, Cepheus, but the game has been made accessible and enjoyable for non-Destiny players too!

name: The Snow Queen is Uncool
summary: It's winter solstice, and Berta should be out there doing her job as an arbiter of mortals, but she prefers to laze around at home instead. This terrible character flaw has almost led to her disappearing from humanity's radar! On her own, she'll have no idea how to fix this... Thankfully, her loyal, brilliant, enterprising and very humble manager knows just the way to save her from obscurity.

name: The Yanus Plan for Escape from the Void
summary: "The Yanus Plan for Escape from the Void" is a first person perspective escape room game where you lose your memory and don't know where you are. You have to keep moving forward and explore the truth.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Gold Road
summary: A forgotten Daedric Prince has returned, bringing chaos to West Weald! Explore a new zone and defend the city of Skingrad, now beset by a dangerous Daedric cult and the jungles of Valenwood. Customize your skills like never before with the new Scribing system.

name: The Hole in Blueblack Lake
summary:
The Hole in Blueblack Lake is a text-based weird fiction fishing game for pen, paper, and your computer. The game is primarily played on your computer but there are additional play elements that you can write on paper/digitally.

Catalog uncanny biologies. Breathe cold lake air. Roll dice to catch fish. Enjoy it while it lasts.

name: The Adventures of Panzer: Legacy Collection
summary: Enter the epic and ridiculous world of General Panzer

name: They Know
summary: Uncover the dirty secrets of the government and reveal the truth to the world.

name: The World of War II: Frontlines of History
summary: Step into the pages of history and embark on an extraordinary journey through the tumultuous landscapes of the World of War II in our immersive gaming experience - The World of War II: Frontlines of History.

name: The Gardener Simulator: Plant, Grow, Decorate, Build Sim
summary: Cultivate Your Imagination, Harvest Your Dreams – Dive into the Botanical Bliss of The Gardener Simulator!

name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Personal Boards 1
The Tender Cut
summary: The Tender Cut is a first person interactive installation/exploration game inspired by the "Il etait une fois" scene from Luis Bunuel's movie "Un Chien Andalou". It invites the viewer/player to dive into a surreal atmosphere, sharing the character's experience.

name: The Red Room
summary: Discover the secret intimacy of a couple in the infamous Red Room. Enjoy this jigsaw puzzle game with awesome HD renders!

name: The First Mine

name: The400 Mini
summary:
Atari brings the computer age home. Again. Welcome back to the Atari 8 bit world of computing.
The powerful Atari 400 set a new standard of capability with its release in 1979, and along with its subsequent models, has been loved by gamers and computer enthusiasts for decades.
Now Retro Games and Atari have collaborated to create THE400 Mini. A half-sized version of the distinctively styled Atari 400, emulating the whole 8-bit Atari range from the 400 to the 800XL, and the Atari 5200 home console.
Also included is a recreation of the classic Atari CX40 joystick, with an additional seven seamlessly integrated function buttons.
Play one of the 25 built-in games, including: Lee, Berzerk, Millipede, Miner 2049er, M.U.L.E, Star Raiders II, and save your progress at any point in one of four save slots per game, or even pause and rewind gameplay to help you through the most difficult parts - a feature new to THE400 Mini.
The multi-region THE400 Mini features HD visuals output via HDMI and with five USB ports, you can connect additional controllers or a standard PC keyboard.
And as with all Retro Games releases you are free to play content you own via a USB flash drive, and learn to program in BASIC. Whether you're a seasoned veteran or a newcomer to the world of retro computing, THE400 Mini has something to offer.

Make your way over the collapsing ice sheet by jumping, sliding, and climbing. Reach abandoned research stations and gather data in a series of mini-games. Analyze the data and uncover what is happening to the climate.

The Tipping Point is developed in collaboration with real world researchers in an interdisciplinary effort (physicists, biologists, chemists, statisticians, and more). The things you do in The Tipping Point are based on what researchers do in the arctic in real life.

As researchers do, you will compare the data you collect to previous data sets and investigate changes in the climate.
