name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Personal Boards 3
The Battle of Embers
summary: Embark on an epic journey in a high fantasy RPG defense multiplayer survival game that thrusts you into a mystical world of ancient spells, legendary creatures, and intense battles. As a hero, your mission is to defend against hordes of fantastical foes in a desperate quest for survival.

name: The Trip
summary: Dive into the mysterious and mind-bending world of The Trip. Embark on a surreal journey as a protagonist with no memory, exploring a psychedelic landscape filled with otherworldly portals, and hidden truths. Uncover your true identity in this immersive and visually stunning adventure.

name: The Island
summary: O maior desafio em the island é sobreviver. Tudo quer que você morra - seja a vida selvagem da ilha ou outros habitantes,Faça o que for preciso para sobreviver.

name: The Human Fly
summary: You have to climb to the top of a many-storied building evading obstacles like window cleaners, police men or birds.

name: The Mystery of Mount Fang
summary: This is a vanilla-compatible four map mini WAD titled "The Mystery of Mount Fang". After enjoying your "vacation", you're hired by an anonymous benefactor to go hiking in Mount Fang, a huge mountain located in Hell. Your mission: To gather information and clues about about a long extinct civilisation that apparently worshipped a guardian spirit taking on the appearance of a huge shark. But you have a suspicion that the thing who hired you knows more about this place than they let on...

name: The Cursed Legacy
summary: The Cursed Legacy is a supernatural investigation set in a dark and mysterious atmosphere. Keep calm and solve the riddles to unravel this strange disappearance. But be careful, you're not alone!

name: The Tower of Archeos
summary: Climb the tower of archeos and kill the evil sorcerer. An enhanced version was later released for itch.io and Steam.

name: Thome Wake
summary: An indie horror first-person game where you are in control of a streamer who learns from his viewers about Pisadeira, a demon/monster from Brazilian folklore. In disbelief, when he sleeps, Pisadeira doesn't allow him to wake up, leaving him stuck in his nightmare, and he has to figure out a way to leave, and finally wake up

name: The Way Home: A Typing Adventure
summary: Type your way through monsters and obstacles to help Emily find her way home in 'The Way Home: A Typing Adventure'. With four difficulty levels and powerful rune attacks, this game tests your typing skills in a captivating world of mystery and wonder.

name: The Ascension of the Lamb
summary: A "Retro PBR" game about a mysterious cult that disappeared in the early 90s.

name: Thunder Force AC
summary: Thunder Force AC is a port of Thunder Force III to Arcades that also borrows enemies and stages from the earlier Thunder Force II, as well as adding some original content.

name: Thunder Force II
summary:
A scrolling shooter and sequel to Thunder Force developed by Technosoft originally released for the X68000 computer before being ported to the Sega Mega Drive/Genesis game console.

The Sharp X68000 version has an introduction sequence and an extra stage (top and side view) not found in the Sega Mega Drive/Genesis version.

name: The 15th Floor
summary: Built by a team of adventure-game lovers, The Fifteenth Floor is an adventure game featuring original character art, 3D models, and music. The game (developed by MindWave) has been 5 months into production, and is nearing completion. It has been inspired by games such as Myst, Crimson Room and Phoenix Wright.

name: The Transporter
summary: Guide the tricked-out BMW to the Eiffel Tower completing Frank's latest job as the transporter. Five collisions and the BMW is toast.

name: The Shell Part II: Purgatorio
summary: Detective Reiji Tokisaka is back to face down a mystery that spans decades if not centuries. With the aftermath of his last case weighing on his soul and a long-silent cult resurgent, can he solve the crime—or will it become his curse?

name: The Last Sorrow
summary:
"Wake up, Young Sorrow..."

You are the Last of the Sorrow, a small group of humans living on the brink of extinction in a harsh and dangerous world that your kind once ruled over.

Fight your way out of the Ancient Fortress in which you have been held prisoner for so long. Escape the Prison and find the other Sorrows...

"There is much to do..."

name: The Twilight Witch
summary: The Twilight Witch is a 2D pixel art RPG where you play as Mael, a young man from the village of New Larton. After your home-town is attacked and ravaged by a mysterious figure, you venture forth to tell of what happened and maybe, just maybe, find a way to stop the hooded aggressor…

name: The Last Rose
summary: Kuri Rose was dead, until she wasn't. Now she stands in defiance to a world that is slowly disappearing in this apocalypse adventure visual novel.

name: The Bit's Escape
summary: Bit's is a small machine built in a underground factory, his dream is to escape and discover life beyond what is below the earth.

name: The house of the missing hands
summary: A first person flat/VR survival horror game where you have to escape the dark farm where you are being kept against your will after finding out the package you were delivering contained a human hand. Use stealth to avoid The hand collector while unraveling the reason he collects hands.

name: The Return of the King
summary: This game tests hands-on ability and brain thinking.

name: The August Before
summary: The August Before is a meditative narrative 3D puzzle about cleaning up, sorting out and packing up your life before moving on. Clean up and don’t forget your old belongings on your way to the new life!

name: The Quantum Conflict
summary: Jump into action-packed space dogfights with up to 8 players (or AI's) locally or over Remote-Play-Together. Use outlandish sci-fi weapons, including the wormhole maker and time altering munitions while avoiding asteroids, wormholes, planet gravity, and other hazards.

name: The Incredible Shrinking Character
summary: An cancelled action-adventure game that was developed by Go-Go Interactive Studios and Cyberdreams studios, taking inspiration the novel/film The Incredible Shrinking Man, and is set in a universe reminiscent of 1950's science-fiction and horror movies. The player would have controlled a private investigator looking for a wealthy young woman named Julia Caldwell, who vanished after visiting the castle of a mad scientist named Dr. Warren Franklin, who would use a shrinking ray on the hero. The gameplay would have had the hero venturing through Dr. Franklin's castle, fighting dangers such as animals and heights along the way, of which grow smaller and smaller after each level.

name: The Forever Winter
summary: The Forever Winter is a co-op tactical survival horror shooter where you and your squad must loot the dead to survive under the shadow of terrifying and gargantuan war machines locked in a never-ending conflict.

name: The New Denpa Men
summary:
Scour radio waves for the Denpa Men: small creatures that call these invisible signals their home.

The New Denpa Men is a free-to-play RPG where you can collect these Denpa Men for your party and adventure with them as your companions. In addition to the main adventure, you can decorate your island, fish, participate in limited-time events, and play against other players.

name: The Hokkaido Serial Murder Case: The Okhotsk Disappearance - Memories in Ice, Tearful Figurine
summary:
The legendary Okhotsk Disappearance... is coming back.

A Nipopo doll sheds a tear—another soul is sheds its mortal coil.
One morning, a man's body is found floating in the Tokyo bay.
He's estimated to be in his forties.
But the incident doesn't stop here. It moves to Hokkaido's cities: Kushiro, Abashiri, Shiretoko, Monbetsu...
A second and third murder link the northern island to Tokyo.

The Okhotsk Disappearance is a graphic adventure game where you play as a police detective.
Your job is to find the truth behind the serial murders with the help of your subordinates.
To do so, you have a command interface with 14 actions, such as "Change Location" and "Ask someone".

name: The Projet Poulet
summary: Help the brave chicken go through dozens of interesting puzzle levels where you must show wit and make timely decisions.

name: The Reason for Your Smile
summary: A visual novel telling the story of Shun Kousaka, a college student starting into a new chapter of his life. Experience and decide his journey through the perils of love as you work towards achieving his biggest dream: Getting a girlfriend!

name: The Corridors
summary: Unravel sanity's edge in The Corridors. Hop, solve, survive – or feed the shadows.

name: The Devil's Typist
summary: Random and endless typing game with rich elements and items.

name: The Lancaster Leak: Entity Exam
summary: Another tape has been leaked, this time a recording of a training protocol. By answering questions and resisting jumpscares, can you beat the Entity Exam?

name: The Sims 4: Crystal Creations
summary: Craft dazzling jewelry and give your creations a spark of power with The Sims 4 Crystal Creations Stuff Pack.

name: The Last Explorer
summary:
Discover an alien world, study and befriend creatures and take beautiful photos along the way.

Explore an open world full of creatures to learn more about, find all the wreckage from your spaceship and use your camera to learn more about the creatures, the world and how you got there.

Throughout your journey you'll be able to do quests for the aliens or just play minigames with them.

Use your camera to take beautiful photos and analyze your environment. Throughout your journey you'll find new effects to take even better and more unique photos.

There are many different creatures you can study, photograph and befriend. Photograph them to learn more and use bait to befriend and ride them.

Find out how your ship crashed and what happened to the other astronauts by exploring the island and photographing the wreckage to analyze it and learn more.

The Last Explorer features:
- A beautiful open world you can explore any way you want
- Complex creatures to study and befriend
- Small side quests
- A highly customizable camera system
- Many interesting camera effects
- Old spaceship wreckage to learn more about
- A mystery to uncover
- Land, Air and Water creatures
- Xbox controller support

name: The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0
summary: The Jackbox Party Quintpack 2.0 is a collection of 25 fan-favorite Jackbox games from Party Packs 6-10 for one low price. It's great for game nights with friends, family get-togethers, and more! And there's no special equipment required - your internet-connected device is your controller.

name: They Need To Be Fed 3
summary:
360 degree gravity platforming is back! Run, jump, collect, avoid enemies and feed yourself to the monster at the end!

"They Need To Be Fed" is a platformer game in which you can walk in all directions: 360 degree gravity ensures you can never fall off. The series has received very positive reviews so far, and is even bigger now!

name: The Penjikent Creature
summary: The Penjikent Creature is a terrifying, short horror experience inspired by the real-life Penjikent Murals in Tajikistan.

name: The Present
summary: A Short Horror Game about receiving Presents on Christmas! However, the presents may not be pleasant...

name: The Life We've Chosen
summary: A melancholy but hopeful visual novel about a person choosing how to deal with their demons, both inner and external.

name: The Machine
summary: Discover the mysteries of "Living Machine"... "It is the year 1887, you and your wife Nina have been invited to Lord Harris's feast, which was going to happen inside of his manor at the countryside of Norfolk. The main person of that event, Lord Harris of Norfolk, was widely regarded as an eccentric and odd engineer due to his researches on steam powered machines and engines. On that night, 19th of October 1887, after several hours of feasting you felt drunk. You made your way to your guest room, you've laid on the floor and fell asleep... " What's waiting for you after you wake up? Or will you ever wake up?

name: The World Ends With You: Live Remix
summary:
Made for the GREE mobile/web network, The World Ends with You: Live Remix is a touch-oriented game inspired by Square Enix's bold Shibuya-based RPG. In the game, players compete in teams to combat the Noise around Shibuya. It was officially shut down on February 28, 2014.

Players had to find and defeat Ringleader Noise, the main enemies of the game. At the beginning of the week, the Players were assigned into groups of 20. The player would have to work with their team to defeat the Ringleader Noise for the week to achieve victory.

Coco Atarashi was a new Reaper introduced in LIVE Remix, becoming the player's guide throughout the game as they explore Shibuya.

The battle system is similar to that of The World Ends with You and The World Ends with You -Solo Remix-, but uses a portrait display orientation instead of a landscape orientation.

name: The Yokai's Curse
summary: Explore a town with little creatures and ghosts in order to rid yourself of a curse.

name: The Need to Live
summary:
A manor in the countryside stands resolute against the elements, protecting its occupants rain or shine.

Henri and Julien, its vampiric occupants, aren't weathering so well, however.

Centuries of life has left one numb and the other with crushing guilt.

When Adeline arrives mysteriously on their front step, it's up to her to find a middle ground while navigating her own set of challenges.

name: The Bike: Moto Ride Simulator
summary: Rev up your adventure.Experience the thrill of the open road in the ultimate motorcycle escapade.

name: The Last of Us Part III
summary: The rumoured sequel of the critically acclaimed game, The Last Of Us.

name: The Attic
summary:
Derrek lives with his mother, his father, is said to still be serving the country making some sort of medicine that can heal a human being via drinking some sort of substance. Derrek has never been allowed past the second floor, where his bedroom is, his fathers workshop takes up everything from the third floor, and The Attic.

The story begins with Derrek reminiscing about his past, when him and his father used to sit on the deck outside of his bedroom as a young child. Derrek realizes, now that he is almost ready to make a family, and move into his own mansion, he should find out what is going on, and why his dad has been missing for 16 years, and why his mother has never said anything.

The player (you) begins the story when Derrek comes to this realization, and must continue through the adventure, revealing secrets of a family secret, that will forever tear him apart, so long as nothing tears him apart first.

name: Thunder Ray: Forgotten Duels
summary: Thunder Ray is Arcade-Boxing, Retro-like gameplay with blood and violence. Defeat all the best fighters in the galaxy to become the GOAT of the universe.

name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Deluxe Edition
There's a Duck Behind You!
summary: A virtual reality action game.

name: The Mask behind the Dream: Kapitel 1
summary: Available in German only.

name: The Dark Thicket
summary: You're the village swordcat, and you're gunna save your friends. A retro 3D adventure game with a unique minimalist aesthetic.

name: The World Is Really Right!
summary: This is a game made of rpg maker mv! A classic jrpg! Bring together people with different world views and backgrounds and meet here! There are swords and magic, infinite magic, bullets and fire, all kinds of fancy things, science and technology, ancient and endless unknown things here!

name: Three Kingdoms Battle Chess
summary: This is a game that combines the style of the Three Kingdoms and Hearthstone Tavern Battle Chess. It has six game modes, over 700 generals, over 100 bonds, over 300 skills, over 80 treasures, troops, formations, items, and operations. It is a must-have for fans of the Three Kingdoms.

name: Threshold
summary: Threshold is a short, dark and atmospheric First Person Exploration game picturing disturbing facts about an untold brutal story. Pick your country, start your shift and try to save the world with the help of your precious bucket, some Air Cans and a bunch of planks.

name: Thorgard
summary: Thorgard is a minimalistic viking base defense game. Defend your sacred meadhall against enemies.

name: This is Normal
summary: An educational game that teaches about Self Managed Abortion.

name: Thus Spoke the Donke
summary: Thus Spoke the Donke is an immersive stealth-action game that casts you as a mercenary assassin. Customize your weapons and abilities, equip them according to your play style. Find the way to complete your mission either stealthily or through pure action with the help of personalized gameplay.

name: Throw Your Phone: Into the Ocean
summary: As simple and as satisfying as it sounds, Throw your Phone! (Into the Ocean) A relaxing and meditative experience designed to calm your wild mind. With scored Arcade and open-ended Zen modes among multiple stunning & immersive environments.

name: Through the Thorns and Curses
summary: This is roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by tabletop games. Start your journey and challenge yourself - became a stranger, build yours decks to explore, fight and collect treasures. Try to make your way through the Thorns and Curses!

name: The Zhukov Line
summary: A short one-room-horror which takes place on a livestock train in a dystopian Soviet state.

name: The Yellow Moon's School: The Ghosts Day
summary: The Yellow Moon's School: The Ghosts Day is a top-down shooter game in which you must shoot ghosts and destroy them to save the school.

name: The Wolf's Hunt
summary: Third Person action game where you are a wolf trying to save your wolf cubs.

name: They Bite!
summary: Dont just survive a zombie apocalypse, thrive in it! Blast hordes of Zeds as you gain experience and cash to buy better gear and see how long you can survive in a fun, low-poly setting.

name: ThirdPlace: Kon and Pon
summary: A casual action game in which you control Pon, a raccoon dog, as he continues his journey up the mountain and beyond!You can change your character's appearance to make him more unique! Changechange" as often as you can to gain an advantage!

name: The Witch Veils: The Mansion
summary: When two witches and an apprentice are kidnapped in a mansion, only Star, the apprentice, can save them and uncover what is happening.

name: The WereCleaner
summary: Kyle is a Janitor. He's also a Werewolf. And now he's got the night shift. Fight for your life - and your paycheck - in a stealth-comedy game with surprises around every corner.

name: The Warehouse
summary: A simple horror collection game set in a warehouse outside of space and time

name: The Wandering Demon Blade
summary: An quick paced action story game drowned out by silence. Cut through with the demon blade all the while surrounded by the quiet of the world. Experience the short story following death.

name: The Ultimate Couch Game
summary: A simple funny couch game to play with up to 9 friends! Enjoy competing to reach the end of the board through winning minigames whilst sabotaging your friends to increase your odds! Best with friends!

name: Theurgic
summary: In this immersive, text-based RPG, you navigate complex social structures as an islander in a culturally tense setting. Delve into the lore and explore themes of identity, allegiance, and moral ambiguity in a story brought to life by the illustrations of artist Ori-Guy James.

name: The Misadventures of Sigfreid the Dark Elf on Tuesday Night
summary: The Misadventures of Sigfreid the Dark Elf on Tuesday Night is an action game created by Scott Cawthon in 2006.

name: The Powermon Adventure!
summary: The Powermon Adventure! is a Pokémon fangame made by Scott Cawthon.

name: The Scrolling Enigma
summary: Solve riddles, decipher cryptic messages, and piece together the fragments of an elusive truth. A one-hour unique escape game experience.

name: The Whiteout
summary: The Whiteout is a chapter based, narrative-driven adventure game that takes place in the not-too-distant future. You’ll play as a lone traveler in a dangerous and broken world: society has collapsed, food is scarce, and trust is not affordable.

name: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap Randomizer
summary: A randomizer mod for The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap

name: The Devil's Route
summary:
Its late at night and you are driving a bus.
What could possibly go wrong...

This game features a total of 6 endings.
Collecting all endings can take between 30 and 45 minutes

name: The book by the blue
summary: in this First-person horror game you will be discovering what's going on with missing persons and a corrupt scientist. Find items littered around to access locked doors and secret passages.

name: The Book of Good
summary: Play as Yvonne in this first-person, single life horror adventure. There are no second chances. Complete the tasks her mother started and be careful--stay alive! Find the Book of Good and what it means. Get out of the house as soon as possible!

name: The Otter Ways
summary: Humans left this place long ago. Now you, an inquisitive otter, must survive there, among the ruins of their kingdoms.

name: The Girl Under The Tree: Anna
summary: Survival horror, exploration, puzzles, zombies, and mystery.

name: The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes
summary: "The Backrooms: Unseen Tapes" is a first-person survival horror game where you navigate a maze-like, ever-changing procedurally generated environment. With stealth, speed, and strategy, evade monsters and conserve limited resources to maintain your sanity and escape this nightmarish dimension.

name: Theory
summary: "Theory" is an intense first-person shooter (FPS) game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by hordes of ravenous zombies. Players find themselves in a vast, desolate landscape. As a survivor, you'll navigate through various environments.

name: The Bathrooms
summary: You awake near a foggy, deserted school with no memory of what happened. You soon discover a horrible secret and descend into a realm of cold, endless halls. Beware—The Custodian is watching you. Your escape from this nightmare depends on your wit and skill.

name: The Lord of Hexa
summary: You are a medieval Lord who must construct a colony, complete challenges to expand the kingdom, and rule an hexagonal low poly world. Immerse yourself in a tranquil ambiance with soothing sounds and music in this minimalistic tile game!

name: The 6-Digit Computer
summary: The 6-Digit Computer is a programming game in an alternate past. You, Deam Mead, just got hired at Farworks as a programmer for their new operating system, HTaeD / O6. However, it's not as simple as you might think! The computer operates on bijective senary, which means that it only has the digits 1-6. So 7 becomes 11, 24 becomes 36 and so on.

name: The Tower
summary:
Build the tallest tower in the world to reach the sky with a power of one-tap gameplay!

Beat your friends, unlock new towers, discover all locations.

name: That's Not My Neighbor
summary: 'That's not my Neighbor' is a 2D Indie horror game based on the job simulator genre with an unique twist created by Ignacio Alvarado Monge AKA NachoSama.

name: The Contact
summary:
The Contact is a first-person horror game.
You have to look for something mysterious by relying on the phone number and location information found on the internet.

name: The Roottrees Are Dead
summary: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

name: The Witch's Night Watch
summary:
Your nightly duty awaits you...
Guard the graveyard from mischievous ghosts that rise every night and make it until sunrise.

Use magic spells, your broom, quick dodges, and summoned allies to help you survive the one-minute onslaught, with random nerfs and buffs being applied between every level.

name: The Secret Atelier
summary: You are the advisor of the art club and the only other person in there is Ichijou Erika. She offers to be a model for the club but your eyes begin to wander towards her erotic body. Something she is very aware of. How will you maintain your composure in front of her lascivious invitation?!

name: The Funeral of Sachertorte
summary: Congratulations on landing the job at the funeral home you've been longing for. Let's satisfy customers seeking end-of-life services.

name: The Fast And The Furriest
summary: An unreleased racing game featuring Rare characters.

name: The Tragic Loss of M. Slazak
summary: Miroslav Slazak - a Polish immigrant who fled to Britain shortly before the outbreak of the Second World War. His only possessions were the clothes on his back, his passport and a large antique ship’s chest. It was chained shut.

name: The Troopers' Playground
summary: The Troopers' Playground is a single-player episode replacement for Doom II. It was created by Matthias Worch and uploaded to the idgames archive on March 29, 1996. The Trooper's Playground contains nine regular levels in TTP.WAD, one bonus level in TTPBONUS.WAD, and two deathmatch-only maps in TTPDEATH.WAD. The episode features a custom status bar and new textures.

name: The First Round
summary:
It's Friday night and we're late to the pub!

Join Mario as he journeys through a series of short but fun levels suitable for even the newest of players. Unlock routes, meet new friends, and awaken your kaizo skills on what is likely Mario's most vital mission yet: avoiding to pay for drinks!

Features:
- Mostly vanilla beginner romhack suitable for both new and experienced kaizo players
- Unlockable routes of progressive difficulty, up to three unique courses!
- Four unlockable endings, including a secret "true" ending
- Progressive save feature; pick up right where you left off!
- Interactive characters old and new, with a charming narrative
- Custom artwork
- Post-credit content

Remember: last one to the pub buys THE FIRST ROUND! Good luck!

name: Thin Ice
summary: Cut ice with skating skills to sink the snow beasts.

name: The Hell: City Builder of the Dead
summary: Welcome to the city-building game set in the depths of Hell. Assume the role of the Hell Governor and embrace the challenge of welcoming souls who perished in major, historically accurate human catastrophes. Are you ready to build and govern your own infernal city?

name: There Is No Sleep
summary: Everyone has nightmares every now and then... but what would you do if a demon trapped you in a nightmare and you couldn't wake up?

name: The Legend of Sebb Linus
summary: Slip into the role of Sebb Linus, a former NCF agent, and sneak into enemy bases undetected. Stay undetected so as not to raise the alarm. Experience the old-school stealth genre.

name: The Argument Solver
summary: Are you tired of solving your arguments the diplomatic way. Grab your Opponent and throw things at each other just like your primate would!

name: The Cat
summary: Face mental challenges as you help the feline overcome rotating platforms in his search for the ball of wool. With hand-drawn graphics, giving the game a unique aesthetic and captivating puzzles, thus testing the player's skill.

name: The Leviathan's Fantasy: DLC
summary: The Lost Immortal Sect— Lingyun Sect, as a pure stream in the world of cultivation, has always taken it upon itself to protect the mortal world.

name: The Little Mermaid: Princess of the Underwater Kingdoms
summary: Ariel returns in a new story, embarking on a heroic mission to safeguard Triton's kingdom, facing unprecedented challenges in a plot full of intrigue and courage.

name: The FMV Collection 4
summary: Wales Interactive is proud to offer the Bloodshore, I Saw Black Clouds and Who Pressed Mute on Uncle Marcus? all in one bundle!

name: The Outlast Trials: Reagent Starter Pack
summary: Get ready with the Reagent Starter Pack, which includes exclusive items.

name: That Cowgirl Life
summary: A cowgirl game that is suitable for children and is based in low-poly environments and is primarily built for VR. This game will receive support and substantial updates that will add to the story as well as adding functionality over the next six years as we explore the beauty and limits of VR.

name: The Vault
summary: A quick view into another world through the eyes of a single console.

name: The Outlast Trials: Deluxe Edition
summary: Experience the mind-numbing horror of Outlast, this time with friends.

name: The Box
summary: The Box began as a Silent Hill proposal, however it is unclear if Konami were ever presented the project, as Silicon Knights soon partnered with SEGA to produce the game. The Box was supposed to be an “open world third person survival horror experience” for the Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3. [source:silenthillmemories]

name: The 257th Element
summary: In 2032, Tokyo scientists unveil Araraginium, the 257th element, capable of materializing matter and bringing back the deceased as Araragi Humans. Masakazu Tokimune, a Japanese high school student, grapples with daily life's blend of humor, intrigue, and love.

name: The 7th Circle: Endless Nightmare Update
summary:
Endless Nightmare was an update released with Gamera Interactive as part of their ReLaunch publishing program for indie games.

Along with bug fixes and quality of life improvements the update added the inferno difficulty mode and 4 post-game dungeons. The additional dungeons offer unique challenges like random dungeon modifiers or an endless mode.

name: The Dream Within
summary: A pixel-graphics open world survival craft RPG, where players are locked in a deep dream world, survive and rescue yourself in this unstable world, forage, hunt, mine, and build up shelters. Find a way to escape.

name: The Devil is in the Details
summary: You're trapped in hell, and the only way out is to beat the devil at its own game. With the help of a mysterious entity known only as 'The Arbiter,' navigate through ominous surroundings and place talismans on cursed objects while trying to survive the many traps and foes lurking in the shadows.

name: This Is No Cave
summary: A one-click parkour game in space. Zoom through intricate levels using your suit's thrusters and grapple hook, all while evading colossal alien worms.

name: The Lord of Time
summary: You find yourself on a strange planet known as Earth and must follow the orders of the Zenti.

name: The Sinking City 2
summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

name: The Nutcracker
summary: Edutainment game based on the Nutcracker Ballet

name: The Big Below
summary: Take on the role of a little gnome exploring twisting, secret-filled dungeons in this retro, top-down adventure game.

name: The Showdown Effect: Reloaded
summary: Experience fast-paced over-the-top multiplayer action in The Showdown Effect: Reloaded. Join players from around the world to engage in high-octane battles filled with bullets, explosions, and one-liners!

name: The Czar is Dead
summary: THE CZAR IS DEAD is a visual novel in the setting of the Russian Empire. Help the last russian emperor save his soul, life and country.

name: That One Dungeon
summary: That One Dungeon is a fast-paced dungeon crawler filled with never-ending levels, monsters, and traps! Choose your class and shoot them down to obtain your best score yet! Navigate through a labyrinth-style dungeon while trying to find hidden secrets and evade your inner fears!

name: They Speak To Us
summary: They Speak To Us is a 1-4 person co-op horror game. Voice record your own monsters, and capture them before the time runs out. Utilize a gravity gun flash light to both help or hinder your friends and monsters alike.

name: The Land of the Magnates
summary: An epic adventure of love, betrayal, and sacrifice awaits, rooted in Middle Eastern myths and legends! As Shahbaz, a disgraced prince, travel across magical realms, defeat minions of darkness with the magic of your sitar, and reclaim your throne, bringing the light back to the Land of the Sun.

name: The Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle Atarisized
summary: This is a hack of Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle where the graphics have been changed to resemble graphics found on the Atari 2600. Also included is a patch with 64 all new levels. The graphics and levels were created in separate patch files so that they may be compatible with other hacks. For example, the graphics patch may be applied to other level hacks where the graphics were left unchanged.

name: Thumbling
summary: Thumbling is a game about exploring and solving labyrinthine puzzles in an immersive environment. The player is a castaway who must use his sense of reflection, his deduction and his skill to mark a path using colored gems, in order to escape from a mysterious island.

name: Things Too Ugly
summary: Clock in at TEREBRO INC. for the night shift in 1986. Protect the company's legacy as Risk Assessment Data Processor. Equipped with era-specific technology, navigate through obscured narratives to shape the company's future.

name: The Witch of Fern Island: Wonderful Witch Pack
summary: Obtain this fantastic Radiance Witch outfit to show off around the town! A beautiful chest will appear near the mailbox and contain a set of bourgeois furniture and wallpapers. This set of deluxe items will turn your cozy life into a new classy experience!

name: The War in Chiapas
summary: Control a group of young people who enter the jungle of Chiapas, Mexico, in the eighties, to form a guerrilla whose objective is to create an army to overthrow the government through a new revolution, however, a paramilitary group appears unexpectedly.

name: The Warden's Paradise
summary: Warden's Paradise is a live action interactive video game where players play the role of a prison warden caught in a conspiracy, interacting with five women with different styles and purposes. Through your choices, gradually uncover the truth of the event!

name: The Walls
summary: A story of escape filled with nightmares, trapped within a simulation universe that is reality itself. Markus, dragged into a deep psychological pit by the pain of losing his family, finds himself confronting his nightmares in this simulation universe.

name: The VIllage of Eri
summary: The Village of Eri is a rogue-lite, metroidvania inspired, platformer. You'll explore the world, fight bosses, buy gear and upgrade your character along the way. You may even choose what to keep for your next run if you can afford it.All of this in order to restore the village.

name: The Tomb of Corruption
summary: Explore procedurally generated dungeons and slash hordes of monsters in THE TOMB OF CORRUPTION! - A 3D action RPG with rogue-lite elements. Fully customize your melee and ranged weapon with hundreds of upgrades, unlock skills, upgrade your armor and get ready to enter the voxel dungeon!

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Slaughter Family Execution Pack 2
summary: Terrorize the Victims even more with these new, grisly executions for the Slaughter Family! This pack features one kill each for Leatherface, The Cook, The Hitchhiker, Sissy, Johnny, and Nancy. Enjoy the hunt!

name: There's Something in the Ice
summary: In 2015, three scientists at the Antarctic research station "Zarya" drilled into the ice to a depth of 2 kilometers and took samples for study... It seems that what they found was not at all what they were looking for...

name: There's something wrong with...
summary: Short first-person horror experience where you navigate through dark tunnels, hide from a monstrous entity, and uncover the biggest secret of your life.

name: The Rise
summary: Help Sam and Elicy on their challenging journey through the abyss. An epic 2D precision platform game where exploring the unknown, overcoming obstacles, and discovering secrets are crucial to reaching the top of the abyss. Adventure awaits you!

name: The Scarlet Chaos
summary: Join Detective Haerrison and his partner on a case involving a supernatural killer and a haunting entity called the Hat Man. Along the way, take on side quests and explore the semi-open world of Kelaura in this dark turn based RPG adventure.

name: The Ten Soul
summary: As time passes, waves of stronger and stronger monsters will attack, with nowhere to run and the need to defend the crystals behind you, which give some ability to kill the monsters to improve your own attributes, or you can sign a contract with them to fight alongside you.

name: The State of Nowhere
summary: Assigned to station 65, your role as employee 100411 will be to serve and sell products to the people, exercising the controls the state deems necessary to keep the population in line

name: TheSpoiler
summary: When you come to your senses, you find yourself trapped in a nightmare. The books scattered around will guide you through your future.

name: The Singing Saw Simulator
summary: Dive into the sensational world of Singing Saw Simulator - a rythm game with a twist! (Or should that be a bend?) Unleash your inner virtuoso as you soar, swoop, sing, and shred your way to your next musical masterpiece in this pulsing, two-tone, musical performance of a lifetime.

name: The Silent Forests
summary: Embark on a captivating journey through the Silent Forests, treacherous sewers, and a mysterious house. Solve puzzles, face monsters, and unravel hidden truths in this adrenaline-packed adventure with a wacky narrator!

name: The Shadow Cat
summary: Transform into a mysterious black cat, navigate through various traps in the shadows, and find the treasure in the ancient castle.

name: These Thieving Hearts
summary: A wealthy benefactor. A master lockpick. A magical bodyguard. A trusted ally. A skillful rival. All of them are out to steal priceless treasures. Which one of them will steal your heart?

name: The Raptured
summary: The Raptured is a TPS horror survival video game that follows Fletcher in Still Pines, overrun by apparitions that stalk the player. Find out what happened to the town, and try not to be consumed by the treacherous hordes of the apparitions.

name: The Recurrence
summary: Explore an open-ended nightmare using paranormal equipment to survive an onslaught of evil spirits that await your return.

name: The Red Button
summary: Resist the urge to press the button and do not uncover the secrets that may lie within its crimson facade. The choice is yours: to press or not to press.

name: There's No Dinosaurs 2
summary: We are back with “There’s No Dinosaurs 2” - a relaxing hidden object point & click game in which your objective is to locate randomly placed dinosaurs amongst nine brand new cozy environments with beautifully hand-drawn graphics. Can you find all the dinosaurs?🦖

name: The Resonant
summary: The Resonant is a Roguelite game w/ Magic, Dark Fantasy, FPS, Dungeon crawler, and Parkour (Wall Run/Dash) gameplay. Unlock over 100+ spells from 10 different elements to create your own custom magic spell slinging mage known as a Reaper. Play as single player or 2-6 player Co-op.

name: The Ord Accord
summary: Plunge into a puzzling exploration of an unfortunate and tragic situation. Dodge vicious chickens and tough bosses, and suffer a cornucopia of painful losses, as you venture deep inside in a castle where the mad reside.

name: The One
summary: The One is a game in which your goal will be alone or in a group of up to four players to explore the world three years after the zombie apocalypse. However, it's not only zombies that will prove to be a problem, but also others who have managed to survive this time behind the gates of the bunkers.

name: The Mystery of Blackthorn Castle 2
summary: Travel back in time to Blackthorn Castle in this much larger game sequel. Break the dark wizard's spells and make deals with a bridge troll!

name: The Night Jackals Vol. 1
summary: "The Night Jackal" is a captivating game where you experience tension as you discover someone breaking into your phone through your security camera. In this game, you'll confront your fears with contemporary technology invading privacy.

name: The Nightmare Accord
summary: A single player or coop game experience that pits players in the world of nightmares as a customizable child conquering their fears!

name: The Nightwatch
summary: Fight your way through hordes of monsters in this highly customisable 2D survival roguelite. Explore, unearth and make the most out of the upgrades, talent trees and items available to push through the attack. What will you find in the dark floors of the wizard tower, and will you save the night ?

name: The Multiverse Trilogy
summary: Introducing The Multiverse Trilogy. The prequel to Alternate Universe

name: The Mosquito Gang
summary: Do you want to drink blood and buzz forever? Or to swat an annoying insect with one left hand? Dive into the eternal confrontation between human and mosquito in The Mosquito Gang!

name: The Monster War
summary: Embark on an epic journey as a knight in a fantasy war. Experience Tower Defense, Side Scroller and Casual Puzzle modes all in one thrilling adventure. Defend the kingdom from the monster invasion, push back the threat, and conquer their bases of operations to emerge victorious from the war!

name: The Monarch: First Light
summary: Will you be the savior to purify this land? The Monarch is a lane-defense game where you control a monarch, expand your kingdom, and defend against evil by strategically managing gold resources, recruiting diverse units, and exploring a world filled with mythical threats.

name: The Mines of White Label
summary: If you want a good outcome, you need a good income. One of the largest companies in the kingdom has fallen into liquidation. Use your trusty hammer and the gap in the market to fight your way to the top.

name: The Midnight Walkers
summary: Fight, Scavenge, and Extract in The Midnight Walkers, a hardcore FPS game with deadly zombies, dangerous players, and valuable loot. Craft weapons, armor, and consumables; trade items; and maintain your hideout. Escape Liberty Grand Center mega complex, and thrive...or die and lose everything.

name: The Magic World 2: Curse of the Ancients
summary: Party role-playing game. You control a squad of characters moving through an open game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

name: The Magician Of Justice
summary: A personally created numerical RPG mini game，The game is full of exploration and randomness, collecting various abilities such as spirit stones, scrolls, weapons, etc. by finding treasure chests or eliminating monsters, and each battle has a different experience

name: The Lost Village: Fantasy
summary: The sky shattered, and a group of folks who called themselves adventurers fell into this world. Their personalities are quirky yet passionately fiery, seemingly always filled with curiosity and hope. Currently, these folks are exploring the entirety of the cultivation world.

name: The Liminal Space
summary: "The Liminal Space" is a thrilling horror adventure game. Explore surreal landscapes, solve puzzles, and escape from terrifying monsters. Are you ready to face the challenges? Enter "The Liminal Space" now!

name: The Lightless World
summary: The Lightless World is a PC reverse horror action RPG co-op game set in a cosmic horror universe where players control demonic god protagonists.

name: The Legends of Maui
summary: Defy gods and trick great spirits as you travel Aotearoa as the trickster Maui, in a time of magic. Based on the legends of Maui as well as several other myths and folklore from New Zealand.

name: The Implant
summary: This is my first relatively big game. You are the brain of a huge narketing company that helps their clients to achieve their sales goals. And you do it in a creative way creating newsbreaks, opinion leaders and shows. Simulating life as you see it should be. And it works because of the implant plan

name: The Island: Escape Room
summary: You wake up on an unknown island, alone and without help. Will you be able to solve the mysteries it contains? Will you find out how you got there? Could you escape from The Island?

name: The Jester's Revenge
summary: Discover a humorous, supernatural adventure with a jester's ghost seeking revenge on the king. Use spectral powers to haunt and vex in a kingdom blending comedy with gothic horror. Become the master of spectral pranks in this unique, ghostly rebellion.

name: The Jusou 3
summary: Why was that cursed nest born... A story tracing back even further, 25 years to its very origins. Exploration inside the school is done using a 3D map! Brace yourself and advance through the corridors swirling with terror!

name: The Krampus
summary: A realistic third-person horror set in the 1800s. Play as brave children escaping Krampus. Navigate diverse levels, including Krampus' workshop and a haunting Victorian home. Choose to brave the nightmare solo or team up with a friend in online co-op. Run, hide, and find your way to survival

name: The Lands of Hyberian
summary: Welcome to The Lands of Hyberian. The kingdom of Tydrall is ruled by the king and queen who have claimed all The Lands of Hyberian. It is up to the brave knights of Tydrall to answer the kings summon! Prepare your training and bring your wisdom as the king seeks an audience with you.

name: The Last Camp 1990
summary: The Last Camp 1990 is a horror game about a group of friends who go camping in the middle of woods.

name: The Last Child
summary: Discover the stunning world of The Last Child. In it you will enjoy the beauty of the world, its deepest darkness and its brightest light. A side view will allow you to concentrate on the world and its characters. Your adventure, your decision can change it.

name: The Last Days of Friendship Valley
summary: A deckbuilding narrative RPG about conflict negotiation, goats, and impending doom. Make your own goat character, navigate arguments with cards, uncover an ancient mystery, and try to save the world.

name: The Last Safe Place
summary: 1853; Mysterious Civilization Unearthed under Ember Mountain! Anthracite coal miners tell of vast treasures exhumed from a forgotten city, full of mysterious ruins and otherworldly beauty. Join the exhibition as you descend through uncharted caverns to find The Last Safe Place.

name: The Last Stop
summary: You're caught in a cycle of light and darkness in a subway car. This eerie dynamic demands memory, strategy, and swift decisions to traverse the unknown. Each moment of visibility is crucial to reach your goal: "The Last Stop".

name: The Legend of Elrian
summary: The Legend of Elrian is an adventure with retro GameBoy inspired visuals. You incarnate Elrian, an Elf who has to leave his village to rescue his missing brother.

name: The Legend Of Perchta
summary: The Legend of Perchta is a fast FPS with roguelite elements in a fantasy world. Find and defeat the Devil himself with God-given magic powers. Unlock new heroes, collect spells, upgrade magic wands and craft powerful magic runes to fight your way through waves of monsters.

name: The Goose Tale
summary: You are a simple and vulnerable goose with a mortal mission, steal and escape from the bigest organization on the planet. The Goose Tale is a 3D platform game, where you will use skills and make easier your escape from the organization.

name: The Immemorial Order
summary: After living in your new house for a few months, you discover the previous owners have left behind some items that were never meant to be found.

name: The Idle
summary: The ultimate idle clicker game with endless possibilities and infinite fun. Passive and active income, seven currencies, interest, bets, prestige, perks and many more features are available!

name: The Hunt for the Lost Treasure 2
summary: Fulfill your treasure hunt craving in this mind-teasing puzzle adventure on a newly discovered archipelago of islands in the Pacific Ocean not far from the Galápagos Islands.

name: The Haunting of Joni Evers
summary: The Haunting of Joni Evers is a psychologically thrilling first-person strollplayer set in the small town of Harvest, Oklahoma. Confront, examine, and reexamine Joni’s memories in this emotional story of estranged family underscored by a malevolent, interdimensional haunting.

name: The hardest game in the universe 2: New DLC
summary: 3 new stages in the new DLC of the most impossible game in the universe

name: The hardest game in the universe 2: Final DLC
summary: Prepare for the ultimate test of skill and determination with the "Ultimate Challenge" DLC for "The Hardest Game in the Universe 2"! This expansion takes the difficulty to unprecedented heights, introducing over 20 new levels designed to push even the most seasoned players to their limits.

name: The Green Room Experiment: Episode 3
summary: You're locked in a dream and you need to wake up. Unravel the mysteries of this surreal exploration series and immerse yourself in a dreamlike, strange and solitary universe.

name: The Great Rebellion
summary: The Great Rebellion is a cyberpunk 2D sidescrolling run'n'gun roguelite using mouse/twinstick-shooter controls. It features randomly generated levels, multiple difficulty modes (including optional permadeath), a dynamic soundtrack and an upgradeable player character.

name: The Great Couturier
summary: Create, evolve, and compete with other players in this fashion-focused game. Can you rise from a novice to become The Great Couturier?

name: The Enchanted Worlds
summary: Three enchanted books transport you to the worlds written on their pages. In this latest adventure with Uncle Henry, he has had a secret kept for many years that he now wishes to share with you.

name: The Emperor
summary: "The Emperor" is a simulation game for dynasty cultivation. In the game, as the master of the divine realm, you can work hard to conquer the world, expand your territory, and govern the world. You can also cultivate education and benefit the people. Come and establish your kingdom's hegemony.

name: The Eerie Surroundings
summary: Observe your surrounding and be confident there is or is not a anomaly to progress.

name: The Dungeon: Dungeon Awaits
summary: Dungeon-Dungeon is a turn-based, loot-heavy fantasy roguelike dungeon crawler. Each step forward is a dance to avoid checkmate. Every monster and weapon has a unique shape, similar to a chess piece. Make the right moves, create a unique build, and conquer the Dungeon-Dungeon!

name: The Drylands
summary: The Drylands is a car-combat party-based RPG. Fight for loot and explore an ever-changing procedurally generated world as the shifting sands reveal lost secrets.

name: The Elliot Brown Case
summary: A new kind of detective game where you uncover cases entirely represented with cards. Interrogate any character about ANY other card. Dissect the events that lead to Eliott Brown's demise... Then write your own thrilling investigation stories and share them to fellow detectives around the world.

name: The Farmer & the Chicken
summary: Unleash the chicken's power and escape in this arcade adventure to avoid being caught by the farmer!

name: The Exile Princes
summary: A story focused, old school, procedural RPG: raise your banner and bring your house to victory in the unique medieval fantasy setting of the Exile Realms. Start out in questing service, gain companions, followers, power and influence, and ultimately through strength or guile learn to rule the lands.

name: The End of Humanity
summary: Survival and construction at the end of zombies, rebuilding homes or becoming plunderers, witnessing the extinction and struggle of human nature

name: The Final Farewell
summary: The Final Farewell is a cosy narrative adventure about finding peace in death, and learning to let go. As a lost ghost, befriend wayward mortals and piece together misty memories. Lay to rest the echoes of the past and discover the truth of your own demise.

name: The Forest Ranger
summary: The Forest Ranger (TFR) is a psychological horror game where you take the role of a ranger and paranormal things happen

name: The Collector
summary: A third-person action-adventure game with horror elements.

name: The Chancellor's Plot
summary: After receiving a letter from a wealthy and powerful benefactor, you journey into the depths of an abandoned mansion to recover a mysterious artifact. But soon you will learn the reason this place has been abandoned.

name: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods
summary: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods is a free-to-play action-adventure game where you embark on a journey to slay a god. The very first game by Studio Castor, set in a medieval high fantasy open world.

name: The Crack
summary: Crack is a text adventure game that combines a profound emotional experience with elements of mystery and puzzle-solving. In this game, players embark on a journey to revisit the past, explore themselves, and uncover hidden secrets.

name: The Cyber Masquerade
summary: Degenerate loner jailbreaks a stolen android.

name: The Darkness Below
summary: Embark on an epic journey into "The Darkness Below", a homage to the golden era of 90's cRPGs, with grid-based movement, turn-based combat and 2.5D perspective. Wander a vast and colorful fantasy world filled with puzzles, exotic creatures, forgotten dungeons and ancient guardians.

name: The Dark Plague: Trials Of Galwefeld
summary: Survive a relentless pursuit by a terrifying entity in this top-down horror adventure. Explore a dark and atmospheric world, gather parts to craft a weapon, and face your fears in a thrilling showdown. Can you escape the fate of becoming one of them?

name: The Dark Side of Ceclon
summary: Jensen, the sole survivor of the Nexentia shuttle crash on the planet CECLON. Alone, light years away from all human life! You will have to face the Nocturnes, primitive creatures in order to bring back the Veka energy, humanity's only hope.

name: The Dark Story
summary: Welcome to THE DARK STORY get ready for a chilling adventure in a jungle mansion. Your task: survive, explore, and escape before the horrors within engulf you. Beware of jumpscares around every corner. Can you brave the darkness and uncover the secrets within?

name: The Dark Horde
summary: The Dark Horde is an exciting roguelike deckbuilder where the cost to play cards is TIME. Play your cards to summon a horde of minions and to cast powerful sorceries! Improve your defenses, acquire rare cards, level up, unlock new upgrades and then lay waste to each human settlements!

name: The Dawn Of A Flower
summary: "She became a prince to survive." Historical materials of ancient Egypt Fusion fantasy romance game "The Dawn Of A Flower"

name: The Dawning Clocks of Time: Remake
summary: A story of love, war and betrayal on an intergalatic scale. A epic third person shooter with both sandbox and linear story progression. Take up arms and battle for the ages, who will decide the fate for all of humanity? Now remade in HD / 4K with cinematic presentation.

name: The Apocalypse Sacrifice
summary: The Apocalypse Sacrifice is a point and click adventure game with multiple endings. You take on the role of an adventurer who has lost his memory, with the only clue being a note found in his mouth. As you recover your memories, you uncover chilling secrets hidden within the town.

name: The Bunker
summary: Go throughout an abandoned bunker with your friends collecting all the notepads. Beware of the zombies that lurk within.

name: The Butler Did It
summary: Battle robots, make friends, and uncover a bizarre conspiracy to avert the apocalypse in this comedy of manners and mayhem with steampunk blasters!

name: The Bright Star Of Seraph-Katis
summary: The Bright Star Of Seraph-Katis is a short text adventure game. This game combines a visual novel and an "adventure mode".

name: The Black Siege
summary: The Black Plague had ravaged 14th Century Europe, turning humans into carnivorous monsters that brought destruction to the continent. Your kingdom stands as the last bastion. Build your fortress, mine resources and train troops to hold out until help arrives in this builder-defense roguelike.

name: The Bibites: Digital Life
summary: Explore real digital life in The Bibites! Play god as you guide your bibites on their evolutionary journey. Analyze their Neural Network brains and genetic information as they adapt to their environments. Save your favorites and test their strength in Challenge Mode!

name: The Backrooms: Descent
summary: The Backrooms: Descent is a 1-4 player co-op horror experience. You are tasked with descending into the vast levels of the Backrooms which have dangerous entities while also finding evidence of previous research teams before you find your escape.

name: The Beautiful Island
summary: A short visual novel about war, peace and hope. Explore a city after a devastating war. Talk to people, try to understand, try to help. The heroes of war are dead, but you can be a hero of peace!

name: The Belligerence
summary: A single player game developed to differentiate itself from existing fighting games. It can be enjoyed with a feeling closest to a real fight. The right stick-based attack and walking parry system provide sensory control. There is a mode to fight cpu and belly hard is incredibly strong

name: The Berlin Apartment
summary: The Berlin Apartment tells the moving stories of inhabitants of an apartment in the city of Berlin over the last 120 years in several unique, emotional episodes as a character-driven adventure game.

name: Thong Girl: The Video Game
summary: The Adventures of Thong Girl combines classic 2D beat-em-up platforming with high-scoring arena action. Help our scantily clad super heroine defeat wave after wave of roid-raging bodybuilders, antipathetic teenagers, and gun-toting gangstas. Join in the fun with Thong Girl as she works her butt off to get to the bottom of the riots plaguing Music City.

name: The Murder of Dale Decker
summary: Use your keyboard to uncover objects located at the crime scene. Guess words by typing to recall the space around you, uncover clues and solve the murder!

name: That Gravity Glow
summary:
Grapple with gravity across a dark, puzzling landscape. I swear it's not blood.

Made using Pancelor's level select fork for Puzzlescript. Originally made for Lowrezjam, using the theme "Gravity is the enemy". The jam had a restriction of 64*64 pixels, and I used 60*60 pixels.

name: The Presidential Turnabout
summary: You play as Apollo, with Trucy as your ever-loyal sidekick. As with most people, the JFK case has always lurked at the back of your mind since childhood, but you’ve never taken a real interest in resolving it until now. But when an innocent trip to a space museum takes a dangerous turn and spirals into a nightmarish adventure of time travel and lawbreaking, you are forced to journey back to the fateful day of John Kennedy’s murder, and find yourself defending the most notorious assassin (or fall guy!) in history, Lee Harvey Oswald. As you hunt around the now world-famous crime scene, desperately looking for some clue or scrap of evidence that everyone else might have overlooked, you slowly become more and more unnerved at the steady trickle of evidence that…….just doesn’t make sense. Your client is clearly not telling you everything he knows, but is he the only one with a skeleton in his closet? Just how many of your own preconceived notions on this case will you have to take another look at? Will you be able to uncover the truth in time, and save your client from his historical date with destiny? Or will you be forced to watch powerlessly, as the inevitable sequence of known events unfolds before your eyes?

name: The Pharaoh's Tomb
summary: Pharaoh's Tomb is isomatiric view adventure game same as 'gold yard' by francesco maisto released in 2004.

name: The Hovering Castle
summary: Hovering castle is one of the first Bulgarian games for PC. The game is a representative of the Quest genre, it was created in 1992 and is not commercial. The authors are Hristo Bozhinov, Ivan Kolev and Stanislav Evstatiev. Ivan Kolev and Stanislav Evstatiev later founded Dimension Design and Garga Games. The game has graphics of (320x200x256 colors) with drawn characters and setting, and even becomes "cult" for many players. The game is partly controlled by text commands in Bulgarian, such as "Вземи чашата", and there are constantly witty messages in Bulgarian.

name: The Night Wanderer
summary:
"The Night Wanderer" is a hybrid of RPG and soulslike genres, characterized by unique solutions and an innovative approach to tried-and-true mechanics. The game utilizes level design known from Metroidvania games and a combat system native to soulsborne productions, which emphasizes dynamic yet tactical gameplay.

The game is based on the award-winning fantasy novel "Lord of the Ice Garden" by Jarosław Grzędowicz.

name: The Bones of Rosalinda
summary:
”Hey, you! Skeleton lady! Can you hear me? You’ve got to pull yourself together and run before the Necromancer turns you into one of his minions!”

Rosalinda realised she wasn’t dreaming. She was in a dark cave, most of her body was missing and there was an agitated brown mouse yelling at her.

”O-okay,” she said. “How do I get out of this place? And... where are my legs?”

Her first day of un-life wasn’t going to be easy.

name: The Little Match Girl 2: Annus Evertens
summary: The little match girl is hired to assassinate a disgusting old man.

name: The Little Match Girl, by Hans Christian Andersen
summary: In The Little Match Girl by Hans Christian Andersen, a little girl is forced to sell matches on the street in the cold of New Year's Eve.

name: The Little Match Girl and Her Friend, the Crow
summary: The little match girl goes on a spooky adventure with her friend (a crow).

name: The Little Match Girl 4: Crown of Pearls
summary: In The Little Match Girl 4 by Hans Christian Andersen, a prince has been born, and the titular little match girl must assemble the subtitular Crown of Pearls.

name: The Little Match Girl against the Universal Sisterhood of Naughty Little Girls
summary: A short game taking place soon after The Little Match Girl 4: Crown of Pearls.

name: The Crimson Debt
summary: You've lived your whole life in a single basement. Now, your cage is unlocked. You could leave this house at any moment you want. But without knowing what happened, can you ever truly be free?

name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Personal Boards 4
The Crystals of Atlantis
summary: A latest match-three game, where you'll strategically swap and match dazzling crystals across 38 levels in Story Mode or compete for high scores in Classic Mode.

name: That Way!
summary: Help your partner perform the heist of a lifetime! Send him instructions for how to get to each vault and make a getaway with your newly found fortune!

name: The Konia Project
summary:
The Konia project is a game for C64 where you can play 3 games "inside" a Nok... ehm, an old "Konia" cellphone, while funny text messages entertain you.

Hitting spacebar in-game makes you warp in the "crazy mode", where a game switches to another game suddenly.

Hitting spacebar during the menu choice picks a random chat to show.

Can you reach 255 points and break the "indestructible" phone?

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - High Caliber Weapon Pack
summary: Take on the biggest game with the High Caliber Weapon Pack. This package contains three top-grade weapons crafted for pure firepower and maximum range as well as five new cosmetics.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Emerald Coast Cosmetic Pack
summary: Decorate your weapons, tents, and ground blinds with these unique cosmetics inspired by Emerald Coast Australia. The contents of this pack are cosmetic only.

name: The Finals: Season 2
summary:
Season 2 was the second season of THE FINALS. It launched on March 14, 2024, and ended on June 13, 2024. The season followed the activities of hacker collective CNS and featured a retro gaming theme.

This season was sponsored by VAIIYA, OSPUZE, and CNS, which added an all-new arena: SYS$HORIZON.

New content introduced in Season 2 includes:
- Arena: SYS$HORIZON
- Game Modes: Power Shift, Terminal Attack
- New cosmetics
- New Battle Pass
- Weapons: 93R, FAMAS, KS-23
- Gadgets: Anti-Gravity Cube, Gateway, Data Reshaper
- Specialization: Dematerializer
- Game show event: Retro Invasion 82
- Progression: Circuits, new career levels
- Private matches

name: Thorgal
summary:
Thorgal is an adventure action game with RPG elements, set in the world of popular comics created by Grzegorz Rosiński and Jean Van Hamme. Based on a classic, well-known tale cherished by fans, the fantasy storyline aims to provide a modern and engaging adaptation.

The player will take on the role of the main character of the series, Thorgal Aegirsson - a Viking warrior with a mysterious origin. He will have to face enemies lurking for him and his family - humans and gods known from Norse mythology. Throughout the gameplay, there are many familiar RPG tasks to complete, and he will also have to confront dangerous monsters, bandits, and powerful unknown forces. During his journey, Thorgal will encounter characters previously known from the comics and visit vast, meticulously crafted locations.

Thorgal aims to interest existing fans of the series, attract new fans of fantasy and introduce this classic comic to RPG enthusiasts.

name: The Witch's Assistant
summary: A sexually explicit visual novel in which the player assists a Witch to run her potion selling business.

name: The Fruit Stealing Girls
summary: Princess Verdant and Princess Carmine, sisters, are torn apart when their cherished golden apples vanish. Accusing each other, they send you to spy on the apple tree. Surrounded by the eerie fog that seems to have a life of its own, you must find out who the ghost is.

name: Three Kingdoms: The Blood Moon
summary: Three Kingdoms: The Blood Moon is a turn-based Roguelike card game where you assume the role of a Shu general. Explore dungeons, gather relics, and amass a collection of cards. In each round, you can assemble a unique combination of cards and treasures to defeat your enemies and rewrite history!

name: The Well of Essenwood
summary: Embark on an enchanting journey in a medieval fairytale land. Play as two main characters, Red Riding Hood and Bo-Peep. Each begins their own adventure, and eventually unite to unravel a sinister plot to seize the magical well in the Essenwoods, which contains the very essence of magic in the land.

name: The Elder Scrolls Bundle
summary: A complete collection of all single-player The Elder Scrolls games released on PC.

name: The Bomb Disarmament Expert
summary: You're the one and only Bomb Disarmament Expert and you've been tasked with disarming a ticking bomb that's right in front of you, so don't panic. You might just blow up if you do!

name: The Zombland: Enter at Your Peril
summary: In this chilling game of survival you're on a mission to find your friend Marcus in the scary world of zombies. Marcus went into Zombland but never returned. Will you be able to save the kidnapped or become another victim in the zombie horde's grip? Remember they can do anything to stop you ….

name: The Tale of Destiny Island
summary: Find your path at this forsaken island. Become a Member of a guild and expand your arsenal to overcome your next obstacle. Stück für Stück wirst du so die Wahrheit erkennen, die hinter dem Vorhang liegt. Piece by piece you will unravel the truth which lies behind the curtain.

name: The Schism
summary: The Schism is an online co-op horror game. There has been a paranormal split, colliding realities and causing all manner of dangerous lifeforms to scatter across the globe. With the world in chaos, it seems like it's down to you and your team of scientists to get to the bottom of it.

name: The Neurochemical Conjob
summary: Eliminate your negative emotions (but save the good ones!) as Agent B. Cell, in this intense and wacky arcade style shooter!

name: The Noob Adventures: Fool For Love
summary: A visual novel set in the world of 'The Noob Adventures'. Meet and talk to your favourite characters in this nostalgic fan-fiction.

name: The Last Faith: The Nycrux Edition
summary:
The Last Faith: The Nycrux Edition is the definitive version of the critically acclaimed ´Soulsbourne Metroidvania´ game The Last Faith.

This collector´s edition includes: The physical game, A stunning 100+ page softcover artbook spotlighting the game´s gorgeous gothic art, The game's epic and orchestral Original Soundtrack on a CD, 5 fine art print cards, And a custom-made collector´s tuck-in box with art by Spanish artist Nekro, especially commissioned for this retail release.

name: The Darkside Detective Duology
summary:
Grab your trench coat, tune your sixth sense and join the Darkside Division as they investigate the outright bizarre, the downright dangerous and the confusing cases of Twin Lakes. Flesh-hungry tentacles, mafian zombies, and the occasional missing sock are no match for The Darkside Detective.

- About The Darkside Detective

Where cultists crawl, where demons dwell, where the occult… occults? *ahem* That's where you’ll find Detective Francis McQueen, the lead investigator of the criminally underfunded Darkside Division. When evil darkens the doorsteps of Twin Lakes City – hell, even when it just loiters around shop fronts or hangs out in shady alleyways – he’s there, ready to investigate the cases that nobody else will.

- About The Darkside Detective: Fumble in the Dark

Twin Lakes is a cursed city. Less cursed than say, “Demons are tearing it apart” but more cursed than “always loses its keys” or “often steps in puddles”. It’s roughly in the middle of the cursed scale, is what we’re trying to say.

Cursed enough that it’s a nuisance. Cursed enough that somebody has to deal with it…

That’s where The Darkside Detective comes in. Whenever you hear a bump in the night, feel a tingle up your spine, or smell something fishy, Detective Francis McQueen isn’t far behind. No, he doesn’t smell of fish - it’s a phrase, come on...

name: The Girl's Moving Castle
summary: he Girl's Moving Castle is an RPG focusing on companion collection and growth, strategic battles, and idle progression, with light interactions. It offers a no-grind, no-pay experience, with daily free rewards, ensuring an easy, premium game experience without spending.

name: The Dating Game
summary:
The Dating Game is a 1-bit memory puzzle game in the style of a dating simulator!
Created by Acerola apart of Ludwig's 2021 Game Jam.

name: Thru the City
summary:
Pick your car and try to get as far as you can!
Through the City is a dynamic endless racing game that will challenge your reflex.
Pick car, get ready and drive through the city as far as you can. Drive your car through traffic and avoid obstacles.
Cross roads and sidewalks. Collect credits and unlock new unique cars.
Touch left or right side of screen to turn - it's that simple.

name: The Crackpet Show: Happy Tree Friends Edition
summary: The Crackpet Show is an action-packed rogue-lite shoot'em-up about mutated animals that fight in a bizarre TV show, crushing their opponents with a variety of weapons. Choose your beastie, gear ‘em up, and go kill your enemies in the name of fame and sweet sponsorship deals!

name: The Valley
summary:
Find treasure fight monsters

Based on the type-in game from the April 1982 edition of Computing Today.

name: The Radio Chaser
summary: Go recover your radio from the blob thingys on an andventure around multiple locations!

name: Thoughtform Invasion
summary:
In THOUGHTFORM INVASION you need to try to fall asleep, while being harassed by [REDACTED]. The more you think about them, the more likely they are to materialize.

Use your flashlight to scare them away, close your eyes and get a good nights rest. And brace yourself if you decide to open your eyes.

name: The Smurfs: Village Party
summary: Papa Smurf has decided to organize an exceptional party! Embark on a party game set in the Smurfs' Village, featuring an adventure mode.

name: The Vampire
summary: The Vampire is a first-person horror adventure game designed for single player use only. Would you like to spend the night with Cooper, a stoic vampire hunter who holds the secrets of an ancient legend? Defeat the vampires and escape their world.

name: The Cursor Game
summary: Are you ready for the challenge? Guide your cursor through 30 difficult levels. Test your patience and precision in this casual hard game! Share your best times with #THECursorGame and become THE Cursor Master.

name: The Chronicles of Penghao: Ming
summary: "The Chronicles of Penghao: Ming" is a 3D action RPG game where players assume the role of an ordinary person during the late Yuan and early Ming Dynasty, witnessing the ebb and flow of countless lives amidst the historical currents.

name: The Scar
summary: The scar is an open world adventure and survival game, where you can create your own weapons and tools, build bases and fight against what were once humans and aliens. You will be able to use Ashun's summons, which to our eyes is magic.

name: The Land of Magic
summary: Are you a challenger? Master obstacles, complete worlds and set new high scores. Play new challenges every day by racing against the clock, collecting stars or crossing mysterious obstacles. Play the current season and get exclusive rewards for your ghost.

name: The Silent Bells
summary: Dive into the eerie realms of "The Silent Bells," a spine-chilling horror anthology video game. Unearth five haunting stories, each a twisted tapestry woven from the threads of internet horror and creepypastas. Brace yourself, for every silent bell tolls the arrival of a new nightmare.

name: The Unknown Strain
summary: Embark on an epic journey where magic meets mystery in a vibrant world. Uncover ancient secrets, battle mystical creatures, and explore breathtaking landscapes. Your adventure begins now! Will you unravel the truths that are hidden behind family secrets?

name: Thanks Mom
summary: "thanks mom" is an adventure game where you control a baby. You are given milk by your mother and sleeping soundly. In your dream, you remember the trials and tribulations that happened in the past. It may have been the days of struggle before you were born.

name: Thunder Ronin
summary: Thunder Ronin is a samurai souls-like boss rush. on your way to take revenge on your familty. slash, deflect, and dash through powerful foes. fighting in ancient japan between sakura trees and the glow of the moon.

name: The Russian Roulette Game: PR
summary: The classic Russian roulette with friends, With a small twist to bring more chaos and fun to the gameplay.

name: The Way of Cooking
summary: Dive into a colorful 3D cartoon parkour game where each leap and step brings adventure. As runners, creators, and explorers, players have the freedom to design their own paths. The "free-build" mechanism transforms individual creations into adventures, blending creativity with exploration.

name: They Fear The Mist
summary: They Fear The Mist is a real-time strategy game, where you command your Troops, build your Settlement, fight off thousands of Enemies and explore the Unknowns of the Mist. Take command of your people and defend them from the incoming hordes… Can you survive?

name: The Temple
summary: The Temple is an interactive visual novel game adapted from the short story of the same name by H. P. Lovecraft. The game is being developed by a single person.

name: The Realm
summary: The player lost in a village in another world is looking for a way out alone.

name: The Endarkenment
summary: This is a narrative-based psychological horror game where the apocalypse itself is just the beginning of The Endarkenment. Explore the enigmatic lands of Antarctica and its surrounding areas all while the world ends.

name: The Next Kingpin
summary: This is a mafia themed First Person Shooter game to become the next Kingpin. You will travel around the city streets filled with other mafia families who all feel they should be the Next Kingpin of New York.

name: There's No Easy Wayout 99
summary: An amazing adventure game. Sometimes as a RPG and Humour game aswell .

name: The Heirloom
summary: The Heirloom is a 2D single player mysterious thriller adventure with puzzle elements inspired by the atmosphere of the Hebrides and Scottish folklore, where players are given the opportunity to make fateful decisions while navigating through a story full of secrets and mysteries.

name: The Witch
summary: The Witch is a first-person indie game in the genre of adventure with elements of horror. In it you are a journalist who has to solve the mystery of the disappearance of the inhabitants of the village of Hoer Verde.

name: The MisAdventures of Xenos: Legacy Edition
summary: Explore the origins of 'The MisAdventures of Xenos' with this Legacy Edition DLC. A blend of nostalgia and new, it brings the classic RPG Maker VX Ace version to life with enhancements for veterans and newcomers alike.

name: The Waifu Game
summary: Have fun with this puzzle game where you'll have to match different Waifus falling onto the board to evolve into new forms and reach the ultimate Waifu. Completing each board will grant you access to new photos in the gallery.

name: The Cost Of Seeds
summary: The price seeds is way too high! You are sick of it so you marching over to the seed factory and getting you fill
