summary: The Deal is a total conversion single player mission mod for Call of Duty 4 which is heavily inspired from the 007 James Bond movies along with other video games and movies. The mission revolves around a secret meeting that takes place in middle of London on which the MI6 is spying upon.

name: They Always Run: Deluxe Edition
summary: The Deluxe Edition includes: - They Always Run - Audio Artbook (Arts from They Always Run)

name: This Is a Square!
summary: It's not a very minimalist geometric rouge game.

name: The Swan
summary: you were invited to participate in a ballet performance of your best friend, but during the process, you were accidentally involved in a murder. As the investigation deepens, you will get to know the two male protagonists in this work during this period

name: TheDay
summary: Daylight is a post-apocalyptic shooter where players explore ruins, respond to threats, and uncover post-apocalyptic mysteries. Realistic graphics and tense battles to experience post-apocalyptic survival

name: The Last Hospital
summary: Every decision made influences humanity's fate, with USMLE level medical questions woven into patient care, revealing the mysteries of a dying world.

name: The Maze of Zabendo
summary: You play as Theo Abescar, a detective who is determined to find out what happened to his favorite park and cartoon when he was a child.

name: The Alchemist's Apprentice in the Maze of Madness
summary: A loveletter to the dungeon crawler genre, filled with procedurally generated mazes, mix and match puzzles, traps and upgrades.

name: The Princess and the Pauper: Storybook Adventures
The Adventures in Carnal Hell
summary:
A slightly naughty GBC-style roguelike RPG!

Let's go through the tower, which has up to 15 floors, defeating enemies as you go.
Every step you take Every time you advance, enemies in the same room will also move and attack you.
At times, enemies that send acid or fireballs flying or traps may block your way.
You must decide how to act and win the game.

name: The Secret of Crystal Mountain
summary: Adventure through a land full of mystery and wonder in The Secret of Crystal Mountain, a platforming adventure game about a delivery cat making his way through a magical world. Stranded on a mysterious island, you explore, get to know its residents and uncover its magical secrets. Run around, swim, climb, glide, fight dangerous foes and discover magical items to explore the island and the mountain's peak.

name: The Adventures of CJ's Closet
summary: A collection of stories and minigames with Christian themes.

name: The Runes of Kalevala
summary: The Runes of Kalevala is a 2D RPG that features local co-op and a story that tells the tales of Finnish folklore and mythology, The Kalevala.

name: The Failure of Aniconfuku: Convention Murder Episode
summary:
Unlike many internet-founded projects, this convention was successful. But close to the end of the second day, someone was found dead in convention hall C. People reported to the local police, and all suspects were gathered in the police station.

And now, Here you are.

name: The Adventure Story of Yixiu
summary: Fantasy RPG that features AP turn-based combat and various RPG nurturing elements, while also offering rich and diverse character storylines that grip the heart.

name: Three Kingdoms and Martial Arts and Jianghu
summary: A sandbox role-playing game that combines the Three Kingdoms and martial arts

name: The Fear Business
summary: The fear of the scared ones keep them alive, VHS supernatural survival horror.

name: The Murder of Sherlock Holmes
summary: Investigate the murder of Sherlock Holmes in an incredible Virtual Reality adventure. Interact with everything in an authentic voxel reconstruction of 221B Baker Street. Search for clues, play the violin, read books and become a oneiric detective in this dreamlike escape room.

name: The Boy Sorcerer: Lost memory
summary: Help Anant escape the tower curse. You will climb the tower, unlock new memories until you complete all game modes for each floor. Good luck and may your memory serve you well.

name: The Backrooms Company
summary: A cooperative horror game about working inside the corporation "The Backrooms". Fulfill contracts and also earn extra money by selling stuff.

name: The Coldest Winter
summary: The Coldest Winter is a mature psychological horror game. Shiver alongside Jovanna as you navigate your way through icy landscapes and face biting decisions to make as you try to unravel the truth behind this seemingly never-ending winter.

name: The Carnival Of Company
summary: A dark action-adventure with rogue-like RPG elements, 'The Carnival of Company' lets you defeat demons, consume their essence for power, and customize combat with the 'Path of Carnival.' Uncover secrets, exact revenge, and shape your destiny.

name: Thievery: Online
summary: Thievery: Online is an action-packed, 5v5 heist shooter that puts you in the shoes of expert thieves or highly-trained guards. Pull off epic heists, or foil expertly laid plans.

name: The Glacial Strain
summary: An ancient viral strain has re-entered the world. People are coming back from the dead and no one knows why. Play as a group of survivors with your friends in this 4-player co-op action survival horror and uncover the mysterious events that have unfolded.

name: The Intertwined Imprints
summary: "The Intertwined Imprints" is a yuri visual novel that tells a story about youth, growth, and love. Due to an accident, Mei Yu was temporarily brought back to the village where she spent her childhood. She didn't think it was a good idea, but... she didn't feel like she had much of a choice.

name: The Philistine Ploy
summary: Adventure based on tales from the Bible.

name: The Outer Worlds: Expansion Pass
summary: The Outer Worlds Expansion Pass includes two story expansions bundled at a discount. Continue your employment in the Halcyon colony and experience mysterious missions, devious characters, outlandish weapons, and strange worlds to explore! With these savings, only a Deserter would pass this up!

name: The Immortal Mayor: The Feather Kingdom
summary: The Feather Kingdom, as described in the "Classic of the Great Wilderness - Southern Wilderness,"

name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb
summary:
The Coma 2B: Catacomb is a Korean survival horror adventure. It is a back story of the previous game The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, and a story bridge of all series. You are back in game as Youngho Choi, the main protagonist of The Coma 1, you must venture from the mirror dimension of reality to survive. What happened between The Coma 1 and The Coma 2? The answer is in here.

Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

Running and wielding your flashlight makes you an easy target. You must precariously balance the urgency of exploration with your absolute need to survive!

name: The Colonists: New Lands
summary: Expand your frontiers with The Colonists: New Lands! Improve your transport network with Bridges and Train Tunnels, boost your economy with the Mint and even allow your bots to discover their spiritual side…

name: The Desperate Flight of Hand Solo
summary: An action-arcade game where you play a space pilot with one good arm who has to defend their ship from alien attacks while fueling up to warp to safety.

name: The Silent Column
summary: After a terrible, supernatural event results in the deaths of most people in the world, Tashen meets fellow survivors and falls in love, as he find himself surrounded by ancient and abstract mysteries.

name: The World of Animals
summary: While making his morning rounds, the Farmer finds an egg shell. He wonders what kind of animal could have come from the shell. You actually get involved helping the Farmer, the Bee, Mother Goose and Saymour and his friends sift through a series of clues to solve the mystery and meet all kinds of farm and wild animals on the way! And, you'll even get personal phone calls from Saymour and the gang!

name: The Finals: Bank Rabbit Set
summary: The Season 2 Bank Rabbit bundle includes: - Bunny Outfit - Hide Easter Egg Emote - 2 400 Multibucks

name: The Settlers: New Allies - Starter Pack
summary: Gear up and explore the world of The Settlers: New Allies with the Starter Pack, including skins, credits, and more.

name: The Architects of the Universe: The Orphans
summary: The Architects of the Universe: The Orphans, is the first release in The Architects of the Universe series. A linear adventure title, with gameplay inspired by classic turn based RPGs and a focus on plot.

name: The Tale of Mara & Moa
summary: Mara and Moa have made a terrible mistake and now they need to find the Spirits of the Forest to save their village. Explore a world full of secrets with dynamic and fast-paced combat, alternating between the two characters and channeling the powers of the Sun and the Moon.

name: The Last Signal
summary: The Last Signal is an interactive thriller about Simon Scott, an engineer aboard the USS Moira.

name: The Game of Sisyphus
summary: Roll the boulder to the top.

name: The Death of Rebirth
summary: A Single Player Parkour Sci-Fi Horror Survival Game Set in the Year 3008 where the Imperials have genetically made you to survive such harsh conditions on what's left of Earth in a controlled trial based environment.

name: The Zombie Wave
summary: 《Zombie》 Wave is a low polygon cartoon style third person shooter game where players need to protect cute cartoon characters from damage, use a variety of weapon choices and strategies, challenge enemies, and engage in thrilling defense battles.

name: The Thing That Happened
summary: Thing That Happened is an Openworld Third Person - Action Adventure Survial game. You can use multiple weapons, attachments, close combat skills tree's and crafting to break through your enemies.

name: The Echo Escape
summary: Escape from the suspicious space by eluding [them].

name: The Mystery of the Cardboard Island
summary: Become a delivery person on the Cardboard Island. Chat with your friends and neighbors, explore and play minigames, deliver strange boxes and fight through the nightmares where your island is being destroyed by demons. Are you ready to solve the Mystery?

name: The Outreach
summary: Welcome Human-V1399 to the "Human Restoration Program," the final hope for the rebirth of mankind. In this physics-based movement shooter, use telekinetic powers to defeat hostile alien-built creatures through the depths of an irradiated planet in a conflict-ridden solar system.

name: The Sacrifice
summary: Immerse yourself in this dark atmospheric puzzle game set in the region of Salem in the 17th century! Help Sarah guide her father with her magical play board and avoid the many dangers of The Sacrifice.

name: The Universe of Red Hope
summary: Embark on an awe-inspiring journey through the cosmos with "The Universe of Red Hope," a mesmerizing space simulation game that brings the wonders of the universe right to your screen. ✨

name: The King's League
summary: Kurestal Kingdom has prospered under the diligent reign of its King. However, the current King is already old of age - and has no heir. His Madjesty has hence declared a league - The King's League - that whoever emerges champion will be eligible to battle him and ascend his throne.

name: The King's League: Emblems
summary:
Years have passed since the events of the previous league.
The King's League is now held again, promising gold and glory for the winner—and a private audience with His Majesty.
For this, three individuals embark on a journey to collect emblems to qualify for the King's League.

name: The Super Mario Bros. Super Literature Club!
summary:
It's the Super Mario Bros. Super Literature Club!
From the creator of block click comes a mod of everyone's favorite horror/anime visual novel that combines it with everyone's favorite animated/live-action television show based on a videogame!

name: The Joy of Creation
summary:
The classic Five Nights at Freddy’s fan-game returns, rebuilt from the ground up to offer a modern and immersive horror experience with real-time graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5.

The Joy of Creation puts you in the shoes of The Creator, a game developer forced to confront the manifestations of his own mind throughout five unique levels, each with a unique blend of free-roaming and classic sit-and-survive gameplay mechanics.

This game is officially backed by Scott Cawthon as part of the Fazbear Fanverse Initiative.

name: Thinkin' Things: Sky Island Mysteries
summary:
Solve Mysteries and Bring Order Back to the Sky Islands!

Break out your logic, prioritization and decision-making skills—you’ll find hundreds of zany and absorbing challenges at the Sky Islands! The more problems you complete, the more clues you pick up for the mysteries. Then zip on over to Clue Central and help Detective Joe Cluestoe and his sidekick, Spike, identify who’s behind each daring deed.

name: The Adventures of MassMouth
summary: MassMouth is an alien from the planet Zeeble (a zeebloid). He has a small, green body with a large mouth. MassMouth is an employee of The Worm, a rich alien with his own personal moon. The Worm employs MassMouth to bring him various valuable items. MassMouth is very well-paid and has his own personal room.

name: That
summary: The game features abstract surreal scenery and doesn't really contain an objective, it is more of a game to relax to and explore.

name: The Curse of Unatxi Kamala
summary: Unatxi was thrilled to finally visit Glastonbury, the witchcraft capital of the UK. However, she did not anticipate the fateful encounter that would change her life forever.

name: The Esoteric Formula
summary: The Esoteric Formula its a boom compatible mapset that focus on esoteric concepts/vignettes and hardcore gameplay. All of these maps were designed to be a challenge to veteran players who seek hard content in doom.

name: Thrice Doomed
summary: 27 100% vanilla-compatible maps for Doom I, replacing the three original episodes. Focus is on short, compact maps with a low to moderate difficulty curve; a secondary aim being more consistent visuals within episodes.

name: The New York Times Simulator
summary:
- Based on hundreds of real world news and headlines.

- Featuring the passive voice and many common framing techniques.

- A modern remake of Lucas Pope’s cult game The Republia Times.

- Free casual play. A session lasts about 10 minutes.

name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Personal Boards 5
The Last Flower
summary: The Last Flower is a 25 to 30 min videogame about Sara, a soldier who climbs a mountain with the hopes to find a legendary flower, said to have the power to bring the people back from death.

name: The Gauntlet
summary: In The Gauntlet, you'll need to move fast and control your every move. Various obstacles stand in your way, and it's up to you to find the best way to get through them, taking advantage of your moves and your unique weapon that lets you freeze objects in place.

name: The Courage to be Disliked
summary: A Healing Journey to Find Yourself

name: The Legend of Azarias Rebirth
summary: Embark on a thrilling journey as the Angel Raphael in this action packed 3D first-person dungeon crawler. Conquer 24 unique floors, battle menacing demons, and undertake challenging side quests to amass power to save the girl Sarah.

name: The Lawnmower Man
summary: Game Boy port of "The Lawnmower Man".

name: The Magus Circle
summary: The Magus Circle is a survival roguelite where you are the spellcaster. Draw arcane sigils and combine powerful upgrades to dominate the endless tide of monstrosities. Join forces with mages from across the universe and uncover the secrets of these mana-hungry monsters and the Magus Circle.

name: The Simulation
summary: Welcome to the Simulation! A first person, physics simulation based puzzle game where you solve puzzles and answer riddles which will test your creativity and intelligence. Gain unique powers along the way. Each puzzle is different and there are multiple ways to solve them. Good Luck!

name: The Destiny Of Nagari
summary: Embark on an epic adventure to become the greatest magician ever! Master the elements - water, fire, air, and earth. Explore magical worlds and use the diary of the last magician king to protect your kingdom from monsters. Are you ready to unleash your powers and save your realm?

name: The Firebrand
summary:
"The pain's always the same."

An interrogation room. Sitting on one side of a table is a woman. On the other is you - a detective tired of asking questions, but desperate for answers.

Who is the woman? Why is she here? What has she done?

The only way to find out is to talk. Every conversation topic giving new leads to chase down. Some worthwhile. Others not so much.

Follow the rabbit hole until you reach the truth.

name: The Vault
summary: The task is, at its core, simple. All you have to do is leave this vault. Any means will do. Provided you abide by certain... conditions.

name: The Tree Of Life
summary:
In the near future, a peculiar type of coffin is invented. One that takes the genetic material of the corpse within it to produce a special tree. It doesn't take long for cemeteries to no longer be barren. In fact, traditional tombstones end up being abandoned altogether. Why wouldn't they?

The person's memory is preserved -- and reflected -- in what comes out of the ground. It's all you need.

A man visits such a grave -- one belonging to his brother. It's not reminiscing that brings him there. The local priest had filed a complaint in an effort to chop the tree down due to its... abnormal nature.

A dead tree.

That -- somehow -- still grows

name: The Last Tiger
summary: In the game "The Last Tiger," you will control the fate of four tank commanders during World War II! You will participate in the most bloody tank battles of the Second World War.

name: They Can Fart
summary: Play as a one-eyed farting creature and glide across the stars in this 3v3 online competitive gravity based multiplayer game, where you jump between planets, dodge other player’s bullet, and plant seeds to make your team win.

name: The Stairway 7
summary: The Stairway 7 is an endless loop anomaly hunt and observation "spot the difference" game where you are stuck in a endless loop of stairways with a cat and you have to observe your surroundings carefully to reach the exit. Anomalies are watching, and ready to hunt you down. Don't take them with you.

name: The Cyber Masquerade: Summer Beach Reverie
summary: On a sun-bathed beach, in a rustic town, he wakes up with her by his side again. A brief moment is all she need.

name: The Crystal Archer Girl
summary: This game combines dating simulation with third-person combat.

name: The Tower Stories Green 1
summary: In a magical universe adorned with colorful characters from various races, we invite you to a visual novel adventure that will lead you to different endings. Define your own path in this captivating fantasy world and set sail on an unforgettable journey.

name: The Horror at Highrook
summary: The Horror at Highrook is an occult card crafting RPG. Explore a haunted mansion with your team of investigators, summon dark entities, craft powerful protections, uncover the fate of the missing family, and choose your own path through the darkness.

name: The Night Guard
summary: This facility was built on a very interesting location and had an interesting history. It grew up on the site of a former hospital for the mentally ill, the only one of its kind. There and spent their final days people suffering from a bunch of ailments.

name: The Ape Tales: An Epic Adventure Game
summary: Experience an epic 2D adventure game by becoming the legendary ape who is the last hope for innocent animals. Traverse through diverse realms and eras, encountering evil that threatens your species. Prepare for the unexpected as each location unveils unique enemies and challenges that you will face.

name: The Elder Gods
summary: "The Elder Gods" is a dark card-based adventure inspired by the works of H.P. Lovecraft. It's an roguelike deckbuilder with a unique sanity-mechanic.

name: The Beast in the Shadows
summary: Experience the heart-pounding suspense of a modern-day werewolf horror story as you step into the shoes of Cassie, a brave woman determined to put an end to a terrifying curse plaguing her small town.

name: The Crimson Lyre
summary: The Crimson Lyre is an immersive first person RPG adventure into a dangerous fantasy land.

name: The Twisting Trail of Clues
summary: The Twisting Trail of Clues is a captivating and thrilling modern-day murder mystery. Set in a bustling city, the story follows detective Emma as she tries to solve a seemingly impossible case - the murder of a prominent businessman by a mysterious secret society.

name: The Crush House
summary: Film and produce 1999's hottest reality TV show: The Crush House! Select a crush-worthy cast, satisfy voracious audiences and keep the show on air to uncover the sinister secrets behind this darkly comic thirst-person shooter.

name: The Jackbox Decade Bundle
summary: The Jackbox Decade Bundle is a collection of 50 fan-favorite Jackbox games from Party Packs 1-10 for one low price. It's great for game nights with friends, family get-togethers, and more! And there's no special equipment required - your internet-connected device is your controller.

name: The Gauntlet
summary: The Gauntlet is a fast-paced movement driven game where you must survive a series of trials to claim the prize, your freedom. Bad Bat's brutal Game-Show has got a new contestant, lets hope they live to see the re-runs.

name: The Anomalous Hour
summary: You are alone in a deserted station. Or are you? Take pictures of strange anomalies around the station and you might find a way out.

name: Thunderbombs
summary: Shooter game in which you have to destroy all the bombs on the screen.

name: The Line Zen
summary:
Welcome to The Line Zen.

The Line Zen is the sequel to 2014's hit game, The Line, but now with a new twist. You still dart and weave through a procedurally generated world while avoiding the red shapes, but now you use friendly green shapes to your advantage -- but be careful -- because sometimes they can get in the way!

name: The Spy Strikes Back!
summary: You have to find nine clues in evil Dr. Xavier Tortion's fortress in East Germany in order to spoil his wicked plans.

name: The Playroom: AR Studio
summary:
Ever wanted to have your own movie studio? Then AR Studio is for you.

Use your tablet or smartphone to create funky banners and holographic billboards, wear funny masks, add your own music and special effects and be the star of your own TV show. You could even start a regular broadcast, beamed directly to “Live From PlayStation”. What will your show be about?

name: The Punniest Pun Messter
summary:
What if you're cursed to make others laugh?

The 'Jester' is an entity who grants children happiness, but he was just another persona of myth... Until one day he appears on your windowsill and bestows his powers upon you. Now you're inflicted with a pun-curse, and thus begins your journey to cure yourself!

Upon changing schools, you meet three boarders who seem to have something to do with your curse...

But little do you know that your curse isn't really what it seems to be...

name: The Hungry Lamb: Traveling in the Late Ming Dynasty
summary: A travel text adventure game with Chinese traditional style. Player will escort four girls to Luoyang in order to discover the truth and make decisions along the way. This game involves themes of “Revenge, Cannibalism, etc.” the darker sides of life, but still expect to convey a positive emotion.

name: The Croaker
summary:
The Croaker is a very fun, feature-packed game where you can collect apples. Where's the fun in that? Well, these apples you collect are used all throughout the game: You can buy skins, powerups, unlock many achievements, and compete on leaderboards against the top players!

There are 50 campaign levels, where the protagonist, Jeremy, gets trapped in a simulation and must escape without the antagonist of Virtual Guy finding him. Not only that, there are going to be brand new Bonus Levels every few updates just to keep adding content to the game.

name: Thorns: Police never sleeps
summary: Thorns. Police never sleeps is a kinetic visual novel about an alternative future. After global warming, cities were separated by a giant ocean. Our story begins in one of these cities.

name: The Dilemma
summary: When you open your eyes in a dark labyrinth, what should you do? Find the right path and escape from this labyrinth!

name: The Old Gentleman
summary: Use Morse Code to communicate with your crewmate and ward off a stalking monster in this short point-and-click horror game.

name: The Citizen
summary: The Citizen is a very short first person exploration game about learning to be a good citizen featuring an overly talkative person who doesn’t really like you.

name: The Collection
summary: A First person, Short story indie horror game with an immersive atmosphere.

name: The Mara Witch
summary: "The Mara Witch" invites players to embark on an unforgettable journey deep into the heart of Africa. Assume the role of Leboo, a young Maasai warrior navigating a landscape fraught with tragedy, betrayal, and mystical encounters.

name: The End of Sanity
summary: Dive into a dark, supernatural open world in this survival RPG, where the city is under the grip of dark entities controlling AI machines. Harness solar power and the environment to fuel your equipment, engage in intense combat, and build defenses. Reclaim the city from the shadows.

name: The Wicked West
summary: A Low-Poly Western-themed FPS that can be played alone or with with up to 6 friends! Wield iconic weapons like the revolver, lever-action rifle, shotgun, and sniper all while relying on strategy, quick reflexes, and steady aim to outduel your friends!

name: The Temple of Children
summary: The Temple of Children is a story-driven horror adventure about a simple little girl from a Russian province. Against her will she became part of horrible events, watching her reality turn into hell. To survive she needs to unravel the secret that children are hiding.

name: The Hunter Cursed by Night
summary: A short-and-sweet 1-bit adventure game with real-time combat. Engage in ranged or close combat to defeat supernatural monsters. Upgrade your tools to progress deeper into the woods.

name: The Demon's Exorcism
summary: "The Demon's Exorcism" is a first-person psychological horror game that reveals the story of a family trapped in a haunting curse. Immerse yourself in the chilling narrative as you exorcise the demon and break the curse.

name: The Evil Sect
summary: Take on the role of Phillip in this light action/horror FPS. They kidnapped your daughter, SAVE HER. Aim, shoot, run, jump, defend yourself. Do everything you can to stay alive, explore the area and complete the objective.

name: The Game Awards
summary: THE GAME AWARDS invites you, the player, to a behind-the-scenes look at one wannabe indie darling's sordid tryst with game development. Learn what it takes to be an amateur, laugh at jokes, experience plot twists, and join our rookie dev on a rollercoaster ride that's rapidly running out of track.

name: The Neath
summary: Beneath you go. Below the bones of the earth and lower into the darkness. Find your way through twisting passages past vile monsters. Explore, discover and conquer your way to greater depths and greater rewards.

name: The Way Of Kings
summary: 《The Way Of Kings》is a love and war based real-time action role-playing game.It tells the story of an ordinary man named Qin Shihuang, who experiences countless fantasy adventures in the end times to conquer the world, unify Kyushu and become emperor.

name: Threads of War
summary: Battle City with rogue-lite progression. Overcome increasingly difficult levels, create your fighting builds, defeat bosses, and liberate Ukraine from dark forces. The campaign can be played cooperatively, allowing players to compete with and support each other.

name: The Highlands of Jurgald
summary: Fantasy Game

name: The Mystery Of Eigengrau
summary: An atmospheric horror/escape room game for mobile devices.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Scions of Ithelia
summary:
Prove your strength to Malacath and defend a demiplane of Oblivion in the Scions of Ithelia dungeon DLC.

Two Challenging Dungeons

Venture into two 4-player PvE dungeons, Oathsworn Pit and Bedlam Veil, coming soon to both the Crown Store and ESO Plus memberships.

Oathsworn Pit

A training ground for Malacath's chosen now lies soaked with the blood of the faithful, and the God of Curses demands you enact revenge on behalf of the fallen.

Bedlam Veil

Cultists have invaded the Bedlam Veil, located within the demiplane of Maelstrom. It’s up to you to defend this ancient vault and the mysterious relic it protects.

Rewards for the Worthy

Survive both dungeons to unlock unique rewards, including new item sets, collectibles, achievements, and more not found anywhere else in Tamriel.

name: The Last Spell: Dwarves of Runenberg
summary: Protect the haven of Runenberg, lead Dwarves with unique abilities into battle and discover new exclusive Perks, weapons and items in the first DLC of the acclaimed tactical rogue-lite. Dive once more into the chaos of The Last Spell to unleash your unique new weaponry upon the Hordes of Evil.

name: The Rogue Prince of Persia
summary:
The Rogue Prince of Persia is a 2D action-platformer developed by Evil Empire in collaboration with Ubisoft. The game combines fast-paced parkour movement with roguelite combat and progression systems. Players control the Prince as he battles enemies and explores procedurally generated levels filled with traps and hazards.
Each run offers new weapons, upgrades, and choices that influence gameplay and replayability.

name: The Fallen Star
summary: This SMW romhack utilizes lush new graphics and spins new level mechanics on classic Super Mario World gameplay.

name: The Sims 4: Urban Homage Kit
summary: Strut boldly into the now with iconic styles from The Sims 4 Urban Homage Kit.

name: The Sims 4: Party Essentials Kit
summary: Coordinate your décor to build the perfect party atmosphere with The Sims 4 Party Essentials Kit.

name: Thule
summary: A turn-based 4X strategy game set in a dark fantasy world. Engage in the dynamic conflict as one of five factions vying for supremacy over Thule through both randomly generated worlds and diverse missions.

name: Thanks Merlin
summary: Thanks Merlin is an adventure horror game where the main goal is to survive. You find yourself in a closed toy store under the control of a giant toy - Chummy Tummy. With a flashlight and a laser gun, you must find a way out of the maze of horror by solving puzzles created by the inventor Merlin.

name: The Lust City 2
summary: Embark on an exotic quest in "The Lust City 2"! Lead your crew through a steamy jungle, unlocking treasures and secrets of an ancient tribe. Craft your seductive harem in a thrilling adventure that will leave you breathless. Explore the lustful depths of the jungle – where danger meets desire!

name: The Milk is Sour
summary: a glimpse into a future

name: The One
summary:
The One' came about when they sought to create a game that focused on a narrative, seeking to keep the player absorbed in the story and exploration of the world.

The main concept from which this idea was born was a simple pen. From this came the mechanics, which mostly revolve around using the feathers, and the main theme, angels and their wings.

Due to the scope of the project, it will be separated into two iterations. The initial idea is the realisation of the first iteration for the delivery of the TFM, while the second iteration will remain in a conceptual form that can be realised from the first iteration.

The first iteration includes the entire 3D open world that the player will explore in search of the elements that will give him access to the story and improve his skills. The second iteration will transform the upgrade items into "portals" that will transport the player to 2D arcade-like levels with side-scrolling platforming, where they will have to progress through different obstacles in order to get that upgrade item.

name: The Forgotten City
summary: The Forgotten City is the first mod in history to win a national Writers' Guild award for its script. It is a critically acclaimed expansion mod offering a unique 6 - 8 hour experience: a murder mystery investigation set in an ancient underground city. You'll need to solve it using your wits, and the ability to travel through time...

name: The Secret of Crimson Manor
summary:
Discover and solve the surprising secret behind the mysterious crimson manor.
Explore the old mansion and its surroundings, solving puzzles and discovering its many intriguing secrets.

name: The Avengers United Battle Force
summary:
Avengers: United Battle Force is an remix of the old Captain America and Avengers arcade game with new chars and many cool things.

Its a 2 players beat-em-up game, featuring Avengers plus some guest chars from Marvel universe.

name: The Necromancer's Tower
summary: A Tiny DRPG.

name: The Rewrite Journal
summary:
"The Prince's lie could only last until the twelfth hour."

On an island in the sky, five friends live out near idyllic lives. But one of them is distanced from the others; separated by time. To get back into their lives, he makes a wish. Except even the most simple of wishes can backfire when their story excludes yours...

name: The Owl House: Witch's Apprentice
summary: A platformer on iOS and Windows featuring characters from Disney's The Owl House. Playing as Luz Noceda, it's your job to unlock all of the relics and complete all the jobs and duties that Eda has set out for you to complete.

name: The Spell Brigade
summary: The Spell Brigade is an online co-op Survivors-like for 1-4 players. Team up with your wizard friends to slay hordes of dark creatures. Complete team-based objectives, unlock new upgrades and create overpowered spell synergies. Friend nor foe is safe in this friendly fire bullet heaven!

name: Three Verses
summary: Three Verses is an adventure game / first person dungeoncrawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

name: The DeLuca Family: Season 1
summary: The DeLuca Family is a story-driven adult game. Try to win over the ladies of the house and increase in the ranks in the crimeworld. Choose your playstyle with three modes - full experience (Text-based rpg game), story+freeroaming, or VN-Mode. But no matter the mode, lots of lewd!

name: The Slime's Choice: TSC
summary: Slim's Choice is a pure game of chopping monsters, upgrading and exploding equipment! You are an adventure game where slime picks up weapons and attacks the boss!

name: The Gif Game
summary: Unleash your creativity in our multiplayer party game! Use your phone to craft witty prompts, select uproarious GIFs, and cast your vote for the funniest in a laughter-filled showdown.

name: The Horrible Inside
summary: You have to plunge into the depths of madness and uncover the dark secrets that lurk within. With every step you take, you will encounter paranormal phenomena and ghosts of your past.

name: The Fanciful Chronicle
summary: The Fanciful Chronicle is a singleplayer first person narrative game. As Mike, you find yourself at a highschool reunion where all kind of memories return to you as you meet your friend Sam. As you explore these memories, Mike discovers more and more about his past - or lack thereof.

name: The Vigilante Diaries
summary: The Vigilante Diaries is a narrative-driven role-playing game where you assume the role of a masked vigilante. Experience his life journey through his diaries spanning years, navigate the changes within his hideout, and make every decision that shapes his destiny.

name: The Ranger: Border Hunt
summary: You are Colt and you have to escape from a monster in a dark forest.

name: The Adventures of Emoji 4: Fly High Mouse - Remastered
summary: Step into The Adventures of Emoji 4 Remastered, where you immerse yourself in this mouse cartoon world playing a shoot em up side-scroller. Follow dynamic rules and use special weapons to defeat enemies for each level. Stay focused on the prize or you might find your game completely cut off.

name: The Pool Rooms
summary: Singleplayer simulation/ maze game. Here you will navigate through the gigantic complex and try to avoid the monsters. Equipped with only a flashlight and a fist to fight with. You will have to run.

name: The Fallen Kingdoms
summary: A brand-new board game that combines turn-based strategy and card-drafting mechanics to provide an enjoyable experience with friends! Build your kingdom, defeat your rivals, and seize the throne!

name: The Baba Yaga
summary: The Baba Yaga is a PC horror game inspired by the original Slenderman game in which you play as a boy who is looking for his sister in the woods. Upon finding her locked up in a cave, you’ll discover the game’s objective– find the missing keys to save her. As you scour the forest, you will find yourself being followed by a dangerous, looming entity. The monster in this game is based on Slavic folktale about the ogress, Baba Yaga (Baba Jaga), who is known to consume children.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Virginia
summary: A distraught Mother who refuses to believe her Son is really gone, Virginia moved closer to Newt, TX in hopes of conducting her own search. Her past experience as a Nurse gives Virginia intimate knowledge of chemicals and other substances, and because of this, she's able to use Sissy's flower powder against the Family, temporarily blinding them. She can also use this skill to eliminate Nugget, permanently.

name: The Ascot
summary: Anything might happen to you on the way to the convenience store. You might even run into a guy handing out cursed ascots that lead you to lost fortunes guarded by terrible monsters. Can you nab 100% of the Hizkwelderbang fortune, or will you be lunch for the Eagle Beast?

name: The Backworlds
summary: RUN, JUMP, ESCAPE. Endlessly high buildings of dead ruins are towering over a giant chasm of green mist. But the reality of our world is seeping in, and some familiar places are now stuck there. This is how you are invited there - against your will. Enter the hostile realm of the BACKWORLDS.

name: The Last Farmer
summary: "The Last Farmer" is not just a tale of survival; it's a journey of restoration. Amidst the sprawling deserts of a forgotten Texas, your farm becomes a symbol of hope and persistence.

name: The Last Oasis Before Chastity
summary: Amidst the barren desert, an oasis shines like a beacon of hope, accessible only by a solitary road. The scorching sands loom on one side, while the weight of the past hangs heavy on the other. It’s a place where one can escape the harsh realities, but also confront them.

name: Thor's Legacy
summary: A new type of roguelike deck-builder that's made to be as flexible and customizable as possible, without losing the difficulty that makes it worth pursuing. Survive for as long as you can against an endless wave of enemies, that come back stronger each time you beat them.

name: The Earth Is Flat
summary: Help Teddy on his adventure to prove that the Earth is flat and win back his ex-girlfriend. Venture through various countries such as Canada, the US, Brazil, Ireland, Italy and many others. Face crazy scientists, control a Jet Ski, try to reach the Earth's atmosphere with balloons, and more.

name: The Krilling: Scare Feast!
summary: In this funny bayou based game, complete recipes as a cursed shrimp ghost by luring in and scaring unassuming hotel guests. Collect your victims emotions, mess with physics, and unlock new possessables to please the mysterious Gator Ghost and possibly become human again!

name: The Aquarians
summary: A point-and-click playable short where you take the role of an artifact collector, navigating the Aquarian Temple's enigmatic architecture and locating its prized relics.

name: The Leviathan's Fantasy: Samurai and Onmyoji
summary: The nine-tailed fox is a mythical animal in ancient Chinese legends, often used as a symbol of auspiciousness.

name: The Violinist
summary: If you love the violin, classical music, or any instrument, this vertical rhythm game is for you.Rosin up your bow, tune your violin, and launch yourself into musical success.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Ana Outfit Pack 2
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Ana.

name: Three Verses
summary: THREE VERSES is an adventure game / first person dungeoncrawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

name: The Tennis Academy
summary: The Tennis Academy is a solo-developed action fantasy RPG and dating sim. Uncover the mysteries of the castle-like school while fighting wacky tennis duels with hand-drawn 2D animated characters. Live your best college life, rizz up classmates to become your Doubles Partners, and save tennis!

name: The 13th Floor
summary: You are stuck in an infinite loop within a hotel.Keenly observe your surroundings, report any anomalies, confront your fears, and escape the nightmare by reaching your room on the 13th floor.This journey tests your resolve and wits at every turn.

name: The College Fantasy Before the End of the Empire
summary: A fictional history based text romance adventure game based on the early 20th century. You need to use your choices to determine you, the one you choose, and even the fate of this country in an era where human stars shine.

name: The Public Domain: The Game
summary: The most ambitious asset flip of all time! A new 2D Platformer with Adventure Game elements created by a single rouge nerd! Every single image and sound in this game is taken from a public domain or royalty free source, including a few familiar faces. . .

name: There is No Plan B
summary: 「There is NO PLAN B」 is a 「Narrative Adventure Game」 set in a cyberpunk world. Step into the shoes of B, a Hikikomori private eye, as you meet clients, investigate crime scenes, gather witness testimonies, and even apprehend suspects yourself. Will you be able to unravel the truth behind each case?

name: The Scroll of Black Loong
summary: A brand new Eastern-style parenting-simulator-RPG adventure. After losing all your family, the mysterious scroll you protect grants you a sister. You will accompany her as she grows up and cultivate her. Remember, every decision you make is crucial.

name: The Ruby Court
summary: The Ruby Court is an interactive fiction game that takes inspiration from 90s and 2000s vampire fiction, with themes about conformity/the queer experience. And blood. Lots of blood.

name: The Reeve
summary: You are an Administrator serving your probationary period in a medieval town. Make decisions to affect the town's reputation, order, might and supplies. Choose wisely to deal with bandits, famines, cultists and plagues. The most difficult choices will decide the fate of your town!

name: The Mournmore Killings
summary: The Mournmore Killings a story-driven, deduction based mystery game where you step into the shoes of a detective trying to solve the enigmatic riddles left behind by a serial killer.

name: The Math Challenge
summary: Embark on a thrilling space adventure as an astronaut, where logic and math are your keys to survival. Navigate through challenges, unravel mysteries, and conquer the cosmos.

name: The Clown's Forest: Fear of a Survivor
summary: Sarah Baines somehow survived the trap in that basement. She is trapped in the collapsed house of horrors in Hartown Amusement Park, and Chester is relentlessly pursuing her. But something dark is manifesting around her. Can she survive the horrors?

name: The Wonderful Life of Koshchei
summary: A visual novel based on Koshchei from Slavic folklore who is living peacefully.

name: The Ghost Town Treasure
summary: An old west Point and Click Game.

name: The Nightmare Of Arrival Chapter 1
summary: Simon Story.... After retiring from the military, Simon's descent into alcohol addiction leads him to a fateful night of heavy drinking. A fall down a flight of stairs renders him unconscious,

name: The Epyx Collection: Handheld
summary: Witness the return of six awesome Epyx classics from the 1980s/90s, originally designed for cutting-edge handheld gaming.

name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Personal Boards 6
The Legend of Snow Maiden
summary: "The Legend of Snow Maiden" is a turn based role-playing game inspired by ancient Chinese mythology. The player takes on the role of the brave female hero Akira Sakura, embarking on an adventure to search for the reincarnation of the Golden Boy and the assistance of the Snow Maiden.

name: The Dream of the Limbo
summary:
The Dream of Limbo is a dark fairytale-style bullet-hell action game.
Players control Psyche, a highly mobile protagonist who uses dashes and dives to break platforms and enemy projectiles, taking on 19 powerful bosses in intense and visually striking battles.

name: The Maze Survivor: The 9th Entrants
summary: The Maze Survivor: The 9th Entrants is a limited space survival game that uniquely combines the characteristics of survival, horror, puzzle solving and maze adventure games. Players will wake up in the center of a complex maze without any clues. Let's try to see if they can survive and escape from this strange maze.

name: The Lost Village: JiangHu
summary: The Out World undergoes another anomaly, with a mysterious sect rising. Its members come from various sects, their realms far surpass average humans, viewed almost as divine or saintly. Once unpredictable and secretive, some hidden in wilderness or concealed in bustling areas....

name: The Ramen Stand
summary: The Ramen Stand is a ramen simulator horror game based on a ramen stand.

name: The Witch's Redemption
summary: Step into a world shrouded in mystery and peril in “The Witch’s Redemption,” an RPG teeming with narrative depth and strategic intrigue. Unravel the mysteries that hold Alice captive through captivating dialogues, thrilling battles, and cunning investigations.

name: The Well of Life Cannot Move
summary: An Idle Auto Battler Reverse-Bullet Hell Score Attack game. Collect life essence from an endless waves of enemies!

name: The Last Warmage
summary: The Last Warmage is a fast-paced, new take on Tower Defense where mana management and strategic spellcasting are crucial. The main campaign follows the story of the dark elf Yoradhin, expanded with a variety of side quests.

name: The Last Spin
summary: The last spin originally named 'Casino?' is a deck-building roguelike that disguises itself as a slot machine. How many spins until the last spin?

name: The Last Mission
summary: The Last Mission is an auto-battler and space battle simulation game where you command a fleet of spacecraft in vast, strategic battles. Equip, configure and upgrade them to be ready to battle the enemy.

name: The Adventures of Lily & Leo
summary: Discover the magical world of Lily and Leo and help them find their faithful companion Quattro in this captivating puzzle adventure. Set up a tripod, follow animal tracks, have clever conversations and much more to track down the missing dog.

name: The Zombie Wave: DLC
summary: Zombie Wave is a 3D shooting survival Roguelike game.

name: The Crew Motorfest: Year 1 Pass
summary: Upgrade your garage with the Year 1 Pass and obtain 25 vehicles throughout Year 1!

name: The Tale of Marena's Deft
summary: You are Marena, the spirit of death. You have spent many nights chasing a demon-queen Dukljana the Deathless, climbing to the very heights of Mount Troyan. If you can't stop her, she will steal the sun itself and who knows what will happen to the world then! Inspired by Touhou games (especially the early ones) and Slavic folk mythology.

name: The Kotchei
summary: In the Kotchei you play as a undead lord risen from the dead to destroy the Order, an evil theocracy. Craft spells and powerful items, summon minions to fight alongside you, build up your keep and rob graves for more material for your research.

name: The Bird and the Bicycle
summary: How far will you go? Take a roadtrip along peaceful country roads, as you fly through an ever changing sky, in this cosy, atmospheric, arcade game, with a retro aesthetic and soundtrack to match.

name: The Blocks Returneth
summary: A loving tribute to the Blocks Cometh by Halfbot (2010).

name: The Phenomenon+
summary:
The Phenomenon is an episodic survival horror game with high replayability. The main character is Barry Nellan, a paranormal researcher whose work is known around the world. Many cases linked to unexplained activity have been studied. Most yielded no real results, but the last one…

In EPISODE 1, you will explore a 3 square kilometer map with over 500 item spawns, use devices for paranormal research, fight creatures with intelligent and tricky AI and discover many other things that make each new unique game.

Compete with other players to take first place on the global leaderboards.

name: The Princess in the Mirror
summary: From Voltage's famous interactive romance series comes the glitzy, fairy tale world of The Princess in the Mirror!

name: The Mandalorian: Chapter 3 - The Sin
summary: A reimagining of The Mandalorian, Chapter 3: The Sin as a Game Boy game.

name: The Kabuki Phantom
summary: You’ve fallen into a rut after finishing college, so when your beloved uncle invites you to apprentice at his kabuki playhouse in Tokyo, you jump at the opportunity to try something new. Before long, you find yourself swept up in the colorful world of Japanese dance-drama alongside your new colleagues—two captivating actors and the theater’s stern manager.

name: The Curse of Death's Kiss
summary: In the harsh world of Victorian high society, it pays to have a good name and a handsome butler by your side. But things aren’t as they seem… For you are cursed.

name: The Rondo of Oblivion
summary: Dear Guest, welcome to Moonwake Manor – a place that will grant your deepest desires. It is with great pleasure and honor to invite you to a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. You may find that the sun never rises and that your only way out is to participate in this game I’ve organized for you and your fellow guests. Do not be frightened, however. Remember your desires lead you here and with desires comes sacrifice. I look forward to seeing how far you will go to reunite with your long-lost brother.

name: The Lost Fate of the Oni
summary:
"Dangerous oni lurk outside, so you must never leave the mansion."
Raised under the protective wing of your loving father, you've always heeded these words and stayed safe inside. Life in the mansion may be comfortable, but you wish that you could experience the outside world just once.

name: The Chains of Enchantment
summary: You were living a peaceful life with your father, Glen, and your rebellious younger brother, Dean. But all of that is destroyed when you’re attacked by a beautiful, but evil witch known as Ramza! Just when you thought it was the end of the line for you, two handsome agents named Spencer and Bradley come to your rescue! They say they were sent here by the Magical Crime Bureau to protect you and before you have a chance to ask more, you’re taken to Bradley’s mansion!

name: The Swords of First Light
summary: You’ve spent your whole life helping your foster parents out at their inn. You’ve finally received word that you’ll be accepted into a special program in the Knight’s Order of First Light, known for their fighting prowess against demons. They even managed to seal Lucifer, the king of demons, away nearly 300 years ago! You work very hard to make yourself useful in the never-ending war against Lucifer’s creatures.

name: The Pet Doctor's Secret
summary: Life in college was pretty normal until one day, your cat gets sick and you have to take it to the nearby animal hospital. They’re not able to figure out what’s wrong, but they recommend you take your cat to the hospital that’s rumored to be able to cure anything. Two extremely handsome doctors and an energetic receptionist seem to be the only staff, but miraculously, they’re able to help your cat in no time! You decide to take up a part-time job at the hospital, but there’s just one rule… Never peak into the operating room while they’re at work!

name: The Fate of Wonderland
summary: You’ve always had a fascination with Alice in Wonderland. Ever since you were a child, you’ve imagined yourself as Alice venturing through the bizarre and enchanting scenery that is Wonderland. But as you grew older, you realized that those were nothing more than fantasies…

name: The House of Grudge
summary: Every night, you’re haunted by a disturbing dream… You’re in an old mansion confronted by an old woman whose face becomes more and more twisted as she talks to you. Finally, she attacks you and you wake from the nightmare. You try to talk to your friend Trevor about it, but he isn’t convinced it’s anything to worry about. Meanwhile, you continue to be haunted by the dream every night…

name: The Spellbinding Kiss
summary: You are a young woman who works at a pharmacy passed down by your father. As you head back home on the afternoon of the yearly town festival, day suddenly turns to night and a raging storm begins. You rush to close up shop when you hear a loud noise. Coming towards you is a man covered in blood.

name: The Devil's Soul Inside Me
summary: In the thriving Towa City, you, an average high school student with a love for spicy food and fantasy games, are about to unravel a staggering truth… Believing yourself to be human, you're haunted by gruesome dreams of your past life as the Demon King Caacrinolaas. As you grapple with your newfound identity, torn between your chivalrous nature and the dark power within, the fate of two worlds hangs in the balance. Can you resist the call of your former existence, choosing the path of a normal human, or will you succumb to your inner demons, ushering in a New Age of darkness and chaos?

name: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road
summary: The Tunnels of Saint Mercy Road is an immersive horror experience that spans 4 areas, each unique and provides a different sense of unease. Inspired by games such as Silent Hill, Outlast, Resident Evil and many other (possibly surprising) games and stories, you will uncover the truth behind the urban legends of the tunnels under Saint Mercy Road.

name: The Distortion Beast
summary:
In sleepy Coppersfield, a remote village on the coast of the Axelands, Maria of Cardo is offered a job. Coppersfield has been plagued by terrible attacks from an insidious and monstrous creature they call The Distortion Beast. The village elders want Maria of Cardo to explore the beat's lair, find it, and destroy it once and for all.

As Maria of Cardo, can you make the right choices, and truly defeat The Distortion Beast?

--

The Distortion Beast is an interactive fiction comic. Become Maria of Cardo, an adventurer who dives into the Lair of the Distortion Beast to rid the Axelands of this menace once and for all. Collect items, make choices, and try to defeat the beast!

name: The Reshaping of Googol 1B: The Tower
summary: The Reshaping of Googol 1B: The Tower, is the second game in the "The Secret of Googol" edutainment series. "The Secret of Googol" is a game series by the San Diego-based company Lightspan Inc (aka Lightspan Adventures).

name: The Twins: Ninja War Legends
summary: An adventurous journey of the true great twins from a mysterious village that has a thousand year history of fighting monsters.

name: The Case of Andrew D.

name: The Snowman

summary: A follow-up to The Quintessential Quintuplets: Quints Puzzle Story The Quintessential Quintuplets: Quints Puzzle Story2nd is a “memorial adventure game” featuring the events, cards, and stories from “The Quintuplets Can't Divide the Puzzle Into Five Equal Parts”, the October 27, 2020-released smartphone game based on The Quintessential Quintuplets, minus the puzzle game elements.

name: The Boohbah Zone
summary: The Boohbah Zone was a website and game promoting the Boohbah TV show, featuring a couple dozen minigames and interactive toys revolving around the 'atoms of energy' and various recurring characters in the show.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Whomp's Fortress
summary: A mod that adds Whomp's Fortress from Super Mario 64 to the Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

summary:
Thalamus Collection 1 brings 11 of the all-time best C64 games to Evercade.
The collection includes Armalyte: Competition Edition, Creatures, Creatures II: Torture Trouble, Hawkeye, Heatseeker, Hunter’s Moon Remastered, Nobby the Aardvark, Retrograde, Snare, Summer Camp and Winter Camp.

name: The Chain Witches

name: The Spellbinding Kiss
summary:
A manga that changes its story with every choice you make!
A new challenge from Genius, a company that has sent out various scenario contents to the world―Interactive Comics!
The first one is from the popular story “The Spellbinding Kiss”!
Enjoy the short story of The Spellbinding Kiss in comic form!

name: The Legend of Spyro: Dawn of the Dragon
Thinking Of U: A Love Story
summary: After a long battle with the Dark Lord, Fiona has saved the world from darkness. Now, all she wants to do is relax on her vacation, without any more trouble...

name: The Smurfs: Dreams
summary: It is a 3D platform game with puzzle elements and solo or cooperative gameplay. There are 12 levels in total and another 16 mini-levels. Players can customize their Smurfs with special magical orbs and tokens taken from bosses.

name: The Jackbox Naughty Pack
summary: Bring the heat with a threesome of fun in Jackbox Naughty Pack. Find out who’s the best liar in Fakin’ It All Night Long, illustrate spicy prompts in Dirty Drawful, and answer questions like “How does this avocado get aroused?” in Let Me Finish.

name: The Fateful Encounter
summary: You were just living out your ordinary college days... When one day, you noticed someone's shadow pursuing you... Their target was your precious pendant!

name: The Lost Prince Pirates
summary: Generations ago, humanity was given six jewels with immense power. Now a tyrannical king is determined to collect them all. Your father is the ruler of the last remaining country yet to fall to this reign of terror, so the tyrant king has demanded that you marry his son and relinquish your jewel to him.

name: The Runes of Zendos
summary: The Runes of Zendos, sequel to The Oracle's Cave, is a game in which the merry principality of Dorcasia is conquered by the evil wizard of Zendos, and the player must rescue the twelve months that the wizard has trapped in a hidden hourglass.

summary:

hi,

name: The North
summary: A PS1 style exploration game. Talk to NPCs and try to solve a murder onboard an arctic icebreaker ship trapped in the ice. You play as Doctor David Barclay, the ship's surgeon and the one man above suspicion. Interact with the crew to get clues but beware, you are not a well liked or respected member of the HMS Ectorius.

name: The Sleeping Sickness
summary:
The Sleeping Sickness is an interactive short story that allows the player to guide the main character's actions.

Each day, the player chooses where Grayson investigates. The player’s choices will lock and unlock future locations, change dialogue, and alter the story. Choices matter in The Sleeping Sickness.

While The Sleeping Sickness includes sounds, graphics, and interactive sections, it focuses on the story.

The game is designed to play like a choose-your-own-adventure book and is an excellent choice for horror fans, avid readers, and lovers of creepy pastas.

name: Throne of Belial
summary: This small debut Quake map offers an intense and immersive experience within a dark and ominous environment. Players will journey through a perilous dungeon teeming with lava, metal, and stone structures, along with eerie torch-lit corridors. The ominous glow of lava running along the border of the level and the subtle smoke enhance the atmosphere, casting haunting shadows across the desolate hallways.

name: The Legend of the Astera Stone

Physical additionally comes with:

name: The A-Team
summary: In this game, players control a soldier who must shoot four massive heads that belong to those of the four characters from the series. Each head shoots back, and contact with their bullets result in a loss of life. Once the heads are destroyed, the players proceed to the next level. As players progress to new levels, the speed of each head increases, making it difficult for players to avoid bullets.

name: The Great Space Race
summary:
The Great Space Race is a combination role-playing game and science-fiction space combat game. The basic premise of the game is that a new super-drink called Natof has been discovered. Natof has three key properties, which are to get the person drunk, never leave him with a hangover, and supply him with all the nutrition required from a well-balanced (if never sober) diet.

The name Natof is a portmanteau of the phrase "NAme TO Follow" - the sentence sent with the first batch of miracle drink by the discoverer.

The manual describes the game as "a true computer movie. The player can just watch events unfold, joining in as much or as little as he wishes." The objective is "to deliver, to the space stations as much Natof as the player can, as fast as he can." The game will play itself if left alone — indeed the computer generally makes a better player than a human does — although that rather defeats the point of the game.

name: The Pyramid Gate
summary: The Pyramid Gate is a short but very atmospheric little adventure created by developer Strangethink for the "lowrezjam". Players will explore a very obtuse and surreal environment to see if they can unravel the mysteries of the various pyramids around.

name: The Sun: Key Of Heaven
summary:
Post-apocalyptic action-shooter with RPG elements.

Celebrate the New Year with The Sun: Key of Heaven!

In this action-packed shooter, you'll explore a post-apocalyptic world filled with chaos and mutants. Fight for survival against ruthless adversaries and save the planet from destruction!

name: The Quizard's Domain
summary:
Pub quiz meets pub brawl in this fast-paced, hero-based Battle Quiz!
Show off your brains AND brawn with up to 4 players locally, in a fusion of classic trivia/quiz elements, social deduction games, and fast-paced 2D action brawlers.
Crash, smash, and dash your way to the right answer, take a slower and more deceptive approach to fool your opponents, or forge completely new strategies across the varied playable characters and arenas.

name: The Whale Island
summary:
"It's just a legend, isn't it?"

A legend of an ancient whale island, one no one believes in after so many years. Is there really lost magic there? Tisha makes Fran a promise.

"I'll take you to the whale island."

name: The Act: An Interactive Comedy
summary: A rare fully animated game in the same vein as Dragon’s Lair. A man named Edgar seeks to woo a nurse named Sylvia who works at the hospital, the same site where he is washing windows.

name: Threat Assessment
summary: Small metal/base Coagula-type void level with a high enemy density.

name: The Bonehoard
summary: Large blue/metal level with caverns, blood, bones and otherworldy parts.

name: The Frater Fracas
summary: Medium sized IKbase map.

name: The Simuloid Affair: Infinite Possibilities
summary: You've wanted to be a sim hunter ever since the incident in the Preservation Dome. When you finally made it in the Agency, you put your all into it, deleting simuloids at a rate second only to your partner, rival and best friend, Ursula. And then your routine Mental Diffusion test came back positive. Are you really a simuloid yourself? Are your memories fake? Is being a simuloid actually a bad thing? Is the entire simuloid panic a hoax perpetrated by the Conglomerate?

name: The Call of the Rats
summary: jimmy wakes up in the middle of nature and he can’t find his pa. help him find his pa.

summary: A UDMF DOOM2 wad

The Milk Quest
summary: The Milk Quest is a point-and-click flash game, in which the player have to help a cat to find its milk. The Milk Quest was created by Begamer and published by FastGames in 2011.

summary: The Whims of the Gods is a city-building game where you can play solo or join forces in co-op to shape an ancient civilization, manage people and resources, face divine challenges, and survive under the ever-watchful gaze of the gods.

name: The Purge Club: Kyuusai! Shukusei Circle
summary: In the name of the client, pretty and shy Seina will punish you!

name: The Sheng's Written: Journey of Hoo
summary: Sheng Wen Zhi Fox Tour Legend is a running role-playing game, in order to save the dynasty will fall and the people suffering in the fire, continue to break through and fight against the forces of all sides!

name: The Netcode Conflict
summary: Welcome to 'The Netcode Conflict'! We are working on a futuristic open world survival shooter with an amazing setup. Let`s start with us our development and create with us the next epic game.

name: The Giant Crab in Space
summary: Take control of the Giant Crab and travel to distant star systems on your quest to free the galaxy from a tyrannical alien empire.

name: The Suitor
summary: Fool the King to marry his daughter. Use diplomacy, cunning or magic on your way to becoming a royal. Beat unusual trials, face many horrors, and always mind your manners.

name: Thorns: Adlia
summary: Thorns: Adlia is a kinetic visual novel about the fictional city of Ocean 17 and the mysterious artificial intelligence Adlia.

name: The Blind Swordsman
summary: You're the blind swordsman and you're on a quest to get your sight back! Fight countless enemies and find new skills you never thought you had!

name: The Nightmare of the Air Balloon
summary: A horror game based on a nightmare about a hot air balloon that is used for eyesight testing.

summary: This set includes the following DLC: Van's Swimsuit, Agnès' Swimsuit, Feri's Swimsuit, Aaron's Swimsuit, Risette's Swimsuit, Quatre's Swimsuit, Judith's Swimsuit, Bergard's Swimsuit and École de Aramis Uniform Set.

name: The Nightmare House
summary: Escape from the nightmare mansion alive. In the protagonist's workplace, rumors of a nightmare are spreading. A terrifying dream where one is chased by something horrifying, and if caught, never wakes up again. Navigate through the mansion of horrors, fleeing from monsters, and attempt to escape.

name: The Strong High School
summary: The Strong High School is said to be attended only by strong characters. Before you know it, "you" will be enrolling in THE STRONG HIGH SCHOOL. ---

name: The Spewnicorn
summary: Build the ultimate deck of cards and wield it to defeat the Gatekeepers! A cute and colorful roguelike full of fantastical whimsy!

name: The Flame's Heir
summary: The Kingdom is protected by the Sacred Flame, a source of power that can only be used by the Flame's Heir. This individual comes from a very long lineage of warriors that wage an eternal war against evil. Vaynard, the son of a veteran of war, is called upon a quest he could never anticipate.

name: The Last Vampire Hunter
summary: As the last of a long lineage of Vampire Hunters, Beaumont Lacaster finds himself in the doorsteps of Nosferatu's Castle. By defeating him, he can rid humanity of the curse and evil of vampires. Will he be able to defeat Nosferatu?

name: The Great Conclovince of Mithrithnogg
summary:
Enter the realm of Agrippa, where ancient gods and nightmare-inducing creatures rule supreme! This action-adventure game blends psychological horror with an intense story, which challenges players to survive in a reality distorted by malevolent forces.

In a realm where the line between reality and madness blurs, the face of the ancient god Agrippa lies atop a mountain, commanding legions of grotesque and contorted creatures. Once an artificial humanoid, now wields god-like powers and harbors a deep resentment towards his creators.

Agrippa's torment is relentless; he creates an alternate reality where every living being is a twisted reflection of Mongol, designed to break his spirit and mind.
You are the shadow of Agrippa, tasked with finding a suitable replacement for Mongol now that he is no longer of any use to him!

name: They Grew Lungs and Drowned
summary:
Explore the wreckage.

Speak with the survivors.

The Permanent Food Source has run dry.

Time to move on.

name: The Greater
summary:
Greater, which finds large numbers and quickly touches them and explodes them, is a casual game good for brain activity for the brain.
Try waking your brain in the morning and calming it down in the evening with a brief play.
Look at the collection of circles that appear and pop them in order from the largest.
Time keeps decreasing. But if you pop a circle, you get more time.

name: The Dark Room
summary:
Puzzle your way out of this hi-tech Pandora's Box, and into the illustrious
"Dark Room Hall of Fame"!

name: The Last Dimension
summary:
You find a key to change your dimension. The infinite curiosity of mankind drives you to a decision: to reach the last dimension.
Do not touch the fractals or stay in the black void to reach higher dimensions! Each level has its own endless fractals, so what are you waiting for?
Please make sure not to reveal any personal information in the weekly leaderboard.
Warning: The Last Dimension's colorful effects may cause epilepsy.

name: The Knight Dance
summary:
Gather 'round, young and old.
Listen as I regale you with the tale of two lovers: one as sure as the other is stubborn.
Dancing shoes, a few stolen hours each night, and an important decision to be made.
Does love truly conquer...or is love never enough?

name: The Northern Passage
summary: The Northern Passage is a (work in progress) horror fantasy CYOA, where you play as a hunter sent up north to investigate a series of missing people along the border of your home country and in the port cities of the Blackwater.

name: The Fast and the Furious & 2 Fast 2 Furious
The Quintessential Quintuplets: Memories of a Quintessential Summer
summary: Based on the manga with the same name, it follows a new storyline that sees Futaro trapped with the girls on a tropical island as a brief summer getaway is stretched out over weeks. There, Futaro will interact with the sisters, Ichika, Nino, Miku, Yotsuba, and Itsuki, as well as Futaro's younger sister, Raiha. Players can unlock new artwork, costumes, and up to 14 endings. The gameplay promises a "heart-pounding desert island life" and a "five-girl tutoring adventure experience."

name: The Legend of Zelda: Era of Decline
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Era of Decline is a fan game based on the first The Legend of Zelda, aiming to be a remake for it. It was taken down by Nintendo after it received media coverage.

name: The Match
summary: Here is the video game “The Match”! Released in 1991 on ZX Spectrum, it's still available and playable with some tinkering. It's a sports game, set in a managerial and soccer / football (european) themes and it was released on Amstrad CPC and Commodore 64 as well.

name: The Executive: Movie Industry Tycoon
summary: Shape the history of the Hollywood movie industry in this sandbox business simulation game. Create the movies you've always wanted to see, hire the best team, research cutting-edge technologies, and dominate the Box Office. Can you rise from a small studio to a Hollywood giant?

name: The Soul Ring of Soro: Divine Realm
summary: A very stress relieving game. Possessing various benefits such as possession, transformation, leather items, and fantasy skills. Let you enjoy a different kind of happiness RPG. Many internet memes. Keep up with current events while making you happy.

name: The Strongest Ancestor
summary: "The Strongest Ancestor" is a joyful simulation mobile game of fishing and cultivating immortals. The game contains a large number of cultivation memes and simulation management gameplay, such as farming, alchemy, refining tools, mining, and other gameplay.

name: The Dearest Person
summary: A visual novel about what it means to be human. A story about loneliness, self-identification, and the meaning of existence.

name: The Beauty
summary: "Explore the nuanced dynamics of popularity in 'The Beauty' where players navigate the complexities of social integration and self-transformation.

name: Thursday the 12th
summary: In this first person adventure, you help our friendly serial killer Johnny in his routine, searching for all the stuff he needs to prepare for his big day. Interact with the items you find or inspect them to know what’s going through Johnny’s mind.

name: The Talos Principle Collection
summary: This bundle includes The Talos Principle: Deluxe Edition and The Talos Principle 2.

name: The Psychological Horror Bundle
summary:
The Psychological Horror Bundle brings you three intense and reflective world-acclaimed story driven horrors bundled together at a reduced price!

Burnhouse Lane
Jump into a terrifying adventure from the masters of horror, that will take you to dark places and make you smile, cry and question life. Finish hopeless tasks to win your life back. Solve puzzles, make friends (and enemies), run, hide and fight your way through peril.

Buddy Simulator 1984
The technology is finally here! We utilised the next generation of AI science to simulate the experience of hanging out with your best buddy. He learns and adapts to your personality!

Afterdream
Get lost in a lucid dream, bending the lines between reality and fiction. Utilize the strange camera to navigate through the ghosts' mysterious residence.

name: The Cyclop
summary: Embark on a journey of precision and determination in "Cyclop," where every move counts and every decision shapes your ascent.

name: The Specter's Desire
summary: This year's Desire Hierarchy has begun. The stakes are now deadly. Hop into The Specter's Desire, a Visual Novel in which you play against the city's top talents to save your parents. Includes puzzling gameplay that has you tearing down arguments, hatching schemes, and revealing the truth!

name: The Hell in I
summary: Dare to step into the darkness, and discover the echoes of agony that linger within the walls of St. Agnes Mental Institution. Can you survive the night as you solve puzzles and mysteries of the asylum?

name: The Rainman
summary: Watch your back in the small peaceful town of Crystalpine Grove, as it is haunted by The Infamous Rainman.

name: The Artifact of Ancients
summary: Embark on an epic journey with a courageous band of adventurers as they brave perilous landscapes and face formidable foes in their pursuit of a long-lost relic of unimaginable power.

name: The Echoes of Mars
summary: A tower defence strategy game with a voxel-styled design, set against the backdrop of the red planet. Ancient Martian creatures emerge from Korolev Crater ice, threatening a research base. Protect it while revealing the planet's hidden secrets through strategic gameplay.

name: Three Bulky Bears
summary: The evil circular witch Rolldilocks has kicked the three bears out of their home! Time to get back and kick her out! In this 2D platformer, switch between Baby Bear, Mama Bear, and Papa Bear to navigate a variety of obstacles, as you roll, jump, swim, and smash your way through 50 challenging levels in 5 unique worlds!

name: The Secret Weapon
summary: Get ready for endless laughs with The Secret Weapon - a wacky online card game that guarantees non-stop hilarity! Challenge friends, create insane combinations, and become the champion of absurdity!

name: The Rise of the Dough
summary:
Once upon a time in a culinary land, a passionate Chef Heiny aspired to craft the finest bread imaginable.

Despite earnest attempts, his initial endeavors proved fruitless, leading him to discard the dough in frustration.

However, the following day brought an unexpected turn of events, and everything took a chaotic twist when Doug Heiny was born.

You must stop Doug H. from spreading across the world!

name: The Lonely Logs of Lincoln Lane
summary: Pore through blueprints and datalogs to solve a series of murders without leaving your apartment. A game of logical deduction and critical thinking. Not all is as it seems...

name: thread and Needle
summary: A mixed up conversation between a mixed up spy and his informant.

name: The Dungeon
summary: The Dungeon is a single player real-time role-playing video game featuring a 3D first-person perspective with texture mapping.

name: The Faceless Man
summary: The Faceless Man is a first-person horror game inspired by an old creepypasta about a Tall Thin Man. Brace yourself to confront one of the victims of the ancient legend known as The Faceless Man, whose intentions remain shrouded in mystery.

name: The Fear of The Past
summary: The Fear of the Past is First person psychological horror game. You find your self in abandoned places and you have no idea how did you end there. Stalkers try to catch and you have to fixed the puzzle to escape the nightmares.

name: The Method of Hiding a Body
summary: A story-driven horror puzzle game where the player takes on the role of a resentful ghost, possessing others in order to search for her own corpse.

name: The Lost Penguin
summary: The lost penguins need help to find their way home. You move the penguins on 2D tiles, strategically plan the route, connect with friends, interact with eggs, blockers, teleports, sharks, and solve unique problems on each level.

name: The Trashcan Games
summary: Time for a brain break? Over 25 mini games to cleanse the mind and not think! Glorious Waste Of Your Time Games has a loaded Trash Can waiting for you. Click, reset, done.

name: They Remain
summary: In this massively multiplayer online game They Remain, band together with other survivors to scavenge for resources across the wildlands. Will you thrive amidst the chaos or succumb to those who remain?

name: Through the Fog
summary: - A exploration rogue lite mapping game - uncover the city's secrets through mini-games - sell your map quickly and efficiently to purchase upgrades

name: The Throne
summary: "The Throne" is a medieval adventure in true Metroidvania style. Get lost in a huge castle with 2.5D pixel art environments and increase your power with new abilities you find along the way. Fight fearsome bosses and navigate dangerous traps to make your way to the throne room!

name: The Last Plast
summary: A remake to Xonix made with Claymation to bring a whole new experience.

name: The Beast of the Rosewood
summary: Percival left his comfortable home to research the legends of the local villages. Eager to find and research a thrilling supernatural tale, fortune, and perhaps love, finds him when a mysterious hunter tells him about the beast that’s said to haunt his village’s surrounding woods.

name: The Pepper Prince: Prologue
