summary: Once upon a time, in a pepper kingdom far away, a young baker goes on a quest for hot foods and hot princes.

name: The Pepper Prince: Episode 3 - Into Thin Air
summary:
The kingdom is in shock: The prince has disappeared and an oppressive mist has enshrouded the kigdom. Find the prince to save him and the kingdom!

This DLC unlocks Episode 3 of The Pepper Prince: Seasoning 1, a quirky point-and-click adventure about love, grief, and the power of friendship. Solve puzzles, meet quirky fairy-tale-inspired characters, and help your friend regain confidence and self-love after heartbreak!

name: The Pepper Prince: Episode 4 - Lover's Peak
summary:
Lover's Peak is a place full of memories and stories. Somewhere among them, you will find the key leading you back to your friend the pepper prince.

This DLC unlocks Episode 4 of The Pepper Prince: Seasoning 1, a quirky point-and-click adventure about love, grief, and the power of friendship. Solve puzzles, meet quirky fairy-tale-inspired characters, and help your friend regain confidence and self-love after heartbreak!

name: The Missing Sock
summary: Simple, light mystery to figure out some names and what happened to the missing sock by snooping around and talking to other animals.

name: The Cold Case
summary:
You're one of our best element but were put in here after some ... trouble in your previous investigation.

You have a natural detective mind and are able to visualize the situation from the data noted during the investigation.

Put your experience to use and you may have the right to get back on the field

name: The Lightshield Report
summary:
Alan works in Sentient Resources for the Dark Lord Xysryhfrx, and it appears multiple monsters in the underdungeon have claimed to have killed Gordon Lightshield, mid-level hero, in order to claim the eon-end bonus.

Ask each of the claimants what their story is, and provide the Dark Lord with a report as to who actually got the kill, and deserves the bonus.

name: Thief Monsters
summary:
An expesive diamond has stolen from a museum. Your job is determinate whose stole the diamond and at what time.There are 5 suspects in the diamond theft.
The five suspects were wandering through a nine room museum from 13:00 to 24:00. When you think you know who is guilty of the theft and the time the diamond was stolen, proceed with the accusation.

name: The Necromancer's Pact
summary: Ready to step into a world where curses came? Embrace your new life as Potman, fulfill the pact, and unravel the mysteries of the 'mancers. Where the wardrobe gets lighter, and the adventure gets heavier!

name: The Young Captain
summary: It's a test of strategy, resource management, and leadership as you navigate the delicate balance between preparation and confrontation.

name: The Best Treasure
summary: The Best Treasure is a precision platformer game where an adventurer enters a mystical cavern inhabited by felines. He must gather treasures as a bargaining chip to save his brother, transformed into an insect by dark magic. Each jump and climb brings you closer to the cure and the true treasure.

name: The Excrawlers + Shiro Bundle
summary: The Excrawlers is an action-RPG slasher game in which you and other heroes will have to plunge into the dark atmosphere of dungeons filled with monsters and madness.

name: The Magic and Murder Bundle
summary: Investigate the case of the missing magician, or summon a demonic harem of murderous mistresses in Neon Doctrine’s Magic and Murder Bundle!

name: The Quintessential Quintuplets Double Pack
summary: Vacation with the Nakano quintuplets in this Double Pack!

name: The Sacred Memory
summary: The Sacred Memory is an ADV-visual novel with an exciting plot, mysterious events and vibrant characters. Reveal the secrets of MEMORIAL as the superpowered youngster!

name: The SpudFather
summary: In "Spudfather," become Spud, a charming secret agent on a veggie-fueled mission. Use charisma to disarm foes, especially the beauties who make Spud blush. This ain't your average garden - it's a world where bad guys are ripe for the pickin'!

name: Throw Bro
summary: Throw Bro is a Gameboy style 2D platformer where you throw things to solve problems and beat enemies!

name: The Legend of Lumina
summary: A block pushing puzzle game with metroidvania style progression, set in a serene forest world.

name: The Storyteller
summary: The Storyteller is an online game that takes traditional TTRPG elements into a digital environment. You can build your own world, play online with your friends, engage in role-playing, and guide them through your story.

name: The Untouchable Man
summary: "From the moment we enter this world, the instinct to protect ourselves is ingrained within us.

name: The Gaze of The Eternal Sun
summary: The Gaze of The Eternal Sun is a yuri visual novel independently developed by the DogMade production team. It tells the story of the protagonist, Shikonomiya Sakuya, who is searching for the truth about her eternal life with the help of others.

name: The Month After
summary: Loot, survive and PVP in a vast zombie infested city. Who knows you might make it to an extract.

name: The Legend Beyond Legends
summary: A 3D or Pop-Up book adventure classic Point & Click game about strange legends. Challenge myths, receive powers, find the missing fisherman, and become a legend! 1-2 hours of gameplay for the entire family, original sound track, and great plot twist

name: The Pepper Prince: Seasoning Pass (Episode 2-5)
summary: The Seasoning Pass unlocks Episode 2-5 of The Pepper Prince: Seasoning 1

name: The Case of the Murdered Matriarch
summary: A classic point-and-click noir murder mystery presented entirely within Google Slides.

name: There's No Socks
summary: Have you ever struggled to find the second sock? That's because there's no socks! There's No Socks is a hidden object game with a selection of 4 locations and random socks to find for each of them.

name: Thunder Age
summary: In the flooded future world, mankind has built floating islands where electricity is harnessed during the raging thunderstorms. This unstable energy is crucial for survival, but also poses the greatest risk in this Tower Defense game.

name: The Littlest Fry
summary: You are a small goldfish who has to protect a youngling while discovering how unforgiving the ponds in the wilderness are. Your objective is to defend a baby fish from predators while out maneuvering them while evading other obstacles that may be in your way while searching for safer waters.

name: The Ethernal Spiral
summary: The Eternal Spiral is an immersive fantasy action RPG that blends intense combat, with an interesting time loop mechanic that ensures that every time playing feels unique.

name: The Outbreak
summary: "What would you do to survive?" Interactive Flash narrative game.

name: The Stray Laboratory
summary: Avoid your fears, survive the experiments, explore your prison and figure out a way to escape. The stray laboratory is a puzzle / horror game designed using PS1-era mechanics and graphics combined with modern-day physics and lighting capabilities. The Stray Laboratory is inspired by games such as Resident Evil, Silent Hill and Maniac Mansion, as well as movies such as The Shining, Psycho and Guest House Paradiso.

name: The Fool
summary: A story driven 2D point and click about an unknowing character. Non is a mild manner new villager just moving into their own. They're excited to live a comfortable, peaceful life and get to know the other towns folk.

name: The Cursed Tape
summary: A short horror game about a mysterious videotape that someone slipped under your door. Do you dare to watch it?!

name: The Earl Street Massacre
summary:
Working in an abusive work environment is quite tiring, especially for a chronic workaholic. But at the end of the day, your cozy little home and your loving wife awaits. Well... Most times they do. Follow Thomas Grey, as he gets home after a long day of work at the office. Ready for nothing more then to rest and prepare for the next tiring day back at the office, he goes through his usual nightly routine. Unfortunatly for him, someone else already has different plans for him....

'The Earl Street Massacre' is a short horror game, with simple, pixelated graphics. As mentioned above, you follow Thomas Grey, going through his nightly routine, his night getting progressively worse every passing second.

name: The Frozen Dead Wait
summary: In the heart of the frozen wilderness, a man's search for his daughter spirals into madness and horror.

name: There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst
summary: Play as the vengeful secret agent Virginia West and take on a silver-loving madman called The Silver Fox in this single-player interactive spy novel. Surveil your enemy, get revenge for your partner's demise, and maybe - just maybe - save the world along the way. Don’t do your best … Do your worst!

name: The Orange
summary: In a forgotten universe lies a legendary orange: the Orange of Infinity. Press it to shape existence itself and confront the darkness.

name: The Adventures of Prince Shiratama: Climb the Mountains
summary: Aim for the top of the mountain with Prince Shiratama. Highly difficult platformer game with a casual appearance.

name: The Last Night
summary: "The Last Night" is a horror point and click game, mixing 2D and 3D with a very particular pixel art style. Will you be able to make the right choices ?

name: The Mare of Jonah
summary: A first-person psychological horror/mystery adventure where you play as a small boy trapped in an unknown and dark mansion. Try to survive the vengeful evil spirits lurking in the dark while exploring the rooms and corridors in hopes of finding clues that may lead to a way out of this horror.

name: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time
summary: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time is the last hour of a lost (nonexistent) JRPG, "remade” in 3D pixel art complete with director’s commentary, the digital manual, and archival footage.

name: The Era of Pioneers
summary: "The Era of Pioneers" is a combination of simulation operation, RPG, turn-based, card-type, Rougelite indie, covering agriculture, farming, business management and many other aspects. Players experience their lives by playing as various characters.

name: There's No Socks: The Extra Challenge
summary: Are you ready for the extra challenge? Test yourself against 5 additional levels and in the dark mode!

name: The Academy
summary: The Academy in the Original Game of FusionFall replaced the Future in a Major Game Update. The first four levels of the game moved much faster to get the Player into the Open World Area than it did previously in the Future, however many Players felt that the call to action was not as powerful as before.

name: The Land: Elf no Mori
summary: Growing and harvesting vegetables and fruits becomes NFTs. It is a farming metaverse game.

name: The Last Match Girl
summary: Finding the Place to Return, A survival horror of ashes and light. In a city where the dawn never comes, Scavenging for food, scavenging for life, And yet you are still alive. ………"Welcome home."

name: The 9th Station of M.t...
summary: While being careful of any abnormalities, continue down the mountain path that continues like a cycle and try to escape safely.

name: The Tome of All Tales
summary: The Tome of All Tales is a minimalist old-school shooter that offers a new story every day.

name: The Fantastic Fivesome
summary: After a visit to the doctor, the player is presented with a devastating diagnosis: death in one week! The only cure is having a fivesome with four beautiful women.

name: The Terraces
summary: A classic Doom 2 city-style map originally made for the cancelled community project "Plain Ol' Doom 2". Originally designed as a Map 20 replacement. Level layout is a based on "Central Yharnam" level from From Software's Bloodborne, and the visual theme is a homage to Viggles' Brigandine.

name: The Civvie 11 Massacre
summary: 20 new maps created by Civvie's discord in a contest with a hub map.

name: The Dragon's Turnabout
summary: This trial follows the first bad ending of Dual Destinies

name: The Walking Dead Match 3 Tales
summary:
The Walkers are coming.
Defend against enemy survivor groups and Walkers in this never-ending fight for survival.

name: The Torture House
summary: In September 1994, Victoria Atkins, a young aspiring model, was traveling through Cooke County, Texas, in search of job opportunities when she suddenly disappeared. While it was initially believed she had simply become lost on the road, days passed without any sign of her. But what no one could imagine were the horrors of the ultra violence she would experience in a place that could easily be described as hell, The Torture House.

name: The British Trivia Challenge
summary: How well do you know your British Trivia? Test your knowledge in The British Trivia Challenge!

name: The Empty Turnabout
summary: Taking place in an Alternate Universe of Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Dual Destinies, The Empty Turnabout features the murder of Ian Arts, a mysterious wealthy man responsible for a major scandal in the past. Apollo Justice steps up and decides to defend Nathaniel Marston of this crime, believing that he is innocent despite having confessed to the deed.

name: The Assistant's Turnabout
summary:
Play as rookie attorney June Rye, tasked with defending the impossible.

Phoenix Wright has just lost his badge due to a forgery charge. During his time in prison, scedules a meeting with Redd White, to which Redd White is found dead in a locked room. Phoenix is the only possible suspect, yet he claims Maya Fey killed him.

name: The VR Idol lives next door!?
summary: An Interactive Game that is filled with sensual romance stories! You will delve into the life as an administrative assistant with a gorgeous love!

name: The Nameless City
summary: The Nameless City is a narrative-driven first person adventure inspired by Lovecraft's short novel of the same name. It has lo-fi 3D graphics inspired by the PSX era and uses AI generated images to convey concepts alien to the human mind.

name: The Booty Creek Cheek Freak
summary: The Booty Creek Cheek Freak is a 2022 short parody slasher horror game developed by Jordan King, and produced/published by Puppet Combo.

name: The Censor
summary: Computer genius Yuto Fujimoto finds himself unemployed after graduating college. Wanting an easy life, he gets a job at Facibook as a censor. Editing online content may be boring, but Yuto FLIPS THE WORLD AROUND!

name: Thalassophobia
summary: As a cataclysmic event rocks the planet, you find yourself in an old, decrepit submarine tasked with only one goal: survive. Manage the internal systems to keep yourself alive and fend off undersea horrors as they attempt to cut your journey short.

name: The Rule of She
summary: A soul about to be reborn mistakenly enters a world of strange tales filled with rules. Beware! This place is fraught with danger, and to successfully complete the rebirth, you must follow the rules of this world. The world will correct any soul that violates the rules. Will you comply or defy?

name: The Sims 4: Riviera Retreat Kit
summary: Bask in the rustic scenery surrounding your secluded, peaceful pool with The Sims 4 Riviera Retreat Kit.

name: The Sims 4: Cozy Bistro Kit
summary: Stop by your favorite hole-in-the-wall bistro and take in the antique ambiance of The Sims 4 Cozy Bistro Kit.

name: The Gap
summary: An abstract interactive experience about a Gap

name: The Aching Aversion
summary: A 3D RPGMaker Horror game about exploring a weird bunker. The bunker will have different horrors waiting in it depending on how you broke into it! 7 different routes to 9 unique endings! An ending collecting game!

name: The Dungeons Of Algoduul
summary: Delay your death for as long as possible after finding yourself trapped in a neatly kept Dungeon full of skeletons without legs! Use your Fireballs, Powers, Physics and even use your enemies against each other as you stumble through your very own well lit purgatory!

name: The Bell of Time
summary: The Bell of Time is an adventure, puzzle and combat game where you'll play a teenager brought to a mysterious mansion. Explore this mansion with its horror-like visual and audio ambience, fight against the supernatural and solve puzzles using never-before-seen mechanics!

name: The Crusade Is Nigh
summary: The Crusade is Nigh Or TCIN is a game consisting of rpg, rts, and tower defense elements where you fight to control up to 5 lanes while trying to keep your base alive from enemy attacks using strategy & skill

name: The Die Is Cast
summary: The Die is Cast. Now, all you need to do is trust your companions and penetrate the enemy's weaknesses.

name: The End of You
summary: The End of You is a short, emotional narrative game about love lost, the ghosts of the past, and the painful crawl towards closure.

name: The Bathhouse Restored Edition
summary: The Bathhouse | 地獄銭湯 Remake is a Japanese horror game that revolves around working at a bathhouse. A complete revamp of the original bathhouse.

name: The Front Yard
summary:
"Meat embraces you whole."

Chicago, 1883.

At the epicenter of bloody beef and pig innards live Fergal Byrne and Eoin Kairys, two New Yorkers who've moved to The Yards for work. Their days are drawn out, miserable, and smelly as they survive work just to sleep another night.

The Front Yard is a short, visual-novel-style RPG Maker game following the monotonous and mundane lives of two best friends who've been consumed by the guilt of living and meat they work with.

name: The Ocean View From the Keiyo Line
summary: A short-form interactive fiction game with two endings. A trans woman riding the Keiyo line looks out toward the ocean.

name: That Time I Became Friends with The Royal Scuttlebug Family and Fell From Space
summary: Mario has made some new spectacular friends, who are these fellas? Well, they're the Royal Scuttlebug family. They are on a trip to the famous Hazy Maze Isles to see the new wonder: a Rocket! Ready for its first flight to new adventures! Our plumber and his new friends will make it there safely, right?

name: The Crawler
summary: In the middle of a forest, a group of kids stop by a supermarket to grab some snacks. As they wander through the aisles, strange things start to happen. They soon realize they are not alone. The main character must uncover the secrets of the supermarket and find a way out before it’s too late.

name: The Cornfield Road
summary: This is a short horror experience where you find yourself stuck in a mysterious road, tring to get back home. But are you really safe walking all by yourself?

name: The Queen's Footsteps
summary:
Today is August 27th, 1904. Nine months ago, you, Emilia Vittorini, joined the Italian Archeological Expedition in Egypt led by Ernesto Schiaparelli, the director of the Egyptian Museum of Turin. You are now back in Genoa, Italy: your steam ferry arrived three days ago with 25 wooden boxes containing Queen Nefertari Meritmut's grave goods, a real treasure! They left Genoa by train, heading towards Turin, yesterday evening. While they were in transit, you were invited to a sumptuous reception organised by a wealthy art lover, Eugenio Collovati, count of Raligotto, but it would be hard to say that you appreciated the evening.

But the reception was yesterday: now, you must catch the train to Turin and check that the treasure arrived safely. I will be your eyes and ears. Good luck.

name: The Sea God
summary: A tiny narrative game on gods, leviathans, death, blessings.

name: The Bragger's Club
summary: You don’t know how you got there. You don’t know why you were invited. However, you’re trapped in a room with only a speaker and mic to communicate with 4 other victims. What could possibly happen?

name: The Fall: Mutant City
summary: Caught in post-apocalyptic desert and ravaged by a treacherous disease, nameless outcast has reached a biosphere, a huge dome that covers the city and protects it from the desert. This city is now controlled by mutant clan, which worships to the prophet. Several survivors exist in their hideouts, and one of them, Henry Leicester, saves the outcast once he enters the city. His motives are simple; the outcast should help him with certain tasks and he helps the outcast with medicine to cure the disease. During the game, player will meet more survivors, understand who is who, and try to survive.

name: The Witches' Whisk
summary:
Manage a magical bakery with your witches' whisk — which doubles as a wand!

Bake pastries, cakes, cookies, and more by casting spells and enchantments to complete orders for your hungry customers. In the Witches' Whisk, you'll play as a witch who owns a bakery. You'll be tasked with bakery management, challenging spell casting, recipe unlocking, decorating desserts and more.

In addition, you will be able to build and upgrade your bakery, including decorating the layout and earning new spells along the way to help you take your recipes even further! You'll be able to decorate your baked goods in fun ways that are unique to your style that you can re-use later. Speaking of style... you will be able to create and customize your own character in this magical journey.

name: The Backstreets
summary: The Backstreets is a doom-like FPS made by GRG Productions. You play as Kain Rodriguez, who must fight The Moths to stop them from cloning people. However, you might be a clone yourself. The Moths are a vicious terrorist organization who have taken over many towns and cities, but there are rumors that something much more is going on behind the scenes. Find out what they are doing by playing The Backstreets.

name: The Battle of Aurinoxia
summary: A retro space shoot 'em up with pixel art graphics, unique enemies, tough angry bosses, and a killer soundtrack. You are among the first pilots to arrive in the system to mount the counteroffensive against the aggressors. Get out there and show these aliens the price for messing with The Alliance!

name: The South Island
summary: Welcome to The South Island! Step into the shoes of a young adventurer, explore the rich fauna and flora while collecting essential resources, learn about the indigenous culture, and face unique enemies and bosses of the region to rescue your family in this old-school RPG!

name: The Playful Worm
summary: Embark on a Challenging Journey to Freedom!

name: The Falling Car
summary: Are you tired of mundane car drifting games?

name: The Crystal of the Cave
summary: Embark on an Epic Quest in The Crystal of the Cave!

name: The Unseen Fears: Fortune's Consequence - Collector's Edition
summary: Can you escape an ancient ice spirit before it's too late?

name: The Mythical City 3
summary: Two sides, two crystals

name: The Mythical City 2
summary: Protect your city from evil!

name: The Ultimate Math Teaching Game
summary: A Math game combined with a futuristic 3D gaming experience that will teach you Algebra, Geometry, and Trigonometry. You will properly understand these concepts and solidify them by solving practical problems. Start your science and engineering career with this game!

name: The Breakup Arena
summary: A Beat 'Em Up game where you confront your ex-lovers, blending intense action with deep emotional storytelling. Explore the complexities of relationships and discover inner peace through unique gameplay.

name: The Watcher's Curse
summary: Search for ancient knowledge, face off against the supernatural, and solve the mysteries plaguing the land of Hollow Veil. The forces of chaos are rising and you may be the only living being that can stop them. Traverse the world, level up, and face down esoteric horrors.

name: The Tortoise and the Hare
summary: Explore a retelling of the classic Aesop Fairy Tale. A songbird, named Simon, narrates the tale, bringing the story alive one word at a time. The experience is fully animated and voiced with an easy to digest story mode and lots of bonuses and secrets to discover!

name: The Nine Tailed Celestial Fox
summary: It's a sandbox cultivation game where players recruit and train talents, build their own homesteads, practice alchemy and crafting, battle monsters, and collect materials. The combat mode features automatic side-scrolling battles with companions, meanwhile player can click cards to execute attacks.

name: The Final Keeper
summary: You are the last surviving keeper, tasked with the recovery of the relics dropped by your fellow fallen keepers. Explore a fully destructible dark fantasy post apocalyptic world, as you fight your way towards redemption.

name: The Origin Theory: Episode One
summary: Origin Theory episode one is a lighthearted story driven survival horror experience. Game has it's classic bad guy, zombies, guns and nasty stuff, but the emphasis is on unraveling the mystery and not grinding down hordes of enemies and surviving bullet soaking boss fights.

name: The Shadows Within: Nightmare's Game
summary: In this survival horror game, players guide Andrea after she receives a distressing call from her ex-girlfriend, setting off a chain of events resulting in her abduction. Stranded in the enigmatic Ebonvale, Andrea fights for survival against an unknown foe.

name: The Fast and the Flirtatious: LA Drift
summary: “The Fast and the Flirtatious: LA Drift” is a Yuri Dating Sim that delves into the LA underground racing and drifting subculture but also explores the thriving lesbian dating scene that flourishes in this community.

name: The Bell Echoes
summary: The Bell Echoes is a turn-based strategy game that combines SRPG-style storytelling with roguelike gameplay.

name: Thieves of Dingirra
summary: In this strategy/RPG game, assume the role of the Master Thief, establish a Thieves Guild in Dingirra, recruit NPCs, grow in power, delve into your companions' pasts, and maybe even develop romantic relationships with them. All while aiming to fully conquer the town of Dingirra.

name: The Zen of Kayaking
summary: An 80KB interactive-fiction text adventure game that begins as you set out with your newly acquired kayak one weekend. Created over 10 days by a team of two.

name: The Little Tales of Alexandria
summary:
The Little Tales of Alexandria is a retro short story driven exploration game for Gameboy and Analogue pocket. Staging inside the apartment block Alexandria, featuring 15 plus different apartments all with their own tale to tell.

Talk to the tenants, and interact with almost ANYTHING and EVERYTHING in and out of there homes, including cats!

name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Complete Edition
The Ghost X: Sniper Simulator - Arsenal Expansion
The Beyond Of Fears: New House
summary: Focuses on the mysterious events surrounding a woman trying to build a calm and peaceful life in the absence of her husband.

name: The Monastery
summary: Do you miss classic survival horror games? Here you will find a classic mansion, riddles, a mysterious atmosphere and references to the good old games.

name: The Hole Town
summary: To the town in the hole... a story about a place where I can't go.

name: The Shadow Over Cyberspace
summary: Dread whispers echo across the Information Superhighway. Y2K is coming, heralding the rise of the Old Ones. With your meatspace mind unraveling, time is running out -- barter with gods, embrace the deathless aeons, or go offline permanently in this modempunk horror story.

name: The Thing: Remastered
summary: Set after the events of the 1982 John Carpenter movie, The Thing: Remastered is a squad based 3rd person shooter, where each member of your team is equipped with a range of weapons and items to help you in your quest to destroy The Thing.

name: There She Goes, Wriggle Nightbug!
summary: This game is a Touhou fangame.

name: The Simulation
summary: A never-before-seen horror game is the only evidence found at a crime scene. As a retired game designer hired to investigate the case, you find a hidden mode that plunges you into a rabbit hole of the unknown. As more obscure games are uncovered, cross the fourth wall of their worlds and investigate terrifying truths that transcend their own reality...

name: The Finals: Season 3
summary:
Season 3 was the third season of THE FINALS. It launched on June 13, 2024, and ended on September 26, 2024. It was revealed on June 7, 2024, at Summer Game Fest. The season followed a predominately Japanese theme.

This season was sponsored by ENGIMO, introducing the all-new arena Kyoto and the tournament series World Tour, alongside OSPUZE, which sponsored the OSPUZE Expo, and DISSUN.

New content introduced in Season 3 includes:
- Arena: Kyoto
- Game Modes: World Tour, ranked Terminal Attack
- New cosmetics
- New Battle Pass
- Weapons: Recurve Bow, Dual Blades, Spear
- Gadget: Thermal Bore
- Specialization: Winch Claw
- Progression: New career levels
- Team text chat on PC

name: The Talos Principle II: Road to Elysium
summary: Road to Elysium is a three-part coda that allows you to dive deeper into the world of The Talos Principle 2, reunite with beloved characters, and put your puzzle-solving skills to the test through a series of thought-provoking new stories.

name: The Act of Misdirection
summary: The Act of Misdirection is a short horror story about magic both fake and real, on the stage of Victorian England. It was nominated for a XYZZY for Best Story of 2004.

name: The Big Catch: Tacklebox
summary: Crack open the Tacklebox to show off your platforming prowess and fishing skills in this free prologue to The Big Catch.

name: The Curse of Orion The Next Encounter
summary: This is the ultimate training phase of your Red Faction probationary period. If you survive you will prove yourself as the chosen one to liberate Mars from Ultor when the time comes. Many miners have been sent to this realm, none ever make it back.

name: TheExit8NYC
summary:
In this first-person game, you are trapped in an endless underground passage.
Carefully observe your surroundings to reach “Exit 8”.

Do not neglect any anomaly, floor 0 is a model without any anomaly, look at all the objects carefully.

If you find any anomalies (object different from the floor 0), turn around immediately this will take you to the next floor.

If you don't find any anomalies, go ahead to go up one floor.

If you make a mistake you will start again from floor 0.

Your objective is to exit via exit 8.

move using the wasd keys
You will find various options such as volume, mouse sensitivity and several graphics options in the "ESC" menu.

name: The Path into the Abyss
summary: "The Path into the Abyss" is a hardcore first-person open-world survival shooter set in Buenos Aires with a backdrop of cosmic horror, combat mechanics, dynamic AI, and looting.

name: The Name is Dio
summary:
The Name is Dio is a game in which you must survive for the most time you can!

Loot the foes!
Survive longer!
Get higher points!

name: The Fog
summary: You discovered a strange place in the woods and decide to explore it. But beware, a terrifying monster roams the forest, always on the hunt. Your mission: gather 12 keys to unlock the nearby cabin and escape the creature.

name: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 4
summary:
Time to get ready for what's coming next, Festival-goers!

With Ubisoft Forward fast approaching, we wanted to thank you all for an amazing first year, your continued feedback, and for making The Crew Motorfest what it is today!

We have some exciting news to share with you next week, but before that, we wanted to give you a first look at what's coming for the end of Year 1:

Season 4 will be your next stop at Motorfest - and trust us, your customization skills will have to reach new heights as we kick off a brand-new playlist.

name: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 7
summary:
The Crew Motorfest Season 7 is out now and brings two new Playlists, one on day one, the second on August 6, 17 new vehicles, and new quality-of-life improvements to the game, all for free.

Available immediately, the new Playlist, Ferrari Supercars, adds the Enzo Ferrari Museum to the island of Maui, seven main events, more than 25 challenges, six photo ops, six feats, and the yet-to-be-released Ferrari F80 supercar. Players will be able to explore the museum on a journey through Ferrari's most legendary models, guided by Michele Pignatti Morano, Director of the Ferrari Museums.

name: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 5
summary:
A brand-new Hawaiian island will be added to the game at the launch of Season 5 - in November 2024 - for free!

Maui, a captivating jewel in the Hawaiian crown - the island embodies an exquisite blend of culture, adventure, and natural wonders, thus offering an enchanting setting for the Motorfest Festival.

From the vibrant energy of Kahului urban grounds to the awe-inspiring landscapes of Haleakalā National Park and its bamboo forest, going through the iconic Ohe’o Gulch sacred pools with its cascading waterfalls, Maui beckons with endless exploration.

Maui will add a whopping 345km of total road network to the game, with 229km of that being asphalt and 190km of dirt roads. So, get ready for some amazing island exploration!

name: The Crew: Motorfest - Season 6
summary:
Season 6 is just around the corner, and we've partnered with one of the most prolific brands that specialize in getting your blood pumping!

Red Bull are here to shake things up across the paradisiacal islands of Hawaii! Get ready to rev your engines and experience the next evolution of The Crew Motorfest! Season 6 brings a fresh wave of thrilling content, including new Playlists, expanded locations, 17 new vehicles, exciting gameplay updates, and overall polish.

name: The Book of Buja
summary: Explore the vast, open world of Darrow. Solve puzzles and collect the six Stalm Pirate remains. With the help of the Zapra Viti Hourglass and your ability to peer into a corpse's demise, uncover the mystery behind the Queen's untimely death.

name: The Wisdom of the Minotaur
summary:
The minotaur is a creature that stands at the boundary between human and animal. To be in-between boxes is to be a monster, something to be ostracized. So, really, you ought to choose if you want to be a man or a woman already. Don't you know the consequences if you don't?

A short, surreal kinetic novel about gender.

name: The Raphael Parable
summary:
The Raphael Parable is a community-made modification for The Stanley Parable, being the most popular mod created for the game along with Experiment 427 and the Escape Pod Ending Overwrite Mod.

The Raphael Parable expands the Office to contain several new areas, new visual assets such as furniture, and new Narrator dialogue. Unlike the main game, The Raphael Parable only contains two endings.

name: The Destiny Star of Girlfriend: Episode of Fujiko
summary: A mini-episode of Destiny Star Girlfriend for the sub-heroine Yonamine Fujiko.

name: The White Day
summary: The eighth game released by Gotmail. This game was never translated into English. The player must escape a cafe.

name: The Heist of the Argonaut Limited
summary: Play the part of a witless criminal, hired for a daring train heist where everything goes wrong. Made in the style of classic RPGs and text adventure games; read, roll, and choose your way through this thrilling adventure with countless paths and dozens of unique endings.

name: The Smiler
summary: Ride and play the Alton Towers rollercoaster "The Smiler"!

name: The Last of Us: Between The Years
summary: The Last of Us: Between The Years takes place in the 20 years following Sarah's death and before the main events of the first game. It delves into Joel's character during this period and his grieving process. Explore the relationships Joel forms during this time and uncover some unexpected secrets hidden within the universe of The Last of Us. This game does not contain any spoilers for the main storyline of Part 1 or Part 2.

name: The Grass of Genesis
summary: This third-person action-adventure seems to be akin to the beloved Tomb Raider series and the adrenaline-packed John Wick film franchise. The gameplay video showcases a prototype that introduces various gameplay elements and engaging animated cinematic sequences.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Sundarpatan Nepal Hunting Reserve
summary: Brave the beauty at the stunning Sundarpatan Nepal Hunting Reserve. Hunt among three distinct climate regions and go in pursuit of 10 new animal species.

name: The Finals: Season 3 Starter Pack
summary: The Season 3 Starter Pack bundle includes: - 3 Legendary Weapon Skins - Season 3 Sticker - 1 150 Multibucks

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Midŋighţ Skin - Elyrioŋ Tribe
summary:
∑∫ỹriȱŋ Skin
Among the dark, spooky forests resides the ₼idŋighţ Cult, an insidious grouping of ∑∫ỹriȱŋ that worship and draw their power from the mysterious Shard of D'Naeh. They've set their sights on transforming the Square into an endless dark forest populated by hungry Dire Wolves, corrupted Dragons, and shadowy Demons.

name: The Ghost X: Sniper Simulator - Premium Edition
The Boys Escape
summary: Gather and lead your army to the finish line! Face your enemies and win the battle!

name: Threshold Sector
summary: You've been stranded by your company in a section of the facility known as "threshold sector". You'll have to find weapons, meds and equipment to survive and try to escape the complex. But be as careful as possible: everything down here wants you dead.

name: The Cake
summary: Deliver a birthday cake to your beloved daughter! Avoid oncoming passersby and aim for the goal! If the cake collapses when it hits someone, you will die instantly! A casual but highly difficult action game.

name: The Lost Compressor
summary: A violence-free top-down puzzle adventure for everyone interested in engineering.

name: The Day Of Survival
summary: The Day Of Survival Immerse yourself in a post-apocalyptic world where every decision is crucial. "The Day Of Survival" is a thrilling survival game that challenges players to explore a harsh, unforgiving landscape filled with zombies and enemy soldiers.

name: The Caldecott Caper
summary: The lowest form of life in the Sixth World is that of the corporate rent-a-cop. You are paid a paltry wage for the privilege of defending the megacorps' ostentatious wealth from the desperate gangers of the Orkland Sprawl. Enter a world of turmoil, greed, and violence, as you struggle for survival with the help of a few hand-picked allies.

name: The InBetween
summary: The InBetween is a 2D, action-packed yet emotional Undertale-Metroidvania in which your fate, as well as the fate of an infected world, lies in your skills and choices.

name: The Great Adventures of Nedmapagmahal
summary: Action rage game that will test your limits

name: The Isles of the Seven Moons
summary: The Isles of the Seven Moons is a First-Person Ritual Sacrifice Adventure where you explore a surreal and relaxing environment while completing an ancient ritual in order to meet the Moon-Sage.

name: The Story of Miss Mouse
summary: An educational game for Apple II.

name: The Croaker: The Ice
summary: An Ice-Themed Expansion Pack with tons of new levels!

name: The Hardest Game in the Universe: DLC 3
summary: The DLC 3 for "The Hardest Game in the Universe" has arrived, bringing an extra dose of difficulty and challenging new enemies. Get ready to tackle complex environments, new traps, and a variety of cunning adversaries.

name: The Dragonspire
summary: It is a dark modern world with a massive surprise to Fantasy, including Scandals, Corruption, Death, Tough Choices, and entire Character Progression while the shape of the world around you changes. The romance you will experience along the way will be rewarding and have an in-depth storyline.

name: The Cursed Land
summary: Embark on a mystical MMORPG adventure with "The Cursed Land"—a world of ancient myths, diverse classes, and strategic combat where every choice forges your destiny.

name: The White Canvas
summary: The White Canvas is the story of Nico Sales, a very ironic painter without inspiration and with a lot of personal problems. Midas, the most important patron in the world has arrived at his city. Nico needs to find him and convince him to take care of his artistic career. This won't be very easy for Nico because feels depressed and anxious due to his lack of inspiration. Moreover, Midas it's very evasive and discret. Will Nico be able to find Midas and convince him? Try to help him and you will find out a lot of interesting things about the charismatic painter Nico Sales. -- Thanks to David Silva for his help.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom
summary:
The people of Hyrule are being stolen away by strange rifts that have appeared, and with a certain swordsman among those missing, it’s up to Princess Zelda to save her kingdom.

Team up with the mysterious fairy, Tri, and use the power of the Tri Rod to learn how to create echoes, imitations of things found in the environment. You can then recreate those echoes whenever you like to solve puzzles and defeat enemies.

Create echoes like water blocks to reach new heights, make bridges out of old beds, throw rocks at foes, or find your own creative combination of echoes to do things your way. You can even create echoes of monsters to fight at your side in combat!

name: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy
summary: A new adventure from the creators of the Danganronpa and Zero Escape series! 15 students are tasked with defending a school from grotesque monsters for 100 days. Can they make it to the end? And will they survive long enough to uncover the truth?

name: Threewave Capture
summary: Threewave Capture is a modification for Quake made by Dave 'Zoid' Kirsch. CTF introduced a couple of things in addition to goal orientated teamplay: runes and a grapple hook. A version of it is included in Quake Remastered.

name: Threewave
summary: Threewave is a remake of the namesake mod for Quake III Arena, featuring other gamemodes like Rune Free-for-All and Capture-Strike. Much of its content was later added to Quake Live.

name: Those Days
summary: Those Days is a casual gay adult visual novel about a guy who decides to spend a few days in his family's farmhouse. There he meets Cott, Salmi, and later on, a few other characters that will make his vacation a bit more interesting.

name: The Blue Pendrive
summary: This is a fan-made adaptation of a story written by ‪Sinuois‬, called "El Pendrive Azul" or "El USB Azul"

name: The Ambush!
summary: The Ambush! is an intense and exciting game of strategy and action, where players take on the role of a group of policemen rushing to defend a bank from a group of dangerous thieves.

name: The Way You Died
summary: How did this person die?! Use your deduction skills to find out! In this first-person view detective game, you will role-play as a medical examiner through several real-life, weird cases. Inspect the crime scene to gather clues, collect intelligence, examine the corpse and perform an autopsy.

name: The Real Driver
summary: What sets "The Real Driver" apart is its unique requirement: all cars are equipped with a manual gearbox.

name: The Flying Farm
summary: Epic Journey to the moon, rescue the Baby Starling! Travel the world and help Barney the farmer to bring back the baby star to his parents in this captivating time management game. This won't be easy, as you'll travel in the sky, in the ocean or on a blazing hot volcano before reaching the Moon!

name: There's No Aliens
summary: There's absolutely no aliens! We all know they are a myth and nobody ever seen one!

name: The Shadowed Rune
summary: 'The Shadowed Rune' is a challenging roguelike game that you can play solo or in two-player co-op. Combine the power of runes to discover new spells and ascend the tower to break the curse.

name: The Bucketlist Tourist
summary: The Bucketlist Tourist is a physics-based multiplayer party game where players complete tasks and capture them photographically. In the battle for the best snapshot, they share only a single camera.

name: The Perfect Bowl
summary: Uncover the stories of your customers with a nice warm bowl of personalized Ramen in this cozy interactive fiction. Travel around Xibalba, a harsh and frigid planet, to meet new people, catch up with old friends, and guide them along their lives depending on the ingredients you choose to add.

name: The Stellar Station Engineer
summary: A sci-fi turn-based strategy, station building game where you need to manage resources and protect the station and human inside from the danger of space, and your own action.

name: The Hustlers
summary: Join the league of hustlers, a secret organization of revolutionaries, cheating card players, swordsmen and detectives. A game that mixes classic adventure games with card tricks, duels and investigation in a plot to uncover the truth.

name: The Jiang Shi 2: Curse of Soul
summary: This is an independent development game based on the Chinese folklore "JiangShi", with a 2.5D horizontal operation perspective as the main focus, and features exploration, decryption, fighting, capture and other game features and gameplay.

name: The Overseer
summary: You are an Overseer on duty. Cycle through the camera feeds looking for anomalies. Upon finding one, report it quickly. Too many anomalies can lead to severe distortions in reality and result in deaths, including yours.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Deluxe Collection - Gold Road
summary:
Pre-purchase now to get immediate access to a new mount and additional rewards at launch.

The Elder Scrolls Online Deluxe Collection: Gold Road is ideal for adventurers who wish to access all major Chapter zones and quests found across Tamriel. The Deluxe Collection: Gold Road includes the Base Game, Gold Road, all previous Chapters (which can be played immediately), and all previous Deluxe in-game items.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road
summary:
Pre-purchase now to get immediate access to a new mount and additional rewards at launch.

The Elder Scrolls Online Collection: Gold Road is ideal for adventurers who wish to access all major Chapter zones and quests found across Tamriel. The Collection: Gold Road includes the Gold Road Chapter (available at launch) in addition to the base game AND all previous Chapters (available immediately).

name: The College Brickout
summary: Get ready to experience the ultimate gaming adventure with THE COLLEGE BRICKOUT. This game features popular artist Kanye West as the protagonist, where players have to help him navigate through various challenges and obstacles to reach his ultimate goal, with it's new and sealed packaging, this game is a must-have for any video game enthusiast. The game is compatible with PlayBlocks 2 and promises hours of entertainment and fun. So, gear up and get your hands on the most exciting game of the year, THE COLLEGE BRICKOUT!

name: The World Ends With You: Noise Busters
summary: A Score-Attack Arcade game with RPG features based on the cult classic, The World Ends With You.

name: The Enchanted Turnabout
summary: The local baker of Labyrinthia stands against the Knights of the Inquisition to prove that the daughter of a wealthy landlady is not actually a witch.

name: The Secret Turnabout
summary: There is no such thing as a flawless system. No matter how we delude ourselves, the cracks will always appear. When that time comes for it to crumble under the weight of failed expectations, will you salvage the remains? Or, will you pretend that it was all just a bad dream?

name: The Scrapper
summary: The ninth game released by Gotmail, in collaboration with Sugiura Metals Company. This game was never translated into English. The player must solve a mystery in a scrapyard.

name: The Maestromusic
summary: The Maestromusic is a rhythm game that comes bundled with a conductor baton controller. In order to play the game, you have to wave the baton at the right speed and with the right amount of force in order to match the game's desired tempo and volume for the length of a song. Depending on how accurate you are with each swing, the game will either grant or subtract points and if you run out of points, you'll fail the song. At the end of a song, you're ranked based on your overall accuracy. The game is divided into Rehearsal and Concert modes that each have their own sets of songs from famous composers. In each mode, you need to complete three songs before the credits will roll. Once songs are played in the main modes, you can replay them as you please in the Free Mode and also read information on each of the game's featured composers.

name: The Tentai Show
summary: The Tentai Show is a free downloadable game for the Nintendo DSi, availible via DS Download Play. The game was created during the 2010 Nintendo Game Seminar. In the game the player defends Earth utilizing a black hole and a white hole.

name: The Intern of Christmas Present
summary: The Intern of Christmas Present is a visual novel where Pressie's last trial before becoming a holiday specter is turning the heart of Girl Dracula, enemy of Christmas. It is a sequel to the story "Vamp Me!" in the developer's previous visual novel, A Trick and a Treat.

name: The Sumerian Game
summary: A game of strategy and management. The Sumerian Game is one of the earliest computer games. Developed and programmed between 1963 and 1965, it was designed to teach children math, economy and ancient history. The source code was lost but now you can play it again.

name: The Playroom: Ninja Bots
summary: Sharpen those shurikens, it's time to send your AR Bots into action in this virtual ninja training mode for up to four players! Using your Dualshock 4 wireless controller, take control of your own Ninja AR Bot, avoiding traps and flicking ninja stars to achieve Ninja Mastership.

name: The Playroom: Toy Maker
summary: Using your smartphone, tablet or PS Vita system, let your creativity loose as your drawings magically transform into toys for your AR Bots to play with. You can create anything you like!

name: The Playroom: My Alien Buddy
summary: Take your fun to another galaxy with this new toy coming to life exclusively inside The Playroom. My Alien Buddy comes complete with deformable body, UFO and gravity beams, so you can spread mayhem in your living room! And best of all: no battery required!

name: The Occultist
summary: The Occultist is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore GodStone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

name: The King of Fighters XIV: 4 Character Bundle 1
summary:
This bundle includes the additional 4 characters ('ROCK HOWARD', 'VANESSA', 'RYUJI YAMAZAKI' and 'WHIP').
These characters will be playable in 'THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV' with this bundle purchase.

name: The 2nd Old-School Level Design Contest: Collaboration Hack
The 1st Old-School Level Design Contest: Collaboration Hack
The Adventures of Catto Boi
summary:
Are you sick of the same old thing over and over again? Generic non-stimulating platforming, little to no plot development, and overall boring gameplay?
Well... unfortunately, you're out of luck.
The Adventures of Catto Boi is the first of many adventures featuring an angry cat who has to find lost cat biscuits scattered all over some random, poorly designed levels.
Doesn't sound fun... But how would you know if you haven't played it?

name: The Case of the Mysterious Maulings
summary: The good news: you've been invited to a classy dinner party in a stately gothic manor! The bad news: you're a hideous, bloodthirsty monster and you keep viciously murdering people. Avoid suspicion by pretending to search for the killer while framing the other party guests. It's kind of a "Clue" meets "Monkey Island" meets "Doom" meets a dating simulator kind of thing.

name: The Jingol
summary: The teachings of his excellency: Jingol.

name: There's No Monsters
summary: Have you checked under the bed? Or in the closet? We guarantee there's no monsters there!

name: The Sims 4: Lovestruck
summary: Explore romance as you match with alluring Sims and plan exciting dates in The Sims 4 Lovestruck Expansion Pack.

name: The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf: A Tale of Cutthroat Lovers
summary: In this twisted love story of a visual novel by CLOCKUP, an insomniac must decide whether to protect his position as a yakuza bigwig’s pet killer or the mysterious woman who can put him to sleep.

name: The Pro Yakyuu Super '94
summary:
The Pro Yakyū Super '94 is a follow-up to The Pro Yakyuu Super. With the exception of a new mode, different music, commentary, and slight interface changes, the gameplay is largely identical to that of the previous entry.

Rosters of the licensed professional Japanese baseball teams have been updated to the current season. The new mode is called "Home Run Contest"; the player controls a batter against a computer-controlled pitcher, trying to score a home run.

name: The Standard Model
summary: The Standard Model is a narrative walking simulator/slice-of-life game set in different worlds throughout the multiverse. The player takes on the role of an undergraduate student that gets to explore and experience 5 different worlds on a quantum adventure.

name: The Choicer Voicer
summary: Use your own voice to match voice clips in a gameshow format. Many customizable options, including the ability to add any audio desired.

name: The Peacekeeper
summary:
In a distant-near future where Global Peace is attained, perceptions of reality can become muddled.
Berzerk Studio presents their rendition of a peaceful utopia; play as the Peacekeeper and promote peace and morality through any mean necessary.

name: The Capitol Cheese Agreement
summary:
The Capitol Food Corporation is rumoured to be adding tracking devices into their food products, transmitting surveillance data on the population on a widespread scale.

According to your clients, they are silently signing a new contract which may have devastating consequences. Your mission is to infiltrate one of their headquarters and retrieve the entirety of the contract for further investigation.

name: The Train Part 2
summary: The Train Part 2 is a sequel to GnomeKing Games's first Game Boy title, The Train. It picks up immediately after where The Train ended, taking Eve and her grandad to a megacity called New Bromdal.

name: The Penguins of Madagascar: Dr. Blowhole Returns Again!
The Obligatory Undertale Yellow Sans fight
summary: The Undertale Yellow Sans fight.

name: The Mystery of the Planet Venus
summary: The Mystery of the Planet Venus is a single-player first-person adventure game set on the planet Venus.

name: The Way Home
summary: One strange evening, our nameless protagonist finds himself on top of a hill--dead-- with little to no memories to go off of. All he knows is that his purpose is to go home.

name: The Lair of Nekro Neko
summary:
Game made for Black and White Jam #8 (Theme: Loop)

In this game you are Salem, a cat trapped in a time loop that will only be undone when he defeats the Machiavellian sorcerer Nekro Neko and saves his friends. For this, Salem will need to face evil creatures that increase his time inside the loop.

The more time he has, the more he will be able to explore the village and get more equipment to face the necromancer cat, but he will have to be careful as his time inside the loop is reduced when being attacked.

name: The Missing Trail
summary:
Today's the day of the Annual Halloween Bonfire! But why is it so... quiet?

The Missing Trail is a short visual novel about community, communication, and Halloween! Follow Tom the ghost as he investigates the mystery of the missing forest trail with the help of his new monster friends! But be careful… there may be mischief afoot!

name: The Punisher
summary:
Shooter game similar to Operation Wolf, based on Marvel comic hero, The Punisher.

Each level consists of a series of single screens in which The Punisher needs to kill all enemies. Shooting an innocent results in instant game over.

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles
summary: Experience a slice of the Jura Tempest Federation life with friends

name: The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf: Woolly Eyes Gaiden
summary: The romantic noir visual novel The Restless Sheep & The Lone Wolf returns to Kabukicho in this unhinged simul-quel. Me, Azami, and the whole ragtag gang rampage through five all-new short stories!

name: The Man in the Fields
summary: The Man in the Fields is a first person horror game based on a ritual of the same name. Once you summon The Man in the Fields, every door and item in your house will be opened. Close everything in time to prevent it from getting in.

name: The Goddess Robbery
summary:
This game is a small adventure (point and click) with two scenes, it can be completed in a few minutes.

Robert Robie's passion is to steal artworks. This time he wants the famous Snake Goddess. Can you steal it?

name: The Simpsons: Bug Squad!
summary: Explore the Simpsons' house as a bug. Pitched to Fox but rejected.

name: The Cell
summary: A Free Short Game For Ludum Dare 38

name: The Legend of the Blue Sword
summary: The evil necromancer has taken over the Castle. As the heroic warrior of this land, it is your task to slay this foul sorcerer and banish him from this realm once and for all.

name: The Jumper Ninja
summary: The Jumper Ninja is an exciting action-packed game that puts you in the shoes of a skilled ninja.

name: The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor
summary:
The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor is an award-winning interactive horror from Stefan Vogt, the acclaimed author of Hibernated and The Curse of Rabenstein.

Take on the role of novelist Thomas King and his wife Cora as they move into a remote Scottish manor house, just days before Christmas 1986. Seeking inspiration for his next book, Thomas begins to explore the history of Blackwood Manor, only to uncover a dark secret that dates back centuries to the days of the Great Scottish Witch Hunts.

The Ghosts of Blackwood Manor is a complex interactive fiction piece written in Infocom's advanced Z-machine format XZIP. The game has three different endings, a bad, a neutral and a good ending, depending on the player's choices. It is very likely that the player, on a first playthrough, will not reach the good ending, even though it is possible. Reaching the bad or neutral ending first is part of the experience and helps the player understanding the true intentions of some of the NPCs and the impact of decisions made, so they may be reconsidered.

name: The Crossword
summary: The Crossword is a browser game playable on The New York Times website. The features daily crossword puzzles.

name: The Test of Insanity
summary: Ever argued with a squirrel? Welcome to The Test of Insanity by Big Nuts! Dive into twisted puzzles, quirky quizzes, and bizarre mini-games. It's not just a game; it's a brain-bending adventure. Think you can outsmart the madness? There's only one way to find out. Play now and embrace the insanity!!

name: The Key of Avalon
summary:
Avalon no Kagi, alternatively known as The Key of Avalon is an arcade game developed by Hitmaker and published by Sega on the Triforce arcade board. It is the third card arcade game by Sega. It is a combination of sugoroku style board game and combat trading card game.

It was often compared to Culdcept, and is able to be played by multiple players at once, using a free in and free out method where other players can drop in and drop out of a match at any time. The cabinet reads a deck of up to 30 cards.

Sega Logistics Service announced it would end service on the machines on March 31, 2017.

name: The Lost Treasures of Infocom II
summary:
The Lost Treasures of Infocom II is a collection of text adventure games from interactive fiction pioneer Infocom, published by Activision in 1992. It was available for MS-DOS and Apple Macintosh, and also as a cross-platform expanded CD-ROM version. This follow-up compilation was released following the commercial success of their previous collection, The Lost Treasures of Infocom, which contained 20 of Infocom's most popular games.

The 11 games included in all versions are:

A Mind Forever Voyaging
Border Zone
Bureaucracy
Cutthroats
Hollywood Hijinx
Nord and Bert Couldn't Make Head or Tail of It
Plundered Hearts
Seastalker
Sherlock: The Riddle of the Crown Jewels
Trinity
Wishbringer

The CD-ROM version included three additional games:

Arthur: The Quest for Excalibur
James Clavell's Shōgun
Journey

The package contains an instruction manual reprinting all of the games' manuals, as well as a few pack-in items from Sherlock and Trinity. However, it leaves out the InvisiClues hint booklets from the original games, replacing them instead with a card advertising a pay-per-minute hint line. The package also includes a coupon for the game Leather Goddesses of Phobos, which had not been included in either of the two collections.

The CD-ROM version includes an instruction manual with instructions for all three games, the Book of Hours pack-in from Arthur, and the maps from Journey and Shōgun.

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
summary: An unlicensed Lord of the Rings Game using the engine from Pocky and Rocky with Becky. Despite the name, the game is vaguely based on the first Lord of the Rings movie, The Fellowship of the Ring. Each level starts off with a screenshot from the movie, though the actual levels and bosses have little resemblance

name: The Last Goodbye
summary: In the shadowy fairy tale metropolis of Prava, the world-weary gun-for-hire Lucille - better known on the streets as The Banshee - takes a job from enigmatic entrepreneur Ark McLean. Her target: Bullseye, the deadliest gangster in town. On her travels through the criminal underworld she meets all manner of friends and foes, with plenty of action and intrigue along the way.

name: The Case Book of Arne: Interlude
summary:
Get a taste of Lynn and Arne's everyday life between cases!
There's a lot more to Lynn's life in the other world than you see in the main story!
Take the curious events at the Lugenberg Festival...
Unravel a new mystery in this Interlude chapter,
which takes place between Cases 1 and 2.

name: The Immortal Lock
summary:
You are Ranger, an operator of the UTJR stationed at a secret, multinational research facility in Finland. You are being deployed to investigate the disappearance of a survey team that went missing beyond the slipgate, cast into the farthest reaches of existence. Yet through the thin veil of reality, you find only a desolate plane of flesh and despair, and a dread voice that beckons your name.

This map is larger than an entire episode, if played in its entirety, and is best experienced in segments. It includes a story, extremely challenging fights, trick jumping, and a vast amount of large secret areas, but is difficulty scaled to accommodate everyone.

name: The Callisto Protocol: Outer Way Skin Collection
summary: Get the Outer Way Skin Collection and survive The Callisto Protocol’s terrifying campaign in style or show off your player and weapon skins in Photo Mode. This collection includes Outer Way themed player and weapons skins for all your gear.

name: The Aztec Ruins
summary: Aztec temple inspired map.

name: The Sub Shop
summary: Duke finds himself in a rocky area close to the sea.

name: The Monastery of Mount Cinburron
summary: Command noticed an anomaly in their Slipgate network. After sending a few scouting parties into the anomaly, none of which have returned, they are starting to fear the worst. They sent you in to investigate the anomaly and report your findings upon your return.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Allhallows Eve
The Based Turnabout
summary: Phoenix Wright faces his final case of his career before retirement, but a case involving the king of turnabouts is never so simple, is it?

name: The Experimental Turnabout
summary: Phoenix, Maya, and Edgeworth awake in a courtroom that seems normal at first, but is in fact one located within a virtual reality created by an individual known only as the Game Master, who insists that this will be a 'history-making experiment'. Now the trio must play along with his scheme and complete the trial he has laid out while working together to figure out who the Game Master is, why he's conducting this experiment, and just how they wound up in this situation at all.

name: The End of the World
summary: Yet another city at night - except this particular one is under a pretty fucking serious type of attack. You wake up to an alien ship having just crashed right down your apartment building.

name: The Last Pissed Time
summary: Duke is held hostage in a prison cell by those alien bastards. He must escape and shut down their power plant.

name: The Rock
summary: A prison themed map based on Alcatraz.

name: The Rock
summary: You are on a island prison and have to fight your way through from the front gate right into the heart of the prison

name: The Corrupted Turnabout
summary: Taking place a few months after Turnabout Time Traveller, Apollo Justice returns from Khura'in to America on what is supposed to be a simple vacation. Unfortunately for him, he is roped yet again into yet another murder case. With a high profile client, a familiar prosecutor and a locked room mystery, will he able to solve the case and glean the truth?

name: The Spirit's Turnabout
summary: Be welcome to The Spirit's Turnabout.

name: The Turned About Turnabout
summary:
Phoenix and Maya are thrown into yet another murder case with little to no idea of what they're doing. Same old, same old, huh? Except, this prosecutor... well, let's just say he's a bit "special." With such a clueless opponent, this should be an easy ride for our humble protagonists.

...Right?

name: The Other Side
summary: This is a very short story, set outside Ace Attorney canon. The game follows Morty Cisco, an entirely unremarkable young man who meets with an unfortunate accident. Now he struggles with an incident from his past that he would prefer to forget. This is a new style for me, so let me know what you think.

name: The Dividing Line
summary: A short game set outside Ace Attorney canon, this game has multiple endings with branching paths with even 'incorrect' choices leading to something new.

name: The Dinner Heist
summary:
The Dinner Heist is a hard platformer game where you play as a rat who has gotten down on hard times. It is your job to help him steal a meal from this prestige factory that creates food.

Developed By TapeTracker

name: The Sinking City: Investigator Pack
summary: Upgrade your gaming experience with an exclusive private investigator outfit, permanent access to a first aid kit, antipsychotics and a crafting materials starter pack.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Sissy Wildflower Outfit
summary: Even when on the hunt, Grandpa always expects everyone to look their best for dinner time! This DLC will give you one brand new outfit for Sissy.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Weapon Skin Variants
summary: What better way to show off your depravity than these new weapon skins! This pack features three new weapons skins each for The Cook, The Hitchhiker, Sissy, Johnny, and Nancy. Maim and kill in style!

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Danny Outfit Pack
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Danny.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Nancy Prim 'N Proper Outfit
summary: Even when on the hunt, Grandpa always expects everyone to look their best for dinner time! This DLC will give you one brand new outfit for Nancy.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Johnny Razor-sharp Outfit
summary: Even when on the hunt, Grandpa always expects everyone to look their best for dinner time! This DLC will give you one brand new outfit for Johnny.

name: The Paradogx Incident
summary:
Step into "The Paradogx Incident," where puzzle-platforming meets rhythmic precision. Guide Dox the dog through mind-twisting, recursive puzzles in a dynamic, beat-driven world and rhythm levels.

Enjoy full controller support and an adaptive soundtrack that changes with every dimension.

Experience a unique blend of genres in this innovative adventure!

name: Throw it! Dinosaur Panic
summary:
Throw it here! Throw it here!
A dinosaur drop game!

name: The Toy Factory
summary: After a hard night drinkin' Duke wakes up in the basement of his office building.

name: The Three Kingdoms Era in China 2000 Years Ago: God Pass
summary: Derived from "Fengshen Bang", a turn based strategy and mythology game in battle chess

name: The Fox's Way Home
summary: Before you know it, you find yourself in the realm between the hidden world and the real world. Rely on the guidance of the Fox shrine Maiden who lives there, and escape from the otherworld!

name: The Feast of Madness: A Night of Drowning in Forbidden Temptation
summary: [New Genre of Horror × Erotica: Escape from the Mad Women!]You stop by a mansion to be invited for a free dinner. Once inside, you are taken by magic somewhere dark. If caught, you will be beaten, ××, and forced to submit. Solve the mysteries and escape the mansion.

name: The Dead Zone 2
summary: Go to various death zones filled with unknown creatures, complete the mission at all costs, and then evacuate. Of course, we will provide various black technology blessings for everyone. Wish you good luck.

name: The Gourmet Factor
summary: The Gourmet Factor - it gives creatures the instinct to eat and be powerful. Strong people who have mastered the factor are active in this continent in the name of food hunters. It is also the prelude to your adventure

name: The Polar Explorer: Hokkyoku he no VR Soriasobi
summary: This is a VR adventure type game in which you play as a brave pilot who drives a sleigh through a world full of icebergs and snow on a polar expedition.

name: The Suspected Murder
summary: Deep night, famous suspense novelist fell from the balcony, leaving his young wife an enormous heritage. Accident, or calculated murder?Novelist's nephew secretly began investigation.He found a hidden manuscript, which contains a creep story, as well as the key clues concerning its author's death.

name: Thief Simulator: Heist Master
summary: Are you ready to embrace the life of a master thief?

name: The Last Ninja
summary: The NES Port of "Last Ninja 2: Back with a Vengeance".

name: The Karate Kid: Street Rumble
summary: Set in the iconic locations of the first three classic The Karate Kid movies, The Karate Kid: Street Rumble lets you step out of the dojo and into the streets of the 1980s San Fernando Valley and Okinawa. Battle waves of challenging enemies in this fast-paced, side-scrolling beat ’em up adventure, brought to life with colorful pixel-art visuals and chiptune music.

name: The Powerpuff Girls: Monkey Mania
summary: Mojo Jojo has stolen the Powerpuff Girls' Chemical X and unleashed an army of manic monkeys and it's now your quest to save Townsville!

name: The Nightmare Chronicles: Horror In Da Hood
summary: Mason is assigned a new job from the big boss when strange things start happening and he discovers the true meaning of fear... Horror in Da Hood is a gripping first-person horror game set in the hood, where the supernatural lurks around every corner. Are you brave enough to face the real terror?

name: The Final Ultra Super Duper Cube Cavern Deluxe GOTY Edition
summary: An action packed "shoot-em-up" through the treacherous underworld from Cube Cavern!

name: The Lost Frames
summary:
This game was made for the Mini Jam 62: Colors.

The world used to be more fluid, but some great calamity has forced the world into two frames. It is your job to go to the three worlds and bring back the animation key frame gems, only then will fluid motion be brought back to the world.

name: The Ice Cream Culprit
summary: Your girlfriend's limited edition ice cream has been stolen! Was it you? Will you help her find it? All that is to be decided by 4 different endings.

name: The Prototype
summary: The Prototype is a short, analog horror-inspired kinetic visual novel.

name: Thunder Jaws
summary:
8-bit home computer conversions for Atari's ThunderJaws.

These conversion are single player, and features 4 levels instead the 13 levels available on the arcade version.

name: The Palace of Fear
summary: A dark turtlemap remake of e4m4. Uses Quoth entities, so you need that mod installed.

name: The Slipgate Massacre
summary: Remix/remake of the original E1M1 - The Slipgate Complex, but larger and more spacious, with many new and expanded areas.

name: The Subterrestrial Hangar
summary: Small idbase level set in a miliary base/hangar. It features three distinct route choices: normal combat, permanent quad damage, and slime maze, and is supposed to be the first map of an episode focusing on these route mechanics.

name: The Sherwood Open
summary: C64 Middle Age mini-golf with Robin & friends at the Sherwood Forest...

name: The Doomed Cathedral
summary: Medium-sized cathedral with a base area.

name: The Legend of the Dragonflame High School 3
summary: This is the third installment of the Beat 'em up series in which Ryuichi and his friends fight with the motorcycle gang in Yokohama!

name: The Biggleboss Incident
summary: There is NOTHING sinister happening at Biggleboss Inc. Or at least that’s what the company motto says. Tom doesn’t have time to debate semantics, though; he’s dangerously late for work – and he hasn’t even started his big Project AGER pitch. …Or is that just what they want him to think?

name: The Traveler
summary: Lost and alone in a cave, you start your adventure jumping and ducking your way through enemies and different environments. Collect coins to upgrade your player & unlock new abilities. Maybe then you'll find the ancient relics that start to reveal how you got here, and maybe...the way out.

name: The History of Magic Tower: Opening
summary: "The History of Magic Tower: Opening" is a fantasy adventure game based on the "Magic Tower" game mode. This work is set against the backdrop of various traditional magical tower worldviews and tells the story of events that occurred before the time point of the classic game "50-layer Magic Tower".

name: This Company of Mine
summary: In the urban workplace, you will hold great power and it's time to decide the fate of others. Eliminate those guys you don't like and hire those you like. This is a company that belongs to you!

name: The Simple Climb Game
summary: This is a game where you climb by jumping, sprinting, and slowing, while being careful not to fall. The only thing you can do to escape from a world where one day suddenly no one is left is to climb. If you keep climbing without giving up, you will definitely be able to escape.

name: The Human Snake
summary: The Human Centipede meets The nokia classic snake in this 1980s retro inspired game entitled THE HUMAN SNAKE!!!

name: The Playful Triangle
summary: Each encounter with these "angry squares" pushes you to use your intellect and strategic thinking to evade danger and stay one step ahead.

name: The Whittled Horse
summary: A boy named Thomas and his friend Evey are trusted to deliver a package. Little do they know there is a force stalking them, and what they carry will decide the future.

name: The Neighbor: Escape Room
summary: Do you dare to discover the secrets hidden behind the next door? "The Neighbor" will immerse you in a thrilling adventure filled with mystery and suspense. Set in a haunting house, your mission is to unravel its dark secrets before it's too late.

name: The Merry Fairy
summary: The Merry Fairy is a cozy idle game where you collect beautiful decorations and create your scrapbook journal in a fairytale environment. Invite the enchanted Fairyland vibe into your life and discover your magic through the stories of Fairy and her friends!

name: The Territory of Egg 2
summary: The Territory of Egg 2 is an unique tower defense indie game. Place Egg Towers, choose evolution branches, combine skills and build defenses. The souls of Heroic Eggs await your awakening! Explore and gather resources in the dark forest, unlock the technology tree, and defeat even stronger enemies!

name: The Demon Blade
summary: Welcome to The Demon Blade. Fight your way through forest, small villages, catacombs and dungeons to find the LEGENDARY DEMON BLADE, a powerful weapon that can slay any demon in it's wake. Using the awesome Supercharge by @Tango.

name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
summary: A remastered demake version of "The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth" for the Sony PSP console.

name: The Thing: Station Survival
summary: Published by Universal Studios and designed to promote the 2011 prequel film.

name: The Witch's Cauldron: Supporter Pack
summary: The Witch's Cauldron Supporter Pack is a great opportunity for players to support our studio and to enjoy exclusive content that comes with it while we continue to work on improving and expanding the game. Let's see what you can expect from it.

name: The Last Train
summary: Your sister has recently gone missing at the nearby metro station. After several more reports of weird occurrences, it is agreed to abandon and close the platform. From hearing the news of losing your sister, every night you have been searching the platform for any clues on her disappearance.

name: The Golden Light Guardian
summary: Save The Mysterious Island! Craft tools, gather resources, and build defenses on a mysterious island. By day, explore and hunt. By night, fight off undead hordes to protect the island's light!

name: The Rocket Man
summary: Have you ever thought what it would be like to have a superpower?

name: The Legend of Piss Boy 2
summary: A retro action platformer! Play as Piss Boy or King Krow and try to defeat the Time Wizard!

name: The Legacy
summary: Cooperative survival and horror genre. You and your family have returned to your native land, on which a terrible curse and darkness has fallen. Will you be able to survive in a harsh and dangerous environment and stop the evil? It depends only on you, on your skills and ability to help each other.

name: The Stalked 2
summary: "The Stalked 2" is a standalone horror sequel to "The Stalked", where you play as Rachel, an avid hiker. What begins as a relaxing hike to a cabin turns into a nightmare filled with eerie interactions and unsettling events. Will you survive?

name: The Colony: New Haven Chronicles
summary: New Haven is a utopia under a red moon, turned into a dystopian nightmare. You are a prisoner with no name, waking up in the middle of an emergency. Fight for survival guided by an enigmatic voice in your head, explore a falling world, solve puzzles, and unravel dark secrets.

name: The Lost Gallery
summary: Works of art are attacking people, turning an exhibition into a bloodbath in a single night. At the same time, you – a phantom thief – happen to be there to steal a valuable masterpiece.

name: The Curse of Elmwood
summary: You hear quiet whispers from deep inside the house, but no one sees. You begin to feel that you are not alone in this house. Curse of Elmwood is an atmospheric horror where you find yourself trapped in a gloomy 18th century mansion, steeped in mystery and horror.

name: The Supper: New Blood
