summary: Do you hear the doorbell, Stewie? Your first guest is here...and something tells me they’ll never leave this motel...

name: The White Room
summary: Locked in the white room and you are slowly losing your mind. Not sure what is real anymore and you must escape.

name: The Rolling Room
summary: Unleash your creativity in "The Rolling Room," the ultimate design and decorating game! Transform ordinary rooms and unique spaces like camper vans and buses with stunning realism.

name: The Last Ramparts
summary: Humanity Has Been All But Destroyed. Find The Last Remaining Few And Protect Them. Discover Unknown Places Along The Way.

name: The Last Hollow
summary: Step into the mysterious world filled with secrets, puzzles, and challenging paths. Embrace your destiny as the chosen hollow from a forgotten dark land to save dark hollows waiting for salvation.

name: The Nick
summary: A horrific adventure where you play as Nick, who needs to find a way out of an abandoned mansion. Will you be able to unravel all the secrets this place holds and still stay alive...?

name: The Test Game
summary: Escape from an abandoned island by collecting points, food, and resources. Fight to survive. Discover the underwater world and get the best high score to unlock various in game achievements. The Test Game, my first game ever!

name: The Adventure of Popo
summary: Join the adorable polar bear Popo on his adventure! Use shakes strategically to evade enemies and collect hints to overcome obstacles. Will Popo safely reach the polar bear village?

name: The Impossible Turnabout
summary: Phoenix Wright is knocked out by a brick, waking up in a hospital, he wakes up to find out what happened to the case in his absence...

name: That time I got reincarnated as a fictional Defence Lawyer in an Ace Attorney fangame and had to defend myself against incredibly unfair odds.
summary: Samallama goes on trial for not submitting an entry to the Red Truth comp, because it's impossible to make an entry in time.

name: The Time Game
summary: Bend the rules of time to your while to outsmart and out-think your opponents. Fun 4-player co-op strategy card-game which will leave you on the edge of your seat!

name: The Last Knight
summary: Earth has been seized by aliens! You are the pilot of the last Knight - a gigantic combat robot. Explore the ruins of civilization, battle giant monsters, travel through time, and prevent humanity's defeat!

name: The Other Side: Tower of Souls Remaster
summary: The return of a 2014 classic now fully remastered for modern platforms! Can you resolve a family squabble before the gates to the realm of the dead swing open in this collector's edition of The Other Side: Tower of Souls?

name: The Pirate's Quest
summary: The Pirate's Quest - You go in search of exciting adventures and ancient treasure hidden on a mysterious island. You will explore dangerous seas, coves and ancient ruins in search of a treasure map, face competitors and fight sea monsters.

name: The Memory of Mallet
summary: September 2020, Shenyang, where the story begins. Originally the most beautiful youth, it has been cast a faint shadow by the epidemic. Did we make another choice at the time, and our outcome would be different?

name: The End of History
summary:
"The End of History" is a sandbox-style strategy RPG set in a medieval-inspired world.

As the protagonist, you leave your foster parent's home one day and embark on a journey as an unknown wanderer.

In a world where the motives of numerous NPCs intertwine, and cooperation and betrayal collide,

you become a part of this world and can live freely as you choose.

name: The Tale of Two Nekos
summary: The Tale of Two Nekoes is a 2D RPG game with 3 stories to play through; Dante's Tale, Akari's Tale, and the Final Tale. This battle system is inspired by the first 6 Final Fantasy games while also having some original aspects as well.

name: The Awakening of a Villainous Lady: A Crimson and Pure White Romance
summary: Step into the role of a young woman who suddenly discovers she's the "wicked rival" in a novel. Navigate the intricate social landscape of an elite academy as you attempt to rewrite your destiny. Can you transform from a predestined antagonist into the author of your own story?

name: The Duck Pond
summary: The Duck Pond is a condensed and relaxing idle game, focused on creating a short handcrafted experience with an ending. Throw food to attract different types of duck, read about them in the duckopedia, and maybe you'll discover the epic giga duck!

name: The Better Deal
summary: A visual novel with a captivating story, ultrarealistic images, top-quality animations, and multiple love interests. Dramatic, emotional journey filled with adult content and meaningful player choices that shape unique endings. Both male and female romances await. Dive in and start your adventure!

name: The Other Side of the Sky
summary: "The Other Side of the Sky" is a short text adventure game with an alternate fantasy setting in a single-line ending narrative mode.

name: The Paradixion: Christmas
summary: [The Paradixion: Christmas] is a point-and-click adventure game with a mysterious atmosphere.Solve various puzzles with a unique atmosphere and find the hidden elements in the game to gather clues about the story.

name: The Tree of Immortality
summary: Awaken as a humble farmer, lost and bewildered in a dense dark forest, before a giant tree. within the darkness are sinister spirit beasts that emerge from the shadows, threatening your survival. Battle these monsters, gain experience, explore and grow stronger before the next wave starts.

name: The Hawkers
summary: The Hawkers invites you to transform a forgotten farm into an agricultural empire. Build your store from scratch, cultivate unique crops, and uncover the story behind your family's legacy. Can you save the town from Mr. Bunny's wicked schemes?

name: The Hardest Game in the Universe 2: Bridging to the Third Chapter
summary: This game will be released in 2080, buy it for your child's child

name: The Great Escape
summary: "The Great Escape" is a 2D platformer game where you explore each stage, collect keys, and find the exit. Dangerous obstacles and challenging terrain may block your path, but if you keep going, you can reach the portal to escape. Help them make their escape!

name: The Normal Turnabout
summary: It's another day for Apollo Justice. He read the news, he didn't clean the toilet for once, he took a coworker to her friend's house: nothing too out of the ordinary. But something totally shocking and not expected at all occurs - absolutely no one could guess this was about to happen - he gets involved in a MUUUURDER!!! And now he has to defend someone who is clearly innocent and find the real culprit! Can you help him get an acquittal and prove an indictment once again!?

name: The Deceived Man
summary: This is a kinetic short story of about 1500 frames.

name: The Best Most Epic Turnabout
summary:
An epic of never before seen proportions... is what our protagonist 'Ren' is yearning for. Being an undefeated prosecutor for years, he's seen it all.

However, he has not yet given up. Some day, he is certain, he will find the glory he is yearning for. Maybe he'll even put an end to the dark age of the law that's looming on the horizon.

name: The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom
summary:
With her engagement annulled, Tiararose was supposed to have been exiled from the country.

"This is the otome game I played!" She realized on the day before the story's ending. Is waiting for my conviction the only thing I can do? But I did not do anything too cruel... Thinking so, the ending proceeds. However, during the judgement, something that was not possible in the game happened. Tiararose was proposed to by the crown prince of the neighboring country.

name: The Bridge to Yesterday
summary: Step into a beautifully crafted world, where you'll embark on an emotional journey filled with intrigue and danger. Explore the touching relationship of two sisters, their struggle for survival, and their unwavering determination in a world where the past crumbles and the future is uncertain.

name: The House of Da Vinci Complete Bundle
summary: Save money and purchase the whole The House of Da Vinci 3D adventure trilogy.

name: The Bad Boy's Cars
summary: Welcome to The Bad Boy's Cars game, where dominance is the name of the game.

name: The Exit 8 VR
summary:
You are trapped in an endless underground passageway.
Observe your surroundings carefully to reach "The Exit 8".

Make sure not to overlook any anomalies.
If you find any anomalies, turn back immediately.
If you don't find any anomalies, keep going.
Kindly exit through Exit 8.

The Exit 8 VR is a short walking simulator inspired by Japanese underground passageways, liminal spaces and the Backrooms.

name: The Lost Episodes of Doom
summary:
The Lost Episodes of Doom is a collection of three eight-level episodes for Doom by Christen Klie and Bob Carter. It takes place on the Jovian moons Callisto and Io, and on Jupiter itself. It was a commercial product and was included on a 3.5" floppy disk that was sold with a 246-page book that details the levels. The book is written by Jonathan Mendoza with some notes by both map designers.

The book was published by Sybex in January 1995.

name: The Show
summary: The Show is an RTS that will immerse the player in a contemporary world where California is governed by a dictator who sends any opponent to prison. The only way to get out is to participate in a television show, with a huge battlefield on which outlaws and the teams of the show fight each other.

name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance
summary: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance is the ultimate edition of the genre-defining roguelike, with so many additions and improvements that it feels like a brand new game. Experience Isaac's adventures with new twists, terrifying turns and over 500 hours of new gameplay!

name: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+
summary: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+ is a dungeon-crawling shoot-'em-up that's literally a different game each and every time you play it! The randomly generated maps are built with over 11,000 unique room configurations, each populated with a nearly endless variety of enemies, items, challenges and secrets!

name: The Woods Have Horns
summary:
Welcome to Camp Shelterlake! Enjoy a beautiful view, take a walk on the woods, and don't be brutally mauled by the legendary Goatman!

Do you have what it takes to survive this pixel-art gorefest?

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Voice Set
summary: This set includes the following DLC: Holo Core Voice: Renne Bright, Holo Core Voice: Judith Lanster and Holo Core Voice: Barkhorn.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Bonus Set
summary: This set includes various cosmetic DLC and some consumable item sets.

name: The Well of Heaven-Reaching
summary: the Well of Heaven-reaching is a platforming game. Choose from a variety of jumps where you'll need to make your way through traps and obstacles to reach the top of the Well of Heaven-reaching.

name: The Walls Still Stand
summary: Step into the eerie Kowloon Walled City in "The Walls Still Stand", an indie horror walking simulator. Complete daily tasks, uncover dark secrets, and explore with 3D spatial sound. Think critically to unlock all six endings in this 1-2 hour journey. Can you escape the city's grip?

name: The Very Idle Game
summary: The most satisfying idle clicker game in the world

name: The Trials 2
summary: The Trials is a mesmerizing puzzle and exloration game that will challenge your mind, this game takes you on an unforgettable journey through an island filled stunning environment. Master the art of teleportation, time manipulation, moving between alternate world to solve intricate puzzles.

name: The Adventures Across the Realm: Book One
summary: embark on an epic journey where ancient forests, treacherous rivers, and shadowy valleys hold secrets both wondrous and perilous. Guided by destiny and bound by friendship the trio face daunting challenges and unearth forgotten mysteries As they navigate the twists and turns of their quest

name: The Process: Need a Job?
summary: In this point and click job simulator you will engage with multiple distractions as you attempt to meet your daily quota. Managing your time, strategizing your next actions, and quick response times will get you far in this game!

name: The King is Dead
summary: You're entangled in a royal conspiracy. A deadly game where the pieces can become friends, foes, lovers, and of course… sacrifices.

name: The Lodge
summary: Renting lodges for living, your company offers the best suburban rent services. Unleash the story behind every customer by joining them during the accommodation!

name: The Art Collector
summary: You're an artist tasked with taking over an art gallery in order to help your mentor. Customize your gallery and home, befriend local artists while you get them the exposure they need, and master the fine art of selling fine art in this narrative-driven, capitalism-management, shopkeeper, RPG, Sim.

name: The Glitch Witch
summary: In a tech-dead future, you play as Rosette, repairing broken tech by solving circuit puzzles to uncover the lost power of 80s technology. She is thrilled about this discovery - until she faces accusations of witchcraft. Will friendship triumph, or force her to choose between power and acceptance?

name: The Hope
summary: Join a desperate father in his quest to find his daughter, in this first-person horror survival game. Unravel the mysteries of his old town and confront unimaginable horrors to reunite with his lost daughter.

name: The Guilty Hearts
summary: Seoyeon Yu, a former police officer, works as a private investigator for a rich family. However, during her investigation, she discovers evidence linking them to her husband's death. Using her ability to see people's guilt, she begins an investigation to solve the mystery.

name: The Tragedy at Deer Creek
summary: Photographer Charlotte Gray travels to Deer Creek to document a long deserted logging camp for her upcoming book ”Forgotten Frontiers”. She finds not only a derelict camp, but also a mournful tale of family, love and loyalty hidden beneath the Alaskan snow, in this point-and-click adventure.

name: The Aspirox Case
summary: A funny point & click adventure.

name: The Hauntings: Surveillance
summary: Monitor haunted locations for anomalies as a technician for a secret government agency. Use various camera modes to collect evidence and identify ghosts. Uncover the truth and prevent public panic in this realistic horror spot-the-difference game.

name: The Good Plague
summary: Uncover a goofy medieval world and its offbeat humor. Choose your hero and challenge your friends and family through a diverse range of minigames in order to escape a plagued kingdom to safety. Playable in local multiplayer from 2 to 4 players.

name: The Rewinder 2
summary: The Rewinder 2 is an action adventure game inspired by eastern mythology. Explore cursed villages, dungeons. Unlock new skills and meet all sorts of ghosts and monsters.

name: The Power of Doznath
summary: Discover the mysteries around the secret thumb of Doznath.

name: The Dwarf Kingdom
summary: Enter the epic fantasy realm of The Dwarf Kingdom - Magic World of War vs Orks and Dragon. Lead your dwarven kingdom to victory through cunning strategy, powerful magic, and skilled diplomacy. Battle fierce enemies, forge alliances, and build your empire in this immersive, action-packed adventure.

name: The Capybarrier
summary: You are a capybara. Your freedom lies on the other side of your greatest obstacle. Despite your past efforts, you can not defeat the wall on your own. You must rally your zoomates to surpass The Capybarrier.

name: Thirsty
summary: Help poor Charlie grab a glass of water. He's up late at night, again.........

name: The Plague
summary: A game was created in 2013. Unfortunately, its development was later canceled due to the belief that zombies don't quite fit within the RPG genre.

name: The Digital Asset Inquisition
summary:
A recent data leak of highly valuable and confidential files has prompted your clients to hire independent contractors to investigate, suspecting the leak to have originated internally. They have reason to believe one of the asset managers may be responsible for the breach.

This individual has not checked in recently, but you have triangulated their last known location to a space hotel on the fringe of the galaxial terminal, where it is suspected they plan to make their escape.

Your mission is to infiltrate the hotel and recover evidence of their involvement in the data leak by
a) retrieving their suitcase for evidence and
b) obtaining the target's brainbox for analysis
Further details are on the chalkboard, and be sure to check your notebook.

name: The Way The Gingerbread Cookie Crumbles
Thoom
summary:
This game title has been an inside joke in community for a while, but it's finally here. Behold! The first First-person shooter game on Thumby ... Thoom.

This is a demake version Doom written in MicroPython, with raycasting pseudo-3D and sprite scaling (for upscale only, it looks unrecognizable when downscale).As a proof of concept, there is only one level, filled with Demons and Imps, and locked doors requiring key card to open, and last but not least a small bossfight.

Hope you enjoy this short game. And hope you use this project to create something more fun. (sorry for ugly codes)

name: The Catalyst Acolyte Tower Defense
summary: Defend the Catalyst Crystal against adorable yet menacing bugs in The Catalyst Acolyte. Strategically construct defenses in handcrafted levels, aided by helpful items every 10 waves. Engaging gameplay and charming visuals make for an addictive tower defense adventure.

name: The Protagonish
summary: An adventure game, where you don't control the adventurer. Play the side characters in a medieval village, and decide to help or hinder the adventurer in their mysterious quest.

name: The Fight: Aftermath
summary: Embark on a thrilling odyssey through a world torn apart by catastrophe. As a lone survivor, navigate treacherous terrain, scavenge for essentials, and confront the horrors of the apocalypse. Will you overcome adversity and rebuild civilization, or succumb to the chaos of the wasteland?

name: The Song of Awakening
summary: The Song of Awakening is a 2D action-platformer where you play as a bard with the power to create magic through music. Explore a world once ruled by the Lyramancers, wielders of music-magic, who were extinguished by a mad king. Defeat the malevolent god of silence and restore harmony to the world.

name: The Whisper of the Abyss: Echo of Eden
summary: The main character finds himself in a dark abyss where darkness and light merge, creating a world of mysteries and dangers. In this intermediate dimension, he encounters demons, angels, and creatures that belong to neither world.

name: The Gravedigger
summary: You're hired to dig up graves at a local church, looting valuables while demonic activity escalates. You must find and return all the burnt bones to stop the demonic activity. Each night you will dig for valuables to find bones, fend off growing corruption, and survive to solve the mystery.

name: The Zombie's House
summary: Large village-type of level; a valley with several buildings including a mill and basement/dungeon areas beneath.

name: The Bright In The Screen
summary: The Bright In the Screen is a 2008 horror Adobe Flash game.

name: The Flower Competition
summary: The Flower Competition tells the story of a person trying to grow a flower for a competition. Through an entire cycle of the moon, you'll go through a rollercoaster of emotions.

name: The Concentration of Lust
summary: Become the Master of All Spells, who unexpectedly discovers uninvited female guests in his tower. Battle mysterious women in a strategic casual Point & Click minigame and uncover dark secrets. Immerse yourself in magical fantasy and master both magic and passion.

name: The Most Searched Playground: Paris 2024
summary: Uncover 20 of the most searched sports, French icons, and moments from the Games’ history.

name: The First Settlement VR
summary: Immerse yourself in "The First Settlement VR," a medieval city-building simulation. Construct unique buildings, manage production chains, and trade with neighboring towns. Experience the evolving economy and culture through your strategic decisions. Witness the impact of your actions in VR.

name: The Green Book
summary: Welcome to The Green Book: Your Cozy Journey into Magical Plant Shopkeeping!

name: The Sunday
summary: The Sunday is a short walkthrough horror game where the idea of being alone will hunt you, until the drakness settles in your brain. The line between reality and nightmare is razor thin.

name: The Good Colony
summary: A co-op horror about investigating and recording aliens. Turn in your recordings to the Colony for a reward. You keep the recordings you make whether you die or survive.

name: The Ninja Gaiden as Interpreted by MiniMacro Sound
summary: This is a from-the-ground-up reimagining of the first Ninja Gaiden NES game. All of the levels are redesigned from scratch, the soundtrack is entirely remixed and there are new graphics.

name: The Adventures of Captain Becky
summary: The adventures of pirate captain Becky! Clear all stages and defeat the enemies! Play a total of 24 stages in EASY, NORMAL and HARD mode! Unlock the Extra stage! Collect 5 different costumes!

name: Three Kingdoms: Zhuge Liang
summary: Employ tactics and formations to conquer cities and dominate the land, ultimately unifying the realm. The game features HD-2D graphics, offering a refreshing and stunning visual experience. Combining 2D pixel art style with 3D scenes, it delivers a visual feast for players.

name: The Verbose Vault Venture
summary:
The Verbose Sky Vault has opened for business recently, specialising in securing various high-value objects. A multi-layered security system operates at all times with an additional five-factor authentication containment unit protecting the main vault. Your client has become particularly interested in a small safe that was deposited here not long ago.

Your mission is to infiltrate the Verbose Vault, traverse the many layers of security, retrieve the safe and finally escape. Due to the highly secure nature of the vault, no alarm defuse boxes were located on site. Extreme caution is advised.

name: The Mini Crossword
summary: The Mini Crossword (or simply The Mini) is the smaller version of the Crossword of the New York Times. It is 5×5 Sunday through Friday and 7×7 on Saturdays, and is significantly easier than the traditional daily puzzle.

name: The Shuddering
summary: Lose yourself in a lonely entity's embrace...

name: The Twelve Slot Saloon
summary: The Twelve Slot Saloon is a Turn-Based RPG with Bullet Hell elements, where your choices matter as you travel across "The Land Without Happy Endings"! Play as a Cat, and explore this Wonderland by yourself, or with Friends! (Single-Screen Co-op.)

name: The Curiosity
summary: The protagonist Ken and his friend Jun have come to a certain mountain to visit a rumored ruin. What awaits them there is...

name: The Drawnjuring
summary: Fight for your peace and quiet in this quirky action packed rougelite game. Hack and slash your way through doodles, create your army and put an end to the mild annoyance once and for all!

name: The Archer
summary: Welcome back, warrior! We're thrilled you've returned to embrace your heritage.

name: The Upper Hand
summary: The Upper Hand is a platformer where you must climb through each level as an alien to reach your freedom. Versatility and adaptability are rewarded as you use our deck builder and pose system to create your own path to reach the top.

name: The Heft Effect
summary: A girl who mysteriously gains weight and learns to like it, two other girls that she pressures into gaining weight, and [TOPIC NOT FOUND]

name: The Last Golfer
summary: Golfr is a sci-fi golf action game. Set in the near future, a robot scout sent from Earth crash-lands on an alien planet that harbors ancient relics locked beneath abandoned golf courses. Golf your way through multiple biomes while engaging hostiles with only a club.

name: The Spreader
summary: Learn to master the art of spreading and compete for the best times in the online leaderboard to prove you are the master spreader in this groundbreaking, never-before-seen spreading experience. Develop new strategies and execute them perfectly to have a chance for a top spot.

name: The Best Duck Clicker
summary: A small clicker game about destroying ducks! Collect 25+ ducks, upgrade all your stats, and repeat!

name: The Dark Tide
summary: The Dark Tide is a campaign mod for Star Wars: Dark Forces, Originally released episodically.

name: The Little Mermaid: Ariel and the Star Festival
summary: In this new adventure, Ariel must activate the Star Festival with the help of her friends, while Morgana tries to stop them. A story full of magic, friendship and challenges under the sea!

name: Think or Die Collection Pack
summary: Discover 4 games to rack your brain!

name: Through the Galaxy
summary: Immerse yourself in an unknown galaxy. Collect resources, upgrade your spaceship and experience an exciting mix of action and adventure with intense battles in a calm atmosphere. Discover new worlds and master challenges on your epic journey through space.

name: The Liminal Theory
summary: What are liminal spaces? What happens when these places collide with each other? Dive into this third-person adventure to explore The Liminal Theory in unique environments like Backrooms, Pools & more. Encounter unique creatures born from Chaos and Limen.

name: Three Alpha One Nine
summary: A modern approach to platformers and adventure where speed, precision, and curiosity are not only required, but rewarded. As robot 3A19, jump, run, and boost your way through a wide range of locations throughout time and space.

name: The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian
summary: This is a narrative role-playing game telling the story of a crown prince of the Blessed Arknian Empire. You possess great power, but are also burdened by duty. Can you change the world and stay true to yourself? Every decision comes with a cost.

name: The Journey into the Virtual Void
summary: The Journey into the Virtual Void is a captivating low-poly VR platformer/adventure game, reminiscent of classic 90s platformers like Mario 64.

name: The Untethered Void
summary: What if artificial intelligence is not evolution incarnate and humanity is left with only Pain as an evolutionary driver. The Untethered Void is a Adventure game in a future world where to be asked to be cured of your fundamental despair, is to ask to be cured of what little self you may have.

name: The Faceless Killer
summary: The Faceless Killer is a first-person survival horror game with retro PS1-style graphics, consisting of 3 chapters. Solve logic puzzles, fight against your enemies, or hide when there's no other option. Unravel this mystery surrounding the Faceless Killer. Who is he, and what are his motivations?

name: The Good Old Days
summary: A nostalgic metroidvania from the good old days back in 19XX. Take on the role of Sean, a young boy who ventures into the fictional city of Arostia to repay his father's debt. Rescue your 3 friends from imprisonment, defeat strong enemies, all while getting your debt paid in time!

name: Thebes
summary: Deploy your pawns, plan your strategy, and make your way through the sunlit plains of Thebes to destroy the enemy fortress, but keep an eye on the fog of war, as enemies might catch you off guard and destroy yours. Activate the abilities of the pieces to gain various advantages during your turn.

name: Thou Shalt Not Kill
summary: "Thou Shalt Not Kill" is a VHS-style first-person walking simulator horror game. You play as Angel, a girl traveling through the forest who finds a VHS tape lying on the ground. She starts watching it, only to discover that the footage is unsettling and tells a mysterious story. As you watch the entire tape, you realize this is no ordinary VHS footage, and you are shocked by its revelations.

name: The Eternal Life of Goldman
summary: The Eternal Life of Goldman is a vibrant yet dark platformer adventure that weaves together legends, fairy tales and myths. Explore a vast hand-drawn Archipelago, inspired by ancient fables and depicted in classic frame-by-frame animation, and defeat a mysterious Deity!

name: The Mortuary Assistant: Definitive Edition
summary:
Darkstone Digital is bringing more scares, more lore, and an endless embalming-only mode for those more interested in Rebecca's day-to-day work without the worry of being scared on August 2nd with The Mortuary Assistant: Definitive Edition!

Along with this free update to owners of Mortuary Assistant on PC and Nintendo Switch, the Definitive Edition is also going to be available on consoles! The Mortuary Assistant: Definitive Edition comes to PlayStation and Xbox on the same date with some new content too!
- Embalming only mode - embalm unlimited bodies
- New Haunt Events
- Additional Lore
- New bodies to embalm
- New Valentine's Day seasonal event (Stop by the mortuary in February)
- New achievements
- Multiple Bug and Stability Fixes
- Performance Improvements

name: The Nullspace
summary: Originally 'The Nullspace', was a map submitted for Quake Brutalist Jam 2 by ExaByt. This is an expansion of it into a mini-episode consisting of 4 maps (including the original Nullspace, slightly updated/rebalanced), and a start map.

name: The Big Lebowski Bowling
summary: The Big Lebowski Bowling is a mobile bowling game for Java mobile devices.

name: The Anomaly Project
summary: Your goal is simple, spot anomalies to escape. Play alone or together with up to 8 players in online co-op. Make the right decisions to advance to the next level, or risk being reset to the beginning!

name: The Lights Went Out
summary: "The lights went out" is a short horror experience with a bizarre story narrated by the victim himself.

name: The Scarlet Cascabel
summary: Originally released as part of the Thief: The Dark Project 20th Anniversary Contest, The Scarlet Cascabel (v2) is an improved version of the original fan maps that adds new content and applies many gameplay fixes

name: The Oracle's Cave
summary: You have five days to escape from the Oracle's Cave and gather as much treasure along the way as possible.

name: The Aching Aversion: Blood Orange Dreams
summary:
The Aching Aversion: Blood Orange Dreams is a Surreal RPG Maker Horror game about exploring Rahma's disturbing dreams.

Unlike many games of this type, progress in Blood Orange Dreams is earned through killing NPCs in your dreams.

Made for Dream Diary Jam 8, Blood Orange Dreams is the second game from the Aching Aversion series.

name: The Invisible Smoke Factory
summary: Surreal point-and-click exploration game inspired by Yume Nikki. 100+ rooms, a few mostly optional puzzles, and minimal text. Meant to be unsettling. No jumpscares.

name: The Dreams of Fritz
summary:
Count to three, walk into your deepest dreams. The visions await.
Made for DDJ8, explore a dark dreamscape and perhaps you'll start to uncover what exactly went wrong.

name: The PTSD Mod
summary:
The PTSD mod, It's weird. It's dumb, it's a guy who has an obsession with old punt and outdated memes.

PTSD mod let's you see the world from PTSD guy's eyes, experience memories, nightmares, memes and all sorts of stuff in this crazy world full of ptsd. Fight back the new punt leader and win back old punt!

name: The PTSD Mod 2
summary: PTSD guy returns in this all new adventure, full with completely new levels, secrets, weapons and returning characters Experience weirdness to it's full extent, and maybe even discover something more sinister/serious in it all...

name: The Sky Climber
summary: The Sky Climber is a fun and small game where you have to run towards the top of the building by wrecking and exploding anything in your way! Avoid falling to the bottom of the construction site!

name: The Dragon's Intern
summary: The Dragon’s Intern is a 2D Adventure Exploration game about an intern- I mean apprentice - who works for a dragon that is hiding under the roads of a city. The boss keeps you busy and each night teaches you about potion making. However, as an apprentice of an underground dragon… you don’t make a lot of money, and have to pay rent in 5 days… Make potions, solve puzzles, and commit petty crimes in order to reach the goal of Not Being Evicted and becoming a Real Wizard.

name: The Three Kingdoms of Destiny
summary: The Three Kingdoms of Destiny is a turn-based strategy simulation game, the opening has four different characteristics of the monarch representing 4 countries for players to choose, there are as many as 100 controllable generals, rich transfer system and rich skills of generals,

name: The Out Door
summary: You wake up in a closed room. To escape, you need to choose the correct door 100 times in a row. Solve the puzzles, attract luck, and clear the challenges. Intelligence, reflexes, accuracy, insight, and gaming skills—everything will be tested.

name: The King Cat Clicker
summary: In this game, you accumulate an absurd amount of coins and help the King of Cats to renovate his kingdom to earn even more coins.

name: The Labyrinth
summary: Race friends in trap-filled mazes. Reach the gold chest first in 'The Labyrinth' – Can you escape?

name: The Rookery
summary: All the strategic depth of chess with all the fun of roguelikes! Upgrade your army with boosts, relics, and consumables to take on formidable bosses - without all the tools at your disposal, you won't stand a chance!

name: The Prison of Infinity Code: Krylosis
summary: The Prison of Infinity Code - Krylosis is a typing game in which players must type code quickly and accurately to defeat Krylosis, the evil artificial intelligence that rules the digital world.

name: The Simp
summary: A horror decryption game. The player needs to carefully observe the interactive items in the scene and deduce how to crack them. Time to test courage and patience!

name: The Silence
summary: Dive into the dark depths of an abandoned hospital in "The Silence", a thrilling single-player horror game. Alone and abandoned, you awaken in a gloomy corridor, surrounded by crumbling walls and an oppressive feeling of isolation. But the silence is deceptive because you are never truly alone. A sinister presence stalks you, watching your every move from the shadows.

name: Thank You For Your Application
summary: Thank You for Your Application is an interview game. You play as a recent graduate who joins the Aeropolis Group as a recruitment officer.

name: The Enigma Cases
summary: The Enigma Cases invites you to test your skills as a detective and solve the most complex cases. Join your friends in this immersive and mysterious world. Do you have what it takes to uncover the truth?

name: The Flames
summary:
The old magician went in search of new knowledge. There has been no news from him for a long time. His student goes in search of her teacher. The path lies through distant lands and ancient ruins. The sorceress will have to break through hordes of enemies, solve riddles with the help of clues and find her teacher.

The player is controlled around the world. Destroys mobs, collects loot, demonstrates objects (eg a bomb), opens new locations. Saving occurs at individual points (obelisk). When revived, the player revives everything else.

name: The Player Who Can't Level Up
summary: The Player Who Can't Level Up is an action roguelite game based on web novels and webtoons of the same name. You can freely combine various combat styles and numerous growth factors to become stronger. Experience unexpected enhancement effects through various random elements.

name: The Good People
summary: A narration-focused interactive fiction about conversation and exploration of a haunted landscape

name: The Trials of Goodbye
summary: You are the reaper of Death. This is the final person on Earth. You must decide if they go to Heaven, Hell, or Purgatory based on your own actions. You may choose to befriend this person or not. The choice is yours.

name: The Dime Birthday Level Collection
summary:
Twelve levels designed for the 25th birthday of Doom speedrunner Dime! The restrictions given to the designers were:
- Boom compatibility (a.k.a. PrBoom+ -complevel 9) - No green or blue armor - Maximum 75 monsters - In the style of scythe map 22-24 gameplay (texture use is up to [one]self) - Must [have] a BFG, but only a maximum of 200 cells in the map INCLUDING BFG pickup.

name: The Train Station
summary: The Train Station is a short horror game developed by one person. Play as a stationmaster on a foggy night in 1940s England. Carry out essential tasks such as collecting lost luggage and cleaning toilets, but remember to attend the ticket booth when you hear the bell.

name: The Lion Guard: Protectors of the Pridelands!
summary: Go on an adventure with the Lion Guard as they show off their unique abilities and practice to become even better at their job as Lion Guard members!

name: The Ripper Wash
summary:
You are Mia, a woman who recently moved to another city. You worked in a restaurant as a waitress, but since the place was far away you decided to change it to one of serving people and calls in a laundromat on the night shift.

Time goes by and the atmosphere becomes more tense, you read a newspaper about the 1993 murderer, "The Ripper Wash", who is thirsty for the blood of a new victim. It also says that in one door of your premises there are all the things about him and his murders...

name: The Blue Marlin
summary: The Blue Marlin is a Sports game, developed by Hot-B and published by Starfish, which was released in Japan in 2000.

name: The Super Mario Bros. Movie Demastered
summary: Experience and play through the Super Mario Bros Movie in an all new epic way through an action packed retro 2D Platformer with over 80 levels, 6 playable characters, 90 Missions, Multiplayer and a rewritten story!

name: The Patchmaker's Workshop
summary:
"One day, whilst crafting a plush doll, something miraculous occured.
The doll smiled at me."

Mario awakes inside a charming workshop with a dark past, with Peach and Bowser transformed into plush dolls sitting beside him.
They had all been attacked by a man named The Patchmaker... To save them, he needs to team up with a creation of that man, the living doll Sewnia.
Embark across 12 different worlds, collecting a new ability in each that helps Mario traverse that area.
What secrets does this workshop hold? What goals does The Patchmaker have?
...And how did Sewnia come to life exactly?

The Patchmaker's Workshop features a fully original soundtrack composed by ornevelder, Tori Draws Stuff, and CowQuack.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time - Crystal Clocks
summary:
Take aim with the Dragshot, a modified slingshot with a creeping twist. Complete 11 different puzzle rooms as you manage platform switches and crystal activation sequences. Puzzles are primarily time-based, so having a good handle on aiming and being able to maintain patience is key. Estimated completion time is one hour.

Looking for an extra challenge? Scattered around the level are four optional Pieces of Hearts. Stay alert for a special hint system that will help you find them all. Although custom music was originally planned and arranged, I was not able to get it working for this release. Listen to it here: • Trailer Theme - The Legend of Zelda: ...

This mod was originally submitted as an entry for Hylian Modding’s first competition. This update adds additional puzzles, new collectibles, new rooms like an ending room, a visual overhaul, various bug fixes, and several quality of life changes.

name: The Bard's Tale: Remastered and Resnarkled
summary: Bundle that includes The Bard's Tale: Remastered and Resnarkled and the original classic trilogy!

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles: Digital Deluxe Edition
summary: The Digital Deluxe Edition includes That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles main game, Bonus Side Quest Collection: Shopping, DLC 1, DLC 2, DLC 3, and Season Pass Bonus Content: Bonus Side Quest Collection: Remembering Shizu.

name: The Super Robot Bros
summary: Learn about this inspiring story of hope and the power of effort to revive a lost world. Join ECHO on their journey to discover if the Earth can be saved and if humanity can return home.

name: Thief Puzzle
summary: Steal your way to the top and become the king of thieves!

name: The Plutonia Experiment
summary:
Every effort has been made by the nation's top scientists to close the seven interdimensional Gates of Hell, but one portal remains open. Alone, you must infiltrate the ravaged base, defeat the demon Gatekeeper, and seal the last Hell portal before the undead take over the world.

A remaster of The Plutonia Experiment made in the KEX Engine, community-published mod support, original midi soundtrack or the modern IDKFA version by Andrew Hulshult, improved performance with multithreaded rendering, BOOM source compatibility, accessibility options and translated into eight new languages.

name: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 2: The Price of Desire
summary:
The Legend of Dark Witch 2 retains its simple controls and enough challenges to satisfy the completist.

Created by indie games company INSIDE SYSTEM in 2014, The Legend of Dark Witch 2 is a 2D action story sequel to "The Legend of Dark Witch". True to its predecessor, Legend of the Dark Witch 2 retains its simple controls and enough challenges to satisfy the completist.

Players have 8 stages to choose from and must use SHOTs to make their way through a variety of obstacles to reach the boss enemy. Within each stage there are hidden "Pura Syega" which are helpful to power up player characters.

name: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4
summary:
The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4 is the latest entry in the action game series that began in 2014.

This 2D action game features charming pixel art, where defeating enemies earns you Tres, a resource used to power up your character.

name: The Shiny Show
summary:
Look at the pictures & answer as many questions as you can!

For every answer you get right, give yourself a shiny!

name: The Distant Planet
summary: The Distant Planet is a sci-fi RTS. Command an army of creatures called Sprouts to explore an uncharted world, carry back foes you've defeated, and convert the once-hostile creatures into miniature units of your own to command, suited to the environment around them!

name: The Liminal Dimension
summary: You're trapped in an endless loop within a liminal dimension, where each loop leads to increasingly unsettling places. Will you find the way out of this psychological horror? The game offers a unique déjà vu experience that blurs the lines between reality and illusion.

name: Thregnar and the Crystals of Chaos
summary: Thregnar and the Crystals of chaos is a cute but challenging platformer where you take control of a ninja on a quest to save the world. Mastering his legendary dive kick is key to overcoming any obstacle.

name: The Guardian Shift
summary: The Guardian Shift is a whimsical adventure about a young guardian, awakened from slumber, who faces a series of perilous trials to fulfill their destiny of safeguarding the planet. Despite the daunting challenges, the guardian must rise to the occasion and protect the world. Go forth, Guardian.

name: The Dreamers Foresight
summary: Embark on a dreamlike journey as a ninja in this roguelite adventure, shaping your world with randomized biome tiles, align similar Tiles for better loot. Build a powerful deck from a variety set of cards while balancing your energy to battle relentless nightmare creatures.

name: The Wanted Man's House
summary:
In "The Wanted Man's House," plunge into the shadows of a slasher suspense, inspired by iconic horror films from the '80s and '90s. Take on the role of Mason, a daring adventurer in pursuit of fame, determined to break into the infamous residence of the sought-after killer known as "Baby Face."

The story unfolds as Mason, armed with courage and a camera, discovers that the location of the house has been inadvertently revealed by his own friends. His goal? Record every chilling moment to expose the terror in the city's newspaper. However, things take an unexpected turn when Baby Face returns home. Are you ready to face the nightmare?

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles - DLC 1
summary: DLC 1: A Strange Fate includes new Scenario, Character, Subquests, and Building Types content for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles!

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles - DLC 2
summary: DLC 2: The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth includes new Scenario, Character, Subquests, and Building Types content for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles!

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles - DLC 3
summary: This DLC includes a new Scenario, Character, Subquests, and Building Types content. Players can campaign through the Additional Scenario: Martial Arts Tournament, where they can liven up the party with the Additional Character, Milim. The game also features Additional Subquests, such as Valentines Day, Blumund Cooking Contest, Prepackaged Curry, and Beer. Additionally, players can sharpen Tempest with the inclusion of new Additional Building Types, including an Edgy Liquor Store, Edgy Tool Shop, Baron Goblin, Edgy Apartment Complex, and Edgy Armory.

name: Thief Puzzle: Tricks
summary:
Take on new challenges and become a master trickster!
With this DLC you'll unlock:
- 260 new levels for you to face!
- 13 cool skins for your hand!
- 6 colorful themes for a fresh look!

Equip new skins and trick others with style!

name: Thief Puzzle: Pranks
summary:
Take on new challenges and become a master prankster!
With this DLC you'll unlock:
- 260 new levels for you to face!
- 13 cool skins for your hand!
- 6 colorful themes for a fresh look!

name: The World's Easyest Game
summary: A funny and easy online quiz game that’s sure to make you laugh! Come and relive your childhood with this classic silly game that really is just as easy as it seems. You’ll also enjoy the upbeat music and colorful layout. This is one quiz you don’t have to sweat about failing.

name: The Idiot Test
summary: A funny quiz game that will test your knowledge on nothing and everything. The idiot test is smarter than you. The idiot test has been around a long time and it has been played millions of times. This is not your normal quiz game, this is not a normal free trivia game on the internet. This is the Idiot test, a game which has ruled the destiny of many a player long before you!

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero - Limited Edition
summary: The Limited Edition includes The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero - Deluxe Edition, "SSS Classified Files" Hardcover Art Book, "Anthems of Crossbell" Official Soundtrack (10 Select Tracks), "Special Support Section, Assemble!" Cloth Poster (17” x 24”), "Heroes of Zero" Acrylic Stand, Steelbook and Collector's Box.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Limited Edition
summary: The Limited Edition includes The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Deluxe Edition, "Azure Archives" Hardcover Art Book, "Anthems of Crossbell Part II" Official Soundtrack (10 Select Tracks), "New Recruits" Acrylic Stand, SteelBook, "United as One" Cloth Poster (17" x 24") and Collector's Box.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Reverie - Digital Deluxe Edition
summary: The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the Base Game, Premium Cosmetic Set and Starter Set DLCs.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Reverie - Limited Edition
summary: The Limited Edition includes The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Reverie - Deluxe Edition, "Legends of Zemuria" Hardcover Art Book, "Songs of Reverie" Official Soundtrack, "Three & Nine: A Trails Tale" Softcover Novel, Steelbook, "The End and the Beginning" Acrylic Print and Collector's Box.

name: The Knightling
summary: The Knightling is a platforming action adventure where you play as an aspiring knight in search of their missing mentor, Sir Lionstone. Equipped with only a legendary shield, you’ll brave your way through the lands of Clesseia to become the unlikely hero.

name: The Freshman: Book 1
summary: A romance story surrounding a young woman who attends a very prestigious college and encounters numerous challenges in life and love as she coasts her way through school.

name: The Freshman: Book 2
summary:
The Freshman, Book 2 is the second book of The Freshman series.

In this book, your character starts the winter quarter of her freshman year at Hartfeld, as she deals with old problems, new projects, and her one true love...

name: The Freshman: Book 3
summary: The Freshman, Book 3 is the third book of The Freshman series.

name: The Freshman: Book 4
summary: The Freshman, Book 4 is the fourth and final book of The Freshman series.

name: The Sophomore: Book 1
summary: A continuation of The Freshman, following the MC from that series as she enters her second year of college, facing yet more trials and tribulations in her life.

name: The Sophomore: Book 2
summary: The Sophomore, Book 2 is the second and final book of The Sophomore series

name: The Junior
summary: A continuation of The Sophomore, following the MC from that series as she enters her third year of college while dealing with a fraternity and a campus prankster with malicious intent.

name: The Senior
summary: A continuation of The Junior, following the MC from that series as she enters her last year of college and looks on towards the future.

name: The Freshman: Love Bites
summary: The Freshman: Love Bites is a Halloween special based on the characters of The Freshman.

name: The Freshman: Snowed In
summary: The Freshman: Snowed In is a Christmas Special Book. This story takes place between The Freshman, Book 1 and Book 2.

name: The Freshman: Game of Love
summary: The Freshman: Game of Love is a Valentine's Day Special Book. This story takes place before the events of Chapter 4 onwards of The Freshman, Book 2.

name: The Sophomore: Hartfeld Horror Story
summary: The Sophomore: Hartfeld Horror Story is a Halloween-themed special book. The story takes place in The Sophomore, Book 1.

name: The Crown & The Flame: Book 1
summary: The Crown & The Flame, Book 1 is the first book of The Crown & The Flame series. It is followed by The Crown & The Flame, Book 2 and The Crown & The Flame, Book 3.

name: The Crown & The Flame: Book 2
summary: The Crown & The Flame, Book 2 is the second book of The Crown & The Flame series. It succeeds its first book, The Crown & The Flame, Book 1, and is followed by The Crown & The Flame, Book 3.

name: The Crown & The Flame: Book 3
summary: The Crown & The Flame, Book 3 is the third and final book of The Crown & The Flame series. It succeeds its first two books, The Crown & The Flame, Book 1, and The Crown & The Flame, Book 2.

name: The Royal Masquerade
summary: The Royal Masquerade is the first and only book of The Royal Masquerade series. Chronologically, it is a sequel series to The Crown & The Flame and a prequel series to The Royal Romance and The Royal Heir respectively.

name: The Hallways
summary: Introducing "Hallways," a multiplayer escape game. Navigate corridors, evade pursuers, and compete with friends or globally. Solo, 2-player, and 4-player modes, with a matchmaking system and private lobbies. Customize characters and gear, employ strategy, and conquer challenging levels in this game.

name: The Royal Romance: Book 1
summary: The Royal Romance, Book 1 is the first book of The Royal Romance series. It is followed by The Royal Romance, Book 2 and The Royal Romance, Book 3.

name: The Royal Romance: Book 2
summary: The Royal Romance, Book 2 is the second book of The Royal Romance series. It succeeds its first book, The Royal Romance, Book 1, and is followed by The Royal Romance, Book 3.

name: The Royal Romance: Book 3
summary: The Royal Romance, Book 3 is the third book of The Royal Romance series. It succeeds its first two books, The Royal Romance, Book 1 & The Royal Romance, Book 2, and is followed by The Royal Holiday and by The Royal Heir series.

name: The Royal Holiday
summary: The Royal Holiday is a holiday special book of The Royal Romance series. It is a sequel to The Royal Romance series, and a prequel to The Royal Heir series, respectively.

name: The Royal Heir: Book 1
summary: The Royal Heir, Book 1 is the fourth book of The Royal Romance series, and the first of the The Royal Heir series. It succeeds its first three books, The Royal Romance, Book 1, The Royal Romance, Book 2, and The Royal Romance, Book 3. It also acts as a follow-up series to The Royal Romance Trilogy. It is followed by The Royal Heir, Book 2.

name: The Royal Heir: Book 2
summary: The Royal Heir, Book 2 is the fifth book of The Royal Romance series, and the second of the The Royal Heir series. It succeeds its first book, The Royal Heir, Book 1, and is followed by The Royal Heir, Book 3.

name: The Royal Heir: Book 3
summary: The Royal Heir, Book 3 is the sixth book of The Royal Romance series, and the third of The Royal Heir series. It succeeds its first two books, The Royal Heir, Book 1 and The Royal Heir, Book 2, and is followed by the The Royal Finale.

name: The Royal Finale
summary: The Royal Finale is the fourth and final book of The Royal Heir series. It is alternatively called The Royal Heir, Book 4. It succeeds its first three books, The Royal Heir, Book 1, The Royal Heir, Book 2 and The Royal Heir, Book 3. It is also the seventh and final book of the entire The Royal Romance series that started on April 13, 2017.

name: The Nanny Affair
summary: The Nanny Affair, Book 1 is the first book of The Nanny Affair series. It is followed by The Nanny Affair, Book 2.

name: The Nanny Affair 2
summary: The Nanny Affair, Book 2 is the second book of The Nanny Affair series. It succeeds its first book, The Nanny Affair, Book 1, and is followed by The Nanny Affair, Book 3.

name: The Nanny Affair 3
summary: The Nanny Affair, Book 3 is the third and final book of The Nanny Affair series. It succeeds its first two books, The Nanny Affair, Book 1 and The Nanny Affair, Book 2.

name: The Dalton Affair
summary:
The Dalton Affair is a VIP-exclusive short form special of the The Nanny Affair series.

It is a reimagining of The Nanny Affair series from Sam Dalton's point of view.

name: The Cursed Heart
summary: The Cursed Heart, Book 1 is the first book of The Cursed Heart series. It is followed by The Cursed Heart, Book 2.

name: The Cursed Heart: Book 2
summary: The Cursed Heart, Book 2 is the second and final book of The Cursed Heart series. It succeeds its first book, The Cursed Heart, Book 1.

name: The Elementalists
summary: The Elementalists, Book 1 is the first book of The Elementalists series. It is followed by The Elementalists, Book 2.

name: The Elementalists 2
summary: The Elementalists, Book 2 is the second and final book of the The Elementalists series. It succeeds its first book, The Elementalists, Book 1.

name: The Elementalists: Winters Past
summary: The Elementalists: Winters Past is a holiday special book of The Elementalists series.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II - Limited Edition
summary: The Limited Edition includes The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II - Deluxe Edition, Collector's Box, Art Book, Art Card Set, Digipak Original Soundtrack, Steelbook and Atlas of Calvard.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II - Deluxe Edition
summary: The Deluxe Edition includes the Base Game, Digital Soundtrack and Mini Art Book.

name: The Haunting of Braidwood Manor
summary: The Haunting of Braidwood Manor is the first and only book of The Haunting of Braidwood Manor series.

name: The Heist: Monaco
summary: The Heist: Monaco is the first and the only book of The Heist: Monaco series.

name: The Evil Unleashed
summary: The Evil Unleashed is a Doom episode replacement mod of nine levels, created by The Innocent Crew

name: The Talosian Incident
summary: A swansong megawad done by The Black Star Coven before heading over to Quake. It stood out against other WADs of the era for its strong emphasis on creating moody atmospheres, helped by a predominantly ambient soundtrack in the vein of Doom 64.

name: The Unexpected Heiress
summary: The Unexpected Heiress is the first and only book of the The Unexpected Heiress series.

name: The Princess Swap
summary: The Princess Swap is the first and only book of The Princess Swap series.

name: The Phantom Agent
summary: The Phantom Agent is the first and only book of The Phantom Agent series.

name: The Ghost of Us
summary: The Ghost of Us is the first and only book of The Ghost of Us series.

name: The Deadliest Game
summary: The Deadliest Game is the first and thus far only book of The Deadliest Game series.

name: The Deadliest Gambit
summary: The Deadliest Gambit is a VIP-exclusive short form special of the The Deadliest Game series.

name: The Duchess Affair
summary: The Duchess Affair is the first and only book of the The Duchess Affair series.

name: The Billionaire's Baby
summary: The Billionaire's Baby is the first and only book of the The Billionaire's Baby series.

name: The Birdcage 3
summary: The Birdcage 3 is the sequel to The Birdcage and The Birdcage 2. As with the first two games, you need to solve a series of puzzles in each chapter in order to open the cage and free the bird.

name: Thirty Monsters Challenge 2: Thirty Aliens
summary: A sequel to the original 30MC, the task was simple: create a map with 30 monsters in it. This set of 36 cl21 maps features work by a number of talented community map designers and contains some custom assets on top of the colorful Ancient Aliens texture pack!

name: The Devil Within
summary: A Sonic.EXE re-take by Brigandistian.

name: The Haunted House
summary: Our heroine "Mikae Mitsu" lived in a house with his aunt after the death of her parents. Mikae was in the house when she woke up and saw the letter placed on her table. But she didn't care Because it was everywhere the water was going anywhere Mikae went to the bathroom. Enough to come back to the room, but suddenly, something unusual happened. Because of a sudden noise from behind her when she turned around, she discovered that a ghost had broken into the house, and Mikae hurried to hide, she began to feel anxious and afraid Then Mikae So find a way to get out of this house.

name: There's an Only One Way Exit.
summary:
Dream is kindly illusion. Find the way to wake up, find the truth beneath the fog.

An interactive RPG game that you is someone who struck in the dream place, find the way to exit, true or lie this is no fault, it only meet the end.

name: The Kantist
summary:
The Kantist is an action-packed adventure 2D-Platformer.

Escape the testing facility and explore the deep and reaching vents of the lab to uncover its secrets. Use your abilities as a test subject to find new Zones, master minigames and befriend other test subjects.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Time Lost
The Talos Principle II: Deluxe Edition
summary: The Deluxe Edition includes The Talos Principle 2 and Road to Elysium DLC.

name: The Things You Do For Love
summary:
A dark romantic-comedy where you get to play as a hopeless yandere who is desperately trying to understand their newfound, romantic feelings all while taking down the competition.

Whether you decide to stalk your crush, eliminate your rivals, or make new friends, just go out there and win some love — no matter what, no matter how!

name: The Apple
summary: The Apple is a clicker game where you click on the apple to increase your score.

name: The Hamster
summary: Welcome to "The Hamster" – a fun and relaxing clicker game where you collect unique skins for your adorable hamster. Earn points, unlock new skins, and enjoy the simple yet captivating gameplay. Perfect for those looking for a light and enjoyable gaming experience.

name: The Games You Make
summary: “Quit your job, take out a loan and make a top seller game” sounded like a great idea two months ago. Now, you’re chasing bizarre bugs, combining features that should never go together, and striving to capture that mysterious thing called “fun”. Every decision is yours—and so are the consequences.

name: The Strawman Augment
summary: A game made within a month with Adventure Game Studio

name: The Fight of the Sumo-Hoppers
summary: The Fight of the Sumo-Hoppers is a physics-based fighting game by Tuomas Korppi. Radioactive wrestlers weighing several megatons fight in the Cement Desert on the planet of Musculia in this ancient holy sport.

name: The Last Scaler
summary: A Foddyvania, where you build yourself up from scrap, collect new abilities, and scale a sacred mountain.

name: The First Descendant: Season 1
summary:
Step into the action in The First Descendant’s thrilling Season 1 Update: Invasion starting August 29th!
Tackle new dungeons, unlock fresh content, and play as Hailey, the new sniper Descendant.

name: The Pyrite Talisman
summary: The Pyrite Talisman is a 3D graphic adventure involving exploration in third person direct movement, puzzle solving and inventory use through a point & click interface. During gameplay the player will play with two characters switching through time to collect informations to progress further into the story.

name: The Duck Song Game
summary: The ever so loved The Duck Song has returned.

name: The Cope
summary: The Cope is a 2D, point-and-click game that presents the fear of the unknown. Your night shift client service job as a janitor will start with you getting entangled in a series of strange stories in The Cope mansion. Work cleaning and serving your client and find the truth of this mansion of fear.

name: The Secret Behind the Exam Paper
summary: A first person horror decryption game with bizarre rules

name: The Life of Me
summary:
The story revolves around Oliver, an eighteen-year-old man who has just moved back to the town he grew up in. Amidst old friends and new acquaintances, he learns about the world of grown-ups; responsibilities, sexual exploration, and that everyone has secrets they wish to keep hidden.

Will he find love, uncover his friends' secrets, or just learn to enjoy what the world has to offer?

name: The House of Da Vinci VR
summary: Experience the world of The House of Da Vinci like never before in this captivating VR puzzle adventure. Solve complex puzzles, uncover hidden items, and escape rooms, all embodying the Renaissance spirit. Use your intellect to discover what led to your master’s disappearance.

name: The Midnight Bus
summary: A short narrative horror experience, in which you find yourself in the middle of nowhere in a snowstorm without knowing what has happened to the driver or the other passengers in the vehicle, you just know that there is something out there lurking.

name: The Wicked Witch of the West
The Nightscarred: Forgotten Gods
summary: Embrace your destiny as the daughter of Erlik, the god of death, in this immersive first-person action game. Craft your own spells, creatively combine them with Nightscarred's hybrid combat system, and assassinate your foes to restore balance in a physics-driven shamanic world based on Turkic mythology. Play alone or team up with a friend in co-op mode.

name: The Little Mermaid: Wonder Puzzles
summary: With over 100 images and three game modes, it's perfect for kids and juniors. Have fun solving all the puzzles. Ideal for little explorers!

name: The Demons Down Under
summary: Play as a bunny and slay demons deeper and deeper into the depths of hell. Collect loot, upgrade weapons, slay demons, and rescue all the sisters in this action RPG shooter.

name: The Avengers Pinball
summary: Pinball table based on the TV show by the same name.

name: The Official Everton FC Intelligensia
summary:
The Official Everton F.C. Intelligensia is a quiz game about football. Despite the title it's not specifically about Everton as the player can choose to represent any English top flight team of the 1989/90 season and it features question about both domestic and international football. All questions have three alternatives to choose from and has to be done before time runs out. Some are accompanied with a picture.

The game is built around the FA Cup and like in real life first division clubs enters the competition in the third round. In each round the player has to answer a number of questions which depends on the opposition drawn and if it's a home or away game. Opposition from higher divisions lead to more questions being asked. Goals are scored by answering questions correctly and the number of answers required depend on the difficulty level chosen. In the same way goals are conceded by answering questions wrongly.

name: The Alchemist & His Battle-Scarred Homunculus
summary:
A heartwarming tale of two broken people finding a new life together!

This heartwarming and dramatic tale follows Rakels, the young alchemist who helped create living homunculi to better the lives of mankind, only to have his partner betray him and turn their creations into tools of war. After years of exile for speaking out against their use as weapons during the war, Rakels discovers the battered form of Mel, a homunculus who was discarded by a slave trader.

As the two begin to confront their traumatic pasts together, a new bond is formed that helps them heal and forge a loving future together. Sweet and tender moments abound as Rakels and Mel face their fears of society and intimacy to truly come together as a couple.

name: The Mixologist
summary:
The Mixologist brings the art of cocktail crafting to life in an immersive virtual reality experience. Whether you’re a seasoned bartender or new to the craft, the game offers over 100 real-life cocktail recipes to master in single player campaign or multiplayer co-op modes. Mix, shake, and garnish drinks with precision, honing your skills through intuitive and rewarding gameplay, or attend the bars as a patron and allow your friends to make your favorite cocktails for you in an inviting social environment.

Explore five distinct bars, each with its own unique atmosphere and challenges. From the cozy neighborhood pub to the bustling rooftop lounge, each venue offers a fresh experience, requiring you to adapt and refine your bartending techniques. As you progress, unlock new recipes and venues, eventually earning your place as a legendary mixologist.

The gameplay blends authenticity with arcade-style fun, making it easy to pick up, but challenging to master. Points are earned based on speed and skill, adding a competitive edge as you strive to perfect each order.

name: The Cummunist Manifesto: Dommy Mommy Commie Adventure
summary: The Cummunist Manifesto is a kinetic novel retelling of the classic Communist Work "The Communist Manifesto" by Karl Marx except Karl is now a busty babe.

name: The Unholy Smoke
summary: THE UNHOLY SMOKE is a small, Half Life inspired retro FPS set in a certain desolate city in Finland. Help Jerry through a completely ordinary looking apartment complex which has definitely not suffered from any unmentioned events, in the hopes of reaching his apartment and having his long awaited smoke break.

name: The Abandoned
summary: The Abandoned is a proof of concept for an SMT-inspired RPG where dice rolls are replaced with quick time events.

name: These Heavenly Bodies
summary: A Lab has obtained three Statues from an excavation of an ancient site. Scans of the Statues indicated preserved bodies within.

name: The Simpsons Movie: The Ball of Death
The Seven Deadly Sins: Idle Adventure
summary:
The Seven Deadly Sins reborn as cute chibis!
The characters from "The Seven Deadly Sins" have been turned into lovable little chibis! But they haven't gotten any weaker!

name: There's No Santa
summary: There's no Santa is a hidden object game with a selection of 4 locations and Christmas-themed items to find for each of them.

name: The Real Face of a VTuber
summary: A courtroom investigation visual novel. You play as Prosecutor Justin Truth, investigating a murder at a VTuber agency where that VTuber's real face is the key to cracking the entire case.

name: The Town of Nie
summary: The protagonist is a young man named Hisora, who works several blue-collar part-time jobs. One day, he suddenly finds himself lost in a strange world. This is an otherworldly boys-love fantasy in which Hisora will risk his life to find a way back to his world.

name: The Weight of Life: An Interactive Death Game of Judgement
summary: Invited to take part in a shady competition known as the Judge's Game, partners Lana and Percy must work together to survive. Alongside ten other participants, they must navigate three deadly weeks of alliances, betrayals, and drama - each bookended by a fatal judgement; Someone must be chosen as the least valuable and face execution. You assume the role of either Lana or Percy in this interactive visual novel, and who lives and who dies rests entirely in your judgement.

name: The Missing Daughter
summary:
A missing person, a shady investigation, the mob on your back... Only your deductive skills will allow you to make progress in this difficult case.

"The Missing Daughter" is a card-based investigation game made for #AdvJam2019 under 2 weeks. It features a unique mechanic to investigate, gather clues and interrogate people.

name: This is Not Your House
summary: Crush someone's skull, suffer from hypothermia, transcend your mortal frame, find all 10 endings. GET YOUR HOUSE BACK.

name: The Legend of Banjo-Kazooie: The Bear Waker Deluxe
The Springlock: Aftermath
summary:
In a timeline where Henry's plan has failed...
You're working for a group of investigators who are trying to get rich information about Fazbear Entertainment and their connection with William Afton. Your job is to investigate the old private warehouse of Fazbear Entertainment and save all possible information to the cloud storage. Things get worse when spectral visitors arrive. So, are you ready for the third round?
The Springlock: Aftermath is an FNaF fan-game featuring over 2 hours of gameplay with 10 intriguing main nights and tons of extra content, giving you a genuine FNAF game experience. There is something new to experience every night!

name: The Devilz Work
summary: Here are 7 SP/coop maps designed for DOS Doom2

name: The Amazing Universe of the Psychotrons
summary: Adventure 2D, retro but not pixel art, you are Agent Plotkin and you wander in O'Psy Town to collect the lost neurons of a mad professor overhauled by its own obsessions. He called those PSYCHOTRONS! Jabby and nervous entities o fthe subconscious.

name: The Search for Salmon
summary:
The Search for Salmon is an expert-level Kaizo. The aim of this hack isn't to troll or torture the player, but rather to provide an extremely difficult challenge in a fair and interesting way. Players will need to employ a wide range of Kaizo and Item Abuse skills. Shell, spring, and p-switch tricks are used alongside tight platforming and jump control. Beginners will likely be very frustrated, but seasoned players will hopefully find a fresh, fun challenge. There are however, a few Kaizo boxes (both marked and un-marked) and few tricks and traps along the way. The game also features optional coins to collect for "100%" runs, and some secret rooms and surprises to discover. There's even a checkpoint-save room so console players can rest without fear of losing any progress! Extensive play-testing has been done by myself and others to confirm that the entire game is indeed RTA-viable. I hope you enjoy it!
Edit - Had to fix a few more potential music problems that would lead to crashes. Everything should be solid now.

name: The Royal Office of Magick Affairs
summary: A dark, tactical RPG, set in a Shelleyan London filled with arcane mysteries to solve, artefacts to recover and beasts to defeat. Guide your team of exorcists and inventors through the darkest corners of Victorian London and try not to lose your mind!

name: The Perplexing Orb: Bounce Challenge
summary: Return to the world of The Perplexing Orb: Bounce N' Roll with this new spin off! The Perplexing Orb: Bounce Challenge takes the obstacle jumping of Bounce N' Roll and cranks it up with all new challenging stages to roll through!

name: The Crow
summary:
The Crow - Is java game based on Famous Brandon Lee film!
Dark roofs of faceless houses, dullness of rain, gray weekdays. He appears under the veil of the night. He is full with power and thirsty for revenge, he is – invincible, he is – the Crow! If you remember and love the legendary movie «the Crow» where the main role was brilliantly played by Brandon Lee, you should not miss its mobile version, which carries you back to the fantastic world of Gothic mystery and legends.

name: The Irritatis: The Road
summary:
A kind of playable short. You can be driving quietly on the route, enjoying the landscape. And when you see some steam coming out from the engine, you think about the bottle of water you’ve forgotten on the table.
Anyway you stay calm because you know that any driver could help you. And so it is …

name: The Last Crusade
summary: The author worked almost 7 months on these 3 combined levels that take place in Rome. This is his most complicated project I have built till now. Many big locations, exploring, puzzles, action and atmosphere. It's all there. When you find all 7 secrets in the first 2 outside levels an actionpacked bonusstage awaits you.

name: The Jumping Donut
summary: From the creative minds at The Jumping Food Games comes a brand new, delicious adventure: "The Jumping Donut". Take on the role of a juicy donut and master 27 exciting levels in this unique puzzle platformer!

name: The Seed: Unit 7
summary: Farm for your future in a sci-fi twist on top-down life sim adventure!

name: The Great Fleece
summary: Oliver and Darran are trying to raid the “Beatrice Auction House”. They need to sneak by some guards and avoid security cameras in order to get a key card to the vault. Can you help them out?

name: The Jumping Ice Cube
summary: From the developers at The Jumping Food Games comes a refreshing new game of skill: "The Jumping Ice Cube". In this fast-paced endless game, you play as a nimble ice cube jumping through icy challenges that test your reactions and skill. How long can you hold out and chase your high score?

name: The Witch, the Ghost and the Snake
The Rescue 1-4
summary: A Tomb Raider fangame made with TRLE.

name: The Rescue 5: Temple of Osiris
summary: A Tomb Raider fangame made with TRLE.

name: The Adventurers
summary: The Adventurers is a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision shapes your legacy. Lead your party of heroes in an open world filled with random events that affect your story. Survive a high fantasy landscape where your epic saga is waiting to be written.

name: The Legend Of Tartar
summary:
Join Tartar on an Adorable Dream Adventure!

Dangerous monsters have appeared in Tartar's dreams!
Please help Tartar stay undisturbed in its sweet sleep!

Our adventure will become another legend!

name: The Bound of Time
summary: The Bound of Time is a tiny action adventure and was made for #lowrezjam within 3 weeks. There a some bugs yet, but the game it's playable and i hope it's enjoyable to.

name: The Object
summary: A man who lost his head and his memories found himself trapped inside a mansion. He must search for clues as he tries to escape, with or without the solution to both of these mysteries.

name: The Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game: Expansion 6 - Faithful Friends
summary: Don't despair — you've got faith on your side in this expansion for the Dresden Files Cooperative Card Game! Inside you'll find two new character decks — Sir Waldo and River Shoulders — and two new book decks — PEACE TALKS and BATTLE GROUND.

name: The Smurfs Dreams: Cosmic Costume
summary:
Sparkle up!
Venture from dream to dream in this dazzling cosmic costume!

name: The Cool Guys Are Level 100
summary: The goal of this game is in it's name. Hack and slash through randomized stages with 8 different playable characters each with their own unique playstyles. Will you be able to reach level 100 without dying and (possibly) become a cool guy?

name: The No No Man
summary: A terrifying Indie horror experience with puzzle-platforming that will keep you on your toes as you find your way through the decrepit house. The only guidance you'll have going forward is your own wit and possibly the world's worst flashlight. But make no mistake, this is HIS house.

name: The Sims 4: Life and Death
summary: Peel back the veil to uncover the secret to fuller Sim lives and beyond in The Sims 4 Life & Death Expansion Pack.

name: The Halloween Party
summary: A short point'n'click adventure game

name: The Catapult
summary:
The Catapult you must help the stickman defend his castle from the siege weapons of the enemy.

Use the catapult to throw stones at the opponents and break their military mechanisms and siege towers.

The game has a simple intuitive control.
Tap on the screen and pull to charge the catapult and select the tension force. Release to launch the projectile into the enemy.

For each struck enemy you will earn coins which help you to buy upgrades shells, for example a bomb.

name: The New Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
summary:
The New Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog is a fangame based on Sonic Cartoons & Archie Comics.
The Game itself takes place in a special Alternate Universe where elements of all three shows (SatAM, AoStH & Underground) co-exist in some kind of fashion. You have a choice to play through 3 zones in this demo; Peridot Coast (a beach in Mobius best known for it's unusual green sand), Marble Valley (a canyon filled with volcanic geysers) & Robotropolis (an industrial city & Primary headquarters of Bumbling villain Dr. Robotnik & his Super Sonic Search & Smash Squad!

name: The Noise's Jam-Packed Radical Mini Mayhem!
summary: The Noise, being the annoying gremlin he is, decided to shrink himself down and go for a "jog" in Peppibot Factory.

name: The Trouble: Defense
summary: This is an ordinary tower defense game. If you are not satisfied with the existing content, you can leave a message in the comment area or our QQ group. We will try our best to make this game better.

name: The Throne of the Monster
summary: The Throne of the Monster is a female protagonist fantasy-style AVG.You will play a "monster" trapped in the human world and embark on an adventure in order to escape.Cities in chains,human beings without tears,betrayals of a thousand years ago...Finally, judge the pale world of love and hate.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Dungeons of Infinity
summary:
This game is a procedurally-generated rogue-like ‘Link to the Past’ dungeon crawler. It’s not a rom hack, it was created in Gamemaker Studio from scratch using the original assets. Many new features and assets were added to this game, but special care was put in to ensure it still looks, feels, and plays like the original game.
