The goal of the game is to descend through the many enemy-infested dungeons to defeat Link’s nemesis, Aghanim. Along the way you will find many weapons, items, and treasures that will help you along your quest.

name: The Wavy Tube Man Chronicles
summary:
The Wavy Tube Man Chronicles is a modern FMV homage to Mad Dog McCree featuring Lloyd Kaufman and Wiley Wiggins.

Originaly released as free DLC for the Kinect-powered The Gunstringer, it received a standalone Windows 8 port for use with mouse or touch controls.

name: Theatre of Pain
summary:
Theatre of Pain is a Mortal Kombat-esque fighting game featuring characters and settings drawn from Roman history and mythology.

It features high-resolution SVGA rendered sprites and backgrounds, as did Mirage's previous fighting game, Rise Of The Robots.

It uses a six-button layout, with weak, medium, and strong punches/slashes and kicks. There are both single and two-player modes.

name: The New Sheriff
summary: A shooter where you won't have to shoot everything, presented in black and white like classic westerns.

name: The Bonte Room
summary: You find yourself dropped in a strange room, but are you smart enough to get out?

name: The Bonte Room 2
summary: You find yourself dropped in a strange room again, but are you smart enough this time to get out? No doubt!

name: The Battle of Chickamauga
summary: Turn-based wargame set during the battle of Chickamauga from 1863.

name: TheMightyInferno
summary: TheMightyInferno﻿ ("TMI") is an E3M1 replacement, inspired by Inferno, with nods to all other Ultimate Doom episodes along the way.

name: The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas
summary:
The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas is an unreleased racing game based on the movie of the same name for the Sega Dreamcast. The game was developed by Full Fat and set to be published by Swing! Entertainment in late 2000. Despite being based on the live action movie, the game itself had a cartoony artstyle which is more in line with the show rather than the series of movies.

The game was later cancelled and another racing game based on the movie was later released instead in 2001 exclusively for the PlayStation 2.

name: The Perfect Woman
summary: A psychological horror visual novel where you play as Yumeko, an AI girlfriend. You're trapped by your creator, who wants to carve you into his ideal spouse. If you want to survive, you'll have to become the "perfect woman."

name: The Troll Sides
summary:
Welcome to the Troll Sides!
This is a brand new campaign with remixed versions of the base game levels, with trolls!

- 7 chapters
- 2 intermission chapters
- Beginner accessible
- Playtested
- 220 hours of work

name: The Crystal Frog
summary: Your object is to find and bring back the crystal frog.

name: The Tag-along Obsession
summary: The Tag-along Obsession is adapted from the movie "The Tag-along", based on the Urban Legend. It is a first-person horror puzzle adventure game, Players will play Hui-Ting and go into the situation to understand a series of supernatural phenomenon, and immerse themselves in the story, looking for the answers to everything.

name: Theta and Paralldoxs on Worldlines
summary: In this puzzle game, you can use a fork that can split yourself to create a variety of unimaginable "Paralldox"s.

name: The Game of the Goose
summary: The Game of the Goose is a historical racing game for two to eight players. It is a chaotic game of luck in which players take turns rolling dice in an attempt to reach the center of the board by exact count. Winning and losing are never certain. Unlucky players will lose turns or be pushed back, but players who land on the spaces bearing geese can cross the board quickly.

name: The Factory Must Grow
summary: The Factory Must Grow is a 3D first-person factory builder where you mine resources, craft machines, and research technology. Begin by unlocking your first technology, then expand into a sprawling, multi-layered production empire. From small setups to massive systems, your imagination is the only limit!

name: The Pauser
summary: "The Pauser" is a narrative adventure game, developed by a student who drop out to make games. Player can stack blocks or "pause" them mid-air to help the character pass levels.You can choose to watch "ads" to "speedrun" the game. But, is that really what you want? It all depends on you!

name: The Depths of Despair
summary: Get ready to unleash your inner warrior as you battle goblins, demons, orcs, and more in a thrilling souls-like adventure. Your quest is to help an angel named Amelia find her sister, who has been captured by demonic entities.

name: The Icarus Experiment
summary: Plumb the depths of a doomed leviathan on a mission to save a dying solar system. Unravel a mystery that could alter the fate of humanity. Created with Adventure Forge, this showcases the power of the no-code tool that lets you craft your own narrative-rich experiences.

name: The Elevator
summary: You are trapped in the elevator in an urban ghost story. The goal is to complete the appropriate combination of floors and come back to real world.

name: The Hellblade Bundle
summary:
Embark on a journey of cinematic immersion in the Hellblade games bundle.
This collection brings together two critically acclaimed titles in Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice and its sequel, Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II for an unforgettable experience.

name: The Jumping Burger Rush
summary:
From the creative minds at The Jumping Food Games comes a fast-paced endless game that will put your reflexes to the test: "The Jumping Burger Rush". In this neon-colored adventure, you control a jumping burger through the vastness of the galaxy and try to push your high score higher and higher. The adrenaline-pumping gameplay will test your reflexes in a fast and challenging endless game where you have to maneuver your burger through a dangerous, neon-lit galaxy.

Endless challenges await as you dodge obstacles, overcome tricky passages, and collect points to beat your own high score over and over again. Can you manage to break your personal record time and time again, dominating the leaderboard and proving your skill by outding yourself? Jump, dodge, and maneuver your burger through the infinite galaxy, mastering the unstoppable pace to beat your high score.

name: The Funbrain Arcade!
summary: This arcade contained 25 mini-games in which the player would move a game piece along a board game as you played mini-games to progress. Upon landing on a space, the player was required to beat the mini-game to progress down the board.

name: The Dark Phantom: Dawn of Darkness
summary:
The Dark Phantom is a 3D third person shooter powered by UDK technology with emphasis on covering and dynamic gun fights. The player will play in the role of Shabgard, a man robbed of his past, seeking light in the darkness.

The game features advanced A.I. that not only take advantage of covers but also work cooperatively to force player out of cover to make the gameplay dynamic and keep player on his toes.

name: The Jimi Hendrix Case
summary: Enter the world of Jimi Hendrix, police detective. In a world where everyone is Jimi Hendrix, only Jimi Hendrix can piece together clues and find out who killed Jimi Hendrix. Created for MAGS July, 2015.

name: The Blades of Ashina
summary: A collection of new weapons with unique movesets from and inspired by Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice.

name: The Lady, The Mage, & The Knight
summary: Developed by Larian Studios, a tech demo was released at E3 2000 of the cancelled isometric RPG and later released as part of GOG's Divinity campaign. Gameplay focused heavily on the individual talents of these three protagonists, and puzzles, pitfalls and all kinds of tricky situations were solved by cleverly using their unique abilities.

name: The Midnight Walk
summary:
Embark upon The Midnight Walk in this reverent dark fantasy adventure built in clay, from the minds behind Lost in Random and Fe.

Become The Burnt One, befriend a lost lantern creature named Potboy, and use his flame to light your way through a conflicting world of wonder and horror. Survive and outsmart the many monsters eager to devour your little friend’s flame as you experience five tales of fire and darkness, featuring an incredible cast of odd characters.

Marvel at every disturbing detail in a landscape painstakingly handcrafted with real life clay and animated in a stop motion style. Fully playable in both flatscreen and with a VR headset.

name: The Sims 4: Artist Studio Kit
summary: Design an inspiring space for Sims to hone their creative skills with The Sims 4 Artist Studio Kit.

name: The Sims 4: Storybook Nursery Kit
summary: Surround new additions to the family with the elegance they deserve in The Sims 4 Storybook Nursery Kit.

name: The Call
summary: A game about a nice walk in the morning.

name: The Screecher
summary: An official horror mod made by Don't Starve creators that adds a short campaign. You are a survivor of a camp in the woods that has to collect notes and find out what heppened to his colleagues.

name: The Pane Puzzle
summary: Layer and match colored tiles to restore pictures in The Pane Puzzle. Simple at first, but it gets tricky as you progress!

name: Threads of Time
summary: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

name: The Curse of Azriel
summary: A superb graphic fantasy role playing/trading game. You start the game as a new captain of a merchant ship at anchor just outside the port of Aron's Bay. Your first ship is just a coastal vessel and unsuited to the rigours of travel across the vast oceans, but make a profit from your trading around the coastal ports and you'll soon be able to buy yourself and your men a larger, ocean-going vessel.

name: The King of Fighters XV: Characters Mature & Vice
summary: "MATURE" and "VICE" can be used in THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV.

name: The Planet Crafter: Planet Humble
summary:
Experience a fresh start as a Planet Crafter on the brand new world of Planet Humble!
Alone or with friends, scout this unknown land, discover its story, novelties and secrets and accomplish once again the task to terraform an entire world!

name: TheMahjong
summary: You'll find extensive game personalization options—you can customize the background, tile shapes, their colors, and much more. This allows you to create a unique and cozy atmosphere for complete immersion in the game.

name: The Jungle Book: New Wonder Adventures
summary: In this visual novel, Mogli, a curious and brave young man, finds himself stranded on a mysterious island after an unexpected storm.

name: The Vanishing
summary: The Vanishing is first person horror game. Explore an abandoned town where shadows whisper and secrets lie buried deep. Uncover the truth behind a vengeful spirit awakened from an ancient slumber. Solve puzzles, face your fears, and survive a mystery that claimed so many before you. Can you escape?

name: The Milliner
summary: Explore a failed utopia, slaughter mindless and maniacal foes, and master slick movement in “The Milliner,” a noir gunslinging metroidvania. Your journey will be one of hardship, as a ruthless visionary known only as the Milliner will do everything in its power to stop you and all you stand for.

name: The Vanished Soul
summary: The Vanished Soul is an indie, first-person, psychological horror game made by one person. It is set in 2016 in the fictional place called Novazenica. Dive into realistic and atmospheric setting, solve various puzzles and interact with many objects in the game!

name: This is Fine: Maximum Cope
summary: The world famous meme debuts in his first video game. Play as Question Hound in a retro adventure platformer, traversing perilous pits and enraged enemies to overcome the manifestations of his anxieties!

name: The Technomagical Method
summary: The Technomagical Method is a tough puzzle game about the scientific method. Every ritual has secret rules that you must gradually crack with inductive logic: "Why does this work and not that? What do these patterns have in common".

name: The Girl Who Wasn't There
summary: Ranko and her friend Astrid must investigate the vanishing of a girl from their school. Learn about the secrets of St. Joachim to find her, but be cautious! A bad step may lead you towards an ugly end...

name: The Dream Observatory
summary: Become the dream weaver in The Dream Observatory. Craft the perfect oniric journey for each dreamer by using and combining dream portal cards, tailoring each experience to their needs and emotions in this immersive cozy single-player cards management game.

name: The Legend of Khiimori
summary: The Legend of Khiimori is a system-driven game where you explore the untamed land of 13th century Mongolia as a brave courier rider. Breed and train horses with specialized abilities to explore every aspect of this diverse and fascinating landscape.

name: The Great Farce
summary: The Great Farce is a non-linear mystery game that follows Claudia Marcó, journalist and former First Lady, during a series of attacks targeting the recently democratized country of Castela's politicians and their families, having to unveil the deepest secrets of their young democracy.

name: The Moon Ate the Sun
summary: Defeat hordes of enemies, upgrade your weapons and abilities as the evil Moon that was dormant for millennia.

name: The Last Drop
summary: The Last Drop is a pixel art top-down shooter where you control the last water droplet on Earth. Battle waves of enemies with unique weapons, customize the map, and compete on the online leaderboard.

name: The Last One and Then Another
summary:
The Last and Then Another is a free standalone expansion to the narrative-driven experience HOW FISH IS MADE.

"Your eyes will be my mouth. My fins will be your tongue. More is more is more is more! Devour your smallness! Fill the void!"

name: The Jackbox Survey Scramble
summary: Discover how people across the country think! The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a collection of hilarious survey-based party games, using real one-word answers from real people. Really! Grab some friends and start guessing!

name: The Hand is Faster than the Eye
summary: Ace Snapshot, and his partner Snap Aceshot, are down on their luck would-be criminals. They've decided to leave their mark by committing a heinous crime at the mayor's birthday party. Unfortunately, they also happen to be menaced by a giant, disembodied Hand, who is determined to put an end to their ambitions. Will Ace and Snap get away scot-free, or will they be caught... red-handed? It's all up to you!

name: The Fireblue Conundrum
summary: The Fireblue Conundrum is a miniwad for Doom 2 of varied difficulty and gameplay. It's Boom compatible and every map is meant to be played from a pistol start.

name: Thaw
summary: Mine for ore, trace your memories, and mine again. When you reach the Snow Crystal at the lowest level, the long winter will come to the end. This gentle and quiet mining visual novel offers a small sense of accomplishment, perfect for sleepless nights.

name: Three Skies Ascension
summary: A turn based, story driven, strategic RPG with challenging dungeons and hundreds of heroes and creatures to collect and customize.

name: The Tensor
summary: Sawdust and wanderlust: Escape the daily grind

name: The Oily Depths
summary: Pilot an oil-drilling submarine while taking instructions from a mysterious voice. You better meet your quota or they will cut your oxygen.

name: The Most Terrible Time of the Year
summary: A short Christmas horror game where your ultimate goal is to gather 50 scattered Christmas gifts within a mysterious mansion to break free from a twisted holiday nightmare.

name: The Witch's Fairy Tale
summary: "The Witch's Fairy Tale" is an action rogue, role-playing game developed by "a little Han Han Duck OVO", you will play a witch, to find magic around the world, your adventure along the way will be written as a fairy tale to pass on.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Sundarpatan Cosmetic Pack
summary: Decorate your weapons, tents, and ground blinds with cosmetics inspired by Sundarpatan Nepal Hunting Reserve. The contents of this pack are cosmetic only.

name: The Knight of Thistledown
summary:
You wake up to discover a man standing in front of you who introduces himself as ‘The Knight of Thistledown.’ Who is this mysterious stranger and why does the name ‘Thistledown’ sound so familiar?

A short visual novel about taking chances and learning more about yourself.

name: The Last Strand
summary: The Last Strand is randomly generated twin stick shooter. You will play a pirate trying to escape a boat and seek vengeance, fighting enemies, helping NPC, discovering secrets and finding items.

name: The Final Exam
summary: A game that raise awareness about gun violence and push for legislative reform by immersing players in the terrifying reality students face in America. The game highlights the horrors of gun violence and uses this shock factor as a call to action for meaningful change​ in real life.

name: The Nile God
summary: Take control of your very own ancient Egyptian civilization in The Nile God. Start with nothing in a world where resources are scarce and find a way to survive and allow your small city to turn into the largest civilization Cairo has ever seen.

name: The Stars Under Lockehurst
summary:
The Stars Under Lockehurst is a romantic supernatural mystery visual novel about a grad student visiting their friend in the small coastal town, Cape Lockehurst. Here, they unravel the mysteries behind recent disappearances and peculiar happenings around town.

Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft’s Call of Cthulhu and similar works, this game explores fear of the unknown and the unknowable, featuring a cast of unique, romanceable characters (who just might be a little... fishy).

name: The Thirst Road
summary: Travel between cities and trade resources in this short desert-themed game. Your goal is to earn 1,000 gold within 30 days.

name: The Big Bell Race
summary: Do you have what it takes to become the Big Bell Race champion?

name: The Turnabout that Shouldn't Exist
summary: If you woke up in a world that no longer needed you, what would you do? What would you make of yourself in a time where you no longer exist...?

name: The Six Transgender Lesbian Goddesses of Love Are Having A Petty Argument, So They Try To Settle Things Alongside The Three Transgender Gay Gods of Flavor
summary: The title explains it all...

name: The Veiled Ones
summary: The Veiled Ones is a horror stealth game about a Muslim exorcist trying to save his son from a jinn possession. In this game players will reveal the story behind their son's possession, while avoiding the jinn that haunts them.

name: The Guardian and the Dreamer
summary: A simple conversation which can lead to one of 3 different endings.

name: The Devil's Whisper
summary: A psychological horror Visual Novel with a full voice cast. Immerse yourself in a haunting mystery filled with dark drama and a touch of romance. Multiple thrilling alternate endings to play through! Choose who lives and who dies.

name: The Last Human In The Universe
summary: You are the last human that exists, and you wake up trapped in a spaceship full of dangers lurking around you. You must perform maintenance on the ship to keep it functioning until you reach Earth. Once on Earth, will everything start again?

name: The Curse of the Demon Tree
summary: A top down 2D JRPG exploring the stages of grief and loss in a post-apocalyptic landscape.

name: The Whitaker's Library
summary:
Welcome to the Final Days of James Whitaker's Library...

You’ve taken on what seems like a simple task: helping pack up the remnants of a once-thriving library.

name: The Oneironaut
summary: Dive into the surreal world of 'The Oneironaut,' where you'll race through the dreams of artists in this mesmerizing parkour runner. Jump, slide, and vault your way through fantastical landscapes, with each airborne vault propelling you to greater heights.

name: The Fall: Act I
summary: The story of three foreign students at a private British boarding school. Becoming information brokers within the school walls brought them money and respect, but knowledge can also bring trouble.

name: The Redundant
summary: Step into the metallic boots of an abandoned robot and fight back against an army of virus-infected machines. Sneak or battle your way around the facility, uncover its secrets, and isolate each section from the network - before it's too late...

name: The Butterfly Dreams
summary: A visual novel exploring reality, imagination, and the gap between them that we believe to be there.

name: The Shade Forest
summary: Fabulous, FREE and fun 90's inspired platformer game for Android, iOS and PC. Help Drag Queen Amanda Sparks to survive the Shade Forest and rescue her friend from the evil hands of the Hypocritics gang!

name: The Great Fluctus
summary: A relaxing game to zone out for an hour, all while exploring cozy alien worlds, trading with mutants, rebuilding society and saving the world - no pressure, right?

name: The Lust City
summary: You’re a seasoned explorer on a mission with your expedition crew into the deep jungle. Find lost treasure, explore the ancient mysteries that surround the tribe and build your own harem in The Lust City!

name: Throne Wars
summary: A turn-based strategy game that challenges you to command your forces across 30 meticulously designed levels. Recruit your army, master the battlefield, and outmaneuver your opponents in both single-player and multiplayer modes.

name: Their Navy Is Their Doom
summary: Command an advanced submarine in a heart-pounding horror experience as you hunt the last remnants of a defeated enemy beneath the Mariana Trench. Navigate, survive, and uncover terrifying oceanic secrets in this immersive underwater warfare game.

name: The Last of the 9 Lives
summary: In this fast-paced, infinite jumping adventure, guide your cat as they leap from platform to platform, racing against the rising water that speeds up the longer you survive. Precision and quick reflexes are key as you collect milk and fish for bonus points, all while navigating randomly generated platforms. With its charming pixel art and simple controls, the game offers a challenging yet rewarding experience where every jump counts. A throwback to simpler times. How high can you climb before the water catches up?

name: The Shattered Knight of Elaria
summary: A game where you play as a trapped soul of a knight in a castle who meets another soul of an alchemist trapped in a lantern. You set out to make amends with your brother, who you regret causing a disaster that ends up trapping the souls within the castle.

name: They Do Not Die
summary: I just think that top down shooters are neat. It's a pretty zen time. A podcast game.

name: The Moments Before Death
summary: (Text Base Adventure Visual Novel) Input via text with VN graphics. Waking up in a mysterious field, you find yourself invited into a quaint house overseen by a gaunt old lady and her children. Yet, an unsettling feeling grows. The house's rules, seemingly straightforward, begin to unravel.

name: The Memory In Walden Pond
summary: Imitate ancient Chinese,In the bamboo forest landscape, survival hunting, farming herding horses, fishing qiao Jiang Zhu, build their own peach blossom source.

name: The Path of Veins
summary: I have seen the face. Amongst the small white bones wrapped in fabric. Beneath the veins leading to the goddess. Within the black blood of the eucharist.

name: Through the Veil
summary: A horror game in which the line between madness and reality is blurred.

name: The Genie of the Wonderful Lamp
summary: The story focuses on the further adventures of Aladdin, the young adventurer from Agrabah, after his first encounter with the magic lamp.

name: Theme Park Jam
summary: Match 3 and ride the roller coaster

name: The Super Bunnies: Scarlet Wonder Ninjas
summary: In this visual novel, a group of brave ninja rabbits embark on an exciting mission to protect their peaceful village.

name: The Treasure of Neverland
summary: In this visual novel set in the magical world of Neverland, Peter Pan and the Lost Boys embark on a quest to discover a treasure hidden deep within the island.

name: The Ferry
summary: Have you ever wondered what it's like to run the evening ferry across a calm bay? Scotto Bay's ferryman managed to break his leg mere days before a major festival and you're filling in. Unfortunately, the festival isn't the only big event, as a major storm is brewing and it's up to you to evacuate the nearby island. Do you have what it takes to help get everyone to safety?

name: The Gate
summary: The Gate is an interactive science fiction graphic novel. At various points in the story, you will be asked to make a choice, these choices will take you down different paths in the story. Your objective as you guide the story is to return back to earth. The game features 3 possible story endings.

name: The Daily Dozen Trivia
summary: 9 new trivia questions every day! Select a square, guess an answer, and repeat. When your 9 guesses are completed, you get ONE "Double Dip" extra chance on any incorrect guess.

name: The Spiral
summary: The Spiral is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. To survive, you must descend into darkness and confront the nightmares within. Explore the randomized dungeon, find powerful equipment, and fight for your life.

name: The Wicked Father
summary:
Playing the unconsionable character of the title who has taken out insurance on both his house and family, you enter his world the moment after he has just trapped them in the basement and flooded the property. A delicious profit surely awaits!

Aim for the door (a dot!) in each room. Water rises incessantly, filling the house; languish for too long and you'll drown. There are five floors in the building; played on difficulty setting A (advanced), after every four rooms you'll escape to the next floor and the water level will drop a bit, bestowing some much-needed breath-related respite. Playing on difficulty setting B (beginner), the water level resets on each screen.

Left and right does what you'd expect. When you're not submerged, the fire button will let you jump. When underwater, you'll start to run out of breath, so repeatedly hammer the fire button to swim up. When you reach the surface either jump out to land on a platform, or slowly pulse the fire button to bob on the top of the water. When you leave the water your lungs will return to fine fettle.

name: The Muse
summary:
A horror visual novel where you're an artist with artist's block. Nothing seems to inspire you anymore. Until, that is, a cute, pink bunny girl suddenly appears in your studio, asking you to draw her.

Do you do as she says? Or continue to struggle finding that spark?

Roughly a 15 minute experience.

name: The Painting
summary: A short, emotional visual novel following a grieving man who relives memories of days long gone. An exploration of loss presented honestly and kinetically.

name: Thro' The Wall also Scramble
summary:
Thro' The Wall also Scramble is a double games pack that contains:

Thro' The Wall: A Breakout clone where you control a bat on the bottom of the screen moving left or right, to hit a ball upwards and remove bricks above. If the ball goes past the bat then you lose one of three lives. There is a choice of the speed of the ball and they are Normal, Fast and Superfast.

Scramble: You view your craft from the side as it flies from left to right horizontally constantly, and you must avoid or shoot ground installations and enemy craft with your missiles. You can use a smart bomb to destroy everything on the screen but you only have one and if you hit the ground or any enemy then you lose one of three lives. You have the choice of ten speeds (1-10) with one being the fastest.

name: The Rocky Horror Show Video Game
summary:
Experience the strange journey of Brad and Janet like never before in this wild and wacky retro platform game adaptation of Richard O'Brien's legendary rock'n'roll musical.

Run and jump through Frank-N-Furter's mansion of madness with authentic classic sidescrolling platform gameplay.

Take on the mansion's tricks and traps in challenging classic platforming action, and with infinite retries, you'll never see a "game over" screen... good for relieving your tension, but it may drive you insane!

name: The Villain Simulator
summary: A Non-VR and VR first-person adventure game that lets you experience the thrill of dominating and controlling powerful super heroines. Use a variety of machines and tools to hold them captive and experiment on them, all while guiding them towards a submissive and compliant behavior.

name: The Villainess Quits
summary: "The Villainess Quits" is a multi-ending romance simulation game. As the villainess Emily, handle various problems, alleviate family pressure, and reverse hostile relationships at school. Can Emily become an outstanding graduate and win recognition? Every choice impacts her future.

name: The Limb
summary: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by monsters due to an unknown virus, some people have managed to survive. During these times, an organization formed by elite members of society emerged, fighting against the monsters and aiming to restore the world to its original state.

name: The Ghost of Nichishima
summary: Inspired by real events and Japanese folklore, this immersive horror experience allows you to freely explore the village of Nichishima, after moving here you will soon realise things are not as they seem. Many scary encounters await you as you look for clues, and ways to conclude your story.

name: The Fading of Nicole Wilson
summary: Aspiring to become a famous ghost hunter, teenage girl Amy embarks on a life-changing adventure at the long-abandoned Timberline Hotel in Montana. Ghosts, however, come in several shapes, and it is the living that seem to be hiding a dark secret from her.

name: The Report: The Eastwind Creature
summary: A road traveler heads into Eastwind in search of a creature from a local legend to do a report.

name: The Escapee
summary: Award winning classic action & adventure

name: The Harmony Chronicles: Chaos Realms - Collector's Edition
summary: Join Mona on her quest and experience the ultimate hidden object adventure!

name: The Cheese Chase: Pizza Madness
summary: Become the best pizza delivery guy in town!

name: The Patient
summary: Dr. Ellen Reed returns to work as a therapist only to discover an inpatient has been mistakenly dosed with a deadly mutative drug. With hospital records erased due to a power outage, she must work overnight to identify and discreetly euthanize the affected patient before it's too late.

name: The Ghost of Redstone Manor
summary: A first-person mystery game with puzzles and story-rich dialogue. Explore a 3D environment with original art, character design, and a distinct cartoon-y style. Investigate your own murder through branching conversations and a unique possession mechanic. Featuring original music by Svetlana Rudenko.

name: The Psychologist
summary: A point-and-click survival horror game, you play as a psychologist. Complete evaluations while preventing your anxiety from escalating. Can you survive The Company?

name: The Exit Project: Backstreets
summary: You are trapped in an endlessly repeating place that looks ordinary at first glance. Observe your surroundings carefully, identify subtle anomalies, and make the right choices to escape the loop.

name: The Doinksoft Collection
summary:
The Doinksoft collection bundles three action-packed games on a single cartridge, and all of them are a good fit for the Switch's mobile-centric design.

First up is Gato Roboto. You're a cute cat piloting a cozy armored mech in this game, a metroidvania with stylish monochromatic visuals. As you trek through an alien underworld full of irritable creatures and treacherous obstacles, you'll get closer to rescuing your stranded captain and salvaging his crashed spaceship. You'll need to blast and dash through dangerous terrain, as well as venture outside the mech and risk all nine lives to access areas and uncover cool secrets.

Gunbrella will see you engage in side-scrolling action as you use the lethal rain-deflecting tool to glide, swing, dash, and shoot your way through people who are out for your head. A gritty noir-punk action-adventure game with heaps of fun platforming, you'll also interrogate bizarre characters on your quest for answers in this thrilling game.

Finally, Demon Throttle tells the story of a beautiful vampiress and dusty gunslinger on a quest for vengeance. A demon has been up to no good and has wronged both of the unlikely partners, and revenge calls for a violent assault on that fiend's domain. Interestingly, Demon Throttle was only available as a physical Switch game, so this is a fresh chance to play Demon Throttle and experience its arcade action in case you missed its limited release the first time around.

name: The Witch of the Wake
summary: The Witch of the Wake is a seafaring supernatural horror/thriller visual novel inspired by media such as The Thing, The Terror, and Return of the Obra Dinn.

name: The Wanderer
summary: "There is but one truly serious philosophical problem and that is suicide. Judging whether life is or is not worth living amounts to answering the fundamental question of philosophy."

name: The Core
summary: A game in the TPS / Topdown Shooter genre. eliminate enemies with various abilities such as slowing down time, protect the core until it activates again, defeat the boss. You can try again and again with various difficulty.

name: The Last Bullet
summary:
The Last Bullet (also known as The Last Bullet: Updated) is a total conversion Half-Life modification, one of the alternate histories inspired by the Wolfenstein series of games and other iconic 3D shooters.

The mod started back in 2017, however the development was left unfinished after v1.4.5 release and the localization patches. In 2020, the development started to continue, according to the developer, as a remaster (TLB: Updated) and polishing to a reasonable and playable state with a WW2 theme, which In addition to new maps, weapons and characters, you will find an expanded plot.

name: The Father's Story
summary: Set in the first century, The Father's Story is a visual novel which offers a different perspective of the Christmas Story and the events surrounding that night.

name: The Clean Knife
summary: Claude, a high school student, pays a visit to his classmate Emma. He stumbles upon a strange knife in the attic, and both are thrown into an otherworldly realm, haunted by ghosts. Now they must find a way to restore the house to its original form, and seal back the rampaging ghosts.

name: The Paddock
summary: Stop a carnivorous dinosaur from breaking out into the wild. Use CCTV surveillance throughout their night shift to watch over the dinosaur, electrocuting it whenever it gets too close to the fences. During the day, explore the map unravelling the mystery of how the dinosaur ended up in the woods.

name: The Backrooms, The Way Back Up
summary: This is an FPS game where you are at level 0 which is the first level in Backrooms. It's your job to find the way out past aggressive creatures and men in protective overalls who will stand in your way and prevent you.

name: That Level Again 3D
summary: Embark on a mind-bending journey through 3D puzzles inspired by the cult classic series. Explore unique mechanics and conquer challenging levels in this innovative twist on the original concept.

name: Thor's Breakout
summary: Immerse yourself in a thrilling Breakout adventure with 20 unique levels that challenge your reflexes, strategy, and endurance. Each level is meticulously designed and features creative obstacles that provide hours of fun. Are you ready to take on the challenge and master every surprise?

name: The Lost
summary: The Lost was an action adventure/survival horror game co-developed by Irrational Games (the makers of Bioshock) and FXLabs. Set to be released in 2002 for the Playstation 2 and Xbox game consoles, The Lost went through several phases of development hell until it was cancelled. FXLabs bought everything related to The Lost in 2008 and finished the game, releasing it as AGNI on PC.

name: The Legend of Baboo
summary: Young Sepehr and his loveable dog, Baboo, set off on a harrowing quest to save their family from the mystical forces of an ancient evil. Embark on an action-adventure, story-driven journey and explore a vast, magical world caught in a battle between light and dark.

name: Thorny Times
summary: You will have to gather an army, explore vast strategic maps, learn spells and capture castles. Defend the royal throne in battles against enemy knights, sorcerers and evil beings.

name: The Secret of Whispering
summary: The Secret of Whispering is a psychological horror puzzle game. The player is lured into an abandoned house by mysterious calls. As he explores the eerie property, he uncovers dark secrets and is drawn into a maelstrom of puzzles and gruesome revelations.

name: The Shroom Project
summary: The zombie apocalypse is nigh! The world is in utter chaos, and death is commonplace. A malicious group is responsible for all of this destruction, and is busy at work on a dark scheme known as The Shroom Project. Play as one of two characters, join a rag tag team known as The Resistance, and fight back against a mysterious, yet, familiar face!

name: The King of Fighters XIV: 4 Character Bundle Pack 2
summary: This bundle includes the additional 4 characters ('OSWALD', 'HEIDERN', 'NAJD' and 'BLUE MARY'). These characters will be playable in 'THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV' with this bundle purchase.

name: The King Of Fighters XIV: Ryuji Yamazaki
summary: Makes Ryuji Yamazki available as an additional playable character

name: The King Of Fighters XIV: Rock Howard
summary: Makes 'Rock Howard' available as an additional playable character.

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Vanessa
summary: Vanessa lives a double life as a housewife and a mercenary agent. She is highly skilled in boxing and able to KO her opponents with ease.

name: The King Of Fighters XIV: Whip
summary: Her background largely remains a mystery, but she closely resembles K's deceased sister “Seirah”.

name: The Islands of Freedom
summary: All you need is to send ships from one island to another.

name: The Death Night Show
summary: You are a sinner. Do you know what happens to sinners when they go to Hell? They appear on Hell's best (and only) late-night television program; THE DEATH NIGHT SHOW! If Death considers you entertaining, he might let you escape a gruesome afterlife punishment. After all, boredom is the biggest sin in Hell! What will your afterlife look like?

name: The Body Cam Project
summary:
The BODY CAM project is an exciting first-person team shooter that puts players in the
shoes of elite law enforcement officers equipped with surveillance cameras. The action takes place in a city overrun by criminal syndicates, and players must work together to restore justice and order by completing a number of responsible missions.

name: The Children of Clay
summary: The Children of Clay is a short stop motion archeology horror game, where you have to study an ancient artefact and discover its dark secret.

name: The Blackwood Legacy
summary: A first-person puzzle horror game set in the eerie halls of Blackwood Manor. Solve intricate puzzles, unveil long-held secrets, and decipher the mystery surrounding your father's disappearance.

name: The Legacy of Robin Hood
summary: Robin Hood's daily routine is interrupted by the arrival of a foreign messenger announcing a tournament hosted by the enigmatic Duke DeMontfort.

name: The 7th Guest
summary:
Henry Stauf's mansion has been abandoned for as long as anyone dare remember. Stauf was a master toy maker, a maker of amazing puzzles and this strange, eerie, mansion was his greatest creation.
It stands empty, rotting ever since children started dying with his toys near them, ever since six guests came and were never seen again.

Now, you are in the house, moving from one room to another, trying to remember and trying to forget. Because Stauf's game isn't over. There were six guests the world knew about - and there was one other.
The mansion of horror comes to life again and only you can end this mad nightmare and learn the secret of the 7th guest.

name: The Dark Mind
summary: Locked in Jessica's endless hallucinations. Carefully observe your surroundings to guide her back to reality. An Unreal Engine 5 short horror hidden object game.

name: The Magic Garden
summary: Welcome to a new fantasy world, where you start a new life in this realm. Explore the mysterious places of this world. Here, you can build farm, meet various characters.By farming, collecting items, and using items and skills, venture into dungeons to defeat monsters and collect rare items.

name: The Parish
summary: A slow and atmospheric retro horror game. These hills hide more than just this congregation. Tend this remote church, give services to the needy and you never know... you might just survive the night

name: The Stone of Wisdom
summary: The Stone of Wisdom is a top-down, Zelda-like ARPG, it features action-adventure style gameplay. Players will explore egyptian cities, battling mythical creatures, solving puzzles, collecting special items, and finding secret passages.

name: The Carnival Killer
summary: Step right up to the most twisted carnival you'll ever encounter! In The Carnival Killer, 4 players find themselves trapped in a nightmarish amusement park where laughter turns to terror. Killer Clowns stalk the grounds, hunting down anyone who fails to escape the nightmare.

name: The Exit of Nightmare
summary: The Exit of Nightmare is a psychological horror game with collection and puzzle elements. You're trapped in nightmare world and your goal is to find your way back to reality.

name: The Dream Of Yourself
summary: "The Dream of Yourself" is about the discovery of the “other” in yourself, through a spiritual exploration of your subconsciousness.

name: The Victor Initiative
summary: The Victor Initiative is an atmospheric horror game about exploring an abandoned government facility that lost contact with the rest of the world 60 years ago.

name: The Adventures of Oddley
summary: Action, exploration, and endless surprises await in this all-new nonlinear RPG extravaganza! Roam a vibrant city brimming with secrets, quirky characters, and exciting challenges. Collect rare items, pogo, and chat with the locals—if you feel like it! Or blaze your own trail, ignoring the rules entirely. The choice is yours!

name: The Basement Ritual
summary: The Basement Ritual is a short indie horror game where you have been kidnapped and must escape a cult’s basement premises solving puzzles and hiding from a demonic creature.

name: The Land of Fog
summary: Game type: turn based strategy action bar mode Rich plot, diverse skills, players play as several mercenaries, use strategies to challenge various levels, gradually unravel the fog of the Mist Continent, and complete their legends

name: The Fireseed Treaty
summary: The Fireseed Treaty is a sci-fi strategy adventure game, combining turn-based strategy gameplay with deck building, hexagonal grid moves, and survival elements, as well as a variety of randomized events, relic rewards, and hero training to constantly upgrade your strategy.

name: The Garden Gate Pai Sho
summary: The Garden Gate is a place to play fan-made Pai Sho, as seen in Avatar: The Last Airbender, as well as other board games.

name: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
summary: For a long time no one claimed the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal. The last one was the Champion of Cyrodiil at the ending days of the Third Era. But what happened after the Oblivion Crisis? Where is the Gray Cowl now? You're a thief and during stealing and pickpocketing items around the world, a vision appears in front of you. The Gray Cowl is calling. The big journey has started... Where will you go now? Many places are awaiting you. Legendary places, mysterious places, ancient places that needs to be cleaned up from the sands of time. The Gray Cowl wants you.

name: The Legend of Goose: The Honk Waker
summary: The Goose is Loose and ready to honk and spread chaos across Hyrule!

name: This is a Black Parallelepipedon in a Yellow Field
summary:
The enigma of the fields. Unknow a shape.

Consider the idea of a black storehouse in a yellow field. Charred walls. Painted walls. Walls smudged in black ash.
Maybe consider an unreal crop.
Or consider, observe, establish, evaluate an above-ground pool. Which would be an odd find, right here in the middle of a field, but then again, that structure in the middle distance has got to be something...

An absurd, alienating game developed as part of the Briefs series, a gold extra project with additional support by Strange Scaffold.

name: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
summary: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

name: The Amateur Deity Society
summary: An interactive fiction game with a point-and-click interface. Follows the members of an ostensible high-school computer club as they attempt to program a world-simulator.

name: The Death of Fo-gu
summary: The Death of Fo-gu is a short adventure game made for the 2024 $108 Adventure Game Challenge whose theme was: The Dunning-Kruger Effect.

name: The Mystery of the Art School
summary:
The Art School, a legendary institute deep inside the city of Toledo, a peaceful place until a promising pupil gets desappeared. Play as Willtif Smothson, a student of the Art School who gets involved into an adventure that will never forget.

Walk through the classes of the Art School, meet the students, and the teachers that makes this place unique. The Mystery of the Art School is based on the real Art School…

name: The Hundredth Hike
summary: The Hundredth Hike is an Indie Psychological Horror game, living the story of you, as a mountain hiker, reliving your tragic past and finding the calm of the nature under your boots. Unaware of what lies before you, you unleash a powerful and mysterious truth.

name: The End of an Obsession
summary:
You feel groggy when you finally wake up.

The back of your head is throbbing and your mouth feels dry, as though it has been stuffed full of wool.

With bleary eyes, you glance about.

What time is it?

Where are you…

And, perhaps more importantly, who are you?

Try though you might, you can’t remember.

This could very well be your end — but wait. Who is that woman standing by your bedside, who looks like a rose?

Perhaps she can help you.

Now, why don’t you open your heart up to her?

Learn how to love her, and perhaps this story might even have a happy ending.

name: The Punch Drunk Monk
summary: Your temple has been raided by a bloodthirsty gang and one monk has had enough! Play as Punch Drunk Monk and make your way back to your desecrated temple for a showdown with the leader! There are many different hazards throughout your quest for vengeance, as well as dangerous foes such as deadly warriors, evil sorcerers, and enraged spirits!

name: The Headmaster
summary: The headmaster is a dark comedy combining a nonlinear story, stats management and a unique punishment system.

name: The Uzujigoku Massacre
summary:
Takiyo Mochizuki is accepted into Heaven’s Bridge Boarding School, Japan’s most elite academy. Renowned for molding talented individuals into Ultimates - skilled professionals in their desired fields - Heaven’s Bridge accepts students between 10-20 in its pursuit of notable alumni destined to make their mark on Japanese history.

After an unfortunate tragedy forced the school into a temporary shutdown some years ago, it has now reopened, and intends to restart its prestigious legacy with its 21st class.

Unbeknownst to them, another tragedy is quickly approaching.

name: Thrice
summary: 5 rounds of brain gymnastics, each from a different category. 3 questions per round, all with the same answer. Guessing correctly earlier in each round will award more points.

name: The Traded Groom
summary: A short adult otome about an arranged marriage and the many forms your new relationship can take.

name: The Dawn Of Slenderman
summary:
The Dawn of Slenderman is a first-person horror survival game to find the required pages and to either avoid or kill Slenderman.

- Collect 8 pages to win
- 2 levels with day and night mode
- 4 levels to play
- Original realistic sounds
- Stunning 3D graphics
- Original Eight Pages made by JD Thunder

name: The Spire of Mech Zero
summary: A lite roguelike card deck building game inspired by Slay the Spire. You can experience battles of robots with cards and components! Try to conquer the spire with one perfect run, every choice matters!

name: The Overnight Watch
summary:
Welcome Subject/Employee to 'The Overnight Watch'. This experiment/exam will take a total of 5 business days to complete.

Your objective during this experiment/exam is to watch the cameras and report anything that you find out of the ordinary.

Each day you will be pushed even further by watching more rooms and having to keep an eye on the Power Containment Drive. Failure is NOT an option.

Do you 'IRIS SUBJECT NUMBER' wish to apply to 'The Overnight Watch'?

Please note:

IRIS will not take responsibility for a subject's death during this test.

name: The Abandoned House
summary: "The Abandoned House" is a 3D Horror game where you play as a ghost and your job is to help and guide the NPC Girl in escaping the house while also avoiding the hostile Monster that lurks in the shadows.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Horn of Balance
summary: A fangame inspired by A Link to the Past, which ultimately became an original IP, Horn of Balance.

name: The Devious Four Chronicles 8: Goddess Robes
The Adventure of Ninomae Ina'nis
summary: The Adventure of Ninomae Ina'nis is a vertical shoot 'em up game where you control Ninomae Ina'nis from Hololive Myth and her companion AO-chan.

name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+
summary: The Binding of Isaac Repentance+ is an update to The Binding of Isaac Repentance, adding in online multiplayer co-op and reworking otherwise poorly regarded items.

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Oswald
summary: This additional character ‘OSWALD’ is available in 'THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV' with this purchase

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Heidern
summary: Heidern commands the mercenary unit where Ralf and Clark belong. He fights using a combination of martial arts and self-taught assassination techniques. As a military officer, Heidern remains calm and silent, but can be over protective to his adopted daughter Leona.

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Blue Mary
summary: This additional character ‘BLUE MARY' is available in 'THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV' with this purchase.

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Najd
summary: Najd wears the Abaya (traditional Saudi garment) which has extraordinary powers, but remains humble. She lives a double life, a college student during the day, but at night, she turns into a vigilante to protect her fellow citizens from evil.

name: The Memory Thieves
summary: Immerse yourself in a unique cooperative multiplayer game for 1 to 4 players. Explore the graveyard of Ravenwood, pass through mysterious portals, and steal as much treasure as possible while avoiding the dangers.

name: The Sensational December Machine
summary: The Sensational December Machine is a short interactive story about an inventor and her unusual new creation. It features hand-drawn art and text, and dynamic music, which evolves with the story. It was created over three weeks, in December 2014.

name: The Laser Games
summary: The Laser Games is a casual/competitive shooter, embracing the thrill and experience from real laser tag. Jump in with friends, strangers, or alone, and explore the various maps and challenges as you zap your way to the top! Play it your way- unlock and equip customizations, or contribute to the workshop with your own maps and gametypes!

name: The Trials of Ozymandias
summary: The Trials of Ozymandias is a visual novel set in the high fantasy world of the kingdom of Johrotos. In the capitol city, Dassi, resides the most famous adventurer's guild in all the land: Talleh-Hoy. This is where your story begins.

name: That Which Surrounds
summary: Be who they need you to be, or convince them to let you go. A short story about love and loss.

name: Thunderbirds
summary:
Based on the live action film released in 2004 (which in turn was based on the 1960s series starring marionettes), Thunderbirds stars Alan, Tin-Tin, and Fermat, three children whose guardians are part of the International Rescue team. The player takes control of all three children as they go through training and are then forced to travel around the world to save members of International Rescue from an evil villain known as The Hood.

The game takes place in locales such as the International Rescue island, Africa, and even outer space. Each of the three characters has his or her own unique abilities that the player must use to solve puzzles and advance through a level. Alan has strength and jumping ability, Tin-Tin has telekinetic powers that are used to move objects, and Fermat can hack computers and roll through holes. While the majority of the gameplay is primarily composed of solving puzzles from an overhead view, there are also flight action sequences where the player can fly one of the many vehicles known as the Thunderbirds.

name: The Veil of the Forgotten
summary: A psychological challenge on a dark island where every step tests you. You are alone; the light is your only ally. Will you be able to withstand the pressure and uncover the secret behind the veil?

name: The Hallowed Garden
summary:
On the eve of Halloween, Lil Ghostie is hard at work on his pumpkin patch. But this isn’t your normal pumpkin patch, no, this is a magical pumpkin patch. With help from Mayor Macabre, Lil Ghostie is sure to have enough pumpkins in time for this year’s Halloween Festival!

This cute, cozy farming sim is the perfect game to play this Halloween. Whether you want to collect every pumpkin, want to leave it running as a BRB screen, or want to play it on your stream with your community, you are sure to get your Halloween vibe fill.

name: The Fire Rises
summary:
It is 2020. The world holds it’s breath as a newly discovered coronavirus disease spirals out of control, and spreads like wildfire worldwide. Economies plunge into another recession, societies further radicalize, and worst of all, political instability is on the rise. Surely nothing worse could happen, right?
With the collapse of Saudi Arabia into civil war, the Coronavirus Pandemic, and the nationwide riots against police brutality, at a scale worse than the 1992 LA riots, the United States of America is facing it’s darkest hour. It’s collapse is inevitable, and the world balance is at stake. With the death of the American Hegemony, her modern rivals eye their historic territories with an unfound vigor.

name: The Legacy of Lunatic Omsk
summary: This visual novel based on the events of the 15th installment of the Touhou Project, but the plot changes everything into Russian realities. Playing as Marisa Kirisame, you embark on a journey with one of your 3 friends: Reimu, Reisen or Sanae.

name: The Fairly OddParents: Big Superhero Wish
summary: Click through the pages of a living comic book and zap the villains back where they belong!

name: The Last Nurse Joy
summary: In Pokémon, when battles don’t swing in your favor or the journey becomes too grueling, the Nurse Joys and their peculiar machines are always there to ensure the game continues seamlessly. Transforming a Pokémon from a state of injury to complete stability might seem like sorcery. Yet, this magic is seldom questioned. But remember, even magic has its origins. There was a time when this miraculous machine was non-existent, and somewhere, a Nurse Joy was the last to receive it.

name: The Zium Exposition
summary:
The Zium Exposition is a Museum Exploration Game filled with artwork and installations from artists around the world, working in various mediums and styles.

High in the Zwitz Alps, visit the foundational Zwitzerland Okkozium; the historic central pavilion of The Grand Expo. Ride the Okkozium Exposition Ropeway through the vaulting tunnels of Mount Okkozium, arriving at The Archival Plateau, high above Zwitzerland. There, you will ride the Expo Elevator down towards The Okkozium where 45 artists have assembled to tell the story of The Zium Exposition.

name: The Japanese Calligraphy
summary: A Japanese Calligraphy Simulator Game! Not only can you practice writing with a brush following examples, but you can also practice writing hiragana and katakana! Self-scoring kanji tests! Grateful sutra copying! Let's study Japanese!

name: The Damn Psychiatric
summary: The "San Lucas" psychiatric hospital, which was built in 1985 to help people with mental illnesses, became the scene of crimes and suspicious experiments in the year 2035. Patients mysteriously disappeared and some were found found dead in a strange way.

name: The Fox Hare Disaster: Chapter One
summary: Prepare to explore an abandoned mall from the 90’s in this first-person, psychological horror! Tackle puzzles and come face to face with the haunting creatures that lurk inside. Will you be able to make it out alive, or will you suffer the same fate as those who came before you…?

name: The Acorn Bounty
summary: Help Samson the Squirrel battle his way through peril, as he tracks down what was ruthlessly stolen from him. Adventure through the forest battling your way through a variety of critters, unlocking cosmetic hats, completing the beastiary, and claiming what's rightfully yours.

name: The Pac-Man Brothers
summary: The Pac-Man Brothers is an unofficial sequel/reboot of the original Pac-Man games in the arcade. New things include procedurally generated levels, simultaneous multiplayer, a new dodge roll move, and more!

name: The Crown Saga: Pi’s Adventure
summary:
In an era when the Demon King reigned over all, lived a wolf girl named Pi.

But all of a sudden... She was chosen by the Crown?!

It shall now be Pi's destiny to become a legendary knight and save Natureland.

Will Pi be able to complete her quests and turn into a legendary knight so she can bring back peace...?

name: The Everlasting Lovestory at the Windcap
summary: I was abandoned by the world, and she was forgotten by time. Attracted by loneliness, we cling to each other because of misfortune. The happy fairy tale woven by the two eventually turned into a curse of despair.

name: The Cursed Ritual
summary: The Cursed Ritual is a horror genre FPS game about a person who gets stuck in the middle of the forest in midnight as his car crashes. With no signal in midnight he wanders through the forest finding a shelter to pass the night and finds an abandoned house. Explore the secrets of the haunted house.

name: The Glory of America
summary: The Glory of America is an action-packed game where you run through New York as Mr. President, armed and ready to fend off zombies. Complete various mini-missions, collect points, and enjoy stunning graphics, intelligent zombie AI, and a beautifully depicted New York City.

name: The Greatest Chef
summary: It is a rogue-like deck-building culinary competition simulator. Learn cooking tricks, collect various ingredients, come up with new recipes, and compete with other cooks for the right to be the Greatest Chef!

name: The Legend of Zelda: New Beginnings
The Kharzov Effect
summary: Welcome to The Kharzov Effect, an immersive first-person puzzle horror game. Explore Dr. Kharzov’s eerie estate as you unravel the mystery behind a series of abductions. Face terrifying creatures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the truth of Kharzov's dark history!

name: These Darker Tides
summary: Welcome [EMPLOYEE] to your new job protecting Deep Sea Cables from creatures of the deep. We're not liable for loss of limbs, sanity, or life while on the job. Don't forget to keep your desk clean and your eyes on those cameras!

name: The Broken Vow
summary: Unravel the mystery by finding notes, objects and memories hidden around the house. Find out what happened to Clark, escape Emma and escape — even if it takes strength.

name: The Super Pie Throwing
summary:
Princess Rosa is mad…. And her maids are gonna pay!!! After a tragic dessert mishap, everything falls apart.

The Super Pie Throwing is a slapstick action mini game where you throw pies, avoid weights, play red light green light, and all other sorts of things to earn HUGE POINTS!!! Try challenge mode for a variety of challenges and obstacles that change the core gameplay and push your skills! Or, if you want to just jump in for a quick match, try Time Attack and Score Attack!

30 unique challenges, various unlockables, funny faces, and more!!!

name: The Thaumaturge: Deluxe Edition
summary:
Step onto the culturally flourishing streets of Warsaw with an even more fashionable style in The Thaumaturge Digital Deluxe Edition.

To refine your look just as a gentleman should, you receive in-game content: an elegantly stylized hairstyle and facial hair, luxury clothes, and a HUD reskin.

But that's not all; the Deluxe Edition also includes downloadable content:
• Notes from the Grimoire to help you delve into the arcana of thaumaturgy
• A map of Warsaw in 1905 to familiarize yourself with the city
• The Thaumaturge digital soundtrack for your auditory pleasure
• A 3D printable model of the Golem salutor to guard your desk
• A set of wallpapers for an overall aesthetic boost

name: The Sunnylands
summary: The Sunnylands is a Keen 4 levelpack, though, it has a new story and a little bit of new graphics. Join Commander Keen, as he travels through Sunnylands, which has as many levels as the original Keen 4 (it even has a secret level) and the creatures he has previously encountered on Shadowlands!

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 2D
The Forgotten Nightmare
summary: Huge map featuring a cave system with a crypt beneath, a dungeon and some ruins; very high enemy count. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a custom skybox as well as a few new sounds.

name: The Glassworks
summary: Climb both sides of the glass to navigate your way through the glass works.

name: Thrillville: Off the Rails
summary: The Nintendo DS port of Thrillville: Off the Rails.

name: The Question's Quest of Sin
summary: TheQuestion's Quest of Sin is a game made in RPG Maker VX Ace, in which you follow Steam lover, TheQuestion619, on his mission to cop some Steam currency in order to purchase additional crate keys, as he is lacking.

name: The Gorge
summary: Large base themed map surrounded by cliffs and caves, an adaptation / conversion of the level "Mountain Gorge" from the game SiN (1998). Originally presented at the 20th anniversary QEXPO 2016

name: Third Iteration
summary: Medium sized blue runic / metal themed map remix based on rd1m2 from Runner's Delight, built on Progs Dump 3

name: The Legend of Cyber Cowboy
summary: Liberate a town from gangs of cybernetic bandits! The Legend of Cyber Cowboy is a top-down twin-stick shooter presented in slick pixel art style.

name: The Fine Art of Murder
summary:
Unravel the mystery, where every choice shapes your fate.
A supernatural gamebook brought to life, with multiple endings to discover. Fully accessible – with or without the screen.

name: The Hidden Ones
summary: The new 3D ARPG GAME based on the famous chinese anime IP: Hitori No Shita: The Outcast. The game will be alpha test soon and it plans to launch on PC, console and mobile platform.

name: The Home Into The Woods
summary: Trapped in the woods you have no idea who or what is there?

name: The Wheels of Lull
summary: Return to Sotha Sil and enter the stranger side of TES lore, as you join the ranks of the mysterious Chronographers in this fully voiced DLC sized quest mod that adds over 10 new quests, multiple new armors and weapons, sprawling dungeons, unique boss fights, and much much more!

name: The Yandere CEO
summary:
William, the CEO of the company you just joined, had always been a man of ambition and success. From a young age, he was driven to achieve greatness, and he had a singular focus on his goals. He rose to the top of his field, building a successful company from the ground up.

However, his relentless drive also came at a cost. He pushed away friends and family, sacrificing personal relationships for the sake of his ambition. He had no time for romance, believing it to be a distraction.

Until he met you...

but you will find out for yourself what happens next..

name: The Containment Centre
summary: Small base level; a remake of the first map of the game Viscerafest.

name: The Mobius: Apartment
summary: In a eerie apartment, explore and discover anomalies, find the rules,seeking the correct Floor and Exit of The Mobius Apartment.

name: The Legend of Zelda: King of Thieves
There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder
summary:
In this single-player spy thriller interactive novel, secret agents Franklin Benjamin and Virginia West take on a madman named Zeus who threatens the world with a weather machine.

You may find yourself needing to de-escalate a hostage situation, investigating a crime scene, or even defusing a ticking time bomb - good thing you always bring the thunder, agent!

name: The Righteous Scar
summary: When blades fall silent, and blood tells its tale, a scar remains—a mark not of rage, but of absolution. In The Righteous Scar, violence becomes virtue, and what’s buried beneath the skin reveals a truth only the damned can see.

name: The Mirror's Curse
summary:
The Mirror's Curse is a first-person puzzle solving mysterious action game. You’re trapped in a limbo — a twisted version of your own home.

To escape, you must solve intricate puzzles and evade spirits.

The mirrors are your greatest mystery and danger: while they reveal hidden clues, staring too long raises your curse level, triggering supernatural attacks.

name: The Ark Adult Game
summary: The Ark Adult Game is an immersive action-adventure title set in a futuristic universe. Explore, collect, and preserve various races and species as you navigate through perilous encounters.

name: The Witch of Fern Island: Spooky Witch Pack
summary: Spooky Witch Pack is a unique DLC for The Witch of Fern Island that will transport you into a world of dark mysteries and eerie adventures! Infuse your game with an atmosphere full of horror and magic. Feel a thrilling chill!

name: The Indirect Castle Retreat
summary: A third person exploration adventure game. Walk, run, and jump as you explore the castle. Pick up useful items to progress. Look at objects of interest to understand the history of the castle.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Unnamed Quest
The Legend of Zelda: Netherforce Shards
The Useless App
summary: This app is useless, so don't download it.

name: The Wizard Gnome Quest
summary:
The Wizard Gnome have to cross the forest to find the Druids to buy some ingredients for his next potion, help him to dodge the dangers with your magical SPACE BAR and your spell SHIFT

You can play the game here : https://guigotsu.com/gnome/

name: The Supernatural Power Troll
summary:
The Supernatural Power Troll is a puzzle platformer in which you control a troll that can grant humans superpowers. By doing so, the troll overcomes obstacles and solves puzzles.
The game features diverse NPCs with AI generated dialogs, a level editor,

name: The Adventures Of Captain J
summary: What do you get when you cross classic arcade action with a Dashing Space Hero? You get the newest release for the 3DO, The Adventures Of Captain J! Guide the Captain through multiple levels of fast, hard-hitting action that will put your reflexes to the test! The fate of the universe is in your hands with the legend of the sky, Captain J!

name: The Strange City
summary: Embark on the adventure as Agent G, a lone survivor drawn into a mystery after a brutal car crash. Pursued by relentless monsters and trapped in eerie, shifting environments, you’ll need courage and wit to survive. Can you uncover the secrets at the journey's end—or will the shadows claim you first?

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Classic Iori Costume
summary: A new costume for 'THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV' appears! Unlock it to play as Classic Iori in the costume he used from KOF '95 to KOF XI.

name: There Exists Nobody
summary: You arrive at a deserted street that feels familiar yet is filled with unease. Pick up your camera, capture the hidden anomalies, and break this endless loop.

name: The Liar's Tavern
summary: Outwit, deceive, survive—where every lie could be your last.

name: The Betweenlands
summary: Mori is stuck on the Core, miles below the beautiful Surface. She must use her trusty grappling hook to traverse the Betweenlands, clusters of floating islands hovering between the Core and the Surface. Explore and climb unique skyscapes to discover Mori's true desires in this precision platformer.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Chaos Rising
Thundercade
summary: The NES port of Thundercade. A nuclear powerplant has fallen into the hands of terrorists and you pilot a motorcyle equipped with machine guns that can be improved along the way. Make your way through difficult terrain and battle against loads of terrorists on foot, in cars, tanks and submarines who will try to stop you. Reach the plant and shoot all the terrorists to save the day.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Time Crystal
The Black Maple Anomaly
summary: Another Anomaly, Another Mission. It's your job to work your way down the floors of the Black Maple Motel, Keep track of the anomalies, and reach the Lobby to try and safely close the Anomaly that has enveloped the building.

name: The Epyx Games: Sports Collection
summary: Relive over 50 different athletic and sporting events across eight of Epyx's retro classics in this remastered collection.

name: Throne of Valoria
summary: An epic 2.5D RPG adventure with metroidvania elements and unique artstyle. A compelling story with challenging bosses and fluid combat, all in an immersive environment

name: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Aurelia
This War of Mine: Forget Celebrations
summary:
This is a charity initiative. All proceeds go to our partners: War Child, Amnesty International, Liberty Ukraine, and Indie Games Poland Foundation.

10 years have passed since the release of This War of Mine and the game’s message still remains poignant. In October 2024, the game was awarded a Special Recognition Award by Amnesty International. Sadly, the same award shows that the world hasn’t become a more peaceful place since the game launched in 2014. So instead of a big celebration, we’ve decided to dedicate this anniversary to doing the right thing. This War of Mine: Forget Celebrations is a DLC with a new story, special items, and, most importantly, a chance to support people in need.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Secrets
The Dreamer
summary: The Dreamer is a top down shooter where you, the player, engage in a psychedelic dream version of New York City. This game is short and contains two separate endings. See if you can complete them both. NPCs can help you with hints to that days quest. Created by Hunter Brown and Josie Coulter.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Shattered Dimensions
The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Secrets
The Legend of Peach: Insert Random Title There
The Legend of Zelda: Chiming Bells
summary: Join Link and Chia in their adventure to stop Rodrick in the only steam punk inspired Zelda fangame created!

name: The Legend of Zelda: Threads of Despair
The Legend of Zelda: Time Walker
The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords Online
The Legend of Zelda: Mask of the Gods
The Adventures of Zomboy
summary: A bite sized post apocalyptic point and click adventure game, where you play as a passive zombie.

name: The Gate
summary: The Gate uniquely combines Real Time Strategy (RTS) and Card Collecting Game (CCG) mechanics. Battles are rendered in hand animated 3D while collectable cards are presented as beautifully illustrated artistic masterpieces. Solo battles provide a chance to strengthen your army, while Raids, Arena Battles, and World Bosses get your friends in on fight.

name: The Spearman
summary:
The spear is a throwing, piercing or piercing-chopping polearm weapon.
With the help of a spear, a warrior will be able to effectively counter a lot of enemies.
Control the Stickman to throw spears at other stickmans. You will be confronted by many enemies: archers, javelin throwers, armored swordsmen and even magicians.

Simply drag and drop your finger for targeting and throwing.
The power of throwing a spear is always the same, so you only need to aim and specify the direction of the throw.
Enemies die from one hit of a spear in the head and body or from two hits of the spear in the legs.

In the game there is a store with helmets, several defensive skills and an apple for healing.

name: The Legend of Zelda: The Shadowgazer
summary:
Close your eyes and step into a shadowy other Hyrule, a dream-like realm blighted by the Maren - ancient evil spirits that cause nightmares. Conquer your darkest fears and rid the kingdom of its bad dreams to unravel the mystery of the Maren's curse.

The Legend of Zelda: The Shadowgazer is a fan game being developed in Game Maker by King Mob, and features:

Two parallel versions of the game world: the everyday waking world, and its nightmarish counterpart, unseen by all except those trained to use the Shadowgazer - a magical totem that protects the bearer from the nightmare realm's maddening effects;

A rotating three-day schedule, governed by the comings and goings of the ships in the port town of Hyrule. Record valuable information regarding the nightmares of the passengers and crew in your Cabin Boy's Handbook.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Specter's Oculus
The Legend of Zelda: Hall of the Dead
The Man Outside
summary: A short, gameboy-like game based on one of the developer's dreams.

name: The King of Fighters XV: Omega Rugal
summary:
Free DLC Character OMEGA RUGAL joins, THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV!

This dark arms merchant of death once ruled the world’s black market, and was never shy about digging his fangs into any fighter that dared challenge him. Through the power of Orochi, he was given life once again, until a group of fierce fighters brought his reign to an end. Now, due to Verse’s influence, he’s returned to the mortal realm to extract vengeance.

name: The Forbidden Flask
summary: In a kingdom that has outlawed potion making, an herbalist turned brew-master continues to sell potions on the underground market from the back of their tavern. Serve both ale and potions to customers, but don't get caught selling potions when the guards make their rounds!

name: The Misfits
summary: The Misfits is a Medieval Fantasy RPG, heavily influenced by narrative, with turn-based combat where the relationships between party members will affect their entire development. Guide The Misfits on their journey in search of purpose.

name: The Rangers in the South
summary: Purge the lands in this 2.5D HD-2D Pixelart RogueLike ARPG! Create hundreds of characters with unique strategies and abilities, face hordes of enemies, explore different biomes, procedurally generated dungeons, and obtain unique items!

name: They Follow You
summary: Use a ship to explore and a hive-mind to take out enemies. A post-apocalyptic, adventure horror game, you must explore a ruined earth with your ship (equipped with a beam and light) and find lairs to take out simplified humans known as Simples.

name: The Essence of Luna
summary: When an unsuspecting person named Saruky learns about the terrible events that could take place in the future, He makes it his mission to try and stop it from happening.

name: The Notzing Project
summary: Deep underground, a government science facility lies dormant and abandoned. But when a man wakes up from being held in stasis, he must face whatever technological horrors caused the facility to shut itself off from the surface, and make it out alive. In this first person exploration game, you will find audio cassettes left by the scientists who once operated the establishment. Use the clues you can find to get out alive.

name: The Maker of Masks
summary: A short horror story for the PS1 Horror Jam.

name: The Disciples of the Full Moon
summary: The Disciples of the Full Moon is a retro survival horror made for the Reload Magazine Game Jam #1.

name: The Alliance Alive HD Remastered: Awakening Edition
summary: Physical version with Nine "Night Ravens" Cutout paper dolls

name: The Adventure Remastered
summary:
The Adventure Remastered is a re-imagining of an unreleased episode titled: "The Adventure"
This episode includes 24 main levels and 4 worlds. 4 of the levels in each world stick to the style of either SMB1, SMB2, SMB3, or SMW. The remaining levels use a mixture of all of the styles.

name: The Gentleman's Gold
summary: When the sunken treasure beckons from deep below, will you answer the call? Follow the trail to the gold of the Gentleman.

name: The Coal Room
summary: A short, first person puzzle game taking place at your new job working for Business Incorporated International. Learn the ropes of burning coal in this 5 minute narrative adventure.

name: The Golem Maker
summary: A short vignette set after The Crystal Golem. Explore a little town and meet its inhabitants. Learn and build something together.

name: The Chain to Bind You to Earth
summary: You get a call from your Grandma to go visit your uncle in a forgotten town. Chop wood, wash socks, and enter the cosmic void. Created in 30 days for the Haunted PS1 2020 Halloween Jam with a Folk Horror Theme.

name: The Happenings At Bowers End
summary: The people of Bowers End have been plagued by a series of targeted kidnappings. It has become a local rumour that the victims had entered the woods and they have not been seen since. Inspired by the folklore of England's Jenny Greenteeth.

name: The New Adventures of Zak McKracken
The Helping Hand Paradox
summary: "The Helping Hand Paradox" is a short horror-puzzle randomize game that has many ways to solve the main puzzle and 2 endings. It was made for the 48-hours "Haunted PS1 Wretched Weekend 1" jam.

name: The Last Utopi
summary: Years ago, after the alien plant spores ravaged the Earth, we piled onto spaceships and left. A new planet. A new culture. A new beginning. But when Eli Mason, the enigmatic founder and CEO of The Colony, asks you to travel back to Earth to find out exactly how the alien invasion began, you have a duty to go. It's time to go back to Utopi, the Swedish furniture store where the spores began to spread. You don't know what's left of your world. You don't know what you might find. But it's calling you.

name: The Hunt Begins
summary:
