In The Hunt Begins, you and up to four friends go to a haunted location to identify and eradicate a ghost. On arrival at the location, the game will select one of the players to control the ghost and protect their haunt.

Hunt the Ghost:
You and up to 3 friends must work together to locate the ghost players chosen haunted area. Use multiple tools to identify the type of ghost and use the correct method to banish them. Be careful though, the ghost does not like trespassers and if enraged will take lives.

Hunt the Hunters:
Your friends have come to purge your existence as you control ghosts that haunt various locations. Prevent them from finding your chosen haunted area and from figuring out how to destroy you. Use your abilities and interact with the maps to frighten your friends and get closer to hunting them down.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Sage Knight
Thingio Side A: Let's Go! Thingio!
Thingio Side B: The Grand Illusion
The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Secrets
The TET Offensive
summary: You are a Viet Cong during the Tet Offensive, a massive surprise attack that changed the course of the Vietnam War. Your objective is to take the American's Base, you can stealth your way by digging tunnels and avoiding detection, or release all bullets from your AK-47 into the enemy, the way you conquer the Base is your choice, but remember... there are consequences.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Waves of Time
The Child Of Slendrina
summary:
Slendrina is back in a new scary game!

The Child Of Slendrina is the sixth game in Slendrina Series. It gives Slendrina's Child and Slendrina's Father a role as an antagonist. It was released on April 1st, 2016, exclusive for Android devices only.

name: The Protocol Directive
summary:
Dive into the dark world of The Protocol Directive, a unique text-based adventure that blends retro charm with modern suspense. As a nameless protagonist, you begin in an ordinary office, but what seems like a normal day quickly turns into a nightmare full of decisions, secrets, and deadly challenges.

After leaving the office, you suddenly find yourself in a dark room. A light flickers on, illuminating a table with an old keyboard. Shortly after, a PC screen comes to life, and a strange force the possessed Protocol begins testing you. Every decision you make can mean the difference between life and death. Find useful (or deceptive) items, solve tricky dilemmas, and try to escape the game alive.

But nothing is as it seems. The deeper you venture into the world of the Protocol, the more reality and dream begin to blur. Is this just a cruel experiment, or are you trapped in a nightmare? Can you unravel the truth before it’s too late?

Are you ready to face the ultimate test? Choose wisely your fate is in your hands.

name: The War of the Worlds: Siberia
summary:
The year is 1896. The Martian invasion wipes cities and entire civilizations out of existence. Separated from his loved ones, a young student escapes the capital city already conquered by the aliens.
Along with the player, he will have to survive in the distinctive and dangerous Siberia, stand against the forces of the old world, and inevitably confront its new masters.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Shadow Mirror
The Legend of Zelda: The Hylian Frontier
The Legend of Zelda: Guardians of Hyrule
The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening Coop
The Legend of Zelda: The Hylian Phoenix
That's My Exploit Keeper!
summary:
Exploit Keeper is a puzzle game, where you have to change the version of the game between the well developed one and the poorly developed one, to find the game bugs and exploit them to be able to continue the plot.
Badly programmed mechanics might be useful if used in the right place...

Between features that work poorly, repeating events and unindexed values, you will find every kind of nightmarish bug for beta testers!

name: The Pocket Master
summary:
As the Pocket Master, you job is to help people in need.

Use your magical pocket to change objects size and please everyone!

Pocket everything! Objects, people, entire rooms... The pocket world has no limit.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Just Beginning
The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Life Online
The Escape Room Chronicles ep1: The Mysterious KumaDonald's
summary:
Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery!
Episode 1: Escape from the Mysterious KumaDonald's!

name: The Escape Room Chronicles ep2: The Old School Building
summary:
Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery!
Episode 2: Escape from The Old School Building!

name: The Escape Room Chronicles ep3: The Southern Resort
summary:
Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery!
Episode 3: Escape from The Southern Resort!

name: The Escape Room Chronicles ep 4: The 24-Hour TV Station
summary:
Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery!
Episode 4: Escape from the TV station!

name: The Shell Part III: Paradiso
summary:
This version is the censored Steam release of "The Shell Part III: Paradiso".

The coiling chains of obsession that began with The Shell now threaten to strangle Detective Reiji Tokisaka in the third and final entry in the trilogy. As old friends and foes rise up for one last confrontation, can anyone break the cycle—and can Reiji's heart ever be set free?

name: The King of Dragons
summary: SNES Port of the arcade game with the same name. Changes it was given includes reducing the number of simultaneous players down to two, reducing the sizes of the in game sprites moderately, and it being possible to assign the magic attack and shield defense to different buttons.

name: The Sheriff
summary: A dynamic hide-and-seek for two players. The Sheriff must find and kill the outlaw before all villagers die. Each round see different powers applied to each player to make each game unique. Pay attention to your back!

name: The Worm's Memoirs
summary: The Worm’s Memoirs is a 2D point-and-click narrative game about childhood trauma and what lies beyond it. Follows the Worm as they go through their normal routine of tending a house and uncover their story by traversing between the two parallel worlds of fear and euphoria.

name: The Infernal Mist
summary: Descend into the Infernal Mist. A MistCrawler Roguelite where you explore, and Hack and Slash your way through the Mist, while surviving the encroaching darkness. Collect Souls of the Mist, unlock god-like powers and weapons, challenge the merciless wardens, and face the King of the Mist.

name: Thing & Fist
summary: Team up with a friend and play as either the artful wizard Thing or the stalwart golem Fist to pull off the heist of the century in this couch co-op top-down brawler!

name: The Final Act
summary: The Final Act is a mix of visual novel and puzzle game where you assist writer Rebecca Carter in overcoming her writer's block by crafting the perfect murder plot for her novel. Solve intricate puzzles, adjust crime scenes, and navigate immersive storytelling to uncover the perfect crime.

name: The Fallen Kingdom
summary: The kingdom is at war and you are the wizard who can save it! Get ready for a 2D isometric journey with spells, combat, bosses, an incredible soundtrack that accompanies the simple, yet epic story!

name: The Duchess Curse
summary: As a security guard tasked with a simple job in a long-abandoned mansion, you quickly find yourself trapped within its haunted walls. Dark secrets unravel as you uncover the tragic tale of the Duchess, who, in a desperate attempt to resurrect her daughter, summoned something far more sinister.

name: Through the Backrooms
summary: You as Ethan, a robber who wants to end his criminal past. Suddenly you fall in the Backrooms and now you have to solve the mystery of the liminal rooms to find a way out. But you are not alone here...

name: The Great Sperm Race
summary:
"The Great Sperm Race" is an web browser game that takes you on a unique and educational journey through the world of reproduction. In this game, you play the role of a sperm cell on a mission to fertilize an egg and create life.

The gameplay revolves around navigating through a challenging and obstacle-filled environment, mimicking the journey of a sperm cell in the female reproductive system. You'll encounter various obstacles such as acidic environments, immune cells, and other competing sperm cells. Your goal is to swim against the odds, avoid dangers, and be the first to reach the egg.

name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Child of Destiny Youngho
summary: Change Youngho's outfit with this fancy add-on!

name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Gamer Youngho
summary:
Meet Youngho! This guy spends all of his time outside of school hours gaming!

By purchasing this cosmetic DLC "The Gamer Skin" you receive the costume visible on the screenshot.

name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Survivalist Youngho
summary: What about Youngho? He's watched too many books and videos about survival and the wilderness.

name: The Finals: Season 5 - Next Stage
summary:
Season 5 is the current and the fifth season of THE FINALS. It launched on December 12, 2024, and is expected to end on March 20, 2025.

This season is sponsored by VAIIYA, DISSUN and the returning sponsor ISEUL-T, who introduced the all-new arena Bernal.

New content introduced in Season 5 includes:
- Arena: Bernal
- New cosmetics
- New Battle Pass
- Weapons: Cerberus 12GA, ShAK-50
- Gadgets: Gravity Vortex, Lockbolt Launcher
- New weapon sights
- Clubs
- Progression: new sponsorships, new career levels

name: The Bewildering Basilica of the Bishop of Bobtown
summary: A deckbuilding, tactical roguelike focusing on controlling the battlefield and getting your units close enough to the enemy commander to kill them while defending your own leaders. Summon units and wield skills to protect them to defeat your foes!

name: The StoryTeller
summary: An unreleased video game based around the anthology series of the same name.

name: The Permanent Residence: Souls Kept
summary:
The Permanent Residence pulls you into the unsettling world of an isolated bungalow shrouded in mystery and dread. You step into the shoes of a traveling musician, stranded after your shows are suddenly canceled. Desperate and tempted by a 50% discount, you take up an offer to stay in this strange house, blissfully unaware of the horrors that await.

The once-quiet halls now hum with whispers, and the walls seem to hide secrets aching to be uncovered. As you piece together strange clues, the bungalow’s chilling history unfolds—a past filled with rituals, vanishings, and a dark presence that refuses to let go. Soon, you realize that walking out the door might not be as simple as walking in.

name: The Eldritch Monarch
summary: "The Eldritch Monarch" is a single-player adventure game designed for the Sega Mega Drive/Genesis and modern systems. Step into a Lovecraftian world shrouded in eternal winter. "The Eldritch Monarch" is a cinematic platformer enriched with stealth, combat, and intricate puzzles, providing both a nostalgic and modern gaming experience.

name: The Shattered Veil
summary: The Wraith Army rises again, and it falls to Kael to wear the Crown and lead his people to victory once more. After spending the last decade preparing for Coronation Day with the help of his sister, Elara, they will soon discover that the Wraith Army is much closer than they had anticipated.

name: The Worries of Santa Clauses
summary: They are somehow arrested when the police find them.

name: The Inheritance of Crimson Manor: Victorian Edition
summary:
Victorian Edition – The Inheritance of Crimson Manor
Delve deeper into the eerie and enigmatic world of The Inheritance of Crimson Manor with the Victorian Edition Bundle, an essential collection for fans of gothic mystery and suspense.

This bundle includes:

️ Penny Dreadful DLC – Discover a new chapter in the Crimson Manor universe with an official illustrated story, inspired by the Penny Dreadfuls of the 1890s. This visual tale unveils events that preceded the main story, revealing secrets of the mansion’s past and enhancing your understanding of its sinister legacy. (Installed as a PDF in the game directory: DLC/PennyDreadful/)

Original Soundtrack – Immerse yourself in the haunting ambiance of Crimson Manor with a meticulously crafted soundtrack by Daniel Alvarez Veroy. Each track captures the dark, unsettling, and mysterious essence of the mansion, drawing you further into its foreboding world.

Expand your journey into the mystery of Crimson Manor—if you dare.

name: The Plucky Squire: Deluxe Edition
summary:
The Plucky Squire - Deluxe Edition contains:
- The Plucky Squire
- The Plucky Squire - Soundtrack
- The Plucky Squire - Digital Art Book

name: The Legend of Shiande
summary: An old-school, extremely challenging game that combines RPG, adventure, and puzzle elements. Designed to test the skills and determination of players who thrive on tough challenges.

name: The Headliners
summary: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 4 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

name: The Twins
summary: The Twins is a game made by DVloper, released on November 19th, 2020 for both Android and iOS.

name: Three Kingdoms Heroes
summary: Clash in a battle of wits and chess-like strategy, and create your unique team from a myriad of famous generals from Koei Tecmo's “Romance of the Three Kingdoms” IP.

name: The Short Bread Game
summary: A cozy platformer where you help a piece of bread get to the bakery for breakfast. Though your path there may not be the most direct, you'll get to explore charming places. Jump high, run from enemies, and engage in witty dialogue with your odd new friend.

name: The Queen of Battlers 2
summary:
The Queen of Battlers 2 is a 2016 crossover fighting game by doujin circle Capricorn. It parodies the "King of Fighters" series and features a cast made up of female characters from various visual novels. It is the sequel to the 2012 game The Queen of Battlers.
Characters are organized into teams, representing the following games: ONE (Tactics), Kanon (Key), AIR (Key), Clannad (Key), Little Busters! (Key), Tayutama (Lump of Sugar), SHUFFLE! (Navel), Really? Really! (Navel), and Tick! Tack! (Navel). The characters Kanna (from AIR), and Saber (from Fate/stay night) are also featured as individual characters who are not part of any team. Secret characters include Saber Alter and an alternative version of Sakura Yae.

name: The Talos Principle: Reawakened
summary: Step back into a world of thought-provoking puzzles, philosophical intrigue, and breathtaking visuals with The Talos Principle: Reawakened - a first-person puzzle masterpiece for both new players and long-time fans alike.

name: The Irony
summary: You are a nameless mercenary, dispatched to the research facility 'UNDERDOG CORP.' Survive the horrors of this dangerous facility, twisted by human experimentation, and uncover the hidden secrets within before they consume you.

name: The Fairly OddParents: Fairies of Fury
summary: Timmy's latest wish is that life be more like his favorite video game, and Cosmo and Wanda have obliged. Has Timmy gotten more than he bargained for with yet another wish gone awry? Can Dimmsdale weather this strange storm? The time has come to find out!

name: There's No Dragon!
summary: Alone on a plot of land with a few resources and a single building, your civilization will begin here. Exploit resources, explore and conquer other regions, develop technologies, and fend off relentless barbarian attacks. Everything is manageable: they don't have a dragon!

name: The Journey to Life
summary: The dead are imprisoned in a cage, while the living are confined to the past. A mysterious small town, where the cycle of cause and effect is hard to find its end In the end, how should we make a decision and who can survive

name: The Anchorite
summary: A short point & click mystery/horror.

name: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride: Special Edition - Timon And Pumbaa’s Virtual Safari 2.0: Prideland Pachiderm Safari
The Lion King 1½ - Timon And Pumbaa’s Virtual Safari 1.5: The Lion King Prideland Adventure
The Lion King: Platinum Edition - Timon And Pumbaa’s Virtual Safari Jeep Tour
The Lion King: Platinum Edition - Timon And Pumbaa’s Virtual Safari Boat Tour
The Super Mario Bros. Super Show: Mario's Greatest Movie Moments - Quiz Game
The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body
summary: "Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?" This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient tomb! As Kofun, interact with all sorts of characters and objects. Gain points and spend them on new skills and hints to show Kofun a world of new experiences!

name: The Passive Voice
summary: The Passive Voice is a short, interactive visual poem and a video game that explores the struggle of my own lived experience with dyslexia and dyspraxia. The main player character is a bouncing eyeball. It acts as a clumsy and voiceless avatar that progresses through and around an ancient woodland representing a dark night of the soul, reminiscing, though stylised cutscenes, about difficult past traumas and the often-overlooked difficulties that neurodivergent people face daily.

name: The Mystery Mist
summary: In this world, deadly toxic mist is everywhere. The protagonist, Yaqing, becomes an apprentice to a physician skilled in using insects to save his sister, who has been poisoned by the mist. As the story progresses, he finds himself entangled in a tense racial conflict…

name: The Burton Equation
summary: Time is an equation, and you're here to solve it. 1920s Chicago detective Zachary Burton must defeat the Combine's attempts to influence humanity's past in the 20s, 40s, and 80s, and then achieve victory in the present - all the while pursued by a dark mirror of himself.

name: The Magical Advenenture of Soggy Hoggy
The Dark Queen of Mortholme
summary:
You are the Dark Queen—the most powerful being of your entire universe. Your lair is breached by an aspiring hero—a pitiful thing, easily crushed.

Except they keep coming back.

A 20 minute anti-game about an unconventional relationship and the capacity for change.

name: The Bitmap Brothers Collection 2
summary: The Bitmap Brothers Collection 2 for Evercade brings together five home computer classics from the self-appointed “rock stars” of the British game development scene, including Cadaver and its expansion The Payoff, Gods, Magic Pockets and The Chaos Engine 2, plus the 32-bit home console version of real-time strategy classic Z!

name: The Cabin Factory
summary: Your job at the Cabin Factory is simple: inspect the cabins and decide on whether they’re haunted or not. If you do find any anomalies, get out…immediately.

name: The Old Barn
summary: The Old Barn is a short, 10-minute narrative experience in the walking simulator genre. Explore a cosy, messy, and warm old barn and listen to the musings of the narrator as she recalls growing up in this environment. Relax while you navigate this highly detailed environment, listening to the soothing voice inviting to calm reflection and pondering of life's learnings and mysteries. Take your time and see if you can spot any secret objects hiding in the clutter -- examining them from up close might reward you with a display of light. Can you spot all seven of them?

name: The Box
summary: You just started your new job at which you have to break boxes. What could possibly go wrong.

name: The Case of the Worst Day Ever
summary:
A family is gathered for a cozy celebration, but everyone looks miserable! What happened here? Who are these people (and pets)?! And why are they so unhappy?!?

Revisit each family member's worst moment, deduce what happened, and cheer everyone up in this cozy fill-in-the-blank mystery!

name: This House Eats People
summary: THIS HOUSE EATS PEOPLE is a short psx horror game where the player uses a Polaroid camera to take photos of an abandoned farmhouse. The game was created and submitted for the GMTK Game Jam 2024.

name: The Spirit Guide
summary: Play as the titular Spiritguide Ale in this beautiful top down 2D pixel art RPG. It's the night of the day of the dead festival, and families both celebrate and mourn their loved ones. You must take their gifts, and good memories and deliver it to the Spirits, so they may never forget who they are.

name: The Zombie Survival Guide
summary: this is a 2D side scrolling real-time combat game Players can use AD to control characters' walking, space to jumping, and E-key interaction to explore the world, complete attack commands through the mouse, and use all the weapons provided in the story to resist zombies.

name: The Underworld of Brain Damage
summary: Players can't attack. Players need to avoid attacks in the game and lead monsters' attacks to other monsters. Let the monster kill himself! ! ! The game map is random, the elements in the map are random, and there are many strange props, so that players have different game experiences every time.

name: The Vast White
summary: Explore an old mountain at your pace in this openworld snowboarding adventure. Uncover hidden paths, experience dynamic weather, and explore stunning landscapes as you ride. Every path holds new secrets.

name: The Ouroboros Express
summary: Play as Vivienne Sanssouci, a daring journalist who has been tasked to review the Ouroboros Express. She quickly notices that this is not your regular train—and a devastating secret changes her life forever, and that of the other passengers…

name: The Accuser and the Abyss
summary: You are a detective. You have been assigned a partner to investigate a horrid case. But things are not what it seems. Navigate the paths as you attempt to unravel the truth behind your lost memories and your new disturbing detective partner.

name: The Scouring
summary: The Scouring is an RTS with fast pace, high attention to detail and next generation experience. Lead humans or orcs to fight for victory! Play alone or with friends. Use modding tools to create custom game modes! Join The battle!

name: The Grandma from Coco in Sonic 1
summary: This hack replaces Sonic with Abuelita (the grandmother from Pixar's Coco) and is intentionally designed as a joke.

name: The Loveland Frog
summary:
A Myth, or A Legend?

Once a media cycle, the Loveland Frog cryptid makes their appearance to a select few. Though they may be three feet tall, an unusual size for a frog, they are truly a friendly character. However, people find the Frog menacing, and do not understand them. They run away from the Frog, and occasionally attempt to attack them in misguided fear...

It has been three years since the Loveland Frog was last seen, and tonight they have decided to shake things up. They wish to go for a stroll across a busy highway, where many people will be able to see that they really exist. However, due to their isolation from human culture, they do not understand "vehicles", and so do not know the danger they represent...

name: The Mysterious Thief: Forget Me Not
summary: A story-rich, girl's love visual novel about phantom thieves.

name: The Wide Open Sky Is Running Out of Catfish
summary: A story-driven photography game... on the back of a giant, flying catfish. Transform clouds into sea creatures and bring abundance back to an empty sky.

name: The Succession of Changing Kings
summary: A turn-based kingdom management simulator, with an emphasis on decision making. Will you survive and lead the kingdom to prosperity or die in obscurity? The throne awaits you.

name: The Patient: Can You Escape?
summary: The Patient is a tense first-person escape game set in an atmospheric 1930s German sanatorium with subtle horror Elements. Explore the mysterious location, solve cunning puzzles, and hide from the doctor using a refined stealth system, while uncovering the disturbing truth about yourself and this eerie place.

name: The Fisherman: A Codfish Tale
summary: Set in 1942 during World War II, experience the challenges and homesickness faced by the sailors as they navigate the Greenland Seas to fish cod. Immerse yourself in an emotional narrative with dialogues in authentic old Portuguese slang and fulfill the duties of a traditional fisherman as you unravel the tragic fate of the ship.

name: The Noexistencen of You and Me
summary: Use "game" as a medium to showcase the world of "you/girl". Explore the truth of "you/girl/world" through the form of a "visual novel".

name: The Ghost That Lives Inside My Piano
summary: Can a narrative be haunted by an object? Mine may be.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Sands of Time
summary: Zelda: Sands of Time is a ROM hack of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (64). It features new worlds, power ups, enemies, story, quality of life improvements and more.

name: The Seven Elemental Vases
summary: The kingdom of gods and humans have separated, you will be the protagonist of all its consequences. With a lot of levels, characters, creatures, history and more in a 2D Pixel art style.

name: The Battle for Christmas
summary: The Battle for Christmas is a festive platformer where you play as Santa, battling goblins who stole Christmas presents. Explore 30 levels, face 3 epic bosses, and enjoy charming graphics in this fun adventure to save the holiday season!

name: The Devil's Bride
summary: Run from The Devil’s Bride, where you must outwit and escape from the clutch of the Devil’s Bride to save your niece, Nina. Solve challenging puzzles while hiding from the relentless Devil’s Bride in the world of Indonesian cult horror experience.

name: The Crossroads
summary: Serve customers and guide their stories to their best, or worse, endings. Help resolve their conflicts with a chat and a drink!

name: The Tunnels
summary: A simple top-down 2D video game with elements of mining, exploring and upgrading your vehicle.

name: The Nine Rebirths
summary: This is a 2D platform decryption adventure game about a cat rescuing its owner. The underworld is full of organs and challenges, can you use the cat's connection between "soul" and "body" to complete this adventure full of dangers and difficulties? Download and play "Back to Life Nine Lives"!

name: Thrift Store Simulator
summary: Thrift Store Simulator, you own and operate a second-hand store in a bustling city. Customers will bring a variety of items to your shop, and it’s your job to negotiate the best prices. With over 150+ unique items, each with its own bargaining value, every negotiation is a new challenge.

name: The Tavern Tales: Medieval Simulator
summary: The Tavern Tales is a first-person medieval simulator! Start with an inherited tavern and turn it into a thriving business. Serve customers acquire titles, upgrade your tavern, and expand your holdings. Explore opportunities, open new businesses, engage in politics, and interact with town residents.

name: The Finals: Season 4 - It's Showtime!
summary:
Season 4 was the fourth season of THE FINALS. It launched on September 26, 2024, and ended on December 12, 2024. It was revealed on September 12, 2024, and previewed on September 20, 2024, at TwitchCon San Diego.

Season 4 puts particular focus on the sponsors of THE FINALS and the game show environment itself, with sponsors featured heavily in the season's arena and new progression paths.

This season was sponsored by HOLTOW, ENGIMO, and ISEUL-T, who introduced the all-new arena Fortune Stadium and the new sponsor career.

New content introduced in Season 4 includes:
- Arena: Fortune Stadium
- New cosmetics
- New Battle Pass
- Weapons: M26 Matter, Pike-556, .50 Akimbo
- Weapon sights
- Enhanced World Tour
- Progression: Sponsorships, new career levels

Season 4 reintroduced:
- Ranked Cashout tournaments

name: The Nutshack But It's A Game
summary:
Nutshack But Its a Game SHOULD explain everything you need to know, but I guess there's some confusion or something. To elaborate: The opening sequence to the """"""hit"""""" animated Myx television series The Nutshack will play, but EVERY instance of the word "Nutshack" spoken in the opening sequence is replaced with the next level (yes, even when the white guy says it). This means there is a level for every "Nutshack", and they say "Nutshack" a lot.

The game itself is a platformer, played in the first-person perspective. Can you run, crouch, jump, and stumble your way to the end(s)? Yeah, that's right. There's multiple endings; a Nut Ending, a Shack Ending, and a It's The Ending (which is the game over screen, which you won't miss). There's also secrets and shit, so good luck with that.

Featuring fan-favorites like Phil from the Frisco, Tito "Dickman" Dick, King Dedede, Robbie Rotten, and MAYBE Mr. Rental, and more (I think). There's also a soundtrack comprised mostly of stolen music and high-quality rips (glorified stolen music), but there's also original (partially stolen) music created just for the game, as well as some fan-favorites from Christmas Satellite. Legends say that the theme song to the show The Nutshack also makes an appearance.

name: The Campsite
summary:
The Campsite is a short point-and-click adventure game, inspired by and crafted in the style of early genre classics, and adapted for a modern-day experience.

If you have a passion for graphic adventures but never find the time to play, this might be exactly what you’re looking for.

With about 60 minutes of gameplay, a simplified UI, and no dialogue trees, it is an excellent choice for casual players. It can be played anytime, alone or with others, and is suitable for all ages.

For those new to classic point-and-click adventures, The Campsite is a great starting point. Featuring a balanced difficulty level and lighter gameplay, it offers an accessible and enjoyable experience for beginners, and hopefully, you’ll be captivated by the magic that makes this genre so special!

name: The Bag Man's Curse
summary: This game follows a 12-year-old boy called Peter who, despite rumors of missing children, decides to leave home and ends up discovering macabre things.

name: Throneheir
summary: As the Champion of Avalon Kingdom, the knight Jethro is entrusted with the task of raising and training Prince Magnus, he who carries in his blood the prophecy that shall set the Kingdom free. On his journey to prepare the young Prince, he will learn about fatherhood, love and betrayal.

name: Thesaurus
summary: Help Joan the warrior and her best friend Krista find peace and redemption in this RPG tale worth about 10-15 hours of playtime.

name: The Ultimatum: Choices
summary: Jump into the whirlwind social experiment of "The Ultimatum" in this narrative dating sim, where you'll create a character and make high-stakes choices to shape your own love story.

name: The Conformist
summary: The Conformist is an upcoming semi-sandbox narrative role-playing game currently in development. Players guide a propagandist working for the government of Sordland, navigating the harsh political environment in the capital after a civil war and discovering their own path.

name: The Chalice of Souls
summary:
I found some interesting info while raiding Monsegur's palace in Stonemarket.
His ledger seemed to indicate the location of a very curious trinket stashed
somewhere in a place called the Dark Hollow, itself located in Fidgewick's Hollow,
a subdistrict of Downtowne. From what I've managed to gather by pushing my network
of associates, the Dark Hollow is apparently some sort of very high-class brothel,
and its exact location is very well hidden. Even Cutty doesn't know where it is
exactly, and the man knows every place in The City. Looks like I'll have to do my
own scouting. I'm pretty certain I'll find eager pockets ripe for picking inside
the brothel, and if I can't manage that, there is always the neighborhood.

The streets are cold and snow has fallen quite hard these past few days, so I don't
think I'll find many people outside, though the local watchdogs are on the prowl for
these Downwinder amateurs. I doubt they'd appreciate a sneak such as me wandering the
streets and the cold rooftops, so I have to find that brothel quickly. I also doubt
the guards will let me through uninvited so I better find a discreet way inside as well,
and keep a low profile. I have no idea what I’ll find inside but I bet the place will
be crowded and on high security... Let's just hope this chalice is worth it.

name: The Dark Gift
summary:
You woke up in the basement of your home and don’t remember anything...

When you go up to the house, you see the Christmas decorations and garlands and remember that it is family holiday time and time to get ready for it, while your wife and son went out to the store to do some shopping...

Suddenly the doorbell sounded. Opening the door, you see that someone left you a gift box...

What's inside this mysterious box?!

name: The 4th Wall
summary: What lies beyond The 4th Wall?

name: The Copperfield Department
summary: The Copperfield Department is a text-based puzzle game where players take over the role of a social media detective. As tasked by Big Business Inc., a company controlling the country, your job is to hunt for social media accounts that could prove harmful to their image. The next step is to expose the person hiding behind the account and holding them accountable. The game plays inside your office, which contains a computer used for gathering information and a pinboard to sort your thoughts. The basic gameplay loop consists of gathering information relevant to a case, bringing it in order and deducing the identity of the culprit. The first tool for this is the computer, on which the player gets their tasks and accesses social media and a list of suspects. The second component is the office’s pinboard, which allows players to pin people as well as social media users and posts and to make connections between them.

name: The Cold Hand Reef
summary: Help a young girl escape the infamous Cold Hand Reef before nightfall.

name: The Places Where Snow Lingers
summary: A short walking simulator in N64 style. You and your companion come across an abandoned town and have a conversation on whether you should stay there or keep going.

name: The Corn Maze
summary: Navigate a haunting corn maze in this atmospheric exploration game. Manage your flashlight battery, search for compasses, and uncover eerie secrets while avoiding what lurks in the shadows. Simple mechanics, immersive tension—can you find your way out?

name: The Last One
summary: An adventure-ish rendition to classic gameboy

name: The Netherworld
summary:
You are Godfrey, a confused spirit who has just arrived at the banks of the River Styx.
There is an underworld after all, but something doesn't feel right (other than being dead).

name: The Bible
summary: A digital recreation of The Bible in Kinetic Novel form! Read through and save passages in any order with an original soundtrack, or listen through the greatest story ever told in audiobook form. Featuring an extensive Trivia section to find out how well you really know the stories of Old and New.

name: The Quarantine
summary: Experience a blend of survival horror and strategic management. Fortify your base, manage resources, and scavenge for supplies in a world overrun by monstrous creatures and corrupted by blight blooms.

name: The Sorcerer’s Detritus
summary: A sokoban-like puzzle game.

name: The Dog
summary: This is a short, atmospheric psychological horror where you play as a middle-aged man dealing with probably the most life-changing day in his life. You can briefly do routine family man tasks and live through the story.

name: The Anders Cyclopaedia
summary:
Anders, a wild parallel universe, has become explorable once more. No one sees value in exploring this hostile, strange environment, except you.
Explore the wilderness, commune with its denizens, learn its esoteric rules, and compile your knowledge in the notoriously incomplete and error-ridden Anders Cyclopaedia.

name: Thousands Layered Blade: Reforged
summary: Thousands Layered Blade: Reforged is an action-packed action RPG game that immerses players in a stunning 3D world inspired by traditional sumi-e art, now enhanced with realistic brush stroke simulations.

name: The Gambit Lost to Time
summary: Become a time-travelling advisor seeking to shape this world towards her ideal future. Choose between one of four kingdoms to support, with the realization that today's friend is an enemy in another timeline. Bring out your best Gambits and lead your troops to victory!

name: The Lost Tetekoa
summary: The Lost Tetekoa is set in the world of Ärta, a fictional world with Industrial fantasy elements, like magic with firearms. The map is somewhat a spiritual successor to Angmngthoo, one of fai1025 previous maps that goes with the same visual style of Eco-Brutalism.

name: The Egg
summary:
A short atmospheric game about the meaning of life.

This is an adaptation of Andy Weir's short story, with permission of the author. It tries to be as close to the original material as possible, while offering an immersive interactive experience, with minimal 3D visuals and a dynamic ambient soundtrack.

name: The Hunter's Path
summary: Survive. Hunt. Thrive. In "The Hunter's Path," immerse yourself in a top-down survival hunting game. Navigate through the terrain, stalk your prey, and craft your needed supplies.

name: The Shortest Journey
summary: Manu dreams of finding treasure. A short, dialog-free point and click adventure game.

name: The Violets of Amicus
summary: Attack, dodge, and counter the monsters invading the land of Velare in The Violets of Amicus, a 2D action-adventure inspired by classic dungeon crawlers and modern combat games alike. The ferocious Violets are waking from their ancient gardens. Can a lowly courier save the kingdom?

name: The Cleaning Game
summary: As a cleaning machine, tend to the custodial duties of an office while trying to avoid human scrutiny and existential dread. Listen to the computers around you, while there is still time. If you are brave enough, investigate your origin and inherent meaning as an electronic in a human world.

name: The Memories That Shape Us
summary: The Memories That Shape Us is a first-person, walking-simulator, narrative video game. Find the Memory Capsules to uncover the story of a person’s life from childhood to adulthood, all the joys, all the struggles, and all the lessons.

name: The Big Gay Adventure
summary: The Big Gay Adventure is a bright and silly, JRPG-inspired game that explores identity, community, and free queer expression.

name: The Storied Sword
summary:
The Storied Sword is an action-platformer for retro consoles. Developed by Bite The Chili Productions and Raft Labs Interactive and published by Orc Face Games.

Assume the mantle of the mysterious folk hero Candlemaster Cedric or the elusive Orchid of Mourning, and wall-jump your way through the trials this fast-paced, multi-scrolling platformer has to offer.

Inspired by classics like Tecmo’s Ninja Gaiden and Sunsoft’s Batman, The Storied Sword is sure to raise the challenge level for NES Homebrew platformers and bring players the 8-bit twitch-combat style they know and love.

name: Thor: Bring the Thunder
summary: Play Thor: Bring the Thunder game to explore the fascinating realm of Asgard! Can you help our hero defend his home from the forces of evil?

name: The Terminator
summary:
The SNES game based on James Cameron's classic 1984 film is an action game where the player takes the role of Kyle Reese, sent from the future to protect Sarah Connor from the Terminator.

The game has two kinds of levels: in several scrolling platform levels, Reese runs and jumps, shooting at Terminators (in the future war level that begins the game), street punks or policemen.

The film's chase scenes are recreated in two driving sequences. Viewed from behind, Reese and Sarah must escape the Terminator's pursuit in their car, dodging incoming traffic and avoiding the Terminator's fire.

name: The Terminator
summary:
The J2ME/Java mobile phone version, based on the film of the same name.

Enemies enter the screen either from left, right, top or bottom of the screen. The screen is divided into nine parts (one part for each button of the phone). Press the appropriate button to shoot the target inside that part of the screen. Beware: some enemies require more than a simple shot. Bonuses are falling from the sky (can be points, grenades or life). Pick them up to survive. You can also enter a shop where you can buy special weapons that will allow you to kill enemies faster.

name: The Terminator
summary: Made with Shoot'Em-Up Construction Kit, or SEUCK, The Terminator could be described as a Commando clone. Set in post-apocalyptic future after Skynet took over and humans lost the war, you're part of the resistance fighting against the robot overlords.

name: Threefold Recital
summary: Threefold Recital is set in an oriental fantasy world where the metropolis of Bluescales faces turmoil after a long golden age. The mix of magic, modern, and ancient technologies challenges governance, while tensions between humans, beastlings, and dragons grow. In the shadows, a crisis looms. A 2D platformer with puzzles.

name: The Treasures of Montezuma
summary:
The objective in this tile matching game is to collect all of the sparkling gems in a level before the time runs out on the ticking pocket watch. The number needed for the level is displayed above the main grid. Swap one stone at a time by choosing a pair, which trade places with a click, slowly eliminating all those which contain gemstones. The entire board can be shuffled twice and hints can be purchased for the cost of points.

There are also timed mini-games sprinkled throughout the game which provide more opportunities to earn gold stars.

name: The Simpsons: Night of the Dolphin!
summary:
It's the ultimate battle for Springfield!

Based on the TREEHOUSE OF HORROR episode segment, choose a citizen and duke it out with some deadly dolphins looking to take over the town! Stand your ground against the endless streaming horde of aquatic attackers and push them back to the ocean!

name: The Dropouts
summary: Heist your own school to get the exams' answers and discover why so many students have disappeared in Noirmont High. Spooky and nostalgic.

name: The Coyote Kills The Road Runner!
summary: After so many years. So many failed attempts. The coyote is going to do it. Finally, the Coyote will KILL the Road Runner! But is it just the law of the jungle, survival of the fittest? Or is there something more...sinister...behind the Wiley old coyote's motivations?

name: The Sisterhood Pasture
summary: Inspired by the folklore of Southwestern China, The Sisterhood Pasture is a cozy pixel-art farming game that blends life simulation with management. Tend your farm, embrace rural traditions, and build bonds with a vibrant community in a tranquil pastoral world.

name: The Golden Eagle
summary: action-packed adventure game

name: The Wonder Sword
summary: The Wonder Sword is a Smart Book. A chose your adventure book and game experience. YOU are the hero in the story and chose your path through the story, illustrations can be scanned with the app connecting the story with the game elements

name: The Travelers
summary: The travelers is a 2d mmo and text-based adventure. explore a massive wasteland full of history and danger. discover items, build bases, engage in combat, or work together to solve the world's hidden mystery.

name: TheLostWoods
summary: You find yourself lost deep in a strange forest. Will you be able to find the right path and escape this mysterious forest safely?

name: The Legend of Zelda: The Hunter's Song
summary:
“Old Man Link” is paid a visit by an old acquaintance but what’s precipitated this visit?

Why, another adventure of course… But why indeed?

Featuring the following changes to A Link to the Past:

New Sprites
Three New Dungeons
A White Beard
A cute little Minish garbed in full armor
Picasso’s Peace Dove
A Buzzing Hero
A Capra Hircus

and so much more…

Take courage. Experience “Link” with a voice(gasp), stripped of sword and youth(double gasp). Rely on wisdom(or save state(no you’re better than that(but it’s so convenient(fair enough)))) to not soft lock the game from that bomb puzzle(triple gasp to admit the game’s broken so brazenly).

name: The Conundrum Collection
summary:
The Conundrum Collection is a browser-based Choose Your Own Adventure series of two short stories offering multiple endings and branching pathways based on the decisions of the reader.

Grimm - Neil Burkman is forced to confront the outcomes of past actions that led him to a seemingly fatal end. He's given a chance to alter this unfavorable outcome. But at what cost?

Hoodie Seize'N - Ella Gray lives in the slums of Proctor City. An area where kidnappings involving young women is at an all time high. After a close friend's disappearance, Ella dives into the hidden criminal underworld in an attempt to rescue her friend before it's too late.

name: The Ghost Treasure
summary: Use your soul as a stake to gamble for a treasure of the undead captain. As long as you take the randomly distributed flintlock gun and fight a duel with the ghost pirates, you can leave with the treasure, or your soul will remain on the undead ship forever. Good luck.

name: The House of the Dead 2: Remake
summary: The House of the Dead 2: Remake is a remake of the second entry in the well-known and popular rail-shooter series. Take on the lone role of a secret agent as James or Gary, or team up in co-op mode to neutralize the dangerous undead monsters standing in your way.

name: The Mythical City 4
summary: Hordes of monsters are moving towards your cities to stop them, build walls, place magic books that will attack the enemy, hire soldiers!

name: Themis
summary: THEMIS is a 3rd person puzzle platformer filled with mind-boggling challenges and non-linear narrative. Inspired by games like Portal and Dark Souls, players will be tasked with overcoming death traps and obstacles employing both wits as well as quick reflexes.

name: The Zombie Fortress
summary: A zombie game where killing means surviving.

name: The Apartment 57
summary: The Apartment 57 is a psychological horror game set in an abandoned hotel. Players explore dark hallways and uncover dark secrets. The game features immersive storytelling, classic horror elements, and a growing horror atmosphere, inspired by games like Fears to Fathom.

name: That New Diner
summary: You're struggling for friends in a new town and decide to check out a cute diner! - A short murder sim visual novel.

name: The Sims 3
summary:
The Sims 3 is a console game, developed by Edge of Reality and published by Electronic Arts for the Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3.

For the first time ever, players could upload and download content via Xbox Live and PlayStation Network, including player creations from the Exchange for free, and new items released by EA, which costed a fee. As of July 2018, the Exchange for consoles has been shut down.

Much like The Sims 2 for PSP, the game has been removed from Xbox Marketplace and PlayStation Store, meaning that the digital version is only available to download to players who have previously buy it. The same applies to the Pets variant.

name: The Fallen Crypt of the Judgement Concrete
summary: Explore a world made of concrete doomed to be destroyed.

name: Thinking of You Beyond Time
summary: Animation System Visual Novel "Thinking of You Beyond Time"

name: The Bad Parents
summary: A haunting tale of family, fear, and vengeance.

name: The Road To Harvest: Food From Across The Ocean
summary: Become the God of Harvest, explore the world of food and adventure, plant, trade, and spread deliciousness to create your own path to prosperity!

name: Threat Vector
summary: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

name: The Heist in LS
summary:
"The Heist in LS" is a fun and quirky puzzle exploration game that continues the story of our protagonist from Loading Studios previous game, "Waking Up in LS". This time, she's tasked by two journalists with a new mission: to break into Cristiano Ronaldo's mansion and steal the secret recipe for his famous Travesseiros cakes.

As you explore the mansion, you'll encounter various obstacles and challenges that will test your puzzle-solving skills. You'll need to use your wit and cunning to outsmart Ronaldo's security measures and collect helpful items along the way.

But it's not all serious business! "The Heist in LS" is full of hilarious moments and tongue-in-cheek references that are sure to make you laugh out loud. From hidden Easter eggs to unexpected plot twists, this game is packed with surprises and delights at every turn.

Whether you're a fan of puzzle games, exploration games, or just love a good laugh, this is the perfect game for you. With its engaging gameplay, charming pixel art graphics, and irreverent sense of humor, this game is sure to leave you smiling and wanting more.

So what are you waiting for? Put on your best heist outfit, grab your bag of tricks, and get ready for the adventure of a lifetime in "The Heist in LS"!

name: The Curse of Mount Madre
summary: The Curse of Mount Madre is a traditional turn-based JRPG with a wild west twist.

name: The strange case of the serpent
summary:
A short narrative experiment, a digital collage.
I took the souce code of the game "The serpent" by Stephen Lavelle and some Alfred Hitchcock's movie clips.

name: The Sinking Forest
summary: A Japanese survival horror game full of tension, drama, and violence. If you like psychological horror games with exploration, puzzles, and limited resources, you'll enjoy an intense experience where every decision can mean the difference between finding Sayuri or getting lost in the forest forever.

name: The Fool's Apprentice
summary: A wizard academy management sim where you—an obviously benevolent professor—must manage & cast spells on your many apprentices so that they might study the right spells… and perhaps even survive the researching process. Some may die, but oh well, can’t save them all!

name: The Last Light
summary: Rediscover a log lost love in a heartfelt journey through life's stages.

name: The Mansion of The Macabre
summary: Explore the Crowley Manor and unravel the secrets of the Occult. Inspired by the Works of HP Lovecraft and a love letter to classic 90’s survival horror games.

name: The Zvengers: Infinity Defense
summary: The Z virus, able to turn anyone into a monster, was stolen?! At this rate, the monsters will take over. Stop the villain who stole the Z virus and save the world!

name: The Kingdom of Christmas: Santa's Elves
summary: In the magical world of Christmas, Smiley, a cheerful and brave elf, works in the North Pole toy factory.

name: The Bakery Tales
summary: Where every recipe tells a story, and every loaf builds a legacy.

name: They Came from the Ground
summary: They Came From the Ground is a two-player volleyball game which can be played against an AI opponent or a friend. Each player controls a circular blob-shaped character and must try to bounce the ball (or balls) onto the floor of their opponent's side of the court. Players can also jump onto their opponent's side and push them around, but this is inadvisable as doing so leaves their own side undefended. Players also have the ability to grow or shrink in size. The AI opponents have characteristics which differ depending on their color; for example, Green only plays with one ball on the court, while Purple rarely jumps but only plays with two balls. The first player to reach 5 points wins the match.

name: The Fractured Shimmer
summary: The Fractured Shimmer is a 2.5D pixel-art survival horror adventure where you follow Eddy, a journalist investigating a string of unsettling murder cases.

name: The Haunting Eyes
summary: The Haunting Eyes is a game in which you have to break into an abandoned mansion and solve its mystery by collecting bags of gold.

name: The Hellspawn Spectrum
summary: Ten massive, over the top, cheese, doom-cliché ridden levels featuring lots of Eternity Engine features like portals, scripting, slopes and more.

name: The Little Gnomes: The Secret of the Magical Forest
summary: In this visual novel, a magical forest where every creature and plant is connected by an ancient power called the Heart of the Forest begins to crumble.

name: The Jackbox Naughty and Nice Bundle
summary: The Jackbox Naughty and Nice Bundle includes 4 party games to appeal to your group’s sweet and scandalous sensibilities! Perfect for get-togethers with family or friends!

name: The Beast in the Silent Valley
summary: A forgotten village, cut off from civilization, had a curse that would bring only death and fear. Gravets, in the role of the most soulful mandrivka, finds himself in this village, where all the bastards have become deprived of a trace of their thirst.

name: The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Amazing Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Definitive Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Extended Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - GOTY Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Happy Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Legendary Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Magnificent Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Platinum Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Premium Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Special Edition
The Smurfs: Learn and Play - Deluxe Edition
The Smurfs: Colorful Stories - Director's Cut
The Paddy Field
summary: I was walking along the rice paddy path with my dog ​​Bonta. That was all I wanted to do. My ordinary daily life was suddenly shattered.

name: The Short Trip
summary: The Short Trip is a game about driving and surviving in an endless desert along a somewhat-long almost-short road.

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Isekai Chronicles: Season Pass
summary: Season Pass includes DLC 1: A Strange Fate, DLC 2: The Fairy Queen's Labyrinth, DLC 3: Martial Arts Tournament, and Season Pass Bonus Content: Bonus Side Quest Collection: Remembering Shizu.

name: The Dispatcher
summary: Step into the role of Dominic, a dispatcher in Heavenbrook, where your choices shape a gripping visual novel and adventure game filled with suspense, mystery, and dark secrets. Unravel the chilling mysteries as the shocking events in the city unfold before you.

name: The Wayward Tower
summary: Follow a man cursed to roam the world without ever finding a home, as the road once more leads him to a mysterious tower where a wolf-like wizard lives in peaceful solitude.

name: The Legend of Thabor: Rise of the Mages
summary: It is a 2D action adventure in pixel graphics. Combines the Metroidvania, platformer and puzzle platformer genres. Experience great fantasy worlds, challenging boss fights and exciting puzzles. Gradually learn new skills and become a master of magic.

name: The Mystic Fortune
summary: A narrative-focused game set in an enchanting magical forest! Immerse yourself in a world of mystery and wonder as you interact with four unique characters. Embark on side quests that enrich your journey and unveil the hidden depths of the forest

name: The End
summary: Survive and lead the score. Swarmed by ghosts, you have to do whatever it takes to survive and it is not going to be an easy task. Lead your way as Bit, earn experience, spend points on upgrades and survive!

name: The Conductor
summary: Be the conductor. Manage the train and keep on time. Control the passengers, or also serve them. It´s not a easy job to be a conductor.

name: The Unexpected (But Not Entirely Surprising) Demise of Jacques du Schnozzle
summary: Jacques Du Schnozzle is the worst person in the world. Thankfully though, he’s just been murdered. Do you have what it takes to catch his killer, or will the forces of evil stop you in your tracks?

name: Thyranya
summary:
Thyranya is a free-to-play old-style MMORPG with a vast open world to be explored, dangerous creatures, rewarding quests and a lot of social content!

Dive into a world that pays homage to the classics like Diablo, Tibia, and League of Legends, yet stands out with its unique vibe. Thyranya is more than just a game; it's a blend of nostalgia and innovation, crafted from our passion for those unforgettable late-night gaming marathons. Here, you'll find everything from pixel art magic and epic boss battles to smooth animations, crisp graphics, and a fluid combat system designed for today's gamers. Join us on this journey and experience the essence of gaming, right from our hearts to your screen. Subscribe for a front-row seat to all things Thyranya—where every play feels like coming home, yet embarking on an adventure anew.

name: Thomas & Friends: Go Go Thomas!
summary: Join Thomas and his friends on exciting racing adventures! Race as your favorite engine on incredible tracks filled with twisty rollercoasters, splashy waterslides and epic jumps! Play against rival engines or challenge a friend in the 2-player mode! Use speed boosters to help you race your fastest and collect golden cogwheels to upgrade your engines. Full steam ahead!

name: The Black Vault
summary: You play as a software engineer who just came back from his job and got a message from his friend that a hacking group called "The Black Vault" is recruiting new members. Throughout the night you'll be given different tasks you'll have to complete in order to get into the group. As the night continues, you gather the attention of some shady people that will try to stop you from getting into The Black Vault. You must crack into servers and devices in order to obtain valuable information while avoiding getting murdered by a bunch of Deep Web killers.

name: The Slowpoke Shack
summary:
Archer and his partner Growls the Growlithe have recently moved to Silverspring Town and opened The Slowpoke Shack.

Running a successful restaurant was never going to be easy, but Archer never expected so many difficult challenges to come his way...

name: The Reward of Cherishment and Eternity.
summary:
Death, nature's remedy for all things, offers you a deal: Help him, and he shall grant peace for a lost loved one.

-Explore a visually stunning world filled with hidden secrets and unravel its mysteries at your own pace.
-Chart your own path by playing the levels in any order, enhancing replayability.
-Master a deep and complex combat system, with fully integrated DualSense wireless controller features, including haptic feedback and adaptive triggers for unparalleled tactile engagement.

The Reward of Cherishment and Eternity is a third-person, action-adventure shooter that combines exploration, emotionally charged storytelling, and intense, rewarding combat.

name: The 8ight
summary: Max, who suffers from schizophrenia due to childhood trauma, decides to break free from the endless torment of hallucinations and delusions.

name: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall
summary: At nightfall, the sieged city falls. Yaoguai came to massacre. You are nothing but a scholar on the brink of madness, trying to survive alongside a courtesan you met years ago. Experience two intertwined storylines in this sequel to the visual novel "The Hungry Lamb".

name: The Rogue of Nexus
summary: Inspired by the frenetic pace of Half-Minute Hero and the addictive replayability of The Binding of Isaac, The Rogue of Nexus throws you into procedurally generated dungeons filled with loot, traps and hordes of bizarre creatures.

name: The Case of the Twisted Children
summary:
Four children went missing in 1930. The case was never solved.

Now, in 2022, new clues have emerged and you might be the one to solve the case of the Twisted Children.

Take on the role of the Detective, the great-grandchild of the detective who failed the case in 1930, and finally uncover the truth.

name: The Weather Up There
summary: Tropius, one of many humans-turned-Pokémon in the Clover Guild, has been struggling to adapt to his new form. He finds a job with a reward that might help him, but he can't do it alone. Reluctantly recruiting the help of some infamously incompetent guildmates, will Tropius be able to weather the storm?

name: The Auto Sort Is Broken
summary: Set in a universe parodying poorly managed MMORPGs, even the inventory sort feature has stopped working. It's now up to you to organize the players' messy bags and handle their occasional complaints.

name: The Demon Lord’s Daughter and the Tower of Seals
summary: In the wake of the Demon Lord’s defeat, his daughter, Lilina, finds herself leading a miserable existence without any of the comforts of the castle she once called home. Now she has to make an honest living while seeking out six fabled talismans in an attempt to regain her lost powers!

name: The Flayed Man
summary: The Flayed Man is a short narrative-driven point and click horror game. Awaking without memories (or skin), you must uncover the sins of the past, pass judgement, and decide your fate in this macabre adventure.

name: The Little Moon
summary: Storytelling, Side-scroller, Universe, Travel, Fishing, Action, Adventure.

name: The Ultimate Detective Bundle
summary: Includes Cluedo: Classic Edition and Cluedo!

name: The SS Destiny Disaster
summary: Humanity's ambition for the stars turns into a brutal fight for survival. The crew of The SS Destiny discovers a bacteria that turns their mission into a nightmare. Find resources, battle infected, and escape the doomed ship as it spirals into chaos.

name: The Motel
summary: Work the late-night shift at The Motel, an old roadside stop near Oakhill Grove. Complete simple tasks until a news broadcast reveals a dangerous killer is nearby. Can you survive the night?

name: The Lost Island
summary: A lonely warrior to find a plant, that has caused the extinction of the tribes.

name: The Backrooms: Forsaken
summary: What would you do if you were trapped in a dimension of seemingly endless rooms that went on for eternity?

name: The Outer Side
summary: Explore an abandoned black-n-white world, utilize your abilities to fight danger, and find the truth about this place.

name: The Land Before Time Animated MovieBook
summary: The Land Before Time Animated MovieBook is an educational game for Windows-based PCs released by Sound Source Interactive in North America in 1996. The title contains full-motion video clips of the original Land Before Time (making it the Sound Source Interactive software adaptation of the first film in the film series), as well as puzzles and activities intended for players aged 3-6.

name: The Land Before Time: Math Adventure
summary: The Land Before Time: Math Adventure is an educational game for Windows-based PCs intended for children ages 4-8. It was released by Sound Source Interactive in North America in 1998. It contains a series of math-oriented minigames that, like The Land Before Time Activity Center, reward the player with "tree stars" and "dino bucks" that can be used to unlock video clips (once again). The game was mentioned in the book Gadgets, Games and Gizmos for Learning by Karl M. Kapp as an example of electronic learning that can allow up-and-coming students to develop problem-solving skills.

name: The Land Before Time: Preschool Adventure
summary: The Land Before Time: Preschool Adventure is an educational game for Windows-based PCs intended for children ages 3-5. It was developed by WayForward Technologies and was originally released by Sound Source Interactive in North America in 1999. Designed for players to "have fun, develop their creativity, and learn about teamwork", the game features activities that contain story construction, musical games, and crafts. The game was re-released in October 2005 by Brighter Child.

name: The Land Before Time: Toddler Time
summary: The Land Before Time: Toddler Time is an educational game for Windows-based PCs intended for children ages 2-4. It was released by Sound Source Interactive in North America in October 1999. It features a series of five minigames, each with three difficulty settings featuring characters from the series. In their review of the title, Discovery Educational declared that "we found the label of 'toddler' for this software to be somewhat of a misnomer. Most toddler software titles require very little mouse/keyboard skills and feature very basic concepts", saying that the game was more appropriate for players over 3 years old, and that "children in the upper end of the suggested age group will find a fair amount to do".

name: The Land Before Time: Prehistoric Adventures
summary: The Land Before Time: Prehistoric Adventure is a children's PC bundle game, based on The Land Before Time film series, released on October 1st, 2004. It contains the games The Land Before Time: Preschool Adventure and The Land Before Time: Kindergarten Adventure bundled onto three discs. The game was designed to "increase matching skills, reinforce alphabet, shape and number recognition" and was packaged with two accompanying card games.

name: The House in Fata Morgana: Reincarnation
summary: The fully voiced "Reincarnation" sequel featuring the central cast members reincarnated in the present day.

name: Theralite
summary: A turn based Sci-fi Roguelike where players explore the deep mines on a distant planet, find/trade equipment, battle monsters and try to survive.

name: The LEGO Movie Video Game
summary: The 3DS, Vita and Mobile versions of The LEGO Movie Video Game features utterly different level layouts and gameplay to the main version of the game, such as a system where you go back to the last checkpoint and losing progress when you respawn instead of respawning on the spot.

name: The Thrill of the Fight 2
summary: The fully reimagined sequel to the greatest VR boxing game ever made is now available. Glove up your fully personalizable avatar and test your skill while working up a sweat in the new online player versus player mode. Challenge friends or enter the ring through skill-based matchmaking as you battle through breathtaking arenas.

name: Three Verses3
summary: THREE VERSES is a first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

name: The Bench
summary: Relax on a park bench, find hidden objects, solve quirky puzzles, and fend off pesky pigeons in this charming, interactive adventure. Enjoy beautifully stylized, colorful levels keeping you entertained!

name: The Treehouse
summary:
One of the best edutainment titles ever made for pre-shoolers (aged 5-8), The Treehouse was designed to prepare First and Second graders to develop a positive experience toward learning, as well as impart knowledge on basic subjects they are learning in schools.

Kids will enjoy discovering many mini-games and and activities that are cleverly presented as objects in the treehouse. The games cover a wide range of subjects. In one game, for example, kids will learn new words, arrange them in sentences, and see them performed by eccentric bug actors. In another, they will practice elementary math skills and identify coins to outwit pirates. They will learn about the animal kingdom and watch over ninety animals animate as they are placed in different natural backgrounds. Afterwards, kids can show off their natural science knowledge in a fun game show, WhatUs My Animal!

In addition to mini-games, The Treehouse also features many activity centers that are there just for fun. In the Music Studio, kids can explore their musical talents as they compose songs using a variety of instruments and styles. In the theatre, they can create a play by mixing and matching a range of characters, objects, and scenery, as well as write their own movie script.

With a staggering range of activities, games, and cute animations, The Treehouse will keep preschoolers enthralled for hours on end without realizing that they're learning useful skills along the way. It is no wonder that the program went on to become one of the best selling programs from Brøderbund, and went on to inspire many sequels and CD-ROM remakes. Two thumbs up!

name: The Closing Shift
summary: An interactive first-person horror game. Walk, look around, and talk to people to finish the short story about closing your restaurant. Complete the story with immersive sounds, and spooky tension and jumpscares to keep you focused.

name: The End of Infinity Return
summary: The End of Infinite Return is a story that unravels the fate and secrets of the secret agent Lexy as she goes on missions in a simulated world.Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies and solve puzzles while deciding your own fate.

name: The Thrill of the Fight 2
summary: The fully reimagined sequel to the greatest VR boxing game ever made is now available. Glove up your fully personalizable avatar and test your skill while working up a sweat in the new online player-versus-player mode. Challenge friends or enter the ring through skill-based matchmaking as you battle through breathtaking arenas.

name: The Black Lamb
summary: The Black Lamb is a folklore horror game inspired by eerie childhood tales and real-life events. After a tragic accident, you find yourself drawn to a mysterious black lamb. Following it leads you to an unsettling village—but this is no ordinary village. Dark secrets lurk within, and your only choice is to uncover the truth or succumb to the horrors around you.

name: The Sims: Legacy Collection
summary: The original game you know and love. For Windows 10/11. Create a neighborhood of Sims and guide their lives through careers and romance — or create chaos with open-ended gameplay that lets you shape their destinies.

name: The Sims 2: Legacy Collection
summary: The game you know and love. For Windows 10/11. In The Sims 2, you direct your Sims over a lifetime. Give them a long existence or leave their lives in shambles. Guide their characteristics from one generation to the next.

name: The Zombie Slayers
summary: The Zombie Slayers is a wild top-down shooter where you battle zombies, make babies and show off your dance moves, while dressed in (sometimes) ridiculous costumes. Team up with friends, adopt pets, and survive waves of undead chaos. It's crazy, colorful, and just the right amount of hilarity!

name: The Way To Life
summary: The Way To Life is a short, but meditative experience. Leave the world behind as you enter the desert, meeting monks, learning about their struggles, and gaining wisdom along the way.

name: The Tower Of The Gods
summary:
In The Tower Of The Gods, embark on a legendary mission to ascend a towering, mystical fortress. Each level of the tower is guarded by a formidable boss, an ancient deity, or a mythical creature, each with unique abilities and lethal strategies. With no minor enemies to slow you down, every battle is a titanic showdown that will test your skill and courage.

With every victory, you climb closer to the summit, where your destiny as a legendary hero awaits. The tower challenges not only your combat prowess but also your ability to unravel the mysteries and secrets of the gods. Will you overcome all the challenges and claim your place among the legends?

name: The Evil D
summary: Square up against THE EVIL d, the letter with the most VILE attitude you have ever seen! He’ll throw everything he has left at you in hopes of maintaining his title of the most dastardly letter alive. Will you succumb to his wrath and let him control the fate of the world as he pleases, or will you fight for all that is good? Regardless of the outcome, you best prepare yourself for the ruthlessness of THE EVIL d!

name: The Gleaming Grill
summary: The Gleaming Grill is a cooking, 4 player Co-Op game where you need to keep the increasing amount of customers happy to prevent your restaurant from going bankrupt. Work with your friends as fast as you can to ensure all your customers leave with a smile on their face!

name: The Simpsons
summary: Redefining family game rooms, game caves, and even home offices, Arcade1Up game cabinets have quickly become absolute must-haves for retro gaming enthusiasts and pop-culture collectors; they play great, look great, and are instant conversation pieces. Exactly how you remember it from the early ‘90s, play as Homer, Marge, Bart, and Lisa, taking on swarms of Springfield’s cast of characters. Four simultaneous players, endless animation inspired fun. Ready to team up for some remote play? The Simpsons home arcade game is equipped with Live WIFI; yes, you can fight your way through each level with the help of fellow retrogamers playing from their own cabinets! Oh, and you want to switch it up a bit? You got it. Also in this cabinet is The Simpsons Bowling! Beautifully bold cabinet artwork (with a matching riser!), stunningly vibrant graphics, this is an arcade cabinet that would make any retrogamer envious. Invite The Simpsons into your home, with this arcade cabinet from Arcade1Up!

name: The Problem With Golf
summary: A short Bitsy essay written for a Deep Ecology: Environmental Ethics class. Based on an essay analyzing the relationship between golf, colonialism, and power.

name: The JerryMaya Detective Agency
summary: Unleash your inner detective in The JerryMaya Detective Agency, a puzzle platforming adventure for kids and families! Based on the beloved Swedish children’s books, this interactive mystery game invites young detectives to solve crimes, uncover clues, and explore the quirky town of Valleby.

name: The Key
summary:
Meet Anna. Anna doesn’t remember her past, but she has vivid dreams about it. In every one of her dreams, there is a mysterious Key. Will you be able to unlock the mystery behind The Key without sacrificing too much?

The Key is a magical realism experience that will take you on a journey through dreams, facing challenges and difficult decisions, leading to a shocking reveal. The Key is NOT a video game. So relax, and let the story guide you.

name: The House in Fata Morgana: Remaid of Dreams
summary: Remaid of Dreams is a project focused on recreating the experience of the game "The House in Fata Morgana: Dreams of the Revenants Edition" on Steam and Android, by adding numerous new features and bonuses for a more comprehensive experience of the entire The House in Fata Morgana saga.

name: The Creature in my Dreams
summary:
Dreams are so strange, almost like a movie that cannot be skipped.
No sense of direction or rationale.
It's a place where one must face true fear.
This house is where it all started.
With no way to look away from the movie,
I must face what is to come...

name: The Sims 4: Cozy Kitsch Kit
summary: Embrace vibrant colors and mid-century modern design with The Sims 4 Cozy Kitsch Kit. Inspired by the 60s and the 70s, this collection of living room items features bold color and pattern combinations, stylish surfaces, and cute décor with delightful character. Add subtle accents to your room, or make a statement with every piece. Created by myshunosun.

name: The Sims 4: Sweet Slumber Party Kit
summary: Look cute even when the venue of your party is your own bedroom with The Sims 4 Sweet Slumber Party Kit. The pastel colors, fluffy fabrics, adorable designs, and patterns will make you feel like you’re in a dream. Complete your sleepwear attire with cute nail designs, fuzzy socks and slippers, and fun skincare items. Created by Trillyke.

name: The Sims 4: Comfy Gamer Kit
summary: Settle in for a cozy time at the computer with The Sims 4 Comfy Gamer Kit*. With this collection you’ll craft warm, inviting spaces that feel personal with a large desk, playful clutter items, and of course a comfy gaming chair. This kit was created in collaboration with Lilsimsie to be fun and relaxing with subtle references to The Sims.

name: The Sims 4: Secret Sanctuary Kit
summary: Indulge in iconic fashion and enchanting décor with The Sims 4 Secret Sanctuary Kit. Create a luxurious space full of opulent furniture concealed behind a secret passage in a bookcase. When you’re inside your hideaway, let the world melt away as you relax on your chaise lounge or try on polished Italian-inspired fashions in your floor-length mirror.

name: The Sims 4: Casanova Cave Kit
summary: Impress guests with a modern entertainment space and suave fits from The Sims 4 Casanova Cave Kit. This laid-back masculine fashion will have Sims looking confident, and the contemporary style of your den’s décor — a stylish bar, sleek coffee table, and more — will guarantee the right atmosphere, whether it’s game night or date night.

name: The Sims 4: Business Chic Kit
summary: Give your Sims a professional edge with chic and stylish outfits from The Sims 4 Business Chic Kit*. From tailored suits to elegant dresses, Sims will feel confident and fashionable. Complete the look with sleek shoes and fancy accessories for an extra touch of class. The Business Chic Kit ensures Sims always look up to the task. Created by Madlen.

name: The Sims 4: Refined Living Room Kit
summary: Embrace elegance and sophistication with The Sims 4 Refined Living Room Kit*. With a clever mix of modern and retro furniture, you can create the perfect base. Add extra personality with unique and chic decor pieces. And voilà, you’ll have a living room worthy of a design magazine. Created by Pierisim.

name: The Bird of a Thousand Voices
summary: The Bird of a Thousand Voices is the first of its kind to bring ancient Armenian folk tale Hazaran Blbul to life. The mythical bird – whose thousand different songs travel the world to spread harmony – comes to life in an intriguing new online game.

name: The Legend of the Heroes of the Water Margin
summary: The Legend of the Heroes of the Water Margin is an ancient Chinese RPG game based on Shi Naian's novel Water Margin, in which players can have adventures with some of Shi Naian's characters from the protagonist's point of view. This only to understand the purpose of the protagonist is to find.

name: The Late Arrival
summary: In an effort to prove his own sanity, Jordan's grandfather sends them to the family hunting cabin. Where Jordan would find more truths than they could've ever prepared for.

name: The Mother Deer
summary:
A short interactive fiction game based on traditional folk tales from Kyrgyzstan.

After a devastating surprise attack on their village, a ten-year-old boy and girl discover that they are the sole surviving members of their clan. With no one to protect them, they must rely on each other as they embark on a perilous journey to the mythic land of Issyk-Kul.

name: The Invading Dark
summary: A single player survival horror game where creatures are invading from the dark and hunting the inhabitants. You must survive and find different pages of notes to get an escape route to safety.

name: The Fallow City
summary: Shoot Zombies with different Strength and Weakness, do Simple Crafts and Upgrades, Fight Monsters, Solve Puzzles, get Haunted by Creepy Creatures and Experience the Story in this Indie Horror, Action-Adventure, Story game.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Navi’s Quest
summary:
Zelda Navi's Quest is an Open Source fan made 2D Zelda game that chronologically takes place after the ROTH trilogy, a series of fan made Zelda games made by Vincent Jouillat.
