The gameplay lies in the ability to play as both Link and Navi, the player being able to heal and survey the area with Navi’s powers.
The game is available to play on PC, the PSP and the PS Vita

name: The Demon's Room
summary: The Demon's Room is a horror suspense interactive video game. Players need to establish a good feeling with the characters, and the plot triggers and selects to influence the story. The game contains many ways of playing. With the deepening of the plot, players can unlock 11 story endings.

name: The Sims 4: Businesses & Hobbies
summary: Pursue new skills and live a life of accomplishment in The Sims 4 Businesses & Hobbies Expansion Pack*. Make your home in Nordhaven — a world of opportunity where you can chase your dreams among a passionate community. Create wearable art with the new Tattooing skill, and even earn Simoleons for it. Or, craft functional pieces with the new Pottery skill and charge for lessons as you improve. Savvy Sims can turn their wildest dreams into profitable businesses, so use your imagination to create something special. Run your business out of your home, hire employees, decide how to charge, and make the rules!

name: Those Who Crawl VR
summary: Crawl through tight cave tunnels and avoid monsters in this claustrophobic VR spelunking game. Escape inhuman monsters and deadly environments as the cave walls turn to flesh.

name: The Dark
summary: It's a small psychological horror game where the player takes on the role of a blonde man trying to escape a mysterious villa, and as the process progresses, he will wake up from a dream he has already done 16 times ......

name: The Reformatory
summary: Your name is Dewey. You enjoy playing video games, much to the dismay of your parents. One day, they send you to a reformatory. There, a man electroshocks you. In convulsions, you fall into a world filled with enemies. This is a top-down 2D pixel-style shooter game with roguelite elements.

name: The Forgotten Deity
summary: The Forgotten Deity is a refreshing action game with a 2D pixel art style, in which blocking is an important mechanism for the exciting offense and defense battles. You will take back your beloved dog from the hands of the Goddess of Light and get involved in the game of the gods.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Initiation
summary: In Link's Initiation, brothers Sahasrahla & Aginah use their mystical abilities to project a dream into Link’s mind, in order to initiate him in the rites of the ancient Seven Sages. You must immerse yourself in Link's unconscious, where everything has a double meaning, and analyze the hidden keys to focus his spirit and acquire the wisdom that will guide him on the Sages path. In this prequel to A Link to the Past, you will have to solve the puzzles to initiate Link into the mystical wisdom of the Seven Sages! Available for Windows, Mac and Linux in English and Spanish.

name: The Pow-er
summary:
That there The POW-er is a punchslinger to the manner born, though she ain't exactly among the warmest of 'em. She's got places to be and bones to crush. Of such appointments she travels to and from by means of locomotive. She ain't in the business of lettin' strangers take her spot at the trainhouse neither — and to The POW-er, everybody's a stranger.

Crash through three unique stages and get The POW-er to the station before the train arrives, with enough strength to uproot whatever poor soul finds themselves sat at the single seat this side of the Milky Way that'll quickest get them a knuckle to the nose... Not that The POW-er needs your help none anyhow.

This game was created in seven days for the Bigmode Game Jam 2025.

name: The Ouroborous Incident
summary: Uncover the dark dealings of the Turing Corporation and their mysterious RAVENOUS project.

name: The Little Uni
summary: The game is a point-and-click adventure game in the form of a story with hand-drawn illustrations. Go on an adventure to the planets with various characters and listen to their stories, and find a new planet for Uni to stay on.

name: The Seven Realms: Realm 1 - Terran
summary: The Seven Realms is a fantasy, story-driven, adult visual novel where your choices will shape the fate of the Realms and the people around you. Will you be a Fair or a Strong Ruler? Will fate be enough for you, or will you want more? The choices are yours to make.

name: The Ultimate Banana Game
summary: The ULTIMATE Banana Game is an idler game about... making an idler game.

name: There's No Dragons
summary: There's No Dragons is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random dragons to find for each of them.

name: The Silent Suite
summary: You live in a hotel room. Everything seems normal—until a strange rumbling wakes you. Panic sets in as you realize you’re not alone. A killer is somewhere in the hotel… Trapped inside, you must navigate the eerie hallways, and find a way to escape… before it's too late.

name: There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin
summary:
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin's former-mentor-turned-rogue-agent Dustin MacGuffin has resurfaced to kidnap the one you care about most.

In this single-player interactive spy novel, play as secret agent Franklin Benjamin and use your particular set of skills to save Virginia from the clutches of the madman Dustin MacGuffin.

Which means - you’d better get the MacGuffin!

name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
summary:
Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world.

In the single-player interactive novel villain team-up game "There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.," you play as his greatest adversaries. Can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. (short for a "Very Important Collective of Terrorists, Operatives, and Rogues") defeat the only man standing between them and world domination?

To the V.I.C.T.O.R. go the spoils!

name: There's No Cake
summary:
The cake is a lie! We looked very hard but still couldn't find any!

There's No Cake is a hidden object game with a selection of 9 locations and random sweet treats to find for each of them.

name: The Camel
summary: Welcome to wild-lands of forest. There was a Camel living, hunting and surviving off the land. Play as a Camel and explore the wilderness of the forest and island near the forest.

name: The Pub Life Simulator
summary: Open your own pub with The Pub Life Simulator, serve food and drinks to keep your customers happy. Enjoy this exciting simulation experience solo or with friends. Unlock higher-quality products, expand your pub, and build the best business in town!

name: The Immemorial Order II Sisters of Darkness
summary: The Immemorial Order II Sisters of Darkness is primarily a spooky, atmospheric, first-person walking simulator that doesn't take itself too seriously.

name: The House
summary: The House is a single player horror and thriller game. As a journalist, you are trapped in a house where the paranormal is on the rise. It's up to you to find photos, notes and tapes and escape the house to survive!

name: The Darkness 2
summary: The second game starring Blaze the Hedgehog (BlazeHedgehog's Sonic fan character).

name: The Seven Realms: Realm - Pythonium
summary:
After the events in Terran, it's time to discover Pythonium, the Realm of Demons and Witches.

On a journey to save one of your oldest friends and find the perpetrator of her suffering, you seek the Witch Queen's help.

What should have been a simple request becomes more complicated as she refuses to fulfil half of your demand for unknown reasons. All is not what it seems as you uncover Pythonium's dark secrets.

name: The Soldier and the Golden Princess
summary: Princess Knight Lucrezia is known for her exceptional swordsmanship and striking beauty, but when whispers about a secret relationship with the much-maligned General Abol start sweeping through the ranks, it falls to you, a lone soldier, to uncover the truth!

name: The Great Yokai of the Haunted Halls
summary: You and your childhood friend Yua were supposed to just pick up a book from the decrepit building, but when a sudden twist of fate sends the two of you stumbling into a hidden realm teeming with spirits and yokai, it'll be up to you to find a way out! In this eerie supernatural dimension, you meet Izuna, who claims to be a great yokai with a fondness for humans. Can you escape this otherworldly realm, with the help of Izuna and the Kosaka sisters' spiritual powers?

name: The Second Sight: Dead Reckoning
summary:
You’re an urban legend in a county full of them. When you were thirteen, you were found passed out in the road by one of the local cops. No missing persons report. No fingerprints on file. No memories. Just a name.

Oh, and some bizarre psychic powers.

You're content with simplicity. You like your isolated cabin and helping Carter track down missing persons. You know that in theory there are more people like you out there, but you've never wanted to look behind the curtain to find out.

However, with the disappearance of a local teen named Casey Powell and a recent attempt on your foster father's life, your serene, isolated life comes abruptly to its end and a new chapter begins.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword HD Randomizer
summary: Randomizer mod for the Nintendo Switch remaster of Skyward Sword.

name: The Darkness
summary: A game starring BlazeHedgehog's Sonic fan character: Blaze the Hedgehog.

name: The Mine Song But It's In A Playable Doom WAD
The Lost Sanatorium
summary: You are a famous researcher, and you found out that in a very popular sanatorium that thousands of people visit, an accident happened where nobody knows what really happened. Many people say that it was a fire or something. The sanatorium has been abandoned for almost a year, but you want to find out what actually happened. So you go to the mountains and try to find out. Finally, you reach the sanatorium, which is very far from any communication/internet. You experience a lot in your visit, but then suddenly...

name: The Seabed's Shining Star
summary: Under the hazy moon, a shrine maiden meets a star. A short visual novel of a two person conversation. Cup ramen recommended.

name: The Northern Path
summary: Embark on an adventure through the vast northern wilderness, where survival depends on your skills and instincts. Experience story-rich exploration as you dredge through untamed lands, face below zero temperatures, and uncover mysteries hidden in the snow. A journey into the long dark awaits!

name: The King of Fighters XV: Ultimate Edition
summary:
This is a special product that includes the main “THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV” game and each content.

[Product Contents]
- "THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV" Base game
- KOF XV Team Pass 1
- KOF XV Team Pass 2
- KOF XV Fighter Pass
- KOF XV DLC Character "MATURE" and "VICE"
- KOF XV DLC Costume "GAROU: MotW TERRY"
- KOF XV DLC Costume "CLASSIC LEONA"

name: The Riftbreaker: Complete Edition
summary: The Riftbreaker Complete Edition contains the core game and all available addons.

name: The Stone of Madness: Special Edition
The Daruma Challenge
summary: A brutal bouncing challenge. No shortcuts, no mercy—just you vs. gravity. How far will you climb before it all comes crashing down?

name: There's Nothing Underground
summary: There's Nothing Underground is a roguelike puzzle adventure where you use random tools to solve levels in endless ways. Unlock and combine tools to tackle 100+ levels, each with unique challenges. Find creative solutions, uncover the asteroid's secrets, and survive!

name: The Grappler
summary: Grapple or Fall. Inspired by brutally challenging platformers like Jump King and Getting Over It, this 2D adventure will push you to your limits, one frustratingly rewarding grapple at a time.

name: The Arkane Collection
summary: The Arkane Collection includes Dishonored: Definitive Edition, Dishonored 2, Dishonored: Death of the Outsider, Prey, Prey: Mooncrash, Typhon Hunter, Redfall and DEATHLOOP Deluxe Edition!

name: The FMV Collection 5
summary: Wales Interactive is proud to offer the Bloodshore, Ten Dates and Mia and the Dragon Princess all in one bundle!

name: The Exorcist: Story of School
summary: The Exorcist girl Woohee enters the school to chase the evil spirit. Stories of disappearing students are about to be revealed!

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Ultimate Hunting Bundle
summary: With the Ultimate Hunting Bundle, you're ready for anything.

name: The Fall Bundle
summary:
Includes the award winning "The Fall" and "The Fall Part 2: Unbound"

In a dark oppressive future, you are the Artificial Intelligence onboard a combat suit. Your sole purpose: Protect your pilot. The problem: He's unconscious. You must take control of the suit, and drag his body towards medical help.

name: The Asylum Closed Ward
summary: The child who got cured from the closed ward, 'Uzur' had a dream about a murdered patient in the ruined hospital. When the child open their eyes, they realized that the scene is identical to the one they dreamed about. So, he decided to escape from the hospital, while avoiding the fear of death which is coming for them....

name: The Lightkeeper is Gone
summary: A retro-styled horror adventure set in the 1930's on a lone island. Take on the job of keeping the lighthouse while discovering the story of those that came before.

name: The Candle
summary: As night falls and a storm rises over the annual county carnival, you are visited by a mysterious spirit. Tasked with laying his soul to rest, you must brave his long dilapidated manor and avoid the horrifying remnants of his estate staff.

name: The Day Valentine Died, and So Did I!
summary: A New Kind of Romantic Adventure:Break the Flags! Akira Morisaki set up "flags" with girls for Valentine’s Day success. But receiving too many chocolates triggered a fatal surge of “love power”! Saved by the angel Chocoriel, he must relive February 14th and break the flags to escape his doomed fate.

name: The Legend of Ezra Raymond Squirrel
The Casting of Frank Stone: Deluxe Edition
summary: The shadow of Frank Stone looms over Cedar Hills, a town forever altered by his violent past. As a group of young friends are about to discover, Stone's blood-soaked legacy cuts deep, leaving scars across families, generations, and the very fabric of reality itself.

name: The Shojing
summary: "SHOJING" is a casual game where you control a cat and break a shoji screen. It's a cat, so it's just about permissible, but humans should never try to imitate this.

name: The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike
summary: The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike combines manga, tactical puzzles, and roguelike gameplay into one thrilling experience. Enjoy stylish pixel-art action while testing your flexible thinking and precise strategy!

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Mississippi Acres Preserve Cosmetic Pack
summary: The contents of this pack are cosmetic only and applicable to all weapons, tents, and ground blinds in the game. They can be previewed in-game for free before purchasing.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Scopes and Crosshairs Pack
summary: Master long-range hunting with new precision scopes and a customizable reticle system designed for superior accuracy.

name: The Outlast Trials: Exotica Pack
summary: Travel the world from inside your cell with the Exotica Pack! The Exotica pack includes an exclusive set of 4 legendary outfits, E.S.O.P.s, cell items, cell posters and player icons so you can customize your horrific journey.

name: The King of Fighters XV: DLC Costume "Classic Leona"
summary:
Leona Heidern Costume for THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV
Leona Heidern's costume can be changed to the costume she wore in "KOF '96".

name: The Fire Nobody Started
summary: This is a train to 21C, via 19C. Passengers will require a valid click to use this service. Passengers are advised that this train consists of 9 cars, divided by each era. Please mind the fire. This train is ready to depart, please stand clear of the fire.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Execution Pack 3
summary: Terrorize the Victims even more with these new, grisly executions for the Slaughter Family! This pack features one kill each for Leatherface, The Cook, The Hitchhiker, Sissy, Johnny, and Nancy. Enjoy the hunt!

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Hands
summary: A distant cousin to the Slaughter Family, "Hands" pushes 7 feet tall and weighs nearly 350 pounds. He's massive, extremely powerful, and can kill you with his bare hands in a matter of minutes. He also has the ability to place electro traps on key objectives, electrocuting any Victims that try to bypass the area. He's a lethal combination of strength and strategy!

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Maria
summary: Maria's disappearance sent shockwaves across central Texas. With little evidence to prove otherwise, many in the surrounding communities started to fear the worst. But deep within the bowels of the Slaughter family's property, Maria was alive, struggling and fighting like hell for survival. However, she soon realized there was something strange occurring. For reasons unknown to her, she was actually being kept alive. It seemed that Grandpa had an affinity towards her, perhaps some type of past connection? Maria wasn't sure why, but she planned to use this vulnerability against the family and escape the nightmare once and for all!

name: The Finals: Metro Drifter Set
summary: The Metro Drifter Set bundle includes: - 1 Legendary Outfit - 1 Legendary Weapon Skins - 1 Legendary Sticker - 1 Epic Emote - 1 Epic Charm - 2 400 Multibucks

name: The SaGa of a Lone Man
summary: A tale of adventure centered around a lone man who has lost his memories, unfolding alongside the companions he meets on his journey. An HD-2D-style fantasy RPG featuring a 3D world and 2D characters. The game employs a simple command-based battle system.

name: The Willowmist Emporium of Antiques & Curiosities
summary: A cozy narrative shop sim where you move to the sleepy town of Willowmist to run your aunt’s antique store. Meet 5 charming love interests and quirky locals—each with secrets to uncover—in a town where nothing is quite as it seems. Buy, sell, and haggle to keep the store afloat!

name: There's a Gun in the Office
summary: You've been kidnapped and have to get out but luckily, there's a gun in the office. Unluckily, your captor comes back home every day, so you have to cover your tracks when you go out of your cell.

name: The Fairly OddParents: Breakin' da Rules
summary:
PC Version of "The Fairly OddParents: Breakin' da Rules"

The PC version features a different plot. In this version, Juandissimo Magnifico tricks Timmy into wishing the book destroyed so that Cosmo and Wanda will get in trouble for it. It also notably features an appearance by Vicky and Tootie's mother (at Timmy's age, as the level featuring her is set in the past), named Nicky. She is shown behaving a lot like Tootie, and Timmy initially mistakes her for Tootie when he first sees her, although the in-game graphics depict her as resembling a young Vicky.

name: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker HD Randomizer
summary: Randomizer mod for the Wii U remaster of Wind Waker by SuperDude88.

name: The Stepfather Remake
summary:
Welcome to the 1920s, an era of jazz, speakeasies, and gangsters with more ambition than brains. In this classic point-and-click adventure, you’ll step into the shoes of Aurelliot, a down-on-his-luck private detective who, drowning in debt and short on clients, takes on a case that seems simple… until it isn’t.

What starts with a mysterious woman and a suspicious job spirals into a tangled web of blackmail, secrets, and absurd situations, where every conversation could hold the key and every object might (or might not) be useful. Inept gangsters, nosy bartenders, and a slew of puzzles await you in this remastered version of the 2003 classic—now with enhanced graphics, a remastered soundtrack, and brand-new voice acting for an even more immersive experience.

name: The Courage of Cordelia
summary: As Cordelia, battle through dynamic dungeons with blasters and magic. Face escalating enemies, dodge traps, and collect powerful loot in fast-paced, randomized arcade shooter runs, each offering fresh challenges.

name: The Fat Cat Fest
summary: Fat Cat Fest is a party game full of minigames and challenges, where funny cats will compete to see who is the fastest and most skillful eater.

name: The Curse of the Howling Woods
summary:
You signed up for a simple job - pull some weeds, make a little cash. Instead, you got bitten by a werewolf, tricked by an old woman, and thrown into a maze of crypts, curses, and questionable life choices.

Now you have two hours to undo your fate before you sprout fur and start howling at the moon.

The Curse of the Howling Woods is a 2D adventure game that blends classic horror tropes, witty dialogue, and cozy but chaotic gameplay. Navigate haunted woods, solve puzzles, dodge traps, and try not to get mugged by a pumpkin.

Features

Cozy Combat – Enemies? One hit and they’re gone. You? Well… hopefully, you’re lucky.

A Maze of Mayhem – Crypts, quicksand, rolling boulders—this forest wants you to fail.

A Cast of Oddballs – Befriend (or avoid) scam-artist Eudora, overly dramatic ghosts, and Tim the werewolf, who insists it was just business.

Survive the night, break the curse, and maybe - just maybe - get paid for your trouble.

name: The Brave Little Pigs
summary: This visual novel follows a group of young pigs who participate in their town's annual race for the first time.

name: The Exit: Liminal Anomaly Horror
summary: Escape the unknown, survive the unseen.

name: The Unholy Priest
summary: Manage a haunted funeral service as a priest in a cursed forest. Bury or cremate the dead, perform exorcisms, fend off demonic possessions, and quiet restless souls. Survive terrifying encounters, maintain sanity, and experience the pinnacle of horror simulation in The Unholy Priest!

name: The Shattered
summary: A fantasy roguelite dungeon crawler, where you decide the powers of your opponents. Overcome randomly generated challenges, create a unique set of skills, and uncover the mystery of your true identity.

name: The Little Pixel That Could
summary: The Little Pixel That Could is puzzle-platformer about a daring pixel on a mission to delete the browser history of its enigmatic owner. Traverse hard drives and firewalls to piece together the fragmented memories of the owner's life.

name: Thanks Tanks!
summary: Design and build an army of tanks to defeat the enemy’s forces in this unique strategy game. Guide your tanks across the war-torn landscape, capturing the enemy’s factories and mines, and laying waste to all they can send against you.

name: The Stare
summary: Step into a nightmare where every level hides a deadly secret. Trapped in a twisted maze of endless corridors and eerie rooms, every door you open could be your last, and every step could lead you deeper into danger. Can you stay calm, solve the mysteries, and find a way out?

name: The Stranger From the Bus Stop
summary: A visual novel inspired of dating sim style and psychological/horror games tropes.

name: The Confinement
summary: The Confinement is a first-person precision platformer. Run, dodge and dash! You are trapped in Confinement, a simulation created by AmokAI. Use your sharp reflexes to overcome obstacles, escape and prove that you are the best at parkour through various levels!

name: Thin Threads
summary: Thin Threads is a first-person psychological horror game about a family's desperate struggle to survive poverty. Step into the shoes of each family member, witnessing their story unfold from different perspectives, immersing you in a truly haunting and disturbing experience.

name: The Running Toaster
summary: Run like a Toaster! Collect slices of Bread and speed up by shooting Toast at the Vegetables!

name: The Bodycam Shooter
summary: Fast, tactical, and relentless—survive the fight.

name: The Harmony Chronicles: Demon Of The Void - Collector's Edition
summary:
Saga continues, Mona is about to travel through dimensions!

After her incredible adventures, Mona, the warrior of Goddess Harmony,
prepares to meet her divine protector before a magic portal transports her to a world on the brink of collapse.
Mona discovers she has arrived at the once-thriving Interdimensional University of Magic, which has become a shadow of its former self.

As the fate of the universe hangs in the balance, Mona embarks on a perilous journey through shattered dimensions,
chasing clues that lead to a terrifying entity devouring everything in its path.

To stop it, she must venture across awe-inspiring worlds, each filled with unique challenges, fantastical creatures, and powerful allies!

name: The New Apartment
summary: A man living in his new apartment finds himself in the center of something much more sinister.

name: The Stamp
summary: Piece together your memories. Reveal the truth. A minimalistic Lovecraftian tale of symbols, sentences, and quiet discovery.

name: The Seven Sisters
summary:
The Seven Sisters is a mini campaign for Thief II: The Metal age comprising a prologue and three missions, taking place across three nights.

As a red moon hangs in the sky, explore a city in the midst of plague and unravel the mystery of the Seven Sisters.

name: The Legend of the Lost Temple
summary: The Legend of the Lost Temple is a platformer that takes place in the rain forest of Peru where an ancient tribe has lived in peace for thousands of year until a group of archaeologists stumbles upon it. The visitors carry a virus that the natives have no immunity to and soon everyone but the young and strong members of the community falls ill. The player takes control of one such young man, Kanu, who sets out to find a temple located deep within a mountain. It is believed that entombed in the temple is an elixir that can save the natives. It is the player's task to find this elixir. Like in other platformers the game involves moving left and right and jumping between platforms while combating a large amount of different creatures (bees, eagles, green men etc.) that stand in the player's way. To kill the enemies Kanu has an unlimited supply of axes (similar to Wonder Boy and Adventure Island) that can be thrown. Other weapons can be acquired by picking up green or blue shields. The green shield gives a mace while the blue shield gives a bolt of magic. Other collectibles include gems that give bonus points and various potions that give increased abilities such as higher jumps, temporary invulnerability, increases fire rate, freeze monsters and provide extra lives. When starting out Kanu has four lives and a limited amount of life blood. Life blood is drained when contact with enemies are made and when it is all gone a life is lost.

name: The Bottle Boy
summary: A 3D Puzzle Platform in which you’ll GO through a rescue mission to reunite a lost puppy with his best friend, who is a fragile glass bottle that enjoys hip hop.

name: The Night of the Exorcism
summary: An unsettling visual novel where every decision shapes your destiny. Face seven diverse, cunning demons in a dark, atmospheric world and uncover hidden truths through multiple branching paths, culminating in nine distinct endings.

name: The Way It Rains on Animals
summary: A short game that takes place in a pet cemetery. Get some umbrellas before it rains!

name: The Pet Squad
summary:
The Pet Squad is a 2D strategy and puzzle game with pixel art aesthetics, mainly inspired by Lemmings, that puts you in the role of a support operator.

The game is set in the not-too-distant future, where humans have managed to artificially evolve animals. The pet squad S.L.U. is an organization responsible for maintaining order between humans and the evolved animals, known as Animanos.

As an operator, you will have to support your squad at all times, guide them along the correct path, and protect them from enemies or themselves. To achieve this, you will have access to the most advanced technology, allowing you to teleport objects and even slow down time.

name: The Voice of Germany: Das offizielle Videospiel!
summary: The Voice of Germany: Das offizielle Videospiel! is a singing party game in which you can become the new The Voice star. You want to have fun with your friends and become the next The Voice great talent, then this game is for you.

name: The Fairly OddParents: Shadow Showdown
summary:
PC Version of "The Fairly OddParents: Shadow Showdown"
Unlike the console versions, which are 3D platformers, the PC version is a point-and-click adventure focused on exploration and problem-solving. It also introduces unique interactions and dialogue with familiar characters, offering a distinct take on the Shadow Showdown storyline.

name: The Barkeeper
summary: A stylized top-down 3D bartender simulator. Your task is to quickly make cocktails & drinks according to recipes in a given time. Success depends on tactics, space planning and your adaptation speed. Ready for the challenge? Then grab your shaker and shake!

name: The Electrifying Incident: A Monster Mini-Expedition
summary: An adorable bite-sized adventure from the creators of A Monster’s Expedition - explore the facility, avoid the live electricity, and repair the malfunctioning reactor.

name: The Flood: Forgotten Exile
summary: As the Battle on Installation 04 rages on between the Covenant and UNSC forces, an evil so terrible lies silently in slumber. In the pursuit of knowledge and power, the Covenant unleash a force that even they fear. As Containment Facilities across Alpha Halo are breached, one in particular is at the forefront of this. On a lone island in the middle of Installation 04's many seas, a facility unlike the others contains something that will make the Flood thousands of times more formidable to combat. A Gravemind lies dormant deep inside the recesses of this vault. The Battle for Installation 04 is about to reach its pinnacle.

name: The Naki Files
summary: Unveil the conspiracies by publishing everything online in this roguelike horror. Type everything manually on the computer, defend your home Home Alone-style, and unload bullets on the Anunnaki trying to stop you.

name: The Lonesome Guild
summary: In a world consumed by loneliness, only friendship can save the day. Lead a quirky cast in this colorful single-player ARPG full of heart, battles, and bonds that change everything.

name: The Shadow of Swallow
summary: "the Shadow of Swallow" is a stylish Chinese side-scrolling action game. Featuring beautiful 3D environments and fluid, acrobatic combat, players take on the role of a deadly female assassin. Experience thrilling stealth action through episodic missions.

name: The Adventures of Badgersaw: Chapter 1
summary: The Adventures of Badgersaw is the only RPG where you can restore your party's MP with a slap. The adventurer Badgersaw and his two companions are lost in a cave full of schizo-tech and nightmarish creatures. They must find their way out, but end up unwittingly unravelling a web of ancient secrets.

name: The Suspense
summary: How might life inside Artificial Intelligence be like? Is it possible to stop this painful routine? This life even real or not? Try your luck...

name: The Last Nordic Tribe
summary: The Last Nordic Tribe is a RPG with survival elements set at the end of Little Ragnarök(536-539 AD), where 95% of Scandinavia's population perished. Survive the frost, battle hunger, foes, and adversity, exploring a brutal world inspired by the early Middle Ages. Will you rise to the challenge?

name: The Wind's Path
summary: The Wind's Path is a fast-paced top down singleplayer game. If you want to stay alive, keep moving. A mysterious force is wreaking havoc in other worlds and only you can stop it. You'll unlock powerful wind abilities that not only make you a force of nature but help you fly through difficult levels.

name: The Brothers Hotel
summary: Welcome to The Brothers Hotel, where shadows whisper secrets, and every corner hides untold horrors. This spine-chilling indie horror game takes you deep into a mysterious hotel filled with eerie atmospheres, enigmatic puzzles, and a story that unveils the dark bond of two brothers.

name: The Second Circle
summary: The Second Circle is a skill-based fast paced movement game. With a unique mix of fast movement mechanics, deadly weapons and powerful abilities all blending together in lethal dance, it is your skill that will prove whether you are worthy to pass the trial or be stuck in the circle of desire!

name: The World Ends in Ohio
summary: Explore the depths of Ohio and uncover a mystery in the Midwest!

name: The Corruption
summary: Explore a decaying digital world and lure its corrupted inhabitants into traps, cascading explosions and the barrel of your grenade launcher.

name: The Void Below
summary: An underwater horror game where you take photos of wreckages in the deep sea. Pilot a submersible vehicle. Locate the shipwrecks with sonar. Get out of the vehicle and take photos while managing your oxygen.

name: This is Kiko
summary: A long time ago, my younger sister and I lived together in a house by the sea.And then, one day—I remember meeting her.Was she a good person? I should have asked myself that question sooner."THIS IS KIKO" is an adventure game set in the modern era.

name: The Thing from Space
summary: A meteorite crater intrigues George, an geologist, due to reports of strange events. He manages to camp there and study the soil, but something outer-worldly happens that night...

name: The Bunker
summary: Trapped in an abandoned bunker, you are alone—your friends locked out, something else locked in. This PSX, VHS-style found-footage psychological horror plunges you into a nightmare of analog terror. Will you unravel the truth, survive the bunker’s horrors, and discover the fate of your friends?

name: The Legend Of Kuro
summary: The Legend of Kuro is a challenging 2D platformer blending precision, captivating storytelling, and samurai aesthetics. Join Kuro on his quest for vengeance against the demons who destroyed his village.

name: The Two Thinkers
summary: A challenging puzzle and platformer game for 2 players. Play with a friend, combine your skills, think logically, and overcome obstacles together to reach the exit and complete each level. Only by working as a team will you be able to overcome every challenge and progress!

name: The Little World
summary: The Little World is a strategy-based tactical game featuring random campaigns, story maps, custom game maps, and custom character creation, with support for multiplayer battles and cooperation.

name: Theurgy Architect
summary: Are you ready to wield the power of creation? In Theurgy City, you are the divine architect. With just a touch, reshape the land and watch as your intelligent citizens build a thriving metropolis around your will.

name: ThrustMe Too
summary: Pilot a lunar lander through 100 unique, alien-infested caves! Rescue astronauts, gather crates, and collect gems to unlock powerful upgrades. Navigate treacherous terrain, face hostile creatures, and deliver your precious cargo to the surface in this thrilling 2D adventure.

name: The Derailed
summary: The Derailed - a first-person psychological horror game.

name: The Tale of Relm
summary: A story-rich JRPG that weaves a tale of adventure and magic, paying tribute to the enchanting worlds and epic journeys of the early Final Fantasy games.

name: They Live in the Fractures
summary: David finally finished his time machine and will be able to stop time and venture to the unknown realm of frozen time. But one should not go and play God.

name: The Last Caretaker
summary: The Last Caretaker is a thoughtful take on the survival-crafting genre, where every decision you make and every action has a consequence. Immerse yourself in a meticulously crafted world where the fate of humanity rests in your hands. Your mission is clear: recover human seeds, reactivate the Lazarus Complex, and launch the last of humanity to the stars.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Aragorn's Quest
summary: The PlayStation 2 of the game is different from the Wii and PS3 version in several ways. For example, they lack a co-op mode or the free-roam Shire over-world. However, it includes an arena mode not featured in the Wii and PS3 versions, and levels set in Caradhras, at the Gates of Erebor (including a battle with the Watcher in the Water), and in Dunharrow, areas not found in the Wii/PS3 versions. This version is played from an isometric three-quarter top-down view, and is more of an action role-playing game, featuring stat-management and experience points to spend on special abilities. The Wii/PS3 version does not feature any kind of stat-management or experience points, save for the above mentioned ability to collect items to improve the attack and defense of characters.

name: The Bear: A Story from the World of Gra
summary: Home is where the stars are. An interactive bedtime story, for anyone who needs one. Take the bear and the little one on a deeply meaningful journey, as you experience stories of togetherness, of letting go and of finding a place you belong.

name: The Wall
summary: Defend the city, Fight the dead. In this fast paced zombie wall defence game set in a neon cyberpunk world, you must man the wall, upgrade defences and build robots and turrets. Face relentless waves of undead as you hold out as long as you can. Its not about if the wall falls its about when.

name: The Night of Escape
summary: The Night of Escape" is an indie game personally crafted with themes of fear, escape, and decryption. Players take on the role of an escapee, constantly dodging danger and utilizing clues found to survive and flee. The game adopts a first-person perspective, immersing you in the experience.

name: Thousand Lantern Lane
summary: On a dreary, rainy night, you and your girlfriend find yourselves lost in a desolate Japanese-style town. The streets are empty, with only the sound of rain tapping against old tiles and stone pavements. It is said that this town harbors ancient secrets.

name: The Empty Desk
summary: Dive into a psychological thriller filled with adventure and puzzles, with touches of horror. Join Detective Bennett on his final case and unravel dark secrets in a world where reality twists and sanity crumbles.

name: The Well: Episode 1
summary: The Well is a single-player, psychological horror game with a deep story and different puzzles. Hide, escape and make the right choices as you solve the terrifying mystery of the wells created in World War II. There is no exit from the wells in this village!

name: The Moth Inside Me
summary: A short dream simulation game.

name: The Last of the Survivors
summary: In "The Last of the Survivors," prepare for zombie battles filled with adrenaline, blood, and realistic physics. Arm yourself and prove your survival skills.

name: The Lonely Architect
summary:
The Lonely Architect is a 2D atmospheric platformer that delves into the subconscious of an overworked architect struggling with isolation. This debut game from Odaro Eguavoen, solo developer behind Ekosodi Games, started off as a demo which won a Top 25 Finalist position in the ‘Safe In Our World’ 2024 Game Jam.

Using a series of eerie spaces and landscapes, a desolate atmosphere becomes the backdrop to this minimalist game.

name: Through the Edges
summary:
Step into a world divided by the enigmatic Spheres, where different races live under strict balance – a balance that has never been questioned… until now.

As the protagonist, an ordinary young person from a remote village, you receive an unexpected invitation to a grand ball. What seems like a stroke of fate soon turns into a revelation of hidden anomalies, ancient powers, and a secret that could shatter reality itself.

But you are not alone.

Meet intriguing characters from various races, each carrying their own secrets, struggles, and desires. Will they become your allies, rivals, or something more? Your choices will shape their destinies – and your own.

name: Three in One
summary: Ready to have some fun? This bundle brings together three games released by Yume Game Studio so far for this platform, with a special discount.

name: The Pools
summary: Anomalies await you in the shadows of The Pools.

name: Thin Line
summary: A short time before fading away.

name: The Golden Tile
summary: Build a thriving city on a hexagonal grid in this unique deck-building game! Buy cards, collect resources, balance upgrades, and unlock relics to enhance your strategy.

name: Three Kingdoms Mushouden
summary: Set on the eve of the Yellow Turban Rebellion (AD 182), you can play as an original character or a historical warlord, building forces and forging alliances. Whether you choose to be a lone wanderer or rally famous generals, use your knowledge and wisdom to reshape history!

name: The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy: Billy the Kid
summary: A Cartoon Network fighting game featuring characters of The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy.

name: The Sorrow of Gadhlan' Thur
summary:
Legend has it that an ancient orc king called Gadlhan' Thur, conquered much of the known world thanks to the help of a powerful magical object.
But the power of the object turned against him and ended up losing his tribe and everything he loved ...
They say he died alone, drowned in an unbearable sadness.
Since then that object is known as "The Sorrow of Gadhlan 'Thur"

The game is finished and there will be a short first batch of 25 cartridges. A second batch will be made in 2 months or more since there are no more 2048k cartridges available at the moment.

The game is an ACTION-RPG of exploration and open world where we will find objects and weapons that will give us new skills and allow us to explore more areas of the enormous mapping.
The villagers will give us clues and sell us objects, the monsters that populate the province will hunt us as soon as they see us, while we look for "The Sorrow of Gadhlan 'Thur".

name: The Final Fragment
summary: A coming-of-age visual novel with GxG romance elements set in a Ukrainian arts academy. Nina tries to keep the trouble at bay. But when a mysterious incident occurs at the academy, will she muster the courage to confront the things she's been running away from?

name: The Charity Shop
summary: An adventure game where you must use your camera to capture the essence of a life lived. To this end, you have been delivered before The Charity Shop, the place where people donate unwanted belongings—each carrying an imprint of the time they once shared.

name: The Bat
summary:
Master Bryce is throwing a party. As his most faithful servant, that means it's your job to make the party run smoothly. But you only have two hands—and far too many duties. You'll have to manage requests from the guests, the master's eccentric demands, and your own composure. All the other staff have quit, unwilling to entertain the master's "moods," but you've served Wyatt Manor for decades; what's one more evening?

A comedy of errors, mild frustrations, and major workplace-safety violations. With limited actions and a limited inventory, juggle hors d'oeuvres, flaming curtains, and radioactive elements—and keep the drinks coming!

name: The Test: Reality Check
summary: The Test: Reality Check is one of multiple installments in an ongoing social experiment that can be classified as an atmospheric, psychological-simulation with horror elements. Dive deep into your own psyche to find answers to questions you've kept locked away, hidden from yourself for far too long.

name: The Impostor
summary: Would you recognize a human? The Impostor is a social deception game where players pretend to be an AI.

name: The Host
summary:
You are a police investigator who recently lost your position, until rumors about a murder that occurred in 2013 convince your boss and lead you to investigate the Reed family home, the main location of the crime.

You just weren't ready for the secrets of the house.

name: Thunder Tiger
summary: Thunder Tiger is a fast-paced side-scrolling shoot ’em up, blending 1980s arcade style with futuristic flair. Blast enemies, grab power-ups, and chase high scores in intense 2D stages. Classic retro vibe meets modern gameplay!

name: The Way of the Tray: Japanese Restaurant Simulator
summary: The Way of the Tray is a waiter simulator with action puzzle elements in a Japanese spirit world setting inspired by Ghibli studio films. Your task is to master the skill of serving dishes and earn the trust of yokai patrons. Will you be able to prove yourself and find your way home?

name: The Last Camp
summary: This is a top-down survival-building game blending farming, tower defense, and micromanagement, requiring you to fend off zombie hordes, grow crops, and strategically deploy traps to defend your homestead.

name: The Artifactory
summary: The Artifactory is a chaotic couch co-op party game set in a whimsical fantasy lootbox factory! Craft potions, forge weapons, and experiment with recipes to fulfill unpredictable orders. Fix broken machines, survive moving platforms, lava, and more! Play solo or with up to 4 players!

name: The Pharody
summary: ARPG about the medieval inquisition. With a view from the 3rd person. Ridicules (parodies) the RPG genre. 18+ as it contains references to alcohol, erotica and rude conversations

name: The Concept
summary: The Concept is a VR action-adventure set in a timeless laboratory where an unknown artifact has disrupted reality. Solve intricate riddles and engage in realistic, physics-based gameplay.

name: The Unrested
summary: The Unrested is a story-driven first-person horror game. A spirit from your past traps you in an abandoned boarding school. A shadow watching your every step will test you with puzzles while forcing you to confront your fears.

name: The Werewolf
summary: The Werewolf is a thrilling survival game where you transform into a bloodthirsty beast under the full moon. Hunt and eliminate victims to satisfy the curse—fail, and it consumes you instead. Will you embrace the monster within or struggle to survive the night?

name: The Dream
summary: A dystopian, open-world shooter set in a simulated Barcelona of 2033. Survive, explore, and uncover the secrets of the metropolis while earning data tokens. Engage in intense battles or form alliances to survive.

name: The Sisyphus Journey
summary: What happens after death? We don't know. But we know what will happen to Sisyphus. Take this journey and find yourself in it. Will you save yourself or others? We will find out when the stone wiil be at the top.

name: The Peacemakers
summary: The Peacemakers – A cinematic single-player FPS set in a war-torn galaxy. As an elite soldier, fight rebels, corporations, and ancient alien threats across hostile planets. Use advanced weapons and your drone to restore order. Peace has a price. Are you ready to pay it?

name: The Overlap
summary: The Overlap is a survival-cosmic-horror 2D sandbox. Explore procedurally generated wastelands, scavenge resources, craft, build, customize and upgrade your survivor, face eldritch horrors, survive the post-cataclysmic world alongside friends online and find out the truth behind it all.

name: The Survivor
summary: Manage your failing ship, evade lurking horrors, and navigate the galaxies to find the Lunar Star Base. With limited oxygen, dwindling power, and unknown terrors closing in, every decision is life or death. Will you make it home—or be lost forever?

name: The Abbess Garden
summary: Cozy third-person gardening in 1643 France. As Agnès, restore a forbidden abbey garden, grow and identify real plants through the seasons, uncover a spy plot, help the community, and find romance.

name: The Untitled Tower
summary: When you woke up in the basement of the tower, you were on a mission. In order to prevent this world from ending like this, you I have to go to the princess in the tower, but...

name: The World Eater & Probiotic Hero Dungeon of Roguelike
summary: "The world eater & Probiotic Hero Dungeon of Roguelike" is a roguelite action where you uncover world mysteries using the power of Probiotics.

name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
summary: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

name: Thysiastery
summary: Thysiastery is a dungeon crawler RPG featuring traditional roguelike and turn-based gameplay. Command a party of bearers of the Brand, drawn into a vast Labyrinth. Recruit while exploring the Labyrinth in hope of finding a way out, and its secrets will be revealed as you delve deeper.

name: The Quest for Achievements
summary: Dive into The Quest for Achievements, a charming pixel-art mini RPG where the thrill of the game meets the satisfaction of collecting. Prepare for an unprecedented achievement hunting experience, unlike any other RPG adventure!

name: The Ultimate Clicker Master of the Universe
The Last Tape
summary: A hidden truth. For over 50 years, Lurmont has been hiding incredibly dark secrets from the public. During an investigation, tapes are discovered showing all the atrocities they have committed.

name: The Vampire's Bride: A Bride Who Gets Married to Vampdoll
summary: A visual novel game featuring a pure love girls' love story bound by blood, with the concept of "Vampires x Military Uniforms x girls' love (yuri) ."

name: The Ringing of Twilight
summary: Navigate through various levels as you search for artifacts. But you must listen to your surroundings, for an invisible entity draws ever closer...

name: The Legend of the Vampire
summary: Legend of the Vampire is an RPG style game with anime visualization. In the game, you have to play as one of the vampires or paladins who fights against vampires. You will be able to fight with friends and other players, get a pet, find a companion and propose to her. Choose a mage, archer, or swordsman character type and go in search of adventures and new friends.

name: The Last Human Touch
summary: A short bitsy game about a time-traveller in their final moments.

name: The First Descendant: Season 2
summary:
The First Descendant Releases Season 2 Episode 2 Update ‘Beyond The Void’

As Season 2's story expands, Descendants embark on missions in the newly introduced Sigma Sector—a once-unknown land concealed by the Void Storm. Following the destruction of the Iron Heart, the Descendants discover a crucial clue in this area while tracking Karel.

During their operations in Sigma Sector, Descendants uncover evidence of Vulgus' experiments on Arche holders. This episode also marks the significant reveal of Dia, the daughter of Gley, whose whereabouts had remained a mystery until now.

Additionally, the episode introduces Serena, one of the original Descendants who vanished 100 years ago. As Karel’s plans begin to unfold, a new enemy faction emerges—the Obliviant, a unit of Descendants who have fallen under Vulgus’ control.

With the introduction of Sigma Sector, new key characters (Dia and Serena), and the Obliviant, Episode 2 deepens the story of The First Descendant’s expanding universe.

name: The Past is Present
summary: "The Past is Present" is a breakout-inspired game where your objective is to survive as long as possible. Blocks at the top of the screen will fall down and increasingly gain strength. While you can level up and gain a stronger ball, you have another resource with time travel which is gained through clearing blocks. When time traveling, the map will reset to the stated time but you will also run into your past self, if you are hit by your other self's ball you will get a game over also but if they get hit by your ball they will be defeated.

name: The Bard’s Tale: Warlocks of Largefearn
summary:
The Bard’s Tale – Warlocks of Largefearn is a groundbreaking Audio RPG developed by the team at Polar Night Studio. With large amounts of player freedom, contextual interaction between the player and the world and an engaging & strategic turn based combat system – Warlocks of Largefearn is aiming to set the standard for Audio RPG’s.

With 4 playable classes, each with their own Subclass and Specialties, several companions and a myriad of puzzles, dungeons and quests that will challenge you this will be the fully audio-scaped adventure of a lifetime!

name: The Bard's Quest: Dungeons of the Unknown
summary: This is a NEW VGA/MCGA 256-color RPG game from VisionSoft! You must unravel the secrets of the mysterious dungeons of Isil Thania and discover the ancient Star Light Cult! So real you'll be playing for hours!

name: The Bard's Lore: The Warrior and the Dragon
summary: Welcome to the mystic world of THE BARD'S LORE. Deriving from the Bard's Tale series, it takes you into the limit of adventuring. If you can beat Grendel, you will truly prove yourself to be a worthy adventurer! But there are some major monsters out there, just waiting to take a bite out of you...you must use all your cunning and wits to solve this one.

name: The Bard's Lore II: The Dark Tower
summary: Welcome to the mystic world of THE BARD'S LORE. Deriving from the Bard's Tale series, it takes you into the limit of adventuring. If you can beat Grendel, you will truly prove yourself to be a worthy adventurer! But there are some major monsters out there, just waiting to take a bite out of you...you must use all your cunning and wits to solve this one.

name: The Crew: Motorfest - Year 2 Pass
summary: Expand your adventure with exclusive new PvE gameplay and a total of 20 new vehicles. The Year 2 Pass includes: The Chase Squad Experience, with an exclusive playlist and new open world challenges. Hunt down all your rivals and unlock 7 exclusive Chase Squad vehicles. 13 new vehicles via monthly drops: 2 vehicles available at the launch of Year 2, and 1 new vehicle added every month.

name: The Hollow Line
summary: Can you escape the tunnels? An AI-powered buddy is following you as you discover the seemingly never-ending network of tunnels. Get ready for a personalized and unique experience at The Hollow Line.

name: The Beacon's End
summary: You play as Samuel, a solitary lighthouse keeper on the remote Blackstone island. Tasked with a daily routine trying to forget his haunting past by maintaining the lighthouse beacon to protect passing ships, Samuel is unaware that underneath the island lurks something very sinister.

name: The Quest
summary: The Quest was the first video game released on the Skulduggery Pleasant Website. It involved trying to follow Gordon Edgley's clues.

name: The Munchkin Army
summary: The Munchkin Army (tentatively known as The Quest Part 2) was the second video game in the Skulduggery Pleasant series. It involved helping Mr. Bliss in defeating Dark Gods.

name: There Is No Lore
summary: Collect Cards, build Decks, alter with Trinkets, discover Synergies, win Locations, beat Bosses. All this and more await you in this roguelite deckbuilding auto-battler, but please remember - There Is No Lore, stop looking.

name: The Catastrophe
summary: Set off into space on your personal spaceship and rescue all the lost catstronauts! Navigate through flying obstacles while managing fuel and health. Don’t forget to watch your ship’s weight — it affects your maneuverability. Enjoy a relaxing gameplay experience with pixel art and cozy cosmic vibes!

name: The Trail: Reign of Apocalypse
summary: We were cut off from heaven hundreds of thousands of years ago. Since then, the corrupted soul of an evil god has wrought constant terror and destruction upon us. Will you be able to defy the prophecy and finally save the Overworld from its endless cycle of evil?

name: The Way of Knight
summary: The Way of Knight is a chess-like puzzle game about the journey of Esroh the knight. You pilot the heroes through various enemies, boards, hazards, and stories.

name: The King's Courier
summary: Life can be tough as a medieval courier. Explore a colourful environment as you plan your daily deliveries, select cards to help optimise your route and purchase upgrades to increase efficiency!

name: The Balldragon
summary: A short parody of everybody's favorite japanese cartoon.

name: The Light of Celestia
summary: The Light of Celestia is a story-driven action-adventure featuring intense combat and mystical exploration. Step into the role of Zoe, a destined protector bound to ancient magic, as she unravels the secrets of Eldoria. Confront dark forces, uncover lost truths, and embrace the light within.

name: The Fall
summary:
Discover [The Fall], an intense arcade experience where you take on the role of a free-falling adventurer in an infinite universe!

In this endless runner game, every second is a battle against gravity. Skillfully dodge a series of unpredictable obstacles to extend your descent and beat your high score.

name: The Throng
summary: An online frog-based game where survival is not guaranteed, so be ready to hide, run, and laugh.

name: The Whispering Woods
summary:
Detective Lukas Berger is investigating the sudden disappearance of several residents from a remote village. Clues are scarce until he receives a call from his colleague John: an abandoned house deep in the forest might hold the key. But as Lukas arrives, he quickly realizes that something is not right. Dark shadows, unexplainable noises, and an eerie presence await him.

Explore the mysterious house in this first-person horror game and face the unknown. Solve challenging puzzles and uncover the truth behind the disappearances – but beware: some secrets are better left undiscovered...

name: The Deep Creep
summary: The Deep Creep is a dynamic stylized first-person shooter. Choose one of 3 unique game modes and defeat all enemies in this dungeon!

name: The Thread of Fate
summary: Explore the territory of the factory, where everything went wrong after an unknown incident. But be prepared - you've been shrunk to tiny size, and now you must fight creepy mutants lurking in the shadows to survive.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Fallen Banners
summary:
Gather your party for two challenging new PvE dungeon experiences: Lep Seclusa and Exiled Redoubt. Unlock new achievements and earn new rewards including item sets, collectibles, and more as you fight to preserve what little peace remains in the war-torn region of Cyrodiil.

Lep Seclusa

The Moth Priests of Lep Seclusa are besieged, and the cunning Orpheon the Tactician is set on seizing the power of the Elder Scroll they safeguard. You must help Sister Chana defend the sanctuary against an army of deserters, protect its people and secrets, and confront Orpheon before he can use the power of the scroll to forever change the face of Cyrodiil.

Exiled Redoubt

Soldiers of the Alliance War, regardless of their faction, are vanishing, and all trails lead to the Imperial fortress known as the Exiled Redoubt. Team up with the Battlemage Lucilla, infiltrate this mysterious stronghold, and put a stop to the schemes of a once noble Imperial house before its chaos can spread beyond its stone walls and throughout Tamriel.

name: The Pale Piper
summary: Uncover the truth behind your death and your sibling’s in a story-driven precision platformer inspired by the Pied Piper myth. Navigate a decaying, interconnected world where movement is your only defense. No combat, only precision, consequence, and secrets hidden in the dark.

name: The Exorcist: Gravebound Horror
summary: Can you survive the wrath of the vengeful spirit?

name: The Purging
summary:
The Purge was created under 48 hours for the Ludum Dare #22 compo.

Its complete, has 9 levels, 6 enemies and a boss.

name: Threaded Dungeons
summary: Solo-developed, unforgiving dungeon crawler with turn-based, party-based, permadeath combat. Discover truths and treasures in a long-since-doomed world. Customize your party to fit your playstyle. Grapple with grief and mortality. Explore, despair, overcome.

name: They Built a Railgun!?
summary: A short kinetic novel about a girl finding out her friends built a railgun.

name: The Last Memory of a Burning Thought
summary: Find what you need to find in this "Deskvania" style game!

name: The Maid
summary: The Maid is a first-person psychological horror and mystery game that focuses on creating fear and tension in the player.

name: The Dark Delivers
summary: Welcome to Postal Sector 7. As the Night Shift Package Inspector, your job is simple: assess parcels and reject anything not up to code. Stay alert for anomalous dangers and survive long enough to meet your quota by 6AM.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D Randomizer
summary: Randomizer for the 3DS remake of Ocarina of Time by gamestabled and many contributors.

name: The Great Gonzo’s Ridiculously Dangerous & Downright Foolish Stunt Game
summary: Watch the all-new movie “Muppets Most Wanted”, in theaters March 21, and see how many points you can score before you run out of stars!

name: The Ramen Sensei 2
summary:
Noodles, soup - easy! Think again!

Get your apron on, it's time to learn about the complexities and wonders that is ramen. Have what it takes to become a noodle legend? Or will you end up as just another dime-a-dozen soup-slinger?

But why stop at one restaurant? Embark on Ramen Odyssey, conquering one region after another with your mouth-watering creations. It's world domination by ramen!

Win over lots of customers at ramen festivals, which you can play together with friends.

Face off rivals at ramen arena contests and make your Ramen Hall prosper. Become THE Ramen Sensei!

name: The Dragon Odyssey
summary:
Embark on a grand adventure in a land steeped in legend and magic. Join forces with other players to reclaim your rightful place among the heroes of old!

Experience top-tier AAA gaming right at your fingertips. Dive into a world of dragons and legends with just a tap. Whether you play for minutes or hours, The Dragon Odyssey offers an unforgettable adventure.

Go solo or team up with friends to defeat colossal foes! Battle swarms of enemies or engage in epic player-vs-player clashes to prove your valor! Explore a vast and enchanting world!

name: The Séance of Blake Manor
summary: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

name: The Primrose Theater
summary: A short love letter to 2013 Unity horror games. Inspired by games like The Theater and Kuro Oni.

name: Thieves
summary: Thieves is a 2D platformer for DOS created in 1997 by Duncan Gill. In Thieves, you play as one or two thieves tasked with hunting down and stopping a witch who is terrorizing the town.

name: The Lost Dino: Survival Expedition
summary: The jungle hides more than predators.

name: The Electric State: Kid Cosmo
summary: Kid Cosmo needs your help! Blast through an '80s-inspired puzzle adventure game-within-a-game alongside boy wonder Chris and his big sister Michelle.

name: The Last Bunker
summary: A "60-Seconds" like scav-survival game. Collect food and water, trade, and defend your bunker. How long can you survive?

name: The Hole to Hyrule
summary: Mario has fallen through a hole transporting him to the land of Hyrule.

name: The Barnhouse Killer
summary: A 4 player horror card game where you have all been kidnapped by a serial killer out of Arkansas and forced to play against each other in a card game, it’s a round based card game where you bid how many hands you think you will win in that round, if you get your bid incorrect a saw Infront of you moves closer until someone is the last man standing.

name: Thorn: Knight of the Fifteenth City
summary: A hyper skill expressive metroidvania

name: The Yellow Sign
summary: Worlds brought to life by H.P. Lovecraft and R.W. Chambers combined in the form of a pixelart point&click game. As Solomon Hill, investigate the mysterious death of your twin brother and an ancient plot to bring back the lost city of Carcosa and its resident Hastur, known as the King in Yellow.

name: Therapist Simulator
summary: As a psychiatrist, journey into the minds of your patients. Make tough decisions, uncover hidden stories, and strive to maintain your mental well-being.

name: The Ball Pit
summary: after visiting the local mcdongs, you want to play in the play area, however this will be the worst mistake of your life. the ball pit is home to one of the most horrific entities on the face of this earth, and you get to meet him.

name: The Blue-diamond Damsel in Distress
summary: A strange letter came to the girl's hand, pointing to a vicious robbery and murder in Qinshan Port City more than a decade ago. Li Meiyuan, a 17-year-old female high school student, lives in depression and delusion all the time. She almost excludes everything around her.

name: The Marbians
summary: A colorful 2D mascot game where you guide a clumsy alien through short, fast-paced levels filled with traps and puzzles. Tap or swipe to jump, dash and activate gadgets as you rescue Marbians, collect stars and unlock quirky costumes.

name: The Ancient Magus' Bride: Midsummer Pilgrimage
summary: A visual novel based on Kore Yamazaki's The Ancient Magus' Bride manga

name: The Haunting Of Stabbey Road
summary: Discover the dark secrets of a once renowned recording studio.

name: The Unknown
summary: Aboard a small spaceship, you embark on an exploration, daring to face the threats of the universe. Activate your spaceship and uncover the hidden secrets of this vast cosmos.

name: The Dark West
summary: The Dark West is a grim ARPG reimagining the genre with deep player agency, innovative systems, and and a fresh take on player progression. We're crafting an experience that blends cutting-edge gameplay within an engaging and immersive world.

name: The Lingering: Last Customer
summary: Devi, a 27-year-old young woman, books a late-night massage at Ahola Spa & Reflexology—the only spa that is still open.. What should have been a relaxing escape turns into a lingering nightmare…

name: The Ballad of Bellum
summary: Take a magical adventure in a world with beautiful tilt-shift effects. Explore dungeons, win powerful items, and defeat bosses! But why? This delightful world isn't as simple as it looks.

name: The Secrets of the Forest
summary: The Secrets of the Forest is a casual puzzle game where the main objective is to find the best way to go past the enemies and obstacles of a forest full of secrets.

name: The Great Emu War of 1932
summary: The Great Emu War Of 1932 is a fast paced top-down shooter based on the famous failed emu cull in outback Western Australia.

name: The Atlas Mystery: PC Edition
summary: Explore the haunted halls of the infamous Atlas Theater, a 1940's era movie palace that played host to a shocking Hollywood tragedy. Solve intricate puzzles, discover startling artifacts, and evade sinister forces to uncover the twisted truth behind the theater's dark history.

name: The Midnight Town Stories: Matt's Nightmare
summary: Get ready for a psychological horror journey where uncovering certain truths might be scarier than staying in the dark.

name: The Untold Legends: Baba Yaga
summary: The first in a series of exploration/horror games giving a new twist on old legends. Follow the clues and stay on the trail or navigate the open world and choose your own path, but beware, the actions you take may alter your ending. Unveil the story while evading the clutches of Baba Yaga.

name: The Doors That Led to Nowhere
summary: "Wake up lost in a void of darkness. With no other option, press onward through cryptic dimensional doors, wielding a mysterious blade created by the fallen entities that came long before you in this heart-pounding First Person RPG."

name: The Remnants
summary: Want a Third-Person, fast-action, 3-way control support shooter? You came to the right place. Good job.

name: The Pilgrim's Progress
summary: Join us in "The Pilgrim's Progress," an epic journey inspired by John Bunyan's classic. Follow Christian's path to the Celestial City, exploring stunning environments, solving puzzles, engaging in strategic battles, and experiencing themes of faith, redemption, and perseverance. Support our vision!

name: The Adventures of Penny & Lou
summary: Step into the paws of two brave shar-pei sisters on a daring mission through Stray City. This captivating 2D platformer whisks you away on an adventure with Penny and Lou as they strive to rescue their cherished toys and lend a helping paw to stray puppies in need.

name: The Hypnic Chain
summary:
The Hypnic Chain is a “dream emulator” based on imagery, situations, and environments that have been known to haunt the developer's dreams.

Inspired by LSD: Dream Emulator, its successor Yume Nikki, and the extended family of RPG Maker horror.

name: The Unlit Sun
summary: The Unlit Sun is a psychological horror game played from a first-person perspective, delving into the boundaries between consciousness and the unknown. Trapped in a distorted world shaped by a mysterious entity named Nyctarion, Ethan struggles to escape a dark reality forged by buried secrets and enigmatic symbolism. In an atmosphere filled with tension and looming danger, every decision draws the protagonist closer to—or further from—his fate. Uncover a deep and unsettling story where light and darkness are two sides of the same power.

name: The Descent VR
summary: The Descent VR, a horror walking sim in Rockwell Mine, immerses players in miners' harsh life and unsettling mine encounters. Play as an investigator uncovering a hometown mystery.

name: The Broken Republic
summary: Lead the Oken Republic with up to 7 friends in this co-op strategy game where you must balance diplomacy, resource management and personal ambition to secure your re-election as the sole president.

name: The Fog
summary: Explore the land collecting lanterns in a desperate attempt to survive the thick, evil fog in this atmospheric platformer.

name: Three Wishes
summary: Have you ever wondered what the three little sisters of the famous Lilypads get up to in their free time? Find out in this Lilypad Lily spinoff adventure full of headpats, plot twists, and silly hijinks!

name: Thoko
summary: Thoko is a thrilling single-player first-person shooter platformer that combines fast-paced action with innovative movement mechanics. Dive into a world where precision, speed, and agility are your greatest allies. Master advanced techniques such as strafing, BHOP (bunny hopping), and surfing.

name: The Adventure of Pixi: The 3 Stones
summary: A humorous adventure of epic proportions, spanning 1 fully open map, 2 worlds, and (more than) 3 colors! The Old Man gives Pixi a quest: find the 3 stones and use them to restore the colors! During her adventure, she will have to cross dungeons, another world, and maybe even face... herself.

name: The Legend of Fartacus
summary: A free 2D precision platformer. Help Fartacus to fart his way to victory and find the big treasure!

name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria - Ent-craft Pack
summary: Grow new inspiration from the great tree-herders of Middle-earth with the Ent-craft Pack! Strap on an all new, quite Ent-ish cosmetic armor then dig into more ways to decorate your base.

name: The Rumble Fish: Complete Pack
summary: A bundle pack of The Rumble Fish + and The Rumble Fish 2 games. The bundle will also include three additional characters for The Rumble FIsh 2. Additional characters can be purchased separately, so please be wary of purchasing the same character multiple times.

name: The Zombie Neighborhood
summary: Shoot zombies to relieve stress and go back to sleep. Nothing like a peaceful life in the countryside... Forgetting that they were once people helps ease the anxiety. It feels less guilty blowing the brains out of a "non-human".

name: The Jester
summary: A first-person psychological horror game with a VHS effect. Something lives in the shadows and feeds on your fear.

name: The Last Bloom
summary: Margarete receives a letter from Veronika, her kind neighbor, saying she’s ill. Concerned, Margarete decides to visit, but the journey is challenging due to her blindness. Now it’s time for you, her trusty four-legged friend, to guide her and help her reach Veronika’s house.

name: The Curse of Town
summary: The Curse of Town is an immersive story game in the single-player horror, puzzle and adventure genre. Solve puzzles and save the town from the curse!

name: The Gallery
summary: The Gallery is a first-person puzzle game where every painting holds a secret. Explore a mysterious art museum, solve observation-based riddles, and unlock new rooms by deciphering clues hidden within the artwork. Will you uncover the truth behind the gallery?

name: The Void Corridors
summary: The Void Corridors is a first-person puzzle horror game where you navigate a maze-like environment, solve intricate puzzles, and manage limited resources to survive.

name: The Waitress
summary: You are a waitress and your job is to serve the client! Try to take orders as quickly as possible! Don't forget to clean the tables!

name: The King of Fighters Wing
summary: Unleash your fighting spirit in The King of Fighters Wing! Choose your fighter, master epic combos, and become the ultimate champion.

name: The Seventh Floor
summary: An atmospheric horror sandbox, will you be able to free yourself from The Seventh Floor?

name: The Third Pig
summary: After your brothers are killed by Mr. Wolf and a mysterious associate you wake up to find yourself trapped in your own home and must use your wits and determination to escape. Do you have what it takes to escape?

name: The Auction Game
summary: A game where you have to guess the prices of paintings sold at auction.

name: The Earth Sucks
summary: A casual space simulation game where you perform orbital manoeuvres on satellites to change their orbit and complete missions.

name: The Mnemograph
summary: A strategy game that combines deck-building, card-based combat, deduction, and management, all set in a steampunk world of press and crime. Build a unique deck and manage your printing factory to create the city's most influential newspaper.

name: Those Who Know
summary: Those Who Know is a clicker game where you click the Beez and get "TWK" Tokens to get more power and become God. God is dead and this is all that's left. Might as well do something. Coming soon for free!

name: Thirst
summary: Viktoria Kopernik, an occult influencer, solves the puzzles and uncovers the story of the Thirst cafe.

name: The Last Gift
summary: Here is a short story about little Lisa, who wants to congratulate her mother on her birthday. But the child has no money for a present. Lisa has to look for ways to earn money for a present all day. But is there any sense in this? Maybe the girl shouldn't strain herself so much for such a mother?

name: The Meowfficer
summary: You play as a cat in the police force, talking with your allies, fighting in intense gun fights, unraveling the lore, and making moral decisions.

name: The Mindvasion
summary: What's more frustrating than watching an army of monsters fail to wipe out humanity? Take control of a minion and turn the tide in a roguelite survival game. Just died? No problem—another creature is ready to be possessed. Keep the carnage going and make sure humanity meets its end!

name: The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood
summary: He is back. Once again take control of mass serial killer John Wade. Six years later, the infamous Pale Grin resurrects from the grave to terrorize the broken town of Happyhills. This time he has more on his mind than simple killing.

name: The Shepherd's Stand
summary: You are a lonely shepherd in an archipelago of islands. Your sheep have been scattered in various islands, bring them all back to you.

name: Three Sisters
summary: Three Sisters is a goofy RPG featuring some cute little (not nightmare inducing) enemies and a story where nothing bad ever happens! Wait, what's that? You played the other games? crap.

name: The Sixth Sorrow
summary: Things haven't felt right since the accident. Your mother's passive aggression, your father's refusal to speak, and strange things around the house... Are they unable to move on, or is something even more sinister lurking beneath the surface?

name: The Forgotten Village
summary: The Forgotten Village is a Fantasy Simulation RPG. Arrive in a rundown Village with nothing but the shirt on your back. Clear the land, Gather Resources, Help the Villagers and Earn new Tools to aid you in restoring the Forgotten Village back to its former Glory!

name: The Black Ice
summary: In a remote and mysterious research facility in Antarctica, an intense atmosphere of fear and death hangs in the air. In horror "The Black Ice", players find themselves exploring this haunting place alone, solving puzzles and fighting to stay alive as they face the chilling unknown.

name: The Bright Path
summary: "The bright path" is a 30 minutes long educational interactive computer game for Windows which you can use to familiarize yourselves or your students with the topics of dangers of drug abuse and active citizenships in your communities.

name: The Junkyard
summary: Explore a network of tunnels that lead to several different rooms. There are various creatures to frighten and hinder you, which grow stronger and more numerous. Defeat bosses. Experience the dramatic and mysterious plot of the life of Joseph, the main character, but be careful not to go mad...

name: This is the last time
summary: This is the Last Time is a minimalist first-person narrative game with a dark and heavy atmosphere.

name: The Station
summary: After a long day, you take the subway home. The train is late, but everything seems normal—until the doors close. Among the passengers, one man starts acting strange... There's nowhere to run.

name: Thrae
summary: Thrae is a cozy crafting adventure game, where you play as a bunny on their path to become the Legendary Easter Bunny! Build relationships, Craft, Decorate & Deliver Enchanted eggs to heal your friends of the forest!

name: The Far Kingdoms: Spooky Mosiacs
summary: You need to prepare your Kingdom for a spooky celebration. Solve puzzles to find gold coins and buy decorations. Solve all the puzzles and find the missing Dracula costume for the Elven Prince.

name: The Far Kingdoms: Magic Mosaics II
summary: The dark magician has returned to threaten all the kingdoms. He has created an evil army that no one can resist. You must solve all the mosaic puzzles to locate the dark crystal. Only by destroying it can the dark magician be finally defeated.

name: The Ransom of Atawallpa
summary: An Adventure in Edutainment

name: The Snake Kingdom of Gennibar-Six
summary: The Snake Kingdom of Gennibar-Six is a surreal MMO-styled retro rpg you can play alone or with others as you travel a strange domain to encounter its secrets and slay its bizzare inhabitants.

name: The Infernal Abyss
summary: Face the nightmares of the main characters and find a way out of this hell.

name: The Bean Trials
summary: In The Bean Trials, join your friends in competing to see who is the best! Play in over 20 different minigames all while trying to top the Leaderboards! Talk in text or voice chat with other beans while you complete challenges, win to earn coins, and unlock over 100 unique items for your bean!

name: The Case of the Dark Strangler
summary:
