The Dark Strangler has been killing the victims of the bizarre "black lightning incident," and the cops refuse to do anything about it...

It's up to private investigator Magnum Johnson to save the day, aided by his trusty companion Gizmo!

Fly your hat around! Shoot homing missiles! Replace most of the oxygen in a room with lead! All that matters is that justice is served!

name: The Story Goes On Chapter 1
summary: A party of fearless adventures investigate a special cave, filled with dangerous creatures, monsters and wonders.

name: The Story Goes On Chapter 2
summary: The party explores the Sunken Citadel, a ruin tied to the chaotic forces they’ve been tracking, braving spectral warriors, a cursed Sea Lord, and a collapsing structure to retrieve a powerful artifact. Their journey leads them to the foreboding Veil of Shadows, where they face shadowy beasts, trials of combat and persuasion, and traverse into the Shadow Realm itself. There, they uncover a shard of primordial light but provoke a mysterious force, setting the stage for a perilous escape and new challenges ahead.

name: The Story Goes On Chapter 3
summary: The party explores the Sunken Citadel, a ruin tied to the chaotic forces they’ve been tracking, braving spectral warriors, a cursed Sea Lord, and a collapsing structure to retrieve a powerful artifact. Their journey leads them to the foreboding Veil of Shadows, where they face shadowy beasts, trials of combat and persuasion, and traverse into the Shadow Realm itself. There, they uncover a shard of primordial light but provoke a mysterious force, setting the stage for a perilous escape and new challenges ahead.

name: The Story Goes On Chapter 4
summary: The band of adventurers confronts chaos spreading across realms after an ancient artifact is shattered, unleashing dark forces. As they navigate treacherous landscapes and face enigmatic guardians, they strive to restore balance by gathering fragments of primordial power. Their journey pits them against sinister foes and tests their unity and resolve, with the fate of their world hanging in the balance.

name: The Story Goes On Chapter 5
summary: The party ventures into the Labyrinth of Echoes, a ruin amplifying their inner emotions, to retrieve a mysterious artifact. After overcoming shadowy clones of themselves, they acquire an orb, unwittingly freeing the Shadow Lord, who vows vengeance. The ensuing battle delays the Shadow Lord's full return, but the party must now seek guidance from the Seers of Vahlara, as a cloaked figure reveals their journey is far from over.

name: The Story Goes On Chapter 6
summary: The heroes narrowly escape the collapsing Temple of Lumina, but their victory is short-lived as the corrupted crystal destabilizes, opening a rift to the Shadow Realm. Entering the Shadow Lord’s domain, they confront his growing power, ultimately shattering the crystal—only to inadvertently unleash him. Guided by a mysterious Keeper, the party embarks on a perilous journey to recover the Shards of Eternity, fragments of creation needed to restore balance across collapsing realms.

name: The Coffee Shop Collision
summary: The Coffee Shop Collision is a story of humor, ambition, and personal growth, showing how even a messy beginning can lead to something beautiful.

name: The Elevator Breakdown
summary: The Elevator Breakdown follows Sophie, a marketing executive, and Ryan, a consultant, who unexpectedly connect while trapped in a malfunctioning elevator. Initially bonded by small talk and shared career frustrations, their paths cross again when Ryan is assigned to audit Sophie’s department. Professional tensions rise as Sophie’s job security is threatened, but Ryan’s integrity leads him to defend her work. As they navigate workplace challenges, mutual respect blossoms into romance, proving that unexpected setbacks can lead to meaningful connections.

name: That Village
summary: As the village of Yugra forgets its past, the power of an ancient community awakens once more. Twelve objects, as part of a ritual, lead the villagers toward a dark future. Galip embarks on a journey to stop the magic and uncover its secrets.

name: The Dinner
summary: In 1950, a war veteran living in a house that should feel like home is haunted by eerie hallucinations and a suffocating sense of dread, and must fight to keep his sanity intact. The horror is more real than it seems...

name: TheSilentSnowfall
summary: The Silent Snowfall is a first-person horror game.Embark on a dark Christmas journey where the silence of a winter night hides blood-chilling secrets.

name: The Last Meadow
summary: April Fool's game published by Discord in 2025

name: Throne of Marrow
summary:
Throne of Marrow is a platforming roguelike featuring cosmic horrors and a world that constantly changes to conquer.

Throne of Marrow puts you in control of Benjamin, one of the recently reanimated dead. In your quest to seek an audience with the royal family, you must survive against a horde of monstrosities.

Experience smooth combat designed to keep you, the player, in complete control of your actions.

Death still signifies progress. During each run, you will encounter permanent upgrades to make each subsequent run easier.

name: Thief Snatch & Run
summary: Steal smart. Move fast. And remember — the cake is worth it.

name: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy - Digital Deluxe Edition
summary: A deluxe set containing The Hundred Line -Last Defense Academy- base game, digital art book, and digital soundtrack.

name: The Coma: Triple Threat Bundle
summary: The Coma: Recut After spending all night studying for the last day of Sehwa High’s final exams, Youngho has an eerie dream. He arrives at school the next morning and learns someone tried to commit suicide in school the night before.

name: The First Berserker: Khazan - Deluxe Edition
summary: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pell Los Empire, who overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

name: The First Berserker: Khazan - Deluxe Edition Upgrade
summary: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pell Los Empire, who overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
summary:
Travel across vast fields, through forests, and to mountain peaks as you discover what has become of the kingdom of Hyrule-and step into a world of discovery, exploration, and adventure that's been upgraded with performance enhancements in The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition! With improved framerates, faster load times, and enhanced resolution and textures, this thrilling open-air adventure has never looked better!

The wilds of Hyrule make for a puzzling game of survival. Climb cliffs to scope out a destination; then cross great distances with the Paraglider or the horses you've tamed. You'll discover items for crafting, beasts to hunt, and plants to forage. Scavenge weapons and armor...or claim them from enemies! From hammers to helmets, items have specific stats, resistances, effects, and levels of durability. Use everything at your disposal to find and conquer more than 100 shrines. Luckily, the in-game Sheikah Slate can project Runes that manipulate objects and enemies in clever ways.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
summary:
In this sequel to The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, you’ll decide your own path through the sprawling landscapes of Hyrule and the mysterious islands floating in the vast skies above. Can you harness the power of Link’s new abilities to fight back against the malevolent forces that threaten the kingdom?

Now with 240 additional voice memories in the Zelda Notes mobile app, you can experience the game with additional lore!

name: The Duskbloods
summary: An online multiplayer PvPvE game where players vie for supremacy among themselves and against challenging foes. Play as the "Bloodsworn"; a group that has transcended human strength thanks to their special blood, and throw yourself into a violent fray for "First Blood" as the twilight of humanity approaches. The moontears will flow for one and one alone.

name: The Longest Tale
summary: Uncover a forgotten legend as you venture through mythical realms. Play as four heroes bound by a mysterious fate. Explore ancient ruins, outsmart deadly foes and solve arcane puzzles. Each path you take reveals a piece of The Longest Tale.

name: The King Of FIghters XIV: Nightmare Geese Costume
summary: The playable character 'Geese Howard' has turned into a 'nightmare zombie', coming back from the dead as 'NIGHTMARE GEESE'.

name: The Great Coffee Caper
summary: A cute and cozy RPG where it's up to Detective Hootsworth to figure out who stole the town's coffee beans. Uncover clues in fast-paced clue battles, question the charming townsfolk, and figure out hoooo dunnit!

name: There Was Something In That Room
summary: Move through the rooms of the lab in this short but replayable horror game. Debug the computers in each room, watch out for errors, and fix sabotages. Make sure you always know where you are... and where other things are.

name: The Curse of Karlanrik
summary: A gothic retro FPS metroidvania where you find new guns and movement techniques to uncover more of the secrets and history of Castle Karlanrik

name: Thalassomania
summary: Thalassomania is a PS1-style 4-player multiplayer psychological horror. Stranded on a derelict ship, you and your friends must navigate, repair, and steer the ship home while evading the lurking terror that is onboard with you. Can you survive, or will you become a lost soul in the sea’s abyss?

name: The Photographer
summary: You are a crime scene photographer who needs to take pictures of the criminal case involving the Edwards family. The house where it occurred feels eerie and you already know that there is something that does not want you to be here...

name: The Froglings
summary: Grow your community of froglings by gathering resources, upgrading buildings and building cute homes to live in! As night falls, protect the colony from raiding robots using the hero and towers ready to defend your new home.

name: The Basement's Calling
summary: Escape the basement, but something will try to stop you.

name: Threads of Karma
summary: Lin Yue'an embarks on a journey home, but unsettling events soon disrupt her ordinary life. Strange dreams, lost memories, and eerie occurrences lead her to uncover hidden truths. Can she trace everything back to its true origin and escape the net of fate that has already been woven around her?

name: The Designer's Curse Chapter 2: Forgotten Horrors
summary: An unmissable survival horror experience with satisfying physics, haunting ambience, and terrifying encounters. Can you escape the horrors of Shaw Well Manor?

name: The Batman: The Cobblebot Caper
summary: The Batman: The CobbleBot Caper was a Macromedia Flash Toonami game that was available to play on cartoonnetwork.com beginning in 2005.

name: The Door
summary: “What if every door you opened was a window into your own mind?” Welcome to The Door, a captivating narrative game where exploration and reflection are at the heart of the experience.

name: The Dark Rites of Arkham
summary: A macabre ritual murder puts Arkham PD detectives Jack Foster and Harvey Whitman to the test. As the investigation progresses, they will unveil a disturbing connection between the Salem witch trials of the 17th century and the end of humankind.

name: The Odyssey
summary:
The Odyssey is a fun Macintosh-only RPG from David Larkin, a lone programmer. The game harks back to the olden days of Ultima IV, when RPGs were played from a bird's eye perspective, and offered a deceptively complex gameplay that would last for months on end.

In addition to a neat plot based on Greek myths and an intuitive interface, The Odyssey offers many cool features that are not usually seen in commercial RPGs—let alone shareware games. The game uses a unique and realistic conversation system that is reminiscent of Ultima VI, and offers a fast and furious combat system that is easy to learn, but requires strategy not unlike the Bard's Tale games to succeed. The writing is strong throughout, and the plot is captivating enough and different enough from dime-a-dozen fantasy fodder to maintain your interest.

A shareware game, the steep $25 fee for the registered version unfortunately got you nothing other than a hintbook. The shareware version for download is already a complete game, although some puzzles will make you wish you had that hintbook nearby.

name: The Voyage Sinister
summary: The Voyage Sinister it's a Gothic story with an investigative and mystery element, set in a Victorian-inspired world. While a JRPG at its core, the game is also a mixture of Visual Novel and Adventure Game.

name: The Spike Cross
summary:
A volleyball game made by an actual volleyball club player!

"The thrill of spiking in volleyball. Why don't you try it out?"

The volleyball game made after numerous trial and error to contain the appeal of volleyball!

name: The Harmony Chronicles: Cat Out of the Bag - Collector’s Edition
summary: Help Mona save the kingdom old kingdom!

name: The Revanchist
summary: The Revanchist is a first person survival horror game featuring punishing combat and inventory management. Investigate a mysterious numbers station and its connection to the disappearance of a loved one. Explore depths forgotten by time, and uncover why some things should stay buried.

name: The Tower of Mimi
summary: Explore the Tower of Mimi floor by floor and try to reach the top! Endure games forced on you by Mimi, resident strange funny animal. See if you can survive... ohoho~

name: The Terror At Freddy's
summary: The Terror At Freddy's Is A FNaF Fan Game Where You Need To Survive All Nights And Complete Challenges And Full Game.

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 11
summary: The pack is back! The Jackbox Party Pack 11 transports your game night with 5 new mind-bending party games. Battle monsters with team-based trivia, sleuth through social clues, destroy wholesome jokes, create the kookiest of cookies, and noise-make your way through endless timelines of fun!

name: This is Interesting
summary: This is Interesting is a psychological horror narrative based game with roguelite elements. You are being watched, and you aren't really sure why. Delve through the depths of memory to uncover the mystery behind the gray purgatory you find yourself in.

name: Throw Home
summary: (This game was created as both a proof of concept and game design showcase) A 2D action showcase for players new to video games.

name: Throweat Area
summary: A arena FPS multiplayer game, were you can collect lot of items around you and throw EVERYTHING on other players or eat EVERYTHING to regenerate your health.

name: Through
summary: Through is a multiplayer arcade hack and slash with social cooperative mechanics in which players face challenges in different dungeons to reach the exit.

name: ThrillKings
summary: THRILLKINGS is a fast-paced Arena FPS with a set of weapons and movement inspired by games from the early 2000s. Compete in classic and new game modes, dominate your enemies through a variety of maps with unique traversal mechanics, and become the ultimate King.

name: Three Sheets
summary: Arcade sailboat racing for all! Take the helm of an offshore racing sailboat in beautiful and challenging waters. Race through the checkpoints and reach the goal before time runs out!

name: Three Kingdoms: Strategy MOBA
summary: Fast-paced war strategy mobile game, 7 days per season, North vs South

name: Three Doors: Labyrinth of Fear
summary: Trapped in darkness, you've lived in fear for as long as you can remember. Now, thirty rooms stand between you and freedom. Each one holds a deadly challenge, but only one path leads forward. One wrong step, and you're lost forever. Open the door!

name: Three Against the Odds
summary: Three Against the Odds is a base defense fantasy roguelike. Build your amphibian hero(es) and settlement as wave after wave of enemies descends from bordering terrain that you can terraform. Play through three campaigns, conquering the shadowy powers that have corrupted the world of Primeva.

name: Thief Office Simulator
summary: Simulation game where player mission is to steal as much money, jewelry etc in different places and avoid guardians and cameras

name: The Yapori Clicker
summary: Yapori Clicker is a Clicker game where you need to keep clicking Yapori to level up and unlock skins, get coins, armor and more

name: Threat: Scream and Escape
summary: THREAT -SCREAM AND ESCAPE- is a unique horror game where you must scream into your microphone to stun approaching creatures and make your escape. Use the power of your voice to clear the path and guide the protagonist, who wakes up in a mysterious research facility, to freedom.

name: The Wungo Dungo Surprise
summary: The Wungo Dungo Surprise is a physics based local 1v1 fighting game, with no combos or roster, just 1 simple enemy to beat repeatedly. The main moves are punching, kicking and dodging, and some extra tools, a few weapons and powers.

name: The Wild Outback
summary: The Wild Outback is an arcade top-down shooter game in a Wild Western setting. It's a single player game where you join cowboys in the fight against an alien invasion of mutant animals and lazer-firing robots!

name: The Void Chronicles Chronis
summary: Every decision matters. It’s a race against the clock in a story where paranoia, creativity, and courage are your only allies. Will you break the loop, or will time break you?

name: The Viewer's Game
summary: Defeat HUGE waves of enemies as Bob, The Viewer's Game is a very satisfying but hectic game where you can Shoot, Burn, and smash into hundreds of enemies and bosses! Each run you get to choose a Class for Bob and discover what each subclass and unlockable weapon does!

name: The Very Brief and Meaningless Adventure of Hero Man
summary: Help Hero Man save the world of Somewhere from a terrible evil ... or do nothing of the sort if you so please in this small, satirical RPG!

name: The Valley: XuGu
summary: The Valley: XuGu is a casual deck-building roguelike game that blends Taoist alchemy with cyber technology. Players can combine herbs based on their grades and elemental attributes to create unique alchemy recipes and refine distinct elixirs. These pills can help those who enter Xugu.

name: The Tunnels
summary: The Tunnels is a procedural maze environment, where everyone loses except grief What can only be the final truth is a mirror showing us what remains of our humanity. There is, however, an end to reach in this hallway.

name: The Trio
summary: The Trio invites you into a world shrouded in mystery and danger. By day, gather resources and reinforce your shelter, but as night falls, sinister creatures rise from the shadows, driven by a dark curse. Survival becomes a desperate fight against cursed creatures that stalk the land.

name: The Tower of Aether
summary: Welcome to the Tower of Aether—a labyrinth filled with countless doors, At the heart of this Tower lies the Heart of Aether, an artifact of unimaginable power, coveted by all who enter. But only one player will emerge victorious, claiming the ultimate prize.

name: The Time Traveling Toxicologist
summary: Travel back in time, investigate a murder, and prevent it from ever happening!

name: The Tale of: Bubble Boy
summary: Help Bubble Boy reach the highest mountaintop in the Alps by moving him upwards inside his giant soap bubble, but don't let the bubble pop, or you will fall, all the way, back down...

name: The Story Is You: Look Within
summary: A freely navigable and open first-person real-time 3D reflective experience. Come see what you see in you. Explore a beautiful and immersive environment that touches on lots of areas of life. See what resonates.

name: The Stairway
summary: A 3D parkour game through the memories of a life. The goal is to reach the top, sometimes the way forward is not obvious.

name: The Rose of Cravenmor
summary: A gothic short story set in the most Blighted city of the North Kingdom.

name: The Ritual
summary: The ritual is a third person survival horror game. You have been hired to find out how a school began crawling with demons. Search the school for information. Run. Scream. Shoot. And remember don't get caught.

name: The Prison
summary: Dive into The Prison, a modern reimagining of the classic late 90's game. Experience a vividly detailed prison world and strategic multiplayer gameplay. Customize your inmate, follow a gripping storyline, and discover new items and secrets. Will you escape or rule from within?

name: The Pancake Paradox
summary: The story of two women, who make pancakes in the middle of a sandstorm, even though the planet is dying. is a bit short, right? ...then a story that has a little more than that.

name: The Nutcracker of Riepass: A Nymph's Tale - Episode 2
summary: A fantasy comedy hybrid visual novel with jrpg battles

name: The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing II: Extended Edition
summary: In the second part of the unfolding Van Helsing saga that could also be enjoyed independently, you can explore new corners of this unique world and experience the mix of old-school gothic and mad science, with more action, powerful foes and plenty of stunning places to visit.

name: There's a Gun in the Office + Fig. bundle
summary: Two games, two completely different worlds — one goal: get out. In There's a Gun in the Office, you’ve been kidnapped and must quietly plan your escape.

name: The Count of Monte Clicker
summary: The Count of Monte Clicker is an incremental game about breaking out of prison and finding treasure. With the help of fellow prisoner Abbe Faria, you, Edmond Dantes must escape the notorious Chateau d'Idle and claim your destiny.

name: Three Kingdoms Front
summary: This is an idle text game based on the Three Kingdoms. As the game progresses, the system will randomly trigger various events, and automatically trigger various military commands and various internal affairs facilities according to different development situations.

name: The Game of Bionic Goat
summary: The Game Of Bionic Goat is a suspenseful story-oriented adventure game in which you manipulate the main character to interact with the scene and game characters, advancing the story through communication and choices with other characters.

name: The War Zone Crisis
summary: The War Zone Crisis is a third person shooting game for online online combat on the Internet. The game supports remote online games through the steam platform. In the game, players play the roles of red and blue teams of anti-terrorism special forces。

name: The Ninth Forset
summary: This game is designed for Ninth Games' VTuber Kuiri Lulu's birthday. Players will take on the role of Kuiri Lulu, who receives a mysterious invitation on the eve of her birthday. She wakes up in a foggy forest and must find the correct path to reach her birthday party.

name: The Museum of Hauntology
summary: The Museum of Hauntology stands as a monument to a future that never was. Featuring counterfactual digital artefacts drawn from an alternative 1970s that did not quite happen. The work is intended to prompt contemplation of the recent past and the type of future in which we now find ourselves.

name: The Most Perfect Revenge in the World
summary: I made one request to the devil, to make my teacher suffer for what he did...

name: The Mad Pantser
summary: The Mad Pantser is more than just your typical survival horror game. It’s a tongue-in-cheek, point-and-click journey filled with unexpected twists, mini-games, and a healthy dose of satire. While you may find some creepy moments, this game isn’t about making you sleep with the lights on—it’s about keeping you on your toes and laughing out loud.

name: The Lost Desert
summary: The Lost Desert is a online multiplayer shooter game is made in the Blitz3D game engine. It works on basically any PC hardware with windows on it. It is mainly for windows 95-98 but works on XP and above to 11.

name: The Losers Team
summary: Lu Yunjie, a junior high school student, annoyed the school bully group by accident. But he also got a powerful superpower unintentionally. With this power, he challenged the bullies, triggering a series of funny events

name: The Lighting Ages
summary: RPG adventure game where player mission is to find skulls to finish levels and also accomplish different quests and avoid enemies

name: The Library
summary: It's a very simple game where you can escape from the library on the 8th floor!

name: The Legend of Tomoko
summary: In this game, you have to defeat various monsters that have invaded the village and the nearby forest. Can the villagers return? You can use swords, cast wateR and Fire magic. reading this description carefully could be strong weapon to defeat your enemies.

name: The Last Farewell
summary: This game is a hidden object puzzle that combines story, psychological horror and reality.

name: The Hunting!
summary: The Hunting! is a turn-based strategy RPG focused on managing and developing new heroes. Train your heroes so they are ready for the final battle.

name: The Human Test / Restart
summary: Two games in one! - Prove you are not human by completing 9 impossible challenges. - Explore various scenes directly inspired by a poem, solving a few riddles along the way.

name: The Horrors at Castle Wülhein
summary: Take the reins as the renowned psychic detective, Taylor Lafosse, in this interactive horror novel. Unravel the dark secrets buried deep within the mysterious Castle Wülhein.

name: The Grave Keeper
summary:
You have been hired to manage a graveyard in the mountains for 10 days.
The company that hired you says you're supposed to take care of one task each day, working during the day for three days and then at night for the next three days.
And if you notice anything out of the ordinary, you are to return to your quarters immediately and report it to the company by phone.

After reporting the anomaly, you're told you can go to sleep without doing any work.
But be careful, you shouldn't call the company if nothing unusual happened.
Beware, if you fall asleep without finishing your work or reporting anomalies, you'll be stuck with a day that never ends.

name: The Future is Ours
summary: You're going to spend 3 days at summer camp! Explore the camp, do camp activities and get to know your fellow campers as you learn about LGBTQ+ issues and more in this storytelling adventure. But, a dark secret awaits

name: The Friendly Droppets
summary: The Friendly Droppets is a simple physics based puzzle game. Take your time. Rotate and position the Droppet and let it fall.Fill the gauge to move to the next level and try to collect a new item in each level.

name: The Dreamscape
summary: Explore The Dreamscape with the help of Statan Industries and their tech, as you venture into The Range to experiment with different Scapers and items!

name: The Dragons' Twilight III
summary: Join Trace and Mila as they unravel the mysteries of Mystrift Isle. Dragons have suddenly reappeared, and magic has returned to the land! Life, while peaceful and prosperous, had become complacent, but now, adventure awaits!

name: The Doors
summary: This is a gambling and exciting clicker for memorization and luck. Click on the doors and collect all the crystals before the time runs out. Roll the dice. It will open the randomly dropped number of doors. Remember what's behind them, open others at your own risk.

name: The Devil Ball
summary: It is a 3D game whose story revolves around a world where its people are magical orbs surrounded by magic and wonders, ruled by the Celestial Orb Kings.

name: The Depths of Avalon
summary: Join Arthur and Merlin in The Depths of Avalon, a cooperative top-down dungeon crawler where you solve puzzles and battle enemies to thwart the dark plans of Morgan La Fey.

name: The Dangerous Back-to-School Season
summary: The Dangerous Back-to-School Season is a pixel RPG where players guide the protagonist through cybersecurity threats . Using dialogue choices and mini-games, players must help the protagonist make the right decisions to ensure a safe enrollment.

name: The Cursed Hour
summary: "The Cursed Hour" is a cooperative survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion to find cursed relics and exorcise the supernatural. With every wrong move, the ghost gets more aggressive, forcing players to work together before fear and darkness consume them.

name: The Cube of Love
summary: The Cube of Love is an enchanting blend of strategy, creativity, and romance, where you become the ultimate matchmaker.

name: The Crimson Call
summary: Set in a post-apocalyptic dystopian future, two young men set out on a journey to find The Great Appearance which manifests itself inside mankind's mind.

name: The Door
summary: This is a short horror game that does not include anything other than "opening doors" and "walking." There are no elements like ``escape from monsters'' like in traditional horror games. Just listen and walk.

name: The Butterfly Collector
summary: investigate the evidence left by a stalker and kidnapper and track the fate of a college girl. The player advances and watches the plot by clicking to make choices for the heroine at key moments, with different choices leading to different endings.

name: The BreakFive
summary: In 1421, the seemingly peaceful Ming Empire is actually rife with undercurrents. As the capital relocation project progresses, numerous forces across the realm are beginning to stir. A massive conspiracy is quietly brewing, and the facade of peace and tranquility is about to be torn apart.

name: The Black Knight Chronicles: The Widow without Time
summary: The Ancients left us with many secrets that should have stayed hidden...

name: The Big Adventure
summary: Explore an entire fantasy world, explore Cat City the beating heart of cats, defeat small or huge bosses, also remember to give Astra some cookies or a cup of Tè before you leave.

name: The Beyond
summary: Your death was a tragedy... your afterlife is a mystery. Unravel the secrets of death with the help of Xochitl, your guide. Can you find your way through the doors of the great library of the Beyond? A new choose-your-path comic book by Jason Shiga.

name: The Backrooms: Anomaly Containment Unit
summary: A first-person horror game with bodycam gameplay and tight controls. Explore the eerie, randomly generated Backrooms, catch anomalies, solve puzzles, and face atmospheric horror. Survive endless corridors in this intense PC survival experience.

name: The Armed Shadow
summary: Shadows are the most dangerous creatures in the world

name: Through the Wall
summary: Through the Wall is a idle game made in two weeks as a fun challenge to help a friend learn how to make a hentai game. The game is short and compact but it has some cool animations paired with some good SFXs.

name: The Road To Druaga
summary: Dragon Buster and The Tower Of Druaga collide into this new adventure across a total of 80 levels. Collect loot, face giant monsters and save the world from the evil Druaga!

name: The Calling
summary: The Calling is a team-based PvP shooter where players can assemble a squad of their favorite live-streamers and battle for dominance. Featuring a growing cast of both new and popular streamers (including 2 established Twitch Partners), this game is built by streamers for streamers and their fanbase.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Aragorn's Quest
summary: The NDS/PSP ports features slightly different HUD, and the NDS version uses the second screen as a map.

name: There's No Santa: The Extra Presents
summary: Enjoy the 5 extra festive levels

name: The Pane Puzzle: The Real Challenge DLC 1
summary: 50 new levels on a refreshed set of shapes

name: The Pane Puzzle: The Real Challenge DLC 2
summary: 50 new levels on a refreshed set of shapes

name: The Last of Them
summary: You play as a detective solving gruesome murders in a haunting, desolate city. Explore dark alleys, uncover hidden clues, and solve puzzles to unravel the mystery. Can you find the killer before they strike again, or will you fall victim to the terror?

name: The Nightmare of Pandemic: Kyle's Story
summary: Kyle wakes with a headache unaware he has survived a helicopter crash in Nannestak Norway. Alone on a farm he suddenly finds himself in a space suit. A flash of light transports him back to a mission he must complete. As he progresses he experiences flashbacks uncovering pieces of his lost memory,

name: The Undergrounders
summary: Play as Jack in this first-person thriller where your choices determine his fate. Uncover dark secrets, solve puzzles, and navigate a world of mystery and emotional drama to save yourself and your daughter.

name: The Horde Wants You Dead
summary: The Horde Wants You Dead is a casual, top-down shooter with 4-player online co-op. Ambushed by an angry horde, you and your friends face a fight for survival against thousands of relentless enemies!

name: The Last Oath
summary: The Last Oath is a short story based game about a knight that fell in in battle fighting for their king. You find yourself with a final task to keep your oath to the king. Complete this task as you find out more about the world by interacting with the environment through text based dialogue.

name: The Room in a Glass Box
summary: Escape a captivating diorama! Rotate, zoom, and solve puzzles to find the key. Explore a miniature world and unlock its secrets!

name: This Is Not A Love Letter
summary:
Your name is Wilbur Soot.

You don't technically have an invite to this party, but technicalities have never kept you out of Las Nevadas. The air is cool, the night is young, and a hand penned letter is burning a hole in your pocket.

name: The Litter: Trigo
summary: A playful way to learn trigonometry, with quirky characters and interactive challenges.

name: The Greenening
summary: The Greenening is a short and wholesome incremental journey about exploring and reawakening a forgotten world. Wash away the ashes to discover the secrets hidden beneath, upgrade your versatile watering abilities, and grow your own cozy space garden.

name: The Battle Orks
summary: The Battle Orks is a fast-paced strategy game that combines deck-building mechanics with real-time PvP combat. Summon your Orks by pulling levers, and watch the battlefield come alive! Trigger three matching symbols to unlock an additional powerful hero—deploy them wisely to crush your enemies!

name: The Massive Iceberg Schoolhouse
summary:
While you were on YouTube, you found a series by Sweguin called Massive YouTube Iceberg Explained where he explains every entry on the Massive YouTube Iceberg (obviously), and it apparently has 1000+ entries. Not only you absolutely loved the series, you wanted to look at more massive iceberg charts like the one in that series. Eventually, you heard that the iceberg's creator, Potted Plant, is making an internet iceberg with 5000+ entries. So just like any sensible person would, you developed a parasocial relationship with him and constantly DMed him on Discord to see the internet iceberg.

A few days later, Potted Plant told you that he just opened a schoolhouse in Thailand where there's not just one, but TEN iceberg charts you can get there, so you immediately booked a ticket to Thailand and travelled to his epic schoolhouse to collect all iceberg charts he made. However, there's a little catch! Potted Plant set it up so you have to answer questions about iceberg charts before retrieving them, and answering incorrectly isn't exactly the best idea in a Thai school. Not only that, he's also brought his whole gang (most of it somehow being entries from his YouTube iceberg) to stop you from collecting all of his icebergs so easily, so you must be careful!

You could either get all 10 of the iceberg charts and exit the school, or you could dive deeper into the iceberg schoolhouse and research some of its interesting anomalies...

name: The Green Way: Farming Simulator
summary: Transform a small plot into a thriving farm in The Green Way, a 3D farming simulation game where you grow crops, expand land, sell produce, be a good farmer and upgrade your lifestyle. Design unique lands with houses, markets, and more to build your farming empire and achieve rural prosperity.

name: Thomas: The Shank Engine
summary: A horror game mimicking a VHS-styled movie based on Thomas the Tank Engine, intent on haunting the player.

name: The Night Museum
summary: The Night Museum needs a night clerk. The job is simple: take the money, give the tickets, and keep the exhibits under control. Just follow the rules, and you’ll make it through the night... probably.

name: The Last of Us Complete
summary: Go back to the beginning and experience the award-winning games that inspired the TV show, as the definitive editions of these two iconic titles are brought together for the first time in one complete collection.

name: The Last of Us Complete: Collector's Edition
summary:
Edition Includes;
• Steelbook Case with physical discs of The Last of Us Part I and The Last of Us Part II Remastered
• Left Behind prequel chapter
• The Last of Us: American Dreams Comics #1-#4 with new cover art
• Set of four lithographic art prints
• Thank You letter from Neil Druckmann

name: The Mushroom of Shadow
summary: You will play as a mushroom that has gained the power of Shadow, absorbs damage, then bounces attacks back to enemies, uses their life energy to spread spores, and finally conquers the world

name: The Soul
summary: The Soul is a story about a hunter of monsters that hide among humans. This project confidently erases the line between the player and the protagonist.

name: The Demonized
summary: The Demonized is an action adventure idle RPG where you play as a hero, who embraces the devil's power to fight the evil forces that are threatening the world. Equip powerful gears, trade with the demons to unlock souls that grant monstrous power, fight challenging bosses, manage resources through Dominion, and take down terrifying bosses on your own or join forces with others in this great battle to save the world from demonic monsters.

name: The Adventures of Detective Donut at Shao-Lu Temple
summary: Detective Donut is at the sacred Shao-Lu temple, which preserves the ancient martial art of Kung-Funghi. Complete the objectives to progress through the ranks and win the coveted black belt! Oh, and watch out for the wasps...

name: The Lost Myth
summary: The Lost Myth is a captivating RPG inspired by the golden era of 16-bit classics. Dive into this turn-based role-playing adventure and immerse yourself in an epic story as you journey across the vast continent of Ancaria to uncover "The Truth".

name: The Ungrateful Son
summary: Back in January of 2022, Robert Dorman released a video on Art Carts. He asked the question "What would a book look like on a Game Boy". I was inspired by this thought and the end result is this - "The Ungrateful Son" by the Brothers Grimm, adapted for the Game Boy.

name: The Pool Invasion
summary: Use your arrow keys to balance the tower from the first level and for the other levels. Zack and Cody are at the pool and because they got bored they decided to play some funny games that will also get them points. Help Zack and Cody get through every level of the game without their mother seeing them and without getting punished.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: 2025 Premium Edition
summary:
Get the 2025 Premium Edition to experience all ESO adventures in one place and begin your journey in the world of Tamriel. Includes the Base Game, 2025 Content Pass, and all eight previous Chapters.

In a direct sequel to ESO's main story, the Worm Cult is back and seeking revenge for its past defeat. Help unite the Three Alliances against an old foe.

With the 2025 Content Pass, experience four new content updates plus a cooperative in-game event that will change the world of Tamriel!

name: The Void
summary:
Explore the depths of the universe and uncover it's terrible secrets.

Imagine combining the Alien and Lovecraft in one universe.

name: The Royal Writ
summary:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honor the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of diverse warriors with interesting abilities that shape your strategy. Lead an army of adorable yet battle-hardened animals. Your ranks may comprise a frail and wounded flamingo, a short sighted chicken bowman, or even a crafty lizard who cheats death by only losing its tail! From the renegade red ants to the food taster cow, every card in your deck has a personality and purpose.

As they march toward glory or death, their individual stories become part of your kingdom's legacy, and their sacrifices will never be forgotten. You may even come across some peculiar creatures on your journey, like the crazed mantis dentist, the goat tactician or the impatient boar shopkeeper - just don’t ask them where they got their credentials.

name: The Flying Car
summary: The Flying Car is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

name: The Boba Teashop
summary: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to grow your business.

name: The Edge
summary: Trapped on a drifting boat in the open sea, uncover a chilling mystery as you follow a distant vessel that slips further away while you get closer to the truth.

name: The Truth of a Snowy Night
summary: This is a single horror game that collects the horror stories of people who have climbed Everest. Play it if you want to have a similar experience to them, or if you think you can handle it. You never know where the truth lies in extreme horror.

name: The Beast of Lycan Isle: Collector's Edition
The Flowertest
summary: Welcome to Mr. Nose’s Flowertest, the ultimate challenge for master florists. Six contestants enter, but only few will win the chance to survive and be the best in town. Do you have what it takes to craft the perfect scent?

name: The Shochu Bar
summary: The eleventh game released by Gotmail, in collaboration with SG lab. The player must solve a mystery in a shochu bar.

name: The Stickman
summary: The Stickman is a movement-based FPS where you're a stick figure! Explore a plethora of customization options and have a whacky time with friends in PvE or PvP! Solo-Developed by a modder with way too much time on their hands

name: The Monkey King: Flying Dojo
summary: As Sun Wukong, you are called upon to conquer the mystical Dragon Valleys. With your enchanted staff in hand, you'll smash through orbs of power and face off against dragon guardians in this arcade VR adventure.

name: The Circle Move
summary: Explore a strange and mysterious world and challenge your mind with intricate puzzles with The Circle Move.

name: The Infinity Road
summary: The Infinity Road is a classic-style game where you control a car, dodge traffic, and avoid crashing to chase the highest score. An endless runner where the road never ends!

name: The Heretics
summary: The Heretics is a 2D bullet-heaven roguelike game. Wield various weapons, slaughter swarms of crusaders and angels, collect their souls, upgrade your skills, and purchase new items to become even stronger. Survive and fulfill your vengeance.

name: ThePlaneWar
summary: This game is a casual aircraft-themed game that supports online multiplayer battles. We sincerely invite all players to give it a try.

name: The Mirror's Edge
summary: "The Mirror Edge" is a first-person horror adventure game set in the urban landscape of Hong Kong. The story follows a young man who arrives at his sister's residence to uncover the truth behind her mysterious disappearance. However, his journey takes a bizarre due to a series of unexpected events..

name: The Soul Driver
summary: Grab your hat, get into your car, flee the police force and reach the Mexico frontier (42 miles) in this crazy pursuit game. Buy upgrade, smash police cars, avoid tons of obstacles. 1 game, 6 challenges and 24 special achievements wait for you.

name: The Gentleman
summary: Take your umbrella, put your top hat and try to understand the Gentleman's way of life in this classy and original adventure.

name: The Naughty List Curse
summary: Let the elf guide you through the world of magic where everything you think you know will change. Fight against the darkness and help to give Christmas back its sparkle. You can run and you can hide, but can you save Christmas?

name: That Time I Found a Box
summary:
“That Time I Found a Box” is a roguelike deckbuilder where cards have no cost and are blank slates for you to build, upgrade and modify as you like. Choose carefully when to play them and when / how to improve them.

The focus is deep strategic card building and deck building with very few moments of there being only one obvious play available, however keeping things simple to understand from moment to moment.

You open a mysterious box of magical cards that intertwines your fate with three powerful beings. The cards are blank slates that you must refine and use to gain the favor of the powerful beings, lest they come after you. Watch your back - your life may depend on it!

name: The Last Spell: Elves of Amberwald
summary: Elves of Amberwald is the second DLC for the acclaimed rogue-lite tactical RPG The Last Spell.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered - Deluxe Edition
summary:
The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered Deluxe Edition includes:
- Digital base game
- Unique digital Akatosh and Mehrunes Dagon Armors, Weapons, and Horse Armor Sets
- Digital Artbook and Soundtrack App
- Shivering Isles and Knights of the Nine story expansions
- Additional downloadable content: Fighter’s Stronghold expansion, Spell Tome Treasures, Vile Lair, Mehrune’s Razor, The Thieves Den, Wizard’s Tower, Orrery, and Horse Pack Armor

name: The Shrimp Crematorium
summary: You work at the Universal Crematorium System. They are doing some weird stuff with shrimps here. Your job is simple: Find out which shrimp are rotting and... Well, exclude these shrimp from the tests.

name: The Haunting of Ptolemy
summary: The Haunting of Ptolemy is a first-person shooter game. The game features a variety of weapons, which will be needed for protection against some of the indigenous life forms. Collect the spore samples, transport them back, outmaneuver the obstacles and traps, and above all, Stay Alive!

name: The Photo of God
summary: A short narrative-driven atmospheric horror game, where you play as an old photographer, who decided to take the photo of God one day. Take your camera and you are ready to go. Birds will lead you.

name: The Dawn Obscura
summary: A old-school role-playing adventure with choices and consequences, and turn-based hex-based party-based tactical combat.

name: The Binding of Isaac: Eternal Edition
summary:
The Binding of Isaac: Eternal Edition (also dubbed Eternal Update or V1.666) is an official free DLC-like expansion to The Binding of Isaac, which adds a new Hard Mode, as well as fixing some long existing bugs.

The DLC was developed by Florian Himsl (the original programmer of the game) and released for free on Steam on May 05, 2015, for anyone who owns Wrath of the Lamb DLC.

name: The Lavarish Facility
summary: A roguelite game where you must complete 50 chambers to experiment with The Facility's lava, but something lurks within.

name: The Deepwatch
summary: As the head of security, you will decide the fate of those who try to enter the underwater colony. Among the hundreds of arrivals, you may encounter dangerous criminals, spies, and the infected. You will decide who lives here, who is banished, and who is eliminated.

name: The Ghost of Alcantra
summary: The Ghost of Alcantra is a free kinetic romance/mystery vn that alternates between two perspectives, one focusing on a blossoming romantic relationship, and another focused on unraveling a murder mystery.

name: The Beast and the Princess
summary: A tower defense game where you combo ultimate moves to take down enemies! Have fun unleashing those moves while learning more about the twin princesses' story. Why did the twins get trapped in a game? What's the goal of the game master? And do you have what it takes to see it all to the end?

name: The Several Journeys of Reemus Chapter 1 - The Royal Journey
summary: The king has requested an audience with Reemus. As the impressive silhouette of the castle of Fredricus looms on the horizon, our duo is filled with anticipation. What treasures await them inside the castle's walls?

name: The Several Journeys of Reemus Prologue: Lair of the Ant Queen
summary: Overshadowed by the exploits of his famous sibling, Reemus the insect exterminator and his sidekick, Liam the purple bear set out on a journey to create a legacy of their own.

name: The Garden of the Gods
summary:
In the village of Hitotose, where the heroin lives, there is a cultural tradition in which every year one of the young girls who turned twenty years old is chosen to dedicate herself to the four seasons Gods of the Earth.
They called this young girl "The Chosen Maiden".
Several years before, the heroin's big sister left the village because she was Chosen.
What is she doing now?
What are exactly the Gods of the Earth?
Why there is no Chosen Maiden who comes back to the village...?
I have attended this year's ceremony with skepticism and a paper doll fell in front of me...?!
Will that be a happy end or everything will end in tears...?
Your fate changes depending on your choices! Capture the hearts of these handsome Gods and get the happy endings!

The Spring God Arata The Youngest x Helpful
The loyal and cheerful type who likes humans a lot
His kindness will certainly make you melt!
The Summer God Ren Pretentious x Clumsy
The tsundere type who dislikes a lot humans
His sometimes sentimental side will keep you enthusiastic about him!
The Autumn God Kaede Mean x Unfortunate
A mean and elusive boy
You will spend days attacked by his sadistic words!
The Winter God Shu Cold x Natural
A cold and taciturn boy
You're fascinated by the gap between some sides of his personality and his appearance!

name: The Spirit Engine DX
summary: The Spirit Engine DX is a complete rewrite of the cult classic indie title from 2003 by Mark Pay. Instead of using a traditional turn-based system, an auto battler with real-time pausing is opted to allow players to switch tactics at their own pace without constant menu prompts.

name: The Sims: 4 Sleek Bathroom Kit
summary: Give your Sims a serene, modern bathroom featuring minimalist design and refined details with The Sims 4 Sleek Bathroom kit*. This collection brings a soothing vibe with a sophisticated aesthetic. The combination of clean lines and natural materials strikes a harmonious balance between warmth and elegance. Soft pastel tones blend effortlessly with brushed metal accents, while touches of greenery breathe life into the space, transforming any bathroom into a polished sanctuary. Created by Syboulette.

name: The Sims 4: Sweet Allure Kit
summary: Add soft colors and clothing adorned with ribbons and bows to your Sims’ wardrobe with The Sims 4 Sweet Allure Kit*. With fashion featuring light colors and clothing adorned with ruffles and frills, the clothing and accessories in this kit give off an elegant vibe with their everyday looks. Express a more delicate side to a Sims’ fashion sense, effortlessly giving your Sim a casual coquette fashion feel. Created by Aharris00britney.

name: The Moon Has Faded Away
summary: After moving to a small apartment in a new city with his sister and mother for work-related reasons, Alex and his family's everyday life continues until an unprecedented event occurs: the disappearance of the moon.

name: The Pink Valley
summary: The Pink Valley is a Doom action-horror mod, a personal project by Vamvilodon that's been in development for around 3 years, where you take control as a disturbed man taking revenge on his small Chilean town.

name: The Bumblezone
summary:
The Bumblezone is a bee dimension filled with many brand new bee-related blocks! There's even quite a few structures to explore and a unique bee armor you can obtain! If you are lucky, you may find a special Throne-Locating Honey Compasses from certain structures that leads you to a Bee Queen! The dimension itself looks like it is the inside of a bee nest and you will find giant walls in rows with canals of water between them. Maybe you'll even find a pollen covered section of the dimension or a canyon full of massive honey-based crystals! Check the Bumblezone advancements tab for how to enter dimension and what to do!

Also, you will find bees are extremely protective of their honey in this dimension. If you mine vanilla's Honey Block, destroy or take honey from Honeycomb Brood Block, or you hit a bee, all bees around you will get many buffs and will become VERY angry at you because you now have the Wrath of the Hive effect! But by feeding bees or the Honeycomb Brood Blocks with the honey foods that you have, you might be able to calm them down. By feeding bees or that brood block, you get Protection of the Hive that makes bees defend you against anyone attacking you! (You can nerf the bees in the config if you find them too strong or buff them if you want to die!)

name: The Dawn Era
summary:
The Dawn Era is a modification for Minecraft that brings many changes to your world.
The main one is the fauna of prehistoric times, which became extinct long ago, as it might seem at first glance. Explore the remains of past civilizations, hunt and tame, explore and discover with The Dawn Era!
Can you survive?

name: Thrice Cursed
summary: A roguelike game with Souls-style combat. Fight with a customised character through quests in a random order with randomised loot. Your character's build will be influenced by what you can find or buy. Every run feels a little different.

name: The Empty House: A Dementia Interactive Experience
summary: A surreal interactive experience exploring dementia through FMV storytelling. Navigate a fading mind, make choices that shape reality, and uncover multiple endings in this emotional and psychological descent into memory loss.

name: The Anomaly Experiment
summary: A Psychological Horror where you’re offered freedom by joining a trial for a new drug. The experiment is simple: enter the room, observe, and identify what has changed. Complete all tasks, and your sentence is commuted.

name: The Pirates of Dark Water
summary:
Based on the cartoon by the same name, The Pirates of Dark Water is a side scrolling hack'n slash platformer with a few adventure elements.

You take control of either Ren, Ioz or Tula who can jump, climb, attack and throw enemies. In most levels you are required to find keys to unlock doors and talk to NPCs who will give you hints. You will also find numerous useful items including throwing weapons, food to replenish your health, potions that have different effects such as temporary invincibility, money that is needed to pay certain NPCs and melons that can be fed to Niddler who will take you back to the map screen in turn.

name: The Outlast Trials: Project Relapse
summary:
Project Relapse is the third season within The Outlast Trials, introduced on April 22nd, 2025.

This update includes:

New Trial: Liquidate the Union
2 New MK-Challenges: Spread the Disease & Cook the Informant
New Deluxe Catalog: Project Relapse
New Enemy: The Jaeger
New Limited-Time Event: Jaeger Onboarding
Introducing a New Game Mode: Trial Maker
Introducing the Relapse Initiative
Player Progression Adjustments
Save Game support in Escalation Therapy
Nudity Filter Toggle
Join Trials “In Progress”
Other additions, improvements and fixes

name: The Fae King Is My Roommate
summary: ​Slice-of-Life Dark Fantasy Romance VN

name: The Rake: Back To Asylum
summary: The Rake: Back To Asylum is a short indie horror game situated in an abandoned asylum, with the goal of retrieving a cellphone and escape.

name: The Long Tale
summary: The Long Tale is a brutal black-and-white pixel platformer where every step can be your last. No tutorials, no mercy — just deadly traps, instant restarts, and pure challenge. Jump, die, rage, repeat — and uncover the long tale behind the ruins, the dragon, and the missing princess.

name: The Jumping Bird
summary: The Jumping Bird is an exciting endless jumping game where you play as a the bird. Your goal is to ascend as high as possible, navigating through colorful obstacles. Each obstacle matches a specific color, and your bird can only pass through if it matches the obstacle's hue. Collect items to change your bird's color and continue your ascent. Test your reflexes and see how far you can go in this challenging and colorful adventure!

name: The Ember Guardian
summary: Explore a post-apocaliptic world in a beautiful pixel art style. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and setup your defenses during the day. At night, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons.

name: The Fortune Teller Game
summary: In 2021, the last time I taught the class, I didn’t want to hide the homework in the games. Instead I used the games as ways of presenting ideas. I made several, but I like this one, a reinterpretation of the fortune-telling minigame from Ultima IV.

name: The Last Prompt
summary: For my very final prompt, I wanted to leave the students with one lasting idea: that I make games for enjoyment and want to do it as much as I can, even when I’m limited to a day or two’s work and 8192 Pico8 tokens. I hope that came across in this little game.

name: The Last Corpse Forge: Survivor
summary: This top-down endless survivor lets you play as re-animated corpses. Progress through this challenging and dark bullet-hell while upgrading your corpses and unlocking powerful torches to help power you through the relentless enemies and bosses.

name: The Rake: Hostel
summary: The Rake: Hostel is a short indie horror game situated in an abandoned hostel, with the goal of retrieving a cellphone and escape.

name: The Last Guild
summary: An RPG full of combat and regions to explore, focused on collecting resources to create magical items and defeat monsters. You are the last defender of this kingdom, hire adventurers to help you on your journey.

name: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show
summary: The incredible Mr. Rabbit invites you all to a mysterious magic show! Celebrate 10 years of Rusty Lake with a new free-to-play point-and-click adventure that promises to delight and… shock you with its sleight of hand!

name: The Age of Bhaarat
summary: The Age of Bhaarat is a dark fantasy action RPG that brings ancient India to life. Become a powerful Forest Warden, master mystical weapons and arcane powers, and defend your homeland against a devastating invasion by vicious demons, the Rakshasas.

name: The Shadow Syndicate
summary: The Shadow Syndicate is a stylized noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Sneak, fight, and uncover a dark conspiracy using supernatural powers. Explore a vibrant city, play mini-games, and solve mysteries in this thrilling cinematic experience.

name: The Heart of Influencer
summary: You are entrusted with training five "troubled" influencers from Mountain & Sea Media, and gain the “Heart Probe” ability which allows you to uncover girls’ inner thoughts. Use your wisdom and ability to help them meet their training KPIs, while discovering their real selves beneath their facades.

name: The Horrors of the Soviet Apartment
summary: A short horror game that takes place in an abandoned, musty Soviet apartment, which has a terrible atmosphere. You have to pick up all the valuables in a short period of time and quickly leave so as not to run into him... face to face. Who is it?

name: The Bunker Notes
summary: "The Bunker Notes" is a visual novel about a concrete trap where the past whispers through the cracks of rusted doors. In this world, survival is everything; meeting another person might be your last mistake.

name: The Reunion: Rediscovering Lost Love
summary: A return to the past, two loves and a second chance: to rekindle love or to leave it behind? You decide the destiny.

name: The Meownth
summary: Work, take care of the cat, and try not to let the house become a disaster for the next 30 days, your bike depends on it!

name: The General Saga
summary:
Create your own Millennium!
JRPG-style survival action

name: The Eyes
summary: Follow Hisoka Kageyama, a desperate man who accepts the grim job of night watchman in an abandoned prison. As he navigates its dark corridors, surreal visions and eerie presences lurk around every corner. Can you discover the secrets hidden within these walls?

name: Through the Fog
summary: You will take on the role of a detective and dive into a dark world from a first-person perspective. What will you have to do? Explore locations in search of clues. Make assumptions and write them down in your diary. Solve puzzles.Run away and hide from your demons.

name: The Abyss Desire
summary: A first-person exploration game set in the deep, dark ocean. Use your flashlight carefully, avoid hidden dangers, and find the items you need to complete your quest.

name: The Maze X: The First Chapter
summary: You return back to the once innocent and carefree escape room on Earth, filled with characters who brought joy to the living children dwelling the mazes walls! Now, it's a blood bath... You must press on! Complete the puzzles, activate the generators and free not just you, but the mazes soul itself.

name: The Haunted Nora Apartment
summary: The Haunted Nora Apartment is a 2D Top-Down Survival Horror game based on the story of the Nora Apartment which was built during the early 2000s.

name: Through the Murky Water
summary: VHS mockumentary horror game. You're an employee of an underwater station. Something lurks in these depths. Something is waiting for you. Something calling to you. Make your way through the murky water.

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Angel Diabla Costume
summary: Obtain this DLC costume in order to play the character Angel dressed as a Diabla!

name: The King Of Fighters XIV: Kula Sundress Costume
summary: Obtain this DLC costume in order to play the character Kula in a sundress!

name: The King Of Fighters XIV: Meitenkun Pajamas Costume
summary: Obtain this DLC costume in order to play the sleepy character Meitenkun in pajamas!

name: Thunderdawn
summary: The last part of Andrew Campbell's "Black Dawn" series of Amiga dungeon crawlers, released in 1996.

name: The Judgment Collection
summary: This bundle includes both Judgment and Lost Judgment, and includes The Kaito Files, a story expansion to Lost Judgment.

name: The Bloody Cross
summary: Fight through a haunting journey of sin and suffering in this short top-down story game inspired by Christian themes and the crucifixion.

name: The Demons Told Me to Make This Game
summary: Welcome to Red Hives, a lovely Midwestern town infested with demons. You're a little spirit stuck in a time loop, your only way to interact with the world is by possessing people and whispering into their ears. Explore timelines, solve mysteries, and please, try to keep your hosts alive...

name: The Quintessential Princesses: Fantasy, Abyss, and Magic Academy
summary: Your goal is to become the private tutor of five underperforming quintuplets on the verge of flunking out of the Magic Academy, and guide them toward graduation.

name: The Mystical Traveler
summary: Play as a mysterious green cube and rise from the depths of a ruined world. Master your jumps, survive traps, and purify a dying ecosystem in this 2D platformer.

name: The Hoff vs Hitler
summary: The Hoff VS Hitler is a sidescrolling parody platformer that pits David Hasselhoff and his loyal car KITT up against a time traveling Adolf Hitler.

name: The Cursed Garden
summary:
I was an ordinary caretaker of a quiet garden, routine nights, sounds of nature, and nothing to worry about...

Until he came that night.

Strange sounds, shadows moving on their own, and symbols carved into trees that never existed before.

The calm turned into a nightmare. And the garden... is no longer what it was.

name: They See Us
summary: They See Us is a multiplayer horror game. Work together to find all the anomalies – before they find you!

name: The Wallway
summary: The Wallway is a cooperative first-person horror game for 1-5 players. Explore endless hallways, collect important items and find your way out. Run away from the terrible monster that hears your every sound through the microphone. Can you escape or are you consumed by darkness and fear?

name: The Grandfather
summary: The clock is ticking as the monster lurking in the shadows hunts you down. Find the missing pieces of the clock and fix it as fast and quietly as possible before it finds you as you try to piece together what happened to you. Beware the grandfather in a short first-person horror experience!

name: The Whistle
summary: a Five Nights at Freddy's fangame based off the Josh Hutcherson whistle meme.

name: The Button Effect
summary: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

name: The Storyteller
summary: The Storyteller is an indie game developed by a single person, where one player becomes the storyteller narrating mysterious tales, while others attempt to unravel unexpected solutions. A multiplayer experience blending suspense and questionable humor.

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Shun'ei Kung-Fu Costume
summary: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV” DLC costume. This will unlock a Kung-Fu Suit costume for the playable character Shun'ei.

name: The King Of Fighters XIV: Nakoruru School Costume
summary: “THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV” DLC costume. This will unlock a Kamuikotan Girls' School Uniform costume for the playable character Nakoruru.

name: The King Of Fighters XIV: Sylvie Little Red Riding Hood Costume
summary: Obtain this DLC costume in order to play the character Sylvie dressed as the Little Red Riding Hood!

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Athena KOF ‘98 Costume
summary: Unlock Athena Asamiya's classic outfit from KOF '98.

name: The King of Fighters XIV: Kyo Classic Costume
summary: The playable character 'Kyo Kusanagi' is dressed with his nostalgic outfit from the Orochi Saga (KOF '95～KOF '97). Online features may be terminated at any time.

name: The Time Intern
summary: A bite-sized incremental game about time

name: The Legend Of Surprisia
summary: Surprisia is a freeware Role-Playing Game made with RPG Maker. The game consists of 3 chapters; chapter 1 was released in 2004, chapter 2 in 2006, and united version containing chapter 3 came out in July, 2008.

name: The King Lion III 2003 Advance
summary: The King Lion III 2003 Advance is a platforming game developed by Sintax and released in 2003 for the Game Boy Color. The game is based on the movie The Lion King, with its gameplay deriving from the tie-in game on the SNES and Sega Genesis.

name: The Incredibles
summary: The Incredibles is an unlicensed platformer for the Game Boy Color made by Sintax possibly around 2004. It is a hack of Pokémon Platinum (Sintax), and unrelated to the Glorysun hack of The Tick of the same name.

name: The Old Woman
summary: The Old Woman is a psychological horror game set in Japan. To attend university, the protagonist moved to the countryside. However, after starting to frequent a certain public bathhouse, strange and unsettling things began to happen.

name: The Expedition
summary: The Expedition is a psychological action horror game in which a late-night trip into the woods takes a terrifying turn. Solve puzzles, manage your flashlight's battery, and escape creatures while uncovering the dark secrets of an abandoned facility. Can you survive and live to tell the tale?

name: The Well's Blessing
summary: Explore the mystical sanctuary of the Old Well and reconnect with your childhood friends while solving environmental puzzles. Meet quirky animals, unravel forgotten tales and immerse yourself in an interactive soundscape as you piece together your place in the world.

name: The Masochistic Ball
summary: Roll. Jump. Fall. Repeat. The Masochistic Ball is a precision 2D platformer with a rising difficulty curve. The early levels welcome everyone. The final ones? Pure nightmare fuel. 40 levels. No enemies. Just you, gravity, and your will to endure.

name: The Long Fall Home
summary: THE LONG FALL HOME is a precision puzzle-platformer for 1-4 players. Waking from cryo-sleep decades too late, you must navigate a surreal, shifting space of bizarre obstacles and cosmic oddities. Solve physics-based puzzles, overcome traps, and uncover the truth on your long journey

name: The Binding of Steve: Minecraft Crossover
summary: Play Isaac Afterbirth + with items directly coming from Minecraft !

name: The Singing Scar
summary: A 20-hour RPG, where a grand cosmic horror looms over the multiverse

name: The Victims of Lost Sunny Days: Eclipse
summary: You accidentally find a game you don't remember having and launch it. There seems to be nothing strange about it: it’s a regular children's game with bright graphics. But in this colorful and friendly world, an ominous eclipse sets in…

name: The Cameraman
summary: "The Cameraman" – A Mind-Bending Psychological Thriller. You document a child's memories—but the deeper you go, reality warps, whispers grow, and the past unravels.

name: The Blue Cut Hook
summary: The Blue Cut Hook blends cozy tavern management with subtle adventure. You're no hero, just a humble tavern keeper, but your food, gear, and advice quietly shape the adventurers who pass through. They make the choices, take the glory, and face the danger, but your influence might keeps them alive.

name: They Cannot Hear Me
summary: It's the middle of Winter and a lonely man goes for a walk thinking about how sad his life has become.

name: The Muppet Show: Backstage Rampage
summary:
Oh-oh. Dr. Bunsen Honeydew’s latest experiment has gone haywire.

Combining “Chemical A” with “Chemical F” was definitely not his best ever idea, and has resulted in the entire downtown Theatre being filled with an invisible Gas - which has temporarily turned all the Security Staff barmy!

Thinking they were acting in The Muppets best interests, the Security Staff have spent the entire day combing the Theatre, locking up the whole Muppet Troupe - to keep them out of harm’s way. But now they’re refusing to let them out!

And with the Muppets Homecoming Premiere Show due to begin tonight, time is precious. Disaster - with no Muppets there can surely be no Show!

So far, though, the fabulous Miss Piggy has evaded capture. Her mission - to free as many Muppets as possible so that the Show can go on as planned. With her currently Top Billing she is determined to succeed!

Take control of Miss Piggy and battle your way past legions of Security Staff across the variety of Stages found throughout the enormous downtown Theatre. Locate and rescue Kermit The Frog so that he can, as usual, ensure the Show opens as planned!

“Muppets” is exclusive to Sky Games.

name: Thesis: Purple Locus
summary: Needing an escape from your daily life of a college professor, you decide to join an MMO role playing server. The scenario you were supposed to be playing? A Death Game - a classic. But as the first session ends, you get an anonymous email, which changes the stakes of the game.

name: The Supplier's Complex
summary: A relaxing, addictive idle game. Create magical jars of human traits to supply the Shop Before Life.

name: The Drunken Beard
summary: In The Drunken Beard, you take the reins of a lively tavern where every pint tells a story. Brew craft beers, manage orders between thirsty dwarves and impatient adventurers, expand the inn and turn it into a legendary haven. Between secret recipes, rustic furnishings, and demanding customers, only the finest innkeeper will win over hearts and livers. Glory awaits… one beer at a time!

name: The Cooking Club
summary:
The Cooking Club is a Slice-Of-Life // Dating Sim visual novel that is produced in the Ren'Py engine!

Ready to start cooking?

High school can be a drag—especially when you’re stuck in classes you can’t stand. Looking for an easy escape, our protagonist.. YOU! (Yes - You!) stumbles upon the only club with an open spot: The Cooking Club.

What starts as a simple excuse to ditch class quickly turns into something far more delicious. Between chopping, stirring, and whisking up new dishes, unexpected sparks begin to fly. Will you master the recipe for love, or will things boil over? With a cast of charming clubmates, secret ingredients of romance, and just a pinch of chaos, The Cooking Club is serving up a story that’s equal parts heart-warming and hilarious. So grab your apron—because in this kitchen, love is always on the menu!

But remember.. each decision you make comes with a choice and a path - you can't have every girl to yourself!

name: The Deadseat
summary: A horror game where you play a hand-held console in the backseat during a long drive home.

name: The End of Gameplay
summary:
droqen's desperate attempt to explain, or explore, or understand the true meaning of "kill gameplay."

something as mundane as lights
neither of us saying "goodbye"
you following me following you
following me following you...

name: The Last Train: Baquedano
summary: In this short first-person psychological horror game, falling asleep on the subway brings you to the final station abandoned and eerie. Explore and try to survive the entity chasing you in the darkness. Who is it? Its face seems familiar...

name: The Dark Arrival: Shadows of the Past
summary: In The Dark Arrival, Jacob, desperate for meaning, is drawn to Hollow Creek by a mysterious letter from his late grandfather. As he explores the eerie town, ghostly apparitions intensify. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden secrets & survive the supernatural forces that haunt the abandoned train station.

name: The Rift
summary: The Rift is a sci-fi arcade game where you pilot a ship with 6 degrees of freedom. The main mode is a race that also integrates shooting mechanics. Dive into a sci-fi universe blending arcade gameplay with realistic physics. Strapped in? Welcome to The Rift!

name: The Drone Lord
summary: THE DRONE LORD is a Virtual Reality First Person Shooter. Dodge the enemy drones in your armored levitation suit. Blast them with multiple weapon systems.

name: The Curator
summary: The audioguide to the exhibition of Polish design is AI. However, being a non-material entity, she does not understand the field she is supposed to be guiding. Go on a surreal journey through her peculiar mind, solve dozens of unique puzzles and let her find out what it's all about.

name: The Sinking City Remastered
summary: Powered by Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City Remastered brings the eerie, atmospheric world of Oakmont back to life with enhanced gameplay and fully relit environments, perfect for both newcomers and returning players.

name: The Great I Am
summary:
Play out the life of I Am, a girl with a very strange speech impediment.

A linear visual novel with a duration of ~10 mins.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - German Shorthaired Pointer
summary: Meet the German Shorthaired Pointer! This skillful dog will point you in the direction of your desired targets and help you find their whereabouts quicker.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Hunters' Choice: Bolt Action Rifle Pack
summary: The first pack created in partnership with our community. Get ready to take your shooting skills to new levels with three versatile bolt-action rifles.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Salzwiesen Park
summary: Explore the salt marsh habitat at Salzwiesen Park and hunt a wide range of waterfowl and small game. Plus, sharpen your shooting skills solo or compete against friends at the new Clay Shooting Range.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Julie Outfit Pack 3
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't have style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Julie.

name: The First Day
summary: Use gravity-changing abilities to solve puzzles.

name: The Hiking Hawk
summary:
In a land where snow never melts and the wind sings through frozen cliffs, a determined young hawk sets his eyes on the peak of the tallest mountain.

But this hawk is different from the rest — instead of soaring through the sky, he chooses to climb, jump, and bounce his way to the top.

Armed only with his spring-loaded boots and pure determination, he begins his journey through slippery slopes, crumbling ledges, and ancient frozen ruins.

Along the way, danger waits behind every rock and cloud:

Ice Bats swoop in to knock him off course.

Giant Yeti stomp the ground and shake the trails.

But with every bounce, every clever jump, he gets closer to the top — where no bird has ever reached by foot (or claw).

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Seasons of the Worm Cult
summary:
Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 launches on June 2 for PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles and is included as part of the 2025 Content Pass. In this new storyline and zone, you must uncover and investigate the Worm Cult’s new base of operations on the tropical island of Solstice.

In Part 1, as you explore Western Solstice, you will quickly discover that the Worm Cult is far from defenseless. They’ve erected a massive arcane barrier using soul magic—the Writhing Wall—that divides the island, and for now, Eastern Solstice (and its secrets) is sealed off by this arcane edifice.

Despite being a zone divided, you will find that Western Solstice is full of challenges and rewards, including new World Bosses, Delves, a Public Dungeon, and a brand-new Trial, the Ossein Cage. There are 16 Antiquities (including three new Mythic items), four new Trial item sets (including Perfected versions), and a host of other rewards, including even more item sets, and a ton of Collectibles, from crafting motifs to pets. You’ll also receive a 10% experience boost from adventuring in Solstice all year!
