Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 2 arrives in Q4 and gives you the opportunity to finally uncover just what these villains have been hiding behind the arcane barrier. Be warned, Eastern Solstice is far less welcoming than the previous territory, thanks to the Worm Cult’s malign influence.

Solstice’s second half introduces yet more challenges and rewards, with additional World Bosses, Delves, another Public Dungeon, and new rewards both exclusive to the new content and shared across the unified Solstice zone. You can expect three new overland item sets (giving Solstice six in total once Part 2 unlocks), three more Mythic items, and many more items and collectibles to earn.

name: The 5th Door
summary: You find yourself in a quiet room with four doors. There's always an anomaly. Choose wisely.

name: The Mandarin II
summary: A fangame faux bootleg loosley based on The Mandalorian, Developed for the Windows and several old computers.

name: The Wardrobe: Even Better Edition + Extra Coin
summary: A 2D adventure in which you play as Skinny, a teen-skeleton with an impertinent attitude + a story-rich life sim set between the real world and a virtual utopia.

name: The Foreigner
summary: The Foreigner is a roguelike and platformer. You were sent to the bottom of the tower, if you want to go back to the top, You'll have to love death, because now it will always be with you...

name: The Mine
summary: You find yourself lost in a mine, the only objective is to find a way out. But something lurks in the shadows, following. Hunting you. Good luck. It's simply a game of cat and mouse. You can run and hide, but your ultimate goal is to find the key and escape the mine. While avoiding the monsters.

name: The Dreamland
summary: This is a small game. All you need to do is live

name: The Old Mansion: Eternal Night
summary: "The Old Mansion" is a horror game that begins when a journalist receives a tip about a mansion that has been abandoned for a long time. As the journalist investigates, they gradually reveal the hidden truths behind the occurrences.

name: The Others
summary: A first-person multiplayer survival game where humans must escape and mannequins hunt—who's real, and who will replace you?

name: The Sarah Jane Adventures: Plant and Animal Habitats
The Dark Knight Rises: The Mobile Game
summary: The 2D counterpart to 3D version intended for lower end mobile devices, Both being tie ins to The Dark Knight Rises movie.

name: The New Flesh
summary: Explore the strange world within the screen in this ambient exploration experience featuring the music of Red Vox.

name: Them
summary: You just want to play a video game in an old game club, but time passes quickly, and strange noises draw you into a dark nightmare! A nightmare that begins with an old video game... Are you ready to experience a 2d platformer game within the heart of a first person psychological creepy game?

name: The Moon is our Friend
summary: Help the Moon protect its best friend from a barrage of asteroids

name: The Warp
summary: The Warp is a 35 map MBF-21 compatible megawad created by Laocoön with two endings and a fully custom non-midi soundtrack.

name: The Walls of Jericho
summary: The Walls of Jericho is a challenging move and match game inspired by an epic tale of faith and preservation. Your faithful followers won't stay around forever, unless you can solve the puzzle, activate powerful combos and bring down the walls!

name: The Doctor's Room
summary: The Ultimate Mixed Reality Demo for Quest 2 and above. The Doctors Room is the perfect spooky but not-too-spooky puzzle game where you must search The Doctors Room for the passcode to return to the ground floor! Your space will be transformed as a mysterious elevator appears in your room, taking you down to The Doctors Office.

name: The Golden Retreat
summary: You work in a hotel and your shift is over but instead of heading home, you find yourself in an endless loop. Your only chance to decrease a floor is to identify anomalies and choose the correct elevator to escape.

name: The Cave Diver
summary: Crawl down a suffocating cave system using only your arms in this punishing physics-horror adventure. What morbid force is calling you deeper into the heart of the caves?

name: The Shift
summary: The Shift is a first-person 3D psychological horror game where you play as a night shift cashier in an isolated gas station, performing routine tasks while uncovering disturbing, unexplained events.

name: Thunderbirds
summary: SCi Games published a Game Boy Color title of Thunderbirds in 2000.

name: The Fallen
summary: The better free-to-play fantasy MMORPG! Fight, craft, and explore your way. Combine unique abilities and weapons to create your own style of play and become what you were always meant to be!

name: The Hunted
summary: The Hunted is a horror-themed exploration and survival game. Months after the disapperences of several people, you are determined to document the fates of the missing, reveal the truth and clear your name. However, a huge, powerful beast lurks within the woods.

name: The House Sitter's 5 Nights
summary: You take on the role of a house sitter tasked with completing chores while surviving 5 nightmarish nights until 6 AM. The catch? You're not alone.

name: The Soul Stone War 3
summary: By the power of your Soul Stone and the strength of your own indomitable soul, uncover secrets held in blood and lead the charge that will change the world. A text-based fantasy novel, 260,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

name: The Bleakest Keep
summary: The Bleakest Keep is a challenging action horror roguelike. Survive the horrors of the Keep, upgrade your gear, and earn ranks as you ascend the tower and save the world!

name: The Last Visit: 98th
summary: "The Last Visit: 98th" is a psychological indie horror from the first person, in the genre of a walking simulator, in the setting of the post-Soviet winter space. The main focus is on the atmosphere of horror, which is emphasized by realistic 3D graphics.

name: The Cursed Underground Parking Lot
summary: After finishing work, the protagonist heads to the underground parking lot to retrieve their car. For some reason, their car is nowhere to be found, and as they search, strange events unfold one after another...

name: The Attack on Egg Harbor
summary: A side-scrolling beat-'em-up roguelike built on a real-time strategy framework. Battle to obtain eggs, upgrade your base and gear, and ultimately repel all invaders to destroy the enemy base and win.

name: The Paper Loop
summary:
Welcome to the Spider Nature Research Laboratory. We are doing really crazy stuff with spiders here! Today is a very important day!

Play as a person, caught in a time loop, exactly 10 minutes before the incident. Find a way to break the loop. Every action can affect future events.

name: The Office Killer
summary: The Office Killer is a 1-3 player online co-op survival horror game. As a spy, your main goal is to complete the file transfer process containing the office's secrets while monitoring live surveillance camera footage. Can you survive the entire night or will you get caught by the killer?

name: The Last Stand
summary: A zombie survival game where you fight off zombies every night and try to survive for as long as possible from your barricade. During the day you can repair the barricade, search for weapons, look for other survivors among other things to help in your defense.

name: The Next World
summary: The Next World is an open-world, action-adventure cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian Los Angeles in the year 2108, Dark. Gritty and full of twists and turns. This is the cyberpunk game you have been waiting for.

name: The Seduction of Shaqeera VR
summary: Play the role of a personal assistant to a famous movie star named Shaqeera! Get a glimpse into what life as the assistant to one of the most famous and hot women is like! Will you be a well-behaved PA always nicely carrying out the tasks she gives you?

name: The Falling Star
summary: The Falling Star is a first-person exploration and narrative-driven walking simulator. Following the mother's last wish, the girl embarks on a journey in a dream to uncover the story of her missing aunt's past.

name: Therapy Simulator
summary: Step into the chair of a therapist in Therapy Simulator! Guide your patients through emotional journeys with branching dialogue choices. Balance humor, humanity, and the chaos of therapy!

name: The Bot Squad: Puzzle Battles
summary:
Lead your Bots to victory in an epic quest for energy, paved with mind bending puzzles & frantic battles!
THE BOT SQUAD: Puzzle Battles is a brand new puzzle/strategy game by Ubisoft that twists and redefines classic Puzzle and Tower Defense gameplay and takes fun and challenge to a whole new level!

name: The Duck Amikaze Strikes Back
summary: Help Amikaze get his revenge! Run, jump, dodge, bounce and make your way as fast as you can to blast the local hunters! Revenge your family who ended up as tenders! And beat the gold times to become THE legendary duck!

name: The Elevator: Beyond the Doors
summary: A narrative-driven psychological visual novel where every floor of an elevator reveals a key moment from your past. Face your regrets, uncover forgotten memories, and make choices that shape your future. Will you find closure, or remain trapped in your own mind?

name: The EverFloating Island
summary: This is a Sky Island simulation game. To prevent your Sky Island from falling, you need a large amount of float stones to maintain the production of float energy. Trade, missions, robbery—do whatever it takes to survive...

name: Thunderhead
summary:
On Friday night, just past midnight, the people of Thunderhead screamed in terror.

Their end began four days earlier, when a strange hill appeared at the edge of the cemetery.

Maybe it began even further back - but our story begins the next morning, when the first light touched a town stained by horror.

What happened in Thunderhead was first told by the man who delivers milk every Friday to towns too quiet to matter.

name: The Weather Kitchen
summary: The Weather Kitchen is an extremely rare edutainment game for the Philips CD-i, with only two physical copies known to exist. Its aim is to teach children about the science behind weather-related natural disasters through live footage, guessing games, and songs.

name: The Panopticon
summary: Welcome to our facility! Here, you’ll experience the thrill of strategic duels – block attacks, acquire ammo, and shoot your opponent. We hope you enjoy your stay with us.

name: The Stick Figure Game
summary: The most convoluted game of capture-the-flag we've ever seen! In this turn-based strategy game, make choices to bring new units into play, position forces, fire on the enemy, dig tunnels to avoid enemy line-of-sight, and more. Play solo vs the computer player, or head-to-head against a friend!

name: The Last Dig
summary: Dig to the center of the Earth before time runs out. Mine gems to sell on the black market, build up your infrastructure, uncover relics of forgotten civilizations, and upgrade to face the dangers of the deep. Don't get caught by bandits or authorities while you drill into your last dig.

name: The Last Escape
summary: Inspired by the classic survival horror games. The Last Escape is a third person, survival horror game. It sets in an abandoned city, where you will be exploring the area, find items, collect keys, fight the undead, and discover what really happened in your journey for your last escape.

name: The Apocalypse
summary: The Apocalypse is a low-poly sandbox survival shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge, craft, build, and fight against zombies and mutants. Enjoy fast-paced gunplay and light survival in a fun, open-world adventure with multiple game modes!

name: The Last Mile
summary: The Last Mile is a narrative-driven action adventure where every decision can change your path. Step into the role of Nick Rieger, a man on the run from his past and the law. Your journey is in your hands – with shifting routes and events that shape a unique story of guilt, redemption, and hope.

name: The Hunger Games: Panem Rising
summary:
Katniss Everdeen has agreed to unify the districts of Panem against the Capitol. Help Katniss enlist other rebels in this Role Playing Card Collection Game that will immerse you in Panem’s unique districts.

Explore each district in Panem, recruit rebels, and collect resources to aid you in victory. Train your rebels to upgrade your team’s skills or equip your squad with specific tools to unlock unique abilities for your journey.

name: The Forgotten Apartment
summary: A psychological horror experience set in a forgotten apartment filled with dark memories, eerie puzzles, and emotional scars waiting to resurface.

name: The Big Farm Theory
summary: Create crazy hybrids of plants and animals!

name: The Glued
summary: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

name: The Girl From Gunma Kai
summary: This game is a retro-style 2D side-scrolling shooting game. Easy one-button operation. It is expressed with graphics and sounds (MSX) typical of the Japanese 80's. The overall structure is psychedelic and crazy, but that's the kind of game it is, so don't worry about it.

name: The Island of Kesmai
summary:
Island of Kesmai is a discontinued multi-user dungeon (MUD) online game. An early entry in the genre, the game was innovative in its use of roguelike pseudo-graphics. It is considered a major forerunner of modern massively multiplayer online role-playing games (MMORPGs).

It was still text-based, with just a tiny ASCII view similar to that in a roguelike, but that simplicity allowed it to offer a depth that it would take years for graphical RPGs to rival. Up to 100 players at once could explore a large open world, killing monsters, doing elaborate quests and hunting “world bosses” that required a powerful party to take down.

Active from 1985 to 1995, Island of Kesmai received multiple expansions, adding new areas and challenges. A key feature was travelling from the Basic Game to the Advanced Game. Doing so would allow you to progress further, but it was a one-way journey to much more dangerous lands. And death in IoK could be permanent.

Thanks to a devout fan-base, Kesmai is one of the best-documented early online games, with multiple guides explaining its systems and the strategies to beat each boss. You can even watch replays from old players using Hunter, a fan-made graphical front-end.

name: The Quest Keeper
summary:
Help a lowly peasant on his journey to become a powerful dungeon master!

Dodge spikes, knives, spiders, skeletons, lasers, saws, and more on your journey to collect rare coins and artifacts.

name: That's a Thing
summary:
Well you will suffer. In this world full of dangerous enemy , the princess of the kingdom was captured by the big bad Cow boy. You control the hero , determined to save the world and the princess too but the world is the most important.

Use the pad for move the character and Y for interact with the environemment

name: Third Shift
summary: As the lead pharmacist in Third Shift, you are in charge of keeping the Everyday Remedies pharmacy safe through the store's closed hours at night from anything that may want enter the property. Will you survive the night and uncover the truth?

name: The Presidential Assassins
summary: Step into the shadows in The Presidential Assassins, a top-down third-person shooter where precision, stealth, and tactics define success. You play as a contract assassin hired to eliminate high-value targets across a range of hostile environments.

name: The Shafts of Damnation
summary: As an investigative reporter, you uncover the horrifying secrets of an abandoned island. Descend into the dark shafts to unveil the truth behind inhumane experiments, confront mutated horrors, and collect evidence to piece together the chilling story.

name: Three Kingdoms: Shu-han Chronicles
summary: A traditional turn-based role-playing game depicting the story of Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei from the Yellow Turban Rebellion to the unification of China. Featuring over 200 characters, players can recruit enemy generals (beyond the Shu Han faction) to build unique battle formations.

name: TheBoll
summary: theBOLL is an arcade platformer with no enemies and no distractions — just intuitive controls and levels built for speedruns or relaxed exploration. It’s you, the ball, and the path you choose. Race to the finish or hunt for hidden secrets!

name: The Crimson Line
summary:
A conflict is about to erupt in the town you call home. She insists on getting out while you still have time. The last train out of town was set to leave by now, but it hasn't.

THE CRIMSON LINE is a short (500 words) IF piece made for Neo-Twiny Jam #24. Headphones recommended.

name: The King of Beasts
summary: Kill enemies to evolve into enemy form. Players will control mutated creatures with this ability, constantly fighting against other mutated creatures to evolve into more powerful creatures. They will survive in terrifying alien experiments and become the king of beasts.

name: The Walking Trade
summary: Run a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate.

name: The Way We All Go
summary: A remake of the 2015 visual novel The Way We All Go. A yandere story with over 20 endings set in the sleepy Japanese countryside. Can you reconnect with your old friends, or will you meet a grisly demise?

name: The Mirrion
summary: Dive into a harsh open world where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Explore untamed lands, build shelters, hunt, craft tools, and defend yourself from threats. Nature, weather, and unexpected events will test your will to survive.

name: The Adventures of Harry: The evidence Under the Underwear
The Initiation
summary: The Initiation is a quest mod centered on the idea of doing odd jobs for the Great Khans. Do well enough, and they might let you join up...

name: The North Road Remastered
summary: Like the original iteration, The North Road: Remastered is a a fairly open-ended quest/worldspace mod. It features a buttload of new content, stories, NPCs, weapons, quests, and locations to explore. You can meet your new companion in a new building in Westside (which you may want to do first), the North Road proper can be started by speaking with Brandt at Ranger Station Bravo, and there's even some unmarked shenanigans in Jacobstown.

name: The Depths of Depravity
summary: The Depths of Depravity is a quest/companion mod that will take players on a journey into the writhing, blood-spattered depths of conspiracy, intrigue, assassination, and degradation. Enjoy (or don't) a series of interconnected quests and missions, all fully voiced and playtested.

name: The High Desert
summary: The High Desert is a relatively open-ended quest mod with everything you'd expect from a quest mod I made. A bit of dungeon crawling here, some wanton murder there, and a cast of (mostly insane) characters for you to speak with and/or violently murder. Build a saloon, do drugs with hippie astrologers, punch lots of dudes in a cave, achieve astral enlightenment. Naturally, everything is fully-voiced and lip-synced, and extensive bug-testing has been performed at the cost of my own sanity. You're welcome.

name: The Lightning Struck Orphan
summary: We combined deckbuilding and spacial puzzles to create The Lightning Struck Orphan. It is Tetris/Patchwork meets Slay the Spire.

name: The Devil's Due
summary: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

name: The Last of the Lords of Ice
summary: The Last of the Lords of Ice is a visual novel about a young woman who is haunted by her past. Involved in the death of a childhood friend, she is now pursued by his vengeful lover. Will she find refuge in Iscah, the so-called gentle North?

name: The Pitch
summary: The Pitch is a zero-gravity, momentum-based arena 2v2 and 1v1 sport where teams pass, dash, and use teamwork to throw or slam the ball into the goal. With wall and player-based jumps, air dashes, and game-changing stuns, every moment is a fast, fluid test of reflexes and teamwork.

name: The Branch
summary:
Stay on the branch as long as you can!

Tap the screen to rotate the world and keep Mike safe.

Get higher scores and collect gems to unlock new characters.

name: The Daily Life of Serving Doll
summary: Start a sweet life with the breast-expanding robot [Service Doll Aisha] who was born to serve you！This is the sequel to “Escape from the Room of the Serving Doll”！Uses the same 3D animation for the H scene as its predecessor， and you can't miss the soft and textured breast animation！

name: The Strange Men Anthology
summary: A set of RPGMaker horror Games by the same developer that tackle heavy topics and all coexist within the same universe

name: The Survivors
summary: You crashed near a city infested by an unknown virus, you discover a world of nightmare infested with zombies but also by fanatics. Deliver yourself, craft, build and fight for your survival and the other survivors that populate this world in this survival game.

name: The Communist Manifesto
summary: The visual novel adaptation of The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. Experience the Manifesto in a conversational style for the first time and fully customize your reading.

name: The Noog Network
summary: Virtual world app created by 2000s-era animator Butch Hartman, containing a virtual world home to cartoons and games.

name: The Seal Hunter
summary:
Very bloody game Seal Hunter, where you will have to act as a defender of the territory from all sorts of sea creatures (and not only). Blood, plenty of weapons and the possibility to play in two make the game worth your attention.
A growing population of seals is destroying all the fish in the sea. The fishermen are left without a catch, and the seals meanwhile continue to multiply and eat all the fish. Two fishermen decide to take control of the situation and get rid of the extra mouths, thus preserving the once fish-rich ocean. Along with the seals, they need to kill penguins, baby seals, and, for some reason, sea turtles and polar bears. In general, armed with a considerable arsenal, fishermen go hunting.
Seal Hunter game at first glance is simple and uncomplicated, but behind all this hides a rather complex timekiller. You can't act on the fly, you won't get far. In the game you need to tactically calculate literally everything. How much ammo is left, and when the boss will appear, what weapon to buy next; what is better to kill a penguin with, and what is better to kill a seal with; how to keep a full horn of ammo in the machine gun to kill a dozen penguins in a few seconds, etc.

name: The Funskin Project
summary: A horrifying experience in a strange and timeless universe. Explore, solve puzzles, fight for your survival and try to escape this nightmare.

name: The Saga of the Candy Scroll
summary:
The text intro presented at the start of the game:

"This is a game made in two days for #candyjam. Enjoy!"

A puzzle game about lining up candy gems, inspired by match-3 games but playing more like a top-down grid-based puzzle game.

Cover taken from the freeindiegam.es page. Exact release date is unknown but presumably was posted some time in early 2014 when the Candy Jam was held.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Demon's Quest
The Lost Soul
summary: The Lost Soul is an arcade difficulty-focused platformer , made in a minimalist style. 13 different levels, each of which contain it’s own unique soundtrack, checkpoint system, as well as many secrets.

name: The Herd
summary: Herding animals is hard—especially when there are predators, traps, and total mayhem at every turn! Can you guide your herd through the perilous world without losing too many along the way?

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Vengir
summary:
Frowned upon by the other tribes and pushed into the unpleasant wastelands. Will they tolerate this injustice or rise to fight back?
Vengir Starts the game with the Smithery tech and a Powerful Swordsman.

name: The Humans: Insult to Injury
summary: Following the success of The Humans, a sequel titled The Humans: Insult to Injury was launched in 1992 as both a stand-alone release and as an expansion pack

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Zebasi
summary:
Zebasi thrive on the warm savannah, cultivating the rich soil to provide food for their mighty population.
Zebasi starts the game with the Farming tech.

name: The Bagman
summary: The bagman is an authentic retro 16-bit horror point and click/survival horror that layers in stealth, commandable NPCS, and gratuitous slasher gore! Time and events continually tick forward, and any of your friends can die. Many paths to follow, multiple endings. Will you survive?

name: Third-person Shooter and Platform Jumping and Level-based Adventure
summary: An adventure game that combines third person shooter and platform jumping to pass levels

name: The Trolley Solution
summary: The Trolley Solution is a compilation of point-and-click minigames based on the famous thought experiment originally proposed by Philippa Foot.

name: The Waning of ShadyVale
summary: Choose your path: play as Detective Mick, determined to uncover the town’s buried secrets, or survive as Alex, focused only on escaping the horror with their life intact. Make Items, solve puzzles, choose to save or abandon the people of this town. Whatever it takes to see the end of this nightmare.

name: The Adventures of Lia and the Celestial Compass
summary: Join Lia on a magical adventure across floating islands with her enchanted compass, new friends, and evil pirates in her way!

name: They Came for More Pasta
summary:
"When aliens order pasta, only one guy can deliver justice!"

You're a food delivery guy in this short, comical graphic adventure, determined to stop the monopoly on italian cousine imposed by an alien invasion.

name: The Wizard of Bug
summary: Unravel the labyrinth's mysteries with your wits as your weapon! A novel and stimulating brain-bending puzzle adventure!

name: The Lost Garden
summary: A group of brave insects embark on an adventure to restore peace to the Lost Garden, now ruled by the Spider Queen.

name: The Salma World
summary: A gaming site that contains interactive games with chat on Twitch and chilling games, contain wheel , Tetris , countries war, question and answers games and drums of war, and more soon .. Most of them are interactive games with chat on Twitch.

name: The Tower of Eden
summary: A roguelite where you play as Izaak, a man with a unique curse on a quest to take down the Astrian King and his court. Become adept at using different weapons and strategies as you battle your way past the closest of the king’s advisors to his chambers.

name: The Book of Plagues
summary: In a city plagued by a deadly plague, you are the last hope for salvation! You are the Plague Doctor, a mysterious and determined healer whose job it is to stop disease, save lives, and restore order to the city...

name: The Heaven
summary: The Heaven is a game about Jungwoo Yom's struggle with the South Korean education system.

name: That Time I Got Trapped in an Office Dungeon
summary: Explore a unique 2nd-person horror puzzle adventure in the corporate world that will put your spatial reasoning to the test. How far are you willing to go to for a job? We're a family here after all.

name: The Son of Art
summary: Step into an art sanctuary woven from colors, shapes, and puzzles, and embark on an unprecedented journey of the soul. You will become an art seeker, traversing the inner worlds of four 20th-century art masters, unlocking the secrets hidden deep within their works.

name: The Lullaby Weaver
summary: The Lullaby Weaver is a 1 bit psychological point & click horror game inspired by games like World of Horror, Silent Hill, Junji Ito, & FAITH.

name: The Czar Is Dead 2
summary: First-person rpg-shooter in the setting of the Russian Empire.

name: The Prisonbreak
summary: Choose your side – cop or criminal! Keep criminals locked up or escape, rob stores, and build your crime empire. Play with friends, create bases, and earn bounties. Action, strategy, and adrenaline-filled gameplay await!

name: The Liftboy
summary: Being a liftboy is easy… until it’s not. Carry luggage, serve guests, and survive the chaos of hotel life. From physics-driven suitcase disasters to questionable VIP requests, this isn’t just a job—it’s a game. And Ted Grady? He’s the last of his kind.

name: The Wellmonts Case
summary: The Wellmonts Case is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1993, Northern Maine. As a private detective, you explore the abandoned Wellmont farm, search for clues, photograph unsettling evidence, and uncover the truth behind a family's unexplained disappearance.

name: The King of Truancy
summary: A modern roguelite deck-builder with supernatural combat & light RPG elements. Build diverse decks, face random events, humorous stories, and charming heroines! Play as a descendant of legendary heroes in modern life, battling bullies, gangs, and agents to uncover 'The Shadow' conspiracy.

name: The Dark Between
summary: BETWEEN LIFE AND DEATH. Survive within surreal mazes in this retro first-person horror, where only by reassembling your soul can you escape.

name: The Last Sanctum
summary: A dark fantasy tactical RPG, a forsaken necromancer, raise an army of the damned to reclaim your sanctum. Explore an open, isometric world, conquer cursed dungeons, recruit souls, and master team-based, turn-based combat in a decaying realm.

name: Those Npc's Love Stories
summary: Create your own love story with those adorable men who were once just background characters.

name: The Quest for the Golden Flece
summary: The programme will let the player feel what the quest for the Golden Fleece was all about! While playing the game, you can learn to concoct the Soporific, a magic sleep-inducing potion, enter a wind-ball throwing battle or go on a fascinating cruise. It is also worthwhile to prove oneself as the general commanding the team of the Argonauts. The chill of the excitement, the gooseflesh from the exhilaration, the spikes of adrenaline and the explosions... of laughter - guaranteed!

name: The Gretlow Tapes
summary: Armed with nothing but your camera, investigate the abandoned Gretlow House in this short, atmospheric horror game. Uncover a chilling mystery through a realistic found-footage lens.

name: The Emperor's Mad Dash
summary: Kuzco is in a heap of trouble. He's about to flunk gym class and lose his kingdom to Yzma - and there's nothing he can do to stop it. Nothing. Well, okay, so maybe there is one thing... Kuzco MUST win the annual Kuzco Academy Cross Country Race! The bad news: he's racing against Kronk. The worse news: Yzma just whipped up a fresh batch of evil, race-thwarting potions. BUT you can use Yzma's potions to your advantage! Guide Kuzco through three heart-pounding levels to win the race.

name: The Fruit Game
summary: A casual cute game about merging fruits and getting the highest score! You can also care and level up pets and in return they'll power up your runs! You can buy fruit skins, music, and backgrounds to customize your experience.

name: Three Legions: Erosion of the Abyss
summary: You awaken in a space eroded by the abyss. Protect the light and press forward. Defeat the monsters within the abyss!

name: The Witch's Realm
summary: Escape and explore a mystery puzzle adventure where you must manage sanity, solve challenges, and uncover the dark secrets of a cursed town. Navigate eerie environments, find hidden objects, and survive the witch's realm.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Child Quest
The Land of Rest 1
summary: The Lands of Rest 1: Part 1 is a story-driven game that narrates the life of Bipara in the Underground Realm.

name: The Vineyard
summary: The Vineyard is a psychological survival horror game set in a cursed wine estate. Escape the twisted halls of the Sangnoire Mansion, solve vintage mechanical puzzles, and survive the hunt of a deranged vineyard master whose madness taints reality itself.

name: The Blessing of Airon
summary: The Blessing of Airon is a First Person Story Adventure (Walking Sim) telling the story of a society which has lost access to all electronic devices capable of processing a neural network due to demon infestation. It is a horror game which focuses on exploration and uncovering mysterious events through a large variety of inspectable items with story text, custom sounds and vfx.

name: The Lamb of the Sabbath is Standing Upon the Hill
The Dance of Maple Leaves
summary: The Dance of Maple Leaves Single-player role-playing combat game Gameplay 1: Open-world exploration map, dungeon maps, and world boss battles. Gameplay 2: Equipment upgrade system, equipment identification system. Gameplay 3: Quest system

name: The Hundred Youkai Master
summary: No shikigami. No spells. Only wit—and a hundred yokai. Sei, a girl without onmyo powers, ends up leading a legion of yokai she once saved by chance. Assemble your Hyakki Yagyō and face terrifying foes with strategy alone. A punishing, high-difficulty command-based RPG awaits!

name: The 18th Attic
summary: The 18th Attic is a psychological horror game where you play as a man trapped in a loop, armed with an instant picture camera. Hunt down paranormal anomalies lurking around by taking their pictures and detecting their presence to unravel secrets of your past. Each photo unlocks a new memory.

name: The Fortress
summary: The Fortress is a dark fantasy dungeon crawler with turn-based combat, mixing strategy and risk. Choose a class, delve into cursed chambers, roll dice to fight brutal enemies, and grab loot. Face tough choices, survive epic bosses, and fight to escape... or fall to the shadows

name: Three Days After the Murderer
summary: Play the ghost of the protagonist Sun Shuling and, within the last 72 hours of your "life", keep getting closer to the murderer's hideout by entering dreams, eavesdropping, peeping, and guiding your beloved cat to collect clues.

name: The Yard of Solace
summary: "The Yard of Solace." is an exploration and life-simulation story-based adventure game. Experience the girl's life and growth across four seasons in an underground sanatorium. Through your choices and actions, witness the different futures that unfold for her.

name: The Four Money Bears: Berryville
summary: Learn to Make Millions in this Cozy Merchant Sim. Build a business and beat the competition to become the biggest merchant in the world by learning smart financial habits, behaviors and traits. Craft pies & jams from tons of different berries. Have fun running your shop & helping your community!

name: The Dancer's Lullaby
summary: Explore, survive, decide and find the dancer. In this new survival horror experience every single decision you take matters. Each decision, each item you use and every door you open will have everlasting consequences bringing you a unique experience each time.

name: The Binding Hour
summary: The Binding Hour is a first-person psychological horror game set in a forgotten house lost deep in the woods. Explore shifting spaces, confront haunting echoes, and uncover a truth that refuses to stay buried. Every hour binds you tighter—will you break the loop, or become part of it?

name: The Swordsman
summary: The Swordsman is a fast-paced 2.5D hack and slash game set in a dark fantasy world. Master fluid combat, choose skills through card-based progression, and craft powerful gear. Face relentless enemy waves and challenging bosses. Each run makes you stronger—adapt, and become the ultimate swordsman!

name: The Final Breath
summary: A 3D side-scrolling adventure game, you will dive into a bizarre dark world and unlock the secrets hidden in it. Use the props you've earned to fight against a variety of sanity-shattering monsters and bosses, challenge creative decryption, explore chilling truths, and reveal your ultimate destiny..

name: The Null Hypothesis
summary: You play as a mutant who is given refuge and enrolled into a school of mutants by Charles Xavier. At the school you meet other mutants and live amongst them, growing your powers, learning, and developing budding relationships with others.

name: The World's Hardest Game 4
summary: The fourth and final entry in the World's Hardest Game series!

name: The Legend Returns
summary: Can you survive the return of the legend? A relentless killer is stalking you, and no one believes your story. The only way out? Perform the ritual… or become the next victim. Run, hide, and fight for your life in this brutal PS1-inspired slasher horror experience!

name: The Shadow Beneath
summary: The Shadow Beneath is an action roguelike where you must fulfill an ancient prophecy and rise against the demonic forces that have taken over the world. You will battle relentless waves of enemies, master powerful abilities and reclaim what humanity lost since the Demon Lords reign began - freedom

name: The Prisoner
summary: Stuck in a prison you don't remember being sent to, you must find a way to escape. Using the guards and the other prisoners as tools to guarantee your escape requires strategizing your movement to successfully maneuver them to solve the puzzling challenges ahead.

name: The Dark Legacy
summary: The Dark Legacy is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore an abandoned surgeon's estate. Uncover hidden memories, solve narrative-driven puzzles, and face the chilling consequences of forbidden experiments. The game emphasizes atmospheric storytelling over jump scares.

name: Thief VR: Legacy of Shadow
summary: Step into the shadows in Thief VR. You are Magpie, a cunning thief orphaned by Baron Northcrest and shaped by the streets. Use VR mechanics to steal, evade, and outsmart the City's forces. Your goal? A relic in Northcrest's vault, which uncovers a far greater artifact with a powerful legacy.

name: The Unseen Awakening
summary: This game essentially has no visuals, it’s designed for players who are visually impaired. Visual cues are available, but for a complete experience, they’re not recommended. If possible, please rely on auditory cues to play. Thank you.

name: The Stairwell
summary: You've been hired to keep watch in a mysterious building with an infinite stairwell. Your task is simple: investigate each floor for strange phenomena. If you find an anomaly, be careful. Test your skills on the global leaderboard and in the weekly challenge event.

name: The Elementalist Typing
summary: A tactical typing role-playing game to sharpen your typing skills! Featuring colorful hand-drawn pixel art and a unique mad-lib engine for endless typing variety! Upgrade your wizard and play tactically to defeat mighty foes and collect fabulous home decorations. Make typing practice fun!

name: There Will Be Light
summary: There Will Be Light is a top-down puzzle adventure in a gloomy but cozy environment. To progress, you have to solve tricky logic puzzles, while defending yourself against enemies. Dive into this cozy but challenging puzzle adventure as you solve riddles and fight your way back to the light.

name: The Tavern In the Woods
summary: "Tavern in the Woods" is a first person, single-player interactive fiction story that blends mystery, storytelling, and supernatural horror. Players explore and investigate an isolated environment as the narrative slowly unfolds, gradually uncovering the truth behind the eerie emptiness.

name: The Liquid Jet
summary: A slimy, psychedelic adventure about a girl attending a forest warehouse rave party with her friends, where she'll go to experience a long, profound bad (?) trip.

name: The Tower of Shadows
summary: Tower of Shadows is a turn-based strategy game where every decision counts. Climb the levels one by one, face formidable opponents, and perfect your tactics to reach the top. Your ultimate challenge? The Master of Shadows himself.

name: The Compunaut & the Meaning of Life
summary: The meaning of life already has been discovered but was lost a long time ago. You explore an ancient organic computer to restore this lost knowledge. But be aware... You are not welcome! Be ready to fight for your life!

name: The Paper Time Travelers
summary: Embark on a magical journey through enchanted worlds! Help Lina and Theo stop an evil force threatening to erase all the stories

name: The Cozy Garden of Forgotten Dreams
summary: An interactive audiobook with fun voices and colorful drawings, where you'll meet Olivia and experience a great enchanted adventure.

name: The Garden of Hermeneus
summary: Step into the role of 'Me,' a linguist, and decipher the words of 'Him,' a beastman. With only 90 days, can 'Me' connect with 'Him' heart to heart within this limited time?

name: The Creator
summary: The Creator is a peaceful meditative game-simulator where you create unique designs for locations and territories. Enjoy the creative process without searching for resources or fear of making mistakes, as you design stunning interiors and exteriors in picturesque corners of the world.

name: The Airflow Trials
summary: In the simulated world, the drone tries to cope with tasks that sometimes defy gravity and at other times, common sense. Loads, buttons, levers, and amusing fails in a physics puzzle where every mistake is almost an experiment.

name: The Town of Nie Iromusubi
summary: A strange tale, weaved like the petals of a flower.

name: The Magnificent Scoundrels
summary: This is a romance simulation game. In this game, there are no naive, overly-sweet girls—you'll need genuine charm and flirting skills to win a girl's heart.

name: The Existence Theory of the No.13 High School
summary: This is a text-based adventure game about a Chinese high school, where you will experience the joys or pains, the richness or meaninglessness of high school life by rolling dice and making choices.

name: The Daily Burgle
summary: There are nine words in the "Word Vault". Players have seven attempts to "burgle" the vault by searching for movies with plot descriptions that may contain the words. All word vaults have a "heist" movie, where all 9 words can be burgled in a single attempt.

name: The Mountain and the Moron
summary: The Mountain and The Moron is a 3D Rage Platformer about a Uncle who is down on his luck, and watches a podcast telling him to "Climb a mountain to become Enlightened".

name: The Demon Queen's Dire Dilemma
summary: A cute and comedic yuri visual novel about a demon queen who just can't catch a break.

name: Thank You For Your Application!
summary: Thank You For Your Application! is a 'Dystopian Job Market Simulator' that is a satire of online job boards and the post-pandemic job market!

name: The Jumping Spaghetti
summary: From the makers of the Jumping Food Games comes the next whirling adventure on the plate. In "The Jumping Spaghetti" you control an elastic noodle through 28 varied levels full of obstacles, rotating platforms and surprising twists and turns.

name: They Call It Gravity
summary: They Call It Gravity is a fast-paced single-player air combat game where you pilot a highly agile drone through handcrafted arenas in push-forward tactical action — dodge air defenses, expand your zone of control and destroy enemy swarms.

name: The Gentle Golem
summary: The Gentle Golem is a relaxing open world exploration game inspired by Zelda and PowerWash Simulator! Clean up the corruption that's encroaching on your home! Grow plants to help you traverse, or just grow pretty ones! Explore the Cloudlands at your own pace. Can you uncover its mysteries?

name: The Cube
summary: The Cube is an MMO RPG shooter. A giant, levitating Cube with rotating rows and edges. Hidden within is an unknown equation capable of altering the laws of reality. Can you survive another turn?

name: The First Descendant: Season 3
summary: Hoverbikes, 8-player Field Colossus Raids, and brand-new Descendants throughout this new season to experience.

name: The Silent One
summary: Explore a cursed hotel, solve puzzles, and face your fears to escape a nightmarish loop. Will you complete the ritual or remain trapped forever?

name: The Last Resourcer
summary: The Last Resourcer is a survival and automation game where energy fuels life and knowledge powers discovery. Gather resources, build your base, and automate with machines. But something watches, twisting the machines that once served you. Who's really in control?

name: Thalassic Dice
summary: Sail the seas in this tactical roguelike dice-rolling game. Assemble your crew, battle sea monsters, sail through hazardous waters and escape ship wrecking storms. Manage and upgrade your ship and recruit and train new crewmates at your own port. What secrets are hiding beneath the waves?

name: The Final Print
summary: You're a journalist investigating a suspicious case during the Harlem riots. Take pictures of evidence, gather information by interrogating people, and put it all together in an article to show people the truth.

name: The Joker's Game
summary: "The Joker's Game" is an FMV crime battle royale. Jack, drowning in debt, joins a lethal game. Critical choices, even small ones, shape outcomes. Outwit rivals, uncover truths, or perish? Every move decides survival... or the deadly prize.

name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
summary: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
summary: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

name: The Bureau of Fantastical & Arcane Affairs
summary: The Bureau of Fantastical & Arcane Affairs is a comedic first-person narrative adventure. As an inspector at the Bureau, the fate of this fable is in your hands. Do your job, fix the shambled story — or, don’t. When you're done, step into the hero’s boots and see what sort of tale your work wrought.

name: The Adventures of Candle Boy
summary: Missing the golden era of action platformers? Candle Boy is here to ignite your nostalgia with a fiery punch! Dive into this action-packed adventure from an indie studio that delivers classic thrills with a modern twist

name: The Phoenix Gene
summary:
The Phoenix Gene is an adrenaline-fueled VR quest for immortality.
Control a fierce phoenix, Firestorm, and genetically enhanced Jackie, bonded by fate and driven by the collapse of the Slipstream multiverse.
Total Immersion. Total Action: Fly, dodge, and move your body in this adventurous ‘schumupp.

name: The Organized Capy God
summary: Help Capy God organize all his creations. Sort, stack and group items in this relaxing and chill game!

name: The King of Fighters XI
summary:
Dreamcast conversion of the Atomiswave game.

It’s not emulation, it’s a conversion.

The only difference is the loading times between stages (cause Atomiswave is a cartridge hardware).

The King of Fighters XI is a 2D fighting game produced by SNK Playmore. It is the eleventh installment in The King of Fighters series following The King of Fighters 2003. It was originally released as a coin-operated arcade game for the Atomiswave platform in 2005.

name: The Triminals
summary: The Triminals is a fantasy roguelike blending squad tactics & deckbuilding. Lead 3 heroes through randomized adventures, collecting cards and making strategic choices in turn-based combat to unravel mysteries of time & space.

name: The Broken Clock
summary: A Japanese fantasy role-playing game in the pure style of the SNES classics. Join Ray, Eliza, Lera and Nets in an exciting adventure where human ingenuity and obsession cause all kinds of problems that they will have to fight to save their world.

name: The Uncultured
summary: The Uncultured is an art museum management game where you turn visitors into artists. Manage your museum, introduce people to art, nurture their talent, and display their creations. Can you transform the uncultured into creators and build the museum of your dreams?

name: The Sintonia Chronicles
summary: Join Maria on an unforgettable journey through the world of Sintonia to rescue her beloved pups. Forge unlikely alliances, face epic bosses, and outsmart every challenge in a universe brimming with magic and adventure.

name: The Forest of Black Eden
summary: Stranded on an island crawling with terrifying creatures, you must survive, build, and uncover its dark secrets. Escape or be one of them with lost dream.

name: Through His Eyes
summary: Through His Eyes is a psychological horror game where a father, trapped in a haunting time loop, must uncover the truth and escape from his house to find his daughter but a dark presence won’t let him go. Unlock doors, solve puzzles and break the cycle.

name: The Map Is the Thing
summary: The Map Is the Thing is a casual, mind-bending puzzle game. Explore a dungeon where you solve puzzles by folding your map to open new paths. Find keys to defeat barriers and find the fabled GaMuffin.

name: The Window 8
summary: Welcome to The Window 8, a psychological horror experience that watches as much as it is played. This isn’t just a game—it’s a doorway. Follow my voice. Trust my guidance. I will lead you to see our god.

name: The Gatekeeper of Scarlet's Mansion
summary: In this Touhou doujin STG, you don't attack enemies by shooting bullets. Instead, use punches, fairy maids, and Spell Cards to fulfill gatekeeper's duty. On top of that, learn how to build combos, win a lot of blue points, and experience the exhilarating feeling when they fill the entire screen!

name: The Visitor Effect
summary: What if your world was a lie? Outsmart inventive puzzles to escape the glitching simulation that holds you captive. Question reality and uncover a dark conspiracy while evading rogue security systems in this innovative puzzle-adventure.

name: The Orange of Tomorrow
summary: The Orange of Tomorrow is a turn-based RPG where you must aim your attacks. Use the power of fate and the elements to discover the meaning of love, oranges and what tomorrow holds.

name: The Outer Worlds 2: Premium Edition
summary:
The Outer Worlds 2 Premium Edition includes:
- The Outer Worlds 2 base game
- Up to 5 days early access
- DLC Pass for 2 future story expansions*
- Moon Man’s Corporate Appreciation Premium Prize Pack
- Access to The Outer Worlds 2 Digital Artbook & Original Soundtrack

name: Thumps & Blows
summary: Chaos and fun are guaranteed in this fighting game, where a quirky cast of stickmen battle each other using ridiculous techniques in fast-paced fights with easy-to-learn yet unexpectedly deep mechanics.

name: Thumblemania
summary: Thumb up and fight! Thumblemania is an action-packed wrestling game where you smack down your opponents to become the “Strongest Thumb of the Univeeeeerse”!

name: The Maimed God's Saga
summary:
The Maimed God's Saga is a fan-made campaign for Neverwinter Nights 2.

You play as a cleric of Tyr, the god of justice, on assignment to investigate attacks by a mysterious beast. Joined in your adventure by a friendly ranger, you solve various problems in a Town with a Dark Secret, a secret that eventually brings you into conflict with corruption at the very heart of the Church of Tyr itself.

name: This World Is Over
summary: Explore, collect, craft, build, hunt, eat, drink, fight or run away in order to survive another day. You have an entire world to make your own history, but remember... This World Is Over...

name: The Eternal Hunt
summary: Endgame-first ARPG: Conquer infinite dungeons, master deep loot, and dominate leaderboards. Built for grinders.

name: The Lighthouse Secrets
summary: On a remote and forgotten island, a century-old lighthouse that once guided ships across the seven seas has ceased to function. Its disappearance has sparked countless theories and speculations. To solve the mystery, the protagonist, is hired to investigate The Lighthouse Secrets.

name: The Death Forest
summary: The Death Forest is a psychological horror game set in a cursed forest where hallucinations blur reality. Solve puzzles, survive terrifying visions, and uncover the truth behind the legend—before you lose your

name: The Tumor
summary: Hardcore stealth survival-horror in retro style with realistic physics. The creature is faster, hears, and feels you perfectly. Escape is impossible. Craft, set traps, strategize. Hide, deceive, and fight to uncover the truth.

name: The King of Fighters XIII Climax
summary: A new version of KOFXIII, including the characters introduced on the console ports, as well as new revisions, was released in Japanese arcades on April 26, 2012, under the name The King of Fighters XIII Climax.

name: The Island of Doctor Morose
summary: A horror adventure game inspired by the art of Theodor Geisel and the works of HP Lovecraft, featuring a mixture of point and click and survival horror elements.

name: Thalia
summary: Thalia is a fast paced roguelike action game. You as Thalia has been summoned to this ancient place where death is not the end, it is only the beginning. Fight hoards of enemies, giant bosses and improve in an infinite mechanic where death only makes you stronger!

name: The Lake Lady
summary: After his girlfriend died in a flood, the surgeon Salvio, in search of the truth behind his missing daughter, enters the "Ward No. 9" of Hongqiang Hospital, shrouded in the legend of the LakeLady.

name: The Giving Well
summary: After wandering into a forgotten town you overhear the townsfolk wishing by the town's well. Having traveled across the ancient forest you embark on quests to retrieve the lost items. Jump, Grapple, and Push your way through the forest to help those in need. While adventuring, you just might run into the spirits of the forest.

name: The Walking Pet
summary: If you think that walking on two legs is easy, the pets do not think so! Be a cat, a cow or a crocodile and try to walk on two legs. How far you can go?

name: The Hatchling
summary: Locked in a dystopian lab, a strange egg stirs. Control its environment, and ensure it hatches—before the system deems you unfit. The Hatchling is a chilling low-bit horror experience where every second counts. The Overseer is watching… will you succeed, or be discarded?

name: The Architect Pack
summary:
The Architect Pack or simply T.A.P is a Don't Starve Together Mod for Base Building!
Made for people who enjoy building and feel the game has not many options for decorations. This mod contains huge amount of decorative structures for Base Building! Also this mod includes some special items, secret structures and a fellow companion!

T.A.P features structures across all the DLCs and Events of Don't Starve such as The Gorge, The Forge, Shipwrecked, Hamlet, Reign of Giants, Legacy Edition
Take a look in what you can build, the limit is your imagination!

Over +1000 Structures: Everything can be crafted in this mod!

Hidden Structures: There's also Easter Eggs, Hidden Structures, Secrets and many References in T.A.P can you find them all?
The blueprints for hidden structures can be obtained by killing specific mobs or doing specific actions!

Decorative Creatures: Some structures comes with unique mobs to make your world more alive, some mobs even interact with you. And you can find new birds across The Constant!
Packim Baggims can be obtained by killing Malbatross while Ro Bin by killing Ancient Guardian.

name: The Seven Enchantments
summary: Play as Józef of Místov a conman exorcist. Discover the unique story through clues about what dark mysteries fell upon the denizens of a remote village of Pradonin, all while trying to survive the Horrors along the way.

name: The Anomaly Protocol
summary: The Anomaly Protocol - Something is wrong with the building. Floors repeat, reality shifts, and you've been assigned to investigate. Use your checklist to track anomalies—but the deeper you go, the more the truth slips away.

name: The Grafted Gear
summary: 《The Grafted Gear》is an auto chess game that focuses on engine building. In each game, you will get a large number of equipment with unique entries and designs, facing enemies with unique designs. In the rest between each battle, you will build your equipment, and build a unique equipment engine.

name: The Archaic: Unauthorized
summary: A story-driven 3D action platformer set in a post-immortal future, where the last organic human awakens. Explore levels with metroidvania progression, momentum-based traversal, and tactical combat. Uncover the ruins of a world that chose immortality over humanity.

name: The Wizards Arena
summary: Fight in an arena build for wizards to duel against each other. Use your mouse like a wand and do some qool magic. You are basicly a gladiator but instead of swords, you use wands and spells.

name: The Soul of Cosmos
summary: "The Soul of Cosmos"is an adventure game about souls that combines card strategy, bullet screen shooting, and role-playing. But please remember, the most important thing in the game is always your choice! The various choices and experiences in the game world will ultimately reflect your soul.

name: The Drawstring Dungeon
summary: Forge insane decks, stack powerful charms, battle pun-fueled monsters, and build your own final boss in this chaotic roguelike deckbuilder packed with evolving cards, extractions, and endless combos.

name: The Shadow of the Warring States Period
summary: This is a RPG game, you can operate a team of 5 people to explore together. Combat is real-time, but allows players to pause the game mid-game to give orders to their team members.

name: The Flower Inspector
summary: It's time to return that favor. You must inspect flowers and decide where you'll ship them to. There's a long night ahead and some of your choices may haunt you.If you feel you're being watched, turn off the lights and hide.

name: The Good, the Bad & the Monkey
summary: Create your own deck with 5 different fun cards in the game and shape your lies. Be careful! There is also a murderer in the game. Will you be able to deceive both the murderer and your friends with your lies at this 5-person table and achieve victory? Anyone who is confident can try!

name: The Great Hatch
summary: Lead an army of goblins in a quest to break a giant floating Egg. Build your village and manage hordes of goblins in a chaotic journey to uncover the mysteries of the giant Egg.

name: The Wondrous Wedding of Ivan the Bard
summary: A romantic fairy tale set in a fantasy medieval Rus'. Play as Ivan, a young bard with a gusli in hand, on a quest to win the love of the elusive Novgorod princess. Learn tunes, make choices!

name: The River
summary: A short story point-and-click visual novel about the afterlife.

name: The Museum
summary: A content creator enters the cursed Museum for views, but finds something watching. Solve twisted puzzles, survive a ghost’s wrath, and choose your ending in this survival horror tale.

name: The Hilltop Funeral
summary: Yet another night at Cherry Hill, a casket arrives. The phone rings—two pallbearers are sent. One hand for one man, navigate through the cemetery and deliver the dead to their destination… at The Hilltop Funeral.

name: The Forgotten Mine
summary: The Forgotten Mine is a small 2D Platformer, from a young small Team.In this Platformer you fell into a mine where nobody was for years. You had a friend with you, but since you woke up the friend is gone. So you're going to search for your friend and for an exit of the mine

name: There Are No Orcs
summary: An RTS-Roguelike hybrid with auto-battling troops. Master building placement, swarm your enemies, and smash their defenses with unit-commander combos!

name: The Mare Show
summary: Overcome different scenarios and monsters, acquire new lantern visuals and reveal what lies behind this circus of horrors dominated by an insane entity.

name: The Smol Mushroomancer
summary: Embrace fungal capitalism in this casual 2.5D mushroom management sim starring Witchy the smol mushroomancer from before she became a smol survivor in her journey to obtain maximum profits by tapping into her mycelium roots.

name: The Maiden and the Cow
summary: Inherit your mother's old farm. Raise mutant animals to discover new species knowing that your discoveries will influence the world around you. Build relationships with a wide cast of characters and help them transform their lives. Can you create the perfect animal?

name: The Undying Sea
summary: The Undying Sea is a first-person exploration title about dealing with death, exploring a city in decline, and reaching out a hand to those who need it on a long-decaying oceanic city filled with once immortal beings now way too aware that they aren't immortal anymore...

name: The Last Squad
summary: A team-based third-person shooter where up to four players battle waves of evolving zombies using class-based tactics, upgrades, and survival skills.

name: The Novice: Animal Kingdom
summary: Survive relentless waves of agitated wild beasts and rise through the ranks of the adventurer’s guild in this intense roguelite action RPG. Collect gems and complete quests to buy powerful upgrades. Increase your rank to unlock new map and quests. Your goal: find the cause of the chaos!

name: Throne of Ages
summary: "Throne of ages" blends roguelike progression with grand-scale RTS gameplay, letting players command multiple legions across vast battlefields. Command your troops in real-time across dynamically generated battlefields where every campaign offers unique randomized upgrades and unit evolution.

name: The End of Paradise
summary: A dark, despair-filled RPG + survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Play as a mercenary survivor in the last paradise. Befriend or kill 6 companions, explore the black mist, face the Old Gods, and choose to save humanity—or end the world.

name: The Light Charmer
summary: This is a rogue-like tower defense game where players control Light Wisps. Players use Light Wisps to build defense towers and obtain Light Shards, which can be combined to create various Light Wisp attack patterns! Use these to defeat enemies and escort Princess Liana to save the world.

name: The Conquest
summary: The Conquest is spiritual successor to The Invasion 2.

name: The Sling and The Stone
summary: The Sling and The Stone is an action-adventure game where players craft powerful stones and use a sling to fight demons, rising from zero to hero in a thrilling journey of revenge and rescue, culminating in a surprising meeting with a greater force.

name: The Midnight Exorcist
summary: Explore the dark corners of a haunted art museum in The Midnight Exorcist, an investigative puzzle game. Discover hidden secrets and follow the clues to piece together the ancient mystery of the museum's past - and the ghostly dangers of its present.

name: The Adventure Ball
summary:
The Adventure Ball is a puzzle game in that the player needs to complete all 20 levels.

Some levels are easy and some levels are more challenging, you can always go to the level you want and pass it too :)

name: The Last Pussy: Survival Lesson
summary: The Last Pussy: Survival Lesson is an adult visual novel with point & click elements in a post-apocalyptic bunker setting.

name: The Guardians of the Secret Garden
summary: A journey through a magical garden, which needs help. An adventurous girl and her dog will seek to restore peace with the help of new friends.

name: The Meaning of Auri
summary: Follow an Auri Field Researcher from the planet Auriga, as they land in an enchanted forest full of creatures who speak an unknown language. Interact with the inhabitants of the forest and learn their language to complete your research–and maybe learn a thing or two about what Auri really means.

name: The Symbiant II
summary: The Symbiant II is a BL / Yaoi / Gay visual novel about a man who goes through change he didn't ask for. It's also a tale of ancient secrets, intimate exploration and unlikely romance.

name: The Shame of a Daydreamer
summary: Shame & choices = possible apocalypse. You need to figure out what’s causing the apocalypse to happen, so that you can prevent it. 2 playable characters with different relations to shame → 2 unique perspectives of the same story. Complicated families, branching choices and unforgiving consequences.

name: The Sims 2: OMGWTFBBQ
summary: Has ACR or "risky woohoo" given your sims too many unwanted crotchfruit? Did the adoption agency fob off another baby on you instead of that pizza you wanted? Brought to you by the coolest acronym ever to grace the face of the Internets, it's OMGWTFBBQ! It's new! It's shiny! It's more awesome than all those lesser, useless downloads that do nothing that isn't already in the game! It even functions as a regular grill, with all the options, for all versions of game, unlike other people and their lesser-awesome crap! And best of all, it can be yours for less than 640K, because 640K is all anyone should ever need. Accept no Kewian-based substitutes! If you don't vote for this to win, I will come in the night and steal your first-born children! And then EAT them!

name: The World of Japanese Tea Through the Way of Tea
summary: In every quiet cup, a deep tradition lives on. This guide explores the world of Japanese tea—from its varieties and flavors to the rich cultural practice of the tea ceremony.

name: The Adventures of Commander Shepard
summary: A short point and click adventure Mass Effect fan game.

name: The Gunstringer: Real Big Shootin'
summary: Real Big Shootin' will challenge players to blast their way to Mad Dog McDog over four different levels featuring everything from “metal dudes” to giant frogs, rockets, spiders, killer bats, and, of course, flying cows.

name: The Gunstringer: El Diablo's 'Merican Adventure
summary: This shooting-gallery themed DLC pack features El Diablo, the Lady of the Dead's husband, as its hero marionette. El Diablo shoots his way through a wide variety of full pop-up gallery environments based on the retail game, along with all-new sets including the Barons oil platform and the Madams bedroom and ballroom.

name: The Pale Deep
summary: Descend into the depths of Neptune's atmosphere, discovering what lies below and how to survive in the aerial depths. See how much you can discover before your equipment, or your knowledge fails you.

name: The Lady Knight and The Three Princes
summary: Choose your fairytale prince and go on an adventure to win his hand in marriage!

name: The Adventures of Ally The Alligator
The Sniper
summary: Defend the landing force from behind enemy lines. Take them out before the sniper gets you!

name: The Last Shelter
summary: Protect your base from alien bugs in this epical strategy/defence game!

name: The Missing Part
summary:
You are a man who has lost what was most important to him. In the prologue, learn all about the events that led you to the current point in your life.

Then decide for yourself how to deal with your grief. Will you find a way out of your pain, or will you trade one emptiness for another?

Meet your potential love interests who can accompany you on your way out or watch you as you continue your descent.

name: The Devil Rais’d the Storm
summary: The Devil rais'd the storm is a mysterious science fiction visual novel with point-and-click elements. Unravel a tense and moody story as you navigate your new role stationed at a strange outpost on a remote planet.

name: The Prophecy of Horn
summary: Defeat the legions of darkness and kill their ruler, the Demon God Horn. The game tells the story of the feat of three heroes in a dark flexible world in an RPG with an original hybrid turn-based combat system and other well-known game mechanics.

name: The Night Is Long
summary: The Night Is Long is a short first-person horror game where a grieving man follows a ghostly vision into an abandoned mansion. Uncover dark secrets, survive atmospheric horrors, and face your past through exploration, puzzles, and subtle scares.

name: The Roast: Coffee Shop Simulator
summary: Enjoy the thrill of managing your own coffee shop! Fill the counter with coffee beans, craft your menu and set prices to your liking, take customer orders, and whip up tasty coffees. Decorate and expand your shop.

name: The Odyssey of Commander Cookie
summary: Take command of the PSS, Paw Space Squadron, and catfight your way through relentless swarms of cybermice. Scavenge their tech. Upgrade your ship and weapons and unlock a fleet of fellow cat heroes, as you claw your way to victory in this intense roguelite twin-stick shooter.

name: This Game is Ground Breaking
summary: This Game is Ground Breaking - aims to bring back the fun of wanting to smash your friend in the head with a controller!

name: The Bunny Graveyard II
summary: Help Skye the Bunny find her lost brother Claudio in this action-packed horror adventure with charming pixel graphics. Hop like a bunny and get ready to explore the haunted streets of Carrot Town!

name: The Book of Living Magic
summary: A point & click adventure set in the faraway Mountains of Oddness. What will you discover on your journey through the Lands of Dream?

name: That Sausage Museum Game
summary: Flip-flop, roll and fling your way through a wacky art museum as a clumsy sausage on the run. Dodge weird obstacles, pull off ridiculous stunts, and try not to fall all the way down as you escape.

name: The Prior Challenge
summary:
Prove that you are ready for the real challenges by solving this game first.
You have been studying all night for a big test. When it is time to leave to take the test you find out that you are locked in the library.
In this casual point-and-click adventure you need to find and solve a series of puzzles to find the key to escape the library.
Expect enjoyment and challenging puzzles in which you need creative solutions to escape the library. How fast can you escape?

Get to know the escape room games of Esciri with this teaser escape room. The Prior Challenge takes place before “the Magician’s Challenge” and “the Knight’s Challenge”.

name: The Sweet Scramble
summary: Fight with sweets! 2D action battle royale! Sweets Battle Royale! A battle royale style action game in which fairies armed with sweets fight until the last man is left standing.

name: The Evil Inside
summary: A single player Horror adventure, asks you to enter various haunted locations and face evil creatures. Using just your lantern, you will face peril in every room and around every corner to complete your task.

name: The House Below
summary: The House Below is a first-person psychological horror game where you navigate dark, shifting corridors with no weapons or clear escape. Tension builds through eerie sounds, subtle puzzles, and unsettling surprises, as you unravel a haunting story told entirely through the environment.

name: The Original Moorhuhn Hunt
summary: Celebrate 25 years of The Original Moorhuhn Hunt! Play the iconic game that started it all and unlock the classic Moorhuhn Remake as a bonus.

name: The Puppy
summary: It's just one week of work: watching over a sweet baby in a quiet, cozy house. Don't worry about my little dog, i love him, and he loves the baby. Seems like an easy job… until night falls.

name: The Legend of Nezha
summary: "The Legend of Nezha" is a casual business simulation game. Players will take on the role of the owner of an inn. They will have a complete and rich set of service functions. The game will meticulously simulate various massage techniques,It can enable players to be more immersed in the game.

name: The Cursed Legacy
summary: The Cursed Legacy is an action/exploration game based on “die and retry” and made with love and passion to pay tribute to the games of the 90s. It also offers mini games that give this work an infinite lifespan.

name: The Magician's Challenge
summary:
It will be a real challenge to escape from this magical room full of puzzles!
Can you solve the biggest-kept secret of the magicians? You are a magician in training about to take your final test.
In this relaxed point-and-click adventure you will discover a magical room. In this room a series of puzzles can be found that need to be solved to find the key, which opens the door so you can escape.
Expect enjoyment and challenging puzzles in which you need creative solutions to escape the library. How fast can you escape?

name: The Knight's Challenge
summary:
You are locked in a tower room of a castle.
Get ready for a point-and-click adventure about knights and castles. In this casual escape room game you have to find all the clues to solve a series of puzzles. Only if you solve all the puzzles will you be able to escape the tower room.
Expect enjoyment and challenging puzzles in which you need creative solutions to escape the library. How fast can you escape?

name: The Last Mage
summary: The Last Mage: Trials of Vahrkesh is a story-rich action RPG where Aelena, pulled from the modern world into a medieval realm, gains forbidden magic and joins a rebellion. Battle, solve puzzles, and face epic trials to stop a tyrant in a world of danger, mystery, and magic.

name: The Incident at Galley House
summary: In 1936, something terrible happened at Galley House. Decades later, with a strange contraption that reveals echoes of the past, you must uncover the truth behind this grisly mystery.

name: The Troll & The Witch's House
summary: The Troll & The Witch’s House is a point-and-click adventure game set in a strange house filled with mysteries. Piece together fragments of the past, uncover secrets and find the key to your escape.

name: The Wizard’s Beans Or: A Short Period of Unplanned Internment
summary: Solve puzzles, enlist magic beans, eat soap, plan your escape, and confront the menacing mage who keeps you confined in his tower. Will you keep cracking jokes or learn from your mistakes? Your choices matter.

name: The Sovereign
summary: A tactical roguelike RPG where you face fragments of an immortal king’s soul in high-stakes turn-based battles. Every decision you make directly impacts your future, with bosses reacting in real-time to your choices and playstyle. Learn their preferences as well as their triggers to survive.

name: The Ruin Wanderer
summary: Somewhere in the Great Desert, an ancient tomb awaits an eager explorer. Can you make it past the traps and escape with the treasure in this short episodic single-player adventure?

name: The Regreening
summary: In our cozy nature-restoration management game, you are the last human on Earth, but your task isn’t survival—it’s renewal. Regreen habitats by planting seeds, restore habitats to welcome back folklore animals, and nurture ecosystems to life. Trade resource extraction for purposeful healing.

name: The Joycare
summary: The Joycare is a psychological horror game where you investigate the abandoned facilities of a forgotten childcare company. What was once a joyful place now hides disturbing secrets, twisted experiments, and something that never left…

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Sonny Outfit Pack 2
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't look fly! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Sonny.

name: The Grey Road
summary: Enter a world of road trip horror in this procedurally generated driving adventure. Face hazardous environments, deadly weather, and gigantic monsters. Scavenge for supplies, navigate obstacles, and search for safehouses - but remember: you are never truly safe.

name: The Pinkman Files
summary: Uncover the mystery of what really broke bad as Jesse Pinkman from the hit television series Breaking Bad alongside his partner in crime Walter White, from Breaking Bad.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Connie Outfit Pack 2
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Connie.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Hitchhiker Outfit Pack 1
summary: Even when on the hunt, Grandpa always expects everyone to look their best for dinner time! This DLC will give you one brand new outfit for the Hitchhiker.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Julie Outfit Pack 2
The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Leland Outfit Pack 2
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Leland.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Cook Outfit 1
summary: Even when on the hunt, Grandpa always expects everyone to look their best for dinner time! This DLC will give you one brand new outfit for the Cook.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Danny Outfit Pack 2
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Danny.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Chainsaw Skin Variants 2
summary: Continue to show off your twisted personality with these three new skins for Leatherface's chainsaw! Includes the Bloody, Grimy, and Muddy variants. Slaughter with style!

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Sissy Ivy Outfit
summary: Even when on the hunt, Grandpa always expects everyone to look their best for dinner time! This DLC will give you one brand new outfit for Sissy.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Virginia Outfit Pack 1
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Virginia.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Execution Pack 4
summary: Terrorize the Victims even more with these new, grisly executions for the Slaughter Family! This pack features one kill each for Leatherface, The Cook, The Hitchhiker, Sissy, Johnny, Hands, and Nancy. Enjoy the hunt!

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Maria Outfit Pack 1
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't do it in style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Maria. Requires Maria character, sold separately.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Leland Outfit Pack 3
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't have great style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Leland.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Ana Outfit Pack 3
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't have style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Ana.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Summer Time Outfit Pack
