summary: Beat the Texas heat while making sure to avoid getting beaten by the Family in these summertime outfits! This DLC pack gives each Victim one brand new themed outfit. Stay cool and alive!

name: The Amazing Digital Circus: Fan VN Game
summary: A fangame Visual Novel adapting the pilot episode of the animated show 'The Amazing Digital Circus'.

name: The Lost Crucible
summary: Race against the clock to craft and sell items for needy adventurers. Use and upgrade equipment to navigate the dozens of levels located in the unique environments of the Crucible, a forgotten arcane workshop. Craft all you can solo, or with up to four friends - local or online.

name: The Cub: Back to Earth Edition
summary:
The Cub is a challenging platformer inspired by classic ’90s SEGA games, blending nostalgic gameplay with modern twists. Set in a post-apocalyptic Earth, players navigate parkour-style through the ruins of humanity, outsmarting evolved wildlife, solving clever environmental puzzles, and evading relentless human hunters in a deadly safari chase.

The Cub: Back to Earth Edition Includes: Special Case, Nintendo Switch Game, Artbook and Digital Soundtrack.

name: The Lingering: Graveyard Visit
summary: (The Lingering) Graveyard Visit is a horror, walking sim game where you play as Eki, an 11-year-old boy who visits his late father’s grave with his mother while finding out the truth about her and the rumor about child sacrificial ritual. Should Eki trust his mother? You decide.

name: The Silent Witness
summary: You’re a detective tracking a brutal murder. The forest holds the documents. The warehouse hides the body. Evidence in hand, you head back—but the forest has changed. The path is gone. Something’s watching. And it doesn’t want you to leave.

name: The Nest
summary: The Nest is a psychological horror adventure set in a secluded mansion shrouded in unfamiliar isolation, where you must undertake given mysterious tasks. Unravel hidden tasks amidst bizarre phenomena and unveil the mansion's secrets.

name: The Solitude Project
summary: The Solitude Project is a complete rework of A Liminal Place Legacy (also known as Remastered). Find your way to the next level, do whatever you want! But remember... you will never find the exit.

name: The Revenant's Lament
summary:
Way out west, in the most lonesome of reaches, strange things are afoot. Cowboys around campfires tell ghost stories and tall tales, speak of impossible, supernatural things. They say the devil walks amongst men. They say he'll grant you impossible wishes at the cost of your eternal soul. They say he can bring dead men back to life.

They say that somewhere out where the wind whispers secrets, there roams a cowboy who can't die. Abandoned by God and the devil alike, left to wander the range, forever searching for something. For someone - that accursed devil or a merciful angel or a lost love or death itself. And when the cowboy finds who he's looking for - there'll be hell to pay.

The Revenant's Lament, they call this tale of woe, the unfortunate ballad of John Cassidy King.

name: The Ballad of Light and Shadow
summary: You were a struggling college student looking for a way out. What you found was far, far more. Plunge into the epic world of New Delphine, a kingdom awaiting its salvation at the hands of its rightful king. A sublimely, scandalously subversive dark fantasy ballad of warring brothers and the women caught in the crossfire rife with juicy plot twists and turns guaranteed to keep you on the edge of... your seat.

name: The Last Sip
summary: The Last Sip is a short, atmospheric single-player experience focused on exploration and environmental storytelling. Uncover clues in a mysterious sci-fi facility and piece together the story behind your strange awakening.

name: The Sims 4: Enchanted by Nature
summary: Live surrounded by the magic of nature in The Sims 4 Enchanted by Nature Expansion Pack.

name: The Sims 4: Kitchen Clutter Kit
summary: The kitchen is the hub of family life, so make yours look lived-in with The Sims 4 Kitchen Clutter Kit *. Tell stories about lives in-progress with everyday items, some of which are open or appear to be in use like groceries or a drying rack. This kit includes all the homey touches you need to make more realistic kitchens.

name: The Sims 4: Restoration Workshop Kit
summary: Complete satisfying repairs in your own versatile workshop with The Sims 4 Restoration Workshop Kit*. Take old, broken-down appliances and revive them with your Handiness skill. This kit will help you capture the full handy-Sim experience with shelves, workbenches, and other details for building a functional space.

name: The Sims 4: Golden Years Kit
summary: Dress Elder Sims in relaxed, practical styles tailored just for them with The Sims 4 Golden Years Kit*. Elder Sims have lived long, interesting lives! These comfortable looks will help them display their personalities wherever their stories take them next whether that’s the garden, the gym, or on a stroll through the neighborhood.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Denim Outfit Pack
summary: A great fit. Close and smooth. Flatters the figure and feels good. Denim has the look that cuts like a chainsaw! This DLC pack includes one new outfit for Connie, Leland, Ana, Sonny, Julie, Danny, Virginia, and Maria.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Sonny Outfit Pack 3
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't look super fly! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Sonny.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Sunday Best Outfit Pack
summary: It is dinner time, so the Family is going to look fancy for Grandpa by putting on their Sunday Best! This DLC pack includes one new outfit for The Cook, The Hitchhiker, Sissy, Johnny, Nancy, and Hands.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Connie Outfit Pack 3
summary: Just because you are fighting for your life doesn't mean you can't have great style! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Connie.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: 2003 Leatherface
summary: Play as the brutal depiction of Leatherface from the 2003 remake! Based on The Texas Chainsaw Massacre film released in 2003, this DLC outfit includes a new look for Leatherface, a new chainsaw skin, and a unique execution. If it's terror what you want, it's terror what you'll have.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Rush Week - Winter Holiday Pack
summary: Show your school spirit and tradition while trying not to get gutted in this Homecoming attire! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit for the Rush Week Victims.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Bones
summary: Lovingly nicknamed "Bones" by fellow members of the Slaughter Family, this duplicitous whack job spends his days serving as a local mortician in Muerto County under one of his many aliases. Bones has the ability to plant gore bomb explosives on most vertical surfaces, and they will detonate if a careless Victim sprints by within range, dealing damage and revealing themselves to the Family. Don't let his clothes and appearance fool you, Bones loves chaos, and is as deadly as they come.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Wyatt
summary: While born in the Austin area, Wyatt grew up near Lubbock, TX, and has been ranching since childhood. A loner by nature, Wyatt headed to the cemetery to celebrate a local bull riding win by his brother's gravestone. Discovering damage to his brother's marker, he confronts the mortician and finds himself abducted and trapped by the Slaughter Family. But he isn't defenseless - with concealed throwing knives by his side, Wyatt is able to stun overconfident Family members from a distance. He has a limited number of them, so each throw must count - will this be enough for him to survive?

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Rush Week - Homecoming Pack
summary: Show your school spirit and tradition while trying not to get gutted in this Homecoming attire! This DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit for the Rush Week Victims.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Hands Suspenders Outfit
summary: Even when on the hunt, Grandpa always expects everyone to look their best for dinner time! This DLC will give you one brand new outfit for Hands. Requires Hands character, sold seperately.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Rush Week - Towel Pack
summary: Running for your life in sheer terror has never looked so good! This DLC pack gives the Towel outfit to the Rush Week Victims. Note - if you played Rush Week before October 22nd 2024, you already own this outfit.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Rush Week - Laundry Day Pack
summary: Running for your life in sheer terror has never looked so good! This DLC pack gives the Laundry Day outfit to the Rush Week Victims.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Rush Week - Halloween Outfit Pack
summary: Get into the spooky holiday spirit with these Halloween themed costumes! This DLC pack gives you several brand new outfits for the Rush Week Victims.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Content Pass
summary: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre Content Pass includes a new Family Member, a new Victim, a new Execution Pack, and four new cosmetics.

name: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Julie Outfit Pack 2
summary: Fight for your life and fight for freedom in style! This Stars 'N Stripes DLC pack gives you one brand new outfit with several color variants for Julie.

name: The Sword Witch's Apprentice
summary: The life of a swordsman, apprentice to the Sword Witch. A simple sword-fighting action that uses only the arrow keys.

name: The Mill: Nine Men's Morris
summary: The classic Nine Men’s Morris is a strategy board game, commonly found on the back of a Checkers / Draughts board, that is as easy to get as Tic Tac Toe, but as hard to master as Chess. Excellent for testing your skills or teaching strategy to kids.

name: The Summit
summary: Dive into the Dark Net and rule the underground. In Ocean City, chaos is business. Hack, deal, steal, and rise to power in a criminal open world where money talks and mercy is rare.

name: The Brave Never Alone
summary: This is an auto-idle game placed at the bottom of your screen. The lonely warrior adheres to the "mission", chases slimes and fights them. The warrior will keep moving forward, growing and dying over and over again. All you have to do is watch this journey.

name: The Left Eye
summary: A honey-trapping, backstabbing, high-stakes story with a romantic heart, featuring problematic gays to suit a variety of bad tastes. Set in 1920s New York, this episodic visual novel follows an audacious conman juggling friends, enemies, and the most outrageous scam he’s ever tried to pull.

name: The Rich King
summary:
The Rich King" allows you to experience wealth like you've never dreamed possible!

Start at the bottom, and work your way to fame and glory!

Brace yourself for challenges and obstacles on your journey to greatness, and overcome the odds.

Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate Beggar King?"

name: The Room Collection
summary: Fireproof Games' The Room Collection featuring - The Room, The Room Two, The Room Three and The Room 4: Old Sins.

name: The Ratline
summary: A murdered priest. A secret list. Hunt Nazi fugitives across the globe in this gritty 1971 detective thriller. Analyze evidence, follow leads, and make sharp deductions before the trail goes cold. From the creators of Family, Rivals, Conspiracy, Echo Beach and Riley & Rochelle.

name: The Walls
summary:
Bounce between the walls and follow the path until you reach the exit of each level!

Just tap the screen at the right moment to move the ball on the next path. Collect gems to unlock new balls and try not to fall off the edges!

How far can you go?

name: The Last Love Letter
summary: The Last Love Letter is a challenging 2D platformer set in World War II. Control Antonio, a wounded carrier pigeon unable to fly, must cross dangerous trenches to repair radio antennas and retrieve love letters left by fallen combatants.

name: The Stochastic Dungeons of Apogee
summary:
"When the moons reach their apogee, the world's protective seal shall weaken, thus bringing forth entities and events never before seen."

Each run will be a different experience; the weapons you acquire may never be acquired again, and your most reliable tool is your knowledge of the elements within the dungeon.

name: The Fog Encounters
summary: There's a passenger who's gone mad from the fog, and a captain who's gravely injured inside the near-deserted airport. Counter the madman, follow the captains instructions and get your aircraft fueled to ESCAPE WITH YOUR LIFE.

name: The Pit
summary:
Run, jump, and slide your way through The Pit!

Watch out for deadly traps as you race against the most dangerous terrain.
Choose to play as multiple characters by collecting coins to unlock new ones. Compete with your friends for the highest score.

How far can you go?

name: The Elomont Raider
summary: The Elomont Raider is a fantasy-themed top-down arcade-style game. Attack！Dodge！and Find your way overcoming difficulties！ Enjoy a pure, retro, joyful gaming experience with extra fun! A little bit of hardcore.

name: The Professor
summary: 《The Professor》is a third-person point of view adventure-based game, characters are customizable, game contains various of different map settings, different bosses, intense battles, variety choices of weapons varying from different timezone, the exploration awaits.

name: The Coffin of Sarah
summary: A 2D top down horror game that takes you on a story about a girl named Sarah. Will you be able to solve the puzzles, escape the horror hiding in the dark, and figure out the secrets hiding in this small town?

name: The Legend of Gandar III
summary: An epic fantasy world returns. This is the next chapter of the highly anticipated The Legend of Gandar III installment developed by Jeddead. The Legend of Gandar III takes place 2 years after the events of The Legend of Gandar II and The Legend of Gandar.

name: Threedays
summary: Threedays — a tactical shooter inspired by real events of the war in Ukraine. Take part in the fight for freedom as real-life soldiers, each with a unique story. The game offers a deep narrative, authentic atmosphere, and dynamic gameplay.

name: The Bullet Hell
summary: A true bullet-hell game. Dodge an onslaught of bullets as a variety of ships while surviving until the boss is whittled down enough. Fight the main bosses in a linear order or play special gamemodes that go on forever.

name: Thrust Fall
summary:
The ultimate experience of freedom and speed. Thrust your way through asteroid fields, speedways and deserted colonies at speeds never before achieved—until now.

Thrust Fall isn't for the faint of heart. It's a physics playground that gives complete control to the player. Your VR controllers become your thrusters. Feel the tension as you narrowly avoid collisions, and the satisfaction when you perfectly execute a maneuver.

name: The Warp: Cephisso
summary: Descend into the infested corridors of the Cephisso in this dark, atmospheric VR sci‑fi shooter. Wield the heavy JDE bolt‑action, load every round by hand—and feel the tension in each silent chamber. Find the survivor. Unravel the ship’s horror. Survive The Warp.

name: The Black Signal
summary: Card Combat RPG featuring Sci-Fi aesthetics, a twisted meta-narrative and social criticism.

name: The Last Shot: Arcades
summary: The pack of Arcades in The Last Shot Universe

name: The Chess
summary: The ChessThemed Chess offers a relaxing, minimalist chess experience with multiple boards, piece sets, AI opponents, and multiplayer. Play in 3D or 2D, learn the game's history, and explore RPG-themed DLC. Free to Play - Download now and enjoy endless strategy!

name: The Last Among The Dead
summary: Dive into a devastated world where survival depends not only on your weapons… but on your choices. In The Last Among The Dead, play as a survivor trapped in a land ravaged by a mysterious infection.

name: The Last Heroine
summary: A 3rd-person adventure game of sword fighting against powerful enemies.

name: ThrowDown
summary: ThrowDown is a familiar yet unique tower defense game with randomly generated maps, reactive mobs, and is designed for replayability.

name: Thunder of the DemonKing
summary: Thunder of the Demon King is an action tower defense game with simple controls. Play as the resurrected Demon King, battling the kingdom’s forces alone. Use powerful thunder attacks to protect yourself and enjoy the thrilling battles as you take down waves of enemies.

name: The Hunt for the Gay Planet
summary:
You thought you were fluent at Galactic Basic, but no one seems to understand you when you say "I'm not interested in guys!" Your lasgun ends up having to do the talking for you. The number of star systems you've had to flee you can count on your knuckles.

Well, enough! You've heard rumors of a secret paradise planet where people like you can be people like you, a glittering world where women walk arm-in-arm with women, where you can feel the heat of a lady's reciprocating gaze without having to feel the burn of a thousand judgemental stares on your skin.

Lesbionica. The gay planet. Let's find it.

name: The Amazing World of Gumball Mini Games
summary:
Journey into “The Amazing World of Gumball” and play games with all your favourite characters!

Karate Chop Challenge

Help Gumball chop his way through objects such as TVs, evil tree stumps and even cardboard crocodiles in his quest to become a Karate Master. Time your swipes to chop through objects, but make sure you don’t miss or risk becoming a Karate Weiner.

Darwin’s Dodge Ball

Become the ultimate dodge ball champion with Darwin. Tilt the device to dodge balls. Tap to fire at the other characters as they run past. Collect special bonus shots, extra lives and time bonuses to help you set the best high score.

Character Creator

Let your imagination loose as you build characters using over 50 different body parts from the show. Take a photo of anything - your dad, your hamster, your house and transform them into your very own Gumball character.

name: The Search For Sonic Mania 2
summary: A joke game made for RAGE 2024, The Search For Sonic Mania 2 sees Sonic exploring a familiar world in the search for a lost sequel.

name: The Forgers
summary:
The goal is to correctly fill in all the sentences in your answers list in order to crack the case.
Look for any contradictions between the picture/plaque and external sources, that may point to it being a forgery.

name: The Knight in Pajamas
summary: The Knight was yanked out of bed and hurled into the craziest beat 'em up adventure! Help him complete his quest and get back home. Slash through hordes of enemies, defeat bosses, and take their unique weapons with special effects.

name: The Last Hearth Defense
summary: Your mission in this game is to outwit, outmaneuver, and outlast the enemy waves using smart tactics and powerful upgrades.

name: The Secret Fake Ring
summary: You have lost your job and your home, and you are reunited with two childhood friends. Then, one of them suddenly proposes “marriage” in order to help you... A true love begins from a fake marriage!

name: The Pressure of Ambition
summary: Immerse yourself in a series of abstract artworks, ranging from towering monoliths to gigantic humanoid entities. Use your body to solve puzzles and exert your control over the environment. Find yourself losing control of the sculptures, only to take it back in the end.

name: The Pixotron 49
summary: The Pixotron 49 is a retro-inspired puzzle game where you craft pixel art by wiring together visual logic nodes. Interact with eclectic characters, solve creative challenges, and bring their requests to life - hopefully not one pixel at a time.

name: The Heist 2
summary: Can’t stay away from trouble, can you? The Heist 2 brings you more missions, more control over your gang and, of course, more high-speed pursuits! Got some time? Do some crime!

name: The Judge
summary: Take down multiple criminals case by case as you judge each and every one of them. Will you be naughty or nice? The final verdict is up to you!

name: The Serpent and the Crow
summary: The Serpent and the Crow is an unforgiving roguelite-survivor game. Rip through countless hordes of enemies to unlock gear, skills, origins, and ascensions and create your perfect broken build. You will need to survive to discover the mysteries of this long forgotten tavern.

name: The Last Captain
summary: Experience nail-biting space combat which mixes tactics, physics, and precision in this top-down, sci-fi RPG. Explore the Pyre Sector and fight, trade, and befriend the local factions while seeking vengeance against an enigmatic threat. Take on the campaign with friends, or take part in PvP online.

name: The Case of Theo
summary: Theo's the new kid at this new school, trying to start fresh from the dark past. But guilt doesn't just go away and this one student won’t stop bothering him and there’s something weird about him... like he's way too interested...

name: The Bridge
summary:
You have to cross a bridge, but you're too heavy to go on.
What will you leave behind?

name: The Wandering
summary: The Wandering is a narrative-driven single-player first-person experience set in a labyrinth with no exit in sight. Trapped with five other people, you can use any dialogue you want from any conversation you like to answer the game's questions and escape!

name: The Goblin Tavern
summary: You are a fallen hero. Beneath your feet lies a shattered world, cursed by a grieving wizard. Alone in this god-forsaken land, you will find refuge in a tavern, to rebuild, gather outcasts, and plot your path through the darkness. Will you face your fate with courage, or repeat the sins of the past?

name: The Smurfs: Flower Defense
summary:
Play the Smurfs as you’ve never played them before, in virtual and mixed reality!
The fairy Leaf is preparing to celebrate the magic of Nature along with the whole Smurf village. But little do they know that Gargamel will show up to spoil the party once again! Using a magic spell, he gets his hands on 20 Smurfs and chases the rest away from the village! Now more powerful than ever, Gargamel forces the Smurfs to flee, while the weakened Leaf returns to her flower state. After being dropped into their magical world, it is up to you to save the Smurfs, protect the Nature Fairy and stop Gargamel!

name: The Club
summary:
THE CLUB was "a cursed browser club MMO" created by the Crows Crows Crows Discord community. Also described as a mission-less, non-competitive, online music listening game.
Community members made songs for the game using a dedicated sample pack. It was playable in browser on theclub.zone, and was taken offline in April 2021.

name: The Lust Voyage
summary: Sir Richard and his wife flee Ertonbury from the citizens that they angered, aboard a sketchy fishing vessel with a suspicious captain... Will they make it to safety the same?

name: The Island of Crossed Destinies
summary: A Pentiment-like set in 19th-century Malaysia, featuring pirates, East Indiamen, headhunters, a locked-room murder mystery, a blade of meteoric ore, a tarot deck, a mountain of light, and a tiger. It’s time to put your thinking cap on; as for those voices in your head – probably best to ignore them.

name: The Deathmind
summary: The Deathmind is a psychological horror game set in a forgotten village shrouded in mystery and silence. Trapped within his own fractured mind, Ethan searches for his missing wife, Clara, by solving environmental puzzles and following haunting memories.

name: The Esoteric Archive
summary: Those with a thirst for knowledge, and an understanding of the weavings, may find themselves in a library like no other. A deep perseverance and an amount of aimless wandering is required to find this place, but should you find it, you would surely find all the answers you seek. For this Esoteric Archive is vast, possibly endless, and filled with knowledge not meant for mankind. However, you have need of such knowledge, don’t you. Otherwise, why would you have come to such a place?

name: The Lord of the Rings Trivia Game
summary: The Lord of the Rings Trivia' is an engaging mobile game designed for fans of J.R.R. Tolkien's epic fantasy saga. Players can immerse themselves in the rich lore of Middle-earth through a series of challenging trivia questions that cover various aspects of the beloved franchise, including the books, films, characters, locations, and events. The game features multiple levels of difficulty, allowing players of all ages and knowledge levels to participate. Users can test their knowledge individually or compete against friends and other players around the world in timed challenges. The user-friendly interface and visually appealing graphics enhance the gaming experience, while sound effects and music from the films add to the immersive atmosphere. With regular updates and a vast database of questions, 'The Lord of the Rings Trivia' offers endless entertainment and an opportunity for fans to deepen their understanding of Tolkien's universe. Whether you are a casual viewer or a die-hard fan, this game promises to be a fun and educational experience that celebrates the timeless adventure of 'The Lord of the Rings.

name: The Lord of the Rings Pinball
The Lord of the Rings: Trilogy
The Lord of the Rings: Legends
The Last Mullu
summary: The Last Mullu combines the strategy of tower building with the replayability and intensity of roguelikes. Pick a companion and fight for survival in this mountainous and coastal 2D pixel art world.

name: The Best Eroge Ever
summary:
A 5 minute eroge parody that covers everything from Jun Maeda to Hyakugojyuuichi. It's the best eroge ever.

* Note that this game is not actually an eroge. It does contain offensive language and content, but nothing 18+

name: The Long Arc
summary: A fast-paced action arcade game. You play as an archer in a tower, fending off waves of enemies by using the crank to pull back your bow. Each level brings tougher challenges: knights, wraiths, skeletons, golems, and griffins.

name: The Razorform
summary: Infiltrate a classified research facility and unleash the Razorform, a time-warping entity from a dimension of nightmares and chaos. Spray gunfire, uncover military secrets, and slice through enemies with electrified blades. The Razorform is a single player atmospheric sci-fi action game.

name: The Train Can't Escape Without XXX!?
summary:
"The two are trapped in a strange train. How will they get out...?"
An official Saihate Station fan-game.

name: The Echo
summary: The Echo is a retro-themed First-Person Horror/Mystery...

name: The Rock and the Rose
summary: A short demo that won second place in the Indie Game Maker Contest 2017

name: The Odd Squad Adventure in Oddbodia
summary:
Published in 1997 by Glow Zone Pty Ltd, The Odd Squad Adventure in Oddbodia was an above-average math / logic title in its time.
You play as Dylan, an average kid who gets suck through his computer into the land of Oddbodia. Myron Megabrain needs your help to rescue Doc Fever from the evil clutches of Draculard. To help you on your quest, Myron gives you a Superhero makeover (to disguise the fact you’re a human). Playing as the Mystery Kid, you team up with Nerdy Neville and Mimi Screami.

name: Thumbylina
summary: Thumbylina is a fingertip-sized life simulation game device designed to be your daily companion. When you set a timer during study or exercise, your in-game character joins you in self-improvement—unlocking new outfits and hairstyles as you progress. Unlike smartphone or PC timer apps, Thumbylina is completely offline, allowing you to focus without any distracting notifications.

name: The Boons of Iluir
summary: A PuzzleScript sokoban game about rule discovery and making the most of what you have.

name: The Matter of Being
summary: Haunt mortals and escape divine punishment in this unique relationship and resource management game. By striking Faustian bargains and manipulating the mortal world, perhaps you can escape the Mansus once and for all — by being born. Published under the Sixth History License by Weather Factory.

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Xenogears Pack
summary:
A pack of three Xenogears music tracks to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Awakening", "Blazing Knights" and "Soaring"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Octopath Traveler Pack
summary:
A pack of additional music tracks from Octopath Traveler to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Battle at Journey's End", "Primrose, the Dancer", "Daughter of the Dark God", "Octopath Traveler -Main Theme-" and "Decisive Battle II"

name: The Girl With The Bow
summary: The story behind this is that I almost lost someone very close and dear to me (fortunately, in the end, I didn’t), so I decided to reflect on how I was feeling through a mod. In practice, the themes addressed in the mod are vague enough (I think) for you to be able to imagine anyone; maybe you yourself can relate to it. I hope you like this little thing I made and maybe, just maybe… it can be helpful in some way.

name: The Lone Keeper
summary: A psychological horror game where nothing is as it seems. Maintain a remote lighthouse, perform daily tasks while descending into isolation, hallucinations, and distorted reality.

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Live A Live Pack
summary:
A pack of additional music tracks from Live A Live to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Go! Go! Steel Titan!", "LIVE・A・LIVE", "Birds Fly, Fish Swim" and "MEGALOMANIA"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - The World Ends with You Pack
summary:
A pack of additional music tracks from The World Ends with You to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"World Is Yours", "Your Ocean", "Breaking Free", "Twister", "Calling" and "Someday"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - SaGa Pack Vol. 2
summary:
A pack of 8 additional music tracks from the SaGa series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"The Celestial Protectors", "Battle #4", "Alone", "Battle #5", "T260G's Last Battle", "Feldschlacht III" and "Mißgestalt"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - SaGa Pack
summary:
A pack of 7 additional music tracks from the SaGa series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Enraged Battle", "Struggle to the Death", "The Conflict", "Horrible Shadow", "Beat Them Up!", "Coup de Grace" and "Ardent Rhythm"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Chrono Pack
summary:
A pack of 6 additional music tracks from the Chrono series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Wings That Cross Time", "Radical Dreamers -Le Trésor Interdit-", "Chrono Trigger", "Boss Battle 2", "Battle with Magus" and "Corridors of Time"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - NieR Pack Vol. 2
summary:
A pack of 6 additional music tracks from the NieR series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Fleeting Words / Outsider", "Song of the Ancients / Devola", "Hills of Radiant Winds", "Kainé / Salvation", "Song of the Ancients / Fate" and "Shadowlord"

name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Season Pass Vol. 1
Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Season Pass Vol. 2
Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - Season Pass Vol. 3
Theatrhythm Final Fantasy: Curtain Call - Rosa Character
Theatrhythm Final Fantasy: Curtain Call - Yuffie Character
Theatrhythm Final Fantasy: Curtain Call - Vincent Character
Theatrhythm Final Fantasy: Curtain Call - Orlandeau Character
The Shadows Over Lighthouse
summary: Investigate your grandfather’s mysterious disappearance in Shadows Over Lighthouse, a Lovecraftian survival horror adventure. Explore eerie 1912 America, solve puzzles, and face horrors as reality twists around you. Can you uncover the truth, or will you lose yourself to madness?

name: The Retrospection of Tomorrow
summary: In this non-linear, time-travel romance visual novel, you'll date four captivating love interests just like in any ordinary otome game… until they die before your eyes(!). Trapped between memories and delusions, fighting fate itself—can you rewrite their endings? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

name: The Saturnians
summary: Saturnians are moth wizards. For many generations, they have passed down techniques for making "light weaving" wands. They yearn to explore the unknown and meet new species. Saturnian villages are usually built on floating islands. When Saturnians ally with each other they typically connect these cities together into a larger network. Most Saturnians are from the largest network of cities, the country Solalei.

name: The Rage of Mert
summary:
A rage game themed around Moarf23, as featured on twitch.tv/moarf23

After Evilmoarf23 teamed up with the devious Trent, the devious duo steal Lomster straight from behind the back of Moarf23, Mert has no choice but to journey, climb, race and jump up the many levels, seamlessly integrated and combined into a challenging rage game! Can he meet all of his awesome mods and collect their individual hats before beating up EvilMoarf and reclaiming his lomster at the top!?

name: The Last Shores
summary: The Last Shores is a chill solar-punk adventure. Clean, explore, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten island while restoring its lost harmony.

name: The Outlast Trials: Project Diarchy
summary: Season 4 - Project Diarchy will include a new Prime Asset villain, a new map: Shopping Mall, Reborn 2.0 and more!

name: The Last Gas Station
summary: In a world where electric cars reign supreme, you are now the owner of an old gas station out in the wilderness. Establish trade, develop your business and uncover the secret of this strange place in the compact gas station simulator.

name: Thousand Island Solitaire HD
summary: A card-playing adventure on the high seas. Navigate ocean hazards to find treasure within this quirky solitaire adventure.

name: The Fable of Fairy Glen
summary: A Richly Layered Story: Explore themes of sacrifice, loyalty, and resistance as you witness the far-reaching consequences of one man’s selflessness. This is a free story driven game.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Rapid Hunt Rifle Pack
summary: Gear up for a new level of hunting with the Rapid Hunt Rifle Pack, featuring three semi automatic rifles known for their quick action and power. Be ready for anything the wild throws your way.

name: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Alberta Hunting Preserve
summary: It's bitterly cold, but the Albertan wilderness is teeming with life. Discover and hunt 19 local species, tackle 13 exclusive missions, and explore this stunning snowy preserve.

name: The Unseen
summary: Invited to a house party and now fighting for your life in the shadows... Have you got what it takes to prove humans should still be at the top of the food chain or are you just another meal waiting for their time?

name: The Cursed Forest
summary: You are a Warlock endeavouring to defeat evil monsters who want to take over the forest that is inhabited by friendly creatures. The goal of the game is to defeat as many monsters as you can as the weather deteriorates around you. The more monsters you defeat, the higher your score goes.

name: The Museum Sentinel
summary: Left alone on the night shift in a forgotten museum, you must uncover its secrets and survive the horrors lurking within. Explore, solve, and stay alive in this story-rich first- and third-person psychological horror experience.

name: The Trade Dynasty
summary: Start as a small trader and build your trading dynasty. Manage carts and ships, master dynamic markets, trade across land and sea, and protect your fleets in this deep trading and strategy simulation.

name: The Future Is Loading...
summary: A game about an all-knowing phone app and soon-to-be graduates.

name: Three Kingdoms
summary: Chaos rises as the empire crumbles. Fuxi sends a Destiny Executor to guide a new ruler. A century after failure, Liu Bei is chosen—not by force, but by virtue. Play as the Executor, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, or Zhang Fei. Shape fate through your choices in this new tale of the Three Kingdoms.

name: The Legend of Demon-Slaying Heroes
summary: "The Legend of Demon-slaying Heroes": A fantasy idle game with an epic 200,000-word narrative, featuring quests, dungeons, forging, alchemy, enchanting, trading, and construction. Join the heroic adventure filled with battles!

name: The Diner
summary: A charming waiter confronts you at a humble diner.

name: The Fixer
summary: The Fixer is an adult life sim lite visual novel. You take the role of the protagonist, Samantha who is a Fixer. In order to solve her employer’s problems she has to face different challenges such as investigating industrial sabotage, diplomacy between factions and tracking down troublemakers. But she needs somehow to carry on with her everyday life while dealing with her missions.

name: The Last Flight: Return Home
summary:
The Last Flight: Return Home is a 3D shooter with elements of survival, exploration, and a deep space atmosphere.

During the test flight of an experimental spacecraft, the protagonist loses consciousness. Upon waking, he finds himself on an unknown planet. Gradually, he realizes that the planet is on the brink of catastrophe — alien creatures are preparing to attack.

The player must survive in this new world, explore the environment, gather resources, and defend against hostile beings. Along the way, he uncovers the truth and faces a decision that could cost him his life — all to save others.

name: This is a real thing that happened
summary: A short, browser-playable IF game written by Carolyn VanEseltine, with technical support from Danielle Church.

name: Thomas & Friends: Railway Adventures
summary:
Engineers Wanted! Spend the day on the railway with Thomas & Friends!

Now you can play engineer and drive Thomas! Blow the whistle, set the throttle, switch tracks, and talk to other characters - it's going to be a busy day on the Island of Sodor! Use your Thomas the Tank Engine Playset to help deliver passengers for Bertie, repair landslide damage with Harold, find and sort the mail - plus a whole lot more! Travel with Thomas through four fun adventures filled with activities, games and cool print features for off-computer play. Clickity-clack, Thomas is back and you're in control!

name: That One Otter Game
summary: That One Otter Game is a mischievous co-op adventure where two young otters take on a wild rite of passage to prove their worth. Complete silly park challenges to fill up your stamp card—catch a panicked penguin, race a hyped-up zebra, or haul a stolen radio to a mountaintop.

name: The Daily Adventurer
summary: An auto battler featuring over 400 units clashing on screen. Manage your resources, upgrade your army, and descend onto the battlefield yourself at critical moments to turn the tide.

name: The Automaton of Second London
summary:
A Victorian Fantasy Halloween Robo-Otome.

Arabella Harlow is a governess seeking new employment in the city of Second London one Halloween season. Her paths cross with an eccentric alchemist-inventor, who introduces her to his myriad of creations. One particular automaton is Jack, a humanoid construct with ruby-red eyes and intellect on par with a human's. But Jack cannot speak - not verbally. So Arabella is hired on to teach him how to communicate through alternate methods.

As they grow in their relationship - are they colleagues? are they comrades? are they confidantes? Arabella herself is not quite sure. - a series of tragic, dramatic events culminate in a murder. Secrets lurk in the city of Second London...secrets that may put Arabella's life in danger...

name: The Struggle to Survive the Dragon Siege
summary: The Struggle to Survive the Dragon Siege is a Tower Defense game inspired by Plants vs Zombies modernizing the formula to make this a unique experience. Different strategies to tackle the waves of enemies and be able to emerge victorious.

name: The Vending Machine
summary: The Vending Machine is a survival stealth horror where you must sneak, run, and escape from an anomalous vending machine.

name: The Godfather: City Wars
summary: The Godfather: City Wars was a mobile idle tycoon & autobattler game developed by PlaySide studios and released for iOS & Android in 2022, developed under license from Paramount and based off the movie trilogy.

name: The Dream's Exit
summary: A ripple stirs across the calm digital ocean, transforming into a human form. Is this entering a dream ? Following the traces left by the guide, feel everything around, and complete the final journey.

name: The Showdown: Gorilla vs 100
summary: A physics-based roguelike brawler where you play as a gorilla smashing your way through 100 men. Punch, throw, and ragdoll your enemies in chaotic, ever-changing game. Easy to pick up, wild to watch, and built to settle the internet’s dumbest debate.

name: The Bastard of Camelot
summary: The Bastard of Camelot is a series of text-based interactive fiction inspired by Arthurian Legends, following Mordred as they become a Knight of the Round Table, and shape the fate of Camelot.

name: The Manor
summary: Another day in the office. Exorcising Demons!

name: The Fallen Eagle
summary: The Fallen Eagle is a total conversion mod that brings Late Antiquity and the Early Medieval Era (361 – 867) to Crusader Kings III.

name: The Coffin of Andrew and Renee
summary: The Coffin of Andrew and Renee is a mod for The Coffin of Andy and Leyley. The Alternate Universe we are developing centers around the question: "What would happen to the timeline of events from the original game, if one aspect of their childhood was changed?". And thus, The Coffin of Andrew and Renee was born.

name: The Curse
summary: "THE CURSE" is a horror mystery visual novel wearing the clothes of an MMORPG.

name: The Old Realms
summary: The Old Realms is a fan made mod project for the game Mount & Blade: Bannerlord. We aim to capture the grim dark nature of the Warhammer Fantasy world with the intention of delivering the best possible experience for the player. The Old World will have the player meeting and fighting (Or WAAAAGHING!!) alongside legendary characters such as Karl Franz and Grimgor Ironhide, as well as exploring well known locations such as Karaz-A-Karak and Castle Drakenhof.

name: The Last Days of the Third Age
summary: The Last Days of the Third Age is a full conversion mod for Mount and Blade Warband that brings the player into the world of Middle Earth. In this mod you must select a faction that you fight for and defeat all your enemies to win the war. There are some interesting side quests you can get from listening to rumours or from various commanders but the main goal is still to crush all your enemies and attain victory!

name: The Swarm 2
summary: Destroy bosses one after another in this fast-paced and dynamic abyssal bullet hell.

name: Third Age: Total War
summary: Third Age: Total War is a total conversion modification for the PC-game Medieval II: Total War by Sega that brings the world of Middle-earth. It changes the map of Europe, North Africa and the Middle East to an extensive historically accurate map of Middle-earth as it was in the Third Age, while retaining the turn-based strategic gameplay and real-time battles of the original.

name: The Dawnless Days
summary: The Dawnless Days is a total overhaul mod for Total War: Attila based on the Tolkien Legendarium. The project brings to life the peoples, places and events of Tolkien's world loved and cherished by fans all around the world, and is set in the time of the great wars of the final years of the main books.

name: Thera: Legacy of Great Torment
summary: Thera gives M2TW players a breath of fresh air by providing them with a whole new strat map portraying a whole Other world which has it's own mysteries buried in the shadows of time. Thera contains a tempting package of 21 new factions never seen or heard before which includes factions like Romano, Mythical, Chivalric, Post renaissance factions. In addition it gives new battle models and strat models to characters and agents in the game which are graphically supreme and better suited to the world of Thera.

name: The Fourth Age: Total War
summary: The Fourth Age: Total War is a modification for 'Rome: Total War - Barbarian Invasion' (v1.6). Our aim with FA:TW was to accurately portray the lands and peoples of Middle-earth as we think they existed approximately three-and-a-half centuries into the Fourth Age. It is based on the works of Tolkien, and especially on his unfinished and abandoned sequel to 'The Lord of the Rings', entitled 'The New Shadow'. With an aim to staying true to the works and spirit of J.R.R. Tolkien's world of Middle-earth, whilst also aspiring to original creative excellence, 'The Fourth Age: Total War' is a must-have for anyone who loves the setting and peoples of Tolkien's mythic world.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Total War
summary: The Lord of the Rings: Total War is a Total Conversion for Alexander TW based on The Lord of the Rings trilogy, focused to recreate the epic battles seen in the movies. It has a complete Middle Earth map, fully customised cities like Minas Tirith and Helm's Deep on Battle and Campaign map, a set of Historical Battles where you can play all the major and minor battles that take place in the trilogy, and a quest line for the Free-People's campaign where, if the player succeeds, will take the Ring-Bearer from Hobbiton to the wasteland of Mordor in an attempt to save the world from its doom.

name: The New Order Victoria 3
summary: This mod, inspired by its original Hearts of Iron IV counterpart, represents an exploration of an alternate Cold War scenario. We firmly denounce all hateful ideologies. This mod is not, under any circumstances, intended to idealize, promote or trivialize the ideologies or regimes that brought untold suffering to millions. We categorically reject any interpretation of this mod that serves as a platform for glorifying or fantasizing about such entities and their actions.

name: The Hamburger Isles
summary: Join Mario (or anybody else other than peach for some reason) into a small tiny adventure full of 10 "Vanilla" Levels! Wart is up to no good again!

name: This is Just the Beginning
summary: “This is just the beginning” is an arcade-style minigame roguelike where you navigate a gauntlet of fast-paced challenges — each inspired by some of the most iconic video game intros.

name: The TimeBuilders: Caveman's Prophecy
summary: Explore a forgotten time when dinosaurs ruled the earth in this time management game. Guide your tribe out of their cave and into the world. Discover new lands filled with dinosaurs, carnivorous plants, and mischievous saber-toothed kittens. Use all your skills to manage your people, build houses, and gather resources while creating awesome inventions to help your people.

name: The Silent Jungle
summary: The Silent Jungle is a classic survival horror game set deep within the haunting jungles of Vietnam. After a brutal ambush, a lost American soldier must survive in a cursed jungle filled with lethal traps and haunting illusions. To escape, he must uncover its dark secrets and break the curse.

name: The TimeBuilders: Pyramid Rising
summary: Assistant to the Royal architect Senmut, you have been appointed the daunting task of reconstructing villages and bringing hope to the people of Egypt. Only you can save them from banishment to eternal darkness by the mighty god, Amen-Ra. Hire workers, manage resources, build structures and gather stone in this time management game while fending off alligator attacks and more.

name: The Abyssal Descent
summary:
The Abyssal Descent is a brutal 2D platformer about falling—fast, deep, and without forgiveness.
Descend through 80 handcrafted pixel-art levels, each more surreal and punishing than the last.
There are no saves, no checkpoints, and no second chances.
Learn from your mistakes, dodge deadly traps, and try to survive the abyss.
Can you reach the bottom without breaking?

name: The Sith Lords Restored Content Modification
summary: This mod's intention is to restore much of the content cut from The Sith Lords, that was lost to the main game due to a rush to release the game. Its goal is to make the KotOR 2: TSL experience as close as possible as what Obsidian originally intended it to be.

name: The Cleanup Crew
summary: As part of the Cleanup Crew for The Company, you are designated to go in after we have detected an entrant dying to an Anomaly and retrieve vital components for us.

name: The Mirage Project
summary: A first-person sci-fi horror game where you explore an abandoned research facility, travel through different timelines using a broken time machine, and uncover shifting, liminal spaces created by the Mirage. Survive evolving shadow-like entities and uncover the facility’s dark secrets.

name: The Cursed Frog
summary:
The Cursed Frog is a single-player puzzle-platformer with an enchanted twist: switch between a brave princess during the day and a cursed frog at night to overcome magical challenges in the heart of Witchwood forest.

Solve environmental puzzles, avoid treacherous traps, and use each form’s unique abilities to forge a path through 30 carefully crafted levels. The day-night shift mechanic changes not only the scenery but also the gameplay: jump higher as the frog to reach hidden areas, or fight enemies as the princess with ranged attacks and agile dashes.

Combine logic and reflexes to activate magic bridges, manipulate platforms, and discover secret routes in this ever-changing enchanted world. Each level brings new challenges that test your creativity and strategy.

name: The Ultimate G
summary: In those gritty concrete jungle streets, it takes a real man to prove himself. Take on the persona of THE ULTIMATE G and prove yourself on those streets! Defeat enemies, level up, and build a powerful warrior out of yourself from the wide array of perks! But be wary - your enemies improve just as much as you do...

name: Thief Life Simulator
summary: Trust no one. Take everything.

name: The Third Tourist
summary: Possessed by a demon, hunted by a cult—sneak, scheme, and deceive your way through a deceptively sunny town in this no-guns stealth adventure.

name: The National Library of Geometric Impossibilities
summary: Shelve books in a paradoxical library.

name: The Devilry Reservation 2
summary: Immerse yourself in the mystical atmosphere of Slavic folklore and post-Soviet aesthetics. Escape the system, seek the truth among half-forgotten myths and urban legends. In this madness, every clue is part of someone else’s game, and your past is the greatest mystery.

name: The Unseen Fears: Last Dance - Collector's Edition
summary: Can you save the city from an otherworldly predator?

name: The Seven
summary: "The Seven" is a single-player roguelike auto-battler where virtue and sin clash. Endless growth. One shot at survival. Lead your army through the eternal war between good and evil.

name: The Last Transmission
summary: The Last Transmission is a short, first-person psychological horror game built around isolation, atmosphere, and slow, creeping dread.

name: Throne of Egypt
summary: Mighty Seth brings the deposed Pharaoh Ay back from oblivion, threatening the world with a war between the Gods. Will Ay carry on with his revenge? And will the young Pharaoh Khyan be able to bring peace to their lands?

name: The 13th Floor
summary: As a weary security guard, navigate a 13-story office building to find your way home. Traverse each floor on foot, moving between elevators while observing subtle details. Set in broad daylight, this exploration game blends curiosity with logic as you uncover the building's secrets.

name: The Plucky Squire x The Swords of Ditto: Mormo's Curse Bundle
summary: This bundle includes The Plucky Squire and The Swords of Ditto: Mormo's Curse.

name: The Days Without Gods
summary: The Days Without Gods is a text-based DND fantasy ADV in which the player takes on the role of Mori Granson, an apprentice and subordinate of Hysso, the president of the Magic Association, and meets Coccinea, a young girl he rescued years ago, and other characters in the mage capital of Tylin.

name: The Death Night Show
summary: The Death Night Show is a narrative game with multiple endings and unlockable scenes where you play as Death's intern in his own late night show. Control the audience's reactions to the events of the program, run errands, and uncover the overarching mystery with each new featured guest.

name: The Keys to the Imagination
summary: With a little imagination and a kitten by your side, any world is possible. Discover it in this beautiful, adorable, and fantastical visual novel.

name: The Exit: Liminal Supermarket Horror
summary: Lost between shelves and shadows.

name: Those I hate 1
summary:
"Falling in Love with the Man You Dislike?! Experience a thrilling office romance in this exciting Love game!"

A Dark Past, Trauma... and an Unexpected Love?
The heroine is struggling with mental health issues caused by painful memories and a troubled past. She regularly visits the hospital for treatment.

While working alongside a clumsy junior colleague, Makoto Minase, she tries to navigate her difficult workplace... but the pressure from both him and her surroundings becomes too much. She finally decides to confront the company president — only to discover that it’s none other than Raiki Kiryuu, the very same boy who used to bully her in the past.

As if things couldn't get any worse, her parents suddenly push her into an arranged marriage. Reluctantly agreeing to meet the suitor, she’s shocked to see Selene Irie, a wealthy heir who used to stalk her as a child...

A Thrilling Office Romance Otome Game
Part of a larger series, but can be enjoyed as a standalone!

18 unique love interests await you!

This title features 3 main characters to pursue in this chapter.

name: The Shores of Stellaluna
summary: Sail a fractured world. Battle through dangerous dungeons, Stack powerful abilities, Rebuild cities, Manage trade, Survive ever-changing islands to gather lumen, get more powerful and shape the fate of a broken world in this first person craft and build focused RPG with a strong storyline.

name: The Child Of Hagar
summary: The Child of Hagar is a 2D/3D hybrid game where you feed the thing you gave birth to. Dig up graves, lie to the police, do what you have to: it is hungry.

name: The Heart of Anathema
summary: Card-driven RTS Roguelike in which you lead your forces into the depths of the mysterious forest and claim its lost relics for your kingdom. To do so, use cards to build your settlement, discover powerful synergies with cards from rival factions, then take command of your army in real-time battles.

name: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 4: Echoes from Episode 3
summary: You can play three remade stages from The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 3.

name: The Alien Device
summary: It's a Point and-click, puzzle game of Ben 10 from 2006, playable in the old cartoon network site.

name: The Last Chance
summary: Journalist David, whose career is not going well, takes on the most dangerous assignment he can after receiving a warning from his editor. As time passes, it becomes clear that what is happening is far from simple.

name: The Trials: Chapter One
summary: A classic choose your own adventure story. Escape the horrors hunting you, make decisions, forge your own path. An original complete story with multiple endings and secrets to unlock. Choose your own play style with a Text Adventure Mode, sound effects, and an ambient soundtrack.

name: The Inconvenient Platformer
summary: Are you ready for the most inconvenient platforming experience of your life? Traverse through exciting colorful environments as you accidentally slip up and fall 3 sections backwards. Try and make your way to the top of the mountain or create your own levels and send them to your friends!

name: The Rotting Man
summary: The Rotting Man is a psychological horror game that depicts a protagonist working as a clerk in a Japanese internet café.

name: The Best Investor
summary: THE BEST INVESTOR is a strategic board game where you start with 5 million dollars, then face your opponents by making investments of all kinds in order to increase this financial wealth as much as possible in order to become the best investor of the game!

name: The Inescapable Nightmare
summary: There Is No Escape.

name: The 3 Little Princesses
summary: Mario & Luigi have been kidnapped as well as Rosalinas home being taken over Peach and Daisy set off a journey to help Rosalina take her home back and to save Mario & Luigi.

name: The Battle of Polytopia+
summary: This is the apple arcade version of the game. It includes many DLC tribes, but requires a subscription to play.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Online
The Day in a Life of a Dayfly
summary: A melancholic journey through the cemetery... and far beyond its gates.

name: The DeadLine
summary: The last subway departs in a world overrun by zombies. At each station, gather materials, find better weapons, and fight off the undead. As you get closer to your family, the danger grows. Survive, upgrade, and make it to the final stop.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria - Durin's Folk Expansion
summary:
Your story doesn’t end here, oh no…

The Dimrill Gate is open but what’s next for you, Dwarf? As Lord of Moria, it is now your responsibility to bring Khazad-dûm back to its former glory and repopulate it. That means only one thing - Durin’s folk are coming back to Moria!

In this expansion, NPCs join you and your Company to establish trade and help you rebuild Moria, while you embark on Expeditions to uncover even greater treasures and long-buried secrets…

name: The Freak Circus
summary:
The Circus of Horrors has arrived in town.

Uncover its secrets and face the terror it hides, all while being led by Pierrot, the silent yandere, or Harlequin, his seductive rival.

Don’t be fooled by their smiles, they’re not what they seem.

You work at a café, and one day, on your way to work, fate leads you to cross paths with Pierrot. That’s when his obsession begins. But he’s not alone, his stage rival decides to join the game, turning this twisted dance into a dangerous competition… all for you.

name: The Witcher: Enhanced Edition – Platinum Edition
summary:
The Witcher: Enhanced Edition – Platinum Edition is an upgraded physical release of The Witcher: Enhanced Edition, distributed on 2 DVDs and fully patched to version 1.5. What sets this edition apart is its wealth of bonus content and additional scenarios, making it the most complete version of the game available.

In addition to the two official adventures from the Enhanced Edition (The Price of Neutrality and Side Effects), this release includes five fan-made scenarios: Blight of Bogs, Deceits, Wraiths of the Quiet Hamlet, The Wedding, and Merry Witchmas. These extra modules, available in English and Polish (subtitles only), add several hours of new gameplay.

The Platinum Edition removes all DRM, allowing the game and the D’jinni Adventure Editor to run without the disc. It also includes voiceovers and subtitles in nine languages, with the option to mix audio and subtitle languages independently.

A second DVD contains rich bonus content: a 204-page artbook in PDF format, multiple official game guides and manuals in several languages, exclusive artwork and wallpapers, character avatars, walkthroughs for the fan-made adventures, and four music collections including the full official soundtrack. It also includes fun extras like a behind-the-scenes video and April Fools bonus material.

This edition is ideal for collectors and fans seeking the most extensive and DRM-free version of the original Witcher experience.

name: The Red House on the third hill of Mataperros
summary:
A Stop Motion fable about finding an old online friend.
A game about communities and their absence.

name: The Guardians
summary: The Guardians is a decision based RPG with flight simulator and first person shooter mechanics. Every decision you make has consequences, your actions will shape the outcome.

name: The Goofy Giraffe Game
summary: The Goofy Giraffe Game is a 3D platformer in which you play Softy, a giraffe locked in a child's bedroom ruled by the terrifying Cube Rouge King. Find your spots and jump higher and higher, breaking your neck to escape from this room !

name: The Last Ski Trip
summary: The main character, travels to a remote snowy valley with his brother for a skiing trip. But soon after their arrival, strange events begin to unfold. What was meant to be a peaceful getaway quickly turns into a nightmare. Over time, he realizes that something terrible is live in the valley...

name: The Mines
summary: Trapped underground after a routine exploration gone wrong, you find yourself sprinting through claustrophobic tunnels. Hot on your heels is an immense, grotesque spider—its scuttling echoes drown out your own panicked breaths. With each step, the shadowy walls seem to close.

name: The Girl in the Clouds
summary: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be repeated.At first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

name: Thunderman: Adventures in Another Realm
summary: Thunderman: Adventures in Another Realm is an exhilarating 2D action-platformer where you embark on an epic journey alongside Kaelan, a young archer chosen as the defender of the universe. To restore peace, you must face dangerous enemies, gather resources to survive.

name: The Backrooms: Expedition
summary: Explore the world of backrooms from this solo developed game. explore creepy and eerie levels, and also calm and liminal levels, but be careful, you're not the only one there.

name: The Temple: Ch 1
summary: Between Dimensions Stands A Haunted Cathedral, Night‑Vision Flickers, Ghosts Lurk & A Monster Awaits Beyond The Portal To Shatter Your Sanity.

name: The Memological Dungeon
summary: The Memological Dungeon is a voxel-based 3D adventure. Forget about robes and swords — shoot magic at monsters with your bare hands (well, almost)! A fun journey filled with traps, meme treasures, and quirky enemies

name: The Void
summary: The Void - a psychological horror game A surreal dimension called the Void is filled with eerie dreams that have become reality.

name: The Way Down
summary: Absurdist Interactive fiction. Talk to the beings that inhabitant the world at its end. We forgot how to die.

name: The Other Side
summary: A platformer about lights! Grab light crystals to brighten your surroundings for 10 seconds as you navigate the challenging courses.

name: This Game
summary: "This Game" is a casual yet strategic board game where you will use various combinations of pieces to achieve maximum profit and reach level goals.

name: The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box
summary: Step into the thrilling world of The Vault: Logic Puzzle Box, an immersive 3D safe-breaker puzzle game! Your goal is to prove yourself as a great puzzle solver and unlock safes to reveal the hidden secrets of Mars!

name: The Little Puzzle House
summary: Welcome to the little puzzle house. Solve puzzles, a Simon game, a pair matching game and more in a nice cozy atmosphere. Take your time, unlock the other rooms and progress through the house.

name: The Secret Order: Return to the Buried Kingdom - Collector's Edition
summary: The Mother Dragon has passed on, leaving the kingdom vulnerable. Strange anomalies are appearing across the land, indicating that an ancient evil is trying to return! The collector's edition contains a bonus gameplay chapter, ingame strategy guide and other goodies.

name: The Aquarium Does Not Dance: Special Edition
summary: Navigate your way through an aquarium overrun by gruesome creatures known as creepies and unravel its hidden mysteries. With each riddle you solve, you’ll find yourself one step closer to uncovering the chilling truth of Bianca Aquarium. Your choices affect the outcome of the game, so choose wisely.

name: The Squirrel & Sea
summary: An underwater journey to the squirrel's past memories

name: The Hollow Lighthouse
summary: The Hollow Lighthouse is a first-person survival horror experience set on a mysterious, fog-covered island in the Black Sea. Fix the broken lighthouse, uncover disturbing secrets, and survive what roams in the dark. You were sent to repair the light. But something is watching you.

name: The Third
summary: Two have been reborn. One remains in the shadows. Explore a cursed temple, uncover ancient secrets, and survive a gripping and terrifying journey through forgotten gods and darkness.

name: The Terminator 2029: Deluxe CD Edition
summary: The Deluxe CD Edition, released in 1994, includes the original game along with the 1993 expansion pack Operation Scour, giving a total of 34 missions.[6] This edition also includes 330MB of additional mission briefings and character speech, as well as new gameplay music.

name: The Statue Got Me High
summary: Your job is to make sure John's party is successful. It won't be, though. Written for the Apollo 18+20 tribute album project.

name: They Took the Sun
summary: They Took the Sun is a short action flight game. Zip through vast forsaken environments in search of gigantic mechanical monstrosities. Find their weak points and shoot them down.

name: The Lost Village: Monster Sect
summary: One day, a vision appeared in the sky, with beams of light piercing through the heavens and earth in many places, like stars falling. However, this is not a sign of peace, but rather a portal for demons from another world to enter this place. They pair up in groups to conquer the entire world.

name: The Lost Village: Monster Sect Part 2
summary: One day, a vision appeared in the sky, with beams of light piercing through the heavens and earth in many places, like stars falling. However, this is not a sign of peace, but rather a portal for demons from another world to enter this place. They pair up in groups to conquer the entire world.

name: The Ruins of Shanhai Labyrinth
summary: Amnesiac Tianyi and Yu live the same day in a paradise-like village until a nightmare reveals hidden cracks. To save someone important, they must tame the eerie Gods of Ruins and uncover the village's secrets. Each failure deepens their despair, and the truth is far crazier than they imagined.

name: The Third Celestial Realm
summary: 1. Fighting with flying swords in 3D space, more than 50 attack skills, and different flying swords can be equipped; 2. Able to control a spiritual sword to fly and attack; 3. Thirty kinds of flying swords; 4. Flying in the air, flying with swords, teleporting, and guarding spiritual.

name: The Clingy Ghost
summary: Become the trending star exorcist and save the cursed haunted house! The worst spirit in history is about to awaken.

name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
summary:
The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is an action RPG set in the world of Philabieldia - a beautiful but savage land dominated by warring beast tribes. Humanity’s last bastion is the Kingdom of Huther, protected by its tall walls and Princess Heuria’s powerful magic.

When a mysterious set of ruins is discovered, a young adventurer named Elliot and his fairy companion Faie are sent off on a journey to investigate. What seems like a simple, if dangerous, mission soon becomes a grand saga that will be woven across time and space.

name: The Interpretation of Dreams
summary: At the beginning of the story, an "old friend" of yours, Sheriff Triss, suddenly calls you and asks you to go to a local exhibition hall to assist in the investigation of a heinous murder case...

name: The Box of Fear
summary: A missing daughter. A father without answers. A suspicious company. Solve puzzles, connect clues, and discover what "The Box" hides in this first-person psychological horror.

name: The Guild: Europa 1410
summary: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

name: The Crawling Dead
summary: The Crawling Dead is a strategy simulation game where you take on the role of a lead scientist tasked with saving Stormveil National Park from ecological collapse. Swarms of invasive insects are devastating the park’s delicate ecosystems, and traditional methods of pest control have failed. Your solution? Genetically engineered parasitoid wasps. Harmless to humans, these beneficial wasps are killers of pest insects and utilize a variety of creepy strategies to manipulate and kill their hosts - turning them into The Crawling Dead!

name: Throne of Blood
summary: Celestial power thrums in your veins, Hell’s throne calls, and demons conspire. Will you ascend as savior, tyrant, or something in between? A text-based horror novel, 295,000 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.

name: The Indigo Initiative
summary: A first-person puzzle adventure where you harness fire, water, electricity, and magnetism to solve multi-step puzzles and explore atmospheric realms to restore balance before reality collapses.

name: The Rainbox
summary: A cute and simple Sokoban-like puzzle adventure through the rainbow! Push blocks to solve puzzles in a variety of rainbow-themed levels. Each block has a different mechanic for you to work around, can you get all of them to their goal while dealing with their personalities?

name: The Land of Morning Calm
summary: A historical strategy tower defense game set in Joseon-era Korea. Build and upgrade towers like hwachas, catapults, and archer posts. Control unique heroes, summon allied units, and actively defend your base against waves of enemies across four tactical stages.

name: The Gazebo
summary: The Gazebo is a short, narrative, psychological horror set in a garden during a snow storm. Tend to the plants, shovel snow, and complete other tasks for seven nights while getting to know your daytime counterpart Sara.

name: The Scarecrow Knight
summary:
A few hundred years before the events of Red-Handed Robin, a strange traveler and his adopted child unravel a mystery about the ancient curse of witchcraft.

This game is a prequel, and can be played without having played Red-Handed Robin!

name: The Template
summary: A heavily experimental planetary-level sandbox sci-fantasy RPG in the infancy of its development, in which you explore semi-liminal worlds, barely engage in any combat, struggle to level your character and engage in some minimal dialogue and questing.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Triforce Power
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Triforce Power, is a Zelda 1 hack that takes place after 2 years after Zelda 2. It is the first in the Zelda: Triforce Power Saga, which will be a 3 part trilogy of games. Also, this hack will be much harder than the original Zelda game.

name: This Game Will End In 205 Clicks.
summary: What does a SUPERVILLAIN do, when he is forbidden from doing anything evil for the day? WARNING: This is not the type of game where you can make meaningful choices.

name: The People of Sea, Sun & Salt
summary: Will you create a lasting civilization or see it collapse into the sea? In Sea, Sun & Salt, you build a city on a small mediterranean island. Define the tenets of your culture, deal with your subjects' needs and withstand the forces of the elements.

name: The Red Cathedral
summary: The Red Cathedral is a fun turn-based strategy game for 1 to 4 players. Manage your resources well to build the cathedral better than anyone else and thus win the Tsar's favor.

name: Thrateon
summary:
From the heart of the ruthless desert of Sistan, more ruthless creatures rise and turn to Zabol. There is no gate that can hinder them. There is no wall that can withstand them. Pishdad Shah is left defenseless. An army rushes from the south - it is Boras who comes to help. Boras drives back the demons, but Zabol is left in a burnt ruin. There is no place to stay. Boras takes the survivors to Jiroft, under the shade of the giant Gokran tree. But the danger still remains. The rebels cannot be controlled. Sistan needs tough men. Boras calls for fighting men. Mehrdad takes up a blade and joins Boras' army. He receives a special mission to take a shipment to Zabol. But this is no ordinary journey. Behind the scenes, there is news...

Thrateon is an action-role-playing game (RPG-Action) inspired by the mythology of Iran. Thrateon, which is more precisely mentioned in the Avesta as " Θraētaona", is the same as Fereydun and means the possessor of three powers. This name was chosen for this game because it features three different characters as the main playable characters: Mehrdad the Warrior, Adar the Mage and Attar the Bard. Each of these three characters takes a different path in a story, and only by taking all the paths and playing with all the characters will the secrets of the story be revealed.

This game is presented episodically, with Mehrdad as the main character in the first part. In terms of story, it can be said that Traton is the sequel to the game Age of Heroes and Roiintan. Boras, a powerful commander, has come to save the people of Zabol, driving the Div away from Zabol and sheltering his people in Jiroft, a city under a huge Gokaran tree. Mehrdad joins Boras' army and the game begins with a mission to Zabol. Like any role-playing game, the main character has a dialogue with characters and takes on missions, travels to strange lands, fights strange creatures, collects weapons, armor, and food, buys and sells in the market or on the street, and goes through stages and events one by one to reveal the hidden secrets of their story. The game's story and character design have won the second computer game festival in Iran. The game's characters are professionally voiced under the supervision of Mohammad Reza Alimardani.

The game's graphics are inspired by Iranian-Islamic buildings and architecture, and based on feedback received at foreign exhibitions, they are competitive in the global market. For example, the city bazaar is based on the bazaars of Tabriz and Zanjan, as well as the Zain al-Din caravanserai. The ramparts, castles, water reservoir, mill and houses are all based on historical and ancient examples of this land. The music of this game is a combination of traditional music and modern orchestration.

name: The Journey Never Ends: Leviathan
summary: A dark cyberpunk turn-based RPG

name: The Star That Longed to Be Free
summary: "What is freedom?" The shrewd merchant makes gold coins clink in his palms, elves spin flowers and plants into bonds that will never be repeated, and the heart of the perfect princess is dotted with shackles woven from shards. Who knows the answer to the question?

name: The King's Legend
summary: Fight your way to victory by strategically sacrificing, upgrading, and regenerating your pieces. Duel your friends in this fantasy turn-based strategy game, seizing every advantage you can. Let the wiser king become the legend!

name: The Qubit Factory
summary: The Qubit Factory is an open-ended puzzle game incorporating real-life concepts from the cutting-edge field of quantum computing. Design and build logic circuits that manipulate bits and qubits (quantum bits) to solve devious computational challenges!

name: The Darkest Dusk
summary: Classic Point-and-Click Adventure Game to experience the feeling from the 80's and 90's | Tech-Noir | Pixel Art and Retro Style | Interactive visual novel

name: The E-Collector
summary: Clean the world, save the future. Join Ekko the robot on a quest to restore a polluted planet. Explore toxic realms, solve eco-puzzles, and battle mutated foes. Upgrade EcoVac 3000, rescue endangered creatures, and transform each region. Enjoy fully included features in this epic eco-adventure!

name: The Cheated Man's Revenge: Triple the Payback
summary: The Cheated Man's Revenge: Triple the Payback is a story-driven visual novel game that blends workplace struggles with themes of emotional revenge. Transform from a cheated man into a vengeful avenger, orchestrating a retribution plan against a rival and a materialistic ex.

name: The Dreamcatcher
summary: The Dreamcatcher is a proof of concept for a hand-drawn adventure platformer where you explore a collection of floating islands as Kit, the Dreamcatcher.

name: The 1500 Year Old Forest Elf and My Anti-materiel Sniper Rifle
summary: 1000 years ago, an alliance of humans and elves drove back the invasion of dragons. Peace was meant to return. Instead, humanity descended into endless bloodshed and tyranny. 1000 years later, the last surviving elves must defend their forests against man-made dragons forged from far deeper cruelty.

name: The Last Purge
summary: A unique indie game combining strategy card play, team building, and a distinctive take on the auto-battler genre. Easy to pick up, endlessly fun to explore, and surprisingly hard to put down.

name: The Bigger Picture
summary:
Just Press The Button...
Go through the levels, pressing the buttons as they appear to zoom out and see more of your environment.
Push levers to move platforms and walls.
Get to higher points by jumping into pipes or bouncing on trampolines.
Walk past arrows to pan across the screen and discover more at the current zoom level.
Turn fans on and off to get to blocked areas.

name: The Scientist Battles
summary: The Scientist Battles is a short, narrative-driven game about the human side of science. Step into the shoes of a scientist facing burnout, self-doubt, and pressure in the lab, and explore an introspective story filled with emotional moments. The game also features light 2D combat inspired by laboratory tools.

name: The Hell: 1923 Kanto Earthquake
summary: 1923: Process the Great Kantō Earthquake death. Lead all the miserable souls, battle quake-storms, and make life-or-death choices in collapsing Kanto's Hell. A historical strategy game inspired by true events where you play as Hell Governor. Oh...there is NAMAZU the Catfish Titan wreaking havoc too.

name: The Last Drive: 2335
summary: Step into a world shrouded in mystery and desolation in "The Last Drive 2335," a terror game that takes you on a haunting journey whilst driving through Veiled Grove. With its nostalgic PSX-styled graphics, immerse yourself in an atmospheric experience reminiscent of classic survival horror titles.

name: The Red Zone: Zombie Factory
summary: A simple puzzle platformer for creating and repairing the undead. Sort body parts on a conveyor belt and combine them into zombified creations for world conquest. Make sure you sort the parts into the correct bins!

name: The Meat Factory
summary: The world has gone to ruin, communities slowly dwindle, and food is scarce. Folks have heard rumors of an operation on the rise to solve the food shortage... but at what cost?

name: The Gears: Factory
summary: [The Gears: Factory] is a third-person 3D factory-building game where the player's main goal is to build automated systems by mining minerals and producing industrial units.

name: The Factory
