summary: The Factory is a first-person, factory sim game with machine purchasing, upgrading, and building expansion. Use income from crafted products to buy and upgrade tools and buildings. Upgrade your factory layout to gain infinite wealth while trying not to lose money from damaging products.

name: The Cabin Factory: Supporters Pack
summary: Grab this Supporters Pack for The Cabin Factory to enjoy exclusive features!

name: The Trial
summary: The Trial is a story-driven adventure mixed with action and puzzles. Meet quirky characters, fight intense and engaging battles and discover the terrific secrets of the kingdom and it's heroes!

name: The Lightkeeper
summary: The Lightkeeper is a psychological horror game set in the atmospheric and heavy ambiance of the 1920s. Alone on a remote island, you're tasked with keeping a lighthouse. But the horrific events that claimed the lives of previous keepers still whisper through the air. Each day, the line between reality and delusion fades and something in the dark is waiting for the last keeper

name: The Protagonist
summary: The Protagonist is a narrative-driven psychological horror game set 635 years after the sun died. You play as Varon, a man searching the underground ruins of humanity for his missing daughter.

name: The Home County
summary: Build your dream village in The Home County! Work alongside skilled villagers to build a flourishing community. Pursue charming hobbies, mine treasures, and explore a world inspired by the British countryside.

name: The Mightiest Sword is Mine!
summary: A clicker game where you can enjoy limitless growth! Strengthen your skills to embark on a journey aiming for the strongest in your preferred playstyle!

name: The Cruciball
summary: An action roguelike played by throwing balls at enemies that are projected in the real world! Adventure across strange lands, collect upgrades, and find secrets. Grow your strength, refine yourself in The Cruciball, and save your pet from the nefarious Warlock!

name: The Wind and the Wisp
summary: A 3D adventure game about blowing into the microphone. Join the Wind, a non-corporeal petal breeze, and the Wisp, a little white ghost with a red ribbon, on their journey to repair a mysterious broken garden.

name: The Lisa Joyful in Hopeful Christmas Special
summary: It's Christmas time in Olathe and a mission has been given to Swen, Luiz, and Yogurt to infiltrate a cult who celebrates the holiday 24/7 in search for the seeds of a tree said to be able to grow unlike most other plant life post flash. Their journey is a perilous one as many members of this cult have been driven mad, but they must carry on all the same.

name: The Exhibit
summary:
Stuck in a room with a weird portrait behind you.

A very early prototype that would later become Exhibit of Sorrows.

name: The Rabbit's Shadow
summary: A Father who has suffered of grief due to his daughter being missing, got trapped in an unknown location resembling an old arcade, while being locked inside a mascot suit. The Father needs to investigate different things such as lockers and play minigames to progress into further rooms to try to escape. Unknown Creatures are aware of his presence however.

name: The Island of Bad Women
summary: The Island of Bad Women is home to a powerful and dangerous group of women, each more ruthless than the last. Bound together by a shared vision of destruction, they have cast aside all morality and now stand united in their mission to bring about the end of humanity.

name: Three Methods to Unseat a Fairy Monarch
summary: A game made for the 2019 Bitsy Secret Santa. It is based on the prompt "threes".

name: Thousand Hells: The Underworld Heists
summary: Four heroes descend into hell in a tactical narrative game blending mythology and surrealism. Recruit your team, choose your path, and overcome the trials of the underworlds. A new systemic storybook experience from the designers of King of Dragon Pass and Six Ages.

name: The King of Tower Defense
summary: A real tower defense game set in a medieval fantasy world. This game has high difficulty that focuses on strategy.

name: The Jester and the Madman
summary: The Jester and the Madman, a sequel to Curse of the Old Gods, is a point-and-click adventure with a 90s-style digitized art aesthetic, steeped in Lovecraftian horror. Solve puzzles, uncover a vast conspiracy, and descend into a world of cults, paranoia, and creeping madness.

name: The Concrete Tower
summary:
Uh-Oh! Bunny got himself trapped in a tower! Can you help him escape?

A Silent Hill like adventure game starring cute critters and not so cute critters.

name: The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 01: Killer Croc
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 02: Catwoman
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 03: The Joker
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 04: Robin
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 05: Batman
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 06: Man-Bat
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 07: Killer Croc
The Coagulation
summary:
You are a wiggly worm about to plan a mushroom party for your friends! However, they are acting... strangely... can you save them?

This game was made as part of the 2021 Bitsy Community Secret Santa.

name: TheC64 Mini: Black Edition
summary: The C64 Mini, the world’s best selling mini home computer, is back in Black! Showcasing 25 of the highest rated new C64 games developed in the last 20 years by a thriving community of exceptional developers, this limited Black Edition delivers captivating gameplay and stunning sounds that you wouldn’t have thought possible back in the day. Once you start playing, you’ll find it difficult to stop! The sleek black design looks fantastic in any retro setup or collection and includes celebrated titles such as Sam’s Journey, A Pig Quest, Steel Ranger and Knight ‘n’ Grail.

name: The Founders of Daytona Beach Also Founded Dayton, Ohio
The Love's Ordeal
summary: Nengchi, can you hold yourself? On the cusp of immortality, the prodigy from Sect of Pure Retreat is forced to face his trail in "Eden of Yao"- a realm of seductive spirits. As the temptresses unleash their charms, can you hold your Chan mind?

name: The Hotel
summary: Climb 'The Hotel' to Floor 250 in hopes of reuniting with your brother, avoiding mysterious creatures and collecting items to help guide you on your journey. Read notes and documents scattered about to reveal the true story of 'The Hotel'.

name: The CodFather
summary: A crazy 3D hack and slash game where you fight as a king! A survival snake-like game that combines snake-like action and card skill selection!

name: The Unseen Fears: Outlive Collector's Edition
summary: It's more than your average survival show...

name: The Paper Arcade: Pong
summary: The Paper Arcade: Pong is a hand-drawn twist on the arcade classic! With soccer-inspired visuals, magnetic chaos, and multiball power-ups, it's pong like you've never seen. Play 1v1 or add up to 6 AI players for frantic free-for-alls and sketchy team battles.

name: The Journey East and West
summary: This game was made for my NMU CS120 Winter 2025 semester final project. It is a text-based game where you use number inputs to control the game through the console. Open JDK no longer needs to be installed and added to your systems PATH do not be alarmed when a Command Prompt window opens.

name: The Door You Can Never Open
summary: Take care of your ailing father while facing a disturbing presence that distorts reality around you in this short psychological horror experience. Your choices matter, and opening the wrong door might be your last.

name: The Mine
summary: 2.5D open world puzzle action adventure game.

name: The Last Crawler
summary: In The Last Crawler you play as a ventilation repair man named David and you enter the vents of Blackwell Station but everything is not as it seems. The vents are not safe and you must find a new way out before its too late.

name: The First Scene
summary: The game is adapted from the incident "Double Secret Room Murder in Grain Deposit". The story sounds abstract and unintroducible? This game will restore the case process and take you to the "first scene"!

name: The Masquerade
summary: "Masquerade" is an independently developed AVG. You will survive in the mysterious and cruel "Little Pig Park" from the first perspective of the male protagonist Youta. There will be multiple choices involved, and you need to struggle between harsh reality and inner conscience, uncovering the truth!

name: The Killing Game of Thirst
summary: Killing Game of the Thirsty is an interactive cinematic game, blending revenge and battle royale genres. 14 people are stranded on a barren land, where the only way to get water is by taking lives. Survive this deadly game: cooperate or betray? Seek redemption or become the killer?

name: The Secret of Weepstone
summary: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

name: The Holdouts
summary: Smash, grab, and grow in this third-person, session-based shooter—playable solo or cooperatively. Bash through small-town locales and cobble together anything deadly to build the most unhinged weapons you’ve ever seen. Lawn equipment, power tools, kitchen appliances, vintage 8-track toys—even the brass section of your local band—all become deadly weapons in your hands. Fight back, hold out, and rebuild a home in a warped new reality.

name: The Lost Meowgician
summary: The Lost Meowgician blends match-3, tower defense, and roguelite strategy. Match tiles to cast spells against waves of enemies. Combine spells and treasures to create unique builds and unleash satisfying combos in a charming, hand-drawn world.

name: The Caretaker’s Lease
summary: 083. In the aftermath of the Quiet Collapse, humanity clings to survival in scattered villages. You are the new caretaker for Sage Creek Outfitters’ most remote winter lease — a 900-acre stretch of frozen wilderness with a dark history. Track game, survive brutal weather, and uncover the fate of your predecessor, Jeb, who vanished without a trace. Every hunt is a test of skill, and every night brings whispers of something older… and hungrier.

name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
summary: A story-driven, atmospheric thriller with pixel-art graphics and survival-horror elements. Short, intense, and unforgettable.

name: The Spirit Weaver
summary: The Spirit Weaver is a narrative-driven visual novel where you use the power of Tarot to guide lost spirits through their grief, and maybe figure out your own. Explore a mystical spirit realm, help its denizens, and restore balance in a bittersweet story of love, loss, and empathy.

name: The Twilight Project
summary:
The Twilight Project is a third person survival horror game where you play as a tourist who gets lost in a forgotten village sealed off from the outside world. As night falls, strange and terrifying creatures begin to appear, and reality starts to shift into something far darker.

You’ll need to survive the night, search for clues, and uncover the dark history behind this cursed place. Some secrets should stay buried... but they might be your only way out.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Feast of Shadows
summary: The second dungeon pack of 2025, Feast of Shadows, is coming to live servers soon. It brings with it two new dungeons, Naj-Caldeesh and Black Gem Foundry. For now, the forgotten ruin of Naj-Caldeesh remains a mystery—perhaps to be unveiled soon. Instead, journey into the depths of Molag Bal’s Oblivion realm of Coldharbour to witness the perils of the Black Gem Foundry dungeon. Learn how events have unfolded there, what deadly threats it holds, and the precious rewards to claim from it.

name: The Story of Red Cloud
summary: The Story of Red Cloud is a massive Dark Souls-inspired adventure built inside the world of Terraria using a custom map, mod and companion soundtrack. Your 1-4 player journey will span 18 dungeons spread across an expansive, hand-crafted open world, offering a 20 to 30+ hour experience for a first playthrough.

name: The Tovanian Stones
summary: A single player first person role-playing game. Explore the land and find enemies to slay for treasure. Scour the world for resources and become a master crafter within a complex crafting system.

name: The Croaked Crown
summary: In a world overrun with creature & corruption, salvation finds a way. It is up to Rib, the Wet One, to cleanse these lands.

name: The Classroom 2
summary:
The Classroom 2 is a sequel to first game instead with more named characters. It now takes place in a high-school and builds on the story of the original flash game, while still maintaining the stealth gameplay of filling up a cheat meter.

The rules are the same as the first. The goal is to cheat off the geek without being caught by the teacher

name: The Breach
summary: Since its arrival in the Orbit of G-54 the Hermes, a prototype Starship did not answer any communication nor did it give any sign of life. As the head of security of G-54 it is Sergei’s job to go aboard the Hermes to see what is happening .What kind of horror Sergei will encounter aboard the Hermes!?! Learn what happened, fight horrible creatures, upgrade your character, collect powerful item in The Breach! In this unique flash Horror Adventure game.

name: The Nightmare Begins
summary: The Nightmare Begins puts players in the role of two detectives searching for missing family members in a terrifying dream realm. They explore eerie landscapes, solve puzzles, and face supernatural threats, uncovering dark family secrets as they fight to escape this relentless nightmare

name: The Cute Machine
summary: In the 1990s, Australian artist Martine Corompt made video game artworks that blended biological theory with technological development to explore the concept of cuteness.

name: The Fatum
summary: This situation is temporary, but it comes with a strict protocol that you must follow. Morality and cold calculation intertwine in a dark tale. You are an investigator, and your arrival marks a turning point in the lives of those you encounter.

name: The Sword Game
summary: The Sword Game is a semi-fast paced retro styled 3D platformer, made to mimic shareware games of early 2000's. Your mission is to get the lowest time possible on all levels. You can cheat, find shortcuts, you have all the freedom in the world.

name: The Last Janitor: Data Cleanup
summary: You are Zildo, the janitor of a company where employees have been replaced by robots. Enraged, you decide to destroy all of them and reclaim your place. Explore procedurally generated worlds, find weapons, and use power-ups to win.

name: The Flower
summary: You have a flower that only needs to be watered once a year but if you give it too much or not enough water it dies.

name: The Search For Above Average Life
summary:
The Search for Above Average Life is a light-hearted bullet-hell adventure where friendship is a matter of overcoming the language barrier. Play as SAAL, a lonely exploration robot, scanning planets and befriending the galaxy’s strangest inhabitants.

Choose how to communicate—Speak, Write, Gesture, or Dance—then dodge red “misunderstanding” projectiles and collect green “understanding” to build trust. Expand your star map, meet eccentric aliens, unlock hints, and discover what it means to find life that’s truly above average.

name: The You Quiz
summary: The You Quiz is a multiplayer game where the questions are about you! Be the King and judge your friends' answers about yourself. Or be a Courtier, guess their quirks, tastes, and dreams. Win favor, climb the ranks, become the new King. 3-8 players, online or local.

name: The Silence After
summary: The Silence After is a first-person atmospheric horror game where you play as a blind sole survivor following a distress signal through an apocalyptic reality, interacting with the environment and using your synesthetic ability to perceive sound as color to progress and avoid death.

name: The Uncalled
summary: A young romantic shepherd is not called to arms for the war in the territory's north. However, witless enough, the enemy has changed its attack route. He is left alone with women, children, and animals to protect and with lots of pain of being belittled by men of the locale and his beloved one.

name: The Roadside Motel
summary: The Roadside MOTEL: 10 rooms. 10 dark pasts. Silence tells more than lies. No one is who they seem. If you dare, knock on the door. But sometimes, the loudest scream is no answer at all.

name: The Ultimate Box Games
summary: The Ultimate Box Games is a simple but chaotic multiplayer filled with throwable props, power ups and more that can help or hurt you as you race to complete your goal of moving the most boxes(and other items) to their new home.

name: The Quiet Hum of a Lonely Heart
summary: Ten-year-old Margo exists in the shadow of her vibrant older sister, Janice, a shadow cast by parents who are too busy admiring one child to truly see the other, leaving Margo to navigate a world of quiet yearning and internal suffering.

name: The Sushi House
summary: On your first day at the sushi shop, everything seemed normal. But as you learn the ropes, you begin to notice strange signs. And slowly, you find yourself drawn toward something hidden within.

name: The Xen
summary: Add up to 10. THE XEN is an adrenaline-pumping puzzle roguelike where every number counts. Test your game sense against the world.

name: The Evil's Nest
summary: The Evil's Nest takes inspiration from the classic survival horror games from the early 2000s

name: The Writ
summary: Let's see how diligently you follow orders.

name: The Noexistencen of Morphean Paradox: The Forest of Silver Shallots
summary: You awaken in the Forest of Silver Shallots, setting out to uncover the secret of the Morphean Paradox. Above, factions weave their schemes; below, the black mist hides a swelling undercurrent. Time never stands still, and truth wears many faces. Not everyone can return to their fate…

name: The Killing Stone
summary: Beat the Devil at his own game. The Killing Stone is a deckbuilding card battler wrapped in a 17th century folk horror narrative. Clean the sins of a cursed family by bargaining against a series of demons - and outwitting the Devil himself.

name: The Lampkeeper
summary: The afterlife is a dark and dreary place. Ages have passed, leaving the souls trapped here to forget the feeling of light, of warmth. It's up to you to help them remember. Traverse the strange terrain of the afterlife, witness its innumerable oddities, and use your lamp to bring back the light!

name: The Cloud Forest
summary: Follow the melodies of the wind through a magical world where seasons merge and secrets float in this visual novel.

name: The Pig Cow: Horizons of the New Valley
summary: Interactive graphic novel that tells the exciting adventures of Rosie, a curious and fun cow who grew up and was raised in a cosy family of pigs.

name: The Wolf and the Blood Moon
The Detective's Apprentice
summary: Step into the shoes of Clementine "Cleo" Ace, an apprentice to her aunt, the world renowned detective, Maya Lynch. From heists to murders, use your deduction skills to solve cases that are too tough for the local police to crack.

name: The Master of the Land
summary:
An interactive fiction intrigue in an immersive and dynamic world.

Text is mixed and combined to show a changing place, with many characters moving around, weather, different events -balls, dinners, ceremonies- and interlocking storylines. With more than 80 thousand words and more than ten major plots, each playthrough shows only a fraction of the possibilities.

name: The Corn Maze: Rebirth
summary: Trapped in a massive corn maze, you must survive monstrous threats, uncover hidden truths, and follow cryptic notes from a mysterious figure. Shoot, scavenge, and explore twisted portals as you unravel a dark conspiracy blending science, cults, and control.

name: The Way Home
summary: The protagonist is on his way home from work. However, something is strange about his "The Way Home" today...

name: The Last Game
summary: In The Last Game, face the Angel of Death in a high-stakes dice poker match for your life. The currency? Days of your existence. Win back time or risk losing it all in this tense battle of chance and strategy. Can you outsmart Death, or will your days run out?

name: The Sims 4: Essential Glam Kit
summary: Makeup for all.

name: The Sims 4: Grange Mudroom Kit
summary: Decorate and organize your entryway into the perfect mudroom.

name: The Sims 25th Birthday Bundle
summary:
The games you know and love. For Windows 10/11.

In The Sims, create an entire neighborhood of Sims and run or ruin their lives. Help them pursue careers, make friends, and find romance — or watch the chaos unfold as you explore different choices. Open-ended gameplay gives you the freedom to set your own goals and chart your Sims’ destinies. It is your neighborhood, and they are your Sims. Whether they prosper or perish is completely up to you.

In The Sims 2, you direct your Sims over a lifetime and guide their characteristics from one generation to the next. You set your Sims' goals in life: popularity, fortune, family, romance, or knowledge. Give them a long, successful existence or leave their lives in shambles. Take them to extremes — from marrying an alien to writing a great novel or even seeing a ghost. Unleash your creativity with Create-A-Sim, building options, and the in-game movie camera. Get ready to guide their characteristics, fulfill their dreams, and push them to extremes. What do you want to do with your Sims' lives?

The Sims 25th Birthday Bundle includes:

The Sims
The Sims 2
The Sims 4 Throwback Fit Kit
The Sims 4 Grunge Revival Kit

The Sims 25th Birthday also includes the following The Sims packs:
The Sims Livin’ Large
The Sims House Party
The Sims Hot Date
The Sims Vacation

The Sims Makin’ Magic

The Sims 2 Happy Holiday Stuff
The Sims 2 Celebration! Stuff
The Sims 2 H&M Fashion Stuff
The Sims 2 Teen Style Stuff
The Sims 2 Kitchen & Bath Interior Design Stuff
The Sims 2 Mansion & Garden Stuff

name: The Fame Game: Welcome to Hollywood
summary:
The Fame Game is an interactive full-motion video (FMV) experience where your choices determine the outcome of your Hollywood journey. You play as Jonathan, an everyday guy who suddenly finds himself cast as the leading man in America’s most-watched television drama, right as its famous on-screen couple breaks up in real life.

As you rise to stardom, you’ll encounter seven distinct love interests, from the glamorous series star to the shy caterer backstage, and navigate the cutthroat world of entertainment, romance, and scandal.

Will you charm your way to the top, find true love, or watch your career crash and burn under the spotlight?

name: The Grey Company
summary: Tabletop Tavern: RTS meets roguelike chaos. Recruit mercenaries, command them in real-time on a tabletop battlefield, and face endless goblin hordes. Unique runs, tough choices, infinite replayability.

name: Thief Simulator: Mastermind Edition
summary: Step into the world of high-stakes burglary in Thief Simulator Mastermind Edition - the ultimate version of the hit stealth sandbox! Now bigger, smarter, and packed with new heists.

name: The Body Transparent
summary: Educate yourself about the vehicle you ride around in every day. Human biology has never been this much fun to learn. Move bones, organs and facts into correct locations. Learn systems, functions, diseases and more.

name: The Secrets We Grow
summary: Guide I.R.I.S., a gardening robot lost to time, to unearth the secrets of her overgrown world. Solve plant-based puzzles using your water spout, and untangle events through environmental storytelling, in this atmospheric journey

name: The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 08: The Riddler
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 09: Robin
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 10: Comissioner Gordon
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 11: The Ninja
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 12: Harley Quinn
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 13: The Ninja
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 14: Two-Face
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 15: Poison Ivy
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 16: Catwoman
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 17: Robin
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 18: Batman
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 19: Batman
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 20: Batman & Robin
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 21: Mr. Freeze
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 22: Man-Bat
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 23: Ra's al Ghul
The Adventures of Batman & Robin: Tiger Barcodzz - 24: The Penguin
The Four Rooms
summary:
The Four Rooms is a first-person, story-driven horror experience:

Explore haunting spaces: dim corridors and locations that are at once familiar and unsettlingly strange.

name: The Bunny Burrow
summary: You wake up inside of a strange nightclub. You don't remember how you got there. Perhaps the lure of music, flashing lights, and pretty women drew you in to possibly forget about your worries for a while. However, you're not exactly certain...

name: The Last Ninja Collection + Bonus Games
summary: A tribute to the golden era of Retro gaming that brings together 7 iconic titles for the first time. This is more than a collection; it's a celebration of gaming history and the preservation of pioneering games from the '80's & '90's allowing you to relive the C64, Amiga and Spectrum versions.

name: The Fourth Anno
summary: Build your team, collect equipment, potions, gems, choose upgrade rewards, and withstand wave after wave of enemy attacks.

name: The Light Prince
summary: Cursed from birth with complete weightlessness, you have been imprisoned in a tower by your godfather, and need to escape and find a way home. Loosely based on George MacDonald's 1864 children's book The Light Princess.

name: The Tunnel
summary: The State sent you to work on The Tunnel, but it's not what you expected. The Machine is not drilling. It's doing something else... something weird. And what do the people living there want with it?

name: The Captive
summary: You have to escape from an island.

name: Thief
summary: Players drive a car around a maze collecting greenbacks while being pursued by a number of police cars. Use dollar symbols to make your car invincible and put police cars temporarily out of action. The game uses a continuous loop tape with actual police band radio banter.

name: The Healing of Sisyphus
summary:
"i fear i'll be the same forever."

Sisyphus was punished with the task of pushing a boulder to the top of a hill, only for it to roll down before he could finish. In every try, he reminisces about his life and wonders if he could ever change for the better. Follow him as he goes through the highs and lows of his mind, finding a strange, absurd meaning to his own struggles.

name: The Parade
summary: Join the mysterious festivities of a transcendental plane.

name: The Golden Tower
summary: The cosmic amulet has risen. Climb the sacred steps. Our monolithic ritual awaits.

name: Three Six Nine
summary: Solve interesting puzzles based on numbers Three, six, and nine. Solve different types of puzzles where you have to make a sequence in 3,6,9 Based on Roman numbers, drag and drop, music sounds, moving blocks, morse code, alphabet, logic, creativity

name: The Secret of Velmora
summary: The artifact of light has been stolen. Something stirs beneath the crypt. And you... are the only one left who remembers the way back.

name: The Light and the Shadow
summary: A magical 2D action-adventure game. Join Fany on a journey through mysterious forests, overcome challenges, face mystical creatures, and uncover forgotten secrets in a charming and magical world.

name: The Sacred Six Crystal: A Hero's Journey
summary: The Sacred Six Crystal: A Hero's Journey is an epic RPG game that tells the story of the heroes' journey to save the world of Elysia from destruction caused by the return of the dark power of Drakmor, the former Supreme God of Darkness.

name: The Bigback Room
summary: A comedy horror game about falling into the backrooms while trying to head to the store to find something to eat. You will need to find food and solve simple puzzles to survive and hopefully find your way out.

name: ThroneBreaker
summary: You play whose family was executed under the orders of a ruthless king Through years of cunning strategy and dangerous alliances, you lead a rebellion and seize the throne for yourself. But the crown is no sanctuary. Years later, just as you begin to rebuild the realm an assassin’s blade finds you.

name: The House: A Maple Street Story
summary: Explore a cursed house where a family was driven to madness by a dark presence. In The House: A Maple Street Story, uncover a terrifying mystery through enigmatic puzzles, an engaging narrative, and a psychological horror atmosphere that holds your every move captive.

name: The Tower of Babel
summary: The Tower of Babel is a 40-map megawad built by 25 talented, beautiful, and humble mappers where your goal is simple : ascend the enigmatic tower, floor by floor, and discover what awaits you at the top - if there is a top, that is. On your climb, you'll encounter galvanic techbases, hellish strongholds, dazzling Doomcute, and... pizza (or gutza, whatever the locals call it) - all crammed into the coolest, Doom 2 vanilla-textured 1024 x 1024 maps around. The wonderful synergy between maps make this megawad a really enjoyable one. The higher you go into the tower, the better it gets. So much so, that you will be wanting more at the end.

name: The Maverick Hunter Chronicles
summary: The Maverick Hunter Chronicles is a short Mega Man X themed Doom Total Conversion made by SirOblivion, featuring a new story taking place alongside the plot of the first game in the X series, and a full set of custom sprites and textures.

name: The Mind Snare
summary: Unravel a deadly labyrinth, recover lost memories, and shape your convictions in this adventure where every choice matters. Can you face the truth?

name: The Grass Reaper
summary: Relaxing yet hellish. An active incremental/clicker with action, where almost every tile is destructible. Grab your scythe, command your minions and reap everything.

name: The Icarus Effect
summary:
A small space adventure visual novel of mystery, horror, mech's and quirkiness.

You are a herald trying to find a candidate to pilot your Gaunt, a vastly advanced organic machine, designed for the sole purpose of bringing the curren war to a complete halt!

In the process you will get to know your pilot better and learn more about funny trivia and weird encounters.

But remember, there is always darkness lurking in the back.

name: The Ball
summary: The ball is a single—player platformer game, featuring mazes and level adventures. You will also be greeted by the colorful and diverse levels created from spheres and hemispheres, which are seasoned with casualness. All this is waiting for you in the game!

name: The Museum of Opportunity
summary:
Learn all about "careers" and make a few friends along the way! This collection of murals will teach you to grab life by the collar and shout "PRODUCTIVITY" in its dirty face!

To view a mural, click outside of the dialogue window.

Created for Archive.org's DiscMaster Game Jam, April 20th-29th- all game assets except for text content were sourced from the DiscMaster CD-ROM archive.

May be buggy, just like life!

name: The Next Stop
summary:
The Next Stop is a narrative adventure about a murder full of contradictions, where the clues don't add up and everything hides something darker. It blends point & click mechanics with the depth of a visual novel, all set in a haunting subway filled with secrets.

Eight people are on board. Eight stories. Eight hidden truths. Each stop on the train reveals a new chapter. Each carriage is a different experience. Every decision you make has consequences.

name: The Little Adventure
summary: A brave dog from a distant planet embarks on a perilous journey through a beautiful yet dangerous world in search of an old friend. Face intense battles, explore breathtaking landscapes, and uncover hidden secrets in this action-packed adventure filled with heartwarming moments and deep connections.

name: The Curry Simulator
summary: Mindlessly mixing curry. That's the best time. Curry will burn if you take your eyes off it for even a moment. Give it lots of love and keep stirring it slowly to prevent it from burning.

name: The Narcotic Operation
summary: Step into the role of a shadowed undercover police officer in Dark Eyes, brave an area dominated by vice and crime, where allies and enemies blur. Every smirk, tear, and lie tightens the web of deceit—will you destroy the empire or lose yourself in its shadows?

name: The Life of Buzludzha
summary: The game is the abandoned monument of Buzludzha and the game included a winter season of atmosphere as real. You have to look for some buttons and an exit.

name: The Retrospekt Retro Gaming Museum: The Game - AVCon 2019 Version
summary: Retrospekt bring to you this virtual tour through the annual AVCon Adelaide and Video Games Festival’s 2019 event. Take a trip through gaming history and learn along the way as you experience this pixelated recreation of the Retro Gaming Museum.

name: The Final Fantasy Legend DX
summary: A full colorization of The Final Fantasy Legend for Game Boy Color version with several bugs in the original game fixed.

name: The Blood's Way
summary: A short narrative-driven 2D side-scrolling action game inspired by ancient Chinese legends. It all begins with a dream. Perhaps someone is pulling the strings—or maybe... it's destiny?

name: The Art of Fugue
summary: A pure story-less puzzle game featuring logical puzzles based on the idea of the fugue: your commands are performed by four different actors, but with increasing delays. The version with music features Daniel Bautista's rendering of Beethoven's Grosse Fuge on electric guitars.

name: The Easiest Way
summary: Defeat waves of angry-looking red enemies with a cubic figure named Kyubi and their boomerangs.

name: The Tail of King Boris of Oris
summary: Live the curse of the ouroboros and devour your kingdom by constricting around it. Wrap yourself around objects and bite your tail to devour them.

name: The Golden Mare
summary: The ouroboros killer has challenged you openly to find him or else he keeps his kill streak. Kill not only challenges you but also mocks the police department. Find him before anyone else is killed.

name: Threadbare
summary: A short game about being old and looking back at how you spent your time on earth. People you met, dreams you left behind, endless hours of working... just for the cycle to begin again.

name: The Tangled Tapestry
summary: You're a monster who got banished to a very strange world, a prison shaped like a Möbius strip: The Tangled Tapestry. Use your unique morphology and understand the shape of this looping world to find a way out.

name: The Apartment
summary: I am an ordinary cleaner working in an ordinary apartment building. At least, that’s what I thought.

name: The Overnight Screening
summary: The story unfolds through the eyes of a first-person protagonist. While working part-time at an old movie theater, the protagonist begins to experience strange and unexplainable events. You must survive the presence that lurks within the theater and uncover hidden clues to reach a meaningful ending.

name: The Game of Life: DX Jinsei Game III
The Queen Riding Insects
summary: It is a 3D game with a third-person perspective. The game is an open world, and the game has real four seasons day and night and changing weather..... Players have to explore the unknown world, challenge hidden dangers, find weapons to defeat monsters....

name: The Next Journey of Life
summary: "The Next Journey of Life"is a simulation management game. You, who work in the real estate industry, are unemployed due to the company's "optimization".A lost horse is not a blessing, as long as we have hope for life, we can walk "The next journey of life" well

name: The Chase: Police Rush
summary: The Chase is an endless driving game where you take the role of a driver on the run from the police. Set on an open, continuous maps, the objective is simple: stay ahead of the cops for as long as possible while avoiding obstacles and collecting essential items like fuel, magnets, coins and presents. With high-speed chases, explosive crashes, and unlockable vehicles and environments, The Chase delivers a heart-pounding experience.

name: The Amazing Digital Circus Visual Novel: Candy Chaos
summary: A fangame Visual Novel that adapts the second episode of "The Amazing Digital Circus", "Candy Carrier Chaos!".

name: The Pagemaster
summary: The Pagemaster is a video game published in 1994 on Windows 3.x by Turner Interactive. It's an adventure game, set in a licensed title, graphic adventure, puzzle elements and movies themes.

name: The Tavern at the End of the Road
summary: A souls-like deckbuilder in first-person 3D where each run is a new life told by a mysterious innkeeper. Journey to the north, Errant, and travel the Road to become Legend. A replayable mystical experience with tactical combat in a world that remembers your choices.

name: The Gallery: A Riley Magras Exhibit
summary: Step into a digital art gallery showcasing the works of Riley Magras. Explore immersive paintings, uncover hidden paintbrushes, and experience art like never before.

name: The Callers
summary: Explore a medieval land as a Nim named Skybrighten and try to save your world from disaster. Find friends to help along the way, but try not to cause more trouble than you fix! Travel where you want, solve a few puzzles, and be nice to people!

name: The Last Prisoner
summary: The Last Prisoner - Hardcore Sci-fi platformer. You are the last prisoner awakened from a corrective cryo-sleep, your task is to escape a space prison containing a rebellious AI and find out where everyone else is? The only way to escape is to manipulate gravity and adapt to the chaos around you.

name: The Almagest Anomalies
summary: The Almagest Anomalies is a short Anomaly Finding game inspired by the Japanese game Exit 8. Find an Anomaly, go back the way you came, to complete a loop. Don’t find an Anomaly, keep moving forward, to complete a loop. Complete ten loops and the exit will reveal itself.

name: The Most Epicest Snowball Fight Ever!
summary: The snowball fight of your dreams! Take up arms against imaginary snow monsters in this charming turn-based tactics game where a child's imagination is their greatest weapon. Can you defeat the forces of the evil Baron von Slushie?

name: The Atlas Problem
summary: Defend Atlas Station from waves of asteroid bombardment. Build towers, shoot and survive in first-person, collect resources from destroyed debris, then upgrade your defenses and the station itself. Die and try again with permanent upgrades in this roguelike tower defense game.

name: The Hordes of the Dead
summary:
A quiet routine patrol in the middle of the night, becomes your worst living nightmare! Unknown sounds from the darkness start coming for you.

This is Survival Shooter, Horror game.

In the middle of the night, you are awakened by a strange sound. Something is coming...

You will have to face fast zombies that are deadly and agile, as well as slower, stronger zombies that can grab you, and tear your flesh.

name: The Death of the Video Star
summary: A visual novel about dealing with the aftermath of killing God, and maybe having to kill Her again.

name: These Are Them
summary: Protect the hearts known as 'these' from the approaching corruption of monsters known as 'them' with the last remaining survivors in this twisted dark fantasy realm.

name: The Fall: Zombie Survival
summary:
The Fall: Zombie Survival is a single-player survival puzzle game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies. You play as a survivor who has been stranded alone for almost a year, struggling to find a way out of this nightmare.

Explore the abandoned city, and scavenge for supplies. Solve puzzles and complete missions to progress through the game and uncover the truth about what happened to the world.

name: The Locked Room
summary: The Locked Room - is a psychological horror with detective elements, where you'll navigate an bizarre motel. The linear storyline, investigation mechanics, and survival elements immerse you in an atmosphere where every action brings you closer to the truth.

name: The Highway
summary: Move across the bridge and prevent the cars from stepping on your shadow!

name: The Escape
summary: The Escape is an unconventional first-person escape room experience. Explore dark, abandoned rooms, search for keys, solve puzzles, and find your way out. Simple to learn but full of tension, it’s designed for short, intense sessions and perfect for streaming or sharing reactions.

name: The Mailroom
summary:
A horror job simulator where you work in the mailroom of a small regional office of Hell located in Modesto, California.

You just started working in the mailroom of that weird building on 5th. The job was easy enough at first. Sort the mail and use their creaky old pneumatic tube system to send it to the correct departments. But then shit started getting weird. Can you figure out what's really going on in this place and find a way out?

name: The Maze Wars
summary: The Maze Wars Fight through deadly mazes in this fast-paced FPS! Explore 2 chapters with 18 handcrafted levels, 6 enemy types, and powerful weapons. Outsmart traps, claim loot, and survive the ultimate challenge!

name: The Null Frequency
summary: When a mysterious signal disrupts the world, driving people to madness, you and your partner must uncover its source. Trust, courage, and teamwork are your only weapons in a fight against an invisible force that threatens to consume reality itself.

name: The Grand Planto Heists
summary: The neighborhood will never be the same! Play as a raccoon obsessed with the front gardens of The Grand Planto Heights in this 3D digging adventure, dodging Animal Control with your woodland critter friends and stealing whatever you can scamper away with in your paws & jaws!

name: That Guy Pisses Me Off
summary:
"A recipe for my favourite soup."

1.) 300g beef
2.) 1 liter water
3.) 1 onion
4.) 2 carrots
5.) 3 potatoes
6.) 1 bay leaf
7.) YOU

name: Thing-Thing Arena
summary: Thing-Thing Arena has you going up against endless waves of enemies in an enclosed area. and it features new weapons, new modes of play, and chaotic addictive gameplay.

name: Thing-Thing Arena 2
summary: Thing-Thing Arena 2 features chaotic gun battles and world wide high score tables!

name: Thing-Thing Arena Classic
summary: Thing-Thing Arena Classic is the fifth iteration of the Thing-Thing Arena series. Arena Classic emphasizes on killing as many enemies as possible with no time limits, no data discs to destroy, and no gun parts, keycards, or secret briefcases to collect.

name: Thing-Thing Arena Pro
summary: Thing-Thing Arena Pro is the forth iteration of the Thing-Thing Arena. Thing-Thing Arena Pro features an objective-based gameplay style, where you would have to complete a series of tasks within a time limit.

name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines
summary: Welcome to the world of The Coma 3: Bloodlines. In this realm of shadows rumors and urban legends become reality, and danger lurks around every corner. If a living intruder dies here, their body will be severed from their spirit and never wake again ...

name: Thunder Spikes Volleyball
summary: Thunder Spikes Volleyball is a 2D video game where you can perform every volleyball move: spikes, tips, blocks, serves, and different types of digs and receptions.

name: The Fixers
summary: The Fixers is a multiplayer cyberpunk third-person shooter with high-stakes extraction gameplay. Players step into the role of mercenaries navigating Maverick City, a brutal sprawl of neon streets, corporate towers, and underground syndicates. Every contract is a gamble: enter raids, fight AI and rival players, secure loot, and escape alive.

name: The Tiny World
summary: The Tiny World is a drama visual novel. A New Year's story about a long separation from home, family, friends, and tears freezing in the cold.

name: The Smoke
summary: The Smoke is a 2D Metroidvania where players wield a gun to disperse the smoke that threatens to engulf the world. Explore a world filled with hidden pathways and treacherous chambers. Blast away enemies, clear toxic clouds, and unlock new abilities. Stop the darkness before it swallows everything.

name: The Blogger: Pumpkins and Witches
summary: One photo could change your fate forever.

name: The Mystery of Eldham
summary: Your epic story awaits here. Experience an epic journey and rescue a village from evil deeds. A retro RPG full of secrets and adventures.

name: The Sims 4: Adventure Awaits
summary:
Break free from the everyday with daring activities and Getaways in The Sims 4 Adventure Awaits Expansion Pack. Nurture the spirit of play in childhood and carry it through a bold, adventurous life. Create Custom Venues for Sims to explore and send them on Getaways you design like a kids’ camp, fitness retreat, or even a romantic contest. Kids will also find their playtime more meaningful than ever. They can even connect with Imaginary Friends!

Warm & Cozy Digital Content— Pair big adventures with big relaxation! Stay cozy outside with the Toasty Tower Lamp, enjoy a comforting beverage from the Toast-Tea Kettle, and keep your feet nice and snuggly with the Toasty Tootsies Socks available when you order through November 13th, 2025.

name: They Won't Get Our Eggs!
summary: They won't get our eggs!!! Welcome to the fantasy world, where you play as the dragon, trying to protect your eggs from the enemies. They won't get our eggs - is a roguelike game where you need to shoot infinite waves of enemies, attacking your nest.

name: The Keisatsu 24-ji
summary: The Keisatsu 24-ji is a Beat 'em up video game published by Desire Factory, EnterBrain released on 2009 for Microsoft Windows.

name: The Drowned Deal
summary: The Drowned Deal is a roguelike deck-building card game inspired by poker. Build powerful hands, buy cursed coins to boost combo points, and survive pirate battles filled with unique penalties every round.

name: The Backrooms: Reset
summary: A first person 2.5D survival-horror exploration roguelike.

name: The Artifact Protocol
summary: A psychological horror game where every artifact traps you in the final moments of someone's life. Face five distinct nightmares, each with its own monster, story, and theme. You're not solving the mystery… you're reliving it.

name: The Final Flame
summary:
A 2D Hack-and-Slash Action RPG with rogue-lite elements. Play as Zaf along with a variety of other characters to stop Altemis, a bored goddess from destroying the world.

Inside Altemis' tower are ever changing rooms, all with different enemies and use it to their advantage. Choose between 11 different characters with different abilities along with 2 characters to assist you in your fight to the top. Use your strengths, skills, and wits, equipped with Falucites to enhance your abilities and cast strong magic, to climb up Altemis' ever changing tower.

name: The Cursed Deep
summary: Dare to navigate 'The Cursed Deep', a gripping VR game where you command a pirate ship fending off the dreaded leviathans. Load cannons, aim true, and repel the monsters of the deep in this immersive test of skill and courage. Will you conquer the depths or be swallowed by the sea's fury?

name: The Great Axe
summary: The Great Axe is a Beat'em up in the style of medieval fantasy

name: The Puzzler
summary: The Puzzler is a first-person escape room style puzzle game where you must solve challenging puzzles using a unique spell-casting system.

name: The Dream Collector
summary: Greetings from the Corporate Offices of The Void Incorporated. In this creepy cozy experience, you will be responsible for handling, repairing, documenting, and collecting dreams. Though simple and relaxing, your work is vital to keeping reality intact.

name: Theden
summary: Escape to a paper paradise filled with colorful characters and noteworthy enemies! Shift between different classes and shuffle a stack of unique items to ream enemies, keep tabs on your friends, enter dungeons, and explore. Don't die, DYE, as you write your legend and rip The Engineer a new one!

name: There Exists
summary: A narrative VR experience where you explore 1790s Australia through the eyes of an English servant and the Dharug people. Uncover hidden histories, navigate immersive environments, and witness a pivotal moment of first contact.

name: The Lost Song
summary: The Lost Song is a visual novel about how an air force member Marina encounters a singing merman Zeru while cruising the island and how this brings enormous changes to her boring life. Become the heroine Marina and see things through her eyes, listen through her ears and make her own choices.

name: The Minister
summary: A turn-based RPG. Play as a Confucian sage's disciple entering politics in a fictional world, striving to save a collapsing dynasty and its suffering people. Cultivate factions, plot schemes, and vie with rivals. Witness hardships, resist power's corruption, rise to power, and stabilize the realm.

name: The Shape That Waits
summary: A turn-based, claustrophobic nightmare and each action feeds the terror hunting you.

name: Thief: The Stray Cat
summary: Help the Stray Cat find as much gold as possible and save his feline family.

name: Three Body Problem
summary:
Three Body Problem is an arcade game about chase and elusion.

Two opponents will attempt to collide with you. They are inside your head. You will die, until you get inside theirs.

name: The Butterfly
summary:
Leila is sick. You should help her.

THE BUTTERFLY is a short narrative-driven psychological horror game about insects and love. About 20-25 minutes of playtime.

name: The Loop Below
summary: Trapped in a looping, claustrophobic bunker, you must detect subtle anomalies before they consume you. Watch every shadow. Memorize every detail. No weapons. No escape. Just your scanner, your instincts — and the creeping dread that something is terribly wrong.

name: The Sacrilege
summary: The Sacrilege is a 2D movie-game with interactive minigames to advance the film. The plot follows a newly pastor, starting over in the same town where his past vanished into darkness years ago. But that darkness never went away and... it is about to return.

name: The Deluge
summary:
"The forest seemed like a fairy tale when you were little, one where you might wander down the trail and never return. In truth, it only stretches a few acres to what used to be an outlying subdivision. Now, though, it might fulfill its old potential. An adventurer could wade, then swim, then find an entire realm under the still and clouded water.

Do you still believe that?"

A hypertext exploration game about the physical and emotional landscape of your flooding hometown and your attempts to get the hell out.

name: The Barber Shop
summary: Run your own little barbershop and see if you've got what it takes to keep the customers happy and the chairs full! Hire barbers, cut hair, earn tips, and upgrade your shop from a run-down room to a buzzing hotspot.

name: The Underdog Tycoon
summary: Forge your path from underdog to tycoon in this challenging business sim! Master character development, manage diverse businesses, and navigate a realistic market. A world of opportunity, both authentic and fun, awaits you!

name: The First Nightmare
summary: John will embark on a dangerous adventure, in search of his mother in the place he once called home and is now a terrifying place with a bloodthirsty enemy, he will have to discover the signs that will lead him to wake up from this nightmare, will he find his mother?

name: The Winter Mind
summary: This is a psychological horror in which we play as a girl who has psychological health problems, and her mother has sent her to the store. Our task is to help her buy groceries.

name: The Amazing Digital Circus: Lost Demo
summary: A short 3D Collect-a-Thon fangame based on the web animated series "The Amazing Digital Circus".

name: The Flying Jet
summary: The Flying Jet is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

name: The Resident
summary:
Your friend invited you over.

But when you arrive, it’s clear… he isn’t the one living here anymore.

A very short PSX-style horror walking sim with multiple endings.

Made in 1 day in Unreal Engine 4.

name: Theater of the Mind
summary: Have you ever wanted to experience hallucinations without the use of mind altering substances, uncomfortable fasting, or costly and time consuming vision quest? Now you can!

name: The Five Nights at Freddy's Mod
The Heavens
summary: Ascend to the Heavens and find out if you're pure enough to be reborn on the Earth.

name: The Spring
summary: The spring is a Japanese-style first-person horror game that can be completed in about an hour. Set in a silent hot spring inn, players must escape the looming terror and struggle to survive.

name: The Resurrected
summary: This is a first-person survival game. There are two different weapons and realistic graphics. This is a high-quality zombie-themed horror game. It features realistic shooting and killing mechanics.

name: The Night Gym
summary: The Night Gym is a small retro-style indie horror experience with a VHS aesthetic where a late-night workout turns into a nightmare. You arrive at the gym after hours — just you and the machines. But something feels off. The lights flicker. The silence is heavy. You're not alone...

name: This Ship Goes Brrr
summary: Get crystals, get upgrades, get points, get dead. Get a high score, get dead again. Get a higher score. Get flying, get addicted.

name: The Cascadier
summary: A coin-pusher roguelike with pinball physics! The Cascadier is a kinetic deckbuilder where you build powerful decks, drop charged coins into enchanted machines, and unleash explosive combos that cascade into high scores, hidden paths, and godly combos.

name: The King is Watching
summary: The King is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder. Rule by the power of your royal gaze! Decide between producing resources, training armies, or balancing both, while adapting to unique events every run

name: Therapy
summary: This game is a fascinating adventure, where players rapidly advance in a whimsical world.

name: The Last Case of John Morley
summary: Step into the mind of John Morley, a 1940s detective on his final case. Explore shadowed places long forgotten by time, and piece together crime scenes in a narrative adventure steeped in mystery, unexpected twists, and a truth buried for decades.

name: The Scarlet Harvest
summary: A 90’s-inspired slasher survival horror. A Halloween party at a remote farm turns into a nightmare as you explore macabre farms, dark cornfields, and dangerous settings where you'll have to run, fight, and survive.

name: The Elf on the Shelf: Christmas Heroes
summary: Santa needs you! Become a Scout Elf, gathering Christmas Spirit and dodging obstacles. Pledge to make things merry and be a Christmas Hero!

name: The Looking Game
summary: Help Mr Tumble and his friends look for their missing objects.

name: The Game Dev Tree
summary: The Game Dev Tree is an incremental game that emphasizes strategy, setting it apart from the original The Prestige Tree.

name: The Ascent: Complete Edition
summary:
Includes:
- The Ascent
- The Ascent: Cyber Heist
- The Ascent: CyberSec Pack
- The Ascent: Cyber Warrior Pack
- The Ascent: Artbook + Weapon Pack
- The Ascent: Soundtrack
- The Ascent: Cyber Heist Soundtrack

name: The Möbius Strip
summary:
A scientist, famous for making a sense-enhancing innovation, is recruited to work for the Silver Bed Foundation on a new project: a way to make immortality real.

A short puzzle RPG with three major acts.

name: The Dead House
summary: Play as an ambitious YouTuber known for exploring paranormal and creepypasta stories. Your latest video takes you to a hauntingly beautiful, abandoned mansion, rumored to hide dark secrets.

name: The Population Must Grow
summary: Start with just one citizens to build up your city. Grow it more and more and more. There is no limit in size. Just the limit of your own PC.

name: The Jungle Challenge
summary: Join Buzzy, an energetic bee, along with his friends Lilo the ladybug, Tito the beetle, and Rocco the grasshopper in this exciting visual novel.

name: The Outlast Trials: Terrified Toddler Pack
summary: A baby fears nothing but a toddler begins to feel the crushing weight of humanity. Stand on uncertain footing against the darkness and keep a wobbly step ahead of all the things you fear. The Terrified Toddler Pack contains 2 Legendary Outfits, 4 cell items and one player icon.

name: The Outlast Trials: Spelunking For Your Life Pack
summary: Exploration is bound to make you hungry. Peel back the flesh and the muscle and cut to the bone to find earthly delights from across time. The Spelunking for Your Life Pack contains 2 Legendary Outfits, the Weary Traveller cell customization pack, 3 cell items and a player icon.

name: The Outlast Trials: Porcelain Observer Pack
summary: One needs to consider the fragility of life and remember that everything is temporary, even your looks. Drink from your own reflection, do not fade into normalcy. The Porcelain Observer Pack contains 2 Legendary Outfits, 4 cell items and a player icon.

name: The Outlast Trials: World of Heavyweights Pack
summary: Tie your gloves on tight and travel the world, but don't write cheques your fists can't cash. Idolize the strong, be weary of the weak, and carry a knuckle sandwich for later. The World of Heavyweights Pack contains 2 Legendary Outfits, 4 cell items and one player icon.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Ragoo
summary: The scourge of the waters, the bane of navies, the serpents of the seas - The Ragoo Pirates! Their fleets of ships and lust for plunder are ready to expand their operations from the Kickoo Isles to the rest of the Square!

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Hoodrick
summary:
The yellow autumn leaves of the Hoodrick woods are perfect hideouts for its peculiar mushroom stuffing inhabitants.
Hoodrick starts the game with Archery Tech

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Kickoo
summary:
White sandy beaches with coconut palms. Abundance of fruit and fish. Welcome to the home of the Kickoo.
Kickoo starts the game with the fishing tech.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Yorthwober
summary: Can you hit a BuzzFly with an arrow from 2 tiles away? Then you might be ready for the Hoodrick Yorthwober. These expert sharpshooters have been personally trained in combat and survival by Yorth, the legendary archer, and comprise the most elite force the Hoodrick can muster.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Lirepacci
summary: The honor of forging your helmet into a laurel is reserved for the Lirepacci, a group of scholars, philosophers, and magistrates near the top of Imperius society.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Baergøff
summary: Bardur who have survived the 5 Tests of Strength are given the rank of Baergøff, meaning “Elite Baerion Hunter”. The sanctified Baerion pelt is thought to let the wearer channel the animal's raw ferocity in battle.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Sha-po
summary: The Sha-po are a secretive legion of soldiers, saboteurs, and assassins trained in the ways of warfare and subterfuge from the moment they're hatched.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Anzala
summary: The disciples of Anzala eschewed the scientific lifestyle of their Zebasi siblings and followed the calling of art and unrestrained expression! Now they're here, with the Square as their canvas, and no one will hinder their creative conquest!

name: The Cube, Save Us
summary: A post-apocalyptic extraction action game built around brutal, close-quarters combat. Step through the Cube Gate and discover ever-shifting worlds filled with strange landscapes and terrifying enemies. Escape the Cube by fighting your way through twisted mutants and Raiders you once called allies.

name: The Groundskeeper
summary: The Groundskeeper is a 2D top-down indie horror game featuring retro pixel art and a mysterious threat to uncover. Button up your overalls and grab your flashlight as the night shift approaches and Gramen Park needs its guardian... for you may find that something sinister lurks in the dark.

name: The Tower
summary: A burning tower with only one way out.

name: The Sims 4 Love & Family Bundle
summary: Face the joys and challenges of partnership and family life with The Sims 4 My Wedding Stories Game Pack*, The Sims 4 Parenthood Game Pack*, and The Sims 4 Growing Together* Expansion Pack.

name: The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape
summary: A dark fantasy style pixel ARPG. Players will travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

name: The Hearth and Harbour
summary: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

name: The Remainer
summary: The Remainer is a survival horror game in which you must travel through a colossal abandoned spaceship. Traverse and adapt to this hostile environment, gather mementos of the past, survive the horrors of this universe and keep yourself together as you plunge deeper and deeper into the unknown.

name: The Last Son of Vorona
summary: In this first person combat adventure, you have one job: Destroy the plague before it destroys you. Slash, dash, jump and run through rats or run the rat race yourself.

name: The Last Screening
summary: You find yourself inside a cinema hallway, ready to watch your film. The venue, however, has other plans for you.

name: The Music at the End of the World
summary: "What music would you listen to at the end of the world?" Explore an abandoned world after the apocalypse of the final winter. Shape the story of a man whose loneliness threatens his sanity. Use violence to survive or avoid it to protect your mind. Experience the end of the world!

name: The Realm of Reincarnation
summary: This game centers on monster hunting, equipment collection, random talents, gear enhancement, and top-tier loot drops.

name: The Last Summer
summary: The Last Summer is an visual novel, telling a story of regret and growth. Frustrated in his career, Sun Hao returns to his childhood, where past events and people constantly bring him back to the summer of his 17th year. The dull memories of school life and the uncertainty about the future leave him feeling lost, until the arrival of a transfer student changes his life...

name: Thrilling Racing
summary: Thrilling Racing is a free-to-play racing game that lets you enjoy the thrill of speed and excitement!

name: The Faction
summary:
In The Faction you will experience a story of action, invasion and adventure!

The game takes place in a camp, in an area belonging to the rival faction to that of the protagonist, where you will be able to explore the entire scenario unrestrictedly. In this area you will have to complete some objectives, like eliminate some members that are there, get some notes and steal a cargo that is in the area. For that, you'll have a medium-long-range weapon and a pistol, and you'll have to use them strategically in order to achieve your goals and make it out alive.

You will control Ruan, in first person and you will have to complete some tasks before reaching your main objective, being able to complete the missions stealthily or kill it. Do what you want, but leave the area alive and with the drug that must be stolen.

The game will provide you with a unique experience, with lots of action and strategy!

name: The Firestorm is Coming
summary: You are a brave firefighter in a magic balloon equipped with a powerful water cannon!

name: The Last Pawn
summary: The Last Pawn is a shooter platformer where you play as the last hope of your kingdom. In your journey across the land, you will find yourself dealing with multiple enemy types, boss battles and 21 different levels.

name: The Experiment
summary: This game is a chapter based indie horror game where you need to find your best friend that have gone missing!

name: The Last Scion
summary: Shrug off bullets, smash buildings with your bare hands, and soar through the air as you battle diabolical supervillains! A text-based interactive superhero novel.

name: The Dark Quarter
summary: A companion app necessary for playing the The Dark Quarter board game from Lucky Duck Games. The Dark Quarter is a cooperative adventure game that tells a rich, adult, dynamic story, mixing an app with physical components.

name: The Path of Blades
summary: A brutal, arcade-style dungeon crawler with modernized combat, Souls-like intensity, and retro-inspired visuals.Classic Dungeon Crawling Reimagined Arcade Souls-Like Gameplay

name: Thank You for Your Time
summary: In a surreal audition purgatory, how long will you wait to be chosen?

name: The Googol Clicker
summary: Could you reach the googol value which is 1e100? Idle clicker game with simple goals but very addictive gameplay!

name: The Chroma: From the Wasteland
summary: A western occult FPS game against the unknown on a train speeding through the western wilderness.

name: The Room Stalker
summary: You are trapped in a hotel room. Find the anomaly and break free from the loop.

name: The Magic World
summary: Party fantasy RPG. You control a party of characters, moving around the game world. Collect items, complete quests, communicate with NPCs, try to survive, destroy enemies with various magic and weapons.

name: The Shadow of the Cherry Trees
summary: Immerse yourself in a magical world inspired by Japan, where Hana must save Yuki by communicating with spirits, solving puzzles, and navigating an enchanted forest. A poetic adventure blending magic, tradition, and courage.

name: The Winter Wedding
summary:
This winter is unlike any other.

There are only 10 days left until your wedding.

Your life is about to change forever...

You can already feel the shift, as extraordinary events refuse to leave you in peace while the tension rises.

Walking the fine line between reality and illusion, you find yourself surrounded by darkness and sinister secrets.

Can you survive your wedding?

Will you escape this labyrinth and find true love?

name: The Adventures of Bucken Berry and Ala-Gold
The Sex Adventures of a Gladiator
summary: The Sex Adventures of a Gladiator is a visual novel in which you will play as a gladiator who wants to destroy the Roman Empire. Embark on an exciting adventure with beautiful girls, hot sex and dinosaurs.

name: The Lift
summary: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

name: Three Kingdoms: Innovatory
summary: This is a classic historical simulation + real-time strategy game, where you will go back to the era of the Three Kingdoms and play as various renowned sovereigns.

name: The Horror Story: Rebirth
summary: Welcome to The Horror Story: Rebirth, a remake version from the original Horror Story powered by Unreal Engine 5. Like all horror games, it contains jumpscares, flashing lights, and loud noises.

name: The Last Hentai: Miku
summary: A third-person girl named Miku move to a new village. Miku should learn how to fight and defeat each bosses.

name: The Darkblade
summary: The Darkblade is a souls-like 2D singleplayer RPG where you battle through cursed lands, master deadly combat, and uncover the truth behind a mysterious stone core—all while adventuring with a loyal, cute companion by your side.

name: The Easter Bunny Game
summary: Grab eggs, bombs and anything else that falls to hand in this frantically stupid multiplayer party game. Perfect for ending quiet nights on the sofa, friendships, or marriages! Absolutely no animals remained intact during the creation of this product.

name: The Molfar: Call of Heart
summary: The Molfar: Call of Heart - adventure game in the aesthetics of Cossack mysticism, set in the alternate history of Ukraine.

name: The Afterlife Cafe
summary: The Afterlife Cafe is a cozy visual novel centered around death and traveling to the afterlife. In the living world, meet and chat with your concierges at the cafes. Then take a temporary trip to the afterlife and learn the stories of those who have passed. Experience moving between the living and spirit realms in this narrative-driven game.

name: The Cesspit
summary: The Cesspit is a first-person adventure horror game set in the sewers. You must explore the dark passageways and escape from the twisted inhabitants. You must find your way using candles and deal with the threats in the darkness.

name: The Sickle Family
summary: The Sickle Family is a haunting adventure game about dogs, exploring how inaction, even when everything seems normal, can lead to deep trauma and heartbreak. It tells a real-life story of grief, loss, and the hidden consequences of everyday moments.

name: The Open League
summary: A social, Discord-based, football/soccer sim

name: The Bond
summary: Far away, in an alien forest, an ancient healer and her faithful beast seek out a sacred glade. Here she can connect with the web of life - and see the world through other’s eyes. But there’s an imbalance - a dark presence. As the forest's guardian she must confront it.

name: Three Kingdoms 2025
summary: In this game, as the protagonist, you can recruit the heroes of the Three Kingdoms, form a dream team, and conquer cities with minimal casualties, minimal time, and optimal strategies, ultimately dominating the world.

name: The Adventures of LinShanHai: Chapter 5 - Three Trees
summary: A child goes missing after school and their whereabouts are unknown. The only clue is that the child had to walk through a forest to get home. The parents suspect that their child may have gotten lost in the forest.

name: The Adventure of Amethyst Knight
summary:
Control the hero to collect resources on the map, defeat monsters, obtain gold coins, and continuously improve your attributes until you defeat the final Demon Dragon King!

This is a single-player RPG based on the 'Tower of the Sorcerer' gameplay.

name: The Whisker Watch
summary: Play as your cat(s) in a co-op roguelike of night prowls, day naps, and endless mischief! Claw at haunted appliances, fight chthonic horrors, and upgrade your cozy mansion! Customize your meow, accessories, and fur; Pet your human for perks!

name: The Game For Skippers
summary: A short visual novel about a person that wants achievements.

name: The Day of the Jellyfish
summary: A point-and-click comedy adventure game featuring original pixel-art and music, quirky puzzles, and fully voice acted dialogue. Play as Hank and Duck, who only showed up in town to put on a rockin' concert, but ended up smack dab in the middle of a mutating cola-based pollution catastrophe.

name: The Unstoppables
summary:
What a catastrophe! The four friends Mai, Jan, Achim and Melissa were standing in front of the food stand completely unsuspectingly when, suddenly, their beloved guide dog Tofu was kidnapped by a mysterious villain! The four friends know their mission clearly: they must free Tofu from the hands of his kidnapper. The friends won’t let their differences get in their way. Only through great teamwork will they be able to overcome the various obstacles in the way of their goal. They are «The Unstoppables!»
This fun journey begins at Melissa’s house and continues step by step to the spooky forest hut.
Will you succeed in helping the Unstoppables free Tofu?

This game was developed alongside the «Diversity Principle» learning resource, which is concerned with the theme of «Sameness and Otherness».

name: There Is More
summary: In this procedurally generated mining roguelite you dig for precious ores by day and defend your city from relentless monsters by night. Each night the waves attacking the core are getting deadlier - upgrade your gear, unlock powerful spells, and descend deeper. Can you survive 10 nights?

name: The Story Of
summary: A collection of 3 relaxing simulators, never before released on PC. Grow the worlds, find all the endings.

name: The Halloween Incident
summary: A detective story with elements of analog horror, in which you will have to conduct your own investigation to get to the truth.

name: The Unstoppables 2
summary:
The friends actually wanted to take it easy, spend a few vacation days at Mai's parents' vacation home in the mountains, hiking, lazing around and canoeing.

But as Melinda is packing, she receives devastating news from Mai. Tofu has disappeared!

Instead of taking the public transport, she had sent her dog ahead with Mai and her parents. And now he's disappeared! Again!

But even this time the different friends Mai, Jan, Achim and Melinda don't give up and they even get reinforcements: this time Rina is also along for the ride.

The search begins at Rina's home and leads into the mountains.

Will you manage to rescue Tofu together with the Unstoppables?

name: The Forgotten Island
summary: When I opened the ancient scroll, I came to the forgotten island. There are medieval figures and buildings on this island. Some people are merchants and some are villagers. First I want to drink water and eat some food, and then explore the island to find a way back to the real world.

name: The Midnight Barber
summary: A narrative ASMR adventure about a supernatural barbershop in late 70s Barcelona. Trim and style your supernatural clientele, gain their trust, and uncover their darkest secrets.

name: The Feces Feasters
summary: a group of outdated loser squatters has taken over the mansion. you've been hired by the owner to take these poop eaters out, but you don't have or need any equipment... just your wits and the determination to earn 2,000 bucks in one night as promised by the mansion's owner.

name: The Cursed Soul
summary: A single-player horror game where you explore a haunted house, collecting items, solving puzzles, and face scares at every turn. Use your inventory to manage your items as you uncover clues to escape. Confront and defeat the monster before it traps your soul forever.

name: The Little Prince
summary: A puzzle game in a watercolor style, where players need to complete puzzles by clicking or dragging with the mouse. The presentation format mimics children's picture books, with different scenes displayed in a paged format. Take you back to the story of the classic work "The Little Prince"!

name: The Waiting Room: An Existential Simulation
summary: Ever been to a waiting room? Ever wanted to? Well now's your chance! Enter The Waiting Room, get your ticket number and wait. "For what?" you might ask. Does it matter? It is an existential life-simulation metaphor? Or a ridiculous waste of time? Well, that, my friends, is up to you.

name: The Tale of Alltynex Deluxe Edition
summary: The Tale Of ALLTYNEX is a trilogy of bullet hell shoot 'em ups developed by SITER SKAIN with its story centering around the malicious super-computer, the ALLTYNEX OS. Each game in the series has its own gameplay mechanics and gimmicks. One thing that stays consistent in the series, however, is that despite the games being of the bullet hell genre, the ships are much tougher and have much larger hitboxes than the standard bullet hell. Thankfully each game provides you with some form of protection against the sheer onslaught of bullets.

name: The B.L.O.O.M Initiative
summary: A fast-paced 2D top-down shoot 'em up with single-player and split-screen co-op. Pilot a drone, fight alien hordes, plant and grow bio-weapons, and survive procedurally generated battlefields in a fusion of action and strategy.

name: The Honours Project
summary: The Honours Project is an autobiographical walking simulator. Enjoy a narrative experience, adventuring through dream-like levels, solving an occasional puzzle and listening to the dark and sometimes comical dialogue that acts as a commentary about being a student and game development.

name: The RPG Engine
summary: Host immersive tabletop campaigns in a world imagined entirely by you! Build from the ground up with The RPG Engine, an intuitive virtual tabletop that lets you create unparalleled roleplaying environments for your party to get lost in.

name: The Wrestling Game
summary: A text based Wrestling Browser game resembling most text based mobile games of today.

name: The Dark Crown: Genesis Demake
summary: 2d, rogue-lite, action platformer, pixel art game. It is about the transition of darkness, which is the 6th and last main element, to humanity. A small early game made before The Dark Crown: Genesis was rebuilt from scratch.

name: The Duck Is In Danger
summary: The Duck Is In Danger is a side-scrolling game with the hardest levels and the most dangerous traps !!! In this incredibly kurta and fun game you play as Karl the duck. You have to get through all the obstacles, all the most dangerous traps that you will meet on the way to complete this game.

name: The Life and Times of Daniel Vastberaden
summary: Daniel Morris Vastberaden first died on December 22nd, 1862. The following thirty-nine years of his life are the subject of the (pseudo)biographical point-and-click puzzle adventure The Life and Times of Daniel Vastberaden.

name: The Paradixion: Restroom
summary: [The Paradixion: Restroom] is a point-and-click adventure game with a mysterious atmosphere.Solve various puzzles with a unique atmosphere and find the hidden elements in the game to gather clues about the story.

name: The Mage
summary: Casual 2D puzzle platformer game that will transport you to a world of magic. Play as a powerful mage on a quest to save his King from a dark and malevolent force that threatens to destroy everything in its path.

name: The Last Hope
summary: A short, thrilling single-player adventure where you step into Rayan oCMz’s shoes and journey through a diverse world to free humanity from the grip of artificial intelligence.

name: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars
