summary: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars is a third-person, fantasy-themed, on-rails shooter for a single player; players take the role of an archer on the back of a dragon AND the dragon itself through short first-person dragon-breath segments.

name: The Piper of Dawn
summary: Welcome to Diamond City—a sealed-off “Paradise”. You play the role of an alchemist running a one-stop empire: farming, "people farming," shopkeeping, and alchemy. Choose your companion and set out on a fantastical journey where rich storytelling blends seamlessly with deep simulation gameplay.

name: The Perfect Prince
summary: The Perfect Prince is an adventure game featuring a touching story and storybook-style visuals. Progress through puzzles and light action, as the tale branches based on your choices and actions. Build bonds with the characters and shape a story that’s uniquely yours.

name: The Touryst: Deluxe
summary: Enjoy your vacation!

name: The Hidden Scrolls
summary: The Hidden Scrolls is a turn-based roguelike tactical RPG with a Chinese-inspired setting. Explore five mysterious regions, battle fierce beasts and ruthless bandits, recruit and train a team of warriors to uncover the secrets hidden within ancient bamboo scrolls.

name: The Street of Adrift
summary: A story of the bond, redemption, and destruction between a noblewoman and the courtesan queen.

name: The Bygone Days of Her and the Flowers
The Last Keeper
summary: Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote island. Maintain the machinery, use the radio and the map to guide ships into the harbor. Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

name: The Dark Protocol
summary: A sci-fi horror game set in a dark space station where only outlines of rooms are visible. Explore eerie corridors, collect items, read notes, solve puzzles, and avoid the terrifying creature lurking in the shadows.

name: The Hole
summary: A fantasy-horror-dark-comedy like no other.

name: The King of Wall Street
summary: This is a rougelite card game that combines parkour-style with stock speculation. You can experience the journey from a stock trading novice to the most powerful king of stocks! More casual or more strategic? It's your choice!

name: The Libido Enigma
summary: A sexy biotech mystery filled lots of sex! You uncover a potential flaw with the female libido enhancement drug within your biotech company. Along the way you encounter several potential female love interests.

name: The Single-Eye Nightmare
summary: Survive deadly traps, solve environmental puzzles, and navigate the twisting corridors and tunnels of a long-forgotten underground temple. But beware: there's a monstrous Cyclops creature lurking around. Stay out of it's sight long enough to find your way out in this first-person horror game.

name: The Dowsing
summary: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

name: The Window 8: Millennium
summary: Hey player, It's the day before the Millennium. Follow me, I will give you a unique psychological horror experience. This isn’t just a game—it’s a doorway. Trust me, and I will lead you to see the god.‍

name: The Screen
summary: Thank you for joining the ███ program. To start out, we would like to ask a few simple questions.

name: The Last Zone
summary: The ultimate survival challenge begins now! In The Last Zone, the battle for humanity’s last stronghold reaches its climax. No longer a test – this is the real war. Armed with powerful weapons, tactical tools, and your will to survive, you must stand your ground against relentless waves of mutated enemies. Every decision, every shot, every second matters.

name: The Grindstone
summary: Create a party of four and begin your open world adventure. Slay monsters, complete quests and find magical treasure.

name: The Jumping Strawberry
summary:
Fast, sweet and full of energy: In "The Jumping Strawberry" you can expect a challenging endless game in which you jump and dodge through a world full of obstacles with an agile strawberry.

Jump your way through a fast-paced adventure that puts your reaction and precision to the test. Every platform counts - one wrong jump and the game starts all over again.

With lovingly drawn cartoon graphics and smooth controls, "The Jumping Strawberry" delivers fast-paced fun with real addictive potential.

name: The Rise of the Hero
summary: The game world is in chaos, and only by reuniting every piece of the crystal can balance and peace be restored.

name: The Hentai Memory
summary: Remember the same symbols, gradually opening the full picture.

name: The Moment of Memory
summary: Help Wendy regain her lost memories. This is a short work about home and love.

name: The Royal Rebel Casino
summary: Clara Kassedy, a private investigator receives an important assignment from her boss that requires her to travel to the Royal Rebel Casino. Throughout her journey, she will interact with characters and be forced to test her luck on popular casino games like blackjack, poker, and roulette.

name: The Eighth Continent
summary:
'The Eighth Continent' is an interactive novel in which you are the story's hero!

In a world devastated by a cataclysmic super-eruption, you must search for your lost family. Who should you trust? What dangers await you in the volcanic wasteland?

Scavenge, fight, hack, and trade your way through a ruined world.

name: The Eighth Continent 2
summary:
'The Eighth Continent 2: The Chasm' is the much anticipated second interactive novel of a trilogy in which you play the hero!

In the first gamebook you sought your lost family across post-apocalyptic London, but now you must venture north, to a mysterious place they call The Chasm.

Scavenge, fight, hack, trade and now persuade your way through a ruined world.

name: Three Kingdoms Mushouden: Digital Deluxe Edition
summary: The Three Kingdoms Mushouden Digital Deluxe Edition includes 4 original character skins, 2 weapons, 1 horse, and 1 additional map BGM track.

name: The Escape: Team Battle Arena
summary: 5:5 team fight. The team that escapes first will grab the victory.

name: The Bladeingtons Camping Adventure
summary: Happy 3rd Anniversary to the first time "The Bladeingtons" was ever uttered on twitter dot com (June 13th, 2020). Here is a special game celebrating this anniversary about a fun camping trip.

name: The Candy Jar On My Desk Is Empty Again
summary: The candy jar on my desk is empty again, and that means something horrible is coming for me. A short interactive fiction game with a confusing metaphor and 20 endings.

name: The Boy and his Story
summary: A fast-action platformer inspired by the Sonic Rush trilogy with decently animated pixel art and music inspired by many artists.

name: The DeviantArt Grind
summary: Congratulations! You got yourself a shrew to raise! Now's your chance to become an ARTIST! Feed your shrew, draw him, and put him on DeviantArt!

name: Thunder Edge
summary: A high-voltage action platformer set in the distant future of 1989, where the supervillain group New Age Pantheon threatens the world. Strike like lightning, and become the hero that will shock the world!

name: The Hurt in Secret
summary: “The Hurt in Secret” is a visual novel game adapted from true events. Players play a role as practice teacher to experience teachers' life. They will involve in a troublesome case. In the story, the chosen dialogue will affect directly to the ending.

name: The World of Marius
summary: Get ready for an epic journey in The World of Marius

name: The Rise of Tianling Sect
summary: Lead your sect to become the strongest in the universe!

name: The Island of Thugs
summary: Welcome to the island of thugs. This tropical island is a secret military base of Russian PMC. You are a Special Agent who must find the leader of PMC and eliminate him. Take the gun and let's go!

name: The Turkish Bazaar
summary: "The Turkish Bazaar" offers players a true bazaar vendor experience. Purchase products wholesale from the hal, load your vehicle, set up your stall, and engage with dynamic customers to become the most successful vendor in the bazaar!

name: The Isle of Cats
summary: Rescue colorful cats to fill your boat in a new digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

name: The Glass Sea
summary: The Glass Sea is an story-focused top down RPG game also featuring traditional 2D platforming mechanics. It focuses on exploring memories and learning about your past. It's produced by talented artist Azi and "experienced" programmer Eve who you may know from her game Dhilly Game 6.

name: The Boykisser Mod
summary: A mod for Minecraft which adds a Boykisser biome, featuring various additions in relation to the Boykisser meme, such as Boykisser mobs and Boykisser ores which can be used to make Boykisser tools and armor. The mod even adds in new potions, such as the Potion of Gay which gives the player the LGBTQIA+ potion effect.

name: The Scam
summary: Play as a little purple square who just wants to have coins and not get scammed.

name: The King's Bargain
summary: A king's foolish bargain. A queen's final curse. A kingdom's rotten soul and a world in ruins. In this gothic survival, RPG-Strategy, manage your team, sanity, and resources to fight the blight that consumes your kingdom.

name: The Serpent & The Seed
summary:
An artistic retelling of the story of The Bible through the lens of the typological seed of the woman mentioned in Genesis 3.

In a post apocalyptic future overrun by thorns and the power of the snake king, a bird discovers an ancient book that may have the answer on how to save the world.

name: The Fight Of Escaper
summary: Humanity has lost sight of itself, blinded by the false prosperity of AI development. You, the protagonist, begin to break free from AI control to uncover the truth of this world. Torn between escaping and erasing your memory, you yearn to leave this city of mechas and reach the shores of freedom.

name: The Outsider
summary: The Outsider is a fan-made story mod for Outer Wilds which expands upon the story told in the original game and its DLC. It adds a bunch of new puzzles and structures and takes place on and around the planet Dark Bramble.

name: Thesis of Love
summary: During the endless summer in Chishima, you join a graduate program hoping to become worthy of your crush. Little do you know what awaits... In this otome dating sim, experience campus life with three lab members trapped in toxic relationships. Your choices may lead them to new paths.

name: The Darkness Delivers
summary: A haunting horror story set in an isolated abbey. Jeanne, a naïve young nun, struggles to save her lover, the angelic Sister Séraphine, from a wasting disease which has ravaged their home - but what is Jeanne prepared to sacrifice for Séraphine's sake?

name: The Uninvited 2: Let Nothing You Dismay
summary: The cult classic returns! Play as Mina Harper, a paranormal investigator haunted by a demon, as you explore a cursed mansion, uncover its dark history through psychic visions, and struggle to keep your soul from being claimed.

name: The Gate Must Stand
summary: Fend off brutal waves of demonic hordes as a mobile hero amongst your stationary allies. As the city’s last line of defense, recruit followers, unlock upgrades, and synergize skills to hold the line against apocalyptic bosses. Remember: heroes can fall, but the gate must stand.

name: Thomas & Friends: Let's Roll
summary:
Join your favorite trains as they adventure through the island of Sodor discovering an array of thrilling destinations and encountering fun challenges along the way.
This app offers endless fun and creativity for kids as they build, explore, and play with their favorite characters from the world of trains!

name: The Last Experiment: A Memetric Story
summary: "The Last Experiment" is a base-defense strategy game. Your base starts as a small shelter, and your mission is to conquer a devastated, monster-infested Earth set in the year 2805. You’ll attempt this by planting radiation-resistant crops while deploying unique combinations of passive-defense tools—designed by the player—to fend off the encroaching "Fleshvine." Your goal is to prevent it from breaching your territory, killing your creatures, and infiltrating the remnants of humanity at your base.

name: The Backrooms: Lost to the Dark
summary: A 6v1 multiplayer asymmetrical horror game, set in eerie Environments, where Explorers work together to unlock new areas, find items, and escape, while a deadly Monster hunts them down using unique powers.

name: The Line of Defense
summary: Prepare for an epic battle to defend your mystical swamplands from the invasion of three ruthless kings!

name: The Forest Keeper
summary: Survive in the merciless wastelands of a post-apocalyptic world where every day is a struggle for food, water and ammo. Fight mutants and survive as long as possible in this merciless slaughter.

name: The Adventures of Little Wurfel
summary: Dive into the world of Little Wurfel — the mighty little cube! Get hypnotized and relax as you watch his astonishing journey through infinity, or take on the thrilling challenge of "Swords & Sharks", where your skills in precision, dodging, and balancing will be put to the ultimate test!

name: The Solitary Existence of a Little Universe
summary: In this dark interactive novel you will play as a lost soul wandering a forsaken desert, accompanied by a mysterious girl. Explore ancient ruins and face obscure choices. Your decisions will shape their journey—often in ways you’ll never fully understand. Will you find peace, or something else?

name: The Hole Keeper
summary: God has chosen you not for strength, but for obedience. Do not question. Do not turn away. Walk. Feed. Repeat.

name: The Backrooms: Maze Escape
summary: Trapped in an endless maze of yellow-tinted halls and eerie silence, your only hope is to find the exit before you lose your mind. The Backrooms: Maze Escape is a first-person exploration game inspired by the viral Backrooms mythos, where every hallway looks the same and reality feels distant. Collect as many coins as possible and try to complete each level as quickly as you can. Navigate two increasingly unsettling levels with no map and no guidance - only your memory and instincts.

name: The Last Ninja Twins
summary:
Super simple research shows that most people wish they were a twin, and secondly that they were a ninja. We didn’t dare not to act on this piece of valuable insight and decided to deliver on what people want – for once.

The result is a nerve-racking twin turboed game requiring asynchronous ninja thumb precision, laser focused eye sight and extraordinary brain-to-hand signal processing capacity. Double the trouble. Double the fun!

Jump the running ninjas through beautiful, fun and challenging levels. Remember that when running with razor sharp swords, every mistake may be your last…

Simple gameplay – press the right half of the screen for the first ninja to jump, and the left half to make the second ninja jump.

name: The Fiancée Has Never Known First Love
summary:
The "Partner System": upon turning 16, the government assigns you a fiancé.
At the start of the new semester, your perfect arranged partner will transfer into your school!
Experience love for the first time and make your relationship with these girls, who have never known romance, a success!

name: They Watch
summary: A horror game where you confront otherworldly entities as you do everything in your power to escape the strange mazes you wake up in.

name: The Evelyn Game
summary: Evelyn`s Game is a third-person psychological horror where memories can be as dangerous as monsters.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Forgotten
summary: The Battle of Polytopia race of The Forgotten can befriend swampy fauna, build structures on the water, create giant squids, ride crocodiles, tame toads and swim effortlessly in their marshy terrain.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Solaris
summary: Burn the Square with the Solaris! Led by the diabolical, extradimensional Ralmi, the Solaris are here to both defeat their icy foes, the Gaami. Using the powers of lava, fire, and steam, the Solaris are the biggest challenge the Polytopians have faced, yet!

name: Thirtle
summary: Like Wordle, but thirty times the fun!

name: The Cinema VR
summary: Ever wanted to do it in a movie theater? The Cinema VR offers an erotic Virtual Reality experience with realistic animations and carefully crafted lighting and sound effects to create maximum immersion.

name: The Orb of Darkness
summary: The Orb of Darkness summons you! Join our little Goth friend as he explores the many different worlds of the dark universe as he tries to find his way back home!

name: The Jumping Bonbon Match 4
summary:
From the makers of the popular Jumping Food Games, the sugary fun returns. In "The Jumping Bonbon Match 4" you can expect new challenges, even more colorful candies and enhanced puzzle gameplay.

Look forward to over 15 new levels, more sophisticated match mechanics and surprising obstacles that will put your skill and planning to the test. With fresh cartoon graphics and improved animations, every level is an experience.

The sweet adventure continues - ready for the next round of candy chaos?

name: The Button Game
summary: The Button Game is a simple button clicker. Simple. You click the big button, and get the score as high as possible! Look out! The number does not hold on its own. The higher the score, the higher chance it has to decrease. If it reaches 0 after you initially leave it, you lose.

name: The Bar Souls
summary: The Bar Souls is a retro pixel souls-like set in a mysterious digital world. Face ruthless bosses, solve puzzles that test mind and heart, and let perseverance unveil hidden secrets on your path to the end.

name: The Dawning Letters: Sunrise
summary: In 1927, Lu Yanhe, a daughter of a royal family of the Qing dynasty decided, to run away from home. Under the changing times and the subtle influence of new thoughts, she began to seek possibilities beyond her destiny......

name: The Algian Sword
summary: The Algian Sword is a narrative-driven RPG where your choices shape a world full of consequences, with a strategic turnbased combat with real time elements.

name: The Name of the Night
summary: We were completely different, but back then we were both obsessed with the same thing in the same place... “The Name of the Night” is a text-based adventure game that explores the arcade music game culture of 2000 through the story of two girls' delicate emotions.

name: The Jumping Ball
summary:
Get ready for an addictive challenge where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are the keys to survival!

Guide your ball through a narrow brick tunnel filled with dangerous red spikes and tricky obstacles. Jump at the right moment, avoid deadly traps, and collect shining stars along the way to boost your score. Every second counts as you push your limits to stay alive longer and rack up points.

name: The House of Hamelin
summary: A deckbuilding roguelite game where you must save Perdita's cat from the horrors of The House of Hamelin! Navigate the ever-changing, twisted hallways and become strong enough to defeat the gruesome creatures that lurk within... if you can.

name: This Is Love
summary: Guide a small character through platforming and puzzle levels that explore the emotions of a toxic relationship. Uncover harrowing real quotes shared by those who endured it as you flee an antagonist determined to keep you captive while searching for freedom.

name: Thugging
summary: THUGGING is a 3rd Person Shoot 'em up set in a dystopian city fueled by drugs and gambling. Inspired by classic 3D retro games it tries to capture this unique oldschool ambient in a semi open world setting. Steal money, kill thugs and get away in your car!

name: The Field Between
summary: A psychological horror farming simulator where you tend to your small farm, gradually progressing from humble beginnings to running a farming empire. Plant, harvest, sell, sleep. Just try to ignore anything out of the ordinary.

name: This Be Mutiny
summary: You and your crew of swashbuckling pirates are on an epic treasure hunt! Until it inevitably devolves into mutiny. But if you can survive the backstabbings and betrayals, the treasure will be all yours!!!

name: The Fifth Bell
summary: The Fifth Bell is a mystical horror rooted in an ancient legend. Search for five hidden offerings in a fog-covered village while the Reaper hunts you. With every toll of the bell, he comes closer—will you survive the fifth?

name: The Never-Ending Sleepover
summary: 14 year old Yuria Oosumi is a lonely girl without many friends. When she meets an interesting girl after school, will she follow her to her "Sleepover Realm"?

name: The Grinch: Christmas Adventures - Merry & Mischievous Edition
summary:
The "Merry & Mischievous Edition" includes:
- Base Game
- Determined to Love Christmas DLC

name: The Grinch: Christmas Adventures - Determined to Love Christmas
summary: It’s official, The Grinch’s heart has changed, and he wants to show all of Who-ville. Get into the spirit along with Max and put on a feast. These missions will be full of puzzles, cool collectibles, and new obstacles to dodge.

name: The Blockade
summary: Tenshen Print is a fantasy single-player role-playing game by Emeng Shanhai Studio, which uses a 2D perspective rarely seen in fantasy RPGS. In the course of the game, the player will set foot on the journey of cultivating the immortal as the spirited young "Qin Xiao".

name: The City: Superhero Flying Experience
summary: The City: Superhero Flying Experience plunges the player into a mesmerizing urban landscape where they take on the role of a superhero. The sprawling metropolis transforms into an expansive playground, teeming with towering skyscrapers, bustling streets, awaiting your airborne prowess.

name: This Game is Crap
summary: Give the game enough time and you'll cry. If you're liking sh***** then don't force yourself. You won't look for tips and hints. If you want to annoy your friend, give him this game.

name: The Hero Of Pixel Spire
summary: Ascend a tower of chaos. Upgrade spells that evolve wildly. Survive savage bosses. Rescue other Ascendents. Will you become the Hero Of Pixel Spire?

name: They Come in Fives
summary:
A story-rich collectible card game with a dark, horror-tinged atmosphere, set in a world where urban legends turn into devilish contracts.

Play as the Reaper on Lucifer’s payroll. Hand over souls, keep bodies, and build an army to overthrow the boss. Unravel urban legends and fight the hidden world government.

name: The Severed Gods
summary: A fantasy roguelite RPG where heroes reincarnate to stop the mystic dragon Umbra. Master turn-based combat, sever giant bosses, and shape your journey through relics and evolving NPC interactions.

name: The Tale of Oath
summary: Uncover ancient magic in The Tale of Oath, a student-built action-adventure where you wield elemental spells, solve puzzles, and battle dark druids in a mystical, atmospheric world.

name: The Little Mermaid: The Wedding
summary: "The Little Mermaid: The Wedding" is the continuation of the game "The Little Mermaid: Magical Adventure". The action of the game unfolds in a fairy-tale world that was created based on Hans Christian Andersen's "The Little Mermaid", and which is well known to young players from the first part of the game. This time, however, this world has become even brighter and more beautiful - the game uses the latest three-dimensional graphics. New game locations have been added both in the underwater world and on the surface.

name: The Bottle of the Heart
summary: Begin a unique life in a furry town! Play as a furry college student, immersing in the furry town's world and stories. A game day has morning, noon, and evening, letting you act freely anytime. Take evening walks with your crush!

name: The Hull
summary: Descend as a Fathomwalker into the ruined depths of a drowned world in this co-op horror dungeon-crawler FPS. Explore the subterrane with friends, uncover forgotten facilities, and survive what lurks beneath. The Hull awaits.

name: The Shaved Ice Shop
summary: A cozy horror game where you run a shave ice shop. Serves customers by serving shaved ice, coffee, milkshakes...

name: The Hunter's Journals: Rogues Gallery
summary: Art imitates life. Horrifying, unclean life.

name: The Bold Bogey
summary: The Bold Bogey is a 3D golf adventure that combines open exploration with satisfying platforming. Explore a vast world filled with dungeons to dive into, bosses to fight, and new ways to upgrade your ball in a golf game unlike any other. Do you have what it takes to become the Boldest Bogey?

name: The Butcher's Village
summary: The Butcher's Village is a psychological slasher horror game that provides a horrifying experience. Explore unsettling environments, solve intricate puzzles, and struggle to survive in a village that is at once eerily familiar and terrifyingly real.

name: The Deal
summary: A Doom II WAD.

name: The Everything Building
summary: Press up and down, elevator goes brrr! Deliver customers to the correct floor and max your score. Serve many customers including but not limited to surfers, astronauts, cars, ghosts, cheerleaders, horses, and cheerleader horses. 1-2 players! 50 different floors! HORSE MODE included!

name: The Bestest Alchemist
summary: Solve puzzles and brew potions in The Bestest Alchemist, a strategic match-3 roguelike! Freely arrange ingredients to create magical combinations, discover 100+ new recipes, and upgrade your collection to build powerful synergies. Your journey to becoming a master alchemist starts now!

name: The RPS Game Show
summary: Tired of losing at 'luck based' games? Yeah? Time to redeem yourself with 'The RPS Game Show'. If you win, you can still lose. If you lose, you can still win. Challenge your friends to a totally normal game of Rock Paper Scissors.

name: The Grey Elegy: Under the Cursed Wings
summary: On a land where light and shadow intertwine, a boy and a girl embark on a journey of destiny. With storybook-inspired art and an epic tale of bonds and choices, experience a timeless RPG adventure.

name: The Last Earth Fighter
summary: The Last Earth Fighter is a 3D atmospheric cinematic shoot 'em up where you pilot, dodge, hide, weave, and engage enemies across cinematic worlds. Focused on immersion and survival, not scores, it delivers a journey through rich, ever-changing environments.

name: The Bus: Hamburg City
summary:
Hamburg is calling and The Bus is ready to go!
With this add-on Hamburg City, you'll experience the Hanseatic city from the perspective of a bus driver. Two varied lines take you through leafy residential neighborhoods, lively city streets, and past world-famous landmarks – right into the heart of one of Germany’s most beautiful cities.

name: The Hollow Alchemist
summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where alchemy fuels your cards, dice shape your fate, and sins whisper in your ear. Build your deck, forge your path, and decide what kind of soul you’ll become.

name: The Little Cars in the Great Race
summary:
The Little Cars in the Great Race is a racing game, an adaptation of the 2006 Brazilian animated film of the same name which was produced by the studio Video Brinquedo. The player chooses one of the six anthropomorphic cars, and takes part in a five-lap race. There is only one track available in the game.

Apart from driving, the cars can also jump in order to get over obstacles in the road. Pick-ups appear occasionally around the track, including a speed boost, an undesirable slowdown, and a "bubble" pickup whose function is unclear. Another item is a pink cube which stops a car that runs into it. Once the player's car completes five laps, the high score table is shown and the game quits.

name: The Hotel - Lost Contact
summary: In 1989, Roger's Hotel had already trouble with drug dealers and users, but it got whole lot worse when inhabitants abandon their rooms with stacking reports of terror inducing sightings, soon after Swat team was sent but never came back.

name: The Legend of The Sacred Stone EX
summary: An adaptation of the movie. And the voice was presented by Vincent Huang, a genius of the eight categories musical instrument in Chinese ancient orchestra.

name: The Last Bug
summary: The Last Bug is a casual battle wargame, in which you can select a champion among many cute bugs and use their unique skills to defeat your opponents in a randomly created arena filled with random events. May you rise from the fair battles and become the strongest and cutest bug in the Jungle!

name: The Infernalist
summary: You are Lyra Quasar, a wanderer in a world where ancient myths meet advanced technology. Piece together your fragmented memories as you navigate puzzles, face mysterious foes, and uncover secrets tied to the Infernalist. Will you find the truth about yourself before everything is consumed by chaos?

name: The Case of the Missing Heirloom
summary: A young woman goes to Sherlock Holmes in the wake of a tragedy, asking him for help. Unfortunately, Holmes has the flu, so it is up to Watson to do the legwork for this particular mystery.

name: The Nurse
summary:
Night falls over the trenches of World War I. The shelling never ends. The sky cracks open from the violence. Hidden in the woods, an English field hospital waits for the maimed and maddened to come.

A nurse wakes. She stands in the mud, disoriented and with blurred vision. What has happened to her? Where is her beloved friend, Nancy? The night feels real. But is it?

name: The Quarantine Sector
summary: The quarantine zone is humanity's last hope. You hold the key. Examine every survivor, search for the truth, and never let the infection in. The fate of the living is in your hands.

name: The Kingdom of God
summary: The Kingdom of God: Creation is an independent game integrating territory management, resource management, strategic chess and exploration. As a new God, players develop their own country in the dangerous universe and eventually become the king of the new generation of gods.

name: The Stones
summary: Welcome to The Stones! CLICK ON A STONE, GET A STONE. Try your luck and unlock unique skins. Collect, customize, and build the ultimate collection as you play.

name: The Prince Fights the Dragon
summary: This is an adventure game. You can use moves, spells and weapons. This game will bring you happiness.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Quetzali
summary: The Quetzali tribe worship the Bird Gods of the red soil and live in harmony with the natural symmetry of their cubistic jungles. They are commonly seen riding giant flightless birds. The Quetzali starts the game with Strategy tech.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Khondor
summary: The ancient sacred order of Khondor Honor Guards has appeared! Hailing from the time of Mubehasi the Undefeated, the Khondor have put on their masks, mounted their Sphelix, and set out to reform the Oumaji out of nomadism and back into a more civilized age.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Iqaruz
summary: The Quetzali may worship the birds, but members of the Iqaruz have taken their devotion a step further by trying to transform themselves into actual birds, with wings and all. Some are even attempting to fly, so they can meet the Bird Gods in the sky, but it rarely ends well.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Yădakk
summary: The Yădakk started out as a nomadic tribe in the beautiful harsh Khalee plains. Now they are the traders of the Square, connecting their empire with impressive trade routes. The Yădakk starts the game with the Road tech.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Luxidoor
summary:
The Luxidoor love expensive things; jewels, rare spices and garments. That is also why they are the most expensive tribe in Polytopia!
The Luxidoor citizens lead very comfortable lives, draped in the finest purple silk. The Luxidoor starts the game with a huge capital.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Ai-Mo
summary:
The tranquil and wise Ai-Mo tribe inhabits the harshest, windiest, and highest mountain range of the square, where they have found inner peace by meditating in the eternal evening light.
Ai-Mo starts the game with the meditation tech.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: To-Lï
summary: The To-Lï rigorously train their bodies and minds in their sturdy Binba forests. They've been summoned from their temples and gyms to aid the Ai-Mo in the war, as few can match their sheer strength and discipline.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Aumux
summary: The gilded Aumux Mercenaries have been serving as the personal army of the Luxidoorian Emperor for many years, as there's no one else who can match their exorbitant demands for gold and precious gems!

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Cultists
summary: Vengir of the fanatical Burzgor Cult will perform the visceral Thdkrkr Ritual, shrugging off their mortal flesh and gaining power directly from the God of Blood, themself. Their zealous display of devotion isn't taken as seriously as they'd like by the other tribes, however.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: Ürkaz
summary: The Ürkaz from the Khalee Highlands are known as a gruff and unfriendly group that controls the Yădakk's criminal underground. Smuggling, racketeering, and other shady dealings are all steps to their goal of economic domination of the Square!

name: The False Alice: Retold Tale
summary: A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice gacha game. It will features a new scenario and new CGs, backgrounds, BGM, character facial expressions and pose differences.

name: The Greys: Human Abductions
summary: In The Greys: Human Abductions, you discover top-secret documents and unsettling alien evidence. As you explore, encounter strange noises, bizarre events, and the chilling possibility of abduction. Will you uncover the truth or become the next victim?

name: The Starfighter
summary: A big, immersive, realistic, Full HD and real-time 3D combat flight arcade game. You are a space alien and fly two-seater Griffin Starfighter. You must wipe out evil King Nimrod's buildings, spaceships, rocket launcher equipped armored buggies, drones, etc. and restore peace to the universe.

name: The Dead Daughter
summary: A single-player psychological horror visual novel. Simply click through the main storyline, presented in text and images. It's short but captivating.

name: The Sea-Demon
summary: A team of detectives was invited by the owner of Octopus Island to solve a six-year-old mystery involving a siren. They were given 24 hours to complete their investigation and submit their own answers. In the end, seven completely different solutions emerged...

name: The Floor Above
summary: A claustrophobic anomaly-horror game where you can only turn, blink, and decide: is it real or not? Survive five endings and uncover Mike’s story.

name: The Saddle Club: Pine Hollow Gymkhana
summary: Pick a horse, saddle up and take part in the Saddle Club gymkhana.

name: The Baby is Here
summary: When everything looked like a tragedy he noticed that everything was broken from the beginning with his son. Help Joseph to complete the masterpiece the boy left unfinished on this Survival Horror Game.

name: The Roach Hotel
summary: The Roach Hotel is a first person analog horror game that drags you into its halls, where every shadow hides a question and every corner dares you to keep following its path.

name: The Black Knight
summary: The peasants aren’t paying their taxes. The king has entrusted you, the Black Knight, to get medieval and beat the gold out of them!

name: The Lustful Touch
summary: The Lustful Touch is an 18+ visual novel in which massage becomes more than just a service, but a revelation. Hidden desires, subtle emotions, and touches that can break down the boundaries between care and temptation. One meeting. One session. Everything can change.

name: This Is Why We Don't Play Golf
summary: Golfing, but up a bizarre mountain where every 'I got it!' is a lie. A chaotic co-op physics platformer where falling is half the fun... probably.

name: The Dream Globe
summary: Idler game inside an antique dream globe, build the small home and help the mini dream world grow

name: The Useless Wizard
summary: An alcoholic wizard with no spells, only rocks, must save his village from depraved monster hordes. Tactical action, chaotic weapon combos, and dark humor collide in this unique twist on the Vampire Survivors formula!

name: The Dev: Enter The Blockchain
summary: A 3D platforming game revolving around the creator of Bitcoin, The Dev. As The Dev you must journey into the blockchain to bring honor back to the world of crypto with nothing but some ciggies, a gun, and your undoubted devving power. This is the best game you will ever play.

name: The Liminal
summary: Encounter bizarre and memorable creatures both friend and foe, immerse yourself in sprawling and twisted landscapes, and evade perilous pursuers while you guide a forgotten child to search for answers in this psychological horror experience.

name: The Shed
summary: A narrative mystery where time bends in a forgotten garden. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and alter the present through echoes of the past. Occasionally shifting into 2D to tell its story in unexpected ways, The Shed is quiet, emotional, and deeply atmospheric.

name: This Isn't Just Tower Defense
summary: Defend your base with placeable towers that can be upgraded endlessly. Automate your production and make sure there's enough power to keep everything running.

name: The Lightning Girl
summary: Awoken by a lightning strike, your eyes adjust to the dark in the basement of a strange man's house. You have no idea how you got here but you know you must escape. Find items, solve puzzles, evade your pursuer, and discover the truth of this house in this survival-horror RPG.

name: These Four Walls
summary:
"A locked door.
It never opens."

These Four Walls is a short game where... nothing happens.

name: The Reflex Lab
summary: You've been kidnapped by an evil (and extremely rude) alien. To escape, you’ll have to complete a series of reflex, skill and patience based trials in his poorly constructed laboratory. Will you survive the alien’s twisted tests and escape? Or will you end up like his last batch of “lab rats”?

name: The Anubis Treasure
summary: Embark on an epic adventure in The Treasure of Anubis, a minimalist 2D platformer.

name: The Cute the Baldy and the Fluffy
summary: A small old-school FPS set during old wild west featuring 2D pixelated graphics in a 3D environment, metroidvania style exploration and some action RPG elements.

name: The Baumman Box
summary:
Your dead son can be resurrected with the power of the mysterious forest, yes. But the forest would rather add your body to its rotting collection.

Explore a dark entombed forest and collect mushrooms to successfully perform a ritual, and know that the forest is ready to stop you. Uncover the mystery of the confined woods as you avoid death in an attempt to save the life of a child. Find the truth of why you are here through the game's multiple endings.

name: The Awakened Avenger
summary: The Awakened Avenger is a top-down shooter light rogue-lite game. Players take on the role of a zombie who has been harmed by biochemical experiments but retains self-awareness. Survive by choosing different equipment and props, and defeat the ultimate villain.

name: Thief's Adventure
summary: A tactical stealth game set in a gritty medieval fantasy world. Sneak past guards, loot valuables, and take down key targets. Being spotted means death.

name: Throne Alone
summary: Not your average toilet-sim: Throne Alone is a cursed physics platformer where gravity hates you, progress is pain, and a blue floating face roasts your every moment.

name: The Mountain
summary: Slow paced puzzle game

name: Through Hell and Back
summary: Through Hell and Back is a timeline based roguelike deckbuilding game. Place your spells on the Timeline to outsmart your enemies. Choose your power ups carefully, trade spells and upgrade the Timeline to unleash devastating combos.

name: The Monad
summary: A short and surreal top down multiplayer adventure game.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition: 10th Anniversary Edition
summary:
The anniversary release of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. Bundle contains
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Game of the Year Edition for PC or The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Complete Edition for PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X together with anniversary steelbook and lenticular card.

name: The Merchant's Eden
summary: In The Merchant's Eden, you build a town around a thriving market. Defend your citizens and traveling merchants against raiding bandits. A minimalist game blending cozy city-building and intense tower-defense as you grow and protect your town.

name: The Cuniculus of Paradise
summary: Dive into The Cuniculus of Paradise and experience humanity's epic battle against Gigantic Beasts! As the pilot of a large humanoid weapons called an Exo, Customize your gear, conquer missions, and explore the Abyssal Labyrinth.

name: The Boo-chelor
summary: Will you find your souldate this Halloween on the no.1 spooky dating show?

name: The Doppel
summary: The Doppel is a single player 2D action game.The player controls the protagonist, a failed novelist, and tries to recover his lost precious feelings while running away from the 'doppel' that pursues him in the dream world.

name: TheVillage: Possession
summary: A cursed village serves as the setting for this single-player psychological horror adventure. As you are drawn into a demonic scheme, solve spooky puzzles, evade deadly spirits, and discover sinister secrets. first in the series TheVillage Chronicles.

name: The House Remembers
summary: After your grandfather’s death, you return to his old house. But something's still there. Something that watches. Something that remembers. Face the haunting truth in this atmospheric psychological horror experience.

name: The Hero Is Too Powerful so Let's Pleeeease Settle This Peacefully!
summary: How strong is too strong? Find out from the hero's victims in this adventure RPG as you talk things out (or destroy everything) on your way to save the hero's childhood friend!

name: The Endless Backgate
summary: The ENDLESS BACKGATE is a survival horror game where you face anomalous phenomena unfolding behind three doors. You begin your job as a 'Field Maintenance Supervisor' for our company. Identify the patterns of various phenomena, respond accordingly, and remove all missing posters.

name: The Awakener: Battle Tendency
summary: The Awakener: Battle Tendency is a hack-and-slash survivor game that blends Eastern fantasy with Western high fantasy. You will control “Awakeners” from different eras and regions to fight against demonic echoes and twisted fate, striving to rewrite a destiny once doomed to fail.

name: The Archivist
summary: A VHS-themed psychological horror where each tape drags you into a new nightmare. Explore haunted hospitals, schools, forests, and liminal spaces. Solve puzzles, uncover the Archivist’s secrets, and survive a house that grows darker with every tape you watch.

name: The Hungry Horde: Holiday Hijinx
summary: The Holiday Hijinx DLC adds a snowy, Christmas-themed experience with new procedurally generated elements, enemies to convert, and mini-games. It includes new maps where players must navigate around snowmen, which will break up your horde if they run into them.

name: The Song of Invermere
summary: A town stuck in endless darkness has gone mad. At the center of it all: a nun taking confessions during the end of days.

name: The Skeletons Are Fighting
summary: A traditional, ground-based 2.5D fighting game (with skeletons) that takes a lot of inspiration from anime/hyper fighters. A nice balance between eccentric mechanics and slower, footsies-based neutral.

name: The Path Home
summary: "The Path Home" is a 2D pixel-art puzzle game where you explore a strange world with a girl. Use panels to "flip" black and white tiles and reshape the puzzle world. The girl always searches for the "shortest path to the goal," but avoiding fake goals and reuniting her with the crow is up to you.

name: The Depths of Duskraven Manor
summary: Follow the exploits of five fugitives as they fight their way through the horrors that lurk under Duskraven Manor. With the promises of a clean slate, wealth and freedom from the pasts that haunt them, they fight through unimaginable terror while uncovering a reality-shattering mystery.

name: The Stalked 3
summary: A late-night thrill turns into a nightmare. Olivia sneaks into Creepwood Wonderland Carnival with her boyfriend, expecting a fun night alone in the park. But something feels off. Distant footsteps. Faint whispers. Someone else is here… Watching.

name: The Depths of My Guilt
summary: Explore the deepest depths of the ocean as you survey the environment by recording audio and taking pictures. Collect fuel found on the mountains in these depths. Be carful though, you are not the only intelligent creature down here.

name: The Last Tape: Before the Mine
summary: In this first chapter of the saga, relive an old tape recorded over 35 years ago, revealing one of Lurmont Corporation’s darkest secrets. Explore the Alhambra mines, uncover the truth behind the events, and survive the constant threat of B-96. What was once recorded now hunts you.

name: The Fantastic Adventures of Mr. Don and Friends
summary: This game is not driven by attribute enhancements or utilitarianism. Bring your friends along to protect Mr. Don and experience once again the pure and simple fun of multiplayer cooperative challenge levels. The game has implemented an online lobby. Recommended for 3 players.

name: The Underdog
summary: A top-down soulslike action game. Play as a medieval mercenary, use 4 weapon types (sword & shield, two-handed sword, mace, spear) to tackle BOSS warrant levels, explore diverse scenes, strengthen through failure, and unlock surprises.

name: The Long March: 20000 Miles of Journey
summary: A story of a little girl joining the Red Army and finishing the Long March, while discovering her true faith.

name: The Cubes
summary: The Cubes is a colorful puzzle adventure where you control four unique cubes to solve spatial challenges. Switch between the cubes, activate buttons, overcome spikes, collect coins and solve puzzles in a relaxing yet brain-teasing experience.

name: Throw Anything: Zombie Invaders
summary: Stack it, smash it, and throw everything you can! Survive wacky zombie waves, clear chaotic chapters, and enjoy nonstop laughter in this physics-based action defense game.

name: The Spiriting Away of Saooni Village
summary: After Mako and Akane arrive at the village, the villagers gaze at them with eerie eyes. Will the two of them be able to leave this place safely?

name: The Valley Beyond
summary: Beyond The Valley is an exploration puzzle game with no quest markers or enemy, only curiosity guides your steps. Find your way through gorgeous landscapes and activate all the artworks. But something went wrong in the park, and to leave, you will have to uncover its secret.

name: The Shadow Cosmos
summary: A 3D metroidvania with retro aesthetic. As master peacock, delve into a mysterious, dream-like world with non-linear exploration and progression, stylish and challenging fights with a powerful halberd, tricky parkour and puzzles. Collect shadows, unleash darkness.

name: The Lists VR
summary: Mount your horse, lower your lance, and experience the thrill of medieval jousting in full virtual reality. The Lists VR puts you directly on the tournament field in 15th-century Europe. Compete in a focused, skill-based jousting experience where your body becomes the controller.

name: The Unplace
summary: “The Unplace: Escaping The Cursed Place by Facing Different Trials” is a first-person game where you must escape a cursed place by completing a series of trials.

name: The Sage's Spirit: Shining Flame
summary: A Japanese-inspired Western fantasy visual novel with a female-centric narrative, set in a unique world. Play commoner mage Nolan: follow your mentor to Sabelien, forge bonds, face power struggles. Choose to avoid chaos or carve your path—your choices will shape Aorleton and the Mage Guild’s fate.

name: The Warrens
summary: An atmospheric first-person horror immersive sim where you use an array of unusual items to escape a murderous cult of rabbit-headed men from a nightmare world.

name: The House Dreams Along With Them
summary:
A first person horror puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity. Solve cryptic puzzles with logic and careful observation while dreaming in different rooms of a mysterious house in the woods. Completing a dream-puzzle makes the dream real in the house.

The game is inspired by Myst, Blue Prince, The Witness, The House of Leaves, Twin Peaks Season 3, liminal space games such as Pools and Limscape, anomaly horror games such as The Exit 8 and Cabin Factory as well the metafictional rabbit holes of games such as Fez, Braid, Tunic, and Animal Well.

name: The Office Rooms
summary: A short exploration game blending liminal spaces and corporate dystopia. Explore an abandoned anomaly control facility and uncover its past and purpose!

name: There's No Differences: Monsters
summary: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar monster-themed scenes!

name: The DvD Idle Game
summary: Remember the old bouncing DvD screensaver? Well now its an idle game, Bounce DvD's all over the screen and increase your profits, and a lot of 2000's technology will come up as shops

name: The Legend of Kairo
summary: You’re the last fire master, fighting an evil army who threaten to bring back an ancient being from hell.

name: The Faith of Sin
summary: One night, you wake up and realize you're no longer in the real world. As you explore your home, you'll uncover clues and piece together hazy fragments of your past. And when you finally remember everything you've done — you'll understand what the 'faith of sin' truly means.

name: The House of Toys
summary: The House of Toys is a horror game in which the player ventures into an old mansion filled with seemingly harmless toys. His mission is to explore each room, searching for clues to discover which of the toys is cursed. To free the soul trapped in this toy, the player must solve intricate puzzles.

name: The Vow: Vampire's Curse
summary: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder fused with turn-based tactics. Build your deck, master deadly synergies, and survive seven cursed nights to rescue your fiancée from the vampire’s grasp.

name: Thargelia
summary: Separated by disaster. Connected by choices.In Thargelia, a narrative adventure multiplayer game for two players, your decisions shape more than just your own fate. Cooperate, sabotage, or survive at any cost. How far are you willing to go to save your own life?

name: The Oversight Bureau
summary: The Oversight Bureau is a voice-driven narrative adventure game. You are candidate 404, trapped inside C.U.T.E. - a rehabilitation program designed to make you a more “appropriate” member of society. As time ticks away and days blur, escape is the only way to keep your sanity and your voice, 404.

name: The Condition
summary: You move into an old house for three months, and everything seems peaceful… until you notice the door you must never open. From the very first day, unexplained noises, fleeting shadows, and objects that move on their own begin to haunt you. The line between reality and paranoia blurs as you explore the house, and every unexpected sound heightens the tension. In The Condition, your choices and curiosity confront a mystery that defies logic and tests your sanity. Some rules are meant never to be broken… will you dare to discover what lies behind the door?

name: The Eggsperts
summary: An arcade game based on the VeggieTales episode "An Easter Carol."

name: The Jumping Orange 3
summary:
The Jumping Orange 3 - from the makers of the Jumping Food Games

The Jumping Orange returns - even wilder, even juicier, even crazier. In The Jumping Orange 3, 15 new levels full of fast-paced action, surprising obstacles and comic-colored game worlds await you.

New level design, even more chaos:
Each stage brings fresh challenges that will test your timing and reflexes to the max.

Maximum fun in a tried and tested style:
Quick to get in, hard to let go - whether for in-between or on the hunt for points, every jump counts here.

Show what you're made of - and get the orange safely to the finish line.
The Jumping Orange 3 - play now and take the next jump.

name: The Curse of Tethria
summary: Explore dungeons, avoid traps, fight monsters and progress through a hand-crafted world. Defeat your enemies with action combat using your sword and shield, the tools you find and items from the environment. Can you overcome these challenges to end the curse and restore the world from evil?

name: The 2024 Secret Santa Collab
summary: This is The 2024 Secret Santa Collab! This was a collaboration project hosted by Goose, BossSauce and Kazt. Featuring 61 maps made over the course of four months, with 3 lobbies that were developed over the course of 7 months.

name: The Chosen Ones
summary:
Twelve peaceful years have passed since The Great War ended. The war that lasted centuries but no man could recall the reason of. The age of despair, bloodshed, loss and grief is now past. The new age brought the opportunity for human kingdoms to rise, as humanity has broken free from the grip of the dragons.

This story focuses on Kingdom of Balgaron and three famous Dragon Slayers: Phodom, Fradz and Galeoth. Each of them starts their journey in different places, but they will eventually meet eachother and join forces along the path. Together, the three are forced to go a conflict beyond their imaginations.

Lead them into an epic world, guided by a strong storyline that covers hate, love, war and peace.

name: The Detectorist Guild
summary: Explore a quintessential British village collecting artefacts and studying local history. Solve a dark mystery that draws in you and your family. Complete quests for villagers who have a habit of losing their treasured possessions. Donate, trade and sell your ‘finds’ to build impressive collections.

name: The High Tower
summary: The High Tower is a third-person, action-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic world. After a global catastrophe, humanity builds a sky-piercing megastructure in search of hope. As the chosen one of the Church, you must ascend the tower, uncover hidden truths.

name: There Are People In Your Walls
summary: Psychological horror game about fear and anxiety, there are people in your walls.

name: The Beast Is yet to Come
summary: Unleash your inner beast in The Beast Is Yet To Come — a chaotic 3D action roguelike where you play as a brutal Troll crushing enemy hordes across multiple battlegrounds. Build devastating "punch hell" combos and fight through the storm.

name: The Rainy Night
summary: On a rainy night, it's all up to you whether to show love or be cruel.

name: The Three Kingdoms: Rebirth
summary: You, an ordinary youth, accidentally travel to a parallel Three Kingdoms era. By fate, you encounter famous historical generals and beauties. Faced with emotional and historical choices, will you retire in the mountains with a beauty, or lead generals into battle?
publishers: Mǎ Qí Ā Duǒ Hù Yú

name: The Faked
summary: Create chaos in a sandbox full of absurd physics, join the wild action, and discover online fun with your friends!

name: Think and Choice
summary: You are a traveler, stepping into a door, traveling to different worlds, leading your team to explore and adventure, and facing challenges.

name: The Funnel
summary: Assemble gear boxes, meet your crew, escape the factory. Experience the unique underground steampunk world of The Funnel, where you may help or betray any of the people you meet. But be careful, the Funnel is watching...

name: The PipeTuber's Guide to the Solar System
summary: The PipeTuber's Guide to the Solar System is a Rogue-Lite Strategy Resource Management game. Players will build “Pipelines” to gather 4 kinds of resources in order to fulfill recurring survival challenges and explore the game world.

name: The Still
summary: Daniel has become homeless! He now travels to a strange land seeking accolades and new beginnings. Join him and his companion Shana on this voyage by creating your own character & picking from a list of races/classes tailored to your preference.

name: The Life Together Online
summary: Live, socialize, create! The Life Together Online is a unique online life simulator where every character is a real player. Work, make friends, customize your home, attend parties and travel. Complete freedom - choose your path and become part of a living world!

name: The Doll Shop
summary: The Doll Shop is a hand-drawn narrative game – part romance, part horror – set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a young dollmaker who reunites with his childhood friend in an eerie snowbound village. Will you dare confess your secret?

name: The Planet Crafter: Toxicity
summary: The "Toxicity" DLC takes you to a unknown planet heavily corrupted by past industrial activity. You must restore its majesty using new tools and machinery. Alone or with friends, explore this wasteland, uncover its secrets, and help it revive!

name: The Radio Tower
summary: A short horror game were you are sent to fix a radio tower at the edge of an evacuation zone to restore a city’s communications.

name: This Game Exists Now
summary: You play as a cube battling heaps of enemies and bosses in order to get your game back from and evil organization called the P.I.A(Pineapple Intelligence Agency) You will be assisted by a wonderfully charming narrator, a strange shop keeper, and MORE! Do you have what it takes to Exist Now? OR NOT!?

name: The Veil of Death
summary: A psychological horror game inspired by the myths and legends of Mexican folklore, set in the Juárez Hospital in Mexico City in 2007. Explore, solve puzzles, fight entities from beyond and reconstruct the truth behind a forgotten tragedy.

name: The Three Moons
summary: A sci-fi survival game on a hostile alien world. As a lone robotic unit, manage resources, upgrade your systems, face extreme weather, and uncover the mystery of the three moons through choices that shape your fate.

name: The Site: Night Shift
summary: At night, you're alone in a half-finished building. Your task is simple: patrol the floors, check the rooms, and watch for any signs of intrusion. But as the nights pass, you begin to realize you're not alone.

name: The Kindling
summary: A short, poetic puzzle experience. Guide a fading soul through strange places, where every object you burn keeps the shadows away. What seems simple may turn into a trial. Choose carefully… and don’t let the light fade.

name: The Arena
summary: Fight for Glory in the arena! Face challenging enemies, deal with random events, and entertain the crowd on your path to becoming the ultimate arena champion!

name: The Panspermia
summary:
The year is 2132. The resources on Earth have become depleted, and mankind sought out new settlements and advanced on to other planets. At that time, a meteorite from space has been detected carrying unicellular organisms with similar DNA structures as those found on Earth. This discovery is thought to contain the key to unlocking the mystery behind the origin of life on Earth, so an investigation has been launched. As a result, an unknown planet has been discovered in our Solar System: Harmonia. An American research team from Mars Base is set out to embark for Harmonia in order to survey it.

Soon the truths behind mankind, life, and the universe will be revealed.

name: The Man Who Walked
summary: The Man Who Walked invites you to solve relaxing puzzles by switching between two worlds: in 2D you rearrange the environment, in 3D you explore it. Only by combining both perspectives will you uncover the end of the story.

name: Three Kingdom: Zhang Jiao Revival
summary: Three Kingdom - Zhang Jue Revival is a real time RPG roguelite. Battle alone or recruit up to 10 comrade to fight along side in real time combat. Specialize in 1 class or learn all 6, wide range of equipment to create your own build. Powerful yet simple statistic system to spice up game play.

name: The Mare Show: Obscure Tech Skin Pack
summary: Equip yourself with your technological implants to survive, and enjoy this exclusive skin pack! Starring the cyber shark "Blue" from the CyberWar: Neon City series!

name: The Last Worlds: Crossed Souls
summary: 3D Action Open World RPG set on the alien planet Ness-444. Explore this world on the brink of ruin with your inseparable companion Lupio. Fight or tame countless nessky, fantastic creatures now blinded by darkness. Survive to learn the truth of this world and find out where other like you have gone.

name: Through the Nest
summary: Through the Nest is a fast-paced sci-fi roguelite shooter set in deadly alien hives. Start with two classes, unlock more with chips, and survive each run by choosing upgrades along the way.

name: The Erased Student
summary: First-person horror game set in an abandoned Soviet-era school. You play as a Russian father whose son vanished years ago. Explore the decaying building, read forgotten letters, follow clues, and uncover a dark and disturbing truth.

name: The Beast
summary: A horror-tinged point and click / visual novel set in an eerie cave complex. Developed in a month as part of the Spooktober 7th Annual Visual Novel Jam in 2025.

name: Thine Rogueth
summary:
The tales of Dirk McSteel are legend. True, he wasn't much of a fighter, but boy could he run! And run he did, collecting five Treasures of Complacency in the Temple of Forgotten Spine Monsters, or so it is told. Such a brave adventurer was he, risking life and limb at every turn, 'til that dreadful dungeon devoured him whole, never to be seen again.

But what if I told you he was still alive?

And if one acted fast, they might be able to save him...

And there's something more. For some curious reason, saving him is worth more than all twelve treasures combined.

Now wilt Thine Rogueth?!

name: The Lurking Fear
summary: A minimalistic survival horror game where you fight or run from monsters using stealth to hunt you.

name: The Definitive Subsistence Update
summary:
MGS2 received a Substance version that added new content to play.
MGS3 received a Subsistence version that changed how the game was played.
MGSV deserves an update of the same caliber.
Definitive Subsistence adds new content and new meaningful gameplay mechanics that'll make you feel like you're playing MGSV for the first time

name: The Demon's Apple: Otome Game
summary: The Demon's Apple is a Dark Fantasy otome game with mature content. Pomme, a herbalist as to make an alliance with a bloodthirsty demon she saved to survive in a world hostile to both. Play as Pomme who has to learn to live under the same roof as the demon who wants her blood and more.

name: The Game for Free
summary: This game is [FREE] of charge.

name: The Myth of a Godslayer
summary: Follow Klain's mythical adventures in this top-down Action-RPG mixing combat, exploration, puzzles and platforming. Travel through the New World, explore forgotten dungeons, confront terrible foes and... become a Godslayer!

name: There's No Differences: Cake
summary: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar sweet scenes!

name: There's No Differences: Dragons
summary: Ready to test your detective skills? Find the differences between two similar dragon-themed scenes!

name: The Driver Syndicate
summary: The Driver Syndicate is an open-world driving action game inspired by the classic Driver series.

name: The Sushi Restaurant
summary: Prepare sushi in this cozy horror game and unlock new recipes every day. But something is making the atmosphere grow creepier. Can you figure out what?

name: The False God's Fold
summary: A turn-based card strategy game. You are a Card-Seeker, wandering ruined lands and forgotten realms, collecting forbidden cards—shattered relics of fallen gods. Wield their power to battle twisted creatures and ancient guardians. Each card is a weapon. Each play, a gamble.

name: The Pact
summary: The Pact is a first-person, story-driven psychological horror game where you unravel your family's dark legacy across generations. Face unsettling trials, uncover truths meant to stay forgotten, and witness the horrors that follow your bloodline through the centuries.

name: The Black Bahr
summary: The Black Bahr is a sandbox colony simulation RPG blending ocean exploration, crew management, and dynamic faction politics. Freely chart your course as a pirate, merchant, or honorable captain, shaping your destiny across the open seas.

name: The Last Delivery Man on Earth
summary: A lonely and challenging experience with realistic driving physics. Pickup packages, deliver them and escape the death zone to finish the job.

name: The Shadow of Ayutthaya
summary: Betrayed all his life, Gabin seeks truth alongside Kaewsai in this brutal Souls-like Action-RPG. Wield shadows as weapons, master ancient Thai combat, and survive the fall of Ayutthaya. An authentic Thai experience by two passionate developers.

name: This Ain’t Even Poker, Ya Joker
summary: A unique incremental idle clicker where you flip cards to earn money, grow your hand, buy new decks, unlock powerful upgrades, discover new cards, and more. Can you defeat the Jester and escape the carnival?

name: The High Life
summary: You wake up in a strange city smelling of marijuana, covered in puke and you have no idea what happened or who you are. With no money and no place to go, you get sucked into the underground world of drug trade being run by rival gangs...

name: The Boons of IIUIR
summary: A bunny is bestowed with a powerful ability in this short open-world sokoban game.

name: The Deep Library
summary: A first-person exploration horror roguelite. Explore the depths of a seemingly endless library in search of rare books, but beware of the terrifying entities that protect it!

name: The Tooth Fae
summary: A nightmarish dental simulator where you sneak into townsfolks' homes to steal their teeth. An expanded version of the Ludum Dare 58 game of the same name, made by a solo developer.

name: The Day of Salvation
summary: "The Day of Salvation" is a horror game in which players must escape from giant humanoid creatures by hiding in the fog and discovering their true identities.

name: The End Protocol
summary: In the fog-shrouded ruins, you will explore, gather, forge, and fight—within this dark Roguelike strategy game, cast the Dice of Fate, forge the ultimate relic, and face countless unspeakable foes. Every choice can turn the tide of battle, as you carve your own story through endless cycles of fate.

name: The Black Pool: Arena Survivors
summary: Survive an onslaught of alien robots in this fast and intense action roguelike. Rapidly evolve your build by leveraging a huge pool of abilities, augments, and upgrades. There are millions of possibilities. Are you and your friends up to the challenge?

name: The Eldritch Ascent
summary: "The Eldritch Ascent" Is a new grimdark fantasy narrative driven turn based game. Explore and battle your way up the twisted spire as the Eldritch, a wretched lost soul brought back from the depths by a mysterious demon.

name: The Backrooms
summary: Welcome to the Backrooms! Embrace the despair of the endless, monolithic yellow maze. How long will you endure?

name: The Backrooms: Rescue Expedition
summary: The Backrooms: Rescue Expedition is a realistic first-person horror game up to 4 players. You and your team are tasked with saving the lives of the missing expedition unit, Echo-7 North. Ruthless entities and the madness of infinite halls create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

name: The Voynich Project
summary: A choice-driven romance visual novel where every decision shapes your relationships and the story. Meet unique characters, explore multiple routes, and unlock different endings. Featuring high-quality anime-style art, an immersive soundtrack, and deep storytelling. Your journey begins now!

name: The Flipbook
summary: This game reads you. You are not alone in this Arena-Shooter-Roguelite. Even the shop is watching you. It adapts. It evolves. Build bonkers synergies and survive 20 waves of hand-painted horror in the Flipbook of a failed artist. Build your arsenal of memories to unravel his tragic past.

name: The Ice Cream Shop
summary: You run a late-night ice cream shop, but your illness makes reality twist. Serve customers who may not be what they seem, and try to separate your mind’s visions from the horrors at your door.

name: The Last Portrait
summary: Dark legends surround the abandoned mansion Ashwood Manor: Once, an art collector lived here, and his most valuable piece is said to still be hidden in the villa. Break into the house, solve the puzzles of Ashwood Manor, steal the cursed painting – and escape. Are you brave enough?

name: The Last Witness
summary: Micheal Jillien, a Vietnamese medical graduate, accepts a job interview in the suburbs. But behind it lies a deadly plot. Can you help her survive and escape the trap?

name: The Never Ending Flower Shop
summary: The Never Ending Flower Shop is a game focused on exploration, you will fight your way through the lost Floricultura Consuelo, a place that once thrived in the ownership of your mother, now forgotten, exactly as she left it.

name: Think Like a Shrink
summary: Think Like a Shrink is an unreleased Nintendo DS game that was being developed by Mind Gamz in 2008. The composer for the game was Marianthe Bezzerides, who has the game listed on her website on the "credits" page.

name: The Birthday Boys
summary: An absurd co-op dungeon crawler where the only thing more dangerous than the enemies is your own party.

name: The Nobody Woods: Lucy
summary: The Nobody Woods: Lucy is an adventure game set in Nobody Woods, a place on the border between life and death. Escape from those who want to take Lucy's life, explore the forest, solve puzzles, and meet new friends.

name: The Hambagu Shop
summary: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror narrative simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

name: The Night Crawler
summary:
The Night Crawler is a tiny cozy game where you’ll discover the enchanting world of nocturnal insects! Grab your torchlight and embark on a delightful journey to create a new home for tiny, fascinating creatures.

Relax by collecting, caring for your creatures, follow quests to earn rewards, upgrade your gears and adjust the gameplay for a tailor experience. But keep your eyes open as you never know what mysterious species you might stumble upon...

name: The Finals: The Chirurgeon Set
summary: The Chirurgeon Set includes: 1 Legendary Outfit, 1 Epic Emote, 1 Legendary Weapon Skin, 1 Epic Charm, 2 400 Multibucks.

name: The Finals: The Apothecarion Set
summary: The Apothecarion Set includes: 1 Legendary Outfit, 1 Epic Emote, 1 Legendary Weapon Skin, 1 Epic Charm, 2 400 Multibucks.

name: The LEGO Movie 2 Videogame: Prophecy Pack
summary: A pre-order bonus for the LEGO Movie 2 Videogame that featured the playable characters Cleopatra, Emmet wearing pyjamas, Lord Business, human Metalbeard, Shakespeare, and young Vitruvius. Unlike most other LEGO game pre-order bonuses, it was not released as paid DLC later on, and there is no official way to obtain it following the game's release unless you pre-ordered.

name: The Silent Cartographer: Evolved
summary: A reimagining of the fourth level of Halo: Combat Evolved with a visual overhaul, a complete redesign of the layout & weapon sets, and expanded set pieces.

name: The Wapple Hous
summary:
When Death grows weary of their whole soul capturing gig, they turn to Zoe, the next in line to take up the mantle as the grim reaper.

Zoe has quite a long way to go before they're even close to Death material, and current Death has grown rather impatient.

In an attempt to speed things along, Death sends Zoe out on their first solo run... Tasked with capturing and escorting a freshly deceased soul into the afterlife. Are they up to the task? Probably not...

name: The Numbers I Keep In My Head
summary: An interactive hypertext story made with Twine.

name: The Sims 4: Autumn Apparel Kit
summary: Breathe in that crisp autumn air, watch the leaves change color, and reach for something warm from The Sims 4 Autumn Apparel Kit†. This collection features layered looks plus accessories, like scarves and a wide-brimmed hat that are perfect for strolling down chilly streets, as well as snuggly sweaters that’ll make the season feel extra cozy.

name: The Last Phoenix
summary: The Last Phoenix is a roguelite inspired action platformer RPG where death fuels your power. You grow stronger with every death. Felix, a goblin who possesses a demonic power of reincarnation, must save his kind from eradication at the hands of a cult!

name: The Secret Planet
summary: The Secret Planet is a 2D adventure game styled after the classic games of the 90s. Your ship has crash-landed on an unknown planet. In order to survive, you'll need to explore and use your own skills and wits. After all- No one knows about this planet, and no one knows what awaits you on this journey.

name: The Corgi Knight
summary: The Corgi Knight is about a corgi who starts out as a simple apple-picker, in a simple corgi town. No one expects much greatness from this little corgi, but when danger strikes, he finds himself in the midst of an epic adventure to save not only his village, but much, much more.

name: The Vernyhorn
summary: A third-person open-world RPG inspired by classic role-playing roots. Follow a man haunted by his past as he faces his inner demons in a world shaped by faith, fear, and survival — where every choice leaves a mark that time cannot erase.

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as an Autonomous Robotic Vacuum Cleaner
summary: A short humor/horror game where you play as an autonomous robotic vacuum cleaner trying to clean a haunted house.

name: The Mine Room
summary: A first person twist on the classic game of Minesweeper. It's dark, all you have is a torch and a burning desire to flag all those pesky mines without falling in the goo or getting blown up.

name: The Lost Battalion
summary: The Lost Battalion is a large-scale overhaul mod for Arma 3, built around immersive, handcrafted missions and realistic military simulation. The mod combines custom-made assets, detailed operations, and a structured unit system to deliver an authentic tactical experience. Developed and maintained by its own dedicated community, The Lost Battalion runs continuous story-driven campaigns and handcrafted missions that emphasize teamwork, realism, and dynamic combat scenarios.

name: The Florist
summary: A classic survival horror experience, set in a town overgrown with deadly yet beautiful flowers.

name: The Living Shadows
summary: The Living Shadows is a survival horror game where you have to take the role of a woman named Amelia and go through the world of the dead in order to save your sister and try to return to the real world.

name: Thief's Riddles
summary: In the game, you’ll experience: Various locations and missions Lots of puzzles and mysteries Diverse criminals, each with their own secrets and paranoia Engaging stealth gameplay A range of enemies: criminals, insane homeowners, guard dogs

name: The Virus Game
summary:
In this novel, we download a deleted game, after completing which people died.
After downloading the game, we meet one of the characters - the Virus, which feeds on the souls of people. Depending on your decisions you will either be friends with him or die :)

name: The Backrooms Deluxe 2
summary: A new, immersive Backrooms game featuring many entities and many levels

name: The Lost Heaven
summary: The Lost Heaven is a narrative-driven, post-apocalyptic sci-fi action-adventure game. You will play the role of a failed interstellar immigrant trying to survive on a world on the verge of collapse, find your ideal machine companion, embark on an unexpected journey, and uncover the truth behind the "doomsday" together.

name: The Walk
summary:
The story of “The Walk” starts with Matt, who is traveling on a back road to get to a friend's house. After several hours of driving, his car breaks down after going through a tunnel. Matt finds himself in a town called “Nominal Town” and, with no towing options, decides to look for lodging. While walking through the dark streets, he meets a blind man who offers to stay in his house. Matt declines the offer, but the blind man warns him that the town is full of crazies and that at the end of the road there is only nothingness.

Matt continues on his way and stops at a store where the cashier is also surprised to see that Matt is looking for a house at the end of town, since, according to him, there is only empty field there. Despite the warnings, Matt continues on. On the way, he encounters an old woman on the road who reacts strangely...

name: The Defiant
summary: The defiant Set during the Sino-Japanese War (1937-1945), the game is still in early development but promises to deliver action-packed shootouts, puzzle solving, and cinematic action. The game is dedicated to the memory of those who fought to liberate China, giving it a historical context and deep emotional meaning.

name: The Lewd Deal
summary: The Lewd Deal is a short adult visual novel in which you will meet Ashley, a hot real estate agent. You can choose to be a single man and seduce her, or be married and dominate her with the help of your beautiful wife. Both routes have a similar initial premise but quite different fetishes/stories.

name: The Answer Is Behind You
summary: You, a professional translator, are contacted by a researcher asking for assistance with a text written in a language never seen before. The offer is too tempting to refuse... but what secrets does this long-forgotten language hold?

name: The Binding of Isaac: Revelations
summary: The Binding of Isaac: Revelations is a three-part mod for the rogue-like videogame, Binding of Isaac: Rebirth and its subsequent DLCs. The mod adds a variety of content, such as new monsters, items, characters, and most notably, new custom floors.

name: The Three Vegan Entrepreneurs
summary: It's 5 Days before Christmas, Santa Claus is trying a new Vegan diet to lose weight! He finds a shift at bad vegan restaurant, he takes the job for employee discounts at the food bar, but he gets pursued by creepy Mascots of the night. Stay alive, or it's your funeral...

name: The Sakabashira Game
summary:
An amnesiac, a nurse, a baker, a fashion model, a computer genius, a tough guy and a grumpy old man wake up in a mysterious place with no exit. They have supplies, a bathroom, a kitchen and a bedroom. But there is no way out and time appears to have stopped...

What is this place? Are they trapped forever? Or are they part of something beyond their understanding? Help these people and uncover the truth of...THE SAKABASHIRA GAME.
