name: The Halloween
summary: A special for The House franchise. The player's goal is to venture through the scenario.

name: The Salesman
summary: In the Salesman, you play as a recently laid-off employee trying to survive the grind of job applications, debt, and dwindling hope. Trade your belongings for ad-supported replacements as you slowly sell away your life in this psychological horror game

name: The Jackbox Big Bang Bundle
summary: The Jackbox Big Bang Bundle includes 6 party games designed to send your night to a new dimension of infinite fun! Perfect for get-togethers with family or friends!

name: The Last Salvage Squad
summary: Battle enemy forces reminiscent of alien weapons from retro sci-fi works in this single-player 2.5D FPS.

name: The Core
summary: “A hyper roguelike action shooter where you dodge endless waves of enemies, evolve, and fight your way toward the Core.”

name: The Dreaded Hut
summary: A mysterious flood swallows a small village in the Philippines. Wade through the ruined homes, drowned fields, and whispers in the fog to search for your lost sister. Be careful of the water, some things don’t drown… they wake up.

name: The Haunted Spot
summary: The Haunted Spot is a 2D Top-Down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Jack who arrived at a haunted hotel in order to experience the paranormal.

name: The Runesmith
summary: Explore ancient lands, gather rare materials, and forge powerful runes blessed by mighty gods. Craft, hunt, mine, and master the art of runesmithing — a fallen god’s path to reclaim his place among the divine.

name: The Mantis
summary: The Mantis is a psx style short horror experience i used to learn a few tricks in godot.

name: The Terror Room
summary: Traverse the intricacies of office life in this thrilling office horror drama, featuring famous stars such as Bezi, myself and the other people too.

name: The Banana Splits: Banana Bop Game
The Kepler Experiment
summary: The Kepler Experiment is a survival-horror first-person shooter, drawing inspiration from games like Half-Life, Amnesia and System Shock 2.

name: The Biorift
summary: 2.5D action shooter with metroidvania elements and episodic presentation. Each level is a new chapter, new style, new enemies and challenges. The game combines dynamic battles, transitions between dimensions and saving survivors.

name: The Saint Wife’s Newlywed Trials
summary: Play as both Dirk and Marianne. As Dirk, head to the Adventurers' Guild and complete requests to rank up. Fend off monsters in turn-based RPG combat and explore dungeons to obtain items and earn the money you need to get by. As Marianne, grow crops and help out the other villagers. Develop the village by interacting with your new neighbors and assisting them with their problems.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Legacy of Morgoth
summary: The Lord of the Rings Online: Legacy of Morgoth is the twelfth expansion for the MMORPG, The Lord of the Rings Online (LOTRO). In this new expansion, players must venture to the deserts and marshlands of Near Harad. The expansion continues the epic questline, Song of Waves and Wind, and features 350+ new quests.

name: The Cat With Amazing Hat
summary: A small 2D platformer about a cat in an amazing hat. Go through all the obstacles, flying platforms, strange pistons, evil insects and mice. But all these obstacles should not prevent you from guiding the cat to the portal! But be careful, one wrong move and you will have to start all over again.

name: The Garden
summary: A very short story about gardens, rabbits, cats and toxic relationships.

name: The Pro Mahjong: Menkyo Minnaten
summary:
The Pro Mahjong - Menkyo Kaiden is a mahjong game that features 5 different boards, 2 game modes:
- Tournament: Compete against different opponents advancing rounds.
- Free Mode: Play mahjong games against 15 Japanese spies of the Japan Pro Mahjong Federation opponents.

In the tournament domination mode, you can challenge the ranking certification exam at each rank.

name: The Apothecary of Trubiz
summary: The Apothecary of Trubiz puts players in the role of a medieval pharmacist who must decode cryptic manuals and create potions for their patients. Players solve puzzles by translating fictional language texts, mixing ingredients, and determining the correct prescriptions for those seeking remedies in this compact puzzle-focused experience.

name: The Girl In White
summary: What seems like a miracle at first quickly reveals itself to be more of a nightmare, as Long realizes that restless Ghosts have always Surrounded Us—unseen, until now...

name: The Midnighters
summary: The Midnighters is a survival horror game for 1-4 players where you hunt for cursed treasures. Find and seize the treasures claimed by terrifying creatures. But as you do, heed the devil's whispers and never trust your eyes.

name: Thousand N' Thousand: Mimico
summary: Short story driven RPG-esque top-down adventure with simple puzzles. Escape the Igneferia mini-mall before it's too late. May fortune be on your side!

name: The Solace of Flowers
summary: The Solace of Flowers is a roguelike deckbuilder where flowers are used to restore life in a dying world. Build and improve your deck and use it to cover the corrupted areas of the world with vegetation before the damage to the environment becomes irreversible.

name: The Last Faith: Awakened Ancients
summary: Awakened Ancients delivers long-awaited content, answers, deeper challenges and the most polished version of The Last Faith to date.

name: The Corpse
summary:
Over the course of a year, Big Bag handed the corpse from one to another, leaving nothing but a folder of assets for the next person to use. We had little to no knowledge of what came before or what would come after.

Our one rule was that we could only use the Mouse to control our corpse. The seams are there, and blood runs everywhere...

the corpse is meant to be played more than once, but only as many times as it takes to reach the white light at the end.

name: The Dead City
summary: The Dead City is a short first-person point and click adventure set in the gloomy decay of a futuristic city. Polluted rain falls from the sky and runs into a river more toxin than water. As the main character, the player is trying to find the killer, but the game's antihero soon learns that the stakes are much greater.

name: The Yamamura Estate
summary: Are you ready to face your nightmares?

name: The Shadow of Shadows
summary: Lilith is a young Shadow that wants to be a Light. She embarks on a journey to learn how Light is made but is about to find out a horrible secret. Will you help her turn the tides?

name: The Green Hook Fighter
summary: The Green Hook Fighter finally lands on Steam with intense battles, unique characters, and indie soul. Get ready for electrifying 3D fights in a universe full of style, personality, and urban legend inspiration.

name: The Unseen Fears: Body Thief - Collector's Edition
summary: Experience the terrifying investigation that started it all! Can you stop a mystical murderer in time?

name: The Loopler
summary: The Loopler is a idle-like roguelite simulation of a car driving in loops. Pick upgrades, place gates and sit back and relax as the mesmerizing loop gets going and the dopamine hits of numbers going up fills your brain. See if you can go endless and beyond.

name: The Watch
summary: You must collect the necessary components to complete a ritual to banish the wetland witch to the afterlife once and for all.

name: The Diamond Adventures
summary: The Diamond Adventures is a multi-genre, single-player adventure game packed with minigames and exploration. DanTDM is taken back through the old eras of his YouTube journey, allying with old friends and facing old foes as he makes his way through the memories into the present day.

name: The Noexistencen of Morphean Paradox: The Forest of Silver Shallots
summary: You awaken in the Forest of Silver Shallots, setting out to uncover the secret of the Morphean Paradox. Above, factions weave their schemes; below, the black mist hides a swelling undercurrent. Time never stands still, and truth wears many faces. Not everyone can return to their fate…

name: The Maze
summary: In a pitch dark maze like factory, you must avoid He, secure secret documents, and escape with only a flashlight. If He finds you, He’ll charge from the dark with an axe. Can you survive and escape?

name: The Killer
summary: Navigate Oak City's eerie nights, solving puzzles and escaping chained rooms to survive. Uncover the dark plan of the relentless predator in this immersive adventure. Each step tests your wits and courage. Can you escape, or will you become the next victim?

name: The Drop
summary: RIP your way through a party of BLOOD THIRSTY cultists, to uncover the true intent and source of its CHAOS in this roguelike, cinematic, action fest!

name: The Runner
summary: mmerse yourself in the breathtaking realism of Venice's labyrinthine waterways. Dash past ancient architecture, navigate bustling squares, and embrace the challenge of an authentic Venetian endless runner. Can you master the art of swift navigation in this stunning, true-to-life cityscape?"

name: The Last Hero
summary: Play this first person medieval game and jump, run, fight, collect, and stop the threat that is coming with the well known and last hero of Corli.Hugh Ashdown.

name: The Ball
summary: Are you ready to conquer all the worlds and master every level?

name: The Adventures of Astel and the Dark Curse
summary: Join Astel, the boldest (and funniest) bunny in Cenourolândia, on a magical adventure! Face bizarre enemies, collect epic powers, and save your village from a dark curse. What are you waiting for? Jump in and explore this incredible journey!

name: The Unsolved
summary: The Unsolved is a detective story-driven game where you step into the shoes of an investigator, gathering clues, interrogating suspects, and connecting evidence to solve complex murder cases. Your goal is to uncover the identity of a serial killer who has left a trail of destruction in your life.

name: The Exit Strategy
summary: A rouge-like escape room game

name: The Attic
summary: Visual Novel and Walking Simulator style game with multiple endings. A love letter to the classical horror stories about old haunted houses, basements and ofcourse attics. Psychological horror inspired by author's experience with OCD-like symptoms and intrusive thoughts.

name: The Portsmoor Abysm
summary: Explore the Catacombs of Portsmoor, push boulders, avoid deadly traps, face otherworldly monsters, and solve mind-bending puzzles. The Portsmoor Abysm is an atmospheric puzzle game with Sokoban-like mechanics, inspired by classics such as Boulder Dash, Supaplex, or Emerald Mine.

name: The Riese Project
summary: Those who went underground never came back. But something still breathes beneath the ruins. The Riese Project is a narrative FPP/VR thriller about a place that hasn’t forgotten anyone.

name: The Music Box: Arc
summary: A sequel to (Mario) The Music Box -ARC-, continuing off of the 'Missing' ending. Make choices to go down either a 'sane' or 'insane' path.

name: Thug Life
summary: Step into the gritty underworld of New York. Build your reputation from the ground up — fight, steal, and rise through the ranks of dangerous gangs or form your own crew. Every action shapes your fate in a living, reactive city full of chaos and crime.

name: The Heritage
summary: A long-forgotten house becomes your inheritance. But as you wander its dark corridors and solve its eerie puzzles, you soon realize this legacy isn’t yours alone. Uncover the hidden secrets and face the true nature of what you’ve inherited.

name: The DeadLine
summary: The DeadLine is an online third-person asymmetric horror game. Become the killer and hunt down survivors without mercy, or become a survivor and escape from the killer's pursuit. Hunt or escape — which fate awaits you?

name: The Box is Alive
summary: A physics-based comedy platformer where you tumble, roll, and flap your way through chaotic warehouse challenges as a living cardboard box.

name: The Murder of Ava Monroe
summary: A gripping detective noir mystery that blends investigation and deduction with a rich, character-driven story. The Murder of Ava Monroe is cozy, twisty, and oozing with atmosphere.

name: The Jumping Food Racing
summary:
In The Jumping Food Racing, you compete with your favorite foods on a variety of race tracks. Speed and responsiveness are what counts here.

Different tracks, increasing challenges:
Master tight bends, dangerous obstacles and increasing levels of difficulty on ever new tracks in the typical food design.

name: The Colorful Biplane
summary: Soar through vibrant skies in The Colorful Biplane! Take control of your bright vintage aircraft and navigate through stunning low-poly landscapes filled with floating rings, hot air balloons, and exciting challenges. Collect points, avoid obstacles, and test your flying skills as you chase the highest score!

name: The Sims 4: Modern Retreat Kit
summary: Bring a modern vision of nature's spirit into your Sims' living room with The Sims 4 Modern Retreat†.

name: The Sims 4: Garden to Table Kit
summary: Transform your outdoor dining area into a rustic retreat where homegrown harvests are the cornerstone of meal time with The Sims 4 Garden to Table Kit†.

name: The Last Poem
summary:
5 years have passed since then.
The sequel to "Christmas Tina" by the original team.
Here and now. A "Chinese" and a "Japanese" meet once more in a non-romantic encounter. At the end of the century, a journey begins—from the first (her) to the last (her)...

name: The Holiday Story
summary: The Holiday Story is an indie horror game about Christmas and New Year, set in the 80s.

name: The Cat: Tales of Istanbul
summary: Live, explore, and survive as three cats on the streets of Istanbul. A cozy yet emotional adventure full of discovery, freedom, and belonging — blending cat life simulation, narrative storytelling, and atmospheric exploration

name: The Planetarian
summary: Join the Planetarian, guardian of the World Tree, on an epic journey to protect various planets. Experience intense third-person shooter gameplay with bullet hell elements. Battle diverse enemies across seven visually stunning planets and collect equipment infused with planetary energy.

name: The Everloom
summary: On high cliffs overlooking an open sky, a group of strangers is trapped in a shared dream. In this classic pixel art adventure from the golden era of Flash games, play as a boy caught in a tangled web of intrigue. Talk to characters to learn their stories and use the items they give you to find solutions to their problems.

name: The Museum Of Mr. Pence
summary:
The museum of Mr. Pence has opened and people from all over the world are going to visit it.
An edgy plumber named "Skullpain" has decided to check out the museum.
This is a compilation of three Mr. Pence games.

The games included are:
Mr. Pence's Christmas Blast!
NEW! Mr. Pence
and a secret third game.

You can also see artwork from almost all the Mr. Pence games and talk to the other people at the museum.
(All games are mostly the same as the original versions, there are only a few differences).

name: The Doodle Palette
summary: A cozy sandbox for building and painting miniature worlds. Place, paint, and decorate while tiny people and birds bring your dioramas to life.

name: The Visitor: Massacre
summary: Control an alien slug as it rains death and destruction onto a sleepy campground. Devour creatures to gain their abilities of flight, swimming, climbing and size as you make your way to your next human meal. Based on Zeebarf's hit game The Visitor, the insatiable death slug is back in an all new action-adventure horror game. Guide him through the mountainous forest grounds of Camp Happy, as he destroys everything in his path in search of victims.

name: The Visitor Returns
summary: Guide the alien death slug through 7 brand new scenarios, using everything in the environment to kill his prey and gain their powers. The Visitor Returns is filled with more horror and gore than ever before. Battle it out in a bloody final confrontation with 6 possible outcomes.

name: TheOdd1sOut: Let's Bounce
summary: Starring the YouTuber TheOdd1sOut, Let's Bounce is a mobile game where you have to travel through time.

name: The Quiet After
summary: The Quiet After is a narrative visual novel where players guide Ava, a survivor navigating a quiet but dangerous world shaped by memory, trauma, and choice. Every decision branches the story, influences Ava’s inner voice, and determines how you survive in the aftermath. The game blends choice-driven storytelling, psychological horror, and atmospheric art to create an emotional narrative experience focused on healing, survival, and the consequences of the past.

name: The Broken Lolipop
summary: Lala is a sad clown that is widely considered a misfit. While your meeting with her is a chance encounter, it will be a large deciding factor in her fate. With you be the helping hand she needs? Or will you be the final straw that gives her the drive to end her suffering once and for all? It all depends on how you treat her and what you learn about her.

name: The Undead
summary: The Undead is a first-person shooter that takes place in a cemetery. You must fight waves of zombies and skeletons. When you reach 30 kills, you'll be confronted with a fearsome foe.

name: Threshold of Judgement
summary: A mysterious gate judges your soul between Heaven and Hell. Answer wisely — fifteen truths lead to salvation, one mistake to eternal damnation.

name: The Cute Whale
summary: Get ready for an ocean full of puzzles and charm. Guide a lovable whale through 30 handcrafted stages where strategy meets relaxation. Push the turtles onto the buoys and help restore harmony to the sea in this adorable adventure of logic and calm.

name: This Is Where I Want To Die
summary: A very short kinetic novel about a dying person trying to remember what happened. This Is Where I Want To Die is a depressing story with an important message I want to put across. The game is free to play and I would recommend it for players 16+. TIWIWTD was created in less than a month for NaNoRenO 2013.

name: The Ramen Shop
summary: A horror game where you manage a ramen shop. Take orders from your customers, serve hot delicious ramens and sweet cold drinks to hungry customers.

name: The Fall of Magic Castle
summary: A new adventure awaits!

name: The Destroyer from Jail
summary: The Destroyer from Jail is a Korean arcade game that uses the "belt-scrolling" perspective typical of beat 'em ups. but features gun based combat. Control a convict shooting down a criminal boss and his goons across five levels to gain his freedom.

name: The Dungeon Of Horror
summary: A dark medieval-fantasy turn-based dungeon crawler where you try to escape the dungeon of your own creation! Place tiles, fight monster and cooperate with friends to find and destroy the pagan shaman Meir to escape this horror!

name: The Lighthouse
summary: A first-person puzzle adventure to test your limits and illuminate your mind. Can you reveal the secrets of The Lighthouse?

name: The Space Between
summary: A 2D, open-world indie combat RPG set in an unstable world parallel to ours. Fight chaotic entities and bosses, explore broken worlds, and collect unique items to customize your loadout. Warp the fabric of time and space, and discover new unstable elements to grow your power and reach victory.

name: They Looked Like Us
summary: An emergency broadcast urges people to stay inside and follow careful instructions to survive. Turn the lights off and close the curtains, do not let them find you.

name: The McMilian Tree Lot
summary:
Near the outskirts of town exists a sleepy, solitary tree lot.
Some say that the firewood purchased from this place burns extra hot.
Many a customer has gotten lost traveling it's narrow, creepy rows...
For the thing which lurks in the lot's heart grows.

name: The Jumping Food Catcher
summary: Collect pizza, sushi, donuts and more - but stay alert, because the pace keeps picking up.

name: The Romance of the Moth and the Flame
summary: A visual novel by the indie group Crying Rules Actually.

name: The House Always Wins
summary: Design and expand your dream casino solo or in co-op. Keep gamblers happy, manage operations, and tackle hilarious chaos — from vandals to fires — as you rise to the top of the gambling world.

name: The Invisible Us
summary: “The invisible us” is a FMV game where you play as Song Wufei, a timid high school student targeted by bullies. When a brave classmate intervenes, a series of mysterious events unfold. Investigate and piece together the hidden truth through deduction.

name: The Man You See
summary: You're Dorian Vale. Heartbreak leads you to moving towns. Your eyes may or may not deceive you along the way.

name: The Black Pyramid
summary: A Black Pyramid materializes across the globe. Dr. Mehdi Algun must decipher why, before its hunger for death and suffering consumes everything. An ancient cycle of cleansing has begun. As madness spreads and humanity tears itself apart, choose: become the destroyer, or join the cleansed.

name: The Underpass
summary:
Inspired by Exit 8, The Underpass is an anomaly hunting game in which you must remember your surroundings and spot any differences in order to escape the loop.

At release the game has 30+ anomalies, with an average gameplay length of 30-60 minutes.

name: The Thing
summary:
This project is a fan-made remake of The Thing, reimagined inside the original Max Payne engine, Max-FX.

The aim is to blend the atmospheric survival horror of John Carpenter’s iconic 1982 film with the gritty, noir-infused mechanics and visuals of Max Payne. Built entirely on the Max-FX framework, the remake leverages its detailed particle effects, real-time lighting, and scripted event system to recreate the paranoia, tension, and claustrophobic environments of an Antarctic research station under siege by a shape-shifting alien lifeform.

Players will experience a narrative-driven single-player campaign where exploration, environmental storytelling, and scripted scares replace Max Payne’s traditional urban gunfights. Combat will be sparse and deliberate, emphasizing resource management and the fear of not knowing who to trust. The mod will include newly modeled environments inspired by the film’s Outpost 31, custom character models and animations, dynamic weather effects.

name: The Melty Way
summary: You move, you melt. Play as a brave size-shifting slime in this colorful precision puzzle-platformer, dashing through handcrafted puzzles and perilous traps on your journey in The Melty Way.

name: The Garry Story
summary: This mod puts you in the shoes of a character named Garry G. An employee that accidentally went to work on Sunday, he's tasked with leaving the office building while a silly narrator keeps talking.

name: The Purple Peacock
summary: The Purple Peacock is a 2D point-and-click adventure game where players guide Virgil Russ, in a mysterious quest to find a rare and elusive stamp, the “Purple Peacock”.

name: The Fairview Files: Episode Zero
summary:
"There's something rotten going on here in Fairview
And you and I are going to get to the bottom of it."

Fairview is a place shrouded in both mystery and the paranormal.

Newly moved into town is Detective Dalia, a private investigator dead-set on deciphering the town's complexities.

Episode Zero recounts the night that her nephew, Ted, decided to take an ill-advised shortcut...

name: Those Who Dwell
summary: Those Who Dwell is a story-first psychological horror focused on isolation, atmosphere, and folklore. Light is your only hope as you explore deeper into a cursed cave system disturbed by those who dug too deep. Restore shrines, survive the dark, and uncover what became of Those Who Dwell.

name: The Legacy
summary: A journey to a mysterious ancient civilization.

name: The Bee Hive
summary: Defend the insect kingdom from the spiders, in this colourful 3D action-adventure platformer, The Bee Hive! Crafted entirely by one developer, a love letter to the platformers of old.

name: The Tomb Raider & Soul Reaver Remastered Bundle
summary: 8 Games. 2 Legends. 1 Bundle.

name: The Most Annoying Game Ever
summary:
Welcome to The Most Annoying Game Ever, a puzzle game designed to test your patience.

This isn't your average brain-teaser. It’s the equivalent of an IQ test, but for your patience. Every interaction, every setting, every mechanic is carefully engineered to waste your time, push your buttons, and make you question why you even clicked "New Game".

name: The Aperture Dilemma
summary: Step into the life of Aperture Lab's employee Mike, as he faces an extreme dilemma while at his place of work...

name: The Last Survivors Harem
summary: This is a simple survivor game, and also a loot-collecting game. While fighting hordes of monsters, you can collect equipment of various qualities. Combining these equipment allows your character to gradually grow stronger.

name: The Angel's Devil Tail: One More Question 2
summary: A Single-Player Lateral Thinking Puzzle game. This title features a Bishoujo ADV story where you deduce the truth behind bizarre mysteries. With Steam Workshop support for infinite puzzles, it's the perfect solo detective experience!

name: The Cradle
summary: You are Alex, a curious journalist who has decided to investigate the mysterious disappearance of the entire staff of Synergy Soft. Six months ago, all the employees went mad at once, staging a bloody massacre. The official version is mass psychosis. But the truth is much more terrifying.

name: The Interval Bureau: Extension 0
summary: A short psychological audio horror call where every number routes you deeper into a faceless bureau that measures and files you.

name: The Counter Gambit
summary: A revenge-themed visual novel. After a decade of study, I entered a top university, only to be framed in the library and unjustly imprisoned. Now at rock bottom, how can I break free? Is there any chance left to flip this ruined life of mine?

name: The Abyss
summary: "The Abyss" is a first-person survival horror. After an accident, explore a dark world filled with horrors, puzzles, and secrets that challenge your sanity. Will you escape the Abyss or succumb?

name: The Abyssal Maze
summary: Trapped in a nightmarish labyrinth, you have only two goals, find the ancient book and escape. But the walls are alive with echoes, and the monsters that stalk the corridors never sleep.

name: The Abyss Book
summary: The Abyss Book a groundbreaking text-based adventure game that blends AI-powered dynamic story generation with stunning 3D visuals. Every choice you make shapes a unique adventure, with AI responding in real-time, delivering a new generation of personalized experiences.

name: The Abyss Break
summary: Hardcore first-person co-op horror extraction game. Explore the parallel worlds of the Abyss alone or with a team, gather resources, and make life-or-death decisions that will determine your survival.

name: The World 21: Gambit Abyss
summary: "The World 21" is a blackjack-based card game in which players use strategy and economy management to win, assist an ancient god "Verus" in collecting scattered "power currency", and uncover the truth.

name: The Llamasoft Collection
summary: The Llamasoft Collection is the latest addition to Evercade’s expanding lineup, featuring 27 games from industry legend Jeff Minter. Spanning the early 8-bit home computer era through to the Atari ST, this collection brings together 21 unique titles with multiple system versions of some of Minter’s most iconic creations.

name: The Fruits of the Literature Club
The Farm
summary:
"The Farm", a gothic comedy set in 14th century France.

When Nicole's father takes ill she begins working for the de Fosse family on a neighbouring farm. There she is reacquainted with her childhood friend, Cecille de Fosse, and the rest of Cecille's family. Over the next few days Nicole's presence begins to have an effect on the de Fosse family, for better or for worse.

name: The Shadow Ritual
summary: This ritual can only be completed between 11pm and 12am. The moment the clock exceeds midnight, the ritual is void.

name: The Red Hood: Hunting the Wolf
summary: In "Red Hood's Hunt for the Wolf," you play as Red Riding Hood on a perilous journey through forests and caves to defeat the evil wolf. Battle enemies like skeletons and elves with your sword, collect coins, and overcome obstacles in this classic platformer to save the forest.

name: The Da Vinci Cryptex 4
summary: Unravel 50 codes, unlock the Cryptex, and escape the room!

name: The Escape to the Afterlife
summary: The Escape to the Afterlife is a horror game where the protagonist, who has passed away, searches for a path to the afterlife.

name: The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth
summary: A new collaboration by Acacia, the developers of Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban, and G-MODE. Explore dungeons and face a story of sickly sweetness, alt accounts, and a girl band with issues in The Streamer's Alt Account Labyrinth.

name: The House of the Dead Bundle Pack
summary: The House of the Dead Bundle Pack is a bundle consisting of three downloadable The House of the Dead games for PlayStation 3.

name: The Forgotten Past
summary: While investigating a forgotten factory, you uncover dark secrets, haunted machines, and a past that was never meant to be found. Strange visions, buried truths… and something watching from the shadows. Be careful, this place isn't abandoned.

name: The Banker Tycoon
summary: Start a management experience where you grow your own bank step by step. Handle customer operations yourself, control risk and fees, unlock new systems through a wide research tree, upgrade your bank and rise from a small branch to a respected financial center.

name: Three Foreign Sisters!!
summary:
This visual novel follows Kiro Nishikawa, whose quiet daily life is suddenly disrupted when three young women from different countries unexpectedly move into his home. Claiming to be his half-sisters, the trio quickly turns his routine into a lively and chaotic household filled with misunderstandings, comedy, and personal interactions.

The game focuses on character-driven storytelling and slice-of-life scenarios, featuring multiple endings and full voice acting throughout the story.

name: The Rusted
summary: Explore hauntingly beautiful, abandoned environments filled with corrupted machines in a rusted world. Test your platforming skills, and fight to survive. The Rusted is a fully hand-drawn action-adventure where you play as a loyal robot dog.

name: The Eternal Mines
summary: Upgrade your minions as you journey deeper into the mines. Discover new areas with unique effects. Upgrade and equip masks to change the behaviors of the your miners

name: The Scream of Darkness
summary: the scream of darkness is a first person psychological horror with multiple endings, it shows the story about one guy that gets his whole life ruined in days. can you discover the truth?

name: The Night Job: Hotel
summary: The Night Job: Hotel is a first-person horror game about surviving five terrifying nights in an old hotel. Complete your tasks, avoid the entities that haunt the halls, and keep the place running after dark. Stay alert. Stay moving. Stay alive.

name: The Complex Chapter 1: Who, What, Where?
summary: Wake up in a trashed apartment and investigate mysterious disappearances. Solve challenging puzzles, interact with others, and confront a terrifying boss. Your choices lead to one of five unique endings in this tense, atmospheric puzzle-horror game

name: The Acid Queens of the Moon
summary: Lulu's had a bad day at work and wants to get piss-drunk to kick off her weekend. But her resourceful friend Alison has another suggestion, one that will prove life changing... join Lulu on her very first acid trip as she has a chill and fun day!

name: The Folk
summary: Craft items in this high-pressure resource management game to get enough gems to last until tomorrow. By combining resource management, crafting, and roguelike elements the pressure is on the whole time you play!

name: The Tales of the Magical Space Dough: Rebaked
summary: You are a living piece of dough who lands on a planet and enters a pizza restaurant. The chef, seeing you as the perfect ingredient for his prized pizza, chases you through various environments. Now, you must escape to avoid becoming the main course!

name: The Tales of Wonderlend
summary: You play as "Vittoria Rossi" You are a writer, you got called for writing a book about a abbandonate Rifugio. What hidden story is behind that place? Will Vittoria find out the truth?

name: The Three Kingdoms: The Tales of Jian An
summary: This is a historical strategy game set in the Three Kingdoms era, told from Liu Bei's perspective. It covers the Yellow Turban Rebellion to early Three Kingdoms. Featuring classic turn-based gameplay, it reinterprets historical events, offering both engaging battles and rich cultural insights.

name: The Witch Girls
summary: A Twine horror game set in Scotland. Two girls appeal to the school's clique of witches for boyfriends, only to be told, "We don't do love magic." They take things into their own hands. Ranked #8 in the 31st Annual Interactive Fiction Competition.

name: Think Like a Block
summary: Think Like a Block is a minimalist puzzle where logic becomes power. Push, connect, and manipulate blocks to activate mechanisms, open paths, and shift reactive rooms. Master abilities, find clever solutions, and face challenges where one wrong move can change everything.

name: Thriving in Ruins: The End of Humanity is not the End of the World
summary: Explore a post-post-apocalyptic world thriving without humans. Collect drawings to solve environmental riddles, unlocking biomes from mycelium roots to underwater seas. Piece the story together through exploration while enjoying cinematic views and atmospheric soundtracks.

name: The Doors to Netherwhere
summary: A rogue-like RPG about defending a monastery against hordes of enemies. Prepare your villagers, organize your defenses, and decide whether you will risk opening the Doors that have been sealed for a generation.

name: The Richest
summary: Take advantage of real Renaissance events to become the richest man in history.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky
summary: Hailed as one of the largest, longest and most meticulously detailed turn-based JRPG series of all time, this first chapter in the ongoing Trails saga sets the stage for what's quickly become Ys developer Nihon Falcom's most popular and best-selling franchise in their entire 30+ year history.

name: The Final Shift
summary: The Final Shift is a slow-burn psychological horror game where a janitor’s lonely night in an empty office building turns into a nightmare of looping floors, distorted realities, and haunting memories that refuse to stay buried.

name: The King's Follower
summary: The King was called and he needs protection to get through the grueling forest. That's where you come along! Equipped with your trusty enchanted weapon that gets stronger everytime it kills a bunch of enemies, journey through the depths of the forest to slay monsters while also protecting the King!

name: The Night Doner
summary: Asım takes a night shift at a local doner shop to make ends meet. But as he prepares orders, he realizes he isn't alone. Slice meat, serve customers, and try to survive in this short psychological horror game that blends job simulation with eerie suspense.

name: The Well
summary: Isolation. Hopelessness. Starvation. By the will of an unknown force, you find yourself isolated from the outside world. Now you are doomed to starve to death. No one will come to your aid. No one will hear your prayers.

name: The Last Feather
summary: The Last Feather is a high-octane top-down shooter packed with raw brutality, hard-edged gunfights, and bone-crushing close combat. Through neon-soaked streets and relentless encounters, it delivers a fierce journey of vengeance with every step.

name: The Lost Experiment
summary: It is 1997. Farhad, an investigative journalist, arrives at an abandoned military base to uncover the truth behind a silenced 1986 meteor crash. But as he delves deeper into the forest, he finds that the debris isn't the only thing buried here. Some headlines are better left unwritten.

name: The Backrooms: Liminal Space
summary: A short horror experience rendered with a real-time VHS filter (grain, scan lines). Freely explore the spaces of a strange yellow maze. Independently created by a 12-year-old developer using UE5, it immerses you in a purely liminal space atmosphere.

name: The Gas Station: Graveyard Shift
summary: Congratulations, You've been hired as the new nightshift employee at silver lake gas station. Can you survive the night?

name: The Apple Girl
summary: Apple-loving girl delivers potatoes and makes people happy... ?

name: The Last Delivery: Nightmare Courier
summary: You're a night shift courier. Your job is to deliver packages before dawn. But the further you go, the clearer it becomes—the clients aren’t waiting for the cargo… They’re waiting for you. Will you survive your final shift?

name: The Chess Player
summary: The Chess Player provides players with options to save games, print moves, and even change sides during a match. The game also includes features like castling and en-passant captures, adding depth to the chess experience. The integration of these features makes The Chess Player a comprehensive chess simulation for its time.

name: The Basment
summary: Descend into the basement and confront three escalating stages of psychological horror. Each phase offers subtle environmental clues and cryptic hints, pushing you to observe, interpret, and survive. This demo delivers an atmospheric preview of the full experience — the complete release will expand the story, puzzles, and intensity of the terror to come.

name: The Alters: Deluxe Edition
summary:
Dive into an emotional sci-fi story and alter your experience even further, with the Deluxe Edition of the game. This inspiring collection includes:
The Alters
The Alters: Original Soundtrack
The Alters: Deluxe Outfits
1 DLC released after the game’s premiere

name: Thief Simulator 3
summary: The Thief is back! Play solo or team up in CO-OP as a duo of thieves, plan the perfect hits, or improvise when things go wrong. From pickpocket to crime boss – only the best gangs will make it to the top.

name: The Last Bee
summary: Apis and Lili are two of the last bees in the world. They are trapped in some hideous caves among ants and other creatures.Help Apis find the key and free Lili.

name: The Remains
summary: The Remains is a multiplayer co-op survival horror game (4 players) where players must make use of stealth to complete objectives and escape enemies and progress through levels to advance their story.

name: The Celestial Seeker
summary: Irata, a space bounty hunter is caught in a galactic conflict. A rogue federation seeks the fragments of the Eternium Core, an advanced chip that commands all defense systems in the solar system. In this sci-fi Metroidvania, explore, fight, and upgrade your way to stop the enemy and save the galaxy.

name: The Jumping Food Racing 2
summary: In The Jumping Food Racing 2, you compete with your favorite foods on a variety of race tracks. Speed and responsiveness are what counts here.

name: The House of Hikmah
summary: The House of Hikmah is a narrative-driven 3D adventure game exploring grief, legacy and the search for answers after profound loss. Solve puzzles, encounter historical scholars of the Islamic Golden Age, and uncover timeless lessons in a beautifully imagined House of Wisdom.

name: The Enigma Lounge
summary: The Enigma Lounge is a hand-pixeled, point and click escape room puzzle game. It features a cozy yet mysterious vibe, and a small but tricky set of interconnected puzzles that must be solved in order to escape.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Kingdoms of Harad
summary: The Lord of the Rings Online: Kingdoms of Harad is the thirteenth expansion for the MMORPG, The Lord of the Rings Online (LOTRO). This expansion increases the level cap to 160 and concludes the epic, The Song of Waves and Wind. In this expansion, players travel into Harad to fight Morgoth's forces and features over 400 new quests.

name: The Great Flood
summary: "A War you can grasp." An upcoming strategy game, featuring the ability to engage in duels in VR/MR Dual Modes.

name: The Amusement
summary: An abandoned amusement park, a tangled memory, a family shattered by the Great War… Discover an intense story in this redirected-walking VR adventure in which every step counts.

name: The Daughter
summary: The Daughter is a first-person narrative horror game where the line between reality, dream, and memory slowly fades. You search for your missing daughter in a forest, only to find a house and a silent child who offers to help you… on one condition.

name: The Curse We Made
summary: A short ride into a cursed town — a hand-drawn puzzle adventure where ghouls and monsters haunt every corner, and solving puzzles slowly brings life back to the world and uncovers the truth.

name: The Adventures of Emilie in Paris
summary: The Adventures of Emilie in Paris is an independent 2D platform game with a unique Parisian atmosphere, inspired by 90s classics with an original twist.

name: Thinky Dailies
summary: A daily puzzle adventure connected by a delightful story — a journey into a strange and wonderful world where almost everything is a puzzle. Every day, a new kind of handcrafted puzzle.

name: This Winter of Ours
summary: Alone as two, together as one - A fantasy/yuri visual novel telling the story of two girls traversing a snow covered forest and growing closer.

name: The Vanishing Train
summary: The Vanishing Train is a psychological horror game where you work as a train driver on a rural Japanese railway line.

name: There's No Differences: Santa
summary: Can you find the differences between the two festive images?

name: The Alley
summary: A first-person psychological horror game where you explore a maze-like Korean alley, photograph and identify supernatural 'Demon Traces' from realistic illusions, and escape while evading a relentless ghost.

name: The Wake
summary: The Wake is a Lovecraftian Fishing Adventure where you explore a forgotten island chain. Catch strange fish with customizable gear and learn to wield eldritch magic. Fend off abyssal beasts with powerful weapons, all while sailing the dark waters of an open world.

name: The Wall
summary: A cinematic sci-fi horror visual novel, with multiple endings and a shocking mature story where your decisions will impact your psichology and the events of the story.

name: The Way
summary: RPG+Rouge+AFK+forging? Cultivate characters, AFK cultivation, Rouge cards, unlock skills, craft equipment, and experience the irresistible fun!

name: The Trench
summary: This is a post ww1 horror game about a soldier coming back to the trench he was stationed at and the events that happened there. You will find out the truth and uncover what happened there as you also find a way to move one from the past.

name: The Tunnel
summary: Awakened in a mysterious place, with no memory of how you got there. Your only companions are your trusty lantern and a weapon. Every step you take, you can't shake the feeling that something's watching. Can you find your way out?

name: The Stairwell
summary: You want to leave this weird apartment, but the stairs seem to have no end and there are strange noises coming from the corridor. Things are getting weirder and weirder.

name: The Tower
summary: Play a simple dungeon grinder RPG! Choose your character, customize their class and name, and delve into randomly selected dungeons filled with enemies and treasure. Gather loot, and gear up at The Tower's Guild to tackle higher floors..

name: The Search
summary: A post-apocalyptic sci-fi adventure where players harness magic and advanced weaponry to battle enemies in an open world. Engage in intense combat, explore desolate landscapes, and uncover hidden secrets while mastering both supernatural powers and tactical shooting.

name: The Ritual
summary: A exploratory based game in where you find a key to be able to leave the room. Avoid that monster and see clearly.

name: The Queen's Quest
summary: In this top-down adventure, you are a bee on a quest to find the legendary Flower of Life. Along the way, you'll befriend allies with powers who help you solve puzzles, battle fierce enemies and overcome epic challenges. Explore four unique worlds and unravel the hidden mysteries of this realm.

name: The Night Shift
summary: The Night Shift is a Third Person OpenWorld game, where players live their Adventure freely, in a day and night circle where wildlife became more dangerous at night. Free content updates and new random weekly quests and zones will include for keep the community rewarded.

name: The Nightmare
summary: You are trapped in a nightmare shaped by your inner darkness. To escape and awaken, you must solve puzzles and confront deep-seated traumas. Explore twisted versions of daily life—convenience stores, trains, stations, hometowns, endless tunnels. Face your fears and reclaim yourself.

name: The Place
summary: The Place is an atmospheric science fiction quest inspired by classic works like Aliens, Predator and The X-Files. Immerse yourself in the retro-futuristic aesthetic of the 90s as you travel to Venus to find a weapon against Earth's alien invaders.

name: The Nurse
summary: Hide wherever you can, look for everything you can use, be quiet to avoid attracting attention, protect yourself from the enemy's bloodthirst, Katherine sees and hears everything, don't get caught in her sight. Explore the territory, find a way to escape from this hell.

name: The Line
summary: A first-person psychological horror game where you use your phone to spot anomalies, interact with strangers, and navigate an unsettling night outside a nightclub

name: The Librarian
summary: Welcome to The Librarian, where magic is a privilege… that you don’t have. Manage a chaotic library, juggle forbidden tomes, impatient clients, and absurd rules. Become a master of knowledge and prove that organization beats even the best-cast spell!

name: The Late Arrival
summary: Horror engine-based exploration game that takes place in an abandoned subway station that has experienced strange occurrences. The graffiti artist starts exploring an old subway station and finds more than he expected. His experiences include mysterious figures, strange sounds, and happenings.

name: The Last Light
summary: "The Last Light" is an atmospheric puzzle-platformer set in the early 1980s Pacific Northwest.

name: The Last Days
summary: Fight for your life in the exciting top-down zombie shooter! Explore locations and their stories, kill various zombies, and make a unique playstyle with a wide amount of weapons and items. Get an immersive experience of horror and action, trying to survive. The Last Days of your life begin now...

name: The Sweet Spot
summary: The Sweet Spot is a cozy horror game where you work the last shift at an 80s ice cream shop. Make ice cream, serve customers and watch out for strange things.

name: The Huntter
summary: Embark on a journey of self-reliance in 'The Huntter,' a survival game crafted by a solo developer. Explore vast natural landscapes, hone your hunting and gathering skills, and build a base to secure your essentials. Will you be the Hunter or the Hunted?

name: The Dark Crown: Genesis
summary: A pixel-perfect rogue-lite where darkness becomes your greatest weapon. Sacrificed by your kingdom, you awaken in the depths of the endless cursed dungeon. Defeat powerful Demons, claim their elements, and rise through.

name: The Count of Monte Cristo
summary: Play as the Count of Monte Cristo in 19th-century France. Charm & Dominate your enemies. Exploit their weaknesses, and orchestrate their downfall in this gripping narrative-driven tale of revenge.

name: The Colony
summary: You're a renegade ex-priest who has abandoned the cassock to wield shotguns and occult rituals. Armed with corrupted faith and the occult, you face lost souls in search of redemption or revenge. A survival horror game inspired by the real-life atrocities of the Colony Hospital in Barbacena (Brazil).

name: The Core
summary: Step into a world of mystery and self-discovery with The Core, an immersive action-adventure game. As an autonomous AI core, you awaken alone in a long-forgotten facility, your memory lost. Embark on a thrilling journey to uncover your true identity and unravel the purpose behind your creation.

name: TheCube
summary: The game is an online multiplayer cooperative FPS Rougelike set in a world where the players are only allowed to exist there as long as their time allows it. Time is used as currency and is obtained via completing missions, tasks, and goals.

name: The DollMaker
summary: Trapped in an abandoned hospital, you must survive the Dollmaker's twisted test to escape. Solve devious puzzles and outsmart his horrific creations, or risk becoming one of his soulless, Creatures. Will you survive the trial, or will you become his next experiment?

name: The Flying Dutchman
summary: The Flying Dutchman is a game about uncovering mysteries in a world of floating islands. Set sail as a skyfaring pirate, uncover secrets, and help out tiny sea creatures that need your help!

name: The Family
summary: Step into 1950s Bayford, Italy, as Tyler Jones, a struggling boxer who gets entangled in the deadly world of the Mafia. Navigate a treacherous path between two rival crime families, where every decision could be your last. Will you rise or fall in this ruthless underworld?

name: The Explorer
summary: Explore forgotten planets, gather minerals, build bases, and uncover the secrets of ancient artifacts. No combat just discovery. Every world has its story.

name: The Collectors
summary: Welcome to the vibrant world of animal civilization in The Collectors—a team of once-extinct and endangered animals working together to save the world from overflowing trash.

name: The Outlast Trials: Project Messiah
summary: Season 5: Project Messiah will include a new Prime Asset villain, a new map: Resort, Winter Kills and more!

name: That's Not Your Neighbor
summary: Spot the Doppelgangers! Take on the role of a doorman in your building. Year 1955, stay sharp, stay alert. Remember, kindness is key—treat your true neighbors with care while keeping the doppelgangers at bay. Can you keep your building safe? The challenge awaits!

name: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
summary: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

name: The Szechuan Sword: A PostModern Strategy Game
Thrifty Business
summary: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

name: The Dark Curiosity
summary: First-person sci-fi psychological horror set on a secret corporate station. Left alone to secure it, you navigate oppressive corridors where every sound, shadow and choice punishes. "Curiosity always leads you further than fear ever could."

name: The Plant Shop
summary: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.

name: Three Feet From Death
summary: Enter into what might be the most insane gaming challenge created - Three Feet from Death. A precision platformer with bullet-hell elements, responsive, fast paced gameplay, and a skill ceiling that even masters of the genre may spend their lives reaching for. Good luck.

name: The Battle of Polytopia: New Dawn Skin
summary: The New Dawn skin for Cymanti gives a cuter, more colorful appearance for their hordes of bugs and fungi.

name: The Last Gift
summary: A Christmas horror story about a thief who encounters a ghost in an “empty” house.

name: The Finals: Season 9 - Dragon Rising
summary: Dragon Rising draws from the depth and richness of Chinese culture with a blend of historic symbols, architectural styles, and modern city energy. There’s a new mode, a new Arena, and plenty more to uncover, so let’s take a look at Dragon Rising and dive into a fresh season of the World’s Greatest Gameshow.

name: The Temple of Elemental Evil
summary: Years ago a demoness's elemental cult ruled from a temple near Nulb until the Circle of Eight razed it. Now bandits stalk Hommlet and dark forces gather at the ruins. In this classic party‑based D&D RPG, unmask their true purpose and confront the reborn evil before chaos engulfs the land.

name: The Free Shepherd
summary: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

name: The Lightseeker
summary: The Lightseeker is a 2D pixel-art platformer in which you guide Analú, a young girl seeking her inner light in a world of darkness. Explore mysterious caves, shape paths with your lantern, and face trials in a deeply moving journey of self-discovery.

name: The Last Haven
summary:
After getting himself into a bunch of messes, gambling, betrayals, bad choices, Tom decides to flee into the woods and start his life over from scratch. But he didn't expect nature to have a surprise in store for him: bringing back all his “nightmares”, people with whom he still has scores to settle.

Use your Master of Gambits skills to collect resources in Brazilian biomes and defend yourself from the shadows that want to drive you away.

name: The Fiancée Has Never Known First Love: Motto Iinazuke
summary:
"Next time for sure, you'll make ME your fiancée, right?!"
This new release add Ayaka's route that wasn't present in the original game.

name: The Maze: L'ultimo soldato
summary: You have been chosen to descend into the abyss. No one told you why those before you never returned. Do not turn back. Do not listen to the noises in the corridors. You have one task: restore power to your nation before the Maze takes you. The mission is clear. Your fate is not.

name: The Herzbury Curse
summary: A cruel twist of fate lets Annalie and Archibald stumble into Herzbury, a cursed and long fallen castle. Now separated, it is upon Annalie to save her beloved brother. A potentially deadly adventure, filled with puzzles and whimsical characters.

name: The Glitch Prison Together
summary: Find bugs with your friends, exploit them, and escape!

name: The First Alkahistorian: Stage One
summary: The first stage of The First Alkahistorian, take the role of a young man seeking a cure for your father's illness by experimenting with the 4 basic elements across a small game that introduces its trilogy.

name: That Damn Fox
summary: That Damn Fox is a Quake engine based third person platformer with some high-octane gunplay action! Join Cam the Fox on her adventure to save her city from the evil Dr. Henney Penny and his plan to 'Taxerminate' the world with his reanimated-cybernetic animal army!

name: The Division 2: Mutiny
summary: Agents, The Division 2: Mutiny brings a shift in the conflict. True Sons defectors are breaking ranks, and we can recruit them as field ready Companions. With the Command Link system at the center of this season, your coordination with these recruits becomes a powerful tool in every fight. New threats, new equipment and a demanding Master Climax Mission will test how well you can adapt and work together.

name: Thirsty Princess
summary: Thirsty Princess is a fast-paced, top-down party game for 2–4 local players where you and your friends compete to drink beer with an impatient and unreasonable princess. Get drunk and slowly lose control while you brawl, steal from and sabotage your friends to win the favour of your princess.

name: The Gurgling
summary: A 3D Psychological Horror game where you navigate through tense levels filled with dread, fear, isolation and suffering as an unknown presence lurks beyond, leaving a trail of haunting sounds that are both oppressive and foreboding. Containing approximately 4-8 hours of disturbing gameplay.

name: The Boo Croo
summary: 4-player cooperative and competitive party game with various minigames where everyone can win... and everyone can lose!

name: The Frog That Leapt Too Far
summary: Frog was kidnapped by a crow, only to be trashed far away from home. He'll have to croak around to find his way back.

name: The Alters: Signature Edition
summary:
Explore an emotional sci-fi game with a unique blend of survival, adventure, and base-building elements. Help Jan Dolski, the sole survivor of an ill-fated space expedition, create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoils with this unconventional crew.

The Signature Edition contains:
Signature Edition Box
Digital download code in game box
Set of 4 pins
Metal keychain
Pierogi Press
Lenticular Card
Sticker Sheet

name: The Land Forgotten
summary: A hand-painted adventure puzzle game where language is magic. Explore a mysterious land, decipher ancient scripts, and solve language-based puzzles to uncover the secrets of a lost civilization.

name: The Christmas Cackler
summary: The Christmas Cackler is a first-person Christmas-themed Comedic Horror game where you play as little Jimmy, lying in bed on the night before Christmas, trying to finish drawing his mother's present and avoid getting grabbed by the Christmas Cackler!

name: The Purple Coin: Club Saturn Edition
The Sagittarian
summary: A zombie choose your own adventure game.

name: The Sagittarian 2
summary: The Sagittarian 2 is the second game of the point-and-click decision-making game series with a compelling story set in a post-zombie apocalypse.

name: The Void: An Incremental Roguelite
summary: Roll the reels to determine the outcome of your attacks! An unique mix of luck, strategy and incremental elements comes together in this colorful roguelite; battle out against other lost souls in turn-based combat while traversing through the void, trying to find answers to what you are.

name: The Witch's Fabulous Cracker Show
summary: Play as Cracker, the witch's errand boy. Collect ingredients for the ingenious cake plan and avoid the hungry children. Solve amusing puzzles, unlock new abilities, and explore the witty world of the Cracker Show.

name: The First Alkahistorian: Stage Two
summary: Take control of a young man and continue the research into the Elements 7 months since the first game, now with new systems and a new goal.

name: The Krampus Game
summary: The Krampus Game is a chaotic, scary-fun multiplayer adventure where ancient winter folklore turns into wild holiday mayhem. Inspired by real Krampus and Nikolaus parades, this game brings the tradition to life — but with more monsters, more laughs, and a whole lot more chaos.

name: The Sultand and his Harem
summary: The Sultan and His Harem is an adult strategy and relationship game where players step into the role of Suli, ruling the Ottoman Empire while building the most exquisite and diverse harem in history.

name: Those Nights at Fredbear's
summary: A faithful remake and completion of Nikson's original Those Nights at Fredbear's game.

name: The Amen Variations
summary: The unique Amen Break anthem. Make music generated in real time, shoot things in rhythm, defend your cores with musical towers and discover what electronic music is all about.

name: The Helios Incident
summary: A challenging top-down survivor game where your mind is your greatest enemy.

name: The Power of Fish
summary: Go fishing! Catch unique fish! And then... interrogate them?! The many fish in this pond may not be what they seem in this fishing-meets-detective game.

name: Thrust Issues
summary: A co-op adventure game about leaving a dying colonial planet by using the cartridges in a smart way on your P.S.M (Programmable Sequence Machine) before it's too late.

name: There's Blood in my Soup
summary:
Housed in an ex-funeral parlor, we invite you to immerse yourself and enjoy only the freshest ingredients in this one of a kind dining experience.

Our attentive jiangshi* staff members ensure that every visit is memorable, so do come and satiate your hunger to your mind’s content!

(*Rest assured they will not take your qi.)

name: The Final Front
summary: Free-to-play sci-fi hovercraft action that focuses on strategy, base building, and communication. Collaborate with your team to command mighty StarForts, inflict destruction, and eliminate the enemy team on strange new worlds.

name: Three Kingdoms Heroes
summary: Swallowing the Heaven and Earth Version of Zhao Yun's Biography, in which multiple girls fall in love with you, also known as: Zhao Yun's Harem Biography

name: The Rooster Files
summary: Panic strikes the heart of Miami as horrific massacres take place during the night. We've all seen this story a hundred times, however The Rooster Files takes a twist on your typical Hotline Miami story, as you can now play as both Jacket and the police who are trying to find him. After each level, return to the scene of the crime as the police and hunt for clues to track down the Rooster Man! Featuring Custom Music, Modded Sprites and 9 levels from easy to very hard!

name: The Last of Us Part II Remastered: Patch 2.0.0
summary:
Two new characters are being introduced for the 'No Return' mode – The Last of Us Part I’s Bill and Marlene. Like with each No Return combatant, these characters offer their own unique playstyles, and should offer both new and returning fans an exciting new opportunity to test their mettle. Bill is a “Smuggler” playstyle who can access a custom pump shotgun from dead drops, and receives double rewards from drops as well. He’s stronger against melee attacks but can’t dodge. Marlene, meanwhile, features a “Risk Taker” playstyle that includes a Custom Assault Rifle, “All or Nothing” gambits, can reroute her No Return path once per run, and more.

Four new maps have also been added to No Return. Overlook, which is set high above the city of Seattle and features plenty of verticality, is the memorable site of a Seraphites encounter in the campaign. School is, during the campaign, the abandoned elementary school in which Ellie and Dina face off against the W.L.F. Streets is set in the overgrown Seattle neighborhood of Hillcrest, while Nest will be familiar to players who have played as Abby through an Infected-infested building.

Other than bugfixes, a new cosmetic from Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet has been added for Ellie.

name: The Last of Us Part II Remastered: Chronological Experience
summary:
In this "Chronological Experience" update, new trophies, character skins, and a "Chronological" mode has been added.

We believe players will gain even deeper insight into Part II’s narrative. Players will be able to see how Ellie being gifted a guitar flows so neatly into her learning to play, for example, while the journey through Seattle will showcase the fascinating parallels between Ellie and Abby’s crisscrossing journeys. You’ll see just how close they come into running into each other, how their actions impact each other, and more.

The new trophies are tied to completing the narrative experience in chronological order, doing so will also unlock two new, perhaps surprisingly familiar skins…

name: The Predecessor
summary: Exploration-focused walking simulator. Traverse abstract worlds. Interact with enigmatic characters. Collect memories from the one who came before you.

name: The Moon Adventures of Apollo Starlight
summary: Embark on an interstellar journey like no other - a captivating 2D game that blends retro charm with modern excitement. Join the fearless astronaut, Apollo Starlight, as he explores the mysterious lunar landscapes, encountering enigmatic aliens, and completing thrilling objectives.

name: The Binding of Isaac: Most Unholy Edition
summary:
An updated version of the previous released Unholy Edition. This edition has the following content:

Steam gifting key
A fan-art poster
An Art Booklet with various design sketches from the developers

Along with new content exclusive to the Most Unholy Edition:

An DRM-Free physical disc of the updated version of The Binding of Isaac (v1.50)
The Binding of Isaac: Wrath of the Lamb expansion
The Soundtrack as MP3 files on the same disc that has the DRM-Free copy of The Binding of Isaac
Stickers

Only released in Europe

name: The Night Cleaner
summary: Night shift office cleaning. All that greets you, a new hire, is a dirty floor… and a formless sense of unease. In the silent floors above, something is unmistakably moving.

name: The Bomb Split
summary: Two mysterious, challenging platformers where you launch yourself with an infinite supply of bombs.

name: The Mirror Circle
summary: Naomi enters an abandoned mountain hotel searching for her missing sister. Armed only with a ritual mirror that reveals and purifies spirits, she must confront invisible horrors and uncover the truth hidden within the darkness.

name: The Seven Bad Apples
summary: Ranko and her friend Astrid must investigate the case of some missing scores just before the big Christmas concert of the academy. Help them question the seven daunting suspects before it's too late!

name: The Champions of Lootheim
summary: The Champions of Lootheim is an action roguelike where you face hordes of creatures to survive. Have fun defeating enemies to evolve your attributes throughout the game and buy permanent upgrades in the shop, as well as equipment dropped in chests by powerful enemies.

name: The Not-Deer Stew
summary: A Christmas folk-horror cooking adventure where you hunt the Not-Deer to finish the recipe.

name: The Future
summary: Defeat Futuristic Enemies In A Battle To Save The City

name: The Heart of the Earth
summary: Two soldiers are stuck together in a trench. And none of them are sane, that's for sure. They pursue different goals — but what would be left of their hopes when the field phone rings... for the first time in two years?

name: The Shaman Diary
summary: A turn-based RPG with strategic combat, character progression, and a strong narrative in a vast heroic-fantasy world... Level up, gear up, learn skills, and meet allies in an original story!

name: The Mushroom Journal
summary: The Mushroom Journal is a Single-Player RPG, that takes you on an adventure to Mush Meadows. Mush Meadows is a mushroom-centered village, where you will have to help your neighbours by identifying and collecting them to uncover the mysteries that may lie under trading table.

name: The Remains of Dahlia
summary: In the early 2010s, a housewife known as “Dahlia” was reported missing after running away from home. Her husband, Bowo, filed a report with the police, but the investigation yielded no results. With no clear answers, Bowo decided to investigate the case on his own.

name: The Light Of Our Yearning
summary: I marched to the shine like moth to death, yearning for salvation

name: The Servers Are Shutting Down in 24 Hours but My Pull Rate's Been Set to 0.0001%?!
summary: The servers for Forgelight Moon are shutting down in 24 hours, but Lamona - Witch-in-Training (SSR)'s pull rate has been set to 0.0001%! At this rate, nobody will pull her before server shutdown...

name: The Frog Festival
summary: Restore music and color to a cozy archipelago as a small frog, exploring instrument-themed islands and helping friendly frogs along the way.

name: The Nightmares at The Krusty Krab
summary: A fan-made FPS survival horror game where players control SpongeBob as he fights waves of enemies and searches for an escape inside a nightmarish version of the Krusty Krab.

name: The Legend of Dad: Quest for Milk
summary: The Legend of Dad is a speed running adventure game. You have to help baby Seb get his milk before he gets too hungry. Use the energy drinks to give you an extra boost. Can you find all the keys and get to the milk before the time runs out?

name: The Honest Little Fisher
summary: A cozy fishing game made with care, full of discovery, gentle progression, and hundreds of things to catch. Set out to explore the sea, upgrade your boat, and uncover stories, fun facts, and legendary finds along the way.

name: The Duke
summary: The Duke wants to eat sandwiches, a lot of them… so grab your bread and get to work.

name: The Forever Winter: Holiday Hangover
summary: The Forever Winter Holiday Hangover Skin Pack includes: The U-PAC Skin for Gunhead The Dedwak Skin for Shaman The Kevlar Cake Skin for Scav Girl

name: The Artisan of Glimmith
summary: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

name: The Coin
summary: The Coin is a thrilling clicker game where a simple coin flip becomes a high-stakes gamble. Heads or tails—pure luck decides. But beware: the longer your streak, the bigger the rewards… and the risk. Can you quit while you're ahead?

name: The Fox's Dream
summary: Solve puzzles and unravel mysteries with the little fox. Look for clues scattered around the level, find patterns in them and become a hero with the cute fox

name: The Painting of Gustavo Repaintend
summary: Complete the painting, complete the painting, complete the painting, watch out for Gustavo, complete the painting, watch out for monsters, complete the painting, it's dangerous, find the puzzles and COMPLETE THE PAINTING

name: The Aurora Chronicles
summary: A crew of four. Mysteries at the edge of known space. A utopia that might be more fragile than it appears. The Aurora Chronicles is an episodic sci-fi visual novel where your choices shape relationships, uncover buried secrets, and test whether hope can survive what you discover.

name: The Princess That Was Turned into a Doll
summary:
This game is not intended for children.

SFW. Creepy atmosphere, but not intended as horror.

Short, branching narrative about transformation and loss of agency.

Developed for the Doll & Kigu-jam: https://itch.io/jam/dollandkigujam

name: The Criminal
summary:
Roam around the beautiful open world, looting and stealing. But remember, all your actions have consequences. With your car full of stolen loot, race back to your hideout with police tight on your heels, trying to arrest you. If they capture you, all loot is lost. However.
Make it back to your hideout, and the loot is yours to sell, earning you a nice quick buck.
Use money to Upgrade your skills and vehicles. Every unlockable car and hideout has different useful benefits, that will help you on your journey.

name: The Symbiant + The Symbiant Re:Union Bundle
summary:
The Symbiant + The Symbiant Re:Union Bundle contains:

The Symbiant
The Symbiant - OST
The Symbiant - PG-13 Artbook & CG Pack
The Symbiant - Game Choice & Achievement Guide
The Symbiant Re:Union
The Symbiant Re:Union - PG-13 Artbook & CG Pack

name: The Coma 2B: Catacomb - Deluxe Edition
summary:
The Coma 2B: Catacomb Deluxe Edition contains:
The Coma 2B: Catacomb
The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Child of Destiny Skin
The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Gamer Skin
The Coma 2B: Catacomb - The Survivalist Skin
The Coma 2B: Catacomb Artbook
The Coma 2B: Catacomb Original Soundtrack

name: The Promise Tree of Alden
summary: The Promise Tree of Alden is a short, atmospheric narrative experience about remorse, memory, and the silence of a forest once alive.

name: The Town of Nowhere: End Of The Line
summary: This is the first downloadable entry in the Town of Nowhere series. This game was made with the intention of being playable and enjoyable regardless of if you know the back story of the larger surrealist horror series. Largely inspired by CGA DOS adventure games TTON:EotL is in full first person 3D.

name: The Dagby Files
summary: Assemble beautiful hand-illustrated jigsaw puzzles to unveil the clues as intrepid Inspector Dagby investigates dastardly crimes. Listen in as Dagby questions the suspects. Then solve the case yourself! Seven perplexing mysteries await. Features 28 brand-new illustrations from artist Dave Montes.

name: The Big Hollow: 1982
summary: A serial killer’s dumping ground is exposed. Find details in the evidence, interpret their behaviors, and prove your worth to the FBI’s new Behavioral Science Unit. A dark, atmospheric 2D animated murder mystery.

name: The Approaching Quiet
summary:
The Fog is enveloping the Earth

The last hope for Humanity is reaching the spaceship bound to the stars before the Earth is swallowed whole. You're a bus driver, driving what few survivors are left to the launch pad.

The Approaching Quiet is a turn-based tactical RPG about hard choices.

Manage your food and fuel to reach your destination

Decide who you can bring with you, and who will be left behind for the Fog

The story and gameplay are different each run!

name: The Moon Looks Beautiful Tonight: Definitive Edition
summary: The Moon Looks Beautiful Tonight: Definitive Edition is a Yuri Visual Novel about fear of the unknown. The re-release is a complete edit of the original story, including new graphics, an original OST, and an updated story.

name: Thrust Me Bro
summary: A physics party brawler for up to 4 players. Momentum is your weapon! Thrust, charge, and slam your friends off the arena in family-friendly local couch co-op chaos that's easy to learn and hard to master. Grab controllers and start shoving each other into space.

name: The Invention of "Q"
summary: A new letter has arrived, and the Alphabet Meeting is in disarray. You have the tiebreaker vote... do you admit Q?

name: The Angel's Tears
summary: A child braves the dark forest, to help someone in need.

name: The Daily Spell
summary: The Daily Spell is a daily word puzzle game with an ongoing story. Unscramble the headlines by dropping letters into place and discover each day's top story from a magical world.

name: The Granny Detective Society
summary: A cozy and quirky detective game where Madeline, a retired little mouse, watches her street and dives into thrilling investigations… until the Granny Detective Society contacts her and she discovers that the whole neighborhood is living a double life… especially the grannies.

name: The Dream of Jacob
summary: Travel as Jacob through the most transcendent astral dream ever told. Discover heaven and hell, overcoming unexpected challenges and fighting your inner demons. Will you reach the top of the ladder?

name: The Dinner Table
summary: A blend of visual novel elements with platforming levels. An ode to the challenging levels of the 16-bit era. No checkpoints.

name: Theory
summary:
(This project was made in 48 hours for Ludum Dare 49, "Unstable".)

You are Erwin, a cat that has been captured by a race of alien robots, the Drexl'erin. After weeks of experimentation on you, you've developed the ability to shift between a living and dead state, but only when not being observed. You must use this power to escape your captors.

name: The Forest Watches
summary: You are the newest member of a forest cult. Complete assigned rituals, obey their rules, and uncover the forest’s unsettling secrets. Every step is watched.

name: The Cursed Moon: The Girl Trapped in the Haunted House
summary: After hearing a young girl's cry for help, Yukine as a kami went in to the unknowned dimension to help. While helping the ghosts on the way to fulfill their wishes, she also has to solve riddles and traps. Will Yukine be able to save the girl from this cursed dimension ...?

name: The Trolling Adventure
summary: Troll Adventures is a hilarious and unconventional puzzle game created by the trolls for the trolls. Get ready to embark on a wacky journey around the world filled with mind-bending challenges.

name: The Bubonicz
summary: Outsmart zombies and deadly traps using the environment as your weapon in BubonicZ, a third-person horror puzzle of survival in a plague-ravaged prison.

name: The Beginner Investor
summary: Start from scratch, learn the market, and build your fortune in this accessible stock market tycoon game. Buy, sell, and diversify your way to wealth!

name: The Rumble Fish 2: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
summary:
The Fight for Survival
The legendary fighting game has returned sporting new features!

name: The Board is Yours
summary: The Board is Yours is a strategic chess-based incremental game: buy squares, unlock upgrades, and chain synergies through defended pieces. It plays as a demanding idle game where you’ll constantly reposition pieces and optimize your production until the board belongs to you.

name: The Beautiful World
summary: You are a cube. A mysterious voice wakes you up and promises a beautiful world above. The only way to see it is by climbing. Jump between platforms, press un-labeled buttons and discover what this world has to offer.

name: The Last Joy
summary: The play center was once a vibrant and happy place filled with children's laughter and the latest interactive toys. However, a mysterious accident caused its sudden closure. Nobody knows exactly what happened

name: The Clockwork Requiem
summary: When a band of survivors unearths a rare ore said to power Aetherforge's miraculous machines, they see it as their final hope for salvation. But as they journey to trade it, the party is drawn into secrets, whispers of vanished ages, and a truth that could unmake what remains of their world.

name: The Isolated
summary: You are an ordinary man who found himself in the wrong place at the wrong time. Your plane crashes off the coast of a sinister island, hidden from civilization by a shroud of fog and rumor.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: West Gondor
summary: The West Gondor Quest Pack unlocks the region of Western Gondor, which is designed for characters around level 95. This area is rich in story content and scenic locations, offering players a chance to explore iconic places from Tolkien’s world.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: Central Gondor
summary: The Central Gondor Quest Pack continues the Gondor storyline after Western Gondor, focusing on the escalating conflict as the shadow of Mordor spreads deeper into Gondor’s heartlands. This pack is designed for characters around level 100+ and unlocks several key regions and quests.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: East Gondor
summary:
The East Gondor Quest Pack unlocks adventures for characters around level 100+ in the eastern regions of Gondor. It includes:

Regions:

Upper Lebennin
Lossarnach
South Ithilien

Major Hub: Osgiliath, the ruined city on the Anduin River.
Instances:

The Sunken Labyrinth
The Ruined City
The Dome of Stars

LOTRO Store Info: This pack provides quests, deeds, and instances in Eastern Gondor. It is purchasable with LOTRO Points and free for VIP players.
