name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: Old Anórien
summary:
The Old Anórien Quest Pack unlocks adventures in some of the most iconic locations of Gondor during the climactic moments of the War of the Ring. It is designed for characters level 100+ and includes:

Regions:

Pelennor Fields – the vast battlefield outside Minas Tirith.
Talath Anor – the sunlit plains leading to the White City.
Minas Tirith – the seven-tiered city under siege.

Epic Battle Content:
Participate in the Battle of Pelennor Fields, one of the most famous conflicts in Tolkien’s lore.
LOTRO Store Info:
This pack provides quests, deeds, and epic battle scenarios in Old Anórien.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Region Pack: Far Anórien
summary:
The Far Anórien Region Pack unlocks content for characters around level 100–105, bridging the story between Old Anórien and the climactic Battle of Pelennor Fields. It includes:

Regions:

Beacon Hills – rolling hills dotted with Gondorian beacons.
Drúadan Forest (Taur Drúadan) – home to the mysterious Wose people.

Key Features:

Over 60 quests supporting levels 100–105.
Instance Cluster – Battle of Pelennor Fields:

Blood of the Black Serpent (Small Fellowship)
The Quays of the Harlond (Small Fellowship)
The Silent Street (Full Fellowship)

Raid: Throne of the Dread Terror – a massive 12-person raid.

LOTRO Store Info: Available for purchase with LOTRO Points (free for VIP players).

name: The Key Riddle
summary: Exciting riddles and more are ahead of you. Try not to lose yourself in the maze walls. The key riddle is not for those with weak hearts, you enter the village at your own risk. Doors are not doors, the walls are high.

name: The Short Story Of A Riftkeeper
summary: The Short Story of A Riftkeeper is a first-person story-based game about a particular Riftkeeper, one who is tasked to close doors in the Rifts to prevent any unwanted things from entering the universe.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: Legacy of the Necromancer
summary:
The Legacy of the Necromancer Quest Pack unlocks content for characters around level 115, taking players to the Strongholds of the North. This includes:

Regions:

Eryn Lasgalen (formerly Northern Mirkwood)
Dale-lands
Lake-town
Erebor

Content:

Over 100 quests and deeds
New reputation factions tied to Elves of Felegoth, Men of Dale, and Dwarves of Erebor

LOTRO Store Info: Available as a quest pack or included with VIP access.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: Where Dragons Dwell
summary:
This quest pack unlocks adventures in the Dwarf-holds of the Grey Mountains, the Iron Hills, and Erebor. Key features include:

Regions:

Ered Mithrin and Withered Heath
Expanded halls beneath the Lonely Mountain

Content:

Over 120 quests and deeds for levels 115–120
Grey Mountains Instance Cluster: Caverns of Thrumfall, Glimmerdeep
Raid: The Anvil of Winterstith

LOTRO Store Info: Available for purchase or free for VIPs and Lifetime members.

name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: The Vales of Anduin
summary:
This quest pack unlocks adventures in the Vales of the Great River, a lush region between the Misty Mountains and Mirkwood. Key features include:

Regions Covered:

Beorning-lands
Wilderlands
Great Eagle eyries
Gladden Fields
Edges of Lothlórien

Content:

Over 150 quests and deeds for level 120 characters
A 6-player instance: The Depths of Kidzul-kâlah

LOTRO Store Info: Available for purchase or free for VIP players.

name: The Cold Hand
summary: A simple 2D platformer featuring collectibles, enemies, multiple levels, and multiple endings which are achieved based on the combination of your actions within each level, all deriving from the overarching story of your character's struggle with mental health.

name: This is Adam
summary: A man called Adam was just created. Help him make the choices he isn't able to make himself and guide him to the ending you think Adam deserves.

name: The Eagle Keita
summary: An eagle is about to lay an egg. She has lost her mate and has to face the rest of her life alone: constantly getting food and bringing it back to the nest.

name: Thailand Bus Simulator
summary: Thailand Bus Simulator is a bus driving simulation game that delivers a fun and realistic Thailand bus experience. Drive iconic Thailand buses across a large map, travel from city to city, and enjoy diverse road scenery inspired by real environments.

name: The Elven Forest VR
summary: Experience the elven hospitality as their guest of honor... The Elven Forest VR offers an erotic Virtual Reality experience with realistic animations and carefully crafted lighting and sound effects to create maximum immersion.

name: The Perplexing Orb: Bounce Mania
summary: The Perplexing Orb returns in the final chapter of the Bounce series, Bounce Mania! Welcome to the world of The Perplexing Orb, an arcade game where you roll the orb through various stages dodging obstacles, collecting items, and knocking down the finish post without falling off! Bounce Mania brings all new levels, enhanced art, new platforms, and new obstacles to dodge!

name: The Lustful Champion
summary: The Lustful Champions is a Visual novel mixed with CCG elements. This game has been inspired by old adult-comedy comics from the early 2000s. Multiple paths, multiple endings, and multiple cards to collect. 112 collectible CG images!

name: The Other Order
summary: A surreal tile-based roguelike where you build and reshape tile combinations to attack your enemies.

name: Thief's Market
summary: Sneak into houses and steal valuables without being noticed. Set up your market with stolen items, haggle with tough customers and use your cards to convince them. Master the art of the steal and the deal.

name: Thriftgirl
summary: a mini memoir about being trans in 2024.

name: The Forsaken Tomb
summary: The Forsaken Tomb is a first-person anomaly-spotting psychological horror game set in an endlessly shifting tomb. Observe subtle environmental changes and choose the correct path to progress, with randomised room generation, two modes, and four difficulty levels.

name: The Last Lighthouse
summary: A cozy yet tense management game where you maintain a magical Lighthouse. Become a lighthouse spirit, balance daily duties, and aid incoming ships, all while the world around you slowly dims and is consumed by ever-creeping darkness.

name: Thot on Trial
summary: Thot on Trial is an adult NTR visual novel with cuck sim elements and a touch of corruption. Control both husband and wife as they navigate temptation in LA. Will you try to save their marriage, or tear it apart one choice at a time? The outcome is entirely up to you.

name: The NewZealand Story: Untold Adventure
summary: The NewZealand Story comes back to life with Bitobit: experience the adventure of Tiki, the little Kiwi created by Taito in 1988, in a colorful 2D platformer full of challenges and nostalgia!

name: The Black Route
summary: The contract has you lined up for 10 days driving the Black Rails, make sure the goods arrive. Callers can't resist the train's rumble.

name: The Seventh Variable
summary: Infiltrate Shuangqing City, a cyberpunk metropolis. As a mercenary, plan your base by day and execute high-stakes contracts by night. Use your hacking skills to tip the balance of power among three factions and shape the city's future.

name: The Monster Pimp
summary: A story about a guy and monsters of Japan!! Hearing rumors about the monsters, the main character goes out on a search for monsters using his special ability. Fight off the Evil Spirits and unlock the secret...

name: The Golden Girl Cloud Top Board
summary: It is a tactical magic battle game.4 girls come to Genting, they are ready to compete here. In each match, killing a specified enemy is considered a victory. Different cosmetic treatments can have different effects.

name: The Wailing of the Forest
summary: A short horror game about a folkloric ghost from the Costa Rican rainforest. Originally created for 2023's Global Game Jam.

name: The Sweetness that Returned
summary: Join Lia, Sofi, and Tomás in the Sweetness Rebellion and bring joy back to a candy-free city with the help of a magical sugar fairy!

name: The Secret Workshop of Wishes
summary: Nila and three toys bring laughter to Santa Claus; he gives her a magic paintbrush and they create the Kindness Express.

name: The Dismissed Case: Black Hollow
summary: An old case closed due to lack of evidence resurfaces in 1993. Play as a dismissed detective, investigate the case, gather evidence, solve the mystery, and uncover the truth. Bringing justice to the town of Ridgemour and ending the uncertainty is in your hands.

name: The Starfallen Prince
summary: The Starfallen Prince, an action-RPG bullet heaven where an invasion shatters Belden’s world, Losing everything he held dear. Driven by loss, he escapes into the wilds to begin a journey of survival, revenge and the fate of his people.

name: The Lewd of the Cock Rings: The Return of Doug Fooker
summary: This is a fantasy, turn-based, RPG game involving nudity and sexual situations. The main character is a male protagonist roaming the countryside trying to stop the evil antagonist. Random re-playable interactive sex scenes are located throughout the entire game involving varied anthromorphs.

name: The Last Element
summary: The Last Element is a platformer game, that challenge you. Gon on a journey in this strange world, full of hurt and cunning. Explore black&white location, solve difficult puzzles, destroy your enemies. Try to find last element and solve main nystery of this universe.

name: The Incident
summary:
This content shares the combination of Five Nights At Freddy's 2-3-4.

Also this game has point and click free roaming features,

The game features a flashlight, door, Sounds, vent lock, locker mechanics...

name: The Case of Arcadia Springs
summary: A short, story-driven, detective-mystery game where you are tasked with solving a deceptively simple break-in case. Meet the citizens of Arcadia Springs, find and follow the clues, make the right choices, and you may unlock a dark secret kept under lock and key.

name: The Watching Woods: The Louse
summary: Twelve-year-old Leva, returning to the mining village after the hospital, learns about the mysterious disappearance of his friend, and the familiar rhythms of school life begin to unravel. Soon, his days turn into a terrifying nightmare, accompanied by the relentless stomping of hundreds of insects.

name: The Last Frame
summary: The Last Frame is a psychological horror experience about following the traces of a missing father. As you explore the places he left behind, it becomes clear that his need to observe and document may have changed more than he intended.

name: The Rebellion
summary: Fuel a people’s uprising through fast turn-based tactical battles and hard choices; lead your heroes, stretch scarce resources, heed the crowd’s needs, plan each move with care, break the tyrant’s grip, and let hope rise again!

name: The Academy of the Cosmic Realm
summary: The Academy of the Cosmic Realm is a short first-person horror game where you explore an old abandoned academy to discover what terrible event led to it's closure.

name: The Dreadthorn Therapist
summary: A mysterious black fog covers the skies, plunging Dreadthorn into endless night, corrupting some residents. In this horror therapist-sim, run your business, decide your clients’ fate, and survive what seems like end times.

name: The Princess Factory
summary: The Princess Factory is an anomaly-detection horror game where you check princess animatronics for errors in a mysterious factory beneath an abandoned fairy-tale theme park. Your actions may determine far more than simply whether or not you get out alive...but which path will you choose?

name: The Hollow Keep
summary: Some believe the castle exists. Others insist it’s just a lure. Paul and his friends decide to find out for themselves.

name: The Meek Mirtho
summary:
The Meek Mirtho is a top-down strategic roguelite. In the demon world, power is everything — and power is earned through fear. You play as Mirtho, a small, harmless demon who has been bullied and cast aside for being “unscary.” But weakness is a matter of perception.

Using your unique talent for manipulation, you escape into the human world to find anxious souls and twist their fears into loyalty. These frightened humans become your army — not through terror, but through wit.

The game blends maze-running and deck-building mechanics. In each wave, you’ll have limited time to explore a grid-based maze, gather followers, and collect scattered equipment (weapons and armor). Equip your human allies to evolve them into new character classes, unlocking them permanently in your collection.

Guide your followers through the gateway to challenge the boss of the wave. Battles unfold as automatic, turn-based card fights, where your preparation determines the outcome. Fail, and your dark little revenge story resets… but your legacy grows stronger with each run.

name: The Sims 4: Royalty & Legacy
summary: A lifestyle expansion for The Sims 4 focused on aristocratic drama and dynasty-building. Manage family prestige and unity as you vie for a throne, shape a kingdom in the new world of Ondarion, and navigate scandals, rivalries, and romantic intrigue.

name: The Tiny Chef Show: Cooking with Fwends
summary: Cheffy’s opening a pop-up restaurant and needs your help. Shrink down and cook up something tasty in Tiny Chef’s cozy kitchen.

name: Third Person Basketball Court
summary: Rise to the top of basketball with your aim and movement skills! “TPBC” is a third-person, online multiplayer basketball game that brings the familiar controls of FPS/TPS titles straight to the court. Take on skilled players from around the world and prove your mastery!

name: The Trial of Kharzoid
summary: The Trial of Kharzoid is an arkanoidvania for the NES. It combines classic brick-breaking games like Arkanoid with Castlevania's classic elements like exploration, defeating huge bosses and eating chicken you find in walls! The goal is to navigate through the deadly levels and go back to Kharzoid's tower to defeat this son of a witch. You will learn more about the lore by talking to NPCs.

name: The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy - Nintendo Switch Version with Sleeve
summary: A Special Edition released in Japan, including the game with a special sleeve, an acrylic block with the keyart of HUNDRED LINE 2 and a badge set featuring the characters Takumi Sumino and Eito Aotsuki.

name: The Last Star Walker: Season 1
summary: The Last Star Walker is a story-focused adult visual novel where magic and technology collide. Navigate deep relationships, make tough choices, and shape a universe-spanning conflict as a doppelgänger caught between two planets: magical Navā and technological Terra.

name: The Titty-Fucking Hot Spring Ryokan Ghost
summary: This is a titty-fucking only exploration horror game.

name: The SeethingSwarm Collection
summary: A curated anthology of classic Flash games by SeethingSwarm. Play 25+ games from the golden age of the web — preserved just as they were, with fullscreen support (F11) — all launched through a console-style retro menu.

name: The Williams Family Sacrifice
summary: Things have been hard for Elizabeth Williams after the tragic death of her husband. She has been doing all she can for her family, but she has been struggling and she's starting to slip. Hopefully she doesn't slip too far...

name: The Shrink Season Two
summary: The Shrink is an AVN. This is the continuation of the story from Season One. In Season Two you get to continue playing the game right after the events of Season One.

name: The Wizard's Dolly Break
summary: The Wizards Dolly Break is the visual novel equivalent of leaning over my shoulder as I play with my dolls, please enjoy~

name: The Blighted Core
summary: Rot has arrived, and all things wither. In this cruel yet beautiful 2D hand-drawn Souls-like, embark on a lonely and brutal journey of redemption! Explore a forest kingdom twisted by plague, and battle infected, mutated fruits and vegetables to uncover the secret behind the corruption.

name: The Empty Eyes
summary: The Empty Eyes is a first-person psychological horror experience that immerses you in an investigation steeped in mystery. Every step inside the house brings you closer to a hidden truth, while tension mounts and fear takes root in your mind.

name: The Harakin
summary: Hunt challenging monsters across shifting planets in this top-down action-RPG. Craft gears with monster parts, cook meals to get buffs, track your target, hunt or capture it, then return to cash rewards and repeat the loop.

name: The Bookman
summary: A reporter uncovers the story, revealing that the hospital staff have fallen victim to a mysterious creature whose face is made of book pages. Traveling through various locations of the hospital, the player will collect clues and solve puzzles to uncover the truth.

name: The Last Call
summary: The Last Call is an FMV + FPS action game. Mack is an ex-DEA agent armed with the memories of his murdered wife and an unstoppable rage. Mack will need to wage a one-man war searching drug safehouses and shooting through cartel nightclubs to deliver his own brand of justice… no matter the cost.

name: The happiness of maggots
summary: It is a visual novel AVG with a female beta as the protagonist,. At a noisy drinking party after work, you'll start the story and learn about the experiences of the protagonist and the people he cares about, and decide how they end up in the story.

name: The Reason My Wife Has Gotten More Beautiful
summary:
Rintaro Tsukamoto has begun to notice a curious change: his beloved wife seems to grow more radiant with each passing day. Though this should be a welcome change, it stirs up a sense of anxiety in him. Something is off, and driven by his deepening curiosity, he resolves to seek out the man who has become secretly entangled with his wife, walking a path of self-discovery and self-destruction.

Follow Rintaro's story as you uncover the secrets behind his wife's sudden change in this compelling visual novel. Dive into the mysteries and read through events with stunning art and beautiful backgrounds that help bring the story to life.

name: The Lost Painter
summary: Welcome to The Lost Painter, A single player, first person, atmospheric walking simulator exploring liminal spaces. Enter your Paintings and explore a world full of mystery and Horror. Storm the beaches of Normandy, Get lost in the Backroooms and Survive the Devils Labyrinth.

name: The Round-about Orchard
summary: The Round-about Orchard is a super tiny fan project (about 15 minutes of play time!) that reunites some Over the Garden Wall folks (creator Patrick McHale, background artist Levon Jihanian, musicians The Blasting Company, and Elijah Wood is back as Wirt!) to create this nugget of point-and-click adventure gaming!

name: The Scaling
summary: The Scaling is a platformer with special mechanics. Increase and decrease to overcome obstacles.

name: The Land of Stuff
summary: The Land of Stuff is an online multiplayer role-playing game. You can explore a vast world solo or with friends, battling monsters, gaining loot and completing story quests.

name: They Walk Beyond
summary: You wake alone in a bunker on a desolate alien world, and the mysterious commands on your computer may be the only key to your survival. There's something very big moving outside.

name: The Story of the Rice House
summary: Players cultivate various rice varieties to breed rice that meets the needs of the people, and have merchants collect ingredients from all over Taiwan to develop and unlock new products and earn research funds.

name: The Anomaly Manor
summary: There's a mansion with a dark legend: Whoever enters disappears forever. Equipped with your spectral camera, you decide to delve inside to investigate. Locate and photograph the anomalies to escape before the wandering souls catch you!

name: The Lost Block
summary: A fun adventure where three friends save Cubilandia with imagination, friendship and surprises.

name: The Letter That Came Over Time
summary: A remake of Casablanca ni Ai o: Satsujinsha wa Jikū o Koete which changed from being a text adventure with graphics to using menus instead.

name: The Fallen Will
summary: Play as an Ublum, half-cat half-human, in a perilous ascent of the Abyss. Explore unique and varied biomes, establish your refuges, and shape your story in the heart of nature. An atmospheric adventure blending survival, mystery, and dark cuteness. The truth awaits at the summit.

name: The Curator
summary: The Curator is a gallery-management roguelite about managing your own traveling exhibition. Upgrade your van and constantly re-organize artworks to unleash synergies while satisfying picky visitors. Prepare for special events and curate a collection that pleases everyone, including the Baron Family.

name: The Carcass
summary: A deep roguelike colony RPG inside a dead god's corpse. Procedurally generated events, branching narratives, species with unique traits, and meaningful choices that shape your colony's fate. Every playthrough tells a different story of survival and evolution.

name: The Cemetery Shift
summary:
The Cemetery Shift is a short, first-person horror story that takes place over a single night. You play as a college student working an overnight security job at a remote cemetery in the Arkansas woods.
You’ll spend most of your shift monitoring CCTV feeds from the security booth, then stepping out to investigate when the cameras catch something suspicious. Search the grounds, interact with the environment, and follow the trail of events to keep the night moving forward.

name: The Skin Stapler
summary: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.

name: The End of the Beginning of Courage, Reasoning, and Seaweed 10
The Run
summary: An FMV horror-thriller. A famous fitness influencer must fight for survival when she's hunted by killers. Your decisions determine whether she lives or dies.

name: The Joy of Putting
summary: Relive the era of Flash mini-golf games on more than 54 holes based on real courses! And do it... for The Joy of Putting!

name: The Donut Gallery
summary: The showcase of student donuts and other 3d models from their stemmersion class.

name: The Other Plumber
summary: Inspired by the release of CorgiSpace and SEBI16, the author wanted to try out PICO-8. Here is the result! His first PICO-8 game, made between January 18th-22nd of 2026.

name: The Rite of Lilium
summary:
Literature, yuri, and light-filled horror.
A horror adventure set in a girls' school in modern Japan.

name: The Empty Halls
summary: The Empty Halls is a VHS analog horror exploration game inspired by the idea of liminal spaces. Explore eerie Backrooms-style environments, record strange anomalies with your VHS camera, and complete missions assigned by the anonymous higher ups.

name: The Lucky Stray Cat
summary: “The Lucky Stray Cat” is a hybrid Dungeon Crawler and Visual Novel, told through an urban horror narrative reminiscent of Junji Ito's storytelling style.

name: The Sea Lion
summary: Hunt other animals as a sea lion and enjoy thrilling underwater hunts without any predators.

name: The Rot Below
summary: Discover the secrets of a mad lich who thought themselves a god. Explore an ancient palace, a subterranean city of the undead, and an insane warlock's research hall. Includes three boss battles, a voice acted story, new weapons, and a host of new enemies. Foil Namira's plans and stop the coming rot.

name: The First Spine - Arena
summary: The First Spine Arena is an exhilarating online competitive board and card game. In this game, players place their unique cards on a board with the goal of reaching their opponent's side. Each card is generated according to the player's level, ensuring a balanced and challenging experience for all.

name: The December Job
summary: The December Job is a short first-person horror stealth game built with that classic feel. Navigate a maze like workshop filled with dimly lit hallways and storage rooms as you attempt to collect a target number of deserved gifts.

name: The Another World
summary: The Another World is a fantasy-themed adventure game where you have to defeat the monster king, but before that, you have to find a key to open each door to reach the monster king, and every time you look for the key, there will be monsters in your way! Be careful

name: The Hero of Destiny Was Killed by the Final Boss
summary: How many NPCs equal 1 Hero? In the land of Alta, The Hero of Destiny was fated to defeat a terrible Dark Wizard... but the Hero of Destiny was killed by the final boss. What now? Next to the final dungeon, in a sleepy village, 50 NPCs decide to take matters into their own hands.

name: The Game Has Started
summary: The Game Has Started is a horror indie murder mystery visual novel game. Investigate the murders, prepare for trials and build up different realtionships with characters! Game perfectly matches the aesthetics of old-retro visual novels. Face the trials, as *they* remember who you truly are.

name: The Bistro: Ryouri & Wine no Shokunin tachi
summary:
The Bistro - Ryouri & Wine no Shokunin-tachi is a simulation game in which the player can own his own bistro restaurant hiring the different staff members, selecting the foods and drinks, etc. The goal of the game is to have the best restaurant of the city.

The game features 3 main countries to choose (Japanese, Italian & French) over 230 different wine kinds and a complete encyclopedia of meals and drinks.

name: The Last Night: Zombie Attack
summary: This game is a tense, atmospheric survival experience built around exploration, pressure, and learning the environment through failure and persistence.

name: The Saplum Cradle
summary: A choose-your-own-adventure horror game about using the memories of the dead to scavenge lost civilisations.

name: The Devil Card
summary: The Devil Card is a card battle game inspired by Final Fantasy VIII’s Triple Triad. Select 5 cards and place them on the Grid. Flip opponent cards to win, collect them, and progress through the story. Defeat the Devil to earn his soul card and complete the campaign, or play with custom rules in Freeplay mode.

name: The No Arms Knight
summary: TNAK is a 2D adventure packed with action and typing, where you'll need to type accurately, use your skills strategically, and type-type-type. You'll control Wailo, a knight who has lost his armor, and will defeat all his enemies to get it back.

name: The Darklight Chronicles
summary: A text adventure game made by heavensouls.

name: The Llama
summary: Experience a lovely day out walking the beautiful British countryside with your new animal friend Rosie, the llama! Soak in the stunning views of Mortfordshire and relax in the serene peace of nature. Just be sure to stick to the trails and not wander off too far.

name: Thunderhawk: Danger Close
summary: Fire the ferocious guns of an AC-130 as you escort friendlies in this chaotic 90s arcade-inspired on-rails shooter! Decimate waves of enemy soldiers and turn vehicles into scrap with high explosive rounds. Avoid a Game Over with accurate gunfire, carefully timed reloads, and quick bursts of flares!

name: The Saint
summary: The Saint" is a first-person psychological horror set in eerie liminal spaces with VHS body cam visuals. Explore a decaying dreamworld, solve symbolic puzzles, and escape a nightmare inspired by the dread and mystery of Silent Hill.

name: The Great Indian Safari
summary: Build an Indian wildlife reserve, rewild habitats, design safari routes, and capture breathtaking wildlife photography. Balance ecosystem health with ecotourism as you grow from local park to global conservation icon.

name: The Shattered Mind of Lucas Hayes
summary: A first-person walking simulator focused on atmosphere and introspection, where players explore surreal spaces, discover memories, and move at their own pace through a calm, dreamlike experience.

name: The Case of the Dungeon Descent
summary:
The princess has disappeared in the dungeon! Scry on magical events to deduce what spells were cast when, piece together the stories of multiple adventurers, and uncover the princess’s fate.

Inspired by games like Type Help, The Roottrees Are Dead, and Her Story.

name: The Alighieri Circle: Dante’s Bloodline
summary: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

name: That's My Seat
summary: Welcome to That’s My Seat – Logic Puzzle, the hit game where every level is a fun brain teaser! Your challenge: place each character in the correct seat by following clever rules. Easy to start, but only the sharpest minds will master them all.

name: The Great Sneeze
summary: A short, witty point & click game for kids, teenagers and all other art enthusiasts.

name: The Lone Hero
summary:
The Lone Hero is an independent PC action game developed by a solo developer.
The game focuses on combat against enemies using three different abilities.
Players can earn in-game currency to unlock new playable characters.

name: The House on the Hill
summary: First-person horror exploration game! You've just moved to a new rural town and you've been tasked with babysitting the neighbor kid. Only, things in this town seem strange. Explore the world and solve the secrets of your neighborhood while still being a half-decent babysitter.

name: The Billion Clicker
summary: Could you reach the billion? Idle clicker game with simple goals but very addictive gameplay

name: The Most Difficult Ball Game
summary: Getting Over It — but with a ball.

name: The Remains and The Residue
summary: The Remains and The Residue is a story-based linear adventure game where you play the stories and the memories of the famous author Janus Brennhart.

name: The Archive
summary: Welcome to the Case Processing Unit. Classify forgotten reports, uncover hidden patterns, and discover why this backlog exists, and why you were brought in to handle it.

name: The Bartlett Saga
summary: An educational game for the ICON.

name: The Red Pearls of Borneo
summary:
The Red Pearls of Borneo is a detective mystery deduction game inspired by Type Help, Return of the Obra Dinn and The Case of the Golden Idol.

You are a clairvoyant investigator in 1948 London, exploring the psychic echoes of a tragedy that occurred eight years prior on a remote plantation in Borneo.

name: The AI Bubble
summary: Survive the corporate hell where AI tries to replace you... literally. Play as a Junior Dev, collect absurd upgrades (like 'Paid in Exposure' or '144p Tutorial'), and destroy hordes of buggy robots in this satirical Action Roguelite / Bullet Heaven.

name: The Last Spell: Tales of Torment
summary: Tales of Torment is the third and final DLC for the acclaimed tactical rogue-lite The Last Spell!

name: The Holy Fool
summary: In a world shattered by false gods and endless cycles, you awaken as The Fool—a jester bound to a cursed, living hat. Explore a surreal land, confront ancient deities, and shape the fate of tribes driven by wrath and illusion. Power comes with pain. Can you escape the joke, or will it consume you?

name: The Lantern of the Laughless Saint
summary: A solo or co-op RPG inspired by classic RPGs. Drawn by a shared dream, you awaken on an isolated island crowned by a silent Tower. Unravel the mystery of the Laughless Saint, confront the weight of human desire, and decide what deserves to be saved when the light beneath the world finally stirs.

name: Thy Lyin' Eyes Be Damned!
summary:
Thy Lyin' Eyes Be Damned is a fantasy comedy otome visual novels about a pair of misfits alongside a little gremlin going on a quest to obtain a dragon egg.

It has over 35k words, multiple endings and comedic romance!

name: The Surprise Gift
summary: You’re Amaan, spending your birthday alone—until a strange package arrives from your uncle and aunt. An old doll once owned by your late father. As you follow your daily routine, eerie disturbances grow. Was this a gift… or a curse passed down?

name: The Empathy Algorithm
summary: Are you an android? Two university students volunteer for a paid experiment, rating an android's humanity—except Erin Cole isn’t told she might be the test subject. Their conversations about love, free will, and death challenge what it means to be human in this thrilling, melancholic visual novel.

name: The Super Adventure of John
summary: This is my first plataformer game Super John, shit post game where john go adventure!!

name: The Legend of the Wind
summary:
Romhack by Sunset Tides Interactive (Trevor Belmondo, ‪@CorrMods‬ , ‪@woon6436‬, E-Gor, KoloKorn) with help from Chadlight
Released on 1/17/26 for the Hylian Modding 2025 Crossover Competition.

name: The Lawnmower Man
summary: Port of "The Lawnmower Man" for CD-based consoles and home computers. This version is a interactive movie, in addition to the platformer on other home consoles of the time.

name: The Dead Roam Free
summary:
Play Snake as you’ve never played it before.

In The Dead Roam Free, you slither, shoot, and snack your way through a twisted military experiment gone wrong. Blood, betrayal, and bad jokes are all part of the package.

You are Bob Segatti, private eye and fixer for those who can pay. When a mysterious dame walks into his office, Bob bites off more than he can chew — literally. One betrayal and a concrete floor later, he wakes up undead and hungry for answers.

Crawl through labs, streets, and sewers in a top-down action-puzzle adventure where every meal makes you longer, stronger, and dumber. Uncover the truth behind the army’s secret zombie program, rescue the girl, and get revenge — one bite at a time.

name: The Visit: Mizukawa
summary: Inspired by Incantation. The Visit: Mizukawa is a first-person psychological horror game following several perspectives tied by a single curse. In a city haunted by tapes, each story brings the ritual one step closer to its end.

name: The Heroic Knight
summary: The king’s castle is under attack! The jewels that maintain peace and harmony throughout the kingdom have been scattered and are now guarded by hordes of enemy pigs.

name: The Traveling Witch in Animal Town
summary: A beautiful side-scrolling platformer with a unique turn-based, bag-of-charms combat system. Explore worlds imagined over decades by artist Jon Carling as you rescue the cozy residents of Animal Town from creepy villains. Enjoy limitless replay with non-linear levels and abundant charm combinations.

name: The Simpsons.exe
summary: A FNAF-inspired horror game that uses characters and assets from The Simpsons. Spend 5 days trying to prevent Homer.exe from killing Bart Simpson.

name: The Last Frontier
summary: You are the last surviving person on earth, between you and the hordes of zombies, only the walls of your bunker. Learn how to build weapons and turrets, defend yourself and your base, but remember, sooner or later they will break through your defenses...

name: The Devil's Accountant
summary: Step into the ink-stained ledgers of Hell in The Devil’s Accountant, a darkly satirical card-based game where bureaucracy meets damnation. You are Hell’s newest bookkeeper, overworked, under-appreciated, and mysteriously sentenced to eternal torment for your creative financial practices.

name: Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor
summary: Join Thomas and his friends on a special journey across Sodor! Hop into the cabs of North Western Railway’s classic steam team to enjoy nostalgic stories and all-new narratives right from the drivers’ seats. Explore the Wonders of Sodor – fun and magic await!

name: The Hollow
summary: The Hollow is a first-person shooter with a semi-open world set in the Tunguska anomaly and Ukrainian adventure novel.

name: The Legend of Zelda: 18 Hours Past
The Sushi Bar
summary: The Sushi Bar is a Japanese-style horror game where you play as a sushi chef working the night shift.

name: The Calamity Trials
summary: Complete platform parkour featuring multiple unique weapons and obstacles while IT chases you. These weapons will increase speed, or become another obstacle you must overcome.

name: The Medical Examination Diary: Teamwork in Paradise.
summary: "The medical examination diary: Teamwork in Paradise." is a novel game. Enjoy new episodes by the heroines of "The medical examination diary: the exciting days of me and my senpai" and "The 2nd page of the medical examination diary: Another story of exciting days of me and my senpai".

name: The Last Cat in the Universe
summary: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

name: The Last Departure
summary: The Last Departure is an atmospheric horror game set aboard the final run of a closing train line. Find your way out or loop forever.

name: Think in Two
summary: Get ready for a puzzle 2D video game that will dazzle your eyes and challenge your mind! In this game, in this game you can Clone your self to explore new possibilities! But that’s not all! You’ll be amazed by how this simple mechanic transforms into something bigger and better with every level!

name: The Last Day of Adolf
summary: Play as Adolf on his last day in the bunker, the Nazies have lost the war and you get to play out the events that follow with a humorous and dark twist.

name: The Swashbugglers
summary: A cartoon-style 2D roguelike autochess focused on tactical strategy. Recruit insect "heroes" from the forest to form a team. Develop their skills, equipment, and stone inscriptions through battles to defeat the source of chaos within the time limit.

name: The Kulka
summary: One-button bullet-heaven where a single shot mutates into neon chaos. Imagine Flappy Bird colliding with Vampire Survivors. Full version adds online leaderboards, challenges and unlockable gear.

name: The Grade 5B Case Files
summary: A narrative AVG focused on everyday mysteries from the lives of elementary school students. The two protagonists encounter ordinary yet unusual incidents at school, and through investigation and deduction, players uncover the truth together with them.

name: The Arcana: Dark Tarot & Kings of Madness
summary:
Dark Arcana.
Strategic cards.
Power bends to your will.

name: The Arcana: Dark Tarot & Queens of Madness
summary:
Seductive Arcana.
Strategic cards.
Power is won by choice.

name: The Test: Reimagined
summary: The Test: Reimagined is a masterful mix of Personality Test Psychology and Dark Tarot. Answer a series of fully-narrated questions to receive a personalized, unique ending based on your choices. Dive deep into your own psyche and join millions in a social experiment that you will NOT want to miss!

name: The Grand Slamboree
summary:
The Grand Slamboree is a 2D Platform-Fighter, where every hit is lethal for intense, fast-paced rounds. With simplified movesets, anyone can join in the brawl, while leaving plenty for dedicated players to master!

Bash, blast and chomp your way to victory in this tournament of creatures, weirdos and not-quite-heroes.

name: The Pink Robot
summary: The Pink Robot is a fast-paced isometric action roguelite with deep build variety and fluid combat. Create powerful synergies through skills and mementos, and face relentless challenges that grow stronger with every run.

name: Thelma Fantastic
summary: Thelma Fantastic is a hidden object mystery game where every level and every hidden object is randomized. It is a game of finding objects, earning clues, and eliminating suspects to solve the case. An endless supply of randomly generated hidden object scenes for you to enjoy.

name: The Other Me Reborn
summary: Step into the role of Ophelia as she returns to the isolated town she once shared with her twin, now twisted by secrets and shadows. Her search for answers spirals into a nightmare of shifting halls and memories that refuse to stay buried

name: The Recipe for Life. A Journey Through Silent Apocalypses
summary: You are a traveler with a cracked soul and a house on wheels. Your mission is to listen to those standing on the edge and find the right words before strangers fall silent forever.

name: The Perdition Man: Interval
summary: The Perdition Man: Interval is a side scrolling run n' gun steeped in heavy atmosphere. You are alone on your mission and unable to control what you see and what you are about to do. In this single player campaign you must traverse platforming sections and push on through hordes of haunting enemies.

name: The Strange Lights
summary: You have arrived in a forest where people are rumored to disappear and strange things happen... Locals often see bright flashes and hear strange sounds...

name: The Puppet's Casket
summary: The Puppet's Casket is a 2D puzzle adventure set in a mysterious Victorian manor. Navigate among eerie marionettes, solve intricate puzzles, and gather clues to seize the artificial eye and uncover the truth behind the Thorn family's tragic downfall.

name: The Brewline
summary: The Brewline is an open world bootlegging simulation. Players build their own alcohol empire through production, trade, and NPC interactions while competing against rival gangs. Manage your resources and navigate a dangerous landscape to expand your illegal operations.

name: Thekku Island
summary: A chilling psychological horror set in 1980s Kerala. After weeks of silence, you arrive on a remote island to search for your missing wife. Explore an abandoned house, uncover local folklore, survive haunting encounters, and unravel the island’s buried secrets.

name: The Whispering Bones
summary: The Whispering Bones is a roguelike psychological horror where you gamble with a mysterious stranger in the depths of a nebulous wood. Speak to him, unravel his secrets, make bets and win a chance for a better life.

name: The Gardener
summary: Solve tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

name: The World Beyond
summary: Discover an engrossing new world of mixed reality, where your play space merges with a virtual landscape. Interact with Oppy and The World Beyond using your hands and voice. Use a magic flashlight to find energy orbs in your own room, hidden behind Passthrough. Grab them with your hands, tossing them into your space as Oppy navigates around your furniture and room. Use voice commands to ask Oppy to jump or come, or just say hi! Feed her energy orbs so she can return home!

name: The Smurfs: Dreams - Digital Deluxe Edition
summary:
This edition includes:
The game "The Smurfs: Dreams"
The "Thief Costume" skin
The game's digital artbook
The game’s digital OST

name: They Will Come
summary: Survive a nightmare and save your family. They Will Come is a cinematic steampunk horror adventure set in an alternate 1897. You must avoid detection, solve puzzles, and fight back against mysterious enemies with the help of your powerful robot companion, Talus.

name: The Ashen Oz
summary: A fast-paced dark fantasy action roguelite where you chain attacks and parries into fluid, combo-driven combat through a twisted fairytale world.

name: The Palaces of The Mind
summary: The Palaces of The Mind is a mystical 2D adventure that tells the story of how most ordinary day of two friends turned into a nightmare. Becca, her owl Dolly, and Meg must now escape from the world of the animeds, forest creatures that can smell fear.

name: The Witch and the Lost Babies
summary: As a journalist, you travel to an abandoned village to investigate a dark event that occurred years ago. As you progress through missing babies, hidden diaries, and forbidden rituals, you will be forced to perform a dangerous ritual yourself to uncover the truth.

name: The Seventh Seal
summary: The Seventh Seal is a story-driven supernatural horror game about survival at the end of days. Trapped inside a sealed apartment complex as the world collapses, Violet must navigate haunting corridors, solve deadly environmental puzzles, and outsmart malicious spirits using the very traps meant to kill her. With an emphasis on vulnerability, fear, and demonic horror, The Seventh Seal is built for players who crave tension, dread, and survival through wit—not firepower.

name: The Henchmen
summary: The Henchmen is a chaotic co-op heist game where you and your crew play as clueless, disposable henchmen pulling off robberies that are way above your pay grade. Sneak, steal, mess up, improvise, and try to escape with the loot.

name: The Kingdoms of Ædloran
summary: The Kingdoms of Ædloran is a 2D top-down pixel RPG. Explore a living open world, encounter strange and fantastic creatures, level up and learn new abilities, battle savage beasts and monstrous foes, delve deep into perilous dungeons, and claim legendary loot.

name: The Headlands
summary: A cozy top-down farming management game focused on planning and steady growth. Manage fields, machinery, and resources, upgrade your farm, and develop efficient processes at your own pace in a calm, strategic experience.

name: The Dragon Princess
summary: On the night before her wedding, Princess Amaia of Steinna whispers a wish she thinks will be unheard. The moment she pronounces thse words, "I don't want to marry him", a dragon appears and, in a pure fairy tale fashion, kidnaps the Princess, trapping her in a tower. Surprisingly enough, the dragon, named Happho, is rather sympathetic and claims she wants to set Amaia free from her tyrannic fiancé, Azaiah, of whom the Princess of Steinna seems frightened... Can Amaia really trust her jailor? And in the end, who will save the Princess?

name: The Anomaly Unit
summary: Forced into working as an Anomaly Observer in a space stockroom, you must explore, observe carefully, and report inconsistencies. Earn Credits to buy upgrades, but beware: hideous horrors are creeping in the dark.

name: Thunder and Line-ing
summary: Move lightning through the air to form lines. When everything aligns a boom echoes blasting your score up to a higher strata!

name: The Kendama Challenge: 100 Players
summary: Help the challengers who appear one after another succeed at kendama. Simply land the ball on the large cup for 100 people in a row. However, if even one person fails, it's game over. Can you overcome various pressures and guide all 100 people to success!?

name: The Builder: Season 1
summary: Classy adult visual novel. You play the role of a skilled young man who is commissioned to build a memorial in a village in the far north. Soon you discover that your real task is quite different: In order to save the village from extinction, you must make all the women there pregnant.

name: Thrust 8
summary: One day, the protagonist wakes up in a strange place. Bright, stimulating lights dazzle the protagonist's eyes, and beautiful women tempt him. In front of them, firm buttocks of various colors swayed. “If you find the buttocks you want, you can insert it!”

name: The Debt Collector
summary: A horror dice game where you gamble your life to pay off your debts. Score enough points to avoid the debt collector.

name: The Last Harvest: Uncanny Smile
summary: Arriving in a strange world, your only way to return home is to farm for the Pumpking in return for a safe passage. You must grow your farm, survive the dangerous of this world and make it home. Be careful who you trust.

name: The Subject: Protocol Zero
summary: Turn on your camera. The Kessler Foundation is paying for your pain. The game uses your webcam and microphone, turning the room into a lab. Complete four stages: from the blink ban to the "Green Light, Red Light" game. Money or sanity? Be the first to complete Protocol Zero. If you dare.

name: The Train Arrives at 10 PM
summary: A psychological visual novel about grief, memory, and time loops shaped by player choice. Experience a story driven by atmosphere and emotion, where each decision reveals hidden truths and leads toward one of several possible endings.

name: The Village Rises
summary: The Village Rises is a medieval survival and defense game about rebuilding a broken village and protecting it against relentless threats.

name: The Lost Lunch
summary: In this First-Squirrel perspective Environmental Puzzle Game, your son has forgotten his lunch! The only problem: he's climbing the Great Tree today! As a caring squirrel mother you are determined to solve your way up the fantastical Great Tree to reunite lunch with an empty belly.

name: The Last Wizard: A Goblin Detective Mystery
summary: Investigate a murder as the first goblin detective in a comedic fantasy world without magic...where a wizard is the prime suspect!

name: The Hopeless Few
summary: Third-person survival roguelite shooter, where you've got 20 minutes before the infection takes over. Use that time to salvage valuable loot & secure the survival of others.

name: The Ark
summary: Exploring the dark and atmospheric environments of The Ark.

name: The Perfect Portrait
summary: A short visual novel about a robot running an AI art generator painting the portrait of a narcissistic megalomaniac.

name: The Housekeeper
summary: Work a 1900s night shift where routine chores meet an oppressive psychological dread. As a lone caretaker, navigate the heavy silence and unsettling shadows of a dark past. In this atmospheric horror, the terror lies in what remains unseen. Complete your tasks before the shift takes its toll.

name: The White Lamb: No Shelter
summary: 《TheWhiteLamb:NoShelter》: Psychological Suspense & Fast-Paced FPS Combat. Control the ego, explore the looping dream of Persona Storm and the traumas of id/superego (Red Cloak/Blue Cloak). Promote reconciliation through words and fateful choices, and uncover the truth.

name: The Day That Wasn't
summary: Relive the same day without remembering it. Your choices feed four inner alter egos (Shadow, Mad, Alex, and Bully) — shaping reality, glitches, and one of 16 possible endings. The day repeats. Your mind doesn’t. Or does it?

name: The Sigil Engine
summary: A magical automation puzzle game where you program a little shikigami automaton using visual spell blocks - explore, harvest energy, and cleanse corrupted sigils in a cozy fantasy world.

name: The Zyrdain Sands
summary: Visceral twin-stick shooter where desert gods sabotage your run with no-shots, sandstorms, and cursed upgrades while you evolve Zyrd's weapons to save the Sacred Stone.

name: The Long Way Home
summary: You are alone on a drifting starship. No humans, only robots. As Miner 13-553; craft, farm, repair, upgrade skills and find your way home. Fight the machines or choose a peaceful path. Explore the mystery or just focus on the journey. The choice is yours.

name: The Legend of You
summary: Shape a fantasy realm with your words. Choose your hero’s tale, recruit, train, and equip allies, and battle through turn-based encounters of your own design. Each victory writes your legend, each choice brings you closer to the ultimate treasure.

name: The Seven Days I Spent With You
summary: With the enigmatic girl who imprisoned you――seven days in an unfamiliar room.

name: The Corner Cafe
summary: The Corner Cafe is a cozy(ish) cafe simulator set in a retro futuristic mythical Ireland in the year 2160. Play as Dan, the new owner of The Corner Cafe, the last independent cafe in Galway City. It is up to you to create an oasis of community in this dystopia...

name: The Shadow Architect
summary: Are new bans coming to your country? You, bring even more. Forget city-building games. You're not a builder, you're a DESTROYER. Use taxes and bureaucracy to collapse a flawlessly functioning dystopian industrial system from within. A card-based ideological collapse simulation game.

name: The Last Sigh(t)
summary: An empty world stretches before you, one still marked by her footsteps in the soil below, and one where her voice can still be heard across the howling winds that carry her fragrance. But despite everything, you remain faithful. Do not lose yourself in this journey for the summit.

name: The Adventure of Natsuki Hinomiya
summary: "The Adventure of Natsuki Hinomiya" is an Action RPG that prioritizes the joy of exploration and is designed for short-cycle, repeatable runs.Gather items scattered across the open field, defeat the enemies blocking your path, and empower your protagonist.

name: The Last Legion
summary: The Last Legion is an RTS-RPG hybrid shooter that combines Real-Time Strategy, Role-Playing, and Base Building elements. The core gameplay centers on Desperate Survival and Base Reconstruction: you must unlock and build barracks, R&D facilities, and defenses.

name: The Industrial Council
summary: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

name: The Anomaly Detective
summary: Your mind plays tricks on you in this hotel. Is what you see real, or just a hallucination? Close your eyes, take a deep breath, and clear your mind. Whatever remains when you open them is your only truth. Photograph the anomalies, connect the evidence, and solve the mystery.

name: The Vig
summary: You'll be "Xie En", infiltrating the traitor's money empire. This urban hunt is a revenge saga where wit is your spear. Return as "Wu Wei," using rules as your shield in a world of grey. Will you choose love or vengeance? This lethal game of cash, betrayal and redemption awaits your move.

name: The Final Oath
summary: Pick a Hero, Build your Battle deck and destroy endless hordes of enemies. The Final Oath is a Deck-building, Rogue-like, Survivor game. Chase your power fantasy by acquiring powerful cards, min-max your stats and destroy everything in your way. Most Importantly, Fulfill your Oath to Protect!

name: Thomas Ireham in Crimson Spotlight
summary: A complete time-loop detective story set in the 1940s — solve a case before it even happens in a single, self-contained sitting.

name: The Bold Club
summary: A totally chaotic card game for up to 6 players where you must cheat to win. Match shapes and colors, use special cards, cheat to secretly get rid of your cards and report other players before they do the same.

name: Theme Park Simulator
summary: Build, manage, and grow your own theme park in this multiplayer simulator for 1–4 players. Buy rides, serve customers, manage cleanliness, and maximize profits with day and night cycles.

name: The Dame
summary: A first-person psychological horror where a harmless camp ritual awakens The Dame: a presence bound to mirrors and silence. Break the mirrors before she reaches you.

name: The American Dream of Gunther Aims
summary: A retro puzzle shooter built around ricochets, where every shot counts. You play as Gunther, a revolver and a family man, in a constrained turn-based system: one action at a time, until it fully resolves.

name: The V Anomaly
summary: The V Anomaly is an atmospheric observation game where small changes matter. Search each room for anomalies and choose the correct exit: progress deeper as the Area number climbs or make one wrong call and return to Area 0. Stay sharp. Doubt everything.

name: The White Hell
summary: A visual novel game about fate and choice importance.

name: The Worst Game
summary: Click Big Button. Unlock achievements and waste your time. Rank amongst the top players and stand proud on top of the leaderboard.

name: The Gallery: VR Secrets
summary: Step Into The Gallery: VR Secrets - Immerse yourself in a VR art gallery where every painting holds a hidden puzzle.

name: The Ones Beyond
summary: A first-person forest horror game where you search for your missing sister while being stalked by a mysterious cult in the darkness.

name: The Martial World of Drinking: Wu Song
summary: In Wu Song, you will step into the passionate Water Margin world as the hero Wu Song and embark on a unique card-based strategic adventure!

name: The Mortimer Paradox
summary: A third-person sci-fi horror game about exploring your grandfather’s abandoned mansion and its interdimensional portals. Solve puzzles, evade monsters, and uncover why Dr. Voss vanished.

name: The Long Winter: I Am Not an Animal
summary: You inherit your father’s tavern in a small, isolated region.By day, life seems ordinaryBut when night falls, someone always knocks on your door.

name: The Trailer Incident
summary: A lonely evening in a RV in the woods. Strange lights appear above the trees. Hide from the unknown and try to survive the night when the sky grows comes too close.

name: The Old Man’s Will
summary: Welcome to your grandfather’s old property, a lonely patch of land deep in the woods. Strange creatures roam the area at night, hungry and unpredictable. Watch the cameras, keep them fed, and try to make it through five long nights alive.

name: The Story of Mikagoyama
summary: This is an RPG where you explore a mountain called Mikagoyama. The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.The water from this mountain is very delicious.Th

name: The Adventures of R.Sole: Nothing, Nowhere & Not at the Same Time
summary: A sarcastic IT guy becomes the universe’s least qualified hero in a crisis he can’t reboot. Surrounded by oddball characters and improbable predicaments, he learns sarcasm really can save the day. A comedy sci-fi point & click where chaos reigns, heroism is optional, and logic is a mere suggestion.

name: The Last Mothership
summary: A short incremental game about harvesting planets to feed your mothership. Mine, manage resources, grow your fleet, and unlock upgrades to evolve your species. You are the devourer of worlds.

name: The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths
summary: Decode the "Second Reality." Decipher the true feelings behind the words of Visitors you can't fully understand. Talk. Read minds. Translate. An empathy-driven psychological mystery adventure that doesn't turn chuunibyo—an adolescent delusion syndrome—into a joke, but gets to how they really feel.

name: The Hilarious Three Kingdoms 2
summary: This is a traditional turn-based strategy game set in the era of the Three Kingdoms.Control different feudal lords, step onto the historical battlefield, experience the funny plot, strategize and unite the world!

name: The Lone Sword
summary: The Lone Sword is a narrative platformer where YOU are the weapon. As a living Sword, embark on a nostalgic journey to find your Maker. Explore the Castle, solve physics puzzles, master the blade with unique mechanics, and reflect on your purpose in this emotionally rich adventure.

name: The Day I Became a Bird
summary: Join Frank, an awkward young boy, as he discovers newfound feelings for his classmate, Sylvia - who only has eyes for birds. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles as Frank attempts to catch her attention with a homespun, feathery transformation in this warm and nostalgic return to childhood.

name: Three Jokers
summary: A card roguelike inspired by Balatro and Cuphead. Fight duels, play insane mini-games, build Joker City and rise to greatness — in Three Jokers!

name: The Tale of Spring City
summary: Ziqing Xu, a young girl from Spring City. Her father mysteriously disappeared soon after. During a strange turn of events, she suddenly gains the ability to see into the supernatural realm—the so-called "Yin Yan." Will she be able to uncover the truth?

name: The Fog
summary: Out of the fog, zombies, aliens, ghosts, monsters and many other creatures are trying to eat you. Shoot them with your pistols! Power up after every wave! Don't die! Made with the Godot Engine.

name: The Wrong Floor
summary: Trapped in a mysterious hotel, you must observe, decide, and take risks. Use your points and abilities to descend faster… if you dare.

name: The Last Market
summary: The Last Market is an open-world game set in a post-apocalyptic world where you run your own market in a safe zone for survivors. Fight zombies, collect sellable items, and grow your market by selling them.

name: The Qixia Diary
summary: The Qixia Diary is an original Visual Novel inspired by the food culture of Hangzhou, China. You play as Sheng Sheng—a first-year art student at Yunqi University. Through her eyes, you'll step into a unique university life brimming with warmth and local charm beside the West Lake.

name: Thrill Drill
summary: You are a miner and you have to get out of the mine as quickly as possible. To do this, you will have to climb the walls of the mine and extract crystals that will reduce your time.

name: They Left Us Here
summary: A Sci-Fi First Person Horror Game where you explore an abandoned Space Station

name: The Wanderer's Rest
summary: This game is a traditional Chinese-style simulation building game that integrates efficiency tools. Travel around the world and discover new settlements. Every time you focus on creation with the efficiency tools, it will bring changes to the settlement.

name: The Curse of Womanland
summary: A romance-adventure text-based game themed around the Land of Women. You will travel to the Land of Women, meet the mysterious young lady Jian Ling, and gradually uncover the bloody and dark secrets behind this realm. Death, resistance, or degeneration? Everything depends on your choices.

name: That's My Tofu
summary: A chaotic VR cooking game where you use chopsticks to cook, serve, and defend your hotpot feast against your mischievous cousin.

name: The Spotter: Dig or Die
summary: Dig by day, fight by night in this blend of mining and Tower Defense. As the last Spotter at a ruined gas station, hold back mutant hordes, scavenge the wasteland, and repair your receiver to capture the President’s vital message and humanity’s last hope.

name: The Zone
summary:
The Zone FPV is a next-generation FPV drone simulator built by a professional freestyle pilot, combining accurate physics, realistic maps, and multiplayer lobbies in one complete experience.

The physics are modeled after real-world quads and validated against real flight footage and Blackbox data, allowing pilots to fly naturally without hours of tuning.

name: The Christmas Pickle
summary:
‘Twas the night before Christmas—and something slimy is stirring.

You’re on the naughty list, and something green is coming for you. Something pickled! Run, hide, and survive the brined wrath of the Christmas Pickle—a festive slasher nightmare soaked in blood, and vinegar.

Deck the halls… with screams. Because this Christmas Dill be your last!

name: The Quiet Days of Dorothy
summary: During the 2020 lockdown, Dorothy spends her days caring for jars of sourdough starters. By sharing them with others, she builds unexpected connections and discovers small acts of kindness that bring warmth in difficult times.

name: The Stars are Right
summary: The Stars are Right is a party based RPG with a focus on PVP.

name: The Newspapers of the Day
summary: In 1920s Gyeongseong, the pen is mightier than the sword, but your hand is trembling. As an editor-in-chief, arrange articles, dodge censorship, and manipulate public opinion. Will you wake the people with the truth or yield to survive? Your editorial choices will rewrite history.

name: The Joogle Bros.
summary: Joogle is a game about a Joogle named Joogle who lives in Joogle City on Planet Joogle and his brother commands the Joogle Army. There's also KING SURN who is very important to the plot.

name: The Node
summary: A short sci-fi point-and-click adventure about forbidden time travel. Explore a facility outside normal time, solve clever puzzles, and uncover the purpose of The Node. Featuring subtle (and not that subtle) references to classic time-travel movies and TV shows.

name: The Slow Process of Pulling Out My Guts
summary: a dead-end girl clashes infinitely with a parasite in her head.

name: The Postman Cometh
summary: Deliver mail in a strange little town in the middle of nowhere. Meet a colorful cast of villagers as you try to figure out what happened to the previous postman.

name: The Garden of Garden Gnome
summary: The Garden of Garden Gnome is a deck-building roguelike where you grow plants in your garden and battle with them. Deeply blending deck-building with tactical RPG strategy, plant seeds, cultivate your plants, and fight enemies with the power of the cards you've nurtured.

name: The Pinkman Files
summary: The Pinkman Files is a mini-game rich, fast paced, turn based combat game with a side of visual novel, that will challenge your detective skills and allow you to uncover the secrets of a peculiar town.

name: The Cats of Monte Cristo
summary: A fun hidden object game with cats!  Explore detailed locations from Dumas' novel while finding fluffy witnesses to a great revenge.

name: The End of the World and Her Room
summary: The End of the World and Her Room is a short, free point-and-click puzzle game. This is a quiet and fleeting story: in the final moments, inside her room, you observe the surroundings, search for clues, unlock her phone’s password, and slowly understand the traces the world has left behind.

name: The Sixth Extinction
summary: The Sixth Extinction is a story-driven adventure where you play as an environmental agent investigating escalating disasters. Follow the clues, uncover what hides in the shadows, and reveal the truth before the world falls silent.

name: That Friday Again
summary: Medieval Europe. With dark humor, pagan gods, and endless Fridays. You are a former king. Having quarreled with the gods, you lost everything and are stuck in a curse. From now on, you are forced to live the same day forever. Everything depends on your actions. Can you break the curse?

name: The Goddess's Will
summary: Dive into a 2.5D isometric action RPG adventure inspired by late-90s and early-00s classics. Face cunning enemy factions, explore a layered world filled with vivid characters, mythic stories, and handcrafted environments. Immerse yourself in a dangerous and unforgiving golden age of power fantasy.

name: The Caribou Trail
summary: The WWI story where your goal isn't to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.

name: The Plight of the Cracked
summary: Take control of the nutcracker and set out on your sacred task: Slay the King of Mice so it may never torment dear Lady Marie. Explore the fortress city of Mausolia and battle the king's henchmen along the way.

name: Through Death's Door
summary: A small horror RPGmaker game where you really want to go home.

name: There Is No Next Stop
summary: After the announcement "There is no next stop," you are trapped in an endless subway. But you're not alone—the "GUESTS" are hunting you. Trust the "GUIDES" to survive. Or don't.

name: The Diving Bell
summary: Isolation takes its toll on even the strongest of wills. Survive the madness, faulty machinery, and the crushing depths of the ocean, and reach your salvation inside the diving bell.

name: The Thing in the Lake
summary: Something horrible is hiding in its murky depths...

name: The Guiding Spirit
summary: Mix and match hundreds of traits, flaws, and skills to design unique heroes with complex personalities and ambitions. Watch them love, hate, help, and hinder each other. Roll the dice and become the Guiding Spirit of your group of misfits in this story-rich fantasy campaign simulator!

name: The Toy Shop
summary: What do you do when you can't trust what you see, hear, or touch? What reality do you chose to be your own? Do you take your fate in to your own hands, or play on as someone else's toy?

name: The Shore: Enhanced Edition
summary: The complete experience unfolds in The Shore, a first-person Lovecraftian horror adventure that blends exploration and puzzles in a world shaped by ancient gods and forbidden knowledge.

name: The Fruit Merchant's Diary
summary: Start as a small fruit wholesaler and earn your fortune! Will you remain honest, or get rich through bribery and risk the wrath of the 'Great Blue Eye'? Spend your earnings on good or evil to shape your Karma. Remember, the Eye only watches the sinners in this narrative-driven economy sim.

name: The Gilded Lady: Life and Love in a Cyborg Shop
summary: Live a day-in-the-life of a cyborg mechanic in a soft-apocalyptic future where disease is staved off with hard work and metal parts. Choose your person, romantic or otherwise, and walk their unique path through the walled city. Manage the shop and grow your future in one of 6 separate endings.

name: The Bicameral Protocol
summary: By all measures Isaac Llewellyn is a success in life. So why doesn't it feel like that? Something is horribly wrong. Join Isaac as he returns to his childhood home to try to make sense of what happened in his youth. To reconcile truth with memory, Isaac must explore a horrifying past.

name: Throw a Life!
summary: "Throw A Life!" is a chaotic party survival game for up to four players! Work together to mine, craft, build, and hunt on a dangerous island. Divide roles to survive efficiently—or embrace the chaos and have fun with friends!

name: The Zodiac Mystery
summary: Step into The Zodiac Mystery, where a suspense-filled adventure begins! Players are immersed in a complex and bewildering cold case, searching for clues across time and space. Examine crime scenes, review files, and analyze evidence, following the trail concealed within a celestial haze.

name: They Are Rising
summary: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

name: The Knight of Niraking
summary: Play as the hero to save the land of Niraking from the Nohak Lord. Explore dungeons, castles, and ancient temples. Fight bosses and natural beasts to gather more gear or progress in the story. Talk to NPCs and add some of them to your party to advance your quest.

name: The House Unrest
summary: After an old priest performs a profane ritual of everlasting life, he unwittingly invites the plague demon Asakku into our realm. Searching to right his wrongs and save our reality, he contacts you, a mysterious demon-hunting priest. Armed with a gun and the light of God, you must battle the flesh given form and banish Asakku back to where he came from.

name: The Book of Blood
summary: The night signals closing time at Pomeroy Grasslands carnival and its employee Trevor volunteers to lock up. Alone in his booth, with a strange book in Lost and Found, a man steps out of the darkness and hands Trevor a note: “let me in.”

name: The Gaming Cafe
summary: Build, run, and grow your own Gaming Cafe. Set up gaming stations, manage customer flow, and boost profits by selling drinks and shelf products.

name: This Place at the End: An Apocalyptic RPG
summary: This Place at the End is a tactical, turn-based RPG about moving forward at the end of the world. 30 in-game days, 30 real-time hours, and 12 ways to reach the end.

name: The Paths We Cross
summary: Explore Lavyn and its surroundings in this mix between Metroidvania and Tower Defense / RTS. Fight various enemies, unlock new abilities, activate and defend stone cores, build mighty towers and meet unique characters who might help you on your mission.

name: The Haunted House: Dark Island
summary: Dynamic anime-style battles, reimagined in a turn-based RPG!

name: The Maker Way
summary: Build creative machines, rovers, drones or robots. Use them to gather resources, discover new machine parts, source energy, construct bases and battle enemy factions in a physics-based open world.

name: The Adventures of Hori
summary: Join Hori and his lovable crew of baby astronauts and their loyal Bernese Mountain Dog, Charlie, as they blast off on a thrilling journey across the galaxy! In The Adventures of Hori, you'll unravel cosmic mysteries, outsmart villainous cats known as the “Ronronneurs Maléfiques,” and discover magical objects like the Destructive Lollipop, all while forging bonds of friendship and teamwork. This heartwarming and humorous space tale is brought to life with adorable cartoon visuals, interactive choices, and immersive storytelling perfect for young players and families alike.

name: The Far Node
summary: Enter a meditative maze where every jump matters. Navigate through an abstract network of interconnected nodes as you search for the elusive blue Exit Node, with each leap subtly shifting your momentum and altering your journey's rhythm. Experience pure, distraction-free gameplay with minimalist vector graphics and a soothing color palette designed to focus your mind on the process itself. Random events will test your choices and dramatically change your path — will you accept the risk or play it safe in this zen-like puzzle adventure?

name: The Jumping Cat
summary: Dive into high-speed arcade action inside a glowing, ever-shifting tunnel. Collect energy cubes, dodge incoming obstacles, and push your reflexes to the limit as the pace intensifies. Simple to learn but endlessly addictive, every run challenges you to survive longer, score higher, and master the perfect flow.

name: The Long Drift
summary: Build, upgrade, and watch your tiny universe evolve.

name: Three Kingdoms Club Manager
summary: Choose various factions from the Three Kingdoms period to run your club, hire, trade and cultivate military generals, and strive to compete in high-level leagues and cup tournaments.

name: The Albino Hunter: Revamp
summary: Kalymn Nox returns as the Albino Hunter (as in the hunter with albinism, not some creep who hunts albinos); even his pretentious and slightly racist title can keep him from waking up broke after a night of drinking. Join him as he takes on various jobs throughout the land.

name: The Last Lodge
summary: The Last Lodge is a medieval choice-based psychological horror game where you work as an innkeeper. Listen closely to your patrons' strange stories, prepare their orders, and ultimately, choose which traveller has visited their very last lodge.

name: TheDrippingSound
summary: Dare to explore the abandoned school, solve twisted puzzles, and uncover all six endings to reveal its hidden secrets.

name: The Flinch: Unforgiven West
summary: To pull the trigger takes guts; to miss invites death. Hunt down 10 sinners in this mouse-only Noir Western. Battle your own nerves and a cursed revolver where hand tremors make every duel a gamble. How steady is your aim?

name: They Killed Your Cat
summary: A short but relentless first-person shooter featuring manual reloading, walking, and blinking, with settings that let you customize your experience.

name: They're Gonna Get In
summary: They're Gonna Get In is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim - Apostasy
summary: Apostasy is a modlist for Skyrim Special Edition offering high-fidelity visuals, expanded and enhanced locations, new quests, and modern, action-oriented gameplay.

name: This Game Is Not Real
summary: You are [GAME]. A universally hated destructive mental health horror novel, where you [TALK] with a slightly delusional game developer, debug their creation, and guide the game to “completion.”

name: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Anniversary Edition + Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition Bundle
summary: Experience Bethesda Game Studios’ post-nuclear and epic fantasy masterpieces.

name: Th3_M1dday_L4dies
summary: Uninhabited island. 5? furry girls. 7 nights. The processes of flirting and re-flashing. You. And...

name: The Builder: Season 2
summary: The story continues with season 2 of the popular adult visual novel The Builder. REMEMBER TO PLAY SEASON 1 FIRST! You need to deepen your relations with the women of the small community. Not all goes as planned. Uknowingly, you start your true mission: To get all the women pregnant.

name: The Last Orgasm
summary: Dive into 'The Last Orgasm', an Adult-Only FPS horror game where sensuality meets dread. Navigate explicit scenes and visceral combat in a dystopian world, unveiling a hauntingly erotic truth.

name: The Second Chance Strip Club
summary: Dance your heart out at The Second Chance Strip Club. Featuring an eclectic cast of characters, a raving club soundtrack, and a talking dog called Sensei!

name: The Witch's Warehouse Management
summary: Maho is a wizard who is naive and bad at business. Her store is deserted today. One day, out of boredom, she decides to accept a job offer to organize a warehouse...

name: Through the Lens
summary: A visual novel where romance and mystery intertwine. Uncover the dark secrets of Mirage Corp in Paris while diving into a medieval legend hidden within an ancient book. The past and present are about to collide.

name: The Record of the Male Demon Witch
summary: "The Record of the Male Demon Witch" is a dynamic jigsaw puzzle game. Every girl wants to fully express herself and interact with you in her own world. Come and complete the puzzle and interact with her!

name: The Femdom Project
summary: Experience the first chapter of your journey in The Femdom Project, where Sadow, your big-breasted, sadistic, slightly unhinged bully, wastes no time in tormenting you.

name: The Masculine Urge to Blow a Femboy
summary: After finding a femboy online who catches your fancy, and consuming all his free content, you find yourself overcome by an unexpected urge.

name: The Queen of Phalli
summary: Step into a FUTA world where power is forged through passion. Guide Elifael El'Naar through the dangers of the Baptism, that she may prove herself to Goddess and Matron. Will she win over the affection and respect of her kin, or fall into disgrace and ruin? Your choices shape her fate.

name: The Adventures of Kroma
summary: You play as Kroma, a caveman who's in search for a gift for his girlfriend. Kroma's quest takes him through dangerous caves on his pursuit for the perfect gift.

name: The Homecoming Exhibition
summary: A high-fidelity immersive gallery experience that places you into fully interactive 3D world of modern art, sculptures, and culture as you explore the minimalist environment inspired by Hiroshi Senju's Museum. Experience the future of art with groundbreaking work of Nako Baev.

name: Thug Destroyer
summary: Horror platformer where you play as a thug trapped in a deranged superhero's simulation. Triple-jump and find 9 thuggies to escape 9 twisted levels. It’s chaotic, it’s unfair, and it’s laughing at you

name: The Story Page
