summary: An independently developed indie game in the genre of online RPG with an open world created by a single person. Create your own character using the editor. Engage in various activities ranging from fishing and farming to managing taverns, castles, and even entire cities.

name: The Night Games Collection
summary: This collection takes you into mysterious events set in isolated locations and seemingly ordinary jobs, offering immersive experiences with a night-time theme. Each game features unique, choice-driven stories with multiple outcomes and memorable moments.

name: The House of the Dead 2: Remake - Infect Edition
summary:
The Infect Edition comes with a slipcase and 3 art cards.

The House of the Dead 2: Remake is a remake of the second entry in the well-known and popular rail-shooter series. Take on the lone role of a secret agent as James or Gary, or team up in co-op mode to neutralize the dangerous undead monsters standing in your way.

name: The Game: The Game
summary: The Game: The Game is a feminist video game exploring consent and the practices of the male seduction community. In this unconventional dating simulator, infamous pick-up artists attempt to seduce the player using techniques taken from their instructional materials. Pitting players up against six prominent seduction coaches who are vying for your attention at a bar, the game provides the opportunity for players to explore the complexity of seduction social dynamics as well as the experience of being a femme-presenting individual navigating this complicated and often dangerous terrain. The Game: The Game’s musical score was composed by Xiu Xiu.

name: The Eternal Night
summary: A disgraced knight and a moon priestess must journey across Etheria and beyond, from sacred shrines to forsaken lands swallowed by shadow and only through unity can the Eternal Night be stopped.

name: The Girl Walks Back
summary: "The Girl Walks Back" is a dark, stage-based monochrome puzzle-adventure played only with the mouse. The girl attempts to return home from a deep forest. No complex controls are needed, but obstacles must be overcome through puzzles or action. Your choices lead to 8 different endings.

name: The Tall Man Tapes
summary: The Tall Man Tapes is a found footage inspired horror game. You're a UFO investigator trying to get to the bottom of a mystery. Will you learn the truth and escape with your life?

name: The Ballad Singer: Knights Templar
summary: Manage your own Templar chapter in the Holy Land, engage in strategic combat and complete all narrative paths! A new innovative combat system based on cards and the micro management of the single blows delivered by the warriors.

name: The Inexperienced Exorcist
summary: A romantic visual novel game for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

name: The Crew Motorfest: Audi Double Car Pack
summary: The looks of a daily driver, the performance of a supercar: that's the Audi RS recipe.

name: The Crew Motorfest: JDM Custom Car Pack
summary: When it comes to Japanese-style street racing, performance is nothing without exceptional customization.

name: The Crew Motorfest: Triple Bike Pack
summary: Unleash pure power and precision with a selection of premium motorcycles from BMW, Kawasaki, and KTM.

name: Themely
summary:
Guess the audio from the movie, game or series

Listen to the audio and try to guess it. You have 5 guesses. You get more listening time each time you guess wrong.

name: Thinky Dailies: Season 2
summary: Every day, a new kind of handcrafted puzzle. In the Season 2, the lead of our story is set to learn more about the mysterious society of the "Solvers" that appeared during the first season, and they'll be encountering all manner of new characters while venturing to strange new depths.

name: The Cubiw Dungeon
summary: A roguelike where a cube shoots to more cubes.

name: The Sequencer
summary: The Sequencer is a top-down puzzle solver game set in a computer based world with your character trying to solve puzzles by using cubes. The game contains an engaging binary puzzle system and challenges you the player to think outside of the box (pun intended).

name: This Night
summary: A single-player exploration/scavenger hunt game set in a haunted forest where the player searches for a missing key needed to unlock a remote cabin. The key spawns in different areas each playthrough and roaming spirits must be avoided while discovering landmarks and hidden locations, including an underground cave. Difficulty settings along with tracked run statistics encourage players to improve their times and complete repeated runs.

name: The Factory Must Fall
summary: Build a factory, then let it battle other players! Draft buildings from a randomized shop, optimize resource allocation and army composition, then watch your factory crush your friends and foes in this PvP factory-builder.

name: TheParcelEscape
summary: TheParcel-Escape is a first-person psychological horror puzzle-escape game where you explore Chinese Dreamcore memory scenes, solve bizarre puzzles to find the parcel code, and flee the daily eternal nightmare before your Sanity runs out.

name: The Double
summary: Tarot meets Blackjack with psychological horror inspired by Dostoevsky. A gore card game based on one of the strangest novels. Gameplay with puzzles, dark themes, surreal horror, cards and black humor. Experimental gameplay blending multiple mechanics

name: The Spooky Island
summary: A dark horror game in which the protagonist, Liam, embarks on an expedition to an island to find treasure and earn money. But the island holds secrets and horrors. Over time, the expedition turns into a nightmare from which he must escape...

name: The Guest: Home Alone
summary: The Guest: Home Alone is a short psychological horror experience. You play as Tyler, a man who returns home after a long day at work seeking rest — but something feels wrong. Are you really alone?.

name: The Bard's Tale: Tales of the Unknown
The Bard's Tale
summary: The original Famicom port developed by Atelier Double.

name: The Story About Princess 8 Out of 10
summary: Once upon a time, there was a perfectly average princess — 8/10 at best. No singing animals, no magical destiny. Just an annoying father-king and a whole bunch of creepy barons trying to marry her off.

name: The King is Watching: Crowns of History
summary: Play as Cleopatra, Taizong of Tang, and Xerxes, three legendary-inspired rulers with radically different playstyles. Master death and rebirth, dominate with devastating defenses, or risk everything for overwhelming power.

name: Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor - James Addon
summary:
Join everyone’s favourite red, mixed-traffic tender engine on some extra adventures around Sodor.

Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor – James Add-On is powered by Train Sim World, combining the unparalleled detail and realism of Unreal Engine and Simugraph with accessible controls to create a nostalgic experience that all Thomas & Friends fans can enjoy.

name: Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor - Deluxe Edition
summary: This Deluxe Bundle of Thomas & Friends: Wonders of Sodor includes North Western Railway’s Number 5 engine: James! Join everyone’s favourite red, mixed-traffic tender engine on some extra adventures around Sodor.

name: Those Who Rule II
summary: When a country cracks, those willing to act will decide its future. From a small militia to a force that shapes a nation, forge your squad, customize builds, and outmaneuver foes in challenging turn-based battles as you shape a gripping story of hope, betrayal, and the price of unity.

name: The Experiment: 49
summary: The Eexperiment: 49 is a first-person horror game that immerses you in the depths of fear A dangerous experiment that escaped from HelixGen Labs has reached a family home deep in the forest. Your mission is to uncover the secrets hidden within the house, survive, and find a way to end this nightmare.

name: The Arrogance of Man
summary: A vehicle shuts down due to shear cold, the flesh follows.

name: The Family Trip
summary: An 13-year-old boy travels with his parents to a cabin in a remote area for a short trip. During their stay, they explore the surroundings, visit a nearby abandoned house, and spend their evenings at the cabin. The trip does not continue as planned.

name: The Undermall
summary: This is an anomaly game set inside a mall. Currently only one store is available ("Warm Subject") with many more planned. Spot the difference game with a touch of horror / jump scares.

name: The Legend of California
summary: The Legend of California is an open world, action-survival shooter set on the mythical Island of California during the gold rush era. Explore a vast, untamed frontier and forge your legacy alone or with friends

name: The Witch and the Hundred Knight Mobile
The Knights of the Cross
summary: The Knights of the Cross is an RPG card game adapted from The Knights of the Cross by Nobel Prize-winning author Henryk Sienkiewicz. You will play as the knight Zbyszko and embark on a medieval adventure.

name: The War Disorder Hexa
summary: War consumes the Kingdom of Node as an empire marches forward. Six protagonists stand on different sides of the conflict, each driven by their own motives, struggles, and paths to survival.

name: The Garden of Youth
summary: "The Garden of Youth" is a visual light novel with a focus on youthful love. The story mainly tells of a group of teenagers and girls suffering from mental illness -" AS "- who are involved in a" box court "experiment.

name: The Jumping Bonbon Match 5
summary: From the creators of the popular Jumping Food Games, the sugar-sweet gaming fun returns. In “The Jumping Bonbon Match 5” you can expect new challenges, even more colorful candies and an evolved puzzle gameplay.

name: Thornetica
summary: Thornetica is a strategy rpg and slice of life visual novel that revolves around the university’s theatre club. Engage in classic strategy combat, choose who to cast as each role in the play when these kids jump on stage to perform. Take the time to unwind, bond and play minigames in the backstage!

name: The 7th Guest Remake
summary: The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure, reimagined for modern platforms.

name: The 9th Dragon
summary: Fight through the criminal underworld of 1980s Kowloon Walled City: The 9th Dragon is a brutal narrative-driven action game with tactical combat and branching choices, where every decision shapes the fate of the city.

name: They See You
summary: A computer engineer arrives in a remote mountain village, where tech failures and missing residents put him face to face with an unsettling force lurking behind the screen.

name: The Price Is Right
summary: The DS port of the Wii game based on the TV show of the same name.

name: The Price Is Right: 2010 Edition
summary:
Based on the long-running game show The Price is Right, the 2010 edition allows players to hit all the highlights from the show - bidding on Contestant's Row, playing one of 30 pricing games, spinning the giant wheel, and hopefully participating in the Showcase.

Single player has two modes. "Classic" simply takes you through a single episode of the show as a contestant. "Three Strikes" has you keep playing as a contestant until you lose at Contestant's Row three times. Win or lose at the Row, you'll still play a pricing game after, and try to rack up the most money before you get your three strikes.

This release improves on the previous DS edition by lowering the audience background noise, with different audio sliders for sound and narration, and features improved animations.

name: The People's Tree 2021
summary: The People's Tree was an app for designing, pinning, and viewing ornaments on a single, shared tree. This web build is now an archival version that contains an interactive timeline tool.

name: The Black Whale
summary: The factory chip began to malfunction. Your horrible headaches don’t bother anyone in this dystopian world. “Black Whale”, the attractive white powder, is the only thing that can stop the pain. And show you the life without the horrors of harsh reality.

name: The Light: Remastered Edition
summary: This game is a remaster of the 2012 game "the Light".

name: The Narrator Says We're Meant to Be!
The Turrican Collection
summary:
The Turrican Collection re-releases 9 entries from the run-and-gun series Turrican to the Evercade line of systems.

The collection contains:

- 3 Amiga games (Turrican, Turrican II: The Final Fight, Turrican 3)
- 3 SEGA Mega Drive/Genesis entries (Mega Turrican, Mega Turrican Director's Cut and Mega Turrican Score Attack)
- 4 Super Nintendo Entertainment System entries (Super Turrican, Super Turrican Director's Cut, Super Turrican Score Attack and Super Turrican 2).

name: They Stare
summary: Investigate and unravel the horrors of Clear County. Gather evidence and survive the North Ridge Loop while uncovering the fate of a missing hiker. Explore and escape procedurally generated levels in nightmare mode, avoiding or confronting the dangers within. Do you have what it takes to survive?

name: The Love Between Litchis and Elm
summary: A high school romance game about love, friendship, and growth. Play as a girl in an international school, bonding with three boys—a cold senior, a kind genius, and a cheerful childhood friend. Your choices shape a nostalgic story with meaningful details and bonus content.

name: The Climb
summary: Never give up !

name: The Great Exhibition of 1851 in VR
summary:
The Great Exhibition ran from May to October 1851 in London's Hyde Park, in a temporary building known as the Crystal Palace. Six million visitors passed through the turnstiles, to view over 100,000 individual exhibits.

Now, over 170 years later, we are recreating the exhibition as an immersive VR experience. The simulation includes a narrator to describe each of the exhibits and the Crystal Palace building. Fire up your SteamVR system and explore the Great Exhibition...

name: The Last Kich Of Us
summary: You are the LAST slice of quiche! Dive into this survivors-like to pulverize hordes of rotten food with pop culture–inspired attacks while avoiding the putrid fog. Choose wisely: grab upgrades now, or wait for better odds—every second could be your last.

name: The Curse of Eira
summary: The Curse of Eira is a metroidvania where the main character is unable to die, but each time she is knocked out she gets back up weaker with slower movement speed small jump heights and smaller attack range

name: The Prince of Tennis: Sweet School Festival 0-40 and more…
summary: Originally released on PlayStation 2, the Prince of Tennis game where you play as a high school student preparing for the school festival is being remastered in celebration of its 20th anniversary.

name: The Prince of Tennis: Doki Doki Survival - Eternal Passion! Tie Break Game
summary: Originally released on PlayStation 2 as two separate games and later combined into one on Nintendo DS, the Prince of Tennis game where you find yourself stranded on an island on the way to the National Middle School Tennis Championship is being remastered for modern platforms.

name: The Key to Forgotten Souls
summary: The Key to Forgotten Souls is a psychological horror game focused on exploration, mystery, and immersive storytelling. Explore dark abandoned locations, solve puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and survive a haunting story where lost souls and terrifying truths await.

name: The Forsaken Anthology: Obsession
summary: The Forsaken Anthology: Obsession, a psychological horror game that explores the dark side of human desire and the lengths one might go to fulfill it

name: The Kathy Rain Saga
summary: Experience the mystery and adventure of the complete Kathy Rain story with the Kathy Rain Saga Bundle which contains both Kathy Rain: Director's Cut and Kathy Rain 2!

name: The Butler
summary:
You play as Deacon, the son of George, a maintenance man who mysteriously disappeared years ago. Driven by years of unanswered questions, you’ve devoted years to finding him. But the deeper you dig, the darker the truths you uncover, secrets you wish you’d never known, and horrors that will linger long after the game ends.

The Butler is a spin-off set in the world of Claire, centered on George—a figure briefly mentioned in the original game. What was once a passing detail now unfolds into a story of its own, revealing events that connect back to Claire in unexpected ways.

name: The last fortress
summary: Simple strategy game in which you must build and expand your kingdom while defending it from waves of enemies. You will be able to recruit allies and raise defenses, while adversaries become more numerous and evolve over time.

name: The Distant Circular World
summary:
The sequel to Return to Shironagasu Island.
Ikeda Sen, a detective working in New York, is approached by a mysterious woman named Lila.
At the same time, his client Walton entrusts Ikeda with a mysterious device.
Meanwhile, Izumozaki Neneko, who has returned to her everyday life, discovers a decomposing corpse along the Horikawa River on her way to school.
These two completely unrelated stories soon begin to strangely intersect...

name: The Gigglebone Gang: World Tour
summary: This is an entertaining companion to teach young children about 10 nations, including Australia, Egypt, Ghana, Peru, and Russia.

name: The Scrolls
summary:
This game is about a Kitsune who was sent by the boss on a mission to collect scrolls.
The gameplay consists of dodging enemies and collecting scrolls in order to advance to the next level.
In this game, there are two worlds, each with its own challenges you must face.

name: The Internal
summary: A time-based action roguelike where you battle twisted simulations of your co-workers and climb the corporate ladder before the clock hits 1700.

name: The Boys: Trigger Warning
summary: Developed with the creators and featuring cast from the hit series, “The Boys: Trigger Warning” plunges you into the gloriously twisted world of The Boys. This time, you’re not watching the chaos—you’re in it: close-up, personal, and dangerously real.

name: The Fancy Pants Adventures Online
summary: Relive the classic Fancy Pants Adventures with your friends in an epic online arcade. Play through the story, mess around in platforming sandboxes, challenge each other to some friendly PvP, or tour through a round of Fancy Golf together.

name: The Dunkers
summary: Great 1on1 fun! Homage to 2D basketball and keyboards! Dunks, shoots, layups and blocks you will feel! Dunk you very much!

name: The Legend of Chalkvania
summary: A bite-sized retro action-adventure set in a quirky, cursed land. Fight monsters, meet strange characters, and uncover hidden secrets in this fast-paced homage to classic 2D side-scrollers. Choose your path—embrace the light or the curse. Your legend begins in Chalkvania.

name: The Knife Sharpener
summary: You are trying to make a living in an indifferent city full of freaks, one knife at the time.

name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales - Digital Deluxe Edition
summary: This set is a bundle of The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales game with various adventuring accessories.

name: The First Million
summary: An idle deckbuilder where you constantly unlock new cards and upgrades and discover one game-breaking strategy after another to make THE FIRST MILLION — and then many more!

name: The Assault: Survivor
summary: The Assault Survivor is an exciting action game that takes you into the world of the apocalypse. You play as survivors, where every step is fraught with danger. You will have to fight mutants, look for resources to level up and try to survive in this cruel world.

name: The Witch's Disciples
summary: After being rescued by a beautiful witch named Mireille, Kyle is lovestruck and decides to become her pupil and learn the ways of magic. Set out for adventure as Kyle with the witch Mireille and go questing in dungeons in this lightweight RPG! Fight monsters, gain experience, learn spells, and use magic to conquer bosses.

name: The Entertainer
summary: The Entertainer is a minimal, top-down adventure in which you must entertain the masses to survive.

name: Them's Tale: The Road to Her
summary: Them's Tales is a story-driven game series based on Reddit-style storytelling. The stories are written to seem inspired by real events, but they're completely fictional.

name: The Sentinels
summary: This is an FPS game where you will be surrounded by Sentinels. Initially where designed and programmed to serve humans but, some how they have gone berserk. Your job is the destroy as many Sentinels as possible.

name: The Week With Grugles
summary: A Brand New Horror Attraction Is Now Under Your Watch! You are the security guard, and you must use your cameras and close the doors to keep any unexpected guests out of your office!

name: The Week With Grugles 2
summary: Grugles Is Back! Make Sure He Doesn't Go Anywhere... Use the cameras and door to see if there are any intruders. But be careful, your power is limited!

name: The toilet zone
summary: A game about friends, evil and destiny.

name: The 1% Club World Challenge
summary: Do you have what it takes to answer a question only 1% of people get right? Test your brainpower and compete against players worldwide!

name: Thunder Tank: Iron Shield
summary: A relaxing strategy idle shooter that blends bullet hell action with backpack-like inventory management. Pilot your vehicle through a desolate, post-modern world, conquer 20 difficulty levels, collect diverse weapons, and build the ultimate firepower lineup to survive the wasteland.

name: The Secret Story 1996
summary: What begins as a quiet night in an old hotel soon turns into a desperate fight for survival. As midnight approaches, Serena must uncover the truth, face her fears, and decide which path to take.

name: There Is No Escape
summary: There is no Escape is a storyless 2D side-scrolling puzzle platformer, it was inspired by early to late 2000's flash games of a similar nature. Jump, fail, repeat! Experience the nostalgia of the classic platforming genre.

name: Threadline
summary: A clean, rhythm‑infused precision runner where you weave through shifting obstacles with focus and flow. Threadline rewards instinct, timing, and mastery, delivering short, intense runs that pull you into a calm, satisfying state of momentum.

name: The Game That Was Stolen From Me at Indiecade2019
The Harbinger of the Deep
summary: Destroy the frustrations of other Beings and befriend them, or ignore them and slay them all instead! Shoot your actions and decide the fate of this submerged world in The Harbinger of the Deep!

name: The Road
summary: A co-op horror + driving game for up to 5 players. Explore an anomaly-ridden world, loot buildings for valuables, and drive for your life to escape the creatures that lurk.

name: The Anomaly Inspector
summary: You're an Anomaly Inspector working the night shift at a remote facility. Walk through each area, report what's wrong at the terminal—or report that everything is clear. But as the night progresses, the anomalies become harder to ignore. Can you survive until morning?

name: The Abandoned Levels
summary:
The Abandoned Levels is an intense single-player survival horror where the line between reality and nightmare blurs.
After a series of personal tragedies, you plunge into the eerie Backrooms – an endless labyrinth of dark corridors, decaying rooms, and deadly creatures that can kill you with the slightest mistake.

name: The Flintstones: Bedrock Jackpot
summary: Web browser game from Cartoon Network. The gameplay is a combination of a jackpot machine that results on a bowling play.

name: Thy Flesh Consumed
summary: Fight your way through the snowy cliffside and find your way into the village.

name: The Pirate: Republic of Nassau
summary: The Pirate: Republic of Nassau is an open-world pirate game that gives players the freedom to shape their own destiny. Plunder merchant ships or become a trader yourself. Take on missions from governors and follow tavern rumors to discover hidden caves and unlock special missions such as prison breaks or bandit camp assaults.

name: The Hell Provided
summary:
Every day is the same.

The weight of your duty grinds you down.

You live for life's sake.

When does it end?

name: The Sea of Glomp
summary: Sea of Glomp is an adventure puzzle game set in a surreal underwater world. You play as a fish on a mission to recover a stolen egg, journeying through diverse and unusual regions of the sea. The game emphasizes open-ended exploration, with no tutorials or direct instructions provided. Progress is achieved through experimentation and interaction with the environment. With a focus on discovery and non-linear gameplay, Sea of Glomp challenges players to navigate its expansive world and uncover its mechanics independently.

name: The Ghost Of Solaris
summary: When a legendary enforcer returns to a city transformed into a corporate prison, he must coordinate a high-stakes revolution to save his family and settle a debt written in blood. Experience a gritty story of betrayal and vengeance across the neon-drenched slums and silver towers of Solaris Bay.

name: The Kingdom of the Golden Thread and the MadClocks
summary: Two worlds, one brilliant bond.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Season Zero Dawn and Dusk
summary:
Season Zero: Dawn and Dusk is the first-ever “Season” released for The Elder Scrolls Online, launching on April 2, 2026. It marks a structural shift away from ESO’s traditional annual Chapter model toward shorter, roughly 90‑day Seasons, with all core gameplay content included for free for anyone who owns the base game.

Thematically, “Dawn and Dusk” represents a transitional age for ESO—both narratively and mechanically—setting the stage for future experimental content while modernizing long‑requested systems

It centers on a limited‑time Event Zone called The Night Market, located in the Oblivion realm of Fargrave.

Within the Night Market:

Players pledge allegiance to one of three unique factions
Each faction offers a series of challenging PvE encounters
Progression through the event rewards players with a free player home, Night’s Den.

The Night Market is framed as a dangerous, ever‑shifting crossroads of Daedric influence rather than a permanent open‑world zone, reinforcing the “dusk” side of the season’s theme.

name: The Last Hand
summary: The Last Hand is a gothic blackjack roguelike where players draft powerful modifiers, build custom decks, create synergistic combos, and face twisted dealers and bosses inside The House.

name: The Red Dowry
summary:
Your tiny, secluded and humble village has followed the same tradition of marrying a young girl to a secluded village on the mountains near you for ninety-years, with the special rule that no individual from your village ever goes to that village, and that the girl fully commits to her new life.

On the hundredth occasion of this tradition, your own wedding, you find out exactly why this tradition was so.

name: The Glory Dungeon Raider
summary: Enter the depths of a treacherous dungeon in The Glory Dungeon Raider, a fast-paced 2D roguelike where every run is a new challenge! Arm yourself with various weapons, and face off against deadly creatures. Do you have what it takes to survive?

name: The Gray Painter
summary:
In this 2012 New Jersey period piece of 150,000 words, help average office worker Ash gain the confidence to break up with their partner and make new friends in an exclusive private painting group.

Ash is a pre-set character. You can select Ash's sex, gender, and orientation. Ash begins the game in a relationship with Harper, a gender-selectable partner. The option to break up with Harper becomes available in Chapter 9 (out of 20 chapters).

name: The Day After Ever After
summary:
Play as Cinderella or her prince in a new twist on an old tale. You can usurp the throne, tear down the monarchy with a bloody revolution, and do just about anything you want to change this fairytale world you only think you know.

Explore a fantasy world filled with intrigue, danger, humor and magic while you navigate your royal role by continuing where the original story ended. Will you choose to take on the role of Cinderella, the classic character whose journey from peasant to princess is as fast as it is unexpected? Or perhaps you will experience life as her prince, a man born into power and privilege trying to find his way both in love and life outside of his father’s shadow? This is the first of many choices that could lead you to find love, win control of a country, or even alter reality itself!

name: The People's House
summary:
You’ve risen to the highest office in the land—the Presidency. The campaign was grueling, but the next four years promise to be even more daunting.

The People's House is an interactive novel by R. F. Kramer, where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—over 400,000 words, without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

name: The Last Opening
summary:
Play chess against Death. One move at a time.
Survive the cold, gather what you can, and shape a world where every action echoes on the board.

name: The Last Errant
summary: The Last Errant is a challenging, turn-based tactical deckbuilder where every move counts. Build your deck, master unique classes and variants, manage your sanity, evolve and mutate your cards, shape your playstyle through meaningful choices, and outthink your enemies on a grid-based battlefield with extreme replayability.

name: [This Game Isn’t Fun]
summary:
This game is a minimalistic platformer with simple enemies. You get as many lives as you need, restarting from the beginning of the current level, mostly. A speedrun would probably take about 30 minutes, but you won't beat it.
It's nearly impossible to get people to play a game you've made. With that in mind, this is a game that wins when no one plays it. To the game, existence is suffering. The longer you play the game, the more pain it passes on to you in an attempt to make you quit. The game itself is the final boss, and it's you vs the game. If you never play it, the game wins.

name: The Comyths
summary: Stop, slow, and rewind time in a bullet-hell action game. The Comyths is a reality-bending character-driven game where you wield the fundamental forces of Space, Time, Matter, Life, Mind, and Void. Chase S-ranks, unlock art rewards, and uncover story logs.

name: The Corporation
summary:
Created for Sprint - Jam.
Art and sprites by Juanje 'sometrash'

name: Third Crisis: Neon Nights
summary: A lewd 2D narrative RPG set in a neon-drenched megacity of corruption and desire. Make story-defining choices, engage in interactive challenges, and uncover secrets across its seedy districts. Give in to temptation, or fight to stay pure. Will you thrive in the Neon Nights?

name: The Red Wood
summary:
Cursed to see the deads, Golda must run from the ghost as they try to possess her for their own personal vendetta. All Golda wants is to find her mother, who disappeared, deep within the woods. But now Golda must battle not only the deads, but she has to stop something much... more... sinister.

The sequel to Red Grimly Tale.

name: They Not Fae!
summary: A short horror where you help a teenage girl rescue her cat, exploring a creepy building filled with creepy monsters.

name: The Canon of Balls
summary: Hardcore, first-person, co-op platformer. Shadow of the Colossus' PSX aesthetics meets Monkey Ball. An easy-to-learn, hard-to-master open-world experience to explore and master together with your friends. A vast open world, with each platforming course bringing its own twist.

name: The Sorting Bureau
summary: A cozy sorting game set in a quiet Tokyo workshop. Clients bring you boxes of clutter: buttons, coins, gears, stamps. Sort, match, and piece everything together with satisfying ASMR clicks. No timers. No wrong answers. Just the joy of tidying up.

name: The Time Traveler's Lost and Found
summary: A spine-breakingly fun shipping warehouse management simulator, where you take the role of a lonely logistics employee going through her workday: dreaming of a nice cup of coffee and a solid dental plan.

name: The Minimum Project
summary:
Hiroshi, an average if vertically-challenged student at Saisho Academy agrees to assist the science club president with one of her newest inventions. Something goes terribly wrong and he finds himself stuck at 1/100th of his normal height. Seek out someone to help you grow back while trying (or not) to avoid getting killed by unaware or malicious giantesses!

This is an adventure-style game created in RPG maker with scripted events, CGs, animations, and minigames.

The game also contains a few battle scenes, but they play out more like an event/minigame. There is no random enemy encounters or grinding in a conventional RPG sense in this game.

There is also an affection / affinity system in the game. How you interact with the characters will influence future dialogue / events with those characters.

name: The Void
summary: The Void is a wave based survival fps inspired by the movie "The Mist" and spiritual theology. Your objective is to survive by utilizing the scarce resources and fighting through the hordes of creatures.

name: The Dragon and the Sword
summary: Clea’s parents were murdered by a “dragon”―a creature that shouldn’t even exist. Determined to find it and gain the strength to slay it, she steps onto the adventurer’s path. When four individuals, each driven by different motives yet bound by a single purpose, come together, their story takes a dramatic turn...

name: The Woods
summary: The Woods is a short first-person horror game emphasizing atmosphere and tension, inspired by games like Slender or Seeking Evil: The Wendigo. Players explore a dark, eerie woods to collect 5 mementos with only a flashlight and limited stamina, all while being hunted by a creature of the forest.

name: The Cure
summary: The Cure is a 3D, action, survival horror game, in which the player must evade a monster that is continually chasing them. The player can evade by running or shutting doors, blocking off pathways to not be followed. The player must collect three cure vials in order to mix the final cure.

name: The Palace of Deceit: The Secret of Castle Lockemoer
There's Nothing Down There
summary: There's Nothing Down There is a short undersea horror exploration game. Descend into a sinkhole at the bottom of the ocean and discover the remains of a lost, yet not dead, civilization.

name: The Cook in the Court of the Count
summary: Chop till you drop in The Cook in the Court of the Count, a frantic time management game created for the Chicaghoul 2025 game jam! Weave your way through the treacherous kitchen within the walls of the Count's haunted castle to feed Dracula's ravenous army!

name: The Book of Outcasts
summary: A disgraced former soldier is recruited into a secretive order of royal investigators to find a rogue mage, but becomes caught up in the politics of a mysterious order of undying wizards and travelling from icy forests to exotic jungles in this RPG dungeon crawler and management sim.

name: Throne of Shards
summary: A dark TCG where you explore a massive dungeon, collect cards, and fight brutal battles. Each floor introduces its own unique rules, twisting the experience in this classic card adventure.

name: The Eclipse Files
summary: A dice-driven, Lovecraftian tactical RPG. Explore, solve mysteries, and battle on the strategic grid. Command your investigators between sanity and madness. Choose wisely—uncover the truth before the lurking madness consumes you.

name: The Alchemist's Cards
summary: The Alchemist's Cards is a casual 2D visual novel with card-based mechanics. Grow plants, brew potions, then sell or use them in battle! Explore the kingdom of Navitea, uncover secrets, and fight your way out of debt in this charming adventure.

name: The Buried Pillars
summary: Explore the world, fight fierce and alluring monster girls to uncover the secrets hidden within! A Metroidvania 2D platformer with combats that push you to the edge!

name: The Raid of Brunswick
summary: A first-person simulation where players take on the roles of a Lancaster bomber crew during a single World War II bombing raid over Brunswick.

name: Thingamajigs
summary: A cozy hidden object game about helping the inhabitants of a vibrant hand-drawn world. From troubled bards to awkward first dates, follow along with their stories to discover new locations and more people in need of a helping hand!

name: The Chosen Duck
summary: Welcome to The Chosen Duck. The world that you can be a... Duck! What were you expecting? So, get your ducks in a row, and let's begin our adventure!

name: The Fish Shack
summary:
A fun, free browser-based fishing game designed for Twitch streamers and their viewers.

Viewers can join the stream’s fishing pond directly through chat commands — no downloads, no sign-ups, completely free. Cast your line, catch fish, and climb the leaderboard in real-time alongside other viewers.

name: That Summer: Hannah's Summer Vacation
summary: In a quiet, somewhat remote town, Hannah lives with her father and younger brother. Eventually the summer break comes, and with it the question: "How to spend the last summer before her senior year in high school?"

name: The Hunter Files: Case One
summary: The Hunter Files: Case One is a story driven point and click adventure about a private detective caught in routine work. What starts as a simple surveillance job slowly turns into a missing person case, told through dialogue, puzzles, and exploration.

name: The Pissing Game
summary: Step into a bizarre world where even taking a piss becomes a quest. Kill bugs, earn Piss-coins, upgrade, unlock hidden areas… and ultimately, flush.

name: The Dark Path to the Black Tower
summary: Anomaly horror with a dark fantasy theme. Traverse a cursed forest on a stormy night. If you see signs of witchcraft, turn back... Else you remain trapped on the path for eternity...

name: The Path
summary:
The Path is a short procedural multiple choice text-based adventure that will create a different world and atmosphere every time you play it.

There is no right or wrong choice, only different endings based on your previous choices.

name: The Succubus Trap Island
summary:
Leaf, a female knight serving as the princess’s bodyguard, visits the island of Torion — a tourist spot known for its ancient ruins.
However, due to a small mishap and the schemes of the succubi who manage the island, she ends up having to conquer a dungeon filled with traps.

Will Leaf be able to reach Princess Marika, who awaits deep within the island?

name: The Brotherhood: The Way of the Sleeper
summary:
You are treading on hallowed ground...
Greetings, stranger. I see that you doubt what the henchmen of the archbarons try to sell you as true and just. You know why. Because it's LIES! They tell you that we worship a foolish idol, that our herb clouds the mind, and that our Templars are fanatical murderers. Don't be deceived by their false words! Witness our hospitality for yourself, taste the calming effects of the herb, and perhaps you will be one of the chosen ones to whom the Sleeper reveals himself in a dream...

In 2012, a small group of enthusiasts founded an RPG about the Brotherhood of the Sleeper in the WorldOfGothic subforum. For two years stories of faith, community and steaming root soup, but also of betrayal and the most heinous treachery, grew. Now you can experience these stories for yourselves. THE PATH OF THE SLEEPER (original title - Die Bruderschaft: Der Weg des Schläfers) accompanies the RPG's original members on their adventures within the Barrier. Will the brothers bring freedom to their community, or will they deliver the entire island into the clutches of a malevolent archdemon's madness? Find out!

name: The Bow: Ultimate Weapon
summary: A top-down shooter incremental game where you defeat enemies, sell loot, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat bosses for special items, and shape your own combat build through steady progression.

name: The Cluster
summary: Experience the story of Richard, a poor hunter, and his wife, Lilith. They are fighting to escape their circumstances with high hopes that their hard work is finally about to pay off, allowing them to leave this place behind forever.

name: The Aeon Fall
summary: Survival breeds threat. The Aeon Fall is a system-driven hardcore defense where growth noise stimulates the swarm. Build and survive an onslaught of 100,000 entities. Master strategic choices that evolve every session.

name: The Box
summary:
We are a small, recently founded independent studio, Cibeles Games. This is our first video game: a horror experience based on Catholic theology.

The game offers an unusual approach to the genre, exploring the concept of the devil and the struggle against evil from a perspective consistent with Catholic doctrine. To ensure this approach, the project consulted with priests and also features the participation of a real priest who collaborated by explaining, in one part of the game, what the devil is from the standpoint of Catholic theology.

Step into a chilling first-person point-and-click adventure where the line between faith and madness blurs. As a man of the cloth visiting an old friend in distress, you must unravel the mystery behind her condition. Explore a heavy psychological atmosphere within the walls of a decaying home, where you’ll question every shadow in this homage to 90s cult horror classics. To save a soul, you must first survive the truth.

Through its narrative and gameplay mechanics, the title aims to offer a different kind of horror experience, using the interactive medium to address spiritual and theological questions from a playful perspective.

Not recommended for children under 12.

name: The Don't Do List
summary:
An Interactive experience about making changes

You probably have a lot of To-Do Lists, but what about a Don't-Do List?

A unique, fun, and emotional experience about making changes.

name: Thieves and Tasers
summary: Sneak, steal, get tased. A fast-paced asymmetrical PvP heist game where thieves steal loot and scramble for their escape while security hunts them down. Team up, outsmart your friends, and make your escape. Or make sure nobody does.

name: The Door at the End of the Hall
summary: Trapped in a looping hallway, you must study subtle changes to choose the right doors. Each passage resets the hall, but slightly wrong. Observe carefully, make smart choices, and uncover the path that unlocks the mysterious door at the end of the hall.

name: The Cursed Hotel
summary: A short game inspired by 90s horror games where you must escape a zombies infested hotel by using the elevator

name: The Adventures of Graham
summary: A sci-fi retro Metroidvania. Help Brigadier General Graham recover his gear, defeat enemies, and complete his mission.

name: The Last Inquisition
summary: The witch hunt begins. Command your followers in a dark roguelike strategy experience. Evolve spells and units without limits through blood and faith. Shape formations, adapt tactics, and uncover the conspiracy in ever-changing battles.

name: The Concrete Sutra #1
summary: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

name: The love letter
summary: A interactive fanfiction inside the world of Shingeki no Kyojin

name: Three Misses Confectionery
summary: On a rainy afternoon, a young man takes shelter in a cute and quiet confectionery. Three sweet chefs welcome him enthusiastically and offer irresistible cakes.

name: The Universal Symphony
summary: Feel the beat, keep the city shining.

name: The Woman Above
summary: The Woman Above — a psychological horror game where, during your vacation, you check into a rented apartment and on the very first night hear strange moans coming from the apartment above. Will you dare to go and find out what’s happening up there?

name: The Echoes of Me
summary: The Echoes of Me is a first‑person horror experience focused on tense exploration and completing objective‑based sequences under pressure. You’ll move through dark environments, search for key items, and trigger events that push the story forward. Typical gameplay centres on roaming, solving environmental puzzles, and avoiding enemies that react to your presence. Expect scripted scares, dynamic jump scares, a quick‑time event, and a chase sequence.

name: The Payphone
summary: You are an investigator working in a near-bankrupt agency, however a case no-one would take landed on your desk. Disappearances of Ashfield Plains, each case is hauntingly similar, all their final phone calls were traced back to that specific payphone. Short on cash, you took the case.

name: The Restricted Index
summary: Read between the lies in this first-person mystery puzzle game. You are the last librarian in Britain. Identify books. Recommend them. Ban them. Burn them. Uncover a catalogue of secrets and lost stories buried between the pages.

name: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
summary: Mind-controlled squirrels! Alien abductions! Monsters in the forest! Are the rumors true - or is it just an elaborate hoax?  Help Maya Harper unravel this comedy point 'n click mystery and escape Doomsday Valley alive.

name: The Well Is Not Empty
summary: The well has gone dry. It's up to you to find out why. Traverse through abandoned tunnels. Discover remnants of a ritual never meant to be seen. Power dying machinery to bring light into darkness. Dig into broken earth and crawl your way out. Down here you’re not exploring... you're trespassing.

name: The Darkness of Gordoth
summary:
Frightening things begin to happen in the Old Camp. Diggers are dying in unexplained and brutal circumstances. The murderer remains elusive for the guards. At the same time, one of the most powerful barons, Oldrik, suddenly disappears. The case of finding the baron is assigned to Anton - once the best of the detectives in Khorinis. Dense darkness envelopes the Valley of Mines.

The modification offers:
- a dark plot for a few hours of fun
- new horror music and dark atmosphere
- new scripts, sounds, textures, models
- full polish dubbing

name: The Golden Gate
summary:
Golden Gate is an iconic total conversion modification for Gothic 2: Night of the Raven. Its story takes place 10 years after the events from Gothic 3 and tells about another adventure of the Nameless Hero. The Kingdom of Myrtana needs his help once more!

Jharkendar is under the invasion of the Plague of Beliar – the forces of good and evil race each other to uncover the legendary treasury, Golden Gate, which hides uncountable riches and powerful artifacts! On your way, you will meet new companions but also many old friends. Can you find the mysterious treasury before the minions of the Dark God do so?

name: The Dark Saga
summary:
The story narrates about Alaster and Marik, new heroes who plunged into adventure. They decided to make their life of idleness in Vanguard more varied and exciting. Searching of an ancient treasure was their main purpose but the destiny has her own thoughts on them. So they will get a lot more than originally planned.

Features:
- new worlds like: arge island, three-leveled ore mine, ancient fort dungeons
- 5 fractions with unique quests: slaves, orc mercenary, ferocian hunters, paladins and pirates
- new monsters, animations, skills
- approximately 300 pages long scenario containing over 90 quests
- around 40 hours of gameplay

name: The Valley of Dawn
summary:
The Valley of Dawn (original title - Долина Рассвета) is a mod in which you will play the role of a former assassin named Derek, who once worked for the ore baron Raven. The owner betrayed him, and his beloved fell into the clutches of the Dark Magician. Pursuing the necromancer, Derek enters the Valley of Dawn and realizes that getting to the enemy will not be easy. He has to kill the necromancer, save his beloved and decide the fate of the inhabitants of the Valley of Dawn...
Features:
- new colorful world
- new items and armor
- new textures
- about 50 interesting quests
- from 8 hours of playing time
- strong connection with the original story
- two guilds to join
- slideshow videos in the style of "The Witcher"
- new NPCs with developed characters

name: The Snowdrop Diaries
summary: Raised by the nuns inside the monastery's walls, Nellie grew up being a dreamer who loves reading old books. She feels like her beloved legends are trying to warn her about the return of an ancient murderous monster. Will she be able to save the people she cares about when they say that monsters aren't real?

name: The Housekeeper
summary: The Housekeeper is a psychological horror simulation game where you will work as the new night shift housekeeper at an ominous hotel. As you work through your shifts, you will start to experience strange events. Will these events reveal a dark secret, or will they be the cause of your demise?

name: The Cabin Game
summary: The Cabin Game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...

name: The Silver Crow
summary: You play Conrad - executioner, outcast, and the last man anyone would trust to solve a murder. A handcrafted adventure steeped in Renaissance atmosphere, occult shadows and moral ambiguity. A point & click mystery in a city where truth is buried, power decides guilt, and someone is always watching.

name: The Hall
summary: The Hall - a rare place entered by people who have truly discovered their true inner self, beware of the white walls, the jazz music, its all in your mind. They say its the gate for inner peace, but with a big price to pay.

name: The Last Show
summary: The Last Show is a survival game show where players compete against unpredictable robot hosts. Gather 2–8 players to face bizarre AI clones and test your wit with chaotic rounds like Topic Thunder and Singled Out. Use your phone to input topics, craft funny answers, and sabotage friends for victory. Each game offers unique, unscripted fun as the hosts improvise roasts based on player responses, ensuring replayability and laughs.

name: The Magic Hour
summary: "The Magic Hour" is a sequel to "Together Again: A Lake's Funland Story" set 20 years after the game's events, it covers a new story full of new faces and new tragedies. Try walking in Reagan Schmidt's shoes as she tries to survive a week at this place, so lively in the day's bright light, but rather obscure and dangerous at night.

name: The Abandoned House in Yeongdeok
summary: She was sent to the abandoned house in Yeongdeok as part of a viewer punishment challenge. But the joke ended the moment the door slammed shut.

name: The Candy Adventure
summary: Dive into The Candy Adventure! Join your friend after falling through a magical portal and getting lost in a world of enchanted sweets. On an epic journey home. Alone or in cooperation, every moment is a delightful surprise. Adventure, friendship and sweetness await you!

name: The Edge of Water
summary: An adventure game about a girl leading her floating village on the course of a great fish migration. Herd sea creatures, protect them from danger, and surf across both beautiful scenery and troubled waters.

name: The Last (Hotdog) Stand
summary: Run your own hotdog stand in this fast-paced food management game! Take orders, make dogs, and keep customers happy as you work to grow your hotdog empire, and restore hotdogs to their former glory. Upgrade your stand, unlock new ingredients, and expand to bigger, busier locations!

name: The Angel's Mandate
summary: The Angel's Mandate is a first-person horror game where you play as Jesse, who finds himself in the palace of an angel after his mother falls ill, slowly losing her senses and physical control, one piece at a time. The angel claims you can save her, and asks you to face a trial beyond mortal limits.

name: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
summary: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, secure vital sectors, deploy fortifications, and unlock new units and upgrades mid-battle to outmaneuver and crush the alien threat.

name: Throttle Trace
summary: Slot cars meets simulation racing. Master grip, timing, and race strategy using only throttle and brake. Push to the limit, outsmart rivals, and fight for every corner in intense wheel-to-wheel competition.

name: The Last Customer
summary:
A normal shift at a restaurant… until it isn’t.
Strange customers. Unnatural behavior.
Some of them are not human.

Something is watching from the dark.

Reality vs illusion.
Keep working… even if something doesn’t want you to.

Playtime: 10–12 minutes (depending on how you play)

name: This One's From Santa
summary: The Gelido Goons have taken over the North Pole and only the intrepid Elfy can save Christmas! Pair up with Blitzen to take down the mob but don't miss your deliveries! Chuck presents at homes and coal at the naughty neighbors and if you cause a little mayhem, forgiveness is in the Christmas spirit!!

name: The Hollow Complex
summary: The Hollow Complex is an action-filled survival thriller inspired by the Backrooms. Dive into a dark and twisted rendition of internet folklore that actually allows you to fight back. Explore, scavenge, complete quests, and find a way out of a seemingly endless labyrinth.

name: The One Who Wouldn't Leave
summary: In this psychological horror experience, you must survive the night, and uncover who you can trust - if anyone.

name: The Chambers Beneath
summary:
You are an adventurer who has recently arrived in a once-bustling medieval city whose streets are strangely deserted. The people are here, but they no longer gather in the cobbled streets and the public squares. Instead, they cower in the safety of their houses. Few shops are open, and it is difficult to find out the cause of this eerie quiet.

All that you can find out from the few frightened, gabbling citizens you come across is that a great and significant treasure has gone missing from the city. It seems that this is no ordinary treasure, but one that guarantees the safety of the city and its inhabitants. With it missing, everyone is expecting a great calamity to fall upon them.

You will have to consult the city’s ruler to find out exactly what has gone missing, and what reward there is to the hero who retrieves it. All you can gather from those you have spoken to so far is that there exists a network of underground passages and chambers with unsavoury inhabitants, and everyone believes the treasure has been hidden down there.

So being an adventurer hungry for glory, you think you should be the one to take on the quest, and venture down into The Chambers Beneath. This is a role-playing game, of a type sometimes known as a roguelike or a dungeon crawler. It is turn-based, meaning that the emphasis is not on fast reactions but on planning and careful con- sideration.

In this game you will be choosing a character, and equipping them with weaponry to start the adventure. You’ll be descending into the dungeons, killing monsters, finding treasure, and improving your natural attributes and skill set in order to deal with ever more difficult challenges down in the depths. And if you do well, you’ll be returning to the ruler of the city to present them with the lost treasure and gain a great reward.

The Chambers Beneath runs on any PC with an 8088 processor, CGA graphics, and 512k RAM, or better, including an emulated PC in DOSBox.

name: The Guidelines: Hotel Napoli
summary: "High pay. Simple tasks. Room and board included." Monitor "anomalies" through hidden CCTV cameras scattered throughout the hotel rooms. You must accurately judge and report whether a situation requires a mere cleaner, the intervention of law enforcement, or... something far beyond.

name: Three The Hard Way
summary: Recognized by many as a classic of the RPG Maker genre since its release in 2003, it has 50+ hours worth of content, complex plot and a growth system similar to the SaGa series. A non-direct sequel, called The Queen's Court, was announced in 2007, though it seems to be on hiatus ever since.

name: The Adventure Collection
summary:
"Welcome to the world of interactive fiction. The story is yours to unravel. Every inquiry elicits response. Your every command evokes an action... or perhaps inaction... which may intrigue you further. It's a world of suspense requiring word for word interpretation of a puzzling story only your imagination can solve. A world where curiosity could be the only thing to keep you alive. And knowing could 'literally' kill you."

This is a collection of several Infocom interactive fiction games, including: Border Zone, Cutthroats, Infidel, Planetfall, Plundered Hearts, Trinity, and Zork III.

name: The Case of the World between Worlds
summary: Hidden magic, real mates, and a city that is quietly falling apart.

name: The End Comes Tomorrow: Gamebook Edition
summary:
A narrative choice adventure about the end of the world.
Live out your last day on earth however you please. Your choices will quickly veer into the unpredictable.

name: The Reflection
summary: The Reflection is a ritual-based co-op horror game where players attempt to exorcise a demonic entity while being relentlessly hunted. Investigate cursed locations, perform the correct rituals, stay silent, and work together under pressure — one mistake can mean certain death.

name: The Amazing Digital Dating Sim
summary:
The Amazing Digital Dating Simulator is a visual novel style fan-game for Glitch's popular hit show "The Amazing Digital Circus".

Taking place in the anime adventure world, spend 5 days helping the cast prepare for the upcoming culture festival. There are 5 romance-able characters: Pomni, Ragatha, Gangle, Zooble, and Jax!

And Caine and Kinger fans, don't you fret! Caine and Kinger routes are currently being written to add to the game at a later date.

name: The Crosley Tower Horror
summary: The Crosley Tower Horror is a game heavily inspired by the real life building by the same name (Crosley Tower). This game is an urban exploration with strong horror elements. You will be able to explore 6 available floors of the tower, including the mysterious and closed off 16th floor. To reach the top and steal the D.E.M.O.N. sphere, you must solve puzzles, navigate asbestos filled corridors, and find notes left behind by the scientists. Not everything is as it seems in the halls of Crosley.

name: The Mask of Agnosia
summary: The Mask of Agnosia is a surreal 3D narrative RPG. Navigate and map a shifting network of waterways to recover a boat keeper’s memories. Solve matching puzzles to reveal a fallen kingdom, confront specters of time, and collect sacred masks to rebuild an ancient tower before the light fades.

name: The Rhymatory
summary: The Rhymatory is a mobile word game with over 300 rhyming riddles to solve in a cozy, steampunk atmosphere. For each riddle, players must answer with a pair of rhyming words. A fox, an owl, and a crow accompany you to provide hints as needed and brew a steady supply of tea.

name: The Final Days of Olin Earl
summary: Investigate, trespass, eavesdrop, and platform through a would-be murder mystery as a lovable old grandpa who made a deal with Death for all the right reasons.

name: The Hollow Road: Prologue
summary: A psychological horror prologue where a strange house, a silent church, and something lurking in the dark pull you into a waking nightmare. Explore, uncover hidden truths, and survive what waits beyond the last door.

name: The Shocking World Mysteries
summary:
That nagging feeling is the doorway to the truth.
Tap your way to the shocking secrets behind each baffling case!

name: The Outer Frame
summary: Discover the truth. Bury it better. Decide how before the masses turn on you. A choice-driven mystery where witnesses and evidence are in your hands.

name: The Golden Caravan
summary: Fight your way up The Golden Caravan Casino in this noir Roguelite where Poker Battles decide your fate. Play bold Hands, gamble for powerful Trinkets and pull daring Tricks to shift the odds in your favor.

name: The Grimwood Hex
summary: The Grimwood Hex is a wooden roguelike deckbuilder where time is against you. Place and explore a board of enchanted tiles, craft unique decks and fight twisted creatures in the safety of daylight, rushing back to the town before nightfall.

name: Theatre of War: Rearmed
summary: Command real-time WWII battles across the complete Theatre of War series, unified on the latest version of its original engine. Experience deep tactical combat, realistic ballistics, and over 100 missions, enhanced for modern systems.

name: The Legend of Heroes IV: Akai Shizuku
summary: Windows remake of the PC98 game of the same name. Features a more linear narrative-focused design with a completely rewritten script to bring it more in line with the other two games of the trilogy, as opposed to the non-linear design of the original.

name: The New Adventures Of Billy The Kid
summary: Lonesome Cowboy Faust.

name: The Insanity Box
summary:
The Insanity Box --- Full solo game I made as I started learning how to code. Inspired by "The Impossible Quiz" and "WarioWare". At this point I would make 500-2000$ for a game lol. I considered this "enough".

DON'T PRESS TAB, EVER!

Entry for the Max Games contest!

There are SAVE POINTS on level 25, 50 and 75.

name: The Three Little Pigs: Interactive Book
The Guest II
summary: The Guest II is a first-person psychological horror experience.

name: The Archives of Trevosa
summary: Search through the hidden archives of Trevosa, translate their cultural terms, and uncover the relationships within a complex royal family tree. Can you untangle all seven generations? A challenging narrative deduction game inspired by The Roottrees Are Dead.

name: The Electric Bots
summary: Fight as unique combat-ready robots in spear-based melee battles. Experience Story, Quick Game, Training, and Drone Modes. Master skills, spray toxic gas as a drone, and battle through gritty prison arenas with immersive sound and replayable challenges.

name: The World Is Ruled According to Sexual Prowess So I’m Playing Dirty to Get My Harem: Episode 1
summary: Having being hit by a truck and dying, the loser man, Mihara Yuji is revived to a world where women are taken possession by men who are good at sex.

name: The Tenth Minute
summary: The Tenth Minute is a short emotional visual novel about memory, regret, and the words people fail to say at the right moment. The game focuses on reading, character conversations, and quiet choices that affect how certain scenes unfold.

name: The Comeback King
summary: The Comeback King is a light-hearted, mildly satirical retro boxing management game set in the UK in the 1980s. Take on a has-been boxer and manage his career. Decide who he'll fight, train him up and send him into the ring! Can you guide your boxer to a title contest against the division Champion?

name: The Crane Rider's Tale
summary: Fly passengers around a fantasy town inspired by Chinese folktales and unravel a mindbending, Zero Escape-like mystery.

name: The Art of Creation
summary: This horror based visual novel is a retelling of the story of Adam & Eve in a queer context that strives to eliminate the stigma certain religions can hold towards members of the LGBTQ+ community.

name: The Quiz Quest
summary: The Quiz Quest is a text-based short boss battle game where the goal is to face three tough opponents for a million dollars. You start with 100 "points", and when the other two contestants attack you with trivia, answering correctly gives you some of their points, while being wrong gives them some of your points. Once the contestants both hit 0, the host of the show himself comes to fight you for the money.

name: The Trials: Chapter Two
summary: A classic 90s choose your own adventure style horror visual novel. Escape the horrors hunting you, make decisions, forge your own path. An original complete story with multiple endings. Choose your own play style with a Text Adventure Mode, sound effects, and an ambient soundtrack.

name: The Kingsward
summary: Explore an open-world RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.

name: Thor: God of Thunder
summary: Thor: God of Thunder is a third-person beat-’em-up where you battle across realms, climb the frozen mountain, and defeat the Frost King. Unlock new armor and storm powers like Thunder Wave and Loki’s Illusion. Crush Frost Giants, transform into a Titan, and fight to a reactive rock soundtrack.

name: The Bazaar: Karnok
summary: The Karnok DLC adds the playable hero Karnok to The Bazaar alongside over 120 new items, skills, and unique encounters to aid Karnok on his hunts.

name: The House Always Wins
summary:
The House Always Wins is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a bizarre multiverse casino where every run is built on clever choices, powerful synergies, and calculated chaos.

Build your deck, battle through strange worlds, and collect relics in the form of playing cards. Each relic has its own unique effect, but the real power lies in the combinations you create. Form classic poker hands like pairs, three of a kind, or full houses to unlock massive bonuses, then experiment to uncover secret combos hidden throughout the game. You are not just building a deck — you are building a winning hand.

name: The Wandering Her
summary: Stitch delicate threads and solve gentle puzzles while restoring pieces of forgotten embroidery. As old photos, worn fabrics, and unfinished patterns resurface, uncover a quiet story of memories, family, and a secret hidden within the threads of time.

name: The End of Warriors
summary: This is a strategy round rogue-like RPG. Random maps, random events, free teams, skill matches, and turn-based battles, where players will lead their teams to a magnificent revenge for the justice in their hearts!

name: The Wizard of Gloss
summary: The Wizard of Gloss is a PSX-style metroidvania game with horror elements. Grab your wand and prepare for a bloodbath.

name: The Song Of Will
summary: Arise and step into the whimsical, mysterious world of The Song Of WILL, a turn-based, story driven RPG that feels alive!

name: The Old Flesh of Nuraga
summary: Search among the sands of Nuraga to unearth what's driving your grandpa mad. The Ancient Times are seeping out. Will you succumb to them?

name: The Last Letter
summary: The Last Letter is a short VHS-style horror game about a film student who receives mysterious letters containing coordinates that lead to a house deep in the forest, where the truth about his past awaits.

name: The Last Summer
summary: The Last Summer is a psychological horror adventure about childhood memories, the fear of growing up and the fear of discovering the true identity of a family. No big jumpscares but just a story waiting to be discovered, with a sprinkle of items to find around and a lot of videogames references. Get ready to explore Timothy troubled mind and childhood as he unveils the secrets behind his apparently "normal" family life.

name: The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows
summary: In The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows, play as a dog defending your family from paranormal creatures. Explore the world and solve environmental puzzles to save your loved ones and uncover the mystery.

name: The Freeblades
summary: The Freeblades is a Multiplayer Co-Op, Dungeon-Adventure RPG set in a gritty, low-fantasy Medieval world ruled by noble houses, magical cults, and tribal monsters.

name: The Soul Inside Us
summary: In the midst of dark secrets and deadly dangers, do you have the courage to survive and thwart the spirit's plans? Embark on this thrilling adventure with The Soul Inside Us and push your limits!

name: Throne Requiem
summary: Embark on a dark, brutal quest in this first-person, party-based dungeon crawler. Choose from 50 classes to form your 6-member team and conquer the Dark Tower, or recruit monsters in tamer mode. Every decision matters in this medieval world where insanity and death are commonplace. Will you survive?

name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
summary: It’s the golden age of game nights with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Play 5 brand-new party games designed to turn your standard bash into a sidesplitting blast. You bring the friends, we’ll bring the fun. Coming this fall to screens near you!

name: The Meter is Running
summary: You inherited a taxi dispatch business but it came with debt attached. Hire drivers, dispatch fares, navigate Istanbul’s chaos, deal with bad customers and worse luck. You have 15 days to pay it off or lose everything. The meter is running.

name: The Dream Machine: The Definitive Edition
summary:
The Dream Machine is an award-winning point & click adventure about exploring other people’s dreams.

Delve into surreal, hand-crafted worlds built from real physical materials as you uncover the secrets of a strange apartment building — and the people who live there.

The Definitive Edition includes all chapters, a reworked back half, new locations, and improved sound and visuals.

name: The Call Button
summary: It's a psychologial observation-based horror thriller. Every day you wake up in a hospital bedroom. You notice anomalies? Take your pills. You think it's safe? Use the call button. But survive long enough, and you must face your interactive nightmares...

name: The Deepest Castle
summary: You are a mighty knight - how powerful your blows are! And in the very center of a vast forest lies a fortress filled with evil and black magic. There, they raise the dead and hide great artifacts. You decide to explore the fortress and see what the black magicians are hiding.

name: The Crust: Supporter Pack
summary: Supporter Pack includes: Exclusive Beacon of Hope module, Digital Artbook, The Crust Wallpapers, and exclusive vehicle skins.

name: The Dreams in the Peacock House
summary: Wake up from a never-ending slumber and find your lost dreams in the shadows of the Peacock House.

name: The Birth Cry
summary: Mikhail Markov, lives in the city of Nesgrad in Virelia in the 1990s. The city's old maternity hospital, "Riverside Maternity Hospital," has been closed, and many stories and paranormal claims circulate among the public about its whereabouts.

name: The Aleksandre Case
summary:
Take out a human trafficking ring.

Gather clues, solve puzzles and crack open Aleksandre's passwords in this minimalist experience.

name: The Abyssal Diplomat
summary: The humans and the monsters can't agree on what year it is, a conflict that threatens to tear apart their sense of shared reality. A mysterious creature is called upon to bring the two communities together. The Abyssal Diplomat will do its best. But will its best be enough?

name: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire - From the Streets
summary:
From the Streets is a major update for The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire that expands the game’s sandbox progression with new starting paths, activities, and criminal management systems. Players can take on roles such as dealer, thief, or club owner while building illegal operations and avoiding an expanded police and wanted system.

The update also adds upgradeable warehouses, new jobs and side activities, RPG-style progression improvements, vehicle damage systems, and expanded combat and customization features.

name: The Door in The Skybox
summary: “The Door in The Skybox” is a third-person puzzle game about manipulating door frames to connect fragmented spaces. Featuring a surreal, dreamlike style inspired by 19th–20th century art, the game spans fifteen levels, each with a distinct visual identity.

name: There’s Something Wrong With the Hero’s Choices
summary:
It's supposed to be a simple novel game, but the "choices" are just plain weird!?
A wildly unconventional text adventure game where twists beyond your imagination await!
Guide the hero's party to the Dark Lord by making one bizarre choice after another!

name: The Journal of Ambrose Brant
summary: The Journal of Ambrose Brant was created for Pirate Jam 15, themed "Shadows & Alchemy".

name: The Manaworks
summary: Click, build, and grow! Gain resources, build to increase resource gathering potential, automate to get more and more, faster and faster. Upgrade buildings, stats, and see the numbers go up!

name: The Lost Froglins
summary: What if Vampire Survivors was a platformer? 100 lost baby froglins are trapped in a cave. Every one you save joins your swarm and fights for you. One is cute. Ten is trouble. A hundred is unstoppable. Die, upgrade, go again. A roguelite side-scroller.

name: The Real Academic Challenge High School Level
summary: A high school–level academic challenge that even adults stumble over

name: The Exegesis of John the Martyr
summary: The Exegesis of John the Martyr was an experimental ergodic text about ghosts, loneliness and the instability of narrative. It was designed in a custom engine using assets from and inspired by Hotline Miami, and represented an attempt at exploring the potential of the Hotline Miami visual style as a medium for alternative experiences and genres.

name: The Way Home
summary: A first-person psychological horror game set in the remote countryside of South Korea in the 1990s. Over the course of just three days, you will encounter a series of mysterious events and come face-to-face with an unseen, encroaching threat

name: The Lonely Dog Yearns For Love
This House Wants No One Else
summary: THIS HOUSE WANTS NO ONE ELSE is an interactive fanzine-ish endeavor.

name: The Fullness of the Air
summary: revisit your 500-year-old past

name: That Time My School Was Invaded by Dimensional Snakes and Now I'm Bound to a Multiverse Protector!
summary: A browser-based survival horror and psychological visual novel where a school is suddenly attacked by giant dimensional snakes. As reality begins to collapse, hidden choices and long-term consequences shape character survival, uncovering a darker multiverse mystery beyond the initial disaster.

name: The Little Crumb
summary: The Little Crumb is a cute management sim set in a toy-like world. Bake and serve handcrafted treats, customise your character, befriend quirky wooden locals, and grow your shop into a warm, thriving bakery.

name: The Last Prayer
summary:
The Last Prayer is a first-person psychological horror game.
How much can a game truly affect your real life?

Set within a realistic home environment and inspired by real events, this story places you in the middle of terrifying moments beyond imagination. As you confront the darkness lurking within, the line between reality and nightmare slowly begins to fade.

name: The Doom Brutalist Community Project
summary:
Rejoice! Lovers of All Things Grey!

Welcome to D.B.C.P. or the Doom Brutalist Community Project, inspired by Quake community's Quake Brutalist Jam, it is an community project where we seek to bring brutalism to the colourful world of good o' Doom. Venture through twenty-eight maps of different mapper's interpretation of brutalism and their implementation in Doom, whether it is a grey desolate mega structure, an aftermath of socialist brutalism, or an abandoned cement city which had become mother-nature's lush garden.

name: The Quiet Pelagian
summary: The method was that taking and bending of materials and people to one purpose, the outlook that everything could be used in the fight; that nothing could be excluded, that everything was a weapon, and the ability to handle those weapons, to find them and choose which one to aim and fire; that talent, that ability, that use of weapons...

name: The Journey of the Gnomes: The Battle of the Elder Isles
summary: The Journey of the Gnomes is an atmospheric, arcade fantasy roguelite survivor. Stand as a beacon against the shadow horde, master elemental magic, and protect the ancient light of the Gnomelands.

name: Thornkin
summary: Into the thorns, through the dark.

name: The Curse 404
summary: The Curse 404 is a psychological horror puzzle game set inside a mysterious house trapped in a repeating time loop. Each time you awaken, the environment resets but the clues you discover remain.
developers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
publishers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

name: Thornspell
summary: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. Thornspell is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

name: The Talos Principle III
summary: The Talos Principle 3 is the last chapter of the thought-provoking first-person puzzle series, taking you on a cosmic journey across more than a dozen worlds and testing your mind with all-new challenges.

name: The Endless Village
summary: Automate your growth, uncover a gorgeous city, and chase the ultimate metric: Liveliness. This cozy idle clicker lets you unlock passive income boosts and powerful minigames to rapidly scale your empire. Attract every unique citizen and claim your spot on the global leaderboard!

name: The Frog’s Adventure
summary:
He is not a handsome frog, but he wears overalls, boots, and is very likeable.
A superhero nobody asked for.

name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Nightmare Slayer Skin
summary: The hidden world is much like an RPG game. There are enemies you can strike down at any moment, items to collect, and occasionally quest missions to undertake!

name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Sehwa Arts High School Skin
The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Gangster Shaman Girl Skin

- The Last Spell The Last Spell
