name: The Great Beyond
summary:
Defeat the onslaught of aliens by building your own moon base, placing & upgrading tower defences, managing units, and mining resources!

Colony Sim, Underground, Strategy, Simulation.

name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Overaction Skin
summary: Wider eyes and a gaping mouth! Young-ho has honed his acting skills through self-taught methods. His exaggerated gestures and expressions make his very character seem altered, rendering horrific and terrifying situations all the more grotesque... or absurdly ridiculous.

name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Daughter of a Millionaire Skin
The Long Dark: Quiet Apocalypse Edition
The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Autumn Girl Skin
summary: The crisp Korean autumn. The melancholic atmosphere, intertwined with vibrant autumn foliage, feels like a fashion week for Korea's youth. To keep pace with the dazzling fashionistas roaming the streets, Mina adorns herself to the fullest today.

name: The Backrooms
summary: The Backrooms is a horror adventure game where you explore the liminal space of the Backrooms while you interact with strange and creepy characters. Explore the Backrooms, find the unexpected as you go into impossible spaces and see things you shouldn't have seen.

name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Overly Attractive Teacher Skin
summary: Sehwa Private High School was thrown into utter chaos by her appearance. In fact, the entire school in Songreung District suffered the consequences. Not only was she a teacher with an impressive CV, having studied abroad, but her looks were celebrity-grade, and her attire was excessive...

name: The Return To Freddy's 2
summary: The Return To Freddy's 2 is the second installment in the TRTF Saga, but despite the game having a '2' in the title, this game is actually a prequel to The Return To Freddy's Classic, taking place a few decades before it. The next game in the series is The Return To Freddy's 3.

name: The Retro Exorcist
summary: You've been hired to perform exorcisms on all sorts of entities. The only thing you can't seem to understand is...why do they all haunt video games?

name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines - Ghost Agent No. 3 Skin
summary: Our Youngho is one of a kind; the more splendid the vigilante, the more shabbily he dresses, and he thought it utterly uncool to live in filth just to scrape by. So Youngho went to a tailor in the Coma, picked out a splendid suit, donned a tie, and hid his piercing gaze behind sunglasses.

name: The Coma: Sehwa Complete Edition
summary:
The Coma: Sehwa Complete Edition contains:
The Coma: Recut
The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters
The Coma 2B: Catacomb
The Coma 3: Bloodlines

name: The Infinite Grimoire
summary: Build your magical academy, produce arcane tomes, merge them into stronger forms, train students, and expand your influence across the world. An idle management game where your spellcraft grows even while you're away.

name: The Northsong Rift
summary: Project made with RPG Maker Unite for the RPG Maker Themed Game Jam #6: Journey to the Underworld.

name: The Vaults Below Durn: A Field Study
summary: Three Doors. One Safe Path. Observe the signs, learn the patterns, and uncover the fate of the explorer who ventured before you.

name: The Fallen Castle: Chapter 1
summary: The equilibrium between the living and the dead has been shattered in the kingdom of Selestia. Play as Victoria, a young soldier tasked with stopping a supernatural invasion. A narrative-driven RPG with dark comedy elements, exploring themes of grief, resilience, and personal identity through a psychological journey where time is limited.

name: Threeboard
summary: Use a three button keyboard to load binary data into a shift register to solve puzzles.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Beyond the Horizon - Complete Launch Edition
summary: The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon Complete Launch Edition bundles the full JRPG experience with extensive cosmetic, audio, and gameplay add-ons. Alongside the base game it includes multiple character outfits and costume packs, BGM collections, Starter and Advanced gameplay packs, survival items, and art/music extras—offering deep customization and convenience while you explore Zemuria’s story-rich world.

name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails Beyond the Horizon - Ultimate Edition
summary:
The Legend of Heroes: Trails beyond the Horizon - Ultimate Edition includes:

Base game

name: The Starlit Escape
summary: A Game Boy style Metroidvania about exploring a haunted space station and meeting ghosts along the way! Made in the month of October for Halloween!

name: The Last Ladybug
summary: Fly forward and save your swarm in THE LAST LADYBUG - a rail shooter set in a colorful world where the skies are ruled by mechanical monsters and the lands are scorched by destruction!

name: The 60 Second Syndrome
summary: You will die in 60 seconds. This is a single-player horror escape game in which a man trapped within a 60-second time loop must escape from a sealed room. Inside the locked room, time resets every time you die. Observe repeating phenomena, remember the changes, and break free from the loop.

name: The Grove
summary: Scout out an uncanny pine grove for hidden artifacts and discover the fate of the children who went missing from a quiet town in Indiana.

name: The Case of the Cryosleep Killer
summary: A hard sci-fi murder mystery in space. Scour the bowels of the Ark ship for tactile clues, uncover hidden connections, and unlock the secrets of the sleeping passengers.

name: The Last Camp: Dawn
summary: The Last Camp is a post-apocalyptic world-themed game. It utilizes high-quality graphics, a rich weapon and item system, and a vast world map to create a cross-generational twin-stick shooter, bringing a feast to hardcore shooter players.

name: There Are Millions of Goblins
summary: Fight gigantic hordes of goblins with a supercharged vehicle and arsenal of crazy weapons, in a chaotic physics-based battle for survival

name: The Architects of the Universe: The Orbital Wars
The Occultist: Deluxe Edition
summary:
The Deluxe Edition of The Occultist contains:

-The Occultist game
-The game's complete Soundtrack
-The Occultist Artbook with over 200 pages of behind-the-scenes material

name: The Azure One
summary: Follow the young boy Qiuxu to meet the girl who always sprints in the sunshine, and get to know three other girls with distinct personalities. In the daily life of the Second Municipal High School, you will witness a youth that cannot be turned back — a story destined to go somewhere.

name: The Red Weight
summary: Mars, Bab al-Hadid habitat. A body in a corridor. A cover-up nobody asked you to crack. How much weight will you carry for another?

name: The Marvelous Raincaster of Yell Holler
summary: A time-looping puzzle ballad of Ozark folk superstition. Reorder events in time to unravel the legend of a weather-making rooster.

name: The Particle of Infinite Free Will
The Kaiju is My Childhood Friend
summary: A high schooler's life takes a crazy turn when he is reunited with his childhood friend who, occasionally, turns into a 300-ft tall kaiju.

name: Thornhold
summary:
Thornhold is a forest-defense autobattler where water is your most powerful weapon, and you choose where it flows. Shape the forest and protect the Great Tree from lumber-hungry orcs.

Route a river across a grid, place tree structures and troops, and survive waves of escalating orc hordes. Every cell you connect, every terrain you activate, and every card you play shapes the battlefield.

The River Changes Everything. The path you carve determines which bonuses fire, which groves you awaken, and whether your Forest Core gets the power it needs to survive.

Seasons Shift and the Map Transforms. Every few waves, the season changes, and all terrain bonuses rotate. Adapt your strategy to survive.

Draft. Grow. Fight. Draw from a pool of 20+ cards - structures that auto-attack, troops that march into battle, and mutations that stack bonuses.

name: The Pactmaker
summary: You are a professor who forged pacts with otherworldly entities to save your daughter. Dive into the memories of others, alter reality, and use your new supernatural abilities to uncover the truth in this dark point-and-click thriller.

name: That’s An Order Ensign
summary: Complete a slew of mundane and dangerous tasks, Do it quick or you're dismissed! Try to stay alive, but do your job. Because after all... That's an order, ensign!

name: The Incentive Program
summary: The Incentive Program is a match-3 roguelike about a surreal corporate job that’s hiding something. You’re paid to play, but you won’t win. So rig the odds, exploit the rules, and escape the program.

name: The Possession Experiment
summary:
A short survival-horror game, where you're a Scientist controlling Human Test Subjects to help you try and escape a bunker overrun by a hostile Entity.

The Game can be viewed as a hybrid of Classic PS1 Horror Games like Silent Hill and Resident Evil and modern horror games like Five Nights at Freddy's.

name: The Way of Ping-pong
summary: A roguelike bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

name: The Rake Sees You
summary: Alex and his friends set out for a camping trip deep in the forest. What starts as a fun escape quickly turns into something far darker. This forest hides secrets… and something is always watching. Survive. Escape. Don’t look back...

name: The Rebirth Tale of Broken Horn Demon Lord Alice
summary: To exact revenge on the Brave, the reckless Demon Lord Alice, after her rebirth, decides to proceed cautiously, step by step. To weaken the brave's forces, she must defeat the Four Sages and expand her territory.

name: The Dark Field
summary: After receiving a strange message, Ahmed Raked finds himself at a remote farm with nothing but his phone to guide him. What starts as a simple job slowly twists into a dark, personal mystery—one that may be rooted deep in his past. Some jobs are more than they seem.

name: The Second Sight: The Devil and the Wheel
The Second Sight: All Hallow's Eve
The Undead Lawyer
summary: A hyper-movement, action puzzle game where you speed through the world to save the souls of the damned, reviving them and executing them in specific ways decreed by the gods as fast as you can!

name: The New Me
summary: The main character is a young special forces soldier, who has been fighting the drug cartel for a long time. During the regular mission, everything went wrong...

name: The Match Golf
summary: The Match Golf is a golf game with cartoon graphics and features 7 different character to choose. The game used the match play mode: the player that wins more holes win the match. The game features different camera angles, a practice and a match play mode and the player can choose to play againts the computer or against another human player.

name: The Larper
summary: The Larper is a short Incremental game about auto-clicking on keys and solving passwords. Buy Upgrades and unlock Secret Key Combinations, while listening to Classical Music and generating Beautiful Paintings in the background!

name: The Cloudberry Abyss
summary: Hunt down 10 jewels in a haunted pastry shop, while terrifying creatures start to hunt YOU. This Point-and-Click Survival Horror Game is like FNAF meets "Emily Wants to Play" meets iSpy.

name: The Last Tale
summary: Embark on an odyssey through Northern realms in this 2D couch co-op adventure. Play as siblings Torsten and Annika, using gifts from the gods to avenge your village and hunt the mysterious Ivar. Combine axe, bow, and magic to overcome mythological beasts and puzzles to save the world from darkness.

name: The Membrane
summary: Defend the jungle against The Membrane's vile spawns in this fantasy roguelite survivor. You've signed your life away, now you must fight your way from naked servant to fortified King. Earn wages, craft defenses, and improve your base. Will you survive long enough to slay every putrid boss?

name: The Wreck That Should Not Be
summary: When the mysterious Doctor Hoffmann hires your submarine to explore the east Caribbean sea, you accept, unware of the danger he is leading you into...

name: The Little Land
summary: The Little Land is a strategy god-sim where you play as a god worshipped by the Littles. Command the forces of nature, protect them from danger, and watch as they gather resources and expand their village.

name: This Short Indie Game Made Me Miss My Friends: Rainy Plays Lonely Game Livestream
summary: Tidy up after a sleepover birthday party by finding a home for each decoration and belonging in this story-rich, fully narrated, block-fitting puzzle game. Play alongside a commentating vtuber as you delve into their experience with loneliness evoked by this cleaning indie game.

name: The Immortal Is Watching
summary: Players will take on the role of a little flower fairy and tap on wish plaques to send blessings. Each character’s story will unfold differently based on your choices. Once all wishes have been fulfilled, she will also experience different endings depending on your decisions.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past
summary:
Songs of the Past is a brand-new full-fledged expansion to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, one of the most acclaimed role-playing games of all time.

Created in partnership with Fool’s Theory, a team comprising veteran The Witcher 3 developers, players can once again take on the role of Geralt of Rivia and embark on a brand-new adventure before heading out on the Path as Ciri in the upcoming The Witcher 4.

name: The Art of Tortoise Walking
summary: A walking simulator with a deep sense of zen. Embody a tortoise on a desolate island, independently controlling each of its four limbs with a controller. In every clumsy step, rediscover the instinct of walking.

name: The Traveller's Sight
summary: Vincent Dumas, an investigator with supernatural powers, is sent to a small town in France with a murky history to uncover the truth behind the death of Laurène Delgado. Using his ability to communicate with the dead, he sets out to find clues that will lead him to the killer.

name: The Egg
summary: You always wanted to be an egg or maybe you just want to know how an egg lives? Then you can now with "The Egg".

name: The Outbound Ghost: Reborn
summary: The Outbound Ghost: Reborn is a turn-based Creature Collector where the monsters you use are ghostly figments of your imagination. Experience a new supernatural story with overhauled gameplay in this sequel to The Outbound Ghost.

name: The Stinky Adventures of DungDung
summary: DungDung, a martial arts dung beetle, sets out to defend the kingdom from Princess Petunias creeping corruption...only to discover that he's inside a glitching videogame! He must master poojitsu. Hell harness glitch powers. Can you save the realm and the game in this love letter to the classics?

name: Thermocline
summary: A BLIZZARD RAGES. Lone survivor, you are STRANDED upon a FRIGID CORPSE-PLANET. THEY seek your warmth, sucking Soul from the shadows. AND TONIGHT, THE WIND IS YOUR CLOSEST SEMBLANCE OF A FRIEND.

name: The Pazaak Battles
summary: The Pazaak Battles is a recreation of a popular Star Wars card game, with a twist: an alternative adventure featuring Han Solo, and many other characters from Star Wars. This definitely has the potential to become a fan favorite homebrew game.

name: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters - Gamer Girl
The Solyani's Code
summary: A Sci-Fi story set on the moon Selene, featuring LUMA, a glowing companion that assists you with unique abilities.

name: The Embodiment of Scarlet Hair Portable: I'm Lovin' It
The Hidden Library
summary: The Hidden Library is a 2D puzzle adventure, where you will immerse yourself in worlds forbidden by authority, awakening the imagination and guiding you through a forgotten literary past.

name: They Can't Hear You
summary:
This dying star may kill you.

Something went wrong and your capsule was shot into the void of space during a Supernova blast. Now, your only hope of survival are your drones. Can you triangulate a rescue signal through the surrounding debris before your oxygen runs out? It's the only chance you've got.

name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Tyrant God
summary: Slay waves of monsters with your mouse, collect coins, buy permanent upgrades, and grow stronger round after round in a compact incremental action game.

name: The Dogs
summary: The Dogs (formerly Dog Simulator) is a simulator that allows players to immerse themselves in the world of dog life. The game offers unique features and constant updates, making the gameplay interesting and varied.

name: The Magician's Hand
summary: Set in Victorian London, this moody atmospheric puzzle platformer, you play as the severed hand of the mysterious Magician Fabrizio. Waking up with no memory, only a nagging urge to uncover the truth. Brave, curious, and drawn to adventure, hand grows along the journey, discovering his inner strength and a few unexpected gifts. Embarking on this adventure with perspective-shifting mini games and distinctive boss battles. You need find Fabrizio before it is too late!

name: The Labyrinth on Burrow Hill
summary: Unravel a thread of riddles and mystery as you progress your way through the atmospheric halls of a dazzlingly large, long-deserted labyrinth. Explore the vistas of spectacular rooms and the hidden challenges within. Do you have what it takes to find what lies at the labyrinth's centre?

name: The Only Droid
summary: Tear enemy robots apart piece by piece in a physics-based action roguelike. Destroy weak points, stack upgrades, and create your unique build as you turn relentless robotic enemy waves into mechanical graveyards.

name: The Cleaner
summary: The Cleaner is a journey of a small bird named Taki through a living, hand-drawn world of nature in search of food. Solve puzzles and uncover clues hidden in sounds and details. A paper world where levels are living beings, and the story unfolds through observation and interaction with nature.

name: The Hand of the Crownbearer
summary: “The Hand of the Crown-Bearer” is a character-training adventure game where you develop the protagonist while building relationships with specific characters. With numerous branching paths and a higher difficulty level, your choices shape the story. One playthrough lasts about two hours.

name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
summary: Join your favorite Dr. Seuss characters in 18 exciting minigames and challenges. Your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

name: Thirsty Bird
summary: A retro-ish, rhythm-ish game about catching raindrops and dodging hazards with an unusual two-level control scheme. You've got to try it to understand it.

name: The Traveller Tale
summary: A fully voiced, old-school first-person CRPG where you build your party, explore towns, caves, and dungeons, and face deadly foes in turn-based combat. Take on quests, meet memorable characters, and craft, fish, and mine in a world full of danger and discovery.

name: The Magical Quest of Molly the Marble
summary: A cozy adventure where you tilt the world to guide a marble through cardboard dioramas to find secrets, solve puzzles, and navigate dungeons on a quest to find your lost friends. ASMR audio and multiple accessibility options ensures you will have a relaxing experience.

name: Theos: Cities of Myth
summary: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

name: The First Chip
summary: Build an illegal gambling empire from scratch. Rig machines, outplay customers, and rise from a shady fair stand to a full-scale casino in this sandbox simulation.

name: The Pale Mimic
summary: The Pale Mimic is an atmospheric horror set in the untamed Alaskan wilderness. As a high profile fugitive on the run, it's just you and your dog surviving in the chilling forests, until something else shows up uninvited.

name: The Pines
summary: A psychological horror RPG where every choice has consequences. After a failed case, former detective Edward Walker arrives at The Pines, a secluded retreat with therapists on site and the promise of peace. But beneath its carefully constructed calm, something is deeply wrong.

name: The Shade
summary: A first-person psychological horror set in rural Finland, where isolation and unsettling encounters slowly turn your housekeeping job into something far more disturbing.

name: The Bird of the North
summary: In 1921: a kidnapping, a revolution... Investigate and uncover the truth behind a dark, mysterious story.

name: The Organ Woman
summary: A 1–4 player cooperative horror game set in an abandoned hospital in Japan. Work together with your friends, collect boxes containing organs, and escape from the hospital where something lurks!

name: The Miki Komori Project
summary:
Before the streams…
Before the audience…
Before anyone knew her name…

there was Miki.

Enter a surreal visual novel exploring the hidden lore behind TheMikiKomori, the mysterious angel shark VTuber drifting between loneliness, memory, and the endless pull of the digital sea.

This is the story before the streams, before the audience, and before the name “TheMikiKomori” ever existed. Follow Miki as she navigates loneliness, identity, and the strange events that slowly guide her toward an uncertain future.

Uncover hidden secrets, forge emotional connections, and piece together the origins of a girl who was never meant to be found.

name: The Last Question
summary:
The Last Question is a psychological interrogation game where every suspect is powered by AI.

Step into the role of a detective and question suspects in your own words. Uncover contradictions, apply pressure, build trust, and piece together evidence as you search for the truth behind each case.

Every suspect has their own personality, secrets, motivations, and breaking point. There are no predefined dialogue trees. Instead, conversations unfold dynamically based on your questioning style, the evidence you've discovered, and the psychological tactics you choose to employ.

Will you gain their confidence? Expose their lies? Or push them far enough to confess?

Featuring dozens of unique criminal cases, progression systems, skills, achievements, and community-created suspects, The Last Question challenges players to think like real investigators and uncover the truth one question at a time. Inspired by detective fiction, interrogation psychology, and modern AI technology.

name: The Machine Stops
summary: A strategic, resource management game where you must make an AI startup succeed within a time limit all while pondering the larger ethical implications of AI and its role in society. Game takes place within a Matrix-style terminal.

name: The Demon Party
summary: The Demon Lord has vanished, and the Demon Lord’s Castle has fallen into chaos. Become Lethe, a demon girl, dominate defeated monsters, form your own Demon Party, and raise a new demon army!

name: Thousand Floors
summary: Tower Climbers carry amber light; allies follow through misty pagodas in an endless Eastern tower. Thousands Floors blends side-view pixel art with hands-off combat—summon, upgrade, and let them climb. Grow via allies, floor lockdown, and relics.

name: The Moment of Panic
summary: Trapped in an underground bunker with your finger on the button, interpret intelligence signals, question unreliable AI advisors, and decide whether to escalate, stand down, or unleash doomsday.

name: The Sims 4: Silver Screen Style Kit
The Sims 4: Tea Time Solarium Kit
The Sims 4: Bikini Bottom Bundle - Goofy Goober Guitar
summary: The Goofy Goober Guitar

name: The Sims 4: Bikini Bottom Bundle - Conch Street Aquarium and The Flying Dutchman's Jungle Gym
summary: Conch Street Aquarium & The Flying Dutchman's Jungle Gym

name: The Sims 4: SpongeBob Kid’s Room Kit
The Sims 4: Lady Bridgerton’s Masquerade Ballroom Kit
The Sims 4: Lady Bridgerton's Masquerade Ball Fashion Kit
The Omega Reach
summary: Reach for the stars, gather their instruments, and curate the best collection in the universe! The Omega Reach is a point-and-click museum simulator (and dungeon crawler) which makes you feel like a musical genius.

name: The Book of Prosperity
summary: A 2D Action RPG set in a surreal pixel-art world where ancient magic seeps through Hong Kong-inspired streets. Pulled into a parallel dimension ruled by the Circle, Cyrus must master rhythmic combat, rooftop parkour, and forbidden truths to uncover the cost of a world built on false prosperity.

name: Thieves and Gold
summary: Smash containers, grab the gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves in this medieval loot-heist incremental. Race the clock in Heist Mode or play relaxed in Casual Mode.

name: The Last Show
summary: A narrative incremental about fireworks that starts as a hobby and becomes an obsession. Grow your arsenal, fire strategically to stack combos, build grand finales, and grow a rabid fanbase. A journey that begins in your backyard and ends somewhere you didn't expect.

name: Their Story.
summary: Their Story. is a 2D narrative exploration and puzzle adventure about love and connection between two cyclists in the city of Valparaíso. As you uncover their stories and daily lives, a hidden bond between two strangers begins to emerge. Will they ever meet?.

name: The Birdsong Tree
summary: A cozy building and light simulation game where you observe birds, create custom birdhouses, and help a living urban tree grow. Balance sound, diversity, and neighbor reactions as you shape a calm, reactive environment.

name: They Stop for Gas at Night
summary: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

name: The Legend Of Chupacabra And The Sentient Log
The Bull of Heaven
summary: In a city near the mountains the bull of heaven is unleashed, tearing a wound in the world. A vivid action-rhythm game split across eleven intense levels.

name: The Farm Racing
summary: Can you outsmart the dangers of the farm and reunite mother and calf?

name: The Good Book VN
summary: The Good Book VN is a visual novel set in 1980s–90s England. With 50+ pages of crime fiction, it follows a teen dragged into gangs, drugs, and violence. Witness his fall into street life and its harsh price—he lived it, so you don’t have to.

name: Thrown
summary: Roll for survival. Thrown is a roguelike dicebuilder combining turn-based strategy and horror. Trapped in the basement, forced to play a twisted tabletop game against your kidnapper, grow your dice bag and piece together who you are, and why you're here.

name: The Looking Glass Wars: House of Cards
summary: We built a solitaire game around a darker version of Alice in Wonderland that you won't put down. Draw cards, build runs and sets across 140+ handcrafted quests. It's the kind of game you play for one more quest at midnight.

name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
summary: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

name: The Modern Atlas
summary: This is an in-progress visual novel from the perspective of Ernest Frankenstein, Victor's younger brother, taking place after the events of Mary Shelley's novel.

name: The Zibbo Show
summary: Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

name: The Telwynium
summary: A 90s fantasy adventure epic from the creator of The Drifter- It's your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

name: The Queens Gondola
summary: Stuck on the Queen’s royal aircraft, you have been trapped in a mystical loop fueled by dark magic. Armed with nothing but your wits, keep an eye out for anomalies, and you might just find an escape.

name: The Wandering Village: The Last Leviathan
summary: Set out on a new journey with The Wandering Village: The Last Leviathan! Build your settlement on Levi, the all-new marine creature, develop your relationship and take care of its unique needs or advantage of its new resources.

name: The Cinderling
summary:
The Cinderling is an immersive, rhythmic blacksmith and shop keeper game.
Complete mini-games and feel the heat of the cracking coals, work the bellows to push the flames and strike the anvil in perfect time.

Stay in sync with the music and lose yourself in the rhythmic ring of hammered iron.
Explore a narrative rich world. Get to know the eccentric customers and the reason behind their weird requests. Uncover the secrets of the forge. And break the curse that binds you!eries of the forge.

name: The Alters: Last Variable
summary: Continue Jan Scientist's story as he stays behind to unlock the planet's secrets. Build an underground base, assemble a crew of specialised Scientist alters, master Terraformation, invent new technologies, and conduct research that could define a legacy.

name: The Isle of Lost Bees
summary: Welcome to the Isle of Lost Bees, a cozy idle game where you and your collection of Australian bees harvest pollen, research flowers, and uncover the island’s secrets. You're a bee-obsessed researcher on an island devoid of humans. You never seemed to need human contact anyway.

name: The Rewind Hero Returns
summary: A visual novel, action, puzzle game. The enemies are always much stronger than you, and your goal is to figure out how to beat them by using elements of the environment to your advantage.

name: The Guild Manager
summary: Recruit your team, forge a legendary guild! In this unique management simulation, you won't play as a lone hero—you'll become a Guild Master, leading a group of flesh-and-blood, distinct personalities from rookies to conquerors of epic raids.

name: The Last Guardian: Limited Edition
publishers: Sony Interactive Entertainment Worldwide Studios America

name: The Last Voyage of the SS Aurelia
summary: An interrogation mystery aboard a 1936 ocean liner. Five suspects. One murder. No dialogue options — every suspect is powered by AI and will remember every word, deflect every question, and only surrender their secrets under pressure. Four voyages. One truth. Break someone.

name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Season One - Return of the Thieves Guild
The Cycling Games
summary: Les Jeux du Cycle turns your Bluetooth FTMS trainer into a cycling party game: sprint, dodge, team up, add bots, and outplay friends across 25+ minigames.

name: The Endless Night
summary:
The Endless Night is an urban fantasy roguelite deck-builder where modern mages battle cultists, monsters, and creeping darkness across a city on the edge of collapse.

Build a deck of spell cards, chain magical combos, protect civilians, gather allies, and choose which threats to confront before the night spirals out of control. Each run challenges you to balance power, survival, and corruption as dark rituals spread through the city and an Avatar of Darkness waits to be summoned.

name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
summary: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

name: The Memphis Chronicles
summary: Welcome to Memphis, a city you can only visit once. A place where dreamers and the dead dance. Explore Memphis in the first person, uncover mysteries, and maybe even learn a bit more about yourself. You can’t bring any friends, but everyone you need is already here. This is the trip of a lifetime.

name: The Named
summary:
3,236 years after the Copper Odyssey events, a Very Interesting Person creates a game show for TV where contestants can get a chance at winning a Name in this nameless world. The effects of the Sun and the colors of the Sky are now friends with the humans, or so it seems.

See how this game show plays out, and who will be the winner deserving of a Name.

name: The Ballad of a True Thug
summary:
The Ballad of a True Thug is a crime ballad written in lead and blood. Your story of revenge begins at the bottom—in the dark alleys of Europe and the neon traps of '90s America. To reach those who took everything, you must rise from a small-time crook to a living legend of the criminal underworld.

Here, every fight is a dance on the edge of a knife. Slow down time to find the right move, dodge bullets with a desperate slide, and use everything from cheap alcohol to a heavy gun to gain an advantage. One false step, one miss, and this ballad will end forever.

Destiny awaits your move. Make it.

name: The Three Kingdoms Era in China 2000 Years Ago
summary: This is a Chinese historical story game that chronicles the dusty past of the Sima Yi family during the late Han Dynasty and the Three Kingdoms period - the unification of the Three Kingdoms.

name: The Misadventures of Spaceman Biff
summary: Help Biff, the unluckiest pilot in the galaxy, get home after he crash lands on an alien rock in this punishing platformer. Use his trusty jetpack to climb up mountains, the remains of his ship, and into the many secrets of this strange alien world - slip once and tumble for eternity.

name: The Gate of Front: Monster Auction
summary: A fun party board game that supports 5 people to play online! Auction animals, make secret deals, get the ultimate victory!During the course of the game, you and four other players will find new monsters each turn, auction them off, and earn gold. And use the gold to buy new monsters.

name: The Last Knight Hawk
summary: A hack-n-slash title, featuring aerial acrobatic swordplay, epic bosses and a character-driven story.

name: The Detractor
summary: Enter a dark fantasy world consumed by the King of Hatred in The Detractor: Rise of the Exiled! Step into the role of The Detractor, an exiled hero seeking vengeance and redemption in this gripping roguelike adventure. Explore three epic chapters filled with peril and mystery as you challenge the tyrannical ruler who cast you down.

name: The 11th Power
summary:
Combine powers of 2 to unleash attacks and devastating combos as you fight your way through a dungeon full of evil cultists, disgusting slimes, and unspeakable horrors from another dimension!

The 11th Power is a deckbuilding roguelike unlike any you've ever played before. It takes the gameplay of the classic game 2048 and adds special powers to the tiles that are activated when you combine them with other tiles, and then merge into something even more powerful!

Play as the Barbarian, the Archer, or the Mage, each with their own special set of tiles to suit your playstyle.

Unlock devastating power as you reach toward the 11th power of 2: 2048!

name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
summary: A remake of the 1998 Nintendo 64 title for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.

name: The Server
summary: A full English-voiced otome mystery visual novel set in a fog-shrouded coastal town. Work as a waitress at an exclusive supper club, romance four men hiding dangerous secrets, and uncover the truth buried beneath. Every choice you make shapes your path and where it ends.

name: The Door Factory
summary: The Door Factory is a first-person horror game where you inspect mysterious doors before they are sent into production. Step inside, observe the environment, spot anomalies, and decide whether each door should be approved or reported.

name: The Options Menu
summary: The Options Menu is a game where you play as a 'Player' and experience a life filled with Options. Explore countless endings to uncover a game that may surprise you as the real friend all along was your Options Menu in this Comedic Story.

name: The Shu Legend
summary: The Shu Legend is an interactive adventure novel. In an apocalypse ruled by the Dog Clan, bandit Shi Jin is forced by a terrifying army to undertake a mysterious mission after his squad is wiped out. This quest unravels the clan's buried history, sparking a tense fight for survival...

name: The Ministry for Anomaly Observation
summary: A retro anomaly observation game where a government ministry tasks you with monitoring CCTV feeds and identifying anomalies to construct case files. Missed anomalies corrupt the shift and its case file evidence.

name: The Big Number
summary: The Big Number is a strategic incremental idle clicker where you breach 17 massive firewalls to reach infinity. Start from zero and build your way to unimaginable numbers through tactical resource management, automated systems, and strategic progression.

name: The Boomies Show
summary: A frantic twin-stick roguelite set in a candy-coated amusement park turned massacre arena. Dual weapons, recoil mastery and modular builds. Survive the waves, push your luck and extract before the show swallows you whole.

name: The Resonance Initiative
summary: In this open-world factory sandbox you need to harness unique power waveforms to run your machines. Use everything as fuel, from plant life to fallen enemies. Explore the world to uncover new foes and resources to exploit as your empire grows.

name: The Sin of Fabien
summary: Maybe you didn’t do it… but you watched. The Sin of Fabien is a psychological horror experience woven around guilt, denial, and silence, where every choice reshapes the world and the story. Each decision brings you closer to the truth… or pulls you further away from it forever.

name: The Murder of Yesterday
summary: A psychological horror crime experience where time is your only weapon. Travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

name: The Hidden Evils Club
summary: When Weird Hill begins to fall, a strange school club becomes the town’s last line of defense. Build towers, manage resources, trade with survivors, command unusual heroes, and protect the heart of the town from escalating zombie waves.

name: The Blinking Room
summary: One night, young Lily wakes from a nightmare — unaware that her real nightmares are only just beginning. Uncover the secrets hidden behind closed eyes.

name: The Calling Past
summary: Jeb, going through a difficult time, decides to return to his hometown. Wanting to hide from dark thoughts among friends and family, he starts having nightmares that haunt him not only in sleep but also while awake. Find out what is the source of Jeb's nightmares.

name: The Sleepless Nights Origins
summary: A first-person psychological horror walking simulator. The same rain-soaked corporate street, looping. Notice what's wrong before it notices you back.

name: The Office Void
summary: You’re stuck on the night shift. The code refuses to compile, the deadline is on fire, and your mind is no longer yours. To keep from passing out and blowing the entire shift, you have to drink coffee. Lots of it.

name: The Remnants
summary: You, a supernatural detective, are sent to investigate Hawthorne Residences on the Cunningham property. Something isn’t right. Observe carefully, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth before the building begins to distort around you.

name: Thoughtless
summary: A dark sci-fi psychological Visual Novel where your choices shape who you are. The world has ended and it's been dominated by mysterious aliens who roam the city. Despite that, you only think of what you've lost. Will you be able to rebuild your relationships? Or even... the world itself?

name: The Watching Woods: The Friend
summary: Trying to fit in at her new school, Sonechka befriends a group of girls who call themselves the village witches. Completing their dares, she soon finds the tasks becoming increasingly strange, eerie, and cruel. How far will she go to be accepted?

name: The Crimson Hunt
summary: You play as Victoria, a vampire hunter haunted by her past, and Eleanor, a young woman trapped in a nightmare that has only just begun. Together, they must endure grotesque creatures, hidden traps, and a presence that seems to know them better than they realize.

name: The Others Will Join Shortly
summary: A variation on classic memory game in horror setting. Cards can change, you have to stay focused, catching replaced card is a life or death situation. Play the cards. Track the changes. Survive the week. Collect your pay check.

name: The Ayna
summary: The Ayna is a psychological exploration game set in Türkiye, inspired by the music video aesthetics and lyrical themes of a female vocalist. The player is tasked with noticing anomalies in the concert venue and uncovering the truth.

name: The Dare
summary: A horror experience where a simple dare leads you into an abandoned construction site hiding something far darker. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and survive using stealth as every sound and decision shapes your fate.

name: The Falling Skies
summary: The Falling Skies is a dark psychological horror walking simulator with survival elements. You play as a forest ranger patrolling a cursed forest where a village mysteriously destroyed itself in a single night. Explore abandoned paths and uncover the echoes of a tragic past.

name: The Burning Owl
summary: Michael Clow is a photographer who documents what he sees. But after following his neighbor into the woods, his camera begins capturing things he never witnessed.

name: The Isolation Project
summary: You are Eleanor, a space station engineer who made the choice to join the crew of the Aurora 9. however, 200 cycles into your 500 cycle contract, your crew mysteriously disappeared without a trace. It's now up to you to find your missing crew.

name: The Kuon Island Nursery Rhyme Murders: Case Notes
summary: A storm-lashed island, a nursery rhyme that foretells death, seven prodigies, serial murders, modern locked-room mysteries, classic locked-room mysteries, astrology, a jigsaw of flesh and blood, a survivor—and one lie told only so you would see this story.

name: The Wheelchair Man
summary: Steal $5,000 from an abandoned apartment complex while avoiding a demented man.

name: The Cursed Ward
summary: A system-driven psychological horror game where every threat has a pattern and every death has a reason. Each run is unique and will be timed.

name: The Facility
summary: The Facility is a minimal act-based horror game about escaping a secret facility after a project went wrong.

name: The Hat Man
summary: A first-person psychological horror game inspired by The Hat Man urban legend, focusing on sleep paralysis, fear, and the terror of being unable to move.

name: The Life You Missed
summary: The Life You Missed — you achieved success, but lost yourself along the way. In an old house, you uncover someone else’s life — and your own. Relive memories and face choices in your dreams. Every decision shapes the ending.

name: The Perfect Lover
summary: "The Perfect Lover" is a lily themed visual novel produced by XUWULE Game Studio, which is a story about promise and redemption.

name: The Man Behind the Trigger
summary: Action-platform game set in the mid-2000s. Take vengeance upon six key figures of the entertainment industry for morally bankrupt the society you once loved.

name: The Last of Touch
summary: Every piece brings you closer to perfection!

name: The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand
The Obsessive Shadow: Chapter 2
summary: Something sinister stirs on Old Diamond Drive. 16 year old Justin, armed only with a flashlight and camcorder, takes a dare to spend the night. As shadows close in, he realizes escape isn't possible, and he's not alone. Witness the horrors of the past as you explore the ruins of what once thrived...

name: The Blue-G Interactive Vector Archive 77-97
summary: Explore the rich vector arcade 'history' of Blue-G Interactive in this enhanced collection of 11 games. Made to run fast even on low spec hardware!

name: The Bone Crypt
summary: Steam’s first PvP Domino Deckbuilder! Connect pips on bone tiles to chain attacks and outsmart enemies in a tactical roguelike tomb. Master a deep solo campaign or crush rivals in online PvP. No cards, just pure bone-clinking strategy. Do you have the marrow to escape the crypt?

name: The Profaned
summary: The Profaned is an Anomaly-Hunt horror game about a person who's trying to cleanse his sins. The primary task is to investigate the endless forsaken church to find the anomalies and capture them with your camera to cleanse your sins. And if you fail to do so, start again from the beginning.

name: Through the Manor
summary: A cozy building sandbox where you craft painterly structures and step inside them in 3rd person. Build whimsical manors, explore every room you design, and reside within your creations in this atmospheric, stress-free experience.

name: The Minesweeper
summary: The classic game of minesweeper from a fresh new perspective. Play alone or with a friend in this third person puzzle game, where you toss grenades, plant flags, and math a path to victory. Enjoy the calm of nature, chill tunes and chaotic reveals.

name: The Message From Deep Space
summary: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.
